items.summary_zh: 美國聖地牙哥州立大學9月累計14例腮腺炎,校方免費提供學生疫苗追加劑。
items.summary_en: San Diego State University in the US reported 14 mumps cases in September, and offered students free vaccine booster doses.
items.description_zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥州立大學(SDSU),今年9月累計報告14例病例,受影響者為該校球隊隊員。因應疫情,校方已免費提供學生疫苗追加劑。
items.description_en: San Diego State University (SDSU) in California, USA, has reported a cumulative 14 mumps cases this September; those affected are members of the university's sports teams. In response, the university has provided free mumps vaccine booster doses to students.

items.headline_zh: 非洲-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 非洲流腦帶去年24國報告21,526例疑似病例、971死亡,較前年降5.9%。
items.summary_en: WHO: 24 African meningitis belt countries reported 21,526 suspected cases and 971 deaths last year, cases down 5.9%.
items.description_zh: WHO報告指出,非洲流腦帶(African Meningitis Belt),從塞內加爾延伸至衣索比亞等26國,去年計有24國累計報告21,526例疑病例、971例死亡(致死率:4.5%),病例較前年下降5.9%。目前正推動5價疫苗(Men5CV/MMCV),其中日(Niger)已於去年展開全國性疫苗接種活動。
items.description_en: WHO reports that the African Meningitis Belt, which extends from Senegal to Ethiopia across 26 countries, recorded 21,526 suspected cases and 971 deaths (case fatality rate 4.5%) in 24 countries last year, with cases down 5.9% from the previous year. The pentavalent meningococcal vaccine (Men5CV/MMCV) is being promoted, and Niger launched a nationwide vaccination campaign last year.
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,尼日,塞內加爾

items.summary_zh: 摩洛哥蘇斯-馬塞大區2起家庭群聚,已確認1例、8例調查中,當局進行防治。
items.summary_en: Two household clusters of diphtheria in Morocco's Souss-Massa region: one confirmed case and eight under investigation as of 28 September.
items.description_zh: 摩洛哥中北部蘇斯-馬塞大區(Souss-Massa)有2起家庭群聚,截至今年9/28,經實驗室檢驗1例確定病例、8例調查中。當局已針對密切接觸者進行追蹤、預防性投藥及疫苗接種等防治措施。
items.description_en: Two household clusters have been detected in the Souss-Massa region of central-northern Morocco. As of 28 September this year, one case has been confirmed by laboratory testing and eight cases are under investigation. Authorities have implemented control measures for close contacts, including contact tracing, preventive medication and vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 宏都拉斯/哈薩克-百日咳
items.summary_zh: 宏都拉斯今年280例百日咳、22例死亡,較去年全年增145.6%;哈薩克76例。
items.summary_en: Honduras reported 280 pertussis cases and 22 deaths this year, up 145.6% on last year's full-year total; Kazakhstan reported 76 cases, mostly unvaccinated children.
items.description_zh: 宏都拉斯疫情持續,今年截至9/23累計報告280例確定病例、22 例死亡,較去年全年報告114例增幅達145.6%,目前該國疫苗覆蓋率約80%,當局呼籲⺠眾落實常規疫苗接種。 哈薩克自2026年以來累計報告76例確定病例,其中以88%為未接種疫苗的兒童為主,當局推測較去年同期下降2.8倍,可能與該國持續進行疫苗接種和兒童補接種措施有關。當局亦將持續加強接種疫苗等衛教宣導。
items.description_en: Pertussis transmission continues in Honduras. As of 23 September this year, 280 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, an increase of 145.6% over the 114 cases reported for the whole of last year. The country's vaccination coverage is approximately 80%, and authorities urge the public to follow routine vaccination schedules. Kazakhstan has reported 76 confirmed cases since the start of 2026, 88% of them unvaccinated children. Authorities estimate that cases are 2.8 times lower than in the same period last year, possibly due to ongoing vaccination and catch-up immunisation of children. Authorities will continue to strengthen vaccination and health education.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年3,887例麻疹,紐約州宣布緊急狀態;澳洲119例;敘利亞765例。
items.summary_en: US measles cases reached 3,887 this year, prompting New York's emergency declaration; Australia reported 119 and Syria 765 cases.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約州今年截至10/3累計108例確定病例,鑑於該州及鄰近地區病例增加,於10/5發佈行政命令,宣佈進入緊急狀態,主要擴大疫苗施打對象,並持續提供臨床指引、病例調查與接觸者追蹤及加速實驗室檢驗。該國今年截至10/2累計47個行政區報告3,887例確定病例,已逾去年全年2,289例,95%為未接種疫苗或情況不明,其中以賓州(963例)、南卡羅萊納(670例)及猶他州(535例)為主。 澳洲南澳州阿德萊德(Adelaide)某中學發生群聚,截至9/24累計5例確定病例,該州今年迄今累計9例確定病例,去年全年僅7 例。澳洲今年病例持續增加,截至9月底累計119例,低於去年全年181例,惟已明顯高於2022‒24年同期及全年水準。病例主要與海外感染及輸入病例相關,該國提供未接種2劑疫苗者免費施打疫苗。 敘利亞今年截至第33週累計765例經實驗室檢驗之確定病例,當局與UNICEF、WHO等國際組織合作,於7月下旬在高風險地區啟動疫苗接種措施。
items.description_en: New York State has reported 108 confirmed cases this year as of 3 October. Given the rise in cases in the state and neighbouring areas, it issued an executive order on 5 October declaring a state of emergency, mainly expanding the eligible population for vaccination, and continues to provide clinical guidance, case investigation, contact tracing and accelerated laboratory testing. As of 2 October, the United States had reported 3,887 confirmed cases this year across 47 jurisdictions, already exceeding the 2,289 cases reported for all of last year; 95% were unvaccinated or of unknown vaccination status, mainly in Pennsylvania (963 cases), South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). A cluster has occurred at a secondary school in Adelaide, South Australia, with 5 confirmed cases as of 24 September; the state has recorded 9 confirmed cases this year, compared with only 7 for all of last year. Australia has 119 cumulative cases as of the end of September, below the 181 for all of last year but clearly above the same period and full-year levels for 2022–24. Cases are mainly linked to overseas infection and imported cases, and the country provides free vaccination to people who have not received two doses. Syria has reported 765 laboratory-confirmed cases as of week 33 this year; working with UNICEF, WHO and other international organisations, authorities launched vaccination in high-risk areas in late July.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年987例西尼羅熱,洛杉磯郡135例含5例死亡,已超過去年全年。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 987 West Nile cases this year; Los Angeles County's 135 cases, including 5 deaths, already exceed last year's total.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至10/5累計報告987例病例,疫情多集中於加州,其中加州洛杉磯郡今年截至10/1累計報告135例病例,其中5例死亡,有130例需住院,疫情高於去(2025)年全年的22例與2例死亡。另紐澤西州亦於10/5報告今年首例死亡個案,當局警告秋季氣溫降低之際仍須嚴防蚊蟲叮咬,呼籲⺠眾落實清除積水容器。
items.description_en: As of 5 October this year, the United States has reported 987 cases, concentrated mainly in California. Los Angeles County, California, has reported 135 cases as of 1 October this year, including 5 deaths, with 130 requiring hospitalisation. This is higher than the 22 cases and 2 deaths reported for all of 2025. New Jersey also reported its first death of the year on 5 October. Authorities warn that cooling autumn temperatures do not end the risk, and urge people to continue guarding against mosquito bites and to clear containers holding standing water.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾今年截至10月初9,923例恙蟲病、7例死亡,9月新增2,746例。
items.summary_en: Nepal has reported 9,923 scrub typhus cases and 7 deaths so far this year, with 2,746 cases in September alone.
items.description_zh: 泊爾今年截至10月初累計報告9,923例確定病例,其中7例死亡,疫情自7月起快速上升,其中9月新增2,746例(占全年病例數近三成),病患分布於74個行政區。當局已加強宣導農業與戶外活動⺠眾穿著⻑袖衣褲並使用防蚊劑,且提供免費抗生素治療。另該國於2024-25年流行季累計報告1.6萬例病例。
items.description_en: Nepal has reported 9,923 confirmed cases this year as of early October, including 7 deaths. Cases have risen rapidly since July, with 2,746 new cases in September alone, nearly 30% of the year's total, distributed across 74 districts. Authorities have stepped up messaging urging people working in agriculture and outdoor activities to wear long-sleeved clothing and use insect repellent, and provide free antibiotic treatment. The country also reported 16,000 cases in the 2024–25 epidemic season.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉登革熱今年住院8萬4,369例、死亡2,256例,9月死亡148例。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh dengue: 84,369 hospitalised cases and 2,256 deaths this year as of 4 October; 148 deaths in September alone.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情持續惡化,今年截至10/4累計報告8萬4,369例住院病例,其中2,256例死亡,9月份單月死亡達148例,今年累計死亡數為2,000年以來第四高,病媒蚊(埃及斑蚊)已由主要城市蔓延至全國,專家預測10月份疫情將進一步升溫。當局呼籲⺠眾積極清除家戶積水孳生源,以緩解醫療系統同時面對登革熱及麻疹等多重疫情的壓力。
items.description_en: The dengue situation in Bangladesh continues to worsen. As of 4 October this year, 84,369 hospitalised cases and 2,256 deaths have been reported, with 148 deaths in September alone. The cumulative death toll this year is the fourth highest since 2000. The vector mosquito (Aedes aegypti) has spread from major cities to the whole country, and experts predict the outbreak will intensify further in October. Authorities urge the public to actively clear household standing water, which breeds mosquitoes, to ease the pressure on a health system already dealing with dengue and measles outbreaks.

items.headline_zh: 俄羅斯/布里亞特共和國-鼠疫
items.headline_en: Russian Federation / Republic of Buryatia – Plague
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯伊爾庫茨克州1例疑肺鼠疫死亡,約200名密切接觸者被隔離。
items.summary_en: Russia's Irkutsk region reported one suspected pneumonic plague death; about 200 close contacts have been quarantined.
items.description_zh: 俄羅斯西伯利亞伊爾庫茨克州(Irkutsk)於10/2報告1例疑肺鼠疫(Pneumonic plague)死亡病例,病患為伊爾庫茨克防疫研究所28 歲之女性實驗室技術人員,疑於9/25不慎打破裝有鼠疫桿菌的試管,2日後病情惡化,出現嚴重肺炎後死亡。惟另有一說表示病患係從布里亞特共和國出差返回後發病。當局已匡列約200名密切接觸者進行隔離,醫院亦進行封鎖,並強制周邊工廠人員佩戴口罩,據報導部分接觸者已出現疑症狀。當局宣稱該案為不明原因肺炎且周遭情況穩定,然相關資訊仍待釐清。另WHO資料顯示2019-2025年全球累計有10國報告疑或確定病例。
items.description_en: On 2 October, Irkutsk Oblast in Siberian Russia reported one suspected death from pneumonic plague. The patient was a 28-year-old female laboratory technician at the Irkutsk anti-plague research institute, who is suspected to have accidentally broken a test tube containing plague bacteria on 25 September. Her condition deteriorated two days later, and she died after developing severe pneumonia. Another account states that the patient fell ill after returning from a business trip to the Republic of Buryatia. Authorities have placed approximately 200 close contacts in quarantine, the hospital has been locked down, and workers at surrounding factories have been required to wear masks; some contacts have reportedly developed suspicious symptoms. Authorities state that the case is pneumonia of unknown cause and that the surrounding situation is stable, but relevant information remains to be clarified. WHO data show that between 2019 and 2025, a total of 10 countries worldwide reported suspected or confirmed cases.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年45例人類新型A型流感病例,68國家/地區通報禽流感疫情。
items.summary_en: Globally, 45 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year, while 68 countries reported 4,181 avian influenza outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週新增1件。全球今年累計報告45例,分別為32例H9N2、9例H5N1、2例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計68國家/地區報告4,181起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共7國於2026/9/28-10/2期間報告12起H5N1疫情,美國4 起、加拿大3起、丹麥/德國/挪威/瑞典/荷蘭各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: one new case was reported this week. Globally, 45 cases have been reported this year: 32 H9N2, 9 H5N1, 2 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,181 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 68 countries/territories this year. A total of 7 countries reported 12 H5N1 outbreaks during 28 September–2 October 2026: 4 in the United States, 3 in Canada, and one each in Denmark, Germany, Norway, Sweden and the Netherlands.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第36週陽性率3.59%,歐洲上升;中國、香港、韓國疫情下降。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 3.59% in week 36 and rising in Europe, while China, Hong Kong and South Korea declined.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第36週(9/7-13)為3.59%,歐洲呈上升趨勢;全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG、NB.1.8.1、JN.1及PQ.16.1.1為主。 中國疫情持續下降,第39週(9/21-27)門急診陽性率為7.2%,較第38週(9.3%)下降。 香港疫情降至低點,第39週陽性率0.41%,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1(88.6%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(3.4%)、JN.1(3.3%)及XFG(2.8%)。 韓國疫情單週下降,第39週陽性率為14.2%,新增248例住院,變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1(53.9%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(19.7%)、 BA.3.2(15.8%)及RF.5(5.3%) 。
items.description_en: Globally, the test positivity rate in week 36 of this year (7–13 September) was 3.59%, with an upward trend in Europe. Recently circulating variants globally are mainly XFG, NB.1.8.1, JN.1 and PQ.16.1.1. Mainland China's epidemic continues to decline; in week 39 (21–27 September), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 7.2%, down from 9.3% in week 38. Hong Kong's epidemic has fallen to a low; the week 39 positivity rate was 0.41%, and wastewater surveillance shows that variants are mainly PQ.16.1.1 (88.6%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (3.4%), JN.1 (3.3%) and XFG (2.8%). In South Korea, cases declined week on week; the week 39 positivity rate was 14.2%, with 248 new hospitalisations, and variants are mainly PQ.16.1.1 (53.9%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19.7%), BA.3.2 (15.8%) and RF.5 (5.3%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區,韓國

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增76例伊波拉確定病例,累計8,376例、死亡4,042例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 76 new confirmed Ebola cases on 1 October, bringing the total to 8,376 cases and 4,042 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,10/1新增76例確定病例,其中24例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(49例)、北基伍省(23例)、上韋萊省(3例)、喬波省(1例)。迄至10/1累計8,376例確定病例(4,042例死亡、2,182例康復),致死率48.3%,疫情分佈於7個省份(63個衛生區),其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國75.7%病例數。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases: on 1 October, 76 new confirmed cases were added, including 24 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (49), North Kivu Province (23), Haut-Uele Province (3) and Tshopo Province (1). As of 1 October, a cumulative 8,376 confirmed cases have been reported (4,042 deaths, 2,182 recovered), with a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 7 provinces (63 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severe, accounting for 75.7% of national cases.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉朗布爾專區37例疑似病例與屠宰病牛有關;尚比亞穆欽加省21例確定。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh's Rangpur division recorded 37 suspected anthrax cases linked to slaughtered sick cattle; Zambia reported 21 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉西北部朗布爾專區某衛生中心截至今年9/24,收治37例疑症狀患者。該疫情與屠宰病牛後,牛肉分送約100戶食用有關,且牛肉檢體已驗出陽性菌,部分病例曾參與屠宰或處理牛肉。當局已啟動疫情調查,並持續推動受影響地區疫苗接種,以降低傳播風險。 尚比亞疫情更新,東北部穆欽加省截至今年9/21累計報告21例確定病例,病情穩定,另有59頭野生動物死亡。當局已啟動大規模家畜疫苗接種,並呼籲⺠眾勿食用野生動物肉品,以降低人畜共通傳播風險。
items.description_en: As of 24 September this year, a health centre in Rangpur division in north-western Bangladesh had admitted 37 suspected cases. The outbreak is linked to the slaughter of sick cattle, after which the beef was distributed to about 100 households for consumption; beef samples tested positive for the bacterium, and some cases had taken part in slaughtering or handling the beef. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and continue to promote vaccination in affected areas to reduce the risk of transmission. Zambia update: Muchinga Province in the north-east has reported 21 confirmed cases as of 21 September this year; cases are stable, and 59 wild animals have died. Authorities have launched large-scale livestock vaccination and urge people not to eat wildlife meat, to reduce the risk of transmission between animals and humans.

items.summary_zh: 捷克9月通報1例48歲男性破傷風,為2022年來首例,近20年僅5例。
items.summary_en: Czech Republic reported a tetanus case in a 48-year-old man in September, its first since 2022; only five cases in nearly 20 years.
items.description_zh: 捷克今年9月通報1例48歲男性確定病例,因頭部撕裂傷接受治療,為自2022年來首例,該國近20年僅報告5例。
items.description_en: The Czech Republic reported one confirmed case in September this year, in a 48-year-old man being treated for a scalp laceration. This is the first case since 2022, and the country has reported only 5 cases in nearly 20 years.

items.summary_zh: WHO認證智利消除犬隻傳播狂犬病;馬來西亞吉打州1名男性死亡。
items.summary_en: WHO certified Chile as having eliminated dog-mediated human rabies; Malaysia's Kedah state reported a 31-year-old man's rabies death.
items.description_zh: WHO於今年9/14宣布智利消除犬隻傳播的人類狂犬病,為南美洲第一個認證的國家。該國⻑期推動犬隻疫苗接種、疫情監測、實驗室診斷及暴露後預防處置(PEP)等措施,已超過50年未發生案例。依WHO消除認證標準,要求至少連續2年無相關人類死亡病例,並具備完善公衛監測、實驗室診斷、犬隻疫苗接種及暴露後預防處置(PEP)等因應整備能力。 馬來西亞西北部吉打州古邦巴素縣報告1名31歲男性死亡案例,為該縣自1998年以來首例人類病例。 個案於8月被流浪狗咬傷後就醫,未接受暴露後預防(PEP),相關部門已採取預防措施,並進行流行病學調查,以確定感染來源。
items.description_en: On 14 September this year, WHO declared Chile free of dog-mediated human rabies, the first country in South America to be certified. The country has long promoted dog vaccination, surveillance, laboratory diagnosis and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and has gone more than 50 years without cases. Under WHO elimination certification criteria, a country must have no related human deaths for at least two consecutive years and must have adequate public health surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, dog vaccination and PEP capacity. In north-western Malaysia, in Kubang Pasu district of Kedah state, a 31-year-old man has died of rabies, the first human case in the district since 1998. He was bitten by a stray dog in August, sought medical care, but did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis. Authorities have taken preventive measures and are conducting an epidemiological investigation to identify the source of infection.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增49例伊波拉確定病例,累計8,116例、死亡3,924例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 49 new confirmed Ebola cases as of 27 September, bringing the total to 8,116 cases and 3,924 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/27新增49例確定病例,其中23例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(27例)、北基伍省(18例)及上韋萊省(4例)。迄9/27累計8,116例確定病例(3,924例死亡、2,088例康復),致死率48.3%,疫情分佈於7個省份(63個衛生區),其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國76.2%病例數。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 27 September, 49 new confirmed cases were added, including 23 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (27), North Kivu Province (18) and Haut-Uele Province (4). As of 27 September, a cumulative 8,116 confirmed cases have been reported (3,924 deaths, 2,088 recovered), with a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 7 provinces (63 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severe, accounting for 76.2% of national cases.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗新增7例WPV1病例,巴基斯坦今年第5例,cVDPV2新增4例。
items.summary_en: Afghanistan reported 7 WPV1 polio cases in the 17–23 September period; Pakistan recorded its fifth WPV1 case this year.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/17-23期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗7例;cVDPV2新增2國共4例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國3例、查德1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件 。 巴基斯坦9/29報告新增1例WPV1病例,為17個月大的女嬰,居住於西北部開伯爾-普赫圖赫瓦省(KP)班努地區。此案為該國今年第5例病例,其中4例在班努地區發現,該國今年已啟動4次大規模疫苗接種運動。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 17–23 September, WPV1 added 7 cases in Afghanistan; cVDPV2 added 4 cases in 2 countries, 3 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Chad; and in environmental samples, WPV1 added 1 detection in Pakistan. On 29 September, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case, a 17-month-old girl living in Bannu district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province in the north-west. This is the country's fifth case this year, 4 of which were found in Bannu district. The country has launched four mass vaccination campaigns this year.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,查德,剛果民主共和國

items.summary_zh: 德國今年6月起39例沙門氏菌感染,疑與義大利進口番茄有關,疫情跨年延續。
items.summary_en: Germany has reported 39 Salmonella cases since June; the outbreak, possibly linked to Italian tomatoes, spans multiple years.
items.description_zh: 德國今年6月迄今報告39例病例,且上一個流行季(2025年6月迄今年3月)累計報告116例病例,其中至少24例住院,全基因組定序顯示,本次流行菌株與歐洲(17個國家)於2011-24年期間疫情(逾600 例)流行之菌株,以及奧地利於2025年檢出之菌株相,疑感染源為義大利進口之番茄,懷疑為灌溉用水受汙染所致。當局警告疫情屬跨年性⻑期流行,且受污染番茄已流入多個歐洲國家。
items.description_en: Germany has reported 39 cases since June this year. The previous epidemic season (June 2025 to March this year) reported 116 cases in total, at least 24 of whom were hospitalised. Whole-genome sequencing shows that the outbreak strain is closely related to strains that circulated in Europe (17 countries) during 2011–24 (over 600 cases), as well as to a strain detected in Austria in 2025. The suspected source is tomatoes imported from Italy, with contaminated irrigation water suspected as the cause. Authorities warn that this is a multi-year outbreak and that contaminated tomatoes have reached several European countries.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 美國-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_en: United States – Enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli infection
items.summary_zh: 美國13例O26大腸桿菌感染,8例住院,3例併發HUS,疑與生乳起司有關。
items.summary_en: The US reported 13 E. coli O26:H11 infections, 8 hospitalised and 3 with HUS, linked to raw-milk cheese; over half are under 5.
items.description_zh: 美國9/25報告13例感染大腸桿菌(O26:H11)病例,其中8例住院,有3例併發溶血性尿毒症候群(HUS),分布於加州等9個州,超過一半病例為5歲以下,發病日介於7/7-8/26。經當局調查,病患皆曾食用某生產商製造之生乳起司,已要求產品下架並溯源調查。
items.description_en: On 25 September, the United States reported 13 cases of E. coli O26:H11 infection, 8 of whom were hospitalised and 3 of whom developed haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS). Cases are distributed across 9 states including California, more than half are under 5 years old, and onset dates range from 7 July to 26 August. Authorities' investigation found that all patients had eaten raw-milk cheese made by a certain producer; the product has been ordered off the market and a traceback investigation is under way.

items.headline_zh: 日本-細菌性腸胃炎(產氣莢膜桿菌)
items.summary_zh: 日本德島縣29例急性腸胃炎,皆70歲以上長者,5例檢出產氣莢膜桿菌。
items.summary_en: Tokushima Prefecture, Japan reported 29 gastroenteritis cases in people aged 70+, with 5 testing positive for Clostridium perfringens.
items.description_zh: 日本德島縣9/23報告29例病例,均為70歲以上長者,分布於2間⻑照機構,於9/16-17出現腹瀉等急性腸胃炎症狀,經採檢,其中5 例測出產氣莢膜桿菌陽性,疑感染源為團膳業者供應之餐點,當局已要求業者清消並停業5天。
items.description_en: Tokushima Prefecture in Japan reported 29 cases on 23 September, all aged 70 or over, distributed across two long-term care facilities. Acute gastroenteritis symptoms, including diarrhoea, appeared on 16–17 September. Of those tested, 5 cases were positive for Clostridium perfringens. The suspected source is meals supplied by a catering contractor; authorities have ordered the operator to disinfect its facilities and suspended its business for five days.

items.summary_zh: 2025年全球霍亂45萬1,499例,死亡7,870例,死亡數較前年增30%。
items.summary_en: WHO reported 451,499 global cholera cases and 7,870 deaths in 2025; deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest since 1999.
items.description_zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
items.description_en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

items.summary_zh: 美國伊利諾州2例退伍軍人病,病例均今年8月前往某飯店,相關設施已關閉。
items.summary_en: Illinois reported 2 Legionnaires' cases, both linked to a hotel visited in August; water from some facilities tested positive and the facilities were closed.
items.description_zh: 美國伊利諾州報告2例確定病例,個案均曾於今年8月前往某飯店,當局已進行環境調查及水質採樣,並已關閉相關設施,部分設施的供水系統檢體檢測陽性。
items.description_en: Illinois, USA, has reported 2 confirmed cases, both of whom visited a certain hotel in August this year. Authorities have carried out an environmental investigation and water sampling and have closed the relevant facilities; water-system samples from some of the facilities tested positive.

items.summary_zh: 美國3,659例、墨西哥13,484例、秘魯2,438例麻疹確定病例。
items.summary_en: US, Mexico and Peru reported 3,659, 13,484 and 2,438 confirmed measles cases this year; 95% of US cases were unvaccinated or of unknown status.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至9/28,累計47個州/地區報告3,659例確定病例、2例死亡,95%病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明,以5-19歲(1,577例)佔43%為多,其中以賓州(850例)、南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(535例)等地為主。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至9/28,累計報告13,484例確定病例、22例死亡,其中以哈利斯科州(Jalisco)7,266例為多、其次為首都墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,033例;年齡分佈以1-4歲2,692例為多,其次為5-9歲(2,398例)及25-29歲(2,234例)。 秘魯今年截至9/25,累計報告2,438例確定病例,1例死亡,為洛雷托大區(Loreto)16歲未接種疫苗男孩,因麻疹併發症(包括肺炎)死亡。由於該區地理偏遠、交通不便等因素,致疫苗接種、病例追蹤與醫療服務等,面臨挑戰。
items.description_en: US measles cases continue to rise. As of 28 September this year, 3,659 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been reported across 47 states/jurisdictions; 95% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and ages 5–19 (1,577 cases, 43%) accounted for the largest share. The largest numbers are in Pennsylvania (850), South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). Mexico's epidemic continues: as of 28 September this year, 13,484 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, with Jalisco (7,266 cases) having the most, followed by the capital, Mexico City (1,033 cases). By age, the largest numbers were among those aged 1–4 (2,692), followed by 5–9 years (2,398) and 25–29 years (2,234). As of 25 September this year, Peru has reported 2,438 confirmed cases and one death: a 16-year-old unvaccinated boy in the Loreto region who died of measles complications, including pneumonia. Because the region is geographically remote and hard to reach, vaccination, case tracing and healthcare services face challenges.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲第38週新冠陽性率升至15%,南非流感陽性率9%,以B型為主。
items.summary_en: Europe's COVID-19 positivity rose to 15% in week 38, while South Africa's influenza positivity was 9%, mainly influenza B in recent weeks.
items.description_zh: 歐洲地區今年第38週,新冠肺炎陽性率(15%)上升,變異株以XFG佔74%為主;流感陽性率(5.3%)低於基線,以A(H3N2)型別為主;呼吸道融合病毒活動度低。  南非今年第38週,新冠肺炎陽性率(1.5%)維持低水平;流感陽性率(9%),近4週(第35‒38週)以B型佔64%為主;呼吸道融合病毒(RSV)陽性率(1.5%)低於流行閾,該國於9/28宣布RSV流行季於第34週結束,惟仍需採取預防措施,以減少呼吸道病毒傳播。
items.description_en: In the European region in week 38 of this year, the COVID-19 test positivity rate (15%) rose, with variant XFG accounting for 74%; the influenza positivity rate (5.3%) was below baseline, mainly influenza A(H3N2); respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) activity was low. In South Africa in week 38, COVID-19 positivity (1.5%) remained at a low level; influenza positivity (9%) over the past four weeks (weeks 35–38) was mainly influenza B, at 64%; RSV positivity (1.5%) was below the epidemic threshold. On 28 September the country announced that its RSV season ended in week 34, but preventive measures are still needed to reduce the spread of respiratory viruses.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年44例人類新型A型流感,中國本週新增2例H9N2。
items.summary_en: Globally 44 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year; China added 2 H9N2 cases this week.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週新增中國2例A(H9N2)案件。全球今年累計報告44例,分別為32例H9N2、8例H5N1、2例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,168起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共6國於2026/9/21-25期間報告18起H5N1疫情,美國8起、秘魯5起、挪威2起、丹麥/奈及利亞/瑞典各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: two new A(H9N2) cases were reported in China this week. Globally, 44 cases have been reported this year: 32 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 2 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,168 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. A total of 6 countries reported 18 H5N1 outbreaks during 21–25 September 2026: 8 in the United States, 5 in Peru, 2 in Norway, and one each in Denmark, Nigeria and Sweden.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞拉薩熱今年截至第36週1,086例、259例死亡,致死率23.9%。
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 1,086 Lassa fever cases and 259 deaths this year through week 36, a 23.9% fatality rate.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情呈下降趨勢,第36週12例確定病例,較第35週(18 例)為低,今年截至第36週累計通報1,086例確定病例、259例死亡(致死率23.9%,高於去年同期18.6%),分布於24州(118個區),87%病例集中於包奇州(Bauchi)、翁多州(Ondo)、塔拉巴州(Taraba)、貝努埃州(Benue)、埃多州(Edo)等5州,病患以21-30歲族群為主。當局呼籲持續防範鼠類傳播風險。
items.description_en: Nigeria's epidemic shows a downward trend: 12 confirmed cases were reported in week 36, fewer than the 18 in week 35. Cumulatively this year through week 36, 1,086 confirmed cases and 259 deaths have been reported (case fatality rate 23.9%, higher than 18.6% in the same period last year), spread across 24 states (118 local government areas). 87% of cases are concentrated in five states – Bauchi, Ondo, Taraba, Benue and Edo – and patients are mainly aged 21–30. Authorities urge continued vigilance against transmission risk from rodents.

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年34,161例登革熱,第38週新增1,462例,高於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has reported 34,161 dengue cases this year as of week 38, with 1,462 in week 38 alone, higher than the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市今年截至第38週(9/20)累計報告34,161例病例,其中第38週(9/14-20)報告1,462例,較近4週平均增加3.2%,且高於去年同期,疫情集中於崑島特區及平慶社等行政區。
items.description_en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, has reported 34,161 cases this year as of week 38 (20 September). In week 38 (14–20 September), 1,462 cases were reported, 3.2% above the average of the previous four weeks and higher than the same period last year. The outbreak is concentrated in administrative areas including Côn Đảo special zone and Bình Khánh commune.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第35週陽性率3.68%,歐洲及美洲上升;中國門急診陽性率降至9.3%。
items.summary_en: COVID-19 positivity was 3.68% globally in week 35, rising in Europe and the Americas; China's outpatient positivity fell to 9.3% in week 38.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第35週(8/31-9/6)為3.68%,歐洲及美洲呈上升趨勢;全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG、NB.1.8.1、JN.1及PQ.16.1.1為主。 中國疫情下降,第38週(9/14-20)門急診陽性率為9.3%,較第37 週(12.5%)下降。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 35 of this year (31 August–6 September) was 3.68%, with upward trends in Europe and the Americas. Variants currently accounting for the largest shares globally are mainly XFG, NB.1.8.1, JN.1 and PQ.16.1.1. China's epidemic is declining; in week 38 (14–20 September), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 9.3%, down from 12.5% in week 37.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增43例伊波拉確定病例,累計7,989例、死亡3,852例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 43 new confirmed Ebola cases on 25 September, bringing the total to 7,989 cases and 3,852 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/25新增43例確定病例,其中19例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(31例)、北基伍省(9例)、上韋萊省(3例)。迄9/25累計7,989例確定病例(3,852例死亡、2,033例康復),致死率48.2%,疫情分佈於7個省份(63個衛生區),其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國76.3%病例數。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 25 September, 43 new confirmed cases were added, including 19 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (31), North Kivu Province (9) and Haut-Uele Province (3). As of 25 September, a cumulative 7,989 confirmed cases have been reported (3,852 deaths, 2,033 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.2%. The outbreak is distributed across 7 provinces (63 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severe, accounting for 76.3% of national cases.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: WPV1新增3例(阿富汗、巴基斯坦),cVDPV2新增4例(剛果等3國)。
items.summary_en: WPV1 polio added 3 cases in Afghanistan and Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added 4 cases across three countries, including the DRC, Mali and Nigeria.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/10-16期間,WPV1新增2國共3例,分別為阿富汗2例、巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國2例、馬利/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 10–16 September, WPV1 added 3 cases in two countries: 2 in Afghanistan and 1 in Pakistan. cVDPV2 added 4 cases in three countries: 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and 1 each in Mali and Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added one detection in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added two detections in Somalia.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,馬利
items.area_en: Afghanistan,Congo,Democratic Republic of the,Nigeria,Pakistan,Republic of Mali

items.headline_zh: 喬治亞-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 喬治亞首都提比里斯20所幼兒園爆發諾羅病毒,住院逾100例,感染源調查中。
items.summary_en: Tbilisi, Georgia reported over 100 hospitalised cases across 20 kindergartens, with norovirus detected; the source is under investigation.
items.description_zh: 喬治亞首都提比里斯(Tbilisi)於9/17-21累計報告逾100例住院病例,其中多件檢體檢出諾羅病毒,病患分布於20所幼兒園。當局表示多所幼兒園同時爆發疫情,可能與集中供應的餐點受污染有關,目前病患多已逐漸恢復,感染源仍調查中。
items.description_en: In the capital, Tbilisi, more than 100 hospitalised cases were reported cumulatively during 17–21 September. Several specimens tested positive for norovirus, and patients were distributed across 20 kindergartens. Authorities say the simultaneous outbreaks in several kindergartens may be linked to contaminated centrally supplied meals. Most patients are gradually recovering, and the source of infection is still under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年累計逾11.3萬例腸病毒,河內近5,000例,開學後幼兒園及小學擴散。
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has reported over 113,000 enterovirus cases this year as of 21 September; Hanoi has nearly 5,000, with spread in schools.
items.description_zh: 越南今年全國截至9/21累計報告逾113,000例病例,較去年同期增加,其中河內市今年迄今報告近5,000例,胡志⺠市近期重症數亦增加,因適逢開學季,於幼兒園與小學之疫情快速擴散。當局規劃疫苗於今年10月上市,以提供進一步保護措施。
items.description_en: Viet Nam reported more than 113,000 cases nationwide cumulatively as of 21 September this year, an increase over the same period last year. Hanoi has reported nearly 5,000 cases so far this year, and severe cases in Ho Chi Minh City have also recently increased. As the school year has started, the outbreak is spreading rapidly in kindergartens and primary schools. Authorities plan to launch a vaccine in October this year to provide further protection.

items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Cholera
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國今年截至8月逾39,400例疑似霍亂,1,173人死亡。
items.summary_en: DRC reported over 39,400 suspected cholera cases and 1,173 deaths this year through August; North and South Kivu account for over half of new cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)今年截至8月累計報告逾39,400例疑病例,其中1,173例死亡,疫情集中於東部的北基伍省(North Kivu)與南基伍省(South Kivu),合計新增病例數占全國一半以上,局勢不穩、人口流動頻繁及缺乏安全飲水設施等係疫情上升主因,因當地同時面臨伊波拉病毒感染疫情,致醫療與人道救援體系面臨雙重壓力 。
items.description_en: The DRC has reported more than 39,400 suspected cases this year through August, including 1,173 deaths. The outbreak is concentrated in the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, which together account for more than half of new cases nationwide. Political instability, frequent population movement and a lack of safe drinking-water facilities are the main drivers of the rise. Because the area is simultaneously facing an Ebola virus disease outbreak, the health and humanitarian response systems face dual pressure.

items.summary_zh: 聖地牙哥州立大學3例確定、2例可能腮腺炎;全美今年截至9/10共157例。
items.summary_en: San Diego State University reported 3 confirmed and 2 probable mumps cases among students; US total is 157 confirmed cases in 31 states as of 10 September.
items.description_zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥州立大學(SDSU),於今年9/18報告3例確定病例及2例可能(probable)病例。皆為同校學生,已啟動接觸者追蹤,並進行症狀篩檢及提供疫苗接種。該國今年截至9/10累計31州報告157例確定病例。
items.description_en: San Diego State University (SDSU) in California, USA, reported 3 confirmed cases and 2 probable cases on 18 September this year. All are students at the same university. Contact tracing has been initiated, with symptom screening and vaccination provided. As of 10 September this year, 31 states had cumulatively reported 157 confirmed cases in the country.

items.summary_zh: 非洲8國白喉疫情,累計逾1.5萬例疑似病例,奈及利亞占12,155例。
items.summary_en: Diphtheria in eight African countries has reached over 15,000 suspected cases, with Nigeria accounting for 12,155 suspected cases and 225 deaths.
items.description_zh: 非洲地區疫情持續,WHO今年9/16發佈風險評估報告,該地區風險評估為中等(Moderate)、全球風險低(Low)。今年截至8月下旬,該洲共8國出現疫情,累計逾1.5萬例疑病例,以奈及利亞12,155例疑病例、225例死亡為主,其次為查德(1,251例疑病例、5例死亡)、日(818例疑病例、27例死亡)及幾內亞(600例確定病例、49例死亡)等。疫苗覆蓋率下降、低實驗室確診率、即時治療(抗生素及白喉抗毒素)的不穩定性,人群跨境移動等因素阻礙疫情控制。
items.description_en: Diphtheria activity continues in Africa. WHO issued a risk assessment on 16 September: the regional risk is assessed as moderate and the global risk as low. As of late August this year, eight countries in the region have reported outbreaks, with more than 15,000 cumulative suspected cases, mainly Nigeria with 12,155 suspected cases and 225 deaths, followed by Chad (1,251 suspected cases, 5 deaths), Niger (818 suspected cases, 27 deaths) and Guinea (600 confirmed cases, 49 deaths). Declining vaccine coverage, low laboratory confirmation rates, unstable access to immediate treatment (antibiotics and diphtheria antitoxin) and cross-border population movement are hindering outbreak control.
items.area_zh: 查德,幾內亞,尼日,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年麻疹52,676例、死亡61例,瓜地馬拉33,334例居首。
items.summary_en: The Americas reported 52,676 confirmed measles cases and 61 deaths this year as of 5 September, with Guatemala accounting for 33,334.
items.description_zh: 歐盟今年7月共計13國報告118例確定病例,以保加利亞(61 例)、義大利(29例)、西班牙(7例)、波蘭(7例)及比利時(4例)為多。近12個月(2025/8/1-2026/7/31)共計30國報告2,339例病例,其中2,012例(86.0%)經實驗室確診。個案集中於15歲(含)以上(51.2%)。ECDC評估疫情主因為部分國家疫苗覆蓋率不足、境外移入等因素,並呼籲各國提升疫苗覆蓋率至95%以上。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至9/5(第35週),計17個國家/地區累計報告52,676例確定病例及61例死亡(CFR:0.12%),較去年同期病例數增加約3.8倍。有99.5%的病例集中於瓜地馬拉(33,334 例)、墨西哥(12,848例)、美國(3,134例)、秘魯(1,997例)及加拿大(1,119例);泛美衛生組織(PAHO)預計今年11月進行評估墨西哥消除麻疹認證。
items.description_en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.
items.area_zh: 比利時,保加利亞,加拿大,瓜地馬拉,義大利,墨西哥,秘魯,波蘭,西班牙,美國

items.disease_zh: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_zh: 泰國-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症(SFTS)
items.headline_en: Thailand – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 泰國今年3例發熱伴血小板減少綜合症,2例死亡;9/18起列為法定傳染病。
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 3 SFTS cases this year, 2 fatal, and on 18 September listed SFTS as a mandatory notifiable disease.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至9/16累計報告3例確定病例,其中2例死亡。自2019 年啟動監測以來,該國累計報告10例病例,其中5例死亡,病患多為50歲以上,感染途徑與飼養寵物、接觸貓狗、遭蜱蟲叮咬或徒手觸碰蜱蟲相關,由於SFTS病毒在當地犬隻動物血清陽性率達16.6%,存在廣泛天然宿主,該國已於9/18將SFTS正式列入法定傳染病強制通報,提醒⺠眾接觸動物後若出現不明原因發燒,應儘速就醫。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 3 confirmed cases this year as of 16 September, 2 of which were fatal. Since surveillance began in 2019, the country has reported 10 cumulative cases, 5 of them fatal; patients are mainly over 50 years old. Transmission is associated with keeping pets, contact with cats or dogs, tick bites, or bare-handed handling of ticks. Because SFTS virus has a seropositivity rate of 16.6% in local dogs, indicating a wide natural host reservoir, Thailand formally listed SFTS as a mandatory notifiable disease on 18 September, and reminds people that if they develop unexplained fever after contact with animals they should seek medical care promptly.

items.summary_zh: 廣東省今年4–8月屈公病736例,8月496例,逐月上升,但遠低於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Guangdong, China reported 736 chikungunya cases from April to August this year, rising monthly but well below last year's levels.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省今年4-8月報告736例病例,其中8月報告496例、7月報告171例,疫情呈逐月上升趨勢,惟仍遠低於去年同期。另廣東省於去(2025)年累計報告逾2萬例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, reported 736 cases from April to August this year, including 496 in August and 171 in July; the monthly trend is rising, but cases remain far below the same period last year. Guangdong Province reported more than 20,000 cumulative cases in 2025.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年登革熱6萬1,972例、死亡184例,9月新增2萬6,126例。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported 61,972 dengue cases and 184 deaths this year as of 20 September, with 26,126 new cases in September alone.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情嚴峻,今年截至9/20累計報告6萬1,972例病例,其中184例死亡,9月新增2萬6,126例病例及87例死亡,創今年單月最高紀錄。該國已於9月初啟動為期3個月之全國防疫計畫,加強病媒蚊孳生源清除與衛教宣導。 美國佛羅里達州本土疫情持續擴大,今年迄今累計報告152例病例,疫情多集中於希爾斯波羅郡(Hillsborough County),其中9/18報告1例死亡病例,血清型以第2型(DENV-2)為多,當局已擴大病媒蚊噴藥與孳生源清除,提醒⺠眾落實個人防蚊措施,並加強對重症之監測。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's epidemic is severe. As of 20 September this year, 61,972 cases and 184 deaths have been reported cumulatively; 26,126 new cases and 87 deaths were recorded in September alone, the highest monthly figure this year. At the start of September, the country launched a three-month nationwide prevention programme, strengthening the removal of mosquito breeding sites and health education. In the United States, locally acquired dengue in Florida continues to expand: 152 cases have been reported so far this year, concentrated in Hillsborough County. One death was reported on 18 September. Serotype 2 (DENV-2) predominates. Authorities have expanded mosquito spraying and breeding-site removal, urged people to take personal mosquito-protection measures, and strengthened surveillance of severe cases.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年42例人類新型A型流感,本週無新增;67國家/地區通報禽流感疫情。
items.summary_en: Globally, 42 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year, with none new this week; 67 countries reported avian outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週無新增案件。全球今年累計報告42例,分別為30例H9N2、8例H5N1、2例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,150起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 菲律賓於2026/9/15期間報告1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 ○ 共7國於2026/9/15-18期間報告11起H5N1疫情,美國/英國各3起、保加利亞/加拿大/挪威/瑞典/菲律賓各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: no new cases were reported this week. Globally, 42 cases have been reported this year: 30 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 2 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,150 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. The Philippines reported one H5 (N untyped) outbreak during 15 September 2026. A total of 7 countries reported 11 H5N1 outbreaks during 15–18 September 2026: 3 each in the United States and the United Kingdom, and one each in Bulgaria, Canada, Norway, Sweden and the Philippines.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第34週陽性率2.69%,多區上升;中國第37週門急診陽性率12.5%。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 2.69% in week 34 and rising in several regions; China's outpatient positivity was 12.5% in week 37.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第34週(8/24-8/30)為2.69%,歐洲、美洲、非洲及東地中海區呈上升趨勢;全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG、NB.1.8.1、JN.1及PQ.16.1.1為主。 中國疫情下降,第37週(9/7-9/13)門急診陽性率為12.5%,其中以5-14歲族群檢測陽性率較高。 香港疫情降至低點,第37週陽性率0.81%,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1(97.4%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(2.2%)及XFG(0.1%)。 韓國疫情單週下降,第37週陽性率為14.2%,新增287例住院,變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1(53.9%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(19.7%)、 BA.3.2(15.8%)及RF.5(5.3%) 。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 34 of this year (24–30 August) was 2.69%, with upward trends in Europe, the Americas, Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Variants currently accounting for the largest shares globally are mainly XFG, NB.1.8.1, JN.1 and PQ.16.1.1. China's epidemic is declining; in week 37 (7–13 September), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 12.5%, with higher positivity among people aged 5–14. Hong Kong's epidemic has fallen to a low; the week 37 positivity rate was 0.81%, and wastewater surveillance shows variants are mainly PQ.16.1.1 (97.4%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (2.2%) and XFG (0.1%). South Korea's epidemic declined week on week; the week 37 positivity rate was 14.2%, with 287 new hospitalisations, and variants are mainly PQ.16.1.1 (53.9%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19.7%), BA.3.2 (15.8%) and RF.5 (5.3%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區,韓國

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增73例伊波拉確定病例,累計7,614例、死亡3,676例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 73 new confirmed Ebola cases on 18 September, bringing the total to 7,614 cases and 3,676 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/18新增73例確定病例,其中37例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(46例)、北基伍省(18例)及上韋萊省(6例)、喬波省(3例)。迄9/18累計7,614例確定病例(3,676 例死亡、1,864例康復),致死率48.3%,疫情分佈於7個省份(63 個衛生區),其中上韋萊省新增一個受影響衛生區(Dungu),有地理區持續擴大情形。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 18 September, 73 new confirmed cases were added, including 37 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (46), North Kivu Province (18), Haut-Uele Province (6) and Tshopo Province (3). As of 18 September, a cumulative 7,614 confirmed cases have been reported (3,676 deaths, 1,864 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 7 provinces (63 health zones); Haut-Uele Province has added one newly affected health zone (Dungu), and geographic spread continues.

items.summary_zh: 德國9/17新增2例惡性瘧確定病例,1例死亡,均未前往流行地區。
items.summary_en: Germany reported two confirmed falciparum malaria cases on 17 September, one fatal; neither patient had travelled to an endemic area.
items.description_zh: 德國9/17新增報告2例惡性瘧原蟲感染確定病例,皆住院治療,惟其中1例死亡,個案均未曾前往流行地區,亦未在機場工作,居住緊鄰該國法蘭克福機場周邊約五公里範圍內之施萬海姆區(Schwanheim)的不同住所。該機場及周邊地區今年截至9/18累計8例確定病例、3例死亡。該國上次報告機場瘧疾病例發生在2023年。當局已提醒醫師,對於無旅行史,且出現不明原因發燒患者,應考慮瘧疾的可能性。
items.description_en: Germany reported 2 new confirmed cases of Plasmodium falciparum malaria on 17 September, both hospitalised, and one of them died. Neither case had travelled to an endemic area or worked at the airport; they lived in different residences in Schwanheim district, within about five kilometres of Frankfurt Airport. The airport and surrounding area have recorded 8 confirmed cases and 3 deaths so far this year as of 18 September. Germany last reported an airport-related malaria case in 2023. Authorities have reminded physicians to consider malaria in patients with unexplained fever and no travel history.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗WPV1新增4例,cVDPV2新增6例(剛果民主共和國5例)。
items.summary_en: Afghanistan reported 4 WPV1 polio cases in 3–9 September, while cVDPV2 added 6 cases, five in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/3-9期間,WPV1新增阿富汗4例;cVDPV2新增2國共6例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國5例、奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦3件,cVDPV1 新增馬達加斯加1件,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞1件 。
items.description_en: The GPEI reported that during 3–9 September, WPV1 added 4 cases in Afghanistan; cVDPV2 added 6 cases in two countries, 5 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 3 detections in Pakistan, cVDPV1 added 1 in Madagascar, and cVDPV2 added 1 in Somalia.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年累計6萬5,108例腸病毒,第37週新增5,472例,多為4歲以下。
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 65,108 enterovirus cases this year as of 16 September, with 5,472 in week 37, mostly children under 4.
items.description_zh: 泰國疫情持續上升,今年截至9/16累計報告6萬5,108例,其中1例死亡,第37週報告5,472例,病患以4歲以下為多,病患分布以素林府(Surin) 為多。
items.description_en: Thailand's epidemic continues to rise. As of 16 September this year, 65,108 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 1 death; 5,472 cases were reported in week 37. Patients are mainly under 4 years old, and cases are most concentrated in Surin Province.

items.summary_zh: 美國累計12,883例環孢子蟲病,31州受影響,已宣布疫情結束。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 12,883 cyclosporiasis cases and 2 deaths across 31 states; the outbreak has been declared over.
items.description_zh: 美國截至9/11累計報告1萬2,883例確定病例,其中570例住院及2 例死亡,疫情影響31個州,高於去年同期疫情(5-8月報告1,180例),最後1例於8/17發病,當局業於9/11宣布此波疫情結束,疫情主要感染來源為墨西哥生產的結球萵苣,相關單位仍持續於加工廠採樣調查中。
items.description_en: As of 11 September, the United States has cumulatively reported 12,883 confirmed cases, including 570 hospitalisations and 2 deaths, affecting 31 states. This is higher than the same period last year (1,180 cases reported May–August). The last case had onset on 17 August, and on 11 September authorities declared the outbreak over. The main source of infection was head lettuce grown in Mexico; relevant agencies continue to sample and investigate at processing plants.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲2025年5月至今年8月341例沙門氏菌,近期比利時因雞蛋污染逾300例。
items.summary_en: Europe reported 341 Salmonella cases from May 2025 to August 2026, with Belgium recently reporting over 300 cases linked to contaminated eggs.
items.description_zh: 歐洲去(2025)年5月截至今年8月累計報告341例確定病例,其中近半數疫情集中於今年5月以後,病患以4歲以下嬰幼兒為多,報告病例以英國(474例)及荷蘭(106例)為多,近期比利時因受雞蛋污染影響,報告逾300例病例。歐洲食品安全局(EFSA)統計全歐每年約報告9.1萬例,估計每年醫療與生產力損失等經濟負擔達30億歐元,當局呼籲⺠眾外食時,應避免食用未熟肉類、雞蛋與未加熱消毒之乳製品。
items.description_en: From May 2025 to August this year, Europe cumulatively reported 341 confirmed cases, nearly half of which occurred after May this year; most patients were infants and children under 4. The United Kingdom (474 cases) and the Netherlands (106 cases) reported the most. Recently, Belgium has reported more than 300 cases due to contaminated eggs. EFSA estimates that about 91,000 cases are reported across Europe each year, with an estimated annual economic burden, including healthcare and productivity losses, of €3 billion. Authorities advise people eating out to avoid undercooked meat, raw eggs and unpasteurised dairy products.
items.area_en: Belgium,Netherlands,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染-斐濟
items.summary_zh: 斐濟2025年新增2,016例HIV感染,9/15宣布進入國家緊急狀態。
items.summary_en: Fiji recorded 2,016 new HIV infections in 2025, with 1 in 60 adults infected; on 15 September the authorities declared a national state of emergency.
items.description_zh: 斐濟疫情嚴峻,2025年新增2,016例感染病例,每60名成年人中即有1名為感染者,多為靜脈注射毒品共用針頭以及不安全性行為而傳播,疫情惡化主因為低保險套使用率、缺乏篩檢、多重性伴侶及污名化不敢就醫等,且有2%孕婦感染,母嬰垂直感染風險高。當局已於9/15宣布疫情進入國家緊急狀態,將擴大篩檢、推動暴露前預防性投藥(PrEP)並進行針具交換計畫。
items.description_en: Fiji's epidemic is severe: 2,016 new infections were recorded in 2025, meaning 1 in every 60 adults is infected. Transmission is mainly through sharing injection drug needles and unsafe sexual practices. The worsening is attributed to low condom use, lack of screening, multiple sexual partners, and stigma that deters people from seeking care; 2% of pregnant women are infected, and the risk of mother-to-child transmission is high. On 15 September the authorities declared a national state of emergency, and will expand screening, promote pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and implement needle and syringe exchange programmes.

items.summary_zh: WHO認證不丹消除犬隻傳播之人類狂犬病;美國暴露風險升,疫苗用量增約33%。
items.summary_en: WHO recognised Bhutan's elimination of dog-mediated human rabies; in the US, exposure risk rose and vaccine use grew about 33%.
items.description_zh: 美國自2026年7月以來,多個地區通報人類暴露風險呈增加趨勢,CDC於7-8月接獲之相關諮詢較2025年同期增加17%,且至少有8個州衛生部門反映PEP使用增加或發生施打錯誤情形。截至9/2止,疫苗及免疫球蛋白之使用量分別較去年同期增加約33% 及76%,惟目前無藥品供應短缺情形。該疾病暴露事件通常在夏季較為常見,主要與⺠眾戶外活動增加、接觸野生動物機會提高有關。在該國50個州中,目前僅夏威夷州為非狂犬病疫區。 WHO於今年9/4宣布不丹成功消除犬隻傳播的人類狂犬病,為東南亞區第一個達成之國家。該國自2023年6月迄未再發生犬傳人之死亡案例。WHO消除認證標準要求至少連續2年無相關人類死亡病例,並具備完善公衛監測、實驗室診斷、犬隻疫苗接種及暴露後預防處置(PEP)等整備能力。
items.description_en: Since July 2026, several US regions have reported a rising trend in human exposure risk. CDC received 17% more related consultations in July and August than in the same period of 2025, and at least eight state health departments reported increased use of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) or administration errors. As of 2 September, vaccine and immunoglobulin use had risen by about 33% and 76% respectively compared with the same period last year, but there is currently no drug shortage. Such exposure events are usually more common in summer, mainly because of increased outdoor activity and greater contact with wildlife. Of the 50 states, only Hawaii is currently rabies-free. WHO announced on 4 September this year that Bhutan had successfully eliminated dog-mediated human rabies, the first country in the South-East Asia Region to do so. Bhutan has recorded no dog-transmitted human deaths since June 2023. WHO elimination certification requires at least two consecutive years without related human deaths, as well as adequate public health surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, dog vaccination and PEP preparedness.

items.summary_zh: 尚比亞穆欽加省3縣約40頭動物暴斃、11例疑似症狀,尚無死亡病例。
items.summary_en: Zambia's Muchinga Province reported about 40 animal deaths and 11 suspected anthrax cases in three districts, with no human deaths yet.
items.description_zh: 尚比亞東北部姆欽加省(Muchinga Province)三個縣近期爆發疑疫情,已造成約40頭動物異常暴斃,並有11名個案出現疑症狀,目前尚無死亡案例。由於炭疽芽孢可⻑期存活於土壤,且偏遠農村檢測與醫療資源有限,當局已派員啟動現場調查,以防堵疫情擴大,並呼籲居⺠勿食用、處理或販售暴斃動物之肉品。該國2023年曾爆發全國性(9個省份)大流行,累計684例疑病例及4例死亡;2011年亦曾發生因接觸死河馬肉,導致逾500人感染之重大疫情事件。
items.description_en: Several suspected outbreaks have recently occurred in three districts of Muchinga Province in north-eastern Zambia, causing abnormal deaths of about 40 animals and 11 people with suspected symptoms; no deaths have been reported so far. Because anthrax spores can survive in soil for long periods, and detection and medical resources in remote rural areas are limited, authorities have dispatched staff to conduct field investigations to prevent the outbreak from spreading, and urge residents not to eat, handle or sell meat from animals that died suddenly. In 2023, the country experienced a nationwide epidemic across nine provinces, with 684 cumulative suspected cases and 4 deaths; in 2011, contact with dead hippopotamus meat caused a major outbreak that infected more than 500 people.

items.summary_zh: 全球7月32國新增1,370例M痘確診、7例死亡,歐洲多國出現Ib型社區傳播。
items.summary_en: Globally in July, 32 countries reported 1,370 mpox cases and 7 deaths; several European countries have clade Ib community transmission.
items.description_zh: 全球於7月共32個國家新增通報1,370例確診、7例死亡, 智利及匈牙利近期首次通報Clade Ib基因型境外移入確定病例,個案發病前均具歐洲國家旅遊史,歐洲多國存在Clade Ib社區傳播 。另WHO啟動新的疫苗國際協調機制(ICG),並將常規建議延⻑至2027年8月,強調疫情雖未達「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」標準,惟各締約國仍應依據該建議,維持公衛監測、風險溝通及防治應變機制 。WHO評估全球疫情仍持續,整體風險為中。
items.description_en: Globally in July, 32 countries newly reported 1,370 confirmed cases and 7 deaths. Chile and Hungary recently reported, for the first time, imported confirmed cases of clade Ib; all had a history of travel to European countries before symptom onset, and several European countries have community transmission of clade Ib. WHO has launched a new international vaccine coordination mechanism (ICG) and extended its standing recommendations to August 2027. WHO stresses that although the outbreak does not meet the criteria for a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), States Parties should continue public health surveillance, risk communication and response measures in line with the recommendations. WHO assesses that the global outbreak continues and that the overall risk remains moderate.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增87例伊波拉確定病例,累計7,200例、死亡3,475例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 87 new confirmed Ebola cases on 12 September, bringing the total to 7,200 cases and 3,475 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/12新增87例確定病例,其中38例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(44例)、北基伍省(37例)、上韋萊省(3例)及喬波省(3例)。迄9/12累計7,200例確定病例(3,475例死亡、1,712例康復),致死率48.3%,疫情分佈於7個省份(62個衛生區),其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國78%病例數,且單日新增確定病例中亦有50.6%集中於該省。 伊圖里省近3週(8/24-9/13)新增病例數下降25%,惟北基伍省病例數上升76.1%。目前女性病例佔多數,且高達68%死亡病例發生於社區。WHO評估仍需5,000名醫衛人員進駐支援,並維持該疫情為「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件」(PHEIC)。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 12 September, 87 new confirmed cases were added, including 38 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (44), North Kivu Province (37), Haut-Uele Province (3) and Tshopo Province (3). As of 12 September, a cumulative 7,200 confirmed cases have been reported (3,475 deaths, 1,712 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 7 provinces (62 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severe, accounting for 78% of national cases; 50.6% of the new confirmed cases added that day were also in this province. Over the past three weeks (24 August–13 September), new cases in Ituri Province fell by 25%, while cases in North Kivu Province rose by 76.1%. Women currently make up the majority of cases, and as many as 68% of deaths occurred in the community. WHO assesses that 5,000 health workers are still needed to deploy in support, and the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

items.summary_zh: 紐約市南布朗克斯區退伍軍人病群聚,累計11例確定病例、1例死亡。
items.summary_en: A Legionnaires' disease cluster in South Bronx, New York City has reached 11 confirmed cases and one death; cooling towers are being tested.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市南布朗克斯區(South Bronx)發生群聚,截至9/14累計報告11例確定病例,3例住院、1例死亡,當局已啟動調查,並針對受影響區域之冷卻水塔進行實驗室檢測及清消作業。
items.description_en: A cluster has occurred in South Bronx, New York City, USA. As of 14 September, 11 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, with 3 hospitalised and one death. Authorities have launched an investigation and are testing and disinfecting the cooling towers in the affected area.

items.headline_zh: 塞內加爾/奈及利亞-白喉
items.summary_zh: 塞內加爾今年57例白喉確定病例、8例死亡;奈及利亞累計逾1萬例。
items.summary_en: Senegal reported 57 diphtheria cases and 8 deaths this year as of 8 September; Nigeria has reported over 10,000 cases.
items.description_zh: 塞內加爾疫情持續,今年截至9/8累計報告57例確定病例,其中8例死亡(致死率:14%),分布於8(/14)個行政區,並以凱杜古區(Kédougou Region)27例為多,當局呼籲家⻑應確認孩童接種情形,並依免疫接種規劃期程進行疫苗接種,且於出現症狀時即時就醫。 奈及利亞今年截至9/12已累計超過1萬例病例,98%確定病例分佈於8個州,其中68%確定病例未接種疫苗,推估持續的免疫缺口,導致疫情持續不斷。另高原州(Plateau State)疫情擴大,今年8/24-30報告48例確定病例,其中4例死亡,9/7起暫時關閉所有中/小學校,以降低傳播風險,並加強疾病監測、接觸者追蹤及疫苗接種等防治措施。
items.description_en: Diphtheria in Senegal continues. As of 8 September this year, 57 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, 8 of whom died (case fatality rate 14%), spread across 8 of 14 districts, with 27 cases in Kédougou Region. Authorities urge parents to check children's vaccination status, to vaccinate according to the immunisation schedule, and to seek medical care promptly when symptoms appear. In Nigeria, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported this year as of 12 September; 98% of confirmed cases are distributed across 8 states, and 68% of confirmed cases were unvaccinated, indicating persistent immunity gaps that keep the outbreak going. The outbreak has also expanded in Plateau State, which reported 48 confirmed cases during 24–30 August this year, 4 of them fatal; from 7 September, all primary and secondary schools were temporarily closed to reduce the risk of transmission, and surveillance, contact tracing and vaccination are being strengthened.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉麻疹自3月中旬起逾17萬例,確定20,124例、死亡100例。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported over 170,000 measles cases since mid-March, including 20,124 confirmed cases and 100 deaths as of 14 September.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情持續,自今年3月中旬以來,截至9/14,累計報告逾17萬例病例,其中20,124例確定病例、100例死亡。以首都達卡(Dhaka)12,410例確定病例(佔61.6%)、63例死亡為多,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)2,711例確定病例。當局雖已啟動大規模疫苗接種,惟病例數仍持續上升。此外,該國同時面臨登革熱疫情,導致醫療體系嚴重負荷。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues. Since mid-March this year, more than 170,000 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 14 September, including 20,124 confirmed cases and 100 deaths. The capital, Dhaka, accounts for most of these, with 12,410 confirmed cases (61.6%) and 63 deaths, followed by Chattogram with 2,711 confirmed cases. Although authorities have launched large-scale vaccination, case numbers continue to rise. The country is also facing a dengue epidemic at the same time, placing a heavy burden on the health system.

items.headline_zh: 阿根廷-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 阿根廷內烏肯省2例漢他病毒症候群,1例死亡,已啟動接觸者追蹤。
items.summary_en: Neuquén Province, Argentina reported 2 hantavirus syndrome cases, one fatal; contact tracing and surveillance have been launched.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷內烏肯省(Neuquén Province)今年截至9/3,累計報告2 例確定病例,其中1例死亡。指標個案為26歲男性,出現發燒、肌肉疼痛、呼吸困難等症狀,8/15住院治療,8/18死亡,居住區有嚙齒類動物出沒紀錄;第2例為指標個案之密切接觸者,目前病情穩定。該國已啟動接觸者追蹤及監測,並發佈公共衛生防疫等預防建議。
items.description_en: In Neuquén Province, Argentina, 2 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported this year as of 3 September, one of whom died. The index case was a 26-year-old man who presented with fever, muscle pain and difficulty breathing, was hospitalised on 15 August and died on 18 August; rodent activity had been recorded in his residential area. The second case is a close contact of the index case and is currently stable. The country has initiated contact tracing and surveillance and issued public health prevention recommendations.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲今年流感確定病例逾13萬例,較去年同期減62.6%,近期持續升溫。
items.summary_en: Australia has reported 130,355 influenza cases this year as of 6 September, 62.6% lower than the same period last year, but activity is still rising.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情持續,8/24-9/6累計31,650例確定病例,較前2週(24,883例)增加27.2%,今年截至9/6累計報告130,355例,較去年同期減少62.6%,陽性率上升至8.4%,病毒型別主要以A(H3N2)佔71.1%為主,疫苗覆蓋率為30.2%,整體活動度仍低於去年。惟推估疫情尚未達高峰,將持續升溫;近期兒童及高齡族群住院數亦增加。
items.description_en: Influenza activity in Australia continues. Between 24 August and 6 September, 31,650 confirmed cases were reported, 27.2% more than in the previous two weeks (24,883 cases). Cumulatively this year as of 6 September, 130,355 cases have been reported, 62.6% lower than in the same period last year. The positivity rate has risen to 8.4%; influenza A(H3N2) accounts for 71.1% of virus types, vaccination coverage is 30.2%, and overall activity remains below last year's level. However, activity is estimated not to have peaked yet and will continue to rise; recently, hospitalisations among children and older people have also increased.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲15國今年1,086例西尼羅熱本土病例、61例死亡,超過過去10年同期平均。
items.summary_en: Fifteen European countries reported 1,086 locally acquired West Nile cases and 61 deaths as of 3 September, above the past decade's same-period average.
items.description_zh: 歐洲今年截至9/3共15國累計報告1,086例本土病例,其中61例死亡(CFR:6%),病例數超過過去10年同期平均(736例),病例以義大利(516例)、希臘(284例)及西班牙(88例) 等國為多,荷蘭為2020年以來首次報告人類病例。另亦有持續報告鳥類及馬科動物群聚疫情,雖尚無跡象顯示疾病嚴重度增加,當局評估當前氣候條件有利於病媒蚊傳播,預期未來數週病例數仍將持續上升。
items.description_en: As of 3 September this year, 15 European countries have cumulatively reported 1,086 locally acquired cases, including 61 deaths (CFR 6%). The case count exceeds the average of 736 for the same period over the past 10 years. Cases are concentrated in Italy (516), Greece (284) and Spain (88), among others; the Netherlands reported its first human case since 2020. Bird and equine cluster outbreaks continue to be reported. Although there is no sign that disease severity is increasing, authorities assess that current climatic conditions favour mosquito-borne transmission, and case numbers are expected to keep rising in the coming weeks.
items.area_zh: 希臘,義大利,荷蘭,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 印度2015–25年瘧疾病例與死亡均降約80%,高負擔地區由155個減至33個。
items.summary_en: India's malaria cases and deaths both fell about 80% from 2015 to 2025, and high-burden districts dropped from 155 to 33.
items.description_zh: 印度公布近年疫情顯著下降,2015-25年病例數與死亡數均下降約80%,高疾病負擔行政區自155個降至33個,且有160個區域於2022-25年無報告本土病例,當局將持續加強疫情監測、檢驗、治療與追蹤,目標於2030年消除瘧疾。
items.description_en: India has announced a marked decline in malaria in recent years: cases and deaths both fell by about 80% between 2015 and 2025. The number of high-burden districts fell from 155 to 33, and 160 areas reported no locally acquired cases during 2022–25. Authorities will continue to strengthen malaria surveillance, testing, treatment and case tracing, with the aim of eliminating malaria by 2030.

items.summary_zh: 南韓今年首例本土日本腦炎確定病例,為60多歲未接種疫苗女性,疫情多於9至10月。
items.summary_en: South Korea reported its first local Japanese encephalitis case this year on 9 September, an unvaccinated woman in her 60s; cases usually peak in September–October.
items.description_zh: 南韓於9/9報告今年首例本土確定病例,病患為60多歲女性,無接種疫苗且有蚊子叮咬史。該國疫情主要發生於9至10月,且主要影響50歲以上族群,因三斑家蚊仍持續活躍,當局呼籲戶外活動應落實防蚊措施,居住於稻田或養豬場附近之⺠眾應接種疫苗。
items.description_en: On 9 September, South Korea reported its first locally acquired confirmed case this year, a woman in her 60s who was unvaccinated and had a history of mosquito bites. Korea's outbreaks mainly occur in September and October and mainly affect people over 50. Because Culex tritaeniorhynchus mosquitoes remain active, authorities urge people to take mosquito-prevention measures during outdoor activities, and recommend vaccination for people living near rice paddies or pig farms.

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年累計31,032例登革熱,已連續5週單週新增逾1,000例。
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has reported 31,032 dengue cases this year as of 6 September, with weekly cases above 1,000 for five straight weeks.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續升溫,今年截至9/6累計報告3萬1,032例病例,已連續5週單週新增超過1,000例,因高溫多雨及高人口密度提供埃及斑蚊極佳繁殖環境,當局呼籲⺠眾應徹底清除孳生源。
items.description_en: The dengue epidemic in Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to intensify: as of 6 September this year, 31,032 cases have been reported cumulatively, and weekly new cases have exceeded 1,000 for five consecutive weeks. High temperatures, heavy rainfall and high population density provide an excellent breeding environment for Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, and authorities urge people to thoroughly remove breeding sources.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年42例人類新型A型流感,本週新增2例;67國家/地區通報禽流感疫情。
items.summary_en: Globally, 42 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year, with 2 new this week; 67 countries reported avian outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週新增2件。全球今年累計報告42例,分別為30例H9N2、8例H5N1、2例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,137起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共1國於2026/9/11報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,冰島2 起。 ○ 共5國於2026/9/7-2026/9/11期間報告19起H5N1疫情,秘魯8起、美國4起、挪威3起、智利/法國各2起。
items.description_en: Human cases: 2 new cases were reported this week. Globally, 42 cases have been reported this year: 30 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 2 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,137 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. One country, Iceland, reported 2 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 11 September 2026. A total of 5 countries reported 19 H5N1 outbreaks during 7–11 September 2026: 8 in Peru, 4 in the United States, 3 in Norway, and 2 each in Chile and France.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第33週陽性率2.33%,歐洲、美洲上升;韓國第36週陽性率16.3%。
items.summary_en: COVID-19 positivity was 2.33% globally in week 33, rising in Europe and the Americas; South Korea's positivity reached 16.3% in week 36.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第33週(8/17-8/23)為2.33%,歐洲、美洲及東南亞區呈上升趨勢;近期全球流行變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1、NB.1.8.1、XFG及JN.1為主。 中國疫情下降,第36週(8/31-9/6)門急診陽性率為14%,其中以0-4歲及15-59歲族群檢測陽性率較高;變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈波動趨勢,第36週陽性率1.12%,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1(97.6%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(1.7%)、XFG(0.6%)及JN.1(0.1%)。 韓國疫情上升,第36週陽性率為16.3%,新增193例住院,變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1(53.9%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(19.7%)、BA.3.2(15.8%)及RF.5(5.3%) 。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 33 of this year (17–23 August) was 2.33%, with upward trends in Europe, the Americas and the South-East Asia Region; the variants with the largest shares globally are mainly PQ.16.1.1, NB.1.8.1, XFG and JN.1. China's epidemic is declining; in week 36 (31 August–6 September), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 14%, with higher positivity among people aged 0–4 and 15–59; the variant share is mainly NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong's epidemic is fluctuating; the week 36 positivity rate was 1.12%, and wastewater surveillance shows variants are mainly PQ.16.1.1 (97.6%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (1.7%), XFG (0.6%) and JN.1 (0.1%). South Korea's epidemic is rising; the week 36 positivity rate was 16.3%, with 193 new hospitalisations, and variants are mainly PQ.16.1.1 (53.9%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19.7%), BA.3.2 (15.8%) and RF.5 (5.3%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區,韓國

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增80例伊波拉確定病例,累計7,022例、死亡3,398例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 80 new confirmed Ebola cases on 10 September, bringing the total to 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/10新增80例確定病例,其中49例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(30例)、北基伍省(43例)及上韋萊省(6例)、南烏班吉省(1例),另南烏班吉省新增1個受影響衛生區(Bulu),有地理區持續擴大情形。迄9/10累計7,022例確定病例(3,398例死亡、1,671例康復),致死率48.4%。 DRC疫情持續擴大,目前已影響全國7省(/26省)共62個衛生區,其中51個衛生區於過去21天內仍有病例,增幅部分可能來自監測、檢驗與診斷能力提升及未通報資料校正,惟病例與死亡持續增加亦反映社區傳播延續及明顯地理擴張。WHO於8/14評估DRC境內疫情風險為「極高(Very High)」,與DRC接壤之所有鄰國風險為「高(high)」,非洲其他地區及全球則維持「低(Low),並不建議對受影響國家實施旅行或貿易限制。 WHO表示Ervebo疫苗對BVD之人體效益仍未知,僅建議於研究計畫使用;截至9/6止,已有2,007名醫護及第一線人員接種該疫苗。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 10 September, 80 new confirmed cases were added, including 49 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (30), North Kivu Province (43), Haut-Uele Province (6) and South Ubangi Province (1). South Ubangi Province has added one newly affected health zone (Bulu), and geographic spread continues. As of 10 September, a cumulative 7,022 confirmed cases have been reported (3,398 deaths, 1,671 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The DRC outbreak continues to expand: it now affects 7 of the country's 26 provinces, across 62 health zones, 51 of which have reported cases in the past 21 days. Part of the increase may reflect improved surveillance, testing and diagnostic capacity and corrections to unreported data; however, the continued rise in cases and deaths also reflects ongoing community transmission and clear geographic expansion. WHO assessed the risk within the DRC as very high on 14 August; the risk for all countries bordering the DRC is high, and the risk for the rest of Africa and the world remains low. WHO does not recommend travel or trade restrictions on affected countries. WHO says the human benefit of the Ervebo vaccine against BVD remains unknown and recommends its use only within research protocols; as of 6 September, 2,007 health workers and frontline personnel had been vaccinated with this vaccine.

items.summary_zh: 南韓9/11發布流感流行預警,病毒陽性率升至16.3%,300例住院。
items.summary_en: South Korea issued an influenza epidemic alert on 11 September; virus positivity rose to 16.3% and 300 patients were hospitalised.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情上升,於9/11發布流行預警,該國定醫通報數今年第36週上升至每千人25.3例(高於去年同期6.6例),高於基線12.9例;病毒陽性率為16.3%,高於上週12.3%,300例住院,主要以A(H1N1)pdm09型別為主。當局呼籲高風險族群倘出現發燒等呼吸道症狀,應儘早就醫治療,並督促⺠眾勤洗手、佩戴口罩與接種疫苗等落實呼吸道防護措施。
items.description_en: Influenza activity in South Korea is rising. On 11 September the authorities issued an epidemic alert. Sentinel physician reports of influenza-like illness (ILI) in week 36 of this year rose to 25.3 per 1,000 people, higher than 6.6 in the same period last year and above the baseline of 12.9. The virus positivity rate was 16.3%, up from 12.3% the previous week, with 300 hospitalisations, mainly of influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. Authorities urge high-risk groups to seek treatment early if they develop respiratory symptoms such as fever, and urge the public to wash hands frequently, wear masks and get vaccinated as part of respiratory protection.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓洪災後鉤端螺旋體病6,253例確定、378例死亡,較去年同期減12%。
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 6,253 confirmed leptospirosis cases and 378 deaths as of 29 August, 12% below last year's level, amid flooding.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓受洪災影響,致疫情上升,今年截至8/29累計通報6,253例確定病例及378例死亡(CFR 6%),雖較去年同期7,084例減少12% ,惟考量潛伏期,預估8月底洪災衍生之病例仍可能持續增加,目前部分醫院已超額收治。當局提供120萬顆Doxycycline抗生素進行預防性投藥,並呼籲涉水且發燒⺠眾應儘速就醫 。
items.description_en: Flooding in the Philippines has led to rising cases. As of 29 August this year, 6,253 confirmed cases and 378 deaths (CFR 6%) have been reported cumulatively. Although this is 12% lower than the 7,084 cases in the same period last year, given the incubation period, cases arising from the flooding at the end of August are expected to keep increasing, and some hospitals are already over capacity. Authorities are providing 1.2 million doxycycline tablets for preventive treatment and urge people who have waded through floodwater and developed fever to seek medical care promptly.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 以色列-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.summary_zh: 以色列9歲男童於加利利海游泳感染福氏內格里阿米巴,仍插管治療。
items.summary_en: Israel reported a 9-year-old boy infected with Naegleria fowleri after swimming in the Sea of Galilee; he remains intubated in intensive care.
items.description_zh: 以色列報告1名9歲男童於今年8月底在加利利海庫爾西海灘(Kursi Beach)游泳,約1週後發病確診,截至9/6止仍於加護病房插管治療。此案為該國近年第3例,前2例均為2024年與加利利海周邊水上樂園有關個案,其中1例死亡、1例重症。病原通常經受污染暖淡水進入鼻腔後侵入腦部,不會經飲水或人際接觸傳播。因病程發展迅速,且致死率達97%以上,即時識別病人將影響後續療程。
items.description_en: Israel has reported a 9-year-old boy who swam at Kursi Beach on the Sea of Galilee at the end of August this year. He developed symptoms and was diagnosed about a week later, and as of 6 September remained intubated in intensive care. This is the third case in the country in recent years; the previous two, both in 2024, were linked to water parks around the Sea of Galilee, one of which was fatal and one of which was severe. The pathogen usually enters the brain through the nasal cavity from contaminated warm fresh water, and is not transmitted through drinking water or person-to-person contact. Because the disease progresses rapidly and has a case fatality rate above 97%, early identification of patients will affect subsequent treatment.

items.summary_zh: 蒙古科布多省1例腺鼠疫確定病例,與處理旱獺有關,呼籲勿接觸野生旱獺。
items.summary_en: Mongolia confirmed a bubonic plague case in Khovd Province near the Chinese border, linked to handling marmots; authorities urge avoiding wild marmots.
items.description_zh: 蒙古2026年在北部庫蘇古爾省(Khuvsgul)進行監測,確認當地為鼠疫自然疫源地,另在中國邊境之科布多省(Khovd)發現1例腺鼠疫確定病例,與處理來自巴彥烏列蓋省(Bayan-Ölgii)已知疫源區之旱獺有關。目前尚無證據顯示人際間傳播,由於旱獺獵捕為主要傳播途徑,且偏遠地區診療不易,當局呼籲⺠眾勿接觸野生旱獺。
items.description_en: In 2026, Mongolia conducted surveillance in Khuvsgul Province in the north and confirmed that the area is a natural plague focus. In addition, one confirmed case of bubonic plague was detected in Khovd Province on the Chinese border, linked to handling marmots from the known plague focus in Bayan-Ölgii Province. There is currently no evidence of human-to-human transmission. Because marmot hunting is the main transmission route and diagnosis and treatment in remote areas are difficult, authorities urge people not to come into contact with wild marmots.

items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭1例Ib型;安哥拉疫情轉為社區傳播,今年264例確定、2例死亡。
items.summary_en: Ukraine reported one clade Ib case; Angola, where community transmission has taken hold, has 264 confirmed mpox cases and 2 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 烏克蘭文察州(Vinnytsia Oblast)報告1例感染Ib型之成年男性病例,具歐洲旅遊史,病況輕微,目前已實施隔離,並針對接觸者進行21天健康監測,迄無新增病例。該國目前無本土傳播疫情,惟仍須嚴防來自其他歐洲國家之境外移入風險。 安哥拉卡賓達省(Cabinda)疫情由2024-25年之零星病例轉為持續社區傳播,目前爆發Ib型疫情。該國今年截至9/8累計264例確定病例,其中38例住院、2例死亡。個案以20-29歲(52%)及女性(66%)為主,多無旅遊史,主要經身體與性接觸傳播。當局已調撥3萬劑疫苗,針對醫護人員與高風險區⺠眾展開緊急接種防護。
items.description_en: In Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine, one adult male infected with clade Ib, with a history of travel in Europe, has been reported; the case is mild. The patient has been isolated, and contacts are under 21 days of health monitoring; no new cases have been found. Ukraine currently has no local transmission, but must still guard strictly against imported cases from other European countries. In Cabinda Province, Angola, the outbreak has shifted from sporadic cases in 2024–25 to sustained community transmission, and a clade Ib outbreak is now under way. The country has reported 264 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 8 September, including 38 hospitalised and 2 deaths. Cases are mainly aged 20–29 (52%) and female (66%), most without travel history, and transmission is mainly through physical and sexual contact. Authorities have allocated 30,000 doses of vaccine for emergency vaccination of health workers and residents in high-risk areas.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增86例伊波拉確定病例,累計6,843例、死亡3,310例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 86 new confirmed Ebola cases on 8 September, bringing the total to 6,843 cases and 3,310 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/8新增86例確定病例,其中43例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(55例)、北基伍省(27例)、上韋萊省(2例)及喬波省(2例)。迄9/8累計6,843例確定病例(3,310例死亡、1,611例康復),致死率48.4%,疫情分佈於6個省份(61個衛生區)。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 8 September, 86 new confirmed cases were added, including 43 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (55), North Kivu Province (27), Haut-Uele Province (2) and Tshopo Province (2). As of 8 September, a cumulative 6,843 confirmed cases have been reported (3,310 deaths, 1,611 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The outbreak is distributed across 6 provinces (61 health zones).

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: cVDPV2新增12例(剛果等3國),巴基斯坦WPV1環境樣本6件。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 12 cVDPV2 polio cases in three countries, led by the DRC with 8, and 6 WPV1 environmental detections in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/27-9/2期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增3國共12例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國8例、南蘇丹3例、馬利1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞2 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件 。
items.description_en: The GPEI reported that during 27 August–2 September, cVDPV1 added 1 case in South Sudan; cVDPV2 added 12 cases in three countries: 8 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 3 in South Sudan and 1 in Mali; cVDPV3 added 2 cases in Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 6 detections in Pakistan.
