items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至9/1累計53,362例腸病毒,住院5,408例,較去年同期低。
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 53,362 enterovirus cases this year as of 1 September, including 5,408 hospitalisations, below the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至9/1累計報告53,362例病例,其中住院5,408例、死亡1例,疫情低於去年同期,病患集中於0-4歲、5-9歲及10-14歲年齡層。因適逢雨季與開學季,學校與托嬰中爆發群聚疫情,當局已發布警報,呼籲學童倘發病應在家休養5天,如同一班級一週內出現2例以上個案,應停課清消1天,並於後續一週加強班級疫情監測。
items.description_en: As of 1 September this year, Thailand has cumulatively reported 53,362 cases, of which 5,408 were hospitalised and one died. The epidemic is lower than the same period last year, with cases concentrated in the 0–4, 5–9 and 10–14 age groups. Because it coincides with the rainy season and the start of the school term, clusters have broken out in schools and infant care centres. Authorities have issued an alert advising that children who fall ill stay at home to rest for five days; if two or more cases occur in the same class within one week, the class should be suspended for one day for disinfection, and surveillance in the class should be strengthened for the following week.

items.summary_zh: 葉門南部貝達地區8月逾1,000例疑似霍亂、6人死亡,快篩及藥物短缺。
items.summary_en: Al-Bayda in southern Yemen reported over 1,000 suspected cholera cases and 6 deaths in August, amid shortages of test kits and drugs.
items.description_zh: 葉門南部貝達地區(Al-Bayda)今年8月報告逾1,000例疑病例,其中6例死亡,媒體報導因水質受污染及監管不當導致疫情蔓延,且當地面臨快篩試劑與藥物短缺,推估疫情可能低估。
items.description_en: In the Al-Bayda area of southern Yemen, more than 1,000 suspected cases and 6 deaths were reported in August this year. Media reports attribute the spread of the outbreak to water contamination and inadequate regulation. Local rapid test kits and medicines are in short supply, and the outbreak is likely underestimated.

items.summary_zh: 法國今年5月至8月沙門氏菌感染81例,6例住院,源於洛特加龍省南瓜子產品。
items.summary_en: France reported 81 Salmonella cases from May to August this year, 6 hospitalised; the source was pumpkin-seed products made in Lot-et-Garonne, now withdrawn.
items.description_zh: 法國今年5/3至8/12累計報告81例確定病例,其中6例住院,疫情分布於10個行政區,基因型檢測均相同,經調查感染源為洛特加龍省(Lot-et-Garonne)加工廠所生產之南瓜子產品,相關產品亦銷往盧森堡,當局已將產品下架。
items.description_en: France reported 81 confirmed cases cumulatively from 3 May to 12 August this year, of which 6 were hospitalised. Cases are distributed across 10 administrative areas, and genotyping results are identical across cases. Investigation identified the source of infection as pumpkin-seed products produced by a processing plant in Lot-et-Garonne; the products were also distributed to Luxembourg, and authorities have had the products withdrawn from sale.

items.headline_zh: 哥斯大黎加-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Costa Rica – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加今年772例A型肝炎,逾2025年全年兩倍,73%集中聖荷西省。
items.summary_en: Costa Rica has reported 772 hepatitis A cases this year through week 32, over twice the 2025 full-year total; 73% are in San José Province.
items.description_zh: 哥斯大黎加疫情升溫,今年截至第32週累計報告772例確定病例,逾去(2025)年全年報告數(373例)之兩倍,疫情主要集中於聖荷西省(San José),占全國病例73%,病患以20-64歲族群為主,部分區域以男性為多。經調查尚未發現單一共同感染源,懷疑為人傳人或水質不良所導致,當局已加強衛教宣導,呼籲⺠ 眾應飲用煮沸後之飲用水。
items.description_en: Costa Rica's epidemic is rising: as of week 32 this year, 772 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, more than double the 373 cases reported for all of 2025. The outbreak is concentrated in San José Province, which accounts for 73% of national cases; patients are mainly aged 20–64, and in some areas males predominate. Investigation has not identified a single common source; person-to-person transmission or poor water quality is suspected. Authorities have strengthened health education and urge people to drink boiled water.

items.summary_zh: 薩瓦省退伍軍人病48例、2死,30例與尚貝里餐廳噴霧系統有關,關閉後無新增。
items.summary_en: Savoie, France reported 48 Legionnaires' cases and 2 deaths; 30 were linked to a misting system at a Chambéry restaurant, with no new cases since its closure.
items.description_zh: 法國疫情更新,東南部薩瓦省(Savoie)自今年6/1至8/21累計報告48例確定病例,其中46例住院、2例死亡,經調查其中30例病例與尚貝里(Chambéry)一家餐廳之噴霧系統(misting system) 有關,該國要求關閉該設施後,迄無新增相關病例。
items.description_en: France update: in Savoie department in south-eastern France, 48 confirmed cases were cumulatively reported from 1 June to 21 August this year, of which 46 were hospitalised and 2 died. Investigation showed that 30 of the cases were linked to a misting system at a restaurant in Chambéry; after the country required the facility to be closed, no new related cases have been reported.

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年截至8/22麻疹51,027例、死亡55例,較去年同期增約4.6倍。
items.summary_en: The Americas reported 51,027 confirmed measles cases and 55 deaths as of 22 August, about 4.6 times the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/22(第33週),計17個國家/地區累計報告51,027例確定病例及55例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4.6倍,96%病例來自瓜地馬拉(32,566例)、墨西哥(12,607例)、美國(2,777例)及加拿大(1,117例)。
items.description_en: Americas regional update: as of 22 August this year (week 33), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 51,027 confirmed cases and 55 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about 4.6 times the number in the same period last year. 96% of cases came from Guatemala (32,566), Mexico (12,607), the United States (2,777) and Canada (1,117).
items.area_zh: 加拿大,瓜地馬拉,墨西哥,美國

items.summary_zh: 日本疫情上升,流感確定病例6,543例;韓國每千人13.3例,較上週升。
items.summary_en: Japan's influenza epidemic is rising, with 6,543 confirmed cases in week 35; South Korea's ILI rate rose week on week to 13.3 per 1,000.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情上升,今年第35週(8/24-30)報告6,543例確定病例(高於去年同期1,347例),定醫平均報告1.76例(高於去年同期0.35),住院213例,較上週(167例)增加,其中以70歲以上(108例)佔50.7%為主。主要分佈於沖繩縣(8.5)、岩手縣(4.33)及新潟縣(3.58)等地,全國47個都道府縣中,39個都道府縣病例數較前一週增加。 韓國疫情微幅上升,該國定醫通報數今年第35週上升至每千人13.3例,高於上週9.2例;病毒陽性率為12.3%,高於上週10%,主要以A(H1N1)pdm09型別為主。當局於9/4呼籲團體活動(包括兒童和學生)應遵守個人健康準則,⺠眾應勤洗手、佩戴口罩及接種疫苗等呼吸道防治措施。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic is rising: in week 35 of this year (24–30 August), 6,543 confirmed cases were reported, 1,347 more than the same period last year. The average reported per sentinel site was 1.76, 0.35 higher than last year, and 213 were hospitalised, up from 167 the previous week; cases aged 70 and over (108) accounted for 50.7%. Cases are mainly distributed in Okinawa Prefecture (8.5), Iwate Prefecture (4.33) and Niigata Prefecture (3.58); of Japan's 47 prefectures, 39 reported more cases than the previous week. South Korea's epidemic rose slightly: the sentinel physician reports of influenza-like illness (ILI) in week 35 rose to 13.3 per 1,000, up from 9.2 the previous week, and the virus positivity rate was 12.3%, up from 10% the previous week, mainly A(H1N1)pdm09. On 4 September the authorities called on group activities (including those involving children and students) to follow personal health guidelines, and urged the public to practise respiratory protection measures such as frequent hand washing, wearing masks and vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 中國-亞洲⻑角血蜱正內羅病毒(ALTNV)感染
items.headline_en: China – Asian longhorned tick orthonairovirus (ALTNV) infection
items.summary_zh: 中國3,163例蜱叮咬患者約10.4%檢出ALTNV,部分與SFTS共感染。
items.summary_en: China found Asian longhorned tick orthonairovirus (ALTNV) in about 10.4% of 3,163 patients with tick-bite histories, some co-infected with SFTS virus.
items.description_zh: 中國於3,163名有蜱叮咬史的患者中發現新的蜱媒病毒 ,約10.4% 個案檢出亞洲⻑角血蜱正內羅病毒(Asian longhorned ticknairovirus, ALTNV)之核酸或IgM抗體,感染者常見發燒、倦怠、腸胃道不適、血小板減少及肝功能異常等症狀,臨床表現與發熱伴血小板減少綜合徵(SFTS)相,該病毒亦自⻑角血蜱(H.longicornis )檢出,並在部分患者發現與SFTS病毒共同感染,其中38例共同感染者中有7例死亡。
items.description_en: China has identified a new tick-borne virus in 3,163 patients with a history of tick bites. About 10.4% of cases had detectable nucleic acid or IgM antibodies for Asian longhorned tick orthonairovirus (ALTNV). Infected people commonly present with fever, fatigue, gastrointestinal discomfort, thrombocytopenia and abnormal liver function, with clinical features resembling severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). The virus has also been detected in Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks, and co-infection with SFTS virus was found in some patients; of the 38 co-infected cases, 7 died.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉登革熱42,590例住院、117死,單日住院1,558例創今年新高。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported 42,590 hospitalised dengue cases and 117 deaths as of early September, with 1,558 hospitalised in one day, a yearly high.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情持續上升,今年截至9月初累計報告42,590例住院病例,其中117例死亡,疫情已擴散至全國64個行政區,9/6單日新增1,558例住院病例,達今年高峰,各地醫院病床不堪負荷。當局警告9月疫情將更為嚴峻,單月住院病例恐突破3萬例,評估疫情可能延燒至10月。同時該國現亦承受麻疹疫情壓力(今年累計近千名兒童死亡),醫療與公衛雙重壓力遽升。 美國佛羅里達州本土疫情持續升溫,今年截至8/29累計報告73 例本土確定病例,其中近一週新增32例,新增病例主要集中於坦帕灣(Tampa Bay area),以第2型血清型(DENV-2)為多。當局已啟動空中與地面聯合噴藥作業,進行成蚊撲滅與蚊子幼蟲防治,呼籲⺠眾落實個人防護與清除孳生源。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to rise: as of early September this year, 42,590 hospitalised cases and 117 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 64 districts nationwide, and on 6 September 1,558 hospitalised cases were added in a single day, the highest this year, with hospital beds across the country overloaded. Authorities warn that the epidemic will be more severe in September, with monthly hospitalisations possibly exceeding 30,000, and assess that it may continue into October. The country is also under pressure from a measles epidemic (nearly 1,000 children have died this year), placing a sharp dual burden on health and public health systems. In Florida, USA, locally acquired dengue continues to rise: as of 29 August this year, 73 locally acquired confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, 32 of them in the past week. New cases are concentrated in the Tampa Bay area, mainly serotype 2 (DENV-2). Authorities have launched joint aerial and ground spraying to kill adult mosquitoes and control larvae, and urge people to take personal protective measures and remove breeding sources.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 尼泊爾-大腸桿菌感染症等災後傳染病
items.headline_en: Nepal – Post-flood infectious disease risks (including E. coli infection)
items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾8/26山洪致數千人罹難失蹤,5處飲用水源遭大腸桿菌汙染。
items.summary_en: A flash flood on 26 August in Nepal's Rasuwa area killed or left missing thousands, and five drinking water sources are contaminated with E. coli.
items.description_zh: 泊爾拉蘇瓦(Rasuwa)地區於8/26爆發災難性山洪,已有數千人罹難及失蹤,努瓦科縣(Nuwakot)避難中亦已報告腹瀉與發燒病例,且有5處飲用水源遭大腸桿菌汙染。當局警告受汙染之飲用水極易導致霍亂、傷寒及A型/E型肝炎等腸道傳染病疫情,預計替10 萬名⺠眾接種霍亂疫苗、7.5萬名兒童接種麻疹及德國麻疹疫苗。WHO亦已緊急提供登革熱、瘧疾、恙蟲病、流感及鉤端螺旋體病等快篩試劑,以加強疫情監測。
items.description_en: A catastrophic flash flood struck the Rasuwa area of Nepal on 26 August; thousands of people have died or gone missing. In evacuation shelters in Nuwakot district, cases of diarrhoea and fever have also been reported, and five drinking water sources have been contaminated with E. coli. Authorities warn that contaminated drinking water can readily cause outbreaks of intestinal infections such as cholera, typhoid and hepatitis A and E. They plan to vaccinate 100,000 people against cholera and 75,000 children against measles and rubella. WHO has also urgently provided rapid test kits for dengue, malaria, scrub typhus, influenza and leptospirosis to strengthen outbreak surveillance.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘7月新增1,370例、7例死亡,非洲占74.8%,較6月降12.5%。
items.summary_en: Global mpox reported 1,370 confirmed cases and 7 deaths in July, with Africa accounting for 74.8% and cases down 12.5% from June.
items.description_zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
items.description_en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年40例人類新型A型流感,本週無新增;10國報告14起H5N1禽流感。
items.summary_en: Globally, 40 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year with none new this week; 10 countries reported 14 H5N1 avian outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週無新增。全球今年累計報告40例,分別為29例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,115起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共10國於2026/8/28-9/3期間報告14起H5N1疫情,為智利3 起、美國/荷蘭各2起、丹麥/保加利亞/南非/挪威/法國/紐西蘭/臺灣各1起。 ○ 共1國於2026/8/27-2026/8/27期間報告1起H7N3疫情,墨西哥1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: no new cases this week. Globally, 40 cases have been reported this year: 29 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,115 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. A total of 10 countries reported 14 H5N1 outbreaks during 28 August–3 September 2026: 3 in Chile, 2 each in the United States and the Netherlands, and one each in Denmark, Bulgaria, South Africa, Norway, France, New Zealand and Taiwan. One country, Mexico, reported 1 H7N3 outbreak on 27 August 2026.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉麻疹逾16.3萬例疑病例、1.9萬例確定,至少991名幼童死亡。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh's measles outbreak has reached over 163,000 suspected and 19,000 confirmed cases since March, with at least 991 children dead.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉持續發生大規模疫情,自今年3月中旬以來累計逾16.3萬例疑病例、1.9萬例確定病例,並導致至少991名幼童染疫死亡。當局已啟動大規模疫苗接種,惟病例數仍持續上升,近期每日仍新增約800至1,100例疑病例。
items.description_en: Bangladesh continues to experience a large-scale epidemic. Since mid-March this year, more than 163,000 suspected cases and 19,000 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, and at least 991 young children have died from infection. Authorities have launched large-scale vaccination, but case numbers continue to rise; recently, about 800 to 1,100 new suspected cases are still being added each day.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第32週陽性率1.28%,歐洲及美洲上升;韓國第35週陽性率11.3%。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 1.28% in week 32 and rising in Europe and the Americas; South Korea's positivity was 11.3% in week 35.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第32週(8/10-8/16)為1.28%,歐洲及美洲區呈上升趨勢;近期全球流行變異株占比以NB.1.8.1、PQ.16.1.1、XFG及JN.1為主。 中國疫情下降,第35週(8/24-30)門急診陽性率為15.8%,其中以0-4歲及15-59歲族群檢測陽性率較高;變異株占比以NB.1.8.1 為主。 香港疫情持續下降,第35週陽性率1.06%,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16.1.1(97.6%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(1.7%)、XFG(0.6%)及JN.1(0.1%)。 韓國疫情上升,第35週陽性率為11.3%,新增109例住院,變異株占比以BA.3.2(50.0%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(22.8%)、PQ.16.1.1(18.2%)及RF.5(6.7%) 。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 32 of this year (10–16 August) was 1.28%, with upward trends in Europe and the Americas; the variants with the largest shares globally are mainly NB.1.8.1, PQ.16.1.1, XFG and JN.1. China's epidemic is declining; in week 35 (24–30 August), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 15.8%, with higher positivity among people aged 0–4 and 15–59; the variant share is mainly NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong's epidemic continues to decline; the week 35 positivity rate was 1.06%, and wastewater surveillance shows variants are mainly PQ.16.1.1 (97.6%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (1.7%), XFG (0.6%) and JN.1 (0.1%). South Korea's epidemic is rising; the week 35 positivity rate was 11.3%, with 109 new hospitalisations, and variants are mainly BA.3.2 (50.0%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (22.8%), PQ.16.1.1 (18.2%) and RF.5 (6.7%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區,韓國

items.summary_zh: 美國東北部四州7至8月報告4件動物狂犬病,未見人類次級感染。
items.summary_en: Four northeastern US states reported animal rabies cases in July and August, with no secondary human infections.
items.description_zh: 美國東北部紐約州、紐澤西州、賓夕法亞州及馬里蘭州於2026 年7月底至8月下旬分別報告蝙蝠、土撥鼠、郊狼及浣熊等4件動物狂犬病案例。各事件地理上彼此分散,無流行病學關聯,均已進行動物處置、接觸者調查及暴露後預防接種措施,未報告次級傳播人類感染事件,當局呼籲遭動物抓咬傷者應儘速就醫評估。
items.description_en: In late July to late August 2026, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Maryland in the north-eastern United States each reported animal rabies cases, involving bats, groundhogs, coyotes and raccoons, four cases in total. The events are geographically dispersed and epidemiologically unrelated. Animal control measures, contact investigations and post-exposure prophylaxis have been carried out in each case; no secondary human infection has been reported. Authorities urge anyone bitten or scratched by an animal to seek medical assessment promptly.

items.summary_zh: 拉脫維亞今年截至9/1確定兔熱病17例,全數住院,已超過去年全年11例。
items.summary_en: Latvia has reported 17 tularaemia cases this year as of 1 September, all hospitalised, already above the 11 cases recorded for all of 2025.
items.description_zh: 拉脫維亞今年截至9/1累計報告17例確定病例,所有病患均住院接受治療。此病例數高於去(2025)年11例,更為過去10年(2015至2024年)總數7例之2.4倍。病例分布於全國5個地區,並以中南部澤姆加爾 (Zemgale)及里加(Riga)為多,患者以中年男性為主(71%)。專家推測洪災頻繁,衍生囓齒類動物及蚊蜱病媒增加 ,導致⺠眾進行戶外活動時 ,暴露風險增加。未經治療個案致死率可達15%,當局呼籲⺠眾加強個人防護。
items.description_en: Latvia has reported 17 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 1 September, and all patients were hospitalised for treatment. This is higher than the 11 cases for all of last year (2025), and 2.4 times the total of 7 cases over the past decade (2015–2024). Cases are distributed across five regions of the country, mainly Zemgale in the centre-south and Riga, and patients are mainly middle-aged men (71%). Experts suspect that frequent flooding has increased rodents and mosquito and tick vectors, raising exposure risk for people engaged in outdoor activities. The case fatality rate for untreated cases can reach 15%, and authorities urge people to strengthen personal protection.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增64例伊波拉確定病例,累計6,250例、死亡3,039例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 64 new confirmed Ebola cases on 1 September, bringing the total to 6,250 cases and 3,039 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/1新增64例確定病例,其中25例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(39例)、北基伍省(20例)、上韋萊省(4例)及喬波省(1例)。迄9/1累計6,250例確定病例(3,039例死亡、1,439例康復),致死率48.6%,疫情分佈於6個省份(60個衛生區)。 目前核准Ervebo疫苗主要針對Zaire ebola virus,其對Bundibugyo ebola virus之保護效力尚未確定,WHO目前不支持Ervebo作為BDBV常規防疫疫苗, 建議僅能在研究計畫或臨床研究架構下使用,不應取代接觸者追蹤、感染管制及安全埋葬等既有疫情控制措施。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 1 September, 64 new confirmed cases were added, including 25 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (39), North Kivu Province (20), Haut-Uele Province (4) and Tshopo Province (1). As of 1 September, a cumulative 6,250 confirmed cases have been reported (3,039 deaths, 1,439 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak is distributed across 6 provinces (60 health zones). The Ervebo vaccine is currently approved mainly for Zaire ebolavirus, and its protective efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus has not been established. WHO does not currently support Ervebo as a routine vaccine for BDBV, and recommends its use only within research protocols or clinical study frameworks; it should not replace existing outbreak control measures such as contact tracing, infection control and safe burials.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: cVDPV2新增7例(剛果民主共和國5例、奈及利亞2例)。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 7 cVDPV2 polio cases in two countries during 20–26 August, five in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and two in Nigeria.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/20-26期間,cVDPV2 新增2國共7例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國5例、奈及利亞2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增阿富汗18件。
items.description_en: The GPEI reported that during 20–26 August, cVDPV2 added 7 cases in two countries: 5 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 2 in Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 18 detections in Afghanistan.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 越南今年8月中旬腸病毒近10萬例,為去年同期2.5倍,南部以腸病毒71型為主。
items.summary_en: Viet Nam reported nearly 100,000 enterovirus cases by mid-August, 2.5 times the same period last year; EV71 made up 56% of southern positive specimens.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情上升,今年截至8月中旬累計報告近10萬例病例,為去年同期的2.5倍,近期每週新增逾3,000例,疫情多集中於南部省份與大城市。腸病毒71型占南部地區陽性檢體的56%,且今年轉為C1基因型為主。因適逢開學季,當局加強宣導、推動環境清消與手部衛生。另當局已於今年3月核准腸病毒71型疫苗,規劃於今年底前替2個月至6歲以下兒童施打疫苗。
items.description_en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising: as of mid-August this year, nearly 100,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, 2.5 times the same period last year. Recently more than 3,000 cases have been added each week, with cases concentrated in southern provinces and large cities. Enterovirus 71 accounted for 56% of positive specimens in the southern region, and this year the predominant genotype has shifted to C1. As the school year has started, authorities have strengthened communication, promoted environmental disinfection and hand hygiene. Authorities approved an EV71 vaccine in March this year and plan to vaccinate children aged 2 months to under 6 years by the end of this year.

items.summary_zh: 印度估計2023年490萬例傷寒、7,850例死亡,82%住院病例具抗藥性。
items.summary_en: A study estimates India had 4.9 million typhoid cases in 2023, with 7,850 deaths; 82% of hospitalised cases showed fluoroquinolone resistance.
items.description_zh: 最新研究公布印度2023年估計有490萬例病例,其中73萬例住院、7,850例死亡,9歲以下兒童住院及死亡風險最高,82%住院病例產生氟喹諾酮類(Fluoroquinolone)抗生素抗藥性,抗藥性菌株已成為住院與死亡主因。故WHO於8/14調整傷寒疫苗接種指引,建議加強高風險兒童之保護及施打疫苗追加劑。
items.description_en: A recent study estimates that India had 4.9 million typhoid cases in 2023, of which 730,000 were hospitalised and 7,850 died. Children under 9 have the highest risk of hospitalisation and death. 82% of hospitalised cases showed resistance to fluoroquinolone antibiotics, and resistant strains have become a leading cause of hospitalisation and death. WHO therefore updated its typhoid vaccination guidance on 14 August, recommending stronger protection for high-risk children and booster doses.

items.summary_zh: 英國最大沙門氏菌群聚截至8/28累計474例、1例死亡,疑與進口雞蛋有關。
items.summary_en: The largest of three UK Salmonella outbreaks has reached 474 confirmed cases and one death as of 28 August, possibly linked to imported eggs.
items.description_zh: 英國爆發3起群聚事件,其中最大規模群聚事件截至8/28累計報告474例確定病例,其中1例死亡。本次疫情呈現罕見的大規模且同一時間感染之趨勢,疑感染源為餐飲業、學校及養老院等通路使用之進口雞蛋,當局評估在供應鏈未溯源確認前,疫情將持續攀升,呼籲⺠眾外食應避免半熟或生蛋料理。
items.description_en: The UK has had three outbreak clusters; the largest had cumulatively reported 474 confirmed cases as of 28 August, including one death. This outbreak shows a rare pattern of large numbers of infections occurring at the same time. The suspected source is imported eggs used by channels such as food-service businesses, schools and care homes for the elderly. Authorities assess that cases will continue to rise until the supply chain is traced and confirmed, and urge people eating out to avoid half-cooked or raw egg dishes.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 英國2025年梨形鞭毛蟲病6,069例,為2016年以來最高。
items.summary_en: The UK recorded 6,069 giardiasis cases in 2025, the highest since 2016 and above 2024's 5,450; London accounted for 1,568.
items.description_zh: 英國2025年報告6,069例病例,高於2024年疫情(5,450例),且為2016年以來最高,分布以倫敦為多(1,568例)。近年疫情上升除與檢驗技術進步,提高敏感度外,國際旅遊復甦、氣候變遷亦為可能因素。當局提醒旅客應食用熟食及避免飲用未煮沸自來水,以降低感染風險。
items.description_en: The UK reported 6,069 cases in 2025, higher than the 5,450 cases in 2024 and the highest since 2016; London accounted for the most (1,568 cases). Besides improved test sensitivity, the recovery of international travel and climate change are also possible factors in the recent rise. Authorities remind travellers to eat cooked food and avoid drinking untreated tap water to reduce the risk of infection.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 奧地利林茲7/20–8/27退伍軍人病31例確定、3例死亡,冷卻水塔已消毒。
items.summary_en: Linz, Austria reported 31 Legionnaires' cases and 3 deaths from 20 July to 27 August; cooling towers that tested positive have been cleaned and disinfected.
items.description_zh: 奧地利今年8/27報告東北部林茲(Linz)7/20-8/27期間,累積報告31例確定病例、3例死亡,其中有4例住院,針對檢出陽性之冷卻水塔,已進行清潔及消毒,感染源仍待釐清調查中。
items.description_en: On 27 August this year, Austria reported that in Linz in the north-east, 31 confirmed cases and 3 deaths had been cumulatively reported for 20 July–27 August, of whom 4 were hospitalised. Cooling towers that tested positive have been cleaned and disinfected; the source of infection remains under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 南非今年麻疹3,891例,1–14歲佔7成;秘魯1,747例,當局發布警報。
items.summary_en: South Africa reported 3,891 measles cases this year as of 16 August, 70% in children aged 1–14; Peru has 1,747 cases and issued an alert.
items.description_zh: 南非今年截至8/16(第33週),累計報告3,891例確定病例,較上週增加144例,1-14歲兒童佔總病例數之70%,新增病例以西開普省38例為多,其次為林波波省30例及北開普省20例;疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為主要因素,1歲以下未接種疫苗比例從2017年12.1%上升至2026年36.3%,該國優先針對未接種疫苗或尚未完整接種之兒童進行補接種作業。 秘魯今年截至第33週報告1,747例確定病例,其中以普諾地區(1,264例)為多,由於病例數增加,該國衛生部發佈流行病學警報,針對醫療機構加強流行病學監測及早期發現,並在受影響地區採取防治措施。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/8(第31週),計17個國家/地區累積報告48,690例確定病例及51例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4倍,97%病例來自瓜地馬拉(31,140例)、墨西哥(12,479例)、美國(2,465例)及加拿大(1,114例),部分國家通報延遲,研判疫情可能低估。
items.description_en: South Africa: as of 16 August this year (week 33), 3,891 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of 144 over the previous week; children aged 1–14 account for 70% of total cases. The largest numbers of new cases are in Western Cape (38), followed by Limpopo (30) and Northern Cape (20). Insufficient vaccination coverage is the main factor: the proportion of unvaccinated children under 1 year old rose from 12.1% in 2017 to 36.3% in 2026. The country is prioritising catch-up vaccination for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated children. Peru: as of week 33 this year, 1,747 confirmed cases have been reported, mainly in the Puno region (1,264 cases). Because case numbers are rising, the Ministry of Health has issued an epidemiological alert, strengthening surveillance and early detection in healthcare facilities and taking control measures in affected areas. Americas regional update: as of 8 August this year (week 31), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 48,690 confirmed cases and 51 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about four times the number in the same period last year; 97% of cases came from Guatemala (31,140), Mexico (12,479), the United States (2,465) and Canada (1,114). Because some countries reported with delays, the outbreak is likely underestimated.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,瓜地馬拉,墨西哥,秘魯,南非,美國

items.summary_zh: 義大利巴勒摩未接種疫苗的4歲童死於白喉,另1例疑病例為其表親。
items.summary_en: Italy reported a diphtheria death in an unvaccinated 4-year-old in Palermo, Sicily; a suspected case in the child's cousin has been hospitalised.
items.description_zh: 歐洲報告1例義大利西西里島巴勒摩(Palermo)4歲兒童死亡案例,該童未接種疫苗,於8/10-11出現發燒、食慾不振、嘔吐等症狀,8/15出現高燒及呼吸困難,住院接受治療,8/20死亡。該國衛生研究院(Istituto Superiore di Sanità,ISS)於8/25檢驗出白喉棒狀桿菌,其後報告第2例疑病例,為指標病例之4歲表親,症狀較輕,已住院治療。ECDC評估歐盟地區整體疫苗覆蓋率高,傳播機率風險低,然而疫苗接種率低之弱勢族群仍可能出現散發病例,ECDC將持續監測此事件及追蹤接觸者。
items.description_en: A death has been reported in Europe of a 4-year-old unvaccinated child in Palermo, Sicily, Italy. The child developed fever, poor appetite and vomiting on 10–11 August, high fever and breathing difficulties on 15 August, was hospitalised for treatment, and died on 20 August. On 25 August, Italy's National Institute of Health (Istituto Superiore di Sanità, ISS) detected Corynebacterium diphtheriae. A second suspected case was subsequently reported, a 4-year-old cousin of the index case with milder symptoms, who has been hospitalised for treatment. ECDC assesses that overall vaccination coverage in the EU is high and the risk of transmission is low; however, sporadic cases may still occur among vulnerable groups with low vaccination rates, and ECDC will continue to monitor the event and trace contacts.

items.summary_zh: 日本8/28進入流行期,第34週確定病例4,094例,多於去年同期1,183例。
items.summary_en: Japan declared a nationwide influenza epidemic period on 28 August; week 34 saw 4,094 confirmed cases, 1,183 more than the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情上升,厚生勞動省8/28宣布全國進入流行期,今年第34週(8/17-23)報告4,094例確定病例(高於去年同期1,183例),定醫平均報告1.11例(高於去年同期0.31),住院167例,較上週(120例)增加,其中以70歲以上(84例)佔50%為主。主要分佈地區為沖繩縣(4.43)、岩手縣(2.1)及青森縣(2.08)等地,該國呼籲⺠眾勤洗手、戴口罩及施打疫苗等落實基本防護措施。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic is rising. On 28 August the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare declared that the whole country had entered the epidemic period. In week 34 of this year (17–23 August), 4,094 confirmed cases were reported, 1,183 more than the same period last year; the average per sentinel site was 1.11, 0.31 higher than last year, and 167 were hospitalised, up from 120 the previous week; cases aged 70 and over (84) accounted for 50%. The main distribution is in Okinawa Prefecture (4.43), Iwate Prefecture (2.1) and Aomori Prefecture (2.08). Authorities urge people to practise basic protective measures such as frequent hand washing, wearing masks and vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年截至8/22疑似茲卡11,017例、確定537例,占美洲病例75%。
items.summary_en: Brazil reported 11,017 suspected Zika cases and 537 confirmed as of 22 August, accounting for 75% of reported cases in the Americas.
items.description_zh: 巴西今年截至8/22累計報告1萬1,017例疑病例,其中537例為確定病例,為美洲疫情最高(占報告病例75%)。針對2015-16年大規模疫情⻑期追蹤顯示,當時逾3,000名嬰兒因母子垂直感染,迄今至少444名病童死亡。現年約10歲的倖存病童正浮現第二波併發症,98%倖存病童出現骨骼畸形,伴隨小兒性早熟、自閉症及神經發育遲緩等,致該族群死亡率攀升。研究顯示10年前疫情後的群體免疫力已大幅衰退,未曾暴露的新生代增加,加上仍無疫苗及快篩工具,該國未來15至20年內恐爆發新一波疫情。
items.description_en: As of 22 August this year, Brazil has cumulatively reported 11,017 suspected cases, of which 537 are confirmed; this is the highest in the Americas, accounting for 75% of reported cases. Long-term follow-up of the large-scale outbreak in 2015–16 shows that more than 3,000 infants were infected through mother-to-child transmission at that time, and at least 444 affected children have died to date. Surviving children, now about 10 years old, are showing a second wave of complications: 98% of surviving children have skeletal malformations, accompanied by precocious puberty, autism and neurodevelopmental delay, and mortality in this group is rising. Studies show that population immunity has declined substantially a decade after the earlier outbreak and that the number of unexposed younger people has increased; with still no vaccine or rapid test tools, the country may face a new wave of outbreaks within the next 15 to 20 years.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓屈公病今年849例疑似、52例確定,較去年同期增36%,第八區超流行閾。
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 849 suspected and 52 confirmed chikungunya cases this year as of 22 August, 36% above the same period last year; Region VIII exceeds the epidemic threshold.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,今年截至8/22累計報告849例疑病例及52例確定病例,較去年同期(662例)增加36%。其中第八行政區今年累計報告405例,遠高於去年6例,疫情已超越流行閾。
items.description_en: The Philippines' epidemic is rising: as of 22 August this year, 849 suspected cases and 52 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, 36% more than the 662 cases in the same period last year. Region VIII reported 405 cases cumulatively this year, far above 6 cases last year, and the epidemic has exceeded the epidemic threshold.

items.headline_zh: 菲律賓/馬來西亞/印度/歐洲-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓宿霧省2,324例登革熱、17死;馬來西亞逾6.2萬例、60死,疫情上升。
items.summary_en: Cebu, Philippines reported 2,324 dengue cases and 17 deaths; Malaysia has over 62,000 cases and 60 deaths, with rising outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓宿霧省(Cebu)疫情上升,今年截至8/18累計報告2,324例病例,其中17例死亡,自7月進入雨季以來積水增加,致疫情顯著上升;鄰近之薄荷省(Bohol)亦爆發疫情,今年截至8/22累計報告1,883例病例,較去年同期增加7%,已至少20例死亡,致死率(CFR:1.17%)已超過該國設定之流行閾(1%),且全省12 個行政區已連續3週逾流行閾,疫情以塔利邦(Talibon)、塔比拉蘭(Tagbilaran City)及烏拜(Ubay)最為嚴重,當局已宣佈進入疫情警示。 馬來西亞疫情快速上升,今年迄今累計報告逾6.2萬例病例,其中60例死亡,疫情較去年同期增加60%。當局已啟動應變中,於吉隆坡與雪蘭莪州(Selangor )等熱點部署,擴大釋放沃爾巴克氏菌(Wolbachia)轉染的蚊子以進行生物防治,並進行登革熱疫苗成本效益分析,評估可能納入國家常規疫苗接種計畫。 印度今年截至7月累計報告3萬3,060例病例,與去年同期相當,其中7月新增1萬122例,較6月增加53%。該國病例通常於每年5-6月(季風雨季開始)呈現上升趨勢,並在9-10月達到全年高峰。 歐洲今年截至8/5僅有法國報告4例本土病例。研究顯示因為氣候變遷因素,2015-24年歐洲的疫情發生風險,為1982-2010年的3倍。
items.description_en: In Cebu Province, Philippines, dengue is rising: as of 18 August this year, 2,324 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17 deaths; standing water has increased since the rainy season began in July, causing a marked rise. Neighbouring Bohol Province has also had an outbreak: as of 22 August this year, 1,883 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7% more than the same period last year, with at least 20 deaths. The case fatality rate (1.17%) exceeds the country's epidemic threshold (1%), and 12 administrative areas across the province have exceeded the threshold for three consecutive weeks; the outbreak is most serious in Talibon, Tagbilaran City and Ubay. Authorities have declared an outbreak alert. Malaysia's outbreak is rising rapidly: as of this year, more than 62,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 60 deaths, 60% more than the same period last year. Authorities have activated a response and are deploying hotspot measures in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, expanding the release of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes for biological control, and conducting a cost-effectiveness analysis of a dengue vaccine to assess whether it could be included in the national routine vaccination programme. India reported 33,060 cases cumulatively through July this year, similar to the same period last year; 10,122 were added in July, 53% more than in June. Cases in India usually rise from May to June, at the start of the monsoon rains, and reach an annual peak in September–October. In Europe, as of 5 August this year, only France had reported 4 locally acquired cases. Studies show that climate change has made the risk of dengue outbreaks in Europe during 2015–24 three times that of 1982–2010.
items.area_zh: 法國,印度,馬來西亞,菲律賓

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年40例人類新型A型流感,本週新增1例;67國家/地區通報禽流感。
items.summary_en: Globally, 40 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year, with 1 new this week; 67 countries reported avian influenza.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週新增1例。全球今年累計報告40例,分別為29例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,100起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共4國於2026/8/24-26期間報告5起H5N1疫情,為挪威2 起、丹麥/英國/葡萄牙各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: 1 new case this week. Globally, 40 cases have been reported this year: 29 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,100 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. A total of 4 countries reported 5 H5N1 outbreaks during 24–26 August 2026: 2 in Norway, and one each in Denmark, the United Kingdom and Portugal.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.summary_zh: WHO宣布烏干達伊波拉疫情結束,累計20例確定、2例死亡,疾管署調降旅遊等級。
items.summary_en: WHO declared Uganda's Ebola outbreak over; 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, and Taiwan CDC lowered its travel advisory.
items.description_zh: WHO正式宣布烏干達伊波拉疫情(Bundibugyo virus )結束。該國最後1例境外移入病例於7/16出院後,持續監測至8/27,已連續42天無新增病例。此波疫情累計20例確定病例,其中15例為自剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)境外移入,另5例為與境外移入病例相關之接觸者及醫療人員本土感染;共18例康復、2例死亡,並追蹤逾800名接觸者。本署已於8/28將該國旅遊疫情建議等級調降為「無等級」。
items.description_en: WHO has officially declared the end of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in Uganda. The country's last imported case was discharged on 16 July, and monitoring continued until 27 August, with 42 consecutive days without new cases. This outbreak recorded 20 confirmed cases cumulatively: 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 5 local infections among contacts of imported cases and health workers; 18 recovered, 2 died, and more than 800 contacts were followed. Taiwan CDC lowered the travel advisory level for Uganda to 'no level' on 28 August.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第31週陽性率1.29%,歐美上升;中國第34週門急診陽性率19.5%。
items.summary_en: COVID-19 positivity was 1.29% globally in week 31, rising in Europe and the Americas; China's outpatient positivity reached 19.5% in week 34.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第31週(8/3-8/9)為1.29%,歐洲及美洲區呈上升或微幅上升趨勢;近期全球流行變異株占比以NB.1.8.1、PQ.16.1.1、XFG及JN.1為主。 中國疫情下降,第34週(8/17-23)門急診陽性率為19.5%,為陽性率最高的呼吸道病原體;變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情持續下降,第34週陽性率2.03%,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16(包括PQ.16.1.1)77.3%為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(16%) 、JN.1(3.3%)及XFG(1.6%) 。 韓國疫情上升,第34週陽性率為11.3%,新增61例住院,變異株占比以BA.3.2(50.0%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(22.8%)、PQ.16.1.1(18.2%)及RF.5(6.7%) 。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 31 of this year (3–9 August) was 1.29%, with upward or slightly upward trends in Europe and the Americas; the variants with the largest shares globally are mainly NB.1.8.1, PQ.16.1.1, XFG and JN.1. China's epidemic is declining; in week 34 (17–23 August), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 19.5%, the highest of any respiratory pathogen; the variant share is mainly NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong's epidemic continues to decline; the week 34 positivity rate was 2.03%, and wastewater surveillance shows variants are mainly PQ.16 (including PQ.16.1.1) at 77.3%, followed by NB.1.8.1 (16%), JN.1 (3.3%) and XFG (1.6%). South Korea's epidemic is rising; the week 34 positivity rate was 11.3%, with 61 new hospitalisations, and variants are mainly BA.3.2 (50.0%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (22.8%), PQ.16.1.1 (18.2%) and RF.5 (6.7%).

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 美國-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_en: United States – Primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (Naegleria fowleri)
items.summary_zh: 美國路易斯安那州7歲童游泳感染福氏內格里阿米巴,為該州1937年來第4例。
items.summary_en: Louisiana reported a rare Naegleria fowleri infection in a 7-year-old child who swam in Lake Claiborne; it is the state's fourth case since 1937.
items.description_zh: 美國路易斯安那州報告1例罕見確定病例,病患為7歲兒童,於克萊本湖游泳後感染並住院治療。該病原體常存在夏季溫暖淡水中,所引發腦膜腦炎症狀進展快速,致死率逾97%以上,惟未具人傳人能力,整體人群感染風險極低,此案為該州自1937年以來第4例個案。該國於1937-2025年間計180例病例,每年確定病例約0至8例。當局提醒⺠眾戲水時,應避免將頭部浸入水中及攪動淺水區之底部泥沙,以降低感染風險。
items.description_en: Louisiana, USA, has reported one rare confirmed case in a 7-year-old child, who was infected after swimming in Lake Claiborne and was hospitalised for treatment. The pathogen is commonly found in warm fresh water in summer. The meningoencephalitis it causes progresses rapidly, with a case fatality rate above 97%, but it cannot spread from person to person, so the overall risk of infection in the population is extremely low. This is the fourth case in the state since 1937. Nationally, 180 cases were recorded during 1937–2025, with about 0 to 8 confirmed cases per year. Authorities remind people to avoid submerging their heads in water and to avoid stirring up sediment at the bottom of shallow water when swimming, to reduce the risk of infection.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓截至8/17鉤端螺旋體病3,760例,奎松市兩週增62例、5例死亡。
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 3,760 leptospirosis cases as of 17 August; Quezon City added 62 cases and 5 deaths in two weeks.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓受降雨影響,該國衛生部截至8/17累計報告 3,760例確定病例,低於去年同期,其中以奎松市最為嚴峻,兩週內爆增62例病例及5例死亡,高達71%為男性(44例),多為司機、保全、清潔工及外送員等環境涉水者。目前大馬拉都會區(Metro Manila)多家大型醫院滿床,被迫限制非緊急收治。當局呼籲涉水⺠眾應穿戴防護、及早投藥預防,出現疑症狀應儘速就醫。
items.description_en: The Philippines is affected by heavy rainfall. The Department of Health reported 3,760 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 17 August, lower than the same period last year. Quezon City is the most serious, with 62 cases and 5 deaths added in two weeks; 71% of cases were male (44), mostly people working in water-exposed environments such as drivers, security guards, cleaners and delivery riders. Many large hospitals in Metro Manila are currently full, and some have been forced to restrict non-emergency admissions. Authorities urge people who wade through water to wear protective equipment and take preventive medication early, and to seek medical care promptly if they develop suspicious symptoms.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘自2022年累計188,847例、521例死亡,馬達加斯加疫情全球最大。
items.summary_en: Mpox has reached 188,847 confirmed cases and 521 deaths globally since 2022; Madagascar hosts the world's largest clade Ib outbreak.
items.description_zh: 全球自2022年迄2026年6月底,共145個國家/地區累計報告188,847例確定病例及521例死亡,致死率約0.3%。目前疫情風險主要集中於非洲,馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發目前全球最大規模疫情,已有61%行政區受影響,近期檢驗陽性率達74%,疫情尚未獲控制;剛果⺠主共和國則持續有Clade Ia及Ib共同流行,惟監測及檢驗量能下降,可能低估實際疫情規模;巴基斯坦年初發生Clade Ib院內群聚,34例確定病例中有8例嬰幼兒死亡。另全球於英國、印度及卡達發現3例Clade Ib/IIb重組病毒株,目前尚無證據顯示其傳播力或疾病嚴重度增加,仍須持續監測。WHO評估維持全球風險為中,主要以高風險性行為族群傳播為主,該族群風險為中,一般大眾則為低。
items.description_en: Globally, from 2022 to the end of June 2026, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 188,847 confirmed cases and 521 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 0.3%. Current risk is concentrated mainly in Africa. Madagascar has been experiencing the world's largest current outbreak since December 2025; 61% of its administrative areas have been affected, the recent test positivity rate has reached 74%, and the outbreak is not yet under control. The DRC continues to see co-circulation of clade Ia and Ib, but declining surveillance and testing capacity may underestimate the actual scale of the outbreak. Pakistan had a clade Ib hospital cluster early this year, in which 8 of 34 confirmed cases were infants and young children who died. In addition, 3 recombinant clade Ib/IIb virus strains have been found in the United Kingdom, India and Qatar; there is currently no evidence that transmissibility or disease severity has increased, but monitoring must continue. WHO assesses the global risk as moderate. Transmission is mainly within high-risk sexual networks, where the risk is moderate; for the general public, the risk is low.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增57例伊波拉確定病例,累計5,713例、死亡2,744例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 57 new confirmed Ebola cases on 25 August, bringing the total to 5,713 cases and 2,744 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/25新增57例確定病例,其中11例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(34例)、北基伍省(18例)、上韋萊省(5例)。迄8/25累計5,713例確定病例(2,744例死亡、1,269例康復),致死率48.0%,疫情分佈於6個省份(58個衛生區)。 DRC伊圖里省逾80%新感染個案未在接觸者名單內,約60%調查後仍無流行病學關聯,近三分之二死亡病例發生於治療中之外,增加社區環境暴露與葬禮感染之風險。另確定病例中女性占53%,以18‒49歲最多,推估可能與承擔醫療照護及準備葬禮等暴露有關。WHO與非洲CDC已緊急宣布分配7萬劑Ervebo 疫苗(原用於薩伊株伊波拉),其中5萬劑將提供第一線醫療人員使用,另2萬劑則投入第三期臨床試驗,以評估其對邦迪布焦病毒的防護效果。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 25 August, 57 new confirmed cases were added, including 11 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (34), North Kivu Province (18) and Haut-Uele Province (5). As of 25 August, a cumulative 5,713 confirmed cases have been reported (2,744 deaths, 1,269 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.0%; the outbreak is distributed across 6 provinces (58 health zones). More than 80% of new infections in Ituri Province were not on contact lists, and about 60% remain without an epidemiological link after investigation. Nearly two-thirds of deaths occurred outside of treatment, increasing the risk of community and funeral-related infection. Women account for 53% of confirmed cases, most of them aged 18–49, which may be linked to exposure through caring for patients and preparing funerals. WHO and Africa CDC have announced the urgent allocation of 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine (originally used for the Zaire strain of Ebola): 50,000 doses will go to frontline health workers, and 20,000 doses will be used in a Phase III clinical trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo virus.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: WHO續認定小兒麻痺仍為PHEIC;非洲5國cVDPV2疫情終止。
items.summary_en: The WHO polio committee kept polio a PHEIC and declared cVDPV2 outbreaks over in five African countries, including Uganda and Ghana.
items.description_zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
items.description_en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲2025年5月至今年8月341例沙門氏菌,英國207例,疑與進口雞蛋有關。
items.summary_en: Europe reported 341 Salmonella cases from May 2025 to August this year, with 207 in the UK, where imported eggs are the suspected source.
items.description_zh: 歐洲疫情更新,自去(2025)年5月迄今年8月累計報告341例確定病例,其中至少34例住院,疫情自5月起顯著上升(新增152例),病患分布於英國(207例)、荷蘭(106例)、比利時(15例)、德國(6 例)等7國,英國研判疑感染源為進口雞蛋,荷蘭懷疑感染源為雞肉。全基因定序顯示,本次菌株與2025年於荷蘭通報之雞蛋與家禽疫情相關。
items.description_en: Europe update: from May 2025 to August this year, 341 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, of which at least 34 were hospitalised. The outbreak has risen markedly since May (152 new cases), with patients distributed across seven countries, including the UK (207 cases), the Netherlands (106), Belgium (15) and Germany (6). The UK suspects imported eggs as the source of infection, and the Netherlands suspects chicken meat. Whole-genome sequencing shows that this strain is related to egg and poultry outbreaks reported in the Netherlands in 2025.
items.area_en: Belgium,Germany,Netherlands,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.disease_zh: 沙門氏菌感染症,桿菌性痢疾
items.headline_zh: 美國-桿菌性痢疾/沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 美國15州5/31–8/8相關感染55例,76%病例曾食用苜蓿芽,已要求下架。
items.summary_en: 15 US states reported 55 illnesses linked to alfalfa sprouts from 31 May to 8 August; 76% of cases ate them, and the product was ordered off the market.
items.description_zh: 美國今年5/31-8/8累計15個州報告55 例與疫情相關疾病,包括46 例桿菌性痢疾病例、7例沙門氏菌感染症病例及2例混合感染,其中4例住院,76%病例發病前曾食用苜蓿芽,經調查感染源為明蘇達州某生產商經銷之苜蓿芽,本事件在流行病學上屬罕見,單一食品涉及3種產志賀毒素大腸桿菌(STEC)型別及1種沙門氏菌株,當局已要求產品下架並擴大檢測。
items.description_en: From 31 May to 8 August this year, 15 US states reported 55 illnesses linked to this outbreak, including 46 shigellosis cases, 7 Salmonella infection cases and 2 mixed infections; 4 were hospitalised. 76% of cases had eaten alfalfa sprouts before onset. Investigation identified the source as alfalfa sprouts distributed by a producer in Minnesota. The event is epidemiologically rare: a single food was linked to three types of Shiga toxin-producing E. coli (STEC) and one Salmonella strain. Authorities have ordered the product removed from sale and expanded testing.

items.summary_zh: 美國賓州麻疹393例、2例死亡(均未接種),為該州1991年來首例死亡。
items.summary_en: Pennsylvania reported 393 measles cases and 2 unvaccinated deaths this year as of 24 August, its first measles deaths since 1991.
items.description_zh: 美國賓州今年截至8/24累計報告393例確定病例(過去7天新增86 例)、2例死亡(均未接種疫苗),為該州自1991年來首次出現相關死亡病例;為因應此波疫情,該州衛生部計劃增設臨時疫苗診所加強接種。另該國疫情持續,今年截至8/20累計47州/地區報告2,777例確定病例(含16例境外移入),66%為19歲以下兒童及青年,94%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明,7%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例)為多,兒童疫苗接種率自2019-20年之95.2%下降到2025-26年92.4%。
items.description_en: Pennsylvania, USA, has reported 393 confirmed cases this year as of 24 August (86 added in the past seven days) and 2 deaths, both unvaccinated; these are the first measles deaths in the state since 1991. In response, the state health department plans to add temporary vaccination clinics. Nationally, the outbreak continues: as of 20 August this year, 2,777 confirmed cases (including 16 imported cases) had been reported cumulatively across 47 states and jurisdictions. 66% were children and young people aged 19 and under, 94% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 7% of patients were hospitalised. The largest numbers are in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Childhood vaccination coverage has fallen from 95.2% in 2019–20 to 92.4% in 2025–26.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大多倫多退伍軍人病截至目前6例確定,7/2–26間出現症狀,正調查感染源。
items.summary_en: Toronto, Canada has reported 6 Legionnaires' disease cases with symptoms in 2–26 July; sampling is under way to find the source.
items.description_zh: 加拿大多倫多截至目前報告6例確定病例,於7/2-26期間出現症狀,主要為居住、工作或造訪該區之人員,衛生機構透過環境採樣進行可能感染源調查,並實施預防性防治措施,包含通知醫療機構協助識別可能潛在之病例。
items.description_en: Toronto, Canada, has reported 6 confirmed cases to date, with symptoms appearing between 2 and 26 July. Most were residents, workers or visitors to the area. Health authorities are conducting environmental sampling to investigate the possible source and have implemented preventive measures, including notifying healthcare facilities to help identify potential cases.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/瑞典/莫三比克-麻疹
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Sweden / Mozambique – Measles
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國疑似麻疹11萬4,004例、死亡1,487例,已超過去年全年。
items.summary_en: DRC has reported 114,004 suspected measles cases and 1,487 deaths this year, already above last year's full-year total.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)今年截至第31週累計報告11萬4,004例疑病例(78%為5歲以下兒童),1,487例死亡,已超越去年全年疫情(83,486例,死亡1,187例),其中北基伍省和南基伍省(佔47.7%)為最嚴重地區。由於武裝衝突、人口流離及多種疾病(伊波拉、霍亂與瘧疾)同時傳播等影響,導致醫療體系嚴重負擔,無國界醫師(MSF)已在北基伍/南基伍省實施介入措施,避免疫情傳播。Beacon 8/18 瑞典疫情持續,今年截至8/24累計30例確定病例,均為參與今年音樂節(7/30-8/2)相關病例,多數為18歲以下未接種過疫苗之兒童,其中以斯德哥爾摩(9例)及西博滕省(6例)為多。由於該節日吸引約萬名遊客參加,該國與各地感染管制相關部門進行接觸者追蹤,並建議未接種疫苗或接種不完整者進行自主監測。 莫三比克自2025/7/29宣布爆發疫情後,截至今年8/18累計報告2,595例確定病例,4例死亡。主要以北部南普拉省(1,137例病例,4例死亡)較為嚴重,其次為索法拉省(585例)。相較今年3月資料(697例,1例死亡),短期間內增加1,898例。
items.description_en: The DRC has reported 114,004 suspected cases this year as of week 31 (78% of them children under 5), with 1,487 deaths, already exceeding last year's total (83,486 cases and 1,187 deaths). The worst-affected areas are North Kivu and South Kivu provinces (47.7%). Armed conflict, population displacement and the simultaneous spread of multiple diseases (Ebola, cholera and malaria) are placing a severe burden on the health system. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has implemented interventions in North Kivu and South Kivu to prevent transmission (Beacon, 18 August). Sweden's outbreak continues: as of 24 August this year, 30 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, all linked to this year's music festival (30 July–2 August). Most were unvaccinated children under 18, with cases concentrated in Stockholm (9) and Västerbotten (6). As the festival drew about 10,000 visitors, the country and regional infection-control authorities are conducting contact tracing and recommend self-monitoring for those who are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Mozambique has reported 2,595 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 18 August this year, including 4 deaths, since declaring an outbreak on 29 July 2025. The worst-affected area is Nampula Province in the north (1,137 cases, 4 deaths), followed by Sofala Province (585 cases). Compared with 697 cases and 1 death in March this year, cases have increased by 1,898 in a short period.
