items.summary_zh: 紐西蘭流感上升,8/16當週SARI住院177例,較前週125例增。
items.summary_en: New Zealand's influenza is rising: 177 SARI hospitalisations in the week of 16 August, up from 125, mainly H3N2 subclade K.
items.description_zh: 紐西蘭疫情上升,今年8/16當週,ILI通報每10萬人36.32例,奧克蘭哨點醫師顯示因嚴重急性呼吸道感染(SARI)住院有177例,較上週125例增加,主要型別以A型H3N2流感K分支為主,與本流感季之歐洲高流感活動有關, 該國呼籲施打疫苗以降低重症風險。另該國同時流行呼吸道融合病毒(RSV)、鼻病毒及SARS-CoV-2多種呼吸道病毒,主要集中於0至4歲幼童及65歲以上⻑者。此次疫情對醫療體系造成衝擊,當局已啟動冬季應變計畫,增設醫護人力、病床,並全力推動社區藥局分流與遠距醫療服務,以緩解急診及住院壓力。
items.description_en: New Zealand's epidemic is rising. In the week of 16 August this year, ILI reports were 36.32 per 100,000 people; sentinel physicians in Auckland recorded 177 hospitalisations for severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), up from 125 the previous week. The main subtype is influenza A(H3N2) subclade K, linked to high influenza activity in Europe this season. The country urges vaccination to reduce the risk of severe disease. Several respiratory viruses, including RSV, rhinovirus and SARS-CoV-2, are also circulating, mainly among children aged 0–4 and people over 65. The outbreak has put pressure on the health system; authorities have activated a winter response plan, adding healthcare staff and beds and vigorously promoting community pharmacy triage and telehealth services to ease pressure on emergency and inpatient services.

items.summary_zh: 法國今年截至8/17本土屈公病25例、3起疫情,最大在西部吉倫特省。
items.summary_en: France has reported 25 locally acquired chikungunya cases this year as of 17 August in three outbreaks, the largest in Gironde.
items.description_zh: 法國今年截至8/17累計報告25例本土確定病例,分別為3起疫情事件,其中最大規模疫情發生於西部吉倫特省(Gironde),當局已展開疫情調查及病媒蚊防治,評估至11月前仍有傳播風險。該國2010-2024年累積報告32例本土病例,惟去(2025)年爆發大規模疫情,共報告809例本土病例。
items.description_en: As of 17 August this year, France has reported 25 confirmed locally acquired cases in three outbreak events; the largest occurred in western Gironde. Authorities have launched outbreak investigations and vector mosquito control, and assess that transmission risk will remain until November. France cumulatively reported 32 locally acquired cases during 2010–2024, but a large outbreak occurred last year (2025), with 809 locally acquired cases reported.

items.headline_zh: 美國-萊姆病/AGS紅肉過敏症/波旁病毒感染
items.headline_en: United States – Lyme disease / alpha-gal syndrome / Bourbon virus infection
items.summary_zh: 美國蜱媒傳染病每年估50萬例,孤星蜱致約50萬人罹患α-gal症候群。
items.summary_en: The US sees an estimated 500,000 tick-borne disease cases a year, and lone star ticks have caused about 500,000 people to develop alpha-gal syndrome.
items.description_zh: 美國近年蜱蟲相關傳染病疫情擴張,每年估計有50萬例病例;推估有50萬人曾因孤星蜱罹患AGS紅肉過敏症(alpha-gal syndrome),該蜱蟲活動範圍也從過去僅限於南部,擴張至東北部及中西部地區;紐約州蘇福克郡(Suffolk County)為蜱蟲高風險地區,今年7月報告罕見的波旁病毒(Bourbon virus)感染病例。氣候變遷、郊區擴張及白尾鹿等宿主數量增加,造成蜱蟲相關傳染病疫情上升,另該疾病疫苗仍在研發中。
items.description_en: Tick-borne infectious diseases in the US have expanded in recent years, with an estimated 500,000 cases a year. An estimated 500,000 people have developed alpha-gal syndrome (AGS, red-meat allergy) because of lone star ticks, and the range of this tick has expanded from the south alone to the north-east and Midwest. Suffolk County, New York, is a high-risk area for ticks; in July this year it reported a rare Bourbon virus infection. Climate change, suburban expansion and rising numbers of hosts such as white-tailed deer have driven the rise in tick-related diseases. A vaccine for this disease is still under development.

items.headline_zh: 馬來西亞/孟加拉-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞登革熱今年58,079例、55死,孟加拉住院2萬8,090例、77死。
items.summary_en: Malaysia reported 58,079 dengue cases and 55 deaths this year as of 22 August; Bangladesh reported 28,090 hospitalised cases and 77 deaths.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞今年截至8/22累計報告5萬8,079例病例,其中55例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加56.2%,疫情主要集中於中部雪蘭莪州(Selangor),報告逾2.5萬例,吉隆坡等地疫情亦上升。當局表示天氣變化造成疫情攀升,已啟動早期病例偵測及病媒蚊防治等措施,另因自費價偏高且宣導不足,登革熱疫苗接種率處低點。 孟加拉疫情持續上升,今年截至8/22累計報告2萬8,090例住院病例,其中77例死亡,疫情高於去年同期,且8月疫情較7月增幅高。目前部分醫院專責病房已滿載,多數患者入院時已有血壓下降及休克等併發症,當局表示近期間歇性降雨有利於病媒蚊孳生,加上全國蚊媒防治措施未達預期,預期疫情將持續攀升至10月。
items.description_en: Malaysia reported 58,079 cases cumulatively as of 22 August this year, including 55 deaths; cases are 56.2% higher than in the same period last year. The outbreak is concentrated in Selangor state in central Malaysia, which has reported more than 25,000 cases, and cases are also rising in Kuala Lumpur and other areas. Authorities say weather changes have driven the rise; early case detection and vector mosquito control measures have been launched. Uptake of dengue vaccination is at a low point because the out-of-pocket price is high and awareness is inadequate. Bangladesh's epidemic continues to rise: as of 22 August this year, 28,090 hospitalised cases have been reported cumulatively, including 77 deaths. The epidemic is higher than the same period last year, and the increase in August was larger than in July. Some hospital dedicated wards are now full, and most patients already had complications such as falling blood pressure and shock on admission. Authorities say recent intermittent rain favours mosquito breeding and that nationwide vector control measures have not met expectations; they expect the outbreak to keep rising into October.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年39例人類新型A型流感;美國密西根州2名未成年人感染A(H1N2)v。
items.summary_en: Globally, 39 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year; two under-18s in Michigan, USA, were infected with A(H1N2)v.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週新增1例。全球今年累計報告39例,分別為28例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 美國密西根州於8/21報告2例未滿18歲之A(H1N2)v病例,於今年第32週出現症狀並就醫,其中1例曾接受抗病毒藥物治療,均已康復。調查顯示,個案發病前均曾參加出現染病豬隻之農業博覽會,個案間無相關接觸史,迄未發現其他病例。該國自2025年起累積4例A(H1N2)v病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,095起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共1國於2026/8/14-21期間報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,為美國2起。 ○ 共7國於2026/7/21-8/21期間報告28起H5N1疫情,秘魯20 起、挪威3起、墨西哥/巴西/智利/瑞典/荷蘭各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: 1 new case this week. Globally, 39 cases have been reported this year: 28 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Michigan, USA, reported 2 cases of A(H1N2)v in people under 18 on 21 August; they developed symptoms and sought care in week 32 of this year, and one had received antiviral treatment; both recovered. Investigation showed that all cases had attended an agricultural fair where infected pigs were present before onset; there was no contact between cases, and no other cases have been found. The country has reported 4 A(H1N2)v cases since 2025. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,095 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. A total of 1 country reported 2 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 14–21 August 2026, both in the United States. A total of 7 countries reported 28 H5N1 outbreaks during 21 July–21 August 2026: 20 in Peru, 3 in Norway, and one each in Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Sweden and the Netherlands.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國新增85例伊波拉確定病例,累計5,375例、死亡2,557例。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 85 new confirmed Ebola cases on 20 August, bringing the total to 5,375 cases and 2,557 deaths.
items.description_zh: WHO於8/14最新風險評估剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)維持極高傳播風險;與DRC接壤之所有鄰國 (包含烏干達) 仍面臨境外移入傳播風險,列為高風險;非洲其他地區及全球維持低風險,並呼籲各國須維持高度監測,且落實各項防治措施。其中烏干達風險等級由「極高風險」調降到「高風險」。 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/20新增85例確定病例,其中18例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(63例)、北基伍省(17例)、上韋萊省(5例) ,目前累計5,375例確定病例(2,557例死亡、1,167例康復),致死率47.6%,疫情分佈於6個省份(56個衛生區)。
items.description_en: In its latest risk assessment on 14 August, WHO maintains the risk of transmission in the DRC as very high. All neighbouring countries bordering the DRC (including Uganda) still face the risk of imported transmission and are rated high risk; the rest of Africa and the world remain at low risk. WHO calls on countries to maintain high levels of surveillance and implement control measures. Uganda's risk level has been lowered from very high to high. The DRC continues to report new cases: on 20 August, 85 new confirmed cases were added, including 18 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (63), North Kivu Province (17) and Haut-Uele Province (5). The cumulative total is now 5,375 confirmed cases (2,557 deaths, 1,167 recovered), a case fatality rate of 47.6%; the outbreak is distributed across 6 provinces (56 health zones).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第30週陽性率1.24%,歐非上升;中國第33週門急診陽性率21.2%。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 1.24% in week 30, rising in Europe and Africa; China's outpatient positivity reached 21.2% in week 33.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第30週(7/27-8/2)為1.24%,歐、非洲區呈上升趨勢, 西太平洋區處高原期;近期全球流行變異株以PQ.16.1.1為主,其次為NB.1.8.1、XFG。 中國疫情持平,第33週(8/10-16)門急診陽性率為21.2%,為陽性率最高的呼吸道病原體,其中以15-59歲族群檢測陽性率較高;變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情持續下降,第33週(8/9-15)陽性率3.4%,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16(包括PQ.16.1.1)77.3%為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(16%) 。 韓國疫情上升,第33週陽性率為9.1%,新增56例住院,變異株占比以BA.3.2(50.0%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(22.8%)、PQ.16.1.1(18.2%)及RF.5(6.7%) 。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 30 of this year (27 July–2 August) was 1.24%, with upward trends in Europe and the African Region and a plateau in the Western Pacific Region; the variants currently circulating globally are mainly PQ.16.1.1, followed by NB.1.8.1 and XFG. China's epidemic is stable; in week 33 (10–16 August), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 21.2%, the highest of any respiratory pathogen, with higher positivity among people aged 15–59; the variant share is mainly NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong's epidemic continues to decline; the week 33 positivity rate was 3.4% (9–15 August), and wastewater surveillance shows variants are mainly PQ.16 (including PQ.16.1.1) at 77.3%, followed by NB.1.8.1 (16%). South Korea's epidemic is rising; the week 33 positivity rate was 9.1%, with 56 new hospitalisations, and variants are mainly BA.3.2 (50.0%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (22.8%), PQ.16.1.1 (18.2%) and RF.5 (6.7%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區,韓國

items.summary_zh: 以色列8月在拉馬干市及耶路撒冷郊區確診2例動物狂犬病,今年91例高於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Israel confirmed two animal rabies cases in August, in Ramla and near Jerusalem; 91 cases this year exceed the 66 of the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 以色列特拉維夫區拉馬干市及耶路撒冷郊區,分別於8/12及8/18 確診1例犬隻病例。其中,拉馬干市染疫流浪犬(病毒基因型VIIA) 曾於公園咬傷居⺠,當局已緊急安排10名接觸者進行暴露後預防接種。以往疫情多集中於北部,近期逐漸向中部人口稠密區蔓延,恐加劇人畜頻繁接觸及染疫風險。該國今年累計已達91例動物確定病例,已高於去年同期之66例。
items.description_en: Israel confirmed one animal rabies case each in Ramla, in the Tel Aviv district, on 12 August, and in the outskirts of Jerusalem on 18 August. In Ramla, the infected stray dog (virus genotype VIIa) had bitten residents in a park, and authorities urgently arranged post-exposure vaccination for 10 contacts. Previous cases were concentrated in the north, but have recently spread to the densely populated central region, which may increase frequent human–animal contact and the risk of infection. This year the country has cumulatively recorded 91 confirmed animal cases, higher than the 66 cases in the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 亞塞拜然西北部薩穆赫區炭疽病1例確定、9例疑似,極端乾旱致牲畜接觸孢子污染土壤。
items.summary_en: Samukh district in north-western Azerbaijan reported one confirmed and nine suspected anthrax cases, linked to extreme drought and cattle contact.
items.description_zh: 亞塞拜然西北部薩穆赫區(Samukh)於8/12爆發疫情,累計1例確定病例與9例疑個案,患者均具牛隻接觸史,初期因食用受污染肉品出現腸胃道及皮膚病變,現已收治隔離且病況穩定。當局指出,極端乾旱促使牲畜接觸受孢子污染的土壤衍生此波疫情,目前已啟動跨部門應變機制並強化屠宰管制。未經治療之腸胃道炭疽病例致死率高達25%至60%,及早診斷與介入治療為當前疫情防治之重點工作。
items.description_en: An outbreak occurred in Samukh district in north-western Azerbaijan on 12 August, with 1 confirmed and 9 suspected cases cumulatively; all patients had contact with cattle. Initially, patients developed gastrointestinal and skin lesions after eating contaminated meat. Patients have now been admitted and isolated, and their condition is stable. Authorities say extreme drought caused livestock to come into contact with spore-contaminated soil, leading to this outbreak; a cross-departmental response mechanism has been activated and slaughter controls strengthened. Untreated gastrointestinal anthrax has a case fatality rate of 25% to 60%, so early diagnosis and treatment are the priorities.

items.summary_zh: 法屬馬約特島今年截至7/26 M痘43例,其中23例本土、19例境外移入。
items.summary_en: Mayotte, a French territory, has reported 43 mpox cases this year as of 26 July: 23 local and 19 imported, mostly from Madagascar.
items.description_zh: 法屬馬約特島今年至7/26止累計43例確定病例,包括23例本土與19例境外移入(其中18例來自鄰國馬達加斯加、1例為法國)。個案以男性為主(70%),且近8成具高風險性行為史。目前疫情已波及10個(10/17)市鎮,以首府馬穆楚(13例)最為嚴峻,當局呼籲加強監測與接觸者追蹤。
items.description_en: Mayotte, a French overseas territory, has cumulatively reported 43 confirmed cases this year as of 26 July: 23 local and 19 imported (18 from neighbouring Madagascar and 1 from mainland France). Cases are mainly male (70%), and nearly 80% had a history of high-risk sexual behaviour. The outbreak has spread to 10 of 17 communes; the capital, Mamoudzou, is the most affected, with 13 cases. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance and contact tracing.

items.summary_zh: WHO於8/19召開伊波拉緊急委員會第二次會議,約80%新增感染未列接觸者名單。
items.summary_en: WHO's Emergency Committee met on 19 August; about 80% of new infections were not on existing contact lists.
items.description_zh: WHO依據《國際衛生條例》於8/19召開緊急委員會第二次會議。資料顯示目前疫情傳播速度較以往更快,且尚未獲得控制。WHO 於7月估計,約80%的新增感染病例未列於既有接觸者名單,顯示仍有大量傳播鏈未被掌握,病毒可能持續於家庭、社區及治療中等場域傳播,疫情控制仍面臨高度挑戰。
items.description_en: Under the International Health Regulations, WHO convened the second meeting of its Emergency Committee on 19 August. The data show that the outbreak is spreading faster than before and has not yet been controlled. WHO estimated in July that about 80% of new infections were not on existing contact lists, indicating that many transmission chains remain unidentified. The virus may continue to spread in households, communities and treatment settings, and outbreak control remains highly challenging.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: cVDPV2新增奈及利亞、索馬利亞各1例;WPV1環境檢體15件,多在巴基斯坦。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported cVDPV2 cases of 1 each in Nigeria and Somalia, and 15 environmental WPV1 detections in Pakistan and Afghanistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/6-12期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增奈及利亞/索馬利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共15件,分別為巴基斯坦10件、阿富汗5件,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1件,cVDPV2新增3國共5件,分別為索馬利亞3件、利比亞/奈及利亞各1件,cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The GPEI reported that during 6–12 August, cVDPV1 added 1 case in South Sudan, and cVDPV2 added 1 case each in Nigeria and Somalia. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 15 detections in two countries: 10 in Pakistan and 5 in Afghanistan. cVDPV1 added 1 detection in South Sudan; cVDPV2 added 5 detections in three countries: 3 in Somalia, and 1 each in Libya and Nigeria; and cVDPV3 added 1 detection in Nigeria.
items.area_zh: 奈及利亞,索馬利亞,南蘇丹共和國

items.headline_zh: 中國-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 中國今年截至7月A型肝炎1萬20例,7月降為1,638例。
items.summary_en: China has reported 10,020 hepatitis A cases this year through July; cases fell to 1,638 in July.
items.description_zh: 中國今年截至7月累計報告1萬20例病例,其中僅6月單月報告逾2,000例,7月降為1,638例,近期疫情與去年同期相當。
items.description_en: China reported 10,020 cases cumulatively this year through July. June alone had more than 2,000 cases, but July fell to 1,638 cases. Recent levels are comparable to the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 英國2025年8月至今年8月207例沙門氏菌確定,1例死亡,疑與進口雞蛋有關。
items.summary_en: The UK recorded 207 confirmed cases of one Salmonella strain from August 2025 to August 2026, with 1 death; contaminated imported eggs are suspected.
items.description_zh: 英國自2025年8/11截至今年8/13累計報告207例感染特定單一菌株之確定病例,其中38%住院,並有1例死亡,疫情多發生於今年7月,病患分布以英蘭為多,基因定序顯示存在共同感染源 。疑感染源為受汙染之進口雞蛋,當局評估實際感染病例數可能更高,呼籲幼童等高風險族群應食用具安全認證之雞蛋。
items.description_en: From 11 August 2025 to 13 August this year, the UK cumulatively reported 207 confirmed cases infected with one specific strain; 38% were hospitalised and 1 died. The outbreak occurred mainly in July this year, and cases were concentrated in England. Genome sequencing shows a common source of infection. The suspected source is contaminated imported eggs. Authorities assess that the actual number of infections may be higher, and call on high-risk groups such as young children to eat eggs with safety certification.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 緬甸仰光霍亂,自8/9起逾500人住院,至少149例快篩陽性,1例死亡。
items.summary_en: Yangon, Myanmar has reported over 500 diarrhoea hospitalisations since 9 August amid a cholera outbreak; at least 149 rapid tests were positive, and one died.
items.description_zh: 緬甸仰光自8/9迄今報告逾500人因腹瀉住院,其中至少149例快篩陽性,並有1例死亡,已有病例輸出至孟邦(Mon State)等地區,病患主要集中於仰光市中,疑感染源為受汙染之水源及街頭小吃。仰光以往罕見霍亂疫情,惟因基礎設施缺乏維護、嚴重降雨洪災,加上內戰導致醫療公衛系統脆弱,大幅加劇傳播風險。
items.description_en: In Yangon, Myanmar, more than 500 people have been hospitalised for diarrhoea since 9 August, of whom at least 149 tested positive on rapid tests, and one has died. Cases have been exported to other areas, including Mon State, and are mainly concentrated in central Yangon; contaminated water sources and street food are suspected sources of infection. Cholera outbreaks were previously rare in Yangon, but poorly maintained infrastructure, severe flooding, and a fragile health and public health system weakened by civil war have greatly increased the risk of transmission.

items.summary_zh: 法國薩瓦省退伍軍人病43例確定、2例死亡,當局採樣排水系統與冷卻水塔。
items.summary_en: Savoie, France has reported 43 Legionnaires' cases and 2 deaths this year as of 12 August; drainage and cooling towers are being sampled.
items.description_zh: 法國東南部薩瓦省(Savoie)今年6/1-8/12累計報告43例確定病例,其中41例住院、2例死亡(CFR:4.7%),年齡介於26-91歲,當局正進行排水系統及冷卻水塔等環境採樣,感染源調查中。
items.description_en: In Savoie department in south-eastern France, 43 confirmed cases were cumulatively reported from 1 June to 12 August this year, of whom 41 were hospitalised and 2 died (CFR 4.7%); patients were aged 26–91. Authorities are conducting environmental sampling of drainage systems and cooling towers, and the source investigation is ongoing.

items.summary_zh: 非洲區8國白喉疑病例逾2.9萬例、1,420例死亡,奈及利亞疫情持續擴散。
items.summary_en: Eight African Region countries have reported over 29,000 suspected diphtheria cases and 1,420 deaths since early 2025; Nigeria's outbreak is spreading.
items.description_zh: 非洲區自2025年初迄今年3/1,阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞和南非8國共通報超過29,000 例疑病例,其中1,420例死亡(CFR:4.9%),其中 752例經實驗確定病例,主要集中於日(313例)、奈及利亞(211例)及南非(93例)。WHO評估疫情有進一步地理擴散的潛力、致死率偏高、控制疫情的資源(疫苗與DAT)嚴重不足、且監測與實驗室系統受限, 該區傳播風險為中,全球風險為低。 奈及利亞日(Niger)州疫情呈多點擴散,今年截至8月,累計報告124例確定病例,17例死亡(CFR:13.7%),高於該國同期平均(2.3%),病例主要為未接種疫苗之兒童。因疫苗覆蓋率低,以及跨區人口流動及疫苗猶豫等因素,該國刻正推動逐戶接種疫苗及與宗教領袖合作等措施,以防止疫情擴散。 塞內加爾今年5至8月進行病歷回溯調查(醫療機構病歷),有591 例曾出現喉嚨痛、扁桃腺炎等症狀,其中7例為確定病例,主要集中於東部凱杜古(Kedougou)及薩拉亞(Saraya)地區,該國已於受影響區加強疫苗補接種與主動監測,以防止疫情向周邊擴散。
items.description_en: From early 2025 to 1 March this year, eight countries in the African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) reported more than 29,000 suspected cases, of which 1,420 died (CFR 4.9%). 752 cases were laboratory-confirmed, mainly in Niger (313), Nigeria (211) and South Africa (93). WHO assesses that the outbreak has potential for further geographic spread and a high case fatality rate, that control resources (vaccines and diphtheria antitoxin, DAT) are severely insufficient, and that surveillance and laboratory systems are limited; the transmission risk in the region is moderate, and the global risk is low. In Niger State, Nigeria, the outbreak has spread across multiple points: as of August this year, 124 confirmed cases and 17 deaths had been cumulatively reported (CFR 13.7%), higher than the country's average for the same period (2.3%); most cases were unvaccinated children. Owing to low vaccine coverage, cross-regional population movement and vaccine hesitancy, the country is pursuing door-to-door vaccination and cooperation with religious leaders to prevent further spread. In Senegal, a retrospective review of medical records from May to August this year identified 591 cases with symptoms such as sore throat and tonsillitis, of which 7 were confirmed, mainly in the eastern Kédougou and Saraya areas. Senegal has strengthened catch-up vaccination and active surveillance in affected areas to prevent spread to surrounding areas.
items.area_zh: 阿爾及利亞,查德,幾內亞,茅利塔尼亞,尼日,奈及利亞,馬利,塞內加爾,南非

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉/美洲區/瑞典-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉麻疹17,385例確定、880例死亡;美洲7月中47,459例確定。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has 17,385 confirmed measles cases and 880 deaths as of 11 August; the Americas reported 47,459 confirmed cases by mid-July.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情持續擴大,今年截至8/11,累計報告近14萬例病例其中17,385例確定病例及880例死亡(98例確定),所有行政區皆有病例,主要集中於首都達卡(Dhaka Division;60,866例、404例死亡),較為嚴重,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)及巴里薩爾(Barishal),當局持續擴大疫苗接種活動。 美洲區今年截至7月中旬,累積4,7459例確定病例,44例死亡,今年累積確定病例數相較去年同期5,123例增加8倍,且為自2004年以來確定病例數最多之一年,病例數以瓜地馬拉、墨西哥、美國及祕魯最為嚴峻,合計占該洲病例數95%,另以20-29 歲年齡組病例比例最高(31%)。 美國今年截至8/13累積報告2,566例(含16例境外移入),約19% 為5歲(含)以下兒童,67%為青少年,7%患者需住院治療。主要集中於南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例);賓州為目前疫情熱區,8/17當週新增60例確定病例,迄今累計307例。另93%病患為未接種疫苗或疫苗接種史不明。 瑞典今年截至8/17報告10例疑病例,可能與7/31至8/1辦理之音樂節相關,多數病例為18歲以下兒童;該國已啟動接觸者追蹤與跨國通報,並持續監測相關疫情。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to expand. As of 11 August this year, nearly 140,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17,385 confirmed cases and 880 deaths (98 of them confirmed). Cases have been reported in all administrative areas and are concentrated mainly in the capital, Dhaka Division (60,866 cases, 404 deaths), followed by Chattogram and Barishal; authorities continue to expand vaccination activities. In the Americas, as of mid-July this year, 47,459 confirmed cases and 44 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Confirmed cases this year are 8 times the 5,123 in the same period last year, making this one of the years with the highest number of confirmed cases since 2004. Cases are most severe in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States and Peru, which together account for 95% of the region's cases; the 20–29 age group has the highest proportion (31%). In the United States, as of 13 August this year, 2,566 cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively; about 19% were children aged 5 and under, 67% were adolescents, and 7% of patients required hospitalisation. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Pennsylvania is currently the hotspot, with 60 confirmed cases added in the week of 17 August and 307 cumulatively to date. In addition, 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Sweden reported 10 suspected cases as of 17 August this year, possibly linked to a music festival held on 31 July–1 August; most were children under 18. The country has initiated contact tracing and cross-border notification and continues to monitor the related outbreak.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,瓜地馬拉,墨西哥,秘魯,瑞典,美國

items.summary_zh: 歐洲今年截至8/5西尼羅熱245例、12例死亡,低於過去10年同期平均。
items.summary_en: Seven European countries reported 245 West Nile cases and 12 deaths as of 5 August, below the past decade's same-period average.
items.description_zh: 歐洲今年截至8/5共有7國累計報告245例病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:5%),病例以義大利(139例)、希臘(65例)及西班牙(17例) 等國為多,患者多為65歲以上男性,72%需住院治療。目前疫情低於過去10年同期平均(403例),惟地理擴散範圍更廣,且多國新增首次報告本土病例的地區。該疾病傳播季節為每年5 至11月,當局評估當前氣候條件有利於病媒蚊傳播,預估於8-9月人類與動物病例數將持續增加。
items.description_en: As of 5 August this year, seven European countries had cumulatively reported 245 cases, of which 12 died (CFR 5%). Cases are concentrated in Italy (139), Greece (65) and Spain (17), among others. Patients are mostly men aged over 65, and 72% required hospitalisation. The current outbreak is below the same-period average of the past 10 years (403 cases), but geographic spread is wider, and several countries have reported locally acquired cases for the first time in new areas. The transmission season for this disease is May to November each year. Authorities assess that current climatic conditions favour mosquito-borne transmission, and human and animal cases are expected to continue rising in August and September.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾今年截至8/11日本腦炎46例、9例死亡,印度阿薩姆州7月156例。
items.summary_en: Nepal reported 46 Japanese encephalitis cases and 9 deaths as of 11 August; Assam state in India recorded 156 cases in July.
items.description_zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年截至8/11累計46例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:20%),疫情逐漸向東部特萊平原(Terai)蔓延,相較2025年,以藍毗省最為嚴重。該國疫情流行高峰介於6-10月,惟當局針對高風險區之疫苗接種計畫要到2027年才能展開,預期疫情將持續上升。該國去年累計141例感染,41例死亡(CFR :23%),76%死亡病例年齡大於40歲 ,顯示該疾病正在影響大量超出常規兒童疫苗接種年齡範圍的族群。 印度阿薩姆州(Assam)疫情持續,今年7月報告156例確定病例,其中至少20例死亡(CFR: 12.8%)。自2018年迄今,該州占全國死亡總數達6成。當局已於高風險地區推動疫苗接種(涵蓋率約75%),惟該邦近期面臨洪災,加上正水稻種植及雨季,恐加劇病媒蚊孳生,預期疫情將持續至季風季節結束。
items.description_en: Nepal's epidemic is rising: as of 11 August this year, 46 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths (CFR 20%). The outbreak is gradually spreading into the eastern Terai plains, and compared with 2025, Lumbini Province is the most severely affected. The epidemic peak in the country falls between June and October, but the vaccination programme for high-risk areas will not begin until 2027, so cases are expected to keep rising. Last year the country cumulatively recorded 141 infections and 41 deaths (CFR 23%), with 76% of deaths in people over 40, indicating that the disease is affecting many people beyond the age range covered by routine childhood vaccination. In Assam state, India, the outbreak continues: 156 confirmed cases were reported in July this year, of which at least 20 died (CFR 12.8%). Since 2018, the state has accounted for 60% of national deaths. Authorities have promoted vaccination in high-risk areas (coverage about 75%), but the state has recently been hit by flooding, and paddy cultivation and the rainy season may intensify mosquito breeding; the outbreak is expected to continue until the end of the monsoon season.

items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞今年55,855例登革熱、49死,已超過2025年全年55,399例。
items.summary_en: Malaysia has recorded 55,855 dengue cases and 49 deaths this year as of 11 August, already above 2025's full-year total of 55,399.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞今年截至8/11累計報告5萬5,855例病例,其中死亡49 例,已超越2025年全年病例數(5萬5,399例)。該國過往主要流行型別為DENV-2型,惟今年DENV-3型已構成威脅,過往曾感染DENV-2型之⺠眾對於DENV-3型不但未具保護力,反而更容易引發重症,當局評估聖嬰現象之高溫將導致疫情持續上升,惟評估應不會達到2023及2024年之12萬例高峰。 美國南部佛羅里達州坦帕灣(Tampa Bay)地區爆發本土疫情,近日累計報告10例本土確定病例,該州南部之邁阿密戴德郡(Miami-Dade)及棕櫚灘郡(Palm Beach)亦報告本土病例。
items.description_en: Malaysia reported 55,855 cases cumulatively this year as of 11 August, including 49 deaths, already exceeding the full-year total for 2025 (55,399 cases). Malaysia's main circulating serotype has previously been DENV-2, but this year DENV-3 has posed a threat; people previously infected with DENV-2 have no protection against DENV-3 and are in fact more prone to severe disease. Authorities assess that high temperatures associated with El Niño will keep the epidemic rising, but assess that it should not reach the peak of 120,000 cases seen in 2023 and 2024. In the Tampa Bay area of southern Florida, USA, a local outbreak has occurred; 10 locally acquired confirmed cases have recently been reported cumulatively. Locally acquired cases have also been reported in Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties in southern Florida.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年38例人類新型A型流感;5國報告32起H5N1,秘魯24起。
items.summary_en: Globally, 38 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year; 5 countries reported 32 H5N1 outbreaks, 24 of them in Peru.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週新增1例。全球今年累計報告38例,分別為27例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,065起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共5國於2026/8/8-11期間報告32起H5N1疫情,秘魯24起、智利4起、荷蘭2起、挪威/瑞典各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: 1 new case this week. Globally, 38 cases have been reported this year: 27 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,065 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. A total of 5 countries reported 32 H5N1 outbreaks during 8–11 August 2026: 24 in Peru, 4 in Chile, 2 in the Netherlands, and one each in Norway and Sweden.

items.summary_zh: 南韓8/13發布全國瘧疾警報,今年201例較去年同期減43.4%。
items.summary_en: South Korea issued a nationwide malaria alert on 13 August after vivax parasite genes were found in mosquitoes; cases are 43.4% lower than the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 南韓疾病管理廳(KDCPA)於8/13發布全國瘧疾警報,第31週(7/27-8/2)於京畿道坡州市及漣川郡採集之瘧蚊體內,檢測出間日瘧原蟲(Plasmodium vivax)基因,叮咬感染風險隨之攀升。因受熱浪影響,今年病媒蚊密度整體低於去年,另今年截至8/1累計201例,較去年同期355例減少43.4%。當局呼籲⺠眾做好防蚊措施,出現發燒、畏寒等症狀時,應儘速就醫。
items.description_en: The Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCPA) issued a nationwide malaria alert on 13 August. In week 31 (27 July–2 August), Plasmodium vivax genes were detected in Anopheles mosquitoes collected in Paju City and Yeoncheon County in Gyeonggi Province, raising the risk of bites and infection. Because of the heatwave, mosquito density this year is generally lower than last year. In addition, 201 cases have been reported this year as of 1 August, 43.4% fewer than the 355 cases in the same period last year. Authorities urge people to take mosquito-prevention measures and to seek medical care promptly if they develop fever, chills or other symptoms.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國第32週新增579例確定,單週創新高,累計4,665例。
items.summary_en: DRC recorded 579 new confirmed Ebola cases in week 32, a weekly record; cumulative total reached 4,665 cases as of 12 August.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情傳播加劇,第32週(8/3-9)新增 579例確定病例及304例死亡,創下單週最高紀錄。近期新增1個受影響省份,巴斯韋萊省(Bas-Uélé)報告1例具上韋萊省旅遊史之確定病例(8/4發病)。目前地理區持續擴大,疫情已蔓延全國6個省份(伊圖里省、北基伍省、南基伍省、上韋萊省、喬波省與巴斯韋萊省)54個衛生區,其中伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國85%病例數及79%死亡數。截至8/12累計4,665例確定病例(2,184例死亡、965例康復),致死率46.8%。本次疫情規模及擴散速度已超越以往紀錄(2018年至2020年累計3,317例)。 自疫情爆發以來,醫護人員感染情形持續發生。截至8/9至少155例確定病例(其中45例死亡及68例康復),凸顯職業暴露風險與院感控制(IPC)挑戰。在安全局勢動盪、人口大規模流離失所等背景下,防疫小組的行動屢遭阻礙。自5/17宣布國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)以來,已紀錄到12起針對醫療設施之襲擊事件。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the DRC is intensifying: in week 32 (3–9 August), 579 new confirmed cases and 304 deaths were added, the highest weekly record. A new province has recently been affected: Bas-Uélé Province reported one confirmed case with a history of travel to Haut-Uele Province (onset 4 August). Geographic spread continues; the outbreak has now reached 6 provinces across the country (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé), covering 54 health zones. Ituri Province is the most severe, accounting for 85% of national cases and 79% of deaths. As of 12 August, a cumulative 4,665 confirmed cases (2,184 deaths, 965 recovered) have been reported, a case fatality rate of 46.8%. The scale and speed of spread of this outbreak have exceeded previous records (3,317 cumulative cases in 2018–2020). Healthcare worker infections have continued since the outbreak began: as of 9 August, at least 155 confirmed cases among health workers had been recorded (45 died and 68 recovered), highlighting occupational exposure risks and infection prevention and control (IPC) challenges. Against a backdrop of unstable security and large-scale population displacement, response teams have repeatedly been obstructed. Since the PHEIC was declared on 17 May, 12 attacks on health facilities have been recorded.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第29週陽性率1.21%,歐非上升;中國第32週門急診陽性率21.1%。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 1.21% in week 29, rising in Europe and Africa; China's outpatient positivity reached 21.1% in week 32.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第29週(7/20-26)為1.21%,歐、非洲區呈上升趨勢, 西太平洋區處高原期;近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1、XFG及JN.1為主。 中國單週疫情下降,第32週(8/3-8/9)門急診陽性率為21.1%,為陽性率最高的呼吸道病原體;今年7月新增52萬1,751例確定病例,其中487例重症、1例死亡,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情連續3週下降,第32週陽性率5.2%,相較前1週(7.51%)下降,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16(包括PQ.16.1.1)占49.5%為主,其次為NB.1.8.1占29.7%。 韓國單週疫情下降,第32週陽性率為5.7%,新增46例住院,變異株占比以BA.3.2(50.0%)為主,其次為NB.1.8.1(22.8%)、PQ.16.1.1(18.2%)及RF.5(6.7%)。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 29 of this year (20–26 July) was 1.21%, with upward trends in Europe and the African Region and a plateau in the Western Pacific Region. Variants currently circulating globally are mainly NB.1.8.1, XFG and JN.1. China's epidemic declined within a single week; in week 32 (3–9 August), the outpatient and emergency department positivity rate was 21.1%, the highest of any respiratory pathogen. In July this year, 521,751 confirmed cases were added, including 487 severe cases and 1 death; the variant share is mainly NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong's epidemic has declined for three consecutive weeks; the week 32 positivity rate was 5.2%, down from 7.51% the previous week. Wastewater surveillance shows variants are mainly PQ.16 (including PQ.16.1.1) at 49.5%, followed by NB.1.8.1 at 29.7%. South Korea's epidemic declined week on week; the week 32 positivity rate was 5.7%, with 46 new hospitalisations, and variants are mainly BA.3.2 (50.0%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (22.8%), PQ.16.1.1 (18.2%) and RF.5 (6.7%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區,韓國

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞拉薩熱今年截至第30週1,000例、237例死亡,53名醫護確診。
items.summary_en: Nigeria's Lassa fever reached 1,000 confirmed cases and 237 deaths this year by week 30, with 53 health workers infected.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情持續升溫,今年截至第30週累計報告1,000例確定病例與237例死亡(CFR 23.7%,高於去年同期18.8%),波及23州116個區,病患以21-30歲族群為主。另今年累計53名醫療人員確診,顯示醫療機構感染管制不佳,當局在WHO及US CDC支持下,已啟動為期30天的緊急防護計畫。NCDC表示個案數與致死率上升主因為治療費用高昂、延遲就醫及環境衛生不佳等影響。
items.description_en: Nigeria's epidemic continues to escalate: as of week 30 this year, 1,000 confirmed cases and 237 deaths have been reported cumulatively (CFR 23.7%, higher than 18.8% for the same period last year), spread across 23 states and 116 local government areas, with patients mainly aged 21–30. In addition, 53 healthcare workers have been confirmed infected this year, indicating poor infection control in healthcare facilities. With support from WHO and US CDC, authorities have launched a 30-day emergency protection plan. The NCDC states that the main reasons for the rise in cases and case fatality are high treatment costs, delayed care-seeking and poor environmental sanitation.

items.summary_zh: 美國俄亥俄州凱霍加郡近2個月5隻蝙蝠狂犬病陽性,已發布警訊,尚無人類病例。
items.summary_en: Cuyahoga County, Ohio issued a rabies alert after 5 bats tested positive in two months; no human cases have been reported.
items.description_zh: 美國俄亥俄州凱霍加郡於8/10發布警訊,當地近2個月內檢出5隻蝙蝠狂犬病陽性,檢出率高於往年。雖目前尚無人類感染病例,惟該郡人口密集,⺠眾接觸風險較高。蝙蝠為該國人類狂犬病之主要感染來源,在2000年至2024年間報告的42例本土病例中,其中35例(83%)具蝙蝠接觸史。
items.description_en: Cuyahoga County, Ohio, USA, issued an alert on 10 August after detecting five rabies-positive bats in the past two months, a detection rate higher than in previous years. No human cases have been reported so far, but the county is densely populated and public exposure risk is relatively high. Bats are the main source of human rabies in the country: of 42 locally acquired human cases reported in 2000–2024, 35 (83%) had a history of bat contact.

items.headline_en: United States / Hong Kong SAR – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 加州聖地牙哥郡報告首例Clade I M痘,香港8/5一例無流行病學關聯。
items.summary_en: San Diego County, California reported its first Clade I mpox case; Hong Kong recorded a case on 5 August with no epidemiological link to earlier cases.
items.description_zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥郡報告當地首例第一分支(Clade I)病例,個案具疫區旅遊史,目前密切接觸者均無症狀。該郡今年累計27例,皆為17-53歲男性,且多數未完整接種疫苗。 香港於8/5報告1例31歲男性確定病例,患者曾有多次高風險性行為,目前於醫院隔離治療中。因該病例與先前個案無流行病學關聯,顯示社區恐存在未偵測到之隱性傳播鏈。香港今年報告8例,自2022年迄今累計94例病例(含75例本土及19例境外移入),皆為男性,且多與高風險性行為密切相關。
items.description_en: San Diego County, California, USA, reported its first Clade I case in the county; the individual had a history of travel to an affected area, and all close contacts are currently asymptomatic. The county has reported 27 cases this year, all men aged 17–53, most of whom had not completed vaccination. Hong Kong reported 1 confirmed case in a 31-year-old man on 5 August; the patient had had multiple high-risk sexual encounters and is isolated in hospital for treatment. Because this case has no epidemiological link to previous cases, undetected hidden transmission chains may exist in the community. Hong Kong has reported 8 cases this year; since 2022, a cumulative 94 cases (75 local and 19 imported) have been reported, all in men, and most closely linked to high-risk sexual behaviour.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國截至8/10累計4,449例伊波拉確定病例、2,061例死亡。
items.summary_en: DRC reported 4,449 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,061 deaths as of 10 August.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,截至8/10累計4,449例確定病例(2,061例死亡、886例康復),致死率46.3%,疫情分佈於5個省份(53個衛生區),主要集中於伊圖里省,另南基伍省已連續75天無新增病例。 非洲CDC表示,此次疫情傳播速度為2014年至2016年西非大流行同期的7倍 。目前接觸者追蹤率僅75%,遠低於95%目標,且高達70%的新增病例未列於接觸者名單。另逾3分之2的死亡個案發生於社區而非治療中,顯示患者可能普遍存在延遲就醫,或未能及時獲得醫療照護之情形。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases: as of 10 August, a cumulative 4,449 confirmed cases have been reported (2,061 deaths, 886 recovered), a case fatality rate of 46.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (53 health zones), mainly concentrated in Ituri Province; South Kivu Province has gone 75 consecutive days without new cases. The Africa CDC said the speed of this outbreak is seven times that of the same period during the 2014–2016 West African epidemic. The current contact tracing rate is only 75%, far below the 95% target, and as many as 70% of new cases are not on contact lists. In addition, more than two-thirds of deaths occurred in the community rather than during treatment, indicating that patients commonly delay seeking care or fail to receive timely medical care.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: cVDPV2新增13例,其中剛果民主共和國12例。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 13 cVDPV2 cases in 30 July–5 August, 12 of them in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and one in Nigeria.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/30-8/5期間,cVDPV2 新增2國共13例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)12例、奈及利亞1 例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件,cVDPV2新增2國共5件,分別為索馬利亞4件、剛果⺠主共和國1件。
items.description_en: The GPEI reported that during 30 July–5 August, cVDPV2 added 13 cases in two countries: 12 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Nigeria; cVDPV3 added 1 case in Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 6 detections in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added 5 detections in two countries: 4 in Somalia and 1 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞

items.headline_en: Russian Federation / South Korea – Enterovirus infection
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯外貝加爾邊疆區第31週腸病毒139例,以6歲以下幼童為主,校園群聚。
items.summary_en: Zabaykalsky Krai in Russia reported 139 enterovirus cases in week 31, mostly children under 6, with school and institutional clusters.
items.description_zh: 俄羅斯外貝加爾邊疆區(Zabaykalsky Krai)疫情自6月底以來持續處於高點,今年第31週(7/27-8/2)報告139例病例,病患以6歲以下幼童為多,具校園或機構群聚傳播情形,當局已發布指引,呼籲加強手部衛生,並落實生病學童停課並在家休養。 韓國疫情於高點略降,第31週(7/26-8/1)的定醫門診就診千分比為35,以0至6歲幼童為多,檢出型別以克沙奇A6型為多,並有報告急性無力肢體麻痺(AFP)病例。當前疫情雖高,惟仍低於2019及2024年的歷史高峰,當局已發布警示,呼籲生病幼童應停課並在家休養。
items.description_en: In Zabaykalsky Krai, Russia, enterovirus activity has remained at a high level since late June. In week 31 (27 July–2 August) of this year, 139 cases were reported, mainly children under 6, with clusters in schools and institutions. Authorities have issued guidance calling for enhanced hand hygiene and requiring sick children to stay home from school and rest at home. South Korea's epidemic has slightly declined from its peak. In week 31 (26 July–1 August), the sentinel outpatient visit rate was 35 per 1,000, mainly among children aged 0–6; the predominant type detected was coxsackievirus A6, and acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) cases have been reported. Although the current epidemic is high, it remains below the historical peaks of 2019 and 2024. Authorities have issued an alert urging that sick children stay home from school and rest at home.

items.summary_zh: 美國路易斯安那州今年截至8/6創傷弧菌感染9例、5例死亡,死亡數顯著上升。
items.summary_en: Louisiana reported 9 Vibrio vulnificus infections and 5 deaths as of 6 August, with deaths far above the 10-year same-period average.
items.description_zh: 美國路易斯安那州今年截至8/6累計報告9例病例,其中5例死亡(CFR:56%)。病患皆因傷口接觸海水而感染,未發現與食用海鮮相關之食媒傳染途徑。該州過去10年同期平均為7例病例及1例死亡,今年死亡數顯著上升,當局已發布公衛警示,提醒免疫力低下等高風險族群應避免傷口接觸海水。另佛羅里達州今年迄今亦已報告2例死亡病例。
items.description_en: Louisiana, USA, reported 9 cases this year as of 6 August, of which 5 died (CFR 56%). All patients were infected through wound exposure to seawater, and no foodborne transmission through eating seafood has been identified. The state's same-period average over the past 10 years was 7 cases and 1 death; deaths this year have risen markedly. Authorities have issued a public health alert, reminding high-risk groups such as people with weakened immunity to avoid wound contact with seawater. Florida has also reported 2 deaths so far this year.

items.summary_zh: 美國俄亥俄州一長期照護機構今年8例退伍軍人病,無死亡,全部住院。
items.summary_en: A long-term care facility in Ohio, USA, has reported 8 Legionnaires' disease cases this year, with no deaths and all patients hospitalised.
items.description_zh: 美國俄亥俄州1間⻑期照護機構,今年截至8/6,累計報告8例確定病例,無死亡病例,因病情嚴重,全部病例皆已住院,該機構收治住⺠多為罹患呼吸道疾病及癌症等高風險族群,感染源仍在調查中,當局已在該機構採取全面防治措施。
items.description_en: A long-term care facility in Ohio, USA, has reported 8 confirmed Legionnaires' disease cases as of 6 August this year, with no deaths. Because the illnesses are severe, all cases have been hospitalised. Residents of the facility are mainly people with high-risk conditions such as respiratory disease and cancer. The source of infection is still under investigation, and authorities have taken comprehensive prevention and control measures at the facility.

items.headline_zh: 葉門/哈薩克/馬達加斯加/美國-麻疹
items.headline_en: Yemen / Kazakhstan / Madagascar / United States – Measles
items.summary_zh: 葉門馬里卜麻疹1,624例(確定290例),哈薩克上半年確定167例。
items.summary_en: Yemen's Marib reported 1,624 measles cases, of which 290 were confirmed; Kazakhstan reported 167 confirmed cases in the first half of the year.
items.description_zh: 葉門馬里卜(Marib)今年8/2宣布公共衛生緊急狀態(Public health emergency),今年截至8/2,累計報告1,624例病例,其中僅290例確定病例,及12例相關死亡案例。因當地診斷能力嚴重受限,疫情實際負擔比報告病例數要高得多。由於戰亂導致未接種疫苗等,當局已擴大疫苗接種,防止疫情擴散。 哈薩克北部庫斯塔奈(Kostanay)今年上半年累計報告167例確定病例,較去年同期10例,增加16倍,其中57例(34.1%)為未滿1 歲嬰兒。近期顯示疫情在北部多個地區蔓延,⺠眾疫苗猶豫現象造成免疫覆蓋率偏低,疫情持續傳播 。另該國於2024年報告27,967例病例,成為當年歐洲區域麻疹負擔最重之國家。 馬達加斯加瓦卡南卡拉特拉(Vakinankaratra),截至今年7月中旬,累計報告229例確定病例,2例於8/4-5期間死亡;該國42區中,有24區處於活躍期,18區為監測期。由於該國去年疫苗覆蓋率僅72%,以及學校假期,增加兒童跨區互動,加速疫情擴散。當局已在受影響地區進行補接種疫苗,並預計今年10月展開全國大規模疫苗接種。 美國疫情持續,今年截至8/9,累計報告2,465例確定病例(含16 例境外移入),高於去年2,289例。有68%為19歲以下兒童及青少年,93%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明者,7%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(524例)為多。另賓州近期疫情快速上升,8/10之當週新增57例確定病例,今年累計達232例。
items.description_en: Yemen: Marib declared a public health emergency on 2 August this year. As of 2 August, 1,624 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which only 290 were confirmed, along with 12 related deaths. Because local diagnostic capacity is severely limited, the true disease burden is much higher than the reported case count. Owing to armed conflict and low vaccination, authorities have expanded vaccination to prevent the outbreak from spreading. Kazakhstan: in Kostanay in the north, 167 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively in the first half of this year, compared with 10 in the same period last year, a 16-fold increase; 57 (34.1%) were infants under 1 year old. Recent data show the outbreak is spreading across several northern areas. Vaccine hesitancy among residents has led to low immunity coverage, and transmission continues. In addition, the country reported 27,967 cases in 2024, making it the country with the heaviest measles burden in the European Region that year. Madagascar: in Vakinankaratra, 229 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively as of mid-July this year, and 2 died between 4 and 5 August. Of the country's 42 districts, 24 are in the active phase and 18 are under surveillance. Because vaccination coverage last year was only 72%, and school holidays increased inter-district contact among children, the outbreak has accelerated. Authorities have carried out catch-up vaccination in affected areas and plan to launch nationwide mass vaccination in October this year. United States: the outbreak continues. As of 9 August this year, 2,465 confirmed cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 2,289 cases last year. 68% were children and young people aged 19 and under, 93% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 7% of patients were hospitalised. The largest numbers are in South Carolina (670) and Utah (524). In Pennsylvania, the outbreak has risen rapidly recently; 57 confirmed cases were added in the week of 10 August, bringing the total this year to 232.
items.area_zh: 哈薩克,馬達加斯加,美國,葉門

items.summary_zh: 希臘今年截至8/5西尼羅熱65例、6死;義大利84例、2死,與去年相當。
items.summary_en: Greece reported 65 West Nile cases and 6 deaths as of 5 August; Italy reported 84 cases and 2 deaths, similar to last year.
items.description_zh: 希臘今年截至8/5累計報告65例病例,其中6例死亡(皆為65歲以上),疫情分布於25個行政區,多數病患出現中樞神經系統症狀(CNS),該國疫情多於5-11月間流行。 義大利今年2月至7/28累計報告84例病例,其中2例死亡; 19例為透過捐血發現之無症狀感染者,整體疫情與去年同期相當。
items.description_en: Greece has reported 65 cases cumulatively this year as of 5 August, of which 6 were fatal (all aged over 65). Cases are distributed across 25 administrative areas, and most patients presented with central nervous system (CNS) symptoms. The epidemic in the country usually circulates between May and November. Italy has reported 84 cases cumulatively from February to 28 July this year, of which 2 were fatal; 19 were asymptomatic infections detected through blood donation. The overall outbreak is comparable to the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 美國8/4報告3例茲卡病例皆曾赴斐濟,斐濟未通報病例,可能被低估。
items.summary_en: The US reported 3 Zika cases on 4 August, all linked to travel to Fiji, where no cases have been reported and infections may be underestimated.
items.description_zh: 美國8/4報告3例確定病例,個案皆具斐濟旅遊史;紐西蘭亦於第30週(7/25-31)報告3例病例,具斐濟(2例)及印(1例)旅遊史。斐濟當局並未報告感染症病例,可能與當地使用的檢驗工具敏感度較低,或與登革熱等產生血清交叉反應等有關,估計實際感染人數可能被低估,美國CDC呼籲赴斐濟旅客(特別是孕婦及備孕婦女) 應加強防蚊措施。
items.description_en: The US reported 3 confirmed cases on 4 August, all with a history of travel to Fiji. New Zealand also reported 3 cases in week 30 (25–31 July), with travel histories to Fiji (2) and India (1). Fiji has not reported any Zika cases; this may be related to the lower sensitivity of locally used test tools or to serological cross-reaction with dengue and other infections, and the actual number of infections may be underestimated. The US CDC urges travellers to Fiji, especially pregnant women and women planning pregnancy, to strengthen mosquito-protection measures.

items.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加今年屈公病82例(確定48例),2016–25年無確定病例。
items.summary_en: Costa Rica has reported 82 chikungunya cases this year (48 confirmed); it reported no confirmed cases from 2016 to 2025.
items.description_zh: 哥斯大黎加今年迄今報告82例病例(48例確定病例),疫情集中於西北部地區。該國自2016-2025年皆未報告確定病例,其中2025 年報告8例疑病例,惟皆未確診。
items.description_en: Costa Rica has reported 82 cases so far this year (48 confirmed), concentrated in the north-west of the country. The country reported no confirmed cases from 2016 to 2025; in 2025, 8 suspected cases were reported, but none were diagnosed.

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市登革熱較去年同期增23.9%,菲律賓三寶顏市1,241例、12死
items.summary_en: Dengue in Ho Chi Minh City rose 23.9% over the same period last year, while Zamboanga City in the Philippines reported 1,241 cases and 12 deaths amid rising transmission.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市今年截至第30週(7/20-26)累計報告2萬3,481例病例,較去年同期增加23.9%,其中第30週報告995例病例,較近4週平均增加20%。 菲律賓三寶顏市(Zamboanga)於8/4宣布爆發疫情,今年截至8月初已報告1,241例病例及12例死亡。該市疫情持續上升,已達流行閾,超過50%感染者為10歲(含)以下兒童,全市有39個(/98)行政區受到影響,當局已加強防治措施。
items.description_en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, has reported 23,481 dengue cases cumulatively up to week 30 (20–26 July) this year, a 23.9% increase over the same period last year. Of these, 995 cases were reported in week 30, 20% above the average of the previous four weeks. On 4 August, Zamboanga City in the Philippines declared an outbreak; as of early August, 1,241 cases and 12 deaths had been reported this year. Cases in the city continue to rise and have reached the epidemic threshold, with more than 50% of infections among children aged 10 years and under. Thirty-nine of the city's 98 administrative districts are affected, and authorities have strengthened prevention and control measures.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情持續擴大,累計4,209例、1,916死亡
items.summary_en: Ebola cases in the DRC keep rising, with 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths cumulatively as of 7 August, a CFR of 45.5%.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/7新增89例確定病例,其中21例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(73例)、北基伍省(12例)、上韋萊省(4例)。新增4個受影響的衛生區,有地理區持續擴大情形。迄至8/7累計4,209例確定病例(1,916例死亡、828例康復),致死率45.5%,疫情分佈於5個省份(53個衛生區),以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國86.3%的病例數。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 7 August, 89 new confirmed cases were added, including 21 deaths, in Ituri Province (73 cases), North Kivu Province (12) and Haut-Uélé Province (4). Four newly affected health zones were added, and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 7 August, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 4,209 (1,916 deaths, 828 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 45.5%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (53 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 86.3% of national cases.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年新型A型流感人類病例37例,本週無新增
items.summary_en: Globally, 37 human novel influenza A cases were reported this year and none this week, while 67 countries have reported avian influenza outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週無新增病例。全球今年累計報告37例,分別為26例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,032起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共6國於2026/8/4-7期間報告62起H5N1疫情,澳大利亞44 起、荷蘭10起、智利5起、瑞典/美國/芬蘭各1起。 ○ 墨西哥於2026/8/7報告1起H7N3疫情。
items.description_en: Human cases: No new cases were reported this week. Globally, 37 cases have been reported this year: 26 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 67 countries/territories have reported 4,032 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Six countries reported 62 H5N1 outbreaks during 4–7 August 2026: Australia 44, Netherlands 10, Chile 5, and Sweden, United States and Finland 1 each. Mexico reported 1 H7N3 outbreak on 7 August 2026.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 中國門急診新冠陽性率連升10週至22.3%,香港連降2週
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 1.28% in week 28 and rising in the Western Pacific; China's positivity reached 22.3%, its tenth consecutive weekly rise.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第28週(7/13-19)為1.28%,西太平洋區署持續上升;近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1、XFG及JN.1為主。 中國疫情上升,第31週(7/27-8/2)門急診陽性率上升為22.3%,相較前1週上升1.9%,已連續10週上升,為陽性率最高的呼吸道病原體,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情連續2週下降,第31週陽性率7.51%,相較前1週(9.44%)下降1.93%,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以PQ.16(包括PQ.16.1.1)占49.5%為主,其次為NB.1.8.1占29.7% 。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate was 1.28% in week 28 of this year (13–19 July), and the Western Pacific Region continues to rise. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1, XFG and JN.1. In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose to 22.3% in week 31 (27 July–2 August), up 1.9 percentage points from the previous week, and has risen for 10 consecutive weeks. It is the respiratory pathogen with the highest positivity rate, and NB.1.8.1 is the main variant. In Hong Kong, cases have declined for 2 consecutive weeks. Positivity in week 31 was 7.51%, down 1.93 percentage points from the previous week (9.44%). Wastewater surveillance shows PQ.16 (including PQ.16.1.1) predominates at 49.5%, followed by NB.1.8.1 at 29.7%.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉4,053例、1,850死,WHO建議試用Ervebo
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola outbreak has reached 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths; WHO on 7 August recommended including the Ervebo vaccine in clinical trials.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情持續,截至8/7累計報告4,053例確定病例,其中1,850例死亡(CFR:45.6%),疫情分佈於5個省份。因應此波疫情快速發展,WHO於8/7建議將現行已核准針對薩伊株(Zaire)的伊波拉疫苗(Ervebo)納入臨床試驗,研發單位將於邦迪布焦(Bundibugyo)疫苗的第二/三期臨床試驗時一併將Ervebo納入疫苗效力評估。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues. As of 7 August, 4,053 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 1,850 deaths (CFR: 45.6%), distributed across 5 provinces. In response to the rapid development of this wave of the outbreak, WHO on 7 August recommended including Ervebo, the currently licensed Ebola vaccine targeting the Zaire strain, in clinical trials. Developers will also include Ervebo in vaccine efficacy evaluation alongside the Phase II/III clinical trials of the Bundibugyo vaccine.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大魁北克省首例流浪貓感染浣熊狂犬病,今年已確診126例野生動物病例
items.summary_en: Quebec, Canada, reported its first stray cat infected with raccoon rabies, with 126 wildlife rabies cases confirmed this year as of 27 July.
items.description_zh: 加拿大魁北克省報告首例流浪貓感染浣熊狂犬病病例,該省今年截至7/27已確診126例野生動物狂犬病,主要感染動物為浣熊與臭鼬。當局警示,流浪貓可能成為狂犬病病毒由野生動物傳入人類生活環境之橋梁,呼籲飼主務必為寵物完成狂犬病疫苗接種,7/16通報流浪貓抓咬傷⺠眾,致3人接受暴露後預防接種事件。
items.description_en: Quebec Province in Canada has reported the first case of a stray cat infected with raccoon rabies. As of 27 July this year, the province has confirmed 126 wildlife rabies cases, mainly in raccoons and skunks. Authorities warn that stray cats may serve as a bridge for the rabies virus to pass from wildlife into human living environments, and urge pet owners to ensure their pets are fully vaccinated against rabies. On 16 July, a bite or scratch from a stray cat was reported, and 3 people received post-exposure vaccination as a result.

items.headline_zh: 法屬留尼旺島/印度-鉤端螺旋體病
items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉州鉤端螺旋體病今年1,394例、63死,7月新增415例
items.summary_en: Kerala, India: 1,394 leptospirosis cases and 63 deaths this year, with 415 cases added in July as the monsoon-linked outbreak spreads.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島今年截至7/23累計報告221例確定病例,其中1例死亡。疫情於3月達高峰(71例)後,隨乾季來臨逐步下降,7月僅報告8例,淡水休閒活動及農業工作為主要暴露風險。今年65% 病例需住院治療,可能與延遲就醫或感染毒力較高之血清群有關。該島歷來以Icterohaemorrhagiae血清群為主要流行菌株,該血清群與較嚴重之臨床表現相關,可能引發韋氏病(Weil disease)。 印度喀拉拉州受雨季影響,疫情大幅上升,今年截至7/31累計報告1,394例確定病例及63例死亡,7月即新增415例確定病例及30例死亡,疫情已擴及至少10個地區,呈全州性傳播趨勢。死亡個案以40至69歲勞工及農業工作者為主,該病死亡數占該州傳染病死亡總數52%。鑑於8月為流行高峰期,且致死率已由4.2%升至6%,當局持續推廣以去氧羥四環素(doxycycline)進行預防性投藥,以抑制疫情。
items.description_en: Réunion has reported 221 confirmed leptospirosis cases this year as of 23 July, including 1 death. After peaking in March (71 cases), cases declined with the arrival of the dry season, with only 8 cases reported in July. The main exposure risks are recreational freshwater activities and agricultural work. This year, 65% of cases required hospitalization, which may be related to delayed care-seeking or to more virulent infecting serogroups. The island has historically been dominated by the Icterohaemorrhagiae serogroup, which is associated with more severe clinical presentations and can cause Weil disease. In India, Kerala State has seen a sharp rise in cases during the monsoon season. As of 31 July this year, 1,394 confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with 415 confirmed cases and 30 deaths added in July alone. The outbreak has spread to at least 10 areas, showing a statewide transmission trend. Deaths have mainly occurred among workers and agricultural workers aged 40 to 69 years, and leptospirosis accounts for 52% of the state's total infectious disease deaths. As August is the peak season and the case fatality ratio has risen from 4.2% to 6%, authorities continue to promote doxycycline chemoprophylaxis to curb the outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 多明尼加拘留所爆發M痘群聚,9例疑似、2例確診,尚無社區傳播
items.summary_en: A mpox cluster at a Dominican Republic detention centre has 9 suspected cases and 2 confirmed, with no community transmission identified.
items.description_zh: 多明加共和國聖克里斯多福省一處拘留所爆發群聚,於今年7/28報告9例疑個案(均為收容人),目前經RT-PCR確診2例,餘7 例調查中,尚無社區傳播情形,當局已進行接觸者追蹤與環境消毒。該國於2022年至2024年累計83例確定病例後,已近2年無發生疫情。
items.description_en: A cluster has emerged at a detention centre in San Cristóbal Province, Dominican Republic. On 28 July this year, 9 suspected cases, all of them detainees, were reported. Two have been confirmed by RT-PCR, and the remaining 7 are under investigation. No community transmission has been identified, and authorities have conducted contact tracing and environmental disinfection. Following a cumulative total of 83 confirmed cases recorded from 2022 to 2024, the country has gone almost two years without an outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 美國紐約州薩福克郡報告3例疑似兔熱病,全美病例近年上升
items.summary_en: Suffolk County, New York, reported 3 suspected tularaemia cases, while US cases have trended upward in recent years.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約州薩福克郡報告3例疑病例,全美近年病例呈上升趨勢,相較2019至2023年每年報告仍少於200例。此疾病於5至9月較常見,其中蜱蟲或鹿蠅叮咬多發生在夏季,因狩獵和接觸動物引起的感染則不限季節。另男性病例較多,推估與狩獵和園藝活動暴露風險高有關,病患雖涵蓋各年齡層,惟以兒童為較高風險族群。
items.description_en: Suffolk County, New York State, has reported 3 suspected cases. Nationally, cases have trended upward in recent years, but annual reports remain below 200, compared with 2019–2023. The disease is more common from May to September. Tick bites and deer fly bites mostly occur in summer, while infections from hunting and animal contact can occur at any time of year. Male cases are more numerous, which is estimated to reflect higher exposure risk from hunting and gardening activities. Although patients span all age groups, children are at higher risk.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計3,973例、1,801死,單日新增99例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, with 99 new cases added on 4 August.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/4新增99例確定病例,其中52例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(85例)、北基伍省(10例)、上韋萊省(4例)。目前累計3,973例確定病例(1,801例死亡、776例康復),致死率45.3%,疫情分佈於5個省份(51個衛生區)。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 4 August, 99 new confirmed cases were added, including 52 deaths, in Ituri Province (85 cases), North Kivu Province (10) and Haut-Uélé Province (4). To date, 3,973 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (1,801 deaths, 776 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 45.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (51 health zones).

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 疫苗衍生小兒麻痺新增:寮國、南蘇丹各1例,剛果民主共和國4例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported new vaccine-derived polio cases in Laos, South Sudan and the DRC, plus two WPV1-positive environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/23-29期間,cVDPV1 新增為寮國/南蘇丹各1例;cVDPV2新增剛果⺠主共和國4例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2件 。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 23–29 July, new cVDPV1 cases were 1 each in Laos and South Sudan, and new cVDPV2 cases were 4 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. For environmental samples, 2 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan.

items.summary_zh: 韓國腸病毒門診就診千分比36.1,升至近6年次高,多為0至6歲幼童
items.summary_en: South Korea's enterovirus outpatient rate rose to 36.1 per 1,000 in week 30, the second-highest in six years, mostly affecting children aged 0–6.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情持續上升,今年第30週(7/19-25)門診就診千分比為36.1,較前1週增加,疫情為近6年來次高,病患多為0-6歲兒童,流行型別以克沙奇A4型為多。
items.description_en: Enterovirus activity in South Korea continues to rise. In week 30 of this year (19–25 July), the outpatient visit rate was 36.1 per 1,000, an increase from the previous week and the second-highest level in six years. Most patients are children aged 0–6 years, and the predominant type is Coxsackievirus A4.

items.summary_zh: 美國環孢子蟲病疫情集中密西根州,今年逾2.1萬例,該州首報2例死亡
items.summary_en: Since May, US cyclosporiasis cases have exceeded 21,000, concentrated in Michigan, which reported its first 2 deaths on 3 August.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情更新,今年5月截至7/31累計報告逾2.1萬例病例,其中疫情集中於密西根州,該州迄今報告1萬1,234例病例,並於8/3首次報告2例死亡病例。
items.description_en: US outbreak update: From May this year through 31 July, more than 21,000 cases have been reported cumulatively in the United States, with the outbreak concentrated in Michigan. Michigan has reported 11,234 cases to date and, on 3 August, reported its first 2 deaths.

items.headline_zh: 哥倫比亞-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞納里奧省腹瀉群聚,7/17起逾777例,部分檢出諾羅病毒
items.summary_en: A diarrhoea outbreak in Nariño, Colombia, has affected more than 777 people since 17 July, with norovirus detected and no deaths reported.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞西部納里奧省(Nariño)自今年7/17起爆發腹瀉群聚疫情,迄今報告逾777例病例,無重症或死亡個案,疫情影響多處市區及鄉鎮,部份患者檢體檢出諾羅病毒。因嚴重乾旱,導致河川稀釋能力降低,加上家庭與工業廢水排入,造成自來水系統與河水遭受汙染,當局已發布警報並要求學校暫時停課。
items.description_en: In Nariño Department in western Colombia, a diarrhoea cluster has been reported since 17 July this year, with more than 777 cases to date. No severe or fatal cases have been reported. The outbreak has affected multiple urban and rural areas, and norovirus was detected in some patient specimens. Severe drought has reduced the dilution capacity of rivers, and discharge of household and industrial wastewater has contaminated tap water systems and river water. Authorities have issued an alert and asked schools to suspend classes temporarily.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計3,874例、1,751死,莫德納啟動候選疫苗試驗
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola total reached 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths, while Moderna began Phase 1 trials of a candidate Bundibugyo vaccine in Canada.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/3新增72例確定病例,其中44例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(58例)、北基伍省(12例)、上韋萊省(2例)。目前累計3,874例確定病例(1,751例死亡、749例康復),致死率45.1%,疫情分佈於5個省份(51個衛生區)。 莫德納公司已於加拿大啟動mRNA-1469候選疫苗第一期人體臨床試驗,以評估其預防邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(BDBV)之安全性及抗體反應,目前首批受試者已完成接種。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 3 August, 72 new confirmed cases were added, including 44 deaths, in Ituri Province (58 cases), North Kivu Province (12) and Haut-Uélé Province (2). Cumulatively, 3,874 confirmed cases have been reported (1,751 deaths, 749 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 45.1%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (51 health zones). Moderna has begun a Phase 1 human clinical trial of its mRNA-1469 candidate vaccine in Canada to assess its safety and antibody response in preventing Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) infection, and the first group of participants has completed vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 智利漢他病毒症候群今年46例、18死,致死率升至39%,衛生部發布健康警報
items.summary_en: Chile reported 46 hantavirus syndrome cases and 18 deaths this year, a 39% fatality ratio that prompted a Ministry of Health alert through next July.
items.description_zh: 智利今年迄7/21累計報告46例確定病例、18例死亡(CFR:39%),相較去年同期44例確定病例、8例死亡(CFR:18%),致死率上升,爰該國衛生部(MINSAL)於今年7/28發佈漢他病毒健康警報(Health Alert),地區含蓋北部阿塔卡馬(Atacama)至南部麥哲倫(Magallanes),並持續至明年7/31。
items.description_en: As of 21 July this year, Chile has reported 46 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 39%), compared with 44 confirmed cases and 8 deaths (CFR: 18%) in the same period last year. As the case fatality ratio has risen, the Ministry of Health (MINSAL) issued a hantavirus Health Alert on 28 July this year. The alert covers regions from Atacama in the north to Magallanes in the south, and remains in effect until 31 July next year.

items.summary_zh: 紐約市上東區退伍軍人病宣告結束,今年全市累計92例、7死
items.summary_en: New York City declared its Upper East Side Legionnaires' outbreak over after 92 cases and 7 deaths this year; Basel, Switzerland reported 26 cases.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市7/31宣布上東區疫情已結束,連續2週未新增確定病例且無相關症狀,今年截至7/30,累計報告92例確定病例及7例死亡。 瑞士西北部巴塞爾(Basel)爆發群聚疫情,今年累計報告26例確定病例(含1例死亡、9例住院),該國進行冷卻水塔檢測發現有8 座濃度超標,已於7/31要求關閉受影響之設施。
items.description_en: On 31 July, New York City declared the outbreak in the Upper East Side over, as no new confirmed cases had been reported for 2 consecutive weeks and no related symptoms were present. As of 30 July this year, 92 confirmed cases and 7 deaths have been reported cumulatively in the city. In Basel, northwestern Switzerland, a cluster outbreak has occurred, with 26 confirmed cases reported cumulatively this year, including 1 death and 9 hospitalizations. Switzerland tested cooling towers and found 8 with concentrations above the limit, and on 31 July it required the affected facilities to shut down.

items.headline_zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞/巴西/美洲地區-麻疹
items.headline_en: Papua New Guinea / Brazil / Region of the Americas – Measles
items.summary_zh: 美洲麻疹今年累計4萬7,026例、48死,巴西出現持續本土傳播
items.summary_en: The Americas has reported 47,026 measles cases and 48 deaths this year, a five-fold increase, while Brazil sees its first sustained local transmission since elimination certification.
items.description_zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞衛生部於今年7/7宣佈爆發疫情,該國8個省份自今年1月以來累計報告108例疑個案(含3例確定病例),由於該國實驗室檢驗量能不足,須送往澳洲進行檢驗,可能低估實際傳播情形。另病例地理分佈無流行病學關聯,且該國疫苗覆蓋率低,預期疫情擴散。 巴西今年截至7/31,累計報告18例確定病例,主要集中於首都聖保羅(15例)之2歲以下與20-50歲族群。此波疫情為該國獲得消除麻疹認證後,首次出現持續性本土傳播,主因為該地區為重要樞紐,且近期世界盃結束後人潮返國及7至8月學校假期等因素。該國已針對特定地區擴大疫苗接種對象為6個月至59歲族群,防止疫情向外擴散。 美洲地區疫情持續,自今年截至7/25,共17國/地區累計報告4 萬7,026例確定病例及48例死亡(CFR:0.10%),病例數較去年同期增加5倍。其中,高達97%確定病例集中於瓜地馬拉(30,040例)、墨西哥(12,233例)、美國(2,318例)及加拿大(1,107 例)。
items.description_en: Papua New Guinea's Ministry of Health declared an outbreak on 7 July this year. Across 8 provinces, 108 suspected cases (including 3 confirmed) have been reported since January this year. Because the country's laboratory testing capacity is limited, samples must be sent to Australia for testing, which may underestimate the actual spread. In addition, cases are geographically dispersed with no epidemiological links, and vaccination coverage is low, so the outbreak is expected to spread. As of 31 July this year, Brazil has reported 18 confirmed measles cases, mainly in the city of São Paulo (15 cases), among children under 2 years and people aged 20 to 50 years. This is the first sustained local transmission since the country was certified as having eliminated measles. The main factors are that the area is an important hub, the return of travellers after the recently concluded World Cup, and school holidays in July and August. Brazil has expanded vaccination in specific areas to people aged 6 months to 59 years to prevent the outbreak from spreading further. Measles activity in the Region of the Americas continues. As of 25 July this year, 17 countries and territories have reported a cumulative 47,026 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (CFR: 0.10%), a five-fold increase over the same period last year. As many as 97% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Guatemala (30,040), Mexico (12,233), the United States (2,318) and Canada (1,107).

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計3,802例、1,707死,北基伍省恐有延遲發現
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 3,802 confirmed cases and 1,707 deaths, with North Kivu's higher fatality suggesting possible delayed detection.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/2新增58例確定病例,其中40例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(39例)、北基伍省(18例)、上韋萊省(1例)。新增2個受影響的衛生區(位於喬波省Wanie-Rukula、北基伍省Lubero),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前累計3,802例確定病例(1,707例死亡、727例康復),致死率44.9%,疫情分佈於5個省份(51個衛生區),以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國87%病例數;北基伍省為第二大疫情熱區,惟其致死率高於伊圖里省約27%,顯示該省病例可能存在延遲發現情形。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 2 August, 58 new confirmed cases were added, including 40 deaths, in Ituri Province (39 cases), North Kivu Province (18) and Haut-Uélé Province (1). Two newly affected health zones were added, in Wanie-Rukula (Tshopo Province) and Lubero (North Kivu Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. To date, 3,802 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (1,707 deaths, 727 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.9%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (51 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected at 87% of national cases. North Kivu is the second-largest hotspot, but its case fatality ratio is about 27% higher than that of Ituri, which suggests that cases in that province may be detected with a delay.

items.summary_zh: 馬拉威今年截至6月瘧疾病例117萬例、555死,較去年同期減少72%
items.summary_en: Malawi's malaria cases fell 72% through June compared with last year, to 1.17 million cases and 555 deaths, which authorities attribute to expanded prevention.
items.description_zh: 馬拉威今年截至6月累計報告117萬例病例,其中555例死亡,與去年同期比較,病例數減少72%(去年同期426萬例),死亡數亦減少51%(去年同期1143例)。當局表示多重防疫措施使得瘧疾疫情大幅下降,社區宣導、發送防蚊帳並將瘧疾疫苗納入常規接種計畫,疫情已遠低於2024年高峰(940萬例)。
items.description_en: Malawi has reported 1.17 million malaria cases cumulatively through June this year, including 555 deaths. Compared with the same period last year, cases decreased by 72% (4.26 million last year) and deaths decreased by 51% (1,143 last year). Authorities say that multiple prevention measures have led to a sharp decline in malaria, including community education, distribution of insecticide-treated bed nets, and inclusion of the malaria vaccine in the routine immunization programme. Cases are well below the 2024 peak of 9.4 million.

items.headline_zh: 斯里蘭卡/泰國/菲律賓-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡今年登革熱84,724例、62死,7月約2.9萬例
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka reported 84,724 dengue cases and 62 deaths this year, about 29,000 in July alone, concentrated in Gampaha District.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡今年截至7/30累計報告84,724例病例,其中62例死亡(CFR: 0.07%),其中7月報告約2.9萬例,疫情集中於加姆珀哈區(Gampaha District),以第二型(DENV-2)血清型傳播力為高。近一週病例數雖下降3%,惟住院數仍高,當局已增加登革熱高風險告警區域。 泰國今年截至第30週(8/1)累計報告1萬7,299例病例,病患多介於10-19歲,死亡率最高的年齡層為40-49歲及60歲以上,疫情低於預測且低於去年同期。 菲律賓宿霧(Cebu)今年截至7/18累計報告1228例病例,其中10 例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加12.35%;另三寶顏市(Zamboanga)今年截至7/25累計報告1,184例,疫情較去年同期增加20%,其中11例死亡(多為10歲以下兒童)。
items.description_en: Sri Lanka has reported 84,724 dengue cases cumulatively this year up to 30 July, including 62 deaths (CFR: 0.07%). About 29,000 cases were reported in July alone. The outbreak is concentrated in Gampaha District, where transmission of DENV-2 serotype is high. Although cases fell 3% over the past week, hospitalizations remain high, and authorities have expanded high-risk dengue alert areas. Thailand has reported 17,299 cases cumulatively this year as of week 30 (1 August), mostly among people aged 10–19 years. The highest mortality is among those aged 40–49 years and 60 years and above. Cases are below forecasts and lower than the same period last year. In the Philippines, Cebu has reported 1,228 cases cumulatively as of 18 July, including 10 deaths, a 12.35% increase over the same period last year. Zamboanga City has reported 1,184 cases cumulatively as of 25 July, a 20% increase over the same period last year, including 11 deaths, mostly among children under 10 years.

items.summary_zh: 美國紐約州薩福克郡今年1例確診、2例疑似兔熱病,當局警告疫情上升
items.summary_en: Suffolk County, New York, has reported 1 confirmed and 2 suspected tularaemia cases this year, and authorities warn cases are rising.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約州薩福克郡(Suffolk)今年截至7月報告1例確定病例及2例疑病例,其中1例兒童病患的住家庭院有野兔及蜱蟲活動。另美國年平均報告205例,近10年疫情呈上升趨勢,其中紐約州1993-2023年報告30例病例,有病患43%居住在薩福克郡,當局警告今年疫情上升。
items.description_en: Suffolk County, New York State, has reported 1 confirmed and 2 suspected tularaemia cases so far this year, as of July. In one child patient's case, rabbits and ticks were active in the family's yard. The United States reports an annual average of 205 cases, and cases have risen over the past decade. New York State reported 30 cases from 1993 to 2023, and 43% of those patients lived in Suffolk County. Authorities warn that cases are rising this year.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘自2022年累計18萬8,565例、521死,6月新增1,128例
items.summary_en: Global mpox since 2022 totals 188,565 confirmed cases and 521 deaths, with 1,128 cases in June, led by Madagascar with 546.
items.description_zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
items.description_en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.
