items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年人類新型A型流感37例,本週新增4例H9N2
items.summary_en: Four new H9N2 human cases were reported this week, with 37 novel influenza A human cases reported globally this year.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週新增4例H9N2。全球今年累計報告37例,分別為26例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告3,969起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共6國於2026/7/24-31期間報告35起H5N1疫情,美國16起、澳大利亞8起、印度6起、挪威3起、德國/英國各1起 。
items.description_en: Human cases: 4 new H9N2 cases were reported this week. Globally, 37 cases have been reported this year: 26 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 67 countries and territories have reported 3,969 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Six countries reported 35 H5N1 outbreaks during 24–31 July 2026: United States 16, Australia 8, India 6, Norway 3, and Germany and the United Kingdom 1 each.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率1.19%,中國門急診陽性率連升9週至20.3%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 1.19% in week 27; China's positivity rose to 20.3% in week 30, its ninth consecutive weekly rise.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第27週(7/6-12)為1.19%,西太平洋區署陽性率增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占52.8%)為主,其次為XFG(占19.9%)及JN.1(占15.5%)。 中國疫情上升,第30週(7/20-26)門急診陽性率上升為20.3%,相較前1週上升4%,已連續9週上升,為陽性率最高的呼吸道病原體,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate was 1.19% in week 27 of this year (6–12 July), with positivity increasing in the Western Pacific Region. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (52.8%), followed by XFG (19.9%) and JN.1 (15.5%). In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose to 20.3% in week 30 (20–26 July), up 4 percentage points from the previous week. This is the ninth consecutive weekly increase, and it is the respiratory pathogen with the highest positivity rate; NB.1.8.1 is the main variant.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計3,674例、1,621死;烏干達7/28宣布疫情結束
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 3,674 confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths, while Uganda declared its outbreak over on 28 July.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/31新增69例確定病例,其中34例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(53例)、北基伍省(12例)、上韋萊省(4例),喬波省於7/30新增一個受影響衛生區,有地理區持續擴大情形。目前累計3,674例確定病例(含1,621例死亡、666例康復),致死率44.1%,疫情分佈於5個省份共49個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國88%病例數。 烏干達於7/28宣布該國疫情結束,因其最後1例本土確定病例於6/16康復出院後,已連續42天未新增本土病例。惟依循國際準則,最近1例境外移入患者於7/16出院,WHO自該日(7/16)進行為期42天之監測追蹤,以確保沒有任何遺漏之傳播鏈。鑑於鄰國DRC疫情持續擴大、人員流動等跨境傳播風險,該國仍可能面臨境外移入傳播之風險,須維持高度監測及相關防治措施。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 31 July, 69 new confirmed cases were added, including 34 deaths, in Ituri Province (53 cases), North Kivu Province (12) and Haut-Uélé Province (4). On 30 July, one newly affected health zone was added in Tshopo Province, and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 31 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 3,674 (including 1,621 deaths and 666 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.1%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (49 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 88% of national cases. Uganda declared the end of its outbreak on 28 July. Its last locally confirmed case recovered and was discharged on 16 June, and no new locally acquired cases have been reported for 42 consecutive days since then. However, in line with international standards, the most recent imported patient was discharged on 16 July, and WHO began 42 days of follow-up monitoring from that date to ensure no transmission chains were missed. Given the continued expansion of the DRC outbreak and the cross-border transmission risk from population movement, Uganda may still face imported transmission and must maintain high-level surveillance and related control measures.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓鉤端螺旋體病今年累計2,177例,伊洛伊洛省CFR達11.6%
items.summary_en: The Philippines has reported 2,177 leptospirosis cases this year to early June, 6% more than the same period last year, with Iloilo's fatality ratio at 11.6%.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓進入雨季後疫情上升,該國今年迄至6月初累計報告2,177 例確定病例,較去年同期增加6%,其中以伊洛伊洛省(Iloilo)疫情最為嚴峻,該省之CFR為 11.6%(自2025年同期2例增加至8例死亡),個案多為農⺠與經常涉水者,因常接觸受感染鼠類尿液污染之水體及土壤,導致感染風險增加。
items.description_en: As the rainy season begins, cases in the Philippines have risen. As of early June this year, 2,177 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, 6% more than the same period last year. The most severe outbreak is in Iloilo Province, where the case fatality ratio is 11.6% (deaths increased from 2 in the same period of 2025 to 8). Most cases are farmers and people who frequently wade through water, and exposure to water and soil contaminated by rodent urine increases the risk of infection.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞拉薩熱累計963例、229死,CFR達23.8%,高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Lassa fever in Nigeria has reached 963 confirmed cases and 229 deaths this year to week 28, a 23.8% CFR above last year's 18.7%.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情升溫,截至今年第28週累計報告963例確定病例與229例死亡(CFR 23.8%,高於去年同期18.7%),波及23州114個區,86%病例集中於包奇州(Bauchi)、翁多州(Ondo)、塔拉巴州(Taraba)、貝努埃州(Benue)、埃多州(Edo)這5州。病患以21至30 歲族群為主,推估因從事農業、市場貿易等職業面臨較高的嚙齒動物及汙染環境暴露風險;另於28週新增1名醫療人員確診,凸顯臨床存在感染管制漏洞。
items.description_en: Lassa fever is rising in Nigeria. As of week 28 this year, 963 confirmed cases and 229 deaths have been reported cumulatively (CFR 23.8%, higher than 18.7% in the same period last year). Cases have spread to 114 districts in 23 states, and 86% of cases are concentrated in five states: Bauchi, Ondo, Taraba, Benue and Edo. Most patients are aged 21 to 30 years. Because of occupations such as farming and market trading, they are estimated to face higher exposure risk from rodents and contaminated environments. In addition, one healthcare worker was newly confirmed in week 28, highlighting gaps in clinical infection control.

items.summary_zh: 塞爾維亞拉什卡州羊痘爆發,132隻綿羊中6隻發病,已全數撲殺
items.summary_en: Serbia reported sheep pox in Raška District, where 6 of 132 sheep showed symptoms and all were culled; illegal smuggling from Kosovo is suspected.
items.description_zh: 歐洲塞爾維亞拉什卡州(Raska)於7/28報告世界動物組織(WOAH) 今年首起動物疫情。養殖場132隻綿羊中,其中6隻出現症狀,全數已遭撲殺。該國農業部調查本次疫情可能經由科索沃非法走私管道傳入,當局已實施移動管制與撲殺補償,另強調無人畜共通傳染風險。
items.description_en: On 28 July, Raška District in Serbia, Europe, reported the first animal outbreak this year to WOAH (World Organisation for Animal Health). Of 132 sheep on the farm, 6 showed symptoms, and all of them have been culled. The Ministry of Agriculture investigated and found that the outbreak may have been introduced through illegal smuggling routes from Kosovo. Authorities have implemented movement controls and culling compensation, and stressed that there is no zoonotic transmission risk.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計3,360例、1,487死,單日新增98例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths, with 98 new cases added on 27 July.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/27新增98例確定病例,其中50例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(87例)、北基伍省(11例)。目前累計3,360例確定病例(含1,487例死亡、597例康復),致死率44.3% ,疫情分佈於5個省份共48個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國89%病例數。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 27 July, 98 new confirmed cases were added, including 50 deaths, in Ituri Province (87 cases) and North Kivu Province (11). To date, 3,360 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (including 1,487 deaths and 597 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.3%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (48 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 89% of national cases.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗WPV1新增4例,奈及利亞、中非共和國共3例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 4 new WPV1 cases in Afghanistan and 3 cVDPV2 cases in Nigeria and the Central African Republic for 16–22 July.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/16-22期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗4例;cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為奈及利亞2例、中非共和國1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增阿富汗7件,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1件,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 16–22 July: WPV1 cases increased by 4 in Afghanistan; cVDPV2 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Nigeria and 1 in the Central African Republic. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 7 in Afghanistan, cVDPV1 increased by 1 in South Sudan, and cVDPV2 increased by 1 in Nigeria.

items.summary_zh: 日本腸病毒疫情高點,第29週2萬1,078例,定點平均9.35例
items.summary_en: Japan's enterovirus outbreak remains at a peak, with 21,078 cases in week 29 and an average of 9.35 per sentinel clinic, the second-highest since 2021.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情仍處高點,今年第29週(7/13-19)累計報告2萬1,078例病例,略高於第28週(2萬557例),定醫平均病例數為9.35例,顯著高於去年同期(0.57例),且為2021年以來次高。另今年截至7/19累計9萬7,929例手足口病病例,檢出型別以克沙奇A6型為多。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak remains at a peak. In week 29 of this year (13–19 July), 21,078 cases were reported, slightly higher than week 28 (20,557 cases). The average number of cases per sentinel clinic is 9.35, significantly higher than the same period last year (0.57), and the second-highest since 2021. In addition, as of 19 July this year, 97,929 cumulative hand, foot and mouth disease cases have been reported, with Coxsackievirus A6 as the predominant type detected.

items.summary_zh: 美國環孢子蟲病截至7/28累計逾6,707例,45州疫情,史上最大規模
items.summary_en: US cyclosporiasis cases have exceeded 6,707 confirmed since May, spanning 45 states, the largest outbreak in the country's history.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續擴大,今年5月截至7/28累計報告逾6,707例確定病例,其中423例住院,病患年齡中位數44歲,另有11,500例疑病例仍待實驗室檢測,疫情分布達45州,為該國史上最大規模之疫情。其中1,947例經調查與連鎖速食店群聚事件相關,密西根州疫調顯示高達9成患者曾食用結球萵苣。本次疫情出現兩波高峰(6月中旬及7月初),推測為多次暴露所致。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the United States continues to expand. From May this year through 28 July, more than 6,707 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 423 were hospitalized. The median patient age is 44 years. A further 11,500 suspected cases are still awaiting laboratory testing. The outbreak has reached 45 states and is the largest in the country's history. Of the cases, 1,947 have been linked through investigation to a cluster associated with a chain of fast-food restaurants. Michigan's epidemiological investigation shows that as many as 90% of patients had eaten iceberg lettuce. The outbreak has had two peaks (mid-June and early July), presumed to result from multiple exposures.

items.summary_zh: 美國沙門氏菌群聚98例、26例住院,疑源為德州雞蛋廠商,已回收160萬盒
items.summary_en: The US reported 98 Salmonella cases in 17 states, with a suspected Texas egg producer source; 1.6 million egg boxes have been recalled.
items.description_zh: 美國7/24報告一起群聚事件,累計報告98例病例,其中26例住院,疫情波及17州。接受疫調的患者有91%曾食用雞蛋,經全基因定序檢測疑感染源為德州某雞蛋生廠商,已緊急回收160 萬盒雞蛋。
items.description_en: On 24 July, the United States reported a cluster event with 98 cumulative cases, of which 26 were hospitalized, spanning 17 states. Of the patients interviewed, 91% had eaten eggs. Whole-genome sequencing suggests the suspected source is an egg producer in Texas, and 1.6 million egg boxes have been urgently recalled.

items.headline_zh: 烏克蘭-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭利維夫州首例漢他病毒確診,53歲男性,發病前曾赴克羅埃西亞
items.summary_en: Ukraine's Lviv Region reported a 53-year-old man with confirmed hantavirus infection, who had travelled to Croatia before falling ill; the country has 3 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 烏克蘭利維夫州(Lviv Regional)於7/23公佈首例確定病例,為53 歲男性, 其於7/12出現發燒、頭痛等症狀,7/15住院,經PCR確診為漢他病毒引起之腎綜合症出血熱。發病前曾前往克羅埃西亞,感染源不明。該國今年迄累計3例確定病例,已在患者住家當地加強防疫及預防措施 。
items.description_en: On 23 July, Lviv Region in Ukraine announced its first confirmed case, a 53-year-old man who developed fever and headache on 12 July and was hospitalized on 15 July. PCR confirmed hantavirus-caused haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. He had travelled to Croatia before onset, and the source of infection is unknown. This year, the country has reported 3 confirmed cases cumulatively. Prevention and control measures have been strengthened in the patient's home area.

items.summary_zh: 紐約市今年截至7/27退伍軍人病累計90例,5例死亡
items.summary_en: New York City reported 90 confirmed Legionnaires' cases this year as of 27 July, including 5 deaths, with 7 patients still hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市今年截至7/27,已累計報告90例確定病例,目前有7例住院、65例出院、5例死亡。
items.description_en: As of 27 July this year, New York City has reported 90 confirmed cases cumulatively. Currently, 7 are hospitalized, 65 have been discharged, and 5 have died.

items.headline_zh: 美國/墨西哥/哈薩克/瓜地馬拉-麻疹
items.headline_en: United States / Mexico / Kazakhstan / Guatemala – Measles
items.summary_zh: 美國、墨西哥、瓜地馬拉麻疹疫情上升,美國今年2,318例超越去年全年
items.summary_en: US measles cases this year (2,318) have surpassed last year's full-year total of 2,289; Guatemala has reported 30,040 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至7/23,累計2,318例確定病例,已超越去年全年2,289例,19歲以下族群達1,581例,其中有10%之5歲以下兒童住院,且高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。賓州迄7/27,過去7天新增報告31例確定病例,累計142例確定病例,為近期疫情上升地區之一。該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至7/24,累計報告12,335例確定病例,18例死亡,超越去年全年6,614例。其中以西部哈利斯科州(Jalisco)6,611例為多,墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,012例次之。確診人數以1-9歲孩童(4,753例)及25-29歲年輕成人(2,154 例)為好發族群。 哈薩克巴甫洛達爾州(Pavlodar)疫情上升,今年上半年已累積報告398例確定病例,有345例(87%)未接種疫苗,其中288例為14歲以下兒童。該國指出疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為此次爆發疫情的主要原因,該國已加強疫苗接種,並針對拒絕接種疫苗之家庭加強溝通。 瓜地馬拉(Guatemala)今年截至7/24,累計報告30,040例確定病例,29例死亡(CFR:0.1%) ,約10%個案住院,另15至39歲族群佔確定病例63%,1歲以下為高風險族群。
items.description_en: The United States has reported 2,318 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 23 July, exceeding last year's full-year total of 2,289. Cases aged under 19 years total 1,581, and 10% of children under 5 years have been hospitalized. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Pennsylvania reported 31 new confirmed cases in the 7 days to 27 July, bringing its cumulative total to 142 confirmed cases, and it is one of the areas where the outbreak has recently increased. The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. Mexico's outbreak continues. As of 24 July this year, 12,335 confirmed cases and 18 deaths have been reported cumulatively, exceeding last year's total of 6,614. Jalisco State accounts for most cases (6,611), followed by Mexico City (1,012). Children aged 1 to 9 years (4,753 cases) and young adults aged 25 to 29 years (2,154 cases) are the most affected groups. In Pavlodar Region of Kazakhstan, cases are rising. In the first half of this year, 398 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 345 (87%) were unvaccinated, including 288 children aged under 14 years. The country identifies insufficient vaccination coverage as the main cause of this outbreak, has strengthened vaccination, and has enhanced communication with families who refuse vaccination. Guatemala has reported 30,040 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 24 July, including 29 deaths (CFR: 0.1%). About 10% of cases were hospitalized. People aged 15 to 39 years account for 63% of confirmed cases, and infants under 1 year are a high-risk group.
items.area_zh: 瓜地馬拉,哈薩克,墨西哥,美國

items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計3,262例、1,437死,地理擴散趨緩
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola total reached 3,262 confirmed cases and 1,437 deaths, while geographic spread has slowed.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/26新增62例確定病例,其中32例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(53例)、北基伍省(8例)及上韋萊省(1例)。目前累計3,262例確定病例(含1,437例死亡、583 例康復),致死率44.1%,疫情分佈於5個省份共48個衛生區。 雖病例數持續增加,惟地理擴散速度趨緩。7/16-25間,受影響衛生區僅由46個微增至48個;伊圖里省自7/6以來,亦僅從25區增至28區(共36區)。 由牛津大學研發之全球首款BDBV專屬疫苗(ChAdOx1 BDBV)已於7/24為首位自願者接種。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 26 July, 62 new confirmed cases were added, including 32 deaths, in Ituri Province (53 cases), North Kivu Province (8) and Haut-Uélé Province (1). Cumulatively, 3,262 confirmed cases have been reported (including 1,437 deaths and 583 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.1%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (48 health zones). Although case numbers continue to rise, the speed of geographic spread has slowed. Between 16 and 25 July, the number of affected health zones increased only slightly, from 46 to 48. Since 6 July, Ituri Province has increased from 25 to 28 affected health zones (out of 36 in total). The world's first BDBV-specific vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, developed by the University of Oxford, was given to its first volunteer on 24 July.

items.summary_zh: 安哥拉馬蘭哲省今年截至6月瘧疾52萬例、418死,5歲以下兒童死亡率最高
items.summary_en: Malanje Province, Angola, has reported over 520,000 malaria cases and 418 deaths through June this year, with the highest death rate among children under 5.
items.description_zh: 安哥拉馬蘭哲省(Malanje)今年截至6月累計報告逾52萬例病例,其中418例死亡,5歲以下兒童的死亡率最高, 病例數於近幾年呈大幅增加趨勢,並存在就醫延遲之情形。該國傳播高峰期通常在雨季期間及之後(10月至次年5月), 當局已預訂於今年年底進行疫苗接種活動。另該國2024年累計報告700萬例病例,其中1.1 萬例死亡。
items.description_en: In Malanje Province, Angola, more than 520,000 malaria cases have been reported cumulatively this year through June, including 418 deaths. The death rate is highest among children under 5 years. Case numbers have increased sharply in recent years, and delays in seeking care have been observed. Transmission usually peaks during and after the rainy season (October to May of the following year). Authorities have scheduled a vaccination campaign for the end of this year. In addition, the country reported 7 million cases in 2024, including 11,000 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 巴西登革熱今年累計111萬1,023例、259死,低於去年同期約321萬例
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported 1,111,023 dengue cases and 259 deaths this year through week 28, below last year's roughly 3.21 million cases.
items.description_zh: 巴西今年截至第28週(7/18)累積報告111萬1,023例病例,其中重症533例、死亡259例(CFR: 0.023%),病例數占全美洲的79%,每10萬人口發生率為美洲國家次高,今年疫情低於去年同期(約321 萬例)。另該國於1-5月已接種50萬人次的全球首款單劑型疫苗,因有42人產生嚴重不良反應(其中2人死亡),當局已於6月暫停該疫苗之接種。
items.description_en: As of week 28 (18 July) this year, Brazil has reported 1,111,023 cases cumulatively, including 533 severe cases and 259 deaths (CFR: 0.023%). Brazil accounts for 79% of cases in the Americas, and its incidence per 100,000 population is the second-highest among countries in the Americas. Case numbers this year are lower than the same period last year (about 3.21 million cases). In addition, between January and May, 500,000 doses of the world's first single-dose dengue vaccine were administered. Because 42 people had serious adverse reactions (2 of whom died), authorities suspended vaccination with the vaccine in June.

items.headline_zh: 中國/菲律賓/法屬圭亞那-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 法屬圭亞那今年屈公病確定1,157例、2死,當局已發布警報
items.summary_en: French Guiana's chikungunya outbreak has reported 1,157 confirmed cases and 2 deaths this year, and authorities have issued an alert.
items.description_zh: 中國今年4-6月報告78例,其中廣東省今年截至5月報告36例。該國去年截至12/4累計報告2萬9,497例,曾於廣東省佛山去年7月爆發之大規模疫情已於11月受到控制(累計2萬5,826例)。 菲律賓薩馬省(Samar)疫情上升,今年2/5-7/13累計報告329例疑病例,疫情高峰落於第26週,病患分布以巴塞(Basey)和甘達拉(Gandara)鎮為多,年齡集中於10-29歲,該國近期已展開社區衛教活動。 法屬圭亞那疫情擴張,今年截至7/16累計報告1,157例確定病例,其中2例死亡,且有210例極可能或確定病例住院,並有出現母子垂直感染之案例,病例在部分醫院占其急診就診數的4-6%,疫情高峰落於4月底至5月中,惟近期可能有通報延遲之情形,當局已發布警報。
items.description_en: China reported 78 cases in April to June this year, of which Guangdong Province reported 36 as of May. The country had reported 29,497 cases as of 4 December last year. A large-scale outbreak in Foshan, Guangdong, which began in July last year, was brought under control in November (25,826 cases cumulatively). In Samar Province, Philippines, cases are rising. From 5 February to 13 July this year, 329 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively. The peak fell in week 26, cases are concentrated in the towns of Basey and Gandara, and most patients are aged 10 to 29 years. The country has recently launched community health education activities. In French Guiana, the outbreak is expanding. As of 16 July this year, 1,157 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths. Of the probable or confirmed cases, 210 were hospitalized, and cases of vertical mother-to-child transmission have been reported. In some hospitals, cases account for 4–6% of emergency department visits. The peak fell between late April and mid-May, but reporting may have been delayed recently, and authorities have issued an alert.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,法屬圭亞那,菲律賓

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年新型A型流感33例,本週無新增人類病例
items.summary_en: Globally, 33 human novel influenza A cases have been reported this year, none new this week, while 4 countries reported 17 H5N1 animal outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週無新增病例。全球今年累計報告33例,分別為22例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告3,934起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共4國於2026/7/18-24期間報告17起H5N1疫情,荷蘭7起、多哥5起、巴西2起、厄瓜多/澳大利亞/紐西蘭各1起。 墨西哥於2026/7/21-24期間報告4起H7N3疫情。
items.description_en: Human cases: No new cases were reported this week. Globally, 33 cases have been reported this year: 22 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 67 countries and territories have reported 3,934 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Four countries reported 17 H5N1 outbreaks during 18–24 July 2026: the Netherlands 7, Togo 5, Brazil 2, and Ecuador, Australia and New Zealand 1 each. Mexico reported 4 H7N3 outbreaks during 21–24 July 2026.

items.summary_zh: 美國麻疹今年2,318例,為1991年以來新高,恐失去麻疹消除地位
items.summary_en: US measles cases reached 2,318 this year, the highest since 1991, and the country may lose its measles elimination status this autumn.
items.description_zh: 美國今年迄今累計報告2,318例確定病例,已超越去年全年2,289 例,疫情創下自1991年以來新高。除16例屬境外移入,餘皆為本土感染,高達93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近9成感染者為19 歲以下兒童與青少年,住院率達7%,目前尚無死亡病例。猶他州為最大疫區(逾500例),賓州為新增疫區(單週新增29例,累計達139例)。專家建議加強MMR疫苗接種,防堵疫情擴散。該國恐於今年秋季失去自2000年迄今之麻疹消除地位。
items.description_en: The United States has reported 2,318 confirmed cases to date this year, exceeding last year's full-year total of 2,289, and the highest since 1991. Of these, 16 were imported, and the rest were locally acquired infections. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and nearly 90% of cases were children and adolescents aged under 19 years. The hospitalization rate is 7%, and no deaths have been reported so far. Utah is the largest outbreak area (more than 500 cases), and Pennsylvania is a newly affected area (29 new cases in a single week, bringing its total to 139). Experts recommend strengthening MMR vaccination to prevent further spread. The country may lose the measles elimination status it has held since 2000 as early as this autumn.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率1.77%,中國門急診陽性率連升8週至16.3%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity reached 1.77% in week 26, while China's rose to 16.3% in week 29 and Hong Kong's to 10.27%, both after eight straight weekly increases.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第26週(6/29-7/5)為1.77%,西太平洋區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占58.76%)為主,其次為XFG(占19.07%)及JN.1(占15.46%)。 中國疫情上升,第29週(7/13-17)門急診陽性率上升為16.3%,相較前1週上升4.3%,已連續8週上升,且躍昇為陽性率最高的呼吸道病原體,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情上升,第29週(7/12-7/18)陽性率上升至10.27%,已連續8週上升,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以NB.1.8.1(占99.8%)為主。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate was 1.77% in week 26 of this year (29 June–5 July), and positivity in the Western Pacific Region rose markedly. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (58.76%), followed by XFG (19.07%) and JN.1 (15.46%). In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose to 16.3% in week 29 (13–17 July), up 4.3 percentage points from the previous week, and has risen for 8 consecutive weeks. It has become the respiratory pathogen with the highest positivity rate, and NB.1.8.1 is the main variant. In Hong Kong, cases are rising. Positivity rose to 10.27% in week 29 (12–18 July), with 8 consecutive weeks of increase. Wastewater surveillance shows NB.1.8.1 predominates at 99.8%.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計3,075例、1,354死,醫護罷工影響防疫
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola total reached 3,075 confirmed cases and 1,354 deaths, while health workers in Ituri strike over unpaid wages.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/24新增102例確定病例,其中45例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(87例)、北基伍省(9例)及上韋萊省(6例),7/23新增1個受影響的衛生區(上韋萊省Rungu),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前累計3,075例確定病例(含1,354例死亡、556例康復),致死率44.0%,疫情分佈於5個省份共48個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國89%病例數。 重災區伊圖里省爆發嚴重公衛危機,百名醫療人員因連續兩個月未獲發薪資獎金,於7/25起發起罷工,已嚴重癱瘓布亞(Bunia)治療中運作,並導致病患死亡。此外,因高風險工作環境,迄今已逾100名醫療照護人員不幸染疫。WHO表示由於迄今仍未找到指標個案,再加上東部地區武裝衝突、非法採礦、人口流離失所及部分⺠眾不信任政府,導致疫情追蹤工作困難。 本次疫情蔓延速度超越以往,為史上第三大規模。啟動應變措施僅40天,確定病例數即突破千例;相較2018年DRC北基伍省疫情,當時耗時235天才達此規模。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 24 July, 102 new confirmed cases were added, including 45 deaths, in Ituri Province (87 cases), North Kivu Province (9) and Haut-Uélé Province (6). On 23 July, one newly affected health zone was added (Rungu in Haut-Uélé Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. To date, 3,075 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (including 1,354 deaths and 556 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.0%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (48 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 89% of national cases. Ituri, the hardest-hit province, is facing a serious public health crisis: about 100 health workers began a strike on 25 July after two consecutive months without salaries and bonuses. The strike has severely disrupted operations at the treatment centre in Bunia and has led to patient deaths. In addition, more than 100 healthcare workers have been infected because of the high-risk working environment. WHO has said that because no index case has yet been identified, and because of armed conflict in the eastern region, illegal mining, population displacement and some people's distrust of the government, contact tracing has been difficult. This outbreak is spreading faster than previous ones and is the third-largest on record. Confirmed cases exceeded 1,000 just 40 days after the response was activated; by comparison, the 2018 outbreak in North Kivu Province took 235 days to reach this scale.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲西澳州M痘今年36例,超過前兩年全年;哥斯大黎加今年第3例
items.summary_en: Western Australia's mpox cases this year (36) already exceed the full-year totals of the past two years, while Costa Rica has reported its third case.
items.description_zh: 澳洲西澳大利亞州(Western Australia)疫情上升,今年迄今累計 36例確定病例,已高於過去2年整年病例數(2025年28例、 2024年23例),迄無死亡病例,多數病例為本土感染,且為第二分支之 IIb子分支(Clade IIb)。另感染者已從GBMSM族群擴大至異性戀男女,當局已提供高風險群體免費接種兩劑疫苗。該國疫情上升,今年共報告166例,自2022年迄今累計報告1,973例。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第3例確定病例,為37歲男性,調查顯示與第2例病例具流病關聯。疫情自首都聖荷西省擴散至埃雷迪亞省 ,當局已啟動接觸者追蹤。目前該國今年報告之 3 例確定病例病況皆穩定(均為成年男性,年齡介於27- 52歲間)。去(2025)年累計報告5例,自2022年迄今累計報告235例確定病例,其中1例死亡。
items.description_en: Mpox cases are rising in Western Australia. So far this year, 36 confirmed cases have been reported, which is higher than the full-year totals of the past two years (28 in 2025 and 23 in 2024). No deaths have been reported to date. Most cases are locally acquired infections of Clade IIb, a subclade of the second clade. Infections have also spread from gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM) to heterosexual men and women. Authorities are providing free two-dose vaccination to high-risk groups. Australia has reported 166 cases this year and 1,973 cumulative cases since 2022. In Costa Rica, the country has reported its third confirmed case this year, a 37-year-old man. Investigation shows an epidemiological link to the second case. The outbreak has spread from the capital province of San José to Heredia Province, and authorities have started contact tracing. The three confirmed cases reported this year are all in stable condition (all adult men aged 27 to 52 years). Costa Rica reported 5 cases last year and has reported 235 confirmed cases since 2022, including 1 death.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計2,536例、1,033死,單日新增63例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with 63 new cases added on 21 July.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/21新增63例確定病例,其中34例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(46例)、北基伍省(12例)及上韋萊省(5例)。目前累計2,536例確定病例(含1,033例死亡、506例康復),致死率40.7%,疫情分佈於5個省份共47個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國89%病例數,其次為北基伍省10.2%。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 21 July, 63 new confirmed cases were added, including 34 deaths, in Ituri Province (46 cases), North Kivu Province (12) and Haut-Uélé Province (5). To date, 2,536 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (including 1,033 deaths and 506 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 40.7%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (47 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected at 89% of national cases, followed by North Kivu Province at 10.2%.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗WPV1新增4例,多國新增cVDPV病例共7例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 4 new WPV1 cases in Afghanistan and 7 new vaccine-derived polio cases across several countries for 9–15 July.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/9-15期間,WPV1新增阿富汗4例;cVDPV1新增2國共3例,分別為衣索比亞2例、南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國2例、查德1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共13件,分別為阿富汗12件、巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV1新增馬達加斯加2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 9–15 July: WPV1 cases increased by 4 in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Ethiopia and 1 in South Sudan; cVDPV2 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Chad; and cVDPV3 cases increased by 1 in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 13 across 2 countries, with 12 in Afghanistan and 1 in Pakistan, and cVDPV1 increased by 2 in Madagascar.

items.summary_zh: 日本第28週手足口病2萬557例,較前週增30%,定點平均9.12例
items.summary_en: Japan's hand, foot and mouth disease cases rose 30% in week 28 to 20,557, averaging 9.12 per sentinel clinic, the second-highest in five years.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情於高點,今年第28週(7/6-12)累計報告2萬557例手足口病病例,較前1週(1萬5,848例)增加30%,定醫平均病例數為9.12例,顯著高於去年同期(0.57例),且為近5年次高。另今年截至7/5累計7萬6,772例病例。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is at its peak. In week 28 of this year (6–12 July), 20,557 hand, foot and mouth disease cases were reported, an increase of 30% from the previous week (15,848 cases). The average number per sentinel clinic was 9.12, significantly higher than the same period last year (0.57) and the second-highest in the past five years. In addition, as of 5 July this year, 76,772 cases have been reported cumulatively.

items.summary_zh: 美國環孢子蟲病今年累計4,173例,41州疫情,另約7,400例待確認
items.summary_en: US cyclosporiasis cases reached 4,173 from 4 May to 20 July across 41 states, with at least 7,400 more awaiting lab confirmation.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情更新,今年5/4-7/20累計報告4,173例病例,其中308 例住院,疫情分布於41州,並估計仍有至少7,400例待實驗室確認病例,疫情顯著高於2025年同期。FDA已發布澄清報告指出,墨西哥生產的萵苣檢體,經複測結果為偽陽性。
items.description_en: US outbreak update: From 4 May to 20 July this year, 4,173 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 308 were hospitalized, across 41 states. At least 7,400 more cases are estimated to be still awaiting laboratory confirmation. The outbreak is significantly higher than in the same period of 2025. The FDA has issued a clarification report stating that retesting of lettuce samples from Mexico produced false-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 美國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 美國郵輪諾羅病毒群聚18例,占乘客29%,今年已報8起船上腸胃道疫情
items.summary_en: A US cruise norovirus cluster reached 18 cases, 29% of passengers, on an Alaska voyage; 8 shipboard GI outbreaks have been reported this year.
items.description_zh: 美國7/12報告一起郵輪群聚事件,累計18例病例,占所有乘客的29%,乘客係於前往阿拉斯加之航程上發病。該郵輪今年已發生過兩起諾羅病毒感染疫情(5月報告12例、6月報告20例)。該國今年迄今累計報告8件船隻上之腸胃道相關疫情,另2025年累計報告23件,諾羅病毒為郵輪疫情的常見致病原(占9成)。
items.description_en: On 12 July, the United States reported a cruise ship cluster with 18 cumulative cases, accounting for 29% of all passengers. Passengers fell ill during a voyage to Alaska. The ship has already experienced two norovirus outbreaks this year (12 cases reported in May and 20 in June). So far this year, the country has reported 8 gastrointestinal outbreaks on ships; 23 were reported cumulatively in 2025. Norovirus is a common pathogen in cruise ship outbreaks, accounting for 90%.

items.headline_zh: 委內瑞拉-不明原因致死疾病
items.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉不明原因疾病致至少6人死亡,含3名醫師,已排除登革熱與黃熱病
items.summary_en: Venezuela reported at least 6 deaths from an unexplained illness, including 3 doctors; dengue and yellow fever have been ruled out and investigation continues.
items.description_zh: 委內瑞拉7/21報告至少6例死亡病例,為3名巴里納斯州(Barinas)醫師,以及安索阿特吉州(Anzoátegui)3名同家庭成員,症狀包含呼吸道症狀、發燒與出血及肺衰竭等。當局已排除登革熱與黃熱病,雖專家推測可能為漢他病毒症候群或委內瑞拉出血熱(Venezuelan hemorrhagic fever),惟疫情仍調查中。
items.description_en: On 21 July, Venezuela reported at least 6 deaths: 3 doctors in Barinas State, and 3 members of the same family in Anzoátegui State. Symptoms included respiratory symptoms, fever, bleeding and pulmonary failure. Authorities have ruled out dengue and yellow fever. Experts speculate the illness may be hantavirus syndrome or Venezuelan haemorrhagic fever, but the outbreak is still under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞去年確定病例1萬5,273例,增42.5%,尼日州疑白喉群聚
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 15,273 confirmed cases last year, up 42.5%, and a suspected diphtheria cluster in Niger State has caused one death.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞去年累計報告1萬5,273例確定病例,相較前年1萬714 例確定病例,增加42.5%。近期日(Niger State )出現疑白喉群聚事件,截至7/18,有2名兒童住院治療,1名死亡,針對本次事件,該國與聯合國兒童基金會(UNICEF)已緊急介入,加強當地感染預防與控制(IPC)及加強個案管理,以防止疫情擴散。
items.description_en: Nigeria reported 15,273 confirmed cases last year, an increase of 42.5% over the 10,714 confirmed cases the year before. Recently, a suspected diphtheria cluster emerged in Niger State. As of 18 July, 2 children had been hospitalized and 1 death had occurred. In response, Nigeria and UNICEF have intervened urgently to strengthen local infection prevention and control (IPC) and case management, in order to prevent further spread.

items.summary_zh: 紐約市今年截至7/20累計76例,4例死亡,76座冷卻水塔檢出退伍軍人菌
items.summary_en: New York City reported 76 Legionnaires' cases this year as of 20 July, including 4 deaths, and at least 76 cooling towers were found to contain Legionella.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市今年截至7/20,累計報告76例確定病例,其中有7例住院、4例死亡,病例主要集中於曼哈頓上東區。另截至7/20,經檢測發現當地至少有76座冷卻水塔存在退伍軍人菌,該市針對檢測呈陽性之冷卻水塔進行清潔和消毒。
items.description_en: As of 20 July this year, New York City has reported 76 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 7 hospitalized and 4 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the Upper East Side of Manhattan. Also as of 20 July, testing found that at least 76 cooling towers in the area contained Legionella bacteria. The city is cleaning and disinfecting cooling towers that tested positive.

items.headline_zh: 美國/孟加拉/剛果⺠主共和國-麻疹
items.headline_en: United States / Bangladesh / Democratic Republic of the Congo – Measles
items.summary_zh: 麻疹:美國今年2,260例、孟加拉逾11萬例、剛果民主共和國9萬9,200例
items.summary_en: Measles is rising in the US (2,260 cases this year), Bangladesh (over 110,000 cases, 771 deaths) and the DRC (99,200 confirmed cases).
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至7/16,累計報告2,260例確定病例,接近去年全年2,289例,多數為19歲以下(70%)族群,有146 例(6%)需住院治療,且有高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。疫情主要集中於南卡羅來納州(670例),其次為猶他州(518例)、德州(182例)及維吉亞州(176)例;該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 孟加拉今年截至7/15,累計報告逾11萬例病例(1萬3,907例確定病例),累計達771例(95例確定)死亡,以首都達卡(8,912例確定病例、59例死亡)最為嚴峻,疫情呈地域性蔓延,全國8個行政區均有通報及死亡病例。儘管該國疫苗覆蓋率高達99%,惟疫情仍持續傳播,懷疑覆蓋率高為近期加強推動接種活動的結果,後續仍需結合常規免疫指標,監測流行學病學趨勢。 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情上升,今年截至6/28,累計報告9萬9,200例確定病例,高於去年同期3萬4,000例,主要集中於東部南基伍省(26,900例)和北基伍省(17,500例),兩省總病例數合計佔該國45%;由於該國面臨兒童營養不良、武裝衝突等因素,影響WHO常規疫苗接種計畫,導致該國疫情擴大。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the United States continues to rise. As of 16 July this year, 2,260 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, approaching last year's full-year total of 2,289. Most (70%) are aged under 19 years; 146 (6%) required hospitalization, and as many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak is concentrated in South Carolina (670 cases), followed by Utah (518), Texas (182) and Virginia (176). The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. In Bangladesh, as of 15 July this year, more than 110,000 cases have been reported cumulatively (13,907 confirmed cases), and cumulative deaths have reached 771 (95 confirmed). The capital, Dhaka, is the most severely affected (8,912 confirmed cases and 59 deaths), and the outbreak is spreading regionally, with cases and deaths reported in all 8 administrative divisions nationwide. Although the country's vaccination coverage is as high as 99%, transmission continues. It is suspected that the high coverage rate is the result of recently intensified vaccination campaigns, so routine immunization indicators need to be considered alongside monitoring of epidemiological trends. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), cases are rising. As of 28 June this year, 99,200 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 34,000 in the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in South Kivu Province (26,900) and North Kivu Province (17,500), which together account for 45% of the national total. Because of factors including child malnutrition and armed conflict, which affect WHO's routine vaccination programme, the outbreak has expanded.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計2,423例、967死,伊圖里省佔90%
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 2,423 confirmed cases and 967 deaths, with Ituri Province accounting for 90% of national cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/19新增79例確定病例,其中37例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(70例)及北基伍省(9例)。新增1 個受影響的衛生區(伊圖里省),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前疫情分佈於5個省份共47個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國90%病例數,累計2,423例確定病例(含967例死亡、469例康復)。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 19 July, 79 new confirmed cases were added, including 37 deaths, in Ituri Province (70 cases) and North Kivu Province (9). One newly affected health zone was added in Ituri Province, and the geographic spread continues to expand. The outbreak is currently distributed across 5 provinces (47 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 90% of national cases. Cumulatively, 2,423 confirmed cases have been reported (including 967 deaths and 469 recoveries).

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至7/8登革熱13,143例、19死,病例數約去年一半但仍上升
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 13,143 dengue cases and 19 deaths this year as of 8 July; case numbers are about half of last year's, but the trend is rising.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至7/8累計報告1萬3,143例病例,其中19例死亡,病患以10-14歲為多,死亡個案多為⻑者或有其他共病等,病例數雖約為去(2025)年之50%,惟整體疫情仍呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en: As of 8 July this year, Thailand has reported 13,143 cases cumulatively, including 19 deaths. Patients are mostly aged 10 to 14 years, and deaths have mostly occurred among older people or those with other comorbidities. Although case numbers are about 50% of last year's, the overall outbreak continues to show an upward trend.

items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞黃熱病今年累計202例、90死,致死率44%,多數未接種疫苗
items.summary_en: Colombia has reported 202 yellow fever cases and 90 deaths this year as of 15 July, a 44% fatality ratio, mostly among unvaccinated people.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞今年截至7/15累計報告202例病例,其中90例死亡(CFR: 44%),疫情以托利馬省(Tolima)為高,多數病例無接種疫苗,此波疫情係從2024年9月延續迄今,當局評估,本次疫情致死率偏高,主要與疫情擴散至新地區導致延誤診斷,以及與登革熱共同流行有關。另該國過往疫苗涵蓋率為64%(1-59歲族群)。
items.description_en: As of 15 July this year, Colombia has reported 202 cases cumulatively, including 90 deaths (CFR: 44%). The outbreak is concentrated in Tolima Department, and most cases were unvaccinated. This wave has continued since September 2024. Authorities assess that the high fatality ratio in this outbreak is mainly related to the spread of the outbreak to new areas, which has delayed diagnosis, and to co-circulation with dengue. Vaccination coverage in the country was previously 64% (population aged 1 to 59 years).

items.summary_zh: 美國西尼羅熱今年至少81例,約79%為嚴重神經侵襲性疾病,分布18州
items.summary_en: US West Nile fever has reached at least 81 cases in 18 states this year, with about 79% severe neuroinvasive disease, eight times the annual average since 2004.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情擴大,今年截至6/30累計報告至少81例病例,其中約有79%出現嚴重神經侵襲性疾病,病患分布於亞利桑那及德州等18個州,病例數為2004年以來年平均數(約10例)的8倍且流行季較往年提早開始 ,並有23個州報告有病毒的病媒蚊活動情形,為10年來最高,相關資料顯示目前流行的病毒株毒性高或暴露族群多為易感族群。目前尚無核准的人用疫苗和特效抗病毒療法,故必須落實病媒控制和個人防護措施。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the United States is expanding. As of 30 June this year, at least 81 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which about 79% had severe neuroinvasive disease. Cases are distributed across 18 states, including Arizona and Texas. The number of cases is eight times the annual average since 2004 (about 10 cases), and the transmission season began earlier than usual. Virus-carrying mosquito activity has been reported in 23 states, the highest in 10 years. Relevant data suggest that the currently circulating virus strain is highly virulent, or that exposed populations are largely susceptible. There are currently no approved human vaccines or specific antiviral therapies, so vector control and personal protective measures must be implemented.

items.headline_zh: 西班牙-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 西班牙今年克里米亞-剛果出血熱2例,1例死亡(84歲女性)
items.summary_en: Spain, the only European country reporting cases so far this year, has 2 Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases, including one death.
items.description_zh: 西班牙今年截至7/15累計報告2例病例,其中1例死亡(84歲女性) ,病患發病日介於6/11-7/8。西班牙為歐洲今年迄今唯一報告疫情的國家,另2016-2024年累計報告16例病例。歐洲CDC評估目前疫情與過往6-8月季節性疫情趨勢一致,感染重症需住院者中約有30%會致命。
items.description_en: As of 15 July this year, Spain has reported 2 cases cumulatively, including 1 death (an 84-year-old woman), with onset dates between 11 June and 8 July. Spain is the only European country to have reported cases so far this year. From 2016 to 2024, 16 cases were reported cumulatively. The European CDC assesses that the current outbreak is consistent with the seasonal trend of previous June–August outbreaks, and that about 30% of severe infections requiring hospitalization are fatal.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 全球伊波拉累計2,367例、932死,DRC占2,344例
items.summary_en: Globally, Ebola has reached 2,367 confirmed cases and 932 deaths as of 18 July, with 2,344 cases in the DRC and 4 countries affected.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/18新增83例確定病例,其中40例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(67例)及北基伍省(16例),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前疫情分佈於5個省份共46個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國89%病例數。 全球疫情概況:截至7/18,疫情波及4個國家,累計報告2,367例確定病例,其中932例死亡(CFR:39%)。病例主要集中於DRC ,計2,344例確定病例(含930例死亡、466例康復);鄰國烏干達計20例確定病例(含2例死亡、18例康復),其個案均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關;美國計2例(含1例已康復)、法國計1例(已康復),此零星個案皆為於DRC當地進行醫療照護之人員或人道救援者。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 18 July, 83 new confirmed cases were added, including 40 deaths, in Ituri Province (67 cases) and North Kivu Province (16), and the geographic spread continues to expand. The outbreak is currently distributed across 5 provinces (46 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 89% of national cases. Global overview: as of 18 July, the outbreak has spread to 4 countries, with 2,367 confirmed cases reported cumulatively, including 932 deaths (CFR: 39%). Most cases are in the DRC, with 2,344 confirmed cases (including 930 deaths and 466 recoveries). Neighbouring Uganda has reported 20 confirmed cases (including 2 deaths and 18 recoveries), all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. The United States has reported 2 cases (1 recovered) and France 1 case (recovered). These sporadic cases were all healthcare workers or humanitarian responders providing care in the DRC.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年新型A型流感33例,今年禽流感64國通報3,900起
items.summary_en: Globally, 33 human novel influenza A cases have been reported this year, while 64 countries have reported 3,900 avian influenza outbreaks in animals.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:全球今年累計報告33例,分別為22例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計64國家/地區報告3,900起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共8國於2026/7/10-16期間報告39起H5N1疫情,泊爾17 起、印11起、荷蘭5起、秘魯2起、加拿大/奧地利/挪威/ 紐西蘭各1起。 共1國於2026/7/13-2026/7/13期間報告3起H5N5疫情,加拿大3起。
items.description_en: Human cases: Globally, 33 cases have been reported this year: 22 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 64 countries and territories have reported 3,900 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Eight countries reported 39 H5N1 outbreaks during 10–16 July 2026: Nepal 17, India 11, the Netherlands 5, Peru 2, and Canada, Austria, Norway and New Zealand 1 each. One country (Canada) reported 3 H5N5 outbreaks on 13 July 2026.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率1.19%,中國門急診陽性率連升7週至11.9%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 1.19% in week 25, while China's rose to 11.9% in week 28 and Hong Kong's to 9.79%, both after seven straight weekly increases.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第25週(6/22-28)為1.19%,其中,西太平洋區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占58.76%)為主,其次為XFG(占19.07%)及JN.1(占15.46%)。 中國疫情上升,第28週(7/6-7/12)門急診陽性率上升為11.9%,相較前1週上升2.3%,已連續7週上升,且躍昇為各呼吸道病原體中的第2高(最高為流感),變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情上升,第28週(7/5-7/11)陽性率上升至9.79%,已連續7週上升,汙水監測顯示變異株占比以NB.1.8.1(占94.3%)為主。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate was 1.19% in week 25 of this year (22–28 June), and positivity in the Western Pacific Region rose markedly. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (58.76%), followed by XFG (19.07%) and JN.1 (15.46%). In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose to 11.9% in week 28 (6–12 July), up 2.3 percentage points from the previous week, and has risen for 7 consecutive weeks. It has become the second-highest of all respiratory pathogens (after influenza), and NB.1.8.1 is the main variant. In Hong Kong, cases are rising. Positivity rose to 9.79% in week 28 (5–11 July), with 7 consecutive weeks of increase. Wastewater surveillance shows NB.1.8.1 predominates at 94.3%.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸,香港特別行政區

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 全球伊波拉累計2,147例、830死,DRC佔2,124例
items.summary_en: Global Ebola cases reached 2,147 confirmed and 830 deaths as of 15 July, while Uganda began a 42-day monitoring period after its last patient was discharged.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/14-15新增113例確定病例,其中74例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(96例)、北基伍省(17例)。另7/15伊圖里省新增1個受影響衛生區(Mahagi),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前疫情分佈於5個省份共46個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國90%的病例數。 烏干達自6/22迄今無新增疫情,7/16宣布該國最後一名患者出院,將啟動42天監測期追蹤,若無新增病例,可依WHO規定宣布此波疫情結束。 全球疫情概況:截至7/15,疫情波及4個國家,累計報告2,147例確定病例,其中830例死亡(CFR38.7%)。病例主要集中於DRC,計2,124例確定病例(含828例死亡、390例康復);鄰國烏干達計20例確定病例(含2例死亡、18例康復),其個案均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關;美國計2例(含1例已康復)、法國計1例(已康復),此零星個案皆為於DRC當地進行醫療照護之人員或人道救援者。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. Between 14 and 15 July, 113 new confirmed cases were added, including 74 deaths, in Ituri Province (96 cases) and North Kivu Province (17). On 15 July, one newly affected health zone was added in Ituri Province (Mahagi), and the geographic spread continues to expand. The outbreak is currently distributed across 5 provinces (46 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 90% of national cases. Uganda has reported no new cases since 22 June. On 16 July, the country announced the discharge of its last patient and began a 42-day monitoring period; if no new cases are reported, Uganda can declare the end of this wave of the outbreak in line with WHO requirements. Global overview: as of 15 July, the outbreak has spread to 4 countries, with 2,147 confirmed cases reported cumulatively, including 830 deaths (CFR: 38.7%). Most cases are in the DRC, with 2,124 confirmed cases (including 828 deaths and 390 recoveries). Neighbouring Uganda has 20 confirmed cases (including 2 deaths and 18 recoveries), all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. The United States has 2 cases (1 recovered) and France 1 case (recovered). These sporadic cases were all healthcare workers or humanitarian responders providing care in the DRC.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,法國,烏干達,美國

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞拉薩熱今年922例、221死,致死率24%,高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Lassa fever in Nigeria has reported 922 confirmed cases and 221 deaths this year, a 24% CFR higher than the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情升溫,已波及全國23州(23/36),其中85%病例集中於5個州(翁多州Ondo 30%、包奇州Bauchi 26%、塔拉巴州Taraba 14%、埃多州Edo 9%及貝努埃州Benue 6%)。今年累計報告922例確定病例,其中221例死亡,致死率24%,高於去(2025)年同期(790例,其中190例死亡),21至30歲為主要受影響族群。當局已於2019年1月宣布此波疫情為國家級公共衛生緊急事件。
items.description_en: Lassa fever is rising in Nigeria, which has now affected 23 of the country's 36 states. Of cases, 85% are concentrated in 5 states: Ondo (30%), Bauchi (26%), Taraba (14%), Edo (9%) and Benue (6%). This year, 922 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 221 deaths, a CFR of 24%. This is higher than the same period last year (790 cases, including 190 deaths). Patients aged 21 to 30 years are the main affected group. In January 2019, authorities declared this wave of the outbreak a national public health emergency.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達西部希馬市炭疽病14例感染、5死,因食用不明死因牛肉所致
items.summary_en: A gastrointestinal anthrax outbreak in Hima, western Uganda, infected 14 people and caused 5 deaths after eating beef from cattle that died of unknown causes.
items.description_zh: 烏干達西部希馬市於2026年5-6月期間爆發疑腸胃型炭疽病疫情,經調查起因於⺠眾食用死因不明之牛隻肉品,已致14例感染,其中9例重症住院與5例死亡,致死率逾35%。當局呼籲⺠眾勿處理或食用死因不明之動物屍體,嚴防疫情擴大 。
items.description_en: Between May and June 2026, a suspected gastrointestinal anthrax outbreak occurred in Hima town in western Uganda. Investigation found that people had eaten beef from cattle that died of unknown causes. A total of 14 people were infected, including 9 severely ill and hospitalized and 5 deaths, a fatality ratio of over 35%. Authorities urge the public not to handle or eat the carcasses of animals that died of unknown causes, in order to prevent the outbreak from spreading.

items.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加首都聖荷西今年首報2例M痘,尚未查明感染源,已啟動接觸者追蹤
items.summary_en: San José, Costa Rica's capital, reported its first 2 mpox cases this year, both without recent travel or epidemiological links, and contact tracing has started.
items.description_zh: 哥斯大黎加首都聖荷西今年首度報告2例確定病例,分別為25及55 歲男性,近期均無旅遊史,且無流行病學關聯,感染源及病毒分支型別仍待釐清,當局已啟動接觸者追蹤。該國去(2025)年共報告5例,自2022年迄今累計報告234例確定病例,其中1例死亡。
items.description_en: The capital, San José, of Costa Rica reported 2 confirmed cases this year for the first time, both men aged 25 and 55 years. Neither had recent travel history, and they have no epidemiological link. The source of infection and the virus lineage remain to be clarified, and authorities have started contact tracing. Costa Rica reported 5 cases last year, and 234 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively since 2022, including 1 death.

items.summary_zh: 牛津大學啟動Bundibugyo伊波拉候選疫苗一期試驗,DRC暴露後預防試驗
items.summary_en: Oxford University began a Phase 1 trial of a Bundibugyo Ebola candidate vaccine, while recruitment for an obeldesivir post-exposure prophylaxis trial began in the DRC.
items.description_zh: 英國牛津大學疫苗團隊啟動Bundibugyo伊波拉候選疫苗之第一期(Phase 1)人體試驗,將評估在50名健康成年人之安全性及免疫反應(年齡介於18至55歲間)。 針對無症狀之高風險接觸者,實驗性抗病毒藥物obeldesivir之暴露後預防(EBO-PEP)臨床試驗計畫,已於7/14在剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省重災區(布亞Bunia及魯瓦姆帕拉Rwampara 衛生區)啟動召募計畫,預計召募近1,000 名參與者(須為成人或12歲以上兒童)。
items.description_en: The University of Oxford vaccine team in the United Kingdom has launched a Phase 1 human trial of the Bundibugyo Ebola candidate vaccine, which will assess safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18 to 55 years. For asymptomatic high-risk contacts, a clinical trial of post-exposure prophylaxis (EBO-PEP) with the experimental antiviral obeldesivir began recruitment on 14 July in the hard-hit Ituri Province of the DRC (Bunia and Rwampara health zones). Nearly 1,000 participants are expected to be enrolled (adults or children aged 12 years and older).
items.area_en: Congo,Democratic Republic of the,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯省旋毛蟲感染症6例確定、45例調查中,疑為自製香腸
items.summary_en: Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, has reported 6 confirmed trichinellosis cases with 45 more under investigation, suspected to come from homemade sausage.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯省(Buenos Aires)7/12報告6例確定病例,並有45例仍調查中,感染來源疑為自製香腸,當局已加強檢查,並呼籲⺠眾避免食用未經認證的醃製肉類製品。
items.description_en: Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, reported 6 confirmed cases on 12 July, with 45 cases still under investigation. The suspected source of infection is homemade sausage. Authorities have strengthened inspections and urge the public to avoid eating uncertified cured meat products.

items.headline_zh: 約旦-不明原因飲食相關疾病
items.summary_zh: 約旦扎爾卡區138例飲食相關疾病,皆於某餐廳用餐,28例住院觀察
items.summary_en: Jordan's Zarqa Governorate reported 138 unexplained foodborne illness cases, all linked to a single restaurant, with 28 still hospitalized for observation.
items.description_zh: 約旦扎爾卡(Zarqa)區域7/13報告138例病例,病患皆於某餐廳用餐後發病,目前仍有28例需住院觀察,無死亡病例報告。 當局已要求餐廳暫時停業,並調查感染源。另該國於2020年曾爆發單一餐廳的沙門氏菌感染症群聚事件。
items.description_en: Zarqa Governorate in Jordan reported 138 cases on 13 July. All patients fell ill after dining at a certain restaurant. Currently, 28 cases still require hospital observation, and no deaths have been reported. Authorities have ordered the restaurant to close temporarily and are investigating the source of infection. The country also experienced a Salmonella cluster linked to a single restaurant in 2020.

items.summary_zh: 美國環孢子蟲病確定1,645例、141例住院,密西根州逾2,500例
items.summary_en: US cyclosporiasis reached 1,645 confirmed cases by 13 July, with more than 7,000 suspected cases under investigation and Michigan has reported over 2,500 cases.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續擴大,CDC統計今年5/1截至7/13累計報告1,645例確定病例,其中141例住院,病患分布34個州,年齡中位數為44 歲,56%為女性,介於5-7月發病,評估全國疑及調查中病例數逾7,000例,導致今年疫情為2025年的27倍。密西根州迄今已報告逾2,500例,當局表示可能感染源為萵苣;紐約市疫情已為去年3 倍;佛羅里達州關閉恐有環孢子蟲暴露的戲水區。當局呼籲⺠眾避免食用覆盆子、包裝沙拉、羅勒等生鮮蔬果,且食物應充分加熱。該國之該疾病流行期為5-8月。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the United States continues to expand. According to CDC statistics, from 1 May to 13 July this year, 1,645 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 141 were hospitalized. Patients are spread across 34 states, the median age is 44 years, and 56% are female. Onset occurred between May and July. Based on an estimate of the national total, the number of suspected cases and cases under investigation exceeds 7,000, making this year's outbreak 27 times that of 2025. Michigan has reported more than 2,500 cases to date, and authorities said the likely source is lettuce. New York City's outbreak is already three times that of last year. Florida closed a water play area where cyclospora exposure may have occurred. Authorities urge the public to avoid eating raw produce such as raspberries, bagged salads and basil, and to heat food thoroughly. The disease season in the country runs from May to August.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計2,011例、754死,伊圖里省佔90%
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of 13 July, with Ituri Province at 90% of national cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/13新增54例確定病例,其中28例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(42例)、北基伍省(5例)及上韋萊省(7例),另上韋萊省新增3個受影響的衛生區,有地理區持續擴大情形。迄至7/13累計2,011例確定病例(754例死亡、366例康復),致死率37.5%,疫情分佈於5個省份(45個衛生區),其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國90%的病例數。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 13 July, 54 new confirmed cases were added, including 28 deaths, in Ituri Province (42 cases), North Kivu Province (5) and Haut-Uélé Province (7). In addition, Haut-Uélé Province added 3 newly affected health zones, and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 13 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 2,011 (754 deaths, 366 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 37.5%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (45 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 90% of national cases.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/美國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / United States – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 美國人道援助人員在DRC確診伊波拉,轉至德國治療;美國延續暫停入境
items.summary_en: A US humanitarian worker with Ebola in the DRC was treated in Germany, and US entry restrictions on recent visitors from the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan were extended.
items.description_zh: 一名於剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)從事人道救援工作之美國公⺠確診,個案已於7/13後送至德國醫院治療,目前病況穩定。 美國CDC於7/13宣布,延續針對過去21天內曾停留DRC、烏干達或南蘇丹之外籍人士實施暫停入境措施,目前僅允許該國公⺠、國⺠、特定政府與軍事人員,或經專案核准個案入境。
items.description_en: A US citizen working in humanitarian aid in the DRC was diagnosed with Ebola. After 13 July, the patient was evacuated to a hospital in Germany for treatment, and their condition is currently stable. On 13 July, the US CDC announced that it would extend its entry suspension for foreign nationals who had been in the DRC, Uganda or South Sudan within the past 21 days. Currently, only the country's citizens and nationals, certain government and military personnel, or individuals approved on a case-by-case basis may enter.

items.summary_zh: 紐約市今年截至7/13累計60例退伍軍人病,15例住院,31座冷卻水塔含菌
items.summary_en: New York City reported 60 Legionnaires' cases this year as of 13 July, including 15 hospitalized, and at least 31 cooling towers tested positive for Legionella.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市今年截至7/13,累計60例確定病例,其中有15例住院,病例主要集中於曼哈頓上東區。另截至7/9,經檢測發現當地至少有31座冷卻水塔存在退伍軍人菌。
items.description_en: As of 13 July this year, New York City has reported 60 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 15 hospitalized. Cases are concentrated in the Upper East Side of Manhattan. In addition, as of 9 July, testing found that at least 31 cooling towers in the area contained Legionella bacteria.

items.headline_zh: 美國/英國/馬爾地夫-麻疹
items.headline_en: United States / United Kingdom / Maldives – Measles
items.summary_zh: 麻疹蔓延:美國今年2,231例,英國883例、馬爾地夫121例
items.summary_en: Measles is rising in the US (2,231 cases through June), the UK (883 cases, 3 deaths by 6 July) and the Maldives (121 cases, 55 in the most recent week).
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續擴大,今年截至6月,累計報告2,231例確定病例,接近去年全年2,289例,多數為19 歲以下(70%)族群,且有高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。疫情主要集中於南卡羅來納州(670例),其次為猶他州(516例)、德州(182例)及佛羅里達州(141)例。 英國近期疫情上升,今年截至7/6,累計報告883例確定病例及3 例死亡,病例主要分布於倫敦(52%),其次為西密德蘭郡(17%) 。該國疫苗覆蓋率偏低與倫敦為國際主要交通樞紐,是引發此波疫情主因。該國優先針對免疫功能不全者、未滿 1 歲嬰兒及孕婦等高風險族群進行補接種計畫。 馬爾地夫今年截至7/11累計報告121例確定病例,近期單週新增55例確定病例。疫情集中於首都馬列(Malé),且多數為15至35 歲族群。該國採取擴大疫苗接種,並進行接觸者追蹤與基因定序等防疫措施。
items.description_en: The US outbreak continues to rise. As of June this year, 2,231 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, approaching last year's full-year total of 2,289. Most (70%) are aged under 19 years, and as many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak is concentrated in South Carolina (670 cases), followed by Utah (516), Texas (182) and Florida (141). The UK has seen a recent rise in cases. As of 6 July this year, 883 confirmed cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in London (52%), followed by West Midlands County (17%). Low vaccination coverage in the country and London's status as a major international transport hub are the main drivers of this wave. The country is prioritizing catch-up vaccination for high-risk groups, including immunocompromised people, infants under 1 year and pregnant women. Maldives has reported 121 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 11 July, with 55 new confirmed cases added in the most recent week. Cases are concentrated in the capital, Malé, and most are aged 15 to 35 years. The country is expanding vaccination and carrying out contact tracing and genomic sequencing.

items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡登革熱逾6.7萬例、47死,巴西疑似逾41萬例
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka has recorded over 67,200 dengue cases and 47 deaths, while Brazil reports more than 410,000 suspected cases nationwide this year.
items.description_zh: 巴西東南部米納斯吉拉斯州(Minas Gerais )今年截至6/22累積報告6萬4,304例極可能病例,其中3萬6,517確診、32例死亡並有39例死亡案例仍調查中。另巴西全國今年迄今累計報告逾41萬例疑病例 ,246 例死亡 。 斯里蘭卡疫情嚴峻,今年截至7/11累計報告逾6萬7,200例病例,其中47例死亡,近期住院數從每週700餘例增加至1,000餘例,醫療量能已不堪負荷,專家推估實際感染人數可能接近20萬人,公共衛生資源嚴重不足為導致大規模疫情之主因。
items.description_en: In Minas Gerais State in southeastern Brazil, 64,304 probable cases have been reported cumulatively as of 22 June this year, including 36,517 confirmed cases and 32 deaths, with 39 death cases still under investigation. Nationwide, Brazil has reported more than 410,000 suspected cases cumulatively this year, including 246 deaths. Sri Lanka's outbreak is severe. As of 11 July this year, more than 67,200 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 47 deaths. Weekly hospitalizations have risen from over 700 to more than 1,000. Health care capacity is overwhelmed, and experts estimate the actual number of infections may be close to 200,000. A serious shortage of public health resources is the main cause of this large-scale outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓薩馬省甘達拉鎮屈公病累計至少84例,當局發布紅色警戒
items.summary_en: Gandara, Samar Province, Philippines, has reported at least 84 chikungunya cases since May, mostly in two neighbouring villages, and a red alert has been issued.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓東部薩馬省(Samar)甘達拉(Gandara)今年自5月截至7/9累計報告至少84例病例,疫情多集中於2個相鄰村莊,當局已發布紅色警戒,並加強當地環境孳清等防治措施及積極監測其餘67個村莊之疫情。
items.description_en: In Gandara, Samar Province, eastern Philippines, at least 84 cases have been reported cumulatively from May this year to 9 July. Cases are concentrated in 2 neighbouring villages. Authorities have issued a red alert, strengthened local control measures such as eliminating mosquito breeding sites, and are actively monitoring the remaining 67 villages.

items.summary_zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥郡報告首例本土美洲錐蟲病,無症狀,為捐血篩檢發現
items.summary_en: San Diego County, California, reported its first locally acquired Chagas disease case, an asymptomatic person identified through routine blood donation screening.
items.description_zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥郡於7/13報告當地首例本土病例(Chagas disease),該病例無症狀,於進行例行捐血篩檢時發現 ,係該郡自2024年列為需通報傳染病以來之第4例病例(前3例為境外移入),當局表示此案例顯示該疾病已不僅止於拉丁美洲地區流行。該疾病症狀通常輕微或不明顯,可能出現發燒、頭痛、淋巴結腫大或叮咬處出現紅腫發炎,部分患者會在數年後發展為重症,導致臟肥大及衰竭等嚴重併發症。
items.description_en: On 13 July, San Diego County, California, United States, reported its first locally acquired case of Chagas disease. The case was asymptomatic and was found during routine blood donation screening. It is the county's fourth case since the disease became notifiable in 2024; the previous three were imported. Authorities said this case shows the disease is no longer confined to Latin America. The disease usually causes mild or inconspicuous symptoms, which may include fever, headache, swollen lymph nodes, or redness and inflammation at the bite site. Some patients develop serious complications years later, such as enlargement of organs and organ failure.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至第28週茲卡病毒感染76例,疫情呈下降趨勢
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 76 Zika cases this year through week 28, continuing a downward trend from over 700 in 2023.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至第28週累計報告76例病例,另2023-2025年分別報告逾700例、423例及236例,疫情呈下降趨勢。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 76 cases cumulatively this year as of week 28. Thailand reported more than 700 cases in 2023, 423 in 2024 and 236 in 2025. Case numbers show a downward trend.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,926例、702死,全球4國共1,949例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with 1,949 confirmed cases across 4 countries globally as of 11 July.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/11新增53例確定病例,其中30例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(45例)及北基伍省(8例),另新增6個受影響的衛生區(分別位於伊圖里省、喬波省及上韋萊省),有地理區持續擴大情形。迄至7/11累計1,926例確定病例(702例死亡、318例康復),致死率36.4%,疫情分佈於5個省份(42個衛生區),其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國90%的病例數。 全球疫情:目前波及4個國家,迄7/11累計1,949例確定病例、704例死亡(致死率36%)。主要分布於DRC(1,926例確定病例、702例死亡);鄰國烏干達(20例確定病例、2例死亡)之個案均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關;美國(2例確定病例)及法國(1例確定病例)之零星個案,皆為於DRC當地進行醫療照護之人員或人道救援者。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 11 July, 53 new confirmed cases were added, including 30 deaths, in Ituri Province (45 cases) and North Kivu Province (8). In addition, 6 newly affected health zones were added (in Ituri Province, Tshopo Province and Haut-Uélé Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 11 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,926 (702 deaths, 318 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 36.4%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (42 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 90% of national cases. Global situation: the outbreak has spread to 4 countries. As of 11 July, 1,949 confirmed cases and 704 deaths (CFR 36%) have been reported cumulatively. Most cases are in the DRC (1,926 confirmed cases, 702 deaths). Uganda's 20 confirmed cases (2 deaths) are all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. The sporadic cases in the United States (2 confirmed cases) and France (1 confirmed case) were all healthcare workers or humanitarian responders providing care in the DRC.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,法國,烏干達,美國

items.summary_zh: 葉門塔伊茲省今年1至5月狂犬病逾400例,多為兒童,疫苗短缺
items.summary_en: Taiz Governorate in Yemen reported over 400 rabies cases in January–May, mostly children, amid severe vaccine and immunoglobulin shortages.
items.description_zh: 葉門塔伊茲省(Taiz)疫情上升,今年1至5月期間,累計逾400例人類病例,主要為兒童,迄無通報死亡病例。相較2024-2025年(分別為148、481例)疫情,顯著上升。當地疫苗與免疫球蛋白嚴重短缺,大幅限制暴露後預防(PEP)量能。 泰國羅勇府(Rayong)報告1件動物確定案例(該犬隻已死亡),3名遭咬傷⺠眾及具暴露風險之貓犬,皆已進行暴露後預防接種。當局已於羅勇府、曼谷及北欖府部分高風險地區發布臨時疫區公告,並實施為期30天的哺乳類動物移動限制。
items.description_en: In Taiz Governorate, Yemen, cases are rising. From January to May this year, more than 400 human cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly among children, and no deaths have been reported so far. This is significantly higher than the cases reported in 2024 and 2025 (148 and 481 respectively). Local shortages of vaccines and immunoglobulin severely limit post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) capacity. In Rayong Province, Thailand, 1 confirmed animal case was reported (the dog has died). Three people who were bitten, and cats and dogs with exposure risk, have all received post-exposure vaccination. Authorities have issued temporary outbreak zone notices in high-risk areas of Rayong, Bangkok and Nonthaburi, and imposed a 30-day movement restriction on mammals.

items.headline_zh: 幾內亞比索/馬達加斯加-M痘
items.summary_zh: 幾內亞比索首例M痘確診,馬達加斯加Ib型疫情逾4,100例,檢驗陽性率72%
items.summary_en: Guinea-Bissau reported its first confirmed mpox case, while Madagascar's clade Ib outbreak has exceeded 4,100 cases with a test positivity rate of 72%.
items.description_zh: 幾內亞比索(Guinea-Bissau)於7/4報告首例確定病例,病患為27 歲女性,目前仍待確認病毒型別及感染源。當局已啟動應變機制並匡列接觸者,囿於當地診斷量能,需嚴防社區傳播風險。自2025年1月迄今,非洲31國累計報告逾4.9萬例確定病例及222例死亡(CFR0.5%)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來爆發全球最大規模之Ib型疫情。截至7/4,累計報告逾4,100例病例(含2,636例確定病例及15死亡)。近期疫情急劇升溫,5/25-7/30期間新增報告逾千例,檢驗陽性率高達72%,囿於全國僅有3間檢驗實驗室,實際疫情負擔恐被低估 。
items.description_en: Guinea-Bissau reported its first confirmed case on 4 July, a 27-year-old woman. The virus type and source of infection are still to be confirmed. Authorities have activated their response mechanism and identified contacts. Given limited local diagnostic capacity, there is a serious risk of community transmission. From January 2025 to date, 31 African countries have reported more than 49,000 confirmed cases cumulatively and 222 deaths (CFR 0.5%). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 4 July, more than 4,100 cases have been reported cumulatively (including 2,636 confirmed cases and 15 deaths). The outbreak has accelerated sharply recently: more than 1,000 new cases were reported between 25 May and 30 July, and the test positivity rate is as high as 72%. With only 3 testing laboratories nationwide, the actual disease burden may be underestimated.
items.area_zh: 幾內亞比索,馬達加斯加

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年新型A型流感30例;柬埔寨今年第5例H5N1人類感染
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported its fifth H5N1 human case this year, a 9-month-old girl in Phnom Penh, while 30 novel influenza A human cases have been reported globally.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨 於7/9通報1例新型A型流感H5N1人類感染病例,為居住於金邊棉芷區村莊的1名9個月大女嬰,已被隔離並接受重症監護,感染源及密切接觸者正調查追蹤中,並進行暴露後預防措施。此案為該國今年第5例H5N1人類感染病例。 人類疫情:全球今年累計報告30例,分別為19例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計62國家/地區報告3,823起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○共8國於2026/7/3-10期間報告33起H5N1疫情,菲律賓12起、泊爾9起、德國4起、美國3起、澳大利亞2起、奈及利亞/波蘭/臺灣各1起。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported 1 human H5N1 infection on 9 July: a 9-month-old girl living in a village in Meanchey district, Phnom Penh. She has been isolated and is receiving intensive care. The source of infection and close contacts are under investigation and follow-up, and post-exposure prophylaxis measures are being implemented. This is the country's fifth human H5N1 case this year. Human cases: globally, 30 cases have been reported this year: 19 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 62 countries and territories have reported 3,823 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Eight countries reported 33 H5N1 outbreaks during 3–10 July 2026: the Philippines 12, Nepal 9, Germany 4, United States 3, Australia 2, and Nigeria, Poland and Taiwan 1 each.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率1.36%,中國門急診陽性率連升6週至11.6%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 1.36% in week 24, while China's rose to 11.6% in week 27, its sixth consecutive weekly increase.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第24週(6/15-21)上升至1.36%,其中,西太平洋、東南亞及非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占60.48%)為主,其次為JN.1(占22.16%)及XFG( 占8.38%)。 中國疫情上升,第27週(6/28-7/5)門急診陽性率上升為11.6%,已連續6週上升,且躍昇為各呼吸道病原體中的第2高(最高為流感)。另6月累計報告7.9萬例病例,較5月2.1萬例增加,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate rose to 1.36% in week 24 of this year (15–21 June), with positivity increasing markedly in the Western Pacific, South-East Asia and African Regions. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (60.48%), followed by JN.1 (22.16%) and XFG (8.38%). In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose to 11.6% in week 27 (28 June–5 July), with 6 consecutive weeks of increase, and has become the second-highest of all respiratory pathogens (after influenza). A total of 79,000 cases were reported in June, up from 21,000 in May, and NB.1.8.1 is the main variant.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達/法國/美國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda / France / United States – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,830例、648死,美國人道工作者確診
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths as of 9 July, and a US aid worker in the DRC was confirmed infected.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/9新增38例確定病例,其中23例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(32例)及北基伍省(6例),7/1新增1個受影響衛生區(為伊圖里省Boga),有地理區持續擴大趨勢。迄7/9累計1,830例確定病例(648例死亡、300例康復),致死率35.4%,疫情分佈於37個衛生區,以伊圖里省最為嚴峻(1,663 例,影響25個衛生區,占該省69.4%)、其次為北基伍省(163例,影響11個衛生區,占該省32.4%)及南基伍省(3例,影響1個衛生區,占該省2.9%),整體接觸者追蹤率78.1%。 DRC喬波省基桑加衛生區(Kisangani)新增2例個案,該省目前共報告4例確定病例(其中2例死亡),均來自伊圖里省亞亞衛生區。另上韋萊省初估有5例確定病例(為自伊圖里省移入之病患,可能為參加葬禮之接觸者)。 法國於6/24通報之首例境外移入個案,在連續兩次PCR檢測皆呈陰性後,已於7/4宣布康復出院。 美國於7/10證實1名於DRC從事人道救援工作之美國公⺠確診,過去1個月主要於伊圖里省布亞(Bunia)從事後勤,目前於當地治療中隔離中,突顯第一線高暴露風險。CDC評估國內風險低,惟呼籲⺠眾避免前往DRC東部三省。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至7/10累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、17例康復),尚無社區傳播疫情。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 9 July, 38 new confirmed cases were added, including 23 deaths, in Ituri Province (32 cases) and North Kivu Province (6). On 1 July, one newly affected health zone was added (Boga in Ituri Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 9 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,830 (648 deaths, 300 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 35.4%. Cases are distributed across 37 health zones. Ituri Province is the most severely affected, with 1,663 cases and 25 health zones affected, 69.4% of the province. North Kivu Province follows with 163 cases and 11 health zones affected (32.4% of the province), and South Kivu Province has 3 cases and 1 health zone affected (2.9% of the province). The overall contact tracing rate is 78.1%. In Kisangani health zone, Tshopo Province, 2 new cases were reported, bringing the province's total to 4 confirmed cases (2 deaths), all from Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province. In addition, Haut-Uélé Province preliminarily reports 5 confirmed cases, patients imported from Ituri who may have been contacts of funeral attendees. France's first imported case, notified on 24 June, was discharged on 4 July after two consecutive negative PCR tests. On 10 July, the United States confirmed that a US citizen working in humanitarian aid in the DRC had been infected. In the past month, the patient mainly worked in logistics in Bunia, Ituri Province, and is currently being treated in isolation locally, which highlights the high exposure risk for frontline workers. The CDC assesses the domestic risk as low but urges the public to avoid travel to the three eastern DRC provinces. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 10 July, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 17 recoveries), with no community transmission.
