items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球小兒麻痺6/25-7/1新增:阿富汗WPV1 1例、南蘇丹cVDPV1 2例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 1 new WPV1 case in Afghanistan and 2 cVDPV1 cases in South Sudan for 25 June–1 July, plus 6 WPV1-positive environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/25-7/1期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 25 June–1 July: WPV1 cases increased by 1 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV1 cases increased by 2 in South Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 6 in Pakistan.

items.headline_zh: 印度-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 印度卡納塔克州門洛爾市A型肝炎15例,疑似供水系統受汙染
items.summary_en: Mangaluru city in Karnataka, India, reported 15 hepatitis A cases on 6 July, with a contaminated water supply suspected as the source.
items.description_zh: 印度南部卡納塔克州(Karnataka)門洛爾市(Mangaluru)7/6報告15例病例,疑感染源為受汙染的供水系統,因多地區皆爆發疫情,當局症擴大採檢,以釐清感染源,並呼籲⺠眾應煮沸飲水並食用熟食。
items.description_en: In Mangaluru city, Karnataka State, southern India, 15 cases were reported on 6 July. The suspected source of infection is a contaminated water supply system. Because outbreaks have occurred in multiple areas, authorities have expanded testing to clarify the source of infection, and urge the public to boil drinking water and eat cooked food.

items.headline_zh: 摩爾多瓦-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 摩爾多瓦首都基希涅夫某飯店沙門氏菌群聚,59例、20例住院
items.summary_en: A hotel cluster of salmonellosis in Chișinău, Moldova, has reported 59 cases, 20 of them hospitalized, with the food source still under investigation.
items.description_zh: 東歐摩爾多瓦首都基希涅夫(Chisinau)某飯店報告群聚事件,6/22-7/3累計報告59例病例,其中20例住院。當局檢測飯店服務生與備餐區域皆呈陰性,食物感染源仍調查中。
items.description_en: A hotel in the capital, Chișinău, Moldova, reported a cluster event: 59 cases were reported cumulatively from 22 June to 3 July, of which 20 were hospitalized. Authorities tested hotel waiters and food preparation areas, and both tested negative. The food source of infection remains under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 美國環孢子蟲病17州145例,密西根州6/22-7/4累計572例
items.summary_en: US cyclosporiasis has reached 145 cases across 17 states since May, with Michigan reporting 572 cases from 22 June to 4 July.
items.description_zh: 美國17個州自今年5月截至6月中旬累計報告145例環孢子蟲病例(Cyclosporiasis),其中20例住院。密西根州近期疫情快速上升,6/22-7/4累計報告572例病例,紐約州近期疫情亦上升。當局評估疫情可能為多州同時爆發,過往疫情常見感染源為覆盆子或袋裝沙拉等蔬果,提醒⺠眾應用流動的水徹底清洗蔬果,並高溫烹調以確保飲食衛生。
items.description_en: From May this year to mid-June, 17 states in the United States reported 145 cyclosporiasis cases cumulatively, of which 20 were hospitalized. The outbreak in Michigan has risen rapidly, with 572 cases reported cumulatively from 22 June to 4 July, and the outbreak in New York State has also risen recently. Authorities assess that the outbreak may involve several states at the same time. Common sources of past outbreaks have been fruits such as raspberries or bagged salads, and the public is reminded to wash fruits and vegetables thoroughly under running water and to cook food at high temperatures to ensure food safety.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,708例、580死,烏干達20例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,708 confirmed cases and 580 deaths as of 6 July, while Uganda has 20 cases and no community transmission.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/6新增84例確定病例,其中59例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(79例)及北基伍省(5例)。迄至7/6累計1,708例確定病例(580例死亡、280例康復),致死率34% ,疫情分佈於3個衛生區,以伊圖里省最為嚴峻(1,556例)、其次為北基伍省(149例)及南基伍省(3例),整體接觸者追蹤率75.2%。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至7/7累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、16例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例,尚無社區傳播疫情。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 6 July, 84 new confirmed cases were added, including 59 deaths, in Ituri Province (79 cases) and North Kivu Province (5). As of 6 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,708 (580 deaths, 280 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 34%. Cases are distributed across 3 health zones, with Ituri Province the most severely affected (1,556 cases), followed by North Kivu Province (149) and South Kivu Province (3). The overall contact tracing rate is 75.2%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 7 July, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 16 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases, with no community transmission.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 宏都拉斯百日咳累計逾180例、14死,多數為未完成接種之1歲以下嬰兒
items.summary_en: Honduras has reported over 180 pertussis cases and 14 deaths, mostly unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated infants under 1 year.
items.description_zh: 宏都拉斯疫情持續擴大,累計報告逾180例病例,14例死亡。多數個案為未完成接種之1歲以下嬰兒,當局正持續監測並持續推動孕婦與幼兒補接種疫苗計畫,因應此波疫情。
items.description_en: The outbreak in Honduras continues to expand, with more than 180 cases reported cumulatively and 14 deaths. Most cases are infants under 1 year who had not completed vaccination. Authorities continue to monitor the situation and to promote catch-up vaccination for pregnant women and young children in response to this wave of the outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲白喉今年累計410例確定病例,金伯利地區135例,疫情擴散至中西部
items.summary_en: Australia has recorded 410 confirmed diphtheria cases this year, with 135 in the Kimberley region, and the outbreak has spread to the Midwest.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情持續蔓延,通報170例報告,疫情集中在金伯利(135例),皮爾巴拉(31例)和金礦區(4例),並擴展至中西部地區,今年累計410例確定病例。因應疫情跨區擴散,當局啟動擴大疫苗接種計畫,提高疫苗接種覆蓋率,降低疾病傳播風險。
items.description_en: Diphtheria continues to spread in Australia, with 170 cases reported. Cases are concentrated in the Kimberley (135 cases), Pilbara (31) and Goldfields (4) regions, and the outbreak has spread to the Midwest region. This year, 410 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. In response to cross-regional spread, authorities have launched an expanded vaccination programme to increase vaccination coverage and reduce transmission risk.

items.headline_en: Zambia / Region of the Americas – Measles
items.summary_zh: 美洲麻疹今年逾2.29萬例、39死,較去年同期增181%
items.summary_en: Zambia's measles outbreak has reached 119 confirmed cases, while the Americas recorded over 22,900 confirmed cases and 39 deaths, up 181% over the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 尚比亞疫情上升,今年1月至7月3日,全國累計報告700例疑個案(含119例確定病例與4例死亡)。目前全國10個省中已有9個省份出現確定病例,其中以西部省(Western Province)最為嚴峻。高達87.4%的確定病例無疫苗接種紀錄,當局預計於7/6-11 在5個高風險地區,針對6個月至9歲兒童展開緊急疫苗接種。 瓜地馬拉疫情嚴峻且範圍持續擴大,今年截至7/5,全國累計報告逾2萬5,700例病例,其中7,260例經實驗室確診,並有24例死亡。此波疫情源自去(114)年12月的大型宗教集會,首例個案於今(115)年1/9確診。自6月中旬迄今之3週內,快速新增近9,000 例確定病例,當局正擴大疫苗接種計畫中。 美洲地區麻疹疫情嚴峻。自今年初迄6/27止,共17國累計報告逾2萬2,900例確定病例及39例死亡,較去年同期遽增181%。逾96%確定病例集中於墨西哥(11,820例)、瓜地馬拉(7,067例)、美國(2,134例)及加拿大(1,079例)。近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第23至24週病例報告數較前2週下降51.1%,主要為墨西哥、秘魯及美國病例減少;加拿大則處於疫情低點;另瓜地馬拉恐有通報延遲情形,須謹慎解讀該國疫情趨勢。
items.description_en: Measles is rising in Zambia. From January to 3 July this year, 700 suspected cases have been reported nationally, including 119 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Confirmed cases have now been identified in 9 of the country's 10 provinces, with the most severe situation in Western Province. As many as 87.4% of confirmed cases had no vaccination record. Authorities plan to carry out emergency vaccination for children aged 6 months to 9 years in 5 high-risk districts from 6 to 11 July. Guatemala's outbreak is severe and continues to expand. As of 5 July this year, more than 25,700 cases have been reported nationally, of which 7,260 were laboratory-confirmed, and 24 deaths have occurred. This wave originated from a large religious gathering in December 2025, and the first case was confirmed on 9 January 2026. In the three weeks since mid-June, nearly 9,000 confirmed cases have been added rapidly, and authorities are expanding the vaccination programme. The measles outbreak in the Region of the Americas is severe. From the start of this year to 27 June, 17 countries have reported more than 22,900 confirmed cases and 39 deaths cumulatively, a sharp 181% increase over the same period last year. More than 96% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Mexico (11,820), Guatemala (7,067), the United States (2,134) and Canada (1,079). The recent trend is declining: case reports in weeks 23–24 were 51.1% lower than in the previous two weeks, mainly because of fewer cases in Mexico, Peru and the United States. Canada is at a low point. Guatemala may have reporting delays, so its trend should be interpreted with caution.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,瓜地馬拉,墨西哥,秘魯,美國,尚比亞

items.summary_zh: 美國西尼羅熱今年截至6/30累計48例,12州報告,38例重症神經侵襲
items.summary_en: US West Nile fever reached 48 cases in 12 states by 30 June, 38 with severe neuroinvasive disease, the highest for that time in 10 years.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至6/30累計12州報告48例病例,其中38例造成嚴重侵犯神經系統疾病,由於今年流行季提早開始,病例數為近10年來同期最高, 以亞利桑那州病例數最多。
items.description_en: As of 30 June this year, 48 cases have been reported cumulatively from 12 states, of which 38 were severe neuroinvasive disease. Because the transmission season started earlier this year, the number of cases is the highest for this time of year in the past 10 years. Arizona has the largest number of cases.

items.headline_zh: 印度/法屬馬約特島-瘧疾
items.summary_zh: 印度賈坎德州腦性瘧疾150例、4童死亡;法屬馬約特島244例已超去年全年
items.summary_en: India's Jharkhand reported 150 cerebral malaria cases including 4 child deaths, while Mayotte's 244 confirmed cases already exceed last year's full-year total.
items.description_zh: 印度賈坎德州東新奔縣爆發疫情,自6/24-7/2累計報告150例腦性瘧疾(cerebral malaria)病例,其中4例兒童死亡,致死率約2.7%,6/30單日檢出26例腦性瘧疾病例,顯示於當地持續傳播。賈坎德州為該國惡性瘧原蟲(P. falciparum)感染病例數較多地區之一。 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,今年截至6/21累計報告244例確定病例,其中已知161例為境外移入(95.6%來自葛摩)、25例為本土病例,今年累計244例病例數已高於去年全年111例,且疫情已於希龍吉以外地區傳播,55%病例為15-44歲年齡層族群,目前檢出致病原為惡性瘧原蟲。
items.description_en: In East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand State, India, an outbreak has reported 150 cerebral malaria cases cumulatively from 24 June to 2 July, including 4 child deaths, a fatality ratio of about 2.7%. On 30 June alone, 26 cerebral malaria cases were detected, indicating ongoing local transmission. Jharkhand is one of the states in India with a high number of Plasmodium falciparum infections. In Mayotte, France, cases are rising. As of 21 June this year, 244 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively; of these, 161 were known imported cases (95.6% from Comoros) and 25 were local cases. The 244 cases reported this year already exceed last year's full-year total of 111. The outbreak has spread beyond Chirongui, and 55% of cases are aged 15 to 44 years. The pathogen detected is Plasmodium falciparum.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained deadly illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國北基伍省不明原因疾病致9死,專家推測霍亂、傷寒或瘧疾
items.summary_en: An unexplained illness in Mangumo, North Kivu, DRC, has caused 9 deaths since 25 June, with cholera, typhoid or malaria among possible causes.
items.description_zh: DRC北基伍省盧貝羅(Lubero)地區之偏遠礦業村莊曼古莫(Mangumo),近期爆發不明原因致死疾病。自6/25迄7/4止,累計報告9例死亡個案,且另有數名病患處於病危狀態,症狀主要為腹瀉、發燒及頭痛,目前尚無任何實驗室診斷結果。專家評估病原體可能為霍亂、傷寒、瘧疾或BVD病毒。另盧貝羅地區尚未列為此波伊波拉病毒疫情影響地區,亦無流行病學關聯。
items.description_en: In Mangumo, a remote mining village in Lubero health zone, North Kivu Province, DRC, an unexplained deadly illness has recently broken out. From 25 June to 4 July, 9 deaths were reported cumulatively, and several other patients are critically ill. The main symptoms are diarrhoea, fever and headache, and no laboratory diagnostic results are yet available. Experts assess that the pathogen may be cholera, typhoid, malaria or BVD virus. Lubero has not been listed as an area affected by the current Ebola outbreak and has no epidemiological link to it.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,561例、506死,伊圖里省佔1,417例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,561 confirmed cases and 506 deaths as of 4 July, with Ituri Province accounting for 1,417 cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/4新增33例確定病例,其中6例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(30例)及北基伍省(3例)。迄至7/4累計1,561例確定病例(506例死亡、254例康復),致死率32.4%,疫情分佈於36個衛生區,以伊圖里省最為嚴峻(1,417例,影響24個衛生區,占該省66.7%);其次為北基伍省(141例,影響11個衛生區,占 32.3%)及南基伍省(3例,影響1個衛生區,占2.9%)。接觸者追蹤率約81.6%。 DRC於6/30報告東北部上韋萊省(Haut-Uélé)新增2例、喬波省(Tshopo)新增1例確定病例,其中一名24歲孕婦死亡後,遺體被秘密運送至喬波省基桑加(Kisangani)後檢出陽性,經流病調查證實,該3名病患皆具重災區伊圖里省亞亞(Nia-Nia)衛生區暴露史,當局納入該省病例統計。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至7/5累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、16例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例,尚無社區傳播疫情。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 4 July, 33 new confirmed cases were added, including 6 deaths, in Ituri Province (30 cases) and North Kivu Province (3). As of 4 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,561 (506 deaths, 254 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 32.4%. Cases are distributed across 36 health zones: Ituri Province is the most severely affected (1,417 cases, 24 health zones affected, 66.7% of the province), followed by North Kivu Province (141 cases, 11 health zones affected, 32.3% of the province) and South Kivu Province (3 cases, 1 health zone affected, 2.9% of the province). The contact tracing rate is about 81.6%. On 30 June, the DRC reported 2 new confirmed cases in Haut-Uélé Province and 1 in Tshopo Province. After a 24-year-old pregnant woman died, her body was secretly transported to Kisangani in Tshopo Province, where it tested positive. Epidemiological investigation confirmed that all 3 patients had exposure history in Nia-Nia health zone, the hardest-hit area in Ituri Province, and the authorities have included these cases in Ituri's statistics. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 5 July, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 16 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases, with no community transmission.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘自2022年累計18萬5,882例、509死,5月新增1,142例
items.summary_en: Global mpox since 2022 totals 185,882 confirmed cases and 509 deaths, with 1,142 cases in May, led by Madagascar with 649 cases.
items.description_zh: 全球自2022年截至今年5/31累計144國/地區報告18萬5,882例確定病例,其中509例死亡。 今年5月共計32國家/地區報告1,142例確定病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加(649例)、中國(89例)、法國(63例)、澳洲(50例)及德國(45例)為高,63.9%的病例來自非洲地區。相較今年4月,西太平洋區及非洲區病例數呈上升趨勢 ,其餘地區疫情則下降,挪威通報首例Ib型病例,另波蘭先前的I型病例確定為Ib型次分支。 非洲地區近6週(5/4-6/14)共計10國報告790例確定病例,其中3 例死亡(CFR 0.45%),以馬達加斯加、肯亞、幾內亞、南蘇丹、喀麥隆及剛果⺠主共和國為高;非洲以外地區,為西班牙與泰國持續報告Ib型社區傳播。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來面臨全球最大規模的Ib型疫情,截至今年6/14,累計2,117例確定病例與7例死亡(多為免疫低下者)。疫情已擴及全國60%的行政區(69/115),主要影響15-49 歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(超過7.9萬人施打),惟面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流與醫療量能挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。
items.description_en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年新型A型流感29例,孟加拉新增1例H5、中國1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Globally 29 human novel influenza A cases have been reported this year, with one new H5 case in Bangladesh and one H9N2 case in China this week.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:孟加拉新增1例H5病例、中國新增1例H9N2病例。全球今年累計報告29例,分別為19例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計62國家/地區報告3,823起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 ○ 共10國於2026/6/27-7/3期間報告72起H5N1疫情,德國52 起、美國5起、南非/澳大利亞各3起、丹麥/智利/葡萄牙各2 起、哥倫比亞/比利時/英國各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: Bangladesh reported 1 new H5 case and China reported 1 new H9N2 case this week. Globally, 29 cases have been reported this year: 19 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 62 countries and territories have reported 3,823 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Ten countries reported 72 H5N1 outbreaks during 27 June–3 July 2026: Germany 52, United States 5, South Africa and Australia 3 each, Denmark, Chile and Portugal 2 each, and Colombia, Belgium and the United Kingdom 1 each.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率0.92%,中國門急診陽性率連升5週至7.4%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity eased to 0.92% in week 23, while China's rose to 7.4% in week 26 and the Philippines' to 11.11% in week 24.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第23週(6/8-14)由低點略降至0.92%,除歐洲及美洲區署以外,各區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占58.1%)為主,其次為JN.1(占16.2%)及BA.3.2(占14.2%)。 中國疫情上升,第26週(6/21-27)門急診陽性率上升為7.4%,已連續5週上升,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 菲律賓疫情上升,第24週陽性率上升至11.11%,6月迄今變異株占比以JN.1為主。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate eased slightly from a low point to 0.92% in week 23 of this year (8–14 June), with positivity increasing markedly in all WHO regional offices except Europe and the Americas. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (58.1%), followed by JN.1 (16.2%) and BA.3.2 (14.2%). In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose to 7.4% in week 26 (21–27 June), with 5 consecutive weeks of increase, and the main variant is NB.1.8.1. The Philippines' outbreak is rising: positivity rose to 11.11% in week 24, and JN.1 has been the predominant variant since June.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,528例、492死,烏干達20例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,528 confirmed cases and 492 deaths as of 3 July, while Uganda has reported no new cases since 21 June.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/3新增26例確定病例,其中10例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(21例)及北基伍省(5例)。迄至7/3累計1,528例確定病例(492例死亡、239例康復),致死率32.2%,疫情分佈於36個衛生區,以伊圖里省最為嚴峻(1,387例,影響24個衛生區,占該省66.7%);其次為北基伍省(138例,影響11個衛生區,占 32.3%)及南基伍省(3例,影響1個衛生區,占2.9%)。接觸者追蹤率約81.5%。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至7/5累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、16例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 3 July, 26 new confirmed cases were added, including 10 deaths, in Ituri Province (21 cases) and North Kivu Province (5). As of 3 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,528 (492 deaths, 239 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 32.2%. Cases are distributed across 36 health zones: Ituri Province is the most severely affected (1,387 cases, 24 health zones affected, 66.7% of the province), followed by North Kivu Province (138 cases, 11 health zones affected, 32.3% of the province) and South Kivu Province (3 cases, 1 health zone affected, 2.9% of the province). The contact tracing rate is about 81.5%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 5 July, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 16 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 安大略省兒童遭蝙蝠接觸未接受暴露後預防,狂犬病死亡
items.summary_en: A child in Ontario, Canada, died of rabies after a bat was found on their face while asleep, and the family did not seek medical evaluation or post-exposure prophylaxis.
items.description_zh: 加拿大安大略省布蘭特福-布蘭特(Brantford-Brant)地區報告1例兒童感染致死的確定病例,為當地自1967年來首例本土人類感染病例。病患發病前19天於安大略省北部的小木屋度假時,熟睡中發現蝙蝠停留臉部,因無明顯傷口且蝙蝠無異常行為,家屬未尋求醫療評估及暴露後預防接種(PEP),導致病患發病死亡。
items.description_en: The Brantford-Brant area in Ontario, Canada, reported a fatal confirmed rabies case in a child, the first locally acquired human infection in the area since 1967. Nineteen days before onset, while on holiday at a cabin in northern Ontario, a bat was found on the child's face while the child was asleep. As there was no obvious wound and the bat showed no abnormal behaviour, the family did not seek medical evaluation or post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and the child later died.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓曼達盧永市M痘本土1例,今年截至6/13累計55例,較去年減少約79%
items.summary_en: Mandaluyong City, Philippines, reported a locally acquired mpox case, while the country's 55 cases this year are down about 79% on 2025.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓曼達盧永市(Mandaluyong City)報告1例本土確定病例。當局已啟動疫調與接觸者追蹤。截至今年6/13止,該國累計報告55例確定病例,較2025年大幅降低約79%(減少205例)。
items.description_en: Mandaluyong City in the Philippines has reported 1 locally acquired confirmed case, and authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and contact tracing. As of 13 June this year, the country has reported 55 confirmed cases cumulatively, a sharp decrease of about 79% (205 fewer cases) compared with 2025.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉州科澤科德縣立百病毒感染1例,追蹤104名接觸者
items.summary_en: Kerala, India, reported a Nipah virus case in an adult man in Kozhikode, with 104 contacts identified and no new cases so far.
items.description_zh: 印度南部喀拉拉州(Kerala)科澤科德縣(Kozhikode)報告1例確定病例(前已掌握)。病患為成年男性,於5/30發病,6/10住院,主要出現嚴重神經系統症狀,目前於加護病房插管治療中。截至6/18止,當局已匡列104名接觸者(含45名醫護人員)進行追蹤,目前無新增病例。此為該國今年第2起疫情(前一起為西孟加拉州於2026年1月報告之2例確定病例),WHO評估該國國內傳播風險為中,全球與區域風險為低。
items.description_en: In Kozhikode district of Kerala State, southern India, 1 confirmed case has been reported (previously identified). The patient is an adult man who developed symptoms on 30 May and was hospitalized on 10 June with mainly severe neurological symptoms, and is currently intubated in intensive care. As of 18 June, authorities had identified 104 contacts (including 45 healthcare workers) for follow-up, and no new cases have been found. This is the country's second outbreak this year; the previous one was 2 confirmed cases reported in West Bengal in January 2026. WHO assesses the risk of transmission within the country as moderate and the global and regional risk as low.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-馬堡病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 烏干達西部基埃蓋瓜區馬堡病毒出血熱1例,幼童死亡,暴露源不明
items.summary_en: Kyegegwa District in western Uganda reported a fatal Marburg virus disease case in a toddler with an unknown exposure source.
items.description_zh: 烏干達西部基埃蓋瓜區(Kyegegwa)出現1例確定病例,病患為1歲多幼童(前已掌握),已死亡。因暴露源不明,且該區設有收容逾10萬人的難⺠營,頻繁人口流動恐大幅增加接觸者追蹤難度與次級傳播風險 。
items.description_en: One confirmed case has been reported in Kyegegwa District in western Uganda. The patient is a toddler over one year old (previously identified), who has died. Because the exposure source is unknown, and the district hosts a refugee camp housing more than 100,000 people, frequent population movement may greatly increase the difficulty of contact tracing and the risk of secondary transmission.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,333例、399死,單日新增26例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths as of 29 June, with 26 new cases added that day.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/29新增26例確定病例,其中8例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(17例)及北基伍省(9例)。 迄至6/29累計1,333例確定病例(399例死亡、189例康復),致死率29.7%,疫情分佈於35個衛生區,以伊圖里省最為嚴峻(1,214例,影響23個衛生區,占該省63.9%);其次為北基伍省(116例,影響11個衛生區,占 32.3%)及南基伍省(3例,影響1個衛生區,占2.9%)。接觸者追蹤率約82.7%。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至7/1累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、15例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 29 June, 26 new confirmed cases were added, including 8 deaths, in Ituri Province (17 cases) and North Kivu Province (9). As of 29 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,333 (399 deaths, 189 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 29.7%. Cases are distributed across 35 health zones: Ituri Province is the most severely affected (1,214 cases, 23 health zones affected, 63.9% of the province), followed by North Kivu Province (116 cases, 11 health zones affected, 32.3% of the province) and South Kivu Province (3 cases, 1 health zone affected, 2.9% of the province). The contact tracing rate is about 82.7%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 1 July, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 15 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases.

items.summary_zh: 全球cVDPV1新增3例、cVDPV2新增2例,寮國、衣索比亞等地
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 3 new cVDPV1 cases, in Laos and Ethiopia, and 2 new cVDPV2 cases, in the Central African Republic and Mali, for 18–24 June.
items.description_zh: 小兒麻痺症全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/18-24期間,cVDPV1 新增2國共3例,分別為寮國2例(前已掌握)、衣索比亞1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 18–24 June: cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Laos (previously identified) and 1 in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 each in the Central African Republic and Mali; and for environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by 1 in Nigeria.

items.summary_zh: 越南腸病毒自去年12月中至今年6月約5.5萬例、10死,為去年同期兩倍
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has reported about 55,000 enterovirus cases and 10 deaths since mid-December, roughly double last year's same-period total, when no deaths were recorded.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情持續,今年5/18-6/18報告約9,900例病例,且自去年12月中旬截至今年6月累計報告約5萬5,000例病例,其中10例死亡,疫情約為去年同期(2萬8,081例)的2倍,且去年同期無死亡案例。
items.description_en: The outbreak in Viet Nam continues. From 18 May to 18 June this year, about 9,900 cases were reported, and from mid-December last year to June this year, about 55,000 cases were reported cumulatively, including 10 deaths. The outbreak is about twice the same-period total of last year (28,081 cases), and there were no deaths in the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 全球霍亂累計11萬4,829例、1,318死,DRC寬果省致死率7.4%
items.summary_en: WHO reports 114,829 cholera cases and 1,318 deaths globally through May this year, with a 7.4% fatality rate in Kwango Province, DRC.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至5月累計報告11萬4,829 例病例,其中1,318例死亡,5月新增病例數較今4月增加43%,惟較去年同期下降59%,各國致死率(CFR)介於0-11.6%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 23 個國家,近期新增病例以阿富汗、奈及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)為多,其中DRC寬果省(Kwango)於6月底爆發疫情,致死率(CFR)達7.4%,高於WHO的1%警戒閾。WHO 評估因受極端氣候與部分地區基礎衛生系統癱瘓影響,約有10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, 114,829 cases, including 1,318 deaths, were reported cumulatively through May this year. New cases in May rose 43% compared with April, but fell 59% compared with the same period last year. The case fatality ratio across countries ranges from 0 to 11.6%. Cases are distributed across 23 countries in the Eastern Mediterranean, African, South-East Asian and Americas Regions. Recently, new cases have been concentrated in Afghanistan, Nigeria and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). In the DRC, an outbreak in Kwango Province began at the end of June, with a case fatality ratio of 7.4%, above WHO's alert threshold of 1%. WHO assesses that, owing to extreme weather and the collapse of basic health systems in some areas, about 1 billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 挪威5/26-6/15耶爾森氏菌感染15例,基因型相同,疑為同一感染源
items.summary_en: Norway reported 15 Yersinia enterocolitica O3 cases from 26 May to 15 June, with identical genotypes suggesting a common source.
items.description_zh: 挪威5/26-6/15報告15例病例,病患年齡中位數29歲並以女性為多,檢測為Yersinia enterocolitica O3血清型且基因型都相同,當局推測為相同感染源,疫情調查進行中。另該國2025年報告94例病例。
items.description_en: Norway reported 15 cases between 26 May and 15 June. The median age of patients is 29 years, and most are women. Testing identified the Yersinia enterocolitica O3 serotype, with identical genotypes, and authorities suspect a common source of infection. The outbreak investigation is ongoing. Norway reported 94 cases in 2025.

items.headline_zh: 委內瑞拉-麻疹等震災後傳染病
items.headline_en: Venezuela – Communicable disease risks after earthquake
items.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉6/24大地震後,WHO警告麻疹、登革熱等傳染病風險上升
items.summary_en: After a 24 June earthquake in Venezuela, WHO warned of rising risks for measles, dengue, yellow fever, malaria and other communicable diseases amid low vaccination coverage.
items.description_zh: 委內瑞拉6/24大地震後,WHO警告呼吸道、蟲媒及食物飲水相關傳染病爆發的風險增加,包含麻疹、白喉、百日咳、黃熱病、登革熱、屈公病、茲卡病毒感染症、奧羅普切熱及瘧疾等傳染病,地震前疫苗接種率偏低,且醫療服務量能存在嚴重缺口。
items.description_en: After a major earthquake in Venezuela on 24 June, WHO warned that the risk of outbreaks of respiratory, vector-borne and food- and water-borne communicable diseases has increased. These include measles, diphtheria, pertussis, yellow fever, dengue, chikungunya, Zika virus infection, Oropouche fever and malaria. Vaccination coverage was low before the earthquake, and health service capacity has serious gaps.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,307例、377死,已擴散至4省
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths as of 29 June, with spread to 4 provinces.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,迄至6/29累計1,307例確定病例(377例死亡),病患擴增分布於4個省份。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至6/30累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、15例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. As of 29 June, 1,307 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (377 deaths), and cases have spread to 4 provinces. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 30 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 15 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 伊波拉擴散至上韋萊省,DRC累計1,274例、360死
items.summary_en: Ebola has spread to Haut-Uélé Province, the DRC's fourth province, with 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths reported as of 27 June.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,地理擴散至第4個省份上韋萊省(Haut-Uele),一名自伊圖里省移入的病患抵達後死亡 。上韋萊省位於DRC東北部,與南蘇丹及中非共和國接壤且跨境移動頻繁,大幅提升跨國傳播風險,且當地武裝衝突嚴重,阻礙防疫工作,當局已禁止首都金夏沙及多省的大型集會。截至6/27止,DRC累計報告1,274例確定病例與360例死亡;烏干達則報告20例確定病例與2例死亡。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases, and geographic spread has extended to a fourth province, Haut-Uélé, where a patient transferred from Ituri died after arrival. Haut-Uélé is located in the north-east of the DRC, borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic, and has frequent cross-border movement, which substantially raises the risk of transnational spread. Local armed conflict is severe and hinders disease control efforts, and authorities have banned large gatherings in the capital, Kinshasa, and several provinces. As of 27 June, the DRC has reported 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths cumulatively; Uganda has reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲10國沙門氏菌感染109例、1死,源頭為印度進口苜蓿芽種子
items.summary_en: Ten European countries have reported 109 Salmonella cases this year, including 1 death, traced to alfalfa sprout seeds imported from India.
items.description_zh: 英國、奧地利、比利時等共10個歐州國家今年截至5月累計報告109例病例,其中1例死亡、18例住院,病患以女性、成人為多,經調查感染源為苜蓿芽種子,由印度進口並分銷歐洲各地,各國已要求廠商將產品下架,ECDC評估此事件對於經常食用者的風險為低至中。
items.description_en: Ten European countries, including the United Kingdom, Austria and Belgium, reported 109 cases cumulatively this year through May, including 1 death and 18 hospitalizations. Patients are mainly female and adults. The source of infection was identified as alfalfa sprout seeds imported from India and distributed across Europe. Countries have required manufacturers to withdraw the products from sale. The ECDC assesses the risk of this event to frequent consumers as low to moderate.

items.summary_zh: 全球黃熱病美洲6國79例,非洲3國16例,未接種族群風險較高
items.summary_en: Six countries in the Americas reported 79 yellow fever cases and three African countries reported 16 this year, with unvaccinated people at higher risk.
items.description_zh: 美洲地區去年病例數上升,今年疾病仍持續傳播,截至5/26累計6 國報告79例病例,分布於哥倫比亞、委內瑞拉、玻利維亞、秘魯、厄瓜多及巴西等國 ;非洲地區今年截至5月累計3國報告16例病例,分布於布吉納法索、中非共和國及喀麥隆等國。WHO風險評估顯示,具黃熱病傳播史國家/地區之未接種疫苗族群風險較高。
items.description_en: Cases in the Americas rose last year, and transmission continues this year. As of late May, 6 countries have reported 79 cases cumulatively, in Colombia, Venezuela, Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador and Brazil. In the African Region, 3 countries have reported 16 cases cumulatively as of May this year, in Burkina Faso, the Central African Republic and Cameroon. WHO's risk assessment shows that unvaccinated populations in countries and territories with a history of yellow fever transmission are at higher risk.

items.headline_zh: 斯里蘭卡/孟加拉-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡登革熱今年截至6/27累計52,068例,孟加拉累計5,800例
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka's dengue cases reached 52,068 by 27 June, with 5,267 suspected cases added in one week, while Bangladesh has reported 5,800 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,近1週(6/15-21)新增5,267例疑病例,今年截至6/27累計報告52,068例病例,病例主要分布於西部省的可倫坡及加姆珀哈區分別為10,839及10,113例,該國6月迄今已報告18,227例(占今年病例數的35%)。 孟加拉疫情更新,近1週新增約1千例病例,今年迄今累計報告5,800例病例,主要分布於巴里薩爾及吉大港區,該國6月截至6/28已報告2,603例(占今年病例數的45%)。
items.description_en: Sri Lanka's outbreak is rising. In the past week (15–21 June), 5,267 suspected cases were added, and this year as of 27 June, 52,068 cases have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in the Western Province, with 10,839 in Colombo and 10,113 in Gampaha District. Sri Lanka has reported 18,227 cases so far in June, 35% of this year's total. Bangladesh's outbreak update: about 1,000 new cases were added in the past week, and 5,800 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, mainly in the Barisal and Chattogram divisions. Bangladesh reported 2,603 cases in June through 28 June, 45% of this year's total.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,274例、360死,追蹤率僅87.1%
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths as of 27 June, with contact tracing at 87.1%, below WHO's 95% target.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/27新增47例確定病例,其中12例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(45例)及北基伍省(2例),6/27新增1個受影響的衛生區(為伊圖里省Mandima),有地理區持續擴大情形。南基伍省自5/26迄今,無新增病例。 迄至6/27 累計1,274例確定病例(360例死亡、178例康復),致死率28.3% ,疫情分佈於35個衛生區,以伊圖里省最為嚴峻(1,165 例,影響23個衛生區,占該省63.9%);其次為北基伍省(106 例,影響11個衛生區,占 32.3%)及南基伍省(3例,影響1個衛生區,占2.9%)。接觸者追蹤率約87.1%,尚未達WHO 95%的目標。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至6/28累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、15例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 27 June, 47 new confirmed cases were added, including 12 deaths, in Ituri Province (45 cases) and North Kivu Province (2). On 27 June, one newly affected health zone was added (Mandima in Ituri Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. South Kivu Province has reported no new cases since 26 May. As of 27 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,274 (360 deaths, 178 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 28.3%. Cases are distributed across 35 health zones: Ituri Province is the most severely affected (1,165 cases, 23 health zones affected, 63.9% of the province), followed by North Kivu Province (106 cases, 11 health zones affected, 32.3% of the province) and South Kivu Province (3 cases, 1 health zone affected, 2.9% of the province). The contact tracing rate is about 87.1%, below WHO's target of 95%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 28 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 15 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in the capital, Kampala, and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年新型A型流感28例,本週無新增人類病例
items.summary_en: Globally 28 human novel influenza A cases have been reported this year, with none new this week, while Peru reported 21 H5N1 animal outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週無新增病例。全球今年累計報告28例,分別為18例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3及1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計61國家/地區報告3,712起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共7國於2026/6/20-26期間報告58起H5N1疫情,秘魯21起、泊爾15起、德國10起、荷蘭6起、美國4起、丹麥/澳大利亞各1起。 加拿大於2026/6/23報告1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。
items.description_en: Human cases: No new cases were reported this week. Globally, 28 cases have been reported this year: 18 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 61 countries and territories have reported 3,712 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Seven countries reported 58 H5N1 outbreaks during 20–26 June 2026: Peru 21, Nepal 15, Germany 10, the Netherlands 6, the United States 4, and Denmark and Australia 1 each. Canada reported 1 H5 (N-untyped) outbreak on 23 June 2026.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率1.51%,連續4週上升,韓國第24週陽性率2.9%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose slightly to 1.51% in week 22, its fourth consecutive weekly increase, while South Korea's rose to 2.9% in week 24.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第22週(6/1-7)由低點略升至1.51%,西太平洋及東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加,整體疫情已連續4週上升。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占48.56%)為主,其次為XFG( 占17.31%)及JN.1(占15.87%)。 韓國疫情於低點上升,第24週陽性率升至2.9%,新增16例住院病例,變異株以BA.3.2占多數。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate rose slightly from a low point to 1.51% in week 22 of this year (1–7 June), with positivity increasing markedly in the Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean Regions, and overall activity has risen for 4 consecutive weeks. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (48.56%), followed by XFG (17.31%) and JN.1 (15.87%). In South Korea, positivity rose from a low to 2.9% in week 24, with 16 new hospitalized cases, and BA.3.2 is the majority variant.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,203例、321死,WHO預估9月中達8,210例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,203 confirmed cases and 321 deaths as of 25 June; WHO projects 8,210 cases by mid-September.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/25新增48例確定病例,其中11例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(42例)及北基伍省(6例)。迄6/25累計1,203例確定病例(321例死亡、148例康復),致死率26.7%,疫情主要集中在東部伊圖里(1,096例)、北基伍(104例) 及南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約82.8%。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,迄6/27累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、15例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5 例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。 WHO非洲區署依據DRC截至6/8的累計598例確定病例數作SEIRD隨機數理模型推估,預測DRC至9/16將達8,210例確定病例(其中1,440例死亡)。推估截至8/12對烏干達造成至少1例境外移入的可能性為94.2%,其次為南蘇丹(可能性69.3%)、盧安達(可能性8.6%)、蒲隆地(可能性2%)。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 25 June, 48 new confirmed cases were added, including 11 deaths, in Ituri Province (42 cases) and North Kivu Province (6). As of 25 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,203 (321 deaths, 148 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 26.7%. The outbreak is mainly concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (1,096 cases), North Kivu (104) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 82.8%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 27 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 15 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in the capital, Kampala, and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission. The WHO Regional Office for Africa, using a SEIRD stochastic model based on the DRC's cumulative total of 598 confirmed cases as of 8 June, projects that the DRC will reach 8,210 confirmed cases by 16 September, including 1,440 deaths. The model estimates a 94.2% probability that Uganda will have at least one imported case by 12 August, followed by South Sudan (69.3%), Rwanda (8.6%) and Burundi (2%).

items.summary_zh: 芝加哥6/23報告第1分支M痘確定病例,無旅遊史,美國第1分支累計逾20例
items.summary_en: Chicago reported a clade I mpox case on 23 June with no recent travel, while nationwide more than 20 clade I cases have been reported.
items.description_zh: 美國伊利諾州芝加哥6/23報告1例確定病例(第1分支),近期無旅遊史,此為該市第2例確定病例,與2025年12月首例境外移入病例無關,感染源尚待釐清。今年該國累計報告11例確定病例(包含各分支),全美則已累計逾20例(第1分支)。該分支在歐美部分地區已出現社區傳播,主要影響MSM族群,因適逢當地舉辦驕傲大遊行活動,當局呼籲高風險族群應儘速接種兩劑型JYNNEOS疫苗。
items.description_en: The city of Chicago, Illinois, United States, reported a confirmed clade I case on 23 June. The patient had no recent travel history. This is the city's second confirmed case and is unrelated to the first imported case in December 2025; the source of infection remains unclear. This year, the country has reported 11 confirmed cases cumulatively (all clades), and more than 20 clade I cases have been reported nationwide cumulatively. This clade has shown community transmission in parts of Europe and the United States, mainly affecting men who have sex with men (MSM). Because a local Pride parade is taking place, authorities urge high-risk groups to get two doses of JYNNEOS vaccine as soon as possible.

items.headline_zh: 墨西哥/美國/加拿大-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 世界盃主辦國麻疹持續:墨西哥累計1.84萬例、43死,加拿大1,073例
items.summary_en: Measles continues to spread in World Cup host countries, with Mexico at 18,440 confirmed cases and 43 deaths and Canada at 1,073 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 世界盃足球賽(FIFA) 主辦國疫情持續,  墨西哥自6/18-22新增55例確定病例。自2025年至2026/6/22止,已累計報告1萬8,440例確定病例,並導致11個州共43人死亡,其中西部哈里斯科州累計報告6,517例確定病例,為全國最高;而首都墨西哥城則累計達993例確定病例。 美國加州截至6/12報告50例確定病例,為去年度總數之兩倍,亦創下2019年以來新高。 加拿大截至6/22累計報告1,073例確定病例,專家表示頻繁的賽事跨國移動及墨國的本土疫情,疫情可能持續擴散。
items.description_en: The outbreak continues in the host countries of the FIFA World Cup. Mexico reported 55 confirmed cases between 18 and 22 June. From 2025 through 22 June 2026, 18,440 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, causing 43 deaths across 11 states. Jalisco State in the west has the highest cumulative total, with 6,517 confirmed cases, while the capital, Mexico City, has reached 993 confirmed cases cumulatively. California, United States, reported 50 confirmed cases as of 12 June, twice last year's total and the highest since 2019. Canada reported 1,073 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 22 June. Experts say frequent cross-border movement during the tournament, together with the local outbreak in Mexico, may allow the outbreak to continue spreading.

items.summary_zh: 法國6/24報告首例境外移入伊波拉病例,為人道救援醫師
items.summary_en: France reported its first imported Ebola case from the DRC on 24 June, a humanitarian aid doctor whose condition is stable and who is being treated in hospital.
items.description_zh: 法國6/24報告首例自DRC境外移入確定病例,為人道救援醫師,目前病毒量低且病情穩定,正於醫院治療中,該國已啟動接觸者追蹤。
items.description_en: On 24 June, France reported its first imported confirmed case from the DRC, a humanitarian aid doctor. The patient's viral load is low and the condition is stable, and the patient is being treated in hospital. France has started contact tracing.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球小兒麻痺6/11-17新增:阿富汗WPV1 2例,巴基斯坦環境樣本1件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 2 new WPV1 cases in Afghanistan and 1 WPV1-positive environmental sample in Pakistan for 11–17 June.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/11-17期間,WPV1新增阿富汗2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 11–17 June: WPV1 cases increased by 2 in Afghanistan; for environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 1 in Pakistan.

items.summary_zh: 法國普羅旺斯桿菌性痢疾95例、15例確診,多為學童,農場飲水不合規
items.summary_en: The Provence region of France has reported 95 bacillary dysentery cases, mainly schoolchildren, linked to an education farm's non-compliant drinking water supply.
items.description_zh: 法國普羅旺斯地區通報95例病例(15例確診),主要為學童,於近期參訪羅納河口省奧裡奧爾的一家教育農場後陸續發病,經調查為該農場未遵守飲用水供應規範所致,當局已要求該農場關閉並進行改善措施。
items.description_en: The Provence region of France has reported 95 cases (15 confirmed), mainly schoolchildren, who fell ill after recently visiting an education farm in Auriol, Bouches-du-Rhône. Investigation found that the farm had not complied with drinking water supply standards. Authorities have ordered the farm to close and carry out improvement measures.

items.summary_zh: 越南同塔省沙門氏菌感染303例疑病例,25例檢出,源於連鎖麵包店
items.summary_en: Đồng Tháp Province, Viet Nam, reported 303 suspected salmonellosis cases from 16 to 20 June, 25 positive for Salmonella, all after eating one bakery chain's bread.
items.description_zh: 越南同塔省自6/16-20累積報告303例疑病例,其中有25例檢體檢出沙門氏菌,病患皆食用某連鎖麵包店之越南麵包,當局已要求店家停業。該連鎖麵包店前於2024年及今年年初皆曾爆發食品中毒群聚事件。
items.description_en: In Đồng Tháp Province, Viet Nam, 303 suspected cases were reported cumulatively from 16 to 20 June, and Salmonella was detected in specimens from 25 of them. All patients had eaten Vietnamese bread from a bakery chain, and authorities have ordered the shops to close. The bakery chain had previously experienced food poisoning clusters in 2024 and earlier this year.

items.headline_zh: 美國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 美國維吉亞州阿帕契步道5-6月多起諾羅病毒疫情,向北蔓延,無死亡通報
items.summary_en: Several norovirus outbreaks on Virginia's Appalachian Trail in May and June appear to be spreading northward, with no deaths reported.
items.description_zh: 美國維吉亞州阿帕契步道(ATC)於5-6月爆發多起疫情,且有往北蔓延趨勢,多名健行者於旅途中陸續發病,累計感染人數不明,且無通報死亡病例。當局已發布公告,提醒健行者用肥皂洗手,勿共食或共用餐具,妥善處理排泄物,有症狀應休養3天。該國之典型流行季節為11月至隔年4月。
items.description_en: Several outbreaks occurred on the Appalachian Trail (ATC) in Virginia from May to June and appear to be spreading northward. Multiple hikers fell ill during their journeys. The cumulative number of infections is unknown, and no deaths have been reported. Authorities have issued notices reminding hikers to wash hands with soap, avoid sharing food or utensils, dispose of waste properly, and rest for 3 days if symptomatic. The country's typical season is November to April.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,094例、277死,接觸者追蹤率約72.8%
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,094 confirmed cases and 277 deaths as of 22 June, with contact tracing at about 72.8%.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/22新增46例確定病例,其中10例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(43例)及北基伍省(3例)。迄6/22累計1,094例確定病例(277例死亡、115例康復),致死率25.3%,疫情主要集中在東部伊圖里(997例)、北基伍(94例)及南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約72.8%。 烏干達疫情更新,自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,迄6/22累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、14例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 22 June, 46 new confirmed cases were added, including 10 deaths, in Ituri Province (43 cases) and North Kivu Province (3). As of 22 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,094 (277 deaths, 115 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 25.3%. Cases are mainly concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (997 cases), North Kivu (94) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 72.8%. Uganda update: since 1 new confirmed case was added on 21 June, no further new cases have been reported. As of 22 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 14 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in the capital, Kampala, and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission.

items.summary_zh: 美國麻疹今年2,104例,孟加拉累計逾9萬例疑病例,為史上最大疫情
items.summary_en: The US has reported 2,104 measles cases this year, while Bangladesh's largest-ever outbreak has recorded over 92,000 suspected cases.
items.description_zh: 美國上週新增 31 例確定病例,今年累計2,104例(含11例境外移入),趨近114年全年確定病例數(2,288例) 。高達93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,其中21%為5歲以下兒童,51%為5至19 歲青少年,另約 6%的患者需住院治療 。以東南部南卡羅來納州累計670例為多,其次為西部猶他州(498例)。此外,東部維吉亞州近期疫情升溫,上週新增19例確定病例,累計達129例,多與5月白金漢郡(Buckingham)群聚疫情相關。 孟加拉自今年3月中旬以來疫情持續擴大,全國已累計通報9萬2,790例疑病例及逾1萬例確定病例,此為該國史上規模最大疫情,近期新增7名兒童疑染疫死亡。達卡地區累計病例最多,疑病例42,766例,確診病例7,501例;其他累計疑病例較多之地區包括吉大港(15,700例)、巴里薩爾(9,063例)、拉傑沙希(7,639 例)和庫爾納(6,648例)。
items.description_en: The United States reported 31 new confirmed cases last week, bringing its total for this year to 2,104 (including 11 imported cases), approaching the 2,288 confirmed cases reported for the whole of 2025. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. By age, 21% were children under 5 years and 51% were adolescents aged 5 to 19 years, and about 6% required hospitalization. South Carolina has the highest cumulative total, with 670 cases, followed by Utah (498). In addition, cases in eastern Virginia have risen recently, with 19 new confirmed cases last week, bringing the cumulative total to 129; most are linked to a May outbreak in Buckingham County. In Bangladesh, the outbreak has continued to expand since mid-March this year. Nationwide, 92,790 suspected cases and more than 10,000 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, making this the largest outbreak in the country's history. Recently, 7 children with suspected infection have died. Dhaka has the most cumulative cases, with 42,766 suspected and 7,501 confirmed cases. Other areas with high cumulative suspected cases include Chattogram (15,700), Barisal (9,063), Rajshahi (7,639) and Khulna (6,648).

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達/以色列-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda / Israel – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計1,048例、267死,以色列2例疑似
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 1,048 confirmed cases and 267 deaths as of 21 June, while Israel is isolating 2 suspected cases who returned from the DRC.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/21新增45例確定病例,其中13例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(38例)及北基伍省(7例),6/16-18期間新增3個受影響衛生區,有持續擴大情形。迄至6/21累計1,048例確定病例(267例死亡、112例康復),致死率25.5%,疫情主要集中在東部伊圖里(954例)、北基伍(91例)及南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約70.8%。 烏干達疫情更新,6/21新增1例確定病例,迄6/22累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、14例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。 以色列近期報告2例自DRC返國之疑個案,分別收治於特拉維夫(Tel Aviv)與海法(Haifa)的醫院隔離治療中,尚無檢驗結果報告,當局已啟動接觸者追蹤。 DRC西部奎盧省(Kwilu Province)布隆古(Bulungu)地區爆發不明原因疾病,過去兩週內已造成10至14例死亡,部分媒體稱另有20例病例。病患主要出現發燒、頭痛、嘔吐與腹瀉症狀。目前致病原不明,當局已將12件檢體送至國家生物醫學研究院(INRB)檢驗 。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 21 June, 45 new confirmed cases were added, including 13 deaths, in Ituri Province (38 cases) and North Kivu Province (7). Between 16 and 18 June, 3 newly affected health zones were added, and the outbreak continues to expand. As of 21 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,048 (267 deaths, 112 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 25.5%. Cases are mainly concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (954 cases), North Kivu (91) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 70.8%. Uganda update: 1 new confirmed case was reported on 21 June. As of 22 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 14 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in Kampala and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission. Israel has recently reported 2 suspected cases returning from the DRC; they are being isolated in hospitals in Tel Aviv and Haifa, no test results have been reported yet, and authorities have started contact tracing. An unexplained illness has broken out in the Bulungu area of Kwilu Province in western DRC. In the past two weeks, 10 to 14 deaths have occurred, and some media report another 20 cases. Patients mainly present with fever, headache, vomiting and diarrhoea. The causative pathogen is still unknown, and authorities have sent 12 specimens to the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) for testing.

items.summary_zh: 美國亞利桑那州馬里科帕郡西尼羅熱今年本土25例、2死,高於去年同期10例
items.summary_en: Maricopa County, Arizona, has reported 25 locally acquired West Nile fever cases and 2 deaths this year, up from 10 cases last year.
items.description_zh: 美國亞利桑那州馬里科帕郡疫情上升,今年截至6/18已報告25例本土病例(2例死亡),高於去年同期的10例病例(無死亡),當局表示當地蚊媒活動增加,呼籲⺠眾採取防蚊措施,預防疾病發生。
items.description_en: Maricopa County, Arizona, United States, has seen rising cases. As of 18 June this year, 25 locally acquired cases have been reported, including 2 deaths, compared with 10 cases and no deaths in the same period last year. Authorities say mosquito activity has increased locally and urge the public to take mosquito-prevention measures to prevent disease.

items.disease_zh: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_zh: 日本-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_en: Japan – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 日本發熱伴血小板減少綜合症今年截至6/7累計72例,已見於26都道府縣
items.summary_en: Japan has reported 72 severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) cases this year as of 7 June, above the same period last year, across 26 prefectures.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情上升,今年截至6/7累計報告72例病例,高於去年同期(該國去年共報告192例病例,病例數為近年來最高),已有26個都道府縣報告病例,以往病例主要分布於該國西部及中部地區,去年疫情向北部及東部地區蔓延,地理分布範圍擴大,該疾病疫情通常自每年3月開始上升,並於5-10月達高峰 。
items.description_en: Cases in Japan are rising. As of 7 June this year, 72 cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the same period last year. Japan reported 192 cases last year, the highest in recent years. Cases have now been reported from 26 prefectures. Previously, cases were mainly in the western and central regions of the country; last year the outbreak spread to northern and eastern regions, expanding the geographic range. The disease season usually begins to rise in March each year and peaks between May and October.

items.headline_zh: 馬來西亞/孟加拉-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞今年截至6/13登革熱33,367例、23死,較去年同期升27%
items.summary_en: Malaysia has reported 33,367 dengue cases and 23 deaths by 13 June, 27% above last year, while Bangladesh's June-to-date cases are twice May's total.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞疫情上升,今年截至6/13累計報告33,367例病例,較去年同期27,640例上升27%,病例數以雪蘭莪州15,422例最多。該國今年已報告23例死亡,較去年同期17例死亡上升35%,目前主要流行型別為DENV-3。 孟加拉疫情更新,最近24小時內新增60例病例,今年截至6/20 累計4,680例病例及7例死亡,病例數以巴里薩爾市1,243例為多,該國近期疫情遽升,自6月迄今病例數1,483例,為5月病例數(714例)的2倍,且以男性為多(62.9%)。
items.description_en: Malaysia's outbreak is rising. As of 13 June this year, 33,367 cases have been reported cumulatively, 27% higher than the 27,640 cases in the same period last year. Selangor State has the most cases, with 15,422. Malaysia has reported 23 deaths this year, 35% higher than the 17 deaths in the same period last year. The main circulating serotype is DENV-3. Bangladesh's outbreak update: in the past 24 hours, 60 new cases were added, and as of 20 June this year, 4,680 cases and 7 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Barisal City has the most cases, with 1,243. The outbreak in Bangladesh has recently surged: cases since June total 1,483, twice the 714 cases reported in May, and male cases predominate (62.9%).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年新型A型流感28例,香港及中國各新增1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Hong Kong and mainland China each reported one new H9N2 case, and Taiwan CDC raised travel notices for Hong Kong and Guangxi.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:中國、香港各新增1例H9N2病例。全球今年累計報告28例,分別為18例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3 及1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 此次新增2例H9N2病例,發病時間介於今年5/31-6/9期間,案1 為香港男童,案2為中國廣西壯族自治區女童。香港今年累計1 例,自1999年迄今累計報告11例病例,無死亡病例;中國今年累計16例,自2015年迄今累計報告165例病例,其中2例死亡(CFR:1.2%)。評估該病毒在家禽中呈地方性流行,預期仍會出現零星人類個案,惟尚未具備持續人際傳播能力,因此,人傳人持續傳播風險為低。本署已提升香港旅遊疫情建議等級為第一級:注意(Watch),及中國該區為第二級:警示(Alert)。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計59國家/地區報告3,689起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共8國於2026/6/13-19期間報告51起H5N1疫情,德國31起、荷蘭11起、比利時4起、不丹/丹麥/挪威/瑞典/美國各1起。 斯洛維亞於2026/6/12報告1起H3N8疫情。 丹麥於2026/6/10報告1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。
items.description_en: Human cases: China and Hong Kong each reported 1 new H9N2 case. Globally, 28 cases have been reported this year: 18 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. The 2 new H9N2 cases had onset between 31 May and 9 June this year: case 1 was a boy in Hong Kong and case 2 a girl in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of China. Hong Kong has reported 1 case this year and 11 cases cumulatively since 1999, with no deaths. China has reported 16 cases this year and 165 cases cumulatively since 2015, including 2 deaths (CFR 1.2%). The virus is assessed to be endemic in poultry, and sporadic human cases are expected to continue, but it has not yet acquired sustained human-to-human transmission capacity, so the risk of sustained human-to-human transmission is assessed as low. Taiwan CDC has raised its travel health notice for Hong Kong to Level 1 (Watch), and for Guangxi to Level 2 (Alert). Avian/animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 59 countries and territories have reported 3,689 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Eight countries reported 51 H5N1 outbreaks during 13–19 June 2026: Germany 31, the Netherlands 11, Belgium 4, and Bhutan, Denmark, Norway, Sweden and the United States 1 each. Slovenia reported 1 H3N8 outbreak on 12 June 2026, and Denmark reported 1 H5 (N-untyped) outbreak on 10 June 2026.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率1.38%,除歐洲外多區上升,印度第21週陽性率3.44%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose slightly to 1.38% in week 21, its third consecutive weekly increase, while India's rose to 3.44% in week 21.
items.description_zh: 全球陽性率於今年第21週(5/25-31)由低點略升至1.38%,除歐洲外,各區署陽性率明顯增加,整體疫情已連續3週上升。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占48.56%)為主,其次為XFG(占17.31%)及JN.1(占15.87%)。 印度疫情持續上升,第21週陽性率升至3.44%,疫情已連續5週上升。
items.description_en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate rose slightly from a low point to 1.38% in week 21 of this year (25–31 May), with positivity increasing markedly in all regions except Europe, and overall activity has risen for 3 consecutive weeks. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (48.56%), followed by XFG (17.31%) and JN.1 (15.87%). India's outbreak continues to rise: positivity rose to 3.44% in week 21, marking 5 consecutive weeks of increase.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計956例、247死,醫護感染75人
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 956 confirmed cases and 247 deaths as of 19 June, with 75 healthcare workers infected amid shortages of protective equipment.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/19新增23例確診病例,其中2例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(21例)及北基伍省(2例),6/16-18期間新增3個受影響的衛生區,有地理區持續擴大情形。迄至6/19累計956例確定病例(247例死亡、92例康復),致死率25.8%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省(874例)、北基伍(79例) 與南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約69.3%。    WHO表示因防護物資短缺,截至6/19止,DRC高達75名醫護人員感染(含17例死亡)。當局警告疫情尚未達高峰,跨國擴散風險極高。另目前約 23%‒26% 致死率反映的是地理擴展規模與病例負擔,而非該病毒株本身,在疫情迅速擴散期間,難以精確評估致死率的準確性。 近期病例增加的部分原因是檢測和診斷能力提升,由於疫情爆發前發生的許多死亡病例仍在調查中,故目前的致死率可能被低估。 Africa CDC表示此次疫情的嚴重程度已達 2000 年烏干達的三倍,且多達 3.5 萬名密切接觸者面臨感染風險,惟目前傷亡規模尚不及 2014 年疫情。   烏干達疫情更新,6/21新增1例確定病例,迄至6/21累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、14例康復),個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。
items.description_en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 19 June, 23 new confirmed cases were added, including 2 deaths, in Ituri Province (21 cases) and North Kivu Province (2). Between 16 and 18 June, 3 newly affected health zones were added, and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 19 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 956 (247 deaths, 92 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 25.8%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri Province (874 cases), North Kivu (79) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 69.3%. WHO said that, owing to a shortage of protective equipment, as of 19 June a total of 75 healthcare workers in the DRC had been infected, including 17 deaths. Authorities warn that the outbreak has not yet peaked, and the risk of cross-border spread is very high. The case fatality ratio of about 23–26% reflects the scale of geographic spread and case burden rather than the characteristics of the virus itself, and during rapid spread it is difficult to assess its accuracy precisely. Part of the recent rise in cases reflects improved testing and diagnostic capacity. Because many deaths that occurred before the outbreak was identified are still under investigation, the current case fatality ratio may be underestimated. Africa CDC says the severity of this outbreak is three times that of Uganda's 2000 outbreak, and as many as 35,000 close contacts face the risk of infection, but the current death toll is not yet as large as in the 2014 outbreak. Uganda update: 1 new confirmed case was added on 21 June. As of 21 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 14 recoveries). The cases are in Kampala and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission.

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉/美國/瓜地馬拉-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉麻疹累計86,923例疑病例、656死,致死率0.9%
items.summary_en: Bangladesh's measles outbreak has reported 86,923 suspected cases and 656 deaths since mid-March, a CFR of 0.9%, with Dhaka most affected.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,過去24小時內新增972例病例,自今年3月中旬爆發疫情迄今累計報告86,923例疑病例(10,387例為確定病例),死亡656例(其中93例確定病例死亡),致死率為0.9%,疫情以首都達卡地區最為嚴峻。 美國疫情更新,今年迄今累計2,073例病例,6%病患住院治療,近期維吉亞州白金漢郡病例數明顯上升,該州今年迄6/11 已累計110例病例。另該國去年全年累計2,288例病例。 瓜地馬拉自今年1/9迄6/12累計報告16,840例病例(6,903例為確定病例),其中有22例死亡,死亡病例以7歲以下兒童為主,1歲以下兒童死亡率高於一般族群,隨著當局大規模疫苗接種措施,疫情已呈下降趨勢,惟隨著實驗室診斷確診為非必要項目,實際疫情仍可能受低估。
items.description_en: Bangladesh outbreak update: in the past 24 hours, 972 new cases were added. Since the outbreak began in mid-March this year, 86,923 suspected cases (including 10,387 confirmed cases) have been reported cumulatively, with 656 deaths (93 of them confirmed cases), a case fatality ratio of 0.9%. The outbreak is most severe in the capital, Dhaka. United States outbreak update: 2,073 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, and 6% of patients were hospitalized. Cases in Buckingham County, Virginia, have risen markedly recently, and the state has reported 110 cases cumulatively this year as of 11 June. The country reported 2,288 cases for the whole of last year. Guatemala has reported 16,840 cases cumulatively from 9 January this year to 12 June (6,903 confirmed), including 22 deaths. Deaths are mainly among children under 7 years, and the mortality rate among infants under 1 year is higher than in the general population. With large-scale vaccination by authorities, the outbreak has shown a downward trend; however, as laboratory confirmation is no longer a required step for every case, the actual outbreak may still be underestimated.

items.summary_zh: 香港2歲男童H9N2感染,低致病性,同住6人無症狀,本地風險低
items.summary_en: A 2-year-old boy in Hong Kong was infected with low-pathogenicity H9N2, and the six people living with him are asymptomatic.
items.description_zh: 香港於6/12通報之2歲男童新型A型流感(H9)感染病例(前已掌握),經基因定序和分析,確認為低致病性A(H9N2)病毒株 ,且未檢測到明顯基因變異。患者目前病情穩定,與其同住6人均無症狀,評估當地流行風險低。自1999年以來,香港累計11例H9N2病例,其中5例為本地病例,6例為輸入性病例。
items.description_en: A 2-year-old boy in Hong Kong, reported on 12 June, was infected with novel influenza A (H9), previously identified. Genetic sequencing and analysis confirmed a low-pathogenicity A(H9N2) virus, with no significant genetic mutations detected. The patient is currently stable, and all 6 people living with him are asymptomatic. The local transmission risk is assessed as low. Since 1999, Hong Kong has cumulatively reported 11 H9N2 cases, of which 5 were local cases and 6 were imported.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計837例、196死,ECDC估實際感染為通報3至10倍
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths as of 15 June, while ECDC models suggest true infections are 3.0 to 10.2 times reported.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,6/15新增29例確定病例,其中4例死亡,截至6/15累計報告837例確定病例(196例死亡、49 例康復),致死率23.4%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共31個衛生區。 烏干達迄至6/16連續8日無新增病例(最後一例為6/8),累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、7例康復)。 ECDC以模型推估實際疫情較報告之疫情嚴峻,其中一個模型估計,截至6/13,累計感染人數是通報病例數之3.0到10.2倍(90%可信區間),另盧安達、坦尚亞和肯亞的輸入風險最高,而歐盟/歐洲經濟區的輸入風險則為低。
items.description_en: The DRC has reported 29 new confirmed cases on 15 June, including 4 deaths. As of 15 June, 837 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (196 deaths, 49 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 23.4%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, across 31 health zones. Uganda has reported no new cases for 8 consecutive days through 16 June (last case on 8 June), with 19 confirmed cases cumulatively (2 deaths, 7 recoveries). ECDC modelling suggests the actual outbreak is more severe than reported. One model estimates that, as of 13 June, cumulative infections were 3.0 to 10.2 times the number of reported cases (90% credible interval). Rwanda, Tanzania and Kenya face the highest importation risk, while the importation risk for the EU/EEA is low.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,肯亞,盧安達,坦尚尼亞,烏干達

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞cVDPV2新增2例,巴基斯坦WPV1環境樣本4件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 2 new cVDPV2 cases in Nigeria for 4–10 June, plus 4 WPV1-positive environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/4-10期間,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦4件,cVDPV2新增3國共4件,分別為南蘇丹2件、馬拉威/奈及利亞各1 件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 4–10 June: cVDPV2 cases increased by 2 in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 4 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 4 across 3 countries: 2 in South Sudan, and 1 each in Malawi and Nigeria.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞博爾諾州霍亂疑病例7,850例、74死,擴散至14個行政區
items.summary_en: Borno State, Nigeria, has reported 7,850 suspected cholera cases and 74 deaths since early May, with the outbreak spreading to 14 local areas.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞東部博爾諾州(Borno)自5月初截至6/7累計報告7,850例疑病例,其中74例死亡,疫情已擴散至當地14個行政區,當局及無國界醫生組織已加強監測、轉診及治療等措施。
items.description_en: Borno State in north-eastern Nigeria reported 7,850 suspected cases cumulatively from early May to 7 June, including 74 deaths. The outbreak has spread to 14 local areas. Authorities and Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) have strengthened surveillance, referral and treatment measures.

items.summary_zh: 美國肉毒桿菌中毒3例皆為嬰兒,源於某廠商嬰兒配方奶,已下架
items.summary_en: The US reported 3 botulism cases, all infants, traced to infant formula from one manufacturer, and authorities have ordered the product withdrawn.
items.description_zh: 美國6/13報告3例病例,皆為嬰兒,分布於加州、華盛頓及賓夕法亞州,病患介於4/20-5/31發病,目前持續住院治療中,經調查感染源為某生產商生產的嬰兒配方奶,於全美市場占比小於1%,當局已要求產品下架。
items.description_en: On 13 June, the United States reported 3 cases, all in infants, located in California, Washington and Pennsylvania, with onset between 20 April and 31 May. The patients remain hospitalized. Investigation traced the source to infant formula produced by one manufacturer, which accounts for less than 1% of the US market, and authorities have ordered the product withdrawn from sale.

items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計808例、192死,單日新增26例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths as of 14 June, with 26 new cases that day.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,6/14新增26例確定病例,其中11例死亡,截至6/14累計報告808例確定病例(192例死亡、48例康復),致死率23.8%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共31個衛生區。 烏干達迄至6/16連續8日無新增病例(最後一例為6/8),累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、7例康復)。
items.description_en: The DRC has reported 26 new confirmed cases on 14 June, including 11 deaths. As of 14 June, 808 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (192 deaths, 48 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 23.8%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, across 31 health zones. Uganda has reported no new cases for 8 consecutive days through 16 June (last case on 8 June), with 19 confirmed cases cumulatively (2 deaths, 7 recoveries).

items.summary_zh: 美國新墨西哥州聖塔菲郡報告今年首例女性鼠疫死亡,已進行接觸者調查
items.summary_en: Santa Fe County, New Mexico, reported this year's first plague death, a woman, and has begun contact investigations.
items.description_zh: 美國新墨西哥州聖塔菲郡報告今年首例女性死亡病例,當局已進行接觸者調查。該州於2024及2025年分別報告1、 3例人類感染病例。
items.description_en: In Santa Fe County, New Mexico, United States, authorities reported the first death of a woman this year and have carried out contact investigations. The state reported 1 and 3 human infection cases in 2024 and 2025, respectively.

items.summary_zh: 越南登革熱今年1-5月逾5萬例,為去年同期2.5倍
items.summary_en: Viet Nam reported over 50,000 dengue cases from January to May, about 2.5 times last year's same-period level, while Sri Lanka's cases reached 36,168 by 5 June.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情上升,今年1-5月累計報告逾50,000例病例,約為去年同期病例數的2.5倍,疫情時間較往年提早,病例發生不再局限於特定地區、季節或年齡層,該國大部分地區皆有報告病例,包含過去較少報告病例的北部地區,目前主要流行型別為DENV-2。 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年截至6/5累計報告36,168例病例,病例數較去年同期增加約1萬例,近50%病例分布於西部省,另有20例相關死亡病例,其中包括 3 例兒童死亡病例。當局已啟動預防控制計畫。
items.description_en: Viet Nam's outbreak is rising. Between January and May this year, more than 50,000 cases were reported cumulatively, about 2.5 times the same period last year. The outbreak started earlier than usual, and cases are no longer confined to specific regions, seasons or age groups. Most parts of the country have reported cases, including the northern region, which previously reported few cases. The main circulating serotype is DENV-2. Sri Lanka's outbreak is rising. As of 5 June this year, 36,168 cases have been reported cumulatively, about 10,000 more than the same period last year. Nearly 50% of cases are in the Western Province, and 20 related deaths have been recorded, including 3 child deaths. Authorities have launched a prevention and control plan.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計782例、181死,24小時新增72例
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of 13 June, with 72 new cases in the past 24 hours.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/13累計782例確定病例(181例死亡、40例康復),致死率23.1%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共31個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約56.5%。過去 24 小時新增72例確診病例(伊圖里省56例、北基伍省16例),其中29例死亡。 烏干達於過去24小時無新增病例,迄至6/15累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、7例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。
items.description_en: The DRC has reported 782 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 13 June (181 deaths, 40 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 23.1%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, across 31 health zones, and the DRC's contact tracing rate is about 56.5%. In the past 24 hours, 72 confirmed cases were added (56 in Ituri Province and 16 in North Kivu Province), of which 29 died. Uganda reported no new cases in the past 24 hours; as of 15 June, 19 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 7 recoveries), and 14 of the confirmed cases were imported.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 香港沙田區2歲男童本地感染H9,全球今年新型A型流感27例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a locally acquired H9 infection in a 2-year-old boy in Sha Tin; globally, 27 novel influenza A cases have been reported this year.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:香港新增1例H9人類感染病例。全球今年累計報告27例,分別為16例H9N2、1例H9、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3及1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 香港於6/12通報沙田區新增1例H9人類感染病例,為2歲男童,6/9出現發燒及輕微腹瀉症狀,6/10就醫,目前情況穩定,經檢驗證實對A(H9)流感病毒呈陽性,分型結果待定。調查顯示,個案於潛伏期內無外遊,屬本地感染,家中無飼養禽鳥,亦無食用未經煮熟家禽或接觸病人,惟6月初曾與家人於販售活雞店家逗留觀看家禽,並觸摸該店周遭環境,當局已對感染源及接觸者進行調查,接觸者迄未出現症狀。香港自1999年起累計報告10例A(H9N2)病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計59國家/地區報告3,635起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共6國於2026/6/9-12期間報告58起H5N1疫情,德國40起、美國7起、法國5起、塞爾維亞4起、挪威/立陶宛各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: Hong Kong reported 1 new H9 human infection this week. Globally, 27 cases have been reported this year: 16 H9N2, 1 H9, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Many cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Hong Kong reported on 12 June a new H9 human infection in a 2-year-old boy in Sha Tin District, who developed fever and mild diarrhoea on 9 June and sought care on 10 June. His condition is currently stable, and testing confirmed positivity for influenza A(H9) virus, with subtyping pending. Investigation showed the case was locally acquired, with no travel during the incubation period. There were no poultry or birds at home, and he had not eaten undercooked poultry or been in contact with patients. However, in early June he and his family had visited a shop selling live chickens to watch the poultry and had touched the surroundings of the shop. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and contacts, and no contacts have shown symptoms so far. Since 1999, Hong Kong has reported 10 A(H9N2) cases cumulatively. Avian/animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 59 countries and territories have reported 3,635 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Six countries reported 58 H5N1 outbreaks during 9–12 June 2026: Germany 40, United States 7, France 5, Serbia 4, and Norway and Lithuania 1 each.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率1.24%,連續2週上升,新加坡第22週降至11%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose slightly to 1.24% in week 20, while Singapore's fell to 11% in week 22, its second straight weekly decline.
items.description_zh: 今年第20週(5/18-24)全球陽性率由低點略升至1.24%,其中,東南亞區、西太平洋、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加,整體疫情已連續2週上升。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占47.22%) 為主,其次為BA.3.2及JN.1(各占18.33%)。 中國疫情於低點略升,第23週(6/1-7)門急診陽性率略升為3.6%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 新加坡疫情從高點波動下降,第22週陽性率降至11%,疫情已連續兩週下降,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。
items.description_en: In week 20 of this year (18–24 May), the global COVID-19 positivity rate rose slightly from a low point to 1.24%, with positivity increasing markedly in the South-East Asia, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean Regions, and overall activity has risen for 2 consecutive weeks. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (47.22%), followed by BA.3.2 and JN.1 (18.33% each). In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose slightly to 3.6% in week 23 (1–7 June), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the majority of variants. Singapore's outbreak has fluctuated downward from a peak, with positivity falling to 11% in week 22. Cases have declined for 2 consecutive weeks, and NB.1.8.1 accounts for the majority of variants.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉州科澤科德縣立百病毒感染重症1例,43歲男性,追蹤77名接觸者
items.summary_en: Kerala, India, reported a severe Nipah virus case in a 43-year-old man, with 77 contacts, including 58 healthcare workers, being followed up.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉州科澤科德縣(Kozhikode)於6/11確診1例重症確定病例,為43歲男性,疑清理一座有蝙蝠及鳥類棲息之倉庫而感染,現正插管隔離治療中。因病患確診前曾於院內進行多項檢查,已緊急匡列77名接觸者(58名醫療人員、14名家人與5名朋友),目前均無症狀。當地5至9月為立百病毒傳播高峰期,當局已加強監測。
items.description_en: In Kozhikode, Kerala State, India, a severe confirmed case was diagnosed on 11 June: a 43-year-old man who is suspected to have been infected while cleaning a warehouse inhabited by bats and birds. He is intubated and in isolation for treatment. Because multiple tests were performed at the hospital before the diagnosis, authorities have urgently identified 77 contacts (58 healthcare workers, 14 family members and 5 friends), all currently asymptomatic. The region's Nipah transmission peak is May to September, and authorities have strengthened surveillance.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉累計689例、139死,接觸者追蹤率僅28.4%
items.summary_en: DRC Ebola cumulative total reached 689 confirmed cases and 139 deaths as of 11 June, with contact tracing at only 28.4%.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄6/11累計689例確定病例(139例死亡、32例康復),致死率(CFR)20.2%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共29個行政區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約28.4%。另過去24小時新增17例確定病例於伊圖里省,其中5例死亡。 烏干達於過去24小時無新增病例,迄至6/14累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。 WHO評估DRC風險為「非常高」,烏干達以及與已記錄BDBV 檢出國家接壤的其他國家之風險為「高」,非洲其他地區以及全球之風險為「低」。
items.description_en: The DRC has reported 689 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 11 June (139 deaths, 32 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 20.2%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, across 29 administrative areas, and the DRC's contact tracing rate is about 28.4%. In addition, 17 new confirmed cases were added in Ituri Province in the past 24 hours, of which 5 died. Uganda reported no new cases in the past 24 hours; as of 14 June, 19 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 5 recoveries), of which 14 were imported. WHO assesses the risk in the DRC as very high, the risk for Uganda and other countries bordering countries where BDBV has been detected as high, and the risk for other African countries and globally as low.
