items.summary_zh: GPEI公布:cVDPV2新增3國共4例,巴基斯坦環境樣本新增4件WPV1
items.summary_en: GPEI reported four new cVDPV2 cases across three countries, plus four WPV1 environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/27-6/2期間,cVDPV2 新增3國共4例,分別為中非共和國2例、馬拉威/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦4件,cVDPV2新增馬拉威2 件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 27 May and 2 June, cVDPV2 detections were newly added in three countries, totalling four cases: two in the Central African Republic and one each in Malawi and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added four specimens in Pakistan and cVDPV2 added two in Malawi.
items.area_zh: 中非共和國,馬拉威,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 歐洲9國沙門氏菌感染,累計至少83例、20例住院,疑與雞肉產品相關
items.summary_en: A Salmonella Stanley outbreak in nine European countries has at least 83 cases and 20 hospitalisations, likely linked to chicken products.
items.description_zh: 歐洲疫情更新,多國自去(2025)年12月截至今年5月中旬累計報告至少83例病例,其中至少20例住院,病患以兒童及年輕人為多,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疫情分布於丹麥、匈牙利、捷克、法國等9個歐洲國家,經調查疑感染源為雞肉相關產品,受影響國家已要求廠商將相關產品下架。
items.description_en: European outbreak update: between December 2025 and mid-May 2026, multiple countries reported at least 83 cases, of which at least 20 were hospitalised. Cases are mainly among children and young people. Genotyping identified Salmonella Stanley ST2045. The outbreak is spread across nine European countries, including Denmark, Hungary, Czechia and France. Investigations suggest the suspected source is chicken-related products, and affected countries have asked manufacturers to withdraw the products from the market.

items.disease_zh: 傷寒,沙門氏菌感染症,桿菌性痢疾,霍亂
items.disease_en: Typhoid fever, 沙門氏菌感染症, Shigellosis, Cholera
items.headline_zh: 全球-沙門氏菌感染症/桿菌性痢疾/傷寒/曲狀桿菌/霍亂
items.headline_en: Global – Salmonella infection / Shigellosis / Typhoid fever / Campylobacteriosis / Cholera
items.summary_zh: 研究估計2021年全球8.6億人因不安全食物致病,150萬人死亡
items.summary_en: A study estimates 860 million people fell ill from unsafe food in 2021, causing 1.5 million deaths across 194 countries.
items.description_zh: 近期研究估計全球194個國家於2021年有8.6億人因不安全的食物導致疾病,並造成150萬人死亡,總生產力損失相當於3,100億美元,5歲以下的發生率為5歲以上的2.7倍,其中傳染病致病源導致死亡的前5名為沙門氏菌感染症、桿菌性痢疾、傷寒、曲狀桿菌及霍亂,疫情以非洲及東南亞為多。
items.description_en: A recent study estimates that in 2021, across 194 countries, 860 million people fell ill from unsafe food, resulting in 1.5 million deaths and total productivity losses equivalent to US$310 billion. The incidence among children under 5 is 2.7 times that among people aged 5 and over. The top five infectious agents causing death are Salmonella infection, shigellosis, typhoid fever, campylobacteriosis and cholera. Outbreaks are concentrated in Africa and Southeast Asia.

items.summary_zh: 旺角桑拿群聚累計5例,場所暫時關閉,呼籲5月1日後到訪者注意健康
items.summary_en: A Mong Kok sauna-linked Mpox cluster has reached five cases; the venue is closed and recent visitors are urged to monitor their health.
items.description_zh: 香港疫情更新,截至6/9旺角桑拿相關群聚事件累計報告5例病例,該場所為同志友善的俱樂部,最近1例於5/23造訪後發生高風險接觸活動,於6/3發病,該場所已暫時關閉,當局呼籲5/1後曾造訪的⺠眾應加強健康監測並接種疫苗。另香港自2022年迄今累計報告90例病例,其中17例為境外移入。
items.description_en: Hong Kong outbreak update: as of 9 June, a Mong Kok sauna-related cluster has reported five cumulative cases. The venue is a gay-friendly club. The most recent case had high-risk contact activities after visiting on 23 May and developed symptoms on 3 June. The venue has been temporarily closed. Authorities urge people who visited the venue after 1 May to strengthen health monitoring and get vaccinated. Hong Kong has reported 90 cumulative cases since 2022, of which 17 were imported.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉州1例立百病毒初步陽性,患者40多歲,已隔離待確認
items.summary_en: India's Kerala State reported a preliminary Nipah virus case in a man in his 40s, now isolated pending confirmation.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉州科澤科德(Kozhikode)於6/10報告1例病例,初步檢測陽性, 為40多歲男性,可能於清理倉庫時,疑有蝙蝠出沒 ,導致感染,該患者最初出現發燒症狀,隨後康復,之後又出現第二次發燒;在此期間,他多次就醫,疑在隔離前造成大量的接觸暴露,該個案已被隔離並接受進一步的檢驗確認。另該國2001-2024年累計報告102例病例,其中74例死亡(CFR:73%)。
items.description_en: On 10 June, Kozhikode in Kerala State, India, reported one case that tested positive in preliminary testing. The patient is a man in his 40s who may have been infected while clearing a warehouse where bats were suspected to be present. He initially had fever and recovered, then developed a second fever. During this period he sought medical care several times, and significant contact exposure may have occurred before isolation. The case has been isolated and is undergoing further laboratory confirmation. The country reported 102 cases cumulatively from 2001 to 2024, of which 74 were fatal (CFR: 73%).

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計635例確定病例、127例死亡,烏干達累計19例
items.summary_en: DRC has 635 confirmed Ebola cases and 127 deaths as of 9 June, including 37 new in 24 hours; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄6/9累計635例確定病例(127 例死亡、30例康復),致死率(CFR)20%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共26個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約56.3%,WHO表示接觸者追蹤目標為90-95%。另過去24小時新增37例確定病例於伊圖里省,其中12例死亡。另6/9發表之研究推估DRC截至5/27累計病例數介於280-2,520之間。 烏干達於過去24小時無新增病例,迄至6/10累計19例確定病例(2 例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 9 June, 635 confirmed cases have been reported (127 deaths, 30 recovered), with a CFR of 20%. The outbreak is concentrated in 26 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 56.3%; WHO states the contact tracing target is 90–95%. In the past 24 hours, 37 new confirmed cases were added in Ituri Province, of which 12 died. A study published on 9 June estimates DRC's cumulative case count as of 27 May at between 280 and 2,520. Uganda reported no new cases in the past 24 hours; as of 10 June it had 19 cumulative confirmed cases (2 deaths, 5 recovered), 14 of which were imported.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 美國加州與羅德島發現野生動物狂犬病,蝙蝠陽性率上升、土撥鼠確診
items.summary_en: Wildlife rabies has been found in urban areas: rising bat positivity in San Diego County and a confirmed woodchuck case in Rhode Island.
items.description_zh: 美國報告近期於都會區發現野生動物狂犬病案例。加州聖地牙哥郡(San Diego County)警示當地蝙蝠陽性檢出率攀升;羅德島州東普羅維登斯(East Providence )亦通報1件土撥鼠感染確定病例。針對羅德島州,相關單位已完成4名接觸者與2隻犬隻暴露後預防接種。
items.description_en: The United States has reported recent cases of wildlife rabies in metropolitan areas. San Diego County, California, has warned that the positivity rate in local bats is rising. East Providence, Rhode Island, has reported one confirmed rabies infection in a woodchuck. For Rhode Island, the relevant authorities have completed post-exposure vaccination for four contacts and two dogs.

items.headline_zh: 馬達加斯加/葛摩/模里西斯/留尼旺-M痘
items.summary_zh: 馬達加斯加截至6/7累計3,241例M痘、7死;留尼旺、模里西斯亦有本土病例
items.summary_en: Madagascar has reported 3,241 Mpox cases and seven deaths as of 7 June; Réunion and Mauritius have also recorded local cases.
items.description_zh: 馬達加斯加疫情自2025年12月中旬爆發以來急遽升溫,截至6/7 累計報告3,241例病例,其中1,976例確定病例及7例死亡。最近1 例死亡病例為39歲女性,並同時感染HIV,突顯免疫低下族群感染第I分支Ib子分支(Ib型)之重症風險。另葛摩及模里西斯分別於今年1月與4月報告來自馬國的境外移入病例。 留旺自2026年1月23日報告首例以來,累計15例確定病例(10例境外移入,5例本土)。近兩週新增3例(1例自馬達加斯加境外移入、2例本土),目前尚未確認該病毒分支,推估應為Ib型。當局已於2/9針對免疫低下者、MSM族群、性工作者及赴馬國旅客,全面推動兩劑型JYNNEOS疫苗接種計畫。 模里西斯於6/4確診今年首例本土病例,個案近期無旅遊史,為在當地居住的64歲瑞士籍男性。該國今年累計報告3例(2例境外移入、1例本土)。
items.description_en: Madagascar's outbreak has escalated sharply since it began in mid-December 2025. As of 7 June, 3,241 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 1,976 confirmed cases and 7 deaths. The most recent death was a 39-year-old woman co-infected with HIV, highlighting the risk of severe disease among immunocompromised people infected with clade Ib (subclade Ib). Comoros and Mauritius reported imported cases from Madagascar in January and April this year, respectively. Réunion has reported 15 cumulative confirmed cases since its first case on 23 January 2026 (10 imported, 5 local). It has recorded three new cases in the past two weeks (one imported from Madagascar, two local). The virus subclade has not yet been confirmed but is presumed to be Ib. On 9 February, a two-dose JYNNEOS vaccination programme was launched for immunocompromised people, MSM, sex workers and travellers to Madagascar. Mauritius confirmed its first local case this year on 4 June, in a 64-year-old Swiss man living locally with no recent travel history. The country has reported three cases this year (two imported, one local).

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計598例確定病例、115例死亡,24小時新增48例
items.summary_en: DRC has 598 confirmed Ebola cases and 115 deaths as of 8 June, with 48 new cases in 24 hours; Uganda reports 19 cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/8累計598例確定病例(115例死亡、22例康復),致死率19.2%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約56.3%,WHO表示接觸者追蹤目標為90-95%。另過去24小時新增48例確診病例(伊圖里省45例、北基伍省3例),其中14例死亡。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至6/9累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 8 June, 598 confirmed cases have been reported (115 deaths, 22 recovered), with a CFR of 19.2%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 56.3%; WHO states the contact tracing target is 90–95%. In the past 24 hours, 48 new confirmed cases were added (45 in Ituri Province and 3 in North Kivu Province), of which 14 died. Uganda outbreak update: as of 9 June, it had 19 cumulative confirmed cases (2 deaths, 5 recovered), 14 of which were imported.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.disease_zh: 中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒感染症
items.headline_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯-中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒感染
items.summary_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯今年截至4月2例MERS、1例死亡;全球累計2,649例
items.summary_en: Saudi Arabia reported two MERS cases through April this year, one fatal; ECDC rates transmission risk in the EU/EEA as low.
items.description_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯今年截至4月累計報告2例病例,其中1例死亡,病患皆為成年男性,感染來源仍不明,該國去(2025)年累計報告17 例。全球自2012年4月迄今累計報告2,649例確定病例及960例死亡病例。歐洲CDC評估歐盟/歐洲經濟區傳播風險為低。
items.description_en: Saudi Arabia reported two cases cumulatively as of April this year, one of which was fatal. All patients were adult men, and the source of infection remains unknown. The country reported 17 cases in total last year (2025). Globally, since April 2012, 2,649 confirmed cases and 960 deaths have been reported cumulatively. ECDC assesses the risk of transmission in the EU/EEA as low.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉3/15至6/9累計8萬104例、628死;美國今年2,030例確診
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has recorded 80,104 measles cases and 628 deaths since 15 March; the US has 2,030 confirmed cases this year.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉今年自3/15截至6/9累計報告8萬0,104例病例(其中9,779 例為確定病例),死亡628例(其中92例確定病例死亡),已有61,278例康復,疫情以首都達卡地區最為嚴峻,已報告3萬7,387例疑病例及6,794例確定病例。 美國今年截至6/4累計報告2,030例確定病例,其中127例住院,疫情分布40個州,病患以5-19歲年齡層占大宗(51%),有92%病例未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。
items.description_en: Bangladesh has reported 80,104 cumulative cases this year from 15 March to 9 June, of which 9,779 were confirmed, with 628 deaths (92 among confirmed cases) and 61,278 recovered. The outbreak is most severe in the capital Dhaka region, where 37,387 suspected cases and 6,794 confirmed cases have been reported. The United States has reported 2,030 confirmed cases this year as of 4 June, of which 127 were hospitalised. Cases have been reported in 40 states; those aged 5–19 years make up the majority (51%), and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計550例確定病例、101例死亡,WHO風險評估為非常高
items.summary_en: WHO rates DRC's Ebola risk as very high, with 550 confirmed cases and 101 deaths as of 7 June and 35 new in 24 hours.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/7累計550例確定病例(101例死亡、19例康復),致死率18.4%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約64.4%。過去 24 小時新增35例確診病例(伊圖里省31例、北基伍省4例),其中10例死亡。  WHO維持評估DRC風險為「非常高」,烏干達及已確認BDBV檢出國家接壤之其他國家為「高」,非洲區域其餘國家及全球風險為「低」。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 7 June, 550 confirmed cases have been reported (101 deaths, 19 recovered), with a CFR of 18.4%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 64.4%. In the past 24 hours, 35 new confirmed cases were added (31 in Ituri Province and 4 in North Kivu Province), of which 10 died. WHO maintains its risk assessment for DRC as very high, for Uganda and other countries bordering those where BDBV has been confirmed as high, and for the rest of the African region and globally as low.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 法屬圭亞那屈公病累計509例,疫情由西部沿海擴散,美國CDC升至第2級
items.summary_en: French Guiana has reported 509 confirmed Chikungunya cases since late January, and the US CDC raised its travel alert to Level 2.
items.description_zh: 法屬圭亞那疫情持續,自今年 1 月下旬迄今累計報告509例確診病例,疫情已由西部沿海地區蔓延至其他地區,美國CDC近期提升法屬圭亞那疫情旅遊警示至第2級。
items.description_en: The outbreak in French Guiana continues. Since late January this year, 509 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, and the outbreak has spread from western coastal areas to other regions. The US CDC recently raised its travel alert for the French Guiana outbreak to Level 2.

items.headline_zh: 法屬馬約特島/葉門-瘧疾
items.summary_zh: 葉門塔伊茲省今年逾2.2萬例瘧疾,馬約特島累計197例,疫情均呈上升
items.summary_en: Yemen's Taiz Governorate has recorded over 22,000 malaria cases this year, while Mayotte reports 197 cases; both are rising.
items.description_zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,今年截至5月下旬累計報告197例病例,於5月份疫情傳播呈現加速趨勢,主要分布於南部地區(希龍吉),美國CDC近期提升法屬馬約特島疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 葉門塔伊茲省疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告逾22,000例病例,較往年明顯增加,該國約64%人口面臨感染風險,尤其是孕婦及5歲以下兒童為最脆弱族群。
items.description_en: Malaria in Mayotte is rising: 197 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of late May, and transmission accelerated in May, mainly in the southern region (Chirongui). The US CDC recently raised its travel alert for the Mayotte outbreak to Level 2. In Yemen's Taiz Governorate, malaria is rising: more than 22,000 cases have been reported so far this year, markedly higher than in previous years. About 64% of the country's population is at risk of infection, with pregnant women and children under 5 the most vulnerable.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計515例確定病例、91死;美籍醫師在德國治癒出院
items.summary_en: DRC has 515 confirmed Ebola cases and 91 deaths as of 6 June; a US physician infected in DRC was treated in Germany and discharged.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/6累計515例確定病例(91例死亡、12例康復),致死率17.7%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約50.3%。過去 24 小時新增27例確診病例,均集中在伊圖里省。 1名在剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省布亞(Bunia)醫院執行手術而暴露感染的美國籍醫師,於德國醫院接受治療(包括實驗性治療), 現已康復出院。該病患於5/20後送德國,接受抗病毒藥物及支持性治療後,因連續72小時無症狀,且2次PCR結果為陰性,故解除隔離。其5名同住家人接觸者,經預防性隔離均無症狀 。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 6 June, 515 confirmed cases have been reported (91 deaths, 12 recovered), with a CFR of 17.7%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 50.3%. In the past 24 hours, 27 new confirmed cases were added, all in Ituri Province. A US citizen physician who was exposed to infection while performing surgery at Bunia Hospital in Ituri Province, DRC, was treated in a German hospital, including with experimental therapy, and has now recovered and been discharged. The physician was transferred to Germany after 20 May and received antiviral drugs and supportive care. Isolation was lifted after 72 consecutive hours without symptoms and two negative PCR results. Five household contacts placed under precautionary isolation remained asymptomatic.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,德國,美國

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年26例人類新型A型流感,中國新增1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Globally 26 human novel influenza A cases this year, with a new H9N2 case in China; 35 H5N1 animal outbreaks in 10 countries in the week to 5 June.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:中國新增1例H9N2病例。全球今年累計報告26例,分別為16例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3及1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計57國家/地區報告3,559起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共10國於2026/5/29-6/5期間報告35起H5N1疫情,美國11起、南非9起、荷蘭7起、加拿大2起、丹麥/塞內加爾/拉脫維亞/挪威/法國/英國各1起。 美國於2026/5/29報告4起H5 (N untyped)疫情。
items.description_en: Human cases: China reported one new H9N2 case. Globally, 26 cases have been reported this year: 16 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 57 countries and territories have reported 3,559 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Ten countries reported 35 H5N1 outbreaks between 29 May and 5 June 2026: the United States 11, South Africa 9, the Netherlands 7, Canada 2, and Denmark, Senegal, Latvia, Norway, France and the United Kingdom one each. The United States reported four H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 29 May 2026.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第19週陽性率升至1.12%,變異株以BA.3.2及XFG為主
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity edged up to 1.12% in week 19, with BA.3.2 and XFG the leading variants at 37.5% each.
items.description_zh: 今年第19週(5/11-17)全球陽性率由低點略升至1.12%,其中,東南亞區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以BA.3.2及XFG為主(各占37.5%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占21.88%)。 中國疫情於低點略升,第22週(5/25-31)門急診陽性率略升為2.1%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 新加坡疫情於高點波動,第19-20週陽性率自16.67%再上升至18%,第21週則下降至13%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。
items.description_en: In week 19 (11–17 May), the global positivity rate rose slightly from its low point to 1.12%, with a marked increase in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Circulating variants are mainly BA.3.2 and XFG (each 37.5%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21.88%). In China, the positivity rate at outpatient and emergency visits rose slightly to 2.1% in week 22 (25–31 May), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for most variants. In Singapore, positivity has fluctuated at a high level: it rose from 16.67% to 18% in weeks 19–20, then fell to 13% in week 21, with NB.1.8.1 the dominant variant.

items.headline_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計381例確定病例、64死,美國一般民眾風險評為低
items.summary_en: DRC has 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 64 deaths as of 3 June; US CDC rates overall risk to the American public as low.
items.description_zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/3累計381例確定病例(64例死亡、7例康復),疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約55.5%。 美國CDC 於6/5 MMWR 表示目前R0相對較高,且隔離率低於50%情況下,預估有1萬例確診與2,000例死亡。另評估疫情輸入與社區傳播機率極低,在未來 3 個月對美國一般⺠眾整體風險為「低」,惟一旦發生個案,疾病嚴重度與防疫資源需求將造成「高影響」。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 3 June, 381 confirmed cases have been reported (64 deaths, 7 recovered). The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 55.5%. The US CDC, in its 5 June MMWR, stated that with a relatively high R0 and an isolation rate below 50%, it estimates 10,000 confirmed cases and 2,000 deaths. The CDC assessed the probability of importation and community transmission as extremely low. Over the next three months, the overall risk to the general US public is rated low; however, if a case occurs, the high impact on disease severity and prevention resource needs would be rated high.

items.headline_zh: 俄羅斯/義大利/摩洛哥-狂犬病
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯鄂木斯克州3例狂犬病死亡,義大利威托大區1例犬隻確診
items.summary_en: Russia's Omsk region recorded three fatal human rabies cases since April; Italy confirmed a rabies dog imported from Morocco.
items.description_zh: 俄羅斯鄂木斯克州自 2026 年 4 月初起,通報 3 例人類狂犬病確定死亡病例。個案均為被家中貓狗咬傷後,未及時尋求或拒絕暴露後預防接種(PEP)而發病致死。該國每年記錄 2-6 例死亡案例,鄂木斯克州於今年 5 月底已達到/超過全國年度死亡數下限。 義大利威托大區 1 例自摩洛哥非法輸入犬隻於 5/27 確定染病,並遭安樂死,目前無人類感染病例。此為該國近 15 年來首度通報動物個案,專家強調須落實跨部門「健康一體」(One Health)的應對機制,嚴遵守跨國移動的動物檢疫與疫苗規範,才能有效防範人畜共通傳染病的再次爆發。
items.description_en: Omsk Oblast in the Russian Federation has reported three confirmed human rabies deaths since early April 2026. All patients were bitten by household cats or dogs and did not seek, or refused, timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and died as a result. The country records two to six rabies deaths each year, and Omsk Oblast had reached or exceeded the national annual lower limit for deaths by late May this year. In Italy's Veneto Region, one dog illegally imported from Morocco was confirmed infected with rabies on 27 May and was euthanised. No human infections have been reported. This is the first animal case reported in the country in nearly 15 years. Experts stress the need for a cross-sectoral One Health response, with strict compliance with animal quarantine and vaccination rules for cross-border movement, to prevent a recurrence of zoonotic outbreaks.

items.headline_zh: 安哥拉/剛果民主共和國(DRC)-M痘
items.headline_en: Angola / Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 安哥拉累計13例M痘確定病例,卡賓達新增3例無旅遊史個案,顯示本土傳播
items.summary_en: Angola has 13 confirmed Mpox cases, including three new Cabinda cases without travel history, suggesting local community spread.
items.description_zh: 安哥拉自 2024 年至 2026/5/29,全國累計 13 例確定病例,主要分布於接壤剛果民主共和國(DRC)的卡賓達省(9 例)與烏伊熱省(4 例)。卡賓達近期新通報 3 例均為無旅遊史個案,顯示已發生本土社區傳播,惟病毒分支類型尚待確認。目前該國 MVA-BN 疫苗優先提供給邊境警察接種,一般社區民眾則缺乏保護力。
items.description_en: From 2024 to 29 May 2026, Angola has reported 13 confirmed cases nationwide, mainly in Cabinda Province (9) and Uíge Province (4), both bordering the DRC. The three newly reported cases in Cabinda had no travel history, indicating local community transmission, although the virus clade has yet to be confirmed. The MVA-BN vaccine is currently prioritised for border police, leaving the general community without protection.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,剛果民主共和國

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計363例確定病例、62死,西班牙取消該國熱身賽
items.summary_en: DRC has 363 confirmed Ebola cases and 62 deaths as of 2 June; Spain cancelled a DRC warm-up match and the US imposed 21-day quarantine.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至 6/2 累計 363 例確定病例(62 例死亡、6 例康復),疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共 25 個衛生區,其中重災區伊圖里省新增曼巴薩(Mambasa)衛生區,DRC 接觸者追蹤率僅約 45.5%。 西班牙取消 DRC 國家足球隊的世界盃熱身賽;美國要求 DRC 國家足球隊在入境參與世界盃前,必須先完成 21 天隔離。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 2 June, 363 confirmed cases have been reported (62 deaths, 6 recovered), concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Within the heavily affected Ituri Province, Mambasa health zone has been newly added. DRC's contact tracing rate is only about 45.5%. Spain has cancelled the DRC national football team's World Cup warm-up match. The United States requires the DRC national football team to complete 21 days of quarantine before entering to take part in the World Cup.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,西班牙,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:5/21-27期間阿富汗新增1例WPV1,奈及利亞新增3例cVDPV3
items.summary_en: GPEI reported new polio cases in Afghanistan, Madagascar, South Sudan, Somalia and Nigeria between 21 and 27 May.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 5/21-27 期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗 1 例;cVDPV1 新增馬達加斯加/南蘇丹各 1 例;cVDPV2 新增索馬利亞 2 例;cVDPV3 新增奈及利亞 3 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1 新增阿富汗 11 件,cVDPV2 新增索馬利亞 3 件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 21 and 27 May, WPV1 added one case in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 added one case each in Madagascar and South Sudan; cVDPV2 added two cases in Somalia; and cVDPV3 added three cases in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 11 specimens in Afghanistan and cVDPV2 added three in Somalia.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,馬達加斯加,奈及利亞,索馬利亞,南蘇丹共和國

items.summary_zh: 紐約州布魯姆郡矯正機構沙門氏菌群聚逾300例,感染源為雞肉沙拉
items.summary_en: A New York correctional facility in Broome County reports over 300 Salmonella cases, traced to chicken salad served in its restaurant.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約州布魯姆郡(Broome)某矯正機構自 5/25 迄今累計報告逾300 例病例,其中 10 例住院,經查感染源為該矯正機構餐廳之雞肉沙拉,當局已加強清消、暫停探視、進行接觸者追蹤並將食物分開採購。另美國每年估計有 130 萬例沙門氏菌感染者。
items.description_en: A correctional facility in Broome County, New York State, has reported more than 300 cumulative cases since 25 May, of which 10 were hospitalised. The investigation identified the source as chicken salad from the facility's restaurant. Authorities have intensified disinfection, suspended visitation, conducted contact tracing and separated food procurement. The United States is estimated to have 1.3 million Salmonella infections each year.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計344例確定病例、60死;烏干達累計15例
items.summary_en: DRC has 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths as of 1 June, with 289 suspected cases pending; Uganda has 15 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至 6/1 累計 344 例確定病例(60 例死亡、6 例康復),目前尚有 289 例待確定之疑病例,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共 24 個衛生區。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至 6/2 累計 15 例確定病例 (1 例死亡),其中新增的 6 例病例均為確定個案之密切接觸者。 WHO 表示剛果民主共和國(DRC)近期疑病例數下降,此與疑病例經調查或檢測後被排除有關。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 1 June, 344 confirmed cases have been reported (60 deaths, 6 recovered), and 289 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 24 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda outbreak update: as of 2 June, it had 15 cumulative confirmed cases (1 death); the six newly added cases were all close contacts of confirmed cases. WHO said the number of suspected cases in DRC has recently declined, due to suspected cases being ruled out after investigation or testing.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: WHO:今年截至4/26全球霍亂79,740例、1,010死,4月較3月降54%
items.summary_en: WHO reports 79,740 cholera cases and 1,010 deaths globally this year as of 26 April; April cases fell 54% from March.
items.description_zh: WHO 公布全球今年截至 4/26 累計報告 7 萬 9,740 例病例,1,010 例死亡,其中,4 月新增病例數較今年 3 月下降 54%,且較去年同期下降 62%,各國 CFR 介於 0-8.9%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 22 個國家,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗、安哥拉及南蘇丹為多。WHO 評估約有 10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, as of 26 April this year, 79,740 cases and 1,010 deaths have been reported cumulatively. New cases in April fell 54% from March this year and 62% from the same period last year. CFR across countries ranges from 0% to 8.9%. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia and the Americas. Recent new cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan, Angola and South Sudan. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face infection risk, and the global transmission risk is very high.

items.headline_zh: 巴西-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 巴西馬托羅索州累計53例確定病例、8死,疫情仍低於去年同期
items.summary_en: Mato Grosso State, Brazil, has 53 confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases and 8 deaths; authorities say this year is still below last year.
items.description_zh: 巴西馬托羅索州5/29報告53例確定病例(8例死亡),以50-64歲為多,致死率則以5-9歲年齡層為高,病患分布於庫亞巴(Cuiaba)等20個城市,顯示疫情有地理分布擴散且有低度社區傳播。目前正當地流行期(5-10月),當局評估今年疫情仍低於去年同期,當地疫苗覆蓋率已達98.72%,仍持續加強疫苗接種。另該國2010-2019年平均每年報告1萬8,200例病例,致死率為9.26%。
items.description_en: In Mato Grosso State, Brazil, 53 confirmed cases (8 deaths) were reported on 29 May, most among people aged 50–64. The case fatality rate is highest in the 5–9 age group. Cases are distributed across 20 cities, including Cuiabá, indicating geographic spread and low-level community transmission. The region is currently in its local epidemic season (May–October). Authorities assess that this year's outbreak is still lower than the same period last year. Local vaccination coverage has reached 98.72%, and vaccination efforts continue to be strengthened. Brazil reported an average of 18,200 cases a year in 2010–2019, with a CFR of 9.26%.

items.summary_zh: 日本今年累計511例麻疹,已超過去年全年;孟加拉自3月起累計7萬936例
items.summary_en: Japan's 511 measles cases this year already exceed last year's full-year total; Bangladesh has reported 70,936 cases since March.
items.description_zh: 日本今年迄今累計511例病例,已逾去年全年病例數(265例),近4週增幅趨緩,感染者多為20至29歲族群,以東京都、神奈川縣及埼玉縣為多,境外移入感染國以印為多,多數病例接種史不明、未接種或接種1劑疫苗。 孟加拉疫情嚴峻,自今年3月爆發疫情迄今累計報告70,936例病例(9,049例確診),585例相關死亡病例(90例確診),達卡地區最為嚴峻(6,306例確診)。
items.description_en: Japan has reported 511 cumulative cases so far this year, already exceeding the full-year total for last year (265 cases). The increase has slowed over the past four weeks. Most infected people are aged 20–29, with the most cases in Tokyo Metropolis, Kanagawa Prefecture and Saitama Prefecture. Among imported cases, most were acquired in India. Most cases had an unknown vaccination history, were unvaccinated, or had received one dose of vaccine. Bangladesh's outbreak is severe: since it began in March this year, 70,936 cases (9,049 confirmed) and 585 related deaths (90 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively. The Dhaka region is the most severely affected, with 6,306 confirmed cases.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/烏干達/巴西-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda / Brazil – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計321例確定病例、48死,巴西疑似病例已排除伊波拉
items.summary_en: DRC has 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths as of 31 May; Uganda has nine, and Brazil has ruled out Ebola in two suspected cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/31累計321例確定病例(48例死亡、6例康復),目前尚有220例待確認之疑病例。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至5/31累計9確定病例 (1例死亡),個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),與跨境移動與醫療照護暴露有關。 巴西報告2例疑病例,其中1例具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,經檢驗為流行性腦脊髓膜炎及瘧疾,已排除伊波拉病毒感染。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 31 May, 321 confirmed cases had been reported (48 deaths, 6 recovered), and 220 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. Uganda outbreak update: as of 31 May, 9 cumulative confirmed cases (1 death) had been reported, distributed across the capital Kampala and Wakiso District, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. Brazil reported two suspected cases; one had recent travel history to the DRC. Testing identified meningitis and malaria, and Ebola virus infection has been ruled out.
items.area_zh: 巴西,剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年累計850,783例登革熱、153死,米納斯吉拉斯州6萬1,229例
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported 850,783 dengue cases and 153 deaths this year, including 61,229 cases in Minas Gerais State as of 25 May.
items.description_zh: 巴西米納斯吉拉斯州截至5/25累計報告61,229例病例(29,116例確診)及23例死亡;該國今年迄今累計報告850,783例病例(197,719例確診)及153例死亡。
items.description_en: As of 25 May, Minas Gerais State, Brazil, had reported 61,229 cumulative cases (29,116 confirmed) and 23 deaths. Nationwide, Brazil has reported 850,783 cases (197,719 confirmed) and 153 deaths so far this year.

items.summary_zh: 美國紐約長島首例本土波旁病毒感染,患者2021年遭蜱叮咬,今年5月確診
items.summary_en: New York's Long Island reports its first local Bourbon virus infection, in a 67-year-old man bitten by a tick in 2021 and diagnosed in May.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約州長島報告當地首例人類感染波旁病毒(Bourbon virus)病例,為一名67歲男性戶外工作者,於2021年遭蜱蟲叮咬,出現皮疹、發燒、盜汗及頭痛,經5天醫療照護,最後康復,該病例其後參加追蹤研究,並每季抽血,於今年5月確診。專家評估長島之孤星蜱蟲數量眾多,該地區可能有未被發現的感染者。
items.description_en: New York's Long Island has reported its first locally acquired human Bourbon virus infection. The patient is a 67-year-old man who works outdoors. He was bitten by a tick in 2021 and developed a rash, fever, night sweats and headache. After five days of medical care he recovered. He later took part in a follow-up study with quarterly blood draws, and was diagnosed in May this year. Experts assess that the population of lone star ticks on Long Island is large, and undetected infections may exist in the area.

items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞2024年至5/17累計192例黃熱病、85死,疫情已擴散至10省
items.summary_en: Colombia has reported 192 yellow fever cases and 85 deaths since 2024 across 10 departments, with spread beyond Tolima.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,2024年至2026年5/17累計10省報告192例病例及85例死亡,疫情傳播不再局限於托利馬省,已蔓延至其他省份,大部分重症及死亡病例無疫苗接種紀錄。
items.description_en: Colombia outbreak update: from 2024 to 17 May 2026, 10 departments have reported 192 cumulative cases and 85 deaths. Transmission is no longer confined to Tolima Department and has spread to other departments. Most severe and fatal cases had no vaccination record.

items.summary_zh: DRC累計282例確診、42死;巴西2例疑似伊波拉個案隔離待驗
items.summary_en: DRC has 282 confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths as of 30 May; two suspected cases in Brazil are isolated awaiting test results.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/30累計282例確診病例(42例死亡、2例康復),目前尚有321例待確認之疑病例。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共22個衛生區。另烏干達目前9例確診病例 (1例死亡)。 巴西當局於聖保羅與里約熱內盧監測2名伊波拉疑個案:案1為近期自DRC入境之DRC籍男性,案2為近期自烏干達入境之比利時籍男性。兩案雖已分別確診腦膜炎與瘧疾,惟尚未排除伊波拉病毒共感染之可能性,目前均已隔離並等待檢驗結果。 WHO秘書長譚德塞於5/30親赴DRC伊圖里省重災區視察,強調妥善治療可提高存活率。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 30 May, 282 confirmed cases (42 deaths, 2 recovered) had been reported, and 321 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 22 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda currently has nine confirmed cases (1 death). Brazilian authorities are monitoring two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro: case 1 is a DRC national man who recently entered Brazil from the DRC, and case 2 is a Belgian man who recently entered from Uganda. Although they were diagnosed with meningitis and malaria respectively, Ebola virus co-infection has not been ruled out, and both are isolated awaiting test results. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the hard-hit area of Ituri Province, DRC, on 30 May and stressed that proper treatment can improve survival.
items.area_zh: 比利時,巴西,剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 全球累計18萬4,531例M痘確診、至少506死,馬達加斯加近6週居首
items.summary_en: Globally 184,531 confirmed Mpox cases and at least 506 deaths since 2022; Madagascar reported the most African cases over the past six weeks.
items.description_zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
items.description_en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A 型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年25例人類新型A型流感,中國新增1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Globally 25 human novel influenza A cases this year, including a new H9N2 case in China; Japan reported 66 of 96 H5N1 animal outbreaks in late May.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:中國新增1例H9N2病例。全球今年累計報告25 例,分別為15例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3、1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,540起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共10國於2026/5/23-29期間報告96起H5N1疫情,日本66起、泊爾12 起、芬蘭5 起、荷蘭4 起、加拿大3 起、波蘭2起、挪威/法國/臺灣/西班牙各1起。 日本於2026/5/27報告26起H5 (N untyped)、1起H5N5疫情。
items.description_en: Human cases: China reported one new H9N2 case. Globally, 25 cases have been reported this year: 15 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,540 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Ten countries reported 96 H5N1 outbreaks between 23 and 29 May 2026: Japan 66, Nepal 12, Finland 5, the Netherlands 4, Canada 3, Poland 2, and Norway, France, Taiwan and Spain one each. Japan reported 26 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks and one H5N5 outbreak on 27 May 2026.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第18週陽性率降至0.86%,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(占26.81%)
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity fell to 0.86% in week 18, with NB.1.8.1 the leading variant at 26.81%.
items.description_zh: 今年第18 週(5/4-10)全球陽性率下降為0.86%,其中,東南亞、東地中海、非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(占26.81%)、其次為BA.3.2(占23.91%)及XFG(占21.01%)。 中國疫情於低點略降,第21 週(5/18-24)門急診陽性率略降為1.5%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 日本疫情於低點略增,第20週(5/11-17)平均定醫報告數增為0.37,近期住院病例以80歲以上為多。
items.description_en: In week 18 (4–10 May), the global positivity rate fell to 0.86%, with a marked increase in positivity in the WHO regional offices for South-East Asia, the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. Circulating variants are mainly NB.1.8.1 (26.81%), followed by BA.3.2 (23.91%) and XFG (21.01%). In China, the positivity rate at outpatient and emergency visits fell slightly to 1.5% in week 21 (18–24 May), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for most variants. In Japan, activity rose slightly from a low point: the average number of reports per designated sentinel clinic rose to 0.37 in week 20 (11–17 May), and recent hospitalised cases were mainly aged 80 and over.

items.summary_zh: 郵輪漢他病毒群聚累計13例、3死,WHO評估全球風險低
items.summary_en: A hantavirus cluster linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship has 13 cases and three deaths; WHO rates global risk as low.
items.description_zh: WHO更新「洪迪亞斯號」郵輪疫情資訊,截至5/30累計報告13例病例,其中3 例死亡(致死率為23%),報告病例中有11 例確診為漢他病毒安地斯型感染,2 例為可能病例,自WHO 前於5/13 公布疫情資訊以來,共新增3例包括加拿大、荷蘭及西班牙確診病例。截至5/22 已有逾600 名接觸者進行追蹤,其中53%為高風險接觸者。WHO評估此疫情事件對全球之風險為低。
items.description_en: WHO has updated information on the outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship. As of 30 May, 13 cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths (CFR 23%). Of the reported cases, 11 were confirmed as Andes hantavirus infection and two were probable cases. Since WHO's previous update on 13 May, three new cases have been added, in Canada, the Netherlands and Spain. As of 22 May, more than 600 contacts had been traced, 53% of them high-risk contacts. WHO assesses the global risk from this event as low.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計1,039例病例、242死,烏干達確診增至9例
items.summary_en: DRC has 1,039 cumulative cases and 242 deaths as of 28 May, including 133 confirmed; Uganda's confirmed cases rose to nine.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,截至5/28累計報告1,039例病例及242例死亡,分別為906例疑病例(其中223例疑死亡)、133例確診病例(其中19例確診死亡)。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省,並波及北基伍與南基伍省共13 個衛生區,其中Bunia、Rwampara、Mongbwalu、Nyankunde個案數較多。此外,近期檢驗量能提升促使病例重新分類,致下修疑病例數,另位於Rwampara 的治療中心有首例治癒個案。烏干達確診病例增加至9例(其中1例死亡),個案分布於首都Kampala及Wakiso,與跨境移動與醫療照護暴露有關。 WHO於5/28建議3款治療藥物作為 (Bundibugyo virus disease,BVD)臨床試驗評估,並推薦1款口服抗病毒藥物作為暴露後預防之臨床試驗評估、以及2款候選疫苗作為開發評估。 WHO專家推測爆發疫情可能與DRC當地獵捕與食用野味習慣有關,另肯亞法院暫停美國專屬醫療設施計畫。
items.description_en: DRC outbreak update: as of 28 May, 1,039 cases and 242 deaths had been reported cumulatively, comprising 906 suspected cases (223 suspected deaths) and 133 confirmed cases (19 confirmed deaths). The outbreak is mainly concentrated in Ituri Province and has spread to 13 health zones in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces; Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Nyankunde have the most cases. Recent increases in testing capacity have led to reclassification of cases, which lowered the suspected case count. A first cured case has also been recorded at the treatment centre in Rwampara. Uganda's confirmed cases increased to nine (one death), distributed across the capital Kampala and Wakiso, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. On 28 May, WHO recommended three therapeutic drugs for clinical trial evaluation in Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), one oral antiviral drug for clinical trial evaluation as post-exposure prophylaxis, and two candidate vaccines for development evaluation. WHO experts suspect the outbreak may be linked to local bushmeat hunting and consumption practices in the DRC. Separately, a Kenyan court has suspended a US-exclusive medical facility programme.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 蘇丹南達爾富爾州截至5/21通報347例M痘病例;中國2例具香港旅遊史
items.summary_en: Sudan's South Darfur reports 347 Mpox cases as of 21 May in a suspected outbreak; China reported two cases with Hong Kong travel history.
items.description_zh: 蘇丹南達爾富爾州(South Darfur)傑貝勒馬拉(Jebel Marra)地區爆發疑疫情。截至5/21當地通報347例病例,疫情於一週內急速攀升,目前尚未有死亡病例報告,且病毒分支(clade)與實驗室檢驗結果仍待確認。該區收容約70萬名流離失所者,極度擁擠的難民營、缺乏衛生設施與疫苗,加上醫療監測系統崩潰,致傳播風險極高。 中國近期通報2例具香港旅遊史的確診病例。2名男性(28及30歲)潛伏期內均曾造訪香港旺角同一場所,並有高風險行為,其後陸續出現發燒、腹股溝腫痛及下肢紅疹等症狀後確診。2022年迄今,香港累計86例確診病例(含69例本土與17例境外移入個案),且個案皆為男性。
items.description_en: A suspected outbreak has occurred in the Jebel Marra area of South Darfur State, Sudan. As of 21 May, 347 cases had been reported locally. Cases rose sharply within one week. No deaths have been reported so far, and the clade and laboratory results remain pending. The area hosts about 700,000 displaced people; extremely crowded refugee camps, lack of sanitation and vaccines, and the collapse of the health monitoring system make the transmission risk extremely high. China recently reported two confirmed cases with a history of travel to Hong Kong. The two men, aged 28 and 30, both visited the same venue in Mong Kok, Hong Kong, during their incubation period and engaged in high-risk behaviour. They subsequently developed fever, groin swelling and pain, and lower-limb rashes, and were then confirmed. Since 2022, Hong Kong has reported 86 cumulative confirmed cases (69 local and 17 imported), all in men.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國截至5/26累計121例確診、1,077例疑似,蒙布瓦盧醫院遭襲
items.summary_en: DRC has reported 121 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,077 suspected cases as of 26 May; at least 25 suspected patients fled an attacked hospital.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC),截至5/26累計報告1,077例疑病例(其中238人死亡)、121例確診病例(其中17例死亡)。重災區集中在伊圖里、北基伍與南基伍三省,其中最嚴重的地區為伊圖里省的布亞(Bunia)、魯瓦姆帕拉(Rwampara)及蒙布瓦盧(Mongbwalu)。另蒙布瓦盧醫院於5/23-25遭襲,至少25名疑BVD病患逃離,其中包括一名確診病例,對當地防疫構成嚴重風險。
items.description_en: DRC: as of 26 May, 1,077 suspected cases (238 of whom died) and 121 confirmed cases (17 deaths) had been reported cumulatively. The heavily affected areas are concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. The most severe areas are Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu in Ituri Province. In addition, the Mongbwalu hospital was attacked on 23–25 May, and at least 25 suspected BVD patients fled, including one confirmed case, posing a serious risk to local disease control.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:5/14-20期間南蘇丹新增1例cVDPV1,葉門新增1例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: GPEI reported new cVDPV1 and cVDPV2 polio cases in South Sudan, Nigeria and Yemen between 14 and 20 May.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/14-20期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增奈及利亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增葉門2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 14 and 20 May, cVDPV1 added one case in South Sudan, and cVDPV2 added one case each in Nigeria and Yemen. For environmental samples, WPV1 added one specimen in Pakistan and cVDPV2 added two in Yemen.
items.area_zh: 奈及利亞,南蘇丹共和國,葉門

items.summary_zh: 中國今年第19-20週腸病毒病例3萬6,258例,較去年同期增94%
items.summary_en: China reported 36,258 enterovirus cases in weeks 19–20 (4–17 May), 94% above the same period last year, with no deaths.
items.description_zh: 中國疫情呈上升趨勢,今年第19-20週(5/4-17)報告3萬6,258例病例,其中重症5例,無死亡案例,疫情較前兩週增加11%、較去年同期增加94%。近期實驗室確診病例中,以克沙奇A16型占比為多(47.5%),其次為腸病毒A71型(占17.9%)。
items.description_en: China's enterovirus outbreak is on an upward trend: in weeks 19–20 (4–17 May), 36,258 cases were reported, including five severe cases and no deaths. This is 11% higher than the previous two weeks and 94% higher than the same period last year. Among recent laboratory-confirmed cases, coxsackievirus A16 accounted for the largest share (47.5%), followed by enterovirus A71 (17.9%).

items.headline_zh: 美國/墨西哥-布氏桿菌病
items.summary_zh: 加州南洛杉磯郡5/23公布布氏桿菌病群聚,病例均食用墨西哥未殺菌起司
items.summary_en: Southern Los Angeles County reported a brucellosis cluster on 23 May; all patients ate unpasteurised cheese shipped from Mexico.
items.description_zh: 美國加州南洛杉磯郡5/23公布1起群聚疫情,病例數仍調查中,病患皆食用從墨西哥銷入的未殺菌起司。該郡過往每年報告低於15例病例,多與食用未殺菌起司、職業或實驗室暴露有關,當局呼籲民眾避免食用生食或未經殺菌的乳製品。
items.description_en: On 23 May, Southern Los Angeles County, California, United States, announced a cluster; case numbers are still under investigation. All patients ate unpasteurised cheese sold after being shipped from Mexico. In past years the county has reported fewer than 15 cases a year, mostly linked to eating unpasteurised cheese or to occupational or laboratory exposure. Authorities urge the public to avoid eating raw or unpasteurised dairy products.

items.headline_zh: 比利時-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 比利時今年累計236例沙門氏菌確診,疑與某生產商雞蛋有關
items.summary_en: Belgium has reported 236 confirmed Salmonella cases this year; eggs from one producer are suspected as the source and authorities have asked for their withdrawal.
items.description_zh: 比利時今年2/19-5/11累計報告236例確診病例,病患分布於各年齡層,經調查疑感染源為某生產商販售之雞蛋,當局已要求將商品下架。另該國2025年累計報告3,375例食物相關傳染病病例,其中有71例住院。
items.description_en: From 19 February to 11 May this year, Belgium has reported 236 confirmed cases across all age groups. The investigation suspects eggs sold by a certain producer as the source, and authorities have asked for the products to be withdrawn. In 2025, Belgium reported 3,375 foodborne infectious disease cases cumulatively, of which 71 were hospitalised.

items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國累計1,011例、233死;加拿大禁止兩國公民入境90天
items.summary_en: DRC has reported 1,011 Ebola cases and 233 deaths as of 26 May; Canada imposed a 90-day entry ban on DRC and Ugandan citizens.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續攀升,截至5/26累計報告1,011例病例,其中105例確診、233例死亡,致死率(CFR)達23%。加拿大於5/26宣布禁止DRC與烏干達之公民入境,禁令為期90天;泰國5/26宣布自DRC與烏干達入境之旅客須進行21天入境檢疫;印度於各大機場啟動篩檢與監測措施,5/26報告1例自烏干達境外移入之疑病例,於5/27檢驗呈陰性,已排除風險。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to grow: as of 26 May, 1,011 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 105 confirmed cases and 233 deaths, with a CFR of 23%. On 26 May, Canada announced a 90-day entry ban on citizens of the DRC and Uganda. On the same day, Thailand announced that travellers entering from the DRC and Uganda must undergo 21 days of entry quarantine. India has launched screening and surveillance measures at major airports; on 26 May it reported one suspected case imported from Uganda, which tested negative on 27 May, so the risk was ruled out.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,剛果民主共和國,印度,泰國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 關島今年4月至5/22累計15例百日咳確診、1例疑似,當局加強接種
items.summary_en: Guam has reported 15 confirmed pertussis cases and one suspected case since April, and has stepped up vaccination.
items.description_zh: 美國關島自今年4月截至5/22累計報告1例疑病例及15例確診病例,因疫情持續,當局已加強於健身房等處推動疫苗接種,呼籲與新生兒密切接觸的人踴躍接種。
items.description_en: Guam has reported one suspected case and 15 confirmed cases cumulatively from April this year through 22 May. As the outbreak continues, authorities have stepped up vaccination promotion at venues such as gyms and urge people in close contact with newborns to get vaccinated.

items.disease_zh: 腸病毒感染併發重症,流感併發重症
items.disease_en: Severe enterovirus infection, 流感併發重症
items.headline_zh: 日本-流感/鼻病毒/腸病毒/人類間質肺炎病毒感染
items.headline_en: Japan – Influenza / rhinovirus / enterovirus / human metapneumovirus infection
items.summary_zh: 日本第19週急性呼吸道感染數較前週降近4成,受黃金週休診影響
items.summary_en: Japan's acute respiratory infections fell nearly 40% in week 19, which is assessed to reflect Golden Week clinic closures.
items.description_zh: 日本今年第19週(5/4-10)整體急性呼吸道感染(ARI)數,較第18週下降近4成,評估係因黃金週「休診效應」影響。另3月呼吸道陽性檢體中,以B型流感病毒(占25.5%) 與鼻病毒或腸病毒(占14.9%)為多,其次為人類間質肺炎病毒(占6%)。
items.description_en: In week 19 of this year (4–10 May), Japan's overall number of acute respiratory infections (ARI) fell by nearly 40% compared with week 18. This is assessed to be due to the effect of Golden Week clinic closures. Among respiratory specimens positive in March, influenza B virus accounted for the largest share (25.5%), followed by rhinovirus or enterovirus (14.9%) and human metapneumovirus (6%).

items.summary_zh: 澳洲今年累計逾231例白喉,為近年年均30倍,出現近10年首例死亡
items.summary_en: Australia has over 231 diphtheria cases as of 20 May, 30 times the recent annual average, and reported its first death in nearly 10 years.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞疫情嚴峻,今年截至5/20累計報告逾231例病例,為近年年平均病例數的30倍,且報告近10年首例死亡案例,疫情自北領地(Northern Territory)擴散至西澳州及昆士蘭等地,25%病患需住院治療,當局已加強疫苗接種及醫護人力支援等措施。
items.description_en: Australia's outbreak is severe: as of 20 May this year, more than 231 cases have been reported cumulatively, which is 30 times the average annual number of cases in recent years. The country has reported its first death in nearly 10 years. The outbreak has spread from the Northern Territory to Western Australia and Queensland, among other states. 25% of patients required hospitalisation. Authorities have strengthened vaccination and healthcare workforce support.

items.headline_zh: 宏都拉斯/瓜地馬拉/墨西哥-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 宏都拉斯首例麻疹為瓜地馬拉境外移入,墨西哥今年累計1萬1,033例
items.summary_en: Honduras reported its first measles case, imported from Guatemala, where 6,209 confirmed cases and 12 deaths had been reported as of 13 May.
items.description_zh: 宏都拉斯於5/21報告首例病例,該案為40歲男性,經研判為自鄰國瓜地馬拉境外移入案例。瓜地馬拉自2025年12月截至5/13累計報告6,209例確診病例、7,752例極可能病例及12例死亡,該國已發布紅色疫情警戒,本事件顯示瓜地馬拉疫情持續擴大,已出現跨國傳播案例。 墨西哥今年截至5/22累計報告1萬1,033例病例,病患分布以哈利斯科州及墨西哥市為多。自2025年1月起,此波疫情累計報告1萬7,641例病例及41例死亡,病患年層以1-4歲占大宗,其次為5-9歲。
items.description_en: Honduras reported its first case on 21 May: a 40-year-old man, assessed as an imported case from neighbouring Guatemala. From December 2025 through 13 May, Guatemala reported 6,209 confirmed cases, 7,752 probable cases and 12 deaths cumulatively. The country has issued a red alert for the outbreak. This event shows that the outbreak in Guatemala continues to expand and has produced cross-border transmission. Mexico reported 11,033 cases this year as of 22 May, mainly in Jalisco State and Mexico City. Since January 2025, this wave of the outbreak has recorded 17,641 cases and 41 deaths cumulatively, with children aged 1–4 accounting for the largest share, followed by those aged 5–9.
items.area_zh: 瓜地馬拉,宏都拉斯,墨西哥

items.summary_zh: 西班牙5/25新增1例安地斯病毒感染,為郵輪撤離人員,接觸者隔離中
items.summary_en: Spain reported a new Andes virus case on 25 May in a person evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship; other contacts remain isolated.
items.description_zh: 西班牙於5/25新增報告1例自MV Hondius號郵輪撤離後確診之安地斯病毒(ANDV)病例。14名西班牙公民於5/10自特內裡費島撤離,並被送往醫院隔離。第1例於抵達後一天被發現(症狀輕微,正在康復中);第2例則於5/25被發現(無症狀,常規PCR篩檢發現),兩例患者均已被轉移至高級隔離病房。其餘接觸者自5/10起在醫院隔離 28 天,之後在家隔離共42天。
items.description_en: Spain reported one new Andes virus (ANDV) case on 25 May, in a person evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship. Fourteen Spanish citizens were evacuated from Tenerife on 10 May and taken to hospital for isolation. The first case was detected one day after arrival (mild symptoms, now recovering). The second case was detected on 25 May (asymptomatic, found through routine PCR screening). Both patients have been moved to high-level isolation wards. The remaining contacts have been isolated in hospital for 28 days from 10 May, and then isolated at home for a total of 42 days.

items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國截至5/24確診112例、11死;非洲11國有傳播風險
items.summary_en: DRC has 112 confirmed Ebola cases and 11 deaths as of 24 May; Africa CDC assesses transmission risk in 11 countries.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市近1週414例登革熱,斯里蘭卡今年累計29,589例、15死
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City reported 414 dengue cases in the week to 17 May; Sri Lanka has 29,589 cases and 15 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情更新,近1週(5/11-17)報告414例病例,較前4週平均數下降,2026年截至第20週累計報告16,892例病例,高於2025年同期。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,2026年截至5/18累計報告29,589例病例及15例死亡,病例分布於該國25個行政區。
items.description_en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: in the most recent week (11–17 May), 414 cases were reported, lower than the average of the previous four weeks. Cumulatively, 16,892 cases were reported up to week 20 of 2026, higher than in the same period of 2025. Sri Lanka outbreak update: as of 18 May 2026, 29,589 cases and 15 deaths had been reported cumulatively, distributed across 25 administrative districts of the country.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲北領地愛麗斯泉2例墨累河谷腦炎死亡,雨季蚊蟲增加,已啟動監測
items.summary_en: Alice Springs in Australia's Northern Territory has reported two Murray Valley encephalitis deaths in April and May as mosquito numbers rise.
items.description_zh: 澳洲北領地愛麗斯泉報告2例死亡病例,分別發生於2026年4、5月,雨季降雨量增加導致北領地蚊子數量上升,疾病傳播風險亦上升,通常於3-5月間病例數較高,大多數感染僅引起輕微發熱性疾病,少數病例進展為嚴重神經系統疾病,包括腦炎。當地已啟動蚊子監測及控制措施。
items.description_en: Alice Springs in the Northern Territory of Australia has reported two deaths, occurring in April and May 2026. Increased rainfall in the wet season has led to rising mosquito numbers in the Northern Territory, and the risk of transmission has also increased. Cases usually peak between March and May. Most infections cause only mild febrile illness, while a small number progress to severe neurological disease, including encephalitis. Mosquito surveillance and control measures have been activated locally.

items.summary_zh: 聖保羅州2025-2026監測期累計9例黃熱病確診、5死,確診者皆未接種疫苗
items.summary_en: São Paulo State, Brazil, has reported nine confirmed yellow fever cases and five deaths since July 2025, all unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 巴西聖保羅州於2025-2026監測期(自2025年7月起)截至2026年5/19已報告9例確診病例及5例死亡(致死率約56%),所有確診病例皆未接種疫苗,當局已加強疫苗接種工作。
items.description_en: In São Paulo State, Brazil, during the 2025–2026 surveillance period (since July 2025), 9 confirmed cases and 5 deaths (CFR about 56%) had been reported as of 19 May 2026. All confirmed cases were unvaccinated, and authorities have stepped up vaccination efforts.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年24例人類新型A型流感,中國新增1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Globally 24 human novel influenza A cases this year, including a new H9N2 case in China; Poland led 23 H5N1 animal outbreaks in mid-May.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:中國新增1例H9N2病例。全球今年累計報告24例,分別為14例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3、1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,420起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共10國於2026/5/15-22期間報告23起H5N1疫情,波蘭8起、美國5起、英國/荷蘭各2起、丹麥/奧地利/愛沙亞/挪威/瑞典/芬蘭各1起。
items.description_en: Human cases: China reported one new H9N2 case. Globally, 24 cases have been reported this year: 14 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,420 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Ten countries reported 23 H5N1 outbreaks between 15 and 22 May 2026: Poland 8, the United States 5, the United Kingdom 2, the Netherlands 2, and Denmark, Austria, Estonia, Norway, Sweden and Finland one each.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉3/15至5/23累計512例麻疹死亡,為數十年來最嚴峻疫情
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has recorded 512 measles deaths from 15 March to 23 May, its most severe outbreak in decades; 18 million children vaccinated.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉3/15-5/23累計報告512例死亡病例,為數十年來最嚴峻疫情,該國自2024年疫苗接種計畫停滯後,導致大批兒童缺乏免疫力,當局因應疫情,已進行1,800萬兒童之疫苗接種。
items.description_en: From 15 March to 23 May, Bangladesh reported 512 measles deaths cumulatively, making this the most severe outbreak in decades. Since the vaccination programme stalled in 2024, large numbers of children have lacked immunity. In response, authorities have vaccinated 18 million children.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 新加坡第19週新增1萬2,700例,較前週8,000例明顯上升
items.summary_en: Singapore reported 12,700 COVID-19 cases in week 19, up from 8,000 the prior week, with NB.1.8.1 the dominant variant.
items.description_zh: 今年第17週(4/27-5/3)全球陽性率下降為0.86%,其中,東南亞、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(占34.86%)、其次為XFG(占22.48%)及JN.1(占21.1%)。 中國疫情於低點略增,第20週(5/11-17)門急診陽性率略增為1.7%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 新加坡疫情持續上升,第19週新增1萬2,700例病例,較第18週(8,000例)增加,近期住院率亦上升,另第17週陽性率為16.78%,當局表示疫情上升原因與群體免疫下降有關,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。
items.description_en: In week 17 (27 April–3 May), the global positivity rate fell to 0.86%, with a marked increase in positivity in the WHO regional offices for South-East Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean. Circulating variants are mainly NB.1.8.1 (34.86%), followed by XFG (22.48%) and JN.1 (21.1%). In China, positivity at outpatient and emergency visits rose slightly from a low point to 1.7% in week 20 (11–17 May), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for most variants. In Singapore, the outbreak continues to rise: 12,700 cases were reported in week 19, up from 8,000 in week 18, and hospitalisation rates have also risen recently. Positivity in week 17 was 16.78%. Authorities say the rise is linked to declining population immunity, and NB.1.8.1 accounts for most variants.

items.summary_zh: 日本福岡縣出現「神秘感冒」,就診數增2至3成,疑為hMPV等常見病毒
items.summary_en: Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan, reports a 'mysterious cold' with clinic visits up 20–30%; rapid COVID-19 and flu tests are negative and hMPV is suspected.
items.description_zh: 日本九州福岡縣近期出現「神秘感冒」,於黃金週後,診所求診數較往年增加2至3成,並擴散至關東地區。病患症狀多為喉嚨劇痛、久咳帶痰及鼻水,惟新冠及流感快篩皆呈陰性。福岡縣醫師會表示初步推測應為人類間質肺炎病毒(hMPV)等常見呼吸道病毒,惟仍待釐清,暫排除新興傳染病之可能性。目前該國呼吸道傳染病監測數據亦顯示通報數未達警戒標準,醫界呼籲民眾毋需過度恐慌。
items.description_en: A so-called 'mysterious cold' has emerged in Fukuoka Prefecture in Kyushu, Japan. After the Golden Week holiday, clinic visits have risen by 20–30% compared with previous years, and the illness has spread to the Kanto region. Symptoms are mostly severe sore throat, prolonged cough with sputum, and runny nose, but rapid tests for COVID-19 and influenza are negative. The Fukuoka Medical Association said the preliminary assessment is that it is likely a common respiratory virus such as human metapneumovirus (hMPV), though this still needs to be clarified; a novel emerging infectious disease has been tentatively ruled out. Surveillance data for Japan's respiratory infectious diseases also show that reports have not reached alert thresholds, and medical bodies urge the public not to panic unnecessarily.

items.summary_zh: 郵輪漢他病毒疫情荷蘭新增1例,累計12例、3死
items.summary_en: WHO reports one new Netherlands case in the MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak, bringing the total to 12 cases and three deaths.
items.description_zh: WHO更新MV Hondus郵輪疫情資訊,荷蘭確認1例新增病例,該名船員先前在特內里費島(Tenerife)下船後被遣返回荷蘭,刻正隔離中。目前總計有12例病例,其中3例死亡,自5月2日WHO首次接獲通報以來,迄未有新增死亡病例,另在30個國家,仍有超過600名接觸者正持續追蹤。
items.description_en: WHO updated information on the MV Hondius cruise ship outbreak. The Netherlands confirmed one new case; this crew member had disembarked at Tenerife earlier, was repatriated to the Netherlands, and is now in isolation. There are currently 12 cases in total, including three deaths. Since WHO first received the report on 2 May, no new deaths have been reported. More than 600 contacts in 30 countries are still being followed up.

items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國截至5/23確診91例、10死,WHO評估風險非常高
items.summary_en: DRC and Uganda together reported 91 confirmed Ebola cases and 10 deaths as of 23 May; WHO rates DRC's risk as very high.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

items.summary_zh: 馬達加斯加累計2,793例M痘、6死;美國康乃狄克州出現首例I分支病例
items.summary_en: Madagascar has 2,793 reported Mpox cases and six deaths, with 54 health zones affected; Connecticut reports the first US clade I case.
items.description_zh: 馬達加斯加第I分支Ib子分支(Ib型)疫情持續升溫,自2025年12月爆發疫情迄今,累計通報2,793例,其中1,606例確診,檢測陽性率達67%,疫情已蔓延至54個衛生區,目前累計6例死亡。當局已啟動及擴大(包括監獄等高風險場所)疫苗接種計畫。 美國康乃狄克州於2026年5月13日公布首例Clade1病例,為具西歐旅遊史之境外移入個案。自2024年11月迄今,全美累計報告逾20例Clade1病例,均與前往疫區旅行或與旅客密切接觸有關,尚無本土社區傳播。當局呼籲高風險者儘速完成兩劑JYNNEOS疫苗接種。
items.description_en: Madagascar's clade I, subclade Ib outbreak continues to escalate. Since the outbreak began in December 2025, 2,793 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 1,606 are confirmed, with a test positivity rate of 67%. The outbreak has spread to 54 health zones, with six deaths cumulatively. Authorities have launched and expanded vaccination, including in high-risk settings such as prisons. Connecticut, United States, announced its first clade I case on 13 May 2026, an imported case with a recent travel history to Western Europe. Since November 2024, more than 20 clade I cases have been reported in total across the United States. All are linked to travel to outbreak areas or close contact with travellers, and there is no local community transmission. Authorities urge high-risk people to complete a two-dose JYNNEOS vaccination course as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 印尼累計23例確定漢他病毒出血熱併腎症候群病例,3例死亡
items.summary_en: Indonesia has confirmed 23 hantavirus HFRS cases since 2024 (three deaths, CFR 13%), all Seoul virus, with cases rising yearly.
items.description_zh: 印2024年截至今年5/20累計報告256例疑病例及23例漢他病毒出血熱併腎症候群(HFRS) 確定病例,其中確定病例有3例死亡(CFR為13%),該國病例病毒基因定序皆為首爾型漢他病毒,疫情呈逐年增加趨勢,分佈於雅加達特區等6個省份。另全球估計有1至10萬例感染病例,以亞洲及歐洲負擔較重。
items.description_en: Indonesia reported 256 suspected cases and 23 confirmed cases of haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) caused by hantavirus from 2024 through 20 May this year. Three of the confirmed cases died (CFR 13%). Viral gene sequencing of the cases identified Seoul hantavirus. The outbreak shows an increasing trend year on year and is distributed across six provinces, including the Special Capital Region of Jakarta. Globally, an estimated 1 to 100,000 infections occur, with a heavier burden in Asia and Europe.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/烏干達/南蘇丹-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda / South Sudan – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國截至5/20近600例疑似病例、139死,南蘇丹通報1例疑似
items.summary_en: DRC and Uganda have nearly 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 deaths as of 20 May; South Sudan reported one suspected case.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情急遽擴大,截至5/20累計報告近600例疑與139死亡病例,南蘇丹亦通報1例疑個案,跨國傳播風險驟升。由於目前DRC面臨武裝衝突、大量人口流離失所,加上檢體運送困難,當局表示可能嚴重低估通報病例數。另烏干達已宣布取消年度大型慶典「殉道者節」。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the DRC and Uganda is expanding rapidly: as of 20 May, nearly 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan has also reported one suspected case, and the risk of cross-border spread has sharply increased. Because the DRC is facing armed conflict and mass displacement, and sample transport is difficult, authorities say case numbers may be seriously underreported. Uganda has also announced the cancellation of its annual major celebration, Martyrs' Day.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:5/7-13期間衣索比亞新增4例cVDPV1,3國10例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 10 new cVDPV2 polio cases in three countries and four cVDPV1 cases in Ethiopia between 7 and 13 May.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/7-13期間,cVDPV1新增衣索比亞4例;cVDPV2新增3國共10例,分別為奈及利亞6例、剛果民主共和國3例及蘇丹1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦9件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 7 and 13 May, cVDPV1 added four cases in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 added 10 cases across three countries: six in Nigeria, three in the DRC and one in Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 added nine specimens in Pakistan.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,衣索比亞,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,蘇丹

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 加拿大曼尼托巴省自2025年11月至4/26累計601例A型肝炎、3死
items.summary_en: Manitoba, Canada, has recorded 601 hepatitis A cases from November 2025 through 26 April, including 133 hospitalisations and three deaths.
items.description_zh: 加拿大曼托巴省(Manitoba)疫情更新,自去(2025)年11月起截至4/26累計報告601例病例,其中133例住院、3例死亡,病患以年輕族群為主,其中,街友與用藥者之感染數上升。當局已發布多次警告,呼籲民眾加強個人衛生與疫苗接種等防疫措施。
items.description_en: Manitoba, Canada: the outbreak update reports 601 cumulative cases from November 2025 through 26 April, including 133 hospitalisations and three deaths. Most patients are young people. Infections among people experiencing homelessness and people who use drugs have risen. Authorities have issued repeated warnings and urge people to strengthen personal hygiene and get vaccinated.

items.headline_zh: 法國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 法國波爾多英籍郵輪諾羅病毒群聚,60名乘客、4名船員出現腸胃症狀
items.summary_en: A British-flagged cruise ship reported in Bordeaux, France, has a norovirus cluster: 60 passengers and four crew with gastrointestinal symptoms.
items.description_zh: 法國波爾多5/13報告1艘英籍郵輪群聚事件,截至5/16累計報告60名乘客及4名工作人員出現腸胃症狀,超過1,700名乘客/船員被命令留在船上,經當局檢測確認為諾羅病毒感染後,始同意無症狀者下船。另先前有1名人員死亡,惟無腹瀉相關症狀,死因仍未確定。
items.description_en: On 13 May, Bordeaux, France, reported a cluster on a British-flagged cruise ship. As of 16 May, 60 passengers and four crew members had cumulatively reported gastrointestinal symptoms. More than 1,700 passengers and crew were ordered to remain on board. Only after authorities confirmed norovirus infection through testing did they agree to let asymptomatic people disembark. One crew member had previously died without diarrhoea-related symptoms, and the cause of death has not yet been determined.

items.headline_zh: 韓國-細菌性腸胃炎(沙門氏菌/曲狀桿菌)
items.summary_zh: 韓國第19週細菌性腸胃炎225例,較第15週增48%,沙門氏菌與曲狀桿菌上升
items.summary_en: South Korea reported 225 bacterial gastroenteritis cases in week 19, up 48% from week 15, with Salmonella and Campylobacter detections rising.
items.description_zh: 韓國第19週(5/3-9)報告225例細菌性腸胃炎病例,較第15週152例增加48%,其中沙門氏菌與曲狀桿菌檢出數皆上升,當局呼籲應加強飲食衛生,並避免食物於製備過程交叉感染。
items.description_en: In week 19 (3–9 May), South Korea reported 225 cases of bacterial gastroenteritis, a 48% increase from 152 cases in week 15. Detections of both Salmonella and Campylobacter have risen. Authorities urge strengthened food hygiene and avoidance of cross-contamination during food preparation.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊圖里省BVD疫情截至5/19死亡136例、疑似逾543例
items.summary_en: DRC's Ituri Bundibugyo virus outbreak has 136 deaths and over 543 suspected cases as of 19 May; UK modelling suggests 1–2 times more cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省(Ituri)爆發邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(Bundibugyo virus disease, BVD)疫情(資料更新),截至5/19死亡數累計達136例,疑病例逾543例。英國專家以模型推估本次疫情規模可能是現有病例數的1-2倍。
items.description_en: A Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak has occurred in Ituri Province, DRC (data updated). As of 19 May, cumulative deaths reached 136, with more than 543 suspected cases. UK experts using modelling estimate that the true size of this outbreak could be one to two times the number of existing cases.

items.summary_zh: 智利今年截至5/9累計41例漢他病毒、14死,致死率34%高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Chile has reported 41 hantavirus cases and 14 deaths this year as of 9 May, a 34% CFR, higher than 18% for the same period in 2025.
items.description_zh: 智利今年截至5/9累計報告41例病例及14例死亡,致死率為34%,高於2025年同期致死率18%(44例病例及8例死亡),以艾森大區之發生率為高,病毒型別為安第斯病毒。病例以男性為多(78%),年齡中位數為31歲,主要危險因子包含居住在鄉村地區、戶外活動或健行、農業或林業工作等。
items.description_en: Chile has reported 41 cases and 14 deaths cumulatively this year as of 9 May, a CFR of 34%, higher than the 18% for the same period in 2025 (44 cases and 8 deaths). Incidence is highest in the Aysén Region, and the virus type is Andes virus. Men account for most cases (78%), with a median age of 31 years. Main risk factors include living in rural areas, outdoor activities or hiking, and agricultural or forestry work.

items.summary_zh: 秘魯普諾大區231例確診,宣布衛生緊急;美國今年累計1,893例
items.summary_en: Peru has declared a health emergency over its Puno Region measles outbreak (231 confirmed cases); the US has reported 1,893 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 秘魯普諾大區今年截至5/14報告231例確診及115例疑病例,近期疫情大幅增加且為近年來規模最大的疫情之一,該國宣布疫情為衛生緊急事件,涵蓋大都會利馬、卡亞俄憲法省及另外12個省份。另美洲地區2025年報告14,891例確診病例,高於2024年的466例。 美國疫情持續,今年迄今累計報告1,893例病例,76%為19歲以下兒童及青年,92%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明者,6%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州及猶他州為多,該國去年共計2,288例病例。
items.description_en: In the Puno Region of Peru, 231 confirmed cases and 115 suspected cases had been reported as of 14 May this year. Recent cases have increased sharply, and this is one of the largest outbreaks in recent years. The country has declared the outbreak a public health emergency, covering the Lima Metropolitan Area, the Constitutional Province of Callao and 12 other provinces. In addition, the Americas reported 14,891 confirmed measles cases in 2025, up from 466 in 2024. In the United States, the outbreak continues: 1,893 cases have been reported so far this year, 76% of them aged 19 or under, 92% unvaccinated or with unknown vaccination history, and 6% hospitalised. Cases are most numerous in South Carolina and Utah. The country reported 2,288 cases last year.

items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊圖里省BVD疫情死亡累計131例,北基伍省首例確診
items.summary_en: DRC's Ituri Province Bundibugyo outbreak has 131 cumulative deaths and 33 confirmed cases; North Kivu reported its first confirmed case on 18 May.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省(Ituri)爆發邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(Bundibugyo virus disease, BVD)疫情(資料更新),當地於24小時內新增26例疑死亡病例,死亡數累計達131例,另已通報516例疑病例及33例確診病例。該國北基伍省布滕博市於5/18通報首例確診病例。
items.description_en: A Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak has occurred in Ituri Province, DRC (data updated). Within 24 hours, 26 new suspected deaths were recorded, bringing cumulative deaths to 131. A total of 516 suspected cases and 33 confirmed cases have been reported. In North Kivu Province, Butembo city reported its first confirmed case on 18 May.

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年截至第19週逾1.6萬例登革熱,斯里蘭卡累計27,754例
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has over 16,000 dengue cases this year through week 19, up over 70% from last year; Sri Lanka has 27,754 cases.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,今年截至第19週累計報告逾16,000例病例,較去年同期上升70%以上。 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年截至5/11累計報告27,754例病例及14例死亡,病例數高於去年同期,以西部省病例數最多。
items.description_en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: the outbreak is rising, with more than 16,000 cases reported cumulatively this year as of week 19, up more than 70% from the same period last year. Sri Lanka: the outbreak is rising, with 27,754 cases and 14 deaths reported cumulatively this year as of 11 May. Case numbers are higher than in the same period last year, and the Western Province has the most cases.

items.summary_zh: 馬約特島近1週32例瘧疾為今年單週最高,17例疑為本土
items.summary_en: Mayotte reported 32 malaria cases in the week to 3 May, the highest weekly figure this year; 17 are suspected to be local.
items.description_zh: 法屬馬約特島近1週(4/27-5/3)報告32例病例,為今年單週最高病例數,主要分布於南部希龍吉(20例),其中17例疑為本土病例,該島已多年無本土病例。今年截至5/12當地累計報告156例確診病例,惡性瘧原蟲為主要瘧原蟲。
items.description_en: In the most recent week (27 April–3 May), Mayotte reported 32 cases, the highest weekly number this year, mainly in the southern Chirongui area (20 cases). Of these, 17 cases are suspected to be locally acquired; the island had no local cases for many years. As of 12 May this year, 156 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, with Plasmodium falciparum the main species.

items.headline_zh: 模里西斯共和國-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 模里西斯截至3/30累計735例屈公病確診,美國CDC旅遊警示升至第2級
items.summary_en: Mauritius has reported 735 confirmed Chikungunya cases as of 30 March, and the US CDC raised its travel alert to Level 2.
items.description_zh: 模里西斯共和國疫情更新,截至3/30累計報告735例確診病例,主要分布於羅斯希爾等城鎮地區及Baie-du-Tombeau等北部地區,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。
items.description_en: Mauritius outbreak update: as of 30 March, 735 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in towns such as Rose Hill and northern areas such as Baie-du-Tombeau. The US CDC recently raised its travel alert for Mauritius to Level 2.

items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國伊圖里省BVD疫情,至少6名美國公民為高風險接觸者
items.summary_en: In DRC's Ituri Province Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak, at least six US citizens are high-risk contacts, one symptomatic; US authorities are assisting.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省(Ituri)爆發邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(Bundibugyo virus disease, BVD)疫情(資料更新),據報導至少6名美國公民為高風險接觸者,其中1人有症狀,美國當局已介入協助。
items.description_en: A Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak has occurred in Ituri Province, DRC (data updated). Reports indicate that at least six US citizens are high-risk contacts, one of whom has symptoms, and US authorities have become involved to provide assistance.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 加拿大卑詩省1名郵輪乘客確診安地斯病毒,10名高風險接觸者觀察中
items.summary_en: Canada confirmed Andes virus infection in an MV Hondius cruise passenger in British Columbia; ten high-risk contacts are under quarantine observation.
items.description_zh: 加拿大於5/17公布,1名正在卑詩省接受檢疫的國際郵輪「洪迪亞斯號」乘客,確診感染安地斯型病毒,其於3天前出現發熱、頭痛等輕微症狀,隨後被送醫院,檢測結果呈陽性,正接受隔離治療,尚未發現其他病例。該國所有高風險接觸者(10名)均已安排檢疫觀察,另有26名曾與確診病例搭乘同一航班者亦被要求進行健康監測。
items.description_en: Canada announced on 17 May that a passenger on the international cruise ship MV Hondius, who was undergoing quarantine in British Columbia, had tested positive for Andes virus infection. The passenger had developed mild symptoms such as fever and headache three days earlier, was then taken to hospital, and tested positive. The patient is receiving isolation treatment, and no other cases have been found. All 10 high-risk contacts in the country have been placed under quarantine observation, and 26 people who had been on the same flight as the confirmed case have also been asked to undergo health monitoring.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: WHO宣布剛果民主共和國與烏干達BVD疫情為國際關注公共衛生緊急事件
items.summary_en: WHO declared Bundibugyo virus disease outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda a PHEIC on 17 May, but not a pandemic emergency.
items.description_zh: WHO於5/17宣布剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達發生由Bundibugyo病毒(BVD)感染引起之疫情為「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件」(PHEIC),惟尚未達「全球大流行緊急事件」(pandemic emergency)。DRC伊圖里省於5/5報告出現一種高致死率的不明原因疾病,5/15證實為Bundibugyo病毒造成此次疫情發生。首例已知病例為4/25出現症狀之醫護人員。伊圖里省截至5/16累計報告246例疑病例及80例死亡病例(疑),其中8例確診,已對接觸者進行追蹤調查。病例年齡介於20至39歲間,女性佔60%以上,主要分別於姆萬帕拉衛生區及蒙布瓦盧衛生區。 烏干達於5/15向WHO報告1例境外移入確診病例,為59歲DRC男性居民,5/11前往烏干達並於坎帕拉住院治療,5/14在加護病房中因出血症狀死亡,5/15證實為Bundibugyo病毒感染。該國坎帕拉於5/15-16累計報告2例確診病例(其中1例死亡),目前2者間無明確流行病學關聯,迄無證據顯示烏干達境內發生本土傳播。 本次疫情為DRC自1976年以來發生的第17次疫情,前一次疫情發生於2025年9/4-12/1,累計報告64例病例(53例確診)及45例死亡,前一次由Bundibugyo病毒造成之疫情發生於2012年8/17-11/26,累計報告59例病例(38例確診)及34例死亡。WHO評估本次疫情存在臨床警覺性低、多種病原共存、院內感染、地緣政治、追蹤困難及疫情已跨國傳播等複雜因素,並研判目前疫情主要集中於非洲特定地區,雖已有跨國個案,惟不建議實施旅遊或貿易限制,評估於國家及區域層級之公共衛生風險為高,於全球之風險則為低。
items.description_en: On 17 May, WHO declared the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), but not a pandemic emergency. Ituri Province in the DRC reported an unexplained high-fatality illness on 5 May; on 15 May it was confirmed to be caused by Bundibugyo virus. The first known case was a health-care worker with symptom onset on 25 April. As of 16 May, Ituri had reported 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths, of which eight were confirmed, and contacts are being followed up. Cases were aged 20–39, with women making up more than 60%, and were mainly in Mwampala and Mongbwalu health zones. On 15 May, Uganda reported to WHO one imported confirmed case: a 59-year-old DRC male resident who travelled to Uganda on 11 May and was hospitalised in Kampala. He died of haemorrhagic symptoms in intensive care on 14 May, and BDBV infection was confirmed on 15 May. Kampala reported two confirmed cases cumulatively on 15–16 May, one of them fatal. There is no clear epidemiological link between the two, and there is no evidence of local transmission in Uganda. This is the 17th DRC outbreak since 1976. The previous outbreak ran from 4 September to 1 December 2025, with 64 cases (53 confirmed) and 45 deaths. The previous outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus ran from 17 August to 26 November 2012, with 59 cases (38 confirmed) and 34 deaths. WHO notes complex factors, including low clinical awareness, multiple pathogens circulating together, nosocomial infection, geopolitical issues, difficulties in contact tracing and cross-border spread. It assesses that the outbreak is currently concentrated in specific areas of Africa and, although there are cross-border cases, does not recommend travel or trade restrictions. WHO assesses the public health risk as high at national and regional levels and low globally.
