items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年23例人類新型A型流感,印度新增1例H5N1、中國新增1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Globally 23 human novel influenza A cases this year, including new H5N1 and H9N2 cases in India and China.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:印度新增1例H5N1病例、中國新增1例H9N2病例。全球今年累計報告23例,分別為13例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3、1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,397起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共9國於2026/5/8-15期間報告25起H5N1疫情,波蘭13起、智利4起、加拿大2起、巴西/日本/比利時/法國/美國/阿根廷各1起。 共2國於2026/5/14-15期間報告5起H5 (N untyped)疫情,秘魯3起、美國2起。    美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,106起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州;該國廢水監測於2026/5/3-9共422個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡州共6個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Update. Human cases: India reported one new H5N1 case and China one new H9N2 case. Globally, 23 cases have been reported this year: 13 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,397 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Nine countries reported 25 H5N1 outbreaks between 8 and 15 May 2026: Poland 13, Chile 4, Canada 2, and Brazil, Japan, Belgium, France, the United States and Argentina one each. Two countries reported five H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 14 and 15 May 2026: Peru three and the United States two. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,106 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated mainly in Idaho. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 422 sampling sites during 3–9 May 2026, of which six sites in New Jersey, Illinois and Oregon detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第16週陽性率升至1.16%,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(占30.92%)
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 1.16% in week 16, with NB.1.8.1 the leading variant at 30.92%; WHO rates global risk as moderate.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:   今年第16週(4/20-26)全球陽性率略升為1.16%,其中西太平洋、東地中海、非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情於低點持平,第19週(5/4-10)門急診陽性率為1.4%,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為主。 韓國疫情於低點波動,第19週陽性率上升至3.6%,住院病例數增加與上週相同(40例),第19週變異株占比以BA.3.2(占73.7%)為多,其次為NB.1.8.1(占15.8%)。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(占30.92%)、其次為BA.3.2(占23.69%)及XFG(占22.89%)。WHO公布之COVID-19全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有6%有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Update: In week 16 (20–26 April), the global positivity rate rose slightly to 1.16%, with a marked increase in positivity in the WHO regional offices for the Western Pacific, the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. China: the outbreak is flat at a low point, with the outpatient and emergency positivity rate at 1.4% in week 19 (4–10 May), and NB.1.8.1 predominates among variants. South Korea: the outbreak fluctuates at a low point; positivity rose to 3.6% in week 19, hospitalised cases rose by 40, the same as last week, and in week 19 BA.3.2 (73.7%) was the main variant, followed by NB.1.8.1 (15.8%). Assessment and recommendations: recently circulating variants are mainly NB.1.8.1 (30.92%), followed by BA.3.2 (23.69%) and XFG (22.89%). WHO's COVID-19 Global Long-term Rapid Risk Assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalisations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subvariants; although they can escape immunity, they do not appear to increase disease severity, although 6% of symptomatic cases have long COVID symptoms. No stable seasonal pattern has yet formed, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel clinic surveillance have become important supplementary tools. WHO notes that vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritising protection of high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its COVID-19 threat management strategic plan, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 斐濟-人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.summary_zh: 斐濟去年愛滋病毒新增逾2,000例,已轉為全面性流行,共用針頭為主因
items.summary_en: Fiji's HIV epidemic has shifted to generalised as cases rose by more than 2,000 last year, driven by needle sharing among people who inject drugs.
items.description_zh: 斐濟過去30年累計確診不到千例,惟去年即遽增逾2,000例,疫情已從低盛行率轉為全面性流行。疫情升溫主因係靜脈注射毒品者共用針頭,同步帶動C肝散播,感染群體亦擴及性工作者及一般異性戀族群。此外,孕婦及兒童感染率攀升,突顯延誤篩檢問題。當局已將全國照護團隊自3個擴增至17個,並呼籲臨床端及早識別,強化早期篩檢與即時治療。
items.description_en: Fiji recorded fewer than 1,000 confirmed cases cumulatively over the past 30 years, but last year alone cases rose by more than 2,000, and the epidemic has shifted from low prevalence to a generalised epidemic. The surge is mainly driven by needle sharing among people who inject drugs, which has also spread hepatitis C. Infection has extended to sex workers and the general heterosexual population. In addition, infection rates among pregnant women and children are rising, highlighting the problem of delayed testing. Authorities have expanded the national care teams from three to 17 and call on clinicians to identify cases early and strengthen early screening and immediate treatment.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至4月底累計754例拉薩熱確診、190死,致死率25.2%
items.summary_en: Nigeria has reported about 754 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 190 deaths as of April, a CFR of 25.2%, above the WHO's 15% benchmark.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至4月底,全國累計報告約754例確診,其中190例死亡(CFR 25.2%),超越去年同期及WHO之15%基準,疫情集中於翁多、埃多及包奇州,佔全國確定病例84%。當局評估致死率異常升高可能與病患延遲就醫、基層病例識別不足、轉診延誤及抗病毒藥物Ribavirin短缺等相關。由於目前尚無核准疫苗,當局呼籲強化醫療量能與藥物供應,以防堵重症風險。
items.description_en: As of the end of April this year, Nigeria had reported about 754 confirmed cases cumulatively nationwide, of which 190 died (CFR 25.2%), exceeding last year's figure for the same period and the WHO benchmark of 15%. The outbreak is concentrated in Ondo, Edo and Bauchi States, which account for 84% of national confirmed cases. Authorities assess that the abnormally high CFR may be related to delayed care-seeking by patients, inadequate case identification at primary level, referral delays and shortages of the antiviral drug ribavirin. As there is currently no approved vaccine, authorities call for strengthened healthcare capacity and drug supply to prevent severe cases.

items.headline_zh: 蒙古-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 蒙古今年累計7例腦膜炎確診、3死,個案均為6個月至10歲幼童
items.summary_en: Mongolia has reported seven confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases, three fatal, as of 6 April, all in children aged 6 months to 10 years.
items.description_zh: 蒙古今年截至4/6累計報告7例確診(含3例死亡),超越近3年病例數,分布於烏蘭巴托、達爾汗烏拉、科布多、烏布蘇等省份,且個案均為6個月至10歲幼童。此外,科布多省於3月曾發生校園群聚(2名個案,其中1名死亡),當局已匡列隔離48名接觸者進行相關防治工作。WHO已介入協助醫療培訓,因致病血清群仍未明且流行期將持續至6月,當局呼籲民眾提高警覺。
items.description_en: As of 6 April this year, Mongolia had reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, including three deaths, exceeding case numbers over the past three years. Cases are distributed across Ulaanbaatar, Darkhan-Uul, Khovd, Uvs and other areas, and all cases were young children aged six months to 10 years. In addition, a school cluster occurred in Khovd Province in March (two cases, one of whom died), and authorities have identified and quarantined 48 contacts. WHO has been involved in supporting medical training. Because the causative serogroup is still unidentified and the epidemic season will continue until June, authorities urge the public to remain alert.

items.summary_zh: WHO:郵輪漢他病毒群聚累計11例、3死;全球風險低
items.summary_en: WHO reports 11 cases and three deaths in an international cruise ship hantavirus cluster; global risk is low, on-board risk moderate.
items.description_zh: WHO於5/13公布國際郵輪漢他病毒安地斯型群聚事件,迄共掌握11例病例(8例確診、2例極可能病例、1例確認中),其中3例死亡。郵輪撤離行動已在西班牙特內里費島(Tenerife)完成,計有120名人員下船,搭乘專機返國,並依照該國家規範進行隔離追蹤。目前郵輪上尚有27人 (25名船員、1名荷蘭醫師/護理師),刻正駛往荷蘭鹿特丹,預計5/17抵達。WHO建議高風險接觸者應自5/10起進行為期42天監測,並在指定機構內觀察、每天測量體溫及檢查症狀(如發燒、疲勞、肌肉酸痛、頭痛、胃腸道及呼吸道症狀)。WHO尊重各國隔離檢疫方式,惟強烈建議下船旅客在監測期間,倘須與其他人接觸,應佩戴高規口罩(如N95或FFP2),另避免在監測期內進行國內/外旅遊。WHO評估此事件對全球公共衛生風險為「低」,船上乘客與船員風險則評估為「中」。
items.description_en: On 13 May, WHO announced an Andes-type hantavirus cluster linked to an international cruise ship. A total of 11 cases have been identified (eight confirmed, two probable and one under investigation), of which three died. Evacuation of the cruise ship was completed at Tenerife, Spain: 120 people disembarked and flew home on charter aircraft, and were placed under isolation follow-up in line with national requirements. There are still 27 people on board (25 crew and one Dutch doctor or nurse), and the ship is heading to Rotterdam, the Netherlands, expected to arrive on 17 May. WHO recommends that high-risk contacts be monitored for 42 days from 10 May, observed at designated facilities, have their temperature measured daily and be checked for symptoms such as fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, and gastrointestinal and respiratory symptoms. WHO respects each country's quarantine approach but strongly recommends that disembarked passengers who must contact others during the monitoring period wear high-grade masks (such as N95 or FFP2) and avoid domestic or international travel during that period. WHO assesses the global public health risk from this event as low, and the risk to passengers and crew on board as moderate.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:4/30-5/6期間巴基斯坦新增2例WPV1,3國新增6例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: GPEI reported new polio cases in Pakistan, Nigeria, Chad and the DRC between 30 April and 6 May.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/30-5/6期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;cVDPV2新增3國共6例,分別為奈及利亞3例、查德2例、剛果民主共和國1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共20件,分別為巴基斯坦14件、阿富汗6件,cVDPV2新增澳大利亞1件(前已掌握)。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 30 April and 6 May, WPV1 added two cases in Pakistan; cVDPV2 added six cases across three countries: three in Nigeria, two in Chad and one in the DRC; and cVDPV3 added two cases in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 20 specimens across two countries: 14 in Pakistan and six in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 added one specimen in Australia, which had already been reported.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,澳大利亞,查德,剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年累計1萬5,104例腸病毒、5死;斯里蘭卡南部近50例疑似
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has reported 15,104 enterovirus cases and five deaths this year; Sri Lanka's Matara district has nearly 50 suspected cases.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續攀升,今年截至5/3累計報告1萬5,104例病例,其中5例死亡,4月新增5,243例,較3月病例數增加1.6倍,且較去(2025)年同期增加1倍。 斯里蘭卡南部馬塔拉區(Matara)德亞亞地區(Deniyaya)截至5/12報告近50例疑病例,其中5例經實驗室確診為腸病毒腦膜炎,病患多為14-15歲的學童,當局已發布停課通知並加強監測等防治措施。
items.description_en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to see rising cases: as of 3 May this year, 15,104 cases had been reported cumulatively, including five deaths. There were 5,243 new cases in April, an increase of 1.6 times over March and of 100% over the same period last year. In Deniyaya, in Matara District of southern Sri Lanka, nearly 50 suspected cases had been reported as of 12 May; five were laboratory-confirmed as enterovirus meningitis. Most patients are schoolchildren aged 14–15. Authorities have issued school suspension notices and strengthened surveillance and other control measures.

items.headline_zh: 美國/丹麥-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 美國5/12通報37例沙門氏菌,疑與某生產商奶粉相關產品有關,產品已要求下架
items.summary_en: The US reported 37 Salmonella cases across 12 states on 12 May; a milk powder product from one manufacturer is suspected as the source.
items.description_zh: 美國及丹麥等9個歐洲國家今年截至5/12累計報告62例病例,病患多為兒童及年輕人,多數需住院治療,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疑為單一食物來源感染,各國當局仍持續調查感染來源。 美國5/12報告37例病例,其中多數需住院治療,病患分布於12個州,經當局調查,疑感染源為某生產商之奶粉相關產品,產品已要求下架。
items.description_en: The United States and nine European countries including Denmark have reported 62 cases this year as of 12 May. Most patients are children and young people, and most required hospitalisation. Genotyping shows Salmonella Stanley ST2045, which is suspected to be infection from a single food source; authorities in each country continue to investigate the source. On 12 May, the United States reported 37 cases, most requiring hospitalisation, distributed across 12 states. An investigation by authorities suspects a milk powder-related product from a certain manufacturer as the source, and the product has been asked to be withdrawn.

items.headline_zh: 美國/巴哈馬-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 美國郵輪諾羅病毒群聚累計160例,佔乘客及工作人員3.6%
items.summary_en: A US cruise ship norovirus cluster has 160 cases as of 11 May, equal to 3.6% of passengers and crew, exceeding the 3% reporting threshold.
items.description_zh: 美國報告1起郵輪群聚事件,截至5/11累計報告160例病例,占全體乘客及工作人員的3.6%,符合侵襲率超過3%需通報的規範,並確認致病原為諾羅病毒。該船4/28自佛羅里達州啟航,預計經過巴哈馬後前往佛羅里達州。另美國近年研究顯示GII.17型病毒的盛行,可能導致多數乘客於欠缺免疫防護下感染病毒。
items.description_en: The United States reported one cruise-ship cluster, with 160 cases cumulatively as of 11 May, equal to 3.6% of all passengers and crew. This meets the reporting criterion of an attack rate above 3%, and norovirus was confirmed as the pathogen. The ship departed from Florida on 28 April and is expected to call at the Bahamas before returning to Florida. Recent US studies show circulation of GII.17 virus, which may lead to most passengers becoming infected without immune protection.

items.summary_zh: 洛杉磯郡報告全球首例經家貓傳人之H5N1禽流感確診病例,獸醫血清呈陽性
items.summary_en: Los Angeles County reports the world's first H5N1 avian flu case transmitted from a domestic cat to a human, a veterinarian with serological evidence.
items.description_zh: 美國加州洛杉磯郡報告全球首例透過家貓傳人之H5N1禽流感確診病例。2024年底當地5戶19隻貓隻因食用含病毒之生乳或生肉染病,並檢測出A(H5N1;2.3.4.4b基因型B3.13)。1名無家禽接觸史之獸醫,在未著防護下接觸染病貓隻,雖暴露後7天PCR檢測陰性且全程無症狀,惟於2025年4月血清檢測出針對A(H5N1)2.3.4.4.b病毒抗體陽性。此案證實貓傳人途徑,當局呼籲獸醫落實防護、避免寵物生食,並嚴防與季節性流感發生基因重組。
items.description_en: Los Angeles County, California, reported the world's first H5N1 avian influenza case confirmed as transmitted from a domestic cat to a human. At the end of 2024, five households with 19 cats locally were infected after eating raw milk or raw meat containing the virus, and A(H5N1; genotype B3.13 of clade 2.3.4.4b) was detected. A veterinarian with no poultry exposure handled infected cats without protection. Although the veterinarian's PCR tests were negative seven days after exposure and he remained asymptomatic throughout, antibodies against A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b virus were detected in serum in April 2025. This case confirms the cat-to-human route of transmission. Authorities urge veterinarians to use protection, avoid feeding pets raw food, and guard strictly against genetic reassortment with seasonal influenza.

items.summary_zh: 漢密爾頓市退伍軍人病群聚累計13例確診,感染源調查中
items.summary_en: Hamilton, Ontario, has 13 confirmed Legionnaires' disease cases in a cluster since 4 May; the common source is still under investigation.
items.description_zh: 加拿大安大略省漢密爾頓市爆發群聚疫情,自今年5/4起,當地已累計報告13例確診病例。疫情集中於該市東部區域,當局正積極調查包含附近冷卻水塔等潛在暴露來源,目前尚未確認共同感染源,並已通知當地醫院提高警覺。當局呼籲50歲以上與免疫力低下等高風險族群提高警覺。
items.description_en: A cluster outbreak has occurred in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, since 4 May this year, with 13 confirmed cases reported cumulatively locally. The outbreak is concentrated in the eastern part of the city. Authorities are actively investigating potential exposure sources, including nearby cooling towers. No common source has yet been confirmed, and local hospitals have been notified to remain alert. Authorities urge high-risk groups, including people aged 50 and over and people with weakened immunity, to be vigilant.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉爆發20年來最嚴重麻疹,今年累計逾5萬例疑病例、350死
items.summary_en: Bangladesh's worst measles outbreak in 20 years has over 50,000 suspected cases and 350 deaths; Canada lost measles elimination status.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉爆發20年來最嚴重疫情,今年截至5/11止,全國累計報告逾5萬例疑病例(350例死亡)及6,937例確診病例(65例死亡),累計近3.6萬例住院。疫情遍及全國,以達卡專區最為嚴峻。疫情爆發主因係常規疫苗覆蓋率長期低於95%,且兒童營養不良加劇重症風險。當局自4月起推動全國緊急疫苗接種,惟每日仍有逾千例新增報告,社區傳播風險持續。 加拿大今年截至4月底已累計逾900例確診,以中部曼托巴省為多,該省報告622例(549例確診;佔全國61%),其中46例住院(含4例重症),半數為10歲以下兒童,暫無死亡病例。該國過往每年平均僅報告約91例,惟2025年病例數激增至5,425例,致於當年底被撤銷「消除麻疹國家認證」。目前流行株與去年同為D8基因型,顯示社區傳播持續,疫情風險仍高。
items.description_en: Bangladesh is experiencing its most severe measles outbreak in 20 years. As of 11 May this year, more than 50,000 suspected cases (350 deaths) and 6,937 confirmed cases (65 deaths) had been reported nationwide, with nearly 36,000 hospitalisations cumulatively. The outbreak has spread across the country and is most severe in the Dhaka division. The outbreak was driven mainly by routine vaccination coverage remaining below 95% for a long time, and child malnutrition has increased the risk of severe disease. Since April, authorities have launched nationwide emergency vaccination, but more than 1,000 new cases are still reported each day, and community transmission risk continues. Canada reported more than 900 confirmed cases this year as of the end of April, mainly in the central province of Manitoba. Manitoba reported 622 cases (549 confirmed; 61% of the national total), of which 46 were hospitalised, including four severe cases. Half are children aged 10 and under, and there have been no deaths so far. Canada previously reported an average of about 91 cases a year, but cases surged to 5,425 in 2025, and the country lost its measles elimination status at the end of that year. The circulating strain is genotype D8, the same as last year, indicating continued community transmission and ongoing high risk.

items.headline_zh: 印尼/法國/德國-茲卡病毒感染症
items.headline_en: Indonesia / France / Germany – Zika virus infection
items.summary_zh: 印尼疫情升溫,法國2025下半年至今年3月累計11例境外移入茲卡確診
items.summary_en: Zika transmission is rising in Indonesia; France has reported 11 imported cases, most with Bali travel, since the second half of 2025.
items.description_zh: 印近期疫情升溫,多國報告旅遊相關病例。法國自2025下半年至今年3月累計報告11例境外移入確診病例(多具峇里島旅遊史),德國今年亦報告2例確診病例。當局呼籲赴該區旅客落實防蚊,孕婦與計畫受孕者須特別提高警覺。
items.description_en: Transmission has recently risen in Indonesia, and several countries have reported travel-related cases. France reported 11 imported confirmed cases cumulatively from the second half of 2025 to March this year, most with a history of travel to Bali. Germany has reported two confirmed cases this year. Authorities urge travellers to the area to protect themselves against mosquitoes, and pregnant women and those planning pregnancy should take particular care.

items.summary_zh: 薩摩亞近1週159例登革熱,累計5,386例確診;東加累計56例確診
items.summary_en: Samoa reported 159 dengue cases in the week to 26 April, with 5,386 confirmed cases since 2025; Tonga has 56 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 薩摩亞疫情持續,近1週(4/20-26)報告159例病例,其中27例確診,自2025年1月迄今累計18,559例臨床診斷病例及5,386例確診病例。主要流行型別為DENV-1(57%)及DENV-2(43%),15歲以下兒童為主要受影響族群。 東加自今年4/17宣布疫情爆發迄今累計報告56例確診病例,自5/4以來新增3例病例,病例主要分布於湯加塔布島,主要流行型別為DENV-2,11-14歲男性為主要受影響族群。
items.description_en: Samoa's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (20–26 April), 159 cases were reported, of which 27 were confirmed. Since January 2025, 18,559 clinically diagnosed cases and 5,386 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The main circulating serotypes are DENV-1 (57%) and DENV-2 (43%), and children under 15 are the main affected group. Tonga declared an outbreak on 17 April this year. Cumulatively, 56 confirmed cases have been reported, with three new cases since 4 May, mainly on Tongatapu Island. The main serotype is DENV-2, and males aged 11–14 are the main affected group.

items.summary_zh: 法國去年監測期間62例西尼羅熱感染、5死,普羅旺斯大區最嚴重
items.summary_en: France recorded 62 West Nile human infections in its 2025 surveillance season, five fatal, with Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur most affected.
items.description_zh: 法國於去(2025)年加強監測期間(5/1-11/30)在6個大區的17個省份發現62例人類感染病例,其中20例(32%)為神經侵襲性疾病,5例(8%)死亡,受影響最嚴重地區為普羅旺斯-阿爾卑斯-藍色海岸大區(30例)。該國自2017年以來,每年都有人類或馬匹感染病例被確診,證實病毒在該國境內持續傳播。
items.description_en: During the enhanced surveillance period from 1 May to 30 November last year, France detected 62 human infection cases across 17 departments in six regions. Of these, 20 (32%) were neuroinvasive disease and five (8%) died. The most affected region was Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, with 30 cases. Since 2017, France has confirmed human or equine infection cases every year, showing that the virus continues to circulate within the country.

items.summary_zh: 印尼2025年瘧疾70.6萬例為近年最高,主要集中東部,尤以巴布亞省為主
items.summary_en: Indonesia reported 706,000 malaria cases in 2025, the highest in recent years, concentrated in eastern regions such as Papua Province.
items.description_zh: 印2025年報告706,000例病例,為該國近年來最高,主要分布於東部地區,尤其巴布亞省,人口流動造成疾病由流行地區傳播至其他地區,如2024年廖内省部分地區再度發生疫情,導致2026年初當地多次宣布進入疫情緊急狀態,此外,氣候變遷及資金缺乏亦為影響疫情上升的因素。該國於2023及2024年分別報告418,000及543,000例病例。
items.description_en: Indonesia reported 706,000 malaria cases in 2025, the highest in recent years, mainly in eastern regions, especially Papua Province. Population movement has spread the disease from endemic areas to other regions; for example, parts of Riau Province experienced an outbreak again in 2024, and local authorities declared outbreak emergency status several times in early 2026. Climate change and funding shortages are also factors in the rising trend. The country reported 418,000 cases in 2023 and 543,000 in 2024.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年20例人類新型A型流感,孟加拉新增1例H5N1,中國1例H5N6
items.summary_en: Globally 20 human novel influenza A cases this year, including a new H5N1 case in Bangladesh and an H5N6 case in China.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:孟加拉新增 1 例 H5N1 病例、中國新增 1 例 H5N6 病例。全球今年累計報告 20 例,分別為 6 例 H5N1、1 例 H5N6、12 例 H9N2 及 1 例 H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計 56 國家/地區報告 3,367 起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共 12 國於 2026/4/30-5/8 期間報告 43 起 H5N1 疫情,波蘭13 起、美國 7 起、英國 6 起、丹麥/挪威各 3 起、冰島/奧地利/捷克/蒙特內哥羅各 2 起、墨西哥/比利時/瑞典各 1 起。 墨西哥於 2026/5/1 報告 3 起 H7N3 疫情。 秘魯於 2026/5/5 報告 16 起 H5(N untyped)疫情。 冰島於 2026/5/6 報告 2 起 H5N5 疫情。   美國乳牛感染禽流感自 2024 年 3 月迄今累計 20 州報告 1,093 起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/26-5/2 共 465 個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡/印第安納州共 8 個採檢點檢出 H5 陽性。
items.description_en: Update. Human cases: Bangladesh reported one new H5N1 case and China one new H5N6 case. Globally, 20 cases have been reported this year: six H5N1, one H5N6, 12 H9N2 and one H10N3. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,367 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Twelve countries reported 43 H5N1 outbreaks between 30 April and 8 May 2026: Poland 13, the United States 7, the United Kingdom 6, Denmark and Norway three each, Iceland, Austria, Czechia and Montenegro two each, and Mexico, Belgium and Sweden one each. Mexico reported three H7N3 outbreaks on 1 May 2026. Peru reported 16 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 5 May 2026. Iceland reported two H5N5 outbreaks on 6 May 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 465 sampling sites during 26 April–2 May 2026, of which eight sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Oregon and Indiana detected H5-positive results.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,中國大陸(不含港澳)

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第15週陽性率1.11%,JN.1、NB.1.8.1、XFG同占26.15%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 1.11% in week 15; JN.1, NB.1.8.1 and XFG each account for 26.15% of circulating variants.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 15 週(4/13-19)全球陽性率略降為 1.11%,其中西太平洋、東南亞、東地中海署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情於低點略增,第 18 週(4/27-5/3)門急診陽性率略升至1.5%,變異株以 NB.1.8.1 占大宗。 韓國疫情略降,第 18 週增加 40 例住院病例,疫情已連續 2 週下降,陽性率 2.8%,近期變異株占比以 NB.1.8.1 及 PQ.2 (均為34.6%)為主,其次為 BA.3.2(占 23.1%)。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株 JN.1、NB.1.8.1、XFG 占比相當(皆為 26.15%),其次為 BA.3.2(占 20%)。WHO 公布 COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有 6%有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Update: In week 15 (13–19 April), the global positivity rate fell slightly to 1.11%, with a marked increase in positivity in the WHO regional offices for the Western Pacific, South-East Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean. In China, the outbreak rose slightly from a low point, and outpatient and emergency positivity rose slightly to 1.5% in week 18 (27 April–3 May), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for most variants. In South Korea, the outbreak has declined slightly: hospitalised cases rose by 40 in week 18, and the outbreak has fallen for two consecutive weeks. Positivity was 2.8%, and recent variant shares were led by NB.1.8.1 and PQ.2 (each 34.6%), followed by BA.3.2 (23.1%). Assessment and recommendations: recently circulating variants JN.1, NB.1.8.1 and XFG account for similar shares (each 26.15%), followed by BA.3.2 (20%). WHO's COVID-19 Global Long-term Rapid Risk Assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalisations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subvariants; although they can escape immunity, they do not appear to increase disease severity, although 6% of symptomatic cases have long COVID symptoms. No stable seasonal pattern has yet formed, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel clinic surveillance have become important supplementary tools. WHO notes that vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritising protection of high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans under its COVID-19 threat management strategic plan, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.headline_zh: 全球-國際郵輪漢他病毒群聚事件
items.headline_en: Global – Hantavirus cluster on international cruise ship
items.summary_zh: 國際郵輪漢他病毒群聚截至5/8累計8例、3死,確診者皆為安地斯病毒
items.summary_en: An international cruise ship hantavirus cluster had eight cases and three deaths as of 8 May; the six confirmed cases are Andes virus.
items.description_zh: WHO公告該事件截至 5 月 8 日,共計通報 8 例病例(6 例確診及 2 例極可能病例),其中 3 例死亡(致死率為 38%)。共有 6 例經實驗室確診為漢他病毒感染,且均鑑定為安地斯病毒(Andes virus, ANDV)。該郵輪已停泊於西班牙加那利群島,並安排人員逐批下船,基於預防原則,WHO 建議高風險接觸者在最後一次暴露後,應進行為期 42 天的主動監測與居家或機構檢疫隔離。WHO 評估此事件對全球公共衛生風險為「低」,並將持續監測流行病學情況及更新風險評估,船上乘客與船員的風險則被評估為「中度」。
items.description_en: WHO reported that as of 8 May, eight cases had been notified for this event (six confirmed and two probable), of which three died (CFR 38%). Six cases were laboratory-confirmed as hantavirus infection, all identified as Andes virus (ANDV). The cruise ship has docked in the Canary Islands, Spain, and personnel are disembarking in batches. As a precautionary measure, WHO recommends that high-risk contacts undergo 42 days of active monitoring after their last exposure, followed by home or facility quarantine. WHO assesses the global public health risk from this event as low and will continue to monitor the epidemiological situation and update its risk assessment. The risk to passengers and crew on board is assessed as moderate.

items.summary_zh: 日本今年截至4/30累計436例麻疹,東京都211例,已超過去年同期96例
items.summary_en: Japan has reported 436 measles cases as of 30 April, above 96 in the same period last year; Tokyo accounts for 211.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情升溫,今年截至 4/30 累計報告 436 例,已超越去年同期(96 例)。疫情以東京都(211 例)最為嚴重,佔全國病例數 48%,其次為神奈川縣(40 例)、鹿兒島縣(34 例)。該國表示此波疫情係境外移入個案所致,並與疫苗接種率下降有關,病例以青少年及年輕成人為主,呼籲民眾應完成兩劑疫苗接種,且出國前應確認疫苗接種狀態。本署已將該國旅遊疫情建議等級提升為「第一級:注意」。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is rising: as of 30 April this year, 436 cases had been reported cumulatively, already above the same period last year (96 cases). Tokyo Metropolis is the most severely affected, with 211 cases, accounting for 48% of national cases, followed by Kanagawa Prefecture (40 cases) and Kagoshima Prefecture (34 cases). The country attributes this wave to imported cases and links it to declining vaccination coverage. Cases are mainly among adolescents and young adults. The public is urged to complete two doses of vaccine and to confirm vaccination status before travelling abroad. The Taiwan CDC has raised Japan's travel epidemic advisory level to Level 1: Watch.

items.summary_zh: 印度馬德亞州野生象疑似炭疽病死亡,迄今無人類病例
items.summary_en: Madhya Pradesh, India, reported a suspected anthrax death in a wild elephant on 29 April; no human cases have been reported.
items.description_zh: 印度中部馬德亞州報告1件野生象疑炭疽病死亡案例,4/29班達迦老虎保護區1隻4歲半雌象因嚴重出血性腹瀉死亡,臨床症狀顯示炭疽桿菌感染。當局已依規焚毀大象屍體並消毒,同時針對風險人員實施疫苗接種及安全監測,避免人畜共通傳染風險,迄無人類病例。
items.description_en: Madhya Pradesh State in central India has reported one suspected anthrax death in a wild elephant. On 29 April, a four-and-a-half-year-old female elephant died of severe haemorrhagic diarrhoea in the Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve, and clinical signs indicated infection with Bacillus anthracis. Authorities have burned the carcass in accordance with regulations and disinfected the area. Vaccination and safety monitoring are being provided to at-risk personnel to prevent zoonotic transmission. No human cases have been reported.

items.summary_zh: 美國紐澤西州海狸咬傷多名遊客,確診狂犬病;德州蝙蝠亦確診
items.summary_en: A New Jersey beaver that bit several people on 3 May was confirmed rabid on 5 May; exposed people are receiving post-exposure vaccination.
items.description_zh: 美國紐澤西州馬瓦市於5/3發生罕見攻擊事件,1隻海狸自水中衝出後,於湖畔咬傷多名遊客,該海狸於5/5確診狂犬病。目前接觸個案皆已進行暴露後預防接種。此外,德州艾爾帕索郡亦於5月初檢出1件蝙蝠確診案例。該國每年報告近4,000件動物案例,逾90%發生於野生動物(蝙蝠、浣熊、臭鼬及狐狸等),當局呼籲民眾避免接觸野生動物,若遭抓咬傷應盡速就醫。
items.description_en: In Mahwah, New Jersey, a rare attack occurred on 3 May when a beaver ran out of the water and bit several people along the lakeshore; the beaver was confirmed rabid on 5 May. All exposed people have received post-exposure vaccination. In addition, El Paso County, Texas, detected one rabid bat in early May. The United States reports nearly 4,000 animal rabies cases each year, more than 90% in wildlife (bats, raccoons, skunks and foxes, among others). Authorities urge people to avoid contact with wildlife and to seek medical care promptly if bitten or scratched.

items.summary_zh: 馬達加斯加截至5/4累計2,462例M痘(1,335例確診)、4死,54區有傳播
items.summary_en: Madagascar has reported 2,462 Mpox cases (1,335 confirmed) and four deaths as of 4 May, with community spread in 54 of 119 districts.
items.description_zh: 馬達加斯加自2025年底起爆發疫情,截至今年5/4累計通報 2,462例(確診1,335例)。疫情已擴及全國近半行政區(54/119),社區傳播嚴峻。目前累計4人死亡,其中博愛大區(Boeny)1名僅出生11天男嬰於5/3病逝。為控制疫情,該國已於3月啟動疫苗接種計畫,優先為第一線醫護人員及接觸者施打,再逐步擴及一般民眾。
items.description_en: Mpox in Madagascar has been spreading since late 2025. As of 4 May this year, 2,462 cases (1,335 confirmed) had been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to nearly half of the country's administrative districts (54 of 119), with serious community transmission. Four deaths have been reported cumulatively; in Boeny Region, a baby boy aged only 11 days died on 3 May. To control the outbreak, the country launched a vaccination programme in March, prioritising frontline health workers and contacts, and gradually extending it to the general public.

items.summary_zh: 郵輪漢他病毒群聚截至5/6累計8例、3死,WHO評估船上風險中等
items.summary_en: The Hondius cruise hantavirus cluster reached eight cases and three deaths by 6 May; WHO rates on-board risk as moderate and global risk as low.
items.description_zh: 荷蘭籍國際郵輪「洪迪亞斯號」發生漢他病毒安地斯型群聚事件,船上共 147 人(86 名乘客及 61 名船員),含括 23 國國籍。截至 5/6 止,WHO 共掌握 8 例郵輪相關病例,其中 3 例死亡,8 例中有 3 例經確認為漢他病毒感染,且其中 2 例基因定序為安地斯病毒。WHO 研判本次群聚發生最可能情境為,指標病例於南美洲南錐體地區(阿根廷、智利等國)旅遊期間經環境暴露感染,於潛伏期內登船,隨後在船上透過與其長時間及密切接觸等,造成人際間傳播。WHO 綜合目前資訊,研判本事件在郵輪整體公共衛生風險為中、全球為低。ECDC 建議將全船人員視為密切接觸者,下船後須進行 6 週隔離與症狀監測。
items.description_en: A Dutch-flagged international cruise ship, the Hondius, has experienced an Andes-type hantavirus cluster. There were 147 people on board (86 passengers and 61 crew) of 23 nationalities. As of 6 May, WHO had identified eight cruise-related cases, three of them fatal. Of the eight cases, three were confirmed as hantavirus infection, and two of these were genome-sequenced as Andes virus. WHO considers the most likely scenario to be that the index case was infected through environmental exposure while travelling in the Southern Cone of South America (such as Argentina and Chile), boarded the ship during the incubation period, and then transmitted the virus to others on board through prolonged close contact. Based on current information, WHO assesses the public health risk on the cruise ship as moderate and the global risk as low. ECDC recommends that all people on board be treated as close contacts and undergo six weeks of quarantine and symptom monitoring after disembarkation.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:cVDPV2新增4例;珀斯檢出1件環境樣本,風險評為非常低
items.summary_en: GPEI reported four new cVDPV2 cases across three countries; Perth, Australia, detected one cVDPV2 environmental sample, rated very low risk.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/23-29期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為查德2例、剛果民主共和國/奈及利亞各21例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為馬拉威/奈及利亞各1件。 澳洲西部珀斯(Perth)於4月中旬檢出 1 件cVDPV2環境樣本,基因定序與近年於非洲、歐洲及巴布亞紐幾內亞檢出之病毒相近,因當地疫苗覆蓋率達92%,且無社區傳播跡象,當局評估風險為非常低,推測可能為旅外人員將病毒排泄至汙水系統。另該國最近 1 例人類案例係發生於1972年。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 23 and 29 April, cVDPV2 added four cases across three countries: two in Chad, and 21 each in the DRC and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added six specimens in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added two specimens across two countries, one each in Malawi and Nigeria. In mid-April, one cVDPV2 environmental sample was detected in Perth, Western Australia. Its genetic sequence is similar to viruses detected in recent years in Africa, Europe and Papua New Guinea. Because local vaccination coverage reaches 92% and there are no signs of community transmission, authorities assess the risk as very low and speculate that the virus may have been excreted into the sewage system by someone who travelled abroad. The country's most recent human case occurred in 1972.

items.headline_zh: 法屬玻里尼西亞-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 法屬玻里尼西亞第17週報告22例沙門氏菌感染,多因某場所集體食用生食
items.summary_en: French Polynesia reported 22 Salmonella cases in week 17, 15 confirmed, mostly from communal raw food eaten at one venue.
items.description_zh: 法屬玻里西亞於今年第 17 週(4/20-26)報告 22 例病例,其中 15 例確診,多數病患因於某場所集體食用生食遭受感染。另該國去(2025) 年 11 月亦曾爆發沙門氏菌感染症群聚事件,影響超過 80 人,顯示食物製備人員衛生教育之重要性。
items.description_en: French Polynesia reported 22 cases in week 17 of this year (20–26 April), of which 15 were confirmed. Most patients were infected after eating raw food collectively at one venue. In November last year, the territory also experienced a Salmonella cluster affecting more than 80 people, which shows the importance of hygiene education for food handlers.

items.headline_zh: 敘利亞-急性病毒性 A 型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 敘利亞南部德拉市4/14-27累計109例A型肝炎,多為兒童,疑水源污染
items.summary_en: Daraa, southern Syria, reported 109 laboratory-confirmed hepatitis A cases from 14 to 27 April, mostly children, with suspected water contamination.
items.description_zh: 敘利亞南部德拉市(Daraa)4/14-27 累計報告 109 例病例,皆經實驗室檢驗確診且無重症,病患以兒童為多且有家庭傳播跡象,經調查疑感染源為水源汙染,包含牲畜鄰近住宅井口、廢水灌溉農作物及汙水管線漏水等。
items.description_en: In Daraa in southern Syria, 109 cases were reported cumulatively from 14 to 27 April. All were laboratory-confirmed, and none were severe. Most patients are children, with signs of household transmission. Investigation suspects water source contamination as the source, including livestock located near household wells, wastewater used for crop irrigation and leaks from sewage pipelines.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/阿富汗/莫三比克-霍亂
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Afghanistan / Mozambique – Cholera
items.summary_zh: WHO:截至3/29全球霍亂5萬8,740例、732死,3月較2月降17%
items.summary_en: WHO reports 58,740 cholera cases and 732 deaths globally as of 29 March; March cases fell 17% from February.
items.description_zh: WHO 公布全球今年截至 3/29 累計報告 5 萬 8,740 例病例、732 例死亡,其中,3 月新增病例數較今年 2 月下降 17%,且較去年同期下降 56%,各國 CFR 介於 0-9.7%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 22 個國家/地區,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗及莫三比克為多。WHO 評估約有 10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, as of 29 March this year, 58,740 cases and 732 deaths have been reported cumulatively. New cases in March fell 17% from February this year and 56% from the same period last year. CFR across countries ranges from 0% to 9.7%. Cases are distributed across 22 countries and territories in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia and the Americas. Recent new cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face infection risk, and the global risk of spread is very high.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,莫三比克

items.headline_zh: 捷克 -流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 捷克2025年侵襲性腦膜炎球菌病23例,高於2024年15例,B型占比較高
items.summary_en: Czechia reported 23 invasive meningococcal disease cases in 2025, up from 15 in 2024, with serogroup B accounting for a larger share.
items.description_zh: 捷克 2025 年侵入性腦膜炎球菌疾病(IMD)疫情上升,2025 年報告 23 例病例,高於 2024 年(15 例),血清群分布以 B 型占比較高,且 0-11 個月大年齡族群之發生率亦明顯上升。
items.description_en: Invasive meningococcal disease (IMD) in Czechia increased in 2025, with 23 cases reported in 2025, higher than 15 in 2024. Serogroup B accounted for a higher share, and incidence in infants aged 0–11 months also rose markedly.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉自3/15累計逾4萬例疑似麻疹、近300死,約半數在達卡
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported over 40,000 suspected measles cases and nearly 300 deaths since 15 March, about half of them in Dhaka.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,自今年 3/15 迄今累計 4 萬餘例疑病例(5,313 例確診)及近 300 例死亡,過去 24 小時內即報告 1 千餘例疑病例,約 50%病例發生於達卡。該國 2024-2025 年遭遇疫苗及檢測試劑短缺問題,可能造成疫苗接種率下降,進而爆發疫情。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's outbreak is rising. Since 15 March this year, more than 40,000 suspected cases (5,313 confirmed) and nearly 300 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with more than 1,000 suspected cases reported in the past 24 hours alone. About 50% of cases have occurred in Dhaka. Bangladesh experienced shortages of vaccines and testing reagents in 2024–2025, which may have led to a decline in vaccination coverage and subsequent outbreaks.

items.headline_zh: 荷蘭/阿根廷/維德角-漢他病毒症候群
items.headline_en: Netherlands / Argentina / Cape Verde – Hantavirus syndrome
items.summary_zh: 荷蘭籍郵輪漢他病毒群聚截至5/4累計7例(2確診、5疑似)、3死
items.summary_en: The Dutch-flagged cruise ship hantavirus cluster had two confirmed and five suspected cases and three deaths as of 4 May.
items.description_zh: WHO更新懸掛荷蘭國旗的郵輪群聚事件,截至5/4累計報告2例確診及5例疑病例,其中3例死亡及1例重症。船上共147名人員(含括23個國籍),4/1從阿根廷出發,發病日介於4/6-28,目前郵輪停靠維德角近海,相關單位已展開後送、撤離及監測等措施。WHO表示過往於歐、亞的致死率(CFR)為 1-15%,而於美洲的致死率可達50%,並評估本事件對大眾風險為低。
items.description_en: WHO has updated information on the cruise ship flying the Dutch flag. As of 4 May, two confirmed cases and five suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths and one severe case. There are 147 people on board (of 23 nationalities). The ship departed Argentina on 1 April, and onset dates ranged from 6 to 28 April. The ship is currently anchored off Cape Verde, and relevant authorities have initiated transfers, evacuations and monitoring. WHO states that the CFR historically reported in Europe and Asia is 1–15%, while in the Americas it can reach 50%, and assesses the risk to the public from this event as low.

items.summary_zh: 韓國首例Oz病毒本土感染,80多歲女性2025年11月感染,無旅遊史
items.summary_en: South Korea reports its first local Oz virus infection, in an 80-something woman infected in November 2025 with no travel history.
items.description_zh: 韓國報告首例人類感染 Oz 病毒(Oz virus)本土病例,於 2025 年 11 月 1 名 80 多歲女性遭受感染,主要症狀為發燒、畏寒及肌肉疼痛,無國外旅遊史,該國曾於 2023 年 7 月報告 1 例境外移入病例;Oz 病毒為一種蜱媒病毒,2023 年曾於日本發生多起人類死亡病例。
items.description_en: South Korea has reported its first locally acquired human case of Oz virus infection. A woman in her 80s was infected in November 2025 and presented mainly with fever, chills and muscle pain. She had no overseas travel history. The country previously reported one imported case in July 2023. Oz virus is a tick-borne virus, and several human deaths occurred in Japan in 2023.

items.summary_zh: 密西根州今年截至4月250例萊姆病確診,蜱活躍季較往年更早更嚴重
items.summary_en: Michigan has 250 confirmed Lyme disease cases as of April, and tick season is starting earlier and more intensely than usual.
items.description_zh: 美國密西根州病例數上升,今年截至 4 月累計 250 例確診病例,2025 年報告 3,380 例病例,高於 2024 年及 2022 年病例數(分別為 1,969 及 1,114 例)。該國許多地區於今年春季因蜱蟲叮咬之急診就診率達2017 年以來同期最高,相較往年多數病例發生在 5-8 月間,顯示蜱蟲活躍季比往年更早且更為嚴重,另流行範圍已從東北部和中大西洋地區的高發率區往外擴展。
items.description_en: Case numbers are rising in Michigan, with 250 confirmed cases reported cumulatively as of April this year. The state reported 3,380 cases in 2025, higher than in 2024 and 2022 (1,969 and 1,114 cases respectively). In many parts of the country, emergency department visits for tick bites this spring were the highest for the same period since 2017. Compared with previous years, when most cases occurred between May and August, the tick season is earlier and more severe, and the outbreak range has expanded outward from high-incidence areas in the northeast and mid-Atlantic regions.

items.summary_zh: 全球累計18萬2,945例M痘確診、至少503死,3月新增1,235例
items.summary_en: Globally 182,945 confirmed Mpox cases and at least 503 deaths since 2022; 1,235 new cases in March, 70.4% from Africa.
items.description_zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
items.description_en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球今年累計5例H5N1、12例H9N2及1例H10N3人類感染
items.summary_en: Globally this year, five human H5N1, 12 H9N2 and one H10N3 infections have been reported; Germany reported 361 H5N1 animal outbreaks in March–April.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共15國於2026/3/11-4/30期間報告439起H5N1疫情,德國361起、智利18起、南韓14起、波蘭13起、泊爾7起、法國5起、美國/臺灣各4起、加拿大3起、丹麥/奧地利/挪威/荷蘭各2起、柬埔寨/義大利各1起。 南韓於2026/4/29報告4起H5N9疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,093起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/19-25共425個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/馬里蘭/麻薩諸塞州共11個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第14週陽性率降至1.15%,中國門急診陽性率連續5週下降
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity dipped to 1.15% in week 14, while China's outpatient positivity fell to 1.3% by week 17 after five weeks of decline.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第14週(4/6-12)全球陽性率略降為1.15%,其中東南亞、東地中海、非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情於低點,第17週(4/20-26)門急診陽性率降至1.3%,疫情已連續5週下降,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 韓國疫情略降,第17週增加55例住院病例,較前1週(63例)下降,陽性率降至2.5%,近期變異株占比以NB.1.8.1 及PQ.2 (均為34.6%)為主,其次為BA.3.2(占23.1%)。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株JN.1、NB.1.8.1、XFG占比相當(皆為26.15%),其次為BA.3.2(占20%)。WHO公布之COVID-19全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有6%有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Update: In week 14 (6–12 April), the global positivity rate fell slightly to 1.15%, with a marked increase in positivity in the WHO regional offices for South-East Asia, the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. China's outbreak is at a low point: outpatient and emergency positivity fell to 1.3% in week 17 (20–26 April), and the outbreak has declined for five consecutive weeks, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for most variants. In South Korea the outbreak fell slightly: hospitalised cases rose by 55 in week 17, down from 63 the previous week, and positivity fell to 2.5%. Recent variant shares were NB.1.8.1 and PQ.2 (each 34.6%), followed by BA.3.2 (23.1%). Assessment and recommendations: recently circulating variants JN.1, NB.1.8.1 and XFG account for similar shares (each 26.15%), followed by BA.3.2 (20%). WHO's COVID-19 Global Long-term Rapid Risk Assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalisations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subvariants; although they can escape immunity, they do not appear to increase disease severity, although 6% of symptomatic cases have long COVID symptoms. No stable seasonal pattern has yet formed, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel clinic surveillance have become important supplementary tools. WHO notes that vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritising protection of high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its coronavirus disease threat management strategic plan, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.summary_zh: 越南南部狂犬病升溫,胡志明市今年3死,同塔省1例死於處理狗肉
items.summary_en: Rabies is rising in southern Viet Nam: Ho Chi Minh City has three deaths this year, and a dog-meat vendor died in Dong Thap Province.
items.description_zh: 越南南部狂犬病疫情升溫,胡志明市今年截至4/20止,累計報告3例死亡病例;同塔省亦報告1例死亡,病患為狗肉攤商,未被犬隻抓咬傷,經調查發現可能於處理染病狗肉時,遭血液或分泌物經皮膚傷口感染。當局呼籲職業高風險族群應接受暴露前預防疫苗接種,因全國犬隻疫苗涵蓋率偏低,將持續推動國家狂犬病防治計畫。
items.description_en: Rabies is rising in southern Viet Nam. In Ho Chi Minh City, three deaths had been reported cumulatively this year as of 20 April. Dong Thap Province also reported one death; the patient was a dog-meat vendor who had not been bitten or scratched by a dog. Investigation found that infection may have occurred through skin wounds when the vendor handled infected dog meat and was exposed to blood or secretions. Authorities urge high-risk occupational groups to receive pre-exposure vaccination. Because dog vaccination coverage nationwide is low, the national rabies control programme will continue to be promoted.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:cVDPV2新增3例(蘇丹2例、剛果民主共和國1例)
items.summary_en: GPEI reported three new cVDPV2 polio cases in Sudan and the DRC between 16 and 22 April.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/16-22期間,cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為蘇丹2例、剛果民主共和國1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1 新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2 新增4國共4件,分別為馬拉威/納米比亞/索馬利亞/蘇丹各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 16 and 22 April, cVDPV2 added three cases across two countries: two in Sudan and one in the DRC. For environmental samples, WPV1 added two specimens in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added four specimens across four countries, one each in Malawi, Namibia, Somalia and Sudan.

items.headline_zh: 泰國-急性病毒性 A 型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至4/20累計672例A型肝炎,無死亡,集中東部及曼谷
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 672 hepatitis A cases this year through 20 April, with no deaths, concentrated in the east and Bangkok.
items.description_zh: 泰國於今年迄 4 月 20 日期間,全國累計報告 672 例,目前無死亡病例。疫情集中於東部(春武里府、羅勇府、尖竹汶府)及曼谷,病患以青壯年族群為主。當局正進行流行病學調查、加強水質監測及衛生系統品質,並呼籲民眾落實飲食安全與手部衛生。
items.description_en: From the start of this year through 20 April, Thailand reported 672 cases cumulatively nationwide, with no deaths so far. Cases are concentrated in the eastern provinces (Chon Buri, Rayong and Chanthaburi) and Bangkok, mainly among working-age adults. Authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations, strengthening water quality monitoring and improving health system quality, and urge people to practise food safety and hand hygiene.

items.summary_zh: 美國廣泛抗藥性桿菌性痢疾檢出率由2011年0%升至2023年8.5%
items.summary_en: US detection of extensively drug-resistant shigellosis rose from 0% in 2011 to 8.5% in 2023, with about a third of cases hospitalised.
items.description_zh: 美國近期報告廣泛抗藥性的病例顯著增加,檢出率從 2011 年的 0% 上升至 2023 年的 8.5%,其中約三分之一需住院治療,8 成無國際旅遊史。早期病例多為兒童或前往衛生環境較差地區旅遊的旅客,近年病患多為成年男性,且多有 MSM 經驗,其中半數同時感染 HIV,另街友亦是高風險族群。
items.description_en: The United States has recently reported a significant increase in extensively drug-resistant shigellosis, with the detection rate rising from 0% in 2011 to 8.5% in 2023. About one-third of cases required hospitalisation, and 80% had no international travel history. Early cases were mainly children or travellers to areas with poor sanitation. In recent years, patients have mostly been adult men, many with a history of sex with men (MSM), and half of them were co-infected with HIV. Homeless people are also a high-risk group.

items.summary_zh: 美國2/26-3/31報告34例沙門氏菌,13例住院,約8成曾接觸家禽
items.summary_en: The US reported 34 Salmonella cases from 26 February to 31 March, 13 hospitalised; about 80% had contact with home poultry.
items.description_zh: 美國2/26-3/31報告34例病例,其中13例住院,尚無死亡報告,病患分布於佛羅里達等13個州,以密西根州6例為多,5 歲以下病患占41%,約8成病患有家中家禽(雞、鴨)接觸史,當局評估疑有相關供應鏈販售之雞鴨遭受汙染,此波疫情造成的高住院率需密切監測。另該國每年約有135萬例病例。
items.description_en: The United States reported 34 cases from 26 February to 31 March, of which 13 were hospitalised, with no deaths reported. Cases were distributed across 13 states including Florida, with Michigan the highest at six cases. Children under five made up 41% of patients, and about 80% had contact with domestic poultry (chickens and ducks) at home. Authorities assess that poultry sold through related supply chains may be contaminated, and the high hospitalisation rate in this wave requires close monitoring. The country also has around 1.35 million cases a year.

items.summary_zh: 香港今年截至4/25累計36例退伍軍人病確定病例,4/19-25新增5例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong has 36 confirmed Legionnaires' disease cases this year as of 25 April, five of them reported between 19 and 25 April.
items.description_zh: 香港於今年 4/19-4/25 期間新增 5 例確定病例,其中 4 例為本土病例,病患皆為 50 歲以上,其中 3 例具慢性病史。當局已啟動疫情調查,並提醒民眾應定期保養供水系統,另高風險族群應採取相關預防措施。香港今年截至 4/25 累計報告 36 例確定病例,另於 2024-25 年分別報告 135 及 167 例確定病例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported five new confirmed cases between 19 and 25 April this year, of which four were local. All patients were aged over 50, and three had chronic illnesses. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and reminded the public to maintain water supply systems regularly; high-risk groups should take relevant precautions. Hong Kong has reported 36 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 25 April, and reported 135 and 167 confirmed cases in 2024–25 respectively.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/尼日/布吉納法索-腦脊髓膜炎
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Niger / Burkina Faso – Meningitis
items.summary_zh: WHO非洲區截至第15週累計6,929例疑似腦膜炎、340死,確診以C型為多
items.summary_en: WHO's African Region reports 6,929 suspected meningitis cases and 340 deaths through week 15; among lab-confirmed cases, serogroup C was most common (39.7%).
items.description_zh: WHO非洲區今年截至第 15 週累計報告 6,929 例疑病例,以剛果民主共和國、日、布吉納法索為多,其中 340 例死亡。報告病例中,700例經實驗室檢驗出病原體,其中包含腦膜炎雙球菌C型(39.7%)、肺炎鏈球菌(33.7%)、腦膜炎雙球菌 W 型(15.3%)及 b 型流感嗜血桿菌(5.6%)等。
items.description_en: WHO's African Region has reported 6,929 suspected cases cumulatively through week 15 this year, mainly in the DRC, Niger and Burkina Faso, including 340 deaths. Of the reported cases, 700 were confirmed by laboratory testing to have a pathogen, including Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (39.7%), Streptococcus pneumoniae (33.7%), N. meningitidis serogroup W (15.3%) and Haemophilus influenzae type b (5.6%), among others.
items.area_zh: 布吉納法索,剛果民主共和國,尼日

items.headline_zh: 日本/孟加拉/巴基斯坦/剛果民主共和國-麻疹
items.headline_en: Japan / Bangladesh / Pakistan / Democratic Republic of the Congo – Measles
items.summary_zh: 日本今年362例麻疹超過去年全年265例;孟加拉自3/15累計逾3萬例疑似
items.summary_en: Japan's 362 measles cases this year already exceed last year's full-year total of 265; Bangladesh has over 30,000 suspected cases since 15 March.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,今年截至4/22累計報告362例,高於去(2025) 年全年病例數(265 例),分布以東京都(153 例)、神奈川縣(36 例)、鹿兒島縣(34 例)、千葉縣(24 例)及愛知縣(23 例)為多,其中 33 例為境外移入病例,59%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 孟加拉自今年 3/15 疫情爆發,截至 4/17 累計報告逾 3 萬例疑病例(含 4,460 例確診),其中 251 例病例死亡(含 42 例確診),疫情目前已擴及全國,當局目前亦面臨檢測試劑短缺問題。 巴基斯坦今年截至 3 月累計報告 4,541 例確定病例及 71 例兒童死亡病例,其中以北部開伯爾-普什圖省(1,712 例)、中部旁遮普省(1,198 例)及東南部信德省(1,183 例)為多,此次疫情係因該國於COVID-19 流行期間中斷預防接種作業而產生大量未接種疫苗兒童族群所致,當局刻正規劃擴大預防接種作業。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年累計報告 10,065 例確定病例及 72 例死亡病例,死亡病例多發生於交通不便地區,當局已提供免費醫療及疫苗接種服務。
items.description_en: Japan: the outbreak has risen sharply, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 22 April this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (265 cases). Cases are concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (153), Kanagawa Prefecture (36), Kagoshima Prefecture (34), Chiba Prefecture (24) and Aichi Prefecture (23). Of these, 33 were imported, and 59% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Bangladesh: since the outbreak began on 15 March this year, more than 30,000 suspected cases (including 4,460 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively as of 17 April, of which 251 died (including 42 confirmed). The outbreak has now spread across the country, and authorities face a shortage of testing reagents. Pakistan: as of March this year, 4,541 confirmed cases and 71 child deaths had been reported cumulatively. Cases are concentrated in the northern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province (1,712), central Punjab Province (1,198) and south-eastern Sindh Province (1,183). The outbreak is attributed to the large number of unvaccinated children created when immunisation was suspended during the COVID-19 pandemic, and authorities are planning to expand immunisation. DRC: South Kivu Province in eastern DRC has reported 10,065 confirmed cases and 72 deaths cumulatively this year. Most deaths occurred in areas with poor transport access, and authorities have provided free medical care and vaccination services.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,剛果民主共和國,日本,巴基斯坦

items.summary_zh: 法屬圭亞那累計108例屈公病確診,82%在西部沿海,30例住院
items.summary_en: French Guiana has 108 confirmed Chikungunya cases, 82% on the western coast, with 30 hospitalised; the first local case since 2014 was reported in January.
items.description_zh: 法屬圭亞那於今年 1 月下旬報告自 2014 年以來首次發生本土確診病例,迄今累計 108 例確診病例,主要分布於西部沿海地區(82%),已有 30 例住院病例。
items.description_en: In late January this year, French Guiana reported its first locally acquired confirmed case since 2014. So far, 108 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the western coastal area (82%), and 30 cases have been hospitalised.

items.headline_en: South Korea – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 韓國今年首例SFTS;2013-2025年累計2,345例、422死
items.summary_en: South Korea reported its first SFTS case of the year on 23 April; since 2013 it has recorded 2,345 cases and 422 deaths, a CFR of 18%.
items.description_zh: 韓國4/23 報告今年首例病例,病患為蔚山廣域市 70 多歲男性,於蔚州郡菜園活動後出現發燒等症狀,目前住院治療中。該國自 2013-2025 年累計報告 2,345 例病例,其中 422 例死亡(CFR:18%),每年 4-11 月為流行期。
items.description_en: South Korea reported its first case of the year on 23 April: a man in his 70s from Ulsan Metropolitan City who developed fever after activity in a vegetable field in Ulju County and is currently hospitalised. From 2013 to 2025, the country reported 2,345 cases cumulatively, of which 422 died (CFR: 18%). The epidemic season is April to November each year.

items.headline_zh: 香港/法屬瓦利斯和富圖那-登革熱
items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR / Wallis and Futuna – Dengue
items.summary_zh: 香港今年首例本土登革熱,21歲男性無旅遊史;富圖納島1例本土確診
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reports its first local dengue case this year, a 21-year-old man with no travel history; Futuna Island also confirmed a local case.
items.description_zh: 香港報告今年首例本土病例,個案為 21 歲男性,於 4/12 出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉痛及出疹等症狀,4/16 就醫,目前病況穩定,於潛伏期間無旅遊史,個案表示其近期曾於工作地點附近遭蚊子叮咬,家庭接觸者及同一地點工作人員目前均無症狀,尚未發現個案與先前報告的輸入個案間有流行病學關連,當局仍持續進行調查。香港今年累計 16 例病例(其中 1 例本土病例),2025 年累計 59 例病例(均為輸入病例);2024 年累計 161 例病例(其中 5 例本土病例)。 法屬瓦利斯和富圖那之富圖納島 4/22 確診 1 例本土病例,個案近期無高風險地區旅遊史,由於鄰近之法屬新喀里多亞於今年 3 月下旬宣布爆發疫情,增加疾病傳播風險。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported its first local case this year: a 21-year-old man who developed fever, headache, muscle pain and rash on 12 April and sought care on 16 April. His condition is stable. He had no travel history during the incubation period, but reported recent mosquito bites near his workplace. Family contacts and staff at the same workplace are currently asymptomatic. No epidemiological link has been found between this case and previously reported imported cases, and authorities continue to investigate. Hong Kong has reported 16 cases cumulatively this year (one local), 59 cases in 2025 (all imported), and 161 cases in 2024 (five local). On Futuna Island in French Wallis and Futuna, one local case was confirmed on 22 April; the case had no recent travel to high-risk areas. The neighbouring French territory of New Caledonia announced an outbreak in late March this year, which increases the risk of transmission.
