items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,今年累計4例;中國新增1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a new H5N1 human case, its fourth this year, in a 66-year-old woman; China reported an H9N2 case.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1病例、中國新增 1 例 H9N2 病例。全球今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。  柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染病例,為該國東南部柴楨省66歲女性,病患於4/21經實驗室確診,目前於醫院加護病房隔離治療中,經調查病患於症狀前1週(4/2-13)曾與家中飼養且生病/死亡之家禽直接接觸,該國今年迄今累計報告4 例H5N1人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告2,864起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  WAHIS共 16 國於 2026/4/14-24 期間報告 103 起 H5N1 疫情,美國34 起、波蘭 24 起、英國 16 起、奧地利 7 起、挪威/智利/芬蘭4各 3 起、印度/日本/荷蘭/阿根廷各 2 起、丹麥/希臘/德國/愛沙亞/烏克蘭各 1 起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感自 2024 年 3 月迄今累計 19 州報告 1,093 起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州;該國廢水監測於 2026/4/12-18 共 450 個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡/馬里蘭州共 6 個採檢點檢出 H5 陽性。
items.description_en: Human cases: Cambodia reported one new H5N1 case, and China one new H9N2 case. Globally this year, five H5N1, 12 H9N2 and one H10N3 human cases have been reported cumulatively; most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Cambodia's new H5N1 human case is a 66-year-old woman from Takeo Province in the south-east of the country, laboratory-confirmed on 21 April and currently isolated in an intensive care unit. Investigation found that in the week before symptom onset (2–13 April) she had direct contact with poultry raised at home that became ill or died. Cambodia has reported four human H5N1 cases this year to date. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 2,864 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. WAHIS reports that 16 countries reported 103 H5N1 outbreaks between 14 and 24 April 2026: the United States 34, Poland 24, the United Kingdom 16, Austria 7, Norway, Chile and Finland three each, India, Japan, the Netherlands and Argentina two each, and Denmark, Greece, Germany, Estonia and Ukraine one each. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 450 sampling sites during 12–18 April 2026, of which six sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Oregon and Maryland detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第13週陽性率升至1.41%,南韓陽性率達5.8%,已連續5週上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose slightly to 1.41% in week 13, while South Korea's positivity reached 5.8% after five weeks of increases.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 13 週(3/30-4/5)全球陽性率略升為 1.41%,其中,西太平洋、東地中海、非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情於低點,第 16 週(4/13-19)門急診陽性率降至 1.3%,疫情已連續 4 週下降,變異株占比以 NB.1.8.1 為多。 韓國疫情呈上升趨勢,第 16 週增加 63 例住院病例,疫情已連續5 週上升,陽性率達 5.8%,近期變異株占比以 NB.1.8.1 及 PQ.2(均為 34.6%)為主,其次為 BA.3.2(占 23.1%)。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占 29.37%),BA.3.2 占比快速上升至 25.87%,其次為 JN.1(占 23.08%)、NB.1.8.1(占 17.48%)。WHO公布之 COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險為中。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,但不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有 6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Update: In week 13 (30 March–5 April), the global positivity rate rose slightly to 1.41%, with marked increases in the WHO regional offices for the Western Pacific, the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. In China, the outbreak is at a low point: outpatient and emergency positivity fell to 1.3% in week 16 (13–19 April), and has declined for four consecutive weeks, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. In South Korea, the outbreak is trending upward: hospitalised cases increased by 63 in week 16, the outbreak has risen for five consecutive weeks, and positivity reached 5.8%. Recent variant shares were led by NB.1.8.1 and PQ.2 (each 34.6%), followed by BA.3.2 (23.1%). Assessment and recommendations: recently circulating variants are led by XFG (29.37%), with BA.3.2 rising rapidly to 25.87%, followed by JN.1 (23.08%) and NB.1.8.1 (17.48%). WHO's COVID-19 Global Long-term Rapid Risk Assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalisations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subvariants; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases have long COVID symptoms. No stable seasonal pattern has yet formed, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel clinic surveillance have become important supplementary tools. WHO notes that vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritising protection of high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its coronavirus disease threat management strategic plan, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.headline_zh: 南蘇丹-不明原因出血熱
items.summary_zh: 南蘇丹東赤道州出現3例疑似出血熱病例,WHO派員調查,病原仍待查明
items.summary_en: South Sudan's Eastern Equatoria State reports three suspected haemorrhagic fever cases; WHO has sent a team and the pathogen is unidentified.
items.description_zh: 南蘇丹東南部東赤道州出現 3 例疑出血熱症狀病例,WHO已派遣調查小組至當地進行疫情調查與控制,目前致病原仍調查中。
items.description_en: Three suspected haemorrhagic fever cases have been reported in Eastern Equatoria State in the south-east of South Sudan. WHO has dispatched an investigation team to conduct outbreak investigation and control on the ground. The causative pathogen is still under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉擴及全國8行政區56縣,3/15起累計逾1.8萬例疑似(2,897例確診)
items.summary_en: Bangladesh's measles outbreak has spread to eight divisions and 56 districts, with over 18,000 suspected cases since 15 March.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情自 2026 年 1 月起急遽升溫,目前已擴及全國 8 行政區共 56 縣。自 3/15 迄今,累計報告逾 1.8 萬例疑病例(含 2,897 例確診),病例集中於人口稠密區與貧民窟群落,並以達卡(Dhaka)近 8千例居多。當局已於 4/5 起針對高風險區幼童展開擴大疫苗接種,預計陸續推廣至全國。WHO 表示多區持續傳播、易感兒童數量龐大、明確之免疫缺口及死亡病例,評估該國傳播風險為高,全球風險為中。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's outbreak has risen sharply since January 2026 and has now spread to eight administrative divisions and 56 districts nationwide. Since 15 March, more than 18,000 suspected cases (including 2,897 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively. Cases are concentrated in densely populated areas and slum communities, with nearly 8,000 in Dhaka. From 5 April, authorities began expanded vaccination of young children in high-risk areas, with plans to roll it out gradually nationwide. WHO states that ongoing transmission in multiple areas, a large number of susceptible children, clear immunity gaps and reported deaths lead it to assess the transmission risk in Bangladesh as high and the global risk as moderate.

items.summary_zh: 加州今年截至4/18週均14.5例M痘,高於2024及2025年同期
items.summary_en: California has averaged 14.5 Mpox cases a week this year through 18 April, above 3.4 in 2025 and 5.8 in 2024.
items.description_zh: 美國加州今年截至 4/18 平均每週報告 14.5 例病例,疫情高於 2025 年(3.4 例/週)及 2024 年(5.8 例/週)。另今年迄今已累計報告 7 例 I 型病例,當局表示多數感染者未接種疫苗,呼籲高風險族群應踴躍接種疫苗。
items.description_en: California, United States, has averaged 14.5 reported cases a week so far this year through 18 April, higher than in 2025 (3.4 cases a week) and 2024 (5.8 cases a week). A total of seven clade I cases have been reported this year. Authorities say most infected people were unvaccinated and urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 賴比瑞亞邦縣近期2例拉薩熱,1例死亡,該地區為疫情熱區
items.summary_en: Bong County, Liberia, has reported two Lassa fever cases, one fatal; the area is a historical hotspot with a CFR of about 44.8%.
items.description_zh: 賴比瑞亞中北部邦縣(Bong County)近期報告 2 例病例,其中 1 例死亡。該地區為疫情熱區,2016-2021 年累計報告 65 例病例,占該國同時期 3 成以上的病例數。另過往 CFR 約為 44.8%,疫情多發生於當年 10 月至次年 3 月間。
items.description_en: Bong County in north-central Liberia has recently reported two cases, one of which was fatal. The area is a hotspot: from 2016 to 2021, 65 cases were reported cumulatively, accounting for more than 30% of the country's cases over the same period. The historical CFR is about 44.8%, and outbreaks mostly occur between October and March of the following year.

items.summary_zh: 肯亞維希加郡2例皮膚炭疽確診,1例死亡,約200人接觸受汙染牛肉
items.summary_en: Vihiga County, Kenya, reported two confirmed cutaneous anthrax cases, one fatal, after people handled and ate meat from a dead cow.
items.description_zh: 肯亞西部韋希加郡(Vihiga)於 4/16 報告 2 例確診人類皮膚炭疽病例,其中 1 例死亡,經調查因處理並食用一頭死亡牛隻的肉而感染,約有200 人接觸受汙染之肉品,該地區另有 2 頭牛隻感染後死亡案例。當局已組成「健康一體」專案小組進行調查,並推動疫苗接種措施及限制牛隻移動等,防止疫情擴大。另該國疫情好發於每年 1 至 6 月間。
items.description_en: In Vihiga County in western Kenya, two confirmed human cutaneous anthrax cases were reported on 16 April, one of which was fatal. Investigation found that the infection was caused by handling and eating meat from a dead cow, and about 200 people were exposed to the contaminated meat. Two other cows in the area also died after infection. Authorities have set up a One Health task force to investigate and are promoting vaccination and restricting cattle movement to prevent spread. The country's outbreaks mostly occur between January and June each year.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至4/16累計732例類鼻疽、23死,1至4月異常增加
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 732 melioidosis cases and 23 deaths this year through 16 April, with cases rising abnormally in January–April.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至 4/16 累計報告 732 例病例,多分布於東北部地區,其中 23 例死亡,高風險族群包括 50 歲以上者、農民及具慢性病個案,往年疫情多發生於雨季(5-10 月),惟今年 1-4 月疫情異常增加。該國過去 1 年約報告 2,000 病例,惟推估實際數應為 7,000 例病例,其中2,800 例死亡,另研究顯示該病在該國動物族群中廣泛存在。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 732 cases cumulatively this year as of 16 April, mainly in the northeast, with 23 deaths. High-risk groups include people over 50, farmers and people with chronic illness. In past years, outbreaks mostly occurred in the rainy season (May–October), but this year cases rose abnormally between January and April. The country reported about 2,000 cases in the past year, but the estimated actual figure is 7,000 cases, of which 2,800 died. Studies show the disease is widespread in the country's animal population.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉北部塔古爾岡縣1例狂犬病死亡,患者遭狐狸咬傷後接種疫苗仍死亡
items.summary_en: A rabies death was reported in Thakurgaon District, northern Bangladesh, after a fox bite; the patient died despite vaccination.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉北部塔古爾岡縣(Thakurgaon)於 4/18 報告 1 例死亡病例,病患於 3/26 遭狐狸咬傷,後續雖有接種疫苗,惟仍於暴露後 17 天出現大量口水和嘔吐等症狀後死亡。評估因當地擴大玉米種植造成生態改變,近期已發生多起狐狸攻擊人類事件。
items.description_en: In Thakurgaon District in northern Bangladesh, one death was reported on 18 April. The patient was bitten by a fox on 26 March and, although vaccinated afterwards, developed heavy salivation and vomiting 17 days after exposure and died. Authorities assess that ecological changes caused by the expansion of maize cultivation in the area have led to several recent fox attacks on humans.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:4/9-15期間阿富汗新增2例WPV1,蘇丹新增4例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: GPEI reported new polio cases in Afghanistan, South Sudan and Sudan between 9 and 15 April; Sudan had four cVDPV2 cases.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 4/9-15 期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗 2 例;cVDPV1 新增南蘇丹 2 例;cVDPV2 新增蘇丹 4 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1 新增巴基斯坦 1 件,cVDPV2 新增 2 國共 3 件,分別為蘇丹 2 件、納米比亞 1 件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 9 and 15 April, WPV1 added two cases in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 added two cases in South Sudan; and cVDPV2 added four cases in Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 added one specimen in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added three specimens across two countries: two in Sudan and one in Namibia.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,南蘇丹共和國,蘇丹

items.headline_zh: 德國/加拿大-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 德國40例沙門氏菌疑與榛果果醬有關;加拿大漢米爾頓13例確診
items.summary_en: Germany reported 40 Salmonella cases, suspected to be linked to a hazelnut spread; Hamilton, Canada, reported 13 confirmed cases and 44 suspected.
items.description_zh: 德國自去(2025)年 9 月迄今年 4/20 累計報告 40 例,病患以 2-15 歲為主,集中在該國東部,其中 1 例死亡,為 60 歲病例。經調查本次疫情血清型為 Bochum,於德國屬罕見血清型(每年 0-4 例),疑感染源為某生產商製造的榛果果醬,當局已命令產品下架。 加拿大安大略省漢米爾頓 4/19 報告 13 例確定病例及 44 例疑病例,其中有 6 例住院,多數病患在某餐廳用餐後發病,惟食物感染源仍不明,當局已下令餐廳停業並持續調查。
items.description_en: Germany has reported 40 cases cumulatively from September last year to 20 April this year, mostly among children aged 2–15 and concentrated in the east of the country. One death, in a 60-year-old case, has been reported. Investigation found that the serotype of this outbreak is Bochum, which is rare in Germany (0–4 cases a year). The suspected source is a hazelnut spread manufactured by a certain producer, and authorities have ordered the product withdrawn. In Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, 13 confirmed cases and 44 suspected cases were reported on 19 April, of which six were hospitalised. Most patients became ill after eating at a certain restaurant, but the food source is still unknown. Authorities have ordered the restaurant closed and are continuing to investigate.

items.headline_zh: 泰國-急性病毒性 A 型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 泰國今年第6-14週每週逾40例A型肝炎,為去年同期2倍,當局警告夏季恐爆發
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported over 40 hepatitis A cases weekly since week 6 this year, twice last year's level, and warns of summer outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年第 6-14 週每週皆報告逾 40 例病例,疫情為去年同期 2 倍,病患多分布於曼谷、春武里、羅勇和尖竹汶府等東部省份,病毒透過未煮熟食物、不安全的飲用水/冰塊傳播,當局警告可能於夏季爆發疫情,呼籲民眾應注意飲食/水衛生。
items.description_en: In Thailand, more than 40 cases were reported each week from week 6 to week 14 of this year, double the level of the same period last year. Cases are mainly distributed in Bangkok and eastern provinces such as Chon Buri, Rayong and Chanthaburi. The virus spreads through undercooked food and unsafe drinking water or ice. Authorities warn that an outbreak may occur in summer and urge people to observe food and water hygiene.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年截至4/14累計2.6萬例腸病毒、8死,逾99%為10歲以下兒童
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has reported about 26,000 enterovirus cases and eight deaths this year through 14 April; 99% of patients are under 10.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情嚴峻,今年截至 4/14 累計報告 2.6 萬例病例,其中死亡 8 例,10 歲以下之病患占 99%,疫情顯著高於去年同期,且校園群聚持續發生。當局已要求發病兒童須停止上學,並居家隔離 10 天以上。
items.description_en: Viet Nam's outbreak is severe: as of 14 April this year, about 26,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including eight deaths. Children under 10 account for 99% of patients. The outbreak is markedly higher than in the same period last year, and school clusters continue to occur. Authorities have required children who fall ill to stop attending school and to isolate at home for more than 10 days.

items.headline_zh: 英國-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 英國韋茅斯3例B型腦膜炎雙球菌確診,均為青少年,密切接觸者已給藥
items.summary_en: Weymouth, Dorset, England, has three confirmed serogroup B meningococcal cases among young people; close contacts received antibiotics.
items.description_zh: 英國西南部多塞特郡韋茅斯地區報告 3 例確定病例,分別為就讀巴德茅斯學院(2 例)及韋谷學院(1 例)年輕人,病患分別於 3/20-4/15 期間確診為 B 型,均屬同一亞型,惟與近期肯特郡疫情之亞型不同,2 例巴德茅斯學院學院具相互接觸史,另 1 例病患尚未確認其流行病學關聯,病患皆已接受治療且恢復良好,當局已提供密切接觸者抗生素。另表示 B 型腦膜炎雙球菌可能於韋茅斯地區之青少年流行,建議提供該地區年輕人抗生素及疫苗。
items.description_en: In Weymouth, Dorset, in south-west England, three confirmed cases were reported among young people attending Budmouth College (two cases) and Weymouth College (one case). Patients were confirmed as serogroup B between 20 March and 15 April, all belonging to the same subtype, which differs from the subtype in the recent outbreak in Kent. Two of the Budmouth College cases had known contact with each other; the epidemiological link for the third case has not yet been confirmed. All patients have been treated and have recovered well. Authorities have provided antibiotics to close contacts. They say serogroup B meningococcal disease may be circulating among adolescents in the Weymouth area, and recommend that antibiotics and vaccines be offered to young people there.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 日本第15週新增56例麻疹,今年累計299例;英國累計407例確定病例
items.summary_en: Japan added 56 measles cases in week 15 alone, reaching 299 this year; the UK has 407 confirmed cases as of 13 April.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,第 15 週單週新增 56 例確定病例,今年截至4/15 累計報告 299 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印及紐西蘭為多,年齡層以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 108 例、神奈川縣 31 例及鹿兒島縣 28 例為多,61%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,當局呼籲民眾確認兒童按時接種疫苗,另前往流行地區應採取相關防疫措施。 英國今年截至 4/13 累計報告 407 例確定病例,病例數以倫敦 229 例及西密德蘭郡(West Midlands)100 例為多,另所有地區皆有報告至少 1 例確定病例。該國去(2024)年報告 959 例確定病例。 歐盟今年 2 月共計 11 國報告 139 例確定病例,以義大利(63 例)、西班牙(36 例)為多。近 12 個月(2025/3/1-2026/2/28)共計 30 國報告 4,623 例病例,其中 6 例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(1,587 例)、法國(754 例)、義大利(534 例)為多,其中 79.9%病患未接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. The countries of infection were mainly India and New Zealand. Those aged 15–29 accounted for the largest share (50%). Cases were concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (108), Kanagawa Prefecture (31) and Kagoshima Prefecture (28). 61% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Authorities urge the public to confirm that children are vaccinated on schedule and to take appropriate precautions when travelling to epidemic areas. The UK reported 407 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April. Cases are concentrated in London (229) and West Midlands County (100), and every region has reported at least one confirmed case. The UK reported 959 confirmed cases last year (2024). In February this year, 11 EU countries reported 139 confirmed cases, mainly Italy (63) and Spain (36). In the past 12 months (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026), 30 countries reported 4,623 cases, including six deaths, with the largest numbers in Romania (1,587), France (754) and Italy (534); 79.9% of patients were unvaccinated.
items.area_zh: 法國,印尼,義大利,日本,紐西蘭,羅馬尼亞,西班牙,英國
items.area_en: France,Indonesia,Italy,Japan,New Zealand,Romania,Spain,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 阿根廷/巴西/玻利維亞-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 阿根廷今年截至4/11累計5,506例屈公病,其中831例確診,多在薩爾塔省
items.summary_en: Argentina has reported 5,506 Chikungunya cases this year as of 11 April, 831 confirmed, mainly in Salta Province.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年迄 4/11 累計報告 5,506 例病例,其中 831 例確診,主要分布於薩爾塔省;美洲地區累計報告病例數以巴西及玻利維亞為多。
items.description_en: Argentina's outbreak update: as of 11 April this year, 5,506 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 831 confirmed cases, mainly in Salta Province. Across the Americas, Brazil and Bolivia have reported the most cumulative cases.

items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞聖克魯斯省發布黃熱病健康警報,科迪勒拉縣2例確診、1例死亡
items.summary_en: Bolivia's Santa Cruz Department has issued a yellow fever health alert after two confirmed cases, one fatal, in Cordillera Province.
items.description_zh: 玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省於今年 4 月發布健康警報,由於科迪勒拉縣報告 2 例確診病例,其中 1 例死亡,另於同省之查拉瓜鎮報告 1 例疑病例,當局已展開大規模預防接種運動;該國於 2023-2025 年每年報告 5-8 例病例(其中 2-4 例死亡)。
items.description_en: Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia issued a health alert in April this year. Two confirmed cases, one of them fatal, have been reported in Cordillera Province, and one suspected case has been reported in the town of Charagua in the same department. Authorities have launched a large-scale vaccination campaign. Bolivia reported 5–8 cases a year in 2023–2025, of which 2–4 were fatal.

items.summary_zh: 香港新增1例本土麻疹(機場員工接觸者);菲律賓奎松市今年143例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a local measles case, a close contact of airport staff; Quezon City, Philippines, has 143 confirmed cases this year.
items.description_zh: 香港報告 1 例本土病例,病患為 30 歲男性,於 4/14 起出現肌肉痛及發燒等症狀,4/17 出現皮疹就醫,4/18 經實驗室確診。病患為香港於4/3 及 4/6 公布之確診個案之密切接觸者,皆同於機場工作,無國外旅遊史,當局已啟動診所及機場等密切接觸者匡列作業,並呼籲民眾接種麻疹疫苗。 菲律賓國家首都區奎松市今年截至 4/16 報告 143 確診病例,其中 1 例死亡。76%病患為 10 歲以下兒童(109 例),且其中 23 例為未達接種疫苗年齡嬰兒,當局已啟動相關防治及疫苗接種措施。該國今年第一季累計報告 1,627 例麻疹/德國麻疹確定病例,較去年同期增加 45%。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported one local case: a 30-year-old man who developed muscle pain and fever from 14 April, presented with a rash on 17 April, and was laboratory-confirmed on 18 April. He is a close contact of the confirmed cases announced by Hong Kong on 3 and 6 April; all of them worked at the airport, and none had a history of travel abroad. Authorities have activated contact tracing for close contacts in clinics and at the airport, and urge the public to get measles vaccination. Quezon City in the National Capital Region of the Philippines reported 143 confirmed cases this year as of 16 April, including one death. 76% of patients are children under 10 (109 cases), and 23 of them were infants too young to be vaccinated. Authorities have launched related prevention and vaccination measures. In the first quarter of this year, the Philippines reported 1,627 confirmed measles and rubella cases cumulatively, 45% more than in the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,菲律賓

items.summary_zh: 美國麻疹疫情趨緩,今年累計1,748例,最新一週34例為年內單週最低
items.summary_en: US measles cases slowed to 34 in the latest week, the lowest weekly figure of 2026; 1,748 cases reported this year.
items.description_zh: 美國麻疹疫情趨緩,最新 1 週新增 34 例,為 2026 年單週最低。今年累計報告 1,748 例,94%與 19 起群聚相關,病例分布於全國32 州及紐約市,迄無死亡報告,住院率約 6%。92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,且 72%為 19 歲以下族群。 WHO及非洲CDC分析,2000 至 2024 年間非洲 44 國將第 2 劑麻疹疫苗納入常規接種,覆蓋率從 5%提升至 55%,逾 5 億兒童受惠,病例下降 40%,成功預防近 1,950 萬例死亡案例。
items.description_en: The US measles outbreak is slowing: the latest week saw 34 new cases, the lowest weekly figure for 2026. This year, 1,748 cases have been reported cumulatively, 94% of them linked to 19 clusters. Cases are distributed across 32 states and New York City, with no deaths reported and a hospitalisation rate of about 6%. 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 72% were under 19 years old. WHO and Africa CDC analysed that between 2000 and 2024, 44 African countries introduced a second dose of measles vaccine into routine immunisation, raising coverage from 5% to 55%. More than 500 million children have benefited, cases have fallen by 40%, and nearly 19.5 million deaths have been averted.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國新增3例H9N2;今年累計4例H5N1、11例H9N2、1例H10N3
items.summary_en: China reported three new H9N2 human infections; globally this year there are four H5N1, 11 H9N2 and one H10N3 cases.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:中國新增 3 例 H9N2 流感人類感染病例。今年累計報告 H5N1 流感 4 例、H9N2 流感 11 例及 H10N3 流感 1 例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計 56 國家/地區報告 2,761 起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共 20 國於 2026/4/9-17 期間報告 110 起 H5N1 疫情,菲律賓25 起、波蘭 13 起、奧地利/泊爾/英國各 10 起、丹麥 9 起、瑞典 7 起、比利時/義大利各 5 起、匈牙利/印度各 3 起、臺灣2 起、俄羅斯/南韓/希臘/捷克/智利/立陶宛/羅馬亞/象牙海岸各 1 起。 比利時於 2026/4/17 報告 2 起 H5 (N untyped)疫情。    美國乳牛感染禽流感自 2024 年 3 月迄今累計 19 州報告 1,093 起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州(Idaho);該國廢水監測於2026/4/5-11 共 460 個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡州共 6 個採檢點檢出 H5 陽性。
items.description_en: Human cases: China reported three new H9N2 human infections. This year, cumulative reports are four H5N1, 11 H9N2 and one H10N3 influenza cases, and most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 2,761 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Twenty countries reported 110 H5N1 outbreaks between 9 and 17 April 2026: the Philippines 25, Poland 13, Austria, Nepal and the United Kingdom 10 each, Denmark 9, Sweden 7, Belgium and Italy five each, Hungary and India three each, Taiwan two, and Russia, South Korea, Greece, Czechia, Chile, Lithuania, Romania and Côte d'Ivoire one each. Belgium reported two H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 17 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 460 sampling sites during 5–11 April 2026, of which six sites in New Jersey, Illinois and Oregon detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第12週陽性率升至1.84%,阿拉伯聯合大公國陽性率升至8.82%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 1.84% in week 12, while the United Arab Emirates' positivity climbed to 8.82%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 12 週(3/23-29)全球陽性率略升為 1.84%,其中東南亞區署、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。  韓國今年第 14 週增加 45 例住院病例,與前 1 週相當,疫情處低點,惟陽性率已連續4週上升,自 3 月起之變異株占比改以 BA.3.2 為主(45%)、其次為 NB.1.8.1(占 41%)。  阿拉伯聯合大公國疫情快速上升,第 12 週陽性率上升為 8.82%,為東地中海疫情上升之主要國家。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以 XFG 占比最高(占 40.62%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占 26.04%),BA.3.2 占比上升至 12.5%。WHO 公布之COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,但不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有 6%之有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段 COVID-19 尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Update: In week 12 (23–29 March), the global positivity rate rose slightly to 1.84%, with marked increases in the WHO regional offices for South-East Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean. In week 14 of the year, South Korea added 45 hospitalised cases, similar to the previous week; the outbreak is at a low point, but positivity has risen for four consecutive weeks. Since March, the main variant has shifted to BA.3.2 (45%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (41%). The United Arab Emirates' outbreak is rising rapidly: positivity rose to 8.82% in week 12, making it the main country in the Eastern Mediterranean with rising outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: recently circulating variants are led by XFG (40.62%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (26.04%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%. WHO's COVID-19 Global Long-term Rapid Risk Assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalisations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subvariants; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases have long COVID symptoms. No stable seasonal pattern has yet formed for COVID-19, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel clinic surveillance have become important supplementary tools. WHO notes that vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritising protection of high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its coronavirus disease threat management strategic plan, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.
items.area_zh: 韓國,阿拉伯聯合大公國

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉州去年33例狂犬病死亡,為近5年最高,流浪狗咬傷達30萬件
items.summary_en: Kerala, India, recorded 33 rabies deaths last year, its highest in five years, with 300,000 stray dog bite incidents.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉州去年報告33例死亡病例,為近5年最高,該邦近期流浪狗攻擊事件增加,該州去年發生 30 萬件流浪犬咬傷事件。當局呼籲制定流浪動物相關管理法規,尤其是狂犬病流行地區。
items.description_en: Kerala State, India, reported 33 rabies deaths last year, the highest in five years. Stray dog attacks have increased recently in the state, which recorded 300,000 stray dog bite incidents last year. Authorities call for regulations on stray animal management, especially in areas where rabies is endemic.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至3月22州報告663例拉薩熱確診,167死
items.summary_en: Nigeria has 663 confirmed Lassa fever cases in 22 states as of March this year, with 167 deaths.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情上升,今年截至 3 月共計 22 州報告 663 例確定病例,其中 167 例死亡,病患主要分布於東北部包奇州、西南部翁多州、東部塔拉巴州、中部貝努埃州及西南部埃多州。
items.description_en: Nigeria's outbreak is rising: as of March this year, 663 confirmed cases had been reported from 22 states, of which 167 died. Cases are mainly distributed in Bauchi State in the north-east, Ondo State in the south-west, Taraba State in the east, Benue State in the centre, and Edo State in the south-south.

items.headline_zh: 塞內加爾-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 塞內加爾西部新增1例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,非洲今年累計3例
items.summary_en: Senegal reported a new Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever case in a 28-year-old woman in Fatick District; Africa has 3 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 塞內加爾西部法蒂克區於新增 1 例確定病例,為 28 歲女性,於 2/25 出現發燒、頭痛/肌肉痛、嘔吐、出血及腦膜腦炎等症狀,病患近 15天無旅遊史,3/19 經實驗室確診,當局已啟動疫情調查及防治作業。另非洲地區今年迄今累計報告 3 例,包括塞國 2 例,烏干達報告 1 例,迄無死亡病例。
items.description_en: A new confirmed case has been reported in Fatick District in western Senegal: a 28-year-old woman who developed fever, headache and muscle pain, vomiting, bleeding and meningoencephalitis symptoms on 25 February. She had no travel history in the past 15 days, and laboratory confirmation was made on 19 March. Authorities have launched outbreak investigation and control operations. In addition, the African region has reported three cases cumulatively so far this year, including two in Senegal and one in Uganda, with no deaths reported.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年累計3萬1,927例登革熱、4死,南部疫情升溫
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has reported 31,927 dengue cases and four deaths this year, with rising outbreaks in the south during the rainy season.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告 31,927 例病例及 4 例死亡,近期該國多地疫情上升,主要分布於南部地區,由於雨季及濕熱天氣,預期疫情可能持續上升。
items.description_en: Viet Nam outbreak update: so far this year, 31,927 cases and four deaths have been reported cumulatively. Recently the outbreak has risen in many areas of the country, mainly in the southern region. Given the rainy season and hot, humid weather, the outbreak is expected to continue rising.

items.headline_zh: 越南-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 越南今年截至第14週24例確定病例、4死,高於去年同期14例
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has reported 24 confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases through week 14, four fatal, above the 14 reported in the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 越南今年截至第 14 週報告 24 例確定病例,其中 4 例死亡,46%為15 歲以下兒童,目前為社區散發個案,未有群聚事件,近期病例數呈上升趨勢,已高於去年同期(14 例)。當局呼籲民眾保持良好個人衛生習慣,倘出現高燒、頭痛、噁心、頸部僵硬及出血性皮疹等疑症狀,應儘速就醫治療及檢查。
items.description_en: Viet Nam reported 24 confirmed cases this year through week 14, of which four died. Children under 15 make up 46%. The cases are currently sporadic community cases with no clusters. Recent case numbers have been rising and are higher than the 14 cases reported in the same period last year. Authorities urge people to maintain good personal hygiene, and to seek prompt medical treatment and testing if they develop suspected symptoms such as high fever, headache, nausea, neck stiffness or haemorrhagic rash.

items.summary_zh: 印尼南蘇拉威西省麻疹疫情上升,累計169例兒童確定病例
items.summary_en: Measles is rising in South Sulawesi, Indonesia, with 169 confirmed pediatric cases since December 2025, most unvaccinated, and emergency vaccination launched.
items.description_zh: 印南蘇拉威西省望加錫市等 7 個地區爆發疫情,為繼近期全國疫情後局部地區的再次爆發,自去(2025)年 12 月起,至今年 3 月持續上升,已累計報告 169 例兒童確定病例,多數病患為未接種疫苗兒童。由於疫情於全國流行,當局發布命令請各地區進行風險評估,並針對該省發布警報並啟動緊急疫苗接種作業。
items.description_en: Seven areas, including Makassar City in South Sulawesi Province, have experienced outbreaks. This follows a recent nationwide outbreak and represents a renewed local resurgence. From December 2025 through March 2026, cases continued to rise, with 169 confirmed pediatric cases reported cumulatively; most patients were unvaccinated children. Because the outbreak is circulating nationally, authorities have issued an order requiring each region to conduct a risk assessment, and have issued an alert for the province and launched emergency vaccination operations.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 4月2-8日全球新增5例疫苗衍生型病毒病例,集中於奈及利亞
items.summary_en: GPEI reported five new cVDPV2 cases in 2–8 April across three countries, three of them in Nigeria, plus environmental detections.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/2-8期間,cVDPV2新增3國共5例,分別為奈及利亞3例、剛果民主共和國/索馬利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共11件,分別為巴基斯坦7件、阿富汗4件,cVDPV2新增2國共6件,分別為蘇丹5件、奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 2–8 April, cVDPV2 cases were newly reported in three countries, totalling five cases: three in Nigeria, and one each in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Somalia. For environmental samples, WPV1 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling 11 samples: seven in Pakistan and four in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 environmental detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling six samples: five in Sudan and one in Nigeria.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞,索馬利亞

items.headline_zh: 香港-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 香港今年累計27例A型肝炎,近期仍有男男性行為者病例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 27 hepatitis A cases through March this year, with recent cases still linked to MSM; over 60 people vaccinated.
items.description_zh: 香港疫情更新,今年截至3月累計報告27例病例,2-3月疫情已下降(7、8例),其中3月病例均為年齡介於28-61歲男性。當局已推出免費疫苗接種措施,迄今已逾60人接種,惟近期仍持續報告有MSM經驗之病例。另香港於2015-2017年亦曾爆發MSM相關疫情,已透過高風險族群的疫苗接種措施成功控制。
items.description_en: Hong Kong epidemic update: as of March this year, 27 cases have been reported cumulatively. Case numbers declined in February and March (7 and 8 cases, respectively). All cases reported in March were men aged 28–61 years. Authorities have launched a free vaccination programme, and more than 60 people have been vaccinated to date; however, cases with a history of sex with men (MSM) continue to be reported. Hong Kong also experienced MSM-related outbreaks in 2015–2017, which were brought under control through vaccination of high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 俄羅斯-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯弗拉迪米爾州4月7-13日報告677例腸胃炎,36例為諾羅病毒
items.summary_en: Vladimir Oblast, Russia, reported 677 gastroenteritis cases in 7–13 April; 36 were confirmed norovirus, and drinking water is suspected.
items.description_zh: 俄羅斯弗拉迪米爾州(Vladimir)4/7-13累計報告677例急性腸胃炎病例,其中36例經實驗室檢測為諾羅病毒感染,約半數病患為兒童。經當局調查疑感染源可能為飲用水遭受汙染。
items.description_en: In Vladimir Oblast, Russia, a total of 677 acute gastroenteritis cases were reported for 7–13 April. Of these, 36 were laboratory-confirmed as norovirus infections, and about half of the patients were children. Authorities' investigation indicates that the suspected source of infection may be contaminated drinking water.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年逾2.6萬例腸病毒病例、8例死亡,胡志明市疫情嚴峻
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has reported over 26,000 enterovirus cases and 8 deaths this year, with Ho Chi Minh City's surge driving severe EV71 disease in children.
items.description_zh: 越南今年迄今已累計逾26,000例病例及8例死亡,尤以南部地區疫情嚴峻,其中胡志明市今年截至第14週(3/30-4/5)累計報告1萬496例,第14週即增加1,347例,較前4週平均增加64%。兒童醫院就醫數於近期大幅增加,多為EV71型且衍生重症,許多兒童在危急狀況、呼吸衰竭及心臟休克時被送醫治療,已發生急性腦損傷,惟沒有明顯紅斑或口腔潰瘍,並在12-24小時內死亡。
items.description_en: Viet Nam has reported more than 26,000 cases and 8 deaths so far this year, with the situation especially severe in the south. Ho Chi Minh City reported 10,496 cases this year through week 14 (30 March–5 April), and week 14 alone saw 1,347 new cases, a 64% increase over the average of the previous four weeks. Paediatric hospital visits have risen sharply recently, mostly for EV71 infections with severe complications. Many children were brought in for treatment in critical condition, with respiratory failure and cardiac shock, and acute brain injury has occurred. However, no obvious erythema or oral ulcers were present, and the children died within 12–24 hours.

items.summary_zh: 英國今年確定8例退伍軍人病,病患均與倫敦西北或西南區有關
items.summary_en: The UK has confirmed eight Legionnaires' disease cases this year, all with links to north-west or south-west London, with 13 more under investigation.
items.description_zh: 英國今年截至 3/23 報告 8 例確定病例,所有病患均居住/工作/曾到訪過倫敦西北部或西南部地區,且細菌序列類型均相同,另有 13 例病例持續調查中,當局已啟動流行病學等調查,以確認是否有潛在共同感染源。
items.description_en: As of 23 March this year, the United Kingdom has reported 8 confirmed cases. All patients lived in, worked in, or had visited north-west or south-west London, and all share the same bacterial sequence type. A further 13 cases are under investigation. Authorities have launched epidemiological and other investigations to determine whether there is a potential common source of infection.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 日本今年累計236例麻疹,美國33州累計1,704例,猶他州疫情上升
items.summary_en: Japan reported 236 measles cases this year, 30 imported, while the US had 1,704 confirmed cases in 33 states, with Utah rising.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情上升,今(2026)年截至 4/8 累計報告 236 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印12例為多,其次為紐西蘭7例,以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 72 例、鹿兒島縣27 例、愛知縣 23 例及神奈川/千葉縣 20 例為多。 美國疫情持續,今年截至 4/9 共 33 州累計報告 1,704 例確定病例,其中 96 例住院,病患以 5-19 歲年齡層族群(888 例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(667 例),其次為猶他州(408)及德州(176 例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他州。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is rising: as of 8 April this year, 236 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. Indonesia accounted for the most imported cases (12), followed by New Zealand (7). Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (72 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (27), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa and Chiba Prefectures (20) reported the most. The United States outbreak continues: as of 9 April, 1,704 confirmed cases have been reported across 33 states this year, of which 96 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (888 cases), concentrated in South Carolina (667 cases), followed by Utah (408) and Texas (176). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah.

items.headline_zh: 蒲隆地-不明原因致死疾病
items.summary_zh: 蒲隆地北部自3月31日起出現不明疾病,至少5例死亡、35例病例
items.summary_en: Burundi has reported at least five deaths and 35 cases of an unexplained illness in northern Mpanda since 31 March; Ebola and Marburg ruled out.
items.description_zh: 蒲隆地北部姆潘達區自 3/31 起通報不明原因疾病,至少 5 例死亡及35 例病例,病例僅限於同一家庭成員及其密切接觸者,症狀包括發燒、頭痛、極度疲勞、腹痛、嘔吐、腹瀉及血尿,嚴重病例出現貧血及黃疸,實驗室已排除伊波拉病毒、馬堡病毒、黃熱病、裂谷熱及克里米亞-剛果出血熱,調查仍在進行中。該地區鄰近剛果民主共和國邊境,除不易進行跨境監測,亦可能出現未被發現的病例。
items.description_en: Since 31 March, an unexplained illness has been reported in Mpanda, in the north of Burundi, with at least 5 deaths and 35 cases. Cases are limited to members of the same family and their close contacts. Symptoms include fever, headache, extreme fatigue, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhoea and haematuria; severe cases showed anaemia and jaundice. Laboratory testing has ruled out Ebola virus, Marburg virus, yellow fever, Rift Valley fever and Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever. The investigation is ongoing. The area borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo; cross-border surveillance is difficult, and undetected cases may also occur.

items.summary_zh: 納米比亞今年約2.8萬例瘧疾,東北部贊比西區近1週新增1,719例
items.summary_en: Namibia reported about 28,000 malaria cases in weeks 1–10 this year; Zambezi Region in the northeast logged 1,719 cases in the past week.
items.description_zh: 納米比亞疫情上升,今年 1-10 週累計報告約 28,000 例病例,其中,該國東北部贊比西區截至 3/30 累計報告 10,330 例病例,近 1 週報告1,719 例病例。
items.description_en: Malaria in Namibia is rising. From week 1 to week 10 this year, about 28,000 cases have been reported cumulatively. In Zambezi Region in the northeast, 10,330 cases were reported cumulatively as of 30 March, and 1,719 cases were reported in the past week.

items.headline_zh: 巴西/哥斯大黎加/瓜地馬拉/墨西哥-屈公病
items.headline_en: Brazil / Costa Rica / Guatemala / Mexico – Chikungunya
items.summary_zh: 巴西今年逾3.8萬例屈公病、15例死亡,中美洲及墨西哥亦有病例
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported over 38,000 chikungunya cases and 15 deaths this year; Costa Rica, Guatemala and Mexico also report cases, and PAHO issued alerts.
items.description_zh: 巴西今年迄今累計報告 38,000 餘例病例及 15 例死亡,其中,西部南馬托羅索州累計逾 2,000 例確診病例及 10 例死亡。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第 3 例病例,為居住於該國西北部瓜納卡斯特省45 歲外國籍男性,依據流行病學調查,個案於潛伏期入境,屬境外移入病例。 瓜地馬拉西南部聖馬可仕省卡塔里娜於 2 月底報告 1 例確診病例,該省鄰近之墨西哥恰帕斯州於今年亦有報告病例。該國另報告 4 例疑病例,分布於埃斯昆特拉、奇基穆拉、瓜地馬拉省。評估美洲各國疫情持續上升,泛美衛生組織持續發布流行病學警示。
items.description_en: Brazil has reported more than 38,000 cases and 15 deaths so far this year, including more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 10 deaths cumulatively in the western state of Mato Grosso do Sul. Costa Rica reported its third case this year, a 45-year-old foreign national man residing in Guanacaste Province in the northwest of the country. Epidemiological investigation shows he entered the country during the incubation period, making it an imported case. In Catarina, San Marcos Department in the southwest of Guatemala, one confirmed case was reported at the end of February; the neighbouring Mexican state of Chiapas has also reported cases this year. Guatemala has also reported four suspected cases in Escuintla, Chiquimula and Guatemala departments. Given continued rises in case numbers across the Americas, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) continues to issue epidemiological alerts.

items.summary_zh: 義大利通報1例H9N2流感病例,患者曾赴塞內加爾,目前病況穩定
items.summary_en: Italy reported a human H9N2 influenza case on 21 March in an adult who had spent six months in Senegal; the patient's condition is stable.
items.description_zh: 義大利於3/21通報1例H9N2人類流感病例,病患為成年個案,曾至塞內加爾6個月,三月中旬前往達義大利,病患因出現發燒及咳嗽等症狀至急診就醫,16 日經檢驗結核分枝桿菌呈陽性,及無法分型之 A 型流感病毒,收治於負壓隔離病房,並接受抗結核藥物及克流感(Oseltamivir)抗病毒治療,目前病況穩定,20 日確診為H9亞型,21日經定序(NGS)確診為A(H9N2),基因證據顯示該病毒源自塞內加爾相關禽類譜系,義大利刻正進行病毒細胞培養分離。病患無直接接觸動物/野生動物或出入農村地區活動史,亦無接觸過確診或疑症狀患者,塞內加爾境內接觸者皆無症狀,義大利境內已取得聯繫之接觸者採檢皆為流感陰性。WHO評估多數A(H9N2) 病例與暴露於受感染禽類或受污染環境有關,臨床症狀多為輕症。由於該病毒在禽類中呈地方性流行,預期仍會出現散發人類病例。
items.description_en: On 21 March, Italy reported one human H9N2 influenza case. The patient is an adult who spent six months in Senegal and travelled to Italy in mid-March. The patient went to the emergency department with fever and cough. On 16 March, tests were positive for Mycobacterium tuberculosis and for an influenza A virus that could not be subtyped. The patient was admitted to a negative-pressure isolation ward and treated with anti-tuberculosis drugs and the antiviral oseltamivir. The patient's condition is currently stable. H9 subtype was confirmed on 20 March, and A(H9N2) was confirmed by next-generation sequencing (NGS) on 21 March. Genetic evidence indicates the virus derives from a lineage associated with poultry in Senegal, and Italy is currently carrying out virus isolation in cell culture. The patient had no direct contact with animals or wildlife and no history of visits to rural areas, and had no contact with confirmed or suspected cases. Asymptomatic contacts in Senegal, and the contacts in Italy who were sampled, all tested negative for influenza. The WHO assesses that most A(H9N2) cases are associated with exposure to infected poultry or contaminated environments, and that clinical symptoms are mostly mild. Because the virus is endemic in poultry, sporadic human cases are expected to continue.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球本週無新增人類禽流感病例,今年累計H5N1 4例、H9N2 8例
items.summary_en: No new human avian influenza cases this week; 2026 totals are 4 H5N1, 8 H9N2 and 1 H10N3; 1,088 US dairy cattle outbreaks since 2024.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:本週無新增病例。今年累計報告 H5N1 流感 4 例、H9N2 流感 8 例及 H10N3 流感 1 例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計 53 國家/地區報告 2,656 起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共 10 國於 2026/3/27-4/10 期間報告 62 起 H5N1 疫情,南韓21 起、波蘭 20 起、泊爾 6 起、丹麥/智利各 4 起、荷蘭 3 起、俄羅斯/挪威/美國/西班牙各 1 起。 秘魯於 2026/4/7-8 期間報告 2 起 H5 (N untyped)疫情。 南韓於 2026/4/7 期間報告 2 起 H5N9 疫情。   美國乳牛感染禽流感自 2024 年 3 月迄今累計 19 州報告 1,088 起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/3/29-4/4 共 437 個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/南達科他/科羅拉多/加州共 7 個採檢點檢出 H5 陽性。
items.description_en: Human cases: No new human cases were reported this week. So far this year, 4 cases of H5N1, 8 cases of H9N2 and 1 case of H10N3 influenza have been reported cumulatively; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 53 countries and regions have reported 2,656 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Ten countries reported 62 H5N1 outbreaks during 27 March–10 April 2026: South Korea 21, Poland 20, Nepal 6, Denmark and Chile 4 each, the Netherlands 3, and Russia, Norway, the United States and Spain 1 each. Peru reported 2 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 7–8 April 2026. South Korea reported 2 H5N9 outbreaks during 7 April 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 437 sampling sites for 29 March–4 April 2026, of which 7 sampling sites in New Jersey, Illinois, South Dakota, Colorado and California detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率升至2.47%,XFG占比最高,BA.3.2增至12.5%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 2.47% in week 11; XFG is the leading variant at 31.44%, and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 11 週(3/16-22)全球陽性率上升為 2.47%,其中東南亞區署、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 德國疫情呈下降,目前處低點,第 13 週新增 282 例病例;變異株以 NB.1.8.1(68%)為主,另變異株 BA.3.2 占比上升,從今年9-10 週的 5%,上升至第 10-11 週的 11%。 英國疫情略升,第 13 週實驗室檢測陽性率略增至 2.1%。變異株以 XFG 占大宗,BA.3 於 2/16-3/1 占比為 2.13%。 GISAID 去年 12 月迄今的病毒株定序資料顯示,BA.3.2 多數易感宿主為年輕族群,其中,愛爾蘭高達 38.8%及法國 27%病例為 18 歲以下族群;美國 49.1%及盧森堡 23.4%病例為 10 歲以下族群,與其他變異株感染病患的年齡層分布顯著不同。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以 XFG 占比最高(占 31.44%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30.68%),BA.3.2 占比上升至 12.5%。WHO 公布之 COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有 6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段 COVID-19 尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 11 of this year (16–22 March), the global positivity rate rose to 2.47%, with notable increases in the WHO South-East Asia and Eastern Mediterranean regions. Germany's epidemic is declining and is currently at a low point, with 282 new cases reported in week 13. NB.1.8.1 (68%) remains the predominant variant, while the share of BA.3.2 has risen from 5% in weeks 9–10 of this year to 11% in weeks 10–11. The UK's epidemic has risen slightly, and laboratory test positivity increased slightly to 2.1% in week 13. XFG accounts for the largest share of variants, and BA.3 accounted for 2.13% during 16 February–1 March. Sequencing data in GISAID since December last year show that most BA.3.2 infections occur in young people: 38.8% of cases in the Republic of Ireland and 27% in France were under 18 years, and 49.1% of cases in the United States and 23.4% in Luxembourg were under 10 years, a significantly different age distribution from patients infected with other variants. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally (31.44%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30.68%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%. WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年累計1,627例麻疹,較去年同期增45%,68%未接種
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 1,627 confirmed measles cases this year through 21 March, 45% higher than the same period last year, with 68% unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓今(2026)年截至3/21累計報告1,627 確定病例,較去(2025)年同期新增45%, 其中1,111 例(68%)未接種疫苗,病例數以南部邦薩莫洛自治區(344例)、南部索科斯克薩爾根大區(322例)、南部達沃區(163例)、國家首都區(158例)為多,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗。
items.description_en: As of 21 March this year, the Philippines has reported 1,627 confirmed cases, 45% higher than the same period last year. Of these, 1,111 cases (68%) were unvaccinated. Cases are concentrated in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (344 cases), SOCCSKSARGEN (322 cases), Davao Region (163 cases) and the National Capital Region (158 cases). Authorities urge the public to get vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 開普敦沿岸南非海豹狂犬病感染逾90例,2月曾有發病海豹攻擊遊客
items.summary_en: Cape Town has issued a rabies alert for Cape fur seals, with over 90 infections detected and a symptomatic seal attacking a tourist in February.
items.description_zh: 南非開普敦針對沿岸的南非海豹發布狂犬病警告,自2年前檢測迄今,已累計逾90件海豹感染案例,且2月曾在豪特灣發生發病海豹攻擊遊客事件。當局已為獸醫等高風險人員施打暴露前疫苗,並於救援船隻配備暴露後預防醫療包,加強防疫與應變能力。
items.description_en: Cape Town has issued a rabies warning regarding Cape fur seals along its coastline. Since testing began two years ago, more than 90 seal infection cases have been recorded cumulatively. In February, a seal with symptoms attacked a tourist in Hout Bay. Authorities have given pre-exposure vaccination to high-risk personnel, including veterinarians, and equipped rescue vessels with post-exposure prophylaxis medical kits to strengthen disease prevention and response capacity.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/厄瓜多/巴基斯坦-M痘
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Ecuador / Pakistan – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國宣布結束公共衛生緊急狀態,巴基斯坦新生兒院內群聚
items.summary_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo ended its national public health emergency on 2 April; Pakistan reported a clade Ib hospital cluster with at least seven neonatal cases.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國於4/2正式宣布結束國家公共衛生緊急狀態。ACDC報告自2024年1月迄2026年3月,該國26省累計報告近16萬例個案,至少有2,267例死亡,其中3萬7,000例確診。此波疫情流行株為Ib型病毒,當局加強疫情監測與擴大高風險族群之疫苗接種,疫情於2025年高峰期單週報告約2,400例,迄2026年4月約170例/週,降幅逾90%。 厄瓜多報告首例Ib型境外移入確診病例,近期有旅遊史,該國已發布警報並向PAHO申請首批疫苗,目前尚無社區傳播風險,將持續加強接觸者追蹤及疫情監測。 巴基斯坦南部信德省海爾布爾縣報告首起Ib型本土院內群聚事件。該地區自3月中旬起持續出現多起疑/確定病例,包括新生兒感染,迄已通報至少7例新生兒病例,其中至少4例確定病例死亡,惟死者亦多具早產、營養不良及體重過輕等病史。當局調查醫院未確實消毒嬰兒保溫箱,導致交叉感染所致,已關閉新生兒加護病房,並啟動接觸者追蹤。另周邊蘇庫爾縣亦有24例疑病例調查中。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo officially declared the end of its national public health emergency on 2 April. Africa CDC reports that from January 2024 to March 2026, 26 provinces of the country cumulatively reported nearly 160,000 cases and at least 2,267 deaths, of which 37,000 were confirmed. The epidemic strain is clade Ib virus. Authorities have strengthened outbreak surveillance and expanded vaccination of high-risk groups. Weekly reports peaked at about 2,400 cases in 2025 and had fallen to about 170 per week by April 2026, a decline of more than 90%. Ecuador has reported its first imported confirmed clade Ib case; the patient had a recent travel history. The country has issued an alert and applied to PAHO for its first batch of vaccines. There is currently no risk of community transmission, and contact tracing and outbreak surveillance will continue to be strengthened. In Khairpur District, Sindh Province, Pakistan, the first locally acquired clade Ib hospital cluster has been reported. Since mid-March, multiple suspected and confirmed cases have continued to occur in the area, including neonatal infections; at least 7 neonatal cases have been reported, of which at least 4 confirmed cases died. Most of the deceased also had histories of premature birth, malnutrition and low birth weight. Authorities' investigation found that hospital infant incubators were not properly disinfected, leading to cross-infection; the neonatal intensive care unit has been closed and contact tracing initiated. In addition, 24 suspected cases are under investigation in neighbouring Sukkur District.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-流行性腦脊隨膜炎
items.summary_zh: 加拿大今年至少63例流行性腦脊髓膜炎,安大略省增幅最大,致死率14%
items.summary_en: Canada has reported at least 63 meningococcal cases so far this year, with Ontario rising most sharply and a 14% case fatality rate.
items.description_zh: 加拿大疫情呈逐年上升趨勢,今年迄今報告至少63例,多個地區病例增加,且各區流行型別不同,其中,安大略省疫情上升最為明顯( 42例),該國去年累計至少155例,為2012年以來新高,且多起死亡案例。此波疫情主要與COVID-19大流行後,常規疫苗接種率下降有關,該國已針對當地流行血清型,調整疫苗接種策略,以加強防治工作。另該疾病在該國致死率為14%,嬰兒和年輕成人為死亡高風險族群。
items.description_en: Meningococcal disease in Canada has shown a year-on-year upward trend. So far this year, at least 63 cases have been reported, with increases in several regions and different circulating serotypes in each region. Ontario has seen the most marked increase (42 cases). Last year, Canada reported at least 155 cases cumulatively, the highest since 2012, with several deaths. This wave is mainly associated with declining routine vaccination coverage after the COVID-19 pandemic. Canada has adjusted its vaccination strategy for locally circulating serotypes to strengthen prevention and control. The case fatality rate for this disease in Canada is 14%, and infants and young adults are at high risk of death.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 3月25-31日小兒麻痺新增阿富汗1例WPV1、奈及利亞1例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new WPV1 case in Afghanistan and one cVDPV2 case in Nigeria for 25–31 March, plus 14 WPV1 environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/25-31期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共14件,分別為阿富汗12件、巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 25–31 March, one new WPV1 case was reported in Afghanistan and one new cVDPV2 case in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling 14 samples: 12 in Afghanistan and two in Pakistan. One cVDPV2 environmental sample was newly reported in Somalia.

items.summary_zh: 印度亞美達巴德市4月1-5日累計22例傷寒病例,因水源污染及排水受損
items.summary_en: Ahmedabad, India, reported 22 typhoid cases from 1–5 April, mainly due to contaminated water and damaged drainage; 445 cases last year.
items.description_zh: 印度西部古加拉特州亞美達巴德市(Ahmedabad)4/1-5累計報告22例感染傷寒桿菌病例,主因為水源受污染及受損的排水系統。另該市去(2025)年累計報告445例傷寒病例,當局表示飲水衛生等設施已逐步改善。
items.description_en: In Ahmedabad, a city in the western Indian state of Gujarat, 22 cases of typhoid (Salmonella Typhi) infection were reported cumulatively for 1–5 April, mainly due to contaminated water sources and damaged drainage systems. The city reported 445 typhoid cases last year. Authorities say that drinking water hygiene and other facilities have been gradually improved.

items.headline_zh: 瑞典-急性病毒性A型肝炎/李斯特菌症
items.headline_en: Sweden – Acute viral hepatitis A / Listeriosis
items.summary_zh: 瑞典去年李斯特菌症達158例創新高,A型肝炎11例疑與冷凍莓果有關
items.summary_en: Sweden recorded a record-high 158 listeriosis cases last year, and 11 hepatitis A cases since September 2025 may be linked to frozen berries.
items.description_zh: 瑞典自去(2025)年9月至今年3月累計報告11例急性病毒性A型肝炎病例,病患年齡介於17-64歲,居住在全國不同地區,病毒型別為IA,經調查疑感染源為冷凍草莓或覆盆莓。另李斯特菌症為瑞典去年主要的食物及飲水傳染病,累計報告158例病例,疫情創歷史新高,其中,某餐廳爆發疫情,共有16例病例在用餐後生病,罹病者年齡較輕,且不屬於任何風險族群。
items.description_en: From September 2025 to March 2026, Sweden cumulatively reported 11 cases of acute viral hepatitis A, in patients aged 17–64 years living in different parts of the country. The virus genotype is IA. Investigation suggests the suspected source of infection was frozen strawberries or raspberries. Listeriosis was Sweden's main foodborne and waterborne disease last year, with 158 cases reported cumulatively, a record high. In one outbreak at a restaurant, 16 cases fell ill after dining there; these patients were younger and did not belong to any risk group.

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 岡山縣倉敷市某餐廳諾羅病毒群聚,24例病例占用餐顧客44%
items.summary_en: Norovirus caused a restaurant cluster of 24 cases in Kurashiki City, Okayama, accounting for 44% of diners; the prefecture recorded 7 foodborne clusters this year.
items.description_zh: 日本岡山縣倉敷市4/1報告某餐廳發生諾羅病毒感染群聚事件,累計報告24例病例,占整體用餐顧客的44%。另該縣今年累計報告7起食物中毒群聚事件,疫情高於去年同期,其中5起由諾羅病毒引起。
items.description_en: On 1 April, Kurashiki City in Okayama Prefecture, Japan, reported a norovirus infection cluster at a restaurant, with 24 cases reported cumulatively, accounting for 44% of all diners. In addition, the prefecture has reported 7 foodborne cluster outbreaks this year, higher than the same period last year, 5 of them caused by norovirus.

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年截至3月底逾9,100例腸病毒,較去年同期增2.4倍
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City reported over 9,100 enterovirus cases through March, a 2.4-fold rise over the same period last year, with EV71 at 56% and several deaths.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情快速上升,胡志明市今年截至3月底累計報告逾9,100例病例,病例數較去年同期增加2.4倍,多為5歲以下兒童,其中EV71型占56%,並報告多起死亡病例。當局表示近期EV71型為C1變異株,該變異株具高毒性且免疫逃脫特性,可能造成重複感染,且大多數嚴重病例並無明顯紅斑症狀。
items.description_en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising rapidly. Ho Chi Minh City reported more than 9,100 cases cumulatively this year through the end of March, a 2.4-fold increase over the same period last year. Most cases are children under 5 years of age. EV71 accounts for 56% of cases, and multiple deaths have been reported. Authorities say the recent EV71 strain is the C1 variant, which is highly virulent, has immune escape characteristics, may cause re-infection, and in most severe cases no obvious erythema symptoms are present.

items.headline_zh: 玻利維亞-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞南部塔里哈省今年2例漢他病毒症候群,均已死亡
items.summary_en: Bolivia's Tarija Department reported two fatal hantavirus syndrome cases this year, in men aged 30 and 36 with rodent exposure.
items.description_zh: 玻利維亞南部塔里哈省今年報告2例病例且皆已死亡,分別為30歲及36歲男性,從事農漁業,均有囓齒動物接觸史。該國去年報告48例漢他病毒肺症候群病例,其中塔里哈省報告15例。
items.description_en: In Tarija Department in southern Bolivia, two cases have been reported this year, both fatal, in men aged 30 and 36 who work in agriculture and fishing; both had a history of contact with rodents. Last year, Bolivia reported 48 cases of hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, 15 of them in Tarija Department.

items.headline_zh: 日本/孟加拉/墨西哥/美國/加拿大/瓜地馬拉-麻疹
items.headline_en: Japan / Bangladesh / Mexico / United States / Canada / Guatemala – Measles
items.summary_zh: 多國麻疹上升,孟加拉57%病例為6個月以下嬰兒,已啟動緊急接種
items.summary_en: Measles is rising in several countries; Bangladesh reports 722 confirmed cases this year, 57% in infants under six months, and emergency vaccination has begun.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情更新,今(2026)年截至4/1累計報告197例,其中28例為境外移入病例,以15-29年齡層為多(占50%),分布以東京都48例、鹿兒島縣24例、愛知縣23例及神奈川縣19例為多。該國去(2025)年報告265例確定病例。 孟加拉疫情上升,該國今年截至3月累計報告722例確定病例,其中僅3月即報告514例,57%病例為6個月以下嬰兒,自3月中旬以來已報告逾7,600例疑病例,近6週報告逾113例死亡,當局已針對30個高風險地區,共計逾130萬名6個月至5歲以下兒童啟動緊急疫苗接種作業。 美洲疫情持續,墨西哥今年截至4/6累計報告8,750例確定病例,其中9例死亡,病例數以西部哈利斯科州(5,062例)為多;美國今年截至4/2共33州累計報告1,671例確定病例,猶他州近期疫情上升;加拿大今年截至3/21累計報告650例確定病例,病例數以曼托巴省(392例)及亞伯達省(209例)為多;瓜地馬拉疫情上升,今年截至3/29共計22省累計報告3,594例確定病例,其中54%病例集中於中南部瓜地馬拉省,該國正聖週期間,宗教活動及旅遊增加,預期病例數將持續上升。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak update: as of 1 April this year, 197 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 28 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (48 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (24), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa Prefecture (19) reported the most. Japan reported 265 confirmed cases last year. Bangladesh's outbreak is rising: as of March this year, 722 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 514 were reported in March alone; 57% of cases were infants under 6 months old. Since mid-March, more than 7,600 suspected cases have been reported, and more than 113 deaths were reported over the past six weeks. Authorities have launched emergency vaccination for more than 1.3 million children aged 6 months to under 5 years in 30 high-risk areas. The outbreak in the Americas continues: as of 6 April this year, Mexico has reported 8,750 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 9 deaths, with most cases in western Jalisco State (5,062 cases). As of 2 April this year, the United States has reported 1,671 confirmed cases across 33 states, and the outbreak in Utah has recently risen. As of 21 March this year, Canada has reported 650 confirmed cases, mainly in Manitoba (392 cases) and Alberta (209 cases). Guatemala's outbreak is rising: as of 29 March this year, 3,594 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 22 departments, with 54% concentrated in Guatemala Department in the central-south. During Holy Week, religious activities and travel increased, and case numbers are expected to continue rising.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類病例,全球禽流感動物疫情以德國居多
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 case; globally, 21 countries reported 293 H5N1 animal outbreaks from 25 March to 3 April, led by Germany.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。今年累計報告H5N1流感4例、H9N2流感8例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計52國家/地區報告2,576起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共21國於2026/3/25-2026/4/3期間報告293起H5N1疫情,德國172起、丹麥36起、美國26起、波蘭12起、英國9起、泊爾/法國各5起、智利/荷蘭各4起、以色列/愛沙亞/比利時各3起、保加利亞/奈及利亞各2起、加拿大/墨西哥/奧地利/捷克/柬埔寨/羅馬亞/義大利各1起。 比利時於2026/4/3報告1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 加拿大於2026/3/31報告2起H5N5疫情。   美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/3/22-28共466個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡/加州共8個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Human cases: Cambodia has reported one new human H5N1 infection case. So far this year, 4 cases of H5N1, 8 cases of H9N2 and 1 case of H10N3 have been reported cumulatively; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 52 countries and regions have reported 2,576 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Twenty-one countries reported 293 H5N1 outbreaks during 25 March–3 April 2026: Germany 172, Denmark 36, the United States 26, Poland 12, the United Kingdom 9, Nepal and France 5 each, Chile and the Netherlands 4 each, Israel, Estonia and Belgium 3 each, Bulgaria and Nigeria 2 each, and Canada, Mexico, Austria, Czechia, Cambodia, Romania and Italy 1 each. Belgium reported 1 H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 3 April 2026. Canada reported 2 H5N5 outbreaks on 31 March 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 466 sampling sites for 22–28 March 2026, of which 8 sampling sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Oregon and California detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率降至2.08%,中國門診陽性率略降至2.4%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity fell to 2.08% in week 11, with China and Canada also declining; BA.3.2 reached 12.5% of global variants.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第11週(3/9-15)全球陽性率降為2.08%,其中僅東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國第13週(3/23-29)門診陽性率略降至2.4%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最高。 加拿大第11週陽性率降至3.1%,疫情已連續4週下降,變異株以PQ.2占大宗;另該國於1/18-2/14報告20例病例感染BA.3.2變異株。   評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占31.44%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30.68%),BA.3.2占比上升至12.5%(增加4.86%)。WHO公布之COVID-19全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估COVID-19對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,但不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段COVID-19尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前COVID-19疫苗疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 11 of this year (9–15 March), the global positivity rate fell to 2.08%, with a notable increase only in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region. China's outpatient positivity rate declined slightly to 2.4% in week 13 (23–29 March), with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Canada's positivity rate fell to 3.1% in week 11, and the epidemic has declined for four consecutive weeks, with PQ.2 the predominant variant. Canada also reported 20 cases infected with the BA.3.2 variant between 18 January and 14 February. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (31.44%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30.68%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%, an increase of 4.86%. WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current COVID-19 vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.summary_zh: 新加坡首次報告Ib型M痘本土傳播,今年截至3月21日累計7例
items.summary_en: Singapore reported its first locally transmitted clade Ib mpox cases, with 7 cases this year as of 21 March, versus 23 last year.
items.description_zh: 新加坡首次報告首起Ib型(clade Ib)本土傳播病例,第1例為30歲男性,近期無旅遊史,3/25出現症狀,3/31確診;第2例為34歲男性,近期有旅遊史,與第1例個案有長時間身體接觸,3/26出現症狀,4/1確診。該國今年截至3/21累計報告7例病例,去年累計報告23例病例。
items.description_en: Singapore has reported its first locally transmitted clade Ib mpox cases. Case 1 is a 30-year-old man with no recent travel history, who developed symptoms on 25 March and was confirmed on 31 March. Case 2 is a 34-year-old man with recent travel history who had prolonged physical contact with case 1; he developed symptoms on 26 March and was confirmed on 1 April. As of 21 March this year, Singapore has reported 7 cumulative cases, and 23 cases were reported last year.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦立百病毒病例降溫,2021-2025年累計約12例
items.summary_en: Kerala, India, issued a seasonal Nipah alert for April–September; about 12 cases were reported in 2021–2025, far fewer than 23 in 2018.
items.description_zh: 印度南部喀拉拉(Kerala)發布今年4至9月季節性警報,當地近年疫情已顯著降溫,2021-2025年累計報告約12例,遠低於2018年之23例(含21例死亡)。當局除宣導民眾避免食用受汙染水果及接觸患病動物外;鑑於過去曾發生因接觸病患體液而導致之院內感染,亦規範醫療機構落實嚴感控措施,防範人傳人風險。
items.description_en: Kerala State in southern India has issued a seasonal alert for April to September this year. Although local activity has declined markedly in recent years, with about 12 cases reported cumulatively for 2021–2025, this is far below the 23 cases (including 21 deaths) recorded in 2018. In addition to educating the public to avoid eating contaminated fruit and contact with infected animals, authorities, given past hospital-acquired infections from contact with patients' body fluids, have also required healthcare facilities to implement strict infection control measures to prevent human-to-human transmission.

items.summary_zh: 河南焦作1人遭流浪犬咬傷,犬隻經檢驗確認為狂犬病陽性
items.summary_en: A person in Jiaozuo, Henan, China, was bitten on the leg by a stray dog that tested positive for rabies and received post-exposure vaccination.
items.description_zh: 中國河南省焦作市近日報告1名個案遭流浪犬咬傷腿部,就醫診斷傷口分級為最嚴重的第三級,已接受專業處置與暴露後疫苗接種。該犬隻於被捕後3日內死亡,經檢驗確定為狂犬病陽性,當局已將犬隻進行無害化掩埋,並加強犬隻曾活動之區域消毒、社區流浪動物巡視及狂犬病防治衛教宣導。該國今年2月報告15例死亡病例。
items.description_en: One person in Jiaozuo City, Henan Province, China, was bitten on the leg by a stray dog and, on medical assessment, the wound was classified as Category III, the most severe grade. The person has received professional treatment and post-exposure vaccination. The dog died within three days of being captured and tested positive for rabies. Authorities have harmlessly buried the dog, strengthened disinfection of areas where it had been active, patrolled community stray animals and carried out rabies prevention education. The country reported 15 rabies deaths in February this year.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 多哥新增2例疫苗衍生型病毒,英國與納米比亞環境樣本檢出
items.summary_en: GPEI reported two new cVDPV2 cases in Togo for 19–25 March, plus cVDPV2 environmental detections in the UK (London) and Namibia.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/19-25期間,多哥新增cVDPV2共2例;環境樣本部分, cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為英國(倫敦)/納米比亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–25 March, Togo recorded two new cVDPV2 cases. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling two samples: one each in the United Kingdom (London) and Namibia.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 美國-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_en: United States – Enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli (EHEC) infection
items.summary_zh: 美國9例腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染,住院者1例併發HUS,疑與生起司有關
items.summary_en: The US reported 9 enterohaemorrhagic E. coli cases; one of three hospitalized patients developed HUS, and fresh cheese is the suspected source.
items.description_zh: 美國3/30報告9例病例,3例住院病患中有1例出現溶血性尿毒症症候群(HUS),病患分布於加州、佛羅里達州及德州,5歲以下病患占超過半數;當局調查疑感染源為某生產商製造的生起司,產品已下架。
items.description_en: The United States reported 9 cases as of 30 March. Of three hospitalized patients, one developed haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS). Cases were distributed across California, Florida and Texas, and children under 5 years accounted for more than half of cases. Authorities investigated and suspect the source of infection to be fresh cheese manufactured by a certain producer; the product has been withdrawn from sale.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年逾2.5萬例腸病毒,EV71占56%,南部8例死亡
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has recorded over 25,000 enterovirus cases this year through March, with EV71 at about 56% and 8 deaths in southern provinces.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情快速上升,今年截至3月累計報告逾25,000例,較去(2025)年同期增加約5倍。南部各省市(含胡志明市)今年截至第12週累計報告17,078例病例,較去年同期增加,其中8例死亡,EV71型於去年11月起再次檢出,迄今占約56%。因今年正每3年一次的流行週期,當局預估疫情將持續上升。
items.description_en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising rapidly. Cumulative cases this year through March exceed 25,000, about a five-fold increase over the same period last year. In the southern provinces and cities (including Ho Chi Minh City), 17,078 cases were reported cumulatively this year through week 12, an increase over the same period last year, with 8 deaths. EV71 has been detected again since November last year and currently accounts for about 56% of cases. Because this year coincides with the three-yearly epidemic cycle, authorities expect the epidemic to continue rising.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/阿富汗/莫三比克-霍亂
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / Afghanistan / Mozambique – Cholera
items.summary_zh: 全球今年截至2月22日累計36,953例霍亂、451例死亡
items.summary_en: WHO reports 36,953 cholera cases and 451 deaths globally as of 22 February this year, with new cases concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至2/22累計報告3萬6,953例病例、451例死亡,其中,2月新增病例數較今年1月下降3%,且較去年同期下降50%,各國CFR介於0-10%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共21個國家/地區,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗及莫三比克為多。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: The WHO reports that globally, as of 22 February this year, 36,953 cases and 451 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Compared with January this year, new cases in February fell by 3%, and were 50% lower than the same period last year; case fatality rates in countries range from 0–10%. Cases have been reported in 21 countries and regions across the Eastern Mediterranean, African, South-East Asian and American regions. Recent new cases are concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people are at risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,莫三比克

items.summary_zh: 澳洲北領地3月20-26日報告4例白喉,自去年累計33例皮膚白喉
items.summary_en: Australia's Northern Territory reported 4 confirmed diphtheria cases in 20–26 March, with 33 cutaneous cases since last year, exceeding past trends.
items.description_zh: 澳洲北領地 (NT) 於今年3/20-26報告4例確定病例,自去年累計報告33例皮膚白喉確定病例,已超過往年趨勢,當局亦已發布警示,並建議民眾檢視自身及家人疫苗接種情形。
items.description_en: The Northern Territory (NT) of Australia reported 4 confirmed cases during 20–26 March this year. Since last year, 33 confirmed cases of cutaneous diphtheria have been reported cumulatively, exceeding past trends. Authorities have issued a warning and recommend that the public check the vaccination status of themselves and their family members.

items.summary_zh: 美洲區去年確定百日咳46,870例,美國28,783例居首
items.summary_en: The Americas reported 46,870 confirmed pertussis cases last year, down from 66,184 in 2024; the United States accounted for 28,783 cases, including suspected.
items.description_zh: WHO美洲區更新流行病學報告,該區去年共計報告46,870例確定病例,低於2024年同期(66,184例),其中以美國病例數為多,共計報告28,783例確定(含疑)病例,以11-19歲年齡層為多,其次為秘魯(4,632例),另智利(3,387例)、巴西(2,682例)、墨西哥(1,596例)、阿根廷(1,210例)及哥倫比亞(1,178例)亦報告逾千例確定病例。另美國今年截至3/27已報告2,355例確定病例。
items.description_en: The WHO Americas Region has updated its epidemiological report. The region reported 46,870 confirmed cases last year, lower than the 66,184 reported in the same period of 2024. The United States reported the most, with 28,783 confirmed (including suspected) cases, mainly among people aged 11–19 years. Peru followed with 4,632 cases, and Chile (3,387), Brazil (2,682), Mexico (1,596), Argentina (1,210) and Colombia (1,178) each also reported more than 1,000 confirmed cases. In addition, the United States had reported 2,355 confirmed cases so far this year as of 27 March.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,巴西,智利,哥倫比亞,墨西哥,秘魯,美國

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年累計逾46例麻疹死亡,確診逾1,500例,3月兒童死亡21例
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported over 46 measles deaths and 1,500 confirmed cases this year, with 21 child deaths in March alone.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉爆發麻疹疫情,今年3月共計7地區報告21例兒童死亡病例,今年累計報告逾46例死亡病例,當局表示疫情從去(2025)年12月開始上升,於3月急遽增加,疫情於全國大部分地區流行,確診病例逾1,500例,惟仍未掌握疫情相關死亡資訊。該國最近一次麻疹疫苗接種活動為2020年,多數兒童未定時接種疫苗,另全國有疫苗短缺問題,當局已進行緊急疫苗採購並籌備專門醫院。
items.description_en: Bangladesh is experiencing a measles outbreak. In March this year, 7 regions reported 21 child deaths, and more than 46 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year. Authorities say the outbreak began rising in December last year, increased sharply in March, and is now circulating in most parts of the country. More than 1,500 confirmed cases have been reported, but information on outbreak-related deaths is still lacking. The country's most recent measles vaccination campaign was in 2020, and most children have not been vaccinated on schedule. The country also faces a vaccine shortage; authorities have carried out emergency vaccine procurement and are preparing a dedicated hospital.

items.headline_en: Anguilla (British Overseas Territory) – West Nile fever
items.summary_zh: 英國海外領地安吉拉報告1例本土西尼羅熱,25歲患者已住院
items.summary_en: Anguilla, a British Overseas Territory, reported a locally acquired West Nile fever case in a 25-year-old with no recent travel, now hospitalised.
items.description_zh: 安吉拉(英國海外領土)報告1例25歲本土病例,近期無旅遊史,3/7出現發燒、頭痛、嘔吐、腹痛等症狀,並已住院治療,當局已採取相關防治措施。
items.description_en: Anguilla, a British Overseas Territory, has reported one locally acquired case in a 25-year-old with no recent travel history. Symptoms of fever, headache, vomiting and abdominal pain began on 7 March; the patient has been hospitalized for treatment. Authorities have implemented relevant prevention and control measures.

items.headline_zh: 法屬新喀里多尼-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 法屬新喀里多尼亞登革熱疫情擴大,截至3月25日累計432例
items.summary_en: New Caledonia reported 432 dengue cases as of 25 March, its first major outbreak since 2019, with over 80 new cases in one week; DENV-1 predominates.
items.description_zh: 法屬新喀里多亞宣布自2019年以來首次發生之較大規模流行疫情,近1週新增逾80例病例,並蔓延至多個市鎮,截至3/25累計報告432例病例,造成此次疫情之主要型別為DENV-1。
items.description_en: New Caledonia, a French overseas territory, has announced its first major epidemic since 2019. More than 80 new cases were reported in the past week, and the outbreak has spread to several municipalities. As of 25 March, 432 cases have been reported cumulatively. The main serotype causing this outbreak is DENV-1.

items.headline_zh: 法屬圭亞那/蘇利南-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 蘇利南今年逾1,357例屈公病檢驗陽性、1例死亡,法屬圭亞那確診65例
items.summary_en: Suriname has more than 1,357 test-positive chikungunya cases and one death this year, while French Guiana has 65 confirmed cases as of 22 March.
items.description_zh: 法屬圭亞那於今年1月下旬報告自2014年以來首次發生本土病例,截至3/22累計65例確診病例,近期仍持續有病例發生,其中88%分布於西部沿海地區。 蘇利南自今年1月宣布爆發疫情以來,病例數明顯上升,已逾1,357例檢驗陽性及1例死亡,病例分布於該國8個行政區。當局表示病例數低估,並預期疫情可能隨著雨季到來而上升。
items.description_en: French Guiana reported its first locally acquired cases since 2014 in late January this year. As of 22 March, 65 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, and cases continue to occur; 88% are distributed along the western coast. Suriname has seen a marked rise in cases since it declared an outbreak in January this year, with more than 1,357 test-positive cases and 1 death reported, distributed across eight administrative districts. Authorities say case numbers are underestimated and expect the outbreak may rise with the arrival of the rainy season.

items.summary_zh: 2月新增1,184例M痘確診,58.6%來自非洲,全球累計逾18萬例
items.summary_en: Mpox saw 1,184 new confirmed cases in February across 46 countries, 58.6% in Africa; globally over 181,000 cases since 2022, at least 492 deaths.
items.description_zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年2/28累計144國/地區報告18萬1千餘例確診病例,其中,至少492例死亡。 今年2月共計46國家/地區報告1,184 例新增確診病例,其中4例死亡,58.6%來自非洲地區,相較今年1月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降或持平,阿根廷、奧地利及中非共和國通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/2/1-3/15)共計17國通報907例確診病例,其中7例死亡,以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、肯亞、蒲隆地及賴比瑞亞為高;非洲以外地區,奧地利、比利時、葡萄牙、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。
items.description_en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.
