items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國新增2例H9N2及1例H1N1v,義大利新增1例H9N2
items.summary_en: Italy reported 1 new human H9N2 case and China 2 new H9N2 and 1 H1N1v cases; 89 H5N1 animal outbreaks were reported in 18 countries 20–27 March.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:義大利新增1例H9N2流感人類感染病例,中國新增2例H9N2及1例H1N1v流感人類感染病例。今年累計報告H5N1流感3例、H9N2流感8例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計51國家/地區報告2,285起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  共18國於2026/3/20-2026/3/27期間報告89起H5N1疫情,波蘭17起、泊爾/瑞典各12起、荷蘭9起、英國7起、愛沙亞/比利時各6起、南韓4起、法國3起、挪威/捷克/摩爾多瓦/芬蘭各2起、奧地利/德國/愛爾蘭/斯洛維亞/義大利各1起。 共2國於2026/3/21-26期間報告4起H5 (N untyped)疫情,秘魯3起、比利時1起。 丹麥於2026/3/20報告1起H5N5疫情。 南韓於2026/3/23報告4起H5N9疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/3/15-21共445個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/加州共9個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Human cases: Italy reported 1 new human H9N2 influenza infection, and China reported 2 new H9N2 cases and 1 new H1N1v human infection. So far this year, 3 cases of H5N1, 8 cases of H9N2 and 1 case of H10N3 have been reported cumulatively; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 51 countries and regions have reported 2,285 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. A total of 18 countries reported 89 H5N1 outbreaks during 20–27 March 2026: Poland 17, Nepal and Sweden 12 each, the Netherlands 9, the United Kingdom 7, Estonia and Belgium 6 each, South Korea 4, France 3, Norway, Czechia, Moldova and Finland 2 each, and Austria, Germany, Ireland, Slovenia and Italy 1 each. Two countries reported 4 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 21–26 March 2026: Peru 3 and Belgium 1. Denmark reported 1 H5N5 outbreak on 20 March 2026. South Korea reported 4 H5N9 outbreaks on 23 March 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided test results from 445 sampling sites for 15–21 March 2026, of which 9 sampling sites in New Jersey, Illinois and California detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率降至2.27%,XFG占比48.87%居首
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity fell to 2.27% in week 10; XFG leads at 48.87%, and the US reported its first locally acquired BA.3.2 case on 25 March.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第10週(3/2-8)全球陽性率降為2.27%,其中僅東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第11週陽性率降至2.5%,變異株以XFG為主。該國自去(2025)年6月報告首例BA.3.2變異株之境外移入病例以來,於今年3/25新增報告首例BA.3.2變異株的本土病例。另美國CDC近期研究顯示,截至今年2/11全球累計23國報告BA.3.2變異株病例,其中BA.3.2變異株占德國、丹麥及荷蘭通報數的30%。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占48.87%),其次為NB.1.8.1(16.59%)。WHO公布「全球長期快速風險評估」(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,然不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段COVID-19尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 10 of this year (2–8 March), the global positivity rate fell to 2.27%, with a notable increase only in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region. The United States' epidemic is declining, with the positivity rate down to 2.5% in week 11, and XFG the main variant. Since the first imported case of the BA.3.2 variant was reported last June, the first locally acquired BA.3.2 case was newly reported on 25 March this year. A recent US CDC study shows that as of 11 February this year, 23 countries worldwide had reported BA.3.2 cases cumulatively, and BA.3.2 accounted for 30% of reports in Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (48.87%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (16.59%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.summary_zh: 日本今年截至3/18累計139例麻疹,鹿兒島高中畢業典禮相關群聚13例
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 139 measles cases this year as of 18 March, 27 imported; a Kagoshima cluster of 13 cases is linked to a high school graduation ceremony.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情更新,今(2026)年截至3/18累計報告139例,其中27例為境外移入病例,以15-29年齡層為多(占53%),分布以東京都32例、愛知縣23例及千葉縣16例為多。另鹿兒島縣於3/25報告群聚事件,共計13例病例與3/2舉辦之高中畢業典禮相關,該縣自3/6報告首例以來,累計報告22例確定病例,當局已公佈於傳染期內有密集接觸人群之病例活動史,另提醒民眾倘有疑症狀,應及時就醫。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak update: as of 18 March this year, 139 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 27 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (53%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (32 cases), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Chiba Prefecture (16) reported the most. In addition, Kagoshima Prefecture reported a cluster on 25 March: 13 cases were linked to a high school graduation ceremony held on 2 March. Since the prefecture's first case was reported on 6 March, 22 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities have published the activity histories of cases who had dense contact with people during their infectious period, and reminded the public to seek medical care promptly if they have suspicious symptoms.

items.summary_zh: 砂拉越今年第3例狂犬病死亡,10歲男童曾被流浪犬咬傷僅清洗傷口
items.summary_en: Sarawak's third rabies case this year, a 10-year-old boy bitten by a stray dog who only washed the wound, died on 18 March.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越報告今年第3例病例,為古晉市10歲男童,2/11遭流浪犬咬傷後僅清洗傷口,於3月初開始出現症狀,經住院治療後於3/18死亡。該州今年截至3/14累計報告4,623例遭動物咬傷病例,其中遭貓咬傷病例數上升,已多於流浪犬咬傷之病例。
items.description_en: Sarawak, Malaysia, reported its third case this year: a 10-year-old boy from Kuching City who was bitten by a stray dog on 11 February and only washed the wound. Symptoms appeared in early March, and after hospital treatment he died on 18 March. As of 14 March, the state has reported 4,623 cumulative animal-bite cases this year; cat-bite cases have risen and now exceed dog-bite cases.

items.summary_zh: 秘魯今年累計1,045例鉤端螺旋體病,含3例死亡,已蔓延23個大區
items.summary_en: Peru has reported 1,045 leptospirosis cases this year, including 3 deaths, with the outbreak spreading to 23 regions nationwide.
items.description_zh: 秘魯疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告1,045例病例(含3例死亡),其中39%為確診病例,61%為疑個案。疫情已蔓延全國 23 個大區,以東北部洛雷托大區(Loreto)300例最多。當局發布警報,加強流病監測、辦理醫護臨床培訓及擴充檢驗量能,並呼籲民眾避免接觸受污染水體。
items.description_en: Peru's outbreak is rising. So far this year, 1,045 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 3 deaths; 39% are confirmed cases and 61% are suspected cases. The outbreak has spread to 23 regions nationwide, with the most cases (300) in Loreto Region in the northeast. Authorities have issued an alert, strengthened epidemiological surveillance, provided clinical training for health care workers, expanded testing capacity, and called on the public to avoid contact with contaminated water.

items.summary_zh: 義大利倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2人類感染,患者於非歐洲國家感染
items.summary_en: Lombardy, Italy, reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza case, a patient infected in a non-European country who is being treated in hospital.
items.description_zh: 義大利北部倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2流感人類感染病例,病患來自非歐洲國家且於該地感染,感染前健康狀況不佳,住院治療中。另已啟動專家小組,以利與相關國際機構進行協調,並持續監控中。 全球約90%報告H9N2病例報告自中國,另越南、印度、埃及、塞內加爾及迦納也曾報告過病例,該病毒主要透過直接接觸受感染之家禽或受污染環境傳播,人類感染症狀輕微,尚未有人際間傳播案例。
items.description_en: Lombardy Region in northern Italy has reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza infection. The patient came from a non-European country and was infected there; the patient was in poor health before infection and is being treated in hospital. Authorities have also activated an expert group to coordinate with relevant international agencies, and monitoring continues. Around 90% of H9N2 cases reported globally have come from China; Viet Nam, India, Egypt, Senegal and Ghana have also reported cases. The virus is transmitted mainly through direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; human infections have mild symptoms, and no human-to-human transmission has been reported.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 3月12-18日新增阿富汗1例WPV1,cVDPV2新增4例分布3國
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new WPV1 case in Afghanistan and four cVDPV2 cases across three countries for 12–18 March, with 27 WPV1 environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/12-18期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為奈及利亞2例、安哥拉/索馬利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共27件,分別為阿富汗20件、巴基斯坦7件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為查德/索馬利亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 March, WPV1 added one case in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 added four cases in three countries: two in Nigeria, and one each in Angola and Somalia. For environmental samples, WPV1 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling 27 samples: 20 in Afghanistan and seven in Pakistan. cVDPV2 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling two samples: one each in Chad and Somalia.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,安哥拉,奈及利亞,索馬利亞

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年截至3/8達6,450例腸病毒,中國今年2月約8.8萬例
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City reported 6,450 enterovirus cases through 8 March and China about 88,000 through February, both above last year's levels.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市今年截至3/8累計報告6,450例病例,高於去年同期,另河內3/6-13新增報告136例病例,較前1週增加30例,並有校園群聚事件,重症多為EV71型病毒引起。 中國今年截至2月累計報告約8.8萬例病例,雖疫情已從2025年10月高峰的37萬例持續下降,仍高於2025年同期(2.3萬例)及2024年同期(3.5萬例)。另2025年第51-52週的報告顯示,病毒型別以克沙奇A16型(占26.3%)、腸病毒A71型(占20.4%)占大宗。
items.description_en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, reported 6,450 cases cumulatively this year through 8 March, higher than the same period last year. Hanoi also reported 136 new cases during 6–13 March, an increase of 30 cases over the previous week, and a school cluster has occurred; severe cases were mostly caused by EV71. China reported about 88,000 cases cumulatively this year through February. Although the epidemic has continued to decline from its October 2025 peak of 370,000 cases, it remains higher than the same period in 2025 (23,000 cases) and in 2024 (35,000 cases). In addition, reports for weeks 51–52 of 2025 show that the main virus types were Coxsackievirus A16 (26.3%) and Enterovirus A71 (20.4%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),越南

items.headline_zh: 中國/印度/義大利-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: China / India / Italy – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 中國今年2月累計2,106例A型肝炎,義大利那不勒斯新增7例
items.summary_en: China reported 2,106 hepatitis A cases through February, below the same period of 2025 but above 2024; Naples, Italy, added 7 cases on 22 March, possibly from raw seafood.
items.description_zh: 中國今年截至2月累計報告2,106例,雖低於2025年同期(4,515例),惟仍高於2024年同期(1,859)例。 印度克拉拉州埃爾訥古勒姆(Ernakulam)區今年1、2月各報告逾150例病例,疫情為該州歷年最高。 義大利那不勒斯(Naples)3/22新增7例病例,疑因生食餐廳海鮮導致感染,當局表示可能與情人節等假期用餐有關。
items.description_en: China reported 2,106 cases cumulatively this year through February, lower than the 4,515 cases in the same period of 2025, but still higher than the 1,859 cases in the same period of 2024. In Ernakulam District of Kerala State, India, more than 150 cases were reported in each of January and February this year, the highest for the state in its history. In Naples, Italy, 7 new cases were reported on 22 March. The infection is suspected to have been caused by eating raw seafood at restaurants, and authorities said it may be related to holiday meals such as Valentine's Day.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),印度,義大利

items.summary_zh: 自2022年9月起維德角旅遊相關桿菌性痢疾累計776例,涉13個歐盟國家
items.summary_en: ECDC reports 776 confirmed and suspected bacillary dysentery cases with Cape Verde travel history since September 2022, in 13 EU countries, the UK and the US.
items.description_zh: ECDC更新維德角相關疫情,自2022年9月截至今年3月,累計報告776例具維德角旅遊史的桿菌性痢疾確定及疑病例,病患分布於13個歐盟國家、英國及美國,經調查病患皆曾居住維德角某連鎖旅館,惟感染源尚未釐清,當局呼籲至維德角旅遊的遊客應落實食物飲水衛生措施。此外,同時期累積報告逾300例病例,感染其它病原體如沙門氏菌等。
items.description_en: The ECDC has updated information on the outbreak linked to Cape Verde. From September 2022 through March this year, 776 confirmed and suspected bacillary dysentery cases with travel history to Cape Verde have been reported cumulatively, distributed across 13 EU countries, the United Kingdom and the United States. Investigations found that all patients had stayed at a chain hotel in Cape Verde, but the source of infection has not yet been identified. Authorities urge travellers to Cape Verde to strictly observe food and water hygiene measures. In the same period, more than 300 cases of infection with other pathogens, such as Salmonella, were also reported cumulatively.

items.headline_zh: 英國/越南-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.headline_en: United Kingdom / Viet Nam – Meningococcal meningitis
items.summary_zh: 英國肯特郡迄3/23確診20例、死亡2例,越南安江省11歲女學生死亡
items.summary_en: Kent County, UK, has reported 20 confirmed meningococcal cases and 2 deaths as of 23 March; an 11-year-old girl died in An Giang, Viet Nam.
items.description_zh: 英國肯特郡迄3/23累計報告20例實驗室確診及3例可能病例,死亡2例,目前疫苗接種已超過8,000人,接受抗生素使用已超過12,100人,流行菌株經基因定序後確認為B群 Neisseria meningitidis ST‐485,屬已知「高度侵襲性(hyperinvasive)」克隆群之一。 越南今年於河內、河寧、老街及安江等地爆發疫情,並已發布警報,其中安江省富國特區於3/16報告1例死亡病例,為11歲女學生,疫苗接種史不明,且未曾與確診病例接觸,雖接受治療,惟病情仍迅速惡化後死亡,其1位同學出現症狀並已接受治療,家人及鄰居等密切接觸者均已接受預防性抗生素或接種疫苗,迄未通報其他病例。另該國去(2025)年累計報告95例病例且為B型,其中3例死亡,疫情為2024年 (21例)的4.5倍。
items.description_en: Kent County, United Kingdom, has reported 20 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3 probable cases as of 23 March, with 2 deaths. More than 8,000 people have been vaccinated, and more than 12,100 people have received antibiotics. Genomic sequencing confirmed the epidemic strain as serogroup B Neisseria meningitidis ST-485, one of the known hyperinvasive clonal complexes. Viet Nam has had outbreaks this year in Hanoi, Ha Nam, Lao Cai and An Giang and has issued an alert. In Phu Quoc Special Zone of An Giang Province, one death was reported on 16 March in an 11-year-old female student with unknown vaccination history and no contact with a confirmed case; although she received treatment, her condition deteriorated rapidly and she died. One of her classmates developed symptoms and has been treated. Close contacts, including family members and neighbours, have received preventive antibiotics or vaccination, and no other cases have been reported. Viet Nam reported 95 cases last year, all serogroup B, of which 3 died; this year's outbreak is 4.5 times the 21 cases reported in 2024.
items.area_en: Vietnam United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥今年截至3/23累計3,422例結核病,去年逾2.1萬例
items.summary_en: Mexico has confirmed 3,422 tuberculosis cases in 32 states this year as of 23 March, with more than 21,000 reported last year, and the trend is rising.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至3/23共32州累計報告3,422例確定病例,主要分布於西北部下加利福亞、東部維拉克魯茲、南部恰帕斯州、東北部新雷昂及塔毛利帕斯州,專家表示該國邊境人口遷移及COVID-19大流行後疫苗接種率下降為病例數增加主因。該國去年報告逾2.1萬例。
items.description_en: Tuberculosis in Mexico is rising. As of 23 March this year, 3,422 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 32 states, mainly in Baja California in the northwest, Veracruz in the east, Chiapas in the south, Nuevo León in the northeast and Tamaulipas. Experts say that cross-border population movement and declining vaccination coverage after the COVID-19 pandemic are the main reasons for the rise in cases. The country reported more than 21,000 cases last year.

items.summary_zh: 截至3/1非洲區8國白喉疑病例逾2.9萬例、死亡1,420例,風險調降為中
items.summary_en: WHO's African Region reported over 29,000 suspected diphtheria cases and 1,420 deaths in eight countries through 1 March; regional risk was lowered to moderate.
items.description_zh: WHO非洲區自去(2025)年截至今年3/1共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2.9萬例疑病例,其中1.8萬例為確定病例,1,420例死亡,752例經實驗室確診,相較WHO於去年10月進行之風險評估,疑病例新增約1.1萬例,死亡人數新增529例,奈及利亞為該區疑及死亡病例最多國家,佔5成以上,病患以5-14歲兒童年齡層及女性為主。WHO考量該區每週新增病例數整體呈下降趨勢且多數國家已啟動應變工作,惟仍有診斷試劑/檢驗/藥物缺乏等問題,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險由「高」調整為「中」,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為「低」,惟仍須留意至非洲區旅遊之罹病風險。
items.description_en: The WHO African Region reported more than 29,000 suspected cases from last year through 1 March this year across eight countries (Algeria, Chad, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria, Mali and South Africa). Of these, 18,000 were classified as confirmed cases, 1,420 died, and 752 were laboratory-confirmed. Compared with the WHO risk assessment conducted in October last year, suspected cases increased by about 11,000 and deaths by 529. Nigeria accounted for more than half of the suspected and fatal cases in the region, and patients were mainly children aged 5–14 years and females. WHO noted that weekly new cases in the region are generally declining and most countries have activated response operations, but shortages of diagnostic tests, laboratory capacity and drugs persist. WHO has therefore revised the overall public health risk for the African Region from 'high' to 'moderate'. Most countries outside Africa have robust immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is assessed as 'low'; however, the risk of disease for travellers to the African Region should still be noted.
items.area_zh: 阿爾及利亞,查德,赤道幾內亞,茅利塔尼亞,尼日,奈及利亞,馬利,南非

items.summary_zh: WHO非洲區今年第10週3,988例疑病例、173例死亡,尼日與查德達流行閾
items.summary_en: WHO's African Region reported 3,988 suspected meningitis cases and 173 deaths by week 10; Niger and Chad have reached the epidemic threshold.
items.description_zh: WHO非洲區今年截至第10週累計報告3,988例疑病例及173例死亡病例,其中日及查德共計2地區達疫情流行閾,中非共和國、日、剛果民主共和國、查德及多哥部分地區達警戒閾。疑病例中,312例經實驗室檢驗病原體,其中包含肺炎鏈球菌(42.9%)、腦膜炎雙球菌C型(38.5%)、腦膜炎雙球菌W型(10.9%)、非b型流感嗜血桿菌(1.3%)等。
items.description_en: The WHO African Region reported 3,988 suspected cases and 173 deaths as of week 10 this year. Niger and Chad have reached the epidemic threshold, while parts of the Central African Republic, Niger, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Chad and Togo have reached the alert threshold. Of the suspected cases, 312 were tested in the laboratory for pathogens, including Streptococcus pneumoniae (42.9%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (38.5%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup W (10.9%), non-type b Haemophilus influenzae (1.3%) and others.
items.area_zh: 中非共和國,查德,剛果民主共和國,尼日,多哥
items.area_en: Central African Republic,Chad,Congo,Democratic Republic of the,Niger,Togo

items.summary_zh: 美國今年1,478例、墨西哥7,584例麻疹確定病例,葉門疫情嚴峻
items.summary_en: As of 20 March, the US had 1,478 and Mexico 7,584 confirmed measles cases this year, while Yemen's outbreak is severe, with vaccination coverage at just 7% in Hadramawt.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續,今年截至3/20共32州累計報告1,478例確定病例,其中74例住院,病患以5-19歲年齡層族群(781例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(668例),其次為猶他州(275例)及德州(147例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他/德州,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至3/20累計報告7,584例確定病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以西部哈利斯科州(4,439例)、南部恰帕斯州(650例)、中部墨西哥城(563例)為多。全國各州自去年迄今皆有報告病例,並以1-4歲兒童病例為多。 葉門疫情嚴峻,政府控制區於今年1月報告逾1,200例確定及8例死亡病例,另哈德拉毛沿海地區病例數急遽上升,該區疫苗接種率僅為7%,當局表示非政府控制區的疫情可能更加嚴重。估計該國去(2025)年累計逾2.3萬確定病例。
items.description_en: The United States outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 1,478 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 32 states, of which 74 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (781 cases), and cases are concentrated in South Carolina (668 cases), followed by Utah (275 cases) and Texas (147 cases). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah and Texas, and 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 7,584 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths. Cases are concentrated in western Jalisco State (4,439 cases), southern Chiapas State (650 cases) and Mexico City in the central region (563 cases). All states have reported cases since last year, mainly among children aged 1–4 years. Yemen's outbreak is severe: in government-controlled areas, more than 1,200 confirmed cases and 8 deaths were reported in January this year, and cases have risen sharply in the coastal area of Hadramawt, where vaccination coverage is only 7%. Authorities say the outbreak in areas not controlled by the government may be even more severe. The country is estimated to have reported more than 23,000 confirmed cases cumulatively last year.

items.summary_zh: 納米比亞今年1-5週累計11,327例瘧疾,73%為本土病例,21例死亡
items.summary_en: Namibia reported 11,327 confirmed malaria cases in weeks 1–5 this year, 73% locally acquired, with 21 deaths.
items.description_zh: 納米比亞疫情上升,今年1-5週累計報告11,327例確診病例,其中,73%為本土病例,27%為境外移入病例,共21例死亡。
items.description_en: Malaria in Namibia is rising. From week 1 to week 5 this year, 11,327 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively; 73% were locally acquired and 27% were imported. A total of 21 deaths have been reported.

items.summary_zh: 巴拿馬今年1-2月累計1,232例登革熱,4例死亡,149例住院
items.summary_en: Panama reported 1,232 dengue cases in January–February this year, including 4 deaths, with 149 patients currently hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,今年1-2月累計報告1,232例病例,其中5例為重症病例,4例死亡,目前149例住院治療,當局呼籲民眾加強預防措施。
items.description_en: Panama's dengue update: from January to February this year, 1,232 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 5 were severe and 4 died. Currently 149 patients are hospitalized for treatment. Authorities call on the public to strengthen preventive measures.

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年第1-7週4國34例黃熱病確診、15例死亡,CFR 44%
items.summary_en: The Americas reported 34 confirmed yellow fever cases and 15 deaths (CFR 44%) in weeks 1–7 across four countries; PAHO issued an alert.
items.description_zh: 美洲地區今年1-7週共4國累計34例確診病例及15例死亡(CFR:44%),分布於哥倫比亞(25例病例及13例死亡)、委內瑞拉(6例病例及1例死亡)、玻利維亞(1例死亡)及秘魯(2例病例)。自2024年9月以來,病例已發生於先前無疫情傳播地區,如亞馬遜雨林以外地區,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,呼籲各國加強監測及疫苗接種等措施。
items.description_en: In the Americas, weeks 1–7 of this year, 4 countries reported a cumulative 34 confirmed cases and 15 deaths (CFR: 44%), distributed as follows: Colombia (25 cases and 13 deaths), Venezuela (6 cases and 1 death), Bolivia (1 death) and Peru (2 cases). Since September 2024, cases have occurred in areas with no previous transmission, including areas outside the Amazon rainforest. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert and called on countries to strengthen surveillance, vaccination and other measures.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,哥倫比亞,秘魯,委內瑞拉

items.headline_zh: 香港-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 香港新增3歲男童流行性腦脊髓膜炎確定病例,今年累計4例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a meningococcal meningitis case in a 3-year-old boy, its fourth confirmed case this year, unrelated to the UK clusters.
items.description_zh: 香港新增報告1例確定病例,為3歲男童,於3/17出現發燒及嘔吐等症狀,隔日就醫並住院治療,目前病情嚴重,經檢驗為腦膜炎雙球菌陽性。病患於潛伏期間無國外旅遊史,密切接觸者迄3/20無人發病,當局已提供接觸者預防性藥物及持續進行疫情調查。香港今年累計報告4例確定病例,當局表示病患皆與英國近期群聚案件無關聯,並提醒民眾復活節假期期間,預期有留學生返港,倘出現相關腦膜炎症狀,應儘速就醫。香港去(2025)年累計報告11例確定病例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong has newly reported 1 confirmed case, a 3-year-old boy who developed fever, vomiting and other symptoms on 17 March, sought medical care the next day and was hospitalized. His condition is currently serious, and testing confirmed Neisseria meningitidis. The patient had no overseas travel history during the incubation period. None of the close contacts had developed illness as of 20 March; authorities have provided preventive medication to contacts and continue the outbreak investigation. Hong Kong has reported 4 confirmed cases so far this year. Authorities said the patients are not linked to recent cluster cases in the United Kingdom, and reminded the public that overseas students are expected to return to Hong Kong during the Easter holiday; anyone with related meningitis symptoms should seek medical care as soon as possible. Hong Kong reported 11 confirmed cases last year.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 3/12-20期間14國報告373起H5N1,德國286起居首
items.summary_en: No new human cases this week; 14 countries reported 373 H5N1 animal outbreaks during 12–20 March, led by Germany with 286.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:本週無新增病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計49國家/地區報告2,188起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共14國於2026/3/12-20期間報告373起H5N1疫情,德國286起、美國39起、丹麥15起、波蘭8起、荷蘭7起、臺灣4起、加拿大/奧地利/愛沙亞/柬埔寨/立陶宛/蒙特內哥羅各2起、捷克/日本各1起。 秘魯於2026/3/14報告1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/3/8-14共452個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,伊利諾/紐澤西/奧勒岡/加州共8個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新: ECDC/EFSA/IZSV共同發布去年12月至今年2月之禽流感監測報告,歐洲共32國報告2,514 起高致病性禽流感A(H5)案例,以野鳥案占多數(2,108例)、家禽(289例)及圈養鳥類(117)例,所有檢出病毒均屬Clade 2.3.4.4b 支系,病毒型別以H5N1為主(99.7%),疫情於去年11月達高峰,隨冬季候鳥遷徙結束後呈現下降,惟整體病毒威脅仍高。哺乳類感染案例呈現增加趨勢,主要集中於紅狐及浣熊等野生動物,荷蘭首次發現疑野鳥病毒溢出至乳牛隻血清學證據,可能進一步影響乳製品供應鏈安全。前揭期間歐洲未出現人類病例,惟中國及柬埔寨報告10例人類感染病例,均與直接接觸感染禽類有關,ECDC評估一般民眾感染風險為「低」,惟職業暴露族群風險為「低至中」。
items.description_en: Epidemic update. Human cases: No new cases were reported this week. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 49 countries and regions have reported 2,188 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Fourteen countries reported 373 H5N1 outbreaks during 12–20 March 2026: Germany 286, the United States 39, Denmark 15, Poland 8, the Netherlands 7, Taiwan 4, Canada, Austria, Estonia, Cambodia, Lithuania and Montenegro 2 each, and Czechia and Japan 1 each. Peru reported 1 H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 14 March 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 452 sampling sites for 8–14 March 2026, of which 8 sampling sites in Illinois, New Jersey, Oregon and California detected H5-positive results. Other updates: The ECDC, EFSA and IZSV jointly published an avian influenza surveillance report covering December last year to February this year. Across 32 European countries, 2,514 highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5) cases were reported, mostly in wild birds (2,108), followed by poultry (289) and captive birds (117). All detected viruses belong to the clade 2.3.4.4b lineage, and H5N1 predominates (99.7%). The epidemic peaked in November last year and has declined since the end of the wild bird winter migration, but the overall viral threat remains high. Mammalian infections show an increasing trend, mainly in wild animals such as red foxes and raccoons. The Netherlands has for the first time found serological evidence of possible spillover of wild-bird virus into dairy cattle, which may further affect the safety of the dairy supply chain. No human cases were reported in Europe during this period, but China and Cambodia reported 10 human infections, all related to direct contact with infected poultry. ECDC assesses the risk to the general population as 'low' and the risk to occupationally exposed groups as 'low to moderate'.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率降至2.35%,新加坡上升至4.23%,XFG占48.79%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity fell to 2.35% in week 9, while Singapore rose to 4.23%, and XFG led variants at 48.79%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第9週(2/23-3/1)全球陽性率降為2.35%,其中僅西太平洋及非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 新加坡疫情上升,第9週陽性率為4.23%,變異株以JN.1為主。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第10週陽性率降至3.4%,變異株以XFG為主。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占48.79%),其次為NB.1.8.1(23.39%)。WHO公布之COVID-19全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估COVID-19對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,但不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段COVID-19尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前COVID-19疫苗疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 9 of this year (23 February–1 March), the global positivity rate fell to 2.35%, with a notable increase only in the WHO Western Pacific and African Regions. Singapore's epidemic is rising, with a positivity rate of 4.23% in week 9 and JN.1 the predominant variant. The United States' epidemic is declining, with the positivity rate down to 3.4% in week 10 and XFG the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (48.79%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (23.39%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current COVID-19 vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.summary_zh: 越南河內國家兒童醫院今年1-2月約3,000例兒童病例,疫情進入高峰
items.summary_en: Hanoi's National Children's Hospital recorded about 3,000 paediatric cases in January–February this year, with hospitalizations up on last year.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情上升,今年1-2月河內國家兒童醫院(National Children's Hospital)已有約3,000例兒童病例,其中約1/3住院治療,住院病例數較去年同期上升,顯示疫情進入高峰期。
items.description_en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising. From January to February this year, the National Children's Hospital in Hanoi has seen about 3,000 paediatric cases, of which about one third were hospitalized. Hospitalizations are higher than in the same period last year, indicating that the epidemic has entered its peak period.

items.headline_zh: 英國-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 英國肯特郡迄3/20累計34例腦脊髓膜炎,其中23例確診,2例死亡
items.summary_en: Kent County, UK, has reported 34 meningitis cases as of 20 March, 23 laboratory-confirmed, with 2 deaths; the strain may be Group B type 485.
items.description_zh: 英國肯特郡疫情更新,迄3/20累計報告34例,其中23例經實驗室確診,另有11例仍在調查中,死亡2例,目前疫苗接種已超過4,500人,接受抗生素使用已超過10,500人,初步分析此菌株可能屬於Group B type 485,惟仍持續確認中。當局評估帶原者出遊,可能造成其他地區出現病例,持續推動疫苗及抗生素措施,並密切監測疫情。
items.description_en: Kent County, UK, has updated its outbreak information: as of 20 March, 34 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 23 were laboratory-confirmed and 11 are still under investigation, with 2 deaths. More than 4,500 people have been vaccinated and more than 10,500 have received antibiotics. Preliminary analysis suggests the strain may belong to Group B type 485, though this is still being confirmed. Authorities assess that carriers who travel could lead to cases in other regions, and continue to promote vaccination and antibiotic measures and to monitor the situation closely.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 斐濟-人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
items.summary_zh: 斐濟去年新增2,003例愛滋病毒感染,另59例嬰兒出生時感染
items.summary_en: Fiji recorded 2,003 new HIV cases last year, with 59 infants infected at birth, and declared a nationwide HIV epidemic in January 2025.
items.description_zh: 斐濟於去(2025)年新增2,003例確定病例,另有59例嬰兒於出生時感染,該國於去年1月宣布全國爆發愛滋病疫情,主要原因為注射毒品者共用針頭及年輕人病例數增加。當局成立國家應變工作小組,惟人力缺乏,以致影響應變能力。該國2024年報告1,583例確定病例。
items.description_en: Fiji reported 2,003 new confirmed cases last year, and another 59 infants were infected at birth. In January last year (2025), the country declared a nationwide HIV epidemic, mainly due to needle-sharing among people who inject drugs and an increase in cases among young people. Authorities established a national response task force, but a shortage of staff has affected response capacity. The country reported 1,583 confirmed cases in 2024.

items.summary_zh: 美國紐約市首例Clade I境外移入M痘,阿根廷首例Ib本土病例
items.summary_en: New York City reported the first imported Clade I mpox case on 13 March, and Argentina its first locally acquired Clade Ib case, a 31-year-old man.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市於3/13報告首例Clade I境外移入病例,分支型別確診中,病患具歐洲旅遊史,目前隔離中,當局表示無本土傳播情形,評估對民眾風險為低。該國自2024年11月起累計報告12例Clade I病例,因應歐洲Clade Ib疫情上升,當局已加強疾病監測、接觸者追蹤及評估高風險群體之疫苗暴露後預防措施。 阿根廷報告首例Ib本土病例,為首都布宜諾斯艾利斯市31歲男性,病患於2/24出現皮疹、發燒、肌肉/頭痛/肛門直腸痛及淋巴結腫大等症狀。病患自述近期無國外旅遊史,惟於發病前曾與多名旅行者發生性關係。
items.description_en: New York City reported the first imported Clade I mpox case in the United States on 13 March; subclade typing is pending. The patient had travelled to Europe and is in isolation. Authorities say there is no local transmission and assess the risk to the public as low. Since November 2024 the United States has reported 12 Clade I cases cumulatively; in response to rising Clade Ib cases in Europe, authorities have strengthened disease surveillance, contact tracing and assessment of post-exposure vaccination for high-risk groups. Argentina reported its first locally acquired Clade Ib case, a 31-year-old man in the capital, Buenos Aires City, who developed rash, fever, muscle and headache pain, anorectal pain and lymphadenopathy from 24 February. The patient reports no recent international travel, but had sexual contact with several travellers before symptom onset.

items.summary_zh: 日本今年截至第10週累計100例麻疹,其中17例為境外移入
items.summary_en: Japan has reported 100 measles cases this year through week 10, 17 of them imported, with most aged 15–29 years.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情更新,今(2026)年截至第10週累計報告100例,其中17例為境外移入病例,以15-29年齡層為多(占49%),分布以東京都19例、愛知縣18例及神奈川/新潟縣各10例為多。當局提醒民眾倘有疑症狀,應先致電醫療機構,遵照指示就醫,並避免搭乘大眾運輸工具,另呼籲檢查是否已定期接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak update: as of week 10 this year, 100 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 17 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (49%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (19 cases), Aichi Prefecture (18) and Kanagawa and Niigata Prefectures (10 each) reported the most. Authorities advise that anyone with suspected symptoms should first call a medical institution and follow its instructions for seeking care, avoid using public transport, and check whether they have been vaccinated on schedule.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 3月5-11日WPV1新增5例,cVDPV3新增奈及利亞2例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported five new WPV1 cases in Afghanistan and Pakistan and two cVDPV3 cases in Nigeria for 5–11 March.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/5-11期間,WPV1新增2國共5例,分別為阿富汗4例及巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件,cVDPV2新增馬拉威2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 5–11 March, WPV1 newly reported five cases in two countries: four in Afghanistan and one in Pakistan. cVDPV3 newly reported two cases in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported six samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported two samples in Malawi.

items.summary_zh: 法國新增12例李斯特菌症,其中2例死亡,疑與某生產商肉醬相關食品有關
items.summary_en: France reported 12 new listeriosis cases, including 2 deaths, with a suspected link to a meat paste product from one producer, now withdrawn.
items.description_zh: 法國新增12例病例,其中2例死亡,病患採檢日介於2025年9月中旬至今年1/23,病患多為65歲以上。經當局調查,疑感染源為某生產商販售的肉醬相關食品,產品已下架。另該國自2021年以來,感染病例持續增加,2024年累計報告619例病例。
items.description_en: France has reported 12 new cases, including 2 deaths. Sampling dates for these patients range from mid-September 2025 to 23 January this year, and most patients are aged over 65. Authorities' investigation suggests the suspected source of infection is a meat paste product from a certain producer; the product has been withdrawn. In addition, infections in France have continued to rise since 2021, with 619 cases reported cumulatively in 2024.

items.headline_zh: 美國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 佛羅里達州郵輪諾羅病毒群聚累計193例,乘客141例、工作人員52例
items.summary_en: A norovirus cluster on a cruise ship in Florida has 193 cases (141 passengers, 52 crew); the ship arrived at Fort Lauderdale on 15 March.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州新增1起郵輪群聚事件,累計報告193例病例,分別為乘客141例、工作人員52例,病患占全體郵輪人員約3%。該郵輪於3/15抵達該州的羅德岱堡市港口(Fort Lauderdale),當局已介入調查及輔導感染管制措施。
items.description_en: Florida, USA, has reported one new cruise ship cluster, with 193 cases cumulatively: 141 passengers and 52 crew members. Patients account for about 3% of all cruise ship personnel. The ship arrived at the port of Fort Lauderdale in the state on 15 March, and authorities have intervened to investigate and advise on infection control measures.

items.headline_zh: 香港-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 香港A型肝炎群聚24例,病毒基因序列相同,14例有MSM經驗
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a 24-case hepatitis A cluster with identical viral sequences; 14 cases reported MSM experience, and sexual transmission is not ruled out.
items.description_zh: 香港公布1起群聚事件,累計報告24例病例,包括22例男性及2例女性個案,病患年齡介於18-55歲,病毒基因序列皆相同,發病日介於2025年9月至今年2月,經調查患者住所和曾光顧的餐廳並無重疊,有14例表示有MSM經驗。當局經調查不排除為性行為相關的群聚事件,呼籲需接種疫苗或諮商的民眾可撥打專線諮詢。
items.description_en: Hong Kong has announced a cluster that has reported 24 cumulative cases, including 22 men and 2 women aged 18–55 years. Viral genetic sequences are identical across cases, and symptom onset dates range from September 2025 to February this year. Investigation found no overlap between patients' homes and the restaurants they had visited, and 14 patients reported MSM experience. Authorities' investigation does not rule out a sexual-contact-related cluster, and people who need vaccination or counselling are advised to call the hotline for advice.

items.summary_zh: 宏都拉斯今年百日咳76例確定病例、8例死亡,與去年全年死亡數相當
items.summary_en: Honduras has confirmed 76 pertussis cases this year, including 8 deaths comparable to all of last year's; all deaths were in infants under three months.
items.description_zh: 宏都拉斯今年疫情嚴峻,迄今累計報告76例確定病例,其中8例死亡病例,與去(2025)年全年死亡數相當,死亡病例皆為月齡3個月以下嬰兒,當局呼籲民眾儘速攜帶1歲以下嬰兒完成疫苗接種。該國去年報告114例確定病例。
items.description_en: Honduras is experiencing a severe pertussis situation this year. So far, 76 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths, comparable to the full-year death toll last year. All deaths were in infants aged under 3 months. Authorities urge that infants under 1 year old be brought in promptly to complete vaccination. The country reported 114 confirmed cases last year.

items.summary_zh: 美國新墨西哥州今年首例漢他病毒症候群確定病例,病患已康復
items.summary_en: New Mexico reported its first confirmed hantavirus syndrome case this year, and the patient has recovered after hospital treatment.
items.description_zh: 美國新墨西哥州報告今年首例確定病例,病患住院治療後已康復,該州疫情多發生在5-8月,當局提醒民眾於春季大掃除前,應進行通風換氣,並於清理可能存在囓齒動物區域時,採取預防措施。該州於2025年累計報告7例確定病例,其中3例死亡,另自1993年以來累計142例確定病例,該州為該國病例數最多之地區。
items.description_en: New Mexico, USA, has reported its first confirmed case this year; the patient recovered after hospital treatment. Outbreaks in the state usually occur from May to August. Authorities remind residents to ventilate their homes before spring cleaning and to take precautions when clearing areas where rodents may be present. The state reported 7 confirmed cases in 2025, of which 3 died. Since 1993 the state has reported 142 confirmed cases cumulatively, the highest number of any state in the country.

items.headline_zh: 英國/剛果民主共和國-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.headline_en: United Kingdom / Democratic Republic of the Congo – Meningococcal meningitis
items.summary_zh: 英國肯特郡13例、剛果民主共和國曼姆博區24例,多為學生
items.summary_en: Kent County, England, reported 13 meningitis cases, and Mangembo district in the DRC reported 24 cases, mainly among students.
items.description_zh: 英國東南部肯特郡報告13例確定病例,其中11例住院,2例死亡,經調查部分病患曾於3/5-7至坎特伯里(Canterbury)之俱樂部(Club Chemistry),病患主要為19-21歲大學生,多名病患為肯特大學學生,當局已提供至俱樂部人員及密切接觸者預防性抗生素治療,另呼籲民眾倘出現疑症狀,應立即就醫。 剛果民主共和國中部省曼姆博(mangembo)區報告24例病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:37%),3例經實驗室確診,主要為13-24歲年齡族群,此波疫情起源於2月下旬,於短時間內發現多名中學生出現類症狀。
items.description_en: Kent County in south-east England has reported 13 confirmed cases, of which 11 were hospitalized and 2 died. Investigations found that some patients had visited a club, Club Chemistry, in Canterbury between 5 and 7 March. Patients were mainly university students aged 19–21 years, and several were students at the University of Kent. Authorities have provided preventive antibiotic treatment to club staff and close contacts, and urge the public to seek medical care immediately if they develop suspicious symptoms. In Mangembo district of the central province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 24 cases were reported, including 9 deaths (CFR: 37%), with 3 laboratory-confirmed. Most were aged 13–24 years. The outbreak began in late February, and several secondary school students were found with similar symptoms within a short period.
