items.summary_zh: 美國今年截至3/5累計1,362例麻疹,31州,92%未接種或接種史不明
items.summary_en: The US reported 1,362 confirmed measles cases in 31 states as of 5 March, with 92% unvaccinated or of unknown vaccination history.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至3/5共31州累計報告1,362例確定病例,其中65例住院,病患以5-19歲年齡層族群(737例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(664例),其次為猶他州(231例),92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。
items.description_en: As of 5 March this year, the United States has reported 1,362 confirmed cases cumulatively across 31 states, of which 65 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (737 cases), and cases are concentrated in South Carolina (664 cases), followed by Utah (231 cases). 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history.

items.summary_zh: 蘇丹北方州截至3/7逾600例登革熱、4例死亡,智利復活節島報告本土病例
items.summary_en: Sudan's Northern State has reported over 600 dengue cases and 4 deaths as of 7 March, and Chile's Easter Island reported a local case.
items.description_zh: 智利復活節島報告2024年以來首例本土病例,截至3/8累計14例確診病例,有2例住院治療。當地於2002年爆發由DENV-1引發之疫情,其後經歷多次不同流行型別疫情,為該國登革熱主要傳播地區。 蘇丹北方州病例數快速上升,截至3/7累計報告逾600例病例及4例死亡,該國自去年迄今年2月報告逾63,000例疑病例,分布於數州。疫情通常在6月雨季開始後上升,並持續至10月。
items.description_en: Easter Island in Chile reported its first local case since 2024; 14 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively as of 8 March, and 2 are hospitalized. The island had an outbreak caused by DENV-1 in 2002, followed by several outbreaks of different serotypes, and it is the main dengue transmission area in the country. In Northern State, Sudan, case numbers have risen rapidly: as of 7 March, more than 600 cases and 4 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The country reported more than 63,000 suspected cases from last year through February this year, distributed across several states. Outbreaks usually rise after the rainy season begins in June and continue until October.

items.headline_zh: 阿根廷/玻利維亞-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 阿根廷薩爾塔省今年截至第8週屈公病36例,已出現本土傳播
items.summary_en: Argentina's Salta Province reported 36 chikungunya cases (29 confirmed) by week 8 this year, and local transmission has now been recorded.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,本季報告2,217例疑病例,西北部薩爾塔省於今年截至第8週報告36例病例(29例確診),分布於該省不同地區,主要為44-65歲族群。自2025年底以來,美洲地區疫情上升,鄰近之玻利維亞病例數上升,導致阿根廷多地發生境外移入病例,後續亦出現本土傳播病例。
items.description_en: Argentina's epidemic update: this season, 2,217 suspected cases have been reported. In Salta Province in the northwest, 36 cases (29 confirmed) were reported as of week 8 this year, distributed across different parts of the province, mainly in the 44–65 age group. Since late 2025, case numbers in the Americas have risen, and case numbers in neighbouring Bolivia have increased, leading to imported cases in several parts of Argentina, followed by locally acquired cases.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,45歲女性確診前曾接觸病死家禽
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, a 45-year-old woman who had contact with dead poultry three days before diagnosis; two cases this year.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染病例,為該國西北部班迭棉吉省45歲女性,目前於醫院隔離並使用Tamiflu藥物治療中,經調查病患確診前3日曾接觸病死家禽,居住的村莊內亦有生病/死亡的雞鴨報告,該國今年累計報告2例H5N1人類感染病例。
items.description_en: Cambodia has reported one new human H5N1 infection, in a 45-year-old woman from Banteay Meanchey Province in the northwest of the country. She is isolated in hospital and receiving treatment with Tamiflu. Investigation found that she had contact with dead poultry 3 days before diagnosis, and sick or dead chickens and ducks had been reported in her village. Cambodia has reported 2 human H5N1 infection cases so far this year.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 3/7-14期間22國報告162起H5N1疫情,人類本週無新增病例
items.summary_en: No new human avian influenza cases this week; 22 countries reported 162 H5N1 animal outbreaks during 7–14 March.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:本週無新增病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計48國家/地區報告1,822起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共22國於2026/3/7-14期間報告162起H5N1疫情,印24起、英國23起、波蘭20起、西班牙19起、荷蘭14起、丹麥12起、瑞典7起、捷克6起、保加利亞/德國/愛沙亞/比利時各5起、匈牙利/挪威/法國各3起、奧地利2起、哥倫比亞/奈及利亞/巴西/智利/羅馬亞/義大利各1起。 共3國於2026/3/12-13期間報告8起H5 (N untyped)疫情,比利時5起、烏拉圭2起、秘魯1起。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/3/1-7共499個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,伊利諾/紐澤西/奧勒岡/加州共8個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Epidemic update. Human cases: No new cases were reported this week. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 48 countries and regions have reported 1,822 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Twenty-two countries reported 162 H5N1 outbreaks during 7–14 March 2026: India 24, the United Kingdom 23, Poland 20, Spain 19, the Netherlands 14, Denmark 12, Sweden 7, Czechia 6, Bulgaria, Germany, Estonia and Belgium 5 each, Hungary, Norway and France 3 each, Austria 2, and Colombia, Nigeria, Brazil, Chile, Romania and Italy 1 each. Three countries reported 8 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 12–13 March 2026: Belgium 5, Uruguay 2 and Peru 1. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 499 sampling sites for 1–7 March 2026, of which 8 sampling sites in Illinois, New Jersey, Oregon and California detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率降至2.75%,XFG占比44.5%居首,歐洲降至低點
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity fell to 2.75% in week 8; XFG leads at 44.5%, and Europe's epidemic has reached a low point.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第8週(2/16-22)全球陽性率降為2.75%,其中僅東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情於低點略升,第10週(3/1-7)門診陽性率增為2.6%,變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為多。 香港疫情於低點略升,第10週陽性率增為0.17%,汙水監測變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為多(占62.8%)。 加拿大疫情略降,今年第8週(2/22-28)陽性率降為4.7%,惟高於去年同期,病患以65歲以上佔大宗(55.9%),變異株占比以NB.1.8.1為多。 歐洲疫情降至低點,第9週整體住院陽性率降為1.1%,變異株改為NB.1.8.1占大宗(62%)、其次為XFG(38%)。  評估與建議: 近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占44.5%),其次為NB.1.8.1(23.39%)。WHO公布之全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,但不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前COVID-19疫苗疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 8 of this year (16–22 February), the global positivity rate fell to 2.75%, with a notable increase only in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region. China's epidemic has risen slightly from its low point, with the outpatient positivity rate increasing to 2.6% in week 10 (1–7 March), and NB.1.8.1 accounting for the largest share of variants. Hong Kong's epidemic has risen slightly from its low point; the positivity rate increased to 0.17% in week 10, and NB.1.8.1 accounted for the largest share of variants in wastewater surveillance (62.8%). Canada's epidemic has declined slightly; the positivity rate fell to 4.7% in week 8 (22–28 February), though it remains higher than the same period last year. Patients aged over 65 account for the majority (55.9%), and NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. Europe's epidemic has reached a low point; the overall hospital positivity rate fell to 1.1% in week 9, and NB.1.8.1 (62%) and XFG (38%) became the main variants. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (44.5%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (23.39%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current COVID-19 vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至3/9逾13萬例流感、15,041例住院、8例死亡,近1週下降
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported over 130,000 influenza cases this year through 9 March, with 15,041 hospitalized and 8 deaths; cases fell over the past week.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至3/9累計報告逾13萬例病例,其中15,041例住院,8例死亡,發生率以北部帕堯/南邦/彭世洛/清邁府及東部烏汶府為高,年齡層發生率則以5-9歲為多,其次為0-4歲,死亡病患多為60歲以上長者,尤以具慢性病史或未接種過疫苗者為主。當局表示近1週病例數下降且低於去(2025)年同期,惟仍高於過去5年平均,流感於社區持續傳播,呼籲民眾落實個人衛生,該國去年累計報告逾110萬例病例,預期今年病例數將高於去年。
items.description_en: Thailand reported more than 130,000 cases cumulatively this year through 9 March, of which 15,041 were hospitalized and 8 died. Incidence is highest in the northern provinces of Phayao, Nan, Phitsanulok and Chiang Mai, and in the eastern province of Ubon Ratchathani. By age, incidence is highest among those aged 5–9 years, followed by those aged 0–4 years. Deaths were mainly among people over 60, especially those with chronic conditions or who had not been vaccinated. Authorities say case numbers fell over the past week and are lower than the same period last year, but remain higher than the five-year average. Influenza continues to spread in the community, and the public is urged to maintain personal hygiene. The country reported more than 1.1 million cases last year, and case numbers this year are expected to exceed last year's.

items.summary_zh: 日本今年截至第9週累計87例麻疹,為2020年以來同期最高
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 87 measles cases this year through week 9, the highest same-period total since 2020, with 15 imported.
items.description_zh: 日本今(2026)年截至第9週累計報告87例,為2020年以來同期累計最高,其中15例為境外移入病例,多來自東南亞國家,病患年齡以15-29年齡層為多(占47%),近期病例多分布於愛知縣、東京都。當局已發布警告,呼籲自境外返國者應留意自身健康狀況、各都道府縣應確保兒童按時接種疫苗,並於前往流行地區時確認疫苗接種記錄。
items.description_en: Japan reported 87 cases cumulatively this year through week 9, the highest cumulative figure for the same period since 2020. Of these, 15 were imported, mostly from Southeast Asian countries. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (47%), and recent cases are mainly distributed in Aichi Prefecture and Tokyo Metropolis. Authorities have issued a warning calling on people returning from overseas to be aware of their own health, on prefectures to ensure children are vaccinated on schedule, and on travellers to epidemic areas to check their vaccination records.

items.headline_zh: 全球-細菌性腸胃炎(仙人掌桿菌)
items.summary_zh: 10國累計144例嬰兒配方奶相關細菌性腸胃炎,已有99國下架產品
items.summary_en: Ten countries reported 144 confirmed and suspected bacterial gastroenteritis cases linked to infant formula; products were withdrawn in 99 countries.
items.description_zh: WHO於3/13更新全球疫情,今年截至2/25有10個國家累計報告144例確定及疑病例,病患分布於英國、西班牙、法國、奧地利、巴西、捷克、新加坡、香港、義大利、比利時,病患皆食用不同廠牌的嬰兒配方奶而發病,經調查係因花生四烯酸(ARA)油供應鏈受汙染所導致,已有99國家將產品下架,WHO評估此事件的整體公共衛生風險為中等。
items.description_en: WHO updated the global situation on 13 March. As of 25 February this year, 10 countries had reported 144 confirmed and suspected cases cumulatively. Cases were distributed across the United Kingdom, Spain, France, Austria, Brazil, Czechia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Italy and Belgium. All patients fell ill after consuming infant formula of different brands. Investigation found the cause to be contamination of the arachidonic acid (ARA) oil supply chain. Products have been withdrawn from sale in 99 countries, and WHO assesses the overall public health risk of this event as moderate.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至第8週拉薩熱累計99例死亡,致死率24.5%高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 99 Lassa fever deaths by week 8 this year, with a CFR of 24.5%, above 18.8% in the same period of 2025.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情上升,今年截至第8週累計報告99例死亡,致死率(CFR:24.5%)較2025年同期高(18.8%),有84%病患集中在包奇(Bauchi)等5個州,且醫護人員感染數亦上升,乾季(11月至4月)為該疾病傳播高峰期。
items.description_en: Nigeria's epidemic is rising. As of week 8 this year, 99 deaths have been reported cumulatively; the case fatality rate (CFR) is 24.5%, higher than the 18.8% in the same period of 2025. 84% of patients are concentrated in five states, including Bauchi, and infections among health workers have also increased. The dry season (November to April) is the peak transmission period for the disease.

items.summary_zh: 迦納2025年5月起累計1,038例M痘、8例死亡,每週病例持續下降
items.summary_en: Ghana has reported 1,038 mpox cases and 8 deaths since May 2025 through 10 March, and weekly infections have continued to decline.
items.description_zh: 迦納自2025年5月截至今年3/10累計報告1,038例病例,其中8例死亡,疫情多集中於人口密集地區。經當局加強居家隔例措施、檢驗量能、疫苗接種,以及感染者醫療費用減免等措施,每週感染人數已持續下降。
items.description_en: From May 2025 to 10 March this year, Ghana has reported 1,038 cumulative cases, including 8 deaths; outbreaks have mainly concentrated in densely populated areas. Authorities have strengthened home isolation measures, testing capacity and vaccination, and introduced reductions in medical costs for infected persons. Weekly infections have continued to decline.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年第1-7週17例狂犬病,低於去年同期49例,多為寵物或流浪狗咬傷
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 17 rabies cases in weeks 1–7 this year, below 49 in the same period last year, mostly from bites by unvaccinated pets or stray dogs.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓今年第1-7週(1/4-2/21)累計報告17例病例,低於去年同期(49例),超過7成的病患係遭未接種的寵物或流浪狗咬傷而感染。另該國每年平均發生400萬件動物抓咬傷案件,造成300-400例狂犬病感染死亡。
items.description_en: The Philippines reported 17 cases in weeks 1–7 this year (4 January–21 February), fewer than the 49 cases in the same period last year. More than 70% of patients were infected through bites from unvaccinated pets or stray dogs. The country records about 4 million animal bite and scratch incidents each year, causing 300–400 rabies deaths.

items.summary_zh: 丹麥2/27獲WHO認證消除先天性梅毒,為歐洲首國
items.summary_en: Denmark became the first European country certified by WHO as having eliminated congenital syphilis, on 27 February this year.
items.description_zh: 丹麥於今年2/27獲WHO認證為第一個消除先天性梅毒的歐洲國家,該國2024年累計報告626例梅毒病例,其中逾500例為男性。另全球研究顯示,2015-25年梅毒發生率持續攀升,並以北美洲、歐洲及亞洲明顯增加,其中,2022年新增報告8百萬例梅毒病例及70萬例先天性梅毒病例。
items.description_en: On 27 February this year, Denmark was certified by WHO as the first European country to eliminate congenital syphilis. In 2024, the country reported 626 cumulative syphilis cases, of which more than 500 were men. Global research shows that syphilis incidence has continued to rise from 2015 to 2025, with significant increases in North America, Europe and Asia. In 2022, 8 million new syphilis cases and 700,000 congenital syphilis cases were reported.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus infection
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國北基伍省貝市3/9報告1例伊波拉疑病例,尚未達宣告爆發標準
items.summary_en: DR Congo's Beni, North Kivu, reported one suspected Ebola case on 9 March with no laboratory results yet; it does not meet the outbreak declaration threshold.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國北基伍省(North Kivu)貝市(Beni)於3/9報告1例疑病例,尚無實驗室檢驗報告,當局已啟動相關防治措施,包含封鎖周邊區域、進行病例調查、接觸者追蹤及感控措施;相較於過去北基伍省、開賽省的爆發疫情案例,本案迄僅通報1例疑病例,尚未達宣告爆發疫情標準。
items.description_en: Beni in North Kivu Province, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, reported one suspected case on 9 March; no laboratory results are yet available. Authorities have launched relevant control measures, including cordoning off surrounding areas, case investigation, contact tracing and infection control measures. Compared with past outbreaks in North Kivu and Kasai provinces, only one suspected case has been reported so far, which does not yet meet the criteria for declaring an outbreak.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 2/26-3/4期間cVDPV2新增5例,奈及利亞4例、查德1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported five new cVDPV2 cases for 26 February–4 March: four in Nigeria and one in Chad.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/26-3/4期間,cVDPV2新增2國共5例,分別為奈及利亞4例及查德1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為馬拉威/索馬利亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 26 February–4 March, cVDPV2 newly reported five cases in two countries: four in Nigeria and one in Chad. For environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported two samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported two samples in two countries: one each in Malawi and Somalia.
items.area_zh: 查德,馬拉威,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,索馬利亞

items.summary_zh: 蘇丹累計逾12萬例霍亂,3,573例死亡,已連續48天無通報,宣布疫情終止
items.summary_en: Sudan has reported over 120,000 cholera cases and 3,573 deaths and declared the outbreak over after 48 days without reported cases.
items.description_zh: 蘇丹自2024年7月迄今累計報告逾12萬例病例,其中,3,573例死亡,當局已持續加強防治措施,包含推動2,300萬人接種疫苗、提升飲水衛生措施等,截至3/3已連續48天監測無通報病例,當局宣布成功終止疫情。
items.description_en: Since July 2024, Sudan has reported more than 120,000 cumulative cases, including 3,573 deaths. Authorities have continued to strengthen control measures, including vaccinating 23 million people and improving drinking water hygiene. As of 3 March, the country had recorded 48 consecutive days with no reported cases, and authorities declared that the outbreak had been successfully ended.

items.headline_zh: 日本/韓國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本第9週感染性腸胃炎定點報告平均降至6.31例,韓國第9週424例
items.summary_en: Japan's average sentinel gastroenteritis reports fell to 6.31 cases in week 9, and South Korea reported 424 cases, its fourth weekly decline.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情呈波動下降趨勢,第9週(2/23-3/1)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告降至6.31例,較2025年同期(9.83例)低,惟疫情仍高於2021-24年同期,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第9週報告424例病例,疫情已連續4週下降,較2025年同期為低,惟疫情仍高於2021-24年同期。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is on a fluctuating downward trend. In week 9 (23 February–1 March), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis fell to 6.31 cases, lower than the 9.83 cases in the same period of 2025, but still higher than the same period in 2021–2024. The pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak is on a downward trend: it reported 424 cases in week 9, has declined for four consecutive weeks, and is lower than the same period in 2025, but still higher than the same period in 2021–2024.

items.headline_zh: 越南/英國-沙門氏菌感染症
items.headline_en: Viet Nam / United Kingdom – Salmonella infection
items.summary_zh: 越南頭頓市108例病例,54%檢體沙門氏菌陽性;英國84例
items.summary_en: Vung Tau, Viet Nam, reported 108 cases on 9 March, with 54% of tested samples Salmonella-positive; the UK reported 84 cases.
items.description_zh: 越南南部頭頓市(Vung Tau)3/9報告108例病例,病患最早於3月初發病,51件病患檢體中有28件(占54%)呈沙門氏菌陽性,迄未出現嚴重病例,疑感染源為某商店販售之越南麵包。 英國今年截至2月底累計報告84例病例,病患年齡中位數為33歲,此波疫情自1月起持續上升,經當局調查疑感染源為某大型連鎖超市的醃製豬肉。
items.description_en: In Vung Tau City in southern Viet Nam, 108 cases were reported on 9 March. The earliest patients fell ill in early March. Of 51 patient specimens, 28 (54%) tested positive for Salmonella. No severe cases have occurred so far. The suspected source of infection is Vietnamese bread sold at a shop. The United Kingdom reported 84 cases cumulatively this year through the end of February. The median age of patients is 33 years, and this wave has risen continuously since January. Authorities' investigation suggests that the suspected source of infection is cured pork sold by a large chain supermarket.
items.area_en: Vietnam United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 捷克-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 捷克今年截至3/1累計643例A型肝炎,男性占59%,南摩拉維亞為多
items.summary_en: Czechia reported 643 acute hepatitis A cases this year through 1 March, 59% men, with the most in the South Moravian Region.
items.description_zh: 捷克今年截至3/1累計報告643例病例,其中59%為男性,病患分布以南模拉維亞(South Moravian)地區為多;另該國2025年累計報告逾3,000例病例,其中40例死亡,為1980年代以來最嚴峻之疫情,當局評估今年疫情將逐步趨緩。
items.description_en: Czechia reported 643 cases cumulatively this year through 1 March, of which 59% were men. Cases are mainly distributed in the South Moravian Region. The country reported more than 3,000 cases in 2025, of which 40 died, the most severe outbreak since the 1980s. Authorities assess that the outbreak will gradually ease this year.

items.summary_zh: 美國1,277例、墨西哥6,104例麻疹,WHO/PAHO將審查其消除狀態
items.summary_en: The US (1,277) and Mexico (6,104) reported measles cases in early March this year; WHO/PAHO will review their measles elimination status in November.
items.description_zh: WHO PAHO於3/2宣布,將於今年11月就美國及墨西哥之「麻疹消除狀態」進行審查,兩國之疫情狀況如下:WHO PAHO  美國今年截至3/5共31州累計報告1,277例確定病例,其中62例住院,23%為5歲以下兒童,77%為19歲以下族群,93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告662例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(184例),近期疫情集中於德克薩斯/猶他/科羅拉多/北達科他州。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至3/6累計報告6,104例確定病例,其中7例死亡,病例數以中西部哈利斯科州(3,604例)、南部恰帕斯州(540例)、中部墨西哥城(424例)為多。
items.description_en: WHO/PAHO announced on 2 March that the measles elimination status of the United States and Mexico will be reviewed in November this year. The current situation in the two countries is as follows. United States: as of 5 March this year, 1,277 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 31 states, of which 62 were hospitalized. Of the cases, 23% were children under 5 years and 77% were under 19 years; 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 662 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (184 cases); recent outbreaks have been concentrated in Texas, Utah, Colorado and North Dakota. Mexico: the outbreak continues, with 6,104 confirmed cases reported cumulatively as of 6 March this year, including 7 deaths. Cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (3,604 cases), southern Chiapas (540 cases) and central Mexico City (424 cases).

items.summary_zh: WHO評估立百病毒全球傳播風險為低,今年印度與孟加拉合計3例
items.summary_en: WHO rates the global risk of Nipah virus as low; India and Bangladesh reported 3 sporadic confirmed cases combined this year as of 6 March.
items.description_zh: WHO於3/6發布全球快速風險評估,疫情具明顯之地理與季節侷限性,主要集中於東南亞與西太平洋區域之自然宿主分布區,雖致死率高(40-75%),惟人傳人有侷限性,且迄未有持續性社區傳播或跨國擴散的跡象,評估全球傳播風險為低。  去(2025)年印度及孟加拉分別報告4例確定病例,今(2026)年截至3/6印度及孟加拉累計報告3例散發確定個案。主要傳播模式為動物源性溢出(Zoonotic Spillover),人際傳播多侷限於醫療照護之院內感染或家戶密切接觸; 非流行地區風險主要為受感染者或受感染牲畜之跨境輸入,惟於非病毒流行地區,次傳播之可能性極低;前往受影響地區旅客風險極低(惟不為零),須留意直接接觸食果蝠、食用受污染食品或接觸豬、馬等受感染動物者; 發生疫情國家已強化其監測系統、診斷及臨床管理能力,目前臨床上尚無核准之疫苗或藥物,快速病例隔離及接觸者追蹤為防止疫情擴散之有效措施; 建議各國應提升對不明原因腦炎的檢測能力,特別是有流行區旅遊史病例;醫療機構應落實標準防護措施,預防院內感染。WHO 空氣或飛沫傳染病疫情
items.description_en: On 6 March, WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment. The outbreaks have clear geographic and seasonal limitations and are mainly concentrated in the areas of natural host distribution in Southeast Asia and the Western Pacific. Although the case fatality rate is high (40–75%), human-to-human transmission is limited, and there have been no signs of sustained community transmission or cross-border spread to date. WHO assesses the global transmission risk as low. In 2025, India and Bangladesh each reported 4 confirmed cases, and as of 6 March this year they have cumulatively reported 3 sporadic confirmed cases. The main transmission pattern is zoonotic spillover; human transmission is mostly limited to nosocomial infection in healthcare settings or close household contact. The risk in non-endemic areas is mainly cross-border importation of infected people or infected livestock, and secondary transmission in non-endemic areas is extremely unlikely. The risk to travellers to affected areas is very low (though not zero); attention should be paid to direct contact with fruit bats, consumption of contaminated food, or contact with infected animals such as pigs and horses. Countries with outbreaks have strengthened their surveillance systems and diagnostic and clinical management capacity. There are currently no licensed vaccines or drugs for clinical use; rapid case isolation and contact tracing are effective measures to prevent spread. WHO recommends that countries improve testing capacity for unexplained encephalitis, particularly in cases with a history of travel to endemic areas, and that healthcare facilities implement standard precautions to prevent nosocomial infection. WHO. Airborne or droplet-transmitted disease outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至第8週拉薩熱累計99例死亡,致死率24.5%高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 99 Lassa fever deaths by week 8 this year, with a CFR of 24.5%, above 18.8% in the same period of 2025.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情上升,今年截至第8週累計報告99例死亡,致死率(CFR:24.5%)較2025年同期高(18.8%),有84%病患集中在包奇(Bauchi)等5個州,且醫護人員感染數亦上升,乾季(11月至4月)為該疾病傳播高峰期。
items.description_en: Nigeria's epidemic is rising. As of week 8 this year, 99 deaths have been reported cumulatively; the case fatality rate (CFR) is 24.5%, higher than the 18.8% in the same period of 2025. 84% of patients are concentrated in five states, including Bauchi, and infections among health workers have also increased. The dry season (November to April) is the peak transmission period for the disease.

items.headline_zh: 聖露西亞/古巴/法屬圭亞那/蓋亞那/蘇利南-屈公病
items.headline_en: Saint Lucia / Cuba / French Guiana / Guyana / Suriname – Chikungunya
items.summary_zh: 聖露西亞2021年來首例屈公病確診,患者住院4天已完全康復
items.summary_en: Saint Lucia reported its first chikungunya case since 2021; the patient was hospitalised for four days and has fully recovered.
items.description_zh: 聖露西亞報告自2021年以來首例確診病例,該患者住院4天並接受支持性照護後,已完全康復,目前國內尚未發現其他病例。美洲包括古巴、法屬圭亞那、蓋亞那及蘇利南等地疫情持續,不同地區間人口流動且當地存在病媒蚊,造成該國仍有病例發生風險。
items.description_en: Saint Lucia has reported its first confirmed case since 2021. The patient was hospitalized for 4 days, received supportive care and has fully recovered; no other cases have been found in the country so far. Outbreaks continue in the Americas, including Cuba, French Guiana, Guyana and Suriname. Population movement between different areas, together with the presence of vector mosquitoes, means the country still faces a risk of cases.
items.area_zh: 古巴,法屬圭亞那,蓋亞那共和國,聖露西亞,蘇利南

items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡今年1-2月累計13,416例登革熱、4例死亡,主要分布於西部省
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka reported 13,416 dengue cases and 4 deaths in January–February this year, mainly in the Western Province.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情持續,今年1-2月累計報告13,416例病例及4例死亡,主要分布於西部省,近年來該省病例數約占全國41.8-49%,係因人口密度較高且環境適於病媒蚊孳生,該國流行4種型別,隨著年度及地區而有變動。
items.description_en: Dengue in Sri Lanka continues. From January to February this year, 13,416 cases and 4 deaths have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the Western Province. In recent years, the province has accounted for about 41.8–49% of national cases, due to high population density and an environment favourable to vector mosquito breeding. The country has four circulating serotypes, which vary by year and region.

items.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉2025年6月至今年1月14州36例黃熱病確診,已擴散至低風險地區
items.summary_en: Venezuela reported 36 confirmed yellow fever cases in 14 states from June 2025 to January this year, spreading to areas previously considered low risk.
items.description_zh: 委內瑞拉自2025年6月迄今年1月共14州報告36例確診病例,主要分布於西部巴里納斯州,目前疫情已從過往流行的叢林地區擴散至先前被視為低風險的地區,包括北部阿拉瓜州等的部分地區,由於疫苗接種率較低, WHO將該國列為高風險國家。
items.description_en: From June 2025 to January this year, 36 confirmed cases were reported in 14 states of Venezuela, mainly in Barinas State in the west. The outbreak has spread from previously endemic jungle areas to areas previously considered low risk, including parts of Aragua State in the north. Because vaccination coverage is low, WHO has listed the country as a high-risk country.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2/23-3/6期間23國報告168起H5N1疫情,波蘭45起居首
items.summary_en: Twenty-three countries reported 168 H5N1 outbreaks during 23 February–6 March 2026, led by Poland with 45.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:西班牙新增1 例H1N1v流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計46國家/地區報告1,683起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共23國於2026/2/23-3/6期間報告168起H5N1疫情,波蘭45起、美國20起、荷蘭17起、比利時16起、瑞典11起、丹麥/德國各8起、捷克/英國各7起、奈及利亞5起、奧地利4起、愛沙亞3起、加拿大/匈牙利/挪威/斯洛伐克/立陶宛/越南各2起、保加利亞/印度/日本/智利/蒙特內哥羅各1起。 美國於2026/3/6期間報告17起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/2/22-28共452個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,伊利諾/紐澤西/奧勒岡/加州共9個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Epidemic update. Human cases: Spain reported 1 new H1N1v human influenza infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 46 countries and regions have reported 1,683 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Twenty-three countries reported 168 H5N1 outbreaks during 23 February–6 March 2026: Poland 45, the United States 20, the Netherlands 17, Belgium 16, Sweden 11, Denmark and Germany 8 each, Czechia and the United Kingdom 7 each, Nigeria 5, Austria 4, Estonia 3, Canada, Hungary, Norway, Slovakia, Lithuania and Viet Nam 2 each, and Bulgaria, India, Japan, Chile and Montenegro 1 each. The United States reported 17 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 6 March 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 452 sampling sites for 22–28 February 2026, of which 9 sampling sites in Illinois, New Jersey, Oregon and California detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 今年第7週全球陽性率3.28%,XFG占56.16%居首,澳洲連4週上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 3.28% in week 7; XFG leads at 56.16%, and Australia's positivity has risen for four consecutive weeks.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第7週(2/9-15)全球陽性率為3.28%,與上週3.31%相當,其中美洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 香港疫情於低點持平,第9週(2/22-28)陽性率為0.08%,汙水監測變異株以NB.1.8.1為多(占62.8%)。 印疫情略升,第7週陽性率上升為3.67%。 澳洲疫情呈上升趨勢,1/26-2/22平均陽性率為2.2%,疫情已連續4週上升,近期變異株以XFG占多數(占33.7%);另近1年成人疫苗覆蓋率為10%,其中以75歲以上覆蓋率(38.5%)為高。  評估與建議: 近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占56.16%),其次為NB.1.8.1(25.37%)。WHO公布之全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,僅有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 7 of this year (9–15 February), the global positivity rate was 3.28%, similar to 3.31% the previous week, with a notable increase in the WHO Regional Office for the Americas. Hong Kong's epidemic has remained flat at a low point; the positivity rate in week 9 (22–28 February) was 0.08%, and NB.1.8.1 was the predominant variant in wastewater surveillance (62.8%). India's epidemic has risen slightly, with the positivity rate rising to 3.67% in week 7. Australia's epidemic is rising: the average positivity rate for 26 January–22 February was 2.2%, and it has risen for four consecutive weeks, with XFG the majority of recent variants (33.7%). In addition, adult vaccination coverage over the past year was 10%, with higher coverage among people aged 75 and over (38.5%). Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (56.16%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (25.37%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but only 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,香港特別行政區,印尼

items.summary_zh: 越南今年截至3/7狂犬病8例死亡,分布8省市,春節後犬貓咬傷增加
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has recorded 8 rabies deaths in eight provinces and cities as of 7 March this year, and dog and cat bites rose after Lunar New Year.
items.description_zh: 越南今(2026)年截至3/7共計8省報告8例死亡病例,分別為萊州/老街/胡志明/永隆/廣義/嘉萊/林同/大樂省(市),當局表示動物狂犬病疫情持續在多地出現,春節後犬貓咬傷人事件顯著增加,呼籲為達2030 年消除狂犬病目標,需要衛生、獸醫及地方當局密切合作,同時提高民眾對寵物接種疫苗、管理犬貓以及正確處理咬傷之認識。該國2025年報告77例死亡病例。
items.description_en: As of 7 March this year, Viet Nam has reported 8 rabies deaths in 8 provinces and cities: Lai Châu, Lào Cai, Ho Chi Minh City, Vĩnh Long, Quảng Ngãi, Gia Lai, Lâm Đồng and Đắk Lắk. Authorities say animal rabies continues to appear in many areas, and dog and cat bite incidents increased markedly after the Lunar New Year. They call for close cooperation among health, veterinary and local authorities to achieve the 2030 rabies elimination goal, and for raising public awareness of vaccinating pets, managing dogs and cats, and correctly managing bite wounds. The country reported 77 rabies deaths in 2025.

items.summary_zh: 香港報告1例本土麻疹,32歲未接種女性,8名密切接觸者均已接種且無症狀
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported one locally acquired measles case in an unvaccinated 32-year-old woman; all 8 close contacts are vaccinated and asymptomatic.
items.description_zh: 香港報告1例本土麻疹病例,為32歲女性個案,未曾接種疫苗,於2/28出現發燒、喉嚨痛、咳嗽、睛發紅及皮疹,於3/4至診所就醫,後轉介至醫院住院,經調查病患於潛伏期無國外旅遊史,8名密切接觸者皆已接種疫苗且無相關症狀,當局呼籲民眾評估接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Hong Kong has reported one locally acquired measles case, a 32-year-old woman who had not been vaccinated. She developed fever, sore throat, cough, red eyes and rash on 28 February, visited a clinic on 4 March, and was then referred to hospital for admission. Investigation found no overseas travel during the incubation period. All 8 close contacts had been vaccinated and showed no related symptoms. Authorities urge the public to consider vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 哈薩克突厥斯坦州奇姆肯特新增1例炭疽病,75歲男性住院治療中
items.summary_en: Kazakhstan's Turkistan Region reported a new anthrax case in Shymkent, a 75-year-old man hospitalized as of 17 February.
items.description_zh: 哈薩克疫情持續,突厥斯坦州奇姆肯特新增1例75歲男性確診病例,於2/17住院治療中,奇姆肯特鄰近地區畜牧業盛行,為炭疽病高風險地區。
items.description_en: Kazakhstan's outbreak continues. In Shymkent city in Turkistan Region, one new confirmed case has been reported in a 75-year-old man, who was being treated in hospital as of 17 February. Livestock farming is widespread in the areas near Shymkent, which are high-risk areas for anthrax.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞第1-7週拉薩熱70例死亡,CFR 22%高於近年
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 70 Lassa fever deaths in weeks 1–7 this year, a CFR of 22%, above the 18.3–18.9% of recent years.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,第1-7週累計1,469例疑病例(318例確診)及70例死亡(CFR:22%),致死率較近年之18.3-18.9%為高,確診病例主要分布於埃多、翁多、塔拉巴等州,且已有15名醫護人員感染歸因於低風險認知及院內感染預防與控制不力。
items.description_en: Nigeria's outbreak update: from week 1 to week 7, 1,469 suspected cases (318 confirmed) and 70 deaths (CFR: 22%) have been reported cumulatively. The case fatality rate is higher than the 18.3–18.9% of recent years. Confirmed cases are mainly distributed in states including Ebonyi, Ondo and Taraba, and 15 health workers have been infected, which is attributed to low risk perception and weak nosocomial infection prevention and control.

items.summary_zh: 馬達加斯加Ib型M痘疫情快速上升,確診458例、疑病例279例
items.summary_en: Madagascar's clade Ib mpox outbreak is rising rapidly, with 458 confirmed and 279 suspected cases as of 2 March.
items.description_zh: 馬達加斯加疫情更新,自去年12月爆發Ib型(clade Ib)疫情以來,截至今年3/2累計報告458例確診病例及279例疑病例,病例數快速上升,疫情持續傳播,並於2/28確診1例3歲女童死亡病例,當局將實施疫苗接種措施,避免疫情傳播。
items.description_en: Madagascar's outbreak update: since the clade Ib outbreak began in December last year, cumulative cases as of 2 March this year total 458 confirmed and 279 suspected. Case numbers are rising rapidly and transmission continues. On 28 February, a death was confirmed in a 3-year-old girl. Authorities will implement vaccination measures to prevent further spread.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 2/19-25期間WPV1新增阿富汗3例,cVDPV2新增4國共12例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 12 new cVDPV2 cases in four countries and three new WPV1 cases in Afghanistan for 19–25 February.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/19-25期間,WPV1新增阿富汗3例;cVDPV2新增4國共12例,分別為奈及利亞7例、剛果民主共和國3例、查德/多哥各1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共3件,分別為阿富汗2件、巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增2國共3件,分別為奈及利亞2件、尚比亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–25 February, WPV1 newly reported three cases in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 newly reported 12 cases in four countries: seven in Nigeria, three in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and one each in Chad and Togo. cVDPV3 newly reported one case in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported three samples in two countries: two in Afghanistan and one in Pakistan. cVDPV2 newly reported three samples in two countries: two in Nigeria and one in Zambia.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,查德,剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞,多哥

items.headline_zh: 香港/日本/韓國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR / Japan / South Korea – Viral gastroenteritis (norovirus)
items.summary_zh: 香港郵輪諾羅病毒群聚累計76例疑病例,日本第8週定點報告8.02例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a norovirus cruise ship cluster with 76 suspected cases; Japan's average sentinel gastroenteritis reports rose to 8.02 in week 8.
items.description_zh: 香港3/1報告1起郵輪群聚事件,累計報告76例疑病例,其中有7件檢體呈陽性;最早有症狀旅客係於2/15從日本橫濱登船後發病,該郵輪共有約2,000名乘客及800名工作人員。 日本疫情於高點波動,第8週(2/16-22)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告增至8.02例,較2025年同期(10.32例)低,惟疫情仍高於近5年同期平均,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第8週(2/15-21)報告456例病例,疫情已連續3週下降,惟仍高於近5年同期。
items.description_en: On 1 March, Hong Kong reported one cruise ship cluster, with 76 suspected cases cumulatively, of which 7 specimens tested positive. The earliest symptomatic passenger had boarded in Yokohama, Japan, on 15 February and fell ill afterwards. The cruise ship carried about 2,000 passengers and 800 crew members. Japan's outbreak is fluctuating at a high level. In week 8 (16–22 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis increased to 8.02 cases, lower than the 10.32 cases in the same period of 2025 but still higher than the five-year average for the same period. The pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak is declining: it reported 456 cases in week 8 (15–21 February), with three consecutive weeks of decline, but still higher than the five-year average for the same period.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 加拿大曼托巴省今年截至2/17累計388例A型肝炎,街友感染數上升
items.summary_en: Manitoba, Canada, reported 388 hepatitis A cases this year as of 17 February, with infections rising among people experiencing homelessness.
items.description_zh: 加拿大曼托巴省今年截至2/17累計報告388例病例,此波疫情自2025年11月起延續迄今,其中,街友之感染數上升;當局已發布多次警告,呼籲民眾加強健康監測與疫苗接種等防疫措施。
items.description_en: Manitoba Province in Canada has reported 388 cases so far this year as of 17 February. This wave has continued since November 2025, with infections rising among people experiencing homelessness. Authorities have issued several warnings, calling on the public to strengthen health monitoring and preventive measures such as vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 印尼/美國/剛果民主共和國-麻疹
items.headline_en: Indonesia / United States / Democratic Republic of the Congo – Measles
items.summary_zh: 印尼今年572例麻疹(4例死亡),剛果民主共和國疑病例逾2萬例
items.summary_en: Indonesia reported 572 measles cases with 4 deaths this year through week 7; DR Congo has 20,231 suspected cases as of 10 February.
items.description_zh: 印今年截至第7週報告572例確定病例,其中4例死亡,另共計11省分報告21起疑(13起確診)疫情,當局已加強監測及調查作業;該國去年報告逾1.1萬確定病例,其中69例死亡。 美國疫情持續,今年截至2/26共28州累計報告1,136例確定病例,其中58例住院,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告653例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(149例)及佛羅里達州(107例)。USCDC 剛果民主共和國今年截至2/10共26省累計20,231例疑病例,其中238例死亡,去(2025)年同期報告7,491例,其中93例死亡。該國2018年5歲以下孩童疫苗接種率僅57%,當局呼籲家長攜帶孩童至疫苗接種場所完成接種。
items.description_en: Indonesia reported 572 confirmed cases this year through week 7, including 4 deaths. Eleven provinces reported 21 outbreaks (13 confirmed), and authorities have strengthened surveillance and investigation. Last year, Indonesia reported more than 11,000 confirmed cases, including 69 deaths. The United States outbreak continues: as of 26 February this year, 1,136 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 28 states, of which 58 were hospitalized; 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 653 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (149 cases) and Florida (107 cases) (US CDC). In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 10 February this year, 20,231 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 provinces, including 238 deaths. In the same period last year, 7,491 cases were reported, including 93 deaths. The country's vaccination coverage among children under 5 years was only 57% in 2018, and authorities urge parents to take children to vaccination sites to complete vaccination.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,印尼,美國

items.disease_zh: 第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.disease_en: 第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至2/10確定49例豬鏈球菌感染,3例死亡,多為男性及60歲以上
items.summary_en: Thailand has confirmed 49 Streptococcus suis infections this year as of 10 February, including 3 deaths, mostly among men over 60.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至2/10共計28府區報告49例確定病例,其中3例死亡,以男性及60歲以上年齡層為多,分布以東北部呵叻府為高,其次為北部帕府、東部春武里府,主要風險因素包括食用未煮熟之豬肉或豬血,及未穿戴防護裝備(靴子和手套)進行生豬屠宰作業。當局已發布指南,提醒民眾避免食用生或未煮熟之豬肉,並購買經認證來源之豬肉,另倘接觸豬隻應穿戴相關防護設備。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 49 confirmed cases this year as of 10 February, across 28 provinces and districts, including 3 deaths. Cases are mainly among men and people aged over 60. Incidence is highest in Nakhon Ratchasima Province in the northeast, followed by Phrae Province in the north and Chon Buri Province in the east. Main risk factors include eating undercooked or raw pork or pig blood, and slaughtering pigs without protective equipment such as boots and gloves. Authorities have issued guidance reminding people to avoid eating raw or undercooked pork, to buy pork from certified sources, and to wear protective equipment when handling pigs.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年累計逾11萬例登革熱(逾2萬例確診)、8例死亡
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported more than 110,000 dengue cases this year, over 20,000 confirmed, and 8 deaths.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告11萬餘例病例(2萬餘例確診)及8例死亡,去年累計報告381萬餘例病例(145萬餘例確診)及1,793例死亡,去年病例數及死亡數均較2024年下降,該國推動疫苗接種措施,並將逐步擴大接種對象。
items.description_en: Brazil's epidemic update: so far this year, more than 110,000 cases have been reported cumulatively (more than 20,000 confirmed), along with 8 deaths. Last year, more than 3.81 million cases (about 1.45 million confirmed) and 1,793 deaths were reported cumulatively. Both case numbers and deaths last year declined compared with 2024. The country is promoting vaccination and will gradually expand the target groups.

items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞今年1-7週屈公病5,518例,聖克魯斯省近週增約1,000例
items.summary_en: Bolivia reported 5,518 chikungunya cases in weeks 1–7 this year, and Santa Cruz added about 1,000 cases in the past week.
items.description_zh: 玻利維亞疫情更新,今年1-7週累計報告5,518例病例(3,976例確診),迄今已有至少37例住院及4例死亡,該國東部聖克魯斯省病例數持續上升,近1週新增約1,000例病例。
items.description_en: Bolivia's epidemic update: in weeks 1–7 this year, 5,518 cases were reported cumulatively (3,976 confirmed), with at least 37 hospitalized and 4 deaths. Case numbers continue to rise in Santa Cruz Department in the east, with about 1,000 new cases added in the past week.

items.summary_zh: 西班牙加泰隆亞報告1例H1N1v人類感染,患者無症狀,為2009年來第4例
items.summary_en: Catalonia, Spain, reported one asymptomatic H1N1v human infection, Spain's fourth case since 2009.
items.description_zh: 西班牙加泰隆亞自治區報告1例H1N1v人類感染病例,病患無豬隻或受汙染環境之接觸史,目前無症狀,流行病學調查中,該國已報告WHO,WHO流感實驗室刻正確認中;本案為該國自2009年第4例病例,最近1例為加泰隆亞自治區於2024年報告之案例。
items.description_en: Catalonia, an autonomous community in Spain, has reported one human H1N1v infection. The patient had no contact with pigs or contaminated environments and is currently asymptomatic; epidemiological investigation is ongoing. Spain has reported the case to WHO, and the WHO influenza laboratory is confirming it. This is Spain's fourth case since 2009; the most recent was reported by Catalonia in 2024.

items.summary_zh: 今年1月全球新增1,334例M痘確診,66%來自非洲,全球累計逾17.9萬例
items.summary_en: January saw 1,334 new mpox cases in 50 countries, 66% in Africa; globally over 179,000 confirmed cases since 2022.
items.description_zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今(2026)年1/31累計144國/地區報告17萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少483例死亡。 今年1月共計50國家/地區報告1,334 例新增確診病例,其中3例死亡,66%來自非洲地區,相較去年12月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,葛摩及法屬留旺島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/1/5-2/15)共計20國通報1,142例確診病例,其中4例死亡,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞及迦納為高;非洲以外地區,法國、葡萄牙及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 WHO 於 2 月發布全球快速風險評估,性接觸仍是跨國擴散主因,全球傳播風險評估為中,對MSM群體(尤其未固定性伴侶族群)傳播風險為中,對一般民眾傳播風險為低。 全球目前累計報告2例Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之重組病毒株,分別為於英國報告具東南亞旅遊史,以及印度報告具阿拉伯半島國家旅遊史之病患,基因定序顯示其為相同重組病毒株。WHO表示實際病例數可能多於目前通報數,惟重組病毒株臨床症狀與一般分支相,且皆無重症,接觸者追蹤亦未發現續發病例,評估整體風險維持不變。
items.description_en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2/18-27期間23國報告678起H5N1疫情,德國527起居首
items.summary_en: 23 countries reported 678 H5N1 animal outbreaks during 18–27 February, led by Germany with 527.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:本週無新增病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計43國家/地區報告1,510起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 比利時與美國於2026/2/27各報告1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 南韓於2026/2/19報告3起H5N9疫情。 共23國於2026/2/18-2/27期間報告678起H5N1疫情,德國527起、波蘭/英國各25起、丹麥24起、美國18起、比利時11起、挪威9起、匈牙利7起、法國5起、奧地利/臺灣各4起、義大利/荷蘭各3起、捷克/立陶宛/羅馬亞各2起、以色列/加拿大/斯洛維亞/日本/瑞典/瑞士/盧森堡各1起。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/2/15-21共499個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡州共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Epidemic update. Human cases: No new cases were reported this week. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 43 countries and regions have reported 1,510 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Belgium and the United States each reported 1 H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 27 February 2026. South Korea reported 3 H5N9 outbreaks on 19 February 2026. A total of 23 countries reported 678 H5N1 outbreaks during 18–27 February 2026: Germany 527, Poland and the United Kingdom 25 each, Denmark 24, the United States 18, Belgium 11, Norway 9, Hungary 7, France 5, Austria and Taiwan 4 each, Italy and the Netherlands 3 each, Czechia, Lithuania and Romania 2 each, and Israel, Canada, Slovenia, Japan, Sweden, Switzerland and Luxembourg 1 each. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 499 sampling sites for 15–21 February 2026, of which 4 sampling sites in New Jersey, Illinois and Oregon detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第6週陽性率升至3.53%,美國降至5.1%,XFG占55.36%居首
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 3.53% in week 6; US positivity fell to 5.1%, and XFG leads globally at 55.36%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  全球今年第6週(2/2-8)陽性率上升至3.53%,其中美洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 美國疫情從高點下降,今年第6週陽性率降至5.1%,疫情已連續2週下降,近期變異株以XFG占比為多(29%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占21%)。另近期研究顯示,美國2024-25年估計有92萬例住院病例及10.7萬例死亡,COVID-19疫苗針對JN.1相關變異株可減少40%住院風險。  評估與建議: 全球近期流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占55.36%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19.31%)。WHO公布全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 6 of this year (2–8 February), the global positivity rate rose to 3.53%, with a notable increase in the WHO Regional Office for the Americas. The United States' epidemic is declining from its peak; the positivity rate fell to 5.1% in week 6, and the epidemic has declined for two consecutive weeks. Recent variants are mainly XFG (29%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21%). In addition, recent research estimates that the United States had 920,000 hospitalizations and 107,000 deaths in 2024–25, and that COVID-19 vaccines targeting JN.1-related variants can reduce hospitalization risk by 40%. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (55.36%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19.31%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達/塞內加爾-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 烏干達2/11新增1例21歲男性護理師確診,塞內加爾東部1例7歲男童確定
items.summary_en: Uganda reported a new confirmed CCHF case on 11 February in a 21-year-old male nurse, and Senegal a case in a 7-year-old boy on 10 February.
items.description_zh: 烏干達中部克揚寬齊區於2/11新增1例確診病例,為21歲男性護理師,於1/17出現頭痛、發燒、非出血性腹瀉、嘔吐、關節痛、結膜炎、上腹部/胸痛、黃疸及鼻腔/牙齦出血等症狀,2/1經實驗室PCR確診。該國每年皆有零星確診病例,去(2025)年報告17例病例(11例確定病例),其中2例死亡。ACDC 2/18 塞內加爾東部坦巴昆達區於2/10報告1例確定病例,為7歲男童,於1/7出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉/關節痛等症狀,並於同日就醫,24日經實驗室PCR確診,病患近15天無旅遊史。另該國中部卡夫林區去(2025)年報告8例病例(2例確定病例),其中1例死亡。ACDC 2/18
items.description_en: In Kyankwanzi District in central Uganda, one new confirmed case was reported on 11 February: a 21-year-old male nurse who developed symptoms from 17 January, including headache, fever, non-haemorrhagic diarrhoea, vomiting, joint pain, conjunctivitis, upper abdominal and chest pain, jaundice and nasal and gum bleeding, and was confirmed by laboratory PCR on 1 February. The country reports sporadic confirmed cases every year; last year (2025), 17 cases were reported (11 confirmed), including 2 deaths (Africa CDC, 18 February). In Tambacounda District in eastern Senegal, one confirmed case was reported on 10 February: a 7-year-old boy who developed fever, headache and muscle and joint pain on 7 January, sought medical care the same day, and was confirmed by laboratory PCR on 24 January; the patient had no travel history in the past 15 days. In Kaffrine District in central Senegal, 8 cases (2 confirmed) were reported last year, including 1 death (Africa CDC, 18 February).

items.summary_zh: 日本今年截至第7週43例麻疹,10-19歲居多,為2020年以來同期最高
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 43 measles cases this year through week 7, the highest same-period total since 2020, mostly among 10–19-year-olds.
items.description_zh: 日本今年截至第7週累計報告43例,為2020年以來同期累計最高,病患年齡以10-19歲居多(占56%),近期病例多分布於東京都、大阪府;當局已發布警告,呼籲加強通報、疫調等防疫措施。
items.description_en: Japan reported 43 cases cumulatively this year through week 7, the highest for the same period since 2020. Patients are mainly aged 10–19 years (56%), and recent cases are mainly distributed in Tokyo Metropolis and Osaka Prefecture. Authorities have issued a warning calling for strengthened reporting, epidemiological investigation and other prevention measures.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 2/12-18期間環境樣本WPV1新增巴基斯坦3件,cVDPV2新增5件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 3 WPV1 environmental samples in Pakistan and 5 cVDPV2 environmental samples in three countries for 12–18 February.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/12-18期間,環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦3件,cVDPV2新增3國共5件,分別為納米比亞/阿爾及利亞2件、奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 February, for environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported three samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported five samples in three countries: two each in Namibia and Algeria, and one in Nigeria.
items.area_zh: 阿爾及利亞,納米比亞,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦

items.headline_zh: 日本/韓國/英國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.headline_en: Japan / South Korea / United Kingdom – Viral gastroenteritis (norovirus)
items.summary_zh: 日本第7週感染性腸胃炎定點報告平均7.98例,為5年同期最高,韓國613例
items.summary_en: Japan's average sentinel gastroenteritis reports reached 7.98 in week 7, a five-year same-period high, while South Korea reported 613 cases.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情略降,第7週(2/9-15)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告7.98例,為5年同期最高,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情略降,第7週報告613例病例,惟仍處高點,為近5年最高。 英國疫情下降,第6-7週累計報告981例病例,惟仍高於近5年同期平均。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is declining slightly. In week 7 (9–15 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis was 7.98 cases, the highest for the same period in five years; the pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak is declining slightly: it reported 613 cases in week 7; it remains at a high point and is the highest in five years. The United Kingdom's outbreak has declined: it reported 981 cases cumulatively in weeks 6–7, but remains higher than the five-year average for the same period.
items.area_en: Japan,Korea(South Korea),United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 全球今年1月累計16,912例霍亂、182例死亡,較去年12月降6%
items.summary_en: WHO reports 16,912 cholera cases and 182 deaths globally in January this year, down 6% from December 2025.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年1月累計報告1萬6,912例病例,182例死亡,病例數較2025年12月下降6%,各國CFR介於0-16.7%;病例分布於東地中海、非洲及東南亞共19個國家/地區,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗及莫三比克為多。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, 16,912 cases and 182 deaths were reported cumulatively in January this year. Case numbers fell 6% compared with December 2025, and case fatality rates across countries range from 0–16.7%. Cases were distributed across 19 countries and regions in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian regions. Recent new cases are concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people are at risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,莫三比克

items.headline_zh: 哈薩克/美國/墨西哥/英國-麻疹
items.headline_en: Kazakhstan / United States / Mexico / United Kingdom – Measles
items.summary_zh: 哈薩克確定麻疹3,343例、美國982例、墨西哥4,497例,英國北倫敦爆發
items.summary_en: As of late February, Kazakhstan (3,343), the US (982) and Mexico (4,497) reported confirmed measles cases, and north London has an outbreak.
items.description_zh: 哈薩克疫情上升,今 (2026) 年截至2/20報告3,343例確定病例,其中84.2%為14歲以下兒童,另77.6%為未接種疫苗兒童,分布於阿斯塔納和阿拉木圖等9個地區。當局已發布防疫命令,包括擴大免疫接種運動、暫時禁止未接種疫苗兒童進入學校和幼稚園,以及強制醫護人員接種疫苗。 美國疫情持續,今(2026)年截至2/19共26州累計報告982例確定病例,其中38例住院,該國94%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明, 病例數以南卡羅來納州報告632例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(117例)及佛羅里達州(64例),其中佛羅里達州病患主要與柯里爾郡(Collier)之聖母瑪利亞大學相關,該校已加強相關疫情防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至2/23累計報告4,497例確定病例,其中5例死亡,病例數以中西部哈利斯科州(2,662例)、南部恰帕斯州(393例)為多。該國自去(2025)年年初爆發疫情,2025年累計報告6,444例確定病例,其中27例死亡,其中以1-4歲嬰兒為多(1,548例)。 英國北倫敦地區爆發疫情,英蘭地區今年已累計96例確診病例,主要分布於倫敦及西密德蘭區域,病例以10歲以下兒童為多,2成之感染兒童住院治療中,所有住院兒童均未完全接種疫苗。當局已設立臨時疫苗接種所,鼓勵補接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Kazakhstan's outbreak is rising. As of 20 February this year, 3,343 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 84.2% were children under 14 years and 77.6% were unvaccinated children, distributed across nine regions including Astana and Almaty. Authorities have issued prevention orders, including expanding immunization campaigns, temporarily banning unvaccinated children from entering schools and kindergartens, and requiring health workers to be vaccinated. The United States outbreak continues: as of 19 February this year, 982 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 states, of which 38 were hospitalized; 94% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 632 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (117 cases) and Florida (64 cases). Florida's patients are mainly linked to Ave Maria University in Collier County, which has strengthened outbreak prevention and control measures. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 23 February this year, 4,497 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 5 deaths; cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (2,662 cases) and southern Chiapas (393 cases). The outbreak in Mexico began in early last year; 6,444 confirmed cases, including 27 deaths, were reported in 2025, mainly among infants aged 1–4 years (1,548 cases). In north London, an outbreak has occurred: England has reported 96 confirmed cases so far this year, mainly in London and the West Midlands, mostly among children under 10 years. Twenty per cent of infected children are being treated in hospital, and all hospitalized children were not fully vaccinated. Authorities have set up temporary vaccination sites to encourage catch-up vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 泰國呵叻府2/21報告1例狂犬病死亡,病患2個月前被犬抓傷且未接種疫苗
items.summary_en: Thailand's Nakhon Ratchasima reported a rabies death on 21 February; the patient was scratched by a dog two months earlier and was unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 泰國呵叻府於2/21報告1例死亡病例,病患曾於2個月前經犬隻抓傷,且未接種疫苗。經調查該犬隻行為異常,且於該事件後不久死亡,當局已啟動疫情監測及調查作業。另提醒民眾,倘被犬貓抓/咬傷,應立即清洗傷口並儘速接種疫苗。
items.description_en: In Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, one death was reported on 21 February. The patient had been scratched by a dog two months earlier and had not been vaccinated. Investigation found the dog had shown abnormal behaviour and died shortly after the incident, and authorities have launched surveillance and investigation. Residents are also reminded that if bitten or scratched by a dog or cat, they should immediately wash the wound and get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡今年迄今9,480例登革熱,西部省病例最多,當局啟動全國防治
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka has reported 9,480 dengue cases so far this year, most in the Western Province, and authorities have launched nationwide control measures.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡今年迄今已報告9,480例病例,以西部省病例數最多,當局評估疫情可能隨季風季節上升,並已啟動全國預防及控制措施。
items.description_en: Sri Lanka has reported 9,480 cases so far this year, with the highest number in the Western Province. Authorities assess that the outbreak may rise with the monsoon season, and have launched national prevention and control measures.

items.headline_zh: 蘇利南/玻利維亞/古巴-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞今年1-5週屈公病1,534例,東部聖克魯斯省1,409例最多
items.summary_en: Bolivia reported 1,534 chikungunya cases in weeks 1–5 this year, with 1,409 in eastern Santa Cruz, the most affected area.
items.description_zh: 蘇利南疫情更新,於去年底報告自2016年以來首例本土病例,迄今年1月底累計712例疑病例(327例確診)及1例死亡,以北部巴拉馬利波區之確診病例數為多。 玻利維亞發生疫情,該國今年1-5週累計報告1,534例病例,其中以東部聖克魯斯省1,409例最多,該省近1週另新增1,515例病例,截至2月中已累計報告3,004例。該國去年累計報告近7,000例病例及4例死亡,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 古巴疫情持續,今年1月累計報告1,457例病例(114例確診)及2例死亡,去年累計報告51,217例病例(近2,000例確診)及46例死亡。
items.description_en: Suriname's epidemic update: at the end of last year, the first locally acquired case since 2016 was reported. As of the end of January this year, 712 suspected cases (327 confirmed) and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, with the most confirmed cases in Paramaribo District in the north. Bolivia's outbreak continues: in weeks 1–5 this year, 1,534 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 1,409 were in the eastern Santa Cruz Department, the most of any area. In the past week, that department added a further 1,515 cases, and 3,004 cases had been reported cumulatively by mid-February. Last year Bolivia reported nearly 7,000 cases and 4 deaths, and the US CDC recently raised its travel notice for the country to Level 2. Cuba's outbreak continues: 1,457 cases (114 confirmed) and 2 deaths were reported cumulatively in January this year; last year, 51,217 cases (nearly 2,000 confirmed) and 46 deaths were reported cumulatively.

items.summary_zh: 日本第7週定點門診平均41.44例,全國逾15萬例,8,174所學校停課
items.summary_en: Japan's sentinel clinics averaged 41.44 flu cases in week 7, with over 150,000 cases nationwide and 8,174 schools suspending classes.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情更新,第7週(2/9-15)定點門診平均病例數為41.44例,全國病例數逾15萬例,主要型別為B型(65%),平均病例數以大分縣(64.43例)、埼玉縣(62.6例)及鹿兒島 (62.12例)為多。另共計35個都道縣平均病例數超過30例警戒,本流感季平均病例數在去(2025)年11月下旬達到高峰51.12例後,於年底下降,惟自今(2026)年1月起持續上升,截至2/15當週,該國共計8,174所學校因流感停課,當局呼籲民眾落實勤洗手及佩戴口罩等防護措施。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak update: in week 7 (9–15 February), the average number of cases at sentinel outpatient clinics was 41.44, with more than 150,000 cases nationwide. The main type is type B (65%). By prefecture, average case numbers were highest in Oita (64.43), Saitama (62.6) and Kagoshima (62.12). A total of 35 prefectures had average case numbers above the warning level of 30. The average case number for this flu season peaked at 51.12 in late November last year and fell at year-end, but has risen continuously since January this year. As of the week of 15 February, 8,174 schools nationwide had suspended classes due to influenza. Authorities urge the public to maintain thorough hand hygiene, wear masks and take other protective measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨今年首例H5N1人類感染,18國報告208起H5N1疫情
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported its first human H5N1 case this year, while 18 countries reported 208 H5N1 animal outbreaks during 10–20 February.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:中國新增2例H9N2、1例H10N3及1例H1N2v流感人類感染病例,柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,孟加拉新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例;今年累計報告H5N1流感2例、H9N2流感5例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。   柬埔寨報告今年首例H5N1人類感染病例,為該國西南部貢布省30歲男性,個案出現發燒、咳嗽及腹痛等症狀,經治療後已康復,調查發現個案發病前於家中有烹煮死亡雞隻,當局對感染源進行調查中。   禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計41國家/地區報告917起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。WAHIS   共18國於2026/2/10-20期間報告208起H5N1疫情,南韓51起、比利時28起、波蘭27起、法國23起、荷蘭15起、丹麥9起、印度/捷克/瑞典各8起、匈牙利/美國各6起、挪威5起、立陶宛4起、不丹/奧地利各3起、愛沙亞2起、斯洛伐克/赫德島和麥克唐納群島各1起。 比利時於2026/2/20期間報告9起H5 (N untyped)疫情。   美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,088(4)起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/2/8-2/14共475個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡/印第安納州共9個採檢點檢出H5陽性。USDA、NWSS
items.description_en: Human cases: China reported 2 new H9N2 cases, 1 H10N3 case and 1 H1N2v human influenza infection; Cambodia reported 1 new H5N1 human infection; and Bangladesh reported 1 new H5N1 human infection. So far this year, 2 cases of H5N1, 5 cases of H9N2 and 1 case of H10N3 influenza have been reported cumulatively, and most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Cambodia reported its first H5N1 human infection this year, in a 30-year-old man from Kampot Province in the southwest of the country, who developed fever, cough and abdominal pain and recovered after treatment. Investigation found that he had cooked dead chickens at home before onset, and authorities are investigating the source of infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 41 countries and regions have reported 917 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. A total of 18 countries reported 208 H5N1 outbreaks during 10–20 February 2026: South Korea 51, Belgium 28, Poland 27, France 23, the Netherlands 15, Denmark 9, India, Czechia and Sweden 8 each, Hungary and the United States 6 each, Norway 5, Lithuania 4, Bhutan and Austria 3 each, Estonia 2, and Slovakia, Heard Island and McDonald Islands 1 each. Belgium reported 9 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 20 February 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,088 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin and California. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 475 sampling sites for 8–14 February 2026, of which 9 sampling sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Oregon and Indiana detected H5-positive results. Sources: USDA; NWSS.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率升至3.67%,XFG占52.51%居首,中國門診陽性率1.7%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 3.67% in week 6; XFG leads variants at 52.51%, and China's outpatient positivity was 1.7% in week 7.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第6週(2/2-8)全球陽性率上升至3.67%,其中西太平洋區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情於低點持平,今年第7週(2/9-15)門診陽性率1.7%,較前1週下降,變異株以NB.1.8.1占多數。 香港疫情於低點略升,今年第7週門診陽性率0.1%,汙水監測變異株以XFG占多數(62%),其次為BA.3.2(占25.1%)。  評估與建議: 全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG最高(占52.51%),其次為NB.1.8.1(21.07%)。WHO公布之全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,尚不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 6 of this year (2–8 February), the global positivity rate rose to 3.67%, with a notable increase in the WHO Western Pacific Region. China's epidemic has remained flat at a low point; in week 7 (9–15 February), the outpatient positivity rate was 1.7%, a decrease from the previous week, and NB.1.8.1 was the majority variant. Hong Kong's epidemic has risen slightly from its low point; the outpatient positivity rate in week 7 was 0.1%, and wastewater surveillance showed XFG as the majority variant (62%), followed by BA.3.2 (25.1%). Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (52.51%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21.07%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they are not expected to cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區

items.summary_zh: 新加坡今年1月11例麻疹確定病例,皆無完整接種史,可能存在未發現社區傳播
items.summary_en: Singapore reported 11 measles cases in January this year, none fully vaccinated, with possible undetected community spread.
items.description_zh: 新加坡今年1月報告11例確定病例,皆未具完整疫苗接種史,其中3例為12個月以下嬰兒,另除1例為遊客外,其餘皆為該國居民,其中7例近期具海外旅遊史。當局表示今年病例數高於去(2025)年同期(2例)。另11例病例中,有3例經實驗室檢測具基因關聯性,惟病例間無相同暴露史,可能存在未被發現之社區傳播,流行病學仍在調查中。
items.description_en: Singapore reported 11 confirmed cases in January this year, none of whom had a complete vaccination history. Three were infants under 12 months old. Apart from one visitor, all were residents of Singapore, and 7 had recent overseas travel history. Authorities say case numbers this year are higher than the 2 cases in the same period last year. Among the 11 cases, 3 showed genetic links by laboratory testing, but there was no common exposure history among cases, so undetected community transmission may exist, and epidemiological investigation is ongoing.

items.summary_zh: 印度西孟加拉州今年1月2例立百病毒確定病例,25歲護理師2/12死亡
items.summary_en: India's West Bengal reported two Nipah cases in January this year; a 25-year-old nurse died on 12 February, the wave's first death.
items.description_zh: 印度西孟加拉州前於今(2026)年1月報告2例確定病例,其中1名25歲護理師感染後,長期昏迷,於接受治療數週後,仍因多種併發症於2/12死亡,為此波疫情之第1例死亡案例,另其近期之病毒檢測結果已轉陰性。
items.description_en: In West Bengal, India, two confirmed cases were reported earlier in January this year. One of them, a 25-year-old nurse, remained in a coma for a long period after infection; after several weeks of treatment, she died on 12 February from multiple complications. She is the first death in this wave of the outbreak. Her most recent virological test has turned negative.

items.summary_zh: 安徽省同家3例鸚鵡熱住院,泰國2/3報告首例,患者均已痊癒
items.summary_en: Anhui, China, reported three hospitalized psittacosis cases in one family, and Thailand its first case on 3 February; all have recovered.
items.description_zh: 中國安徽省2/3報告3例住院病例,病患為同一家人,經接觸家中飼養3隻異常死亡的鸚鵡後發病,病患現已痊癒。 泰國於2/3報告該國首例病例,個案具慢性病史且於2025年年底通報,其於家中通風不良處飼養鳥類,清理鳥籠時未佩戴口罩、手套等防護裝備,病患經治療後已痊癒。
items.description_en: In Anhui Province, China, three hospitalized cases were reported on 3 February. The patients were members of the same family and fell ill after contact with three parrots kept at home that had died unusually. The patients have now recovered. Thailand reported its first case on 3 February. The patient had a chronic disease history and had been notified at the end of 2025. The patient kept birds in a poorly ventilated area of the home and did not wear protective equipment such as masks and gloves when cleaning bird cages. The patient has recovered after treatment.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),泰國

items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭2022-26年累計6例狂犬病死亡,動物感染逐年攀升
items.summary_en: Ukraine has reported 6 rabies deaths cumulatively from 2022 to 2026, and animal infections have risen year by year.
items.description_zh: 烏克蘭自2022-26年累計報告6例死亡病例,2021-24年確診病例數亦自780例上升至2,507例,動物感染數亦逐年攀升;近期研究顯示因受戰爭影響,未接種疫苗的流浪動物(包括野生動物)數量增加,且活動環境擴張。此外,原由家庭飼養之寵物亦遭棄養而流落街頭,進一步增加人畜接觸與傳播風險。
items.description_en: Ukraine has reported 6 rabies deaths cumulatively from 2022 to 2026. Confirmed case numbers for 2021–24 also rose from 780 to 2,507, and animal infections have risen year by year. Recent research shows that, due to the war, the number of unvaccinated stray animals, including wildlife, has increased and their range of activity has expanded. In addition, pets once kept at home have been abandoned and left on the streets, further increasing the risk of human-animal contact and transmission.

items.headline_zh: 俄國-黏質沙雷氏桿菌感染
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯克麥羅沃州新生兒10例死亡,醫院環境檢出黏質沙雷氏桿菌
items.summary_en: Kemerovo Oblast, Russia, reported 10 newborn deaths from December 2025 to early February; hospital wall samples tested positive for Serratia marcescens.
items.description_zh: 俄國中部克麥羅沃州(Kemerovo)2025年12月截至今年2月初累計報告10例死亡病例,病患皆為某醫院產房新生兒,先前感染源不明,經採檢醫院牆壁環境檢體呈黏質沙雷氏桿菌(Serratia marcescens)陽性,且產婦入院時檢測為陰性,經當局評估院內感染的可能原因包含感管疏失、環境污染、或假期期間之醫護人力緊縮所致
items.description_en: In Kemerovo Oblast in central Russia, 10 deaths were reported cumulatively from December 2025 to early February this year. All patients were newborns in the maternity ward of one hospital. The source of infection was initially unknown. Samples from hospital wall surfaces tested positive for Serratia marcescens, while the mothers tested negative on admission. Authorities assess that possible causes of the hospital-acquired infection include lapses in infection control, environmental contamination, or reduced staffing during the holiday period.

items.headline_zh: 阿根廷-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 阿根廷今年14例漢他病毒症候群,自2025年7月起累計73例
items.summary_en: Argentina has reported 14 hantavirus syndrome cases this year as of 10 February, and 73 since July 2025.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷今年截至2/10累計報告14例病例,病患分布於布宜諾斯艾利斯等4個省份。另自本流行季(2025/7)以來累計報告73例病例,疫情已高於往年;該國2019-2024年致死率(CFR)介於10-32%。
items.description_en: Argentina reported 14 cases so far this year as of 10 February, distributed across four provinces, including Buenos Aires. Since the current epidemic season began in July 2025, 73 cases have been reported cumulatively, which is higher than in previous years. Argentina's case fatality rate (CFR) in 2019–2024 ranged from 10% to 32%.

items.summary_zh: PAHO發布警報,美洲去年屈公病313,132例、170例死亡
items.summary_en: PAHO issued an alert on 11 February after rising chikungunya outbreaks in the Americas, which reported 313,132 cases and 170 deaths last year.
items.description_zh: 泛美衛生組織(PAHO)於2/11發布警報,對於美洲數國自去年底迄今年初之疫情上升,建議各國加強監測、臨床及病媒蚊管制。全球去年1/1-12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,其中,美洲報告313,132例病例(113,926例確診)及170例死亡,多國/地區自去年底疫情持續上升,且於近年無疫情發生之地區再次出現本地傳播病例,如蓋亞那、法屬圭亞那及蘇利南等國。
items.description_en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an alert on 11 February about rising outbreaks in several countries in the Americas since late last year and early this year, recommending strengthened surveillance, clinical management and vector mosquito control. Globally, from 1 January to 10 December last year, 41 countries and regions reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. Of these, the Americas reported 313,132 cases (113,926 confirmed) and 170 deaths. Many countries have seen outbreaks continue to rise since late last year, and locally transmitted cases have reappeared in areas without outbreaks in recent years, such as Guyana, French Guiana and Suriname.
items.area_zh: 法屬圭亞那,蓋亞那共和國,蘇利南

items.summary_zh: 中國新增2例H9N2、1例H10N3人類感染,均為去年底至今年初發病
items.summary_en: China reported 2 new H9N2 cases and 1 H10N3 human infection, with onset between late December 2025 and mid-January 2026.
items.description_zh: 中國新增2例H9N2及1例H10N3流感人類感染病例,分別為廣東省73歲女性、湖南省2歲男童及廣東省34歲男性,發病時間介於2025/12/25-2026/1/17,餘流行病學資訊不明。
items.description_en: China reported 2 new H9N2 cases and 1 H10N3 human influenza infection: a 73-year-old woman in Guangdong Province, a 2-year-old boy in Hunan Province and a 34-year-old man in Guangdong Province. Onset dates ranged from 25 December 2025 to 17 January 2026. Other epidemiological information is not available.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 1/29-2/4期間WPV1新增阿富汗3例,cVDPV2新增3例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported three new WPV1 cases in Afghanistan and three new cVDPV2 cases, in Chad and the DRC, for 29 January–4 February.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/29-2/4期間,WPV1新增阿富汗3例;cVDPV2新增查德2例、剛果民主共和國1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增阿富汗4件及巴基斯坦3件,cVDPV2新增貝南2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 29 January–4 February, WPV1 newly reported three cases in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported two cases in Chad and one in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. For environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported four samples in Afghanistan and three in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported two samples in Benin.

items.headline_zh: 日本/韓國/香港-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.headline_en: Japan / South Korea / Hong Kong SAR – Viral gastroenteritis (norovirus)
items.summary_zh: 日本第5週腸胃炎平均9.42例,近10年同期最高;香港食物中毒37起
items.summary_en: Japan's average sentinel gastroenteritis reports reached 9.42 in week 5, the highest for the same period in ten years, and Hong Kong logged 37 food poisoning incidents.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情持續上升,第5週(1/26-2/1)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告9.42例,疫情為近10年同期最高,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情持續攀升,第5週(1/25-31)報告709例病例,疫情為近5年最高,病患以0-6歲佔最多。 香港今年1月起食物中毒案件增加,1/18-2/9累計報告37起食物中毒案件(共影響115人),其中33起(89%)與諾羅病毒相關,共101例病例,疑感染源為韓國、法國及愛爾蘭等地生產的生蠔。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak continues to rise. In week 5 (26 January–1 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis was 9.42 cases, the highest for the same period in the past 10 years; the pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak continues to climb: it reported 709 cases in week 5 (25–31 January), the highest in five years, with children aged 0–6 years accounting for the largest share. In Hong Kong, food poisoning incidents have increased since January this year. Between 18 January and 9 February, 37 food poisoning incidents were reported cumulatively, affecting 115 people, of which 33 (89%) were linked to norovirus, with 101 cases in total. The suspected source of infection is oysters produced in South Korea, France and Ireland.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國

items.summary_zh: 全球2025年累計逾61萬例霍亂、7,598例死亡,12月新增約1.7萬例
items.summary_en: WHO reports more than 610,000 cholera cases and 7,598 deaths globally in 2025, with about 17,000 new cases in December, down 25% from November.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球2025年累計報告逾61萬例病例、死亡7,598例,其中,12月新增報告約1.7萬例,較11月下降25%,各國CFR介於0-8.2%;病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞、美洲及西太平洋區共33個國家/地區,近期新增病例以阿富汗、剛果民主共和國、葉門及莫三比克為多。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally in 2025, more than 610,000 cases and 7,598 deaths were reported cumulatively. In December, about 17,000 new cases were reported, a 25% decrease from November, and CFRs across countries range from 0–8.2%. Cases were distributed across 33 countries and regions in the Eastern Mediterranean, African, South-East Asian, American and Western Pacific regions. Recent new cases are concentrated in Afghanistan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Yemen and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people are at risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

items.headline_zh: 英國/維德角-桿菌性痢疾
items.headline_en: United Kingdom / Cape Verde – Bacillary dysentery (shigellosis)
items.summary_zh: 英國自2025年10月至2/8累計158例桿菌性痢疾,112例有維德角旅遊史
items.summary_en: The UK reported 158 bacillary dysentery cases from October 2025 to 8 February, 112 with Cape Verde travel history.
items.description_zh: 英國疫情更新,自2025年10月起迄今年2/8累計報告158例病例,其中112例有維德角共和國旅遊史,並已報告至少4例死亡案例,當局已發布旅遊建議,呼籲遊客勤洗手、避免生食。另荷蘭、瑞典、法國及愛爾蘭亦有報告與維德角共和國相關之病例。
items.description_en: The UK's outbreak update: from October 2025 to 8 February this year, 158 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 112 had travel history to the Republic of Cabo Verde (Cape Verde), and at least 4 deaths have been reported. Authorities have issued travel advice calling on travellers to wash their hands frequently and avoid eating raw food. Cases linked to Cape Verde have also been reported in the Netherlands, Sweden, France and Ireland.
