items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Cape Verde

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年第1-3週1,031例麻疹,較去年同期增43倍,哈薩克1月1,951例
items.summary_en: The Americas reported 1,031 measles cases in weeks 1–3 this year, a 43-fold rise on last year, and Kazakhstan 1,951 confirmed cases in January.
items.description_zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
items.description_en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,加拿大,智利,法國,瓜地馬拉,義大利,哈薩克,墨西哥,荷蘭,羅馬尼亞,西班牙,烏拉圭,美國

items.summary_zh: 南非姆普馬蘭加省1月瘧疾314例,較去年同期多69例,洪水致病媒蚊增
items.summary_en: South Africa's Mpumalanga Province reported 314 malaria cases in January, 69 more than last year, as flooding boosted mosquito breeding.
items.description_zh: 南非東部姆普馬蘭加省疫情明顯上升,於1月份報告314例病例,高於去年同期69例,由於洪水導致病媒蚊孳生且適逢流行季,疫情可能持續至3-4月,當局呼籲加強預防措施。
items.description_en: Malaria in Mpumalanga Province in eastern South Africa has risen markedly, with 314 cases reported in January, 69 more than the same period last year. Flooding has led to mosquito breeding, and this coincides with the epidemic season. The outbreak may continue until March–April, and authorities call for strengthened prevention measures.

items.summary_zh: 薩摩亞自去年累計16,842例登革熱、8例死亡,近期1名7個月嬰兒死亡
items.summary_en: Samoa has recorded 16,842 dengue cases and 8 deaths since last year, and a 7-month-old infant recently died.
items.description_zh: 薩摩亞近期報告1例7個月大嬰兒死亡病例,1/26-2/2新增56例病例,自去年迄今已累計16,842例病例及8例死亡,主要流行型別為DENV-1。
items.description_en: Samoa has recently reported one death of a 7-month-old infant. From 26 January to 2 February, 56 new cases were reported, and since last year, 16,842 cases and 8 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The main circulating serotype is DENV-1.

items.headline_zh: 蘇利南/哥斯大黎加-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 蘇利南1月累計137例屈公病,哥斯大黎加今年第2例確診為51歲女性
items.summary_en: Suriname recorded 137 chikungunya cases in January, and Costa Rica confirmed its second case this year, a 51-year-old woman.
items.description_zh: 蘇利南疫情持續,1月份累計報告137例病例,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第2例確診病例,為該國西部旁塔雷納斯省埃斯帕爾薩郡51歲女性,依症狀出現日期評估,個案感染日期可能與首例病例相近。
items.description_en: Suriname's outbreak continues: 137 cases were reported in January, and the US CDC recently raised its travel notice for the country to Level 2. Costa Rica reported its second confirmed case this year, a 51-year-old woman from Esparza District in Puntarenas Province in the west of the country. Based on the date of symptom onset, the infection date may be close to that of the first case.

items.headline_zh: 香港-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 香港1/18-2/5食物中毒23起、69例,其中57例為諾羅病毒感染
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 23 food poisoning incidents affecting 69 cases from 18 January to 5 February, 57 of them norovirus infections.
items.description_zh: 香港近期食物中毒案件上升,1/18-2/5累計報告23起食品中毒案件,影響69例病例,其中57例為諾羅病毒感染;經調查疑感染源為韓國、法國、愛爾蘭及西班牙等地生產的生蠔。另於2024年,香港累計報告739食品中毒病例,其中46.9%與諾羅相關。
items.description_en: Hong Kong has seen a recent rise in food poisoning incidents. Between 18 January and 5 February, 23 food poisoning incidents were reported cumulatively, affecting 69 cases, of which 57 were norovirus infections. Investigation suggests the suspected source of infection is oysters produced in South Korea, France, Ireland and Spain. In 2024, Hong Kong reported 739 food poisoning cases cumulatively, of which 46.9% were norovirus-related.

items.summary_zh: 日本第5週門診平均30.03例,全國約11萬例,東京都第2次流感警報
items.summary_en: Japan's sentinel clinic average reached 30.03 flu cases in week 5, about 110,000 cases nationwide, and Tokyo issued its second flu warning this season.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情上升,今年第5週(1/26-2/1)定點門診平均病例數為30.03例,約為第4週病例數2倍,已連續4週上升,全國病例數約為11萬例,較前1週新增5萬餘例,A型流感(56%)及B型(44%)共同流行,平均病例數以大分(52.48例)、鹿兒島 (49.6例)、山梨及千葉縣為多,預期疫情仍會持續2週,當局呼籲民眾落實勤洗手及佩戴口罩等防護措施。東京都第5週平均病例數為26.67例,發布本流感季第2次警報,其於去年11月發布首次警報,今年1月解除,為該都自1999年以來,於同一季發布兩次警報。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is rising. In week 5 (26 January–1 February), the average number of sentinel outpatient cases was 30.03, about twice the number in week 4, and it has risen for four consecutive weeks. Nationwide case numbers were about 110,000, with more than 50,000 new cases compared with the previous week. Influenza A (56%) and B (44%) are circulating together. By prefecture, averages were highest in Oita (52.48), Kagoshima (49.6), Yamanashi and Chiba. The epidemic is expected to continue for two more weeks, and authorities urge the public to maintain thorough hand hygiene and wear masks, among other protective measures. Tokyo's average case number in week 5 was 26.67, and Tokyo has issued the second warning of this flu season. It had issued the first warning in late November last year and lifted it in January this year; this is the first time since 1999 that Tokyo has issued two warnings in the same season.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 1/30-2/6期間21國報告336起H5N1疫情,德國99起居首
items.summary_en: 21 countries reported 336 H5N1 animal outbreaks during 30 January–6 February 2026, led by Germany with 99.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:巴西新增1例H3N2v流感人類感染病例;今年累計報告H9N2流感3例(迄今累計168例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計36國家/地區報告545起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  共21國於2026/1/30-2/6期間報告336起H5N1疫情,德國99起、英國73起、波蘭43起、法國/荷蘭各20起、瑞典19起、捷克11起、匈牙利/挪威各9起、義大利7起、美國/臺灣各5起、羅馬亞4起、瑞士3起、摩爾多瓦/斯洛伐克各2起、保加利亞/奈及利亞/奧地利/斯洛維亞/盧森堡各1起。 墨西哥於2026/2/4報告1起H7N3疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州;該國廢水監測於2026/1/25-31共462個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中密西根/紐澤西/奧勒岡州共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Human cases: Brazil reported 1 new H3N2v human influenza infection. So far this year, 3 cases of H9N2 influenza have been reported, bringing the cumulative total to 168; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): So far this year, 36 countries and regions have reported 545 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. A total of 21 countries reported 336 H5N1 outbreaks during 30 January–6 February 2026: Germany 99, the United Kingdom 73, Poland 43, France and the Netherlands 20 each, Sweden 19, Czechia 11, Hungary and Norway 9 each, Italy 7, the United States and Taiwan 5 each, Romania 4, Switzerland 3, Moldova and Slovakia 2 each, and Bulgaria, Nigeria, Austria, Slovenia and Luxembourg 1 each. Mexico reported 1 H7N3 outbreak on 4 February 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 19 states since March 2024, with 1,084 outbreaks cumulatively; recent cases are concentrated in Wisconsin. US wastewater surveillance provided results from 462 sampling sites for 25–31 January 2026, of which 4 sampling sites in Michigan, New Jersey and Oregon detected H5-positive results.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球第3週陽性率升至3.49%,中國第5週門診陽性率升至2.3%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 3.49% in week 3; China's outpatient positivity rose to 2.3% in week 5.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第3週(1/12-18)全球陽性率上升至3.49%,其中歐洲及東南亞區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情上升,今年第5週(1/26-2/1)門診陽性率上升至2.3%,疫情已連續2週上升,變異株以NB.1.8.1占多數。 韓國疫情上升,今年第5週新增59例住院病例,陽性率略降至1.3%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占多數。  評估與建議: 全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG最高。WHO於2/2發布COVID-19全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,6%「有症狀病例」出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 3 of this year (12–18 January), the global positivity rate rose to 3.49%, with notable increases in the WHO European and South-East Asian regions. China's epidemic is rising: the outpatient positivity rate in week 5 (26 January–1 February) rose to 2.3%, the epidemic has risen for two consecutive weeks, and NB.1.8.1 is the majority variant. South Korea's epidemic is rising: 59 new hospitalized cases were reported in week 5, the positivity rate fell slightly to 1.3%, and NB.1.8.1 is the majority variant. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of globally circulating variants. WHO published its global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) on 2 February, which rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),韓國

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉-立百病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉1例立百病毒確診死亡,全國累計348例、CFR 72%
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported a fatal Nipah case in Naogaon on 3 February, with 348 cases and 250 deaths (CFR 72%) cumulatively since 2001.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉西北部拉傑沙希專區瑙岡縣2/3報告1例確診病例,為40-50歲女性,於1/21出現發燒及神經等症狀,1/28死亡,1/29確診,個案曾於1/5-20期間多次食用生椰棗汁,目前對35名密切接觸者進行追蹤調查,截至2/3尚無新增病例。該國於2001年報告首例病例,迄今累計報告348例病例及250例死亡(CFR:72%),疫情常發生於12月至隔年4月,為椰棗汁的收穫及消費期間。該國自2016年以來,每年報告病例數多為10例以下,僅2023年報告14例,過去疫情曾報告人際傳播情形,惟近年來已減少。WHO評估於孟加拉/區域/全球之公共衛生風險為低,建議依現有資訊目前尚無須對孟加拉採取旅遊或貿易的限制。
items.description_en: In Naogaon District, Rajshahi Division, in north-western Bangladesh, one confirmed case was reported on 3 February: a woman aged 40–50 years who developed fever and neurological symptoms on 21 January, died on 28 January, and was confirmed on 29 January. The patient had repeatedly consumed raw date palm sap between 5 and 20 January. Contact tracing of 35 close contacts is ongoing, and no new cases had been found as of 3 February. The country reported its first case in 2001 and has reported 348 cases and 250 deaths cumulatively (CFR: 72%). Outbreaks usually occur from December to April, coinciding with the harvest and consumption period of date palm sap. Since 2016, the country has reported fewer than 10 cases a year, except for 14 cases in 2023. Human-to-human transmission was reported in past outbreaks but has decreased in recent years. WHO assesses the public health risk in Bangladesh, the region and globally as low, and, based on current information, recommends no travel or trade restrictions on Bangladesh.

items.summary_zh: 中美洲及墨西哥自2023年爆發蠅蛆症,人類逾1,240例、動物逾15萬例
items.summary_en: Central America and Mexico have reported over 1,240 human and 150,000 animal myiasis cases since 2023; US CDC issued a health advisory.
items.description_zh: 中美洲及墨西哥自2023年爆發疫情,截至今年2/3已報告逾1,240例人類病例及逾15萬例動物病例;美國CDC於1/20發布新世界螺旋蠅(NWS)健康警報,說明墨西哥塔毛利帕斯州(與德州接壤)報告8例動物病例,美國截至1/21,境內尚未發現與此次疫情相關之人類或動物感染病例,基於疫情擴散之可能性,該警報提供臨床醫師、衛生部門、實驗室、獸醫師及民眾相關指導建議。
items.description_en: Central America and Mexico have experienced outbreaks since 2023. As of 3 February this year, more than 1,240 human cases and more than 150,000 animal cases have been reported. On 20 January, the US CDC issued a health advisory on New World screwworm (NWS), noting that Tamaulipas State in Mexico, which borders Texas, reported 8 animal cases. As of 21 January, no human or animal infections related to this outbreak had been found within the United States. Given the possibility of spread, the advisory provides guidance for clinicians, health departments, laboratories, veterinarians and the public.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年確定9例M痘,自2022年累計1,032例,多為30-39歲男性
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 9 confirmed mpox cases this year, and 1,032 since 2022, mostly among men aged 30–39, with only sporadic cases so far.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至1/21累計報告9例確定病例,自2022年截至1/25累計報告1,032例確定病例,以30-39歲男性族群為多,當局表示目前僅發現零星病例,未爆發大規模疫情,將持續進行監測、篩檢及高風險族群衛教宣導等工作。另建議民眾倘有發燒、皮疹或膿皰等症狀,且具相關風險因子,應立即就醫,並避免與他人密切接觸。泰國疾管局1/30
items.description_en: Thailand reported 9 confirmed cases this year as of 21 January, and 1,032 confirmed cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 25 January, mainly among men aged 30–39. Authorities say only sporadic cases have been found so far and no large-scale outbreak has occurred; surveillance, screening and health education for high-risk groups will continue. The public is advised that anyone with fever, rash or pustules and relevant risk factors should seek medical care immediately and avoid close contact with others. Source: Thailand Department of Disease Control, 30 January.

items.headline_zh: 香港-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 香港新增1例腦膜炎雙球菌確定病例,64歲男性住院,密切接觸者迄今無人發病。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported one new confirmed meningococcal case in a 64-year-old man; no close contacts have fallen ill so far.
items.description_zh: 香港新增報告1例確定病例,為64歲具慢性病史男性個案,於1/26出現雙腿紅腫疼痛,隔日發燒就醫,並住院治療,目前狀況穩定,經檢驗為腦膜炎雙球菌陽性。病患於潛伏期間無旅遊史,密切接觸者迄2/4無人發病,當局已提供接觸者預防性藥物及持續進行疫情調查,並提醒民眾落實個人及環境衞生。香港去(2025)年累計報告11例確定病例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported one new confirmed case, a 64-year-old man with a history of chronic illness who developed leg redness and pain on 26 January, had a fever the next day and was admitted to hospital. His condition is stable, and laboratory testing was positive for Neisseria meningitidis. The patient had no travel history during the incubation period. As of 4 February, no close contacts had fallen ill. Authorities have provided preventive medication to close contacts, are continuing the outbreak investigation, and remind the public to maintain personal and environmental hygiene. Hong Kong reported 11 confirmed cases in total in 2025.

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本第4週腸胃炎門診平均8.55例,已連續3週上升,病原多為諾羅病毒。
items.summary_en: Japan's average gastroenteritis reports at sentinel clinics rose for three weeks to 8.55 in week 4, mostly norovirus.
items.description_zh: 日本今年第4週(1/19-25)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告8.55例,疫情已連續3週上升,致病原多為諾羅病毒,病患分佈以群馬縣及岐阜縣為多,當局呼籲民眾如廁後,徹底洗手,清理嘔吐物時,佩戴手套及口罩。
items.description_en: In week 4 (19–25 January), the average number of infectious gastroenteritis cases reported at Japan's sentinel clinics was 8.55, and the trend has risen for three consecutive weeks. The causative pathogen is mostly norovirus, with cases concentrated in Gunma and Gifu prefectures. Authorities urge people to wash their hands thoroughly after using the toilet, and to wear gloves and a mask when cleaning up vomit.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 全球/阿富汗/中非共和國/查德/馬利-小兒麻痺症
items.headline_en: Global / Afghanistan / Central African Republic / Chad / Mali – Poliomyelitis
items.summary_zh: GPEI:阿富汗新增1例WPV1病例,中非、查德及馬利各1例cVDPV2病例。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new WPV1 case in Afghanistan and one cVDPV2 case each in the Central African Republic, Chad and Mali.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/22-1/28期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/查德/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦9件、阿富汗5件,cVDPV2新增5國共6件,分別為馬拉威2件、阿爾及利亞/查德/納米比亞/英國各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 22 and 28 January, WPV1 had one new case in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2 had one new case each in the Central African Republic, Chad and Mali. For environmental samples, WPV1 had 9 new positive samples in Pakistan and 5 in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 had 6 new samples across 5 countries: 2 in Malawi, and 1 each in Algeria, Chad, Namibia and the United Kingdom.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,中非共和國,查德,馬利

items.headline_zh: 韓國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 韓國第4週病毒性腸胃炎報告616例,為近5年同期最高,0至6歲佔39.6%。
items.summary_en: South Korea reported 616 viral gastroenteritis cases in week 4, the highest for that period in five years; ages 0–6 made up 39.6%.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情更新,今年第4週(1/18-24)報告616例病例,疫情與前一週相當,為近5年同期最高,嬰幼兒(0-6歲)佔所有患者的39.6%;當局呼籲病患於症狀緩解2天後,再返回校園或職場。
items.description_en: South Korea's update: in week 4 (18–24 January), 616 cases were reported, similar to the previous week and the highest for the same period in the past five years. Infants and young children aged 0–6 years accounted for 39.6% of all patients. Authorities advise patients to return to school or work only 2 days after symptoms ease.

items.summary_zh: 迦納2021至2025年累計約72萬例傷寒病例,擬對食品相關工作者強制接種疫苗。
items.summary_en: Ghana reported about 720,000 cumulative typhoid cases in 2021–2025 and plans mandatory vaccination for food-related workers.
items.description_zh: 迦納2021-2025年累計報告約72萬例病例,當局正規劃替所有食物相關工作者者包括攤販、餐廳及飯店等工作者強制接種疫苗,並加強準備餐飲之衛生教育。
items.description_en: Ghana reported about 720,000 cumulative cases during 2021–2025. Authorities are planning mandatory vaccination for all food-related workers, including street vendors, restaurant staff and hotel workers, and are strengthening health education on food preparation.

items.headline_zh: 美國/新加坡-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 美國報告65例沙門氏菌感染,疑與辣木葉粉有關;新加坡第3週報告22例。
items.summary_en: The US reported 65 Salmonella cases, 14 hospitalised, possibly linked to moringa leaf powder; Singapore reported 22 cases in week 3.
items.description_zh: 美國於1/29報告65例病例,其中14例住院,病患分布於28個州,發病日介於2025年8/22至今年1/11,與典型的季節性(夏末至初秋達到高峰)模式不同。經當局調查疑感染源為某生產商製造之辣木葉粉,商品已下架。 新加坡今年第3週(1/18-24)報告22例病例,較近5年同期中位數(24例)低;近期發表的研究顯示該國2019年之沙門氏菌感染症病例累計2,050例,占該國食物相關傳染病之大宗(占33%),並造成812萬美元之經濟負擔。CDA 1/29、Value in Health Regional Issues 1/16
items.description_en: The United States reported 65 cases on 29 January, 14 of them hospitalised, across 28 states, with onset dates between 22 August 2025 and 11 January 2026. This differs from the typical seasonal pattern, which peaks from late summer to early autumn. Authorities suspect the source is moringa leaf powder produced by one manufacturer, and the product has been removed from sale. Singapore reported 22 cases in week 3 (18–24 January), below the five-year median of 24 for the same period. A recently published study found 2,050 cumulative Salmonella infection cases in Singapore in 2019, the largest share of food-related infectious diseases (33%), with an economic burden of US$8.12 million. Sources: CDA, 29 January; Value in Health Regional Issues, 16 January.

items.summary_zh: 香港1月報告4例兒童流感重症;夏季流感季共25例兒童重症,含3例死亡。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 4 severe paediatric influenza cases in January and 25 in the summer season, including 3 deaths.
items.description_zh: 香港今年1月累計報告4例兒童流感重症個案,年齡介於6個月至15歲,其中2例未接種季節性(2025/2026)流感疫苗,另於1月初結束之夏季流感季累計報告25例兒童重症個案,其中3例死亡,其中80%病例未接種季節性流感疫苗,當局表示目前六個月至未滿兩歲年齡層之疫苗接種率僅23%,呼籲家長應讓子女儘速接種。
items.description_en: In January, Hong Kong reported 4 severe paediatric influenza cases, aged 6 months to 15 years, 2 of whom had not received the 2025/2026 seasonal influenza vaccine. The summer influenza season, which ended in early January, recorded 25 severe paediatric cases in total, including 3 deaths; 80% of these cases had not been vaccinated against seasonal influenza. Authorities said vaccination coverage for children aged 6 months to under 2 years is currently only 23%, and urged parents to have their children vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年麻疹累計588例、17州報告,94%未接種或接種史不明,以南卡為主。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 588 measles cases this year across 17 states, mainly in South Carolina, with 94% unvaccinated or of unknown status.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續,今(2026)年截至1/29共17州累計報告588例確定病例,其中17例住院,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告467例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州53例確定病例,該國94%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/猶他/亞利桑那州。該國去(2025)年報告2,267例病例,為近30年最高。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the United States continues. As of 29 January 2026, 588 confirmed cases had been reported this year across 17 states, 17 of whom were hospitalised. Most cases were in South Carolina, with 467 confirmed cases, followed by Utah with 53. 94% of patients were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina, Utah and Arizona. The country reported 2,267 cases in 2025, the highest in nearly 30 years.

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉-狐蝠正呼腸孤病毒
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉研究在5例疑似立百病毒病例中確認狐蝠正呼腸孤病毒,病例皆曾食用生棗椰汁。
items.summary_en: A Bangladesh study identified Pteropine orthoreovirus in five suspected Nipah cases, all Nipah-negative; all had eaten raw date palm sap.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉研究發現新興蝙蝠來源病毒,5名2022年12月至2023 年3疑感染立百病毒病例(NiV),經PCR 與血清檢測皆為NiV陰性,其中3例成功培養出病毒,且透過高通量定序確認狐蝠正呼腸孤病毒(Pteropine orthoreovirus, PRV),病患皆曾食用生棗椰汁,病例間無流行病學關聯,病患臨床症狀包含發燒、意識混亂、行走異常、呼吸困難及腦炎,其中1名病患於2024年因不明神經症狀惡化死亡,研究顯示食用生椰棗汁的疾病風險不僅限於NiV感染,另PRV病毒基因重組潛力可能致其傳播性和毒力的改變,研究建議於食用生椰棗汁地區,應進行分子和血清學監測,並針對腦炎及其他不明原因發燒疾病之呼吸道疾病進行PRV、NiV及其他蝙蝠傳播病毒鑑別診斷。
items.description_en: A study in Bangladesh identified an emerging bat-borne virus. Five people suspected of Nipah virus (NiV) infection between December 2022 and March 2023 tested negative for NiV by PCR and serological testing. Three of the samples yielded virus isolates, and high-throughput sequencing confirmed Pteropine orthoreovirus (PRV). All patients had consumed raw date palm sap, and the cases had no epidemiological link to one another. Clinical symptoms included fever, confusion, gait abnormalities, difficulty breathing and encephalitis. One patient died in 2024 after unexplained neurological symptoms worsened. The study found that the disease risk from consuming raw date palm sap is not limited to NiV infection. Genetic reassortment of PRV may alter its transmissibility and virulence. The study recommends molecular and serological surveillance in areas where raw date palm sap is consumed, and differential diagnosis for PRV, NiV and other bat-borne viruses in patients with encephalitis or febrile respiratory illness of unknown cause.

items.headline_zh: 法屬圭亞那/蘇利南-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 法屬圭亞那首見本土屈公病病例,蘇利南報告134例及1例死亡,疫情上升。
items.summary_en: French Guiana reported its first local chikungunya case since 2014, while Suriname's outbreak rose to 134 cases and one death.
items.description_zh: 法屬圭亞那報告自2014年以來首例本土病例,個案近期無旅遊史,1/21檢驗陽性,病毒目前仍於印度洋地區傳播,2025年4月曾報告由印度洋地區返回之病例。outbreaknewstoday 1/30 蘇利南疫情上升,報告134例病例及1例死亡,主要分布於45-64歲(38 例病例)及25-44歲族群(27例病例),為該國相隔約10年後再次發生疫情。當局推估首批病例發生於去年12月,預計感染高峰將持續3到4個月
items.description_en: French Guiana reported its first locally acquired case since 2014. The patient had no recent travel history and tested positive on 21 January. The virus is still circulating in the Indian Ocean region, and a case returning from that region was reported in April 2025 (source: Outbreak News Today, 30 January). Suriname's outbreak is growing, with 134 cases and 1 death reported. Most cases are in the 45–64 age group (38 cases) and 25–44 age group (27 cases). This is the country's first outbreak in about 10 years. Authorities estimate the first cases occurred in December last year and expect the peak of infections to last 3 to 4 months.

items.summary_zh: 葉門2025年登革熱明顯上升,15省累計逾2.4萬例病例及67例死亡。
items.summary_en: Dengue rose sharply in Yemen in 2025, with over 24,000 cases and 67 deaths across 15 governorates.
items.description_zh: 葉門2025年疫情明顯上升,共15省累計報告逾24,000例病例及67例死亡,且於亞丁及拉赫季省檢測出型別DENV-3及DENV-4。多種疾病共同流行,已為公共衛生嚴重挑戰。
items.description_en: Dengue cases rose markedly in Yemen in 2025. A total of more than 24,000 cases and 67 deaths were reported across 15 governorates, and serotypes DENV-3 and DENV-4 were detected in Aden and Lahj governorates. Multiple diseases are circulating concurrently, which poses a serious public health challenge.

items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞黃熱病自2024年累計161例、73例死亡,今年1月已有10例死亡。
items.summary_en: Colombia has recorded 161 yellow fever cases and 73 deaths since 2024, including 13 cases and 10 deaths in January 2026.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞自2024年迄今年1/26累計161例病例及73例死亡,於今 年1月即發生13例病例及10例死亡,顯示在無疫苗接種情況下,致死率極高。當局已加強健康警戒,再次呼籲民眾適時接種疫苗,並於風險地區採取防護措施。
items.description_en: From 2024 to 26 January 2026, Colombia recorded 161 cases and 73 deaths. In January 2026 alone, 13 cases and 10 deaths were reported, indicating a very high case fatality rate in the absence of vaccination. Authorities have strengthened health alert measures, again urged timely vaccination, and called for protective measures in at-risk areas.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘續降,去年12月42國報告1,169例,馬達加斯加現Ib型社區傳播。
items.summary_en: Global mpox cases declined in December 2025, with 1,169 new cases in 42 countries; Madagascar has clade Ib community transmission.
items.description_zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
items.description_en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,捷克,法國,迦納共和國,幾內亞,以色列,義大利,肯亞,賴比瑞亞,馬達加斯加,法屬馬約特島,尼泊爾,西班牙

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 今年H9N2人類病例3例、累計168例;美國乳牛禽流感累計報告1,084起疫情。
items.summary_en: This year 3 human H9N2 cases were reported, 168 cumulatively; US dairy cattle avian influenza has 1,084 reported outbreaks since 2024.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例;今年累計報告H9N2流感3例(迄今累計168例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計34國家/地區報告300起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。WAHIS  共22國於2025/12/24-2026/1/30期間報告128起H5N1疫情,義大利/荷蘭各20起、波蘭17起、美國13起、德國12起、捷克9起、比利時8起、匈牙利5起、丹麥/英國各3起、加拿大/挪威/日本/瑞士/立陶宛/芬蘭各2起、奧地利/愛沙亞/愛爾蘭/法國/波士亞與赫塞哥維納/烏克蘭各1起。 共2國於2026/1/27-2026/1/30期間報告7起H5 (N untyped)疫情,比利時4起、義大利3起。 葡萄牙於2026/1/30期間報告1起H5N6疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州;該國廢水監測於2026/1/18-24共441個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/奧勒岡/賓州共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。USDA、NWSS
items.description_en: Situation update. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. This year, 3 H9N2 cases have been reported, bringing the cumulative total to 168; most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): this year, 34 countries and areas have reported 300 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. A total of 22 countries reported 128 H5N1 outbreaks between 24 December 2025 and 30 January 2026: Italy and the Netherlands 20 each, Poland 17, United States 13, Germany 12, Czechia 9, Belgium 8, Hungary 5, Denmark and United Kingdom 3 each, Canada, Norway, Japan, Switzerland, Lithuania and Finland 2 each, and Austria, Estonia, Ireland, France, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Ukraine 1 each. Two countries reported 7 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 27 and 30 January 2026: Belgium 4 and Italy 3. Portugal reported 1 H5N6 outbreak during 30 January 2026. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 1,084 (0) outbreaks across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. US wastewater surveillance for 18–24 January 2026 received results from 441 sampling sites; H5-positive results were detected at 4 sites in New Jersey, Oregon and Pennsylvania (USDA, NWSS).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率升至4.13%,XFG為主要變異株;加拿大與歐洲陽性率亦上升。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity rose to 4.13% in week 2, with XFG the leading variant; Canada and Europe also reported increases.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  今年第2週(1/5-11)全球陽性率上升至4.13%,其中,西太平洋、歐洲及東南亞區署陽性率明顯增加。WHO FluNet 澳大利亞疫情呈上下波動,第2週陽性率為1.78%,近期變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(45.8%)。澳洲疾管局 1/9、WHO1/27 歐洲今年第3週門診陽性率增至3.4%,變異株以XFG占多數(54%),其次為NB.1.8.1(21%)。ECDC 1/28 加拿大疫情呈上升趨勢,第2週(1/11-17)陽性率為5.4%,病患以65歲以上占多數(57%),變異株以XFG為主。Government of Canada 1/23  評估與建議: 全球近期流行變異株占比以XFG最高。鑒於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。WHO 12/2、WHO 1/27
items.description_en: Situation update: in week 2 (5–11 January), global test positivity rose to 4.13%, with notable increases in the Western Pacific, European and South-East Asia Regions (WHO FluNet). Australia's situation is fluctuating; test positivity was 1.78% in week 2, and the recent predominant variant is NB.1.8.1 (45.8%) (Australian CDC, 9 January; WHO, 27 January). In Europe, outpatient test positivity rose to 3.4% in week 3 of this year; XFG was the predominant variant (54%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21%) (ECDC, 28 January). Canada's situation is rising; test positivity was 5.4% in week 2 (11–17 January), with patients mostly aged 65 and over (57%), and XFG is the main variant (Government of Canada, 23 January). Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat (WHO, 2 December; WHO, 27 January).

items.headline_zh: 美國-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 芝加哥1月報告7例成人腦膜炎雙球菌病例,2例死亡,3例為Y血清型。
items.summary_en: Chicago reported 7 adult meningococcal cases in late January, including 2 deaths; 3 were serogroup Y.
items.description_zh: 美國伊利諾州芝加哥市於1/15-30報告7例成人確定病例,其中2例死亡,3例為Y血清型,Y型為該市自2022年以來之主要流行菌株,當局已啟動密切接觸者追蹤及防治作業。該市每年約有10-15例確定病例,病患多集中於冬季,病例常見於老年人、青少年及年輕成人,為獲得最佳保護,該州建議11、12歲之青少年接種MenACWY 疫苗,並於16歲時追加1劑。美國(CDC)表示,自2021年以來病例急劇增加,2024年通報503例病例。
items.description_en: The city of Chicago, Illinois, reported 7 confirmed adult cases between 15 and 30 January, including 2 deaths; 3 cases were serogroup Y. Serogroup Y has been the main circulating strain in the city since 2022, and authorities have started contact tracing and prevention measures. The city typically has 10–15 confirmed cases a year, mostly concentrated in winter, and cases are common among older adults, adolescents and young adults. For optimal protection, the state recommends MenACWY vaccination for adolescents at ages 11 and 12, with a booster dose at age 16. The US CDC says cases have risen sharply since 2021, with 503 cases reported in 2024.

items.summary_zh: 日本第4週流感門診平均16.64例,連續3週上升,A型占74%、B型持續增加。
items.summary_en: Japan's influenza activity rose for three weeks, averaging 16.64 cases per clinic in week 4; type A makes up 74%.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情上升,第4週(1/19-25)定點門診平均病例數為16.64例,第1週為10.35例,已連續3週上升,全國病例數約為6.3萬例,較前1週新增2萬例,其中,鹿兒島縣平均病例數超過30例,病患以A型流感(占74%)為主,惟B型(占26%)流感正在上升,當局呼籲民眾落實勤洗手及佩戴口罩等防護措施。
items.description_en: Japan's influenza activity is rising. In week 4 (19–25 January), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 16.64, up from 10.35 in week 1, and the trend has risen for three consecutive weeks. Nationwide case numbers were about 63,000, an increase of 20,000 from the previous week. Kagoshima Prefecture averaged more than 30 cases per clinic. Type A influenza (74%) predominates, while type B (26%) is increasing. Authorities urge people to wash their hands frequently and wear masks.

items.summary_zh: 賴比瑞亞第二型M痘疫情,2025年1,451例;美國CDC警示升至2級。
items.summary_en: Liberia has a clade II mpox outbreak with 1,451 cases in 2025, and the US CDC raised its travel alert to Level 2.
items.description_zh: 賴比瑞亞爆發第二型(clade II)病毒株疫情,2026年迄今已有4例確診病例,2025年報告1,451例確診病例及6例死亡,此次疫情之男女性別比無明顯差異,與自2022年開始的全球性第二型疫情不同。美國CDC已提升該國M痘第二型(clade II)病毒株疫情旅遊警示至第2級。
items.description_en: Liberia is experiencing an outbreak of clade II mpox virus. So far in 2026, 4 confirmed cases have been reported. In 2025, 1,451 confirmed cases and 6 deaths were reported. The male-to-female ratio in this outbreak shows no clear difference, unlike the global clade II outbreak that began in 2022. The US CDC has raised its travel alert for clade II mpox in Liberia to Level 2.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞拉薩熱疑似病例增加,2026年前3週累計17例死亡,CFR 18.1%。
items.summary_en: Lassa fever rose in Nigeria in weeks 1–3 of 2026, with 17 deaths and a case fatality rate of 18.1%.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情上升,2026年第1-3週分別報告104、144及157例疑病例(21、33及39例確診),且累計報告17例死亡(CFR:18.1%),主要受影響年齡層為21-30歲,89%確診病例來自包奇、翁多、塔拉巴和埃多等4個州。2025年該國報告9,389例疑病例(1,148例確診)及215例死亡(CFR:18.7%),高於2024年致死率16.3%。
items.description_en: Lassa fever is rising in Nigeria. In weeks 1–3 of 2026, 104, 144 and 157 suspected cases were reported (21, 33 and 39 confirmed, respectively), and 17 deaths were reported cumulatively (CFR: 18.1%). The most affected age group is 21–30 years, and 89% of confirmed cases came from four states: Bauchi, Ondo, Taraba and Edo. In 2025, the country reported 9,389 suspected cases (1,148 confirmed) and 215 deaths (CFR: 18.7%), higher than the CFR of 16.3% in 2024.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大安大略省卡什契文爆發隱胞子蟲症,至少44例檢驗陽性,數百居民撤離。
items.summary_en: An outbreak of cryptosporidiosis in Kashechewan, Ontario, has at least 44 positive cases, and several hundred residents have been evacuated.
items.description_zh: 加拿大安大略省北部卡什契文(Kashechewan)爆發疫情,截至1/22累計至少44例檢驗陽性個案,推測實際病例數可能更高。懷疑因當地水處理廠故障,造成緊急公共衛生及安全問題,目前已有數百居民撤離,感染來源調查中。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in Kashechewan in northern Ontario, Canada. As of 22 January, at least 44 test-positive cases had been recorded, and the actual number may be higher. The outbreak is suspected to be linked to a failure at the local water treatment plant, which has caused an urgent public health and safety problem. Several hundred residents have been evacuated, and the source of infection is under investigation.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞cVDPV2新增9例、cVDPV3 5例;巴基斯坦WPV1 1例。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 9 new cVDPV2 and 5 new cVDPV3 cases in Nigeria, plus one new WPV1 case in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/15-21期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增奈及利亞9例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞5例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增德國2件,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 15–21 January: WPV1 had one new case in Pakistan; cVDPV2 had 9 new cases in Nigeria; and cVDPV3 had 5 new cases in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 had 2 new positive samples in Germany, and cVDPV2 had 1 new sample in Nigeria.
items.area_zh: 德國,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦

items.headline_zh: 新加坡/越南/韓國-腸病毒
items.headline_en: Singapore / Viet Nam / South Korea – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 新加坡腸病毒日均新增18例為2025年10月以來最高;越南病例減少19.8%。
items.summary_en: Singapore's daily enterovirus cases rose to 18 in week 2, the highest since October 2025, while Viet Nam's cases fell 19.8%.
items.description_zh: 新加坡疫情呈上升趨勢,今年第2週(1/11-17)平均每日新增18例,為2025年10月以來最高,惟仍低於去年同期或去年最高點;越南疫情趨緩,第3週病例數較前4週平均下降19.8%;韓國第3週(1/11-17)就診率為千分之1.5,較前1週下降,惟仍高於去年同期。
items.description_en: Singapore's situation is rising. In week 2 (11–17 January) this year, an average of 18 new cases were reported per day, the highest since October 2025, though still below the same period last year and last year's peak. Viet Nam's situation has eased; in week 3, case numbers fell 19.8% compared with the average of the previous four weeks. In South Korea, the outpatient visit rate in week 3 (11–17 January) was 1.5 per 1,000, down from the previous week but still higher than the same period last year.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-大腸桿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 加拿大報告23例O26型大腸桿菌感染,5例住院,疑與某廠商11種披薩產品有關。
items.summary_en: Canada reported 23 E. coli O26 cases, 5 hospitalised, linked to suspected pizza products from one manufacturer, now removed from sale.
items.description_zh: 加拿大1/25報告23例病例,其中5例住院,病患分布於8個省份,年齡介於1-87歲,最早於2025年10月發病,檢測血清型別為O26;經當局調查,疑感染源為某生產商的11種披薩食品,產品已下架。
items.description_en: Canada reported 23 cases on 25 January, 5 of whom were hospitalised. Cases are spread across 8 provinces, aged 1 to 87 years, with the earliest onset in October 2025. Serotype O26 was identified. Authorities' investigation suggests the source is 11 pizza products from one manufacturer, and the products have been removed from sale.

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本福岡市城南區報告10例疑似病例,8例確診,患者為托兒所幼童。
items.summary_en: Fukuoka City's Jonan Ward reported 10 suspected gastroenteritis cases, 8 confirmed, among nursery school children.
items.description_zh: 日本福岡市城南區1/26報告10例疑病例,其中有8例檢驗確診,病患為托兒所學生;另該市喬南區亦有通報病例,當局已公告示警,呼籲民眾加強衛生與清消措施。
items.description_en: Fukuoka City's Jonan Ward reported 10 suspected cases on 26 January, 8 of which were laboratory-confirmed; the patients are nursery school children. A second ward, recorded in the source as 喬南區, has also reported cases. Authorities have issued a public alert and urge the public to strengthen hygiene and disinfection measures.

items.summary_zh: 印度西孟加拉州自去年12月起僅通報2例立百病毒確診病例,196名接觸者均陰性。
items.summary_en: India has reported only 2 confirmed Nipah virus cases in West Bengal since December; all 196 contacts were asymptomatic and tested negative.
items.description_zh: 印度衛生部於1/27說明國家疾病控制中心(NCDC)報告,自去年12月迄今,西孟加拉州(West Bengal)僅通報2例確診病例,監測並檢測196名接觸者均無症狀,且檢測結果均呈陰性。
items.description_en: On 27 January, India's Ministry of Health explained a report from the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC): since December last year, only 2 confirmed cases have been reported in West Bengal. Monitoring and testing of 196 contacts found that all were asymptomatic and all tested negative.

items.summary_zh: 南非白喉累計91例確定病例,19例疑或確定死亡,12歲以下兒童占23%。
items.summary_en: South Africa has reported 91 confirmed diphtheria cases since 2024 and 19 suspected or confirmed deaths; 23% were children aged 12 or under.
items.description_zh: 南非報告自2024年截至今年1/18累計報告91例確定病例,19例疑或確定死亡病例, 21例(23%)病例為12歲及以下兒童,分布以西南部西開普省67例為多。當局已針對密切接觸者進行採檢、隔離、提供預防性藥物及預防接種等措施。
items.description_en: From 2024 to 18 January this year, South Africa reported 91 confirmed cases and 19 suspected or confirmed deaths. 21 cases (23%) were children aged 12 and under. Most cases were in the Western Cape province in the southwest, with 67 cases. Authorities have carried out sampling and isolation of close contacts, provided prophylactic medication, and carried out vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥今年麻疹累計987例;自去年爆發迄今7,417例、26例死亡。
items.summary_en: Mexico has reported 987 measles cases this year; since the outbreak began last year, 7,417 cases and 26 deaths.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至1/23累計報告987例確定病例,顯示目前防控措施不足,病例數以中西部哈利斯科州(521例)、南部恰帕斯州(200例)為多。另該國於1/23報告今年首例死亡病例,病例居住於中西部米卻肯州。該國自去年2月通報2例輸入病例後,爆發疫情,截自1/23共計32州報告7,417例確定病例,以1-4歲嬰兒為多,其中26例病例死亡,當局持續進行大規模疫苗接種作業。
items.description_en: Measles continues in Mexico. As of 23 January this year, 987 confirmed cases had been reported, indicating that current control measures are insufficient. Cases are concentrated in Jalisco state in the central-west (521 cases) and Chiapas state in the south (200 cases). On 23 January, Mexico also reported its first death of the year, in a case residing in Michoacán state in the central-west. Mexico reported two imported cases last February, after which an outbreak developed. As of 23 January, 32 states had reported 7,417 confirmed cases since then, mainly among children aged 1–4, and 26 of these cases have died. Authorities continue large-scale vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 全球-細菌性腸胃炎(仙人掌桿菌)
items.summary_zh: 法國2例嬰兒疑似死亡與配方奶有關,全球逾60國下架相關產品。
items.summary_en: France reported two suspected infant deaths linked to infant formula contaminated with Bacillus cereus; over 60 countries have withdrawn products.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情更新,法國報告2例疑死亡病例,於攝食某N廠牌嬰兒配方奶後,分別於2025年12/23及今年1/8死亡,當局已重啟調查。另英國、巴西亦有通報病例,本次疫情初始為N廠牌發現遭汙染,其後L、D廠牌嬰兒配方奶亦遭檢測出桿菌,疑汙染源為中國生產之原料,全球已超過60個國家下架相關產品。
items.description_en: Global outbreak update: France reported 2 suspected infant deaths after consuming infant formula from one brand, on 23 December 2025 and 8 January 2026 respectively, and authorities have reopened the investigation. The United Kingdom and Brazil have also reported cases. The outbreak initially involved contamination found in the brand N product; Bacillus was subsequently also detected in infant formula from brands L and D. The suspected source is raw material produced in China, and more than 60 countries have withdrawn related products.

items.headline_zh: 衣索比亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞宣布馬堡病毒出血熱疫情結束,共19例、死亡14例,所有接觸者追蹤完成。
items.summary_en: Ethiopia declared the end of its first Marburg outbreak after 42 days without new cases; 19 cases and 14 deaths were recorded.
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞於1/26宣布首次疫情結束,自去(2025)年12/14最後1例確診病例死亡以來,已連續2個潛伏期(共42天)未通報新增病例,且所有密切接觸者(857名)均已完成21天追蹤。該國疫情於去年11/14爆發後,截至疫情結束,南部地區共計4個縣報告19例,其中14例為確診(含9例死亡),5例為疑(均死亡)。全球於此案前已累計報告19起疫情,前起疫情為坦尚亞於去年1-3月報告,非洲區域其他曾通報疫情之國家包括安哥拉、剛果民主共和國、赤道幾內亞、迦納、幾內亞、肯亞、盧安達、南非及烏干達。
items.description_en: Ethiopia declared the end of its first outbreak on 26 January. Since the last confirmed case died on 14 December 2025, two incubation periods (42 days in total) have passed without any new cases reported, and all 857 close contacts completed 21 days of follow-up. The outbreak began on 14 November 2025. By its end, 19 cases had been reported in four districts of the southern region: 14 confirmed (including 9 deaths) and 5 suspected (all died). Before this outbreak, 19 outbreaks had been reported globally. The previous outbreak was reported by Tanzania in January–March 2025. Other African countries that have reported outbreaks include Angola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Ghana, Guinea, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa and Uganda.

items.headline_zh: 哥斯大黎加/蘇利南/巴西-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加2017年後首見屈公病;巴西盧卡斯市2025年1,769例。
items.summary_en: Costa Rica reported its first chikungunya case since 2017; Lucas do Rio Verde, Brazil, recorded 1,769 cases in 2025, up from 11 in 2024.
items.description_zh: 哥斯大黎加報告自2017年以來首例病例,為該國西部旁塔雷納斯省24歲男性居民,當局積極進行流行病學監測及病媒蚊控制,預防疾病傳播。outbreaknewstoday 1/25 蘇利南發生疫情,已報告8例病例,皆無國外旅遊史,目前正進行接觸者追蹤調查,並加強監測措施,避免疫情擴散。outbreaknewstoday 1/23 巴西西部馬托羅索州之盧卡斯市(Lucas do Rio Verde),於2025年報告1,769例病例(808例陽性),明顯高於2024年11例報告病例(9例陽性),並發現當地大部分埃及斑蚊孳生地都於住宅內,當局對此已採取相關防治措施。
items.description_en: Costa Rica reported its first case since 2017: a 24-year-old male resident of Puntarenas province in the west. Authorities are carrying out active epidemiological surveillance and vector mosquito control to prevent transmission (source: Outbreak News Today, 25 January). Suriname has an outbreak with 8 reported cases, none with recent travel abroad. Contact tracing is under way, and surveillance has been strengthened to prevent spread (Outbreak News Today, 23 January). In Lucas do Rio Verde in Mato Grosso state, western Brazil, 1,769 cases (808 positive) were reported in 2025, markedly higher than the 11 cases (9 positive) reported in 2024. Most local Aedes aegypti breeding sites were found inside homes, and authorities have taken control measures.
items.area_zh: 巴西,哥斯大黎加,蘇利南

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市近1週登革熱1,430例;越南2025年184,903例、43例死亡。
items.summary_en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City, with 1,430 cases in one week; Viet Nam recorded 184,903 cases and 43 deaths in 2025.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,近1週報告1,430例病例,該國於2025年累計報告184,903例病例及43例死亡,病例/死亡數皆高於2024年同期。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City, with 1,430 cases reported over the past week. In 2025, Viet Nam reported 184,903 cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, both higher than in the same period of 2024.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 荷蘭乳牛首見H5N1抗體(歐洲首例);今年H9N2人類病例3例,累計168例。
items.summary_en: The Netherlands detected H5N1 antibodies in a dairy cow, Europe's first such detection; 3 human H9N2 cases were reported this year.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例;今年累計報告H9N2流感3例(迄今累計168例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計28國家/地區報告122起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。WAHIS  共22國於2026/1/16-23期間報告333起H5N1疫情,法國 110起、比利時99起、英國50起、美國16起、荷蘭13起、以色列6起、丹麥/加拿大/波蘭各5起、捷克4起、日本/義大利各3起、南非/奈及利亞/摩爾多瓦/芬蘭各2起、塞爾維亞/奧地利/巴西/拉脫維亞/瑞士/羅馬亞各1起。 共2國於 2026/1/22-23 期間報告5起H5 (N untyped)疫情,義大利4起、比利時1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州。 荷蘭弗里斯蘭省東北弗里斯蘭市的一頭乳牛被檢測出高致病性(HPAI)H5N1抗體陽性,此為歐洲首次在乳牛體內檢測到抗體。此前,同一農場的一隻貓於2025年12月底死亡,並被檢測出禽流感陽性。其餘農場工人和主治獸醫迄未出現類流感症狀,農場內其他哺乳動物亦未出現感染跡象。 美國廢水監測於2026/1/11-17共525個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡州共6個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Situation update. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. This year, 3 H9N2 cases have been reported (168 cumulative), most with exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): this year, 28 countries and areas have reported 122 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. A total of 22 countries reported 333 H5N1 outbreaks between 16 and 23 January 2026: France 110, Belgium 99, United Kingdom 50, United States 16, Netherlands 13, Israel 6, Denmark, Canada and Poland 5 each, Czechia 4, Japan and Italy 3 each, South Africa, Nigeria, Moldova and Finland 2 each, and Serbia, Austria, Brazil, Latvia, Switzerland and Romania 1 each. Two countries reported 5 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 22 and 23 January 2026: Italy 4 and Belgium 1. In the United States, avian influenza in dairy cattle has been reported in 1,084 outbreaks across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. In the Netherlands, a dairy cow in the Noardeast-Fryslân municipality of Friesland province tested positive for antibodies to highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1, the first detection of antibodies in dairy cattle in Europe. Earlier, a cat on the same farm died at the end of December 2025 and tested positive for avian influenza. Other farm workers and the attending veterinarian have so far shown no influenza-like symptoms, and there are no signs of infection in other mammals on the farm. US wastewater surveillance for 11–17 January 2026 provided results from 525 sampling sites; H5-positive results were detected at 6 sites in New Jersey, Illinois and Oregon.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率略降至3.37%,惟西太平洋與非洲區上升;XFG占比最高。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity dipped to 3.37% in week 1 but rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions; XFG leads variants.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  全球陽性率於今年第1週(12/29-1/4)略降至3.37%,惟西太平洋及非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情處低點,第3週(1/12-18)門急診陽性率略降至0.9%。 香港疫情略升,第3週陽性率上升至0.18%,已連續3週上升,惟整體仍處低點,汙水監測之變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 智利疫情於高點波動,疫情自2025年7月起持續攀升,今年第1週陽性率12.44%,為美洲最高,變異株占比以XFG為多。 美國疫情持續上升,今年第2週(1/4-10)陽性率增至5.2%,近期變異株占比以XFG為主。  評估與建議 全球陽性率近期略降,惟西太平洋及非洲區署陽性率增加;近期全球流行變異株占比以XFG最高(83.33%)。鑒於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。WHO 12/2、WHO 1/25
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity dipped slightly to 3.37% in week 1 of this year (29 December–4 January), but rose notably in the Western Pacific and African Regions. China's situation is at a low point; outpatient and emergency test positivity fell slightly to 0.9% in week 3 (12–18 January). Hong Kong's situation rose slightly: test positivity increased to 0.18% in week 3 and has risen for three consecutive weeks, though overall it remains low; the largest share of variants in wastewater surveillance is NB.1.8.1. Chile's situation fluctuates at a high level; it has continued to rise since July 2025, and test positivity was 12.44% in week 1 this year, the highest in the Americas, with XFG the predominant variant. The United States' situation continues to rise: test positivity increased to 5.2% in week 2 (4–10 January), with XFG the main recent variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has dipped slightly recently, but has increased in the Western Pacific and African Regions. XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally (83.33%). Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat (WHO, 2 December; WHO, 25 January).
items.area_zh: 智利,中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,美國

items.summary_zh: 印度坦米爾那都邦屈公病再度上升;美國佛州邁阿密-戴德郡出現首例本土病例。
items.summary_en: Chikungunya is rising again in India's Tamil Nadu state; Miami-Dade County, Florida, reported its first locally acquired case.
items.description_zh: 印度南部坦米爾那都邦再次出現疫情,於清奈、琴阿爾帕圖、甘吉布勒姆、維盧布勒姆等地區之病例數上升,由於過去數年間當地病例數已下降,對於此次疫情上升,當局已加強監測、防治及宣導措施。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡報告首例本土病例,於2025年12月發病,致該國2025年累計2例本土病例,另1例發生於紐約州長島西部的納蘇郡。
items.description_en: Tamil Nadu state in southern India has seen a renewed outbreak, with case numbers rising in areas including Chennai, Chengalpattu, Kanchipuram and Villupuram. Because local case numbers had declined over recent years, authorities have strengthened surveillance, control and awareness measures in response to the rise. Miami-Dade County in Florida, United States, reported its first locally acquired case, with onset in December 2025, bringing the US total for 2025 to two locally acquired cases. The other case occurred in Nassau County, on western Long Island, New York state.

items.headline_zh: 澳大利亞-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 澳洲新南威爾斯州自2025年11月起報告6例A型肝炎,當局擔憂音樂活動致擴散。
items.summary_en: New South Wales, Australia, reported 6 hepatitis A cases since November 2025; authorities fear spread through a late-January music festival.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞新南威爾斯州自2025年11月迄今累計報告6例病例,其中3例為家庭群聚,其餘病例感染源仍不明,因1月下旬適逢當地音樂節,當局評估此波疫情可能因音樂活動擴散,已提供疫苗與免疫球蛋白予接觸者,呼籲高風險對象採取防疫措施。
items.description_en: In New South Wales, Australia, 6 cases have been reported cumulatively since November 2025. Three were household clusters, and the source of the other cases remains unknown. Because a local music festival took place in late January, authorities assess that this wave may spread through music events. Vaccines and immunoglobulin have been provided to contacts, and high-risk individuals are urged to take preventive measures.

items.headline_zh: 韓國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 韓國第3週病毒性腸胃炎報告617例,連續10週上升,為近5年同期最高。
items.summary_en: South Korea reported 617 viral gastroenteritis cases in week 3, rising for 10 consecutive weeks and the highest for the period in five years.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情更新,今年第3週(1/11-17)報告617例病例,疫情已連續10週上升,且為5年同期最高,其中6歲以下兒童占51.1%,其次為7-18歲(占19.3%);當局呼籲病患於症狀緩解2天後,再返回校園或職場。
items.description_en: South Korea update: in week 3 (11–17 January), 617 cases were reported. Cases have risen for 10 consecutive weeks and are the highest for the same period in five years. Children under 6 years accounted for 51.1% of cases, followed by those aged 7–18 years (19.3%). Authorities advise patients to return to school or work only 2 days after symptoms ease.

items.summary_zh: 印度西孟加拉邦累計5例立百病毒確診,皆為醫護人員;泰國加強機場檢疫。
items.summary_en: West Bengal, India, has reported 5 confirmed Nipah cases as of 24 January, all healthcare workers; Thailand has tightened airport screening.
items.description_zh: 印度西孟加拉邦疫情更新,截至1月24日累積5例確診病例,皆為醫護人員,當局已匡列約100名接觸者進行居家隔離;泰國迄今雖無報告病例,惟已於機場加強檢疫措施,並啟動健康一體的跨部門合作,發布警告,以監測此波疫情。
items.description_en: Update from West Bengal state, India: as of 24 January, 5 confirmed cases had been reported, all of them healthcare workers. Authorities have placed about 100 contacts under home quarantine. Thailand has reported no cases so far, but has strengthened quarantine measures at airports and activated One Health cross-sectoral collaboration, issuing warnings to monitor the outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 中國新增3例H9N2輕症幼童;2015年以來累計152例、2例死亡。
items.summary_en: China reported 3 mild H9N2 cases in young children; 152 cases and 2 deaths (CFR 1.3%) have been reported since 2015.
items.description_zh: 中國新增3例H9N2,病患皆為輕症,發病時間分別介於2025/11/30-12/7間,案1為湖北省5歲男童,具家禽接觸史;案2為江蘇省8歲女童,無直接接觸活禽,惟其父母曾前往販售現宰家禽之店家;案3為廣西壯族自治區1歲男童,曾間接暴露於現宰家禽。該國自2015年以來報告152例,其中2例死亡(CFR:1.3%)。
items.description_en: China reported 3 new H9N2 cases, all mild, with onset between 30 November and 7 December 2025. Case 1: a 5-year-old boy in Hubei province with poultry contact. Case 2: an 8-year-old girl in Jiangsu province with no direct contact with live birds, but whose parents had visited a shop selling freshly slaughtered poultry. Case 3: a 1-year-old boy in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region with indirect exposure to freshly slaughtered poultry. China has reported 152 cases since 2015, including 2 deaths (CFR: 1.3%).

items.summary_zh: 中國2025年12月梅毒通報約5.2萬例;美國先天性梅毒連續12年增加。
items.summary_en: China reported about 52,000 syphilis cases in December 2025; US congenital syphilis has risen for 12 consecutive years.
items.description_zh: 中國2025年12月累計報告約5.2萬例病例,其中3例死亡,通報數較10、11月(約5萬例)為高。中國疾控中心1/9 美國2024年累計報告約19萬例病例,其中近4,000例為先天性梅毒,先天性梅毒病例已連續第12年增加,並以密西西比州疫情最為嚴峻。Labroots 1/4、USCDC 9/24
items.description_en: China reported about 52,000 syphilis cases in December 2025, including 3 deaths. Reported numbers were higher than in October and November, which were about 50,000 each (China CDC, 9 January). In the United States, about 190,000 cases were reported in 2024, of which nearly 4,000 were congenital syphilis. Congenital syphilis cases have increased for the 12th consecutive year, with Mississippi the most severely affected (Labroots, 4 January; USCDC, 24 September).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),美國

items.summary_zh: 泰國M痘累計近1,000例;馬達加斯加290例疑似、78例確診、無死亡。
items.summary_en: Thailand has nearly 1,000 cumulative mpox cases, 97% male; Madagascar has 290 suspected and 78 confirmed cases, with no deaths.
items.description_zh: 泰國自2022年通報首例以來,迄今累計報告近1,000例病例,97%病患為男性,多數有非固定的性伴侶,病例主要分佈於曼谷、春武里、清邁及普吉島等觀光客多的地區,當局已針對高風險性行為者施打逾2,000劑疫苗。 馬達加斯加自2025年發現疫情以來,截至今年1/16累計通報290例疑病例,其中78例已確診(含8例兒童),迄無死亡病例,疫情主要集中在西北部博埃區,病毒型別為Ib型。當局與國際機構已加強監測與治療等防治措施,並計劃推行M痘疫苗接種措施。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported nearly 1,000 cumulative cases since its first case in 2022. 97% of patients are male, most with non-fixed sexual partners, and cases are concentrated in tourist areas including Bangkok, Chon Buri, Chiang Mai and Phuket. Authorities have administered more than 2,000 vaccine doses to people engaging in high-risk sexual behaviour. Madagascar has reported 290 suspected cases cumulatively since an outbreak was detected in 2025, as of 16 January this year, of which 78 have been confirmed (including 8 children). No deaths have been reported. The outbreak is mainly concentrated in the Boeny region in the northwest, and the virus type is clade Ib. Authorities and international organisations have strengthened surveillance and treatment, and plan to roll out mpox vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 英國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 英國諾羅病毒腸胃炎上升,今年前2週較去年12月底增加47%。
items.summary_en: The UK's gastroenteritis cases rose 47% in the first two weeks of 2026 compared with late December 2025.
items.description_zh: 英國疫情上升,今年前2週疫情較2025年12月底增加47%,惟仍在季節性的流行範圍內,疫情多發生於學校、辦公室及醫院;當局已發布警告,呼籲有相關症狀之民眾應於症狀消除後,仍留在家中休養至少2天
items.description_en: The United Kingdom's situation is rising. In the first two weeks of this year, the number of cases increased by 47% compared with late December 2025, though it remains within the seasonal range. Outbreaks mainly occur in schools, offices and hospitals. Authorities have issued a warning, urging people with relevant symptoms to stay at home and rest for at least 2 days after symptoms have resolved.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 美國南卡羅來納州麻疹疫情嚴峻,1月16至20日新增88例,累計646例。
items.summary_en: South Carolina's measles outbreak grew by 88 cases between 16 and 20 January, reaching 646, with 87% unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 美國南卡羅萊納州疫情嚴峻,1/16-20新增88例病例,此波疫情已累積646例,其中,87%病例未接種疫苗,目前有538例採居家隔離、33例採醫院隔離治療。當局已公告感染者曾造訪的地點(含17所學校),並呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗,落實相關防疫措施。
items.description_en: The outbreak in South Carolina is severe. Between 16 and 20 January, 88 new cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total for this wave to 646. 87% of cases were unvaccinated. Currently, 538 cases are under home isolation and 33 are being treated in hospital isolation. Authorities have published the locations visited by infected people, including 17 schools, and urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible and implement related prevention measures.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 全球/剛果民主共和國-小兒麻痺症
items.headline_en: Global / Democratic Republic of the Congo – Poliomyelitis
items.summary_zh: GPEI:剛果民主共和國新增3例cVDPV2,巴基斯坦新增7件WPV1樣本。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 3 new cVDPV2 cases in the DRC for 8–14 January, plus 7 WPV1 environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/8-14期間,cVDPV2新增剛果民主共和國3例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦7件,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 8–14 January: cVDPV2 had 3 new cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. For environmental samples, WPV1 had 7 new samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 had 2 new samples in Somalia.

items.headline_zh: 巴西-細菌性腸胃炎(仙人掌桿菌)
items.summary_zh: 巴西2例嬰兒病例疑與某廠配方奶有關,臺灣相關批次已預防性下架。
items.summary_en: Brazil reported 2 infant cases on 13 January, suspected linked to one manufacturer's formula; related Taiwan batches were withdrawn.
items.description_zh: 巴西1/13報告2例嬰兒病例,病患約1歲,出現嘔吐、腹瀉等症狀,疑感染源為某生產商製造之嬰兒配方奶粉,受影響的產品批次亦於歐洲多國如德國、奧地利、瑞士等銷售,於臺灣販售之相關批次產品亦已預防性下架。
items.description_en: Brazil reported 2 infant cases on 13 January. The patients were about one year old and presented with vomiting and diarrhoea. The suspected source is infant formula from one manufacturer. The affected product batches were also sold in several European countries, including Germany, Austria and Switzerland, and related batches sold in Taiwan have been withdrawn from sale as a precaution.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 巴西夏季海灘大腸桿菌偏高,260個監測點中35%海灘區域不適合游泳。
items.summary_en: Brazil's summer beaches show high E. coli levels; 35% of beach areas at 260 monitoring sites are unsuitable for swimming.
items.description_zh: 巴西於夏季反覆爆發腸胃炎疫情,多處海岸景點檢出高濃度的大腸桿菌,在260個海岸監測點中,評估有35%的海灘區域不適合游泳,包含聖卡塔琳娜州(Santa Catarina)的多個觀光海灘;當局建議大雨後2天內不要游泳,並設置每日水質監測面板,呼籲旅客注意水質。
items.description_en: Brazil has experienced repeated gastroenteritis outbreaks during the summer, with high concentrations of E. coli detected at many coastal sites. Of 260 coastal monitoring sites, 35% of beach areas were assessed as unsuitable for swimming, including several popular beaches in Santa Catarina state. Authorities recommend not swimming for 2 days after heavy rain, have set up daily water-quality monitoring dashboards, and urge travellers to pay attention to water quality.

items.headline_zh: 新加坡/越南/韓國-腸病毒
items.headline_en: Singapore / Viet Nam / South Korea – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 新加坡腸病毒第1週日增15例;越南2025年約10萬例,增28.9%。
items.summary_en: Singapore reported 15 daily enterovirus cases in week 1; Viet Nam recorded about 100,000 cases in 2025, up 28.9% on 2024.
items.description_zh: 新加坡疫情持續,第1週(1/4-10)平均每日新增15例,與前兩週相當,疫情為去年11月以來最高,惟仍低於去年同期或去年最高點;越南疫情持續,2025年累計報告約10萬例病例,較2024年增加28.9%,雖然近期之疫情下降,惟仍持續通報重症個案,疫情多集中於胡志明市、河內等,當局已發布警報;韓國疫情從低點略增,第2週就診率為千分之2,較前1週上升,且高於去年同期。
items.description_en: Singapore's situation continues. In week 1 (4–10 January), an average of 15 new cases were reported per day, similar to the previous two weeks and the highest since November last year, though still below the same period last year and last year's peak. Viet Nam's situation continues: about 100,000 cases were reported cumulatively in 2025, an increase of 28.9% over 2024. Although recent cases have declined, severe cases are still being reported, with outbreaks concentrated in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi and elsewhere, and authorities have issued alerts. South Korea's situation has risen slightly from a low point; the outpatient visit rate in week 2 was 2 per 1,000, higher than the previous week and higher than the same period last year.

items.headline_zh: 韓國/中國/日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.headline_en: South Korea / China / Japan – Viral gastroenteritis (norovirus)
items.summary_zh: 韓國今年前2週新增548例,為近5年同期最高;中國佛山與日本岩手出現群聚。
items.summary_en: South Korea reported 548 new viral gastroenteritis cases in weeks 1–2, the highest for the period in five years; clusters in China and Japan.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情自2025年11月起持續攀升,今年迄第2週止已新增548例病例,為近5年同期最高,其中6歲以下病患占約4成;該國疫情好發於11-3月,主要感染源為受汙染的地下水或海鮮,亦可能透過接觸病患的飛沫或嘔吐物感染,當局呼籲注意個人衛生,尤其托兒機構等應加強衛生防護措施。 中國廣東省佛山市1/17報告某高中群聚事件,累計103例病例,迄無重症或死亡病例,當局已展開調查,加強衛生教育與清消;另中國有78-93%的諾羅疫情發生於校園,疫情流行於10-3月。 日本岩手縣1/20報告1起托嬰中心群聚事件,累計22例病例,包括21名幼童及1名工作人員,其中有4例檢驗呈陽性,發病日介於1/7-18。
items.description_en: South Korea's situation has risen continuously since November 2025, with 548 new cases reported through week 2 of this year, the highest for the same period in the past five years. About 40% of patients were under 6 years old. Outbreaks typically occur from November to March, mainly from contaminated groundwater or seafood, and infection can also occur through respiratory droplets or contact with patients' vomit. Authorities urge attention to personal hygiene, and childcare facilities in particular should strengthen hygiene and protection measures. On 17 January, Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, reported a cluster at a senior high school, with 103 cumulative cases; no severe or fatal cases have been recorded. Authorities have launched an investigation and are strengthening health education and disinfection. In China, 78–93% of norovirus outbreaks occur in schools, and outbreaks are prevalent from October to March. On 20 January, Iwate Prefecture in Japan reported a cluster at a nursery centre, with 22 cumulative cases, including 21 young children and 1 staff member; 4 tested positive, with onset dates between 7 and 18 January.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),日本,韓國

items.headline_zh: 俄羅斯-不明原因致死疾病
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯一婦產醫院2025年12月至2026年1月報告9例新生兒死亡。
items.summary_en: A Russian maternity hospital in Kemerovo Oblast reported 9 neonatal deaths from December 2025 to 11 January 2026; the source is unknown.
items.description_zh: 俄羅斯南部克麥羅沃州新庫茲涅茨克市婦產科醫院報告9例新生兒死亡,死亡發生於2025/12/1-2026/1/11期間,並以早產及低出生體重嬰兒為主。該院宣布爆發急性呼吸道感染疫情,並於1/12暫時關閉,感染源迄仍不明,當局已啟動調查,並公布該院因違規行為須停業90天。
items.description_en: A maternity hospital in Novokuznetsk, Kemerovo Oblast, southern Russia, reported 9 neonatal deaths between 1 December 2025 and 11 January 2026, mainly among preterm and low-birth-weight infants. The hospital announced an outbreak of acute respiratory infection and temporarily closed on 12 January. The source of infection remains unknown. Authorities have launched an investigation and announced that the hospital has been suspended from operating for 90 days due to violations.

items.headline_zh: 阿根廷-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 阿根廷2025年漢他病毒症候群86例、28例死亡;本季52例已達警戒閾。
items.summary_en: Argentina recorded 86 hantavirus syndrome cases and 28 deaths in 2025; this season's 52 cases have reached the alert threshold.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷2025年累計報告86例確定病例,其中28例死亡(CFR:32.5%),該疾病流行期為10月至隔年5月,本流行季累計報告52例,與往年預期病例數相比,已達警戒閾,病患主要分布於中部地區(62%)、其次為西北部地區(29%),病例分佈與宿主分佈相關,另年齡層以20-49歲年齡層為多,當局呼籲民眾加強環境清消、密閉環境須注意通風、控制囓齒動物數量及妥善處理動物屍體等措施,倘出現疑症狀且接觸過囓齒動物,應及時就醫。
items.description_en: Argentina reported 86 confirmed cases in 2025, of which 28 died (CFR: 32.5%). The epidemic season runs from October to May of the following year. This season, 52 cases have been reported cumulatively, which has reached the alert threshold compared with expected case numbers in previous years. Most patients are in the central region (62%), followed by the northwest (29%); case distribution is related to host distribution. Most cases are aged 20–49. Authorities urge strengthened environmental disinfection, ventilation of enclosed spaces, control of rodent numbers and proper disposal of animal carcasses. Anyone with suspicious symptoms after contact with rodents should seek medical care promptly.

items.headline_zh: 墨西哥/哈薩克/美國-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥前2週新增506例麻疹;哈薩克截至1/16累計370例;美國9州171例。
items.summary_en: Mexico added 506 measles cases in weeks 1–2; Kazakhstan has 370 cases to 16 January; the US has 171 cases across 9 states.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥疫情持續,今(2026)年第1-2週新增報告506例確定病例,其中逾5成病例來自中西部哈利斯科州,該國去年共計31州報告6,427例確定病例,其中24例死亡,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州(70%)為多,PAHO預定於4/13邀集美國及墨西哥召開線上會議審查其麻疹消除情形。 哈薩克今年截至1/16累計報告370例確定病例,其中298例為14歲以下兒童,85%之感染兒童未接種疫苗,病例主要分布於東南部江布爾州(191例),該國去年報告4,240例病例,另推估2024年報告達2.4-2.8萬例,當局表示目標年齡層兒童的疫苗涵蓋率低,且拒絕接種的人數增加,致疫情持續。 美國今年共9州累計報告171例確定病例,其中2例住院,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告145例確定病例為多,該州已匡列409名接觸者並預定監測至2/9,該國95%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。該國近年疫苗接種率持續落後,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/猶他州。
items.description_en: Measles continues in Mexico: in weeks 1–2 of 2026, 506 new confirmed cases were reported, more than half from Jalisco state in the central-west. Last year, the country reported 6,427 confirmed cases across 31 states, including 24 deaths; cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (70%). The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) plans an online meeting with the United States and Mexico on 13 April to review their measles elimination status. Kazakhstan has reported 370 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 16 January this year, of which 298 were children under 14, and 85% of infected children were unvaccinated. Cases are concentrated in Zhambyl region in the southeast (191 cases). The country reported 4,240 cases last year, and estimates indicate 24,000–28,000 cases in 2024. Authorities say vaccination coverage among target-age children is low and refusals have increased, which has sustained the outbreak. The United States has reported 171 confirmed cases this year across 9 states, 2 of them hospitalised. Most cases are in South Carolina (145 confirmed). The state has identified 409 contacts and plans monitoring until 9 February. 95% of patients in the country were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. US vaccination rates have continued to lag in recent years, and recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina and Utah.

items.summary_zh: 德國巴伐利亞、柏林及薩克森邦2025年萊姆病上升,柏林為2013年以來最多。
items.summary_en: Lyme disease rose in Bavaria, Berlin and Saxony in 2025; Berlin's more than 1,400 cases are its highest since 2013.
items.description_zh: 德國巴伐利亞、柏林及薩克森邦於2025年疫情上升,巴伐利亞截至12月中旬報告5,469例病例,高於2024年同期病例數;柏林報告逾1,400例病例,為2013年以來最多;薩克森邦報告2,623例病例,較2024年(1,626例)上升61%。
items.description_en: Lyme disease rose in 2025 in the German states of Bavaria, Berlin and Saxony. Bavaria reported 5,469 cases as of mid-December, higher than the same period in 2024. Berlin reported more than 1,400 cases, the highest since 2013. Saxony reported 2,623 cases, a 61% increase on 2024 (1,626 cases).

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨2025年登革熱63,016例、79例死亡,較2024年同期增232%。
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported 63,016 dengue cases and 79 deaths in 2025, a 232% increase over the same period in 2024.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨疫情更新,2025年截至12/31累計報告63,016例病例及79例死亡(致死率為0.13%),病例數較2024年同期(18,983例)上升232%。
items.description_en: Cambodia update: in 2025, up to 31 December, 63,016 cases and 79 deaths were reported cumulatively (case fatality rate 0.13%). Case numbers were 232% higher than the same period in 2024 (18,983 cases).

items.summary_zh: 古巴2025年屈公病累計51,217例,近2,000例確診,15省均有病例。
items.summary_en: Cuba recorded 51,217 chikungunya cases in 2025, nearly 2,000 confirmed, with cases reported in all 15 provinces.
items.description_zh: 古巴疫情更新,2025年累計報告51,217例病例(近2,000例確診)及46例死亡相關病例,該國15個省均報告病例,主要受影響地區包括馬坦薩斯省、哈瓦那省及卡馬圭省等省份。
items.description_en: Cuba update: in 2025, 51,217 cases were reported cumulatively, of which nearly 2,000 were confirmed, along with 46 associated deaths. All 15 provinces of the country reported cases. The main affected areas include Matanzas, Havana and Camagüey provinces.

items.summary_zh: 印度西孟加拉邦2例立百病毒病例確診且病況危急,另3名醫護人員出現症狀。
items.summary_en: West Bengal, India, has two confirmed Nipah cases in critical condition; three healthcare workers have developed symptoms and are being tested.
items.description_zh: 印度西孟加拉邦疫情更新,於1/11報告之2例疑病例,經複驗確診且病況危急,另有3名醫護人員亦出現症狀,刻正檢驗中。當局已匡列約120名密切接觸者包括醫護人員及其家屬,目前感染源仍不明,可能是人傳人,亦可能是從受污染的水果或新鮮椰棗樹汁中感染病毒;許多來自該邦之移工通常在此時間返回家鄉,冬季時,鄉村地區民眾亦傾向於飲用生棗椰汁。
items.description_en: Update from West Bengal state, India: two suspected cases reported on 11 January were confirmed on re-testing and are critically ill. Three healthcare workers have also developed symptoms and are being tested. Authorities have identified about 120 close contacts, including healthcare workers and their families. The source of infection remains unknown and may be person-to-person transmission, or infection from contaminated fruit or fresh date palm sap. Many migrant workers from this state typically return home at this time of year, and in winter, rural residents also tend to drink raw date palm sap.

items.summary_zh: 秘魯2025年登革熱累計39,028例、54例死亡;北部及亞馬遜地區近6週上升。
items.summary_en: Peru recorded 39,028 dengue cases and 54 deaths in 2025; cases rose over six weeks in the north and Amazon regions.
items.description_zh: 秘魯2025年截止至第52週累計報告39,028例確定病例,其中54例死亡,病例數以30-59歲年齡層為多,感染風險(發病率)以12-17歲年齡層為高,其中3,760例病例經血清檢驗分型,以第3型1,774例(47.2%)為主,其次為第1型1,115例(29.7%),第2型871例(23.2%)。該國北部及亞馬遜地區於近6週病例數增加,基於即將進入雨季及氣溫不斷升高,疾病傳播風險增加,當局已發布警報,加強相關預防控制措施;該國2023-24年疫情嚴峻,每年皆報告逾25萬例。
items.description_en: Through week 52 of 2025, Peru reported 39,028 confirmed dengue cases cumulatively, including 54 deaths. Cases were most numerous in the 30–59 age group, while incidence (infection risk) was highest in the 12–17 age group. Of the 3,760 cases serotyped by serological testing, serotype 3 predominated with 1,774 cases (47.2%), followed by serotype 1 with 1,115 cases (29.7%) and serotype 2 with 871 cases (23.2%). Case numbers have increased in the north and Amazon regions over the past six weeks. With the rainy season approaching and temperatures rising, the risk of transmission has increased, and authorities have issued an alert and strengthened prevention and control measures. Peru experienced a severe outbreak in 2023–24, with more than 250,000 cases reported each year.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國新增3例H9N2人類感染;全球H5病毒公共衛生風險仍評估為低。
items.summary_en: China reported 3 new human H9N2 infections; global public health risk from H5 viruses is still assessed as low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:中國新增3例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共23國於2025/12/22-2026/1/16期間新增116起H5N1疫情,美國49起、波蘭/荷蘭7起、加拿大/奧地利/比利時各6起、法國5起、丹麥/德國各4起、匈牙利/斯洛維亞/瑞士各3起、愛沙亞/日本各2起、伊拉克/拉脫維亞/挪威/捷克/摩爾多瓦/烏克蘭/義大利/臺灣/西班牙各1起。 共2國於2026/1/13-2026/1/14期間新增2起H5N2疫情,拉脫維亞/瑞典各1起。 美國於2026/1/10期間新增7起H5 (N untyped) 疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州。 具乳牛接觸史者:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測至少218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:2026/1/4-10共549個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡州共8個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H9N2流感3例(迄今累計168例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:今年累計22國家/地區通報69起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: China reported 3 new human H9N2 infections. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 23 countries reported 116 new H5N1 outbreaks between 22 December 2025 and 16 January 2026: United States 49; Poland and Netherlands 7 each; Canada, Austria and Belgium 6 each; France 5; Denmark and Germany 4 each; Hungary, Slovenia and Switzerland 3 each; Estonia and Japan 2 each; and Iraq, Latvia, Norway, Czechia, Moldova, Ukraine, Italy, Taiwan and Spain 1 each. Two countries reported 2 new H5N2 outbreaks between 13 and 14 January 2026: Latvia and Sweden 1 each. The United States reported 7 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 10 January 2026. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: herds: 1,084 outbreaks have been reported across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and at least 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: for 4–10 January 2026, 549 sampling sites reported results, of which 8 sites in New Jersey, Illinois and Oregon detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases: this year, 3 H9N2 cases have been reported (168 cumulative), most with exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian cases: this year, 22 countries and areas have reported 69 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率升至3.51%,美洲與非洲增加;XFG占全球變異株75%。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity rose to 3.51% in late December, with increases in the Americas and Africa; XFG makes up 75% of variants.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第52週(12/22-28)全球陽性率略增至3.51%,其中美洲、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加明顯。 中國疫情於低點波動,第2週(1/5-11)門急診陽性率略降至1.1%,汙水監測變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 香港疫情上升,第2週陽性率上升至0.11%,已連續兩週上升,惟整體仍處低點,汙水監測變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 美國疫情持續上升,第1週(12/28-1/3)陽性率增至5%,近期變異株占比以XFG占多數(61%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升,其中美洲、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加;近期全球流行變異株占比以XFG最高(75%),其次為NB.1.8.1(9.26%),新公告的BA.3.2占比為2.78%。鑒於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity rose slightly to 3.51% in week 52 of 2025 (22–28 December), with notable increases in the Americas, African and European Regions. China's situation fluctuates at a low level; outpatient and emergency test positivity dipped slightly to 1.1% in week 2 (5–11 January), and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant in wastewater surveillance. Hong Kong's situation is rising: test positivity increased to 0.11% in week 2 and has risen for two consecutive weeks, though it remains low overall; NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant in wastewater surveillance. The United States' situation continues to rise: test positivity increased to 5% in week 1 (28 December–3 January), with XFG the majority of recent variants (61%). Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently risen, with increases in the Americas, African and European Regions. XFG is currently the most common variant globally (75%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (9.26%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for 2.78%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: GPEI:1月1至7日無新增人類病例;巴基斯坦新增36件WPV1環境樣本。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported no new human polio cases for 1–7 January; Pakistan had 36 new WPV1 environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/1-7期間,無新增人類病例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦36件,cVDPV2新增坦尚亞2件。
