items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 1–7 January that no new human cases were added. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 36 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added 2 samples in Tanzania.

items.summary_zh: 新加坡2025年第52至53週腸病毒日均新增15例,為11月以來最高。
items.summary_en: Singapore's enterovirus cases averaged 15 per day in weeks 52–53 of 2025, the highest since November.
items.description_zh: 新加坡疫情上升,2025年第52-53週平均每日新增15例,為11月以來最高,惟仍低於2024年同期;另鄰近國家/地區如中國、香港、日本、韓國及泰國疫情處低點或呈下降趨勢。
items.description_en: Singapore's situation is rising. In weeks 52–53 of 2025, an average of 15 new cases were reported per day, the highest since November, though still below the same period in 2024. Neighbouring countries and regions, including China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea and Thailand, are at low levels or declining.

items.summary_zh: 印度古加拉特、北方邦及泰倫加納邦傷寒上升,多因供水管線滲漏所致。
items.summary_en: Typhoid is rising in Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh and Telangana, mostly due to water pipeline leaks that let sewage mix with drinking water.
items.description_zh: 印度多邦疫情升溫,包含古加拉特邦(Gujarat)、北方邦(Uttar Pradesh)以及泰倫加納邦(Telangana),多為供水系統管線滲漏造成飲用水與汙水混合所致;據研究顯示,該國於2023年估計累計報告490萬例病例,其中7,850例死亡,且高氟喹諾酮(Fluoroquinolone)抗藥性是五歲以下兒童及高負擔地區之住院及死亡主因。
items.description_en: Typhoid is rising in several Indian states, including Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh and Telangana, mostly due to leaks in water supply pipelines that allow sewage to mix with drinking water. A study estimates that India reported 4.9 million cases cumulatively in 2023, including 7,850 deaths. Fluoroquinolone resistance is a major cause of hospitalisation and death among children under five and in high-burden areas.

items.summary_zh: 美國報告45例沙門氏菌感染、12例住院,疑與某品牌營養補充粉有關,已召回。
items.summary_en: The US reported 45 Salmonella cases, 12 hospitalised, possibly linked to a nutritional supplement powder; the product was recalled.
items.description_zh: 美國1/14報告45例病例,其中12例住院,病患分布於威斯康辛州等21個州,發病日介於2025年8/22至12/30;當局調查疑感染源為某牌營養補充粉,該公司已於1/14召回產品。
items.description_en: The United States reported 45 cases on 14 January, 12 of them hospitalised, across 21 states including Wisconsin, with onset dates between 22 August and 30 December 2025. Authorities investigating suspect the source is a nutritional supplement powder from one brand, and the company recalled the product on 14 January.

items.headline_zh: 美國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 美國一郵輪諾羅病毒群聚,2025年12月28日至今年1月9日累計94例。
items.summary_en: A US cruise ship norovirus cluster recorded 94 cases between 28 December 2025 and 9 January 2026.
items.description_zh: 美國1/8新增1起郵輪群聚事件,郵輪上包括2,593名乘客及1,005名船員,於2025年12/28至今年1/9航行期間,累計報告94例病例(含85名乘客及9名船員)。此郵輪自英國南安普敦郵輪碼頭出發,預計於4/3返回,郵輪業者已隔離患者、保留糞便檢體並持續加強清消。
items.description_en: On 8 January, the United States recorded one new cruise ship cluster. The ship, carrying 2,593 passengers and 1,005 crew, reported 94 cumulative cases (85 passengers and 9 crew) during its voyage from 28 December 2025 to 9 January 2026. The ship departed from the Southampton cruise terminal in the United Kingdom and is expected to return on 3 April. The cruise operator has isolated patients, retained stool samples and continued to strengthen disinfection.

items.headline_zh: 印度-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 印度古加拉特邦報告1例26歲男性克里米亞-剛果出血熱,目前住院治療。
items.summary_en: Gujarat state, India, reported a case of Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever in a 26-year-old man, who is receiving hospital treatment.
items.description_zh: 印度西部古加拉特邦報告1例男性病例,個案為26歲並從事農業及養殖相關行業,已於醫院接受治療,該邦約每2-4個月會報告病例,當局已於當地進行大規模監測作業。
items.description_en: Gujarat state in western India reported one male case, aged 26, who works in agriculture and livestock-related industries and is receiving hospital treatment. The state typically reports cases every 2–4 months, and authorities have carried out extensive surveillance in the area.

items.summary_zh: 西班牙馬略卡島報告Ib型M痘群聚,9例男性感染,當局追蹤接觸者並推廣接種。
items.summary_en: Mallorca, Spain, reported a clade Ib mpox cluster of 9 male cases; authorities are tracing contacts and promoting vaccination.
items.description_zh: 西班牙馬略卡島1/10 報告一起感染Ib病毒群聚事件,於2025年11月下旬至12月期間報告9例病例,個案均為男性,年齡介於35-40歲,其中1名個案曾與1名來自德國者性接觸。當局正進行接觸者追蹤並推廣疫苗接種。
items.description_en: On 10 January, Spain's Mallorca island reported a cluster of clade Ib virus infections, with 9 cases reported between late November and December 2025. All cases were male, aged 35–40. One case had sexual contact with a person from Germany. Authorities are conducting contact tracing and promoting vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 印度西孟加拉邦新增2例疑似立百病毒病例,皆為同一醫院護理人員,1例危急。
items.summary_en: West Bengal, India, reported two suspected Nipah cases, both nursing staff at one hospital; one patient is critically ill.
items.description_zh: 印度西孟加拉邦新增報告2例疑病例,皆住院隔離治療中,其中1例病情危急,病患皆為同一家醫院護理人員,近期無國內(其他邦)及國外旅遊史,檢體於1/11初步檢驗結果為立百病毒感染,已續送至中央單位進行確認,當局已啟動疫情應變小組及密切接觸者追蹤作業。病例發生於1月,與病毒出現的歷史季節性模式相符,並與椰棗樹汁採收有關。
items.description_en: West Bengal state, India, has newly reported two suspected cases, both hospitalised in isolation, and one is critically ill. Both patients are nursing staff at the same hospital, and neither has recent travel history within India (to other states) or abroad. Preliminary test results on 11 January indicated Nipah virus infection, and samples have been sent to the central authority for confirmation. Authorities have activated an outbreak response team and contact tracing. The cases occurred in January, consistent with the virus's historical seasonal pattern, and are associated with the harvesting of date palm sap.

items.summary_zh: 印尼東爪哇縣2025年麻疹確診209例、12死;美國南卡累計310例。
items.summary_en: Indonesia's Pamekasan Regency recorded 209 confirmed measles cases and 12 deaths in 2025; South Carolina's total reached 310 cases.
items.description_zh: 印東爪哇省帕梅卡桑縣去(2025)年累計報告1,248例疑病例,其中,209例經實驗室確診,12人死亡,確診/死亡病例主要為1-4歲兒童,約78%確診病患未曾接種疫苗,由於疫情持續迅速傳播,該縣宣布其18個村莊疫情為重大公共衛生事件,並啟動家戶主動訪視之疫苗接種作業。該國去年截至8月累計報告逾2.3萬疑病例(3,444例確診),相較2023-24年之10,628例及3,520例為高。 美國南卡羅來納州於今年1/7-9新增99例確定病例,病患主要集中於斯帕坦堡( Spartanburg),累計病例數達310例,當局已匡列200名接觸者並發布警報,建議醫療機構提高警覺及落實個人防護措施。該國去年共44州累計報告2,144例確定病例,其中240例住院、3例死亡,93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。該國近年疫苗接種率持續落後,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/北卡羅來納州。 智利報告1例境外移入確定病例,為居住於聖地牙哥首都大區43歲女性,當局調查可能感染地點為2025/12/15-19於西班牙馬德里舉行之國際會議,病患於31日搭乘智利南美航空(LATAM Chile, LA 8118)自烏拉圭蒙特維多機場返回智利,當局已啟動接觸者聯繫及安排其疫苗接種作業並加強疫情監測。
items.description_en: In Pamekasan Regency, East Java province, Indonesia, 1,248 suspected cases were reported cumulatively last year (2025), of which 209 were laboratory-confirmed and 12 people died. Confirmed and fatal cases were mainly children aged 1–4, and about 78% of confirmed patients were unvaccinated. As the outbreak continued to spread rapidly, the regency declared the outbreak in its 18 villages a major public health incident and launched household vaccination outreach. Indonesia reported more than 23,000 suspected cases through August last year (3,444 confirmed), higher than the 10,628 suspected and 3,520 confirmed cases in 2023–24. In the United States, South Carolina added 99 confirmed cases on 7–9 January this year, mainly in Spartanburg, bringing the cumulative total to 310. Authorities have identified 200 contacts, issued an alert, and recommended that healthcare facilities remain vigilant and implement personal protective measures. Last year, the United States reported 2,144 confirmed cases across 44 states, including 240 hospitalisations and 3 deaths; 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. US vaccination rates have continued to lag in recent years, and recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina and North Carolina. Chile reported one imported confirmed case, a 43-year-old woman residing in the Santiago Metropolitan Region. Authorities investigated that she may have been infected at an international conference held in Madrid, Spain, from 15 to 19 December 2025. The patient returned to Chile on LATAM Chile flight LA 8118 from Montevideo airport in Uruguay on the 31st. Authorities have activated contact tracing, arranged vaccination, and strengthened surveillance.

items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡2026年迄今登革熱2,170例,平均每日240例;洪水後疫情上升。
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka has reported 2,170 dengue cases so far in 2026, averaging 240 per day, after flooding raised transmission.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,2026年迄今已報告2,170例病例(平均每日報告240例病例),2025年累計報告51,479例病例,當局表示由於2025年11月底至12月初洪水造成疫情上升,已加強監測及病媒蚊控制。
items.description_en: Sri Lanka's situation is rising. So far in 2026, 2,170 cases have been reported, an average of 240 cases per day. In 2025, 51,479 cases were reported cumulatively. Authorities said the increase followed flooding in late November and early December 2025, and they have strengthened surveillance and vector mosquito control.

items.disease_zh: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_zh: 日本-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_en: Japan – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 日本2025年發熱伴血小板減少綜合症累計191例,為近年最高,並向東擴散。
items.summary_en: Japan reported 191 SFTS cases in 2025 across 32 prefectures, the highest in recent years, and the disease is spreading eastward.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情上升,2025年已有32個都道府縣累計報告達191例病例,病例數為近年來最高,主要分布於該國西部地區,以高知縣15例、靜岡縣及大分縣各13例為多,並逐漸向東部蔓延,神奈川縣亦出現首例。
items.description_en: Japan's situation is rising. In 2025, 191 cases were reported cumulatively across 32 prefectures, the highest in recent years. Cases are mainly in western Japan, with the most in Kochi prefecture (15 cases), and 13 each in Shizuoka and Oita prefectures. The disease is gradually spreading eastward, and the first case has also appeared in Kanagawa prefecture.

items.summary_zh: 據媒體報導,古巴10月底一週新增逾1萬例發燒病例,截至12月中旬52人死亡。
items.summary_en: Media reports say Cuba added over 10,000 fever cases in one week in late October 2025, with 52 deaths by mid-December.
items.description_zh: 據報載,古巴傳出高燒、紅疹、脫皮、關節腫脹、嘔吐及腹瀉等症狀病例明顯增加,於2025年10月下旬1週內新增1萬餘例發燒病例,截至12月中旬報告52例死亡,專家分析可能有多種病毒流行,如登革熱、屈公病、奧羅普切熱、流感及新冠病毒等,造成診斷困難。
items.description_en: According to media reports, Cuba has seen a marked increase in cases with high fever, rash, peeling skin, joint swelling, vomiting and diarrhoea. More than 10,000 fever cases were added within one week in late October 2025, and as of mid-December, 52 deaths had been reported. Experts analysed that multiple viruses may be circulating, including dengue, chikungunya, Oropouche fever, influenza and COVID-19, which makes diagnosis difficult.

items.summary_zh: 美國流感季第53週新增8例兒童死亡,累計17例;高風險者宜儘早抗病毒治療。
items.summary_en: The US flu season added 8 paediatric deaths in week 53, bringing the total to 17; high-risk patients should start antivirals early.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續,第53週(2025/12/28-2026/1/3)新增8例兒童死亡病例,本季累計17例,第53週類流感門診就診率為7.2%,高於全國基準 (3.1%),陽性率為24.7%,病患人數及住院/死亡率皆上升。本流感季截至1/9,逾1,500萬例感染、18萬人住院治療及7,400人死亡,共44個地區為高度或極高度流行,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),其中9成為K分支。當局列為中度嚴重流感季,推估流感活動度將持續數週,另疫苗經證實可降低重症風險,建議民眾應接種本季疫苗,且高風險者應儘早使用抗病毒藥物治療。
items.description_en: The US influenza season continues. In week 53 (28 December 2025–3 January 2026), 8 new paediatric deaths were reported, bringing the season total to 17. The outpatient influenza-like illness rate in week 53 was 7.2%, above the national baseline (3.1%), and test positivity was 24.7%. Patient numbers and hospitalisation and death rates have all risen. As of 9 January, this flu season has seen more than 15 million infections, 180,000 hospitalisations and 7,400 deaths. A total of 44 areas are at high or very high activity levels. The main circulating type is A(H3N2), 90% of which belongs to subclade K. Authorities have classified this as a moderately severe flu season and estimate that influenza activity will continue for several weeks. Vaccines have been shown to reduce the risk of severe disease, and people are advised to get this season's vaccine. High-risk people should start antiviral treatment as early as possible.

items.summary_zh: 中國近1週呼吸道檢測,門急診流感樣病例以流感病毒最多,鼻病毒為南方第二高。
items.summary_en: In China's latest weekly testing, influenza virus led outpatient flu-like illness; rhinovirus ranked second in southern provinces.
items.description_zh: 中國近1週(2025/12/29-2026/1/4)呼吸道樣本病原體檢測陽性率,其中哨點醫院門急診類流感病例前三高病原體為流感病毒(27.4%)、RSV(8.8%)及鼻病毒(5.7%),另住院嚴重急性呼吸道感染病例前三高病原體為RSV(11.4%)、流感病毒(10.6%)及鼻病毒(6.4%);近期鼻病毒檢测陽性率於一定區間波動,且具南北方地區及不同年齡族群差異,於南方省分,鼻病毒為第二高病原體,於15-59歲及60歲以上年齡族群,鼻病毒亦為第二高病原體。
items.description_en: In China's respiratory sample testing for the past week (29 December 2025–4 January 2026), the top three pathogens among sentinel hospital outpatient and emergency influenza-like illness cases were influenza virus (27.4%), RSV (8.8%) and rhinovirus (5.7%). Among hospitalised severe acute respiratory infection cases, the top three were RSV (11.4%), influenza virus (10.6%) and rhinovirus (6.4%). Recent rhinovirus test positivity has fluctuated within a range, with differences between northern and southern regions and across age groups. In southern provinces, rhinovirus was the second most common pathogen; among those aged 15–59 and 60 and over, rhinovirus was also the second most common pathogen.

items.summary_zh: 香港本流感季兒童重症25例(3死)、成人重症507例,近1週低於基準。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong's flu activity is below baseline; this season has 25 severe paediatric cases (3 deaths) and 507 severe adult cases (342 deaths).
items.description_zh: 香港近1週(2025/12/28-2026/1/3)陽性率及活動度皆低於基準,本流感季兒童累計報告25例重症個案,其中3例死亡,成人累計507例重症個案,其中342例死亡,8成為65歲以上年齡層,主要流行型別為A(H3N2)。當局於1/8宣布於去(2025)年9月進入之夏季流感季已結束,且夏季與冬季流感季未出現重疊情形,惟天氣漸轉寒冷,活動度可能再度上升,冬季流感季在即,呼籲未接種2025/2026流感疫苗之高風險族群,應儘速接種,另當局評估疫苗仍具A(H3N2) K分支保護力。
items.description_en: In the past week (28 December 2025–3 January 2026), Hong Kong's test positivity and activity levels were below baseline. This flu season, 25 severe paediatric cases have been reported cumulatively, 3 of whom died. 507 severe adult cases have been reported, of whom 342 died, and 80% were aged 65 and over. The main circulating type is A(H3N2). On 8 January, authorities announced that the summer flu season, which began in September last year, had ended, and that the summer and winter flu seasons did not overlap. As the weather turns colder, activity may rise again. With the winter flu season approaching, authorities call on high-risk people who have not received the 2025/2026 influenza vaccine to get vaccinated as soon as possible. Authorities assess that the vaccine still provides protection against A(H3N2) subclade K.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 德國、英國H5N1疫情居多(截至1月9日);2025年H9N2人類病例35例。
items.summary_en: Germany (194) and the UK (83) led 387 new H5N1 outbreaks from late December to early January; 35 human H9N2 cases were reported in 2025.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共22國於2025/12/22-2026/1/9期間新增387起H5N1疫情,德國194起、英國83起、波蘭23起、丹麥22起、印度11起、瑞士/菲律賓各7起、美國6起、荷蘭5起、捷克/法國/義大利各4起、斯洛維亞/日本各3起、保加利亞/匈牙利/西班牙各2起、以色列/哥倫比亞/比利時/瑞典/立陶宛各1起。 共4國於2026/1/2-2026/1/9期間新增8起H5(N untyped)疫情,美國3起、比利時/義大利各2起、菲律賓1起。 菲律賓於2026/1/9新增2起H5N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州。USDA 具乳牛接觸史者:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測至少218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。CDC、CDC 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:2025/12/28-2026/1/3共431個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/明蘇達州共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。CDC  年度摘要:  人類病例:2025年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感35例(迄今累計165例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:今(2026)年累計11國家/地區通報24起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:  FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播情形,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections this week. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 22 countries reported 387 new H5N1 outbreaks between 22 December 2025 and 9 January 2026: Germany 194, United Kingdom 83, Poland 23, Denmark 22, India 11, Switzerland and Philippines 7 each, United States 6, Netherlands 5, Czechia, France and Italy 4 each, Slovenia and Japan 3 each, Bulgaria, Hungary and Spain 2 each, and Israel, Colombia, Belgium, Sweden and Lithuania 1 each. A total of 4 countries reported 8 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 2 and 9 January 2026: United States 3, Belgium and Italy 2 each, and Philippines 1. The Philippines reported 2 new H5N8 outbreaks on 9 January 2026. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: herds: 1,084 outbreaks have been reported across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin (USDA). Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and at least 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms) (CDC). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: from 28 December 2025 to 3 January 2026, 431 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 3 sites in New Jersey and Minnesota (CDC). Annual summary: human cases: in 2025, 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases, 30 H5N1 influenza cases (992* cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 case (2 cumulative), 1 H5N5 case (1 cumulative), 35 H9N2 cases (165 cumulative), and 2 H10N3 cases (6 cumulative). Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Animal and avian cases: this year, 11 countries and areas have reported 24 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率降至3.23%;美國上升至3.9%,德國近期以BA.3.2為主。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity fell to 3.23% in mid-December; US positivity rose to 3.9%, and BA.3.2 led recent variants in Germany.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第51週(12/15-21)全球陽性率下降至3.23%,西太平洋、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加。 香港疫情於低點波動,2025年第53週(12/28-1/3)陽性率上升至0.05%,汙水監測變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 德國疫情下降,2025年第51-52週陽性率為13%,近期變異株轉為BA.3.2占多數(38%)。 美國疫情自2025年11月起持續上升,第52週陽性率增至3.9%,近期變異株以XFG占多數(61%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,西太平洋、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加;近期全球流行變異株占比以XFG最高,其次為NB.1.8.1,新公告的BA.3.2占比為3.7%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity fell to 3.23% in week 51 of 2025 (15–21 December), with increases in the Western Pacific, African and European Regions. Hong Kong's situation fluctuates at a low level; test positivity rose to 0.05% in week 53 of 2025 (28 December–3 January), and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant in wastewater surveillance. Germany's situation has declined; test positivity was 13% in weeks 51–52 of 2025, and the recent predominant variant is now BA.3.2 (38%). The United States' situation has continued to rise since November 2025; test positivity rose to 3.9% in week 52, with XFG the majority of recent variants (61%). Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently trended down, while positivity has increased in the Western Pacific, African and European Regions. XFG is currently the most common variant globally, followed by NB.1.8.1, and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for 3.7%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.

items.headline_zh: 全球/索馬利亞-小兒麻痺症
items.summary_zh: GPEI:索馬利亞12月25至31日新增1例cVDPV2及1件環境樣本。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new cVDPV2 case and one cVDPV2 environmental sample in Somalia for 25–31 December 2025.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2025年12/25-31期間,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞1例;環境樣本部分,新增索馬利亞cVDPV2 1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 25–31 December 2025 that cVDPV2 added 1 case in Somalia. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 1 sample in Somalia.

items.summary_zh: 印度古加拉特邦甘地納加市1月6日報告108例傷寒,疑下水道滲漏汙染所致。
items.summary_en: Gandhinagar, India, reported 108 typhoid cases on 6 January, suspected to be caused by sewage leakage; about 150,000 people were investigated.
items.description_zh: 印度西部古加拉特邦(Gujarat)甘地納加市(Gandhinagar)1/6報告108例病例,疑為下水道滲漏汙染所導致,當局已調查約15萬人,發放氯錠及口服補液;另該國每年約報告470萬例病例。
items.description_en: In Gandhinagar city, Gujarat state, western India, 108 cases were reported on 6 January. The cases are suspected to have been caused by contamination from sewage leakage. Authorities have investigated about 150,000 people and distributed chlorine tablets and oral rehydration solution. India reports about 4.7 million cases each year.

items.disease_zh: 李斯特菌症,腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症,沙門氏菌感染症,肉毒桿菌中毒
items.disease_en: 李斯特菌症, 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症, 沙門氏菌感染症, 肉毒桿菌中毒
items.headline_zh: 美國-沙門氏菌感染症/大腸桿菌感染症/李斯特菌症/肉毒桿菌中毒
items.headline_en: United States – Salmonella infection / E. coli infection / Listeriosis / Botulism
items.summary_zh: 美國FDA 2025年報告33起跨州食品中毒、921例,主要為沙門氏菌等。
items.summary_en: The US FDA reported 33 multistate foodborne outbreaks in 2025 with 921 cases, mainly Salmonella, E. coli and Listeria.
items.description_zh: 美國FDA於2025年累計報告33起跨州食品中毒事件,累計921例病例,常見致病原為沙門氏菌、大腸桿菌與李斯特菌,另嬰兒配方奶粉的肉毒桿菌汙染事件亦受關注,常見汙染源包含雞蛋、即食食品、蔬菜、堅果製品、雞蛋、生蠔等生食海鮮及乳製品等。
items.description_en: The US FDA reported 33 multistate foodborne outbreaks in 2025, with 921 cumulative cases. Common pathogens were Salmonella, E. coli and Listeria. Botulism contamination of infant formula has also drawn attention. Common contamination sources include eggs, ready-to-eat foods, vegetables, nut products, raw seafood such as oysters, and dairy products.

items.headline_zh: 中國/印度-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: China / India – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 中國A型肝炎1.8萬例為去年同期1.4倍;印度喀拉拉邦死亡82例創新高。
items.summary_en: China reported about 18,000 hepatitis A cases from January to November 2025, 1.4 times 2024; Kerala, India, recorded a record 82 deaths.
items.description_zh: 中國於2025年1-11月累計報告約1.8萬例病例,病例數為2024年同期1.4倍,疫情自5月起呈下降趨勢;印度喀拉拉邦(Kerala)2025年累計報告逾3.1萬例病例,其中死亡82例,死亡數創歷史新高。
items.description_en: China reported about 18,000 cases cumulatively from January to November 2025, 1.4 times the same period in 2024. Cases have trended downward since May. In Kerala state, India, more than 31,000 cases were reported cumulatively in 2025, including 82 deaths, a record high number of deaths.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),印度

items.summary_zh: 日本2025年梅毒逾1.3萬例,東京都3,264例最多;韓國2,036例。
items.summary_en: Japan reported over 13,000 syphilis cases through week 50 of 2025, led by Tokyo with 3,264; South Korea reported 2,036 through November.
items.description_zh: 日本2025年截至第50週累計報告逾1.3萬例確定病例,以東京都3,264例為多,其次為大阪府(1,637例)及愛知縣(818例),另愛媛縣(155例)為歷年最高,當局已提供電話諮詢及免費匿名篩檢服務,並呼籲民眾應正確使用保險套,疑感染者應立即接受檢測。 韓國2025年截至11月累計報告2,036例確定病例,年齡層以20-30歲為主,當局持續宣導安全性行為及早期檢測之重要性;該國自2024年起梅毒由抽樣監測調整為全面通報,2024年累計報告2,790例。
items.description_en: Japan reported more than 13,000 confirmed cases cumulatively in 2025 through week 50. The most were in Tokyo Metropolis (3,264), followed by Osaka Prefecture (1,637) and Aichi Prefecture (818). Ehime Prefecture (155) recorded its highest number on record. Authorities have provided telephone consultation and free anonymous screening services, urge people to use condoms correctly, and advise anyone with suspected infection to be tested immediately. South Korea reported 2,036 confirmed cases cumulatively through November 2025, mainly among those aged 20–30; authorities continue to promote safe sex and early testing. Since 2024, South Korea has changed syphilis reporting from sample-based surveillance to full notification; 2,790 cases were reported in 2024.

items.headline_zh: 馬達加斯加/以色列/阿拉伯聯合大公國-M痘
items.headline_en: Madagascar / Israel / United Arab Emirates – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 馬達加斯加西北部報告5例確定M痘;以色列首例Ib型境外移入,疫苗已短缺6個月。
items.summary_en: Madagascar reported 5 confirmed mpox cases in its northwest; Israel reported its first imported clade Ib case amid a six-month vaccine shortage.
items.description_zh: 馬達加斯加報告首起疫情,西北部馬哈贊加市共計報告5例確定病例,病患皆接受治療中,當局已啟動緊急公衛行動中心,加強疫情監測及港口/機場等入境點之健康檢查作業,該國醫療系統資源有限,倘疫情擴散,可能限制診斷、治療及疫苗接種的因應能力。 以色列報告首例1b型境外移入病例,該病患具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已啟動疫情監測及接觸者追蹤作業,惟該國疫苗短缺已持續6個月,致無法及時提供高風險族群疫苗,呼籲民眾倘出現疑症狀,應立即接受檢測。
items.description_en: Madagascar reported its first outbreak. In Mahajanga city in northwestern Madagascar, a total of 5 confirmed cases have been reported, and all are receiving treatment. Authorities have activated an emergency public health operations centre and strengthened surveillance and health screening at entry points such as ports and airports. The country's healthcare system has limited resources, and if the outbreak spreads, its capacity for diagnosis, treatment and vaccination may be restricted. Israel reported its first imported clade Ib case. The patient had travelled to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have activated surveillance and contact tracing. However, the country has had a vaccine shortage for six months, so high-risk groups cannot be vaccinated in a timely manner. People with suspicious symptoms are urged to get tested immediately.
items.area_zh: 以色列,馬達加斯加,阿拉伯聯合大公國

items.summary_zh: 香港2025年第53週報告2例退伍軍人病,2025年全年共167例。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 2 Legionnaires' disease cases in week 53 of 2025; 167 cases were reported in 2025 overall.
items.description_zh: 香港於2025年第53週報告2例確定病例,分別為東區76歲女性及西貢區66歲男性,皆有慢性疾病史,病患間無流行病學關聯。當局已啟動疫情調查,並提醒民眾應使用定期保養/設計良好之供水系統,另高風險族群應採取相關預防措施。香港於2023-25年分別報告121、135及167例病例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported 2 confirmed cases in week 53 of 2025: a 76-year-old woman from Eastern District and a 66-year-old man from Sai Kung District. Both have chronic conditions, and there is no epidemiological link between the patients. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and reminded the public to use well-maintained and well-designed water supply systems. High-risk groups should take relevant preventive measures. Hong Kong reported 121, 135 and 167 cases in 2023, 2024 and 2025 respectively.

items.headline_zh: 越南-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 越南2025年流腦確定病例95例,較2024年增74例,C及W型致死率較高。
items.summary_en: Viet Nam recorded 95 meningococcal cases in 2025, up 74 from 2024; serogroups C and W carry higher mortality.
items.description_zh: 越南2025年累計報告95例確定病例,較2024年增加74例,境內5血清型(A、B、C、W和Y)皆在流行,其中,C及W血清型會導致較高死亡率。另11月份即報告11例,北寧省、胡志明市等地已出現多起死亡病例。專家表示該疾病早期症狀不明顯,致許多病例未進行檢測,實際病例數可能高於官方統計,專家呼籲民眾應提高警覺及進行全面疫苗接種作業。
items.description_en: Viet Nam reported 95 confirmed cases cumulatively in 2025, 74 more than in 2024. All five serogroups (A, B, C, W and Y) are circulating in the country, and serogroups C and W cause higher mortality. In November alone, 11 cases were reported, and several deaths have occurred in areas including Bac Ninh province and Ho Chi Minh City. Experts say early symptoms of the disease are not obvious, so many cases are not tested, and the actual number of cases may be higher than official statistics. Experts urge the public to raise their awareness and to get fully vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 美國流感第52週陽性率升至32.9%,本季已逾1,100萬人感染。
items.summary_en: US flu test positivity rose to 32.9% in week 52, with outpatient illness at 8.2%; over 11 million infections this season.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情上升,共48個地區為高度流行,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),其中9成為K分支,第52週類流感門診就診率為8.2%,高於全國基準 (3.1%),陽性率由第50週14.8上升至32.9%,病患人數及住院/死亡率皆上升。本流感季截至1/5,逾1,100萬人感染、12萬人住院治療及5,000 人死亡,其中,兒童死亡病例達9例,當局列為中度嚴重流感季,推估流感活動度將持續數週,建議民眾應接種本季流感疫苗,另高風險者應儘早使用抗病毒藥物治療。
items.description_en: The US situation is rising, with 48 areas at high activity levels. The main circulating type is A(H3N2), 90% of which is subclade K. In week 52, the outpatient influenza-like illness rate was 8.2%, above the national baseline (3.1%). Test positivity rose from 14.8% in week 50 to 32.9%. Patient numbers and hospitalisation and death rates have all risen. As of 5 January, this flu season has seen more than 11 million infections, 120,000 hospitalisations and 5,000 deaths, including 9 child deaths. Authorities have classified it as a moderately severe flu season and estimate that influenza activity will continue for several weeks. People are advised to get this season's flu vaccine, and high-risk people should start antiviral treatment as early as possible.

items.summary_zh: 美國2025年麻疹2,065例、3死,為近30年最高;澳洲179例多與旅遊有關。
items.summary_en: US measles reached 2,065 cases and 3 deaths in 2025, the highest in nearly 30 years; Australia recorded 179 mostly travel-linked cases.
items.description_zh: 美國2025年截至12/30共44州報告49起疫情及2,065例確定病例,其中235例住院、3例死亡,93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,病例數以德州(803例)、南卡羅來納州(181例) 、亞利桑那州(196例)為多,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/亞利桑那/猶他州;另紐澤西州紐華克自由國際機場、麻州洛根機場及科羅拉多州丹佛國際機場曾有感染麻疹旅客出入,當局提醒民眾可能有傳播風險。該國2025年病例數為近30年最高,2024年報告285例病例。 澳大利亞新南威爾斯州及南澳州發布警示,報告1名自東南亞返國之旅客於具傳染力期間,曾到訪雪梨及阿得雷德部分地區,可能有傳播風險,當局提醒在指定時間出現在暴露地點者,應留意自身健康狀況,並於出現疑症狀時,儘速就醫。該國於2025年累計報告179例,為2024年病例數3倍,病例數多與旅行相關。
items.description_en: As of 30 December 2025, 44 US states had reported 49 outbreaks and 2,065 confirmed cases in 2025, of which 235 were hospitalised and 3 died. 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases were most numerous in Texas (803), Arizona (196) and South Carolina (181). Recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina, Arizona and Utah. Infected travellers also passed through Newark Liberty International Airport in New Jersey, Boston Logan Airport in Massachusetts and Denver International Airport in Colorado, and authorities warn of possible transmission risk. The US case count for 2025 is the highest in nearly 30 years; 285 cases were reported in 2024. New South Wales and South Australia issued alerts after a traveller returning from Southeast Asia visited parts of Sydney and Adelaide during the infectious period, posing a possible transmission risk. Authorities advise people who were at the exposure locations at the specified times to monitor their health and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear. Australia reported 179 cases in 2025, three times the 2024 number, mostly linked to travel.

items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞2025年黃熱病118例、49死;托利馬省自2024年累計121例。
items.summary_en: Colombia recorded 118 yellow fever cases and 49 deaths in 2025; Tolima has 121 cases since 2024, mostly among unvaccinated people.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞疫情持續,2025年共10省累計118例病例及49例死亡,其中,托利馬省自2024年爆發疫情後,已累計121例病例及47例死亡為多,病例主要為未接種疫苗且有疫情風險地區旅遊史者,由於假期人潮流動可能造成疫情上升,當局呼籲加強防治措施,以避免疾病傳播。
items.description_en: Colombia's outbreak continues. In 2025, 118 cases and 49 deaths were reported cumulatively across 10 departments. Tolima department, where the outbreak began after 2024, has cumulatively recorded 121 cases and 47 deaths, the largest share. Cases are mainly among unvaccinated people with travel history to areas at risk of outbreaks. Because holiday travel may increase case numbers, authorities call for strengthened prevention and control measures to prevent the spread of disease.

items.summary_zh: 全球2025年屈公病逾50萬例、186例死亡,美洲、東南亞與西太平洋病例最多。
items.summary_en: Chikungunya reached 502,264 cases and 186 deaths globally in 2025, with the Americas, South-East Asia and the Western Pacific most affected.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
items.description_en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率降至2.8%,惟非洲、美洲及歐洲區上升;BA.3.2占5.04%。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity fell to 2.8% in week 50 but rose in Africa, the Americas and Europe; BA.3.2 accounts for 5.04%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  全球陽性率於2025年第50週(12/8-14)下降至2.8%,惟非洲、美洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加。 中國疫情於低點,2025年第52週(12/22-28)陽性率0.7%,與前1週相同,近期變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情於低點波動,2025年第52週陽性率下降至0.03%,汙水監測變異株以XFG占比最高,惟輕症病例變異株以NB.1.8.1占比為多。 英國疫情下降,2025年第51週住院數下降至495例,陽性率降至1.6%,其中,85歲以上陽性率最高;另本流感季75歲以上民眾已有63%接種COVID-19疫苗。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降,惟非洲、美洲及歐洲區署增加;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1,新公告的BA.3.2占比為5.04%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity fell to 2.8% in week 50 of 2025 (8–14 December), though it rose in the African, American and European Regions. China is at a low level; test positivity was 0.7% in week 52 (22–28 December), the same as the previous week, and NB.1.8.1 is the most common recent variant. Hong Kong fluctuates at a low level; test positivity fell to 0.03% in week 52 of 2025. XFG is the variant with the largest share in wastewater surveillance, while NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant among mild cases. The United Kingdom's situation has declined: hospital admissions fell to 495 in week 51 of 2025 and test positivity fell to 1.6%, with the highest positivity among people aged 85 and over. Of people aged 75 and over, 63% had received a COVID-19 vaccine this flu season. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently declined, but has increased in the African, American and European Regions. XFG is currently the most common circulating variant globally, followed by NB.1.8.1, and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for 5.04%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.
items.area_zh: 全球(第二級及第三級國家除外),中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,英國
items.area_en: China,Hong Kong SAR,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2025年全球71國通報6,947起禽流感疫情;同年H9N2人類病例35例。
items.summary_en: In 2025, 71 countries reported 6,947 avian influenza outbreaks, and 35 human H9N2 cases were recorded.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS)  共14國2025/12/24-31期間新增74起H5N1疫情,英國20起、日本15起、波蘭12起、荷蘭7起、加拿大5起、瑞典3起、哥倫比亞/德國/捷克/葡萄牙各 2起、丹麥/拉脫維亞/法國/臺灣各1起。 芬蘭於2025/12/30新增1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感案: 牛場:2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州。 具乳牛接觸史者:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測至少218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:2025年第51週計462個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西州共1個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:2025年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感35例(迄今累計165例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:2025年累計71國家/地區通報6,947起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播情形,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 14 countries reported 74 new H5N1 outbreaks between 24 and 31 December 2025: United Kingdom 20, Japan 15, Poland 12, Netherlands 7, Canada 5, Sweden 3, Colombia, Germany, Czechia and Portugal 2 each, and Denmark, Latvia, France and Taiwan 1 each. Finland reported 1 new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 30 December 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: herds: 1,084 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and at least 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 51 of 2025, 462 sampling sites reported results, of which 1 site in New Jersey detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases in 2025: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases, 30 H5N1 influenza cases (992* cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 case (2 cumulative), 1 H5N5 case (1 cumulative), 35 H9N2 cases (165 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 cases (6 cumulative). Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Animal and avian cases: in 2025, 71 countries and areas reported 6,947 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there has been no human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

items.summary_zh: 非洲2025年至12月21日霍亂逾31萬例、約3,000死,88%集中於5國。
items.summary_en: Africa recorded over 310,000 cholera cases and about 3,000 deaths in 2025 up to 21 December; 88% were in five countries.
items.description_zh: 非洲2025年截至12/21累計報告逾31萬例病例,其中約3,000例死亡,有88%的病患居住在南蘇丹、蘇丹、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉及奈及利亞,非洲CDC提出整合性策略以對抗疫情;另全球每年約有130-400萬人感染,造成2-14萬人死亡。
items.description_en: In Africa, cumulative cases in 2025 up to 21 December exceeded 310,000, of which about 3,000 died. 88% of patients lived in South Sudan, Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Angola and Nigeria. The Africa CDC has proposed an integrated strategy to combat the outbreak. Globally, an estimated 1.3–4 million people are infected each year, causing 20,000–140,000 deaths.

items.area_en: Angola,Congo,Democratic Republic of the,Nigeria,South Sudan,Republic of,Sudan

items.headline_zh: 多明尼加-鉤端螺旋體病
items.summary_zh: 多明尼加2025年鉤端螺旋體病累計178例、18例死亡,為去年同期2.75倍。
items.summary_en: The Dominican Republic recorded 178 leptospirosis cases and 18 deaths in 2025 up to 13 December, 2.75 times the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 多明加2025年截至12/13累計報告178例病例,其中18例死亡,病例數為去年同期2.75倍,當局表示近期病例出現通報及就醫延遲,呼籲加強社區衛教及通報機制。
items.description_en: The Dominican Republic reported 178 cumulative cases in 2025 up to 13 December, including 18 deaths. The number of cases was 2.75 times the same period last year. Authorities said that there have been recent delays in notification and in seeking medical care, and called for strengthened community health education and notification mechanisms.

items.summary_zh: 美國2025年破傷風累計37例,為10年來最高,多數患者居住於佛羅里達州。
items.summary_en: US tetanus cases reached 37 in 2025 up to 13 December, the highest in a decade, with most patients in Florida.
items.description_zh: 美國2025年截至12/13累計報告37例病例,高於近兩年同期,且為10年來最高,病患居住地以佛羅里達州為多;當局評估疫情升溫與疫苗涵蓋率下降有關,淹水及野火等氣候變遷相關災害,亦造成傷口與土壤接觸之風險增加。
items.description_en: The US reported 37 cumulative cases in 2025 up to 13 December, more than the same period in the past two years and the highest in 10 years. Most patients live in Florida. Authorities assess that the rise is linked to declining vaccination coverage. Climate-related disasters such as flooding and wildfires have also increased the risk of wounds coming into contact with soil.

items.headline_zh: 俄羅斯-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯2025年1至10月漢他病毒症候群逾3,300例,86%為都市居民。
items.summary_en: Russia reported over 3,300 hantavirus syndrome cases from January to October 2025, 86% among urban residents.
items.description_zh: 俄羅斯2025年1至10月累計報告逾3,300例病例,為去年同期1.5倍,病患以都市居民為主(占86%),呈現與過去以鄉村為主的不同流行趨勢;當局研判,人類與齧齒類動物的接觸模式正在改變,可能與秋季鼠類遷入都市建築及周邊環境有關,進而在人口稠密地區形成新的暴露途徑。
items.description_en: Russia reported more than 3,300 cases from January to October 2025, 1.5 times the same period last year. Most patients (86%) were urban residents, a pattern that differs from the past, when cases were mainly rural. Authorities assess that human contact patterns with rodents are changing, possibly because rodents move into urban buildings and surrounding areas in autumn, creating new exposure routes in densely populated areas.

items.summary_zh: 雪梨12月9至18日報告3例退伍軍人病,皆曾到訪Clarence Street。
items.summary_en: Sydney reported 3 Legionnaires' disease cases from 9–18 December, all visiting Clarence Street; cooling towers are being assessed.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞雪梨市於12/9-18報告3例確定病例,皆曾至雪梨市中心Clarence Street停留,病患間互不相識,感染源調查中,目前皆住院治療;當局已啟動冷卻水塔評估調查,另呼籲民眾倘於12/9後曾至Clarence Street 活動,應留意是否出現相關症狀。
items.description_en: Sydney, Australia, reported 3 confirmed cases between 9 and 18 December. All had visited Clarence Street in central Sydney, the patients did not know each other, and the source of infection is under investigation. All are currently hospitalised. Authorities have started an assessment of cooling towers, and urge anyone who has been active on Clarence Street since 9 December to watch for relevant symptoms.

items.disease_zh: 中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒感染症
items.headline_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯/法國-中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 2025年全球MERS-CoV累計19例、4死,沙烏地阿拉伯17例,法國2例。
items.summary_en: MERS-CoV recorded 19 cases and 4 deaths globally in 2025 up to 21 December: 17 in Saudi Arabia and 2 imported into France.
items.description_zh: 全球今(2025)年截自12/21累計報告19例確定病例,其中4例死亡,病患主要分布於沙烏地阿拉伯(17例),另法國通報2例旅遊相關境外移入病例;沙國於6/4-12/21報告7例確定病例,其中2例死亡,分布於中部利雅德省(3例)、西南部奈季蘭省(2例)及西部塔伊夫市(2例)等地,病患間無流行病學關聯;法國於12月報告2例確定病例,皆有阿拉伯半島旅遊史,已完成接觸者追蹤,無次級感染情形。WHO表示病毒仍持續在單峰駱駝中循環,致偶發動物傳人事件,目前尚無疫苗或特效治療藥物,以支持性照護為主,另醫療照護環境是人傳人感染的主要風險場域,建議各國加強急性呼吸道感染監測、落實感染管制措施,並提醒高風險族群避免接觸駱駝及其產品,評估全球及區域風險維持為中。
items.description_en: Globally in 2025, as of 21 December, 19 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, including 4 deaths. Most were in Saudi Arabia (17 cases), and France reported 2 travel-related imported cases. Saudi Arabia reported 7 confirmed cases between 4 June and 21 December, including 2 deaths, distributed across Riyadh province in central Saudi Arabia (3 cases), Najran province in the southwest (2) and the city of Taif in the west (2), with no epidemiological link between patients. France reported 2 confirmed cases in December, both with travel history to the Arabian Peninsula; contact tracing has been completed and no secondary infection was found. WHO said the virus continues to circulate in dromedary camels, causing occasional animal-to-human transmission. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment, and care is mainly supportive. Healthcare settings are the main risk setting for human-to-human transmission. WHO recommends that countries strengthen surveillance of acute respiratory infections, implement infection prevention and control measures, and remind high-risk groups to avoid contact with camels and their products. WHO assesses the global and regional risk as moderate.

items.summary_zh: 東京都一名巴士司機確診麻疹,今年累計33例;墨西哥6,050例、24死。
items.summary_en: Tokyo confirmed a measles case in a bus driver, with 33 cases this year; Mexico has 6,050 cases and 24 deaths, mostly in Chihuahua.
items.description_zh: 日本東京都報告1例確定病例,為30多歲駕駛巴士往返東京羽田及其他機場之男性司機,無出國旅遊史,病患於12/23出現發燒、睛充血及皮疹等症狀,同日下午曾至東京豐洲五金行停留,24日執勤於羽田/成田機場出發之巴士,當局已啟動疫情調查及接觸者匡列作業,並呼籲曾有相同活動史之民眾勿搭乘大眾運輸工具,倘出現發燒、皮疹、咳嗽、流鼻水或睛充血等疑麻疹症狀,應及時就醫。東京都今年累計報告33例確定病例,其中63%為本土感染。 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至12/26共計26州報告6,050例確定病例,其中24例死亡,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州(4,481例)、中西部哈利斯科州(516例)、西南部雷羅州(237例)為多,另死亡病例以契瓦瓦州21例為多。疫情自11月起反彈上升,近4週確診逾100例,病患主要年齡層為0-4歲兒童(1,559例),其次為25-29歲(690例)及5-9歲(655例)年齡層,90%以上未接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Tokyo Metropolis reported one confirmed case: a man in his 30s who drives buses between Tokyo's Haneda airport and other airports, with no history of overseas travel. The patient developed fever, conjunctival injection and rash on 23 December. That afternoon he visited a hardware store in Toyosu, Tokyo, and on 24 December he worked on buses departing from Haneda and Narita airports. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and contact identification, and urge people with the same activity history not to use public transport. Anyone who develops fever, rash, cough, runny nose or conjunctival injection should seek medical care promptly. Tokyo has reported 33 confirmed cases so far this year, 63% of them locally acquired. Mexico's situation is rising. As of 26 December this year, 26 states had reported 6,050 confirmed cases, including 24 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (4,481), Jalisco state in the central-west (516) and Guerrero state in the southwest (237); deaths were most numerous in Chihuahua (21). The outbreak has rebounded since November, with more than 100 confirmed cases in the past four weeks. The main age group is children aged 0–4 (1,559 cases), followed by those aged 25–29 (690) and 5–9 (655). Over 90% were unvaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉第50週登革熱新增2,648例、13例死亡,較前一週下降22.8%。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported 2,648 new dengue cases and 13 deaths in week 50, down 22.8% from the previous week.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,第50週(12/8-14)新增2,648例病例及13例死亡,病例數較前1週3,432例下降22.8%,今年截至12/14累計101,166例病例及412例死亡,該國去年同期累計98,877例病例及551例死亡。
items.description_en: Bangladesh update: in week 50 (8–14 December), 2,648 new cases and 13 deaths were reported. This was a 22.8% decrease from 3,432 cases in the previous week. This year, up to 14 December, 101,166 cases and 412 deaths have been reported cumulatively; in the same period last year, the country reported 98,877 cases and 551 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 美國2025年西尼羅熱累計2,039例;科羅拉多州285例、17死,居全國之首。
items.summary_en: The US recorded 2,039 West Nile fever cases across 46 states; Colorado had 285 cases and the most deaths (17).
items.description_zh: 美國今年共46州累計報告2,039例病例,高於去年同期(約1,800例),其中,1,404例為神經侵襲性病例。病例數以科羅拉多州為多,該州累計報告285例病例,較去年同期上升275%,17例死亡數亦居全國最多,病例主要分布於該州賴瑞默爾、圓石、韋爾德及亞當斯等郡。
items.description_en: This year, 2,039 cases have been reported cumulatively across 46 US states, higher than the same period last year (about 1,800), of which 1,404 were neuroinvasive. Most cases are in Colorado, which has reported 285 cumulative cases, up 275% on the same period last year. Colorado also recorded the most deaths nationally, with 17. Cases are mainly in Larimer, Boulder, Weld and Adams counties.

items.summary_zh: 柏林截至12月17日萊姆病累計1,406例,為2013年以來最多。
items.summary_en: Berlin reported 1,406 Lyme disease cases up to 17 December, its highest since 2013.
items.description_zh: 德國柏林截至12/17累計1,406例病例,近年來每年約報告700-800例,於2023年累計逾1,000例,今年病例數則為2013年以來最多,由於今年夏季潮濕及氣候變遷等因素,有利於蜱蟲生長,導致疫情上升。
items.description_en: Berlin had 1,406 cumulative cases as of 17 December. In recent years, about 700–800 cases have been reported annually, and more than 1,000 were reported in 2023. This year's case count is the highest since 2013. Humid summer conditions this year and climate change have favoured tick growth, increasing cases.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘累計142國逾17.5萬例;11月新增2,150例,WHO評估風險中等。
items.summary_en: Global mpox has reached 142 countries with over 175,000 cases; 2,150 new cases in November; WHO assesses global transmission risk as moderate.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/30累計142國/地區報告17萬5千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%);今年截至11/30累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中206例死亡(CFR:0.41%)。 今年11月共計48國家/地區報告2,150 例新增確診病例,其中 5例死亡(CFR:0.27%),68%來自非洲地區,相較10月,歐洲區與西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。 非洲地區近6週(11/2–12/14)共計19 國通報1,435例確診病例,其中7 例死亡(CFR:0.5%),其中以剛果民主共和國(427例)、幾內亞(330例)、賴比瑞亞(176例)、肯亞(142例)及迦納(107例)為高,除賴比瑞亞外,其餘近期病例數呈下降趨勢,另剛果民主共和國多省同時流行Ia及Ib型,部分省分受安全情勢與人口流動影響監測能力,病例數有低估情形。 非洲以外地區,羅馬亞通報首例 Ib 型境外移入病例,病患為成年男性,於今年8月確診,曾至中國且具高風險行為,入境後即住院隔離,境內未發現接觸者,後續亦無通報病例;西班牙及荷蘭持續出現Ib型社區傳播;英國12/2通報1例境外移入病例,同時檢出Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之 MPXV 重組病毒株,病況為輕症,現階段對該重組病毒株之流行範圍仍缺乏足夠資訊。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源缺乏,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,惟對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.
