items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 12月19至24日全球534起H5N1疫情,德國405起居首;中國3例H9N2。
items.summary_en: Germany led 534 new H5N1 outbreaks reported worldwide for 19–24 December 2025, with 405 of them in Germany; China reported 3 new H9N2 infections.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:中國新增3例H9N2流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共19國於2025/12/19-24期間新增534起H5N1 疫情,德國405起、美國41起、丹麥27起、瑞典17起、荷蘭10起、挪威/波蘭/義大利各5起、加拿大/捷克各3起、奈及利亞/日本/芬蘭/葡萄牙各2起、匈牙利/巴西/比利時/臺灣/英國各1起。 共2國於2025/12/16-23期間新增19起H5(N untyped)疫情,比利時15起、義大利4起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州。 具乳牛接觸史者:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測至少218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第50週計454個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/維吉亞/加州共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感35例(迄今累計165例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計71國家/地區通報6,872起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播情形,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: China reported 3 new human H9N2 infections. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 19 countries reported 534 new H5N1 outbreaks between 19 and 24 December 2025: Germany 405, United States 41, Denmark 27, Sweden 17, Netherlands 10, Norway, Poland and Italy 5 each, Canada and Czechia 3 each, Nigeria, Japan, Finland and Portugal 2 each, and Hungary, Brazil, Belgium, Taiwan and the United Kingdom 1 each. Two countries reported 19 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 16 and 23 December 2025: Belgium 15 and Italy 4. US dairy cattle avian influenza: herds: 1,084 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 19 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and at least 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 50, 454 sampling sites reported results, of which 3 sites in New Jersey, Virginia and California detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases, 30 H5N1 influenza cases (992* cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 case (2 cumulative), 1 H5N5 case (1 cumulative), 35 H9N2 cases (165 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 cases (6 cumulative). Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Animal and avian cases: a cumulative total of 71 countries and areas have reported 6,872 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there has been no human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率升至4.75%,中國、香港及美國上升;XFG為全球主要變異株。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity rose to 4.75% in week 49, with China, Hong Kong and the US increasing; XFG is the leading variant.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第49週(12/1-7)全球陽性率上升至4.75%,惟美洲及西太平洋區署陽性率減少。 中國疫情略升,第51週(12/15-21)陽性率上升至0.7%,已連續兩週上升,整體疫情仍處低點,近期變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情略升,第51週陽性率上升至0.1%,較前1週(0.03%)增加,變異株轉以XFG占比最高(40.1%),其次為LP.8.1(34.2%)及NB.1.8.1(19.1%)。 美國疫情上升,第49週陽性率上升至3.6%,住院率為每10萬人口0.7,近期變異株XFG占比最高。 歐洲疫情下降,第50週整體陽性率下降至6%,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,惟美洲及西太平洋區署減少;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(49.58%),其次為NB.1.8.1(22.69%),新公告的BA.3.2占比為5.04%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity rose to 4.75% in week 49 of 2025 (1–7 December), although it fell in the Americas and Western Pacific Regions. China's situation rose slightly: test positivity rose to 0.7% in week 51 (15–21 December), increasing for two consecutive weeks, though overall the situation remains at a low level; NB.1.8.1 is the most common recent variant. Hong Kong's situation rose slightly: test positivity in week 51 rose to 0.1% from 0.03% the week before. The most common variant has shifted to XFG (40.1%), followed by LP.8.1 (34.2%) and NB.1.8.1 (19.1%). The US situation is rising: test positivity rose to 3.6% in week 49, the hospitalisation rate was 0.7 per 100,000 population, and XFG is the most common recent variant. Europe's situation has declined: overall test positivity fell to 6% in week 50, with XFG the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently trended upward, although it fell in the Americas and Western Pacific Regions. XFG is currently the most common global variant (49.58%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (22.69%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for 5.04%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.
items.area_zh: 全球(第二級及第三級國家除外),中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,美國

items.summary_zh: WHO:第50週全球流感陽性率升至25%,A(H3N2)為主。
items.summary_en: WHO reported global influenza test positivity rose to 25% in week 50, with A(H3N2) predominant and many northern countries above 10%.
items.description_zh: WHO 12/24報告第50週(12/8-14) 全球整體陽性率提升至25%,目前全球流行以A(H3N2)為主,北半球多國陽性率高於10%,中美洲、加勒比海、北非、西歐及亞洲部分國家陽性率超過30%;南半球整體疫情偏低,惟部分國家陽性率仍高於10%。
items.description_en: WHO reported on 24 December that in week 50 (8–14 December), global overall test positivity rose to 25%. A(H3N2) currently predominates worldwide. Many northern hemisphere countries have test positivity above 10%, and some countries in Central America, the Caribbean, North Africa, Western Europe and parts of Asia have test positivity above 30%. Overall activity in the southern hemisphere is low, although test positivity in some countries remains above 10%.

items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 4,843 measles cases in 2025 to 6 December; Mexico reported 5,860 cases and 24 deaths to 19 December.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓今(2025)年截至12/6報告4,843例確定病例,去(2024)年同期為3,748例,其中73%未接種疫苗,病例數以國家首都(Metro Manila)區1,027例、南部邦薩莫洛自治區(Bangsamoro)768例及北部卡拉巴松地區(Calabarzon)505例為多,當局已宣布於明(2026)年啟動加強疫苗接種計畫。The Philippine News Agency 12/20 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至12/19報告5,860例確定病例,其中24例死亡,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州(4,473例)、中西部哈利斯科州(462例)、西南部雷羅州(227例)為多,病患主要年齡層為0-4歲兒童,其中90%以上未接種疫苗。RECORD 12/21
items.description_en: The Philippines reported 4,843 confirmed cases in 2025 as of 6 December, compared with 3,748 in the same period of 2024. 73% were unvaccinated. Cases were most numerous in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila) with 1,027, the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in the south with 768, and the Calabarzon region in the north with 505. Authorities have announced that an intensified vaccination programme will start next year (2026) (Philippine News Agency, 20 December). Mexico's situation is rising. This year as of 19 December, 5,860 confirmed cases had been reported, including 24 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (4,473), Jalisco state in the central-west (462) and Guerrero state in the southwest (227). The main age group is children aged 0–4, and over 90% were unvaccinated (RECORD, 21 December).

items.headline_zh: 多明尼加共和國-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 多明尼加今年截至12月6日流腦通報26例、13例死亡,較去年同期大幅上升。
items.summary_en: The Dominican Republic has notified 26 meningococcal cases and 13 deaths this year to 6 December, sharply up from last year.
items.description_zh: 多明加共和國今年截至12/6累計報告26例通報病例,其中13例死亡,較去年同期病例數(8例)及死亡數(2例)皆大幅上升,當局僅透過週報更新監測資訊,未公布相關疫情調查及具體防治措施。
items.description_en: The Dominican Republic reported 26 notified cases cumulatively this year as of 6 December, 13 of which were fatal. Both case numbers and deaths rose sharply compared with the same period last year (8 cases and 2 deaths). Authorities update surveillance information only through weekly reports and have not published any related outbreak investigation or specific control measures.

items.summary_zh: 美國報告64例沙門氏菌感染、20例住院,疑與牡蠣有關,建議勿生食。
items.summary_en: The US reported 64 Salmonella cases, 20 hospitalised, linked to suspected oysters; people are advised not to eat them raw.
items.description_zh: 美國12/23報告64例病例,其中20例住院,無死亡案例,病患分布於22個州;當局表示本起疫情病患住院率高,經調查牡蠣為疑感染源,建議民眾勿生食。
items.description_en: The US reported 64 cases on 23 December, 20 of them hospitalised, with no deaths; cases are spread across 22 states. Authorities say the hospitalisation rate for this outbreak is high. Investigation identified oysters as the suspected source, and people are advised not to eat them raw.

items.summary_zh: 越南河內腸病毒今年累計6,015例,為去年2倍;韓國下降但仍高於近3年同期。
items.summary_en: Hanoi's enterovirus cases reached 6,015 this year, double last year's figure; South Korea's cases declined but remain above recent years.
items.description_zh: 越南河內疫情上升,今年截至12/22累計報告6,015例病例,疫情為去年2倍;韓國疫情下降,第50週(12/7-13)就診陽性率降為4.5‰,惟疫情仍高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第51週累計報告785例,低於去年同期。
items.description_en: Case numbers are rising in Hanoi, Viet Nam: 6,015 cases were reported cumulatively as of 22 December this year, double last year's figure. South Korea's situation has declined: the outpatient visit positivity rate in week 50 (7–13 December) fell to 4.5 per 1,000, but remains above the same period over the past three years. Thailand's situation has declined: 785 cases were reported cumulatively in week 51, lower than the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞拉薩熱今年至12月7日9,041例,1,069例確診,195例死亡。
items.summary_en: Nigeria's Lassa fever reached 9,041 cases, including 1,069 confirmed and 195 deaths (CFR 18.2%), by 7 December.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,自今年截至12/7累計報告21州9,041例病例,其中,1,069例確診,195例死亡(CFR:18.2%),死亡數高於去年同期190例,病患主要以東北部包奇州及西南部翁多州、埃多州為多。
items.description_en: Nigeria update: from the start of this year to 7 December, 9,041 cases were reported cumulatively from 21 states, of which 1,069 were confirmed and 195 died (CFR: 18.2%). Deaths exceeded the 190 recorded in the same period last year. Patients are mainly in Bauchi state in the northeast and in Ondo and Edo states in the southwest.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 印度-人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.summary_zh: 印度中央邦薩德納區6名地中海貧血兒童感染HIV,其中5例為輸血感染。
items.summary_en: In India's Madhya Pradesh state, 6 thalassaemia children were infected with HIV, 5 through blood transfusions.
items.description_zh: 印度中央邦薩德納區12/17通報6例年齡介於3-15歲之地中海貧血兒童感染案例,其中5例為輸血感染,另1例疑家庭感染,病患每月須輸血2-3次,於今(2025)年1-5月之例行性篩檢呈陽性,當局刻正調查感染源。另該國東部賈坎德邦於10月亦曾報告5例兒童輸血感染案例。
items.description_en: In Satna district, Madhya Pradesh state, India, 6 thalassaemia children aged 3–15 were reported with infection on 17 December. Five cases were transfusion-associated, and one is suspected to be a household infection. The patients need blood transfusions 2–3 times a month and tested positive in routine screening between January and May this year. Authorities are investigating the source of infection. Separately, Jharkhand state in the east reported 5 transfusion-associated infections in children in October.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾今年日本腦炎已報告35例死亡,6月以來新增175例,藍毗省最多。
items.summary_en: Nepal has reported 35 Japanese encephalitis deaths this year and 175 new cases since June, most in Lumbini province.
items.description_zh: 泊爾今年疫情上升,已報告35例死亡,自6月以來新增175例病例,病例及死亡數均明顯高於去年,以藍毗省報告55例病例及11例死亡為多,70%病例為15歲以上族群,當局規劃啟動疫苗接種措施。
items.description_en: Nepal's situation is rising this year. 35 deaths have been reported, and 175 new cases have been added since June; both cases and deaths are clearly higher than last year. Lumbini province reported the most, with 55 cases and 11 deaths. 70% of cases are in people aged 15 and over. Authorities plan to launch vaccination measures.

items.summary_zh: 古巴2025年1至11月屈公病累計38,342例、21例相關死亡,14省受影響。
items.summary_en: Cuba reported 38,342 chikungunya cases and 21 associated deaths from January to November 2025, affecting 14 provinces.
items.description_zh: 古巴疫情更新,今年1-11月累計報告38,342例病例及21例相關死亡,該國14個省均受疫情影響,病例主要分布於馬坦薩斯省、哈瓦那省、卡馬圭省、西恩富戈斯省等省。
items.description_en: Cuba update: from January to November this year, 38,342 cases and 21 associated deaths were reported cumulatively. All 14 provinces are affected, and cases are mainly concentrated in Matanzas, Havana, Camagüey and Cienfuegos provinces.

items.summary_zh: 韓國全羅南道12月恙蟲病逐年上升,2021至2024年為79至192例。
items.summary_en: South Korea's Jeollanam-do province reported rising December scrub typhus cases, from 79 in 2021 to 192 in 2024.
items.description_zh: 韓國全羅南道於冬季疫情仍持續,由於全球暖化導致氣溫升高,當地2021-24年12月份病例數逐年上升,分別報告79、96、109及192例,當局呼籲於戶外活動採取預防措施避免蜱蟲叮咬。
items.description_en: In Jeollanam-do province, South Korea, scrub typhus cases continue into winter. Because rising temperatures linked to global warming, December case numbers in the area have increased each year: 79, 96, 109 and 192 cases were reported for December 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 respectively. Authorities urge people to take precautions during outdoor activities to avoid tick bites.

items.summary_zh: 美國2025至26流感季陽性率升至14.8%,估計逾460萬人感染。
items.summary_en: The US 2025–26 flu season began with test positivity at 14.8% in week 50; an estimated 4.6 million infected and 1,900 deaths by 19 December.
items.description_zh: 美國2025-26流感季開始,共17個地區為高度流行,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),其中9成為K分支,第50週類流感門診就診率為4.1%,高於全國基準 (3.1%),陽性率由第49週8.1%上升至14.8%,病患人數及住院/死亡率皆上升。另本流感季累計報告3例流感相關兒童死亡病例;當局估計本流感季截至12/19,逾460萬人感染、4.9 萬人住院治療及1,900 人死亡,建議民眾應接種本季流感疫苗,另高風險者應儘早使用抗病毒藥物治療。
items.description_en: The US 2025–26 flu season has begun, with 17 areas at high activity levels, mainly A(H3N2), 90% of which are subclade K. The outpatient influenza-like illness rate in week 50 was 4.1%, above the national baseline (3.1%). Test positivity rose from 8.1% in week 49 to 14.8%. Patient numbers, hospitalisation and death rates have all risen. This season so far, 3 paediatric influenza-associated deaths have been reported. Authorities estimate that as of 19 December, more than 4.6 million people have been infected this flu season, 49,000 have been hospitalised and 1,900 have died. People are advised to get this season's flu vaccine, and high-risk people should start antiviral treatment as early as possible.

items.headline_zh: 香港-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 香港新增1例腦膜炎雙球菌病例(30歲健康男性),今年累計11例,為近5年最高。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a new meningococcal case in a healthy 30-year-old man; 11 cases this year, the highest in five years.
items.description_zh: 香港新增報告1例確定病例,為30歲健康男性,12/18出現發燒、全身無力、嘔吐等症狀,19日至急診住院治療,其後曾出現神智模糊及失語,目前病情穩定,腦脊液樣本經檢驗為腦膜炎雙球菌陽性,臨床診斷為腦膜炎;病患於潛伏期間無旅遊史,密切接觸者截至12/20無人發病,當局已針對密切接觸者提供預防性藥物及持續進行疫情調查,並提醒民眾落實個人及環境衞生;香港今(2025)年累計報告11例確定病例,為近5年最高。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported one new confirmed case: a healthy 30-year-old man who developed fever, generalised weakness and vomiting on 18 December, attended emergency and was admitted to hospital on 19 December. He later experienced confusion and aphasia. His condition is currently stable. Cerebrospinal fluid samples tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis, and the clinical diagnosis was meningitis. The patient had no travel history during the incubation period. As of 20 December, no close contacts had fallen ill. Authorities have provided preventive medication to close contacts and continue the outbreak investigation, and remind the public to maintain personal and environmental hygiene. Hong Kong has reported 11 confirmed cases cumulatively in 2025, the highest in five years.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國新增1例H1N1v人類感染;全球禽流感累計71國通報6,319起疫情。
items.summary_en: China reported one new human H1N1v infection; 71 countries have cumulatively reported 6,319 avian influenza outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:中國新增1例H1N1v流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共26國於2025/12/12-2025/12/19期間新增303起H5N1疫情,英國134起、比利時38起、美國28起、波蘭13起、荷蘭11起、義大利9起、德國/法國/瑞典/西班牙各7起、南韓/拉脫維亞/立陶宛各5起、愛爾蘭4起、哥倫比亞/奧地利/葡萄牙各3起、愛沙亞/挪威/捷克/斯洛維亞/臺灣各2起、丹麥/匈牙利/盧森堡/納米比亞各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第49週計454個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/維吉亞/加州共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計71國家/地區通報6,319起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: China reported one new human H1N1v influenza infection. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 26 countries reported 303 new H5N1 outbreaks between 12 and 19 December 2025: United Kingdom 134, Belgium 38, United States 28, Poland 13, Netherlands 11, Italy 9, Germany, France, Sweden and Spain 7 each, South Korea, Latvia and Lithuania 5 each, Ireland 4, Colombia, Austria and Portugal 3 each, Estonia, Norway, Czechia, Slovenia and Taiwan 2 each, and Denmark, Hungary, Luxembourg and Namibia 1 each. US dairy cattle avian influenza: herds: 1,084 (1) outbreaks have been reported across 19 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 49, 454 sampling sites reported results, of which 3 sites in New Jersey, Virginia and California detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases, 30 H5N1 influenza cases (992* cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 case (2 cumulative), 1 H5N5 case (1 cumulative), 32 H9N2 cases (162 cumulative), and 2 H10N3 cases (6 cumulative). Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Animal and avian cases: a cumulative total of 71 countries and areas have reported 6,319 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率降至4.06%,XFG占63.6%;建議LP.8.1為疫苗抗原。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity fell to 4.06% in week 48; XFG is 63.6% of variants; WHO recommends LP.8.1 as the vaccine antigen.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第48週(11/24-30)全球陽性率降至4.06%,其中非洲區署陽性率增加。 中國疫情略增,第50週(12/8-14)門診陽性率為0.5%,較前1週(0.3%)略增,住院陽性率亦上升,整體疫情仍於低點,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情於低點,第50週報告住院數降至99例,陽性率略升為2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 英國疫情於低點波動,第50週實驗室監測陽性率降至1.9%,住院病例數亦下降,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,其中非洲區署呈上升;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(63.6%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12.72%),新公告的BA.3.2占比提升至6.71%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理;另WHO新冠疫苗委員會於12/18公告建議以單價LP.8.1作為推薦的疫苗抗原,且JN.1譜系(JN.1或KP.2)仍為合適的替代選項。
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity fell to 4.06% in week 48 of 2025 (24–30 November), although it rose in the African Region. China's situation rose slightly: outpatient test positivity was 0.5% in week 50 (8–14 December), up slightly from 0.3% the week before, and hospital test positivity also rose; overall the situation remains at a low level, and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant. South Korea's situation is at a low level: hospital admissions fell to 99 in week 50 and test positivity rose slightly to 2%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. The United Kingdom's situation fluctuates at a low level: laboratory surveillance test positivity fell to 1.9% in week 50, hospital admissions also declined, and XFG is the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently declined, although it has risen in the African Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant (63.6%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12.72%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 has risen to 6.71%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat. In addition, the WHO COVID-19 vaccine committee announced on 18 December that monovalent LP.8.1 is recommended as the vaccine antigen, and the JN.1 lineage (JN.1 or KP.2) remains a suitable alternative option.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),韓國,英國
items.area_en: China,Korea(South Korea),United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 寮國3歲童確診cVDPV1,估計已傳播約3年;WHO評估越南輸入風險極高。
items.summary_en: Laos confirmed a cVDPV1 polio case in a 3-year-old, likely circulating for about three years; WHO rates Viet Nam's importation risk as very high.
items.description_zh: 寮國沙灣拿吉省(Savannakhet)於12/12確診1例cVDPV1病例,為3歲個案,於9/3出現急性肢體無力症狀,並在其病毒檢體中發現31個基因突變點,推估已在該國傳播大約3年,另有2例相關病例檢測中;因本案鄰近越南邊界且往來密切,WHO評估越南面臨極高輸入及再出現病例風險,該國已召開全國緊急會議並加強監測。 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於12/4-10期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為安哥拉2例、奈及利亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞2件。
items.description_en: Savannakhet province in Laos confirmed one cVDPV1 case on 12 December, in a 3-year-old child who developed acute limb weakness on 3 September. The viral sample showed 31 genetic mutation sites, and the virus is estimated to have circulated in the country for about three years; two related cases are being tested. Because this case is near the Viet Nam border with close cross-border movement, WHO assesses that Viet Nam faces a very high risk of importation and re-emergence of cases. The country has convened a national emergency meeting and strengthened surveillance. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 4–10 December that cVDPV2 added 4 cases in 3 countries: 2 in Angola, and 1 each in Nigeria and Yemen. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 2 samples in Somalia.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,寮國,奈及利亞,葉門

items.headline_zh: 中國/越南/韓國/泰國-腸病毒
items.headline_en: China / Viet Nam / South Korea / Thailand – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 中國第49至50週腸病毒56,554例,較前2週降43%;韓國升至千分之5.9。
items.summary_en: China recorded 56,554 enterovirus cases in weeks 49–50, down 43% on the prior two weeks; South Korea's visit positivity rose to 5.9 per 1,000.
items.description_zh: 中國第49-50週(12/1-14)累計報告5萬6,554例病例,其中重症20 例、無死亡病例,病例數較前2週下降43%,惟仍較去年同期高134%;越南胡志明市疫情略降,第49週新增1,484例病例,較前1週減少17%;韓國疫情上下波動,第49週就診陽性率增為5.9‰,高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第50週累計報告848例,低於去年同期。
items.description_en: China reported 56,554 cases in weeks 49–50 (1–14 December), including 20 severe cases and no deaths. Case numbers fell 43% compared with the previous two weeks but remain 134% higher than the same period last year. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, the outbreak eased slightly, with 1,484 new cases in week 49, a 17% decrease from the previous week. In South Korea, the situation fluctuated; the outpatient visit positivity rate rose to 5.9 per 1,000 in week 49, higher than the same period over the past three years. In Thailand, the situation declined, with 848 cases reported cumulatively in week 50, lower than the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),韓國,泰國,越南

items.summary_zh: ECDC:2024年歐洲食物相關疫情6,558起,沙門氏菌1,238起居首。
items.summary_en: ECDC reported 6,558 food-related outbreaks in Europe in 2024; Salmonella caused 1,238 of them, with 62,481 cases overall.
items.description_zh: ECDC報告歐洲2024年發生6,558起食物相關疫情事件,累計報告6萬2,481例病例,其中3,336例住院、53例死亡,整體疫情較2023年上升。所有食物相關之疫情中以沙門氏菌感染症為大宗共1,238起疫情,通報案件以法國、荷蘭、西班牙及比利時為多,其中有65起群聚事件之影響人數超過百人,另諾羅病毒則引起631起疫情;經調查交叉污染與未經適當處理、加熱處理不足及廚師受感染為疫情常見原因,發生地以學校、幼稚園、餐廳或職場最常見。
items.description_en: The ECDC reported that Europe recorded 6,558 food-related outbreak events in 2024, with 62,481 cases cumulatively, 3,336 hospitalisations and 53 deaths; the overall situation was higher than in 2023. Salmonella infection accounted for the largest share of food-related outbreaks, with 1,238 outbreaks. Most notifications came from France, the Netherlands, Spain and Belgium. Of these outbreaks, 65 clusters affected more than 100 people. Norovirus caused 631 outbreaks. Investigations found that common causes were cross-contamination, inadequate processing, insufficient heating and infected food handlers. Outbreaks most often occurred in schools, kindergartens, restaurants or workplaces.
items.area_zh: 比利時,法國,荷蘭,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 美國截至12月10日嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒51例,皆住院,源自某廠商嬰兒配方奶。
items.summary_en: The US reported 51 infant botulism cases up to 10 December, all hospitalised, linked to one manufacturer's infant formula.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情更新,截至12/10累計報告51例嬰兒病例,年齡介於16-264天,病例皆已住院治療,無死亡案例,分布於加州等19個州,病患皆攝食某廠商之全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,經調查疫情最早開始於2023年12月,當局已對產品下架不徹底之零售商發出警告。
items.description_en: US update: as of 10 December, 51 infant cases had been reported cumulatively, aged 16–264 days. All cases were hospitalised, with no deaths, and they were spread across 19 states including California. All patients had consumed a complete-nutrition infant formula from one manufacturer. The investigation found the earliest onset was in December 2023. Authorities have warned retailers that did not fully withdraw the product.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓中米沙鄢自11月初至12月10日報告鉤端螺旋體病744例,715例已康復。
items.summary_en: Central Visayas, Philippines, reported 744 leptospirosis cases from early November to 10 December; 715 have recovered.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓中米沙鄢報告自今年11月初截至12/10累計報告744例病例,其中715例已康復,多數病例於暴露洪水後出現發燒、寒顫、頭痛及睛紅腫等症狀。當局呼籲民眾接觸汙水汙泥後,倘發生疑症狀,應儘速就醫。
items.description_en: Central Visayas, Philippines, reported 744 cumulative cases from early November this year to 10 December, of which 715 have recovered. Most cases developed fever, chills, headache and red, swollen eyes after exposure to flood water. Authorities urge people who develop suspicious symptoms after contact with sewage or sludge to seek medical care promptly.

items.headline_zh: 衣索比亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡地區馬堡疫情12月12日新增1例,累計14例確診、9例死亡。
items.summary_en: Ethiopia's Jinka-area Marburg outbreak added a case on 12 December; 14 confirmed cases and 9 deaths so far (CFR 64.2%).
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡地區疫情更新,12/12新增通報1例確診病例,自11/12迄今累計報告14例確診,其中9例死亡(CFR:64.2%),5例已康復。
items.description_en: Update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: one new confirmed case was reported on 12 December. Since 12 November, 14 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 9 died (CFR: 64.2%) and 5 have recovered.

items.summary_zh: 馬利11月21日報告首例M痘,截至12月9日確診5例、1例死亡。
items.summary_en: Mali reported its first mpox case on 21 November; by 9 December, 5 cases were confirmed and 1 had died.
items.description_zh: 馬利疫情更新,自今年11/21報告首例,截至12/9已確診5例病例,其中1例死亡。首例發生於該國西部庫利科羅地區,鄰近幾內亞邊境,病患於今年第47週死亡。該區跨境人口流動頻繁,當局已加強監測,並呼籲所有接觸者皆應隔離及注意個人衛生。
items.description_en: Update on Mali: since the first case was reported on 21 November this year, 5 confirmed cases had been recorded as of 9 December, of which 1 died. The first case occurred in Koulikoro region in the west of the country, near the Guinea border, and the patient died in week 47 of this year. Cross-border population movement in the area is frequent, so authorities have strengthened surveillance and call for all contacts to be quarantined and for attention to personal hygiene.

items.summary_zh: 美國截至12月9日麻疹1,912例、43州,3例死亡,92%未接種或接種史不明。
items.summary_en: As of 9 December, the US had 1,912 measles cases across 43 states, 3 deaths, and 92% unvaccinated or of unknown status.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至12/9共43州報告47起疫情及1,912例確定病例,其中218例住院、3例死亡,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他/亞利桑那/南卡羅來納州,疫情主要爆發於疫苗接種率低之學校及社區教堂等場所。
items.description_en: As of 9 December this year, 43 US states had reported 47 outbreaks and 1,912 confirmed cases, of which 218 were hospitalised and 3 died. 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Recent activity is concentrated in Utah, Arizona and South Carolina. Outbreaks have mainly occurred in schools and community churches with low vaccination coverage.

items.headline_zh: 阿根廷-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 阿根廷第25至44週漢他病毒症候群23例、9死(CFR 39%),七成在中部。
items.summary_en: Argentina reported 23 hantavirus syndrome cases and 9 deaths (CFR 39%) in weeks 25–44; 70% were in the central region.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷第25-44週累計報告23例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:39%),其中70%病患分布於中部地區(布宜諾斯艾利斯市、聖大非省及恩特雷里奧斯省),病患主要為20-49歲年齡層。依13例確定病例之流行病學資料,62%具囓齒動物或其分泌物接觸史,46%具農村居住史,31%具鄉村或野外地區旅遊史,目前尚未發發現人傳人病例。常見症狀包括發燒 (95%)、肌肉痛 (71%)、頭痛、嘔吐及關節痛等;當局表示9月至4月為高風險季節,建議將漢他病毒病納入急性發燒之鑑別診斷之一,另請民眾避免接觸囓齒動物及其分泌物,並落實戶外活動之防疫措施。
items.description_en: Argentina reported 23 confirmed cases cumulatively in weeks 25–44, of which 9 died (CFR: 39%). 70% of cases were in the central region (Buenos Aires city, Santa Fe province and Entre Ríos province), and most patients were aged 20–49. Based on epidemiological data for 13 confirmed cases, 62% had contact with rodents or their secretions, 46% had lived in rural areas, and 31% had travelled to rural or wild areas. No person-to-person transmission has been found. Common symptoms include fever (95%), muscle pain (71%), headache, vomiting and joint pain. Authorities say September to April is the high-risk season, and recommend including hantavirus disease in the differential diagnosis of acute fever. They urge people to avoid contact with rodents and their secretions and to take precautions during outdoor activities.

items.summary_zh: WHO:全球流感活動上升,多國檢出A(H3N2)K分支,北半球季節提早。
items.summary_en: WHO reported rising global influenza activity, with A(H3N2) subclade K detected in many countries and earlier seasons in the Northern Hemisphere.
items.description_zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
items.description_en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉第48週登革熱新增4,128例、13死;菲律賓奎松市今年10,740例。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported 4,128 new dengue cases in week 48; Quezon City, Philippines, has recorded 10,740 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,第48週(11/24-30)新增4,128例病例及13例死亡,病例數較前1週5,267例下降21.6%,今年截至11/30累計95,081例病例及380例死亡,該國去年同期累計92,351例病例及497例死亡。 菲律賓奎松市今年截至12/11累計報告10,740例病例及46例死亡,病例年齡分布以1-10歲為多,54%病例為男性。
items.description_en: Bangladesh update: in week 48 (24–30 November), 4,128 new cases and 13 deaths were reported. Cases fell 21.6% from 5,267 in the previous week. Cumulatively this year to 30 November, 95,081 cases and 380 deaths were reported; in the same period last year, the country reported 92,351 cases and 497 deaths. Quezon City, Philippines, has reported 10,740 cases and 46 deaths so far this year, as of 11 December. Most cases are in the 1–10 age group, and 54% of cases are male.

items.headline_zh: 茅利塔尼亞/塞內加爾-裂谷熱
items.summary_zh: 茅利塔尼亞裂谷熱今年286例、15死;塞內加爾累計546例確診、31死。
items.summary_en: Mauritania reported 286 Rift Valley fever cases and 15 deaths this year; Senegal has 546 confirmed cases and 31 deaths, with weekly numbers declining.
items.description_zh: 茅利塔亞今年迄今共14個地區累計報告286例病例(53例確診)及15例死亡,確診病例以男性為多(77%),年齡分布以大於15歲為主(96%)。 塞內加爾疫情更新,於今年9月爆發疫情,最初病例主要分布於聖路易、盧加及馬塔姆區,迄今累計546例確診病例及31例死亡,病例蔓延至聖路易區(367例)、馬塔姆/法蒂克區(39例)、考拉克區(35例)等地,近期每週新增病例數及死亡數呈下降趨勢。
items.description_en: Mauritania has reported 286 cases this year to date across 14 regions (53 confirmed), including 15 deaths. Among confirmed cases, males predominate (77%), and most cases are aged over 15 (96%). Senegal update: the outbreak began in September this year, with the first cases mainly in Saint-Louis, Louga and Matam regions. To date, 546 confirmed cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases have spread to Saint-Louis region (367), Matam/Fatick region (39) and Kaolack region (35). Weekly numbers of new cases and deaths have shown a declining trend recently.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉登革熱集中於達卡與吉大港,美國CDC近期將旅遊警示提升至第2級。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh's dengue is concentrated in Dhaka and Chattogram; the US CDC has recently raised its travel alert to Level 2.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情主要發生於達卡及吉大港,達卡於今年1-8月報告732例疑病例(400例確診),吉大港截至8月底則報告約2,700例病例。美國CDC近期提升孟加拉疫情旅遊警示至第2級。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's outbreak is concentrated in Dhaka and Chattogram (Chittagong). Dhaka reported 732 suspected cases (400 confirmed) from January to August this year, while Chattogram reported about 2,700 cases by the end of August. The US CDC recently raised its travel alert for the outbreak in Bangladesh to Level 2.

items.summary_zh: 12月5至12日全球新增251起H5N1疫情,荷蘭87起居首。
items.summary_en: The Netherlands reported 87 of 251 new H5N1 outbreaks worldwide between 5 and 12 December 2025; US dairy herd outbreaks total 1,083.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共25國於2025/12/5-12期間新增251起H5N1疫情,荷蘭87起、英國34起、加拿大19起、美國17起、丹麥/義大利各11起、瑞典/葡萄牙各9起、南韓/德國/波蘭各7起、西班牙6起、法國5起、捷克4起、愛沙亞/斯洛伐克各3起、匈牙利/挪威/盧森堡各2起、奈及利亞/斯洛維亞/日本/瑞士/立陶宛/芬蘭各1起。 共2國於2025/12/11-13期間新增2起H5N5疫情,加拿大/英國各1起。 南韓於2025/12/9新增1起H5N6疫情。 南韓於2025/12/9新增1起H5N9疫情。 共2國於2025/12/10-12期間新增2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,哈薩克/美國各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,083起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第49週計392個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州及愛荷華州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計70國家/地區通報6,016起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 25 countries reported 251 new H5N1 outbreaks between 5 and 12 December 2025: Netherlands 87, United Kingdom 34, Canada 19, United States 17, Denmark and Italy 11 each, Sweden and Portugal 9 each, South Korea, Germany and Poland 7 each, Spain 6, France 5, Czechia 4, Estonia and Slovakia 3 each, Hungary, Norway and Luxembourg 2 each, and Nigeria, Slovenia, Japan, Switzerland, Lithuania and Finland 1 each. Two countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 11 and 13 December 2025: Canada and United Kingdom 1 each. South Korea reported 1 new H5N6 outbreak and 1 new H5N9 outbreak on 9 December 2025. Two countries reported 2 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 10 and 12 December 2025: Kazakhstan and United States 1 each. US dairy cattle avian influenza: herds: 1,083 outbreaks have been reported across 18 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in California. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 49, 392 sampling sites reported results, of which 2 sites in New Jersey and Iowa detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases, 30 H5N1 influenza cases (992* cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 case (2 cumulative), 1 H5N5 case (1 cumulative), 32 H9N2 cases (162 cumulative), and 2 H10N3 cases (6 cumulative). Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Animal and avian cases: a cumulative total of 70 countries and areas have reported 6,016 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率升至5.21%;WHO將BA.3.2列為監測中變異株,風險低。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity rose to 5.21%; WHO listed BA.3.2 as a variant under monitoring and assesses its risk as low.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第47週(11/17-23)全球陽性率略升至5.21%,其中東南亞區署陽性率增加。 WHO公告BA.3.2為監測中變異株(VUM),BA.3.2為Omicron BA.3的後代譜系,首例於2024年11/22檢出,截至今年11/9全球有7個國家提報86例BA.3.2序列資訊,在2025年第45週全球變異株中占1.7%,較第42週0.2%上升;WHO評估BA.3.2具顯著抗體逃脫能力,惟造成疾病嚴重度為低,整體評估風險為低,仍需持續監測。 韓國疫情於低點,第49週(11/30-12/6)報告住院降至106例,陽性率降為1.8%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 加拿大疫情從低點略升,第48週報告1,964例病例,陽性率略升至6.6%,各年齡層疫情皆上升,並以65歲以上為多,變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期略升,其中東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(59%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%),新公告的BA.3.2占約5%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity rose slightly to 5.21% in week 47 of 2025 (17–23 November), with increases in the South-East Asia Region. WHO has designated BA.3.2 as a variant under monitoring (VUM). BA.3.2 is a descendant lineage of Omicron BA.3; it was first detected on 22 November 2024. As of 9 November this year, 7 countries had submitted 86 BA.3.2 sequences. In week 45 of 2025, BA.3.2 accounted for 1.7% of global variants, up from 0.2% in week 42. WHO assesses that BA.3.2 has significant antibody escape, but causes low disease severity, and its overall risk is assessed as low; continued monitoring is needed. South Korea's situation is at a low level: hospital admissions fell to 106 in week 49 (30 November–6 December), and test positivity fell to 1.8%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. Canada's situation rose slightly from a low: 1,964 cases were reported in week 48, and test positivity rose slightly to 6.6%. Cases increased in all age groups, mainly among those aged 65 and over, with XFG the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently risen slightly, with an upward trend in the South-East Asia Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant (59%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for about 5%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.

items.summary_zh: 中國第49週流感門急診就診率9.9%;英國住院一週增逾50%。
items.summary_en: China's flu clinic visit rate reached 9.9% in week 49 with 49.8% positivity; UK daily hospitalisations rose more than 50% in one week.
items.description_zh: 中國整體疫情持續上升,第49週定點ILI門急診就診率為9.9%,高於近3年同期,陽性率為49.8%,主要流行型別為A(H3N2);當局表示流感疫情處於高度流行,華東/華南/西南地區之部分省份流感活動持續上升,另陽性率呈上升趨勢,惟上升幅度趨緩,其中5-14歲年齡層之陽性率高於其他年齡層,呼籲幼托、學校及養老院等機構應加強健康監測,及早發現/處理群聚疫情,另民眾應落實個人衛生防護措施。 英國疫情上升,近1週平均每日住院人數為2,660人,較前1週增加逾50%,住院人數以75歲以上及5歲以下年齡層為多,陽性率則以5-14歲年齡層為高,當局表示疫情尚未達高點,預估短期內可能上升至逾5,000人,本流感季提早1個月爆發,主因為H3N2病毒K分支流行,致民眾缺乏既有免疫力,導致傳播加速。 加拿大疫情上升,第48週報告3,655例病例,較前1週增加逾67%,陽性率為13%,高於去年同期(2%),其中以19歲以下年齡層為高。另住院率、群聚爆發數皆呈上升,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),另該國自9/1起,已檢出47件H3N2病毒K分支,專家表示疫苗仍具保護力,呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
items.description_en: China's overall outbreak continues to rise. In week 49, the sentinel ILI outpatient and emergency visit rate was 9.9%, higher than the same period over the past three years, with test positivity of 49.8%; A(H3N2) is the main circulating type. Authorities say influenza is at a high level of circulation; activity continues to rise in some provinces in East, South and Southwest China, and positivity is rising, though more slowly. Test positivity among those aged 5–14 is higher than in other age groups. Authorities call on nurseries, schools and elderly care homes to strengthen health monitoring and detect and manage clusters early, and urge the public to implement personal hygiene protection measures. The United Kingdom's situation is rising: the average daily number of hospitalised patients in the past week was 2,660, an increase of more than 50% from the previous week. Hospitalisations are highest among those aged 75 and over and under 5, while test positivity is highest among those aged 5–14. Authorities say the outbreak has not yet peaked and could rise to more than 5,000 patients in the short term. This flu season began a month early, mainly because the K subclade of H3N2 is circulating, leaving people without existing immunity and accelerating transmission. Canada's situation is rising: 3,655 cases were reported in week 48, an increase of more than 67% from the previous week, with test positivity of 13%, higher than the same period last year (2%), highest among those under 19. Hospitalisation rates and outbreak numbers have also risen, and the main circulating type is A(H3N2). Since 1 September, 47 H3N2 subclade K viruses have been detected in Canada. Experts say vaccines still provide protection and urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has 34,127 enterovirus cases this year; China reported 269,337 in November, 4.5 times last year's level.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,第48週(11/24-30)新增1,484例病例,較前4週平均增加0.9%,今年迄今累計達34,127例,該病每年流行高峰期為9-12月;中國疫情自高點下降,11月報告26萬9,337例病例,其中1例死亡,雖較10月疫情(37萬例)略降,惟仍為去年同期4.5倍;韓國疫情下降,第48週就診陽性率5.2‰,仍高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第49週累計報告820例,低於去年同期。
items.description_en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to rise: 1,484 new cases were reported in week 48 (24–30 November), an increase of 0.9% over the average of the previous four weeks. Cumulatively this year, 34,127 cases have been reported. The disease's annual peak season is September to December. China's situation has declined from its peak: 269,337 cases were reported in November, including 1 death. Although this is slightly lower than October (about 370,000 cases), it is 4.5 times the same period last year. South Korea's situation has declined; the outpatient visit positivity rate in week 48 was 5.2 per 1,000, still higher than the same period over the past three years. Thailand's situation has declined; 820 cases were reported cumulatively in week 49, lower than the same period last year.
