items.headline_zh: 英國/維德角-桿菌性痢疾
items.summary_zh: 英國10月至12月9日報告137例桿菌性痢疾,九成曾赴維德角,感染源相同。
items.summary_en: The UK reported 137 shigellosis cases from October to 9 December; 90% had travelled to Cabo Verde and share one infection source.
items.description_zh: 英國自10月截至12/9累計報告137例病例,病患年齡以50-59歲為主(占40.1%),並以女性為多,有9成病患有維德角共和國旅遊史,經全基因定序檢測顯示為同一感染來源。
items.description_en: The United Kingdom reported 137 cases cumulatively from October to 9 December. Patients are mainly aged 50–59 (40.1%) and are mostly female. 90% of patients had travel history to Cabo Verde, and whole-genome sequencing shows that they share the same source of infection.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Cape Verde

items.headline_zh: 奧地利/捷克/匈牙利/斯洛維尼亞-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Austria / Czechia / Hungary / Slovenia – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 中歐四國A型肝炎今年截至10月逾6,000例,41至80%住院。
items.summary_en: Austria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovenia reported over 6,000 hepatitis A cases to October this year, with 41–80% hospitalised.
items.description_zh: 中歐多國爆發疫情,其中奧地利、捷克、匈牙利、斯洛維亞今年截至10月累計報告逾6,000例病例,其中41-80%住院,病患多為街友或毒品使用者等脆弱族群,病毒型別涵蓋兩組相近的IB型,此波疫情遠高於去年,並已擴及9個歐洲國家,另迄未發現食源性傳播跡象。
items.description_en: Several Central European countries have experienced outbreaks. Austria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovenia reported more than 6,000 cases cumulatively as of October this year, of which 41–80% were hospitalised. Most patients belong to vulnerable groups, such as homeless people or people who use drugs. The virus types include two closely related genotype IB clusters. This outbreak is far higher than last year's and has spread to 9 European countries. No evidence of foodborne transmission has been found so far.
items.area_zh: 奧地利,捷克,匈牙利,斯洛維尼亞

items.summary_zh: 匈牙利今年截至11月中旬先天性梅毒63例、21例死亡,較去年增50%。
items.summary_en: Hungary has reported 63 congenital syphilis cases and 21 infant deaths as of mid-November this year, up 50% on last year.
items.description_zh: 匈牙利疫情上升,今年截至11月中旬已累計63例嬰兒病例,其中21例死亡,病例數較去年(42例)增加50%,並以該國東部死亡率為高,多為低社經族群,當局已擴大孕婦篩檢措施。另該國為歐盟區2022年女性梅毒發病率最高的國家之一。
items.description_en: Hungary's situation is rising. As of mid-November this year, 63 infant cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 21 died. This is a 50% increase over last year (42 cases). Mortality is highest in the east of the country, mainly among lower socioeconomic groups. Authorities have expanded prenatal screening. Hungary is also one of the EU countries with the highest rate of female syphilis in 2022.

items.summary_zh: 美國愛達荷州器官移植傳播狂犬病,13名受贈者中7人死亡。
items.summary_en: A US rabies case spread through organ transplantation killed 7 of 13 recipients; it is the fourth such event since 1978.
items.description_zh: 美國於12/5報告因器官移植致感染之死亡案例,愛達荷州之男性器官捐贈者於去年10月被臭鼬抓傷,致染病死亡並器捐,受贈腎臟移植者於術後5週出現疑症狀,並於移植後51日死亡。捐贈者於移植前檢測血清為陰性,後於其右腎臟樣本檢出病毒變異株;另有3名接受該捐贈者之角膜移植者,因角膜檢出陽性,除已完成暴露後預防(PEP)並接受移植角膜切除手術,迄無症狀。當局匡列370名接觸者,其中357人完成風險評估,共46人建議接受PEP。此為該國自1978年以來第4次器官移植傳播事件,共計13名受贈者,其中7例死亡,6例接受PEP者仍存活。另該國歷年死亡數皆10例。
items.description_en: On 5 December, the US reported a death from infection transmitted through organ transplantation. A male organ donor in Idaho had been scratched by a skunk last October, died of the infection, and donated his organs. A kidney recipient developed suspected symptoms 5 weeks after surgery and died 51 days after transplantation. The donor's serum tested negative before transplantation, but a rabies virus variant was detected in a sample of his right kidney. Three corneal transplant recipients who received tissue from the same donor had positive corneal tests; they have completed post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) and corneal graft removal surgery, and remain asymptomatic. Authorities identified 370 contacts, of whom 357 completed risk assessment, and 46 were recommended to receive PEP. This is the fourth organ-transplant transmission event in the country since 1978, involving 13 recipients in total, 7 of whom died; the 6 recipients who received PEP remain alive. The country reports 10 deaths each year.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘9月解除PHEIC後,至11月24日Ib型累計43例,荷蘭9例。
items.summary_en: Since the PHEIC ended on 5 September, 43 clade Ib mpox cases have been reported globally to 24 November, including 9 in the Netherlands and 6 in Spain.
items.description_zh: 全球自今年9/5解除PHEIC截至11/24(除非洲現有疫區外),累計報告43例Ib型病例(歐洲27例、東南亞5例、美洲4例、西太平洋3例、東地中海/非洲各2例),其中22例為MSM族群;4區署(美洲/歐洲/東南亞/西太平洋)報告24例本土病例,其餘為旅遊相關或其繼發病例。 荷蘭新增3例病例,自10/17報告首例截至11/24已累計9例Ib型病例,其中8例為MSM,6例有共同俱樂部之群聚事件;西班牙自9月截至11/24累計報告6例Ib病例,另新增2例報告為疑I型分支,且無相關旅遊史之病例;黎巴嫩及埃及於今年9-10月分別報告3例及1例病例,分支皆未明。
items.description_en: Since the PHEIC was lifted on 5 September this year, as of 24 November (excluding existing outbreak areas in Africa), 43 clade Ib cases have been reported cumulatively: 27 in Europe, 5 in South-East Asia, 4 in the Americas, 3 in the Western Pacific, and 2 each in the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. Of these, 22 were among MSM. Four regions (the Americas, Europe, South-East Asia and the Western Pacific) reported 24 local cases; the rest were travel-related or secondary cases. The Netherlands reported 3 new cases. Since its first case on 17 October, the Netherlands had recorded 9 clade Ib cases by 24 November, 8 of them among MSM, and 6 of these were linked to a shared club cluster. Spain reported 6 clade Ib cases cumulatively from September to 24 November, and 2 further newly reported cases were suspected clade I cases without relevant travel history. Lebanon and Egypt reported 3 and 1 cases respectively in September and October this year; clade is unknown.
items.area_zh: 埃及,黎巴嫩,荷蘭,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 美國佛州12月3日報告14例退伍軍人病,皆曾到橘郡某健身房。
items.summary_en: Florida reported 14 Legionnaires' cases on 3 December, all linked to a gym in Orange County; 665 cases this year, a 10-year high.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州於12/3報告14例病例,患者皆曾至橘郡(Orange)之某健身房,當局檢視其水療中心有違規事項,另已針對環境檢體進行採樣調查;該州今年迄今累計報告665例,為近10年最高,其中以橘郡(Orange)82例為多。
items.description_en: Florida reported 14 cases on 3 December. All patients had visited a gym in Orange County. Authorities found violations at the gym's spa centre and have collected environmental samples for investigation. This year to date, the state has reported 665 cumulative cases, the highest in 10 years, with Orange County accounting for 82 of them.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大今年截至11月29日麻疹4,926例、2死,89%未接種。
items.summary_en: Canada has recorded 4,926 confirmed measles cases and 2 deaths this year to 29 November; 89% were unvaccinated, mainly in Ontario and Alberta.
items.description_zh: 加拿大疫情更新,今年截至11/29共10省報告4,926例確定病例,其中2例死亡,單週(第48週)新增37例病例,主要分布於安大略省及亞伯達省,89%病患未接種疫苗,另當地媒體表示亞伯達省有病例數低估情形。
items.description_en: Canada update: as of 29 November this year, 10 provinces had reported 4,926 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. 37 new cases were added in week 48 alone. Cases are mainly in Ontario and Alberta, and 89% of patients were unvaccinated. Local media say cases are under-reported in Alberta.

items.summary_zh: 英國報告含Ib與IIb基因片段的M痘重組病毒,將持續監測與接種。
items.summary_en: The UK reported a mpox recombinant virus containing Ib and IIb gene segments on 8 December, and will continue monitoring and routine vaccination for eligible groups.
items.description_zh: 英國12/8報告於1名近期曾前往亞洲國家之感染者體內發現新的重組病毒,經基因定序新病毒株含有目前流行的Ib及IIb型病毒之基因片段,顯示基因突變可能性與持續基因監測的重要性。當局將持續監測並評估風險,另對符合資之群體,包括有多重性伴侶者等,實施例行疫苗接種計畫。研究顯示該疫苗保護效率約為75%至80%。
items.description_en: On 8 December, the United Kingdom reported a new recombinant virus in one infected person who had recently travelled to an Asian country. Genome sequencing showed that the new strain contains gene segments from the currently circulating clade Ib and clade IIb viruses, indicating the possibility of mutation and the importance of continued genomic surveillance. Authorities will continue monitoring and risk assessment, and carry out routine vaccination for eligible groups, including people with multiple sexual partners. Studies show the vaccine's protective efficacy is approximately 75% to 80%.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 香港新增1例本土屈公病,67歲女性居葵青區;今年累計78例,其中10例為本土。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a new locally acquired chikungunya case in a 67-year-old woman; 78 cases this year, 10 locally acquired.
items.description_zh: 香港近期新增1例本土感染病例,個案為居住葵青區67歲女性,潛伏期內無旅遊史,於11/29曾在青衣步道散步,於12/2出現關節痛和發燒症狀,12/5就醫確診,病情穩定,同住家人(含同行者)目前均無症狀。香港今年迄今共確診78例病例,其中10例為本土病例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong recorded one new locally acquired case: a 67-year-old woman living in Kwai Tsing district, with no travel history during the incubation period. She walked along the Tsing Yi trail on 29 November, developed joint pain and fever on 2 December, and was diagnosed on 5 December. Her condition is stable, and family members living with her (including companions) currently show no symptoms. So far this year, Hong Kong has confirmed 78 cases, 10 of which are locally acquired.

items.summary_zh: 印度10月登革熱增21%至22,659例;佛州今年本土登革熱累計60例。
items.summary_en: India's dengue rose 21% to 22,659 cases in October; Florida has recorded 60 locally acquired dengue cases this year.
items.description_zh: 印度疫情更新,今年10月報告22,659例病例,較9月18,803例病例增加21%。今年截至10/31已累計91,015例病例,低於去年同期184,712例病例,去年全年共報告232,425例。 寮國疫情更新,今年1-11月累計11,629例病例及1例死亡,主要分布於永珍5,520例病例及1例死亡,該國去年報告逾20,000例病例及11例死亡。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡近1週新增2例本土病例,該州今年迄今累計60例本土病例,主要分布於布里瓦德郡、希爾斯波羅郡、邁阿密-戴德郡及帕斯科郡,主要檢出型別為DENV-3;該州去年報告91例病例,2023年報告186例病例。
items.description_en: India update: 22,659 cases were reported in October this year, a 21% increase over 18,803 cases in September. Cumulatively this year to 31 October, 91,015 cases have been reported, lower than the 184,712 cases in the same period last year; 232,425 cases were reported in the whole of last year. Laos update: 11,629 cases and 1 death were reported cumulatively in January–November this year, mainly in Vientiane Capital, with 5,520 cases and 1 death. The country reported more than 20,000 cases and 11 deaths last year. In Miami-Dade County, Florida, 2 new local cases were reported in the past week. The state has recorded 60 locally acquired cases so far this year, mainly in Broward, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade and Pasco counties, with DENV-3 the main serotype detected. The state reported 91 cases last year and 186 cases in 2023.

items.summary_zh: 塞內加爾今年9月爆發裂谷熱,截至12月3日累計536例確診、31例死亡。
items.summary_en: Senegal's Rift Valley fever outbreak since September has reached 536 confirmed cases and 31 deaths as of 3 December.
items.description_zh: 塞內加爾疫情更新,自今年9月爆發疫情以來截至12/3共11個地區累計536例確診病例及31例死亡,病例主要分布於該國西北部聖路易區365例,70%病例之職業會暴露於受感染動物或遭受蚊子叮咬。大多數人類病例症狀輕微,惟少部分患者發展成嚴重疾病,另有超過2,000例動物病例或流產,當局已加強動物疫苗接種措施。
items.description_en: Senegal update: since the outbreak began in September this year, 536 confirmed cases and 31 deaths have been reported across 11 regions as of 3 December. Cases are mainly in Saint-Louis region in the northwest (365). 70% of cases had occupational exposure to infected animals or mosquito bites. Most human cases have mild symptoms, while a small number develop severe disease. More than 2,000 animal cases or abortions have also been reported, and authorities have strengthened animal vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 越南-腸病毒感染併發重症
items.headline_en: Viet Nam – Enterovirus infection with severe complications
items.summary_zh: 越南今年截至12月7日腸病毒78,460例;胡志明市逾3.2萬例,重症65例。
items.summary_en: Viet Nam recorded 78,460 enterovirus cases this year to 7 December; Ho Chi Minh City has over 32,000 cases and 65 severe cases.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情上升,今年截至12/7已報告78,460例病例,其中1例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加15.6%。其中,胡志明市今年迄今累計已逾32,000例病例,僅第47週即報告1,547例病例。該市病例數較去年同期增加64%,重症病例數自42週起持續增加,迄已65例重症,某醫院於11月之18例重症病患中,10例 (56%) 經檢測為EV71陽性,該市已發布健康警報。該國每年報告約5萬至10萬例病例,EV71於該國曾引起多起嚴重疫情。
items.description_en: Viet Nam's situation is rising: as of 7 December this year, 78,460 cases had been reported, including 1 death, a 15.6% increase over the same period last year. Ho Chi Minh City has cumulatively exceeded 32,000 cases this year, with 1,547 cases reported in week 47 alone. Cases in the city are 64% higher than the same period last year. Severe cases have continued to rise since week 42, reaching 65 so far. Among 18 severe patients at one hospital in November, 10 (56%) tested positive for EV71. The city has issued a health alert. The country usually reports about 50,000–100,000 cases a year, and EV71 has caused several serious outbreaks in the country.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 11月28日至12月5日全球新增802起H5N1疫情,德國578起居首。
items.summary_en: Germany reported 578 of 802 new H5N1 outbreaks worldwide between 28 November and 5 December 2025.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共27國於2025/11/28-12/5期間新增802起H5N1疫情,德國 578起、比利時49起、美國34起、日本25起、法國22起、義大利21起、南非13起、荷蘭11起、奧地利8起、西班牙7起、印度5起、波蘭4起、南韓/拉脫維亞/立陶宛/葡萄牙各3起、匈牙利/芬蘭各2起、伊拉克/哥倫比亞/愛爾蘭/挪威/斯洛維亞/瑞典/瑞士/瓜地馬拉/開曼群島各1起。 共4國於2025/12/4-12/5期間新增4起H5(N untyped)疫情,冰島/挪威/比利時/西班牙各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,083 (0)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第48週計354個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西州共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計69國家/地區通報5,759起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 27 countries reported 802 new H5N1 outbreaks between 28 November and 5 December 2025: Germany 578, Belgium 49, United States 34, Japan 25, France 22, Italy 21, South Africa 13, Netherlands 11, Austria 8, Spain 7, India 5, Poland 4, South Korea, Latvia, Lithuania and Portugal 3 each, Hungary and Finland 2 each, and Iraq, Colombia, Ireland, Norway, Slovenia, Sweden, Switzerland, Guatemala and the Cayman Islands 1 each. Four countries reported 4 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 4 and 5 December 2025: Iceland, Norway, Belgium and Spain 1 each. US dairy cattle avian influenza: herds: 1,083 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in California. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 48, 354 sampling sites reported results, of which 2 sites in New Jersey detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases, 30 H5N1 influenza cases (992* cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 case (2 cumulative), 1 H5N5 case (1 cumulative), 32 H9N2 cases (162 cumulative), and 2 H10N3 cases (6 cumulative). Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Animal and avian cases: a cumulative total of 69 countries and areas have reported 5,759 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率11月中旬為6.36%;歐洲自高峰下降,XFG為主要變異株。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was 6.36% in mid-November; Europe declined from its peak, with XFG the leading variant.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第46週(11/10-16)全球陽性率6.36%,其中,非洲區署陽性率上升。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第47週(11/17-23)定醫平均報告數1.81,較近3週下降,病患分布以愛知縣、埼玉縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第47週報告住院135例,已連續3週下降,陽性率降為2.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 澳大利亞疫情於低點波動,第46週陽性率略增至1.53%,近期變異株以XFG占比最高(42.4%)。 歐洲疫情下降,第47週整體陽性率5.8%,距第38週的高峰(陽性率24.4%)已明顯趨緩,以變異株XFG占比最高(83%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,惟非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
items.description_en: Situation update: global test positivity was 6.36% in week 46 of 2025 (10–16 November), with increases in the African Region. Japan's situation is declining: in week 47 (17–23 November), the average number of reports at sentinel clinics was 1.81, down over the past three weeks; cases are mostly in Aichi and Saitama prefectures, and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant. South Korea's situation is declining: hospital admissions were 135 in week 47, down for three consecutive weeks, and test positivity fell to 2.5%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. Australia's situation fluctuates at a low level: test positivity rose slightly to 1.53% in week 46, with XFG the most common recent variant (42.4%). Europe's situation is declining: overall test positivity was 5.8% in week 47, well below the week 38 peak (24.4%), with XFG the most common variant (83%). Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently declined, though it is rising in the African Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant, followed by NB.1.8.1. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.

items.summary_zh: 中國第48週流感門急診就診率9.6%、陽性率47.8%,學校群聚增加。
items.summary_en: China's flu clinic visit rate reached 9.6% in week 48 with 47.8% positivity, and school clusters are increasing.
items.description_zh: 中國疫情持續上升,第48週定點ILI門急診就診率為9.6%,高於近3年同期,陽性率為47.8%,其中5-14歲年齡層之陽性率高於其他年齡層,主要流行型別為A(H3N2);定點ILI門急診呼吸道樣本陽性率前3高分別為流感病毒(51.1%)、鼻病毒(5.3%)及呼吸道融合病毒(3.5%),住院呼吸道樣本陽性率前3高分別為流感病毒(19%)、呼吸道融合病毒(7.8%)及鼻病毒(7%);當局表示學校群聚事件增加,整體流感疫情處於高度流行,各省份流感活動度處於中度或高度流行,當局呼籲幼托、學校及養老院等機構應加強健康監測,及早發現/處理群聚疫情,另民眾應落實個人衛生防護措施。
items.description_en: China's overall outbreak continues to rise. In week 48, the sentinel ILI outpatient and emergency visit rate was 9.6%, higher than the same period over the past three years, with test positivity of 47.8%. Test positivity among those aged 5–14 is higher than in other age groups, and A(H3N2) is the main circulating type. The top three pathogens in sentinel outpatient and emergency respiratory samples were influenza virus (51.1%), rhinovirus (5.3%) and RSV (3.5%); among hospitalised respiratory samples, they were influenza virus (19%), RSV (7.8%) and rhinovirus (7%). Authorities say school clusters have increased, overall influenza is at a high level of circulation, and provincial influenza activity is at moderate or high levels. Authorities call on nurseries, schools and elderly care homes to strengthen health monitoring and detect and manage clusters early, and urge the public to implement personal hygiene protection measures.

items.disease_zh: 中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒感染症
items.headline_zh: 法國-中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 法國新增2例MERS-CoV境外移入病例,皆曾赴阿拉伯半島,目前未見次級感染。
items.summary_en: France reported 2 imported MERS-CoV cases from travel to the Arabian Peninsula, with no secondary infection found so far.
items.description_zh: 法國新增2例境外移入病例,病患曾同行至阿拉伯半島旅行,於出現疑症狀後確診,目前住院治療中,病況皆穩定,當局表示已啟動防治措施,旅行團成員健康監測中,目前尚未發現次級感染病例;該國迄今僅2013年通報2例境外移入病例,另全球迄今累計逾2千例,其中,沙烏地阿拉伯占84%病例,該病毒主要動物宿主為單峰駱駝,病例多與接觸駱駝有關,另曾出現醫護人員於接觸病人後感染之案例。
items.description_en: France reported 2 new imported cases. The patients had travelled together to the Arabian Peninsula; they were diagnosed after developing suspicious symptoms and are now hospitalised in stable condition. Authorities have activated prevention and control measures, and members of the tour group are under health monitoring. No secondary cases have been found so far. France had previously reported only 2 imported cases, in 2013. Globally, more than 2,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which Saudi Arabia accounts for 84%. The main animal host is the dromedary camel, and cases are mostly associated with contact with camels. There have also been cases in which healthcare workers were infected after contact with patients.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 納米比亞東北部廢水檢出cVDPV2,為2008年根除後首見。
items.summary_en: Wastewater in Kavango East, Namibia, tested positive for cVDPV2, the first detection since 2008 eradication; it is closely related to the strain in Angola.
items.description_zh: 納米比亞東北部卡萬戈區(Kavango East)於11/27廢水檢體中檢出cVDPV2陽性環境樣本1件,為該國自2008年根除小兒麻痺症後首次檢出cVDPV2,目前尚未報告人類感染病例。該分離株與目前在安哥拉流行之cVDPV2株密切相關,顯示跨國傳播風險。
items.description_en: In the Kavango East region in northeastern Namibia, one wastewater environmental sample collected on 27 November tested positive for cVDPV2. This is the first detection of cVDPV2 since Namibia's polio eradication in 2008, and no human infection has been reported. The isolate is closely related to the cVDPV2 strain currently circulating in Angola, indicating a cross-border transmission risk.

items.summary_zh: 美國1998-2022年研究:20%疫情與雞肉有關,共10,344例病例
items.summary_en: A US study covering 1998–2022 found 20% of Salmonella outbreaks linked to chicken, causing 10,344 cases, and recommends vaccinating chickens.
items.description_zh: 美國1998-2022年長期研究顯示,有20%疫情與雞肉有關,造成10,344例病例,其中住院1,426例、死亡12例,疫情有30%發生於餐廳、25%發生於家中,生食雞肉風險為熟食5倍;研究建議:為雞隻(尤其繁殖母雞)接種疫苗、加強衛生屠宰製程、進行餐飲業及民眾衛教可降低感染風險。
items.description_en: A long-term study of the United States covering 1998–2022 found that 20% of outbreaks were linked to chicken, causing 10,344 cases, including 1,426 hospitalizations and 12 deaths. Thirty percent of outbreaks occurred in restaurants and 25% in homes, and the risk of eating raw chicken was five times that of eating cooked chicken. The study recommends vaccinating chickens (especially breeding hens), strengthening hygiene in slaughter processes, and providing food-service and public health education to reduce infection risk.

items.headline_en: South Korea / Thailand / Japan – Enterovirus infection
items.summary_zh: 韓國陽性率為近3年同期最高,泰國、日本疫情下降
items.summary_en: South Korea's positivity rate is the highest for the same period in three years, while Thailand and Japan's outbreaks are declining.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情上升,第47週(11/16-22)就診陽性率5.9‰,為近3年同期最高;泰國疫情下降,第48週(11/23-29)累計報告1,179例,低於去年同期;日本疫情處低點,第47週(11/17-23)定醫平均報告數0.12,已連續10週下降,且低於近3年同期。
items.description_en: South Korea: Outbreak rising. The test-positivity rate among clinic visits in week 47 (16–22 November) was 5.9‰, the highest for the same period in the past three years. Thailand: Outbreak declining. A cumulative 1,179 cases were reported in week 48 (23–29 November), lower than the same period last year. Japan: Outbreak at a low point. The average number of reports per sentinel medical facility in week 47 (17–23 November) was 0.12; this has declined for 10 consecutive weeks and is below the same period of the past three years.

items.summary_zh: WHO:今年至10月全球逾56萬例霍亂病例,約7千例死亡
items.summary_en: WHO reports over 560,000 cholera cases and about 7,000 deaths globally this year through October, across 32 countries and areas.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至10月累計報告逾56萬例病例,約7,000例死亡,其中,10月新增報告約3.5萬例,較9月下降34%,各國CFR介於0-8.2%;病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,近期新增病例以葉門、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉為多,目前口服疫苗庫存量高於緊急需求數。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: The WHO reports that globally, as of October this year, more than 560,000 cases and about 7,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In October, about 35,000 new cases were reported, a 34% decrease from September, and national case fatality rates range from 0 to 8.2%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific. Recent new cases are concentrated in Yemen, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Angola. Current oral vaccine stocks exceed emergency demand. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,剛果民主共和國,葉門

items.summary_zh: 英國德文郡5所學校爆發疥瘡,已累計19例確診,5校停課
items.summary_en: An outbreak of scabies in Torbay, Devon, England has infected 19 confirmed cases across five schools, which have suspended classes.
items.description_zh: 英國西南部德文郡托貝區爆發疫情,截至11/30已累計報告5校19例確診病例,多數病例誤以為是濕疹而延誤就醫,目前5校皆已停課。該病透過疥蹣傳染,會寄生人體皮膚表層,進而引起搔癢及皮疹,傳染力極強,須儘速就醫用藥,當局呼籲民眾須注意症狀,並加強寢具及衣物之清洗消毒。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in the Torbay area of Devon in south-west England. As of 30 November, 19 confirmed cases had been reported across five schools, and many cases were initially mistaken for eczema, delaying medical care. All five schools have suspended classes. Scabies is transmitted by mites that burrow into the surface layer of the skin, causing itching and rash. It is highly contagious and requires prompt medical treatment. Authorities urge the public to watch for symptoms and to step up washing and disinfection of bedding and clothing.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國宣布中部開賽省伊波拉疫情結束,此波45例死亡
items.summary_en: The DR Congo declared its Kasai-Central Ebola outbreak over after 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases, with 45 deaths.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國宣布中部開賽省疫情結束,最後1例確診者已於10/19康復,42天內無新增病例,該國自9/4報告首例截至11/30累計6區53例確診及11例疑病例,其中45例死亡(CFR:70.3%),此波疫情已有 5名醫護人員感染(3人死亡)。此為該國第16次爆發疫情,由於該國面臨多種疾病疫情,亦長期政治經濟不穩定,對疫情應對能力有限,未來仍可能有地方性流行。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has declared the end of its outbreak in Kasai-Central province, after the last confirmed patient recovered on 19 October and no new cases were reported for 42 days. Since the first case was reported on 4 September, a cumulative total of 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases have been recorded across six health zones as of 30 November, of which 45 died (CFR 70.3%). Five health workers have been infected in this outbreak, three of whom died. This is the country's 16th Ebola outbreak. Given multiple concurrent disease outbreaks and long-standing political and economic instability, its capacity to respond is limited, and localized transmission may still occur in the future.

items.headline_zh: 衣索比亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞金卡地區馬堡病毒累計13例確診,8例死亡
items.summary_en: Ethiopia's Jinka-area Marburg outbreak has 13 confirmed cases, 8 deaths, and 1 new case reported on 3 December.
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡地區疫情更新,12/3新增通報1例,自11/12迄今累計報告13例確診病例,其中8例死亡(CFR:61.5%),4例已康復,1例仍治療中。此為全球第19起疫情,前次為坦尚亞於今年1-3月發生之疫情。
items.description_en: An update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: one new case was reported on 3 December. Since 12 November, a cumulative 13 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 8 died (CFR 61.5%), 4 have recovered and 1 is still under treatment. This is the 19th outbreak recorded worldwide; the previous one occurred in Tanzania from January to March this year.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年逾2.5萬例百日咳,德州、肯塔基州為近10年最高,2-3例嬰兒死亡
items.summary_en: The US has reported over 25,000 pertussis cases this year, with Texas and Kentucky at 10-year highs and 2–3 infant deaths.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至11/26報告逾2.5萬例病例,另2024年同期通報病例超過33,000例,近兩年病例數皆高於往年,其中德克薩斯/肯塔基州病例數為該州近10年最高,並有2-3例嬰兒死亡病例,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗。
items.description_en: The United States has reported more than 25,000 cases this year as of 26 November. The same period in 2024 saw more than 33,000 reported cases, and case numbers in both of the past two years were higher than in earlier years. Texas and Kentucky each recorded their highest case counts in the past 10 years, and 2–3 infant deaths have been reported. Authorities urge the public to get vaccinated.

items.headline_zh: 美國/波蘭/剛果民主共和國/烏干達-麻疹
items.headline_en: United States / Poland / Democratic Republic of the Congo / Uganda – Measles
items.summary_zh: 美國43州共1,798例麻疹,波蘭、烏干達亦有疫情
items.summary_en: The US reported 1,798 measles cases in 43 states this year, with outbreaks also in Poland, Uganda and DR Congo.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至11/29共43州報告1,798例,其中212例住院、3例死亡,並報告46起疫情,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他/亞利桑那/南卡羅來納州。 波蘭東南部喀爾巴阡山脈地區共計4縣市今年截至11/30累計報告18例病例,其中8例住院治療,該國第1及2劑疫苗接種率低於WHO建議之95%,當地社區持續傳播,與鄰國有跨境傳播及發生大規模疫情風險,當局已啟動疫情調查及接觸者監測作業。 非洲疫情更新,剛果民主共和國今年截至8/30報告逾5萬例確定病例,其中794例死亡,無國界醫生組織(MSF)於北基伍省4-11月共計2區報告3,051例病例,其中1,111例出現併發重症,MSF持續進行大規模疫苗接種作業,惟武裝衝突致疫情控制困難;烏干達東北部納帕克區11/19爆發疫情,截至11/28累計報告74例病例,其中11例兒童死亡。
items.description_en: United States: As of 29 November this year, 1,798 cases had been reported from 43 states, including 212 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 46 outbreaks have been reported. Of the patients, 92% were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent outbreaks are concentrated in Utah, Arizona and South Carolina. Poland: In the Carpathian Mountains region of south-eastern Poland, four counties reported a cumulative 18 cases as of 30 November this year, 8 of whom were hospitalized. Poland's first and second dose vaccination coverage is below the 95% recommended by WHO, and local community transmission is ongoing. There is a risk of cross-border spread to neighbouring countries and of large-scale outbreaks, and authorities have launched outbreak investigations and contact monitoring. Africa: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases this year as of 30 August, including 794 deaths. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) reported 3,051 cases in two health zones of North Kivu province from April to November, of which 1,111 developed severe complications. MSF continues large-scale vaccination, but armed conflict makes outbreak control difficult. In north-eastern Uganda, an outbreak began in Napak district on 19 November; as of 28 November, 74 cases had been reported, including 11 child deaths.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,波蘭,烏干達,美國

items.summary_zh: 日本流感提前1個月達高峰,8,817所學校機構採停課等措施,為去年24倍
items.summary_en: Japan's flu season peaked a month earlier than last year, with 8,817 schools and facilities taking measures such as class suspensions.
items.description_zh: 日本第47週(11/17-23)定點門診平均病例數為51.12例,本流感季較去年提前1個月進入高峰,病例數以宮城、福島及岩手縣為多, 80%病患為20歲以下族群,共計有8,817所學校/機構採取停課等措施,為去年同期24倍,專家表示兒童住院數持續上升,另有兒童流感腦炎病例,呼籲於學校等密集場所應注意通風、佩戴口罩及落實洗手等防護措施,並評估接種疫苗。
items.description_en: In week 47 (17–23 November), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic in Japan was 51.12. This flu season reached its peak one month earlier than last year. Cases are concentrated in Miyagi, Fukushima and Iwate prefectures, and 80% of patients are under 20 years old. A total of 8,817 schools and facilities have taken measures such as class suspensions, 24 times the same period last year. Experts say pediatric hospitalizations continue to rise, and pediatric influenza encephalitis cases have been reported. They urge attention to ventilation, mask-wearing and hand hygiene in crowded places such as schools, and recommend assessing vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 越南/孟加拉/茅利塔尼亞/蘇丹-登革熱
items.headline_en: Viet Nam / Bangladesh / Mauritania / Sudan – Dengue
items.summary_zh: 越南今年累計156,828例登革熱病例,死亡32例,孟加拉累計9萬餘例
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has recorded 156,828 dengue cases and 32 deaths this year, with Bangladesh above 90,000 cases and Sudan having the most in Africa.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情更新,近1週(11/14-20)新增6,472例病例及1例死亡,較前1週病例數減少7.3%,今年迄今累計156,828例病例及32例死亡,高於去年同期病例數及死亡數,該國於2022年疫情較為嚴峻,累計逾370,000例病例。 孟加拉疫情更新,近1日新增705例病例,今年迄今累計90,969例病例及366例死亡,病例數以該國南部巴里薩爾專區20,224例為多。 茅利塔亞自今年5月疫情爆發迄今累計7,179例病例(4,029例確診)及1例死亡(致死率為0.01%),主要檢出型別為DENV-1及DENV-2。今年非洲共11國累計報告逾56,000例病例及125例死亡,其中,病例數以蘇丹共和國約42,000例為多,其次為茅利塔亞。
items.description_en: Viet Nam update: In the past week (14–20 November), 6,472 new cases and 1 death were reported, a 7.3% decrease in cases from the previous week. Year to date, 156,828 cases and 32 deaths have been reported cumulatively, higher than the same period last year in both cases and deaths. The country had a severe outbreak in 2022, with a cumulative total of more than 370,000 cases. Bangladesh update: 705 new cases were reported in the past day. Year to date, 90,969 cases and 366 deaths have been reported, with the most cases, 20,224, in the Barisal division of southern Bangladesh. Mauritania: Since its outbreak began in May this year, a cumulative 7,179 cases (4,029 confirmed) and 1 death (case fatality rate 0.01%) have been reported, mainly serotypes DENV-1 and DENV-2. In Africa this year, 11 countries have cumulatively reported more than 56,000 cases and 125 deaths. Sudan has the most cases, about 42,000, followed by Mauritania.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,茅利塔尼亞,蘇丹,越南

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年1-9月瘧疾逾2,446萬例,雨季後疫情持續上升
items.summary_en: Nigeria's malaria cases are rising: over 24.46 million confirmed from January to September, with the rainy season driving further increases.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情上升,今年1-9月累計2,446萬餘例確診病例,其中,第1至3季分別報告730萬、780萬及逾930萬例病例,隨著雨季到來,持續升溫,預期年底前疫情仍可能上升,當局呼籲落實公共衛生措施,以降低疾病傳播。
items.description_en: Malaria is rising in Nigeria. From January to September this year, more than 24.46 million confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The first, second and third quarters reported 7.3 million, 7.8 million and more than 9.3 million cases respectively. With the arrival of the rainy season, cases continue to climb, and the outbreak may keep increasing until the end of the year. Authorities urge implementation of public health measures to reduce transmission.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年逾5.1萬例,非洲外5國列為Ib型社區傳播區
items.summary_en: WHO rates global Mpox risk as moderate after over 51,000 cases this year; clade Ib community transmission is listed in five non-African countries.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/28累計142國/地區報告17萬2千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%)。 今年截至第48週累計99國/地區報告5萬1千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區4萬3千餘例、美洲區4,442例、歐洲區2,429例、西太平洋區1,479例、東南亞區154例及東地中海區46例。非洲、歐洲、西太平洋及中東區疫情下降;惟美洲及東南亞區病例數上升。  其他更新: 馬利西部庫利科羅11/24報告首例死亡病例,其餘資訊不明,當局已加強邊境監測並隔離疑病例。 評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注之公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源不足,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,但對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 28 November this year, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 172,000 confirmed cases globally, of which at least 467 died (CFR 0.27%). Year to date as of week 48, 99 countries and areas have reported more than 51,000 confirmed cases: more than 43,000 in the African Region, 4,442 in the Region of the Americas, 2,429 in the European Region, 1,479 in the Western Pacific Region, 154 in the South-East Asia Region and 46 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have declined in the African, European, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions, but risen in the Americas and South-East Asia. Other updates: In Koulikoro, western Mali, the first death was reported on 24 November; other information is unknown. Authorities have strengthened border surveillance and isolated suspected cases. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are inadequate, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because cases among asymptomatic infected people and travelers from affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The assessed risk to the general public is low, but moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), especially those without a stable sexual partner. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete contact tracing, and high-risk individuals are urged to get vaccinated.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥、美國各新增1例人類新型流感感染,全球公衛風險仍低
items.summary_en: Mexico and the US each reported one new human novel influenza A infection this week, while global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週墨西哥新增1例H5N2流感人類感染病例;美國新增1例H1N2v流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共25國於2025/11/20-28期間新增654起H5N1 疫情,德國179起、法國140起、英國110起、荷蘭50起、比利時36起、義大利35起、加拿大19起、美國17起、捷克/芬蘭各9起、奧地利/西班牙各8起、波蘭7起、拉脫維亞6起、丹麥/瑞典各4 起、斯洛伐克/斯洛維亞/瑞士/葡萄牙各2起、保加利亞/匈牙利/南韓/愛爾蘭/立陶宛各1起。 挪威2025/11/24新增1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,082 (1)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第46週計383個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(紐澤西州)共1個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  墨西哥新增1例H5N2流感人類感染病例,病患為墨西哥城23歲女性,近期無旅遊史,9/14開始出現咳嗽、發燒、吞嚥疼痛、胸痛及咳血等症狀,30日經實驗室檢測為H5型,近期經PAHO實驗室確診為H5N2,病患接受奧司他韋(oseltamivir)治療並於10/11出院,當局表示居住環境有鳥類及家禽,且經檢測出H5型;本案為該國及全球第2例H5N2病例,首例為2024年墨西哥州之死亡病例。另該國今年4月曾通報1例H5N1死亡病例,PAHO表示H5 型禽流感散發病例多與直接接觸受感染動物或受污染環境有關,迄無人傳人情形,建議持續加強動物及人類之跨部門監測。 美國佛蒙特州新增1例H1N2v流感人類感染病例,為年齡18歲個案,於第40週(9/28-10/4)發病,經住院後已康復,迄未確認是否曾接觸豬或其他動物,目前尚無人傳人跡象,亦未具人際間傳播能力;當局表示該案為該國今年第2例H1N2v病例,另自2019年迄今累計報告18例H1N2v病例。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計67國家/地區通報4,857起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week Mexico reported one new human H5N2 influenza infection, and the United States reported one new human H1N2v influenza infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 25 countries reported a total of 654 new H5N1 outbreaks between 20 and 28 November 2025: Germany 179, France 140, United Kingdom 110, Netherlands 50, Belgium 36, Italy 35, Canada 19, United States 17, Czechia and Finland 9 each, Austria and Spain 8 each, Poland 7, Latvia 6, Denmark and Sweden 4 each, Slovakia, Slovenia, Switzerland and Portugal 2 each, and Bulgaria, Hungary, South Korea, Ireland and Lithuania 1 each. Norway reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 24 November 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,082 (1) outbreaks have been reported in cattle herds across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 46, 383 sampling sites provided test reports, and one state (New Jersey) had one sampling site detect H5-positive results. Other updates: Mexico reported one new human H5N2 infection, in a 23-year-old woman in Mexico City with no recent travel history. She developed cough, fever, sore throat, chest pain and coughing up blood from 14 September; on the 30th, laboratory testing identified H5 type, and PAHO later confirmed H5N2. She was treated with oseltamivir and discharged on 11 October. Authorities said her residence had birds and poultry, and H5 was detected. This is the second H5N2 human case in the country and globally; the first was a fatal case in Mexico State in 2024. The country also reported one fatal H5N1 case in April this year. PAHO said sporadic human H5 avian influenza cases are mostly associated with direct contact with infected animals or contaminated environments, with no human-to-human transmission to date, and recommended continued cross-sectoral surveillance of animals and humans. The US state of Vermont reported one new human H1N2v infection in an 18-year-old case who fell ill in week 40 (28 September–4 October). The patient was hospitalized and has recovered. It has not been confirmed whether the patient had contact with pigs or other animals; there are no signs of human-to-human transmission, and the virus does not have sustained human-to-human transmission capacity. Authorities said this is the country's second H1N2v case this year, and 18 H1N2v cases have been reported cumulatively since 2019. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 30 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 1 H5N2 influenza (2 cumulative); 1 H5N5 influenza (1 cumulative); 32 H9N2 influenza (162 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 67 countries and areas have reported 4,857 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection, and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率6.15%近期下降,惟非洲區署上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 6.15% in week 45 and is declining, but rising in the African Region; XFG is the dominant variant.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第45週(11/3-9)全球陽性率6.15%,僅非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第46週(11/10-16)定醫平均報告數1.91,較近2週下降,病患分布以北海道、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 歐洲疫情下降,第46週整體陽性率為6.1%,距第38週高峰(陽性率24.4%)已明顯下降,以變異株XFG占比最高(66%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12%)。 加拿大疫情下降,第46週陽性率降至6.4%,且低於近2年同期,65歲以上病患占6成,變異株XFG占比最高。 南非疫情上升,第46週私立機構陽性率約20%,符合低度流行閾,死亡率亦上升,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,惟非洲區署呈上升;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 45 of 2025 (3–9 November) was 6.15%; only the African Region saw an increase in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 46 (10–16 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 1.91, lower than in the previous two weeks. Cases are concentrated in Hokkaido and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Europe: The outbreak is declining. The overall positivity rate in week 46 was 6.1%, markedly lower than the week 38 peak of 24.4%; the variant XFG has the highest share (66%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). Canada: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate fell to 6.4% in week 46, lower than the same period in the past two years; patients aged 65 and over account for 60%, and the variant XFG has the highest share. South Africa: The outbreak is rising. In week 46, the positivity rate at private facilities was about 20%, meeting the low-level epidemic threshold, and mortality has also risen; the variant XFG has the highest share. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but the African Region is rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.headline_zh: 泰國/日本/辛巴威-腸病毒
items.summary_zh: 泰國疫情上升,哈拉雷於11/20報告575例,5歲以下占9成
items.summary_en: Thailand's enterovirus outbreak is rising, while Japan's is at a low; Zimbabwe's Harare reported 575 cases, 90% under age 5.
items.description_zh: 泰國疫情上升,第47週(11/16-22)累計報告1,466例,高於去年同期;日本疫情處低點,第46週定醫平均報告數0.13,已連續9週下降,且低於近3年同期;辛巴威首都哈拉雷(Harare)於11/20報告575例病例,5歲以下病患占9成,疫情集中於高人口密度地區,並擴散至鄰近區域。
items.description_en: Thailand: Outbreak rising. In week 47 (16–22 November), a cumulative 1,466 cases were reported, higher than the same period last year. Japan: Outbreak at a low point. In week 46, the average number of reports per sentinel medical facility was 0.13; this has declined for nine consecutive weeks and is below the same period of the past three years. Zimbabwe: On 20 November, the capital Harare reported 575 cases, 90% of whom are under 5 years old. The outbreak is concentrated in areas of high population density and has spread to neighboring areas.

items.summary_zh: 美國嬰兒配方奶粉肉毒桿菌中毒累計31例,相關產品已下架
items.summary_en: US botulism outbreak in infants has reached 31 cases across 15 states linked to one infant formula, and products have been withdrawn.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情更新,截至11/20累計報告31例嬰兒病例,分布於加州等15個州,病患皆攝食某廠商之全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,抽測奶粉樣本亦檢測出陽性,並經調查,民眾最早於2024年11月食用該產品;當局正回溯調查自8月起通報之107例病例是否與該產品相關,生產商表示所有產品可能都遭受汙染,產品皆已下架。
items.description_en: US update: As of 20 November, a cumulative 31 infant cases had been reported across 15 states, including California. All patients consumed a whole-nutrition infant formula from one manufacturer, and samples of that formula also tested positive. Investigation found that consumers may have been using the product as early as November 2024. Authorities are retrospectively investigating whether 107 cases reported since August are linked to this product. The manufacturer said all products may have been contaminated, and all products have been removed from shelves.

items.summary_zh: 牙買加颶風後鉤端螺旋體病累計37例疑似病例、6例死亡
items.summary_en: Jamaica has recorded 37 suspected leptospirosis cases and 6 deaths since the late-October hurricane, with 9 confirmed.
items.description_zh: 牙買加11/22報告自10/28颶風侵襲後,累計37例疑及6例死亡病例,其中9例確診。病患多集中於該國西南部蒙特哥貝地區,多為從事農業、清理工作或災後復原之男性。當局表示因電力尚未恢復,無法清理受汙染之水域及環境,致使受感染機率增加。
items.description_en: Jamaica reported on 22 November that since the hurricane struck on 28 October, a cumulative 37 suspected cases and 6 deaths have been recorded, of which 9 were confirmed. Cases are concentrated in the south-western part of the country around Montego Bay, mostly among men engaged in agriculture, clean-up work or post-disaster recovery. Authorities said that because power has not yet been restored, contaminated waters and environments cannot be cleaned up, increasing the risk of infection.

items.headline_zh: 納米比亞-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 納米比亞新增1例克里米亞-剛果出血熱死亡,2016-23年累計7例
items.summary_en: Namibia reported a new death from Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever on 24 November, with 7 confirmed cases recorded during 2016–2023.
items.description_zh: 納米比亞11/24報告新增1例死亡病例,病患於18日因疑症狀入院治療,19日死亡,經實驗室確診,該病為嚴重病毒性出血熱,除經由蜱蟲叮咬,亦可能透過牲畜或其血液組織等接觸傳染,迄無疫苗。該國於2016-23年間累計報告7例確診病例,其中4例死亡(CFR:57%)。當局已匡列接觸者,並進行預防措施,呼籲民眾於戶外穿戴防護衣物,以預防感染,處理動物或在屠宰場工作人員應戴手套和防護裝備,並在屠宰前對動物進行至少2週之治療或隔離措施。
items.description_en: Namibia reported one new death on 24 November. The patient was admitted for treatment on 18 November with suspected symptoms and died on 19 November; laboratory testing confirmed a serious viral haemorrhagic fever. Besides tick bites, it may also be transmitted through contact with livestock or their blood and tissues, and there is no vaccine. From 2016 to 2023, the country reported 7 confirmed cases, of which 4 died (CFR 57%). Authorities have identified contacts and implemented preventive measures, and urge the public to wear protective clothing outdoors. People who handle animals or work in slaughterhouses should wear gloves and protective equipment, and animals should be treated or quarantined for at least two weeks before slaughter.

items.headline_zh: 衣索比亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞金卡地區首次通報馬堡病毒,累計10例確診、5例死亡
items.summary_en: Ethiopia's first Marburg outbreak in the Jinka area has 10 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with national spread risk assessed as high.
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡地區疫情更新,自11/12-25累計報告10例確診病例,其中5例死亡,另3例疑死亡。此為該國首次通報疫情,該病目前尚無藥物或疫苗,僅能支持性治療,目前疫情來源及流行病學特徵仍待釐清調查,另迄今之死亡病例均逕行下葬,又該區鄰近肯亞及南蘇丹,評估國內傳播風險為高,區域為中,全球則為低。
items.description_en: An update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: from 12 to 25 November, a cumulative 10 confirmed cases were reported, of which 5 died, and 3 further deaths are suspected. This is the country's first reported outbreak. The disease currently has no drug or vaccine, and only supportive treatment is available. The source of the outbreak and its epidemiological characteristics are still under investigation. All deaths to date have been buried directly. The area borders Kenya and South Sudan. The assessed risk of spread within the country is high, the regional risk is medium, and the global risk is low.

items.summary_zh: WHO非洲區8國白喉累計逾2萬例疑似病例,1,252例死亡
items.summary_en: Eight WHO African Region countries have reported over 20,000 suspected diphtheria cases and 1,252 deaths, mostly children and adolescents.
items.description_zh: WHO非洲區共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2萬例疑病例,其中9,864 例經實驗室確診,1,252例死亡,多數病患為兒童及青少年族群。受限於診斷試劑/檢驗/臨床照護能力不足及白喉抗毒素(DAT)供應短缺等因素,嚴重影響疫情防治工作。WHO考量非洲區疫情可能持續擴散,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險為高,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為低。
items.description_en: Eight countries in the WHO African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) have cumulatively reported more than 20,000 suspected cases, of which 9,864 were laboratory-confirmed and 1,252 died. Most patients are children and adolescents. Insufficient diagnostic reagents, testing and clinical care capacity, and shortages of diphtheria antitoxin (DAT) are seriously hindering outbreak prevention and control. WHO considers that the outbreak in the African Region may continue to spread, and assesses the overall public health risk in the African Region as high. Most countries outside the African Region have well-established immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is low.
items.area_zh: 阿爾及利亞,查德,幾內亞,茅利塔尼亞,尼日,奈及利亞,馬利,南非

items.summary_zh: 韓國流感高峰較去年提早2個月,泰國累計逾94萬例、100例死亡
items.summary_en: Korea's flu peak came two months earlier than last year, and Thailand has reported over 940,000 cases and 100 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 亞洲多國疫情持續,  日本東京都第46週(11/10-16)定點門診平均病例數為44.75人,共計有1,696所學校/機構採取停課等措施,為去年同期14倍,當局表示國際流行之「H3」型K次演化群已於日本檢出,自今年9月迄今,H3檢體之K次演化群檢出率為92.3%(12/13); 韓國第43-46週病例數呈指數型上升,住院人數顯著上升,病患主要為學齡兒童及青少年,本季高峰期較去年提早2個月,以H3N2為主要流行株,另已檢出變異株,惟當局確認現有疫苗仍對該病毒株有效; 香港今年流感季累計報告21例兒童重症病例,其中2例死亡,第47週單週報告3例兒童重症病例,當局表示本流感季兒童感染嚴重個案較多,6個月至2歲以下兒童疫苗覆蓋率僅近16%,呼籲家長儘速安排兒童疫苗接種作業; 泰國今年截至11/8累計報告逾94萬例病例,其中100例死亡,病患主要為14歲以下年齡層,當局建議高風險族群應每年接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Outbreaks continue in several Asian countries. Tokyo Metropolitan Government: In week 46 (10–16 November), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 44.75, and a total of 1,696 schools and facilities took measures such as class suspensions, 14 times the same period last year. Authorities said the internationally circulating H3 subclade K has been detected in Japan; since September this year, the detection rate of H3 subclade K among specimens has been 92.3% (12/13). South Korea: Cases rose exponentially in weeks 43–46, with hospitalizations rising significantly, mainly among school-age children and adolescents. The peak this season came two months earlier than last year, with H3N2 as the predominant strain. Variant strains have also been detected, but authorities have confirmed that existing vaccines remain effective against this strain. Hong Kong: A cumulative 21 severe pediatric cases have been reported this flu season, including 2 deaths; 3 severe pediatric cases were reported in week 47 alone. Authorities said severe infections in children have been more frequent this season, and vaccine coverage among children aged 6 months to under 2 years is only about 16%; parents are urged to arrange vaccination promptly. Thailand: A cumulative total of more than 940,000 cases and 100 deaths had been reported as of 8 November this year. Most patients are under 14 years old, and authorities recommend annual vaccination for high-risk groups.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,泰國

items.summary_zh: 香港腸病毒累計78例,8成發生於小學及幼兒園,預計12月中旬達高峰
items.summary_en: Hong Kong has recorded 78 enterovirus cases from 26 October to 20 November, 80% in primary schools and kindergartens; a peak is expected mid-December.
items.description_zh: 香港疫情持續上升,10/26-11/20累計報告78例病例,其中有64例(占8成)發生於小學及幼兒園;當局表示每年5-7月及10-12月為疫情高峰,預期本次疫情於12月中旬達到高峰,不排除至聖誕假期才會逐漸趨緩。
items.description_en: Hong Kong's outbreak continues to rise. From 26 October to 20 November, 78 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 64 (80%) occurred in primary schools and kindergartens. Authorities said the outbreak peaks each year in May–July and October–December, and expect this outbreak to peak in mid-December. It may not slow gradually until the Christmas holidays.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓登革熱減少8%至14,038例,阿富汗疑似病例上升
items.summary_en: The Philippines' dengue cases fell 8% to 14,038 over 12–25 October, while Afghanistan's suspected cases rose, with 4,384 reported this year.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情下降,10/12-25報告14,038例病例,較9/28-10/11報告15,182例減少8%,惟當局表示颱風過後,仍存在疫情風險。 阿富汗自9月底以來疑病例數上升,今年共6省累計報告4,384例疑病例,其中楠哈爾省於11月第2週報告1,021例疑病例,較前1週948例增加7.7%。
items.description_en: Philippines: Outbreak declining. From 12 to 25 October, 14,038 cases were reported, an 8% decrease from 15,182 cases reported from 28 September to 11 October. However, authorities say there remains a risk of outbreaks after the typhoon. Afghanistan: Suspected cases have risen since late September. A total of 4,384 suspected cases have been reported this year across six provinces. In Nangarhar province, 1,021 suspected cases were reported in the second week of November, up 7.7% from 948 the previous week.

items.summary_zh: 全球屈公病今年累計458,840例、146例死亡,巴西病例最多
items.summary_en: Global chikungunya cases reached 458,840 with 146 deaths this year, with Brazil reporting the most cases and the Americas leading.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情更新,今年累計報告458,840例病例及146例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加,10月報告病例數較9月增加108%,近2個月病例主要分布於美洲及亞洲。  今年美洲累計266,165例病例及118例死亡,較去年同期為低,以南美洲巴西病例數最多,其中,該國中西部和東南部地區在過去3週疫情最為嚴峻,並預期11月病例數將再度上升。 今年亞洲累計136,233例病例,較去年同期為低,以東南亞印度病例數最多;中國廣東省自7月疫情爆發以來,近期每週病例數呈下降趨勢,惟10月病例數較9月增加,香港及廣西壯族自治區亦有報告病例。 今年歐洲共2國報告病例,法國累計804例本土病例;義大利累計385例本土病例。
items.description_en: Global update: This year, 458,840 cases and 146 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with case numbers higher than the same period last year. Reported cases in October rose 108% from September, and in the past two months cases have been mainly distributed in the Americas and Asia. The Americas have reported 266,165 cumulative cases and 118 deaths this year, lower than the same period last year. Brazil has the most cases; its central-western and south-eastern regions have been the most severely affected in the past three weeks, and case numbers are expected to rise again in November. Asia has reported 136,233 cumulative cases this year, lower than the same period last year. India has the most cases in South-East Asia. In Guangdong Province, China, weekly cases have shown a declining trend since the outbreak began in July, but October cases were higher than September. Cases have also been reported in Hong Kong and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Two European countries have reported cases this year: France has 804 cumulative locally acquired cases and Italy has 385.
items.area_zh: 巴西,法國,香港特別行政區,印度,義大利

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1,美國華盛頓州出現全球首例致死H5N5人類感染
items.summary_en: This week Cambodia reported one new H5N1 human case, and Washington State, US, reported the world's first fatal H5N5 human infection.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例、美國新增1例H5N5流感人類感染死亡病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):WAHIS  共3國於2025/11/14-21期間新增6起H5(N untyped)疫情,比利時3起、中國2起、葡萄牙1起。 共21國於2025/11/14-21期間新增214起H5N1 疫情,英國60起、德國35起、西班牙22起、比利時17起、奈及利亞13 起、美國9起、加拿大8起、丹麥/芬蘭各7起、南非/法國各5起、奧地利/愛爾蘭/拉脫維亞/荷蘭各4起、捷克/瑞士/盧森堡/立陶宛各2起、挪威/葡萄牙各1起。 英國於2025/11/21新增1起H5N5疫情。 南韓於2025/11/19新增1起H5N9疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,082起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第46週計383個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(紐澤西州)共1個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國華盛頓州雷斯港郡(Grays Harbor County)於今年11月通報1例H5N5流感人類感染病例並於11/21死亡案例。個案為高齡且有慢性疾病居民,其在家中飼養多種家禽曾接觸過野鳥。經調查感染途徑極可能源於接觸自家受感染的家禽、禽鳥排泄物或受污染的環境。患者在入院前即出現高燒及呼吸困難等症狀,經確診感染罕見之H5N5病毒後,因併發症死亡。此為全球首例人類感染H5N5病毒,並致死之確診案例。當局已對所有密切接觸者進行追蹤與檢測,目前均未檢測出陽性,且無證據顯示該病毒存在人際傳播,此事件對一般民眾之整體健康風險仍為低。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計67國家/地區通報4,299起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 influenza infection, and the United States reported one new fatal human H5N5 influenza infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): three countries reported six new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 14 and 21 November 2025: Belgium 3, China 2, Portugal 1. Twenty-one countries reported 214 new H5N1 outbreaks between 14 and 21 November 2025: United Kingdom 60, Germany 35, Spain 22, Belgium 17, Nigeria 13, United States 9, Canada 8, Denmark and Finland 7 each, South Africa and France 5 each, Austria, Ireland, Latvia and Netherlands 4 each, Czechia, Switzerland, Luxembourg and Lithuania 2 each, and Norway and Portugal 1 each. The United Kingdom reported one new H5N5 outbreak on 21 November 2025. South Korea reported one new H5N9 outbreak on 19 November 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,082 outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 46, 383 sampling sites provided test reports, and one state (New Jersey) had one sampling site detect H5-positive results. Other updates: In Grays Harbor County, Washington, a human H5N5 influenza infection was reported in November this year, and the patient died on 21 November. The patient was an elderly resident with chronic illness who kept multiple poultry at home and had been in contact with wild birds. Investigation indicates the infection most likely came from contact with the infected domestic poultry, bird droppings or a contaminated environment. The patient had high fever and breathing difficulties before admission, and after the rare H5N5 virus was confirmed, died from complications. This is the first confirmed human H5N5 infection globally to result in death. All close contacts have been traced and tested, and none tested positive; there is no evidence of human-to-human transmission, and the overall health risk to the general public remains low. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 30 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 1 H5N5 influenza (1 cumulative); 32 H9N2 influenza (162 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 67 countries and areas have reported 4,299 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection, and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率6.16%,非洲區署上升,印尼疫情上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 6.16% in week 44, with the African Region and Indonesia rising while Japan, South Korea and the UK declined.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第44週(10/27-11/2)全球陽性率6.16%,其中,非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第45週(11/3-9)定醫平均報告數1.95,較前1週下降,分布以北海道、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第46(11/9-15)報告住院145例,陽性率降為4.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 印疫情上升,第44週陽性率上升至7.46%,今年迄今累計報告505例病例。 英國疫情下降,第45週醫院監測陽性率降為5%,住院數亦下降,以變異株XFG占比最高;另本流感季75歲以上年齡層疫苗覆蓋率為56.5%。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,惟非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 44 of 2025 (27 October–2 November) was 6.16%, and the WHO African Region saw an increase in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 45 (3–9 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 1.95, lower than the previous week; cases are concentrated in Hokkaido and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. In week 46 (9–15 November), 145 hospitalizations were reported and the positivity rate fell to 4.1%; the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Indonesia: The outbreak is rising. In week 44, the positivity rate rose to 7.46%, and 505 cases have been reported cumulatively this year. United Kingdom: The outbreak is declining. In week 45, the hospital surveillance positivity rate fell to 5% and hospitalizations also declined; the variant XFG has the highest share. In addition, vaccination coverage among people aged 75 and over this flu season is 56.5%. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but the African Region is rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_en: Indonesia,Japan,Korea(South Korea),United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 捷克-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 捷克今年截至10/22累計2,141例A型肝炎,26例死亡,布拉最嚴峻
items.summary_en: Czechia has reported 2,141 hepatitis A cases and 26 deaths as of 22 October, the second-highest since 1989, with Prague worst hit.
items.description_zh: 捷克疫情更新,今年截至10/22累計報告2,141例病例,其中26例死亡,疫情為1989年以來第2高,並以布拉最為嚴峻;當局已擴大疫苗接種措施,並調整布拉地鐵車門為自動開啟,以降低民眾接觸之染疫風險。
items.description_en: Czechia update: As of 22 October this year, 2,141 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 26 deaths. The outbreak is the second-highest since 1989 and is most severe in Prague. Authorities have expanded vaccination measures and set Prague metro doors to open automatically to reduce the risk of infection from public contact.

items.headline_zh: 中國/日本/新加坡-腸病毒
items.summary_zh: 中國10月腸病毒逾37萬例,較9月倍增;日本、新加坡疫情處低點
items.summary_en: China's enterovirus cases exceeded 370,000 in October, doubling from September, while Japan and Singapore are at low levels.
items.description_zh: 中國疫情快速上升,10月報告逾37萬例病例,較9月(15萬例)倍增;日本疫情處低點,第45週(11/3-9)定醫平均報告數0.14,已連續8週下降,且低於近3年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,第45週平均每日報告11例,與近2週相當,且低於去年同期。
items.description_en: China's outbreak is rising rapidly: more than 370,000 cases were reported in October, doubling from September (150,000 cases). Japan's outbreak is at a low point: in week 45 (3–9 November), the average number of reports per sentinel medical facility was 0.14, having declined for eight consecutive weeks and below the same period of the past three years. Singapore's outbreak is also at a low point: in week 45, an average of 11 cases per day were reported, similar to the past two weeks and lower than the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),日本,新加坡

items.summary_zh: 非洲CDC:今年霍亂疫情為本世紀最嚴峻,安哥拉累計3.4萬例
items.summary_en: Africa CDC calls this year's cholera outbreak the worst this century, with about 300,000 cases and over 7,000 deaths across Africa.
items.description_zh: 非洲CDC表示今年疫情為本世紀最嚴峻,非洲各國今年迄今累計約30萬例確定及疑病例,其中逾7,000例死亡,病例數較去年增加30%;其中安哥拉今年截至11/12累計報告約3.4萬例病例及874例死亡(CFR:2.5%),疫情自10月底再度攀升,另該國去年無病例數。
items.description_en: The Africa CDC says this year's outbreak is the most severe this century. Across African countries, about 300,000 confirmed and suspected cases have been reported cumulatively this year, of which more than 7,000 died, and case numbers are 30% higher than last year. In Angola, about 34,000 cases and 874 deaths (CFR 2.5%) have been reported cumulatively as of 12 November this year. The outbreak has surged again since late October, and the country reported no cases last year.

items.summary_zh: 中國流感陽性率南方30.7%、北方35.2%,預估12月中下旬達高峰
items.summary_en: China's flu positivity reached 30.7% in the south and 35.2% in the north in week 46, with the peak expected mid-December to early January.
items.description_zh: 中國第46週(11/10-16)南/北方陽性率分別為30.7%及35.2%,南/北方近3週陽性率及定點ILI門急診就診率持續上升,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),多省市報告病例以學生族群為主、兒科急門診患者人數上升且多診斷為流感,及有學校班級因疫情停課情事,專家推估該國流感季高峰為12月中下旬及明年1月初,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗並落實個人衛生防護措施。
items.description_en: In week 46 (10–16 November), China's positivity rates were 30.7% in the south and 35.2% in the north. Positivity rates and sentinel ILI outpatient and emergency visit rates in both regions have continued to rise over the past three weeks. The main circulating type is A(H3N2). Many provinces and cities report cases mainly among students; paediatric emergency outpatient numbers have risen, most diagnosed as influenza, and some school classes have suspended classes due to the outbreak. Experts estimate that the flu season's peak will fall in mid-to-late December and early January of next year. Authorities urge people to get vaccinated and to practise personal hygiene protection measures.

items.summary_zh: 阿根廷今年截至11/8梅毒累計36,702例,較去年同期增約20.5%
items.summary_en: Argentina reported 36,702 syphilis cases from early 2025 to 8 November, about 20.5% above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷11/18報告自2025年初截至11/8累計報告36,702例病例,比去年同期(30,445例)增加約20.5%,各區通報率均增加,惟南部地區增幅最大(32%)。該國自2011年病例數穩定上升,於2015年起劇增,2021-22年因新冠肺炎疫情病例數顯著下降,惟仍高於2015年前的病例數,2022年起再次上升,2023年首次全年報告超過3萬例病例,2024年全年報告達36,917例,較2022年(26,647例)增加38.5%。另以20-29歲年齡層的發病率最高,年增率最高之省份為內烏肯省。當局已加強監測並提升檢測能力。
items.description_en: Argentina reported on 18 November that from early 2025 to 8 November, a cumulative 36,702 cases had been reported, about 20.5% higher than the same period last year (30,445 cases). Reporting rates increased in all regions, with the largest increase in the southern region (32%). Cases in the country rose steadily from 2011 and increased sharply from 2015. They fell significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2021–22 but remained higher than before 2015, and have risen again since 2022. In 2023, more than 30,000 cases were reported for the first time in a full year. In 2024, a total of 36,917 cases were reported, a 38.5% increase over 2022 (26,647 cases). The 20–29 age group has the highest incidence, and the province with the highest annual increase is Neuquén. Authorities have strengthened surveillance and improved testing capacity.

items.summary_zh: 荷蘭累計6例Ib型M痘病例,患者近期無旅遊史,曾共同造訪俱樂部
items.summary_en: The Netherlands has reported six clade Ib mpox cases, none with recent travel; some patients visited the same MSM-frequented club in October.
items.description_zh: 荷蘭自10/17報告首例Ib型病例,截至11/6已累計報告6例Ib型病例,病患近期皆無旅遊史,惟於10月某日曾共同造訪以MSM族群為主之俱樂部,當局呼籲高風險者可接種疫苗,以預防感染並減輕疾病負擔。
items.description_en: The Netherlands reported its first clade Ib case on 17 October. As of 6 November, six clade Ib cases had been reported cumulatively. The patients had no recent travel history, but on a day in October some of them visited together a club mainly frequented by MSM. Authorities urge high-risk individuals to get vaccinated to prevent infection and reduce the disease burden.

items.headline_zh: 衣索比亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞金卡地區馬堡病毒累計26例疑病例、4例確診、3例死亡
items.summary_en: Ethiopia's Jinka-area Marburg outbreak has 26 suspected and 4 confirmed cases as of 18 November, with 129 contacts identified.
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡(Jinka)地區疫情更新,截至11/18累積報告26例疑病例,其中4例確診病例,3例確診死亡,當局已匡列129名接觸者,並進行隔離治療及社區篩檢等措施。
items.description_en: An update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: as of 18 November, 26 suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, including 4 confirmed cases and 3 confirmed deaths. Authorities have identified 129 contacts and implemented isolation treatment, community screening and other measures.

items.summary_zh: 葉門今年截至11/16百日咳確定病例380例,22例死亡
items.summary_en: Yemen has reported 380 confirmed pertussis cases and 22 deaths this year as of 16 November, and actual infections may be higher.
items.description_zh: 葉門今年截至11/16報告380例確定病例,其中22例死亡,以南部阿比揚省63例為多,當局警告由於武裝控制區缺乏疫苗接種計畫,實際感染人數可能更高。
items.description_en: Yemen reported 380 confirmed cases this year as of 16 November, including 22 deaths. The southern governorate of Abyan had the most cases, with 63. Authorities warned that because there is no vaccination programme in areas under armed control, the actual number of infections may be higher.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年1,723例麻疹,越南富壽省爆發學校群聚疫情
items.summary_en: The US reported 1,723 measles cases in 43 states as of 12 November, while Viet Nam's Phu Tho province had a school cluster outbreak.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至11/12共43州報告1,723例,其中206例住院、3例死亡,並報告45起疫情,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他州-亞利桑那州交界處和南卡羅來納州北部地區;該國2024年累計報告285例病例。 越南東北部富壽省爆發學校群聚事件,共計報告29例疑病例,4件樣本中,有3例經實驗室確診,當局已實施民眾衛教、疫苗接種及消毒等緊急措施;該國今年1-4月全國63個省份累計報告逾81,000例疑病例,因新冠疫情及疫苗短缺,兒童常規疫苗接種率降至20年來最低點,導致2024-25年疫情尤其嚴峻,媒體報導全國病例數已趨緩,惟目前尚無更新數據資訊。
items.description_en: United States: As of 12 November this year, 1,723 cases had been reported from 43 states, including 206 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 45 outbreaks have been reported. Of the patients, 92% were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent outbreaks are concentrated at the Utah–Arizona border area and in northern South Carolina. The country reported 285 cases cumulatively in 2024. Viet Nam: A school cluster outbreak occurred in Phu Tho province in the north-east, with 29 suspected cases reported in total; of 4 specimens, 3 were confirmed by laboratory testing. Authorities have implemented emergency measures including public health education, vaccination and disinfection. From January to April this year, more than 81,000 suspected cases were reported cumulatively across all 63 provinces nationwide. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic and vaccine shortages, routine childhood vaccination rates fell to their lowest level in 20 years, which made the 2024–25 outbreaks especially severe. Media reports say national case numbers have slowed, but no updated data are currently available.

items.summary_zh: 日本流感病例超過警戒值20例,英國今年高峰提前5週
items.summary_en: Japan's flu cases per clinic passed the alert level of 20 for the first time this season, and the UK's peak came five weeks early.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情持續上升,第45週(11/2-9)定點門診平均病例數為21.82例,為本流感季首次超過20例警戒,並較去年提前1個月逾,全國病例數約為8.4萬例,為前1週病例數1.5 倍,其中,宮城/埼玉/神奈川/福島/岩手等5個都縣平均病例數超過30例。另東京都平均每家醫療機構為29.03例,兒童因重症住院人數亦上升;當局宣布,倘定點門診平均病例數持續逾30例,且治療藥物生產跟不上需求,將評估動用國家備用藥物,同時呼籲民眾落實手部衛生、佩戴口罩並評估接種疫苗。 英國疫情上升,第45周陽性率為11.9%,近期檢出以H3N2為主,另截至11/2住院率已達每10萬人3.81例,接近往年12月下旬或1月初出現之季節性高峰,當局表示今年疫情高峰提前5週,疫情可能持續更長時間。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak continues to rise. In week 45 (2–9 November), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 21.82, the first time this flu season has exceeded the alert level of 20, more than one month earlier than last year. The national case count was about 84,000, 1.5 times the previous week's. Five prefectures (Miyagi, Saitama, Kanagawa, Fukushima and Iwate) had average case numbers above 30 per clinic. In Tokyo, the average per medical institution was 29.03, and the number of children hospitalized with severe illness is also rising. Authorities announced that if the average per sentinel outpatient clinic remains above 30 and production of treatment drugs cannot keep up with demand, they will evaluate the use of national stockpiled drugs. They also urge people to practise hand hygiene, wear masks and consider vaccination. The UK's outbreak is rising. The positivity rate in week 45 was 11.9%, with H3N2 the predominant strain recently detected. As of 2 November, the hospitalization rate had reached 3.81 per 100,000 population, approaching the seasonal peak that usually occurs in late December or early January. Authorities said this year's peak has come five weeks earlier, and the outbreak may last longer.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Japan

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉/墨西哥/美國-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥今年確診14,652例登革熱,孟加拉累計逾8萬例
items.summary_en: Mexico has 14,652 confirmed dengue cases this year and Bangladesh has over 80,000, while Florida reported three new local cases.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,近1日新增912例病例及3例死亡,今年迄今累計80,634例病例及318例死亡,病例數以該國南部巴里薩爾專區18,765例為多,自7月以來每月報告病例數皆逾1萬例。 墨西哥疫情上升,近1週新增992例病例,今年截至10/27累計14,652例確診病例,以東部維拉克魯茲州2,257例為多,主要流行型別為DENV-3。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡近1週報告新增3例本土病例,該州今年迄今累計56例病例,主要分布於布里瓦德郡、希爾斯波羅郡、邁阿密-戴德郡及帕斯科郡,主要檢出型別為DENV-3。
items.description_en: Bangladesh update: In the past day, 912 new cases and 3 deaths were reported. Year to date, 80,634 cases and 318 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with the most cases, 18,765, in Barisal division in the south. Since July, more than 10,000 cases have been reported each month. Mexico: The outbreak is rising. In the past week, 992 new cases were reported. As of 27 October this year, 14,652 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, most in Veracruz state in the east (2,257 cases). The main serotype detected is DENV-3. United States: Miami-Dade County in Florida reported three new local cases in the past week. The state has reported 56 cases cumulatively this year, mainly in Broward, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade and Pasco counties, and the main serotype detected is DENV-3.

items.summary_zh: 廣東屈公病疫情持續下降,近1週新增48例皆為輕症;香港累計62例
items.summary_en: Guangdong's chikungunya outbreak continues to decline, with 48 mild cases in the past week; Hong Kong has reported 62 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情持續下降,近1週(11/9-15)新增48例病例,主要分布於江門市14例及深圳市12例,皆為輕症,無報告重症及死亡病例,近1週新增病例數較前1週107例下降;香港今年截至11/16累計62例病例,其中4例為本土病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak has continued to decline recently. In the past week (9–15 November), 48 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen (14 cases) and Shenzhen (12 cases). All were mild, with no severe or fatal cases reported. New cases in the past week fell from 107 the previous week. Hong Kong: 62 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 16 November this year, of which 4 were locally acquired.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區

items.headline_zh: 柬埔寨/美國-新型A型流感
items.headline_en: Cambodia / United States – Novel influenza A
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨金邊1例H5N1死亡,美國華盛頓州1例H5N5,為首例人類感染
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a fatal H5N1 case in Phnom Penh, while the US reported the first human H5N5 infection, in Washington State.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感死亡病例,為居住於金邊市22歲男性個案,11/15因發燒、咳嗽、呼吸急促/困難等症狀死亡,為該市首例確診病例。迄未公佈流行病學及基因定序相關資訊,感染源仍在調查中。該國今年已累計確診18例感染病例,其中7例死亡。往年病例多集中於南部各省, 惟於今年,31%病例來自北部暹粒省。病例出現症狀前,多有近期疑或已知之患病/死亡鳥類接觸史,迄未發現人際傳播病例。 美國新增1例H5N5流感病例,為居住於華盛頓州雷斯港郡之老年人,患有慢性疾病,11月初因類流感症狀(高燒、意識混亂和呼吸困難)入院治療,迄仍住院中。家中飼養家禽,且家禽可能曾接觸過野生鳥類,推測家禽或野生鳥類很可能是病毒傳播來源,刻正釐清感染源。此為首例人類感染H5N5亞型病毒案例,之前僅在動物中發現。目前尚未報告人傳人病例,所有密切接觸者皆已接受症狀監測,推估對民眾風險較低。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one new fatal H5N1 influenza case, a 22-year-old man living in Phnom Penh who died on 15 November after fever, cough and rapid or difficult breathing. This is the first confirmed case in the city. Epidemiological and genetic sequencing information has not yet been published, and the source of infection is still under investigation. Cambodia has cumulatively confirmed 18 infection cases this year, 7 of which were fatal. Cases in past years were mostly concentrated in southern provinces, but this year 31% of cases came from northern Siem Reap province. Before symptom onset, most cases had recent suspected or known contact with sick or dead birds, and no human-to-human transmission has been identified. The United States reported one new H5N5 influenza case, an elderly resident of Grays Harbor County, Washington, who has chronic illness and was admitted in early November with influenza-like symptoms (high fever, confusion and breathing difficulties); the patient remains hospitalized. The person kept poultry at home, and the poultry may have had contact with wild birds. Poultry or wild birds are most likely the source of transmission, and the source of infection is being clarified. This is the first human infection case with the H5N5 subtype, which had previously been found only in animals. No human-to-human transmission has been reported, and all close contacts are under symptom monitoring; the risk to the public is estimated to be low.

items.headline_zh: 衣索比亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞金卡地區馬堡病毒累計9例、6例死亡,含2名醫護人員
items.summary_en: Ethiopia's Jinka-area Marburg outbreak has 9 cases and 6 deaths as of 14 November, including two health workers.
