items.description_zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡(Jinka)地區爆發疫情,截至11/14累積報告9例病例,其中6例死亡,包含2名醫護人員,患者出現高燒、頭痛、腹瀉及出血等症狀,部分患者入院後24小時內死亡;當局檢測其病毒型別與先前在東非流行的病毒株相同,已展開隔離治療、接觸者追蹤、及社區篩檢等措施;另今年1-3月在坦尚亞亦發生疫情,造成10例死亡。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia. As of 14 November, 9 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 6 died, including 2 health workers. Patients presented with high fever, headache, diarrhoea and bleeding, and some died within 24 hours of admission. Authorities tested the virus and found it to be the same type as strains previously circulating in East Africa. Isolation treatment, contact tracing and community screening have been launched. Separately, an outbreak occurred in Tanzania from January to March this year, causing 10 deaths.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國本週新增4例H9N2人類感染,德國新增499起H5N1禽流感疫情
items.summary_en: This week China reported 4 new human H9N2 infections, and Germany reported 499 new H5N1 animal outbreaks between 7 and 14 November.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:中國本週新增4例H9N2流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  挪威於2025/11/10新增1起H5 (N untyped) 疫情。 共25國於2025/11/7-14期間新增712起H5N1疫情,德國499起、西班牙44起、英國23起、日本19起、美國17起、盧森堡/荷蘭各15起、加拿大14起、丹麥12起、奧地利/法國各8起、義大利7起、瑞典6起、匈牙利5起、捷克/波蘭各4 起、拉脫維亞3起、愛爾蘭2起、保加利亞/北馬其頓/挪威/烏克蘭/瑞士/立陶宛/蒙古各1起。 英國於 2025/11/14新增1起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,082(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西州、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感29例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計66國家/地區通報3,991起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week China reported 4 new human H9N2 influenza infections. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): Norway reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 10 November 2025. 25 countries reported 712 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 and 14 November 2025: Germany 499, Spain 44, United Kingdom 23, Japan 19, United States 17, Luxembourg and Netherlands 15 each, Canada 14, Denmark 12, Austria and France 8 each, Italy 7, Sweden 6, Hungary 5, Czechia and Poland 4 each, Latvia 3, Ireland 2, and Bulgaria, North Macedonia, Norway, Ukraine, Switzerland, Lithuania and Mongolia 1 each. The United Kingdom reported one new H5N5 outbreak on 14 November 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,082 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 29 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 32 H9N2 influenza (162 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 66 countries and areas have reported 3,991 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率9.04%(第43週)下降,西太平洋及東地中海區署上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 9.04% in week 43 and is declining, but rising in the Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第43週(10/20-26)全球陽性率9.04%,其中,非洲及東地中海區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第44週(10/27-11/2)定醫平均報告數2.28,與前1週相當,病患地理分布以東京都、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第43週陽性率9.23%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 泰國疫情處低點,第45週(11/2-8)新增572例病例,病患年齡以30-39歲為大宗,病患地理分布以曼谷為多。 歐洲疫情呈下降趨勢,第44週陽性率7.9%,較9月中旬陽性率高峰(23.3%)已明顯下降,以變異株XFG占比最高(81%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,其中,惟西太平洋及東地中海區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 43 of 2025 (20–26 October) was 9.04%, with positivity increasing in the Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regional offices. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 44 (27 October–2 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 2.28, similar to the previous week; cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 43 was 9.23%, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Thailand: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 45 (2–8 November), 572 new cases were reported; most patients are aged 30–39, and cases are concentrated in Bangkok. Europe: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 44 was 7.9%, markedly lower than the mid-September peak of 23.3%; the variant XFG has the highest share (81%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but it is rising in the Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regional offices. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 德國汙水監測出WPV1陽性環境樣本,為2021年建置以來首例
items.summary_en: Germany detected a WPV1-positive environmental sample, the first since its 2021 wastewater surveillance began; no human cases; community risk low.
items.description_zh: 德國11/12新增1件WPV1陽性環境樣本,係該國自2021年建置汙水監測機制以來之首例,目前尚未有人類感染病例(最近1例於1990年);該國自2024年以來陸續監測出cVDPV2陽性環境樣本,因疫苗覆蓋率高,當局評估社區傳播風險為低。 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/30-11/5期間,cVDPV2新增2例,分別為奈及利亞/巴布亞紐幾內亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦29件,cVDPV2新增阿爾及利亞/吉布地各1件。
items.description_en: Germany reported one new WPV1-positive environmental sample on 12 November. This is the first such sample since the country established its wastewater surveillance mechanism in 2021. There are currently no human infection cases (the most recent was in 1990). Since 2024, the country has successively detected cVDPV2-positive environmental samples. Because vaccination coverage is high, authorities assess the community transmission risk as low. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 30 October–5 November, two new cVDPV2 cases were reported, one each in Nigeria and Papua New Guinea. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 29 WPV1 samples, and Algeria and Djibouti each added one cVDPV2 sample.

items.summary_zh: 美國中大西洋地區9月197例腸病毒病例,監測系統暫停運作
items.summary_en: The US mid-Atlantic region reported 197 enterovirus cases in September, mostly in schools and daycares, amid suspended surveillance.
items.description_zh: 美國中大西洋地區(mid-Atlantic)9月報告197例病例,東部海岸地區疫情亦上升,疫情多發生於學校及日托中心,病毒型別主要為EVA71型及克沙奇A16。惟因腸病毒非法定通報疾病,且該國公衛監測系統暫停運作,欠缺完整疫情監測資訊。
items.description_en: The US mid-Atlantic region reported 197 cases in September, and outbreaks have also increased in East Coast areas. Outbreaks mainly occur in schools and daycare centres, and the main virus types are EV-A71 and coxsackievirus A16. However, enterovirus infection is not a notifiable disease, and the country's public health surveillance system has temporarily stopped operating, so complete outbreak surveillance information is lacking.

items.headline_zh: 澳大利亞-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 澳洲新南威爾斯等4州共44例沙門氏菌感染,疑為苜蓿芽
items.summary_en: Australia reported 44 Salmonella cases across four states, including New South Wales, with alfalfa sprouts suspected as the source.
items.description_zh: 澳洲於11/8報告44例病例,病患分布於新南威爾斯等4個州,疑感染源為某生產商販售之苜蓿芽,產品已下架。
items.description_en: Australia reported 44 cases on 8 November. Patients are distributed across four states, including New South Wales. The suspected source is alfalfa sprouts sold by a certain producer, and the product has been removed from shelves.

items.headline_zh: 日本-產氣莢膜梭狀芽孢桿菌
items.summary_zh: 北海道某高中宿舍63例腸胃炎,疑餐點感染,已暫停供餐
items.summary_en: 63 gastroenteritis cases among boarding students at a Hokkaido high school are suspected to stem from dormitory meals; meal service is suspended.
items.description_zh: 日本北海道11/6報告63例病例,病患為某高中住宿學生,自10/30起陸續出現腸胃不適等症狀,目前症狀已逐漸緩解;經當局調查,疑感染源為宿舍廚房供應之餐點,已暫停供餐並進行檢查。
items.description_en: Hokkaido, Japan, reported 63 cases on 6 November. The patients are boarding students at a high school who began experiencing gastrointestinal discomfort from 30 October, and their symptoms have gradually eased. Authorities' investigation suspects that meals supplied by the dormitory kitchen were the source; meal service has been suspended and inspections are underway.

items.summary_zh: 美國嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒累計15例,12州,當局要求下架所有批次
items.summary_en: US infant botulism has reached 15 cases across 12 states, all patients having consumed one manufacturer's formula; all batches must be withdrawn.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情更新,截至11/11累計報告15例病例,病患皆為嬰兒,分布於加州等12個州,症狀包含臉部表情少、吞嚥餵食困難及頭部不穩定等;經調查病患皆曾於8-11月期間攝食某公司生產的全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,當局正回溯調查自8月起通報之84例病例是否與該產品相關,並要求生產商下架所有批次產品
items.description_en: US update: As of 11 November, 15 cases had been reported cumulatively. All patients are infants, distributed across 12 states including California. Symptoms include reduced facial expression, difficulty swallowing and feeding, and head instability. Investigation found that all patients had consumed whole-nutrition infant formula produced by one company during August–November. Authorities are retrospectively investigating whether 84 cases reported since August are related to this product, and have required the manufacturer to withdraw all batches of the product.

items.summary_zh: 內華達州萊昂郡50歲男性感染漢他病毒,為該州今年第3例
items.summary_en: Lyon County, Nevada, reported a hantavirus case in a 50-year-old man exposed to rodent droppings while cleaning, the state's third this year.
items.description_zh: 美國內華達州萊昂(Lyon)郡報告1例,為50歲男性,病患出現症狀前數週曾於打掃房屋時,吸入或接觸到囓齒動物之糞便、尿液及其築巢材料,相關調查持續進行中,本案為該州今年第3例病例。另該國自1993年全國監測後,迄2022年累計864例確診病例,94%病例發生在密西西比河以西。
items.description_en: Lyon County, Nevada, reported one case, a 50-year-old man who, several weeks before symptom onset, inhaled or came into contact with rodent feces, urine and nesting material while cleaning a house. The investigation is ongoing, and this is the state's third case this year. Since national surveillance began in 1993, a cumulative 864 confirmed cases had been reported in the United States through 2022, and 94% of cases occurred west of the Mississippi River.

items.summary_zh: 美國西維吉亞州126例、南非483例百日咳確診,南非半數為5歲以下
items.summary_en: West Virginia reported 126 pertussis cases this year, and South Africa 483 confirmed cases, half of them under age 5.
items.description_zh: 美國西維吉亞州今年截至11/6累計報告126例確定病例,主要分布於西部,其中28例須住院治療,病患年齡中位數為12歲,其中23例為12 個月以下嬰兒,當局已公布相關指引,另表示疫情每隔 3-5 年就會出現週期性高峰,流行病例已從嬰兒轉為青少年和成人,評估因其疫苗免疫力減弱所致。 南非今年截至10月累計報告483例確診病例,主要分布於豪登省和西開普省,其中50%為5歲以下兒童,25%為6個月齡以下嬰兒,當局已提醒醫生針對嬰兒及未接種疫苗者提高診斷警覺,並持續監測疫情。
items.description_en: West Virginia, US: As of 6 November this year, 126 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in the western part of the state, and 28 required hospitalization. The median patient age is 12 years, and 23 cases were infants under 12 months old. Authorities have published relevant guidance and state that outbreaks peak cyclically every three to five years. Epidemic cases have shifted from infants to adolescents and adults, which is assessed to be due to waning vaccine-induced immunity. South Africa: As of October this year, 483 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Gauteng and Western Cape provinces. Of these, 50% were children under 5 years old and 25% were infants under 6 months old. Authorities have reminded doctors to maintain heightened diagnostic vigilance for infants and unvaccinated people, and continue to monitor the outbreak.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大/澳大利亞/紐西蘭/以色列-麻疹
items.headline_en: Canada / Australia / New Zealand / Israel – Measles
items.summary_zh: 加拿大失去麻疹消除狀態,以色列今年累計1,935例、9例死亡
items.summary_en: Canada lost its measles elimination status after a year-long outbreak of 4,800 cases; Israel reports 1,935 cases and 9 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 加拿大於11/10宣布PAHO通知該國不再維持自1998以來之麻疹消除狀態,該國自去(2024)年10月起爆發大規模跨區疫情,今(2025)年截至11/1共計10地區報告4,800例確診病例,其中2例死亡,雖近期疫情趨緩,惟已持續超過12個月,主要集中在疫苗接種率較低之社區,經PAHO委員會審查近期流行病學及實驗室數據,證實該國境內同一病毒株已持續傳播1年以上,當局已加強與PAHO及各地方政府合作,以提高疫苗接種率及強化監測措施。 澳大利亞西澳大利亞州今年截至11/6報告54例確診病例,主要分布於西南部和南部地區,病患皆有東南/南亞國外旅遊史或確診病例接觸史,為該州30年以來最嚴重疫情,2023-24年僅報告6例病例,當局已公布確定病例曾暴露之風險場所,建議造訪民眾應監測自身症狀。 紐西蘭今年截至11/7報告18例確診病例,近期新增病例多為本土病例,其中包含7例為藍橋渡輪(Bluebridge Ferry)群聚事件,當局已匡列逾3,000名接觸者,並提醒民眾疫情持續,建議民眾自身評估接種疫苗並密切留意相關症狀。 以色列今年截至11/10累計報告1,935例,其中9例死亡,疫情已傳播至少12個城市,當局已擴大疫苗接種資,並提醒倘出現相關症狀時,應立即就醫,另未完整接種疫苗者應避免參與爆發疫情城市之集會活動。
items.description_en: On 10 November, Canada announced that PAHO had notified it that it no longer maintains measles elimination status, which it had held since 1998. The country has experienced a large-scale, multi-regional outbreak since October 2024. As of 1 November this year, 10 regions had reported 4,800 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. Although the outbreak has slowed recently, it has persisted for more than 12 months, mainly in communities with lower vaccination rates. After the PAHO commission reviewed recent epidemiological and laboratory data, it confirmed that the same virus strain had been circulating in the country for more than one year. Authorities have strengthened cooperation with PAHO and local governments to raise vaccination rates and enhance surveillance. Australia: In Western Australia, 54 confirmed cases had been reported as of 6 November this year, mainly in the south-western and southern regions. All patients had either travel history to countries in South-East or South Asia or contact with a confirmed case. This is the state's most severe outbreak in 30 years; only six cases were reported in 2023–24. Authorities have published venues where confirmed cases were exposed, and recommend that visitors monitor their own symptoms. New Zealand: As of 7 November this year, 18 confirmed cases had been reported. Recent new cases are mostly locally acquired, including 7 cases from a Bluebridge Ferry cluster. Authorities have traced more than 3,000 contacts and reminded the public that the outbreak continues, recommending that people assess their own vaccination status and watch closely for related symptoms. Israel: As of 10 November this year, 1,935 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths. The outbreak has spread to at least 12 cities. Authorities have expanded vaccination and reminded people to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. People who are not fully vaccinated should avoid gatherings in cities with outbreaks.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,加拿大,以色列,紐西蘭

items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞1例狂犬病死亡,24歲實習醫學生曾接觸幼犬
items.summary_en: Bolivia reported a rabies death in a 24-year-old medical intern who had contact with a three-month-old puppy; dog vaccination was launched.
items.description_zh: 南美洲玻利維亞11/8報告1例死亡病例,為24歲女實習醫學生,在鄉村醫療服務時,曾接觸3個月大幼犬,於10/31出現腦膜炎症狀就醫,於11/2轉診途中去世。該病可能透過唾液傳播,當局刻正調查中,並啟動犬隻疫苗接種活動。
items.description_en: Bolivia reported one death on 8 November: a 24-year-old female medical intern who, while providing rural medical services, had come into contact with a three-month-old puppy. She developed meningitis-like symptoms on 31 October and sought care, and died on 2 November while being transferred for referral. The disease may be transmitted through saliva. Authorities are investigating and have launched a dog vaccination campaign.

items.summary_zh: 希臘首例Ib型M痘為境外移入,英國累計18例Ib型,風險升至高
items.summary_en: Greece reported its first imported clade Ib mpox case, and the UK, with 18 clade Ib cases, raised its importation risk to high.
items.description_zh: 希臘11/1報告該國首例Ib型境外移入病例,該病患曾具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,並發生MSM行為。歐洲6國於10/11-20期間報告至少8例I型病例,分別為德國/義大利各2例、比利時/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙各1例,其中2例不具旅遊史,其中3例為MSM族群,顯示可能在同性/雙性族群中尚有未發現的社交傳播鏈。當局評估MSM族群傳播風險為中,一般民眾為低。 英國自2022年截至今年10/31已累計3,732例病例,其中,累計18例Ib型病例,大多數病例與前往Ib型流行國家有直/間接關聯,該國於11/3新增報告1例Ib型病例,即具泰國旅遊史。由於近期歐、美洲MSM族群傳播風險升高,當局評估將該病輸入傳播風險從中提升至高。
items.description_en: Greece reported on 1 November its first imported clade Ib case; the patient had a travel history to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and had engaged in MSM behaviour. Between 11 and 20 October, six European countries reported at least eight clade Ib cases: Germany and Italy 2 each, and Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two of these cases had no travel history, and three were in the MSM population, suggesting that undetected social transmission chains may exist among men who have sex with men and bisexual populations. Authorities assess the transmission risk in the MSM population as moderate and for the general public as low. The United Kingdom has recorded 3,732 cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 31 October this year, including 18 clade Ib cases, most of which are directly or indirectly linked to travel to countries with clade Ib transmission. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 3 November, with a travel history to Thailand. Because the transmission risk among MSM in Europe and the Americas has recently increased, authorities have raised the assessed risk of importation and spread from moderate to high.
items.area_zh: 比利時,德國,希臘,義大利,荷蘭,葡萄牙,西班牙,泰國,阿拉伯聯合大公國,英國
items.area_en: Belgium,Germany,Greece,Italy,Netherlands,Portugal,Spain,Thailand,United Arab Emirates,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞拉薩熱今年累計8,367例、176例死亡,致死率18.4%
items.summary_en: Nigeria has reported 8,367 Lassa fever cases and 176 deaths this year as of 26 October, a case fatality rate of 18.4%.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,今年截至10/26累計21州8,367例病例,其中,995例確診,176例死亡(CFR:18.4%),雖病例數較去年同期為低,惟致死率卻較高(去年CFR:16.6%)。病患主要以西南部翁多州/埃多州及東北部包奇州為多,死者多與延誤就醫及衛生條件不佳等相關。
items.description_en: Nigeria update: As of 26 October this year, 8,367 cases had been reported cumulatively across 21 states, of which 995 were confirmed and 176 died (CFR 18.4%). Although case numbers are lower than in the same period last year, the case fatality rate is higher (last year's CFR: 16.6%). Cases are mainly concentrated in Ondo and Edo states in the south-west and Bauchi state in the north-east. Most deaths are associated with delayed medical care and poor sanitation.

items.headline_zh: 塞內加爾/茅利塔尼亞/甘比亞-裂谷熱
items.headline_en: Senegal / Mauritania / Gambia – Rift Valley fever
items.summary_zh: 塞內加爾今年416例裂谷熱確診、30例死亡,茅利塔尼亞46例
items.summary_en: Senegal has reported 416 confirmed Rift Valley fever cases and 30 deaths from 20 September to 8 November, with Mauritania reporting 46 cases and 14 deaths.
items.description_zh: 塞內加爾今年9/20-11/8累計416例確診病例及30例死亡,病例分布於該國10個地區,並以該國西北部聖路易區為多。鄰近國家茅利塔亞及甘比亞亦出現疫情,茅利塔亞於今年9/27-10/30累計46例確診病例及14例死亡,分布於該國11個地區;甘比亞於11/8報告今年首例病例。裂谷熱為一種主要透過蚊子傳播的病毒性人畜共通傳染病,目前尚未發現人際傳播情形,WHO評估公共衛生風險於國家為高,於區域為中,於全球為低。
items.description_en: Senegal: From 20 September to 8 November this year, 416 confirmed cases and 30 deaths have been reported cumulatively, distributed across 10 regions of the country and mainly in the Saint-Louis region in the north-west. Neighbouring Mauritania has also had cases: from 27 September to 30 October this year, 46 confirmed cases and 14 deaths were reported cumulatively, distributed across 11 regions. The Gambia reported its first case of this year on 8 November. Rift Valley fever is a viral zoonotic disease transmitted mainly by mosquitoes, and no human-to-human transmission has been found so far. WHO assesses the public health risk as high at the national level, moderate at the regional level, and low at the global level.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾今年164例確診日本腦炎、31例死亡,死亡為近10年最多
items.summary_en: Nepal has recorded 164 confirmed Japanese encephalitis cases and 31 deaths this year, the most deaths in 10 years.
items.description_zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告164例確診病例及31例死亡,病例數高於去年全年病例數86例,且死亡數為近10年來最多,死亡病例主要為40歲以上且未接種疫苗者。
items.description_en: Nepal's outbreak is rising. So far this year, 164 confirmed cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The case count exceeds last year's full-year total by 86 cases, and the number of deaths is the highest in 10 years. Most deaths occurred among people aged over 40 who had not been vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增107例,較前週下降,皆為輕症;香港累計59例
items.summary_en: Guangdong's chikungunya outbreak continues to decline, with 107 mild cases in the past week; Hong Kong has reported 59 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情持續下降,近1週(11/2-8)新增107例病例,較前1週259例下降,病例主要分布於深圳市30例、江門市23例、佛山市21例及珠海市10例,皆為輕症,無報告重症及死亡病例;香港今年累計59例病例,包含3例本土病例及56例境外移入病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues to decline. In the past week (2–8 November), 107 new cases were reported, down from 259 the previous week. Cases are mainly distributed in Shenzhen (30), Jiangmen (23), Foshan (21) and Zhuhai (10). All were mild, and no severe or fatal cases have been reported. Hong Kong has reported 59 cases cumulatively this year, including 3 locally acquired cases and 56 imported cases.

items.summary_zh: 美國嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒增至13例,分布10州,已下架兩批奶粉
items.summary_en: US infant botulism has risen to 13 cases across 10 states; authorities have removed two batches of the implicated formula.
items.description_zh: 美國11/8報告13例病例,病患皆為嬰兒,分布於加州等10個州;經調查病患皆於8-11月期間攝食某公司生產的全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,當局已下架兩批產品,奶粉樣本檢測中。
items.description_en: US update: On 8 November, the US reported 13 cases, all in infants, across 10 states including California. Investigation found that all patients had consumed whole-nutrition infant formula produced by one company during August–November. Authorities have removed two batches of the product from shelves, and formula samples are being tested.

items.summary_zh: 日本流感定點門診平均14.9例,超過10例為本季首見,較前週增2.4倍
items.summary_en: Japan's flu cases per sentinel clinic averaged 14.9 in week 44, the first time this season above 10, with Miyagi highest at 28.6.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情持續上升,第44週定點門診平均病例數為14.9例,較前1週增加2.4倍,為本流感季以來首次平均病例數超過10例,以宮城縣28.6例為多,另神奈川/埼玉/千葉/北海道/沖繩/東京等6個都縣平均病例數超過20例,全國所有都道府縣病例數皆較前1週增加,當局呼籲民眾應徹底執行勤洗手及正確佩戴口罩等個人防護,並評估接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak continues to rise. In week 44, the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 14.9, an increase of 2.4-fold from the previous week, and the first time this flu season that the average has exceeded 10 cases. Miyagi Prefecture had the highest figure at 28.6. Six prefectures and metropolitan areas, including Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Hokkaido, Okinawa and Tokyo, had averages above 20 cases. Case numbers increased from the previous week in all prefectures nationwide. Authorities urge people to practise thorough hand hygiene and wear masks correctly, and to consider vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染,德國新增386起H5N1禽流感疫情
items.summary_en: No new human novel influenza A infections were reported this week; Germany reported 386 new H5N1 animal outbreaks between 29 October and 7 November.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共24國於2025/10/29-11/7期間新增609起H5N1 疫情,德國386起、法國68起、荷蘭34起、英國30起、丹麥20起、美國16起、義大利15起、比利時10起、波蘭 5 起、捷克4起、奧地利/拉脫維亞各3起、愛爾蘭/斯洛維亞/葡萄牙各2起、保加利亞/匈牙利/南非/奈及利亞/斯洛伐克/瑞典/瑞士/羅馬亞/臺灣各1起。 共2國於2025/10/31-11/7期間新增2起H5(N untyped) 疫情,挪威/比利時各1起。 冰島於2025/11/5 期間新增4起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,082(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西州、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感29例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H9N2流感28例(迄今累計158例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計65國家/地區通報3,363起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 24 countries reported 609 new H5N1 outbreaks between 29 October and 7 November 2025: Germany 386, France 68, Netherlands 34, United Kingdom 30, Denmark 20, United States 16, Italy 15, Belgium 10, Poland 5, Czechia 4, Austria and Latvia 3 each, Ireland, Slovenia and Portugal 2 each, and Bulgaria, Hungary, South Africa, Nigeria, Slovakia, Sweden, Switzerland, Romania and Taiwan 1 each. Two countries reported 2 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 31 October and 7 November 2025: Norway and Belgium 1 each. Iceland reported 4 new H5N5 outbreaks dated 5 November 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,082 (1) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Other updates: US CDC researchers recently published a study reviewing all publicly available human H5N1 infection cases up to 25 August this year. They found 18 asymptomatic infections on record; most were identified by molecular testing during contact tracing. Reports of asymptomatic human H5N1 infection are extremely rare and mostly come from enhanced surveillance or contact tracing of known exposures. The study recommends more complete data collection on possible asymptomatic infections in the future to support public health decision-making and outbreak response. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 29 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 28 H9N2 influenza (158 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 65 countries and areas have reported 3,363 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率10.88%(第42週)波動下降,東南亞、歐洲等區上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 10.88% in week 42 and fluctuating downward, but rising in Southeast Asia, Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第42週(10/13-19)全球陽性率10.88%,其中,歐洲及東地中海區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第43週定醫平均報告數2.25,已連續6週下降,分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第42週陽性率12.19%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,孟加拉、印度、泰國及泊爾等國第42週陽性率皆處低點。 澳洲疫情處低點,第41週定點實驗室監測陽性率降至1.2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(52.3%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈波動下降趨勢,其中,東南亞、歐洲及東地中海區呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占81%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占12%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 42 of 2025 (13–19 October) was 10.88%, and the European and Eastern Mediterranean regional offices saw increases in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 43, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 2.25, having declined for six consecutive weeks. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 42 was 12.19%, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point; positivity rates in week 42 were at low levels in Bangladesh, India, Thailand and Nepal. Australia: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate in sentinel laboratory surveillance fell to 1.2% in week 41, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share (52.3%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown a fluctuating downward trend, but Southeast Asia, Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean regions are rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (81%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,孟加拉,印度,日本,韓國,尼泊爾,泰國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: cVDPV2新增10例(奈及利亞7例、安哥拉2例),巴基斯坦WPV1新增1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 10 new cVDPV2 cases in 23–29 October, 7 in Nigeria and 2 in Angola, plus one WPV1 case in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/23-29期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增3國共10例,分別為奈及利亞7例、安哥拉2例、巴布亞紐幾內亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦12件,cVDPV2新增5國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞5件、安哥拉/查德/奈及利亞/索馬利亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 23–29 October, WPV1 added one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 added 10 cases across three countries: 7 in Nigeria, 2 in Angola and 1 in Papua New Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 12 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added 9 samples across five countries: 5 in Papua New Guinea, and one each in Angola, Chad, Nigeria and Somalia.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,巴布亞紐幾內亞

items.headline_zh: 美國/希臘-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 美國11例沙門氏菌感染疑與辣木葉粉有關,已要求下架
items.summary_en: US reported 11 Salmonella cases in seven states, with moringa leaf powder suspected; authorities have requested its withdrawal.
items.description_zh: 美國10/31報告11例病例,發病日介於5/12-9/4,病患分布於7個州,疑感染源為某食品商製造的辣木葉粉,當局已要求產品下架。 希臘2024年累積報告1,052例病例,較2023年(936例)為高,疫情多發生於夏季(908例)。
items.description_en: US: On 31 October, 11 cases were reported, with onset dates between 12 May and 4 September; patients are distributed across seven states. The suspected source is moringa leaf powder manufactured by a food company, and authorities have requested that the product be removed from shelves. Greece reported 1,052 cumulative cases in 2024, higher than in 2023 (936 cases); most cases occurred in summer (908 cases).

items.headline_zh: 捷克-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 布拉疫情嚴峻,捷克今年截至11/3累計939例A型肝炎,11例死亡
items.summary_en: Prague's hepatitis A outbreak has reached 939 cases, about 40% of Czechia's total, with 11 deaths as of 3 November.
items.description_zh: 捷克首都布拉疫情嚴峻,今年截至11/3累計報告939例病例,約佔該國所有感染病例之40%,病例數為去年(37例)25倍,其中11例死亡,尤以弱勢族群之傳播風險為高;當局表示該國民眾疫苗接種人次為去年2倍,並持續因應疫情調整接種措施。
items.description_en: The Czech capital, Prague, has a severe outbreak: as of 3 November this year, 939 cases had been reported cumulatively, about 40% of all cases in the country and 25 times last year's total of 37 cases, including 11 deaths. The transmission risk is especially high among vulnerable groups. Authorities say the number of vaccine doses administered in the country this year is twice last year's, and they continue to adjust vaccination measures in response to the outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 南非茨瓦內市11/3報告13例傷寒,多為15歲以下,正進行水質檢測
items.summary_en: Tshwane, South Africa, reported 13 typhoid cases on 3 November, mostly under age 15, while water testing is under way.
items.description_zh: 南非共和國北部茨瓦內市(Tshwane)於11/3報告13例病例,病患年齡多小於15歲,當局正進行水質檢測,以釐清感染源;另該國每年約報告150例確定病例。
items.description_en: Tshwane, a city in the north of the Republic of South Africa, reported 13 cases on 3 November; most patients are under 15 years old. Authorities are testing water quality to identify the source of infection. The country typically reports about 150 confirmed cases each year.

items.summary_zh: 哈薩克南部突厥斯坦州1例炭疽病例,源自違規私人屠宰場
items.summary_en: Kazakhstan's Turkistan region reported one anthrax case, traced to an unhygienic private slaughterhouse; all contacts tested negative.
items.description_zh: 哈薩克南部突厥斯坦州報告1例炭疽病例,病患曾接觸並食用感染動物,醫院治療中,接觸者檢驗皆呈陰性,當局表示本案源自私人屠宰場於宰殺牛隻時,違反衛生相關規定,已公告民眾應至有獸醫認證標誌之官方銷售點購買肉品。
items.description_en: One anthrax case was reported in the Turkistan region of southern Kazakhstan. The patient had handled and eaten an infected animal and is being treated in hospital; all tests on contacts were negative. Authorities say the case originated from a private slaughterhouse that violated hygiene regulations when slaughtering cattle. The public has been advised to buy meat only at official sales points that carry a veterinary certification mark.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦今年截至11/4阿米巴腦膜腦炎160例,36例死亡
items.summary_en: Kerala, India, has recorded 160 confirmed amoebic meningoencephalitis cases and 36 deaths this year as of 4 November, a CFR of 22.5%.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至11/4累計報告160例確定病例,其中36例死亡(CFR:22.5%),10月單月新增65例病例及12例死亡病例,其中以特拉凡德倫(Thiruvananthapuram)地區病例數48例為多,當局表示病原體存在於受污染之水源(如池塘和湖泊)中,可透過開放性傷口或鼻腔進入人體,警告年長及免疫功能低下者勿使用受污染之水清洗傷口或腳,另提醒民眾於季風後接觸未經處理之水源時,應保持警覺及遵守個人衛生。
items.description_en: Kerala state, India: As of 4 November this year, 160 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, including 36 deaths (CFR 22.5%). In October alone, 65 new cases and 12 deaths were reported, with the most cases, 48, in the Thiruvananthapuram area. Authorities say the pathogen is present in contaminated water sources such as ponds and lakes and can enter the body through open wounds or the nasal cavity. They warn older people and people with weakened immune systems not to use contaminated water to clean wounds or feet, and remind people to stay alert and maintain personal hygiene when contacting untreated water sources after the monsoon.

items.summary_zh: 特拉維夫2名醫師感染麻疹,以色列今年累計1,778例
items.summary_en: Two physicians in Tel Aviv were infected with measles while treating an unvaccinated girl; Israel has 1,778 cases this year, including 8 deaths.
items.description_zh: 以色列報告台拉維夫市2名醫師因治療1名未接種疫苗女童受到感染,目前醫師皆已被隔離,身體狀況良好且都有接種疫苗,相關接觸者均已接受預防性治療,刻正進行流行病學調查,該國今年迄今報告1,778例,其中8例死亡。
items.description_en: Israel reported that two physicians in Tel Aviv were infected while treating an unvaccinated girl. Both physicians are now in isolation; they are in good condition and both had been vaccinated. All close contacts have received preventive treatment, and an epidemiological investigation is under way. So far this year, Israel has reported 1,778 cases, including 8 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 阿根廷百日咳截至第42週逾3,500例疑病例,較去年上升3倍
items.summary_en: Argentina's pertussis cases exceeded 3,500 suspected by week 42, up threefold from last year, and Japan reported over 82,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷近期疫情上升,今年截至第42週(10/13-19)報告超過3,500例疑病例,其中382例確診及4例死亡,病例數較去年上升3倍,發病率以南部火地省為最高,其次為首都布宜諾斯艾利斯(布市),約41.6%病例為1歲以下兒童。另火地省首府烏蘇懷亞疫情持續,已報告171例,其中66例確診,該地發病率(23.6例)為首都布市(1.6例)的15倍。 日本今年截至10/19累計報告逾8.2萬例,為2018年以來最高,該國自今年4月起持續進行抗藥性細菌分子檢驗,迄今於24間醫療機構35名病患調查結果,顯示超過80%病患檢出抗藥性菌株。
items.description_en: Argentina's outbreak is rising. As of week 42 (13–19 October) this year, more than 3,500 suspected cases had been reported, including 382 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, and case numbers are up threefold from last year. Incidence is highest in the southern province of Tierra del Fuego, followed by the capital, Buenos Aires city. About 41.6% of cases are children under one year old. In addition, the outbreak in Ushuaia, the capital of Tierra del Fuego province, continues: 171 cases have been reported, of which 66 were confirmed, and the incidence there (23.6 cases) is 15 times that of Buenos Aires city (1.6 cases). Japan reported more than 82,000 cases cumulatively as of 19 October this year, the highest since 2018. Since April this year, Japan has continued molecular testing of antimicrobial-resistant bacteria; investigations of 35 patients at 24 medical institutions to date show that more than 80% of patients had resistant strains detected.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲流感逾42萬例、265死亡,死亡數為2020年來首超新冠
items.summary_en: Australia's flu deaths (265 by August) exceeded COVID-19 deaths for the first time since February 2020, with over 420,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情嚴峻,今年累計報告逾42萬例,截至今年8月死亡265例,為2020年2月以來首次流感死亡數高於新冠死亡數。自6月下旬到8月中旬經歷長期高峰期,疫情下降速度較前幾季慢。病例超過10%為5歲以下兒童,該國今年疫苗接種率低,約為30.6%,僅約25%之5歲以下兒童接種疫苗,老年族群接種率亦下降。 日本疫情持續上升,第43週定點門診平均病例數例為6.29例,較前1週增加1.9倍,以沖繩縣19.4例為多,另東京/千葉/埼玉/神奈川等4個都縣平均病例數超過10例,全國共44個都道府縣病例數皆較前1週增加,當局表示將持續監測疫情,以應對疫情蔓延,並呼籲民眾採取個人防護並接種疫苗。 香港持續處高點,近1週(10/19-25)陽性率為12.01%,近期檢出以A(H3)為主,佔病毒檢出率近90%,另校園群聚事件通報仍處高點,自9月開學迄10/29,報告693件校園群聚,並報告16起兒童重症個案,其中1例死亡。另近期汙水病毒監測將涵蓋季節性流感病毒,以作為傳統監測系統之補充指標。
items.description_en: Australia's outbreak is severe: more than 420,000 cases have been reported this year, and 265 deaths as of August this year. This is the first time since February 2020 that influenza deaths have exceeded COVID-19 deaths. A prolonged peak lasted from late June to mid-August, and the rate of decline is slower than in previous seasons. Over 10% of cases are children under 5 years old. Vaccination coverage in the country this year is low, at about 30.6%; only about 25% of children under 5 have been vaccinated, and vaccination rates among the elderly have also declined. Japan: The outbreak continues to rise. In week 43, the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 6.29, an increase of 1.9-fold from the previous week, with the highest figure, 19.4, in Okinawa Prefecture. Tokyo, Chiba, Saitama and Kanagawa had averages above 10 cases, and case numbers rose from the previous week in all 44 prefectures. Authorities say they will continue monitoring the outbreak to respond to its spread and urge people to take personal protective measures and get vaccinated. Hong Kong remains at a high level: positivity in the past week (19–25 October) was 12.01%. The recently detected strain is mainly A(H3), accounting for nearly 90% of virus detections. School cluster reports also remain at a high level: from the start of the school term in September to 29 October, 693 school clusters were reported, along with 16 severe paediatric cases, including one death. Wastewater virus surveillance will also now cover seasonal influenza viruses as a supplementary indicator to the traditional surveillance system.

items.headline_zh: 塞內加爾/茅利塔尼亞-裂谷熱
items.summary_zh: 塞內加爾裂谷熱累計381例、29例死亡,茅利塔尼亞176例
items.summary_en: Senegal has 381 cumulative Rift Valley fever cases and 29 deaths since September, while Mauritania reports 176 cases and 14 deaths.
items.description_zh: 塞內加爾疫情更新,自9月疫情爆發迄今累計381例病例(312例已康復)及29例死亡(致死率7.6%),分布於該國9個地區,病例數以該國西北部聖路易區294例為多。 茅利塔亞疫情更新,今年迄今累計176例病例(42例確診)及14例死亡(致死率7.95%),分布於該國11個地區。
items.description_en: Senegal update: Since the outbreak began in September, 381 cases (312 recovered) and 29 deaths (case fatality rate 7.6%) have been reported cumulatively, distributed across nine regions of the country. Of these, 294 cases were in the Saint-Louis region in the north-west. Mauritania update: This year to date, 176 cases (42 confirmed) and 14 deaths (case fatality rate 7.95%) have been reported cumulatively, distributed across 11 regions of the country.

items.summary_zh: 巴西聖卡塔琳娜州今年累計25,371例疑病例、20例死亡,DENV-3上升
items.summary_en: Brazil's Santa Catarina state has 25,371 suspected dengue cases and 20 deaths this year, with DENV-3 cases rising sharply.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,該國南部聖卡塔琳娜州今年DENV-3血清型別病例數明顯上升,該州今年迄今累計報告25,371例疑病例(17,859例確診)及20例死亡,9月報告疑病例數較前1個月增加230%,當局提醒未來幾週為高溫降雨天氣,預期病例數將會上升。
items.description_en: Brazil update: In the southern state of Santa Catarina, cases of the DENV-3 serotype have risen markedly this year. So far this year, the state has reported 25,371 cumulative suspected cases (17,859 confirmed) and 20 deaths. Suspected cases reported in September rose 230% from the previous month. Authorities warn that the coming weeks will bring high temperatures and rainfall, and case numbers are expected to rise.

items.summary_zh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增259例、較前週868例大降,香港累計54例
items.summary_en: Guangdong's chikungunya cases fell to 259 in the past week from 868 the week before, while Hong Kong has reported 54 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情持續下降,近1週(10/26-11/1)新增259例病例,主要分布於佛山市51例、深圳市48例、江門市44例及廣州市37例,皆為輕症,無報告重症及死亡病例,近1週新增病例數較前1週868例明顯下降;香港今年迄今累計54例病例,其中2例本土及52例移入病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues to decline. In the past week (26 October–1 November), 259 new cases were reported, mainly in Foshan (51), Shenzhen (48), Jiangmen (44) and Guangzhou (37). All were mild, and no severe or fatal cases have been reported. New cases in the past week fell markedly from 868 the previous week. Hong Kong has reported 54 cases cumulatively this year, including 2 locally acquired cases and 52 imported cases.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年逾4.8萬例,6國報告無旅遊史的本土Ib型病例
items.summary_en: WHO reports over 48,000 Mpox cases this year; six countries outside Central and East Africa report locally acquired cases with no travel history or known contact.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  自2022年5月截至今年10/31累計142國/地區報告16萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少446例死亡(CFR:0.26%)。 今年截至第44週累計98國/地區報告4萬8千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區4萬餘例、美洲區3,653例、歐洲區2,290例、西太平洋區1,355例、東南亞區118例及東地中海區44例。非洲、美洲、西太平洋、中東疫情下降;惟歐洲、東南亞病例數上升。  其他更新:  WHO公布自9/5截至10月中旬,除中/東非外,新增5區署21例Ib型病例(未詳列),其中9例無疫區旅遊史,至少5例為MSM族群。 馬來西亞/納米比亞/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙首次報告Ib型病例。 比利時/德國/義大利/西班牙/卡達/加拿大報告旅遊相關的境外移入Ib型病例,曾前往馬來西亞/烏干達/安哥拉/肯亞/坦尚亞/黎巴嫩/中東等疫區。 在中非及東非外國家,6國(義大利/荷蘭/西班牙/葡萄牙/美國/馬來西亞)報告無旅遊史或已知病例接觸史之本土病例,顯示已有未發現的社區傳播鏈。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注之公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源不足,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。此次報告與2022年前期階段相,為透過MSM族群迅速傳播,且有新世代尚未施打疫苗,亦未曾感染過疾病,形成免疫缺口。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,但對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 31 October this year, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 169,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 446 died (CFR 0.26%). Year to date as of week 44, 98 countries and areas have reported more than 48,000 confirmed cases: more than 40,000 in the African Region, 3,653 in the Region of the Americas, 2,290 in the European Region, 1,355 in the Western Pacific Region, 118 in the South-East Asia Region and 44 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have declined in Africa, the Americas, the Western Pacific and the Middle East, but risen in Europe and South-East Asia. Other updates: WHO reported that from 5 September to mid-October, excluding Central and East Africa, 21 clade Ib cases were newly reported across five WHO regions (details not listed), of which nine had no travel history to affected areas and at least five were in the MSM population. Malaysia, Namibia, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain reported clade Ib cases for the first time. Belgium, Germany, Italy, Spain, Qatar and Canada reported travel-associated imported clade Ib cases, with travel to affected areas including Malaysia, Uganda, Angola, Kenya, Tanzania, Lebanon and the Middle East. In countries outside Central and East Africa, six countries (Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, the United States and Malaysia) reported locally acquired cases with no travel history or known contact with a case, indicating undetected community transmission chains. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are inadequate, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because cases among asymptomatic infected people and travellers from affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as clade Ib community transmission areas. This report resembles the early phase of 2022, with rapid spread through the MSM population, and a new generation that has not been vaccinated and has never been infected, creating an immunity gap. The assessed risk to the general public is low, but moderate for MSM, especially those without a stable sexual partner. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete contact tracing, and high-risk individuals are urged to get vaccinated.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染,美國研究發現18例無症狀H5N1感染
items.summary_en: No new human novel influenza A infections were reported this week; a US CDC study found 18 asymptomatic human H5N1 infections.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共22國於2025/10/23-2025/10/31期間報告137起H5N1疫情,荷蘭31起、德國22起、英國18起、法國15起、加拿大10起、比利時7起、義大利5起、波蘭/瑞典各4起、丹麥/奧地利/日本各3起、挪威/立陶宛各2起、以色列/保加利亞/匈牙利/韓國/奈及利亞/愛爾蘭/斯洛維亞/芬蘭各1起。 挪威於 2025/10/27報告5起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,081(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西州、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC研究人員近期發表關於檢視截至今年8/25前所有已公開人類感染H5N1流感病例之研究報告,發現目前記錄18例無症狀感染病例,多數為接觸者追蹤中以分子檢驗所發現,人類無症狀H5N1流感感染的報告極為罕見,多數來自於針對已知暴露者的加強監測或接觸者追蹤。該研究建議未來應針對可能之無症狀感染者進行更完整的資料收集,以支援公共衛生決策與防疫應變。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感29例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H9N2流感28例(迄今累計158例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計65國家/地區通報2,748起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 22 countries reported 137 H5N1 outbreaks between 23 and 31 October 2025: Netherlands 31, Germany 22, United Kingdom 18, France 15, Canada 10, Belgium 7, Italy 5, Poland and Sweden 4 each, Denmark, Austria and Japan 3 each, Norway and Lithuania 2 each, and Israel, Bulgaria, Hungary, South Korea, Nigeria, Ireland, Slovenia and Finland 1 each. Norway reported 5 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 27 October 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,081 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Other updates: US CDC researchers recently published a study reviewing all publicly reported human H5N1 infection cases up to 25 August this year. The study found 18 asymptomatic infections on record; most were identified by molecular testing during contact tracing. Reports of asymptomatic human H5N1 infection are extremely rare and mostly come from enhanced surveillance or contact tracing of known exposures. The study recommends more complete data collection on possible asymptomatic infections in the future to support public health decision-making and outbreak response. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 29 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 28 H9N2 influenza (158 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 65 countries and areas have reported 2,748 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率13.52%(第41週)上升,英日韓泰疫情下降
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity rose to 13.52% in week 41, with the Western Pacific, Europe and Africa increasing, while the UK, Japan, South Korea and Thailand declined.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第41週(10/6-12)全球陽性率13.52%,其中,西太平洋、歐洲及非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第42週定醫平均報告數2.57,已連續5週下降,分布以東京都、琦玉縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈波動下降趨勢,第41週陽性率16.32%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 泰國疫情處低點,第43週新增426例病例,較前一週下降30%。 英國疫情下降,第42週新增1,935例住院病例,住院陽性率10.3%,較前2週高峰為低,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,西太平洋、歐洲、及非洲呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 41 of 2025 (6–12 October) was 13.52%, with positivity increasing in the Western Pacific, European and African regional offices. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 42, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 2.57, having declined for five consecutive weeks; cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Saitama prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak shows a fluctuating downward trend. The positivity rate in week 41 was 16.32%, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Thailand: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 43, 426 new cases were reported, a 30% decrease from the previous week. United Kingdom: The outbreak is declining. In week 42, 1,935 new hospitalized cases were reported, with a hospital positivity rate of 10.3%, lower than the peak two weeks earlier; the variant XFG has the highest share. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in the Western Pacific, Europe and Africa. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_en: Emilia-Romagna in northern Italy has reported over 50 Salmonella cases, 19 confirmed, with the source under investigation.
items.description_zh: 義大利北部艾米利亞羅馬涅區(Emilia Romagna)10/29報告逾50例病例(含疑),其中19例確診、3例住院,感染源調查中。另該國自2023年迄今累積報告逾100例病例,主要感染源為產自西西里之番茄。
items.description_en: In Emilia-Romagna in northern Italy, more than 50 cases (including suspected cases) had been reported as of 29 October, of which 19 were confirmed and 3 were hospitalized; the source of infection is under investigation. The country has also reported more than 100 cases cumulatively since 2023, and the main source of infection is tomatoes produced in Sicily.
