items.summary_zh: 德國腸出血性大腸桿菌逾350例,48名兒童併發HUS,2例死亡
items.summary_en: Germany has reported over 350 EHEC cases since mid-August, with 48 children developing haemolytic uraemic syndrome and 2 deaths.
items.description_zh: 德國疫情更新,自8月中旬截至10/27累計報告逾350例,其中48例出現溶血性尿毒症候群,且均為兒童,已有2例死亡;病患年齡中位數為4歲,多居住於北部及西部,型別為該國罕見的O45:H2。當局表示,本次疫情為2011年以來次高,感染源調查中。
items.description_en: Germany update: Since mid-August and as of 27 October, more than 350 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 48 developed haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS), all in children, and 2 deaths have been reported. The median patient age is 4 years. Most patients live in the north and west of the country, and the serotype is O45:H2, which is rare in Germany. Authorities say this outbreak is the second-largest since 2011, and the source of infection is under investigation.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 斐濟/菲律賓/巴布亞紐幾內亞/印度-人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
items.headline_en: Fiji / Philippines / Papua New Guinea / India – HIV infection
items.summary_zh: 愛滋病:斐濟、菲律賓等病例急增,印度一醫院輸血感染5名兒童
items.summary_en: HIV cases are surging in Fiji and the Philippines, and five children at an Indian hospital were infected through blood transfusions.
items.description_zh: WHO西太平洋區3國病例數急遽增加,斐濟過去10年新增感染病例上升10倍,主要感染途徑為注射毒品,另有傳播至其他太平洋島國之疑慮;菲律賓自2010-24年新增感染病例增加6倍,主要感染族群為男男性行為者;巴布亞紐幾內亞宣布愛滋病毒感染為國家危機,以應對育齡婦女和兒童族群不斷上升之感染率。WHO及聯合國已召開會議,以因應該區愛滋病危機,並探討解決行動方案。 印度東部賈坎德邦柴巴薩市某醫院於10月爆發5名地中海貧血兒童,經輸血感染愛滋病毒事件,首例於9/13接受輸血,5週後(10/18)檢測陽性,經調查5名病患血型不相同,顯示為多名捐血者血液遭汙染,感染源調查中,另該院血庫與實驗室有多項違規事項,當局已宣布該院血庫僅提供緊急情況使用。
items.description_en: WHO's Western Pacific Region reports sharp increases in case numbers in three countries. In Fiji, new HIV infections have risen tenfold over the past 10 years, mainly through injecting drug use, and there are concerns about spread to other Pacific island countries. In the Philippines, new infections increased sixfold between 2010 and 2024, mainly among men who have sex with men. Papua New Guinea has declared HIV a national crisis to respond to rising infection rates among women of reproductive age and children. WHO and the United Nations have convened meetings to address the regional HIV crisis and discuss action plans. In India, at a hospital in Chaibasa city, Jharkhand state in eastern India, five children with thalassaemia were infected with HIV through blood transfusions in October. The first child received a transfusion on 13 September and tested positive five weeks later, on 18 October. Investigation found that the five patients had different blood types, indicating that blood from several donors was contaminated. The source of infection is under investigation. The hospital's blood bank and laboratory were found to have multiple violations, and authorities have announced that the hospital's blood bank will only provide blood for emergencies.
items.area_zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞,菲律賓,斐濟

items.summary_zh: 秘魯報告6例皮膚炭疽病例,病患皆曾接觸感染動物,已啟動動物疫苗接種
items.summary_en: Peru reported six cutaneous anthrax cases, all in people who had contact with infected animals, and launched animal vaccination.
items.description_zh: 秘魯報告6例皮膚炭疽病例,病患皆有接觸感染動物,當局已啟動動物疫苗接種等防治措施,並提醒民眾倘於接觸感染動物後,出現皮膚病變(如潰瘍、黑痂等),應立即就醫治療。另倘發現有因炭疽病死亡之動物,應深埋兩公尺且不得翻動或挖掘,並通報當地衛生局或醫療機構。
items.description_en: Peru reported six cases of cutaneous anthrax, all in people who had contact with infected animals. Authorities have launched prevention and control measures, including animal vaccination, and remind people that if skin lesions (such as ulcers or black eschars) appear after contact with infected animals, they should seek medical treatment immediately. In addition, if an animal is found to have died of anthrax, it should be buried at a depth of two metres without being turned over or dug up, and the death should be reported to the local health bureau or medical institution.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦今年截至10/25阿米巴腦膜腦炎149例,30例死亡
items.summary_en: Kerala, India, has recorded 149 confirmed amoebic meningoencephalitis cases and 30 deaths as of 25 October, with 56 new cases in October.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至10/25累計報告149例確定病例,其中30例死亡(CFR:20%),10月單月新增56例病例及9例死亡病例,當局表示疾病監測/診斷能力提升致病例數上升,該國其他邦之多數腦炎病因仍未確定,惟井水、未清理之水塔、污染池塘與河川中皆檢測出阿米巴原蟲,已啟動環境污染源及傳播途徑之田野調查。
items.description_en: Kerala state, India: As of 25 October this year, 149 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, including 30 deaths (CFR 20%). In October alone, 56 new cases and 9 deaths were reported. Authorities say that improved disease surveillance and diagnostic capacity have contributed to the rise in cases. In other states of the country, the causes of most encephalitis cases remain undetermined, but amoebae have been detected in well water, uncleaned water tanks, and contaminated ponds and rivers. A field investigation into environmental pollution sources and transmission routes has been launched.

items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州1例狂犬病死亡,患者曾處理未接種疫苗寵物狗屍體
items.summary_en: Sarawak, Malaysia, reported a rabies death in a 51-year-old man who had handled an unvaccinated pet dog's carcass, with no known bite.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州報告1例死亡病例,為51歲男性,未曾被動物抓咬傷,僅於今(2025)年6月處理過未接種疫苗之寵物狗屍體,病患於10/8起陸續出現發燒、手部麻木及關節痛等症狀,9日至診所就醫,18日出現虛弱及脫水現象,經實驗室確診。該州今年累計報告6例死亡病例,當局表示67.5%之咬傷事件來自家中寵物,提醒寵物應每年接種疫苗,倘被犬/貓/寵物抓咬傷,應立即以清水及肥皂清洗傷口至少15分鐘,並立即就醫,如發現犬/貓/動物死亡,勿自行處理,應向當地政府通報。
items.description_en: Sarawak state, Malaysia, reported one death: a 51-year-old man with no known animal bites or scratches, who had handled the carcass of an unvaccinated pet dog in June this year. He began having fever, hand numbness and joint pain from 8 October, visited a clinic on the 9th, and on the 18th developed weakness and dehydration. Laboratory testing confirmed rabies. So far this year, the state has reported six deaths. Authorities say 67.5% of bite incidents involve pets at home, and remind owners to vaccinate pets every year. If a person is bitten or scratched by a dog, cat or other pet, the wound should be washed with clean water and soap for at least 15 minutes and medical care sought immediately. If a dead dog, cat or other animal is found, do not handle it yourself; report it to the local government.

items.summary_zh: 阿根廷火地島省首府烏蘇懷亞135例疑病例、58例確診,已知3條傳播鏈
items.summary_en: Ushuaia, the provincial capital of Tierra del Fuego, has 135 suspected and 58 confirmed pertussis cases, with three known transmission chains.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷南部火地島省爆發疫情,該省首府烏蘇懷亞報告135例疑病例及58例確診病例,另有逾700名接觸者,最近1例報告病例為10/3發病,目前已知有3條傳播鏈,多數病例為成年人,目前當局已進行監測及防護措施。另該國今年迄今報告333例確診病例,超過2021-24年同期病例數,主要分布於中部地區。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in Tierra del Fuego province in southern Argentina. Its provincial capital, Ushuaia, has reported 135 suspected cases and 58 confirmed cases, and more than 700 contacts have been identified. The most recently reported case had onset on 3 October. Three transmission chains are currently known, and most cases are adults. Authorities have implemented surveillance and protective measures. In addition, Argentina has reported 333 confirmed cases so far this year, exceeding the same period in 2021–24, mainly in the central part of the country.

items.summary_zh: 美國猶他州、亞利桑那州麻疹累計123例,以色列今年8例死亡
items.summary_en: Measles in Utah and Arizona has reached 123 confirmed cases, mostly unvaccinated children; Israel has recorded eight deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 美國猶他州/亞利桑那州疫情擴大,截至10月下旬累計報告123例確診病例,多集中於猶他州赫利戴爾(Hildale)及亞利桑那州科羅拉多市(Colorado),多數病患為未接種疫苗之學齡兒童,該地區疫苗覆蓋率不到95%,迄今至少8例住院,無死亡案例,此波疫情為該國今年第2大群聚事件。 以色列新增1例併發症之死亡病例,為未接種疫苗之2歲半幼兒,且為該國今年第8例死亡病例,另該國南部報告1例重症個案,為6歲半且未接種疫苗兒童,目前仍使用呼吸器治療中。該國今年累計報告1,778例,其中574例住院,目前當局於疫情地區推展疫苗接種活動,除將第2劑疫苗提前至1歲半接種外(原為6歲),並建議居住或前往疫情地區之6-11個月大嬰兒應額外接種疫苗。
items.description_en: United States: The outbreak in Utah and Arizona has expanded. As of late October, 123 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mostly in Hildale, Utah, and Colorado City, Arizona. Most patients are unvaccinated school-age children, and vaccination coverage in the area is below 95%. At least 8 patients have been hospitalized and there have been no deaths. This outbreak is the country's second-largest cluster this year. Israel: One new death from complications was reported, in an unvaccinated two-and-a-half-year-old child, the country's eighth death this year. In addition, one severe case was reported in southern Israel, an unvaccinated six-and-a-half-year-old child who remains on a ventilator. Israel has reported 1,778 cases this year, including 574 hospitalizations. In the affected areas, authorities are carrying out vaccination activities: in addition to moving the second dose forward to 18 months of age (originally six years), they recommend that infants aged 6–11 months living in or travelling to affected areas receive an additional dose.

items.summary_zh: 香港流感陽性率11.84%、A(H3N2)近90%,東京71所學校停課
items.summary_en: Hong Kong's flu positivity reached 11.84% with A(H3N2) at nearly 90% of detections, while 71 Tokyo schools had suspended classes by 19 October.
items.description_zh: 中國第43週(10/20-26)監測顯示,南/北方活動度及陽性率皆呈上升趨勢,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),專家表示近期氣溫驟降,進入呼吸道疾病流行季節,鄰近國家近期已提前進入流感季,評估11月下旬至12月中旬為流感高峰期。 香港處夏季流感季高峰,第42週(10/12-18)流感陽性率為11.84%,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),佔整體病毒檢出率近90%,另校園群聚事件持續上升,截至10/22累計報告608件,另今年9月開學迄今累計14例兒童流感重症個案,其中1例死亡,年齡介於2-17歲間。 日本第42週定點門診平均病例數例為3.26例,較前1週增加1.4倍,病例以沖繩縣15.04例為多,全國37個都道府縣病例數增加,另東京都截至10/19共71所學校停課,為去年同期之6倍以上。
items.description_en: China: Week 43 (20–26 October) surveillance shows activity and positivity rates rising in both the south and the north, with A(H3N2) as the main circulating type. Experts say temperatures have dropped sharply recently, marking the start of the respiratory disease season. Neighbouring countries have recently entered their flu seasons early, and the influenza peak is expected between late November and mid-December. Hong Kong is at its summer flu-season peak: the positivity rate in week 42 (12–18 October) was 11.84%, with A(H3N2) as the main type, accounting for nearly 90% of total virus detections. School cluster reports continue to rise, with 608 reported cumulatively as of 22 October. Since school started in September, 14 severe paediatric influenza cases have been reported cumulatively, including one death, with patients aged between 2 and 17. Japan: The average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic in week 42 was 3.26, an increase of 1.4-fold from the previous week. The highest figure was 15.04 in Okinawa Prefecture. Case numbers increased in 37 prefectures nationwide. In Tokyo, 71 schools had suspended classes as of 19 October, more than six times the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本

items.headline_en: Europe / United States – West Nile fever
items.summary_zh: 歐洲今年14國逾1,000例西尼羅熱本土病例,63例死亡,義大利714例
items.summary_en: ECDC reports over 1,000 locally acquired West Nile cases in 14 European countries this year, with 63 deaths, mostly in Italy (714).
items.description_zh: 歐洲疾病預防與控制中心(ECDC)公布今年迄今累計14國,通報逾1,000例本土病例,其中,63例死亡,以義大利(714例)最多,其次為希臘。另德國於2019-24年間每年約4-35例本地病例,大部分來自該國東部地區,惟近期於南部巴伐利亞邦亦報告自2019年以來首例病例,當局提醒至當地參加啤酒節活動之旅客應注意防範蚊蟲叮咬措施。 美國洛杉磯郡報告今年首例死亡病例,個案為聖費爾南多谷地區之居民,因感染後引起神經系統疾病住院並死亡,該郡迄今共通報14例病例,50%感染者居住在聖費爾南多谷地區,當地蚊媒高峰期自6月持續到11月。
items.description_en: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) reports that so far this year, 14 countries have reported more than 1,000 locally acquired cases, of which 63 died, with Italy (714 cases) the most affected, followed by Greece. Germany reported about 4–35 locally acquired cases per year in 2019–24, mostly from the east of the country. Recently, however, it has also reported its first case since 2019 in the southern state of Bavaria, and authorities remind travellers attending beer festival events in the area to take precautions against mosquito bites. United States: Los Angeles County reported its first death of the year, a resident of the San Fernando Valley who was hospitalized and died after developing a neurological disease following infection. The county has reported 14 cases so far, and 50% of those infected live in the San Fernando Valley. The local mosquito peak season runs from June through November.

items.summary_zh: 巴拿馬奧羅普切熱累計逾600例,達連省逾300例,1例母嬰垂直感染
items.summary_en: Panama has reported over 600 Oropouche fever cases across seven regions, including 300-plus in Darién, and one mother-to-child transmission.
items.description_zh: 巴拿馬迄今累計600餘例病例,已於7地區傳播,病例主要分布於東部達連省300餘例,該國亦報告1例母子垂直感染病例,當局持續加強相關監測措施。
items.description_en: Panama has reported a cumulative total of more than 600 cases, which have spread to seven regions. Most cases, more than 300, are in Darién province in the east. The country has also reported one case of mother-to-child (vertical) transmission. Authorities continue to strengthen related surveillance measures.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年累計逾6.5萬例登革熱、200餘例死亡,奎松市8,729例
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has recorded about 65,000 dengue cases and over 200 deaths this year, while Quezon City, Philippines, reports 8,729 cases.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,近1日新增1,143例住院病例,主要分布於該國中部達卡專區282例,10月已報告18,098例病例,今年迄今累計約65,000餘例病例及200餘例死亡。 菲律賓奎松市今年截至10/7累計8,729例病例及30例死亡,病例主要分布於10歲以下兒童(4,235例),病例數較去年同期(4,581例)增加91%。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's outbreak is rising. In the past day, 1,143 new hospitalized cases were reported, with 282 in Dhaka division in central Bangladesh. In October, 18,098 cases were reported, and year to date about 65,000 cases and more than 200 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with the main concentration in Dhaka division. Philippines: Quezon City reported 8,729 cases and 30 deaths cumulatively this year as of 7 October. Cases are mainly among children under 10 years old (4,235 cases), and the number of cases is 91% higher than the same period last year (4,581 cases).

items.summary_zh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增868例,江門終止三級應變;巴西庫亞巴10,978例
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 868 chikungunya cases in the past week, with Jiangmen ending its Level III response, while Cuiabá, Brazil, has 10,978 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情呈波動下降趨勢,近1週(10/19-25)新增868例病例,以江門市199例最多,其次為佛山市130例及廣州市124例,無報告重症及死亡病例,該省近期仍處病媒蚊活躍期,持續有疫情傳播風險,江門市於10/25宣布終止突發公共衛生事件三級響應;香港報告今年首例本土病例,今年迄今累計46例移入病例。 巴西疫情更新,馬托羅索州庫亞巴今年迄今累計10,978例確診病例及27例死亡,疫情仍為該城市重要公共衛生議題。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak shows a fluctuating downward trend. In the past week (19–25 October), 868 new cases were reported, the most in Jiangmen city (199), followed by Foshan (130) and Guangzhou (124). No severe or fatal cases were reported. The province remains in the active season for disease-carrying mosquitoes, and there is an ongoing risk of transmission. Jiangmen City announced the termination of its Level III public health emergency response on 25 October. Hong Kong reported its first locally acquired case this year; so far this year, 46 imported cases have been reported cumulatively. Brazil update: In Cuiabá, the capital of Mato Grosso state, 10,978 confirmed cases and 27 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year. The outbreak remains an important public health issue for the city.
items.area_zh: 巴西,中國大陸(不含港澳)

items.summary_zh: 香港今年截至10/22累計42例屈公病確診,均為移入,1名77歲男性死亡
items.summary_en: Hong Kong has reported 42 confirmed chikungunya cases this year as of 22 October, all imported, including one death in a 77-year-old man.
items.description_zh: 香港疫情更新,今年截至10/22累計42例確診病例,均為移入病例,其中1名77歲有慢性病史男性個案,9/30-10/13有廣東省廣州市旅遊史,10/13出現發燒及關節痛,14日出現皮疹,入院治療後病情惡化,於22日死亡。
items.description_en: Hong Kong update: As of 22 October this year, 42 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, all imported. One case was a 77-year-old man with a chronic illness who had travelled to Guangzhou, Guangdong, from 30 September to 13 October. He developed fever and joint pain on 13 October and a rash on 14 October. His condition deteriorated after admission for treatment, and he died on 22 October.

items.headline_zh: 捷克-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 捷克布拉今年截至10/15累計826例A型肝炎,10例死亡
items.summary_en: Prague, Czechia, has reported 826 hepatitis A cases and 10 deaths as of 15 October; nationally, cases are four times last year's level and the second-worst since 1989.
items.description_zh: 捷克布拉今年截至10/15累計報告826例病例,其中10例死亡;另該國今年截至9月累計報告逾1,500例病例,為去年同期4倍,且為1989年以來第2嚴重之疫情。
items.description_en: Prague, Czechia: As of 15 October this year, 826 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 10 deaths. Separately, the country had reported more than 1,500 cases cumulatively as of September this year, four times the same period last year, making it the second most severe outbreak since 1989.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 加拿大31例沙門氏菌感染,疑為寵物飼料,12-72小時發病
items.summary_en: Canada reported 31 Salmonella cases in four provinces, with many illnesses after hand-feeding dog food; a manufacturer's pet food is suspected.
items.description_zh: 加拿大於10/17報告31例病例,分布於4個省份,介於2-9月發病;經調查,許多病患係用手餵狗吃飼料後12-72小時發病,疑感染源為某製造商生產之豬肉/牛肉/雞肉飼料,當局呼籲民眾餵食完寵物後應洗手,並妥善保存飼料。
items.description_en: Canada reported 31 cases on 17 October, distributed across four provinces, with onset between February and September. Investigation found that many patients became ill 12–72 hours after hand-feeding dog food. The suspected source is pork, beef and chicken pet food produced by a certain manufacturer. Authorities urge people to wash their hands after feeding pets and to store pet food properly.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國新增4例H9N2、柬埔寨1例H5N1人類感染,德國禽流感28起
items.summary_en: This week China reported four human H9N2 infections and Cambodia one human H5N1 infection, while Germany reported 28 H5N1 animal outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週中國新增4例H9N2流感人類感染病例,柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共23國於2025/10/17-24期間報告121起H5N1疫情,德國28起、美國25起、南喬治亞和南桑威奇群島11起、丹麥/比利時 各7起、南非6起、西班牙5起、波蘭4起、柬埔寨/立陶宛/英國各3起、加拿大/奧地利/捷克/斯洛伐克/法國/盧森堡/義大利各2起、伊拉克/匈牙利/日本/荷蘭/葡萄牙各1起。 加拿大於 2025/10/24期間報告1起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,081(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西州、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感29例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H9N2流感28例(迄今累計158例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計64國家/地區通報2,606起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week China reported 4 new human H9N2 influenza infections, and Cambodia reported 1 new human H5N1 influenza infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 23 countries reported 121 H5N1 outbreaks between 17 and 24 October 2025: Germany 28, United States 25, South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands 11, Denmark and Belgium 7 each, South Africa 6, Spain 5, Poland 4, Cambodia, Lithuania and United Kingdom 3 each, Canada, Austria, Czechia, Slovakia, France, Luxembourg and Italy 2 each, and Iraq, Hungary, Japan, Netherlands and Portugal 1 each. Canada reported one H5N5 outbreak during the period of 24 October 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,081 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 29 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 28 H9N2 influenza (158 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 64 countries and areas have reported 2,606 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.
items.area_zh: 柬埔寨,中國大陸(不含港澳)

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率14.84%(第40週),歐非區署上升,日本、韓國下降
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 14.84% in week 40, rising in the European and African regional offices while Japan and South Korea declined.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第40週(9/29-10/5)全球陽性率14.84%,其中,歐洲及非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第41週定醫平均報告數3.72,已連續4週下降,住院數亦呈下降趨勢,病患地理分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情下降,第40週陽性率12.61%,較9月初高峰(38.95%)已明顯下降,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 美洲疫情上升,第40週整體陽性率增至10.7%,其中,中、南美洲陽性率上升,北美洲及加勒比海陽性率下降。 加拿大疫情呈下降趨勢,第41週新增2,359例病例,陽性率降至8.7%,已連續2週下降,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,歐洲及非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 40 of 2025 (29 September–5 October) was 14.84%, with positivity increasing in the European and African regional offices. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 41, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 3.72, having declined for four consecutive weeks, and hospitalizations are also declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 40 was 12.61%, markedly lower than the early-September peak of 38.95%; the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Americas: The outbreak is rising. The overall positivity rate in week 40 rose to 10.7%, with positivity increasing in Central and South America and decreasing in North America and the Caribbean. Canada: The outbreak is declining. In week 41, 2,359 new cases were reported and the positivity rate fell to 8.7%, the second consecutive week of decline; the variant XFG has the highest share. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with the European and African regional offices rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 賴索托塔巴采卡區8例炭疽病確定病例,1名6歲男童死亡
items.summary_en: Lesotho's Thaba-Tseka district reported eight confirmed anthrax cases, including one death in a six-year-old boy.
items.description_zh: 賴索托中部塔巴采卡(Thaba-Tseka)區報告8例確定病例,分別為4名男童及4名成年男性,其中1名6歲男童死亡,其餘住院治療中;該國近期曾向世界動物衛生組織(WOAH)通報牛隻之炭疽病疫情,當局提醒民眾應避免食用不明原因死亡之動物肉品,倘有疑病例應立即向當地獸醫或衛生部門通報。
items.description_en: Eight confirmed cases were reported in Thaba-Tseka district in central Lesotho: four boys and four adult men. One six-year-old boy died, and the others are hospitalized. Lesotho recently notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) of an anthrax outbreak in cattle. Authorities advise the public to avoid eating meat from animals that died of unknown causes, and to report any suspected cases immediately to local veterinary or health authorities.

items.summary_zh: 荷蘭10/20報告首例Ib型M痘,患者無旅遊史、曾接觸MSM者
items.summary_en: The Netherlands reported its first clade Ib mpox case on 20 October, in a patient with no recent related travel but MSM contacts.
items.description_zh: 荷蘭10/20報告該國新增首例Ib型病例,病患近期無相關旅遊史亦未施打疫苗,惟具MSM者接觸史。當局刻正展開疫調及接觸者匡列作業,評估傳播風險為低。該國自2022年截至今年10/20累計報告1,550例病例,該國於2022年夏季時疫情最為嚴峻,單週報告逾160例。
items.description_en: The Netherlands reported its first new clade Ib case on 20 October. The patient had no recent related travel history and had not been vaccinated, but had contact with MSM individuals. Authorities are conducting an epidemiological investigation and contact tracing and assess the transmission risk as low. Since 2022, the country has reported 1,550 cases cumulatively as of 20 October this year. The summer of 2022 was the most severe period, with more than 160 cases reported in a single week.

items.summary_zh: 葉門北部胡希控制區10月5名兒童死於狂犬病,當地缺乏暴露後預防藥
items.summary_en: Five children died of rabies in October in Houthi-controlled northern Yemen, where local hospitals lack post-exposure prophylaxis.
items.description_zh: 葉門北部胡希武裝控制地區10月報告5例死亡病例,皆為兒童,分別來自札馬爾省3名及沙那省2名,近期2例病患皆曾被流浪犬/貓抓咬傷,當地醫院缺乏暴露後預防藥物,致病患無法及時接受治療;札馬爾省每月發生逾400起狗咬人事件,當地媒體表示當局未採取相關防疫措施,致疫情加劇;該國2022年報告69例死亡病例。
items.description_en: In the Houthi-controlled area of northern Yemen, five child deaths were reported in October, three from Dhamar governorate and two from Sana'a governorate. In the two most recent cases, the patients had been bitten or scratched by stray dogs or cats. The local hospital lacked post-exposure prophylaxis, so the patients could not receive timely treatment. Dhamar governorate records more than 400 dog-bite incidents a month, and local media say authorities have taken no relevant preventive measures, which has worsened the outbreak. Yemen reported 69 deaths in 2022.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省伊波拉累計53例確診、43例死亡,無新增病例
items.summary_en: DR Congo's Kasai-Central Ebola outbreak has 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases, 43 deaths, and no new cases since 25 September.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省疫情更新,WHO公佈該國最後1名確診病患已於10/19康復出院,倘42天內無新增病例,預計於今(2025)年12月宣布疫情結束;該國自9/4宣布疫情後,累計報告53例確診及11例疑病例,其中43例死亡,19例已康復,另自9/25起,皆未新增報告病例,當局將持續與WHO專家團隊合作落實監測及防疫等相關措施。
items.description_en: Update on Kasai-Central province, Democratic Republic of the Congo: WHO announced that the last confirmed patient was discharged after recovering on 19 October. If no new cases are reported within 42 days, the outbreak is expected to be declared over in December this year. Since the outbreak was declared on 4 September, a cumulative 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases have been reported, of which 43 died and 19 recovered. No new cases have been reported since 25 September. Authorities will continue to work with WHO's expert team on surveillance and prevention measures.

items.summary_zh: 韓國10/17宣布進入流感季;南半球2025年疫苗效力約50%
items.summary_en: South Korea declared its flu season on 17 October, and a multinational study found 2025 Southern Hemisphere flu vaccine effectiveness of about 50%.
items.description_zh: 韓國於10/17宣布進入流感季,第40週(9/28~10/4)類流感門診就診率為12.1‰,已高於閾9.1‰,且呈上升趨勢,所有年齡層疫情皆為上升,目前病患多為兒童及青少年,檢出型別以H3N2為多。 美國CDC、PAHO及南半球跨國研究顯示,2025年南半球流感季疫苗保護效力(VE)約為50%,研究團隊自澳洲、紐西蘭等8個南半球國家納入2,100餘例類流感(ILI)患者及4.2萬餘例嚴重呼吸道感染(SARI)患者,ILI及SARI患者VE分別為50.4%及49.7%。研究結果顯示,接種疫苗可將需醫療處理的流感相關疾病風險降低約一半,衛生主管機關應推動符合資之人群接種疫苗,以降低流感發生率。
items.description_en: South Korea declared the start of its flu season on 17 October. The outpatient visit rate for influenza-like illness in week 40 (28 September–4 October) was 12.1‰, above the threshold of 9.1‰, and rising. Case numbers are rising in all age groups; patients are currently mainly children and adolescents, and H3N2 is the predominant detected type. The US CDC, PAHO and a multinational study in the Southern Hemisphere show that the vaccine effectiveness (VE) of the 2025 Southern Hemisphere flu season was about 50%. The research team included more than 2,100 patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) and more than 42,000 patients with severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) from eight Southern Hemisphere countries, including Australia and New Zealand. VE was 50.4% for ILI patients and 49.7% for SARI patients. The findings show that vaccination can reduce the risk of influenza-related conditions requiring medical care by about half, and health authorities should promote vaccination among eligible groups to reduce influenza incidence.

items.summary_zh: 蘇丹喀土穆15例白喉、阿爾及利亞5例、馬利343例疑病例
items.summary_en: Sudan's capital Khartoum reported 15 diphtheria cases, Algeria reported five in Skikda, and Mali reported 343 suspected cases with 25 deaths.
items.description_zh: 非洲多國爆發疫情,  蘇丹首都喀土穆報告15例,且3例病例於3日內死亡,當地公衛狀況及防疫體系急遽惡化,專家示警當地將發生疫情,需相關部門立即介入。 阿爾及利亞東北部斯基克達省爆發群聚疫情,10/17-19間報告5例,其中2例死亡,包括1名25歲外國人及1名未接種疫苗之12歲當地女孩。病患皆於住院後因呼吸道併發症死亡,其餘3例仍在治療,當局已進行接觸者追蹤及暴露後預防工作,鄰近地區亦加強監測措施。 馬利報告343例疑病例,其中7例確診及25例死亡(CFR : 7.3%),病例多集中於該國中部莫普提(Mopti)地區,當局現進行疫苗接種活動,目前疫情已獲控制。
items.description_en: Outbreaks have occurred in several African countries. Khartoum, the capital of Sudan, reported 15 cases, and three of the cases died within three days. Local public health conditions and the disease control system have deteriorated sharply, and experts warn that an outbreak will occur locally, calling for immediate intervention by the relevant authorities. In Skikda province in north-eastern Algeria, a cluster outbreak was reported: five cases were reported between 17 and 19 October, of which two died, including a 25-year-old foreigner and an unvaccinated 12-year-old local girl. The two deceased patients died of respiratory complications after hospitalization, and the other three cases are still under treatment. Authorities have carried out contact tracing and post-exposure prevention, and surveillance has been strengthened in neighbouring areas. Mali reported 343 suspected cases, of which 7 were confirmed and 25 died (CFR 7.3%). Cases are concentrated in the Mopti region of central Mali. Authorities are carrying out vaccination activities, and the outbreak is now reported to be under control.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨西南部3歲女童感染H5N1,今年累計16例、5例死亡
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported an H5N1 infection in a three-year-old girl, bringing its total this year to 16 cases, with 5 deaths.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西南部磅士卑省巴塞縣3歲女童,病患出現發燒、咳嗽、呼吸困難及腹瀉等症狀,目前於ICU治療中,據調查病患家中及鄰居飼養家禽於女童發病前1週曾出現死亡情形,當局已針對接觸者及疑病例進行調查及主動監測。該國今年累計報告16例H5N1流感人類感染病例,其中5例死亡,病例檢出多為2.3.2.1e演化支,為該國主要流行株。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 influenza infection: a three-year-old girl from Basae district in Kampong Speu province, south-western Cambodia. She developed fever, cough, difficulty breathing and diarrhoea and is being treated in the ICU. According to the investigation, poultry raised at the girl's home and by her neighbours had died in the week before she fell ill. Authorities are investigating contacts and suspected cases and conducting active surveillance. Cambodia has reported 16 human H5N1 infections this year, of which 5 were fatal. Most detected cases belong to clade 2.3.2.1e, the main circulating strain in the country.

items.summary_zh: 馬爾地夫今年截至7/31登革熱累計821例,低於2024年同期
items.summary_en: Maldives has reported 821 dengue cases so far this year as of 31 July, below the same period in 2024.
items.description_zh: 馬爾地夫今年截至7/31累計821例病例,低於2024年同期病例數,2024年全年累計報告3,294例。
items.description_en: The Maldives reported 821 cumulative cases as of 31 July this year, lower than the same period in 2024. In 2024 as a whole, 3,294 cases were reported cumulatively.

items.summary_zh: 塞內加爾自9月疫情迄今累計245例裂谷熱,21例死亡
items.summary_en: Senegal has reported 245 Rift Valley fever cases and 21 deaths since its September outbreak, with livestock vaccination under way.
items.description_zh: 塞內加爾自9月爆發疫情迄今累計245例病例,其中21例死亡,病患主要分布於西北部聖路易區,當局已與動物部門合作並啟動牲畜疫苗接種作業及民眾宣導等防治措施。
items.description_en: Since the outbreak began in September, Senegal has reported 245 cumulative cases, of which 21 died. Cases are mainly distributed in the north-western Saint-Louis region. Authorities, in cooperation with the animal health sector, have launched livestock vaccination and public awareness measures.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾今年日本腦炎133例、31例死亡,74%為40歲以上未接種農業工作者
items.summary_en: Nepal has recorded 133 Japanese encephalitis cases and 31 deaths this year, with 74% among unvaccinated agricultural workers over 40.
items.description_zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告133例病例及31例死亡,其中74%為40歲以上無接種疫苗之農業工作者,病患主要集中於稻田或養豬/雞場周圍,病例及死亡人數皆為近3年最高,當局表示該國現有疫苗短缺問題;該國於2022-24年分別累計報告79/105/86例病例。
items.description_en: Nepal's outbreak is rising. So far this year, 133 cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Of the cases, 74% were unvaccinated agricultural workers aged over 40, and cases are mainly concentrated around rice paddies or pig and poultry farms. Both case and death numbers are the highest in the past three years. Authorities say the country currently faces a vaccine shortage. Nepal reported 79, 105 and 86 cases cumulatively in 2022, 2023 and 2024 respectively.

items.summary_zh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增2,086例,較前週2,257例下降,無重症死亡
items.summary_en: Guangdong's chikungunya outbreak continues, with 2,086 new cases in the past week, down from 2,257, and no severe or fatal cases.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(10/12-18)新增2,086例病例,較前1週(10/5-11)新增2,257例下降,近1週新增病例主要分布於江門市795例,其次為佛山市241例、深圳市202例及廣州市189例,無報告重症及死亡病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (12–18 October), 2,086 new cases were reported, down from 2,257 in the previous week (5–11 October). Most of the new cases were in Jiangmen (795), followed by Foshan (241), Shenzhen (202) and Guangzhou (189). No severe or fatal cases were reported.

items.summary_zh: 洛杉磯郡新增3例I型本土M痘,為美國首起本土I型病例
items.summary_en: Los Angeles County reported three locally acquired clade I mpox cases, the first such cases in the US, with no known links or travel history.
items.description_zh: 美國加州洛杉磯郡於10/14-17新增3例I型本土病例,為該國首起本土I型病例,病例皆無流行病學關聯及相關旅遊史,當局已啟動疫情及接觸者調查。另該郡自今年截至10/14累計報告118例II型病例。
items.description_en: Los Angeles County, California, reported three new clade I locally acquired cases between 14 and 17 October, the first locally acquired clade I cases in the country. None of the cases had epidemiological links or related travel history, and authorities have launched an outbreak and contact investigation. The county has also reported 118 clade II cases cumulatively this year as of 14 October.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週中國新增2例H9N2人類感染,美洲自2022年累計76例H5人類感染
items.summary_en: This week China reported two human H9N2 infections, while PAHO counts 76 human H5 infections in the Americas since 2022, 71 in the US.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週中國新增2例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共19國於2025/10/10-17期間報告57起H5N1疫情,西班牙9起、德國7起、加拿大6起、奧地利/英國各5起、法國/義大利各4起、波蘭3起、丹麥/保加利亞/拉脫維亞各2起、伊拉克/北馬其頓/南非/愛爾蘭/日本/瑞典/立陶宛/臺灣各1起。 共2國於2025/10/13-17期間報告15起 H5 (N untyped)疫情,日本13起、法國2起。 葡萄牙於2025/10/14報告1起 H7 (N untyped)疫情。 英國於2025/10/14報告1起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,081(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西州、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新: PAHO於10/15更新A(H5N1)流感美洲區流行病學疫情報告,該區自2022年截至今年10/14共5國報告76例A(H5)流感人類感染病例,其中2例死亡,以美國71例為多,其次為墨西哥2例、加拿大/智利/厄瓜多各1例;另2022年截至今年第41週(10/5-10/11),美洲地區共19國報告5,063起禽類H5N1流感疫情,報告指出,近年非禽類物種檢出數上升,並包含陸地/海洋哺乳動物及野生/畜牧/陪伴動物。 年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感28例 (2003年迄今累計991*例),H9N2流感28例(迄今累計158例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計62國家/地區通報2,483起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week China reported two new human H9N2 influenza infections. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 19 countries reported 57 H5N1 outbreaks between 10 and 17 October 2025: Spain 9, Germany 7, Canada 6, Austria and United Kingdom 5 each, France and Italy 4 each, Poland 3, Denmark, Bulgaria and Latvia 2 each, and Iraq, North Macedonia, South Africa, Ireland, Japan, Sweden, Lithuania and Taiwan 1 each. Two countries reported 15 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 13 and 17 October 2025: Japan 13 and France 2. Portugal reported one H7 (N untyped) outbreak on 14 October 2025. The United Kingdom reported one H5N5 outbreak on 14 October 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,081 (1) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Other updates: PAHO updated its epidemiological report on A(H5N1) influenza in the Americas on 15 October. From 2022 to 14 October this year, five countries in the region reported 76 human A(H5) influenza infections, two of which were fatal. The United States accounted for 71 cases, followed by Mexico (2), and Canada, Chile and Ecuador (1 each). From 2022 to week 41 this year (5–11 October), 19 countries in the Americas reported 5,063 avian H5N1 influenza outbreaks. The report notes that detections in non-avian species have risen in recent years, including terrestrial and marine mammals and wild, farmed and companion animals. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 28 H5N1 influenza (991* cumulative since 2003); 28 H9N2 influenza (158 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 62 countries and areas have reported 2,483 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率16.38%(第39週),中港新加坡上升,日韓下降
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 16.38% in week 39, with China, Hong Kong and Singapore rising while Japan and South Korea declined.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  全球於2025年第39週(9/22-28)陽性率16.38%,其中,歐洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第40週定醫平均報告數4.82,已連續3週下降,住院數亦呈下降趨勢,病患分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 西太平洋區署各國第38-39週陽性率介於0-23%之間,其中,中國/香港/印/新加坡疫情上升,日本/韓國疫情下降。 東南亞區署各國第40週病例數及死亡數皆處低點,包含泰國/印度/孟加拉等國。 歐洲疫情下降,第40週門診陽性率13.3%,已連續2週下降,住院陽性率亦呈下降,以變異株XFG占比最高(84%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,歐洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 39 of 2025 (22–28 September) was 16.38%, with positivity increasing in the European regional office. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 40, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 4.82, having declined for three consecutive weeks, and hospitalizations are also declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Western Pacific regional office: In weeks 38–39, positivity rates across countries ranged from 0 to 23%. The outbreaks in China, Hong Kong, India and Singapore are rising, while those in Japan and South Korea are declining. Southeast Asia regional office: In week 40, case and death numbers in countries including Thailand, India and Bangladesh were at low levels. Europe: The outbreak is declining. The outpatient positivity rate in week 40 was 13.3%, having declined for two consecutive weeks; hospital positivity has also declined, and the variant XFG has the highest share (84%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with the European regional office rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),孟加拉,中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,印度,印尼,日本,韓國,新加坡,泰國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗WPV1新增2例,cVDPV2環境樣本新增9件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported two new WPV1 cases in Afghanistan during 3–9 October, and nine cVDPV2 environmental samples across two countries.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-9期間,WPV1新增阿富汗2例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增2國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞7件、查德2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 3–9 October, WPV1 added two cases in Afghanistan. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added nine samples across two countries: seven in Papua New Guinea and two in Chad.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,查德,巴布亞紐幾內亞

items.headline_zh: 斯洛伐克-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 斯洛伐克科馬倫8-9月累計140例A型肝炎,4起校園群聚持續
items.summary_en: Komárno in southern Slovakia reported 140 hepatitis A cases in August and September, with four clusters still ongoing, mostly in schools.
items.description_zh: 斯洛伐克南部科馬倫(Komarno)8-9月累計報告140例病例,仍有4起群聚疫情持續,多發生於校園,該地區於今年年初即發生疫情,8月出現新一波疫情;當局已匡列1,577名接觸者,並加強疫苗接種及環境清消等措施。
items.description_en: In Komárno in southern Slovakia, 140 cases were reported cumulatively in August and September. Four cluster outbreaks are still ongoing, mostly in schools. The area had an outbreak at the beginning of this year, and a new wave appeared in August. Authorities have identified 1,577 contacts and strengthened vaccination and environmental disinfection measures.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥多州10月初爆發腸病毒群聚,多見5歲以下幼童,已停課清消
items.summary_en: Several Mexican states had enterovirus clusters in early October, mainly among children under 5 in day-care centres and schools; classes were suspended.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥多個州於10月初爆發群聚疫情,疫情多發生於日托中心、幼兒園及小學等,病患以5歲以下族群為主,病毒型別為A16及A6型等;當局宣布停課及全面清消。
items.description_en: Several Mexican states had cluster outbreaks in early October, mainly at day-care centres, kindergartens and primary schools. Patients are mainly under 5 years old, and the virus types include A16 and A6, among others. Authorities have announced class suspensions and comprehensive disinfection.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大/英國-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 加拿大10/12報告105例沙門氏菌感染,英國4-6月較1-3月增47%
items.summary_en: Canada reported 105 Salmonella cases by 12 October, with a suspected pistachio and dessert source; the UK's April–June cases were 47% above January–March.
items.description_zh: 加拿大10/12報告105例病例,其中16例住院,病患分布於安大略及魁北克等省份;疑感染源為某生產商製造的開心果及甜點,當局已要求產品下架。 英國今年4-6月累計報告2,342例病例,雖與去年同期(2,387例)相當,但較今年1-3月(1,591例)增加47%。
items.description_en: Canada reported 105 cases on 12 October, of which 16 were hospitalized. Patients are distributed across provinces including Ontario and Quebec. The suspected source is pistachios and desserts produced by a certain manufacturer, and authorities have requested that the products be removed from shelves. The United Kingdom reported 2,342 cumulative cases in April–June this year. Although this is comparable to the same period last year (2,387 cases), it is 47% higher than January–March this year (1,591 cases).
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Canada

items.summary_zh: 紐約市報告1例屈公病本土病例,為美國2015年以來首例,傳播風險極低
items.summary_en: New York City reported one locally acquired chikungunya case, the first US local case since 2015, and assesses the local risk as very low.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市報告1例本土確診病例,個案於8月出現症狀,為該國自2015年以來首次報告本土病例,佛羅里達州及德州於10年前曾分別報告12及1例本土病例,該國於2023-24年分別報告152及199例旅遊相關病例。由於該市目前夜間氣溫較低,評估當地疾病傳播風險為非常低。
items.description_en: New York City reported one locally acquired confirmed case; the patient developed symptoms in August. This is the first locally acquired case reported in the country since 2015. Florida and Texas reported 12 and 1 locally acquired cases, respectively, 10 years ago. The country reported 152 and 199 travel-associated cases in 2023 and 2024, respectively. Because nighttime temperatures in the city are currently low, the assessed risk of local transmission is very low.

items.summary_zh: 西班牙馬德里首例Ib型M痘為境外移入,病患8月曾赴坦尚尼亞
items.summary_en: Spain's first imported clade Ib mpox case, a 49-year-old man in Madrid who travelled to Tanzania in August, was reported on 23 September.
items.description_zh: 西班牙首都馬德里9/23報告新增首例Ib型境外移入病例,病患為49歲男性,於9/8出現皮疹、淋巴結腫大等症狀,18日採檢,22日確診,該病患於今年8月曾至坦尚亞旅遊,並具高風險性接觸史,目前居家隔離中,當局匡列2名接觸者。該國今年截至9/25已累計445例病例。當局評估雖持續發生旅遊感染病例,惟整體傳播風險為低。
items.description_en: Madrid, the Spanish capital, reported its first new imported clade Ib case on 23 September. The patient is a 49-year-old man who developed a rash and swollen lymph nodes on 8 September. A specimen was collected on 18 September and confirmed on 22 September. The patient had travelled to Tanzania in August this year and had a high-risk contact history. He is isolating at home, and authorities have identified two contacts. Spain has reported 445 cases cumulatively this year as of 25 September. Authorities assess that, although travel-related infections continue to occur, the overall transmission risk is low.

items.summary_zh: 越南同奈省2名男童被病犬咬傷,全省今年65例犬隻病例、5例人類死亡
items.summary_en: Dong Nai province, Viet Nam, reported two boys bitten by rabid dogs; the province has 65 animal cases and five human deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 越南南部同奈省報告2起男童遭病犬咬傷事件,兩人皆已接種疫苗及注射免疫球蛋白,該省今年迄今共30個社/坊報告狂犬病疫情,共有65例犬隻病例及5例人類感染死亡病例,該國動物及人類感染病例均有上升趨勢,且疫情發生省份有擴大趨勢。
items.description_en: In Dong Nai province in southern Viet Nam, two boys were bitten by rabid dogs; both had been vaccinated and received rabies immunoglobulin. So far this year, 30 communes and wards in the province have reported rabies outbreaks, with 65 dog cases and five human deaths. Both animal and human infection cases are rising across the country, and the number of provinces affected appears to be expanding.

items.headline_zh: 哈薩克-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 哈薩克南部克孜勒奧爾達州今年22例疑病例、12例確診
items.summary_en: Kazakhstan's Kyzylorda region has reported 22 suspected Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases this year, 12 of them confirmed.
items.description_zh: 哈薩克南部克孜勒奧爾達州今年累計報告22例疑病例,其中12例確診,該州今年迄今超過1,200名居民遭蜱蟲叮咬接受治療,目前與感染者接觸人員均接受觀察,目前尚無出現異常情形。當局已針對當地熱點地區進行消毒及防治措施。
items.description_en: In Kyzylorda region in southern Kazakhstan, 22 suspected cases were reported cumulatively this year, of which 12 were confirmed. More than 1,200 residents of the region have been treated for tick bites so far this year. People in contact with infected patients are under observation, and no abnormalities have been found so far. Authorities have carried out disinfection and control measures in local hotspot areas.

items.summary_zh: 中國新增2例H9N2人類感染,湖南2歲男童、江西70歲女性
items.summary_en: China reported two human H9N2 infections, in a 2-year-old boy in Hunan and a 70-year-old woman in Jiangxi, with onset in late September.
items.description_zh: 中國新增2例H9N2流感人類感染病例,為湖南省2歲男童及江西省70歲女性,發病時間介於9/23-28間,其餘流行病學資訊不明。
items.description_en: China reported two new human H9N2 influenza infections: a two-year-old boy in Hunan province and a 70-year-old woman in Jiangxi province, with onset between 23 and 28 September. Other epidemiological information is unknown.

items.summary_zh: 佛羅里達州今年截至9/27百日咳1,295例,已超過去年全年715例
items.summary_en: Florida reported 1,295 pertussis cases by 27 September, more than double the same period last year and above last year's full-year total of 715.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州今年截至9/27報告1,295例,其中1,068確診,較去年同期409例大幅增加超過2倍,亦高於去年全年病例數715例,約63%為9歲以下兒童,該州病例數增加可能與群體免疫下降、疫苗覆蓋率缺口及社區傳播等因素共同影響,惟該州近期取消強制接種疫苗計畫,可能因接種率下降影響該州弱勢族群及兒童。
items.description_en: Florida reported 1,295 cases this year as of 27 September, of which 1,068 were confirmed. This is more than double the 409 cases reported in the same period last year, and higher than last year's full-year total of 715 cases. About 63% of cases are children under 9 years old. The rise in cases may be due to combined factors such as declining population immunity, gaps in vaccination coverage and community transmission. However, the state has recently cancelled its mandatory vaccination programme, which may lower vaccination rates and affect vulnerable groups and children in the state.

items.headline_zh: 日本/泰國/馬來西亞-流感
items.summary_zh: 日本流感季10/3宣布開始,泰國逾70萬例、65例死亡,馬來西亞群聚97起
items.summary_en: Japan declared its flu season on 3 October, Thailand has reported over 700,000 cases and 65 deaths this year, and Malaysia logged 97 influenza clusters in week 40.
items.description_zh: 日本第40週(9/29-10/5) 流感定點門診平均病例數1.56例,已連續4週上升,該國於10/3宣布進入流感季,以沖繩縣12.18例為多,有36個都道府縣病例數較前1週上升。專家表示今年疫情爆發較往年時間略早,惟現在天氣未如冬季氣溫低且乾燥,現階段不太可能爆發大規模疫情,然仍須留意疫情發展,並做好防護措施。 泰國疫情爆發,今年迄今累計報告超過70萬例,其中65例死亡,多數病例為老年人及兒童,以5-9歲兒童為多,死亡病例以60歲以上族群為多。由於該國雨季結束,天氣轉涼增加呼吸道感染風險,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗並避免前往人口密集場所。 馬來西亞第40週報告97起流感群聚事件,較前1週14起大幅上升,當局表示該國所有州之群聚事件均增加,其中以雪蘭莪州(43起)為多,其次為吉隆坡/布城(15起),多數為教育機構,約有6,000名學生感染。該國定點診所監測顯示,類流感病例數增加,第39週至第40週由5.95%上升至7.38%,型別以A(H3)流感為主。
items.description_en: Japan: In week 40 (29 September–5 October), the average number of influenza cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 1.56, rising for four consecutive weeks. Japan declared the start of its flu season on 3 October. Okinawa Prefecture had the highest figure, at 12.18, and 36 prefectures saw an increase from the previous week. Experts say this year's outbreak began somewhat earlier than in past years, but current weather is not as cold and dry as in winter, so a large-scale outbreak is unlikely at this stage; developments should nevertheless be monitored and protective measures taken. Thailand: An outbreak has occurred. So far this year, more than 700,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 65 died. Most cases are older adults and children, with the largest number among children aged 5–9, and most deaths are among people over 60. Because the rainy season has ended and the weather is turning cooler, the risk of respiratory infection has increased, and authorities urge people to get vaccinated and avoid crowded places. Malaysia: In week 40, 97 influenza cluster incidents were reported, a sharp increase from 14 the previous week. Authorities say cluster incidents rose in all states, with the most in Selangor (43), followed by Kuala Lumpur/Putrajaya (15). Most were in educational institutions, and about 6,000 students were infected. Sentinel clinic surveillance shows that influenza-like illness cases rose from 5.95% in weeks 39 to 40 to 7.38%, with type A(H3) predominant.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥截至10/13確診4,915例、23例死亡,契瓦瓦州4,386例
items.summary_en: Mexico has 4,915 confirmed measles cases and 23 deaths as of 13 October, mostly in Chihuahua; Israel recorded another child death.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥截至10/13報告逾1.1萬例疑病例,其中4,915例確診及23例死亡,病例遍及全國22州,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州4,386例為多,該國疫苗覆蓋率為87%,仍低於95%目標,由於兒童疫苗接種率低、農村及周邊地區健康差距大,與此次疫情上升相關。 以色列新增1例死亡病例,該名幼童未接種疫苗,今年迄今累計7例,所有病例均未滿2歲半,目前仍有19例住院,其中4例仍在ICU治療中。
items.description_en: Mexico: As of 13 October, more than 11,000 suspected cases had been reported, including 4,915 confirmed cases and 23 deaths. Cases have been reported in 22 states across the country, most in north-western Chihuahua state (4,386 cases). Mexico's vaccination coverage is 87%, still below the 95% target. Low childhood vaccination rates and large health disparities between rural and surrounding areas are associated with the rise in this outbreak. Israel: One new death was reported, in an unvaccinated young child. So far this year, the cumulative total is seven cases, all of them children under two and a half years old. Currently 19 patients are hospitalized, four of whom remain in intensive care.

items.summary_zh: WHO:2023年全球約六分之一細菌感染具抗藥性,東南亞及東地中海最嚴重
items.summary_en: WHO reports about one in six lab-confirmed bacterial infections worldwide in 2023 resisted antibiotics, with South-East Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean worst affected.
items.description_zh: WHO於10/13發布全球抗生素抗藥性監測報告,2023年全球經實驗室確診之細菌感染病例中,約有1/6對抗生素出現抗藥性,2018-23年間,監測抗生素中出現抗藥性比例超過40%,平均每年增幅介於5-15%間;各區署中以東南亞及東地中海區抗藥性最為嚴重,約1/3無法以現有抗生素治療。報告顯示,大腸桿菌/克雷伯氏肺炎桿菌(K. pneumoniae)對第三代頭孢菌素(cephalosporin)出現抗藥性的比例迄已分別達40%及55%,於非洲地區更超過70%,另碳青黴烯類(carbapenems)與氟喹諾酮類(fluoroquinolones)等效力也下降,使治療選擇逐漸受限。目前已有104國參與WHO 全球抗藥性與使用監測系統(GLASS),惟近半數未能提供可靠資料,呼籲各國於2030年前提高監測數據品質,強化實驗室系統與抗藥性防治。
items.description_en: On 13 October, WHO issued its global antibiotic resistance surveillance report. Of laboratory-confirmed bacterial infections worldwide in 2023, about one in six were resistant to antibiotics. Between 2018 and 2023, the proportion of resistance among monitored antibiotics exceeded 40%, with average annual increases of 5–15%. Among the regions, South-East Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean have the most serious resistance, with about one third of infections untreatable with existing antibiotics. The report shows that resistance to third-generation cephalosporins has reached 40% in Escherichia coli and 55% in Klebsiella pneumoniae, and more than 70% in the African Region. The effectiveness of carbapenems and fluoroquinolones has also declined, gradually limiting treatment options. Currently 104 countries participate in WHO's Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS), but nearly half cannot provide reliable data. WHO calls on countries to improve the quality of surveillance data by 2030, and to strengthen laboratory systems and antimicrobial resistance control.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年截至10/7西尼羅熱1,433例,42州報告,較去年為高
items.summary_en: The US has reported 1,433 West Nile fever cases in 42 states as of 7 October this year, 67% classified as neuroinvasive, higher than last year.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情上升,今年迄10/7共42州報告1,433例病例,其中,957 例(67%)病例被歸類為較嚴重的神經侵襲性病例。另科羅拉多州報告200餘例病例,伊利諾州報告100餘例病例,加州報告50餘例病例及5例死亡,密蘇里州報告10餘例病例及3例死亡,該國病例數較去年為高。
items.description_en: US cases are rising. As of 7 October this year, 42 states had reported 1,433 cases, of which 957 (67%) were classified as more severe neuroinvasive cases. Colorado reported more than 200 cases, Illinois more than 100, and California more than 50 cases and 5 deaths, while Missouri reported more than 10 cases and 3 deaths. The country's case count is higher than last year's.

items.summary_zh: 廣東屈公病近1週新增2,257例,江門1,255例最多;法國本土累計700例
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 2,257 chikungunya cases in the past week, with 1,255 in Jiangmen, while France's local cumulative total reached 700.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(10/5-11)新增2,257例病例,以江門市新增1,255例最多,其次為廣州市及佛山市分別新增201及196例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市持續落實突發公共衛生事件三級響應措施,該市疫情呈波動下降趨勢,惟仍處較高點。由於廣東省仍處病媒蚊活躍期且假期人潮流動等因素,疫情傳播風險持續。 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至10/8共2國報告病例,法國近1週新增63例本土病例,累計700例;義大利累計353例本土病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (5–11 October), 2,257 new cases were reported. Jiangmen City had the most, with 1,255 new cases, followed by Guangzhou (201) and Foshan (196). No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen City continues to implement Level III public health emergency response measures; its outbreak shows a fluctuating downward trend but remains at a relatively high level. Because Guangdong remains in the active season for disease-carrying mosquitoes and holiday travel continues, the risk of transmission persists. Europe: As of 8 October this year, two countries had reported cases. France recorded 63 new locally acquired cases in the past week, bringing its cumulative total to 700, and Italy has 353 cumulative locally acquired cases.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),法國,義大利

items.summary_zh: 瑞典斯德哥爾摩130例李斯特菌疑病例,10例確診,餐廳已停業
items.summary_en: Stockholm, Sweden, reported 130 suspected listeriosis cases on 2 October, 10 confirmed; all patients dined at one restaurant, now closed.
items.description_zh: 瑞典斯德哥爾摩於10/2報告130例疑病例,其中10例確診,4例出現敗血症,病患皆於9/23-27期間於某餐廳用餐;當局已通知約400名餐廳顧客作自我健康監測,該餐廳已停業,感染源調查中。
items.description_en: Stockholm, Sweden, reported 130 suspected cases on 2 October, of which 10 were confirmed and 4 developed sepsis. All patients had dined at one restaurant between 23 and 27 September. Authorities have notified about 400 restaurant customers to conduct self-health monitoring. The restaurant has closed, and the source of infection is under investigation.

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本第38週諾羅病毒每定點機構平均3.9例,連續5週為近10年最高
items.summary_en: Japan's norovirus gastroenteritis average reached 3.9 cases per sentinel facility in week 38, the highest in 10 years for five straight weeks.
items.description_zh: 日本第38週定醫平均病例數3.9人,連續5週為近10年最高,病患地理分布以群馬縣、福井縣及宮崎縣為主,且不同地區傳播病毒株有所不同,推測為疫情延長之原因。另研究顯示新型諾羅病毒變異株GII.17自去年起傳播,因多數民眾缺乏免疫力而易感染。
items.description_en: In week 38, Japan's average number of cases per sentinel medical facility was 3.9, the highest in the past 10 years for five consecutive weeks. Cases are geographically concentrated in Gunma, Fukui and Miyazaki prefectures, and different regions have different circulating virus strains, which is presumed to be the reason the outbreak has been prolonged. Separate research shows that the new norovirus variant GII.17 has been spreading since last year, and because most people lack immunity, they are susceptible to infection.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染,美國新增12起H5N1禽流感疫情
items.summary_en: No new human novel influenza A infections were reported this week; the US reported 12 new H5N1 animal outbreaks between 6 and 10 October.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共16國於2025/10/6-10期間報告39起H5N1疫情,美國12起、印度5起、德國/法國各4起、丹麥/波蘭各2起、伊朗/保加利亞/挪威/斯洛伐克/瑞典/義大利/英國/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙各1起。 共2國於2025/10/8-9期間報告3起H5 (N untyped)疫情,美國2起、阿根廷1起。 挪威於2025/10/6報告1起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,080(¬0)起疫情,近期主要集中於內布拉斯加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西州、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感28例 (2003年迄今累計991*例),H9N2流感26例(迄今累計156例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計60國家/地區通報2,408起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 16 countries reported 39 H5N1 outbreaks between 6 and 10 October 2025: United States 12, India 5, Germany and France 4 each, Denmark and Poland 2 each, and Iran, Bulgaria, Norway, Slovakia, Sweden, Italy, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two countries reported 3 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 8 and 9 October 2025: United States 2 and Argentina 1. Norway reported one H5N5 outbreak on 6 October 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,080 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Nebraska. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 28 H5N1 influenza (991* cumulative since 2003); 26 H9N2 influenza (156 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 60 countries and areas have reported 2,408 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率17.41%(第38週)上升,英國上升但處低點,美國下降
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 17.41% in week 38 and rising, while the US declined and the UK's outbreak rose from a low level.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第38週(9/15-21)全球陽性率17.41%,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週(9/22-28)定醫平均報告數5.87,已連續2週下降,住院數呈下降趨勢,病患地理分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最高。 西太平區署第36-37週陽性率介於0-31.1%之間,其中,澳洲、柬埔寨、菲律賓及韓國疫情呈上升趨勢。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週陽性率6.7%,已連續5週下降,住院率亦下降,惟死亡率仍處高點,近期變異株以XFG占比最高(85%)。 英國疫情持續上升,惟處低點,第39週實驗監測陽性率8.4%,住院率亦上升,變異株以XFG.3(35%)及XFG(28%)占比為高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 38 of 2025 (15–21 September) was 17.41%, with positivity rising in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 39 (22–28 September), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 5.87, having declined for two consecutive weeks; hospitalizations are also declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Western Pacific regional office: In weeks 36–37, positivity rates ranged from 0 to 31.1%, and the outbreaks in Australia, Cambodia, the Philippines and South Korea are rising. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 39 was 6.7%, having declined for five consecutive weeks, and hospitalization rates have also declined, but the mortality rate remains high. The variant XFG has the highest share recently (85%). United Kingdom: The outbreak continues to rise but is at a low level. The laboratory surveillance positivity rate in week 39 was 8.4%, and hospitalization rates have also risen. The variants XFG.3 (35%) and XFG (28%) have high shares. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 芝加哥M痘6/1-9/30累計104例,非洲26國累計逾11萬例
items.summary_en: Chicago's mpox cases reached 104 from June to September, while 26 African countries have reported 114,784 cases this year, with 690 deaths.
items.description_zh: 美國伊利諾州芝加哥疫情上升,自6/1截至9/30已累計104例病例,已高於2023年(40例)與2024年(53例)同期。病患多為男性,其中有3例住院病例。當局展開疫苗接種活動,呼籲高風險群應接種疫苗。 非洲疫情持續,今年迄9/30已累計26國通報114,784例病例(34,111例確診),其中690例死亡(CFR:0.6%),部分國家疫情上升,包括奈及利亞累計1,312例病例,其中343例確診,4例死亡;肯亞累計532例確診病例,其中8例死亡;馬拉威累計517例病例,其中113例確診,其中1例死亡。另獅子山疫情趨緩,累計5,315例確診病例,其中56例死亡。
items.description_en: Chicago, Illinois, United States: The outbreak is rising. From 1 June to 30 September, a cumulative 104 cases had been reported, already higher than the same period in 2023 (40 cases) and 2024 (53 cases). Most patients are male, and 3 cases have been hospitalized. Authorities have launched vaccination activities and urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated. Africa: Outbreaks continue. As of 30 September this year, 26 countries had reported a cumulative 114,784 cases (34,111 confirmed), including 690 deaths (CFR 0.6%). Outbreaks are rising in some countries. Nigeria has reported 1,312 cumulative cases, including 343 confirmed and 4 deaths; Kenya has 532 confirmed cases, including 8 deaths; and Malawi has 517 cumulative cases, including 113 confirmed and 1 death. Meanwhile, the outbreak in Sierra Leone is easing, with 5,315 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 56 deaths.
items.area_zh: 肯亞,馬拉威,奈及利亞,獅子山

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉北部朗布爾專區今年8例確定、逾50例疑似炭疽病,3例死亡
items.summary_en: Rangpur division in northern Bangladesh has recorded 8 confirmed and over 50 suspected anthrax cases this year, with 3 deaths.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉北部朗布爾專區今年截至9/30累計報告8例確定病例及逾50例疑病例,其中3例死亡,當局已啟動大規模牲畜疫苗接種、快速處置感染動物及民眾衛教等防治措施。
items.description_en: In Rangpur division in northern Bangladesh, 8 confirmed cases and more than 50 suspected cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of 30 September, of which 3 died. Authorities have launched mass livestock vaccination, rapid handling of infected animals and public health education.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省伊波拉截至10/1累計53例確診、42例死亡
items.summary_en: DR Congo's Kasai-Central Ebola outbreak has recorded 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases, with 42 deaths as of 1 October, and is declining.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省疫情更新,今(2025)年截至10/1累計報告53例確診病例及11例疑病例,其中42例死亡(CFR:65.6%),當局已匡列逾1,000名接觸者,另逾8,000名醫護人員、病例及接觸者已接種疫苗;WHO表示疫情呈現下降趨勢,疫情傳播僅侷限於特定地區,已不同於疫情初期之院內感染及超級傳播情形,惟仍警告風險仍在,倘未能及時發現並隔離患者,病毒仍可能於家庭或密切接觸者間持續傳播。
items.description_en: Kasai-Central province, Democratic Republic of the Congo: As of 1 October this year, 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 42 died (CFR 65.6%). Authorities have listed more than 1,000 contacts, and more than 8,000 health workers, cases and contacts have been vaccinated. WHO says the outbreak is declining and transmission is confined to specific areas, unlike the nosocomial infections and superspreading seen in the early stage. However, WHO warns that the risk remains: if patients are not detected and isolated promptly, the virus could continue to spread among family members and close contacts.

items.summary_zh: 全球屈公病今年445,271例、155例死亡,廣東為中國有紀錄以來最大疫情
items.summary_en: Chikungunya has reached 445,271 cases and 155 deaths globally this year, while Guangdong's outbreak is China's largest on record.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.
