items.summary_zh: 密西西比州今年百日咳115例,較去年49例增逾1倍,新生兒死亡
items.summary_en: Mississippi has reported 115 pertussis cases this year, more than double last year's 49, and a newborn death, the state's third since 2008.
items.description_zh: 美國密西西比州今年迄今報告115例,較去年49例大幅增加超過1倍,並報告2008年以來第3例死亡病例,該名死亡新生兒出生未滿2個月,尚不符合接種年齡,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Mississippi has reported 115 cases this year, more than double last year's 49 cases. The state also reported its third death since 2008, a newborn under two months old who was not yet of vaccination age. Authorities urge people to get vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 茅利塔尼亞南部今年白喉疑病例74例、7例死亡,較去年降33%
items.summary_en: Southern Mauritania reported 74 suspected diphtheria cases and 7 deaths this year, 33% fewer than last year, mostly among under-15s.
items.description_zh: 茅利塔亞南部地區今年報告74例疑病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:9.5%),病例較去年同期下降33%,病患主要為15歲以下族群,顯示兒童常規疫苗接種出現免疫缺口,當地已組織應變小組並持續進行流行病學監測,由於該國南部邊境鄰近馬利/塞內加爾,跨境人口流動頻繁,且醫療資源匱乏,使當地易發生跨國傳播。
items.description_en: In southern Mauritania, 74 suspected cases were reported this year, of which 7 died (CFR 9.5%). Cases are 33% lower than in the same period last year, and most patients are under 15 years old, indicating immunization gaps in routine childhood vaccination. A local response team has been organized and epidemiological surveillance continues. Because the southern border is close to Mali and Senegal, cross-border population movement is frequent and medical resources are scarce, the area is prone to cross-border transmission.
items.area_zh: 茅利塔尼亞,馬利,塞內加爾

items.headline_zh: 加拿大/法屬留尼旺島-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 加拿大亞伯達省1例先天性麻疹新生兒死亡,全國今年逾5,000例
items.summary_en: Alberta, Canada, reported a newborn death from congenital measles, with Canada passing 5,000 cases this year; Réunion reports 4 cases.
items.description_zh: 加拿大亞伯達省通報1例新生兒死亡,為該省今年首例死亡病例,嬰兒母親於懷孕期間感染而早產,於出生後死亡,該名新生兒為今年第7例先天性麻疹病例。該省今年截至10/2累計報告1,914例,其中152例住院及15例重症,多數為未接種疫苗之兒童及青少年,該國今年迄今已報告逾5,000例病例。 法屬留旺島今年7月迄今累計報告4例,目前尚無死亡病例,該島去年疫苗覆蓋率僅80%,遠低於95%,該國衛生部表示由於疫苗覆蓋率不佳,可能有新群聚事件、社區傳播及再度爆發疫情風險。該島於2019年爆發疫情,當年報告96例,自2020年迄今年7月間則無通報病例。
items.description_en: Alberta, Canada, reported one newborn death, the province's first death this year. The infant's mother was infected during pregnancy, the baby was born prematurely and died after birth, and the newborn was the seventh congenital measles case this year. As of 2 October this year, the province had reported 1,914 cumulative cases, including 152 hospitalizations and 15 severe cases, mostly among unvaccinated children and adolescents. The country has reported more than 5,000 cases so far this year. In French Réunion, 4 cases have been reported cumulatively since July this year, with no deaths so far. Vaccination coverage on the island was only 80% last year, far below 95%. The health ministry says poor vaccination coverage may lead to new clusters, community transmission and renewed outbreaks. The island had an outbreak in 2019, with 96 cases reported that year; no cases were reported from 2020 until July this year.

items.summary_zh: 日本第39週流感門診平均1.04例超過閾值,宣布流感季開始,較去年早5週
items.summary_en: Japan declared its flu season started, five weeks earlier than last year, with the average per clinic at 1.04, above the threshold.
items.description_zh: 日本第39週流感定點門診平均病例數1.04例,高於流行閾1.0例,厚生勞動省宣布流感季開始,以沖繩縣8.98例為多,其次為東京都1.96例、鹿兒島縣1.68例,共16個都府縣高於閾,今年流感季較去年提早5週,東京都9月通報46起因流感停課事件,為去年同期近3倍,當局呼籲民眾做好個人防護。
items.description_en: In week 39, Japan's average number of influenza cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 1.04, above the epidemic threshold of 1.0. The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare declared the start of the flu season. Okinawa Prefecture had the highest figure, at 8.98, followed by Tokyo at 1.96 and Kagoshima Prefecture at 1.68; a total of 16 prefectures and metropolitan areas exceeded the threshold. This flu season began five weeks earlier than last year. In September, Tokyo reported 46 school class suspensions due to influenza, nearly three times the same period last year. Authorities urge people to take personal protective measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染,10國報告19起H5N1禽流感疫情
items.summary_en: No new human novel influenza A infections were reported this week; 10 countries reported 19 H5N1 animal outbreaks from 28 September to 3 October.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共10國於 2025/9/28-10/3期間報告19起H5N1疫情,西班牙5起、奧地利/英國各3起、墨西哥2起、德國/拉脫維亞/捷克/波蘭/義大利/葡萄牙各1起。 冰島於2025/9/26報告2起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,080(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於內布拉斯加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感1例,H5N1流感28例 (2003年迄今累計991*例),H9N2流感26例(迄今累計156例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計59國家/地區通報2,365起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  其他更新:  WHO免疫事務戰略諮詢專家小組(SAGE)於會議中建議各國可依禽流感暴露風險,發布針對性使用現有已核准 A(H5) 疫苗之建議,其優先建議接種對象包含H5 病毒的實驗室人員、人畜共通流感暴發事件中之第一線應變人員、負責評估與照護疑/確診病例之醫療人員,以及在有動物與人類感染通報地區,持續與動物及其環境接觸之人群。 加拿大食品檢驗局(CFIA)於9/26公布卑詩省某鴕鳥農場檢出D1.3基因型,該基因型與美國俄亥俄州家禽場工人感染病例相關,樣本經基因檢測為俄亥俄州及密蘇里州樣本之直系祖先,研判病毒由該農場傳播至美國。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 10 countries reported 19 H5N1 outbreaks between 28 September and 3 October 2025: Spain 5, Austria and United Kingdom 3 each, Mexico 2, and Germany, Latvia, Czechia, Poland, Italy and Portugal 1 each. Iceland reported 2 H5N5 outbreaks on 26 September 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,080 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Nebraska. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 1 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 28 H5N1 influenza (991* cumulative since 2003); 26 H9N2 influenza (156 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 59 countries and areas have reported 2,365 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Other updates: The WHO Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization (SAGE) recommended at its meeting that countries may issue targeted recommendations for use of existing licensed A(H5) vaccines according to avian influenza exposure risk. Priority groups include laboratory workers handling H5 viruses, first-line responders in zoonotic influenza outbreaks, healthcare workers who assess and care for suspected or confirmed cases, and people who continue to have contact with animals and their environments in areas where animal and human infections have been reported. The Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) announced on 26 September that genotype D1.3 had been detected at an ostrich farm in British Columbia. This genotype is linked to infections among poultry farm workers in Ohio, USA, and genetic testing shows the samples are direct ancestors of the Ohio and Missouri samples, suggesting the virus spread from this farm to the United States. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率18.56%(第37週)上升,歐洲24.3%創今年新高
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 18.56% in week 37 and rising, with Europe's rate reaching 24.3% in week 38, the year's high.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第37週(9/8-14)全球陽性率18.56%,西太平洋、美洲、歐洲區署陽性率皆增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第38週定醫平均報告數6.93,較前1週(8.43)下降,住院數呈下降趨勢,病患分布以東京都、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 泰國疫情上升,第39週新增4,186例病例,較前1週(930例)增加,病患以40-49歲占多數,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 歐洲疫情持續上升,第38週陽性率24.3%,創今年新高,變異株以XFG占比最高57%,其次為NB.1.8.1(12%)。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第38週陽性率7.8%,已連續4週下降,住院率亦下降,惟死亡率仍處高點,近期變異株以XFG占比最高(85%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除東南亞及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(70%),其次為NB.1.8.1(21%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 37 of 2025 (8–14 September) was 18.56%, with positivity increasing in the Western Pacific, Americas and European regional offices. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 38, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 6.93, down from 8.43 the previous week, and hospitalizations are declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Thailand: The outbreak is rising. In week 39, 4,186 new cases were reported, up from 930 the previous week; most patients are aged 40–49, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Europe: The outbreak continues to rise. The positivity rate in week 38 was 24.3%, a new high this year; the variant XFG has the highest share (57%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 38 was 7.8%, having declined for four consecutive weeks; hospitalization rates are also declining, but the mortality rate remains high. The variant XFG has the highest share recently (85%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Southeast Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (70%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_en: GPEI reported two WPV1 cases in Pakistan and seven cVDPV2 cases in Nigeria and Angola for 18–24 September, plus 50 WPV1 environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/18-9/24期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;cVDPV2新增2國共7例,分別為奈及利亞4例、安哥拉3例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦50件,cVDPV2新增阿爾及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 18–24 September, WPV1 added two cases in Pakistan. cVDPV2 added seven cases across two countries: four in Nigeria and three in Angola. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 50 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added one sample in Algeria.

items.summary_zh: 美國20例李斯特菌症,4例死亡、1名孕婦流產,疑為即食麵食
items.summary_en: US listeriosis cases reached 20 by 30 September, including 4 deaths and a miscarriage, with ready-to-eat pasta products suspected.
items.description_zh: 美國9/30報告20例病例,其中4例死亡,並有一名孕婦流產,病患分布於15個州;疑感染源包含即時雞肉義大利麵、牛肉丸番茄麵等,當局已要求製造商下架。
items.description_en: The US reported 20 cases on 30 September, including 4 deaths and one miscarriage in a pregnant woman; cases are distributed across 15 states. Suspected sources include ready-to-eat chicken spaghetti and beef meatball tomato noodles, and authorities have requested that the manufacturer withdraw the products from shelves.

items.summary_zh: 丹麥7/14-9/13彎曲桿菌感染57例,半數住院,疑似雞肉為來源
items.summary_en: Denmark recorded 57 Campylobacter cases from 14 July to 13 September, about half hospitalized, with chicken suspected as the source.
items.description_zh: 丹麥於7/14-9/13累計報告57例病例,其中約半數住院,病患年齡介於2-89歲;當局評估實際感染約上百人,疑感染源為雞肉,另2024年累計報告5,546例。
items.description_en: Denmark reported 57 cumulative cases from 14 July to 13 September, about half of whom were hospitalized; patients are aged 2 to 89 years. Authorities estimate that the actual number of infections is about a hundred. The suspected source is chicken meat. Denmark reported 5,546 cases cumulatively in 2024.

items.summary_zh: WHO:今年至8月全球逾46萬例霍亂,近6,000例死亡
items.summary_en: WHO reports over 460,000 cholera cases and nearly 6,000 deaths globally this year through August, across 32 countries and areas.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至8月累計報告逾46萬例,近6,000例死亡,其中,8月新增報告逾5.7萬例,較7月下降16%,各國CFR介於0-9.8%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及葉門為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, as of August this year, more than 460,000 cases and nearly 6,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In August, more than 57,000 new cases were reported, 16% lower than in July, with national case fatality rates ranging from 0 to 9.8%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and Yemen. WHO assesses that about one billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,南蘇丹共和國,葉門

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 斐濟-人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
items.summary_zh: 斐濟今年截至5月新增逾800例HIV,近半感染者未接受治療或失聯
items.summary_en: Fiji has added over 800 HIV cases from January to May this year, with nearly half of about 9,000 infected people untreated or lost to follow-up.
items.description_zh: 斐濟今年1月宣布爆發疫情,去年報告1,583例確定病例,今年截至5月新增逾800例,推估至今年年底預計新增逾3,000例。該國已累計近9,000例感染者,其中近一半感染者未接受治療或已失聯,該國另有抗病毒藥物庫存短缺問題。該國主要傳染途徑為毒品注射(48%)及性接觸(40%),當局已啟動針頭交換及暴露前預防(PrEP)等新預防措施。
items.description_en: Fiji declared an outbreak in January this year. Last year, 1,583 confirmed cases were reported; from January to May this year, more than 800 new cases were added, and projections indicate more than 3,000 new cases by the end of this year. The country has accumulated nearly 9,000 infected people, and nearly half of them are untreated or have been lost to follow-up. The country also faces a shortage of antiretroviral drug stocks. The main routes of transmission are drug injection (48%) and sexual contact (40%). Authorities have launched new prevention measures, including needle and syringe exchange and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP).

items.headline_zh: 巴基斯坦-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦信德省1名28歲屠夫死於克里米亞-剛果出血熱,今年累計6例死亡
items.summary_en: Sindh province, Pakistan, reported a Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever death in a 28-year-old butcher, with six deaths in the province this year.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦南部信德省報告1例死亡病例,為28歲屠夫,具動物及蜱蟲接觸史,病患於9/24出現高燒、出血及低血壓等症狀,於同日死亡,9/26確診;該省今年迄今累計報告6例死亡病例,病患主要因蜱蟲叮咬或接觸受感染之動物血液/組織感染。
items.description_en: In Sindh province in southern Pakistan, one death was reported: a 28-year-old butcher with contact with animals and ticks. The patient developed high fever, bleeding and low blood pressure on 24 September and died the same day; the diagnosis was confirmed on 26 September. So far this year, the province has reported six cumulative deaths; patients mainly became infected through tick bites or contact with the blood or tissues of infected animals.

items.summary_zh: 法國奧克西塔大區1例狂犬病死亡,患者曾赴北非,1970年來累計26例
items.summary_en: France's Occitanie region reported a rabies death in a patient who had travelled to North Africa; France has recorded 26 cases since 1970.
items.description_zh: 法國南部奧克西塔大區(Occitanie)報告1例死亡病例,病患於9/18出現疑狂犬病症狀住院,24日確診,25日死亡,病患曾至北非,感染源調查中;該國自1970年迄今累計報告26例,其中23例為境外移入,前例為2023年境外移入死亡個案。
items.description_en: In the Occitanie region of southern France, one death was reported. The patient was hospitalized on 18 September with symptoms suspicious of rabies, was confirmed on 24 September, and died on 25 September. The patient had travelled to North Africa, and the source of infection is under investigation. France has reported 26 cases cumulatively since 1970, of which 23 were imported. The previous case was an imported fatal case in 2023.

items.summary_zh: 索馬利亞今年白喉逾1,600例、87例死亡,為去年2倍
items.summary_en: Somalia has reported over 1,600 diphtheria cases and 87 deaths this year, twice last year's total, with most cases in the north-east.
items.description_zh: 索馬利亞今年迄今累計報告1,600餘例,死亡87例,病例數為去(2024)年總數2倍,病例多集中於該國東北部邦特蘭州;索馬利蘭薩納州爆發疫情,報告約20例疑病例及3例死亡,索勒州報告30例疑病例及1例死亡,由於該國疫苗覆蓋率低,且用於疫苗接種及醫療資源之資金減少,導致該國疫情迅速上升。
items.description_en: Somalia has reported more than 1,600 cases this year, with 87 deaths; case numbers are twice last year's total (2024), and most cases are concentrated in the north-eastern Puntland state. An outbreak has occurred in Sanaag region of Somaliland, with about 20 suspected cases and 3 deaths reported; Sool region reported 30 suspected cases and 1 death. Because the country's vaccination coverage is low and funding for vaccination and medical resources has decreased, the outbreak has risen rapidly.

items.headline_zh: 以色列/安哥拉/美國-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 美國1,514例麻疹,新墨西哥州疫情結束;以色列今年6例死亡
items.summary_en: The US reported 1,514 measles cases in 42 states as of 23 September, and New Mexico declared its outbreak over; Israel has six deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 以色列疫情持續,近1週報告4例兒童死亡案例,今年迄今已累計報告6例死亡,該國今年4月爆發疫情,截至9月中旬累計報告超過1,200例,病例多集中於該國中/北部地區。 安哥拉今年迄今累計報告逾6,000例,全國所有省分均有通報病例,該國疫苗覆蓋率已超過70%,惟農村地區及郊區覆蓋率仍低,該國仍持續存在社區傳播風險。 美國今年截至9/23共42州報告1,514例,其中185例住院、3例死亡,並報告40起疫情。新墨西哥州宣布疫情結束,該州自今年2/14爆發疫情,累計報告100例,為該州1996年以來首次爆發疫情,亦為數十年以來最大規模疫情。
items.description_en: Israel: The outbreak continues. In the past week, four child deaths were reported, bringing the cumulative number of deaths this year to six. The outbreak began in April this year, and as of mid-September more than 1,200 cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in the central and northern parts of the country. Angola: More than 6,000 cases have been reported so far this year, with cases reported in all provinces of the country. Vaccination coverage has exceeded 70%, but coverage remains low in rural and suburban areas, and the risk of community transmission persists. United States: As of 23 September this year, 1,514 cases had been reported from 42 states, including 185 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 40 outbreaks had been reported. New Mexico has declared its outbreak over. The state's outbreak began on 14 February this year, with 100 cases reported cumulatively; it was the state's first outbreak since 1996 and the largest in decades.

items.summary_zh: 廣東近1週新增3,153例屈公病,江門2,927例;古巴馬坦薩斯省確診
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 3,153 chikungunya cases in the past week, 2,927 in Jiangmen, while Cuba's Matanzas province reported confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情上升,近1週(9/21-27)新增3,153例病例,較前1週2千餘例增加,主要分布於江門市2,927例,其次為佛山市78例,無報告重症及死亡病例,其中,江門市已連續2週於單週新增逾2千例,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,加強疫情防控。 古巴西部馬坦薩斯省報告確診病例,為該國自2015年以來首次報告病例,且各地報告之蟲媒疾病病例數均有增加,當地已加強病媒防治措施,另美國CDC提升古巴屈公病疫情旅遊警示至第2級。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak has risen recently. In the past week (21–27 September), 3,153 new cases were reported, up from more than 2,000 the previous week. Most were in Jiangmen city (2,927), followed by Foshan (78). No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen has recorded more than 2,000 new cases in a single week for two consecutive weeks, and has launched a Level III public health emergency response to strengthen outbreak control. In Matanzas province in western Cuba, confirmed cases were reported, the country's first reported cases since 2015. Vector-borne disease cases have increased in various regions, and local authorities have strengthened vector control measures. In addition, the US CDC has raised its travel alert for chikungunya in Cuba to Level 2.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),古巴

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年逾4.2萬例,WHO終止PHEIC但評估全球風險仍為中等
items.summary_en: WHO ended Mpox's PHEIC on 5 September but still rates global risk as moderate, with over 42,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年9/26累計141國/地區報告16萬2千餘例確診病例,其中,至少430例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第39週累計96國/地區報告4萬2千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬5,363例、美洲區3,314例、歐洲區2,044例、西太平洋區1,229例、東南亞區95例及東地中海區40例。東地中海與歐洲疫情上升,非洲、美洲、西太平洋、東南亞疫情下降。  其他更新:  美國加州9/15報告新增1例I型病例,為該州第2例、該國第6例I型病例,病患近期具中東旅遊史,與其他病例無流行病學關聯。*加州首例為2024年11月報告。 塞內加爾自今年8月報告首例截至9/23累計4例病例,首例為境外移入Ib型病例,案2確診IIb型,與案1無流行病學關聯,案3、4為案2接觸者,推測感染為IIb型病例,當局已匡列40名接觸者。 愛爾蘭9/18報告3例Ib型確診病例及1例疑病例,首例確診病例與具中東旅遊史之疑病例具流行病關聯,餘2例確診者為首例之密切接觸者,其中有1名兒童,目前病患皆已康復。當局評估該國風險仍低,並呼籲旅外民眾應採取必要公衛措施。 科威特8/10報告該國首例M痘病例,為IIb型,迄今累計3例確診病例,首例具中國旅遊史,當局已疫調並匡列接觸者。 澳大利亞9/9報告新增1例Ib型病例,具中國及菲律賓旅遊史,為該國自2024年1月迄今第3例,當局已疫調並追蹤接觸者,並協助接種暴露後疫苗。 泰國9/9報告新增Ib型病例,病患為成年男性,具阿曼旅遊史。為該國自2024年1月迄今第6例Ib型病例。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5公布經IHR緊急委員會第5次會議討論,建議中止國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),WHO於記者會表示,剛果民主共和國/蒲隆地/獅子山/烏干達等國病例/死亡數持續下降,且對疾病傳播及嚴重度風險因素已逐漸掌握,受影響國家亦建立持續應對能力,不再構成PHEIC,惟提醒PHEIC解除並不代表威脅已經消失,非洲CDC仍持續列為非洲緊急衛生事件。WHO評估全球公共衛生風險為中等,由於不同基因型持續流行、監測及診斷能力不足、資金缺乏及社區參與需更多資源,WHO已將長期建議延長至2026年8月。
items.description_en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 26 September this year, 141 countries and areas have reported more than 162,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 430 died (CFR 0.2%). Year to date as of week 39, 96 countries and areas have reported more than 42,000 confirmed cases: 35,363 in the African Region, 3,314 in the Region of the Americas, 2,044 in the European Region, 1,229 in the Western Pacific Region, 95 in the South-East Asia Region and 40 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have risen in the Eastern Mediterranean and Europe and declined in Africa, the Americas, the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. Other updates: On 15 September, California, United States, reported one new clade I case, the state's second and the country's sixth clade I case. The patient had recent travel history to the Middle East and no epidemiological link to other cases. The state's first case was reported in November 2024. Senegal reported its first case in August this year; as of 23 September, a cumulative 4 cases had been reported. The first case was an imported clade Ib case. Case 2 was confirmed as clade IIb and had no epidemiological link to case 1; cases 3 and 4 were contacts of case 2, and their infection is presumed to be clade IIb. Authorities have identified 40 contacts. Ireland reported three confirmed clade Ib cases and one suspected case on 18 September. The first confirmed case was epidemiologically linked to a suspected case with travel history to the Middle East; the other two confirmed cases were close contacts of the first, one of whom was a child. All patients have recovered. Authorities assess the country's risk as still low and urge travellers abroad to take necessary public health measures. Kuwait reported its first mpox case on 10 August; it was clade IIb, and 3 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The first case had travel history to China, and authorities have conducted an investigation and identified contacts. Australia reported one new clade Ib case on 9 September, with travel history to China and the Philippines; it is the country's third case since January 2024. Authorities have investigated and followed up contacts, and have helped administer post-exposure vaccines. Thailand reported a new clade Ib case on 9 September; the patient is an adult man with travel history to Oman, and it is the country's sixth clade Ib case since January 2024. Assessment and recommendations: On 5 September, WHO, following the fifth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee, recommended ending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). At a press conference, WHO said case and death numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Sierra Leone and Uganda continue to decline, risk factors for transmission and severity are increasingly understood, and affected countries have established sustained response capacity, so the event no longer constitutes a PHEIC. WHO cautioned that ending the PHEIC does not mean the threat has disappeared, and Africa CDC continues to treat the event as an emergency health event in Africa. WHO assesses the global public health risk as moderate. Because different genotypes continue to circulate, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, funding is lacking, and community engagement requires more resources, WHO has extended its long-term recommendations to August 2026.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,科威特,阿曼,菲律賓,愛爾蘭共和國,塞內加爾,泰國,美國

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染,洛杉磯同家庭2隻家貓死亡,1隻檢出H5N1
items.summary_en: No new human novel influenza A infections this week; in Los Angeles, two household cats died after eating raw cat food, one testing positive for H5N1.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共11國於 2025/9/19-26 期間報告51起H5N1疫情,西班牙18起、南非10起、美國 9 起、波蘭4起、葡萄牙3起、加拿大2起、匈牙利/韓國/德國/挪威/瓜地馬拉各1起。 美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,080(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於內布拉斯加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感1例,H5N1流感28例 (2003年迄今累計991*例),H9N2流感26例(迄今累計156例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計59國家/地區通報2,344起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  其他更新: 美國洛杉磯報告出現同一家庭內2隻家貓因食用生鮮貓食死亡案例,其中一隻檢測出高致病性H5N1病毒,該病毒屬於B3.13基因型,此病毒已在美國乳牛和家禽中傳播;另一隻家貓無法檢測,迄今尚未發現人類感染案例。此為 2024 年12月和2025年1月報告10起(9例確診、1例疑)貓群感染病例以來,洛杉磯縣首次出現貓群感染H5N1病毒病例。 評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 11 countries reported 51 H5N1 outbreaks between 19 and 26 September 2025: Spain 18, South Africa 10, United States 9, Poland 4, Portugal 3, Canada 2, and Hungary, South Korea, Germany, Norway and Guatemala 1 each. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,080 (1) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Nebraska. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 1 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 28 H5N1 influenza (991* cumulative since 2003); 26 H9N2 influenza (156 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 59 countries and areas have reported 2,344 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Other updates: In Los Angeles, United States, two domestic cats in the same household died after eating raw cat food. One of them tested positive for highly pathogenic H5N1 virus of genotype B3.13, a virus already spreading among US dairy cattle and poultry; the other could not be tested. No human infection has been found so far. This is the first H5N1 infection cluster in cats in Los Angeles County since 10 cases (9 confirmed and 1 suspected) were reported in December 2024 and January 2025. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率18.98%(第36週)上升,中國、香港、東南亞處低點
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 18.98% in week 36 and rising, while China, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia are at low levels.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第36週(9/1-7)全球陽性率18.98%,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點,第38週(9/15-21)門急診陽性率5.3%,較前一週下降,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情於低點,第38週陽性率下降至0.65%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,第38週報告病例數及死亡數均低,其中,印度及泊爾變異株以XFG占比最高,泰國以NB.1.8.1為主。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第37週陽性率9.5%,已連續3週下降,住院率亦呈下降趨勢,惟死亡率仍處高點。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(72%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 36 of 2025 (1–7 September) was 18.98%, with positivity increasing in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. China: The outbreak is at a low point. The outpatient and emergency positivity rate in week 38 (15–21 September) was 5.3%, lower than the previous week, and the hospital positivity rate is also declining. The variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Hong Kong: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate fell to 0.65% in week 38, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 38, reported cases and deaths were low; the variant XFG has the highest share in India and Nepal, and NB.1.8.1 predominates in Thailand. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 37 was 9.5%, having declined for three consecutive weeks; hospitalization rates are also declining, but the mortality rate remains high. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (72%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,印度,尼泊爾,泰國,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿爾及利亞奧蘭省1例cVDPV1,為近年首例,cVDPV2持續傳播
items.summary_en: Algeria's Oran province reported a cVDPV1 polio case, the first in recent years, while cVDPV2 continues to circulate locally.
items.description_zh: 阿爾及利亞北部奧蘭省(Oran)報告1例cVDPV1病例,係近年首例,病患於1月發病,3月於環境樣本亦檢出cVDPV1陽性;另該國自2022年以來陸續新增cVDPV2病例/陽性樣本,顯示cVDPV2於當地持續傳播。 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/11-17期間,cVDPV1新增阿爾及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增阿富汗共12件,cVDPV1新增阿爾及利亞1件,cVDPV2新增2國共7件,分別為葉門6件、阿爾及利亞1件。
items.description_en: In Oran province in northern Algeria, one cVDPV1 case was reported, the first in recent years. The patient developed symptoms in January, and cVDPV1 was also detected in an environmental sample in March. Algeria has also added cVDPV2 cases and positive samples since 2022, indicating continued cVDPV2 transmission locally. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 11–17 September, Algeria added one cVDPV1 case. For environmental samples, Afghanistan added 12 WPV1 samples, Algeria added one cVDPV1 sample, and two countries added seven cVDPV2 samples: six in Yemen and one in Algeria.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年累計逾7萬例腸病毒病例,無死亡,以0-4歲為多
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported over 70,000 enterovirus cases this year with no deaths, mostly among children aged 0–4.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截9/9累計報告逾約7萬例病例,無死亡案例,病患年齡以0-4歲為多;美國馬里蘭州今年截至9/16累計報告118例病例,高於去年48例。
items.description_en: As of 9 September, Thailand had reported more than approximately 70,000 cases cumulatively this year, with no deaths; most patients were aged 0–4 years. In the US state of Maryland, 118 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of 16 September, higher than the 48 cases reported last year.

items.summary_zh: 中國貴州遵義校園沙門氏菌群聚,累計136例,85例住院
items.summary_en: A Salmonella cluster at a school in Zunyi, Guizhou, has reached 136 cases, with 85 patients hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 中國貴州省遵義市9/22報告校園群聚事件,累計報告136例病例,其中85例住院,症狀包含發燒、腹痛及腹瀉等,疑感染源為三明治。
items.description_en: Zunyi City, Guizhou Province, China, reported a campus cluster on 22 September, with 136 cases cumulatively reported, of whom 85 were hospitalized. Symptoms included fever, abdominal pain and diarrhoea; the suspected source is sandwiches.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 德國-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 德國腸出血性大腸桿菌感染累計121例,28例併發溶血性尿毒症
items.summary_en: Germany has reported 121 EHEC cases since mid-August, 28 with haemolytic uraemic syndrome; the source remains under investigation.
items.description_zh: 德國疫情更新,自8月中旬截至9/19累計報告121例,其中28例出現溶血性尿毒症候群,病患年齡中位數為5歲,發病日介於8/11-9/9,型別為該國罕見的O45:H2,感染源仍調查中。
items.description_en: Germany's outbreak update: from mid-August to 19 September, 121 cases were cumulatively reported, of which 28 developed haemolytic uraemic syndrome. The median patient age is 5 years. Onset dates fall between 11 August and 9 September. The serotype is O45:H2, which is rare in Germany. The source remains under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 美國伊利諾州今年首例波瓦桑病毒病例,病情嚴重,正調查感染來源
items.summary_en: Illinois reported the first Powassan virus case of the year; the patient is seriously ill and the source is under investigation.
items.description_zh: 美國伊利諾州報告今年首例病例,病情嚴重,感染來源調查中,當局已針對病患發病前活動地區進行主動蜱蟲監測,並建議民眾應採取預防蜱蟲叮咬之防護措施,另於常見蜱蟲之戶外活動後,倘出現發燒、疲倦或頭痛等症狀,應立即就醫。
items.description_en: The US state of Illinois reported its first case of the year. The patient is seriously ill, and the source of infection is under investigation. Authorities have conducted active tick surveillance in the areas the patient visited before symptom onset, and recommend that the public take measures to prevent tick bites. After outdoor activities where common ticks are present, anyone who develops fever, fatigue or headache should seek medical care immediately.

items.summary_zh: 蒙古中部後杭愛省報告1例皮膚炭疽病,病患曾屠宰大量牛隻
items.summary_en: Mongolia reported one cutaneous anthrax case in Arkhangai Province after the patient slaughtered many cattle; partial quarantine imposed.
items.description_zh: 蒙古中部後杭愛省(Arkhangai)報告1例皮膚炭疽病例,病患於發病前曾屠宰大量牛隻,刻正住院隔離中,當局針對病患及家屬居住之地區實施部分隔離,另持續進行疫情監測及檢疫等措施。
items.description_en: Mongolia reported one case of cutaneous anthrax in Arkhangai Province in central Mongolia. The patient slaughtered large numbers of cattle before falling ill and is currently hospitalized in isolation. Authorities have imposed partial quarantine in the areas where the patient and family live, and continue surveillance, quarantine and other control measures.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦今年累計77例確定病例,21例死亡
items.summary_en: Kerala, India has reported 77 confirmed amoebic meningitis cases this year, 21 of them fatal (CFR 27%).
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至9/22累計報告77例確定病例,其中21例死亡(CFR:27%),今年病例數已超過往年疫情,且高於其他國家,病患主要集中於馬拉普蘭(Malappuram)區,當局已針對該邦水井、游泳池及水箱進行氯化處理作業,並警告民眾勿接觸不安全淡水。
items.description_en: Kerala State, India, outbreak update: as of 22 September this year, 77 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 21 died (CFR: 27%). This year's case count has already exceeded previous years' outbreaks and is higher than in other countries. Cases are concentrated in Malappuram District. Authorities have chlorinated water wells, swimming pools and water tanks in the state and warned the public not to come into contact with unsafe fresh water.

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉-立百病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年累計4例立百病毒死亡病例,WHO評估國家及區域風險為中
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported four fatal Nipah virus cases this year; WHO rates national and regional risk as moderate, global risk low.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉今年截至8/29累計報告4例死亡病例(前已掌握3例),分別來自不同地區*,病患間無流病關聯,前3案於今年1-2月確診,包含2名成年男性及1名成年女性,發病時間介於1/25-2/17間,皆於就醫住院後死亡,經調查,病患皆曾生飲椰棗樹汁,所有接觸者檢驗均為陰性;案4為男童,於8/6 出現症狀,8-9日住院轉加護病房,14日死亡,經流行病學調查,病患未食用生棕櫚汁,感染源調查中,接觸者共計72名,採檢出現症狀者共計11人,6人為陰性,其餘檢驗中。該國自2001起迄今累計報告347例,其中249例死亡(CFR:72%),近10年除2023年外,病例數皆低於10例。WHO評估該國及區域風險為中,全球風險為低。
items.description_en: Bangladesh has reported four deaths cumulatively this year as of 29 August (three of which were previously known), in different areas. There were no epidemiological links among the patients. The first three cases were confirmed in January and February this year and comprised two adult men and one adult woman, with onset between 25 January and 17 February. All three died after hospitalization. Investigation found that all of these patients had drunk raw date palm sap, and all their contacts tested negative. Case 4 was a boy who developed symptoms on 6 August, was hospitalized and transferred to the intensive care unit on 8–9 August, and died on 14 August. Epidemiological investigation found that this patient had not consumed raw palm sap, and the source of infection is under investigation. A total of 72 contacts were identified; 11 contacts with symptoms were sampled, 6 of whom tested negative, and the remaining tests are pending. Since 2001, the country has cumulatively reported 347 cases, of which 249 were fatal (CFR: 72%). Apart from 2023, case numbers in the past 10 years have been below 10. WHO assesses the risk to the country and region as moderate, and the global risk as low.

items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州報告2例狂犬病死亡,病患皆曾遭貓犬抓咬
items.summary_en: Sarawak, Malaysia reported two rabies deaths after cat and dog bites or scratches; 80 of 87 cases since 2017 were fatal.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州報告2例死亡病例,案1為22歲女學生,曾於7月被流浪貓抓傷,未就醫進行治療,9/8出現發燒、身體無力及吞嚥困難等症狀,19日死亡;案2為67歲女性,8/30曾被犬隻咬傷,9/13出現發燒、行為改變及飲水困難等症狀,16日就醫,19日死亡,另病患飼養4隻寵物皆未接種疫苗,其中一隻曾出現狂犬病症狀死亡;該州自2017年迄今已累計報告87例,其中80例死亡(CFR:92%),今(2025)年累計報告4例,當局提醒民眾倘被犬貓抓咬傷,應立即以清水及肥皂清洗傷口至少15分鐘並立即就醫,另倘發現犬/貓/動物死亡,勿自行處理,應向當地政府通報。
items.description_en: Sarawak State, Malaysia reported two fatal cases. Case 1 was a 22-year-old female student who had been scratched by a stray cat in July and did not seek treatment; she developed fever, physical weakness and difficulty swallowing on 8 September and died on 19 September. Case 2 was a 67-year-old woman who was bitten by a dog on 30 August; she developed fever, behavioural changes and difficulty drinking water on 13 September, sought medical care on 16 September and died on 19 September. The patient kept four pets, none of which had been vaccinated; one of them had shown rabies symptoms and died. Since 2017 the state has cumulatively reported 87 cases, of which 80 were fatal (CFR: 92%); four cases have been reported so far in 2025. Authorities remind the public that if bitten or scratched by a dog or cat, wounds should be washed immediately with clean water and soap for at least 15 minutes, and medical care sought right away. If a dead dog, cat or other animal is found, do not handle it oneself; report it to the local government.

items.headline_zh: 美國/加拿大/玻利維亞-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計1,491例麻疹,加拿大4,902例,玻利維亞逾1,500例
items.summary_en: The US has reported 1,491 measles cases this year, Canada 4,902 and Bolivia over 1,500, mostly among children.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至9/17共42州報告1,491例,其中181例住院、3例死亡,病患年齡以5-19歲占大宗。 加拿大近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第36週(8/31-9/6)新增報告53例,今年累計報告4,902例病例,病患多分布於安大略省及亞伯達省,年齡以5-17歲為多。 玻利維亞今年截至9/19累計報告逾1,500例,為南美洲病例數最多國家,分布以東部聖克魯斯省為多(佔85%),病患年齡多為1-9歲,84%病患未接種疫苗或接種情況不明。
items.description_en: As of 17 September, 42 US states had reported 1,491 cases this year, including 181 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; most patients were aged 5–19 years. Canada's recent outbreak shows a declining trend: 53 new cases were reported in week 36 (31 August–6 September), and 4,902 cases have been reported cumulatively this year. Most cases are in Ontario and Alberta, and most patients are aged 5–17 years. Bolivia reported more than 1,500 cumulative cases as of 19 September, the highest number in South America. Cases are concentrated in eastern Santa Cruz Department (85%); most patients are aged 1–9 years, and 84% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status.

items.summary_zh: 日本福岡縣傳染性紅斑第37週平均2.73例,較前週減少但仍屬警戒
items.summary_en: Fukuoka Prefecture's average of 2.73 erythema infectiosum reports per sentinel institution fell from last week but remains at warning level.
items.description_zh: 日本福岡縣於第37週(9/8-14)定醫平均報告數2.73例,較前一週減少,惟仍處於警戒等級;佐賀縣12家指定醫療機構共報告58例病例。另該國今年截至第36週定醫平均報告1.39例,疫情遠高於近10年同期平均(0.22例)。
items.description_en: In Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan, the average number of reports from sentinel medical institutions in week 37 (8–14 September) was 2.73 cases, a decrease from the previous week but still at warning level. Twelve designated medical institutions in Saga Prefecture reported a total of 58 cases. Japan's average number of sentinel reports as of week 36 this year was 1.39, far above the 10-year average for the same period (0.22).

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至9/20累計約8,500例呼吸道融合病毒病例,1例死亡
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported about 8,500 RSV cases this year as of 20 September, including one death, higher than last year.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至9/20累計報告約8,500例病例,其中1例死亡,疫情高於去年同期,病患以0-4歲族群為多。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported approximately 8,500 cases cumulatively this year as of 20 September, including one death. Activity is higher than in the same period last year, and most patients are in the 0–4 age group.

items.summary_zh: 美國2024-25流感季住院率每10萬人127.1人,為2011年以來最高
items.summary_en: The US 2024–25 influenza season hospitalization rate reached 127.1 per 100,000, the highest since 2011; most hospitalized were over 75.
items.description_zh: 美國於9/11公布2024-25流感季之累計住院率為每10萬人口127.1人,為2011年以來最高,住院病患以75歲以上為多,32%有接種流感疫苗,84%有使用抗病毒藥劑,16.8%入住重症病房,3%於住院期間死亡,CDC建議所有沒有禁忌症且≥6個月大者應每年接種疫苗,所有住院患者應及時接受抗病毒藥物治療,以降低併發症風險。
items.description_en: On 11 September, the United States announced that the cumulative hospitalization rate for the 2024–25 influenza season was 127.1 per 100,000 population, the highest since 2011. Most hospitalized patients were aged over 75. Of hospitalized patients, 32% had received influenza vaccination, 84% had received antiviral treatment, 16.8% were admitted to intensive care units, and 3% died during hospitalization. CDC recommends annual vaccination for everyone aged 6 months and older without contraindications, and timely antiviral treatment for all hospitalized patients to reduce the risk of complications.

items.summary_zh: 巴西米納斯吉拉斯州今年累計27例斑疹熱,卡埃特市2例死亡後宣布公衛緊急事件
items.summary_en: Minas Gerais, Brazil has recorded 27 spotted fever cases this year; after two deaths in Caeté, a public health emergency was declared.
items.description_zh: 巴西米納斯吉拉斯州卡埃特9/18報告2例死亡病例,其後宣布疫情構成公共衛生緊急事件,該州今年迄今累計27例病例,主要分布於美景市5例及伊塔比拉4例;該州去年累計95例病例及4例死亡、2023年累計90例病例及20例死亡、2022年累計27例病例及6例死亡。當局提醒民眾出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉疼痛、噁心或嘔吐等疑症狀應立即就醫,並告知是否曾接觸過動物或蜱蟲。
items.description_en: In Caeté, Minas Gerais State, Brazil, two deaths were reported on 18 September, after which the outbreak was declared a public health emergency. The state has recorded 27 cases so far this year, mainly in Belo Oriente (5 cases) and Itabira (4 cases). Last year the state recorded 95 cases and 4 deaths; in 2023, 90 cases and 20 deaths; and in 2022, 27 cases and 6 deaths. Authorities urge anyone with suspicious symptoms such as fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea or vomiting to seek medical care immediately, and to report any contact with animals or ticks.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年登革熱累計約4.2萬例及179例死亡,單日新增740例住院
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has recorded about 42,000 dengue cases and 179 deaths this year, with 740 new hospitalizations in one day.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,近1日新增740例住院病例及12例死亡,今年迄今累計約42,000例病例及179例死亡,氣候變遷導致疫情升溫;該國於2023年疫情最為嚴峻,累計逾321,000例病例及1,705例死亡。
items.description_en: Dengue cases are rising in Bangladesh. In the past day, 740 new hospitalized cases and 12 deaths were reported. So far this year, approximately 42,000 cases and 179 deaths have been cumulatively reported. Climate change is contributing to the rise. In 2023, the country's worst year, more than 321,000 cases and 1,705 deaths were cumulatively reported.

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東近1週新增逾2千例屈公病,逾9成在江門;法國今年484例本土病例
items.summary_en: Guangdong, China reported over 2,000 chikungunya cases in one week, mostly in Jiangmen; France has 484 locally acquired cases this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情明顯上升,近1週(9/14-20)新增逾2千例病例,超過9成病例分布於江門市,無報告重症及死亡病例,該省近1週病例數較前2週(8/31-9/13)178例及201例顯著增加,江門市於9/20宣布啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,加強疫情防控。香港於9/21新增1例移入病例,於9月中旬曾到訪廣東省佛山市,香港今年累計報告22例病例,全屬移入病例,較往年每年1-11例移入病例為多。 法國疫情更新,今年累計484例本土病例,較前一週(382例)上升,病例除了分布於往年發生地區,今年首次於勃艮第-法蘭琪-康堤、中央-羅亞爾河谷、大東部、新亞奎丹大區亦發生病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen a marked recent rise: more than 2,000 new cases were reported in the past week (14–20 September), over 90% of them in Jiangmen City, and no severe or fatal cases were reported. The province's weekly case count increased significantly compared with 178 and 201 cases in the two preceding weeks (31 August–13 September). On 20 September, Jiangmen City announced activation of a Level III emergency response for public health emergencies to strengthen outbreak prevention and control. Hong Kong reported one new imported case on 21 September; the patient had visited Foshan City, Guangdong, in mid-September. Hong Kong has reported 22 cases this year, all imported, more than the 1–11 imported cases reported annually in previous years. France's outbreak update: 484 locally acquired cases have been reported cumulatively this year, up from 382 the previous week. In addition to areas with cases in previous years, cases have appeared for the first time this year in the Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Centre-Val de Loire, Grand Est and Nouvelle-Aquitaine regions.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),法國

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東9/7-13新增201例屈公病,為前週1.13倍,佛山最多
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 201 chikungunya cases from 7–13 September, 1.13 times the previous week, with Foshan most affected.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情近期回溫,9/7-13新增201例病例,為前一週1.13倍,其中無重症/死亡病例,病患分布於佛山(86例)、廣州(41例)、江門(26例)、深圳(19例),其中江門市於9/20啟動突發公共衛生事件3級響應;另該省於8/3-9/6累計新增2,956例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, reported 201 chikungunya cases during 7–13 September, 1.13 times the previous week. None were severe or fatal. Cases were distributed in Foshan (86), Guangzhou (41), Jiangmen (26) and Shenzhen (19). Jiangmen City announced activation of a Level III public health emergency response on 20 September. From 3 August to 6 September, the province added 2,956 cases cumulatively.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,中國新增4例H9N2,全球公衛風險仍低
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 case and China four H9N2 cases; FAO, WHO and WOAH still assess global public health risk as low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例、中國新增 4 例H9N2流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共6國於 2025/9/12-19 期間報告 30 起 H5N1疫情,英國15起、加拿大6起、美國4起、德國/挪威各2起、葡萄牙 1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,080(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於內布拉斯加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第37週計404個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西、明蘇達、堪薩斯州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感1例,H5N1流感28例 (2003年迄今累計991*例),H9N2流感26例(迄今累計156例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計58國家/地區通報2,289起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, and China reported four new human H9N2 infections. Animal (WAHIS) and poultry outbreaks: a total of six countries reported 30 H5N1 outbreaks during 12–19 September 2025, including the UK (15), Canada (6), the USA (4), Germany (2), Norway (2) and Portugal (1). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,080 (1) herd outbreaks have been reported across 18 states since March last year, with recent cases concentrated mainly in Nebraska. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including one cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 37, 404 sampling sites reported results; three sites in three states (New Jersey, Minnesota and Kansas) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: this year, one H5 influenza case (including presumptive), 28 H5N1 influenza cases (991* cumulatively since 2003), 26 H9N2 influenza cases (156 cumulatively) and two H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 58 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,289 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue. Global public health risk remains low. Risk of infection is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments; the main determinants are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for stronger surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.
items.area_zh: 柬埔寨,中國大陸(不含港澳)

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第35週全球新冠陽性率13.76%,多數區域上升,XFG變異株占62%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity reached 13.76% in week 35 and rose in most regions; XFG is the dominant variant at 62%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第35週(8/25-31)全球陽性率13.76%,除東南亞及非洲區署以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點波動,第37週(9/8-14)門急診陽性率6.8%,與前一週相當,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情處低點,第37週陽性率下降至0.78%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情於高點稍降,第36週定醫平均報告數7.46,較近2週下降,病患以10歲以下為多,地理分布以東京都、大阪為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 加拿大疫情持續上升,第36週陽性率上升至8.5%,惟較近兩年同期低,住院新增283例,病患以65歲以上為多(占55%),以變異株XFG占比最高(49%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(62%),其次為NB.1.8.1(24%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 35 of 2025 (25–31 August), global test positivity was 13.76%; positivity increased in all WHO regions except South-East Asia and Africa. China's outbreak is fluctuating at a low level; in week 37 (8–14 September), outpatient and emergency positivity was 6.8%, similar to the previous week, while inpatient positivity is declining; variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share. Hong Kong's outbreak is at a low level; positivity fell to 0.78% in week 37, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Japan's outbreak has declined slightly from its peak; the average number of sentinel reports in week 36 was 7.46, lower than in the previous two weeks. Patients are mostly under 10 years old, geographically concentrated in Tokyo and Osaka, and NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share. Canada's outbreak continues to rise; positivity rose to 8.5% in week 36, though still lower than the same period in the past two years. There were 283 new hospitalizations, mostly among patients aged 65 and over (55%); variant XFG accounts for the largest share (49%). Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with rising trends in the Americas, Europe and Africa regions. The predominant global variant is XFG (62%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (24%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 9/4-10新增7例cVDPV2小兒麻痺病例,奈及利亞4例最多
items.summary_en: The GPEI reported seven new cVDPV2 cases from 4–10 September in Nigeria, Chad and Somalia, plus one cVDPV3 case in Chad.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/4-10期間,cVDPV2新增3國共7例,分別為奈及利亞4例、查德2例、索馬利亞1例;cVDPV3新增查德1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增4國共5件,分別為查德2件、阿爾及利亞/索馬利亞/坦尚亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 4–10 September, circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) cases increased by seven across three countries: Nigeria (4), Chad (2) and Somalia (1). cVDPV3 increased by one case in Chad. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 detections increased by five across four countries: Chad (2), and Algeria, Somalia and Tanzania (1 each).
items.area_zh: 查德,奈及利亞,索馬利亞

items.summary_zh: 中國8/25-9/7累計3.7萬例腸病毒,13例重症,較前兩週減17%
items.summary_en: China reported 37,000 enterovirus cases from 25 August to 7 September, 13 severe; cases fell 17% but remain above last year.
items.description_zh: 中國第35-36週(8/25-9/7)累計報告3.7萬例病例,其中重症13例,病例數雖較前兩週減少17%,惟仍高於去年同期;病毒型別部分,腸病毒克沙奇A16占22%,A71占13.4%,均較去年占比低。
items.description_en: China reported a cumulative 37,000 cases in weeks 35–36 (25 August–7 September), including 13 severe cases. Although case numbers fell 17% compared with the previous two weeks, they remain higher than in the same period last year. By virus type, coxsackievirus A16 accounted for 22% and enterovirus A71 for 13.4%, both lower proportions than last year.

items.headline_zh: 捷克-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 捷克今年逾1,300例A型肝炎,15例死亡;布拉格為2008年來最嚴重
items.summary_en: Czechia has reported over 1,300 hepatitis A cases and 15 deaths this year; Prague's outbreak is its worst since 2008.
items.description_zh: 捷克首都布拉疫情嚴峻,今年截至9/6累計報告505例,病例數為去年2倍,為自2008年以來最嚴重疫情;當局已加強疫苗接種,並加強環境清潔衛生。另該國今年迄今累計報告逾1,300例病例,其中,15例死亡。
items.description_en: Prague, the capital of Czechia, is experiencing a severe outbreak: as of 6 September this year, 505 cases had been cumulatively reported, twice last year's number and the most serious outbreak since 2008. Authorities have stepped up vaccination and strengthened environmental cleaning and hygiene. The country has also reported more than 1,300 cases cumulatively this year, including 15 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 迦納奧蒂區今年累計2.3萬例傷寒,印度瓦拉納西8月逾250例
items.summary_en: Ghana's Oti Region has reported 23,000 typhoid cases this year, and Varanasi, India, over 250 cases in August, up 30% from July.
items.description_zh: 迦納東部奧蒂區(Oti)今年截至8/28累計報告2.3萬例病例,較今年上半年(1萬例)增加快速;由於當地衛生條件不佳及廢棄物管理不當,當局已發布疫情警示,並加強對食物攤販之稽查。 印度北方邦瓦拉納西市(Varanasi)8月報告逾250例病例,較7月增加30%,且高於平時80至120例;當局呼籲民眾飲用煮沸過之水並保持良好衛生習慣,倘有症狀,應立就醫。
items.description_en: In Oti Region in eastern Ghana, 23,000 cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 28 August, a rapid increase from 10,000 in the first half of the year. Due to poor local sanitation and inadequate waste management, authorities issued an outbreak alert and intensified inspections of food vendors. In Varanasi City, Uttar Pradesh, India, more than 250 cases were reported in August, a 30% increase over July and above the usual 80–120 cases. Authorities urge residents to drink boiled water, maintain good hygiene, and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear.

items.summary_zh: 日本9/14首例Ib型M痘,神戶女性有非洲旅遊史;泰國今年61例
items.summary_en: Japan reported its first clade Ib mpox case, in a woman in Kobe with African travel history; Thailand has 61 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 泰國疫情自5月起上升,第34週(8/17-23)單週新增5例病例,該國今年截至9月初已累計61例病例(無死亡個案),自2022年迄今累計933例,其中13例死亡。病患多為男性且具國際旅遊史,感染源主要為不安全性行為,多數重症或死亡患者亦感染HIV,且未持續服用藥物。當局呼籲民眾避免不安全性行為,該國為旅遊勝地,評估仍有境外移入病例之可能。 日本9/14報告新增首例Ib型病例,為神戶市1名具非洲旅遊史之20多歲女性,出現皮疹、發燒及淋巴結腫大等症狀,於9/12就診。當局呼籲具國際旅遊史民眾,倘有不適症狀,應儘速就醫。該國自2022年截至今年9/12,累計254例病例,其中1例死亡。
items.description_en: Thailand's outbreak has risen since May. In week 34 (17–23 August), five cases were reported in a single week. As of early September this year, Thailand had cumulatively reported 61 cases, with no deaths; since 2022, 933 cases have been reported, including 13 deaths. Patients are mostly men with international travel history, and the main source of infection is unsafe sexual behaviour; most severe or fatal cases were also HIV-positive and not on continuous medication. Authorities urge the public to avoid unsafe sexual behaviour. As a popular tourist destination, Thailand is assessed to still have a possibility of imported cases. On 14 September, Japan reported its first clade Ib case, a woman in her twenties in Kobe City with travel history to Africa, who developed rash, fever and lymphadenopathy and sought care on 12 September. Authorities urge people with international travel history who develop symptoms to seek medical care promptly. From 2022 to 12 September this year, Japan has cumulatively reported 254 cases, including one death.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 巴基斯坦-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦信德省近期新增1例死亡,今年累計5例福氏內格里阿米巴腦炎死亡
items.summary_en: Sindh Province, Pakistan, reported a fatal Naegleria fowleri infection in a 29-year-old man; five deaths so far this year.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦東南部信德省報告1例死亡病例,為29歲男性,於9/7出現症狀,11日病情惡化住院,同日死亡,12日經實驗室確診,病患無水域相關接觸史,僅接觸日常飲用及沐浴之自來水。該省今年累計5例死亡病例,專家建議民眾應定期清潔儲水箱,並將水煮沸或使用氯片淨化水質。
items.description_en: Sindh Province in south-eastern Pakistan reported one death: a 29-year-old man who developed symptoms on 7 September, deteriorated and was admitted to hospital on 11 September, and died the same day. Laboratory confirmation was made on 12 September. The patient had no water-related exposure and only used tap water for daily drinking and bathing. The province has recorded five deaths so far this year. Experts recommend regularly cleaning water storage tanks and boiling water or using chlorine tablets to purify it.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉北部逾50例疑似皮膚炭疽病,9/2起大規模牲畜接種
items.summary_en: Rangpur Division, northern Bangladesh, reported over 50 suspected cutaneous anthrax cases since mid-August; livestock vaccination began 2 September.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉北部朗布爾專區於今年8月中旬至9/6期間報告逾50例疑病例,病患出現與皮膚炭疽病相關之典型皮膚潰瘍。該區於8月中旬報告首例動物死亡案例,隨後出現與處理及食用牛肉相關之人類感染病例,牲畜樣本經實驗室確診為炭疽病,惟當地醫院缺乏疑病例診斷能力。當局已啟動疫情調查控制小組,並於9/2起進行大規模牲畜疫苗接種作業;該國於2010年曾爆發嚴重疫情,共計報告607例確診病例,其中2例死亡。
items.description_en: In Rangpur Division in northern Bangladesh, more than 50 suspected cases were reported from mid-August to 6 September, with patients presenting typical skin ulcers associated with cutaneous anthrax. The division reported its first animal death in mid-August, followed by human infections linked to handling and eating beef. Livestock samples were laboratory-confirmed as anthrax, but local hospitals lack the capacity to diagnose suspected cases. Authorities have set up an outbreak investigation and control team and, from 2 September, began large-scale livestock vaccination. The country had a severe outbreak in 2010, with 607 confirmed cases and 2 deaths.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國開賽省今年累計81例伊波拉病例,28例死亡
items.summary_en: DR Congo's Kasai-Central Province has reported 81 Ebola cases this year, including 28 deaths; over 700 contacts have been identified.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省疫情更新,今(2025)年截至9/13累計報告81例確診及疑病例,其中28例死亡(CFR:34.5%),已匡列逾700名接觸者,近期在疫情中心以外地區發現1例新病例。WHO已與該國合作,提供治療性單株抗體及疫苗等防疫物資;本次為該省18年來首次爆發疫情,其個案管理能力不足及道路不便,已成為疫情防治相關工作之挑戰。
items.description_en: Outbreak update for Kasai-Central Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of 13 September this year, 81 confirmed and suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 28 died (CFR: 34.5%). More than 700 contacts have been identified. A new case was recently detected outside the outbreak centre. WHO, in cooperation with the country, has provided therapeutic monoclonal antibodies, vaccines and other response supplies. This is the first outbreak in the province in 18 years; insufficient case management capacity and poor road access have posed challenges to control efforts.

items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭8月報告1,084例結核病,其中195例為抗藥性結核
items.summary_en: Ukraine reported 1,084 TB cases in August, 195 drug-resistant; a study links declining eastern incidence to difficulties in surveillance during conflict.
items.description_zh: 烏克蘭8月報告1,084例病例,其中195例為抗藥性結核;研究發現東部地區自2022年後,發生率顯著下降,顯示於戰爭衝突下,不易維持監測通報系統之運作。
items.description_en: Ukraine reported 1,084 cases in August, of which 195 were drug-resistant tuberculosis. A study found that incidence in the eastern region has declined significantly since 2022, indicating that under armed conflict it is difficult to maintain the operation of surveillance and notification systems.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年1,454例麻疹,中國8月新增94例為今年單月最低
items.summary_en: The US reported 1,454 measles cases this year as of 10 September; China's 94 August cases were its lowest monthly count this year.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至9/10共42州報告1,454例,其中180例住院、3例死亡,病患以5-19歲族群為主,92%未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明;中國今年截至8月累計報告1,744例病例,無死亡病例,其中8月新增94例,為今年單月最低。
items.description_en: As of 10 September this year, 42 US states had reported 1,454 cases, including 180 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Most patients are aged 5–19 years, and 92% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. China reported a cumulative 1,744 cases this year as of August, with no deaths; 94 new cases were reported in August, the lowest monthly figure this year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),美國

items.summary_zh: 美國紐約西徹斯特郡報告37例退伍軍人病,2例死亡
items.summary_en: Westchester County, New York reported 37 Legionnaires' disease cases, including 2 deaths; the source is under investigation.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市西徹斯特郡(Westchester)於9/8報告37例病例,其中2例死亡,感染源調查中;該市哈林區在8月亦曾因冷卻水塔汙染爆發疫情,造成至少100例病例,其中7例死亡。
items.description_en: Westchester County, New York, USA, reported 37 cases on 8 September, including 2 deaths; the source of infection is under investigation. Earlier in August, an outbreak in the Harlem district of New York City was caused by contamination of a cooling tower, resulting in at least 100 cases, including 7 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳疫情趨緩,第36週報告1,921例,今年累計逾7.2萬例
items.summary_en: Japan's pertussis outbreak is easing, with 1,921 cases in week 36, but this year's cumulative total exceeds 72,000.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情趨緩,第36週(9/1-7)通報1,921例,病患以5-19歲族群為主,並以東京都及神奈川縣為多;今年累計病例已逾72,000例,遠高於過去7年。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is easing. In week 36 (1–7 September), 1,921 cases were reported, mainly among people aged 5–19 years, concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa Prefecture. Cumulative cases this year have exceeded 72,000, far higher than in the past seven years.

items.headline_zh: 義大利/希臘/塞爾維亞/法國/羅馬尼亞/匈牙利/西班牙/阿爾巴尼亞/保加利亞-西尼羅熱
items.headline_en: Italy / Greece / Serbia / France / Romania / Hungary / Spain / Albania / Bulgaria – West Nile fever
items.summary_zh: 義大利今年582例西尼羅熱,39例死亡,歐洲多國出現本土病例
items.summary_en: Italy has reported 582 West Nile fever cases and 39 deaths this year, with 260 neuroinvasive cases; several European countries report local transmission.
items.description_zh: 義大利疫情更新,今年迄今累計582例病例及39例死亡(CFR:15%),其中有260例病例發生侵犯神經系統症狀,病例主要分布於拉吉歐及坎帕亞大區。歐洲今年截至9/3,包括義大利、希臘、塞爾維亞、法國、羅馬亞、匈牙利、西班牙、阿爾巴亞及保加利亞等國均有報告本土病例。
items.description_en: Italy's outbreak update: so far this year, 582 cases and 39 deaths have been reported (CFR: 15%), of which 260 cases had neuroinvasive symptoms; cases are mainly in the Lazio and Campania regions. As of 3 September this year, locally acquired cases have been reported in Europe in several countries, including Italy, Greece, Serbia, France, Romania, Hungary, Spain, Albania and Bulgaria.
items.area_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞,保加利亞,法國,希臘,匈牙利,義大利,羅馬尼亞,塞爾維亞共和國,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 蒙古報告3例鼠疫,追蹤110名接觸者,17省列為風險地區
items.summary_en: Mongolia has reported three plague cases and traced 110 contacts; 17 provinces are listed as risk areas and gatherings are restricted.
items.description_zh: 蒙古報告3例病例,已追蹤110名接觸者,目前該國17個省列為風險地區,當局暫時限制大型活動並採取遠距教學,以避免爆發疫情;2014至2024年共報告20例病例及9例死亡。
items.description_en: Mongolia has reported three cases and has traced 110 contacts. Seventeen provinces across the country are currently listed as risk areas. Authorities have temporarily restricted large gatherings and adopted distance learning to prevent outbreaks. From 2014 to 2024, a total of 20 cases and 9 deaths were reported.

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東疫情趨緩,近1週201例;孟加拉累計732例疑病例
items.summary_en: Guangdong, China reported 201 chikungunya cases in the past week, with the outbreak easing; Bangladesh has 732 suspected cases this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(9/7-13)新增201例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市86例最多,其次為廣州市41例。 孟加拉疫情更新,自4月中旬以來,於城鎮地區之病例數上升,今年截至8/31累計732例疑病例,其中400例確診。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (7–13 September), 201 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 86 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 41. Bangladesh outbreak update: since mid-April, case numbers have risen in urban areas; as of 31 August this year, 732 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 400 were confirmed.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,中國大陸(不含港澳)

items.summary_zh: 美國佛蒙特州首例詹姆士峽谷病毒病例,病患來自溫莎郡
items.summary_en: Vermont reported its first Jamestown Canyon virus case on 8 September, in a patient from Windsor County; there is no vaccine or treatment.
items.description_zh: 美國佛蒙特州9/8報告該州首例,病患來自該州東部溫莎郡(Windsor County),經實驗室檢驗後確診,相關流行病學資訊不明。該病毒今年7月首次於該州檢出,病毒透過蚊蟲傳播,多數人出現發燒、疲勞及頭痛等輕微症狀,部分人出現類流感症狀,免疫系統低下或年長者可能出現神經性症狀或頸部僵硬等嚴重症狀。目前尚無疫苗及治療方法。自2002年迄今,該州報告17例西羅河熱及4例東部馬腦炎,當局表示雖然天氣逐漸轉涼,呼籲民眾仍應採取防蚊措施。
items.description_en: Vermont State, USA, reported its first case of the state on 8 September. The patient, from Windsor County in the east of the state, was confirmed by laboratory testing; relevant epidemiological information is unknown. The virus was first detected in the state in July this year. It is transmitted by mosquitoes. Most people develop mild symptoms such as fever, fatigue and headache, and some have influenza-like symptoms. People with weakened immune systems or older adults may develop severe symptoms, such as neurological symptoms or neck stiffness. There is currently no vaccine or treatment. Since 2002, the state has reported 17 cases of 西羅河熱 (English name to be verified) and four cases of eastern equine encephalitis. Authorities say that although the weather is gradually cooling, the public should continue to take mosquito-prevention measures.

items.summary_zh: 泰國11區列為狂犬病警戒區,曼谷巴域區9/9報告動物感染
items.summary_en: Thailand has designated 11 areas in Bangkok and Nonthaburi as rabies alert zones after animal infections were reported in Prawet on 9 September.
items.description_zh: 泰國公布曼谷及北欖府之11個區域被列為警戒區,曼古府巴域(Prawet)區於9/9報告出現動物感染疫情,當局警告該地區及週邊5公里半徑範圍內,共計11個地區之居民應嚴避免與該地區之流浪動物接觸,倘民眾被抓咬傷或觸摸疑狂犬病之動物,應用肥皂清洗傷口並立即就醫接種疫苗。如發現犬/貓/動物死亡或出現咬東西等疑症狀,應通報動物管理及收容相關單位。
items.description_en: Thailand has designated 11 areas in Bangkok and Nonthaburi Province as alert zones. Prawet District in Bangkok reported animal infections on 9 September. Authorities warn residents of the area and of the 11 districts within a 5-km radius to strictly avoid contact with stray animals in the area. If a person is bitten or scratched, or touches an animal suspected of having rabies, the wound should be washed with soap and the person should seek medical care immediately for vaccination. If a dog, cat or other animal is found dead, or shows suspicious symptoms such as biting objects, it should be reported to animal management and shelter units.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國本週新增4例H9N2,美國加州兒童H5N1感染源仍不明
items.summary_en: This week China reported four new human H9N2 cases; a California child's H5N1 infection, matching the dairy-cattle genotype, remains of unknown source.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週新增4例中國H9N2流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共5國於2025/9/5-12期間報告17起H5N1疫情,南非 8 起、美國3起、德國/挪威/西班牙各2起。 挪威於2025/9/5報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,079起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第36週計422個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中4州(維吉亞州、加州、紐澤西州及阿拉斯加州)共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC公布加州兒童感染H5N1流感調查報告,病患於去年12/13發病,出現發燒、腹痛、肌肉疼痛及結膜炎症狀,於16-17日就醫,於今年1/9 確診H5流感陽性。經定序結果顯示,為2.3.4.4b分支/ B3.13基因型,與該國乳牛疫情型別一致。病患相關接觸者皆為陰性,流病調查部分,病患居住於城市環境,近期無旅遊史,發病前亦未接觸禽/畜/貓/野生動物,家中飼養犬隻,家人未從事高感染風險職業,惟病患家屬於發病前2週於活禽市場購買生禽,於購買當日宰殺食用,目前感染源仍不明。 研究指出A型流感病毒除引起呼吸道症狀外,亦可能造成腹瀉、嘔吐、腹痛等腸胃道症狀。近期美國乳牛感染H5N1並有零星人類感染,顯示病毒具食源性感染之公共衛生風險。該研究顯示季節性與新型A型流感腸胃道併發症的頻率,相關證據顯示A型流感及H5N1流感可在哺乳動物腸胃組織中複製,顯示哺乳動物攝入含病毒物質感染可能性。胃部暴露可能為H5N1流感感染哺乳動物的非呼吸道途徑,多種暴露路徑下可能於腸道檢測到病毒。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感1例,H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例),H9N2流感22例(迄今累計150例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計58國家/地區通報2,263起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: four new human H9N2 infections were reported in China this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of five countries reported 17 H5N1 outbreaks during 5–12 September 2025, including South Africa (8), USA (3), and Germany, Norway and Spain (2 each). Norway reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks on 5 September 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,079 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including one cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 36, 422 sampling sites provided results, and four sites in four states (Virginia, California, New Jersey and Alaska) detected H5-positive samples. Other updates: the US CDC published an investigation report on a child in California infected with H5N1 influenza. The child fell ill on 13 December last year with fever, abdominal pain, muscle pain and conjunctivitis, sought medical care on 16–17 December, and was confirmed H5 influenza-positive on 9 January this year. Sequencing showed clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype B3.13, consistent with the country's dairy cattle outbreak strains. All of the patient's contacts tested negative. The epidemiological investigation found that the patient lived in an urban environment with no recent travel history, had no exposure to poultry, livestock, cats or wild animals before onset, and kept dogs at home. No family member had a high-risk occupation. However, family members bought live poultry at a live-poultry market two weeks before the patient's onset and slaughtered and ate it on the day of purchase. The infection source remains unknown. A study notes that influenza A viruses can cause gastrointestinal symptoms such as diarrhoea, vomiting and abdominal pain in addition to respiratory symptoms. Recent H5N1 infections in US dairy cattle and sporadic human infections suggest a public health risk of foodborne transmission. The study reports the frequency of gastrointestinal complications of seasonal and novel influenza A; evidence indicates that influenza A and H5N1 can replicate in mammalian gut tissue, suggesting possible infection of mammals through ingestion of virus-containing material. Gastric exposure may be a non-respiratory route of H5N1 infection in mammals, and the virus may be detected in the intestine under various exposure routes. Annual summary. Human cases: this year, one H5 (including presumptive) influenza case, 27 H5N1 influenza cases (990* cumulatively since 2003), 22 H9N2 influenza cases (150 cumulatively) and two H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 58 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,263 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e, 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Given their widespread presence in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. The infection risk for the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main determinants are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第34週全球新冠陽性率10.85%,XFG變異株占64%最多
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was 10.85% in week 34, with XFG the dominant variant at 64%; the US remains above its early-year peak.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第34週(8/18-24)全球陽性率10.85%,美洲、歐洲及非洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點波動,8月新增約16萬例病例,其中重症187例、死亡7例,陽性率下降8%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(95.2%)。 香港疫情下降,第36週陽性率下降至1.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情略降,第35週定醫平均報告數7.46,較前一週(8.8)下降,病患以10歲以下為多,地理分布以大阪、埼玉縣為多。 美國疫情經高點後稍降,第35週陽性率降為10.8%,惟已超過今年年初高峰(6.7%),死亡率呈上升,住院率呈下降趨勢,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(64%),其次為NB.1.8.1(27%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 34 of 2025 (18–24 August), global test positivity was 10.85%, with increases in the Americas, Europe and Africa regions. China's outbreak is fluctuating at a low level; about 160,000 cases were reported in August, including 187 severe cases and 7 deaths; positivity declined by 8%, and variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (95.2%). Hong Kong's outbreak is declining; positivity fell to 1.1% in week 36, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Japan's outbreak has declined slightly: the sentinel average in week 35 was 7.46, down from 8.8 the previous week. Patients are mostly under 10 years old, and cases are geographically concentrated in Osaka and Saitama Prefecture. The US outbreak has declined slightly from its peak: positivity fell to 10.8% in week 35, but remains above this year's early-year peak (6.7%); mortality is rising and hospitalization rates are declining, with XFG the variant with the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward. XFG is the predominant global variant (64%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (27%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 8/28-9/3 WPV1新增4例(巴基斯坦3例),cVDPV2新增5例
items.summary_en: Between 28 August and 3 September, GPEI reported four WPV1 cases, three of them in Pakistan, and five cVDPV2 cases across four countries.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/28-9/3期間,WPV1新增2國共4例,分別為巴基斯坦3例、阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增4國共5例,分別為安哥拉2例、查德/奈及利亞/巴布亞紐幾內亞(前已掌握)各1例。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 28 August–3 September, wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) increased by four cases in two countries: Pakistan (3) and Afghanistan (1). cVDPV2 increased by five cases in four countries: Angola (2), and Chad, Nigeria and Papua New Guinea (1 each; previously identified).
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,安哥拉,查德,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,巴布亞紐幾內亞

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至8/5累計約4.8萬例腸病毒病例,為去年同期1.7倍
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported about 48,000 enterovirus cases as of 5 August, 1.7 times last year's figure, mostly children under five.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至8/5累計約4.8萬例病例,為去年同期1.7倍,病患多小於5歲,主要分布於南部、曼谷及中部地區;當局評估此波疫情與季節性氣候之強降雨及高濕度有關,疫情可能持續。
items.description_en: As of 5 August this year, Thailand had cumulatively reported approximately 48,000 cases, 1.7 times the same period last year. Most patients are under 5 years old, and cases are mainly distributed in the southern region, Bangkok and central areas. Authorities assess that this wave of the outbreak is related to seasonal heavy rainfall and high humidity, and the outbreak may continue.

items.summary_zh: 查德自7月起累計1,631例霍亂,113例死亡,多集中於東部難民營
items.summary_en: Chad has reported 1,631 cholera cases and 113 deaths since July, concentrated in eastern refugee camps; 1.1 million doses have been given.
items.description_zh: 查德自7月截至9/6累計報告1,631例病例,其中113例死亡(CFR: 7%),病患以女性為多,年齡多介於5-14歲及15-44歲,主要集中於東部瓦達伊省(Ouaddai)難民營,該難民營收容2萬名來自蘇丹之難民;經實驗鑑定此波疫情為小川型弧菌(O1 Ogawa)引起,已接種110萬劑疫苗,將加強相關防治措施。非洲自2025年迄今,已有23個國家通報239,754例個案,5,274例死亡。
items.description_en: From July to 6 September, Chad cumulatively reported 1,631 cases, including 113 deaths (CFR: 7%). Patients are mostly female, and most are aged 5–14 and 15–44 years. Cases are concentrated in refugee camps in Ouaddai Province in the east, which house 20,000 refugees from Sudan. Laboratory testing identified the outbreak as caused by Vibrio cholerae O1 Ogawa. 1.1 million doses of vaccine have been administered, and control measures will be strengthened.
