Since the start of 2025, 23 African countries have reported 239,754 cases and 5,274 deaths.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 德國-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 德國8月中至9/8累計45例腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染,12例併發溶血性尿毒症
items.summary_en: Germany reported 45 EHEC cases from mid-August to 8 September, 12 with haemolytic uraemic syndrome; the O45:H2 serotype is rare.
items.description_zh: 德國自8月中旬截至9/8累計報告45例病例,其中12例出現溶血性尿毒症候群,病患為16名孩童及6名成人,分布於5個邦,型別為罕見的O45:H2;當局表示該型別在近11年逾1萬件檢體僅檢出13件(占0.1%),感染源仍調查中。
items.description_en: Germany reported 45 cases cumulatively from mid-August to 8 September, of which 12 developed haemolytic uraemic syndrome. Patients comprised 16 children and 6 adults, distributed across five states. The serotype is the rare O45:H2. Authorities state that over the past 11 years, this serotype was detected in only 13 of more than 10,000 specimens (0.1%). The source of infection remains under investigation.

items.headline_zh: 中國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 中國瀋陽某大學8/31起諾羅病毒群聚,累計2,087例,皆為輕症
items.summary_en: A university in Shenyang, Liaoning, reported a norovirus cluster from 31 August with 2,087 mild cases; a contaminated water tank is suspected.
items.description_zh: 中國遼寧省瀋陽市某大學於8/31爆發群聚疫情,報告2,087例病例,皆為輕症,持續新增病例;當局經採檢調查,疑感染源為蓄水池遭諾羅病毒汙染所致。
items.description_en: A university in Shenyang City, Liaoning Province, China, experienced a cluster outbreak starting on 31 August, with 2,087 cases reported. All cases were mild, and new cases continue to be reported. Sampling and investigation by authorities suggest that the suspected source was contamination of a water storage tank with norovirus.

items.summary_zh: 美國愛荷華州馬歇爾郡退伍軍人病群聚,累計34例,1例死亡
items.summary_en: Marshall County, Iowa has reported a Legionnaires' disease cluster with 34 cases and one death since August; the cause is undetermined.
items.description_zh: 美國愛荷華州馬歇爾郡爆發疫情,自8月以來累計報告34例,其中1例死亡,當局確認為群聚事件,惟尚未確定疫情爆發原因。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in Marshall County, Iowa, USA. Since August, 34 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1 death. Authorities have confirmed it as a cluster, but the cause of the outbreak has not yet been determined.

items.headline_zh: 英國/美國/加拿大/墨西哥-麻疹
items.headline_en: United Kingdom / United States / Canada / Mexico – Measles
items.summary_zh: 美國今年1,431例麻疹,墨西哥截至9/9累計9,439例及19例死亡
items.summary_en: The US reported 1,431 measles cases as of 3 September; Mexico has 9,439 cases and 19 deaths as of 9 September.
items.description_zh: 英國英蘭地區今年累計報告742例,該地區病例數自4月開始上升,疫情影響倫敦及西北部地區,惟於7月中旬趨緩,超過70%病例為10歲以下兒童,並報告1例兒童死亡案例。該地區去(2024)年報告2,911例,為2012年以來新高。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至9/3共42州報告1,431例,並報告35起疫情 ,其中178例住院及3例死亡,3月為疫情高峰,目前已趨緩;加拿大截至8/30共10省報告4,849例,其中1例死亡,該國此次疫情流行基因型為D8型;墨西哥截至9/9報告9,439例,其中4,482例確診及19例死亡,該國各州皆有報告病例,病例數以契瓦瓦州報告逾4,100例為多。
items.description_en: In England, 742 cases have been reported this year. Case numbers in the region began rising in April, affecting London and the north-west, but slowed in mid-July. More than 70% of cases are children under 10 years old, and one child death has been reported. The region reported 2,911 cases last year (2024), the highest since 2012. North America outbreak update: in the United States, as of 3 September this year, 42 states had reported 1,431 cases and 35 outbreaks, of which 178 were hospitalized and 3 died; March was the peak, and the outbreak has now slowed. In Canada, as of 30 August, 10 provinces had reported 4,849 cases, including one death; the genotype circulating in this outbreak is D8. In Mexico, as of 9 September, 9,439 cases had been reported, of which 4,482 were confirmed and 19 died; cases have been reported in all states, most of them in Chihuahua State, which reported more than 4,100 cases.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,墨西哥,英國,美國
items.area_en: Canada,Mexico,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland,USA

items.headline_en: China / United States – Novel influenza A
items.summary_zh: 中國新增4例H9N2,美國CDC稱受污染飲食可能感染新型A型流感
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported four new H9N2 cases in China; the US CDC says contaminated food or drink may transmit novel influenza A, though risk is low.
items.description_zh: 香港公布中國新增4例H9N2流感人類感染病例,發病時間介於7/28-8/21間,分布於安徽省/重慶市/湖南省/四川省,病患皆為6歲以下男童,其他流病資訊不明。該國今年累計報告22例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 美國CDC於9/8發布風險評估,表示透過食用或飲用受污染食物或飲品可能感染新型A型流感,近期研究顯示季節性流感及新型A型流感可能感染腸胃道,並透過非呼吸道傳播方式傳染其他哺乳動物。CDC評估透過消化系統接觸為人類及其他哺乳動物感染H5N1流感病毒之潛在途徑,雖目前尚無與飲用受汙染牛乳感染相關病例,惟近2年出現部分感染源不明之人類感染病例,並有寵物貓食用受病毒汙染之食品感染並死亡,表示風險雖低,惟仍可能發生,呼籲民眾避免生飲牛乳或生食乳製品。
items.description_en: Hong Kong announced four new human H9N2 infections in China, with onset between 28 July and 21 August, distributed across Anhui Province, Chongqing Municipality, Hunan Province and Sichuan Province. All patients were boys under 6 years old; other epidemiological information is unknown. China has reported 22 human H9N2 infections cumulatively this year. The US CDC issued a risk assessment on 8 September, stating that novel influenza A may be contracted through eating or drinking contaminated food or beverages. Recent studies show that seasonal and novel influenza A can infect the gastrointestinal tract and spread to other mammals through non-respiratory routes. The CDC assesses that digestive-tract exposure is a potential route of H5N1 influenza infection for humans and other mammals. Although no cases have yet been linked to drinking contaminated milk, some human infections of unknown source have emerged in the past two years, and a pet cat died after eating contaminated food. The CDC says the risk is low but still possible, and urges the public to avoid drinking raw milk or eating raw dairy products.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),美國

items.summary_zh: 哈薩克北部阿克莫拉州6/17-7/4報告13例炭疽病,7/21宣布解除
items.summary_en: Akmola Region, northern Kazakhstan reported 13 confirmed anthrax cases from 17 June to 4 July; the outbreak was declared over on 21 July.
items.description_zh: 哈薩克北部阿克莫拉州6/17-7/4報告13例確定病例及數頭牛隻死亡,當局實施隔離措施及牛隻疫苗接種作業後,疫情獲控制並於7/21宣布解除,本次感染源為不明炭疽病之屍體埋葬地和野外囓齒動物之洞穴。
items.description_en: In Akmola Region of northern Kazakhstan, 13 confirmed cases and several cattle deaths were reported from 17 June to 4 July. After quarantine measures and cattle vaccination, the outbreak was brought under control, and it was declared over on 21 July. The source of infection was the burial site of animal carcasses from an unidentified anthrax cause, and burrows of wild rodents.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至8/24累計857例拉薩熱確診,160例死亡
items.summary_en: Nigeria has reported 857 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 160 deaths in 21 states as of 24 August; the outbreak is easing.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,今年截至8/24累計報告21州857例確診,其中160例死亡(CFR:18.7%),疫情趨緩,單週新增確診病例數下降,病例/死亡數均較去年同期為低,病患主要以西南部翁多州、東北部包奇州及西南部埃多州為多。
items.description_en: Nigeria outbreak update: as of 24 August this year, 857 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported across 21 states, of which 160 died (CFR: 18.7%). The outbreak is easing: the number of new confirmed cases in a single week has declined, and both case and death numbers are lower than in the same period last year. Patients are mainly in Ondo State in the south-west, Bauchi State in the north-east, and Edo State in the south-west.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國今年累計37例伊波拉病例,15例死亡,接觸者有效追蹤僅19.1%
items.summary_en: DR Congo has reported 37 Ebola cases this year, 15 fatal, with only 19.1% of contacts effectively followed up.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國疫情更新,今年截至9/6累計報告37例,其中15例死亡(CFR:38%),9例住院中,5例為確定病例,匡列157名接觸者,惟有效追蹤僅19.1%,當局表示不安全之埋葬方式、接觸者追蹤不足及人口/接觸者移動為當前疫情控制挑戰,將強化疫情監測及接觸者追蹤等防治措施。
items.description_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak update: as of 6 September this year, 37 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 15 died (CFR: 38%). Nine are hospitalized, five of them confirmed cases. 157 contacts have been identified, but effective follow-up is only 19.1%. Authorities state that unsafe burial practices, insufficient contact tracing, and the movement of people and contacts are current challenges to outbreak control, and that surveillance and contact-tracing measures will be strengthened.

items.summary_zh: 江蘇南通通州區9/9新增1例霍亂,病患已痊癒,迄未再有新增
items.summary_en: Tongzhou District, Nantong, Jiangsu reported one cholera case on 9 September; the patient has recovered and no new cases have been found.
items.description_zh: 中國江蘇省南通市通州區9/9新增1例病例,病患已痊癒,感染源疑為農貿市場,迄未發現新增病例;當局正進行疫情調查、環境採檢及清消作業。
items.description_en: Tongzhou District, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, China, reported one new case on 9 September; the patient has recovered. The suspected source is a farmers' market, and no further new cases have been found. Authorities are conducting an outbreak investigation, environmental sampling and disinfection.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾迄今累計113例日本腦炎,23例死亡,多數為40歲以上未接種者
items.summary_en: Nepal has reported 113 Japanese encephalitis cases and 23 deaths across 36 areas; most cases are over 40 and unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 泊爾疫情上升,迄今累計36地區報告113例病例及23例死亡,病例主要分布於藍毗、馬德什及科什等省。多數病例為40歲以上且未接種疫苗者,適逢雨季增加病媒蚊孳生及疾病傳播風險,近年疾病由特萊平原傳播至丘陵區。
items.description_en: Nepal's outbreak is rising: to date, 113 cases and 23 deaths have been cumulatively reported across 36 areas. Cases are mainly distributed in Lumbini, Madhesh and Koshi provinces. Most cases are people over 40 years old who were unvaccinated. The rainy season increases mosquito breeding and the risk of disease transmission, and in recent years the disease has spread from the Terai plains to hilly areas.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年累計67,055例登革熱,8月新增21,640例
items.summary_en: Viet Nam reported 21,640 new dengue cases in August and 67,055 this year; Bangladesh has 30,376 cases and 118 deaths.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,近1日報告432例病例,今年累計30,376例病例及118例死亡,病例主要分布於南部巴里薩爾9,929例;該國去年累計101,000餘例病例及570餘例死亡。 越南疫情明顯上升,8月新增21,640例病例及6例死亡,以南部地區疫情較為嚴峻,尤其是胡志明市,該國今年累計67,055例病例及15例死亡,病例數高於去年同期。
items.description_en: Bangladesh outbreak update: 432 cases were reported in the past day. So far this year, 30,376 cases and 118 deaths have been cumulatively reported, mainly in southern Barisal Division, which accounts for 9,929 cases. Last year the country cumulatively reported over 101,000 cases and over 570 deaths. Viet Nam's outbreak has risen markedly: 21,640 new cases and 6 deaths were reported in August. The southern region is most severely affected, especially Ho Chi Minh City. The country has cumulatively reported 67,055 cases and 15 deaths this year, higher than in the same period last year.

items.headline_zh: 中國/法國/義大利-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 中國廣東近1週新增178例屈公病,佛山85例最多;法國今年301例本土病例
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 178 chikungunya cases in the week to 6 September, with Foshan most affected; France has 301 local cases this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(8/31-9/6)新增178例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市85例最多,其次為廣州市40例,病例數呈下降趨勢,由於移入風險持續、部分地區病媒蚊活躍及氣候等因素,當地仍持續進行病媒蚊防治等工作。 歐洲疫情更新,法國近1週新增74例本土病例,今年累計301例本土病例,義大利今年累計107例本土病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (31 August–6 September), 178 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 85 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 40. Case numbers show a downward trend; because the risk of importation continues, vector mosquitoes remain active in some areas, and climatic factors, vector control work continues locally. Europe outbreak update: France reported 74 new locally acquired cases in the past week, bringing its cumulative total this year to 301 locally acquired cases. Italy has cumulatively reported 107 locally acquired cases this year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),法國,義大利

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉本週新增1例H5人類感染,美國生鮮貓糧受H5N1污染致貓死亡
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported one new human H5 case this week; FDA found H5N1 in a raw cat food brand that killed a pet cat, with no human cases linked.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週新增1例孟加拉H5流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共9國於2025/9/1-5期間報告26起H5N1疫情,南非/挪威各6起、德國/荷蘭3起、臺灣/英國/西班牙各2起、葡萄牙/阿根廷各1起。 挪威於2025/9/1-4期間報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,079(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第35週計431個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(加州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新: 美國FDA公布某廠牌之生鮮貓糧受H5N1流感病毒汙染,舊金山公共衛生局獲通報家貓食用該廠牌貓糧後感染H5N1流感並實施安樂死,當局檢測出該產品H5N1流感病毒陽性,FDA後續針對產品及死亡貓隻進行檢驗,發現產品與貓隻有共同來源,其基因型皆為B3.13型,目前尚未發現人類接觸受汙染寵物食品感染HPAI之案例。 年度摘要:  人類病例: 今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感1例,H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例),H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計58國家/地區通報2,242起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: one new human H5 influenza infection was reported in Bangladesh this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of nine countries reported 26 H5N1 outbreaks during 1–5 September 2025, including South Africa and Norway (6 each), Germany and the Netherlands (3 each), Taiwan, the UK and Spain (2 each), and Portugal and Argentina (1 each). Norway reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 1–4 September 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,079 (1) herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 35, 431 sampling sites provided results; three sampling sites in one state (California) detected H5-positive samples. Other updates: the US FDA announced that a brand of raw cat food was contaminated with H5N1 influenza virus. The San Francisco Department of Public Health was notified that a domestic cat had been infected with H5N1 after eating that brand and was euthanized. Authorities tested the product and found it H5N1-positive. The FDA then tested the product and the dead cat, and found they shared a common source; both were genotype B3.13. No human infections from contact with the contaminated pet food have been identified so far. Annual summary. Human cases: this year, one H5 (including presumptive) influenza case, 27 H5N1 influenza cases (990 cumulatively since 2003), 18 H9N2 influenza cases (146 cumulatively) and two H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 58 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,242 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第33週全球新冠陽性率8.64%,美國第34週升至11.2%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was 8.64% in week 33; US positivity reached 11.2% in week 34, above its early-year peak.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第33週(8/11-17)全球陽性率8.64%,美洲及歐洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情下降,第35週定醫門診陽性率下降至8.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情下降,第35週陽性率下降至1.34%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(76%)。 日本疫情處高點,第33週定醫平均報告數8.76,較前一週(6.3)上升,病患以50-59歲為多,地理分布以愛知縣、大阪為多。 美國疫情持續上升,第34週陽性率11.2%,已超過今年年初高峰(6.7%),新增134例死亡,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲及歐洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(67%),其次為NB.1.8.1(23%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 33 of 2025 (11–17 August), global test positivity was 8.64%, with increases in the Americas and European regions. China's outbreak has declined: sentinel outpatient positivity fell to 8.5% in week 35, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak has declined: positivity fell to 1.34% in week 35, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (76%). Japan's outbreak is at its peak: the sentinel average in week 33 was 8.76, up from 6.3 the previous week. Patients are mostly aged 50–59, and cases are geographically concentrated in Aichi Prefecture and Osaka. The US outbreak continues to rise: positivity was 11.2% in week 34, exceeding this year's early-year peak (6.7%), with 134 new deaths; XFG is the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas and European regions rising. XFG is the predominant global variant (67%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (23%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞-小兒麻痺症
items.summary_zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞萊城8/28報告1例cVDPV2小兒麻痺症,為4歲男童
items.summary_en: Lae City, Papua New Guinea reported a cVDPV2 polio case in a 4-year-old boy on 28 August; environmental detections began in April.
items.description_zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞莫雷貝省(Morobe)萊城(Lae)8/28報告1例cVDPV2病例,病患為4歲男童,出現急性無力肢體麻痺後確診;該地區前於4月起陸續檢出cVDPV2環境樣本,5月報告2例無症狀cVDPV2案例,當局正加強疫苗接種及監測措施。
items.description_en: In Lae City, Morobe Province, Papua New Guinea, one cVDPV2 case was reported on 28 August. The patient is a 4-year-old boy, confirmed after acute flaccid paralysis. The area had detected cVDPV2 environmental samples since April, and two asymptomatic cVDPV2 cases were reported in May. Authorities are strengthening vaccination and surveillance measures.

items.summary_zh: 迦納奧蒂區今年截至8/28累計約2.2萬例傷寒,較6月增加一倍
items.summary_en: Ghana's Oti Region has reported about 22,000 typhoid cases this year as of 28 August, double the June figure, due to poor water and sanitation.
items.description_zh: 迦納東部奧蒂區(Oti region)今年截至8/28累計報告約2.2萬例病例,較6月增加一倍;主因為缺乏乾淨飲水、廢棄物處理不當、環境衛生條件惡劣,當局呼籲民眾將水煮沸或加氯。
items.description_en: In Oti Region in eastern Ghana, approximately 22,000 cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 28 August, double the number in June. The main causes are lack of clean drinking water, improper waste management and poor environmental sanitation. Authorities urge residents to boil water or add chlorine.

items.headline_zh: 日本-細菌性腸胃炎(腸炎弧菌)
items.summary_zh: 日本旭川市144例腸炎弧菌感染,1例死亡,皆食用同一便當店便當
items.summary_en: Asahikawa City, Japan reported 144 Vibrio parahaemolyticus cases and one death; all had eaten from one delivery bento shop, now ordered to suspend.
items.description_zh: 日本北海道旭川市9/2報告144例病例,其中1例死亡,病患年齡介於13-81歲,皆於8/25食用某外送便當店之炸魚及炸雞便當;當局已下令業者停業,感染源調查中。
items.description_en: In Asahikawa City, Hokkaido, Japan, 144 cases were reported on 2 September, including one death. Patients were aged 13–81 years, and all had eaten fried fish and fried chicken bento boxes from a delivery bento shop on 25 August. Authorities have ordered the business to suspend operations, and the source of infection is under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 全球霍亂今年截至7月約38萬例,4,478例死亡,全球風險非常高
items.summary_en: WHO reports about 380,000 cholera cases and 4,478 deaths globally through July this year, and rates global transmission risk as very high.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至7月累計報告約38萬例,4,478例死亡,其中,7月新增報告約6.8萬例、死亡624例,較6月上升14%,各國CFR介於0-11.2%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞及美洲共31個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、阿富汗、葉門及剛果民主共和國為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, as of July this year, about 380,000 cases and 4,478 deaths have been cumulatively reported. In July alone, about 68,000 new cases and 624 deaths were reported, a 14% increase over June. Case fatality rates across countries range from 0–11.2%. Cases are distributed across 31 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia and the Americas, with the most in South Sudan, Afghanistan, Yemen and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO estimates that about one billion people are at risk of infection, and assesses the global transmission risk as very high.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,南蘇丹共和國,葉門
items.area_en: Afghanistan,Congo,Democratic Republic of the,South Sudan,Republic of,Yemen

items.summary_zh: 全球流感活動處低點,孟加拉、馬爾地夫及塞內加爾陽性率逾30%
items.summary_en: Global influenza activity is low, mainly influenza A; test positivity exceeded 30% in Bangladesh, the Maldives and Senegal.
items.description_zh: 全球流感活動處低點,以A型為主要流行株,北半球整體仍呈低點且穩定,中美洲/加勒比海/西非/東非/南亞/東南亞檢測陽性率略升,孟加拉/馬爾地夫/塞內加爾陽性率超過30%,南美熱帶地區/北歐/東南亞活動度略升;南半球多數國家維持穩定,惟東南亞及大洋洲檢測陽性率略高(10%)。型別部分,中美洲/西非/大洋洲以H1N1流行為主,南亞/東南亞以H3N2流行為主,東非則為A型與B型檢出比例相近。
items.description_en: Global influenza activity is at a low level, with influenza A the main circulating type. The Northern Hemisphere as a whole remains low and stable. Test positivity rose slightly in Central America, the Caribbean, West Africa, East Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia; positivity exceeded 30% in Bangladesh, the Maldives and Senegal; activity rose slightly in tropical South America, northern Europe and South-East Asia. Most countries in the Southern Hemisphere remain stable, but test positivity in South-East Asia and Oceania is slightly higher (10%). By subtype, H1N1 predominates in Central America, West Africa and Oceania; H3N2 predominates in South Asia and South-East Asia; in East Africa, influenza A and B detections are similar in proportion.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,馬爾地夫,塞內加爾

items.summary_zh: 紐約哈林區退伍軍人病群聚累計114例,90例住院,7例死亡
items.summary_en: The Harlem, New York City Legionnaires' cluster reached 114 cases by 29 August, with 90 hospitalized and 7 deaths; cooling towers were the source.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市哈林區群聚事件已完成調查,截至8/29累計報告114例,其中90例住院及7例死亡,調查顯示感染源為冷卻水塔,當局已要求擴大水塔檢查並要求物業業主增加檢測頻率等措施。
items.description_en: The investigation of the cluster in the Harlem district of New York City has been completed. As of 29 August, 114 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 90 hospitalized and 7 deaths. The investigation found that the source of infection was a cooling tower. Authorities have requested expanded cooling-tower inspections and asked property owners to increase testing frequency, among other measures.

items.summary_zh: 以色列今年累計770例麻疹,2例死亡,死者皆為未接種疫苗兒童
items.summary_en: Israel has reported 770 measles cases this year as of 27 August, with two deaths, both among unvaccinated children.
items.description_zh: 以色列今年截至8/27累計報告770例,其中24例住院,多數為6歲以下兒童,另有1名成人,其中2例於ICU治療中,2例死亡,死亡病例沒有潛在疾病,且皆為未接種疫苗之兒童。
items.description_en: Israel has cumulatively reported 770 cases this year as of 27 August, of which 24 were hospitalized. Most hospitalized patients are children under 6 years old, and one is an adult. Two patients are being treated in intensive care, and two patients have died. Neither deceased patient had underlying disease, and both were unvaccinated children.

items.headline_zh: 美洲/日本/英國/法屬留尼旺島-百日咳
items.headline_en: Americas / Japan / United Kingdom / Réunion (France) – Pertussis
items.summary_zh: 美洲百日咳2024年逾4.3萬例,今年截至7月1.8萬例及128例死亡
items.summary_en: PAHO warned of rising pertussis in the Americas: over 43,000 cases in 2024, and over 18,000 cases with 128 deaths so far this year.
items.description_zh: PAHO於8/26發布警示,美洲地區近年病例數大幅增加,且出現抗藥性菌株,2023年僅4,100餘例病例,去(2024)年大幅增加至4.3萬餘例,今年截至7月報告1.8萬餘例及128例死亡。由於新冠疫情期間不當使用抗生素可能加速抗藥性擴散,且疫苗覆蓋率下降,目前疫苗接種率上升,惟仍低於95%建議水準。PAHO呼籲各國加強實驗室檢測、技術訓練及孕婦與醫護人員接種,並透過標準化監測系統及早偵測與應對。 日本近1週(8/18-8/24)通報2,762例,較前1週1,506例增加1,200餘例,為近3週以來首次上升,以東京都(245例)為多,其次為琦玉縣(182例)。 英國報告今年首例死亡案例,病患為嬰兒,母親未接種疫苗,該嬰兒於今年4-6月間死亡。英蘭今年第二季(4-6月)報告169例確診,較第一季333例為低,亦遠低於去年同期(7,554例)。超過70%病例為15歲以上族群,該地區去年報告11例嬰兒死亡。該國孕婦及嬰幼兒接種率近年皆下降,惟去年報告死亡病例後,孕婦接種率已回升至73%,惟仍低於峰(76%)。 法屬留旺島爆發疫情,今年迄今累計報告70例,高於去年同期17例,約36%病例為5歲以下兒童,並報告重症病例,其中1例死亡,當局呼籲接種疫苗。
items.description_en: PAHO issued an alert on 26 August: pertussis cases in the Americas have risen sharply in recent years, and antimicrobial-resistant strains have emerged. There were only about 4,100 cases in 2023; cases rose sharply to over 43,000 last year (2024), and so far this year, as of July, over 18,000 cases and 128 deaths have been reported. Inappropriate antibiotic use during the COVID-19 pandemic may have accelerated the spread of resistance, and vaccination coverage has declined. Vaccination rates have now risen, but remain below the recommended 95%. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen laboratory testing and technical training, to vaccinate pregnant women and health workers, and to detect and respond early through standardized surveillance systems. Japan reported 2,762 cases in the past week (18–24 August), an increase of more than 1,200 from 1,506 the previous week. This is the first rise in three weeks, with Tokyo Metropolis (245 cases) the highest, followed by Saitama Prefecture (182 cases). The United Kingdom reported its first death this year, an infant whose mother was unvaccinated; the infant died between April and June this year. In England, 169 confirmed cases were reported in the second quarter (April–June) this year, lower than the 333 in the first quarter and far below the 7,554 in the same period last year. More than 70% of cases are in the 15-and-over group. The region reported 11 infant deaths last year. Vaccination rates among pregnant women and infants have declined in recent years, but after last year's deaths, the vaccination rate among pregnant women has risen back to 73%, still below the peak of 76%. Réunion (France) has an outbreak: 70 cases have been cumulatively reported this year, 17 more than in the same period last year. About 36% of cases are children under 5, and severe cases have been reported, including one death. Authorities urge vaccination.
items.area_zh: 日本,法屬留尼旺島,英國
items.area_en: Japan,Réunion,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年截至8/27累計4,436例鉤端螺旋體病,疫情逐步趨緩
items.summary_en: The Philippines has reported 4,436 leptospirosis cases this year as of 27 August; the outbreak is easing, but flood-related warnings remain.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情持續,今年截至8/27累計報告4,436例,疫情逐步趨緩,惟當局仍針對近期洪水侵襲發出疫情警告,另建議有症狀之民眾可至鄰近之衛生中心或前往衛生部各醫院之鉤端螺旋體病快速通道就診。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the Philippines continues. As of 27 August this year, 4,436 cases had been cumulatively reported, and the outbreak is gradually easing. However, authorities have issued an outbreak warning in view of recent flooding, and suggest that people with symptoms visit a nearby health centre or the leptospirosis fast-track clinics at Department of Health hospitals.

items.headline_zh: 伊拉克-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 伊拉克今年累計231例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,36例死亡,北部新增2例
items.summary_en: Iraq has reported 231 Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases and 36 deaths this year; two new confirmed cases in Kurdistan were butchers.
items.description_zh: 伊拉克北部庫德斯坦地區報告2例確定病例,均為屠夫,其中1例為43歲,住院觀察且病情穩定,另1例為自外地移入,當局已啟動工作隊於豢養牲畜之地區進行大規模農藥噴灑作業。該國今(2025)年迄今累計報告231例,其中36例死亡,病例主要集中於濟加爾省(37%)、巴達省(12%)、穆薩納省(8.6%)和瓦西特省(8.2%)。
items.description_en: In the Kurdistan Region of northern Iraq, two confirmed cases were reported, both butchers. One patient, aged 43, is hospitalized under observation and is stable. The other case was imported from another area. Authorities have launched a team to carry out large-scale pesticide spraying in areas where livestock are kept. So far this year, Iraq has cumulatively reported 231 cases, of which 36 died. Cases are mainly concentrated in Dhi Qar (37%), Badra (12%), Muthanna (8.6%) and Wasit (8.2%) governorates.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦今年累計15例確定病例,2例死亡,當局啟動大規模衛教
items.summary_en: Kerala, India has reported 15 confirmed amoebic meningoencephalitis cases this year, two fatal; authorities launched a health education campaign.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦報告2例確定病例,其中1例死亡,案1為3個月大嬰兒,7月下旬住院治療,8/31死亡,案2為43歲女性個案,8/27轉診至科澤科德醫學院附設醫院,該院截至8/28累計有9名病患(包含4名兒童)住院治療中,分別來自科澤科德(Kozhikode)、瓦亞納德(Wayanad)及馬拉普蘭(Malappuram)地區。今年截至9/1累計報告15例確定病例,其中2例死亡,當局宣布啟動大規模衛教活動,並提醒民眾保持水源清潔及安全。
items.description_en: Kerala State, India, reported two confirmed cases, one of them fatal. Case 1 was a three-month-old infant, hospitalized for treatment in late July, who died on 31 August. Case 2 was a 43-year-old woman referred on 27 August to Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. As of 28 August, that hospital had nine patients hospitalized (including four children), from Kozhikode, Wayanad and Malappuram districts. As of 1 September this year, 15 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported, of which two died. Authorities have announced a large-scale health education campaign and reminded the public to keep water sources clean and safe.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥哈利斯科州68歲男性遭感染牛隻咬傷後死於狂犬病
items.summary_en: A 68-year-old man in Jalisco, Mexico, died on 27 August after being bitten by an infected cow in May; laboratory confirmation followed on 28 August.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥中部哈利斯科州報告1例死亡病例,為68歲男性個案,病患於今(2025)年5月中旬曾被受感染牛隻咬傷,數日後曾出現疲勞及咬傷部位麻痺等症狀就醫,於8/7出現嚴重神經系統症狀至私人醫院,診斷疑狂犬病後,於17日轉院,27日死亡,28日經實驗室確診,當局已啟動接觸者監測並呼籲民眾及時為犬/貓/其他高風險動物接種狂犬病疫苗。該國於2024年報告至少2例病例,分別由貓及野生哺乳動物傳播;另今年報告1例被臭鼬咬傷之死亡病例。
items.description_en: In Jalisco State, central Mexico, one death was reported in a 68-year-old man. The patient had been bitten by an infected cow in mid-May this year. A few days later he developed fatigue and numbness at the bite site and sought medical care. On 7 August he developed severe neurological symptoms and went to a private hospital. After rabies was suspected, he was transferred on 17 August and died on 27 August; laboratory confirmation was made on 28 August. Authorities have activated contact monitoring and urge the public to vaccinate dogs, cats and other high-risk animals against rabies in a timely manner. Mexico reported at least two cases in 2024, transmitted by cats and wild mammals respectively. One death from a skunk bite was reported this year.

items.summary_zh: 巴西亞馬遜州塔巴廷加報告3例委內瑞拉馬腦炎,由蚊子傳播
items.summary_en: Tabatinga, Amazonas State, Brazil reported three Venezuelan equine encephalitis cases; the mosquito-borne disease can leave lasting sequelae.
items.description_zh: 巴西西北部亞馬遜州塔巴廷加報告3例病例,其中,2例男性及1例女性,該疾病係由蚊子傳播,由於該城市位於巴西與哥倫比亞及秘魯交界地區,其生物多樣性及跨國遷移可能對公共衛生造成影響,該疾病會引起大腦炎症,可能會留下包括運動、認知、行為及情緒等後遺症。
items.description_en: In Tabatinga, Amazonas State, north-western Brazil, three cases were reported (two men and one woman). The disease is transmitted by mosquitoes. Because the city lies on the border between Brazil, Colombia and Peru, its biodiversity and cross-border migration may affect public health. The disease causes inflammation of the brain and may leave sequelae including motor, cognitive, behavioural and emotional impairment.

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年截至7月11國逾1.27萬例奧羅普切熱確診,PAHO呼籲加強監測
items.summary_en: The Americas reported over 12,700 confirmed Oropouche fever cases from 11 countries as of July; PAHO urged stronger surveillance and vector control.
items.description_zh: 美洲地區今年截至7月累計11國報告逾12,700例確診病例,其中,巴西、哥倫比亞、古巴、巴拿馬、秘魯及委內瑞拉均有報告本土病例,以往疫情主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟近2年已傳播至原流行區以外地區。泛美衛生組織(PAHO)針對美洲局部地區屈公病疫情及奧羅普切熱病例持續發生,於8/29呼籲美洲地區加強監測及病媒控制,將奧羅普切熱感染納入疑登革熱感染之鑑別診斷中,並提醒可能出現之神經系統併發症狀。
items.description_en: In the Americas, as of July this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported more than 12,700 confirmed cases. Locally acquired cases have been reported in Brazil, Colombia, Cuba, Panama, Peru and Venezuela. Previous outbreaks were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in the past two years the disease has spread beyond its original endemic areas. In view of continued chikungunya outbreaks in parts of the Americas and continued Oropouche cases, PAHO on 29 August called on the region to strengthen surveillance and vector control, to include Oropouche infection in the differential diagnosis of suspected dengue, and to be alert to possible neurological complications.

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東近1週新增225例屈公病,佛山119例最多;全球累計逾27萬例
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 225 chikungunya cases in the week to 30 August, down from 336; globally, over 270,000 cases have been reported this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(8/24-30)新增225例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市119例最多,其次為廣州市49例,相較於前1週新增336例,病例數呈下降趨勢,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。 全球今年截至8月中旬累計逾270,000例病例,美洲地區累計14國報告212,029例病例及110例死亡,主要分布於南美洲(玻利維亞、巴西、巴拉圭)及部分加勒比地區,此外,於印度洋、歐洲及亞洲之持續疫情,提升不同基因型共同循環之可能性,大幅增加其再度傳播及蔓延之風險。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (24–30 August), 225 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 119 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 49. Compared with 336 new cases in the previous week, case numbers are declining. Authorities continue outbreak prevention and control work. Globally, as of mid-August this year, more than 270,000 cases had been cumulatively reported. The Americas region has cumulatively reported 212,029 cases and 110 deaths from 14 countries, mainly in South America (Bolivia, Brazil and Paraguay) and parts of the Caribbean. In addition, ongoing outbreaks in the Indian Ocean, Europe and Asia increase the likelihood of different genotypes circulating together, which greatly increases the risk of renewed transmission and spread.

items.headline_en: Argentina – Klebsiella pneumoniae / Ralstonia pickettii infection
items.summary_zh: 阿根廷受污染芬太尼注射劑引發感染群聚,WHO警告2022年2月後產品有風險
items.summary_en: WHO reports Argentine infection outbreaks since May linked to contaminated fentanyl injections; products from one manufacturer since February 2022 pose a contamination risk.
items.description_zh: WHO於8/29報告阿根廷自5月起爆發多起案例,感染源為受汙染的芬太注射劑(FENTANILO HLB),該藥品常用於疼痛管理;阿根廷當局已於2月禁止藥廠(LABORATORIOS RAMALLO S.A)生產,WHO警告各國,該藥廠於2022年2月後生產的產品存在汙染風險。
items.description_en: WHO reported on 29 August that Argentina has had multiple outbreak cases since May. The source of infection was contaminated fentanyl injection (FENTANILO HLB), a drug commonly used for pain management. Argentine authorities banned production by the manufacturer LABORATORIOS RAMALLO S.A. in February. WHO warns countries that products made by this manufacturer since February 2022 carry a risk of contamination.

items.summary_zh: 截至第35週全球M痘今年逾3.7萬例,中國、菲律賓7月各逾100例
items.summary_en: As of week 35, 84 countries have reported over 37,000 mpox cases this year; WHO extended long-term recommendations by one year.
items.description_zh: 全球本月疫情更新:  自2022年5月截至今年8/28累計139國/地區報告15萬8,000餘例確診病例,其中至少399例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第35週累計84國/地區報告3萬7千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬1,980例、美洲區2,825例、歐洲區1,858例、西太平洋區1,067例、東南亞區82例及東地中海區33例。西太平洋疫情上升,歸因於中國、菲律賓今年7月單月新增皆逾100例病例。  其他更新:   肯亞疫情上升,自2024年7月報告首例病例截至今年8/17累計370例確診,其中6例死亡,死亡個案中有5例為HIV患者。病患多集中於該國東南方第二大港口城市蒙巴薩,病患過半數為20-40歲年輕人,該國近45%縣(21/47)皆報告病例,性接觸傳播為主要擴大因素,尤其是東非主要跨國公路之卡車司機、性工作者及商販等。 中國於8/1報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,於7月中旬入境時回報症狀,當局展開疫調並採防範措施。另澳門於8/27報告今年首例境外移入病例,為該區自2023年第3例病例(前2例於2023年報告)。病患為29歲澳門男性居民,於8/23出現發熱、咽痛及腹瀉等症狀,曾於內地就診,26日返澳就醫確診,病患曾在旅遊時發生高風險性行為,惟未透露地點。 德國於8/19報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已追蹤接觸者並監測症狀。 土耳其報告3例Ib型病例,近期報告1例為7月下旬時確診,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)及埃及旅遊史,餘2例為回溯型病例,具烏干達旅遊史,當局已採疫調及隔離相關措施。 剛果民主共和國首次報告2例IIb型確診病例,指標個案為成年男性,具象牙海岸旅遊史,經分析該序列與象牙海岸及奈及利亞之病例相;案2為指標個案之接觸者,當局匡列25名接觸者追蹤,其中23名接種暴露後疫苗。該國首次檢出IIb型病例,顯示IIb型已進入Ia/Ib型流行區域,公共風險增加。  評估與建議: WHO宣布原定於2025/8/20到期之長期建議措施,因應全球流行病學情勢,將再延長1年,以預防及減少國際傳播及其對健康之影響。強調「持續監測、科學研究、社區合作與公平資源分配」是2025–26年全球防控核心,7大面向建議包括:國家防治計畫與政策持續優化、建立監測與實驗室診斷能力、加強社區保護與風險溝通、推動研究與臨床試驗、制定旅行相關措施(不鼓勵旅行禁令)、提供最佳臨床照護與醫護防護、確保公平獲得疫苗/診斷/治療。
items.description_en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類禽流感病例,西班牙報告10起H5N1動物疫情
items.summary_en: No new human avian influenza cases were reported this week; Spain reported 10 H5N1 animal outbreaks, and global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共3國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告16起H5N1疫情,西班牙10起、保加利亞/挪威各3起。 共2國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,挪威/法國各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078起疫情,近期主要集中於加利福亞州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第34週計431個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(奧勒岡州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計57國家/地區通報2,204起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): three countries reported 16 H5N1 outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, including Spain (10), and Bulgaria and Norway (3 each). Two countries reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, Norway and France (1 each). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 34, 431 sampling sites provided results; two sampling sites in one state (Oregon) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,204 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第32週全球新冠陽性率7.2%創今年新高,XFG變異株占71%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity reached 7.2% in week 32, the highest this year; XFG accounts for 71% of global variants.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第32週(8/4-10)全球陽性率7.2%,創今年新高,美洲及歐洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情下降,第34週(8/18-24)定醫門診陽性率下降至10.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情於低點波動,第34週陽性率下降至1.39%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情處高點,第33週定醫平均報告數6.3,較前一週(6.1)上升,病患以50-59歲為多,地理分布以愛知縣、埼玉縣為多。 歐洲國家疫情持續上升,第33週陽性率中位數15.1%,以變異株XFG占比最高(76%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12%)。  評估與建議:全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲及歐洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(71%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 32 of 2025 (4–10 August), global test positivity was 7.2%, the highest this year; positivity increased in the Americas and European regions. China's outbreak has declined: sentinel outpatient positivity fell to 10.5% in week 34 (18–24 August), with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak fluctuates at a low level: positivity fell to 1.39% in week 34, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Japan's outbreak is at its peak: the sentinel average in week 33 was 6.3, up from 6.1 the previous week; patients are mostly aged 50–59, and cases are geographically concentrated in Aichi and Saitama prefectures. Outbreaks in European countries continue to rise: median positivity in week 33 was 15.1%, with XFG the predominant variant (76%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas and European regions rising. XFG is the predominant global variant (71%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 8/14-20全球新增cVDPV2病例28例,葉門26例最多
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 28 cVDPV2 cases from 14–20 August in three countries, 26 of them in Yemen, plus two WPV1 cases in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/14-20期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;cVDPV1新增剛果民主共和國1例;cVDPV2新增3國共28例,分別為葉門26例、安哥拉/中非共和國各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦42件,cVDPV2新增坦尚亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 14–20 August, WPV1 increased by two cases in Pakistan, and circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 (cVDPV1) increased by one case in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. cVDPV2 increased by 28 cases in three countries: Yemen (26), and Angola and the Central African Republic (1 each). For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 42 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 by one sample in Tanzania.

items.summary_zh: 韓國腸病毒疫情自5月底持續上升,第33週就診陽性率26.7‰
items.summary_en: South Korea's enterovirus outbreak has risen since late May, with a 26.7‰ clinic positivity rate in week 33, above 2022–23 levels.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情自5月底以來持續上升,第33週(8/10-16)就診陽性率26.7‰,超過2022-23年同期,其中0-6歲族群發病率最高,當局評估疫情將持續至秋季結束。
items.description_en: South Korea's outbreak has continued to rise since late May. In week 33 (10–16 August), the outpatient positivity rate was 26.7‰, exceeding the same period in 2022–23. The 0–6 age group had the highest incidence. Authorities assess that the outbreak will continue until the end of autumn.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 加拿大8/26報告62例沙門氏菌感染,魁北克省45例,疑似開心果甜點
items.summary_en: Canada reported 62 Salmonella cases on 26 August, 45 in Quebec; a pistachio dessert brand is the suspected source and 27 products were removed.
items.description_zh: 加拿大於8/26報告62例病例,其中無死亡病例,發病日介於3-7月,病患年齡介於2-89歲,分布以魁北克省(45例)為多;當局調查某品牌之開心果甜點為疑感染源,已下架27種產品。
items.description_en: Canada reported 62 cases on 26 August, with no deaths. Onset dates fall between March and July, and patients are aged 2–89 years. Cases are mainly in Quebec Province (45 cases). Authorities investigated a pistachio dessert of one brand as the suspected source and have removed 27 products from sale.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾比爾根杰市霍亂疫情,42例病例,逾130例疑似,2例死亡
items.summary_en: Birgunj City in southern Nepal reported 42 cholera cases, over 130 suspected cases and two deaths; mobile vendors were banned.
items.description_zh: 泊爾南部比爾根杰市(Birgunj)爆發疫情,8/24報告42例病例,逾130例疑病例(腹瀉),其中2例腹瀉病患死亡;當局禁止流動攤販營業,學校停課2天,並檢測飲用水,以釐清感染源。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in Birgunj City in southern Nepal. As of 24 August, 42 cases were reported, along with more than 130 suspected cases (diarrhoea), of which two diarrhoea patients died. Authorities have banned mobile street vendors from operating, closed schools for two days, and tested drinking water to clarify the source of infection.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥截至8/21累計40例人類蠅蛆症,1例死亡,病例集中於南部
items.summary_en: Mexico has reported 40 human myiasis cases and one death as of 21 August, mostly in Chiapas; Belize recently reported its first human case.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥截至8/21已報告40例人類病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於恰帕斯(36例)及坎佩切州(3例),且已蔓延至塔巴斯科州(1例),疫情係由家畜/禽感染及跨國動物遷移引起,顯示該國南部具有公共衛生及農業風險,並有往北擴散風險;貝里斯於近期亦報告首例人類感染病例。
items.description_en: As of 21 August, Mexico had reported 40 human cases and one death. Cases are mainly in Chiapas State (36) and Campeche State (3), and have spread to Tabasco State (1). The outbreak is caused by infection of livestock and poultry and by cross-border animal movement, indicating public health and agricultural risks in southern Mexico, with a risk of spread northward. Belize also recently reported its first human case.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥今年逾4,200例麻疹,15例死亡;印尼東爪哇省逾2,000例,17例死亡
items.summary_en: Mexico has reported over 4,200 measles cases and 15 deaths this year; East Java, Indonesia has over 2,000 cases and 17 deaths.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥今年截至8/22累計報告4,200餘例,其中契瓦瓦州逾3,900例為多,死亡數累計15例,病例集中於0-4歲嬰幼兒族群。 印東爪哇省今年迄今報告逾2,000例,其中17例死亡,病例多集中於漯水縣(Sumenep),病患多未接種疫苗或未完整接種疫苗,當局已宣布進入公共衛生緊急狀態,該國東部巴布亞省於2018年爆發大規模疫情,造成數十例死亡。因該國疫苗接種率僅72%,部分省分低於50%,疫苗覆蓋率不佳,疫情與接種覆蓋率之波動有關,當局呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Mexico has reported more than 4,200 cases this year as of 22 August, of which more than 3,900 are in Chihuahua State, and 15 deaths cumulatively; cases are concentrated among infants and young children aged 0–4. East Java Province, Indonesia, has reported more than 2,000 cases this year, including 17 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Sumenep Regency, and most patients were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Authorities have declared a public health emergency. Papua Province in eastern Indonesia had a large-scale outbreak in 2018 that caused dozens of deaths. With national vaccination coverage at only 72%, and below 50% in some provinces, poor vaccination coverage is linked to fluctuations in the outbreak; authorities urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 日本8/11-17週報1,506例,較前週減半,惟8月中旬為連假期間
items.summary_en: Japan reported 1,506 pertussis cases in the week of 11–17 August, less than half the prior week; many clinics were closed during the mid-August holiday.
items.description_zh: 日本近1週(8/11-17)通報1,506例,較前1週3,211例減少一半以上,自今年6月下旬以來每週報告數皆超過3,000例,惟8月中旬為該國連假期間,多數醫療院所停診,當局表示將持續關注疫情趨勢。
items.description_en: In week 33 (11–17 August), Japan reported 1,506 cases, less than half of the 3,211 reported the previous week. Weekly reports have exceeded 3,000 since late June this year. However, mid-August was a holiday period during which most medical institutions were closed, and authorities say they will continue to monitor the trend.

items.summary_zh: 美國2024-25流感季275例兒童流感相關死亡,為2004年以來最高
items.summary_en: The US 2024–25 flu season recorded 275 influenza-associated pediatric deaths, the highest since 2004; over 90% were unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC公布,2024-25流感季累計報告275例與流感相關的兒童死亡病例,為2004年以來最高,超過90%的死亡病例未接種流感疫苗。
items.description_en: The US CDC reported that the 2024–25 influenza season recorded 275 influenza-associated pediatric deaths cumulatively, the highest since 2004. More than 90% of the deceased children had not been vaccinated against influenza.

items.summary_zh: 布宜諾斯艾利斯省今年16例阿根廷出血熱確定病例,1例死亡
items.summary_en: Buenos Aires Province, Argentina has 16 confirmed Argentine haemorrhagic fever cases this year as of 9 August, including one death.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯省今年截至8/9累計報告16例確定病例,病患均需住院且未接種疫苗,其中1例死亡、1例收治於加護病房,多數病患曾停留於農村及近郊地區,另有108例疑病例檢驗中,當局已加強地方接種疫苗工作。該國去年(2024)報告23例,病例集中於聖古拉斯(San Nicolás)市。
items.description_en: Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, has reported 16 confirmed cases this year as of 9 August. All patients required hospitalization and were unvaccinated. One patient died and one was admitted to intensive care. Most patients had stayed in rural and peri-urban areas. A further 108 suspected cases are awaiting testing, and authorities have intensified local vaccination work. Argentina reported 23 cases last year (2024), concentrated in San Nicolás city.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達西部避難所1例炭疽死亡,病患為屠夫,另7例疑似
items.summary_en: A 26-year-old butcher died of anthrax in a refugee settlement in western Uganda; one confirmed and seven suspected cases were reported as of 20 August.
items.description_zh: 烏干達西部基埃蓋瓜區避難所報告1例死亡病例,為26歲男性屠夫,病患出現發燒、頭痛、全身無力及呼吸困難等症狀,尋求草藥專家治療後於家中死亡,經實驗室確診,截至8/20共計報告1例確診及7例疑病例。
items.description_en: In a refugee settlement in Kyegegwa District, western Uganda, one death was reported in a 26-year-old male butcher. He developed fever, headache, general weakness and difficulty breathing, sought treatment from a traditional herbal practitioner, and died at home. Laboratory confirmation was made. As of 20 August, one confirmed case and seven suspected cases had been reported.

items.headline_zh: 印度/中國-阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦今年11例確定病例,1例死亡;中國8月2例死亡
items.summary_en: Kerala, India has 11 confirmed amoebic meningoencephalitis cases this year, one fatal; China reported two deaths in August, both children.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至8/23累計報告11例確定病例,其中1例死亡,死亡病患為科澤科德縣9歲女童,其7歲弟弟也確診收治於醫院,兩例個案皆曾在同一池塘洗澡,另該縣報告病例數上升,專家懷疑不同之新型菌株是造成近期報告病例之原因。當局已針對該縣發出疫情警報。 中國8月報告2例死亡病例,案1為福建省5歲女童(前已掌握), 於6/23住院後昏迷轉入加護病房,8/22死亡,病患於發病前曾進行游泳及泡溫泉活動;案2為安徽省6歲男童,於6/17出現發燒症狀,多次就醫後於27日轉院至上海醫院,30日確診,於8/11死亡,病患發病前曾於公園撈魚及學校玩水。當局提醒應避免在不乾淨的水源中戲水,倘至開放水域,需佩戴鼻夾及泳鏡,另應於出現急性發燒及劇烈頭痛及時就醫。
items.description_en: Kerala State, India, update: as of 23 August this year, 11 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported, one of them fatal. The deceased was a 9-year-old girl in Kozhikode District; her 7-year-old younger brother was also confirmed and hospitalized. Both cases had bathed in the same pond. Case numbers in the district are rising, and experts suspect that a different new strain may be responsible for recent cases. Authorities have issued an outbreak alert for the district. China reported two deaths in August. Case 1 was a 5-year-old girl in Fujian Province (previously identified): she was hospitalized on 23 June, fell into a coma and was transferred to intensive care, and died on 22 August; before onset she had been swimming and bathing in hot springs. Case 2 was a 6-year-old boy in Anhui Province who developed fever on 17 June; after repeated medical visits, he was transferred to a Shanghai hospital on 27 June, confirmed on 30 June, and died on 11 August. Before onset he had fished in a park and played in water at school. Authorities advise avoiding play in unclean water sources; when visiting open water, nose clips and goggles should be used, and people with acute fever or severe headache should seek medical care promptly.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),印度

items.summary_zh: 美國馬里蘭州報告首例新世界螺旋蠅人類感染,病患有中美洲旅遊史
items.summary_en: Maryland reported a first human New World screwworm case, in a patient with Central American travel history; public risk is very low.
items.description_zh: 美國馬里蘭州報告首例人類感染新世界螺旋蠅(New world screwworm)病例,個案具中美洲旅遊史,當局評估對美國公共衛生風險極低。
items.description_en: Maryland State, USA, reported the first human case of New World screwworm, in a patient with a travel history to Central America. Authorities assess the public health risk to the United States as extremely low.

items.summary_zh: 瑞典今年累計269例蜱媒腦炎,290個市鎮中173個列為高風險
items.summary_en: Sweden has reported 269 tick-borne encephalitis cases this year, against 384 last year; 173 of 290 municipalities are designated risk areas.
items.description_zh: 瑞典今年疫情上升,迄今累計269例病例,去年累計384例病例,可能因氣候變遷導致蜱蟲繁殖季節延長。依據確診病例數分類,該國290個城市中有173個列為風險地區,當局建議高風險地區之民眾均應接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Cases in Sweden are rising this year: 269 cases have been cumulatively reported so far, compared with 384 cases last year. Climate change may be extending the tick breeding season. Based on confirmed case numbers, 173 of the country's 290 municipalities have been designated as risk areas, and authorities recommend that people in all high-risk areas be vaccinated.

items.headline_zh: 中國/法國/義大利-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 中國廣東近1週新增336例屈公病,佛山206例最多;法國今年156例本土病例
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 336 chikungunya cases in the week to 23 August, with Foshan most affected; France has 156 local cases this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,自7/8報告首例移入病例以來,累計近1萬例病例,近1週(8/17-23)新增336例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市206例最多,其次為廣州市62例,相較於前1週(8/10-16)新增830例,病例數持續呈現下降趨勢,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。 歐洲疫情更新,法國近1週新增45例本土病例,今年累計156例本土病例;義大利近1週新增22例本土病例,今年累計29例本土病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease. Since the first imported case was reported on 8 July, nearly 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported. In the past week (17–23 August), 336 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 206 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 62. Compared with 830 new cases in the previous week (10–16 August), case numbers continue to show a downward trend, and authorities continue outbreak prevention and control. Europe outbreak update: France reported 45 new locally acquired cases in the past week and has 156 cumulative locally acquired cases this year; Italy reported 22 new locally acquired cases in the past week and has 29 cumulative locally acquired cases this year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),法國,義大利

items.summary_zh: 諾魯今年累計379例登革熱,薩摩亞累計3,070例確診及6例死亡
items.summary_en: Nauru has reported 379 dengue cases this year, 77% aged 18 or under; Samoa has 3,070 confirmed cases and six deaths.
items.description_zh: 諾魯爆發疫情,今年截至8/18累計379例病例,7/30報告2例死亡病例,77%病例為18歲以下者,病例主要分布於梅嫩區、代戈莫杜區、愛和區、博埃區及拜齊區。 薩摩亞疫情更新,今年截至8/17累計3,070例確診病例及6例死亡,91%病例來自烏波盧島,主要檢出型別為DENV-1。
items.description_en: Nauru has an outbreak: as of 18 August this year, 379 cases had been cumulatively reported, and two deaths were reported on 30 July. 77% of cases are aged 18 or under. Cases are mainly distributed in Meneng, Denigomodu, Aiwo, Boe and Baiti districts. Samoa's outbreak update: as of 17 August this year, 3,070 confirmed cases and six deaths had been cumulatively reported. 91% of cases came from Upolu Island, and the main serotype detected is DENV-1.

items.summary_zh: 西非塞內加爾8/23報告首例M痘,為境外移入外籍人士
items.summary_en: Senegal reported its first mpox case on 23 August, in a foreign national who entered from abroad; neighbouring Gambia had 75 suspected cases by 30 July.
items.description_zh: 西非塞內加爾於8/23報告新增該國首例病例,病患為境外移入外籍人士,8/19進入該國首都達卡,21日就診、22日確診陽性,刻正隔離中,當局已採取相關措施。鄰近國家甘比亞於今年7月中旬宣布疫情,自7/18報告首例截至7/30累計75例疑病例,跨境風險增加。
items.description_en: Senegal, in West Africa, reported its first case on 23 August. The patient is an imported foreign national who entered the capital, Dakar, on 19 August, sought care on 21 August and tested positive on 22 August. The patient is in isolation, and authorities have taken relevant measures. Neighbouring Gambia declared an outbreak in mid-July this year; since its first case was reported on 18 July, 75 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported as of 30 July, increasing cross-border risk.
items.area_zh: 甘比亞伊斯蘭共和國,塞內加爾

items.headline_en: Philippines – Hand, foot and mouth disease
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年截至8/9累計37,368例手足口病,為去年同期7倍
items.summary_en: The Philippines has reported 37,368 hand, foot and mouth disease cases this year as of 9 August, seven times last year's level; half are aged 1–3.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓報告今年截至8/9已累計報告37,368例病例,為2024年同期病例數(5,081例)之7倍,5成病例為1-3歲兒童。
items.description_en: The Philippines has reported 37,368 cases cumulatively this year as of 9 August, seven times the 5,081 cases in the same period of 2024. Half of the cases are children aged 1–3 years.

items.summary_zh: 美國加州埃爾多拉多郡8/19報告1例鼠疫,患者於南太浩湖露營時遭跳蚤咬傷
items.summary_en: El Dorado County, California reported a plague case on 19 August; the patient was bitten by fleas while camping at South Lake Tahoe.
items.description_zh: 美國加州埃爾多拉多郡8/19報告新增1例病例,為該區2020年以來首例,據調查病患在南太浩湖露營時被跳蚤咬傷,已接受治療,當局指出該州多地區都有鼠疫,呼籲民眾在戶外須避免與囓齒動物接觸,並做好防蟲措施,避免跳蚤叮咬。該郡於2020年報告1例,感染源疑為南太浩湖地區,另2015年報告2例,為優勝美地國家公園感染,3例病患皆接受治療並康復。美國每年平均報告7例,亞利桑那州於今年7月報告1例肺鼠疫死亡病例,評估目前公共風險為低。
items.description_en: El Dorado County, California, USA, reported one new case on 19 August, the first in the area since 2020. Investigation found that the patient was bitten by fleas while camping at South Lake Tahoe, and the patient has received treatment. Authorities noted that plague is present in many areas of the state, and urged the public to avoid contact with rodents outdoors and to take insect-prevention measures to avoid flea bites. The county reported one case in 2020, with the suspected source in the South Lake Tahoe area, and two cases in 2015 infected in Yosemite National Park; all three patients were treated and recovered. The US reports an average of seven cases per year. Arizona reported one fatal pneumonic plague case in July this year. Authorities assess the current public risk as low.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 印度本週新增1例H5N1人類感染,美國乳牛累計1,078起疫情
items.summary_en: This week India reported one new human H5N1 infection; US dairy herd outbreaks total 1,078, and global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週新增印度1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共8國於2025/8/14-2025/8/22期間報告25起H5N1疫情,挪威8起、英國5起、加拿大4起、西班牙3起、比利時2起、美國/葡萄牙/阿根廷各1起。 共2國於2025/8/18-2025/8/22期間報告7起H5 (N untyped)疫情,美國5起、比利時2起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078起疫情,近期主要集中於加利福亞州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第33週計423個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(紐澤西州)共1個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計57國家/地區通報2,182起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: this week, one new H5N1 human infection was reported in India. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): eight countries reported 25 H5N1 outbreaks during 14–22 August 2025, including Norway (8), the UK (5), Canada (4), Spain (3), Belgium (2), and the USA, Portugal and Argentina (1 each). Two countries reported seven H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 18–22 August 2025, the USA (5) and Belgium (2). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 33, 423 sampling sites provided results; one sampling site in one state (New Jersey) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,182 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第31週全球新冠陽性率6.06%創今年新高,中國第33週門急診陽性率11.9%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity reached 6.06% in week 31, the year's highest; China's outpatient and emergency positivity rose to 11.9% by week 33.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第31週(7/28-8/3)全球陽性率6.06%,創今年新高,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點小幅度反彈,第33週(8/11-17)定醫門急診陽性率上升至11.9%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高;香港疫情小幅反彈,第33週陽性率上升至1.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(54%),另XFG占0.3%。 西太平洋區署第31週疫情更新,日本陽性率上升至43%,韓國陽性率上升至23%,其他國家如新加坡、印、寮國、澳洲及紐西蘭等陽性率皆下降。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株由XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 31 of 2025 (28 July–3 August), global test positivity was 6.06%, the highest this year, with increases in the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions. China's outbreak has rebounded slightly from a low: sentinel outpatient and emergency positivity rose to 11.9% in week 33 (11–17 August), with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak rebounded slightly: positivity rose to 1.5% in week 33, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (54%) and XFG at 0.3%. In the Western Pacific Region's week 31 update, positivity rose to 43% in Japan and 23% in South Korea, while positivity fell in other countries including Singapore, India, Lao PDR, Australia and New Zealand. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions rising. The predominant global variant is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1 and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
