items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 8/7-13全球新增cVDPV2病例53例,葉門46例居首
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 53 new cVDPV2 cases from 7–13 August across three countries, 46 of them in Yemen, plus one WPV1 case in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/7-13期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增3國共53例,分別為葉門46例、衣索比亞6例、奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV1新增以色列3件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 7–13 August, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by 53 cases in three countries: Yemen (46), Ethiopia (6) and Nigeria (1). For environmental samples, cVDPV1 increased by three samples in Israel.
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,葉門

items.summary_zh: 丹麥自5月起累計12例隱孢子蟲症,感染同一新型變異株
items.summary_en: Denmark has reported 12 cryptosporidiosis cases since May, all with the same new variant strain; earlier cases were suspected to be linked to vegetables and salads.
items.description_zh: 丹麥自5月迄今累計報告12例病例,感染同一株新型變異株,年齡介於20-60歲之間,病患居住於不同地區;丹麥最早於2024年5月首次監測到新型變種隱孢子蟲,且僅在該國出現,當局調查先前病例疑感染源為蔬菜及沙拉。
items.description_en: Denmark has cumulatively reported 12 cases since May, all infected with the same new variant strain. The patients are aged 20–60 years and live in different regions. Denmark first detected the new Cryptosporidium variant in May 2024, and it has so far appeared only in Denmark. Authorities investigating earlier cases suspect vegetables and salads as the source.

items.headline_zh: 法國/比利時/丹麥/荷蘭/挪威-李斯特菌症
items.headline_en: France / Belgium / Denmark / Netherlands / Norway – Listeriosis
items.summary_zh: 法國累計18例李斯特菌症,2例死亡;疑似起司已銷往32國
items.summary_en: France has reported 18 listeriosis cases and two deaths since June; the suspected cheese, now withdrawn, was sold in 32 countries and regions.
items.description_zh: 法國自6月截至8/13累積報告18例病例,其中2例死亡,病患年齡介於34-95歲間,比利時、丹麥、荷蘭、挪威亦檢出相關案例;當局已下架疑感染源(牛/羊奶起司),惟該產品已銷往全球32個國家/地區,包含鄰近之香港、日本及韓國。
items.description_en: France has reported 18 cases since June, as of 13 August, of which 2 died; patients are aged 34–95 years. Related cases have also been detected in Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway. Authorities have withdrawn the suspected source, a cheese made from cow's and sheep's milk, but the product has been sold to 32 countries and regions, including neighbouring Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea.
items.area_zh: 比利時,丹麥,法國,荷蘭,挪威

items.summary_zh: 日本今年4例球黴菌症,2012-23年34例中33例為境外感染
items.summary_en: Japan has reported four coccidioidomycosis cases this year as of 27 July; 33 of 34 cases in 2012–2023 were acquired abroad, mostly in the US.
items.description_zh: 日本今年截至7/27累計報告4例,分別為千葉縣3例及東京都1例,該病原體不存在於該國自然環境,主要發生於前往流行區之旅客,該國2012-23共計報告34例病例,其中33例為境外感染,分別自美國31例(亞利桑那州19例/加州8例)、墨西哥1例、加拉瓜1例,1例為本土病例,其曾接觸過球孢子菌樣本。病例主要以20多歲為主,並以男性為多(男性22例/女性12例);球黴菌症屬該國第四類感染症,病例必須在診斷後立即通報。 美洲之美國西南部、墨西哥北部、中美洲和南美洲部分地區為地方性流行區,除美國外,其他國家未列入正式全國監測或法定通報疾病。墨西哥感染盛行率與美國西南部相近,於2000-19年報告766例,北部乾旱州份(如索諾拉、下加州)為主要流行區;巴西與阿根廷病例逐年增加,甚至擴展至過去之非流行區,巴西於1978-2021年共計報告292例,主要來自東北部巴西皮奧伊州(Piauí )和馬拉昂州(Maranhão)。
items.description_en: Japan has cumulatively reported four cases this year as of 27 July: three in Chiba Prefecture and one in Tokyo Metropolis. The pathogen does not exist in Japan's natural environment, and cases occur mainly in travellers who visit endemic areas. From 2012 to 2023, Japan reported 34 cases in total, 33 of them acquired abroad: 31 from the United States (19 in Arizona and 8 in California), one from Mexico and one from Nicaragua. One case was locally acquired, in a person who had been exposed to Coccidioides specimens. Most cases are in patients in their 20s and are predominantly male (22 men and 12 women). Coccidioidomycosis is a Category IV notifiable infectious disease in Japan, and cases must be reported immediately upon diagnosis. In the Americas, the south-western United States, northern Mexico, Central America and parts of South America are endemic areas. Apart from the United States, other countries do not include the disease in formal national surveillance or statutory notification. Mexico's infection prevalence is similar to that of the south-western United States; Mexico reported 766 cases in 2000–2019, mainly in arid northern states such as Sonora and Baja California. Cases in Brazil and Argentina are increasing year by year and have even spread into previously non-endemic areas. Brazil reported 292 cases in 1978–2021, mainly from the north-eastern Brazilian states of Piauí and Maranhão.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,巴西,日本,墨西哥,尼加拉瓜,美國

items.summary_zh: 以色列今年截至8/16累計526例麻疹,2例死亡,均為未接種兒童
items.summary_en: Israel has reported 526 measles cases as of 16 August this year, including two deaths, both unvaccinated children; 19 were hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 以色列疫情持續,今年截至8/16累計報告526例,其中2例死亡,均為未接種疫苗孩童,並報告19例住院,其中2例重症於ICU治療中,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Israel's outbreak continues. As of 16 August this year, 526 cases had been cumulatively reported, including two deaths, both of unvaccinated children. A total of 19 cases were hospitalized, two of them severely ill and being treated in intensive care. Authorities urge the public to get vaccinated.

items.headline_zh: 日本/美國/萬那杜-百日咳
items.summary_zh: 日本今年逾6.4萬例百日咳,萬那杜塔納島37例疑似,3名嬰兒死亡
items.summary_en: Japan's pertussis cases exceed 64,000 this year; Vanuatu's Tanna Island has 37 suspected cases, including three infant deaths.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情處高點,近1週(8/4-10)通報3,211例,較前1週3,599例下降388例,以東京都(276)為多,其次為琦玉縣(222)及群馬縣(210)。今年迄今已逾6.4萬例,多地發現抗藥性菌株,並有嬰幼兒重症及死亡病例。 美國夏威夷州疫情上升,今年截至7/31累計報告203例,為去(2024)年全年病例數(84例)2倍以上,該州所有郡皆報告病例,其中考艾島/茂宜島/夏威夷島發病率最高,以1歲以下嬰兒族群受影響最嚴重,未成年族群發病率亦高。 萬那杜宣布該國南部塔菲亞省塔納島爆發疫情,截至8/17報告37例疑,其中3例嬰兒死亡。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is at its peak. In the past week (4–10 August), 3,211 cases were reported, 388 fewer than the previous week's 3,599. Tokyo Metropolis had the most (276), followed by Saitama Prefecture (222) and Gunma Prefecture (210). So far this year, more than 64,000 cases have been reported. Drug-resistant strains have been found in many areas, and there have been severe and fatal cases among infants and young children. In the United States, Hawaii State's outbreak is rising: as of 31 July this year, 203 cases had been cumulatively reported, more than twice the full-year total of 84 cases last year (2024). All counties in the state have reported cases. Kauai, Maui and Hawaii islands have the highest incidence, and infants under one year are the most affected, with high incidence also among minors. Vanuatu announced an outbreak on Tanna Island in Tafea Province in the south of the country; as of 17 August, 37 suspected cases had been reported, including three infant deaths.

items.disease_zh: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_zh: 日本-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症(SFTS)
items.headline_en: Japan – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 日本今年累計135例SFTS,已超過去年全年120例
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 135 SFTS cases this year, already above last year's total of 120; Kochi Prefecture reports the most, with 14 cases.
items.description_zh: 日本今年累計報告達135例,已超過去年總病例數(120例),以高知縣14例為多,當局已發布警示提醒地方政府,除原先流行之西日本地區外,其他地區亦可能報告病例,並宣導戶外活動時,應減少皮膚暴露以避免蜱蟲叮咬措施。該國於2013年首次發現SFTS後,每年報告介於40-130例間。
items.description_en: Japan has cumulatively reported 135 cases this year, already exceeding last year's total of 120. Kochi Prefecture has the most, with 14 cases. Authorities have alerted local governments that cases may be reported outside the previously endemic western Japan region, and advise reducing skin exposure during outdoor activities to prevent tick bites. Since SFTS was first identified in Japan in 2013, the country has reported 40–130 cases per year.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年截至8/9累計15,792例球黴菌症,亞利桑那州8,480例最多
items.summary_en: US coccidioidomycosis reached 15,792 cases in 22 states as of 9 August this year, most in Arizona (8,480) and California (6,741).
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至8/9共22州累計報告15,792例,病例數以亞利桑那州(8,480例)及加州(6,741例)為多,該國每年平均報告2萬例,去(2024)年報告逾2.6萬例,地方性流行於亞利桑那州/加州/內華達州/新墨西哥州,病例多為60歲以上族群,其中,亞利桑那州鳳凰城及土桑(Tucson)都會區,約有15-30%之社區型肺炎患者與球黴菌症相關,該病原體主要分布於該國西南部、墨西哥及中/南美洲之荒漠地帶。本疾病是全國性法定傳染病,惟各州可選擇是否強制通報,評估報告病例數較實際病例數為低。
items.description_en: As of 9 August this year, 22 US states had cumulatively reported 15,792 cases, mainly in Arizona (8,480) and California (6,741). The US reports an average of 20,000 cases per year, and more than 26,000 cases were reported last year (2024). The disease is endemic in Arizona, California, Nevada and New Mexico. Most cases are in people aged over 60. In the Phoenix and Tucson metropolitan areas of Arizona, about 15–30% of community-acquired pneumonia patients have coccidioidomycosis. The pathogen is mainly distributed in the deserts of the south-western US, Mexico, and Central and South America. It is a nationally notifiable disease, but each state may choose whether to require reporting; the reported case count is assessed to be lower than the actual number of cases.

items.summary_zh: 美國加州今年截至7/31累計6,761例球黴菌症,遠高於10年同期平均
items.summary_en: California has reported 6,761 coccidioidomycosis cases this year as of 31 July, far above the 10-year average of 3,833 for that period.
items.description_zh: 美國加州今年截至7/31累計報告6,761例病例,較10年同期平均數3,833例大幅增加,且高於去(2024)年同期6,189例,聖華金谷(San Joaquin Valley)和該州南部為流行區,另中央谷(Central Valley)北部和該州中部海岸沿線病例數也持續上升,專家推測氣候變遷影響乾旱及降雨模式促使病原體擴散。該州去年報告近12,500例病例,為歷年最高,當局表示多數感染者為每年夏末秋初吸入含真菌之灰塵,於1至3週後發病,呼籲出現症狀者主動就醫。另建議旅客於該國西南部及聖華金谷旅行,遭遇刮風時,應停留於室內並關閉門/車窗且使用循環空氣;挖掘及翻動土壤前,應將土壤弄濕;倘無法避免戶外活動,應佩戴合適之N95口罩。
items.description_en: As of 31 July this year, California had cumulatively reported 6,761 cases, far above the 10-year same-period average of 3,833 and higher than the 6,189 cases in the same period last year. San Joaquin Valley and southern California are endemic areas, and case numbers are also continuing to rise in the northern Central Valley and along the central coast of the state. Experts suspect that climate change, affecting drought and rainfall patterns, is helping the pathogen spread. The state reported nearly 12,500 cases last year, the highest on record. Authorities say most infections occur from inhaling fungus-laden dust in late summer and early autumn, with symptoms appearing one to three weeks later, and urge people with symptoms to seek medical care promptly. Travellers in the south-western US and San Joaquin Valley are advised that, when it is windy, they should stay indoors, keep doors and windows closed and use recirculated air; soil should be wetted before digging or turning it over; and if outdoor activities cannot be avoided, a properly fitted N95 mask should be worn.

items.summary_zh: 肯亞M痘累計336例,5例死亡,6週內新增137例
items.summary_en: Kenya has reported 336 mpox cases in 24 counties as of 11 August, including five deaths; 137 were added in six weeks.
items.description_zh: 肯亞疫情上升,自2024年7月報告首例,截至2025年8月11日該國已累計報告24縣336例病例,其中5例死亡,過去6週內新增137例病例,病例以該國東南部蒙巴薩(152例)為多,感染者多為卡車司機及性工作者,由於此類族群較不願透漏接觸者,以致疫調困難及跨境風險增加,當局將加強監測及邊境檢疫措施。
items.description_en: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, the country had cumulatively reported 336 cases in 24 counties as of 11 August 2025, of which five died. In the past six weeks, 137 new cases were added. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa (152 cases), the south-eastern port city. Most infected people are truck drivers and sex workers. Because these groups are less willing to disclose their contacts, contact tracing is difficult and cross-border risk increases. Authorities will strengthen surveillance and border quarantine measures.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 美國/印度-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_en: United States / India – Naegleria fowleri meningoencephalitis
items.summary_zh: 美國密蘇里州及印度喀拉拉邦報告福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎,喀拉拉邦3例,1例死亡
items.summary_en: Missouri, USA reported one Naegleria fowleri case and Kerala, India reported three, one fatal; patients include a three-month-old infant.
items.description_zh: 美國密蘇里州報告1例病例,成年病患於發病前幾日曾於奧札克湖(Ozarks)滑水,感染源調查中,該國於1962-2024年期間共報告167例,當局建議在溫暖之淡水中進行游泳或活動時,應採取相關預防措施。 印度喀拉拉邦報告3例病例,其中1例死亡,2例住院中,病患分別為3個月大嬰兒、9歲女童及1名青年,當局已啟動疫情調查、家庭篩檢及衛教宣導工作。該邦於2016-22年報告8例死亡病例,惟於2023病例數急遽增加,共計報告36例死亡病例。
items.description_en: Missouri State, USA, reported one case. The adult patient had been waterskiing on Lake of the Ozarks a few days before onset. The source of infection is under investigation. The US reported 167 cases in total during 1962–2024. Authorities recommend taking preventive measures when swimming or engaging in activities in warm fresh water. Kerala State, India, reported three cases, one of them fatal. Two patients are currently hospitalized: a three-month-old infant, a nine-year-old girl and a young man. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation, household screening and health education. The state reported eight deaths during 2016–22, but case numbers rose sharply in 2023, and 36 deaths have been reported in total.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥薩卡特卡斯州17歲女性遭臭鼬咬傷未接受狂犬病治療,病情危急
items.summary_en: A 17-year-old woman in Zacatecas, Mexico, bitten by a skunk in June without rabies treatment, is critically ill in intensive care.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥中部薩卡特卡斯州報告1例病例,為17歲女性個案,病患於6月下旬睡覺時被臭鼬咬傷,僅進行傷口消毒,未進行狂犬病治療,於出現相關症狀後就醫,目前病況危急且收治於加護病房,病患為該州自1987年以來首例人類病例,當局已於該州南部設立警戒線,以進行野生動物檢測,另對居民發布疫情警報。
items.description_en: In Zacatecas State, central Mexico, one case was reported: a 17-year-old woman who was bitten by a skunk while sleeping in late June. She only had the wound disinfected and did not receive rabies treatment. She sought medical care after symptoms appeared; her condition is critical and she is in intensive care. She is the first human case in the state since 1987. Authorities have set up an alert zone in the south of the state for wildlife testing and have issued a warning to residents.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾甘達基省近3週新增202例登革熱,博卡拉市432例最多
items.summary_en: Nepal's Gandaki Province added 202 dengue cases in three weeks, with Pokhara City reporting 432; authorities expect further rises.
items.description_zh: 泊爾甘達基省近3週新增202例病例,自前1個月迄今累計811例病例,其中,以博卡拉市報告432例病例為多,該市去年累計逾8,600例確診及3例死亡。當局預估未來幾週疫情將持續上升,已加強防治措施,避免疫情蔓延。
items.description_en: Gandaki Province in Nepal has added 202 cases in the past three weeks, and has recorded 811 cases cumulatively since one month earlier. Pokhara City has reported the most, with 432 cases. Last year, the city cumulatively recorded more than 8,600 confirmed cases and three deaths. Authorities expect cases to continue rising over the coming weeks and have strengthened prevention and control measures to prevent the spread.

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東今年逾9,000例屈公病,近1週830例,佛山644例最多
items.summary_en: Guangdong has over 9,000 chikungunya cases this year, 830 in the week to 16 August, mostly in Foshan; France has 115 local cases.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省屈公病疫情持續,今年迄今累計逾9,000例病例,近1週(8/10-16)新增830例病例,以佛山市644例最多,其次為廣州市85例,無報告重症及死亡病例,相較於前1週(8/3-9)新增1,387例病例,近期病例數呈下降趨勢。 法國疫情更新,今年截至8/12累計115例本土病例,顯示病毒於該國本土傳播風險高。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, continues its chikungunya outbreak, with more than 9,000 cases cumulatively this year. In the past week (10–16 August), 830 new cases were reported, of which 644 were in Foshan City and 85 in Guangzhou City. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Compared with the previous week (3–9 August), when 1,387 new cases were reported, case numbers show a downward trend. France's outbreak update: as of 12 August this year, 115 locally acquired cases have been reported, indicating a high risk of local transmission in the country.

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年截至第30週12,786例奧羅普切熱確診,巴西11,888例
items.summary_en: The Americas reported 12,786 confirmed Oropouche fever cases from 11 countries by week 30, with Brazil accounting for 11,888.
items.description_zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
items.description_en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類禽流感病例,美國乳牛累計1,078起疫情
items.summary_en: No new human avian influenza cases were reported this week; US dairy herd outbreaks total 1,078, and global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共5國於2025/8/8-14 期間報告9起H5N1疫情,西班牙3起、英國/葡萄牙各2起、柬埔寨/阿根廷各1起。 挪威於2025/8/13報告1起H5N5疫情。 法國於 2025/8/13報告2起H5 (N untyped) 疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078起疫情,近期主要集中於加利福亞州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第32週計427個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(加利福亞州、奧勒岡州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計57國家/地區通報2,136起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): five countries reported nine H5N1 outbreaks during 8–14 August 2025, including Spain (3), the UK and Portugal (2 each), and Cambodia and Argentina (1 each). Norway reported one H5N5 outbreak on 13 August 2025. France reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks on 13 August 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 32, 427 sampling sites provided results; two sampling sites in two states (California and Oregon) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: 27 H5N1 influenza cases (990* cumulatively since 2003), 18 H9N2 influenza cases (146 cumulatively) and 2 H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,136 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第30週全球新冠陽性率5.31%創今年新高,日本病例增34%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity reached 5.31% in week 30, the year's highest; Japan's weekly cases rose 34% in week 31.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第30週(7/21-27)全球陽性率5.31%,創今年新高,除西太平洋區以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情持續下降,第32週(8/4-10)定醫門急診陽性率10.8%,較前週下降3.5%,住院陽性率亦下降,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第32週陽性率1.23%,已連續12週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(81.1%)。 日本疫情快速上升,第31週新增約2.1萬例病例,較前1週增加34%,定醫平均病例數增至5.53,病患以東京都、神奈川縣為多,年齡以50-59歲及10歲以下為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 美國疫情持續攀升,第31週陽性率8.6%,創今年新高,新增71例死亡,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,以XFG占比最高(54%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30%)及LP.8.1(7%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 30 of 2025 (21–27 July), global test positivity was 5.31%, the highest this year, with increases in all regions except the Western Pacific. China's outbreak continues to decline: sentinel outpatient and emergency positivity was 10.8% in week 32 (4–10 August), down 3.5% from the previous week, and inpatient positivity also declined, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak is declining: positivity was 1.23% in week 32, down for 12 consecutive weeks; sentinel visit rates have also declined, and wastewater surveillance data show NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (81.1%). Japan's outbreak is rising rapidly: about 21,000 new cases were reported in week 31, up 34% from the previous week; the sentinel average increased to 5.53. Patients are mainly in Tokyo Metropolis and Kanagawa Prefecture, with the largest age groups being 50–59 years and under 10 years; NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. The US outbreak continues to climb: positivity was 8.6% in week 31, a record high this year, with 71 new deaths; NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with XFG the predominant variant (54%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30%) and LP.8.1 (7%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 日本定醫平均病例0.63,低於近3年同期;香港就診陽性率0.8‰
items.summary_en: Japan's enterovirus sentinel average of 0.63 is below the past three years' levels; Hong Kong's clinic positivity is 0.8‰.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第31-32週(7/27-8/9)疫情更新,日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.63,低於近3年同期;香港就診陽性率為0.8‰,較前一周略降,低於近2年同期。
items.description_en: Update for Asian countries for weeks 31–32 (27 July–9 August): Japan's outbreak is rising, with a sentinel average of 0.63, lower than the same period over the past three years. Hong Kong's clinic positivity rate was 0.8‰, slightly lower than the previous week and lower than the same period over the past two years.

items.headline_en: South Africa – Shigellosis / Escherichia coli (EIEC) infection
items.summary_zh: 南非開普敦一餐廳群聚,46例疑似、33例確診痢疾或EIEC感染
items.summary_en: Cape Town, South Africa reported a restaurant cluster of 46 suspected cases, 33 confirmed as shigellosis or EIEC infection, mostly staff.
items.description_zh: 南非首都開普敦8/6報告某餐廳群聚疫情,累計報告46例疑病例,其中33例確診桿菌性痢疾或大腸桿菌感染(EIEC),分別為員工27人、顧客6人;另當局表示2022-24年累計報告437起食品中毒案件,未通報或調查不完整之案件仍多。
items.description_en: The South African capital, Cape Town, reported a restaurant cluster on 6 August. A total of 46 suspected cases were cumulatively reported, of which 33 were confirmed as shigellosis or enteroinvasive E. coli (EIEC) infection: 27 staff and 6 customers. Separately, authorities report that 437 food poisoning incidents were cumulatively reported during 2022–24, and many incidents remain unreported or incompletely investigated.

items.summary_zh: 7/31-8/6 WPV1新增1例(巴基斯坦),cVDPV2新增2例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one WPV1 case in Pakistan and two cVDPV2 cases, in Chad and Nigeria, from 31 July to 6 August.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/31-8/6期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增2國共2例,分別為查德/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增阿富汗4件,cVDPV1新增以色列6件,cVDPV2新增德國8件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 31 July–6 August, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by two cases in two countries, one each in Chad and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by four samples in Afghanistan, cVDPV1 by six samples in Israel, and cVDPV2 by eight samples in Germany.

items.headline_zh: 挪威-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 挪威奧斯陸某餐廳A型肝炎群聚累計22例,餐廳已停業並提供顧客接種
items.summary_en: A hepatitis A cluster at an Oslo restaurant has reached 22 cases; the restaurant has closed and customers are offered vaccination.
items.description_zh: 挪威首都奧斯陸某餐廳爆發群聚疫情,累計報告22例病例,病患於7月後發病,病毒型別為IA;該餐廳在感染風險期間(6月中旬至8月)累計服務1.5萬名顧客,該餐廳已停止營業,衛生當局並提供顧客接種疫苗。
items.description_en: A cluster outbreak occurred at a restaurant in Oslo, the capital of Norway. A total of 22 cases have been cumulatively reported; patients fell ill after July, and the virus type is IA. During the period of infection risk (mid-June to August), the restaurant served a cumulative total of 15,000 customers. The restaurant has ceased operations, and health authorities have offered vaccination to customers.

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東屈公病累計逾9,000例,浙江、福建等6省列為I類地區
items.summary_en: Guangdong's chikungunya outbreak has exceeded 9,000 cases; authorities list six provinces, including Zhejiang and Fujian, as Category I risk areas.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省屈公病疫情仍嚴峻,迄今累計逾9,000例病例,病例數以佛山市最多,其次為廣州市,近期病例數呈現下降趨勢,惟該國廣西、北京、湖北、湖南等其他省市陸續出現病例,當局依據流行風險由高至低分為I類至IV類地區,將浙江、福建、廣東、廣西、海南及雲南等6省份列為I類地區。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, still has a severe chikungunya outbreak, with more than 9,000 cases cumulatively to date. Cases are highest in Foshan City, followed by Guangzhou City, and recent case numbers show a downward trend. However, other provinces and cities, including Guangxi, Beijing, Hubei and Hunan, have successively reported cases. Based on epidemic risk from high to low, authorities have classified areas into Categories I to IV, and listed six provinces (Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan and Yunnan) as Category I areas.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳疫情處高點,近1週3,599例,今年累計逾6萬例
items.summary_en: Japan's pertussis outbreak is at its peak, with 3,599 cases in the week to 3 August and over 60,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情處高點,近1週(7/28-8/3)通報3,599例,較前1週3,399例上升200例,以東京都(299)為多,其次為琦玉縣(261)。今年迄今已逾6萬例,多地發現抗藥性菌株,並有嬰幼兒重症及死亡病例。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is at its peak. In the past week (28 July–3 August), 3,599 cases were reported, up 200 from 3,399 the previous week. Tokyo Metropolis had the most (299), followed by Saitama Prefecture (261). So far this year, more than 60,000 cases have been reported. Drug-resistant strains have been found in many areas, and there have been severe and fatal cases among infants and young children.

items.summary_zh: 索馬利亞首都摩加迪沙白喉病例激增,今年497例、42例死亡
items.summary_en: Mogadishu, Somalia has reported 497 diphtheria cases and 42 deaths this year, compared with 49 cases and 13 deaths last year.
items.description_zh: 索馬利亞首都摩加迪沙及週邊地區,自去(2024)年6月迄今年8月間病例數快速攀升,今年迄今已報告497例及42例死亡,相較去年(49例/13例死亡)為高。
items.description_en: In Mogadishu, Somalia's capital, and surrounding areas, case numbers have risen rapidly from June 2024 to August 2025. This year to date, 497 cases and 42 deaths have been reported, higher than last year's figures of 49 cases and 13 deaths.

items.headline_zh: 以色列/蒙古/韓國/越南/南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/日本-麻疹
items.headline_en: Israel / Mongolia / South Korea / Viet Nam / South Africa / Uzbekistan / Thailand / Italy / Japan – Measles
items.summary_zh: 蒙古今年逾1.3萬例麻疹、10例死亡,韓國68例多為境外移入
items.summary_en: Mongolia has reported over 13,000 measles cases and 10 deaths this year; South Korea's 68 cases are mostly imported, mainly from Viet Nam.
items.description_zh: 以色列今年4月截至8/10累計報告410例,當局評估該國感染人數介於950-1,700人間,並報告22例住院,其中包含2名嬰幼兒重症案例,該國已啟動疫苗接種活動。 蒙古今年截至8/7累計報告逾1.3萬例,其中10例死亡,病例多為未接種疫苗之兒童,該國於2015-16年期間爆發疫情,報告140例死亡,多數為嬰幼兒。 韓國今年截至8/9累計報告68例,其中49例境外移入及19例與境外移入病例相關病例,病例數為去年同期1.4倍,感染國家以越南42例為多,餘有南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/蒙古,病例多為19歲以上成年人,過半數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不詳。 日本東京都病例數上升,今年截至8/7累計報告28例,超過去年全年病例數(10例),因連續假期將至,外出返鄉人潮增加,當局加強警戒。
items.description_en: Israel: 410 cases have been reported since April this year, as of 10 August. Authorities estimate that the number of infected people in the country is between 950 and 1,700. A total of 22 cases were hospitalized, including two severe cases in infants and young children, and the country has launched a vaccination campaign. Mongolia: as of 7 August this year, more than 13,000 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 10 deaths; cases are mostly in unvaccinated children. Mongolia had an outbreak in 2015–16 that reported 140 deaths, most of them infants and young children. South Korea: as of 9 August this year, 68 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 49 were imported and 19 were linked to imported cases; case numbers are 1.4 times those of the same period last year. Most infections were acquired in Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from South Africa, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Italy and Mongolia. Most cases are adults aged 19 and over, and more than half were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Tokyo Metropolis, Japan: case numbers are rising; as of 7 August this year, 28 cases had been cumulatively reported, exceeding last year's full-year total of 10 cases. With the holiday period approaching and more people travelling out and returning home, authorities have increased vigilance.

items.headline_zh: 日本-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症(SFTS)
items.headline_en: Japan – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 日本今年累計124例SFTS,已超過去年120例,高知縣14例最多
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 124 SFTS cases this year, already above last year's 120, with first confirmed cases in five prefectures; Kochi has 14.
items.description_zh: 日本今年迄今累計報告達124例,已超過去年總病例數(120例),並有過往未確診感染地區出現患者,病例主要集中於西日本地區,以高知縣14例為多,另北海道/茨城縣/栃木縣/神奈川縣/岐阜縣均為首次通報確診病例,此外,已有被受感染之寵物貓/狗感染及醫生透過患者血液感染案例。該疾病於2013年首次於該國發現,每年報告數介於40-130例。
items.description_en: Japan has cumulatively reported 124 cases this year, exceeding last year's total of 120. Cases have appeared in areas where infection had not previously been diagnosed. Most cases are concentrated in western Japan, with Kochi Prefecture the highest at 14 cases. Hokkaido, Ibaraki, Tochigi, Kanagawa and Gifu prefectures each reported their first confirmed cases. There have also been cases of infection in pet cats and dogs that were infected, and of doctors infected through the blood of patients. The disease was first identified in Japan in 2013, and 40–130 cases have been reported annually since.

items.summary_zh: 非洲今年25國逾9.5萬例M痘,582例死亡,烏干達6,466例確診
items.summary_en: Africa has reported over 95,000 mpox cases in 25 countries this year, with 582 deaths; Uganda has 6,466 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
items.description_en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.
items.area_zh: 迦納共和國,幾內亞,馬拉威,莫三比克,獅子山,南非,烏干達,尚比亞,辛巴威

items.summary_zh: 美國麻州瑪莎葡萄園島20年來首例疑似病例,全美今年24例
items.summary_en: Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts reported a suspected Powassan virus case, the island's first in 20 years, in a five-week-old infant; the US has 24 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 美國麻薩諸塞州瑪莎葡萄園島新增1例疑病例,為該島20年來首例,病患為5週大嬰兒,據調查該嬰兒與母親於戶外散步時,疑被蜱蟲叮咬,病患於一週後出現癲癇、腦腫脹等症狀,目前於醫院治療中,5至7月為蜱蟲活躍季節,該州其他區今年迄今已累計3例病例。美國全國今年已累計7州24例病例,以威斯康辛州11例為多,近9成(22例)為神經侵襲性病例,該國去年全年累計57例,當局呼籲民眾於戶外須防範蜱蟲叮咬。
items.description_en: A new suspected case has been reported on Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts, USA, the first on the island in 20 years. The patient is a five-week-old infant. Investigation found that the infant and mother were walking outdoors when the infant was suspected of being bitten by a tick; one week later the infant developed seizures and cerebral swelling and is being treated in hospital. May to July is the active tick season. Other areas of the state have reported three cases so far this year. Nationally, the US has reported 24 cases in seven states this year, most in Wisconsin (11); nearly 90% (22 cases) were neuroinvasive. The US reported 57 cases in total last year. Authorities urge people outdoors to guard against tick bites.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓6/8至8/7累計2,396例鉤端螺旋體病,單週569例
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 2,396 leptospirosis cases from 8 June to 7 August, 569 in one week; Quezon City has passed its epidemic threshold.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情持續,自6/8截至8/7累計報告2,396例病例,單週報告569例病例,城市洪災加劇該疾病之蔓延,馬拉大都會和其他地區醫院患者數量激增,部分急診室已超負荷運轉。奎松市今年迄8/3報告207例病例,已超過「流行閾」,其中24例死亡。該國去年截至10月病例數約為5,050例。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the Philippines continues: from 8 June to 7 August, 2,396 cases were cumulatively reported, with 569 cases in a single week. Urban flooding is intensifying the spread of the disease. Patient numbers have surged at hospitals in Metro Manila and other areas, and some emergency rooms are overloaded. Quezon City reported 207 cases as of 3 August this year, exceeding the epidemic threshold, of which 24 died. Last year the country had about 5,050 cases as of October.

items.headline_zh: 義大利/保加利亞/法國/希臘/匈牙利/羅馬尼亞-西尼羅熱
items.headline_en: Italy / Bulgaria / France / Greece / Hungary / Romania – West Nile fever
items.summary_zh: 義大利今年173例西尼羅熱,11例死亡,72例有神經症狀
items.summary_en: Italy has reported 173 West Nile fever cases and 11 deaths this year; 72 cases involved neurological symptoms.
items.description_zh: 義大利疫情上升,今年迄今累計173例病例及11例死亡,其中72例病例出現神經症狀。歐洲今年截至8/6,包括保加利亞、法國、希臘、義大利、匈牙利、羅馬亞等6國均曾報告確診病例。
items.description_en: Italy's outbreak is rising: so far this year, 173 cases and 11 deaths have been cumulatively reported, of which 72 cases had neurological symptoms. As of 6 August this year, six European countries, including Bulgaria, France, Greece, Italy, Hungary and Romania, had reported confirmed cases.
items.area_zh: 保加利亞,法國,希臘,匈牙利,義大利,羅馬尼亞

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東近1週新增1,387例屈公病,較前週減少,佛山1,212例最多
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 1,387 chikungunya cases in the week to 9 August, down from 2,892, with Foshan accounting for 1,212.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省屈公病疫情仍嚴峻,自7/8報告首例境外移入病例以來,迄今累計逾7,000例病例,近1週(8/3-9)新增1,387例病例,相較於前1週(2,892例),近期呈現下降趨勢,病例以佛山市最多(1,212例),其次為廣州市103例,無報告重症及死亡病例。佛山市每日新增病例數亦由疫情高峰期(7/19)之674例下降至8/8之148例,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, still has a severe chikungunya outbreak. Since the first imported case was reported on 8 July, more than 7,000 cases have been cumulatively reported. In the past week (3–9 August), 1,387 new cases were reported, compared with 2,892 in the previous week, showing a recent downward trend. Cases are mostly in Foshan City (1,212), followed by Guangzhou City (103). No severe or fatal cases have been reported. Daily new cases in Foshan fell from a peak of 674 on 19 July to 148 on 8 August, and authorities continue outbreak prevention and control work.

items.summary_zh: 全球今年逾360萬例登革熱,2,000例死亡,美洲逾330萬例
items.summary_en: Globally, over 3.6 million dengue cases and 2,000 deaths have been reported this year, with the Americas accounting for over 3.3 million.
items.description_zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告逾360萬例病例及2,000例死亡,以美洲地區報告逾330萬例病例為多,其中病例主要分布於巴西;今年亞洲地區之印累計89,845例病例、馬來西亞35,348例、斯里蘭卡31,544例、越南28,787例、泰國24,372例及孟加拉20,218例;非洲地區累計10國報告9,266例病例及18例死亡。
items.description_en: Globally, more than 3.6 million cases and 2,000 deaths have been cumulatively reported this year, with the Americas region accounting for more than 3.3 million cases, mainly in Brazil. In Asia this year, Indonesia has cumulatively reported 89,845 cases, Malaysia 35,348, Sri Lanka 31,544, Viet Nam 28,787, Thailand 24,372 and Bangladesh 20,218. In Africa, 10 countries have reported 9,266 cases and 18 deaths cumulatively.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,巴西,印尼,馬來西亞,斯里蘭卡,泰國,越南

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,英國報告19起H5N1動物疫情
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection; the UK reported 19 H5N1 animal outbreaks during 1–8 August, and global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共7國於 2025/8/1-8期間報告 29 起H5N1疫情,英國 19 起、印度/柬埔寨/葡萄牙/西班牙各 2 起、南非/愛爾蘭各1起。 挪威於2025/8/8報告2起H5N5疫情。 法國於 2025/8/6-2025/8/7 報告2起H5 (N untyped) 疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第31週計434個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中4州(紐澤西州、維吉亞州、加利福亞州、馬里蘭州)共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計56國家/地區通報2,114起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): seven countries reported 29 H5N1 outbreaks during 1–8 August 2025, including the UK (19), India, Cambodia, Portugal and Spain (2 each), and South Africa and Ireland (1 each). Norway reported two H5N5 outbreaks on 8 August 2025. France reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 6–7 August 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 (1) herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 31, 434 sampling sites provided results; four sites in four states (New Jersey, Virginia, California and Maryland) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 56 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,114 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第29週全球新冠陽性率4.78%,韓國第31週住院220例為今年新高
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was 4.78% in week 29; South Korea's 220 weekly hospitalizations in week 31 were this year's highest.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第29週(7/14-20)全球陽性率4.78%,西太平洋、歐洲、非洲區署陽性率皆呈增加趨勢。 中國疫情緩慢波動下降,7月累計報告22.6萬例病例,其中重症219例、死亡2例,陽性率呈小幅波動,最後1週為12.7%,以變異株NB.1.8.1為主(95.2%)。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第31週(7/27-8/2)陽性率1.4%,已連續11週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(81.1%)。 韓國疫情快速上升,第31週新增住院220例,創今年新高,陽性率攀升至22.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 歐洲疫情上升,第30週門診陽性率19%,創今年新高,以變異株XFG占比最高(61%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(48%),其次為NB.1.8.1(35%)及LP.8.1(9%)。WHO表示多國已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴之檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 29 of 2025 (14–20 July), global test positivity was 4.78%, with increasing trends in the Western Pacific, European and African regions. China's outbreak is fluctuating and slowly declining: 226,000 cases were reported cumulatively in July, including 219 severe cases and two deaths. Positivity has shown slight fluctuations, reaching 12.7% in the most recent week, with variant NB.1.8.1 predominant (95.2%). Hong Kong's outbreak is declining: positivity was 1.4% in week 31 (27 July–2 August), down for 11 consecutive weeks; sentinel visit rates have also declined; wastewater surveillance data show NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (81.1%). South Korea's outbreak is rising rapidly: 220 new hospitalizations were reported in week 31, the highest this year, and positivity rose to 22.5%, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Europe's outbreak is rising: sentinel outpatient positivity was 19% in week 30, the highest this year, with XFG the predominant variant (61%). Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with XFG the predominant global variant (48%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (35%) and LP.8.1 (9%). WHO notes that many countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,韓國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 7/17-30全球WPV1新增3例,cVDPV2新增49例,葉門43例最多
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 49 cVDPV2 cases from 17–30 July across three countries, 43 of them in Yemen, plus three WPV1 cases in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/17-30期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦3例;cVDPV2新增3國共49例,分別為葉門43例、奈及利亞5例、衣索比亞1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增2國共7件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞6件、象牙海岸1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 17–30 July, WPV1 increased by three cases in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by 49 cases in three countries: Yemen (43), Nigeria (5) and Ethiopia (1). For environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by seven samples in two countries: Papua New Guinea (6) and Côte d'Ivoire (1).
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,葉門

items.summary_zh: 阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯今年截至7月下旬累計50例旋毛蟲感染症
items.summary_en: Buenos Aires has reported 50 trichinellosis cases this year as of late July, mostly linked to pork products; two were hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷首都布宜諾斯艾利斯今年截至7月下旬累計報告50例病例,其中2例住院,病患多食用自製或購買之豬肉食品後發病;另2024年同期累計報告76例病例,當局呼籲民眾將豬肉煮熟,避免食用來路不明的肉品。
items.description_en: Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, reported 50 cases cumulatively this year as of late July, of which two were hospitalized. Patients mostly became ill after eating homemade or purchased pork products. The same period in 2024 had seen 76 cases cumulatively reported. Authorities urge people to cook pork thoroughly and to avoid eating meat of unknown origin.

items.headline_zh: 芬蘭-創傷弧菌感染/非產毒性霍亂弧菌
items.headline_en: Finland – Vibrio vulnificus / non-toxigenic Vibrio cholerae infection
items.summary_zh: 芬蘭7月報告4例重症弧菌感染,患者皆曾於波羅的海沿岸游泳
items.summary_en: Finland reported four severe Vibrio infections in July, all in patients who had swum along the Baltic Sea coast.
items.description_zh: 芬蘭於7月報告4例重症,病患皆曾於波羅地海沿岸游泳,可能透過開放性傷口或喝入海水而感染;當局評估今年北歐氣溫上升,擴大弧菌之傳播風險區域。
items.description_en: Finland reported four severe cases in July. All patients had swum along the Baltic Sea coast, and infection may have occurred through open wounds or by swallowing seawater. Authorities assess that rising temperatures in northern Europe this year are expanding the risk area for Vibrio transmission.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至7月累計3.4萬例腸病毒,無死亡;日本定醫平均0.59
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 34,000 enterovirus cases this year as of July with no deaths; Japan's sentinel average of 0.59 is below the three-year norm.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第28-30週(7/6-26)疫情更新,日本疫情持平,定醫平均病例數0.59,低於近3年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,平均每日新增20例病例,與前兩週相同;泰國今年截至7月累計報告3.4萬例,死亡0例,最常見的病患年齡組依序為0-4歲、5-9歲、10-14歲。
items.description_en: Update for Asian countries for weeks 28–30 (6–26 July): Japan's outbreak is flat, with a sentinel average of 0.59, lower than the same period over the past three years. Singapore's outbreak is at a low level, with an average of 20 new cases per day, the same as in the previous two weeks. Thailand reported 34,000 cases cumulatively this year as of July, with no deaths; the most common age groups among patients are 0–4, 5–9 and 10–14 years, in that order.

items.summary_zh: 中國今年截至6月布氏桿菌病累計33,959例,1例死亡,低於去年同期
items.summary_en: China reported 33,959 brucellosis cases and one death as of June this year, below the same period last year; Xinjiang has high incidence.
items.description_zh: 中國今年截至6月累計報告3萬3,959例病例,其中1例死亡,病例數低於去年同期(3萬7,021例);另2024年全年累計報告6萬7,418例,其中3例死亡;該國2004-22年平均發生率為每10萬人口5例,疫情盛行於春夏季,呈逐年增加趨勢,北部省份發生率高(如新疆、內蒙古及黑龍江等)。 中國新疆2021-23年累計報告1萬8,094例病例,年均發生率為每10萬人口23例,病患年齡以30-60歲為多(占73%),男性占7成,常見職業為農民、牧民,病患分佈以伊犁哈薩克自治州、昌吉回族自治州等為主。
items.description_en: China reported 33,959 cases cumulatively this year as of June, including one death; case numbers are lower than in the same period last year (37,021). In 2024, 67,418 cases were reported in total, including three deaths. China's average incidence in 2004–22 was five per 100,000 population. The disease peaks in spring and summer and has been increasing year by year, with higher incidence in northern provinces such as Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia and Heilongjiang. In Xinjiang, 18,094 cases were reported cumulatively in 2021–23, an average annual incidence of 23 per 100,000 population. Patients are mostly aged 30–60 years (73%) and 70% are male; common occupations are farmers and herders. Cases are mainly distributed in Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture and Changji Hui Autonomous Prefecture, among others.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨6歲女童感染H5N1,今年累計15例,目前加護病房治療
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported an H5N1 infection in a six-year-old girl, now in intensive care; the country has 15 human cases this year.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國南部茶膠省占卡縣6歲女童,出現發燒、咳嗽、氣喘及呼吸困難等症狀,目前仍於ICU治療中,病患所住村莊及家中有大量病死雞隻,且患者母親曾烹煮病死雞,該國今年累計報告15例,為今年5月底以來第12例,自2023年2月以來,已累計報告31例。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, in a six-year-old girl from Chamkar district (占卡縣) in Takeo Province, southern Cambodia. She developed fever, cough, asthma and difficulty breathing and is still being treated in intensive care. There were many dead chickens in the village and at the patient's home, and the patient's mother had cooked dead chickens. Cambodia has reported 15 cases this year, the 12th since late May, and 31 cases since February 2023.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳近1週3,399例,較前週減509例,今年累計逾5.6萬例
items.summary_en: Japan reported 3,399 pertussis cases in the week to 27 July, down 509 from the previous week; cumulative cases this year exceed 56,000.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情處高點,近1週(7/21-7/27)通報3,399例,較前1週3,908例下降509例,以東京都(302)為多,其次為琦玉縣(241)。今年迄今已逾5.6萬例,多地發現抗藥性菌株,並有嬰幼兒重症及死亡病例。專家表示,目前學生為主要流行族群,因進入暑假期間,校園內感染受到控制,惟近期民眾返鄉探親增加,各年齡層族群可能出現疫情擴散風險,仍須留意防範措施。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is at its peak. In the past week (21–27 July), 3,399 cases were reported, down 509 from 3,908 the previous week. Tokyo Metropolis had the most (302), followed by Saitama Prefecture (241). So far this year, more than 56,000 cases have been reported. Drug-resistant strains have been found in many areas, and there have been severe and fatal cases among infants and young children. Experts say students are currently the main affected group. Because summer holidays have begun and transmission on campuses has been controlled, but people are increasingly returning home to visit relatives, there is a risk of spread across all age groups, so prevention measures remain important.

items.summary_zh: 紐約哈林區退伍軍人病自7月下旬累計58例,2例死亡,冷卻水塔為感染源
items.summary_en: Harlem in New York City has reported 58 Legionnaires' disease cases since late July, including two deaths; cooling towers are the source.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約市自7月下旬截至8/4累計報告58例,其中2例死亡,病例主要集中於該市北部哈林區,調查顯示冷卻水塔為感染源。
items.description_en: New York City has reported 58 cases since late July through 4 August, including two deaths. Cases are mainly concentrated in the Harlem district in the north of the city. Investigation shows that cooling towers are the source of infection.

items.headline_zh: 墨西哥/剛果民主共和國/葉門-麻疹
items.headline_en: Mexico / Democratic Republic of the Congo / Yemen – Measles
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥今年逾7,000例疑似麻疹、14例死亡;葉門逾2萬例、178例死亡
items.summary_en: Mexico has more than 7,000 suspected measles cases and 14 deaths this year; Yemen has over 20,000 suspected cases and 178 deaths as of mid-July.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥今年迄今報告逾7,000例疑病例,其中超過3,900例確診及14例死亡,病例數以北部契瓦瓦州逾3,600例為多,且以0-4歲嬰幼兒為主,惟實際病例數可能更高,該國目前疫苗覆蓋率僅76%,當局已啟動監測及接種疫苗計畫。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年迄今報告4,057例,其中122例死亡(CFR:3%),由於當地交通不便及局勢不穩定,死亡率偏高,當局已規劃疫苗接種計畫。 葉門今年截至7/14累計報告2萬餘例疑病例及178例死亡(CFR: 0.85%),病例集中於西部荷台達省及札馬爾省。
items.description_en: Mexico has reported more than 7,000 suspected cases this year, of which more than 3,900 are confirmed, and 14 deaths. Cases are highest in northern Chihuahua State, with more than 3,600, and are mainly among infants and young children aged 0–4. Actual case numbers may be higher. Mexico's vaccination coverage is only 76%, and authorities have launched a surveillance and vaccination programme. In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Kivu Province has reported 4,057 cases this year, of which 122 died (CFR: 3%). The high mortality is attributed to poor transport and instability in the area, and authorities have planned a vaccination programme. Yemen has reported more than 20,000 suspected cases and 178 deaths cumulatively as of 14 July this year (CFR: 0.85%). Cases are concentrated in Hudaydah and Dhamar governorates in the west.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,墨西哥,葉門

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦新增3例立百病毒感染,2例死亡,匡列723名接觸者
items.summary_en: WHO reports three new Nipah virus cases in Kerala, India, two fatal, with 723 contacts identified; WHO warns of potential serious public health impact.
items.description_zh: WHO公布印度喀拉拉邦新增3例確定病例,其中2例死亡,案1為18歲女性,於6/23發病,7/1死亡;案2為38歲女性,於6/25發病,病況危急並收治於加護病房;案3為57歲男性,於7/6發病,10日住院,12日死亡。當局已匡列共計723名接觸者,並針對該邦3縣市(科澤科德縣、馬拉普蘭縣及帕拉卡德縣)發出警示;該國今年累計報告4例病例,皆來自喀拉拉邦,該邦於2018年爆發首次疫情,另於2019、2021及2023-25年持續發生病例,WHO評估該疾病嚴重度高,目前尚無治療藥物及疫苗,且有進一步傳播可能性,此事件有造成嚴重公共衛生影響之潛在風險。
items.description_en: WHO reports that Kerala State, India, has added three confirmed cases, two of them fatal. Case 1 was an 18-year-old woman who fell ill on 23 June and died on 1 July. Case 2 was a 38-year-old woman who fell ill on 25 June and is critically ill in intensive care. Case 3 was a 57-year-old man who fell ill on 6 July, was hospitalized on 10 July and died on 12 July. Authorities have identified 723 contacts in total and issued alerts for three districts in the state: Kozhikode, Malappuram and Palakkad. The country has reported four cases this year, all from Kerala. The state had its first outbreak in 2018, and cases have continued in 2019, 2021 and 2023–25. WHO assesses the disease as highly severe; there is currently no treatment drug or vaccine, further spread is possible, and the event carries a potential risk of serious public health impact.

items.headline_zh: 菲律賓/泰國-鉤端螺旋體病
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年累計3,037例鉤端螺旋體病,泰國1,895例、25例死亡
items.summary_en: The Philippines has reported 3,037 leptospirosis cases this year, and Thailand 1,895 cases with 25 deaths, as of mid-July.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,今年截至7/17累計報告3,037例病例,於7/13-31期間通報569例病例,當局表示該國連續數週暴風雨,導致病例增加,提醒民眾避免涉水,並於接觸後,清洗身體,倘出現相關症狀,應立即就醫,另警告民眾未經醫師處方,不得自行用藥或服用抗生素。 泰國今年截至7/17報告1,895例病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:1.32%),病例/死亡數均以年齡60歲以上族群為多,當局建議民眾避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後,清洗身體,另倘於涉水後1-2週出現相關症狀,應立即就醫並告知接觸史。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the Philippines is rising: as of 17 July this year, 3,037 cases had been cumulatively reported, and 569 cases were reported between 13 and 31 July. Authorities say several consecutive weeks of storms have increased cases. They remind the public to avoid wading through water, to wash the body after contact, and to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. They also warn people not to self-medicate or take antibiotics without a doctor's prescription. Thailand reported 1,895 cases as of 17 July this year, including 25 deaths (CFR: 1.32%). Both cases and deaths are mainly in people aged over 60. Authorities recommend avoiding wading or muddy areas, or wearing protective gear such as boots and gloves, and washing the body after contact. If symptoms appear within one to two weeks after wading, people should seek medical care immediately and report their exposure history.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至7/29累計2,036例類鼻疽,92例死亡,多集中東北部
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 2,036 melioidosis cases and 92 deaths this year as of 29 July, mainly among older farmers in the north-east.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至7/29累計報告2,036例,其中92例死亡(CFR:4.52%),病患職業以農民為主,年齡以60歲以上族群為多,主要分布於該國東北部,當局提醒民眾食用熟食及避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子及手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後,清洗身體,另呼籲農民及糖尿病患者,應留意自身感染風險。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 2,036 cases this year as of 29 July, including 92 deaths (CFR: 4.52%). Patients are mainly farmers and most are aged over 60, with cases mainly in the north-east of the country. Authorities remind the public to eat cooked food, to avoid wading or muddy areas or wear protective gear such as boots and gloves, and to wash the body after contact. Farmers and people with diabetes are urged to be aware of their own risk of infection.

items.summary_zh: 獅子山今年5,072例確診M痘,47例死亡;迦納302例、幾內亞381例
items.summary_en: Sierra Leone has 5,072 confirmed mpox cases and 47 deaths this year; Ghana has 302 and Guinea 381 confirmed cases, with Guinea's outbreak rising.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山今年截至8/4報告5,072例確診病例,其中47例死亡,多集中於西部城市與農村地區,單週(29週)報告逾200例;迦納今年截至7/31報告302例確診病例,於7/22-30新增45例,另於7/27報告首例死亡案例;幾內亞疫情上升,今年截至7/26報告381例確診病例,其中1例死亡,男性占約7成,新增3區有報告病例。
items.description_en: In Africa, Sierra Leone had reported 5,072 confirmed cases as of 4 August this year, of which 47 died. Cases are concentrated in western urban and rural areas, with more than 200 cases in week 29 alone. Ghana reported 302 confirmed cases as of 31 July this year, with 45 new cases between 22 and 30 July, and reported its first death on 27 July. Guinea's outbreak is rising: 381 confirmed cases had been reported as of 26 July this year, including one death; men account for about 70%, and three new districts have reported cases.
items.area_zh: 迦納共和國,幾內亞,獅子山

items.summary_zh: 美國緬因州今年首例波瓦桑病毒病例,病患為漢考克郡成年人並住院治療
items.summary_en: Maine reported its first Powassan virus case this year, an adult in Hancock County who was hospitalized with neurological symptoms.
items.description_zh: 美國緬因州報告今年首例病例,為居住漢考克郡(Hancock)之成年病患,感染後出現神經系統症狀並住院治療,該病重症患者致死率約10%,康復後仍有長期後遺症,目前尚無特效治療方法。當局建議民眾外出,應採取預防蜱蟲叮咬之防護措施。
items.description_en: Maine State, USA, reported its first case this year, an adult resident of Hancock County. The patient developed neurological symptoms after infection and was hospitalized. Severe cases of this disease have a fatality rate of about 10%, and survivors may have long-term sequelae; there is currently no specific treatment. Authorities advise people going outdoors to take measures to prevent tick bites.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至7/20累計822例拉薩熱確診,155例死亡
items.summary_en: Nigeria has reported 822 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 155 deaths in 21 states as of 20 July, with Ondo State rising.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,今年截至7/20累計報告21州822例確診,其中155例死亡(CFR:18.9%),病例/死亡數均較去年同期為低,病患主要年齡層為21-30歲,以西南部翁多州、東北部包奇州及西南部埃多州為多,其中翁多州近期病例數呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en: Nigeria outbreak update: as of 20 July this year, 822 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported across 21 states, of which 155 died (CFR: 18.9%). Case and death numbers are lower than in the same period last year. The main age group of patients is 21–30 years. Cases are mainly in Ondo State in the south-west, Bauchi State in the north-east and Edo State in the south-west; Ondo State has recently shown an upward trend in cases.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾達丁縣偏遠村莊3人死於狂犬病,皆無咬傷紀錄
items.summary_en: Three rabies deaths in a remote village in Dhading District, Nepal, occurred within 1.5 months, with no recorded animal bites; nearly 300 residents received post-exposure vaccination.
items.description_zh: 泊爾達丁縣偏遠村莊報告3例死亡病例,病患在1個半月內相繼死亡,皆無被犬隻或其他動物咬傷紀錄,當局已針對近300位鄰近居民進行暴露後預防接種作業。該國每年報告10-100例病例,惟民眾通報意識不足,病例數有低估情形。
items.description_en: In a remote village in Dhading District, Nepal, three deaths were reported; the patients died one after another within one and a half months, and none had a record of being bitten by dogs or other animals. Authorities have carried out post-exposure vaccination for nearly 300 neighbouring residents. The country reports 10–100 cases per year, but public awareness of reporting is insufficient, and case numbers are likely underestimated.

items.summary_zh: 截至7/30歐洲5國報告西尼羅熱確診,義大利拉蒂納省43例最多
items.summary_en: As of 30 July, five European countries had reported West Nile fever cases; Italy's Latina Province had the most, with 43.
items.description_zh: 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至7/30,歐洲之保加利亞、法國、希臘、義大利、羅馬亞等5國均曾報告確診病例,其中以義大利中部拉蒂納省43例為多,希臘亦報告17例本土病例。
items.description_en: Europe outbreak update: as of 30 July this year, Bulgaria, France, Greece, Italy and Romania had reported confirmed cases. Among them, Latina Province in central Italy reported the most, with 43 cases. Greece also reported 17 locally acquired cases.
items.area_zh: 保加利亞,法國,希臘,義大利,羅馬尼亞

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東近1週新增2,892例屈公病,佛山2,770例最多,澳門報告2例本土
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 2,892 chikungunya cases in one week, 2,770 of them in Foshan; Macao has reported two local cases.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情嚴峻,該省近1週新增2,892例病例,以佛山市最多(2,770例),其次為廣州市(65例),疫情分布地區擴大,惠州市亦出現病例;佛山市截至7/31累計逾6,900例病例,該省其他城市近期亦出現病例,並於澳門及香港等地出現移入病例,澳門近日已報告2例本土病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, has a severe outbreak: 2,892 new cases were reported in the past week, mainly in Foshan City (2,770), followed by Guangzhou City (65). The affected area has expanded, and Huizhou City has also reported cases. As of 31 July, Foshan City had cumulatively reported more than 6,900 cases. Other cities in the province have also recently reported cases, and imported cases have appeared in Macao and Hong Kong. Macao has recently reported two local cases.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,澳門特別行政區

items.summary_zh: 薩摩亞近1週521例登革熱,累計2,277例確診及2例死亡,全校停課一週
items.summary_en: Samoa reported 521 dengue cases in one week and 2,277 confirmed cases with two deaths since April; all schools will close for a week.
items.description_zh: 薩摩亞疫情上升,近1週(7/21-27)報告521例病例,該國自4/17宣布爆發疫情以來已累計2,277例確診病例及2例死亡病例。91%病例來自烏波盧島,且以15歲以下人口族群為主(71%),當局為控制疫情,宣布所有學校停課一週並進行消毒。
items.description_en: Samoa's outbreak is rising: in the past week (21–27 July), 521 cases were reported. Since Samoa declared the outbreak on 17 April, 2,277 confirmed cases and two deaths have been cumulatively reported. 91% of cases came from Upolu Island, and 71% of cases are among people aged under 15. To control the outbreak, authorities have announced that all schools will close for one week and carry out disinfection.

items.summary_zh: 澳門新增2例本土屈公病,香港首例境外移入為12歲男童
items.summary_en: Macao reported two local chikungunya cases this year; Hong Kong's first imported case of the year is a 12-year-old boy who had visited Foshan.
items.description_zh: 澳門今年新增報告2例本土病例,工作地點皆為新城A區,案1為34歲男性,於7/27出現咽喉痛,經檢驗陰性,8/1上肢及胸部出現皮疹,經檢驗確診;案2為34歲女性,於7/30四肢出現紅疹,8/1出現臉部出疹及發燒就醫,2日經檢驗確診,病患住院隔離中,病情穩定,病患曾於7/13-21至日本旅遊,期間未被蚊蟲叮咬,7/22-29(除7/27週休)返澳後皆至新城A區工作,當局近日接獲中國通報多名居住於珠海並於該區工作之確定病例,考量病患之旅遊史、發病時間及檢驗結果,均列為本土病例;今年截至8/2累計6例境外移入及2例本土病例,已啟動防控小組,加強積水和孳生源巡查等防治工作。 香港於8/2報告今年首例境外移入病例,為12歲男童,於7/31出現發燒、皮疹及關節痛至診所就醫,8/1轉介住院並經實驗室確診,病況穩定;病患曾於7/17-30至廣東省佛山市旅遊,自述曾被蚊蟲叮咬,接觸者迄無症狀。香港於2016-19每年通報1-11例境外移入病例,當局已啟動調查及病媒蚊防治工作,另呼籲民眾倘曾至蚊媒傳染病風險地區,應於14日內持續使用防蚊液,倘有發燒、關節痛或皮疹等症狀,應立即就醫。中國廣東省佛山衞生局截至7/31通報逾6,900名病例,病患主要來自於順德區(5,972例)。
items.description_en:
Macao reported two new local cases this year. Both patients work in New City Zone A (新城A區). Case 1 is a 34-year-old man who developed a sore throat on 27 July, with a negative test result; he developed a rash on the upper limbs and chest on 1 August and was confirmed by testing. Case 2 is a 34-year-old woman who developed a red rash on her limbs on 30 July, then facial rash and fever on 1 August, sought care, and was confirmed by testing on 2 August. She is hospitalized in isolation, and her condition is stable. The patient travelled to Japan from 13 to 21 July, reported no mosquito bites during the trip, and after returning to Macao on 22–29 July (excluding the 27 July rest day) worked at New City Zone A every day. Authorities recently received notification from China of several confirmed cases living in Zhuhai and working in the same area; given the patient's travel history, onset timing and test results, both cases have been classified as local. As of 2 August this year, six imported and two local cases had been cumulatively reported. A prevention and control team has been activated, with stronger inspection of standing water and breeding sources.
Hong Kong reported its first imported case of the year on 2 August: a 12-year-old boy who developed fever, rash and joint pain on 31 July and visited a clinic. He was referred to hospital on 1 August, confirmed by laboratory testing, and his condition is stable. The patient had travelled to Foshan City, Guangdong, from 17 to 30 July and reported being bitten by mosquitoes; none of his contacts has shown symptoms. Hong Kong reported 1–11 imported cases annually in 2016–19. Authorities have launched an investigation and vector control work, and urge people who have visited mosquito-borne disease risk areas to keep using mosquito repellent for 14 days, and to seek medical care immediately if they develop fever, joint pain or rash. The Foshan Municipal Health Commission reported more than 6,900 cases as of 31 July, mainly from Shunde District (5,972 cases).

items.summary_zh: 全球今年逾3.3萬例M痘,中國累計23例Ib型確診
items.summary_en: As of week 30, 79 countries have reported 33,370 mpox cases this year; China has reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
items.description_en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,8國報告23起H5N1動物疫情
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection; eight countries reported 23 H5N1 animal outbreaks from 25 July to 1 August, and global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  8國於2025/7/25-2025/8/1 期間報告23起H5N1疫情,英國8 起、美國/西班牙4起、巴西3起、匈牙利/愛爾蘭/波札那/臺灣各1起。 法國於 2025/8/1報告2起H5 (N untyped) 疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,077(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第30週計395個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中4州(紐澤西州、奧勒岡州、加利福亞州、維吉亞州)共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感26例 (2003年迄今累計989*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計56國家/地區通報2,081起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
items.description_en: Summary for the week. Human cases: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): eight countries reported 23 H5N1 outbreaks during 25 July–1 August 2025, including the UK (8), the USA and Spain (4 each), Brazil (3), and Hungary, Ireland, Botswana and Taiwan (1 each). France reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks on 1 August 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,077 (0) herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 30, 395 sampling sites provided results; four sites in four states (New Jersey, Oregon, California and Virginia) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 26 cases (989 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 56 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,081 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 第28週全球新冠陽性率4.54%,日本第29週新增12,069例
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was 4.54% in week 28; Japan reported 12,069 new cases in week 29, up 30% on the previous week.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第28週(7/7-13)全球陽性率4.54%,美洲及歐洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情上下波動,第30週(7/21-27)定醫門診陽性率13.5%,較前1週略減,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第30週陽性率1.89%,已連續10週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(88.1%),另XFG占1.7%。 日本疫情呈上升趨勢,第29週(7/14-20)新增12,069例,較上週增加30%,病患分佈以東京都及神奈川縣為主,年齡分布以50-59歲及10歲以下為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情上升,第30週新增住院病例139例,已連續4週上升,陽性率達20.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、東地中海、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株由XFG占比最高(49%),其次為NB.1.8.1(29.26%)及LP.8.1(10%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 28 of 2025 (7–13 July), global test positivity was 4.54%, with increases in the Americas and European regions. China's outbreak is fluctuating: sentinel outpatient positivity was 13.5% in week 30 (21–27 July), slightly lower than the previous week; positivity is higher in southern provinces than northern ones, inpatient positivity is declining, and NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak is declining: positivity was 1.89% in week 30, down for 10 consecutive weeks; sentinel visit rates have also declined; wastewater surveillance data show NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (88.1%), with XFG at 1.7%. Japan's outbreak is rising: 12,069 new cases were reported in week 29 (14–20 July), up 30% from the previous week; patients are mainly in Tokyo Metropolis and Kanagawa Prefecture, with the largest age groups being 50–59 years and under 10 years, and NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. South Korea's outbreak is rising: 139 new hospitalizations were reported in week 30, rising for four consecutive weeks, with positivity reaching 20.1%, and NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions rising. The predominant global variant is XFG (49%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (29.26%) and LP.8.1 (10%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 愛爾蘭報告9例李斯特菌症含1例死亡,當局已下架逾200項即食商品
items.summary_en: Ireland reported 9 Listeria cases, including 1 death, and withdrew over 200 ready-to-eat supermarket products.
items.description_zh: 愛爾蘭於7/23報告9例病例,其中1例死亡,當局已下架逾200種超市即食商品,感染源仍調查中,另該國過去平均每年報告14-22例病例。
items.description_en: Ireland reported 9 cases as of 23 July, including 1 death. Authorities have withdrawn more than 200 ready-to-eat supermarket products, and the source of infection is still under investigation. The country has reported an average of 14–22 cases per year in past years.

items.summary_zh: 全球截至6月近30.6萬例霍亂、3,522例死亡,6月新增病例降21%
items.summary_en: WHO reports nearly 306,000 cholera cases and 3,522 deaths globally as of June, with June cases down 21%.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至6月累計報告近30.6萬例,3,522例死亡,其中,6月新增報告約6.2萬例、死亡527例,較5月下降21%,各國CFR介於0-8.1%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共28個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、葉門、阿富汗、及剛果民主共和國為多;目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存290萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that as of June this year, nearly 306,000 cases and 3,522 deaths have been reported globally. In June alone, about 62,000 new cases and 527 deaths were reported, a 21% decrease from May. Case fatality ratios range from 0 to 8.1% across countries. Cases were distributed across 28 countries and territories in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, with the most in South Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 2.9 million doses, below the safe threshold of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection, and WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.
