items.summary_zh: 香港腸病毒就診陽性率0.9‰,略降但高於去年同期,日本疫情上升
items.summary_en: Hong Kong's enterovirus clinic positivity rate reached 0.9‰, slightly lower than last week but above last year, while Japan's trend is rising.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第28-30週(7/6-26)疫情更新,香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為0.9‰,較前一周略降,惟高於去年同期;日本疫情呈上升趨勢,定醫平均病例數0.59,惟低於近3年同期。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 28–30 (6–26 July): Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.9‰, slightly lower than the previous week but higher than the same period last year. Japan's epidemic is on an upward trend, with an average of 0.59 cases per sentinel clinic, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years.

items.headline_zh: 中國/中歐-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 中歐A型肝炎今年逾2,000例、9例死亡,中國逾1.1萬例
items.summary_en: Central European hepatitis A cases exceed 2,000 with 9 deaths so far this year, and China has reported over 11,000 cases.
items.description_zh: 中歐國家疫情升高,今年截至6月累計報告逾2,000例,9例死亡,其中斯洛伐克880例、捷克600例、匈牙利530例、奧地利87例,德國3起個案與匈牙利病例基因序列一致,顯示疾病跨域傳播,惟未發現疫情蔓延。ECDC表示此波疫情流行主要為IB型之2個基因群組,影響包括遊民、吸毒者及居住不良衛生環境族群,評估大於40歲為高風險族群,呼籲加強疫苗接種及衛生措施。 中國今年截至6月累計報告逾1.1萬例病例,高於去年同期(7,500例)。
items.description_en: Hepatitis A is rising in Central European countries. As of June this year, more than 2,000 cases and 9 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Slovakia 880, Czech Republic 600, Hungary 530 and Austria 87. Three cases in Germany have genetic sequences identical to Hungarian cases, indicating cross-border transmission, although no wider spread has been detected. The ECDC says this wave is mainly caused by two genogroups of genotype IB, affecting homeless people, people who use drugs, and people living in poor sanitary conditions. People over 40 are assessed as high-risk, and the ECDC calls for stronger vaccination and hygiene measures. China has reported more than 11,000 cases as of June this year, higher than the 7,500 cases in the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 奧地利,中國大陸(不含港澳),捷克,德國,匈牙利,斯洛伐克

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳疫情嚴峻,近1週3,908例創2018年以來新高,今年逾5.2萬例
items.summary_en: Japan's pertussis surge continues, with 3,908 cases in one week, the highest weekly total since 2018, and over 52,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(7/14-20)通報3,908例,較前1週3,682例上升226例,單週新增病例數已連續5週創2018年以來新高,以東京都(310)為多,其次為琦玉縣(240)。今年迄今已逾5.2萬例,多地發現抗藥性菌株。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (14–20 July), 3,908 cases were reported, up 226 from 3,682 the previous week. Weekly new cases have been at the highest level since 2018 for five consecutive weeks. Tokyo Metropolis (310) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (240). So far this year, more than 52,000 cases have been reported, and drug-resistant strains have been found in several areas.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,今年累計14例,患者26歲男性入ICU
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a new H5N1 human case, a 26-year-old man in ICU, bringing its 2025 total to 14 cases.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西北部暹粒省26歲男性,出現發燒、咳嗽、喉嚨痛、腹痛及呼吸困難等症狀,目前仍於ICU治療中,據調查,病患住家附近有病死雞隻,且患者曾於發病前3日宰殺雞隻,該國今年累計報告14例,於近2個月報告11例,自2023年2月以來,已累計報告30例。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, in a 26-year-old man from Siem Reap Province in the northwest. He presented with fever, cough, sore throat, abdominal pain and difficulty breathing, and is still being treated in the ICU. The investigation found dead chickens near his home, and he had slaughtered chickens 3 days before his symptoms began. The country has reported 14 cases this year, 11 of them in the past two months. Since February 2023, 30 cases have been reported cumulatively.

items.summary_zh: 義大利西尼羅熱截至7月29日已致7例死亡,疫情延伸至中南部,預期8月達高峰
items.summary_en: Italy has reported 7 West Nile fever deaths as of 29 July, spreading to central and southern regions; a peak is expected in August.
items.description_zh: 義大利截至7/29已報告7例死亡,分布於拉吉歐、坎帕亞、皮埃蒙特等地,有別於以往疫情多分布於北部地區,今年疫情亦於該國中、南部地區發生,當局已採取病媒蚊防治及限制捐血等措施,預期於8月達疫情高峰。
items.description_en: As of 29 July, Italy has reported 7 deaths, in regions including Lazio, Campania and Piedmont. Unlike past seasons, when outbreaks were mainly in the north, this year's cases have also occurred in central and southern parts of the country. Authorities have implemented mosquito vector control and restrictions on blood donation, and a peak is expected in August.

items.summary_zh: 印尼峇里島珍布拉娜縣今年64例狂犬病,全國1-3月25例死亡
items.summary_en: Jembrana Regency in Bali has reported 64 rabies cases this year; nationally, 25 deaths were recorded in January–March.
items.description_zh: 印峇里島西部珍布拉娜縣(Jembrana Regency)今年截至7/7報告64例病例,當局已宣布南庫塔(South Kuta)、孟威區(Mengwi)為紅色警告地區,其中包含丹戎貝諾瓦(Tanjung Benoa)、努沙杜瓦(Nusa Dua)和金巴蘭灣(Jimbaran Bay)等熱門度假勝地,並啟動大規模犬隻疫苗接種作業,另提醒遊客及當地居民應遠離犬隻及猿猴,倘被抓咬傷,應立即就醫。該國今年1-3月,共通報13,453起咬傷事件及25例死亡。
items.description_en: In Jembrana Regency in western Bali, 64 cases have been reported so far this year, as of 7 July. Authorities have declared South Kuta and Mengwi as red-alert areas, including popular resorts such as Tanjung Benoa, Nusa Dua and Jimbaran Bay, and have launched large-scale dog vaccination. Residents and travelers are reminded to stay away from dogs and monkeys, and to seek medical care immediately if bitten or scratched. Nationally, 13,453 animal bite incidents and 25 deaths were reported in January–March this year.

items.summary_zh: 美國明尼蘇達州今年5例兔熱病,該州每年平均約6例
items.summary_en: Minnesota has reported 5 tularemia cases so far this year, while the state averages 6 cases annually.
items.description_zh: 美國明蘇達州今年迄今報告5例病例,病患分別於蜱蟲叮咬、流浪貓咬傷後,以及修剪草坪時感染,該州每年平均報告達6例,專家提醒民眾留意寵物是否有罹病情形及提供寵物避免被蜱蟲叮咬之防治措施。
items.description_en: Minnesota has reported 5 tularemia cases so far this year. Patients were infected after a tick bite, after a stray cat bite, and while mowing the lawn. The state reports an average of 6 cases per year. Experts remind the public to watch whether pets show signs of illness and to use tick-bite prevention measures for pets.

items.headline_zh: 甘比亞/幾內亞/獅子山-M痘
items.summary_zh: 甘比亞爆發M痘,幾內亞今年206例,獅子山逾4,700例含35例死亡
items.summary_en: The Gambia announced an Mpox outbreak in July; Guinea has 206 cases this year, and Sierra Leone over 4,700 cases with 35 deaths.
items.description_zh: 甘比亞宣布爆發疫情,7/22報告首例,病患為26歲女性,來自該國西部第1衛生區,18日確診,感染源及分支不明;鄰近該國之幾內亞於近期爆發疫情,幾內亞今年截至7/25已累計206例病例,新增1例死亡;獅子山疫情更新,今年截至7/13已累計逾4,700例病例,其中35例死亡。
items.description_en: The Gambia has announced an outbreak. The first case was reported on 22 July: a 26-year-old woman from the first health region in the western part of the country, diagnosed on 18 July. The source of infection and clade are unknown. Neighboring Guinea has also recently had an outbreak; as of 25 July this year, Guinea has cumulatively reported 206 cases, with 1 new death. Sierra Leone's update: as of 13 July this year, more than 4,700 cumulative cases have been reported, including 35 deaths.
items.area_zh: 幾內亞,甘比亞伊斯蘭共和國,獅子山

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 美國-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_en: United States – Naegleria fowleri infection (primary amoebic meningoencephalitis)
items.summary_zh: 美國南卡州12歲男童感染福氏內格里阿米巴致死
items.summary_en: A 12-year-old boy in South Carolina died of Naegleria fowleri infection contracted while swimming, the state's first such death since 2016.
items.description_zh: 美國南卡羅萊納州報告1例死亡病例,為12歲男童,病患於哥倫比亞市之默里湖水庫游泳後感染,於7/17死亡,為該州自2016年以來首例。該國於1962-2024年期間共報告167例,其中163例死亡(CFR:97.6%),每年報告約10例以下,當局建議在溫暖之淡水中進行游泳或活動時,應採取相關預防措施。
items.description_en: South Carolina reported one death, a 12-year-old boy who was infected after swimming in the Murray Lake reservoir in Columbia and died on 17 July. It is the state's first such death since 2016. From 1962 to 2024, the country reported 167 cases, 163 of which were fatal (CFR 97.6%), with about 10 or fewer cases reported per year. Authorities recommend precautions when swimming or engaging in other activities in warm freshwater.

items.headline_zh: 伊拉克-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 伊拉克今年累計231例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,30例死亡
items.summary_en: Iraq has reported 231 Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases and 30 deaths this year, most in Dhi Qar Province.
items.description_zh: 伊拉克疫情更新,今(2025)年迄今累計報告231例,其中30例死亡,以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)84例為多,其次為中部巴達省(Baghdad)38例,當局呼籲民眾於可信賴管道購買肉品、冷凍儲存肉品並於食用前高溫煮熟。該國最大疫情發生在2023年,報告逾587 例病例及83例死亡,主要影響南部省份。
items.description_en: Iraq's epidemic update: so far in 2025, 231 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 30 deaths. Dhi Qar Province in the south accounts for the most, with 84 cases, followed by Baghdad Province in central Iraq with 38 cases. Authorities urge people to buy meat from trusted sources, freeze meat for storage, and cook it thoroughly before eating. Iraq's largest outbreak occurred in 2023, with more than 587 cases and 83 deaths, mainly affecting southern provinces.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓1例狂犬病死亡,當局為116名接觸者接種暴露後疫苗
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported a rabies death, in a patient bitten by a dog in March; 116 close contacts received post-exposure vaccination.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓報告1例死亡病例,病患於今年3月曾被犬隻咬傷,於7月下旬於馬拉拘留中心出現嘔吐、意識模糊、肌肉痙攣及無法進食等症狀後轉至醫療中心,隔日死亡,當局已啟動疫情調查,及提供116名密切接觸者暴露後預防性疫苗接種。
items.description_en: The Philippines reported one death. The patient had been bitten by a dog in March this year. In late July, he developed vomiting, confusion, muscle spasms and inability to eat at a detention center in Manila, was transferred to a medical center, and died the following day. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and provided post-exposure vaccination to 116 close contacts.

items.summary_zh: 薩摩亞登革熱上升,近1週331例,累計1,276例、2例死亡
items.summary_en: Dengue cases in Samoa are rising, with 331 reported in the latest week and 1,276 cumulative cases including 2 deaths.
items.description_zh: 薩摩亞疫情上升,近1週(7/7-13)報告331例病例,累計1,276例病例及2例死亡,病例主要來自烏波盧島,以阿庇亞及烏波盧島西北部地區為多,10%病例住院治療,主要檢出型別為DENV-1。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Samoa. In the most recent week (7–13 July), 331 cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total to 1,276 cases and 2 deaths. Cases are mainly from Upolu Island, concentrated in Apia and the northwest of Upolu. 10% of cases were hospitalized, and the main serotype detected is DENV-1.

items.summary_zh: 廣東屈公病逾4,800例皆為輕症,近1週新增2,940例
items.summary_en: Guangdong has reported over 4,800 Chikungunya cases, all mild, with 2,940 new cases in the past week, mostly in Foshan.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省疫情嚴峻,截至7/26累計逾4,800例病例,均為輕症,尚無重症及死亡病例,近1週(7/20-26)新增2,940例,以佛山市最多(2,882例),其次為廣州市(22例)及中山市(18例),並於澳門等地出現移入病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, has a severe outbreak. As of 26 July, more than 4,800 cumulative cases have been reported, all mild, with no severe or fatal cases. In the past week (20–26 July), 2,940 new cases were reported, most of them in Foshan City (2,882), followed by Guangzhou (22) and Zhongshan (18). Imported cases have also appeared in areas including Macao.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),澳門特別行政區

items.headline_zh: 辛巴威/波札那/史瓦帝尼/納米比亞-瘧疾
items.summary_zh: 辛巴威今年瘧疾126,229例較去年升296.8%,358例死亡
items.summary_en: Zimbabwe has reported 126,229 malaria cases so far this year, up 296.8%, and 358 deaths, up 506.8%; neighbors are also rising.
items.description_zh: 辛巴威疫情上升,今年迄今累計126,229例病例,較去年同期31,813例上升296.8%,以該國東北部中馬紹納蘭省49,944例最多,其次為該國東部馬卡蘭省27,398例;今年迄今累計358例死亡(CFR 0.3%),較去年同期59例死亡上升506.8%。非洲南部之波札那、史瓦帝、納米比亞等國疫情亦上升。
items.description_en: Malaria is rising in Zimbabwe. So far this year, 126,229 cases have been reported, up 296.8% from 31,813 in the same period last year. Mashonaland Central Province in the northeast accounts for the most, with 49,944 cases, followed by Manicaland Province in the east with 27,398 cases. So far this year, 358 deaths have been reported (CFR 0.3%), up 506.8% from 59 deaths in the same period last year. Malaria has also increased in the southern African countries of Botswana, Eswatini and Namibia.
items.area_zh: 波札那共和國,史瓦帝尼王國,納米比亞,辛巴威

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓奎松市洪水後鉤端螺旋體病139例、21例死亡,較去年同期升36%
items.summary_en: Leptospirosis cases rose in Quezon City after flooding: 139 cases and 21 deaths this year, up 36% on the same period in 2024.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓馬拉都會區奎松市近期因洪水導致疫情上升,今年截至7/25累計報告139例病例,其中21例死亡(CFR:15%),較去年(2024)同期增加36%,病患多為男性(82%),年齡介於5-75歲,當局呼籲民眾倘於涉水後2-30天內出現相關症狀,應立即就醫,另提供doxycycline作為暴露後預防藥物;另馬拉市淹水地區近期亦報告4例死亡病例,13例確定病例,當局已提供逾31,000名居民預防性抗生素(doxycycline)。
items.description_en: Flooding has driven up cases in Quezon City, Metro Manila. As of 25 July this year, 139 cases have been reported, including 21 deaths (CFR 15%), a 36% increase over the same period in 2024. Most patients are male (82%), aged 5–75 years. Authorities urge anyone who develops symptoms 2–30 days after wading through floodwater to seek medical care immediately, and doxycycline is offered as post-exposure prophylaxis. In flooded areas of Manila, 4 deaths and 13 confirmed cases have also recently been reported, and authorities have provided preventive antibiotics (doxycycline) to more than 31,000 residents.

items.summary_zh: 中國佛山屈公病累計逾4,000例,已備妥7,220張防蚊隔離病床
items.summary_en: Foshan has reported over 4,000 Chikungunya cases since the first imported case on 8 July, and set up 7,220 mosquito-proof isolation beds.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東佛山市疫情更新,自7/8報告衍生此波疫情之首例境外移入病例以來,截至7/25累計報告逾4,000例病例,病患分佈以順德區為主,此次輸入病毒是印度洋流行株,特別容易被蚊媒傳播,且全國大多數地區,已進入蚊媒快速生長和擴散時期;當局已於佛山市整備53家醫院共7,220張防蚊隔離病床,要求病患進行住院隔離治療。
items.description_en: Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, has provided an update on its outbreak. Since the first imported case that gave rise to this wave was reported on 8 July, more than 4,000 cumulative cases have been reported as of 25 July, mainly in Shunde District. The imported virus is an Indian Ocean lineage, which is particularly easily transmitted by mosquitoes, and most areas of the country have entered a period of rapid mosquito growth and spread. Foshan has prepared 53 hospitals with a total of 7,220 mosquito-proof isolation beds, and patients are required to receive inpatient isolation treatment.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球禽流感週報:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1,三組織評估全球風險仍低
items.summary_en: This week Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 case; the FAO, WHO and WOAH assessment rates global public health risk as low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  7國於2025/7/19-25期間報告17起H5N1疫情,印度/柬埔寨各4 起、葡萄牙3起、巴西/美國各2起、英國/荷蘭各1起。 法國於2025/7/24報告1起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,077(2)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第29週計382個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感25例 (2003年迄今累計988*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計55國家/地區通報2,054起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5病毒風險評估,H5 2.3.4.4b仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week. Human cases: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): seven countries reported 17 H5N1 outbreaks between 19 and 25 July 2025, with India and Cambodia 4 each, Portugal 3, Brazil and the United States 2 each, and the United Kingdom and the Netherlands 1 each. France reported one H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 24 July 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,077 (2) herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated mainly in California. At least 9,600 human exposures to cattle have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including one cat death. Wastewater surveillance: week 29 testing reports were provided by 382 sampling sites, with H5-positive detections at 2 sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Oregon). Annual summary: Human cases: 25 H5N1 influenza cases (988* cumulative since 2003), 18 H9N2 influenza cases (146 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulative); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Following WHO counting, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 2,054 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively by 55 countries and territories. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH assessed H5 virus risk on 17 April. H5 2.3.4.4b remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domesticated animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For the general public, infection risk remains low; for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate, depending on the type and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率上升,歐洲16.7%創今年新高,美國連6週上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity is rising, with Europe at 16.7%, its highest this year, and US positivity up six weeks running.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第27週(6/30-7/6)全球陽性率4.19%,美洲、東地中海、東南亞區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情小幅度反彈,第29週(7/14-20)定醫門診陽性率14%,較第27週11.9%上升,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方,惟住院陽性率仍呈下降趨勢,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第29週陽性率2.3%,已連續9週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(88.1%),另XFG占1.7%。 美國疫情上升,第28週(7/6-12)陽性率4.8%,已連續6週上升,新增63例死亡,近期變異株以NB.1.8.1為主,其次為LP.8.1及XFG。 歐洲疫情上升,第28週(7/6-12)定醫門診陽性率16.7%,創今年新高,以變異株XFG占比最高(52%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、東地中海、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;XFG為全球主要流行變異株,其次為NB.1.8.1及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: Globally, the positivity rate in week 27 of 2025 (30 June–6 July) was 4.19%, with increases in the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. China: a slight rebound. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 29 (14–20 July) was 14%, up from 11.9% in week 27. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern ones, while hospital positivity continues to decline. The dominant variant is NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong: the epidemic is declining. Positivity in week 29 was 2.3%, down for 9 consecutive weeks, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also declined. Wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share (88.1%), with XFG at 1.7%. United States: the epidemic is rising. Positivity in week 28 (6–12 July) was 4.8%, up for 6 consecutive weeks, with 63 new deaths reported. The main variants are NB.1.8.1, followed by LP.8.1 and XFG. Europe: the epidemic is rising. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 28 (6–12 July) was 16.7%, the highest this year, with XFG the dominant variant (52%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with increases in the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. XFG is the main variant circulating globally, followed by NB.1.8.1 and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球新增cVDPV2病例9例,巴基斯坦環境樣本WPV1增41件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 9 new cVDPV2 polio cases in three countries, Yemen leading with 7, and 41 new WPV1 environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/10-16期間,cVDPV2新增3國共9例,分別為葉門7例、查德/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦41件,cVDPV2新增2國共7件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞6件、蘇丹1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 10 and 16 July, cVDPV2 cases increased by 9 across 3 countries: Yemen 7, and Chad and Nigeria 1 each. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 41 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 7 in 2 countries: 6 in Papua New Guinea and 1 in Sudan.

items.summary_zh: 波蘭北部西波美拉亞省1例霍亂,為2019年以來首例本土病例
items.summary_en: Poland reported a cholera case in West Pomeranian Province, its first locally acquired case since 2019, and quarantined 20 contacts.
items.description_zh: 波蘭北部西波美拉亞省(West Pomeranian)於7/20報告1例病例,病患為年長女性,為該國2019年以來之首例本土病例;當局已匡列20名接觸者進行隔離,疫情調查進行中。
items.description_en: West Pomeranian Province in northern Poland reported one case on 20 July, an elderly woman. It is the country's first locally acquired case since 2019. Authorities have identified 20 contacts and placed them in quarantine, and the outbreak investigation is ongoing.

items.summary_zh: 中國第27-29週腸病毒新增約10.5萬例,含43例重症
items.summary_en: China reported about 105,000 new enterovirus cases in weeks 27–29, including 43 severe, and Hong Kong's positivity hit a 2025 high.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第27-29週(6/29-7/19)疫情更新,中國疫情處高點,新增約10.5萬例病例,其中43例重症,新增病例數較前兩週高20%;香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為1.1‰,創今年新高,惟低於近2年同期;日本疫情呈上升趨勢,定醫平均病例數0.57,惟低於近3年同期。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 27–29 (29 June–19 July): China's epidemic has peaked, with about 105,000 new cases, including 43 severe cases; new cases were 20% higher than in the previous two weeks. Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 1.1‰, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Japan's epidemic is on an upward trend, with an average of 0.57 cases per sentinel clinic, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本

items.summary_zh: 美國佛州今年截至7/11創傷弧菌感染11例,4例死亡
items.summary_en: Florida has reported 11 Vibrio vulnificus cases and 4 deaths this year as of 11 July, a 36% case fatality rate.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州今年截至7/11累計報告11例病例,其中4例死亡(CFR: 36%),該州去年因受海倫/米爾頓颶風災情,報告82例病例,其中19例死亡(CFR: 23%);美國全國每年平均報告150至200例病例,因創傷弧菌需要於鹹水環境生存,當局呼籲民眾避免接觸汙水、海水及生食海鮮。
items.description_en: Florida has reported 11 cases so far this year as of 11 July, including 4 deaths (CFR 36%). Last year, the state reported 82 cases, including 19 deaths (CFR 23%), following damage from Hurricanes Helene and Milton. Nationally, the United States reports an average of 150 to 200 cases per year. Because Vibrio vulnificus needs a saltwater environment to survive, authorities urge people to avoid contact with sewage, seawater and raw seafood.

items.summary_zh: 佛山截至7/23累計3,195例屈公病,WHO 7/22緊急呼籲各國行動
items.summary_en: Foshan has reported 3,195 Chikungunya cases, all mild, as of 23 July; WHO urged countries to act urgently on 22 July.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省佛山市疫情遽升,自7/8報告衍生此波疫情之首例境外移入病例以來,截至7/23累計達3,195例病例,佛山市5個區均有病例,且皆為輕症,以順德區2,934例最多,其次為禪城區147例、南海區107例;廣東於2010年首次報告由境外移入病例引起本土傳播後,於部分地區曾發生較小規模疫情,惟未曾發生大規模疫情。澳門截至7/22累計2例病例且均有佛山市旅居史。估計全球有119個國家共56億人生活在面臨該病毒風險之地區,世界衛生組織已於7月22日緊急呼籲各國應採取行動。
items.description_en: Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, has seen a sharp rise in cases. Since the first imported case that gave rise to this wave was reported on 8 July, 3,195 cumulative cases had been reported as of 23 July. All five districts of Foshan have cases, all mild, with Shunde District the most at 2,934, followed by Chancheng District with 147 and Nanhai District with 107. Guangdong first reported local transmission from an imported case in 2010 and has had smaller outbreaks in some areas since, but no large-scale outbreak. Macao had 2 cumulative cases as of 22 July, both with a history of travel to Foshan. An estimated 5.6 billion people in 119 countries live in areas at risk from this virus, and WHO issued an urgent call on 22 July for countries to take action.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲今年截至6月約21萬例流感,1-5月較去年高30%,住院增50%
items.summary_en: Australia has recorded about 210,000 influenza cases this year to June, 30% above last year for January–May, with hospitalizations up 50%.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞今年截至6月累計報告約21萬例病例,其中,1-5月病例數高於去年同期30%,近期住院人數增加50%,該國全體流感疫苗覆蓋率低於30%,65歲以上疫苗覆蓋率達59%。
items.description_en: Australia has reported about 210,000 cases cumulatively so far this year as of June. Cases from January to May were 30% higher than the same period last year, and recent hospitalizations have risen by 50%. Nationwide influenza vaccination coverage is below 30%, while coverage among people aged 65 and over is 59%.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳近1週3,682例,創2018年以來新高,今年逾4.8萬例
items.summary_en: Japan's pertussis cases reached 3,682 in one week, the highest weekly total since 2018, with over 48,000 cases so far this year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(7/7-13)新增3,682例,較前1週通報上升104例,單週新增病例數為2018年以來新高,病患分布以東京都及琦玉縣為多;該國今年迄今累積報告逾4.8萬例。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic remains severe. In the most recent week (7–13 July), 3,682 cases were reported, an increase of 104 over the previous week. Weekly new cases are at the highest level since 2018, with patients concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis and Saitama Prefecture. Japan has reported more than 48,000 cases so far this year.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大今年3,977例麻疹,美國1,309例超過2019年全年,創消除麻疹後新高
items.summary_en: Canada reported 3,977 measles cases this year, and US cases (1,309) already exceed all of 2019, the highest since elimination was declared.
items.description_zh: 加拿大今年截至7/21共10省報告3,977例,病患有86%未接種疫苗,年齡以5-17歲為多,主要分布於安大略省及亞伯達省;該國今年病例數排名全球第9名,另病例數前3名為葉門、巴基斯坦及印度。 美國今年截至7/15共40州報告1,309例,已報告29起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有34%病例為20歲以上,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明。
items.description_en: Canada has reported 3,977 cases in 10 provinces as of 21 July this year. 86% of patients were unvaccinated, most were aged 5–17 years, and cases are mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Canada ranks 9th globally by case count this year; the top three countries by case count are Yemen, Pakistan and India. The United States has reported 1,309 cases in 40 states as of 15 July this year, with 29 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. 34% of cases are aged 20 and over, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1,6歲男童重症入ICU,今年累計13例
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a new H5N1 case, a 6-year-old boy in intensive care, bringing its total this year to 13 cases.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國東部特本克蒙(Tbong Khmum)省6歲男童,病患出現發燒、咳嗽、腹瀉、嘔吐及呼吸困難等症狀,於ICU治療中;據調查,病患居住之地區於7月曾出現病死雞,並攜帶死雞回家烹煮,當局已啟動疫情調查、居民衛教宣導及接觸者防治等措施,另提醒民眾倘出現呼吸道症狀,且14天內曾接觸過生病禽鳥,應避免前往人潮密集之場所,並立即就醫;該國今年迄今累計報告13例。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, in a 6-year-old boy from Tbong Khmum Province in the east. He presented with fever, cough, diarrhea, vomiting and difficulty breathing, and is being treated in the ICU. The investigation found that dead chickens had been reported in the area in July, and the patient had brought dead chickens home to cook. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation, resident health education and contact prophylaxis measures. The public has been reminded that anyone with respiratory symptoms who has had contact with sick birds within the past 14 days should avoid crowded places and seek medical care immediately. The country has reported 13 cases so far this year.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲昆士蘭今年233例類鼻疽含35例死亡,泰國1,676例含72例死亡
items.summary_en: Queensland, Australia, reported 233 melioidosis cases and 35 deaths this year, over triple last year's level; Thailand reported 1,676 cases and 72 deaths.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州今年截至7/20累計報告233例,其中35例死亡,病例數為去(2024)年同期3倍以上,病例多集中於凱恩斯及湯斯維爾區,專家推測疫情與降雨量高於平均及高速公路工程之環境影響相關。 泰國今年截至7/9累計報告1,676例,其中72例死亡,病患主要分布於東北地區,年齡以60歲以上族群為多,當局提醒民眾食用熟食及避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後清洗身體,另呼籲農民及糖尿病患者,應留意自身感染風險。
items.description_en: Queensland, Australia, has reported 233 cases so far this year as of 20 July, including 35 deaths. This is more than three times the number in the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Cairns and Townsville areas. Experts suspect the outbreak is linked to above-average rainfall and the environmental impact of highway construction. Thailand has reported 1,676 cases so far this year as of 9 July, including 72 deaths. Cases are mainly in the northeast, and most patients are aged over 60. Authorities advise people to eat well-cooked food, avoid wading or entering muddy areas, wear protective gear such as boots and gloves where appropriate, and wash the body after exposure. Farmers and people with diabetes are also urged to be aware of their risk of infection.

items.summary_zh: 莫三比克M痘累計13例,馬拉威確診59例但迄無死亡
items.summary_en: Mozambique has reported 13 Mpox cases and Malawi 59 confirmed cases, with no deaths recorded in Malawi.
items.description_zh: 莫三比克7/11報告今年首起3例病例,其後截至20日累計發現報告13例病例、36例疑病例,集中於該國北部亞薩省,首3例病例皆由與該省鄰近之馬拉威移入,該區因鄰近坦尚亞及馬拉威等疫區,造成跨境風險增加,當局已採取相關邊境防疫措施。另該國前次報告疫情為2022年。 馬拉威自4月爆發疫情,截至7/19累計59例確診病例,逾200例疑病例,迄無死亡案例,多集中於該國首都里朗威,匡列逾600名接觸者,其中僅餘6例刻正隔離中,當局已針對疫情加強人員培訓、疫情監測及邊境檢疫等措施。
items.description_en: Mozambique reported its first 3 cases on 11 July. As of 20 July, it had reported 13 cases cumulatively and 36 suspected cases, concentrated in Niassa Province in the north. The first 3 cases were all imported from neighboring Malawi. Because the area borders outbreak zones including Tanzania and Malawi, cross-border risk has increased, and authorities have implemented related border health measures. Mozambique's previous reported outbreak was in 2022. Malawi's outbreak began in April. As of 19 July, 59 confirmed cases and more than 200 suspected cases had been reported, with no deaths. Cases are concentrated in the capital, Lilongwe. More than 600 contacts have been identified, and only 6 of them remain in quarantine. Authorities have strengthened staff training, outbreak surveillance and border quarantine.

items.headline_zh: 羅馬尼亞/巴基斯坦-狂犬病
items.summary_zh: 羅馬尼亞1例狂犬病死亡,巴基斯坦農民遭感染牛咬傷後未發病
items.summary_en: Romania reported a rabies death in an unvaccinated man bitten by a dog, and Pakistan a farmer bitten by an infected cow who did not fall ill.
items.description_zh: 羅馬亞報告1例死亡病例,為44歲男性,病患於今年2月底曾被犬隻咬傷,就醫僅接受抗生素治療,未接種疫苗,於6月中旬發病,住院3週後死亡,該國前次疫情為2012年1例12歲女童死亡病例。 巴基斯坦報告1例病例,為18歲農民,於2024年被受感染之牛隻咬傷,於當日就醫注射狂犬病疫苗,該傷人牛隻於咬傷人後3週死亡,該農民因接受預防措施,未發生疾病。據查牛隻係被流浪狗咬傷且腦部組織經檢測陽性,專家提醒該國發生牲畜傳染至人類情形,建議加強動物監測、狂犬病疫苗接種及儲備作業。
items.description_en: Romania reported one death, a 44-year-old man bitten by a dog in late February this year. He sought care but received only antibiotic treatment and had not been vaccinated. He fell ill in mid-June and died after three weeks in hospital. The country's previous outbreak was in 2012, when a 12-year-old girl died. Pakistan reported one case, an 18-year-old farmer bitten in 2024 by an infected cow. He received rabies vaccine on the day of the bite. The cow died three weeks after biting him, and because he received preventive measures, he did not fall ill. Investigation found that the cow had been bitten by a stray dog, and its brain tissue tested positive. Experts remind that transmission from livestock to humans has occurred in the country, and recommend strengthened animal surveillance, rabies vaccination and stockpiling.

items.summary_zh: 印度阿薩姆邦今年日本腦炎32例住院、5例死亡,當局發布警報
items.summary_en: Assam State, India, has hospitalized 32 Japanese encephalitis cases this year, 5 of whom died, and authorities issued an alert.
items.description_zh: 印度阿薩姆邦疫情上升,今年迄今已有32例病例入院治療及5例死亡(4名兒童及1名長者),病例主要分布於卡姆魯布縣(12例)、訥爾巴里(8例)及達讓縣(5例),自4月病例數開始上升,死亡病例多發生於6月,當局已對於該邦疫情發布警報。
items.description_en: Assam State in India has seen rising cases. So far this year, 32 cases have been hospitalized and 5 deaths reported (4 children and 1 elderly person). Cases are mainly in Kamrup district (12), Nalbari (8) and Darrang (5). Case numbers have risen since April, and most deaths occurred in June. Authorities have issued an alert for the outbreak in the state.

items.summary_zh: 模里西斯今年屈公病累計1,540例、無死亡,7/4迄今新增100例
items.summary_en: Mauritius has reported 1,540 Chikungunya cases this year with no deaths, including 100 cases since 4 July.
items.description_zh: 模里西斯共和國自7/4迄今報告100例病例,於6/22-28報告90例病例,今年迄今累計1,540例病例,無死亡病例,約四分之一病例年齡介於20-39歲,該國於2009年曾爆發疫情,累計逾12,000例病例。
items.description_en: The Republic of Mauritius has reported 100 cases since 4 July, after 90 cases in the period 22–28 June. Cumulatively this year, 1,540 cases have been reported, with no deaths. About one quarter of cases are aged 20–39 years. The country had an outbreak in 2009 with more than 12,000 cumulative cases.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年登革熱32,189例、5例死亡,低於去年同期,上升風險極高
items.summary_en: Vietnam has reported 32,189 dengue cases and 5 deaths this year, below the same period last year, but the risk of a rise is very high.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市、檳椥、西寧、隆安及同奈省等地疫情上升,該國今年迄今累計32,189例病例及5例死亡,病例數及死亡數均較去年同期為低(36,276例病例及6例死亡),惟目前氣候有利蚊子生長,評估疫情上升風險非常高;該國每年平均報告約10萬例病例及100例死亡,病例主要分布於南部地區,惟近幾年北部及中部等地之病例數亦逐漸增加,尤其於6-11月期間疫情較為嚴峻。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City and in Binh Duong, Tay Ninh, Long An and Dong Nai provinces. So far this year, Vietnam has reported 32,189 cases and 5 deaths, lower than the same period last year (36,276 cases and 6 deaths). However, current weather favors mosquito growth, and the risk of a rise is assessed as very high. Vietnam reports an average of about 100,000 cases and 100 deaths per year. Cases are mainly in the south, but case numbers have gradually increased in the north and central regions in recent years, especially during June–November, when outbreaks are more severe.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲昆士蘭州7/19報告第2例I型M痘,為中非移入,社區傳播風險低
items.summary_en: Queensland reported Australia's second Clade I Mpox case on 19 July, imported from Central Africa; community transmission risk is low.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州7/19報告該國第2例I型病例,為自中非境外移入病例,已入院隔離中,當局已匡列19名社區接觸者及40名醫護人員,評估社區傳播風險為低。
items.description_en: Queensland, Australia, reported the country's second Clade I case on 19 July. The patient is an imported case from Central Africa and has been admitted to hospital for isolation. Authorities have identified 19 community contacts and 40 health workers. The risk of community transmission is assessed as low.

items.summary_zh: 法國本土屈公病30例、移入799例;佛山1,199例,澳門今年首例
items.summary_en: France has 30 locally acquired and 799 imported Chikungunya cases; Foshan has 1,199 cases, and Macao reported its first case of the year.
items.description_zh: 法國疫情更新,今年截至7/16本土病例累計30例,境外移入病例累計799例,當局表示過去疫情集中於南部地區,現已傳播至原本無疫情地區,包括東北部之大東部大區(Grand Est)以及西南部之新阿基坦大區(Nouvelle-Aquitaine),另警告本土傳播風險仍高,預期病例數持續上升。 中國廣東省佛山市自7/8報告首例境外移入後,截至7/19已累計1,199例病例,均為輕症病例,分布於佛山市順德區、南海區及禪城區。澳門7/18報告該地區今年首例,病患為61歲男性澳門居民,7/8-17前往佛山市順德區探親,17日早上出現發燒、頭痛及全身肌肉關節痛症狀,18日確診,已住院治療,同居者迄無症狀。
items.description_en: France has updated its situation. As of 16 July this year, 30 locally acquired cases and 799 imported cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities said past outbreaks were concentrated in the south but have now spread to areas that previously had no cases, including the Grand Est region in the northeast and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in the southwest. They warn that the risk of local transmission remains high and that case numbers are expected to keep rising. In Foshan City, Guangdong Province, China, 1,199 cumulative cases had been reported as of 19 July since the first imported case was reported on 8 July. All were mild and distributed across Shunde, Nanhai and Chancheng districts. Macao reported its first case of the year on 18 July: a 61-year-old male resident who visited relatives in Shunde District, Foshan, from 8 to 17 July. He developed fever, headache and generalized muscle and joint pain on the morning of 17 July, was diagnosed on 18 July, and has been hospitalized. His household contacts have shown no symptoms so far.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),法國,澳門特別行政區

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球禽流感週報:印度新增1例H5N1,中國2例H9N2,全球風險仍低
items.summary_en: Weekly global avian influenza update: India reported one new H5N1 human case and China two H9N2 cases; global risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:印度新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例、中國報告 2 例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):WAHIS  共8國於 2025/7/15-18 期間報告19起H5N1疫情,巴西/愛爾蘭/英國/葡萄牙/西班牙各3起、加拿大2起、捷克/柬埔寨各1起。 共2國於2025/7/16-17期間報告2起H5(N untyped)疫情,俄羅斯/阿根廷各1起。 加拿大於2025/7/16新增2起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,075(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第28週計397個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、維吉亞州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感24例 (2003年迄今累計987*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計55國家/地區通報2,039起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5病毒風險評估,H5 2.3.4.4b仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week. Human cases: India reported one new human H5N1 infection, and China reported two human H9N2 infections. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): eight countries reported 19 H5N1 outbreaks between 15 and 18 July 2025, with Brazil, Ireland, the United Kingdom, Portugal and Spain 3 each, Canada 2, and the Czech Republic and Cambodia 1 each. Two countries reported 2 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 16 and 17 July 2025, with Russia and Argentina 1 each. Canada reported 2 H5N5 outbreaks on 16 July 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,075 (0) herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in California and Arizona. At least 9,600 cattle-exposed humans have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: week 28 testing reports were provided by 397 sampling sites, with H5-positive detections at 2 sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Virginia). Annual summary: Human cases: 24 H5N1 influenza cases (987* cumulative since 2003), 18 H9N2 influenza cases (146 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulative); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Following WHO counting, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 2,039 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively by 55 countries and territories. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH assessed H5 virus risk on 17 April. H5 2.3.4.4b remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domesticated animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For the general public, infection risk remains low; for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate, depending on the type and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率4.03%,韓國陽性率13%為第21週來最高
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity reached 4.03% in week 26, while South Korea's positivity rose to 13%, its highest since week 21.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第26週(6/23-29)全球陽性率4.03%,除西太平洋及東南亞以外,其它區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情呈下降趨勢,第27週(6/30-7/6)定醫門診陽性率11.9%,已連續6週下降,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方,以變異株NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第28週(7/6-10)陽性率2.53%,已連續8週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情上升,第28週住院病例100例,為第23週以來次高,陽性率達13%,為第21週以來最高,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 歐洲疫情緩慢上升,第26週定醫門診陽性率13.1%,為第9週以來最高,以變異株XFG占比最高,其次為LP.8.1。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,除西太平洋及東南亞以外,其他區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(39%),其次為NB.1.8.1(36%)、LP.8.1(11%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 26 of 2025 (23–29 June), global positivity was 4.03%, with increases in all regions except the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. China: the epidemic is declining. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 27 (30 June–6 July) was 11.9%, down for 6 consecutive weeks. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern ones, and the main variant is NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong: the epidemic is declining. Positivity in week 28 (6–10 July) was 2.53%, down for 8 consecutive weeks, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also declined. Wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share. South Korea: the epidemic is rising. There were 100 hospitalized cases in week 28, the second highest since week 23, and positivity reached 13%, the highest since week 21, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the largest share. Europe: the epidemic is rising slowly. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 26 was 13.1%, the highest since week 9, with XFG the largest share, followed by LP.8.1. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with increases in regions other than the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. Globally, XFG is the most prevalent variant (39%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (36%) and LP.8.1 (11%). WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增WPV1病例1例,環境樣本WPV1與cVDPV2各增4件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new WPV1 polio case in Pakistan for 3–9 July, plus four new WPV1 and four cVDPV2 environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/3-9期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共4件,分別為阿富汗3件、巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增2國共4件,分別為阿爾及利亞3件、奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 July, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 4 samples in 2 countries: 3 in Afghanistan and 1 in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by 4 samples in 2 countries: 3 in Algeria and 1 in Nigeria.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),巴基斯坦

items.summary_zh: WHO:南蘇丹第25週新增673例霍亂、4例死亡,風險仍高
items.summary_en: WHO reports 673 new cholera cases and 4 deaths in South Sudan in week 25, with children under 5 accounting for 25%.
items.description_zh: WHO更新非洲25國疫情,其中,南蘇丹第25週(6/16-22)新增673例病例,其中4例死亡,病患以5歲以下兒童為多(25%),WHO評估疫情風險仍高,雖口服疫苗接種計畫持續進行,惟戰亂衝突導致衛生環境不佳、延遲就醫及高死亡率。
items.description_en: WHO has updated the situation in 25 African countries. In South Sudan, 673 new cases were reported in week 25 (16–22 June), including 4 deaths. Children under 5 accounted for 25% of cases. WHO assesses the risk as still high. Although oral vaccination campaigns continue, conflict has led to poor sanitation, delayed care and high mortality.

items.summary_zh: 香港腸病毒就診陽性率0.8‰為今年最高,新加坡疫情處低點
items.summary_en: Hong Kong's enterovirus clinic positivity rose to 0.8‰, this year's highest, while Singapore's epidemic is at a low point.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第26-28週(6/22-7/12)疫情更新,香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為0.8‰,為今年最高;日本疫情呈上升趨勢,定醫平均病例數0.52,惟低於近3年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,每日平均病例數為25例。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 26–28 (22 June–12 July): Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.8‰, the highest this year. Japan's epidemic is on an upward trend, with an average of 0.52 cases per sentinel clinic, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. Singapore's epidemic is at a low point, with an average of 25 cases per day.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,新加坡

items.headline_zh: 巴西-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 巴西聖保羅市今年A型肝炎974例,較去年增90%,疫苗涵蓋率降9.7%
items.summary_en: São Paulo city has reported 974 hepatitis A cases this year as of 8 July, 90% more than last year, with vaccination coverage down 9.7%.
items.description_zh: 巴西聖保羅市今年截至7/8累計報告974例病例,較去年增加90%,發生率為每10萬人口2.19,病患以20-39歲男性為主;當局表示疫苗涵蓋率較去年減少9.7%,另該國2017-18年於里約熱內盧的疫情,有超過半數為MSM族群,且與重大賽事有關。
items.description_en: São Paulo city, Brazil, has reported 974 cases so far this year as of 8 July, 90% more than last year. The incidence is 2.19 per 100,000 population, and most patients are men aged 20–39. Authorities say vaccination coverage has decreased by 9.7% compared with last year. In addition, the country's 2017–18 outbreak in Rio de Janeiro involved more than half MSM and was linked to major sporting events.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦1例H1N1v流感,中學生,同班另3人出現症狀
items.summary_en: India reported one H1N1v influenza case in a Kerala secondary school student; three classmates also developed symptoms and test results are pending.
items.description_zh: 印度報告1例H1N1v流感人類感染病例,為喀拉拉邦一名中學生,於7/13出現症狀,同班級之另3名同學亦出現症狀,目前接受治療中,檢驗結果尚待公布。
items.description_en: India has reported one human H1N1v influenza infection, in a secondary school student in Kerala State. Symptoms began on 13 July, and three other students in the same class also developed symptoms. They are currently receiving treatment, and test results have not yet been announced.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳近1週3,578例,今年逾4.3萬例、4例嬰幼兒死亡
items.summary_en: Japan reported 3,578 pertussis cases in one week, the highest since 2018, with over 43,000 cases and 4 infant deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/30-7/6)通報3,578例,較前1週3,353例上升225例,單週新增病例數為2018年以來新高,以東京都(277)為多,其次為琦玉縣(254)。今年迄今已逾4.3萬例,並報告4例嬰幼兒死亡案例,另多地發現抗藥性菌株。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic remains severe. In the most recent week (30 June–6 July), 3,578 cases were reported, an increase of 225 over the previous week's 3,353. Weekly new cases are at the highest level since 2018, with Tokyo Metropolis (277) reporting the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (254). So far this year, more than 43,000 cases have been reported, and 4 deaths among infants and young children have been reported. Drug-resistant strains have also been found in several areas.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大/美國/韓國/越南/烏茲別克/義大利/泰國/蒙古/英國-麻疹
items.headline_en: Canada / United States / South Korea / Viet Nam / Uzbekistan / Italy / Thailand / Mongolia / United Kingdom – Measles
items.summary_zh: 加拿大3,822例、美國1,288例麻疹,韓國65例全為境外移入相關
items.summary_en: Canada has 3,822 measles cases and the US 1,288, with US cases already above all of 2019; South Korea's 65 cases are all import-linked.
items.description_zh: 加拿大今年截至7/5共10省報告3,822例,其中以安大略省及亞伯達省為多,亞伯達省病例數上升,截至7/14報告逾1,200例,當地疫情嚴峻,該省已針對南部及北部部分地區發布警報,由於夏季大型集會增加及學校即將開學,預期疫情風險將持續。 美國今年迄今共39州報告1,288例,已報告27起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有近1/3病例為20歲以上成人,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明,自德州於今年1月發生大規模疫情後,已有多個州爆發小規模疫情,同時有大量境外移入個案。 韓國今年截至7/5累計報告65例,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關個案,感染地以越南(42例)為多,餘有烏茲別克、義大利、泰國及蒙古等國,病患多為19歲以上成年人。 英國利物浦報告1例兒童死亡案例,為英蘭地區近5年來第2例死亡,前1例為2023年大曼徹斯特10歲女童,英蘭地區今年迄今報告529例,以倫敦都會區為多,該地區去年報告2,900餘例,為2012年以來新高。
items.description_en: Canada has reported 3,822 cases in 10 provinces as of 5 July this year, mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Alberta's case count has risen, with more than 1,200 cases reported as of 14 July. The epidemic there is severe, and the province has issued alerts for parts of the south and north. Because of increased large summer gatherings and the imminent start of school, the risk is expected to continue. The United States has reported 1,288 cases in 39 states so far this year, with 27 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. Nearly one third of cases are adults aged over 20, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Since a large outbreak in Texas in January this year, several states have experienced small outbreaks, alongside many imported cases. South Korea reported 65 cases as of 5 July this year, all imported or linked to imported cases. Most were from Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from Uzbekistan, Italy, Thailand and Mongolia, and most patients were adults aged 19 and over. In Liverpool, United Kingdom, one child died; this is the second death in England in five years, the previous being a 10-year-old girl in Greater Manchester in 2023. England has reported 529 cases so far this year, mainly in Greater London. England reported more than 2,900 cases last year, the highest since 2012.
