items.headline_zh: 印度/孟加拉-新型A型流感
items.summary_zh: 印度通報1例孟加拉庫爾納H5N1病例,患者死亡,病毒屬2.3.2.1a分支
items.summary_en: India reported an H5N1 case from Khulna, Bangladesh, in a patient who later died; the virus belongs to clade 2.3.2.1a.
items.description_zh: WHO公布印度報告1例來自孟加拉西部庫爾納專區之H5N1病例,該病患於5月採集檢體,其後死亡,流行病學及接觸史皆不明,據報告該病毒屬2.3.2.1a分支,於孟加拉及印度之鳥類和家禽中傳播。該國於今年4月報告1例2歲女童病例,該病患因感染死亡。
items.description_en: WHO reported that India had identified one H5N1 case from Khulna Division in western Bangladesh. The specimen was collected in May, and the patient later died. Epidemiological and exposure history is unknown. The virus belongs to clade 2.3.2.1a and is circulating among birds and poultry in Bangladesh and India. Bangladesh reported a case in a 2-year-old girl in April this year, who died from the infection.

items.summary_zh: 廣東佛山順德區截至7/15累計478例屈公病,皆為輕症
items.summary_en: Shunde District in Foshan, Guangdong, reported 478 Chikungunya cases as of 15 July, all mild, after an outbreak began on 8 July.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省佛山市順德區7/8爆發疫情,係因境外移入衍生此波疫情,截至7/15累計478例病例,均為輕症,主要分布於樂從鎮、北滘鎮及陳村鎮,當局表示目前已進入高溫多雨季節,為蚊媒傳染病流行期,應加強相關疾病防治措施。
items.description_en: Shunde District in Foshan City, Guangdong Province, China, had an outbreak beginning on 8 July, triggered by an imported case. As of 15 July, 478 cumulative cases have been reported, all mild, mainly in Lecong, Beijiao and Chencun towns. Authorities said the season is now hot and rainy, a period of mosquito-borne disease transmission, and that prevention and control measures should be strengthened.

items.summary_zh: 中國9例Ib型M痘,幾內亞今年112例、1例死亡,跨境風險上升
items.summary_en: China reported 9 new clade Ib Mpox cases, Guinea 112 confirmed cases including 1 death this year, and Turkey a retrospective Ia case.
items.description_zh: 中國自6月底截至7月7日新增9例Ib型病例,其中4例為前已掌握之家庭群聚感染事件,為2例無症狀兒童及2例具接觸史及症狀之成人;另3例與國際旅遊者具流病關聯,其中1例具確診病例之性接觸史;1例為無旅遊史,但與未確診但具症狀者有接觸史,具體細節仍在調查中。該國自去年12月截至今年7月初已累計23例Ib型病例,由於該國調查未明,傳播風險判定為未知。 幾內亞疫情上升,7月初單週報告約50例病例,今年截至7/10累計112例確診病例,其中1例死亡,病例為IIb型,分布於該國首都柯那克里與其周邊區域,指標病例具獅子山旅遊史,因該國南接之獅子山及賴比瑞亞皆有疫情,跨境風險增加,當局加強監測與邊境管制措施。 土耳其回溯報告2024年10月1例Ia型病例,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,並無二次傳播。
items.description_en: China reported 9 new clade Ib cases from the end of June to 7 July. Four were from household cluster infections already identified: two asymptomatic children and two adults with contact history and symptoms. Three were linked to international travelers, one of whom had sexual contact with a confirmed case. One had no travel history but had contact with an unconfirmed person who had symptoms. Details are under investigation. From last December to early July this year, China has reported 23 cumulative clade Ib cases. Because the investigation is incomplete, transmission risk is classified as unknown. Guinea's outbreak is rising: about 50 cases were reported in the first week of July, and 112 confirmed cases have been reported this year as of 10 July, including 1 death. The cases are clade IIb, distributed in the capital, Conakry, and surrounding areas. The index case had travel history to Sierra Leone. Sierra Leone and Liberia, to Guinea's south, both have outbreaks, so cross-border risk has increased, and authorities have strengthened surveillance and border controls. Turkey retrospectively reported one clade Ia case in October 2024, with travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and no secondary transmission.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),幾內亞,土耳其

items.summary_zh: 幾內亞南部恩澤雷科雷區今年截至6/1報告拉薩熱2例,1例死亡
items.summary_en: Guinea's Nzérékoré region reported 2 Lassa fever cases as of 1 June this year, one fatal, and contact tracing is underway.
items.description_zh: 幾內亞南部恩澤雷科雷區今年截至6/1報告2例,其中1例死亡,相關疫情調查及接觸者追蹤作業進行中。
items.description_en: In the Nzérékoré region of southern Guinea, 2 cases had been reported as of 1 June this year, one of which was fatal. Investigation and contact tracing are ongoing.

items.headline_zh: 西班牙-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 西班牙薩拉曼卡省1例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,病況穩定,該省今年2例
items.summary_en: Salamanca Province in Spain reported a Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever case in a stable 63-year-old man; the province has 2 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 西班牙西部薩拉曼卡省(Salamanca)報告1例病例,為63歲男性,目前入院隔離治療,病況穩定,病患曾被蜱蟲叮咬,當局已啟動接觸者監測,該省今年累計報告2例。
items.description_en: Salamanca Province in western Spain has reported one case, a 63-year-old man who is hospitalized in isolation with stable condition. The patient had been bitten by a tick. Authorities have launched contact monitoring. The province has reported 2 cases so far this year.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至7/7狂犬病7例死亡,為去年同期3倍,9成感染源為犬
items.summary_en: Thailand has recorded 7 rabies deaths so far this year as of 7 July, triple last year's same-period figure; 90% of cases involved dogs.
items.description_zh: 泰國疫情更新,今年截至7/7累計7例死亡病例,為去年同期3倍,90%病患感染來源為犬隻,10%為貓隻,當局呼籲民眾倘被犬貓抓咬傷,應立即就診並接種狂犬病疫苗,另飼主應定期為犬貓完整接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Thailand's epidemic update: as of 7 July this year, 7 rabies deaths have been reported cumulatively, three times the same period last year. 90% of patients were infected by dogs and 10% by cats. Authorities urge anyone bitten or scratched by a dog or cat to seek medical care immediately and receive rabies vaccination. Pet owners should ensure dogs and cats are fully vaccinated on a regular schedule.

items.summary_zh: 義大利北部皮亞琴察省1例疑似本土屈公病,為當地首例
items.summary_en: Piacenza Province in Italy reported a suspected local Chikungunya case in a man over 65, the area's first; mosquito control has begun.
items.description_zh: 義大利北部皮亞琴察省報告1例疑本土病例,個案為65歲以上男性,出現發燒、肌肉疼痛、關節疼痛、結膜炎等症狀,近期無流行地區旅遊史,為當地首次報告病例。當局已展開清除病媒蚊等防治措施。
items.description_en: Piacenza Province in northern Italy has reported one suspected locally acquired case, a man over 65 years old with fever, muscle pain, joint pain and conjunctivitis. He had no recent travel history to epidemic areas. This is the first case reported locally in the area. Authorities have begun vector mosquito control and other prevention measures.

items.summary_zh: 納米比亞瘧疾累計89,959例、146例死亡,韓國今年259例
items.summary_en: Namibia has recorded 89,959 malaria cases and 146 deaths since late last year, while South Korea reports 259 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 納米比亞疫情上升,近1週(6/2-8)報告2,475例病例,較前1週增加5%,自去年底迄今累計89,959例病例及146例死亡,以東北部卡蒂馬穆利洛(23,959例病例及19例死亡)疫情較為嚴峻。 韓國疫情更新,今年截至7/14累計259例病例,其中21例為境外移入,低於去年同期(318例),病例主要分布於京畿道。
items.description_en: Malaria is rising in Namibia. In the most recent week (2–8 June), 2,475 cases were reported, up 5% from the previous week. Since late last year, 89,959 cumulative cases and 146 deaths have been reported. The northeastern Katima Mulilo area has the most severe situation, with 23,959 cases and 19 deaths. South Korea's update: as of 14 July this year, 259 cumulative cases have been reported, including 21 imported cases. This is lower than the 318 cases in the same period last year, and cases are mainly in Gyeonggi Province.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年登革熱逾14,000例、54例死亡;巴拿馬6,458例含10例死亡
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has recorded over 14,000 dengue cases and 54 deaths this year, while Panama reported 6,458 cases and 10 deaths by week 25.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,於7/1-11期間報告3,773例病例,今年迄今累計14,000餘例病例及54例死亡,病例數以南部巴里薩爾專區近6,000例最多,其次為吉大港2,000例;該國去年累計101,130例病例及573例死亡,2023年累計321,179例病例及1,705例死亡。 巴拿馬疫情上升,今年截至第25週(6/15-21)累計6,458例病例,其中55例為重症,10例死亡,病例主要發生於10-59歲族群,主要流行型別為DENV-3及DENV-4,造成重症及死亡數增加。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Bangladesh. Between 1 and 11 July, 3,773 cases were reported. So far this year, more than 14,000 cumulative cases and 54 deaths have been reported. Most cases are in the southern Barisal division, with nearly 6,000, followed by Chattogram with 2,000. Last year the country reported 101,130 cumulative cases and 573 deaths, and in 2023 it reported 321,179 cases and 1,705 deaths. Dengue is also rising in Panama. As of week 25 this year (15–21 June), 6,458 cumulative cases have been reported, of which 55 were severe and 10 were fatal. Cases are mainly among people aged 10–59. The main serotypes circulating are DENV-3 and DENV-4, which have increased severe cases and deaths.

items.summary_zh: 美國亞利桑那州可可諾郡1例肺鼠疫死亡,為2007年以來首例
items.summary_en: Arizona's Coconino County reported a pneumonic plague death, the county's first since 2007; the US averages about 7 cases a year.
items.description_zh: 美國亞利桑那州北部可可諾郡報告1例肺鼠疫死亡病例,係因鼠疫桿菌造成嚴重肺部感染,為該郡2007年以後首次報告肺鼠疫死亡病例,感染源與野生動物有關。該國每年約有7例病例,公共風險為低。
items.description_en: Coconino County in northern Arizona has reported one death from pneumonic plague, caused by a severe lung infection from the plague bacterium (Yersinia pestis). It is the county's first pneumonic plague death since 2007, and the source of infection is linked to wildlife. The country records about 7 cases a year, and public risk is assessed as low.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球禽流感週報:本週無人類病例,美國CDC更新H5N1臨床指引
items.summary_en: No human avian influenza cases were reported this week; the US CDC updated H5N1 guidance on 8 July, advising testing and early antiviral prophylaxis.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共7國於 2025/2/2-2025/7/11期間新增22起 H5N1疫情,英國6起、葡萄牙5起、比利時/荷蘭各3起、韓國/巴西各2起、柬埔寨1起。 挪威於2025/7/4新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。 芬蘭於2025/7/7新增1起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,075起疫情,近期主要集中於加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第27週計332個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC於7/8發布最新臨床指引,建議臨床醫師對出現急性呼吸道症狀或結膜炎,在發病前10日內曾接觸病死禽鳥、家畜或其環境,或食用未煮熟之生乳及乳製品患者,應評估H5N1感染可能性,並儘速安排醫療評估與檢驗,且及早使用抗病毒藥物進行預防性治療。另近期H5N1人類與動物病例減少,未來人類病例將持續每週公布,接觸監測與檢驗人數改為每月更新,動物感染資訊則改由農業部門公布。 年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感23例 (2003年迄今累計986*例)、H9N2流感16例(迄今累計144例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計55國家/地區通報2,015起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5病毒風險評估,H5 2.3.4.4b仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week. Human cases: no human infections were reported this week. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): seven countries added 22 H5N1 outbreaks between 2 February and 11 July 2025, with the United Kingdom 6, Portugal 5, Belgium and the Netherlands 3 each, South Korea and Brazil 2 each, and Cambodia 1. Norway added one H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 4 July 2025. Finland added one H5N5 outbreak on 7 July 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,075 herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in California and Arizona. At least 9,600 cattle-exposed humans have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: week 27 testing reports were provided by 332 sampling sites, with H5-positive detections at 2 sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Oregon). Other updates: on 8 July the US CDC issued new clinical guidance recommending that clinicians assess the possibility of H5N1 infection in patients with acute respiratory symptoms or conjunctivitis who, within 10 days before onset, had contact with dead or sick birds, livestock or their environments, or who consumed raw milk and uncooked dairy products; medical evaluation and testing should be arranged promptly, and early antiviral preventive treatment should be considered. Recently, human and animal H5N1 cases have declined. Human cases will continue to be published weekly; exposure monitoring and testing figures will be updated monthly; and animal infection information will now be published by the agriculture sector. Annual summary: Human cases: 23 H5N1 influenza cases (986* cumulative since 2003), 16 H9N2 influenza cases (144 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulative); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Following WHO counting, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 2,015 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively by 55 countries and territories. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH assessed H5 virus risk on 17 April. H5 2.3.4.4b remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domesticated animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For the general public, infection risk remains low; for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate, depending on the type and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率4.05%,XFG首度占比最高(36%)
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 4.05% in week 25, and XFG became the most prevalent variant for the first time, at 36%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  全球於第25週(6/16-22)陽性率4.05%,除西太平洋及非洲以外,其他區域陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情呈下降趨勢,6月累計新增約33萬例病例,其中重症384例、死亡8例,第26週(6/23-29)定醫門診陽性率14%,已連續5週下降,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第27週(6/29-7/5)陽性率3.43%,已連續7週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 泰國疫情下降,第26週報告約1.9萬例病例,其中25例死亡,病例數已連續4週下降,以變異株NB.1.8.1占多數。 澳洲疫情處高原期,第25-26週陽性率增至4.6%,每週新增病例數逾400例,以變異株NB.1.8.1占多數。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,除西太平洋及非洲以外,其他區域呈上升趨勢;自WHO於6/25將XFG列為監測變異株(VUM)後,全球流行變異株首度由XFG占比最高(36%),其次為NB.1.8.1(26%)、LP.8.1(20%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: Globally, positivity in week 25 (16–22 June) was 4.05%, with increases in all regions except the Western Pacific and Africa. China: the epidemic is declining. About 330,000 new cumulative cases were reported in June, including 384 severe cases and 8 deaths. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 26 (23–29 June) was 14%, down for 5 consecutive weeks, and the main variant is NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong: the epidemic is declining. Positivity in week 27 (29 June–5 July) was 3.43%, down for 7 consecutive weeks, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also declined. Wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share. Thailand: the epidemic is declining. About 19,000 cases were reported in week 26, including 25 deaths, and case numbers have fallen for 4 consecutive weeks; NB.1.8.1 is the majority variant. Australia: the epidemic is at a plateau. Positivity rose to 4.6% in weeks 25–26, with more than 400 new cases per week, and NB.1.8.1 is the majority variant. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with increases in all regions except the Western Pacific and Africa. Since WHO designated XFG as a Variant Under Monitoring (VUM) on 25 June, XFG has become the most prevalent global variant for the first time (36%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (26%) and LP.8.1 (20%). WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),澳大利亞,中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,泰國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增WPV1病例1例,安哥拉、查德各新增cVDPV2病例1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new WPV1 polio case in Pakistan and one cVDPV2 case each in Angola and Chad for 26 June–2 July.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/26-7/2期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增2國共2例,分別為安哥拉/查德各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增貝南1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 26 June and 2 July, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by 2 cases in 2 countries, one each in Angola and Chad. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by one sample in Benin.

items.summary_zh: 智利洛斯拉戈斯區今年截至7/9弓形蟲感染108例,多數無症狀
items.summary_en: Chile's Los Lagos Region has reported 108 toxoplasmosis cases this year as of 9 July, most of them asymptomatic.
items.description_zh: 智利中部洛斯拉戈斯區(Los Lagos)今年截至7/9累計報告108例病例,患者多無症狀,傳播途徑包含貓糞、受汙染之水或食物;當局呼籲給寵物貓服用抗寄生蟲藥,孕婦及嬰兒等高風險族群應避免與貓接觸。
items.description_en: The Los Lagos Region in central Chile has reported 108 cases so far this year as of 9 July. Most patients are asymptomatic. Transmission routes include cat feces and contaminated water or food. Authorities urge owners to give antiparasitic medication to pet cats, and advise high-risk groups, including pregnant women and infants, to avoid contact with cats.

items.summary_zh: 美國肯塔基州霍普金斯郡6月報告23例梨形鞭毛蟲病,感染源未明
items.summary_en: Hopkins County, Kentucky, reported 23 giardiasis cases in June, with the source of infection still unclear.
items.description_zh: 美國肯塔基州霍普金斯郡於6月報告23例病例,感染源尚未釐清,當局呼籲民眾確保飲水前煮沸消毒,避免接觸動物糞便,並注意個人飲食衛生。
items.description_en: Hopkins County, Kentucky, USA, reported 23 cases in June. The source of infection has not yet been identified. Authorities urge residents to boil drinking water to disinfect it, avoid contact with animal feces, and maintain personal food hygiene.

items.summary_zh: 日本疫情上升但低於近3年同期,新加坡日均20例為今年最低
items.summary_en: Japan's enterovirus epidemic is rising but below the past three years' levels, while Singapore's 20 daily cases are this year's lowest.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第25-27週(6/15-7/5)疫情更新,日本疫情呈上升趨勢,定醫平均病例數0.42,惟低於近3年同期;香港疫情波動,就診陽性率為0.5‰,低於近2年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,每日平均病例數為20例,為今年最低。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 25–27 (15 June–5 July): Japan's epidemic is on an upward trend, with an average of 0.42 cases per sentinel clinic, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is fluctuating, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.5‰, lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Singapore's epidemic is at a low point, with an average of 20 cases per day, the lowest this year.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,新加坡

items.headline_zh: 西班牙-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 西班牙拉科魯亞省7/4報告162例沙門氏菌感染,22例住院,疑為音樂節玉米餅
items.summary_en: La Coruña Province, Spain, reported 162 salmonellosis cases on 4 July, 22 hospitalized, all attendees of a music festival; corn tortillas are the suspected source.
items.description_zh: 西班牙北部拉科魯亞省(La Coruna)於7/4報告162例病例,其中22例住院,病患皆曾參加當地音樂節活動,當局調查疑感染源為活動攤販販賣之玉米餅;另該國2023年累計報告2,747例病例,4例死亡。
items.description_en: La Coruña Province in northern Spain reported 162 cases on 4 July, 22 of whom were hospitalized. All patients had attended a local music festival. Authorities suspect the source was corn tortillas sold by vendors at the event. Spain reported 2,747 cases cumulatively in 2023, including 4 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳近1週3,353例,今年近4萬例,已報告4例嬰幼兒死亡
items.summary_en: Japan reported 3,353 pertussis cases in one week, up 142, with nearly 40,000 cases this year and 4 infant and toddler deaths.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/23-29)通報3,353例,較前1週3,211例上升142例,單週新增病例數為2018年新高,以東京都(234)為多,其次為琦玉縣(229)。今年迄今已近4萬例,並報告4例嬰幼兒死亡案例,另多地發現抗藥性菌株。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (23–29 June), 3,353 cases were reported, up 142 from 3,211 the previous week. Weekly new cases reached a record high for 2018. Tokyo Metropolis (234) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (229). So far this year, nearly 40,000 cases have been reported. Four infant and young child deaths have been reported, and drug-resistant strains have been found in several areas.

items.headline_zh: 美洲/吉爾吉斯/日本-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 美洲麻疹逾7,100例、13例死亡,日本神奈川1例青少年曾參訪大阪萬博
items.summary_en: The Americas reported over 7,100 measles cases and 13 deaths by mid-June; a Kanagawa teen who visited Expo 2025 Osaka was diagnosed.
items.description_zh: 美洲地區疫情持續,截至今年6月中旬報告逾7,100例及13例死亡,與去(2024)年同期244例,上升29倍,其中以加拿大(3,170例,1例死亡)為多,其次為墨西哥(2,597例,9例死亡)及美國(1,227例,3例死亡),餘有6國病例數介於1-60例間,多數病例為境外移入,受影響族群以5歲以下兒童及10-19歲青少年最為嚴重。病例數增加顯示免疫接種缺口,PAHO呼籲各國維持95%兩劑疫苗覆蓋率。WHO表示今年截至6/6,全球報告逾18萬例疑病例及8.8萬例確診。 吉爾吉斯今年截至6/17累計報告超過8,200例,其中9例死亡,病例數以首都比什凱克、南部奧什州及北部楚伊州為多,近期西部賈拉拉巴德州病例數亦持續增加,惟該國尚未宣布爆發疫情,疫情主因與大量兒童未接種疫苗有關。 日本神奈川縣報告1例10多歲青少年,該病患曾於6/21參訪大阪萬國博覽會,於會場停留約6小時,並於當日出現症狀,7/3確診,患者近期無海外旅遊史,接觸史不明。當局及主辦單位呼籲當日前往參觀人員留意自身健康情形。
items.description_en: Measles activity in the Americas continues. As of mid-June this year, more than 7,100 cases and 13 deaths have been reported, 29 times the 244 cases reported in the same period of 2024. Canada reports the most (3,170 cases, 1 death), followed by Mexico (2,597 cases, 9 deaths) and the United States (1,227 cases, 3 deaths). Six other countries have between 1 and 60 cases each. Most cases are imported. The most affected groups are children under 5 and adolescents aged 10–19. The rise in cases indicates gaps in immunization, and PAHO calls on countries to maintain 95% coverage with two doses of vaccine. WHO reports that as of 6 June this year, more than 180,000 suspected and 88,000 confirmed cases have been reported globally. Kyrgyzstan has reported more than 8,200 cumulative cases so far this year as of 17 June, including 9 deaths. Cases are mainly in the capital, Bishkek, Osh Region in the south and Chui Region in the north, and recently cases have also continued to rise in Jalal-Abad Region in the west. The country has not declared an outbreak; the main cause is that many children are unvaccinated. In Japan, Kanagawa Prefecture reported one teenager, who visited Expo 2025 Osaka on 21 June and stayed at the venue for about 6 hours, developed symptoms that day, and was confirmed on 3 July. The patient had no recent overseas travel, and the contact history is unknown. Authorities and the organizers urge those who visited on that day to monitor their health.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,日本,吉爾吉斯,墨西哥,美國

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉-茲卡病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉吉大港2例42歲個案初檢疑為茲卡病毒感染,待確認
items.summary_en: Chattogram, Bangladesh, reported two 42-year-old patients with preliminary tests suggesting Zika virus infection, pending confirmation.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉吉大港報告2例個案,年齡均為42歲,男性個案出現發燒、身體疼痛及紅疹等症狀,女性個案出現發燒、肢體腫脹及關節痛等症狀,7/6經血液檢體初步檢驗可能為茲卡病毒感染,將進一步檢測確認,當地曾於2016年發生病例。
items.description_en: Chattogram, Bangladesh, has reported two cases, both aged 42. The male case had fever, body pain and a rash; the female case had fever, limb swelling and joint pain. On 6 July, preliminary testing of blood samples suggested possible Zika virus infection, and further testing is needed for confirmation. The area previously had cases in 2016.

items.summary_zh: 泰國清邁府1例M痘,今年40例,自2022年累計900例、13例死亡
items.summary_en: Thailand reported a Mpox case in Chiang Mai; 40 cases this year and 900 since 2022, with 13 deaths, mostly locally acquired.
items.description_zh: 泰國清邁府報告1例,病患接受治療及檢驗中,該國今年累計報告40例,自2022年迄今累計900例,其中13例死亡,當局表示病患多為本土感染,僅5例為境外移入,主要年齡層介於20-39歲,傳染途徑皆為性接觸,當局建議易感族群應採取安全性行為,並針對自非洲和中東等高風險地區返國之旅客採取篩檢措施。
items.description_en: Chiang Mai Province in Thailand has reported one case, who is being treated and tested. Thailand has reported 40 cases this year, and 900 cumulative cases since 2022, of which 13 were fatal. Authorities say most patients were infected locally, and only 5 were imported cases. The main age group is 20–39 years, and all transmission was through sexual contact. Authorities advise susceptible groups to practice safe sex, and screening is being carried out for travelers returning from high-risk areas such as Africa and the Middle East.

items.headline_zh: 澳大利亞/印度/南非-狂犬病
items.summary_zh: 澳洲新南威爾斯、印度北方邦、南非各1例狂犬病死亡
items.summary_en: One rabies death each was reported in New South Wales (Australia), Uttar Pradesh (India) and KwaZulu-Natal (South Africa).
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞新南威爾斯州報告1例死亡病例,為50多歲男性,病患於數月前被受感染之蝙蝠咬傷並接受治療,於7/3死亡,為該州首例死亡病例,該國自1996年迄今已報告4例,當局已啟動疫情調查,並呼籲民眾避免接觸蝙蝠。 印度北方邦報告1例死亡病例,為22歲男性,病患1個月前曾被犬隻咬傷,且未接種疫苗,於6/26出現呼吸困難,28日死亡,當局已啟動衛教宣導及疫苗接種服務。 南非東部夸祖魯-納塔爾省報告1例死亡病例,為32歲男性,曾於3月被犬隻咬傷,且未接種疫苗,於5/30死亡;該省去(2024)年報告3例,當局已啟動犬/貓隻疫苗接種服務。南非病例數前3名省份為夸祖魯-納塔爾、東開普及林波波省。
items.description_en: New South Wales, Australia, reported one death, a man in his 50s who had been bitten months earlier by an infected bat and had received treatment. He died on 3 July, the state's first such death. Australia has reported 4 cases since 1996. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and urge the public to avoid contact with bats. Uttar Pradesh, India, reported one death, a 22-year-old man who had been bitten by a dog one month earlier and was unvaccinated. He developed breathing difficulties on 26 June and died on 28 June. Authorities have launched health education and vaccination services. KwaZulu-Natal Province in eastern South Africa reported one death, a 32-year-old man who was bitten by a dog in March and was unvaccinated. He died on 30 May. The province reported 3 cases last year, and dog and cat vaccination services have been launched. The three provinces with the most cases in South Africa are KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape and Limpopo.

items.summary_zh: 不丹東南部德瓦塘學校群聚,230名學生中180例鉤端螺旋體病、3例死亡
items.summary_en: A school cluster in Dewathang, Bhutan, reported 180 leptospirosis cases among 230 students, including 3 deaths and 89 hospitalizations.
items.description_zh: 不丹東南部德瓦塘地區報告1起學校群聚事件,230名學員中,共計報告180例病例,其中89例住院及3例死亡,該校學員於6/14接觸同一受汙染水池後,於20-29日出現咳嗽、發燒及腹瀉等症狀,部分病患出現急性呼吸窘迫症候群(ARDS)及急性腎損傷重症,經實驗室確診,當局已啟動緊急調查及應對措施,並呼籲民眾避免接觸疑被動物排泄物污染之水源。
items.description_en: A school cluster was reported in the Dewathang area of southeastern Bhutan. Of 230 students, 180 cases were reported, including 89 hospitalized and 3 deaths. The students were exposed to the same contaminated pond on 14 June. From the 20th to the 29th, they developed cough, fever and diarrhea, and some patients developed acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and severe acute kidney injury. Cases were confirmed by laboratory testing. Authorities have launched an emergency investigation and response measures, and urge the public to avoid water sources that may be contaminated by animal excreta.

items.headline_zh: 塔吉克/剛果民主共和國-炭疽病
items.headline_en: Tajikistan / Democratic Republic of the Congo – Anthrax
items.summary_zh: 塔吉克今年炭疽病41例,剛果民主共和國北基伍24例疑似病例
items.summary_en: Tajikistan reported 41 anthrax cases this year, linked to livestock eating contaminated hay; North Kivu, DRC, has 24 suspected cases.
items.description_zh: 中亞塔吉克今年截至7/1報告41例,當局表示疫情與牲畜食用被炭疽孢子污染之乾草相關,夏季為流行季節,其高危險族群為農產品相關人員,該國2023-24年分別報告80及102例,當局呼籲應加強牲畜屠宰前之檢查措施。 剛果民主共和國東部北基伍省疫情更新,該省4個衛生區截至5/26報告24例疑病例,及動物死亡案例,WHO協助當局啟動跨部門應對措施,強化監測、治療、社區宣導及跨境協調,以控制疫情。
items.description_en: Tajikistan in Central Asia has reported 41 cases as of 1 July this year. Authorities say the outbreak is linked to livestock eating hay contaminated with anthrax spores. Summer is the epidemic season, and the high-risk group is workers involved with agricultural products. The country reported 80 cases in 2023 and 102 in 2024. Authorities call for strengthened inspection of livestock before slaughter. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the update for North Kivu Province in the east shows that as of 26 May, four health zones in the province had reported 24 suspected cases and animal deaths. WHO is helping authorities launch a multisectoral response, strengthening surveillance, treatment, community awareness and cross-border coordination to control the outbreak.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,塔吉克

items.summary_zh: 法國今年截至7/1本土屈公病14例,已擴散至大東部大區
items.summary_en: France has reported 14 locally acquired Chikungunya cases as of 1 July, and the disease has spread to the Grand Est region.
items.description_zh: 法國疫情更新,今年截至7/1本土病例累計14例,大東部大區亦出現本土病例,顯示該疾病已傳播至原本無疫情地區,本土傳播風險增加。當局提醒落實報告病例、防止蚊蟲叮咬措施及控制幼蟲滋生之重要性。
items.description_en: France has updated its situation. As of 1 July this year, 14 locally acquired cases have been reported cumulatively. Locally acquired cases have also appeared in the Grand Est region, indicating the disease has spread to areas that previously had none, and the risk of local transmission has increased. Authorities remind people of the importance of reporting cases, preventing mosquito bites and controlling larval breeding.

items.summary_zh: 宏都拉斯今年約7,500例登革熱(中美洲第2多),馬利1,918例
items.summary_en: Honduras has about 7,500 dengue cases, second most in Central America, while Mali has 1,918 cases, second most in Africa.
items.description_zh: 宏都拉斯疫情上升,今年截至第24週累計報告約7,500例病例,為中美洲病例數第二多之國家,病例集中於中區、聖佩德羅蘇拉等區,另美洲地區今年病例數較去年同期下降70%。 馬利疫情上升,今年迄今累計1,918例病例(380例確診),為非洲病例數第二多之國家,分布於全國11個地區,近1週報告52例病例(11例確診),以西南部巴馬科及卡伊病例數為多,非洲今年迄今共7國報告近8,000例病例及7例死亡,近期主要流行型別為DENV-2。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Honduras. As of week 24 this year, about 7,500 cumulative cases have been reported, the second highest in Central America. Cases are concentrated in the Central district and in San Pedro Sula. Case numbers in the Americas this year are 70% lower than in the same period last year. Dengue is also rising in Mali. So far this year, 1,918 cumulative cases (380 confirmed) have been reported, the second highest in Africa, distributed across 11 regions nationwide. In the most recent week, 52 cases (11 confirmed) were reported, with the most in Bamako and Kayes in the southwest. Across Africa, 7 countries have reported nearly 8,000 cases and 7 deaths this year, and the main recently circulating serotype is DENV-2.

items.summary_zh: 緬甸若開邦今年逾1,000例瘧疾、30例死亡,已超過去年全年
items.summary_en: Rakhine State in Myanmar has recorded over 1,000 malaria cases and 30 deaths this year, exceeding last year's full-year totals; Ikongo, Madagascar, has nearly 200 deaths.
items.description_zh: 緬甸西南部若開邦今年迄今累計逾1,000例病例及30例死亡,高於去年全年病例數及死亡數,主要係因公衛醫療資源缺乏,導致疫情上升。 馬達加斯加東部伊孔古區病例數上升,自5月中旬以來報告3,500餘例病例,今年迄今累計近200例死亡,以5月報告66例死亡最多,6月報告49例死亡,惡性瘧原蟲為當地最常見之瘧原蟲。
items.description_en: Rakhine State in southwestern Myanmar has recorded more than 1,000 cumulative cases and 30 deaths so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year totals for cases and deaths. The rise is mainly due to a shortage of public health and medical resources. In Ikongo district in eastern Madagascar, cases have risen, with more than 3,500 cases reported since mid-May and nearly 200 cumulative deaths this year. May recorded the most deaths, with 66, and June recorded 49. Plasmodium falciparum is the most common malaria parasite locally.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦新增2例立百病毒感染,1例死亡,已匡列425名接觸者
items.summary_en: Kerala reported two new Nipah cases; one patient died of acute encephalitis syndrome on 4 July, and 425 contacts are being traced.
items.description_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦新增報告2例病例,分別為18歲及38歲女性個案,前者曾於醫院接受治療,並於7/4死於急性腦炎綜合症(AES),後者病況危急,正在醫院接受治療。目前已匡列425名接觸者,包括醫護人員。另該邦馬拉普蘭縣於今年5月曾確診1例病例。
items.description_en: Kerala State in India has reported two new cases, both women, aged 18 and 38. The 18-year-old had been treated in hospital and died of acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) on 4 July. The 38-year-old is critically ill and is being treated in hospital. A total of 425 contacts, including health workers, have been identified. In Malappuram District of the state, one case was confirmed in May this year.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球禽流感週報:柬埔寨新增4例H5N1,全球風險仍低
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported four new H5N1 human infections this week; the FAO, WHO and WOAH assessment rates global public health risk as low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:柬埔寨新增4例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共8國於2025/6/27-2025/7/4期間新增21起H5N1疫情,墨西哥/德國/柬埔寨各4起、英國3起、南非/愛爾蘭各2起、美國/西班牙 各1起。 美國於7/4新增7起H5(N untyped)疫情。 印度於2025/7/3新增1起H3N8疫情。 墨西哥於2025/7/1新增16起H7N3疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,074起疫情,近期主要集中於亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第25週計370個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感23例 (2003年迄今累計986*例)、H9N2流感16例(迄今累計144例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計55國家/地區通報1,982起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:  FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5病毒風險評估,H5 2.3.4.4b仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week. Human cases: Cambodia reported four new H5N1 human infections. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): eight countries reported 21 H5N1 outbreaks between 27 June and 4 July 2025, with Mexico, Germany and Cambodia 4 each, the United Kingdom 3, South Africa and Ireland 2 each, and the United States and Spain 1 each. The United States reported 7 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 4 July. India reported one H3N8 outbreak on 3 July 2025. Mexico reported 16 H7N3 outbreaks on 1 July 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,074 herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in Arizona. At least 9,600 cattle-exposed humans have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: week 25 testing reports were provided by 370 sampling sites, with H5-positive detections at 3 sampling sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Oregon). Annual summary: Human cases: 23 H5N1 influenza cases (986* cumulative since 2003), 16 H9N2 influenza cases (144 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulative); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Following WHO counting, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 1,982 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively by 55 countries and territories. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH assessed H5 virus risk on 17 April. H5 2.3.4.4b remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domesticated animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For the general public, infection risk remains low; for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate, depending on the type and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),柬埔寨

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率4.02%上升,LP.8.1占比最高(26%)
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 4.02% in week 24 and rising in the Americas, Europe and Eastern Mediterranean; LP.8.1 is the top variant at 26%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第24週(6/9-15)全球陽性率4.02%,美洲、歐洲、東地中海區陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情呈下降趨勢,第25週(6/16-22)定醫門診陽性率15.4%,低於過去4週,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方省份,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第26週(6/22-28)陽性率4.01%,已連續6週下降,定醫就診率持平,污水監測數據顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情略升,第25週(6/16-22)定點平均報告1例,較近4週高,病患分布以沖繩縣為多,變異株NB.1.8.1占多數。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第25週(6/16-22)新增63例病例,較第19週高峰減少55%,陽性率持平,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、東地中海區呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占最多(26%),其次為NB.1.8.1 (24%)及XFG(19%),其中XFG近期快速增加。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: Globally, positivity in week 24 of 2025 (9–15 June) was 4.02%, with increases in the Americas, Europe and Eastern Mediterranean regions. China: the epidemic is declining. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 25 (16–22 June) was 15.4%, lower than in the previous 4 weeks. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern provinces, and the main variant is NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong: the epidemic is declining. Positivity in week 26 (22–28 June) was 4.01%, down for 6 consecutive weeks. Sentinel clinic consultation rates were stable, and wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share. Japan: the epidemic is rising slightly. The sentinel average in week 25 (16–22 June) was 1 case per sentinel site, higher than in the past 4 weeks, with cases concentrated in Okinawa Prefecture. The main variant is NB.1.8.1. South Korea: the epidemic is declining. 63 new cases were reported in week 25 (16–22 June), 55% lower than the peak in week 19. Positivity was stable, and the main variant is NB.1.8.1. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with increases in the Americas, Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean regions. The currently most prevalent variant globally is LP.8.1 (26%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (24%) and XFG (19%), with XFG having increased rapidly in recent weeks. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 6/19-25期間cVDPV2新增3國共3例,巴基斯坦WPV1新增1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported three new cVDPV2 polio cases in Benin, Ethiopia and Yemen, and one new WPV1 case in Pakistan, for 19–25 June.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/19-25期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例,cVDPV2新增3國共3例,分別為貝南/衣索比亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV1型陽性樣本新增吉布地1件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增3國共4例,分別為吉布地2件、坦尚亞/查德各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 19 and 25 June, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 3 cases in 3 countries, one each in Benin, Ethiopia and Yemen. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by one in Pakistan, cVDPV1-positive samples increased by one in Djibouti, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 4 in 3 countries: 2 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Tanzania and Chad.
items.area_zh: 貝南共和國,衣索比亞,巴基斯坦,葉門

items.summary_zh: 印度浦那市今年5月傷寒78例,高於去年同期58例
items.summary_en: Pune, India, reported 78 typhoid cases in May this year, up from 58 in the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 印度西部馬哈拉施特拉邦(Maharashtra)浦那市(Pune)今年5月報告78例病例,較去年同期(58例)增加;另有研究指出,鄰近該邦之古吉拉特邦(Gujarat),該地區檢出之致病菌對常用抗生素之抗藥性日益增強。
items.description_en: Pune City in Maharashtra State, western India, reported 78 cases in May this year, up from 58 in the same period last year. A study also indicates that in Gujarat, which neighbors Maharashtra, pathogens detected in the area are showing growing resistance to commonly used antibiotics.

items.headline_zh: 中國/香港/日本/越南/泰國-腸病毒
items.headline_en: China / Hong Kong SAR / Japan / Viet Nam / Thailand – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 中國腸病毒今年累計253,093例、117例重症,香港陽性率0.7‰為今年最高
items.summary_en: China has recorded 253,093 enterovirus cases this year, including 117 severe with no deaths; Hong Kong's positivity hit a 2025 high.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第24-26週(6/8-28)疫情更新,中國疫情上升,新增約8.8萬例病例,今年迄今累計253,093例,117例重症,無死亡案例;疫情低於近2年同期;香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為0.7‰,為今年最高點;日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.33,為今年最高,惟低於近3年同期;越南今年截至4月累計報告逾1.5萬例病例,其中,胡志明市病例數較去年同期增加49%;泰國今年截至6月累計報告約2.4萬例病例,迄無死亡個案,病患年齡以0-4歲(70%)及10-14歲為多(22%)。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 24–26 (8–28 June): China's epidemic is rising, with about 88,000 new cases in the period. Cumulatively this year, 253,093 cases and 117 severe cases have been reported, with no deaths. The epidemic is lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.7‰, the highest point this year. Japan's epidemic is rising, with an average of 0.33 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. Viet Nam reported more than 15,000 cumulative cases as of April this year, and cases in Ho Chi Minh City were 49% higher than in the same period last year. Thailand reported about 24,000 cumulative cases as of June this year, with no deaths. Patients are mainly aged 0–4 (70%) and 10–14 (22%).
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本,泰國,越南

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 法國-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 法國聖康坦市28例腸出血性大腸桿菌感染,1童死亡,疑為肉品店肉類
items.summary_en: Saint-Quentin, France, reported 28 mostly child EHEC cases; one child died, 10 were diagnosed with HUS, and a butcher shop is suspected.
items.description_zh: 法國北部聖康坦市(Saint-Quentin)於6/28報告28例病例,病患多為兒童,其中1例兒童死亡,10例確診為尿毒溶血症候群(HUS),部分個案仍住院中;當局調查疑感染源為當地肉品店之受汙染肉類,推測為能產生志賀毒素之高毒性菌株,該店家已停業。
items.description_en: Saint-Quentin in northern France reported 28 cases on 28 June, mostly children. One child died, and 10 cases were diagnosed with haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS), some of whom remain hospitalized. Authorities suspect the source was contaminated meat from a local butcher shop, and the strain is presumed to be a highly virulent one capable of producing Shiga toxin. The shop has closed.

items.summary_zh: 日本傳染性紅斑症近1週定點平均2.53例,就診數為1999年以來新高
items.summary_en: Japan's erythema infectiosum average was 2.53 per sentinel site, up from 2.03, with clinic visits highest since 1999.
items.description_zh: 日本近1週定點平均報告數為2.53例,較前一週2.03例上升,定醫平均就診數為1999年以來新高,其中以山形縣7.62例為高,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
items.description_en: Japan's sentinel average in the most recent week was 2.53, up from 2.03 the previous week. The average number of sentinel clinic visits is the highest since 1999, with Yamagata Prefecture highest at 7.62. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳近1週3,211例創2018年來新高,今年近6成為青少年
items.summary_en: Japan reported 3,211 pertussis cases in one week, the highest since 2018, with nearly 60% of cases this year in adolescents.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/16-22)通報3,211例,較前1週2,970例上升241例,單週新增病例數為2018年新高,以東京都(234)為多,其次為琦玉縣(204)。今年迄今已超過3.5萬例,並報告4例嬰幼兒死亡案例,另多地發現抗藥性菌株。今年病例近60%為青少年,自2018年以來,同期青少年患者比例約為10-30%,惟今年病例數顯著上升,專家表示常規疫苗保護效力至中/小學時已降低,感染風險上升,建議於小學入學前或11-12歲時接種追加劑,另呼籲政府應採取相關措施,如補貼追加劑接種費用。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (16–22 June), 3,211 cases were reported, up 241 from 2,970 the previous week. Weekly new cases reached the highest level since 2018. Tokyo Metropolis (234) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (204). So far this year, more than 35,000 cases have been reported, and 4 infant and toddler deaths have been reported; drug-resistant strains have also been found in several areas. Nearly 60% of this year's cases are adolescents. Since 2018, the proportion of adolescent patients in the same period has been about 10–30%, but case numbers have risen markedly this year. Experts say routine vaccine protection has declined by the time children reach junior high or elementary school, raising infection risk. They recommend a booster before elementary school entry or at ages 11–12, and call on the government to take measures such as subsidizing booster costs.

items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞6/24宣布公衛緊急狀態,麻疹60例;蒙古逾1萬例含7例死亡
items.summary_en: Bolivia, with 60 measles cases since April, declared a public health emergency on 24 June; Mongolia has over 10,000 cases and 7 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 玻利維亞於6/24發布公共衛生緊急狀態,該國自4月報告首例以來迄今報告60例,病例多分布於該國東部聖克魯斯省,惟近期疫情擴散至該國西部地區,當局將規劃疫苗採購及接種計畫。 蒙古今年截至6/30累計報告逾10,000例,其中648例住院及7例死亡,病例多為中學生。
items.description_en: Bolivia declared a public health emergency on 24 June. Since the first case was reported in April this year, 60 cases have been reported to date. Cases are mainly in Santa Cruz Department in the east, but the outbreak has recently spread to western regions. Authorities will plan vaccine procurement and vaccination programs. Mongolia has reported more than 10,000 cumulative cases as of 30 June this year, including 648 hospitalized and 7 deaths. Most cases are secondary school students.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨36歲女性感染H5N1危重,今年累計11例、6例死亡
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a new H5N1 case in a critically ill 36-year-old woman; the country has 11 cases this year, 6 of them fatal.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西北部暹粒省博縣36歲女性,與23、29日報告病例所居住村莊相距約3公里,病患出現發燒、咳嗽、倦怠及呼吸困難症狀,目前病況危急,於ICU治療中。據調查,病患曾接觸家中病死家禽,該病例為該省今年第4例。該國今年累計報告11例,其中6例死亡;自2023年迄今累計27例,其中12例死亡。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, in a 36-year-old woman from Bo district in Siem Reap Province in the northwest. The case lives about 3 km from the villages where the cases reported on the 23rd and 29th lived. She presented with fever, cough, fatigue and difficulty breathing, and is critically ill in the ICU. The investigation found that she had contact with sick poultry at home. This is the province's fourth case this year. The country has reported 11 cases this year, 6 of them fatal. Since 2023, 27 cases have been reported cumulatively, 12 of them fatal.

items.disease_zh: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_zh: 韓國-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症(SFTS)
items.headline_en: South Korea – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 韓國忠清北道SFTS院內群聚,69歲女病患死亡,7名醫護人員確診
items.summary_en: A hospital cluster of SFTS in North Chungcheong, Korea, killed a 69-year-old woman; seven healthcare workers were infected through prolonged exposure to her blood and body fluids.
items.description_zh: 韓國忠清北道報告1起院內群聚事件,指標個案為69歲女性病患,6/2出現發燒症狀,4日就醫,因病情惡化2度轉院,11日因多重器官衰竭死亡。共7名醫護人員出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉痛及腹瀉等症狀,經檢驗確診。據調查,醫護人員於醫療過程中長時間暴露於患者血液/體液導致繼發性感染,目前人員均已康復。當局已針對直/間接接觸者進行追蹤;該國自2014年迄今報告35例人傳人繼發性感染,多為醫護人員及殯葬業者。當局表示該國SFTS致死率高達18.5%,提醒醫護人員診療及處置患者須遵守感管指引。
items.description_en: North Chungcheong Province (Chungcheongbuk-do) reported one hospital cluster. The index case, a 69-year-old woman, developed fever on 2 June and sought care on the 4th. Her condition worsened and she was transferred twice, and she died of multiple organ failure on the 11th. Seven healthcare workers developed fever, headache, muscle pain and diarrhoea, and were confirmed by testing. The investigation found that the healthcare workers had been exposed to the patient's blood and body fluids for prolonged periods during care, leading to secondary infection; all have since recovered. Authorities are tracing direct and indirect contacts. South Korea has reported 35 person-to-person secondary infections since 2014, mostly among healthcare workers and funeral workers. Authorities say South Korea's SFTS case fatality rate is as high as 18.5%, and urge healthcare workers to follow infection control guidelines when examining and treating patients.

items.summary_zh: 美國威斯康辛州今年波瓦桑病毒3例,1例死亡,去年12例
items.summary_en: Wisconsin has reported 3 Powassan virus cases this year, one fatal; it reported 12 last year, second only to Minnesota.
items.description_zh: 美國威斯康辛州今年迄今報告3例病例,病患皆住院治療,其中1例死亡,該州去(2024)年報告12例,僅次於明蘇達州(14例),該國中西/東北部為高風險地區,該病致死率約為 10%,目前尚無特效治療方法或疫苗。當局呼籲醫療院所針對疑病例進行檢測,以及戶外活動族群應採取預防蜱蟲叮咬之防護措施。
items.description_en: Wisconsin has reported 3 cases so far this year, all hospitalized, and one patient died. The state reported 12 cases last year, second only to Minnesota (14 cases). In the United States, the Midwest and Northeast are high-risk areas. The fatality rate of the disease is about 10%, and there is currently no specific treatment or vaccine. Authorities urge healthcare facilities to test suspected cases, and urge people who engage in outdoor activities to take measures to prevent tick bites.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 巴基斯坦-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_en: Pakistan – Naegleria fowleri infection (primary amoebic meningoencephalitis)
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦信德省17歲女學生感染福氏內格里阿米巴死亡,該省今年已4例死亡
items.summary_en: A 17-year-old female student in Sindh, Pakistan, died of Naegleria fowleri infection, presumed from untreated home tap water; Sindh has had 4 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦東南部信德省報告1例死亡病例,為17歲女性學生,於6/25出現發燒、身體疼痛及嘔吐等症狀,26日住院並經檢驗確診,27日病情惡化轉入加護病房,28日死亡,病患無開放水域相關接觸史,推測感染源為家中受汙染且未經處理之自來水。該省今年累計4例死亡病例,該國自2008 年迄今累計逾100例死亡病例。
items.description_en: Sindh Province in southeastern Pakistan reported one death, a 17-year-old female student. She developed fever, body pain and vomiting on 25 June, was hospitalized on the 26th and confirmed by testing, and her condition deteriorated and she was transferred to intensive care on the 27th. She died on the 28th. The patient had no contact with open water bodies, and the presumed source is contaminated, untreated tap water at home. The province has recorded 4 deaths this year, and the country has recorded more than 100 deaths cumulatively since 2008.

items.headline_zh: 希臘/伊拉克-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 克里米亞-剛果出血熱:希臘1例死亡,伊拉克今年179例、23例死亡
items.summary_en: Greece reported a CCHF death in a 72-year-old livestock farmer; Iraq has recorded 179 cases and 23 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 希臘北部色薩利大區報告1例死亡病例,為72歲畜牧農民,病情急速惡化,並於住院後死亡,匡列接觸者25人均未出現症狀。本案為該國自2008年以來第2例,當局呼籲高風險族群應採取個人防護措施,以預防蜱蟲叮咬。 伊拉克疫情更新,今(2025)年迄今報告179例,其中23例死亡,以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)50例為多,其次為中部巴達省(Baghdad)28例,感染歸因於不安全的肉類處理和不受監管的屠宰行為,當局呼籲民眾於可信賴管道購買肉品,並於食用前冷凍肉品。
items.description_en: The Thessaly region in northern Greece reported one death, a 72-year-old livestock farmer whose condition deteriorated rapidly and who died after admission to hospital. All 25 contacts identified have remained asymptomatic. This is the second case in the country since 2008. Authorities urge high-risk groups to take personal protective measures to prevent tick bites. Iraq's update: so far in 2025, 179 cases have been reported, including 23 deaths, with 50 cases in Dhi Qar Province in the south and 28 in Baghdad Province in the centre. Infections are attributed to unsafe meat handling and unregulated slaughter. Authorities urge people to buy meat from trusted sources and to freeze meat before eating.

items.summary_zh: 哈薩克北部阿克莫拉州5例皮膚型炭疽病例,病況穩定,環境樣本3/9陽性
items.summary_en: Five cutaneous anthrax cases were reported in Kazakhstan's Akmola Region, all hospitalized in stable condition; 3 of 9 environmental samples were positive.
items.description_zh: 哈薩克北部阿克莫拉州報告5例皮膚炭疽病例,病患皆住院治療且病況穩定,當局已針對該區牛隻屠宰場及放牧場域啟動調查及防治措施,其中部分(3/9)環境樣本檢出陽性。
items.description_en: Five cutaneous anthrax cases were reported in Akmola Region in northern Kazakhstan. All patients are hospitalized and in stable condition. Authorities have launched investigation and control measures at cattle slaughterhouses and grazing areas in the area, and some environmental samples (3 of 9) tested positive.

items.disease_zh: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_zh: 日本-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_en: Japan – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 日本靜岡縣SFTS 1例死亡,為2013年以來該縣首例死亡
items.summary_en: Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, reported an SFTS death in a woman in her 60s, the first there since 2013, with the infection route unclear.
items.description_zh: 日本靜岡縣報告1例死亡病例,為60多歲女性,6/16出現發燒、疲勞及消化問題等症狀,經檢驗確診,23日死亡,為2013年以來該縣首例報告死亡病例,沒有明顯之蜱蟲叮咬痕跡,感染途徑仍待釐清;該縣另報告1例病例,為60多歲男性,6/23確診,身體有被蜱蟲叮咬痕跡,目前住院治療中。
items.description_en: Shizuoka Prefecture in Japan reported one death, a woman in her 60s who developed fever, fatigue and digestive problems on 16 June, was confirmed by testing and died on the 23rd. This is the prefecture's first reported death since 2013. No obvious tick bite marks were found, and the route of infection remains unclear. The prefecture also reported one case, a man in his 60s confirmed on 23 June, who has tick bite marks and is currently hospitalized.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年近1萬例登革熱,柬埔寨今年8,803例
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has nearly 10,000 dengue cases this year, with June cases above 5,500, and Cambodia has 8,803, above last year's same period.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,近2週報告4,000餘例病例,6月報告5,500餘例病例,較5月(1,773例)增加,今年迄今累計近10,000例病例;該國去年累計101,130例病例及573例死亡,2023年累計321,179例病例及1,705例死亡。 柬埔寨疫情上升,今年累計8,803例病例,高於去年同期病例數;該國去年累計18,987例病例及46例死亡,2023年累計35,390例病例及99例死亡。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Bangladesh. Over the past two weeks, more than 4,000 cases were reported, and in June more than 5,500 cases were reported, an increase over May (1,773 cases). So far this year, nearly 10,000 cumulative cases have been reported. Last year the country reported 101,130 cumulative cases and 573 deaths, and in 2023 it reported 321,179 cases and 1,705 deaths. Dengue is rising in Cambodia: this year 8,803 cumulative cases have been reported, higher than the same period last year. Last year the country reported 18,987 cases and 46 deaths, and in 2023 it reported 35,390 cases and 99 deaths.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 中國-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_en: China – Naegleria fowleri infection (primary amoebic meningoencephalitis)
items.summary_zh: 中國福建省5歲女童感染福氏內格里阿米巴,病況危急,曾游泳及泡溫泉
items.summary_en: A 5-year-old girl in Fujian, China, is critically ill with Naegleria fowleri infection after swimming and hot-spring bathing in June.
items.description_zh: 中國福建省報告1例病例,為5歲女童,6/7、14曾進行游泳及泡溫泉活動,於22日出現頭痛、發燒及嘔吐等症狀,23日住院並出現抽搐、昏迷後轉入加護病房,27日經檢驗確診,目前病況危急。
items.description_en: Fujian Province, China, reported one case, a 5-year-old girl who went swimming and soaked in hot springs on 7 and 14 June. She developed headache, fever and vomiting on 22 June, was hospitalized on the 23rd with convulsions and coma, and was transferred to intensive care. The infection was confirmed by testing on the 27th, and her condition is critical.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增2例H5N1,同住家人,今年累計10例、6例死亡
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported two new H5N1 cases, household members aged 41 and 16, bringing its 2025 total to 10 cases, with 6 deaths.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增2例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西北部暹粒省博縣41歲女性及16歲男性,病患為同住家人,為6/23報告1例確定病例後,衛生單位在主動監測調查時發現,與病例住所僅相距20公尺,目前病況穩定,已接受抗病毒藥物治療,據調查,病患曾接觸及食用病死家禽。該國今年累計報告10例,其中6例死亡;自2023年迄今累計26例,其中12例死亡。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported two new human H5N1 infections, a 41-year-old woman and a 16-year-old boy from Bo district in Siem Reap Province in the northwest. They are household members. After a confirmed case was reported on 23 June, health authorities found them through active surveillance; their home is only 20 metres from the case's home. They are in stable condition and have received antiviral treatment. The investigation found that they had contact with and ate sick poultry. The country has reported 10 cases this year, 6 of them fatal. Since 2023, 26 cases have been reported cumulatively, 12 of them fatal.

items.summary_zh: 全球今年29,451例M痘確診,仍為國際關注公衛緊急事件
items.summary_en: WHO reports 29,451 confirmed Mpox cases this year in 76 countries, says the event remains a PHEIC, and extends its recommendations to 20 August.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年6/26累計138國/地區報告15萬195例確診病例,其中至少348例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第26週累計76國/地區報告2萬9,451例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬5,085例、美洲區2,181例、歐洲區1,488例、西太平洋區618例、東南亞區47例及東地中海區32例。  其他更新:   中國報告6月新增1起群聚累計4例Ib型病例,其中1例具剛果及馬利旅遊史,當局仍在疫調中。 義大利於6/4報告該國首例Ib型病例,病患為成年男性,具坦尚亞旅遊史。 英國6/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,其中1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,另1例為其接觸者,該國迄今累計14例Ib型病例。  評估與建議:WHO於6/5召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第4次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升情形,確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持。WHO已將M痘現行建議延長至本年8/20。
items.description_en: Monthly update: Globally, from June 2022 to 26 June this year, 138 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 150,195 confirmed cases, including at least 348 deaths (CFR 0.2%). Globally this year up to week 26, 76 countries and territories have reported 29,451 confirmed cases: 25,085 in the African Region, 2,181 in the Region of the Americas, 1,488 in the European Region, 618 in the Western Pacific Region, 47 in the South-East Asia Region and 32 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: China reported a cluster in June with 4 cumulative clade Ib cases, one of which had travel history to the Congo and Mali; investigation is ongoing. Italy reported its first clade Ib case on 4 June, an adult male with travel history to Tanzania. The United Kingdom reported 2 new clade Ib cases on 19 June, one with travel history to the United Arab Emirates and the other a contact of that case; the UK has 14 cumulative clade Ib cases to date. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the 4th meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June to discuss the rise in Mpox in 2024. It confirmed that the event still constitutes a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. WHO has extended its current Mpox recommendations to 20 August this year.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球禽流感週報:柬埔寨新增2例H5N1,全球風險仍低
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported two new H5N1 human infections this week; the FAO, WHO and WOAH assessment rates global public health risk as low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:柬埔寨新增2例H5N1流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):共7國於2025/6/23-27期間新增24起H5N1疫情,荷蘭 10 起、美國/英國各4起、德國3起、丹麥/巴西/柬埔寨各1起。 日本於2025/6/25新增1起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,074(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於亞利桑那州及加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第25週計370個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感18例 (2003年迄今累計981*例)、H9N2流感14例(迄今累計142例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計54國家/地區通報1,940起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5病毒風險評估,H5 2.3.4.4b仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week. Human cases: Cambodia reported two new human H5N1 infections. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): seven countries reported 24 new H5N1 outbreaks between 23 and 27 June 2025, with the Netherlands 10, the United States and the United Kingdom 4 each, Germany 3, and Denmark, Brazil and Cambodia 1 each. Japan reported one H3N8 outbreak on 25 June 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,074 (1) herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in Arizona and California. At least 9,600 cattle-exposed humans have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: week 25 testing reports were provided by 370 sampling sites, with H5-positive detections at 3 sampling sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Oregon). Annual summary: Human cases: 18 H5N1 influenza cases (981* cumulative since 2003), 14 H9N2 influenza cases (142 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulative); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. (*Following WHO counting, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,940 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively by 54 countries and territories. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH assessed H5 virus risk on 17 April. H5 2.3.4.4b remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domesticated animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For the general public, infection risk remains low; for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate, depending on the type and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率3.78%,XFG占比升至22.7%,風險評估為低
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 3.78% in week 23, and XFG rose to 22.7% of cases by week 22; WHO preliminarily rates global risk as low.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第23週(6/2-8)全球陽性率3.78%,除西太平洋及東地中海區以外,其餘各區域陽性率皆增加。 WHO於6/25將變異株XFG列入監測中變異株(VUM),XFG於全球占比自第19週7.4%,至第22週(5/26-6/1)達22.7%,較其它流行株具增加優勢,且以東南亞區增幅最快,今年截至6/22累計有38國上傳XFG定序資料;迄無證據顯示嚴重度增加,惟免疫逃脫與傳播能力高,WHO初步評估對全球公衛風險為低。 中國疫情呈下降趨勢,第24週(6/9-15)定醫門診陽性率17.1%,低於過去3週,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方省份,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第25週(6/15-21)陽性率4.47%,低於過去4週,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 越南疫情經高峰後初步下降,第24週報告約2,600例病例,較前1週下降16.5%,另該國今年截至6/15累計報告約8,500例病例,為去年同期2.2倍。 泰國疫情下降,經第22週高峰,單週新增逾10萬例病例後,第24週新增5萬例,死亡數亦下降,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。  評估與建議:全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢;目前流行變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最多,其次為LP.8.1及XFG,其中XFG近期遽增。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴之檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持大流行期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 23 of 2025 (2–8 June), global positivity was 3.78%, with increases in all regions except the Western Pacific and the Eastern Mediterranean. On 25 June WHO designated the variant XFG as a Variant Under Monitoring (VUM). XFG's share of global cases rose from 7.4% in week 19 to 22.7% in week 22 (26 May–1 June), with a growth advantage over other circulating strains, fastest in the South-East Asia Region. As of 22 June this year, 38 countries had uploaded XFG sequencing data. No evidence of increased severity has been found so far, but immune escape and transmissibility are high, and WHO's preliminary assessment is that global public health risk is low. China: the epidemic is declining. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 24 (9–15 June) was 17.1%, lower than in the previous 3 weeks. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern ones, and the main variant is NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong: the epidemic is declining. Positivity in week 25 (15–21 June) was 4.47%, lower than in the previous 4 weeks, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also declined. Wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share. Viet Nam: after its peak, the epidemic has initially declined. About 2,600 cases were reported in week 24, down 16.5% from the previous week. The country reported about 8,500 cases this year as of 15 June, 2.2 times the same period last year. Thailand: the epidemic is declining. After a peak in week 22, when more than 100,000 new cases were reported in one week, 50,000 new cases were reported in week 24. Deaths have also declined, and NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward. The most prevalent variants currently are NB.1.8.1, followed by LP.8.1 and XFG, with XFG rising rapidly in recent weeks. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the pandemic.
