items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 衣索比亞/貝南-小兒麻痺症
items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞新增cVDPV2病例4例、貝南1例,巴基斯坦環境樣本WPV1增47件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported five new cVDPV2 polio cases for 12–18 June, four in Ethiopia and one in Benin, plus 47 WPV1 environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/12-18期間,cVDPV2新增2國共5例,分別為衣索比亞4例、貝南1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦47件,cVDPV1型陽性樣本新增吉布地8件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增巴布亞紐幾內亞2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 12 and 18 June, cVDPV2 increased by 5 cases in 2 countries: 4 in Ethiopia and 1 in Benin. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 47 in Pakistan, cVDPV1-positive samples increased by 8 in Djibouti, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 2 in Papua New Guinea.

items.headline_zh: 德國/奧地利-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 德國6/16報告85例沙門氏菌感染,多為0-4歲,覆盆莓腰果醬疑為源頭
items.summary_en: Germany reported 85 salmonellosis cases by 16 June, mostly aged 0–4; raspberry-flavoured cashew butter is the suspected source.
items.description_zh: 德國於6/16報告85例病例,病患多為0-4歲,發病日介於4-5月,奧地利亦有零星個案,至少30例個案住院治療,4例個案出現敗血症;當局調查覆盆莓口味腰果醬為疑感染源,產品已下架。
items.description_en: Germany reported 85 cases as of 16 June. Most patients are aged 0–4, with onset between April and May. Austria has also had sporadic cases. At least 30 cases were hospitalized, and 4 cases developed sepsis. Authorities investigated raspberry-flavoured cashew butter as the suspected source, and the product has been withdrawn from sale.

items.headline_zh: 日本/韓國/新加坡/香港-腸病毒
items.headline_en: Japan / South Korea / Singapore / Hong Kong SAR – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 韓國腸病毒就診陽性率2.6‰為今年最高,日本上升,新加坡下降
items.summary_en: South Korea's enterovirus clinic positivity rose to 2.6‰, this year's highest, while Japan also rose; Singapore's cases fell but remain above the same period of the past five years.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第23-25週(6/1-21)疫情更新,日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.25,為今年最高,惟低於近3年同期;韓國疫情上升,就診陽性率2.6‰,為今年最高,惟低於近2年同期;新加坡疫情已明顯下降,平均單日新增29例病例,仍高於近5年同期;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.2‰。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 23–25 (1–21 June): Japan's epidemic is rising, with an average of 0.25 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. South Korea's epidemic is rising, with clinic positivity of 2.6‰, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Singapore's epidemic has clearly declined, with an average of 29 new cases per day, still higher than the same period over the past 5 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.2‰.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡

items.headline_zh: 葡萄牙-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 葡萄牙A型肝炎今年截至5月累計504例,122例與性行為有關
items.summary_en: Portugal's hepatitis A outbreak, begun in February last year, has 504 cumulative cases as of May; 122 were sexually transmitted.
items.description_zh: 葡萄牙自去年2月爆發疫情,今年截至5月累計報告504例病例,其中,122例之感染途徑與性行為有關,病患多為男性,年齡介於18-44歲,基因型以IA為主,為2017-18年於歐洲MSM族群疫情之主要病毒株;ECDC評估參加6月同志遊行之MSM為高風險族群,呼籲進行疫苗接種。
items.description_en: Portugal has had an outbreak since February last year. As of May this year, 504 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 122 were transmitted through sexual behavior. Patients are mostly male, aged 18–44, and the genotype is mainly IA, the main strain of the 2017–18 outbreak among MSM populations in Europe. ECDC assesses MSM who attend June pride parades as a high-risk group and calls for vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 印尼4省報告8例漢他病毒症候群,所有病患均已康復
items.summary_en: Indonesia reported 8 hantavirus syndrome cases across four provinces, and all patients have recovered.
items.description_zh: 印共4省報告8例,分別分別來自日惹/西爪哇/東努沙登加拉/北蘇拉威西,所有病患均已康復。
items.description_en: Four provinces in Indonesia reported 8 cases, from Yogyakarta, West Java, East Nusa Tenggara and North Sulawesi. All patients have recovered.

items.summary_zh: 日本傳染性紅斑症近1週定點平均2.03例,為近10年同期最高
items.summary_en: Japan's erythema infectiosum sentinel average was 2.03 in early June, the highest for that period in 10 years, with Yamagata highest.
items.description_zh: 日本近1週(6/2-6/8)定點平均報告數為2.03例,較前一週2.28例下降,單週病例數為近10年同期以來最高,其中以山形縣5.73例為高,其次為北海道4.96例,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
items.description_en: In the most recent week (2–8 June), Japan's sentinel average was 2.03, down from 2.28 the previous week. The weekly case count is the highest for the same period in the past 10 years. Yamagata Prefecture was highest at 5.73, followed by Hokkaido at 4.96. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳近1週2,970例,今年逾3萬例,有嬰兒重症及死亡
items.summary_en: Japan reported 2,970 pertussis cases in the latest week, down 74, with over 30,000 cases this year and reported infant severe cases and deaths.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/9-6/15)通報2,970例,較前1週3,044例下降74例,病例數以東京都(189)為多,其次為琦玉縣(172)。今年迄今已超過3萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,疫情仍持續,且進入夏季後天氣炎熱,於室內活動時間增加,提高感染風險;另暑假將至,人群交流機會增加,疫情預期將持續。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (9–15 June), 2,970 cases were reported, down 74 from 3,044 the previous week. Tokyo Metropolis (189) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (172). So far this year, more than 30,000 cases have been reported, and severe infant cases and infant deaths have been reported. The epidemic continues. Hot weather after the start of summer has increased indoor activity, raising infection risk, and with summer holidays approaching and more social contact, the epidemic is expected to continue.

items.headline_zh: 美國/加拿大/墨西哥-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 加拿大今年麻疹3,381例為1998年來最高,墨西哥累計5,584例
items.summary_en: Canada's 3,381 measles cases this year are the highest since 1998, with Mexico at 5,584 cumulative cases and the US at 1,214 in 36 states.
items.description_zh: 北美疫情更新,美國截至6/19共36州報告1,214例及3例死亡,並報告23起疫情;加拿大截至6/23共9省3,381例,其中1例死亡,病例數以安大略省逾2,100例為多,其次為亞伯達省960餘例,該國近期呈下降趨勢,今年病例數為1998年以來最高;墨西哥今年截至6/7累計報告5,584例,其中2,153例確診及4例死亡,病例數以赤瓦瓦州逾2,000例為多。
items.description_en: North American measles update: As of 19 June, the United States has reported 1,214 cases in 36 states, including 3 deaths, and 23 outbreaks. As of 23 June, Canada has reported 3,381 cases in 9 provinces, including 1 death. Ontario has the most, with more than 2,100 cases, followed by Alberta with more than 960. Cases in Canada have recently trended downward, but this year's case count is the highest since 1998. As of 7 June this year, Mexico has cumulatively reported 5,584 cases, of which 2,153 were confirmed and 4 died. Chihuahua State has the most, with more than 2,000 cases.

items.summary_zh: 英國1例境外移入狂犬病死亡,59歲女性2月赴摩洛哥遭犬抓傷
items.summary_en: The UK reported an imported rabies death of a 59-year-old woman scratched by a dog during a February 2025 trip to Morocco.
items.description_zh: 英國報告1例境外移入死亡病例,為59歲女性,於今(2025)年2月前往摩洛哥旅遊期間遭犬隻抓傷,於6月上旬出現頭痛、無法行走、說話、睡覺及吞嚥等症狀後死亡。該國於2020-24年累計報告6例境外移入病例,當局呼籲民眾前往高風險國家應儘可能避免接觸犬貓及其他動物,並於旅行前諮詢是否需要接種狂犬病疫苗。
items.description_en: The United Kingdom reported an imported death: a 59-year-old woman who was scratched by a dog during a trip to Morocco in February this year. In early June she developed headache and was unable to walk, speak, sleep or swallow, and she died. The UK recorded 6 imported cases cumulatively in 2020–24. Authorities urge people travelling to high-risk countries to avoid contact with dogs, cats and other animals as far as possible, and to consult before travel about whether rabies vaccination is needed.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Morocco

items.summary_zh: 厄瓜多今年截至6/1鉤端螺旋體病771例,為去年同期3倍,亞馬遜8童死亡
items.summary_en: Ecuador reported 771 leptospirosis cases as of 1 June this year, triple the same period last year, and an Amazon outbreak killed 8 children.
items.description_zh: 厄瓜多今年截至6/1報告771例病例,為去(2024)年同期3倍,並高於去年全年病例數,年齡層主要分佈為20-49歲,以中部瓜亞斯省190例為最多,其次為西部馬納比省178例。另今年5月該國亞馬遜地區原住民社區亦爆發疫情,造成8名兒童死亡。
items.description_en: Ecuador reported 771 cases as of 1 June this year, three times the same period last year and more than the full-year total for last year. Most cases are among people aged 20–49. Guayas Province in central Ecuador has the most, with 190 cases, followed by Manabí Province in the west with 178. In May this year, an outbreak also occurred in Indigenous communities in the Amazon region, causing the deaths of 8 children.

items.summary_zh: 獅子山今年M痘4,098例、25例死亡,美國出現I型病例
items.summary_en: Sierra Leone has 4,098 confirmed Mpox cases and 25 deaths this year, and Massachusetts reported a clade I case, the fifth in the US.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山報告自今年初截至6/17累計4,098例確診病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:0.6%),該國已為非洲病例數第三多之國家,僅次剛果民主共和國及烏干達;迦納疫情上升,自今年截至6/18累計117例確診,7成病例分布於該國西部;賴比瑞亞報告今年截至5/31累計69例確診病例,包含IIa及IIb型病例,當局已發布警報,以防止社區及跨境傳播。 美國麻薩諸塞州6/17報告該州首例I型且為該國第5例病例,曾有中非旅遊史,當局研判該國與該州的傳播風險為低。
items.description_en: Africa update: Sierra Leone has reported 4,098 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 17 June, including 25 deaths (CFR 0.6%), making it the third highest in Africa, after the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Ghana's outbreak is rising: 117 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 18 June, with 70% in the west of the country. Liberia has reported 69 confirmed cases this year to 31 May, including clade IIa and IIb cases, and authorities have issued an alert to prevent community and cross-border transmission. United States: on 17 June Massachusetts reported the state's first clade I case, the fifth case in the country, in a person with a history of travel to Central Africa. Authorities assess the transmission risk for the country and the state as low.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,迦納共和國,賴比瑞亞,獅子山,烏干達,美國

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 斯洛伐克-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_en: Slovakia – Naegleria fowleri infection (primary amoebic meningoencephalitis)
items.summary_zh: 斯洛伐克11歲男童感染福氏內格里阿米巴死亡,溫泉渡假村預防性關閉
items.summary_en: An 11-year-old boy died in Slovakia of Naegleria fowleri infection after swimming lessons at a thermal resort, which has been closed as a precaution.
items.description_zh: 斯洛伐克報告1例死亡病例,為11歲男童,6月上旬曾至瓦達什溫泉渡假村參加游泳課程,6/14因中樞神經系統受損住院,17日死亡。當局已預防性關閉渡假村,另採集105件水樣中,有10件檢出阿米巴原蟲,惟仍在確認是否為福氏內里阿米巴。
items.description_en: Slovakia reported one death, an 11-year-old boy who attended swimming lessons at the Vadaš thermal resort in early June. He was hospitalized on 14 June with central nervous system damage and died on 17 June. Authorities have preventively closed the resort. Of 105 water samples collected, 10 were positive for amoebae, and it is still being confirmed whether they are Naegleria fowleri.

items.headline_zh: 巴基斯坦-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦克里米亞-剛果出血熱5例死亡,當局指與節慶接觸牲畜有關
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported five CCHF deaths, three in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and two in Sindh, which authorities link to livestock contact during the Eid period.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦報告5例死亡病例,分別為西北部開伯爾-普什圖省3例,東南部信德省2例,均為男性,年齡範圍為22-70歲,當局表示疫情與開齋節期間,民眾與大量牲畜接觸且缺乏預防措施相關,已啟動監測及防治措施,另呼籲民眾遵守當局訂定之疾病預防指南。
items.description_en: Pakistan reported five deaths: three in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province in the northwest and two in Sindh Province in the southeast. All were male, aged 22–70. Authorities say the cases are related to people having contact with large numbers of livestock during the Eid al-Fitr period without adequate preventive measures. Surveillance and control measures have been launched, and the public is urged to follow the disease prevention guidelines issued by the authorities.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨今年第7例H5N1,41歲女性危重入ICU,2023年來累計23例
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported its 7th H5N1 case this year, a critically ill 41-year-old woman in ICU, with 23 cases since 2023.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨報告今年第7例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西北部暹粒省博縣41歲女性,病患出現發燒、咳嗽、疲倦及呼吸困難等症狀,於6/23經檢驗確診,目前狀況危急,仍於ICU治療中。據調查,病患居住環境有病死雞隻,且於發病前曾接觸生病及死亡雞隻,當局刻正調查感染源,並持續監測疑病例,該國自2023年迄今累計23例病例。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported its 7th human H5N1 infection this year, a 41-year-old woman from Bo district in Siem Reap Province in the northwest. She presented with fever, cough, fatigue and difficulty breathing, and was confirmed by testing on 23 June. Her condition is critical and she remains in the ICU. The investigation found dead chickens at her residence, and that she had contact with sick and dead chickens before onset. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and continue to monitor suspected cases. The country has recorded 23 cases cumulatively since 2023.

items.headline_zh: 新加坡/韓國-茲卡病毒感染症
items.headline_en: Singapore / South Korea – Zika virus infection
items.summary_zh: 新加坡今年茲卡7例,6/18報告2例本土病例;韓國2例皆境外移入
items.summary_en: Singapore has 7 Zika cases this year, including 2 local cases reported on 18 June; South Korea has 2 cases, both imported.
items.description_zh: 新加坡6/18報告2例本土病例,今年迄今累計7例病例,今年病例數與去年同期相當,當局已加強相關監測措施。 韓國今年迄今累計2例病例,均為境外移入,該國自2016年以來累計報告41例病例,其中40例為境外移入。
items.description_en: Singapore reported 2 local cases on 18 June, and has recorded 7 cases so far this year, similar to the same period last year. Authorities have strengthened related surveillance measures. South Korea has recorded 2 cases so far this year, both imported. Since 2016, South Korea has reported 41 cases cumulatively, 40 of them imported.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年登革熱累計123,291例,雨季將續升;越南今年22,974例
items.summary_en: The Philippines has 123,291 dengue cases this year, with rising cases expected in the rainy season; Viet Nam has 22,974 cases and 5 deaths.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,於5/11-24報告6,720例病例,較前二週(6,192例)為多,今年迄今累計123,291例病例,預期病例數因雨季到來而持續上升。 越南今年迄今累計22,974例病例及5例死亡,其中,胡志明市疫情上升,尤其兒童醫院病例數快速增加,該市6/2-8報告320例病例,今年迄今累計8,595例病例。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines. From 11 to 24 May, 6,720 cases were reported, more than the 6,192 in the previous two weeks. So far this year, 123,291 cumulative cases have been reported, and cases are expected to keep rising with the arrival of the rainy season. Viet Nam has reported 22,974 cumulative cases and 5 deaths so far this year. In Ho Chi Minh City, cases are rising, with a rapid increase at children's hospitals; the city reported 320 cases in 2–8 June and 8,595 cumulative cases so far this year.

items.summary_zh: 全球今年屈公病約22萬例、80例死亡,巴西14萬1,436例居首
items.summary_en: Globally, about 220,000 Chikungunya cases and 80 deaths have been reported this year, with Brazil accounting for 141,436 cases.
items.description_zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告約220,000例病例及80例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西141,436例及阿根廷2,521例為多,亞洲之印度、斯里蘭卡及巴基斯坦等國報告逾33,000例,非洲塞內加爾亦有報告病例,另法屬留旺島/馬約特島分別報告逾51,000例及560例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境愈來愈利於病媒蚊活動,當地疾病傳播風險增加。
items.description_en: Globally this year, about 220,000 cases and 80 deaths have been reported cumulatively, in the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as in the French overseas territories of Réunion and Mayotte. The Americas have the most cases, with Brazil reporting 141,436 and Argentina 2,521. Asian countries including India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan have reported more than 33,000 cases. Senegal in Africa has also reported cases. Réunion and Mayotte have reported more than 51,000 and 560 cases, respectively. ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is increasingly favorable for vector mosquito activity, and the risk of local transmission is increasing.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,巴西,印度,法屬馬約特島,巴基斯坦,法屬留尼旺島,塞內加爾,斯里蘭卡

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東1例狂犬病死亡,去年全國170例,16年來首次上升
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported a rabies death after an untreated dog bite; China's 2024 cases (170) rose for the first time in 16 years.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省報告1例死亡病例,曾被犬隻咬傷,該傷人犬於咬傷人後5天死亡,病患未接受任何門診處置,於3個月後出現恐風、狂躁等症狀,發病3天後深度昏迷,醫治無效死亡。該國去(2024)年報告170例,其中143例死亡,為連續16年疫情下降後,首次上升,當局提醒民眾勿接近陌生動物,倘被犬貓咬傷,應立即就診,並定期為犬貓完整接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, reported one death. The patient had been bitten by a dog, which died 5 days after biting the patient. The patient received no outpatient treatment. Three months later, hydrophobia and agitation developed; 3 days after onset the patient fell into deep coma, and died despite treatment. China reported 170 cases last year, of which 143 were fatal. This is the first increase after 16 consecutive years of decline. Authorities remind people not to approach unfamiliar animals, to seek medical care immediately if bitten by a dog or cat, and to ensure dogs and cats are fully vaccinated on a regular schedule.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球禽流感週報:柬埔寨新增2例H5N1,中國1例H10N3,全球風險仍低
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported two new H5N1 human infections and China one H10N3 case this week; global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:柬埔寨新增2例H5N1流感人類感染病例,中國新增1例H10N3流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共8國於2025/6/13-20期間新增28起H5N1疫情,英國15起、巴西4起、柬埔寨3起、比利時2起、韓國/愛爾蘭/美國/芬蘭各1起。 挪威於2025/6/12-17期間新增2起H5N5疫情。 比利時於2025/6/20新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,073(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州及加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第24週計344個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、維吉亞州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  研究報導2022年於中國新發現雞源性之H3N3亞型,該病毒漸取代原先具優勢之H3N8亞型,並於雞隻間廣泛流行,病毒為重組株,其H3基因片段源於H3N8,N3基因片段源於H10N3,內部基因片段則源於H9N2。初步結果顯示,新型雞H3N3病毒於人類呼吸道上皮細胞及哺乳動物模型(小鼠/雪貂)中可產生更高病毒量及引發更強致病性,並在雪貂觀察到病毒可高效傳播,顯示新型雞H3N3流感病毒對於家禽產業及公共衛生具潛在威脅。 柬埔寨報告今年第6例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國東部柴楨省52歲男性,病患曾接觸生病及死亡雞隻,經醫療救護後,於6/19死亡,20日確診,為該國今年第5例死亡案例,自2023年迄今累計22例病例。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感17例 (2003年迄今累計980*例)、H9N2流感14例(迄今累計142例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計54國家/地區通報1,926起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week. Human cases: Cambodia reported two new H5N1 human infections, and China reported one new H10N3 human infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): eight countries added 28 H5N1 outbreaks between 13 and 20 June 2025, with the United Kingdom 15, Brazil 4, Cambodia 3, Belgium 2, and South Korea, Ireland, the United States and Finland 1 each. Norway added 2 H5N5 outbreaks between 12 and 17 June 2025. Belgium added one H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 20 June 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,073 (0) herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho and California. At least 9,600 cattle-exposed humans have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: week 24 testing reports were provided by 344 sampling sites, with H5-positive detections at 3 sampling sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Virginia). Other updates: A study reported that a chicken-origin H3N3 subtype was newly identified in China in 2022. This virus has gradually replaced the previously dominant H3N8 subtype and is widely circulating among chickens. It is a reassortant virus: its H3 gene segment comes from H3N8, its N3 segment from H10N3, and its internal gene segments from H9N2. Preliminary results show that the novel chicken H3N3 virus produces higher viral loads and stronger pathogenicity in human respiratory epithelial cells and in mammalian models (mice and ferrets), and efficient transmission was observed in ferrets, indicating the novel chicken H3N3 influenza virus poses a potential threat to the poultry industry and public health. Cambodia reported its 6th human H5N1 infection this year, a 52-year-old man from Chaizhen Province in eastern Cambodia. He had contact with sick and dead chickens, and after medical care he died on 19 June; he was confirmed on 20 June. This is the country's 5th death this year, and 22 cases have been reported cumulatively since 2023. Annual summary: Human cases: 17 H5N1 influenza cases (980* cumulative since 2003), 14 H9N2 influenza cases (142 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulative); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO counting, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 1,926 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively by 54 countries and territories. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment of H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domesticated animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For the general public, infection risk remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate, depending on the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.
items.area_zh: 柬埔寨,中國大陸(不含港澳)

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率3.5%,歐洲11國處高點,馬來西亞陽性率68%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 3.5% in week 22; Malaysia's positivity reached 68% and 11 European countries are at their peak.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第22週(5/26-6/1)全球陽性率3.5%,除非洲、西太平洋及東地中海區以外,餘區域陽性率皆上升。 馬來西亞疫情上升,5月下旬每日新增300例病例,較去年12月高峰為高,住院數亦上升,陽性率達68%;韓國疫情經4月高峰後,呈波動下降趨勢,第24週(6/8-14)新增93例病例,為第10週以來最低,陽性率為9.9%,以NB.1.8.1為主;日本第24週(6/9-15)定點平均報告數0.90例,較前一週0.92例下降,自年初以來,疫情持續下降;越南胡志明市疫情經4-5月高峰後,呈下降趨勢,第24週(6/9-15)報告32例,較前2週下降66%;香港第24週(6/8-14)陽性率4.89%,陽性率及定醫就診率持續呈下降趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,以NB.1.8.1為主要流行變異株。 美國疫情下降,自1月初每週1,000例死亡,下降至5月每週200例,第20週(5/11-17)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比最高,預測NB.1.8.1將成為主流變異株;加拿大疫情處低點,病例數自1月之每週近4,000例,下降至5月每週約500例,第22週(5/25-31)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比為高。  歐洲11國處疫情高點,第23週(6/1-7)門診陽性率10.2%,較前週高峰(10.9%)稍低,惟住院陽性率達5.9%,為今年新高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢;以NB.1.8.1變異株占比最高,LP.8.1占比次高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 22 of 2025 (26 May–1 June), global positivity was 3.5%, with increases in all regions except Africa, the Western Pacific and the Eastern Mediterranean. Malaysia: the epidemic is rising. Daily new cases were about 300 in late May, higher than the December peak; hospitalizations are also rising, and positivity reached 68%. South Korea: after a peak in April, the epidemic has fluctuated and declined. In week 24 (8–14 June), 93 new cases were reported, the lowest since week 10, with positivity of 9.9%, mainly NB.1.8.1. Japan: in week 24 (9–15 June) the sentinel average was 0.90, down from 0.92 the previous week, and the epidemic has continued to decline since the beginning of the year. Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: after a peak in April–May, the epidemic is declining; 32 cases were reported in week 24 (9–15 June), down 66% over the previous two weeks. Hong Kong: in week 24 (8–14 June), positivity was 4.89%. Positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates continue to decline, and wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 as the main circulating variant. United States: the epidemic is declining. Deaths fell from about 1,000 per week in early January to about 200 per week in May. Positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest shares; NB.1.8.1 is predicted to become the dominant variant. Canada: the epidemic is at a low point. Weekly cases fell from nearly 4,000 in January to about 500 in May. Positivity in week 22 (25–31 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for high shares. Europe: 11 countries are at the epidemic peak. Outpatient positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 10.2%, slightly lower than the previous peak of 10.9%, but hospital positivity reached 5.9%, the highest this year. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest share and LP.8.1 the second highest. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 安哥拉/尼日/貝南-小兒麻痺症
items.summary_zh: 6/5-11期間cVDPV2新增3例,分別來自安哥拉、尼日、貝南
items.summary_en: GPEI reported three new cVDPV2 polio cases for 5–11 June, one each in Angola, Niger and Benin.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/5-11期間, cVDPV2新增3國共3例,分別為安哥拉/日/貝南共和國各1例。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 5 and 11 June, cVDPV2 increased by 3 cases in 3 countries, one each in Angola, Niger and Benin.

items.headline_zh: 墨西哥/蒙特內哥羅-布氏桿菌病
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥哈利斯科州布氏桿菌病130例疑似、20例確診,蒙特內哥羅2例
items.summary_en: Jalisco State, Mexico, has 130 suspected and 20 confirmed brucellosis cases this year; Montenegro reported 2 cases, traced to farm sheep.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥哈利斯科州疫情上升,自今年截至6月中旬已累計130例疑及20例確診病例,當局已發布警示並啟動相關監測措施。該州去年報告310例疑及68例確診病例。 歐洲蒙特內哥羅5/11報告該國首例,截至6/10累計2例病例,據調查感染源為農場羊隻,當局已撲殺並採取相關措施。
items.description_en: Jalisco State in Mexico has seen rising cases. From the start of this year to mid-June, 130 suspected and 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities have issued a warning and launched related surveillance measures. The state reported 310 suspected and 68 confirmed cases last year. Montenegro in Europe reported its first case on 11 May, and as of 10 June, 2 cases had been reported cumulatively. The investigation found the source of infection was sheep on a farm, and authorities have culled the animals and taken related measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球/南蘇丹/阿富汗/安哥拉-霍亂
items.headline_en: Global / South Sudan / Afghanistan / Angola – Cholera
items.summary_zh: 全球截至5月近21萬例霍亂、2,754例死亡,5月病例較3月升35%
items.summary_en: WHO reports 210,000 cholera cases and 2,754 deaths globally through May, with May cases up 35% from March.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至5月累計報告達21萬例,2,754例死亡,其中,5月報告5.3萬例病例(死亡552例),較今年3月增加35%,各國CFR介於0-4.7%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共18個國家/地區,盛行率以南蘇丹、阿富汗、安哥拉為高,目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存平均570萬劑,高於安全水平(500萬劑),評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, cumulative cases this year reached 210,000 as of May, with 2,754 deaths. In May, 53,000 cases were reported (552 deaths), up 35% from March this year. Case fatality ratios range from 0 to 4.7% across countries. Cases were distributed across 18 countries and territories in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, with the highest prevalence in South Sudan, Afghanistan and Angola. The current global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine averages 5.7 million doses, above the safe threshold of 5 million doses. WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),阿富汗,安哥拉,南蘇丹共和國

items.summary_zh: 韓國沙門氏菌感染4起機構群聚共208例,感染源為機構麵包類產品
items.summary_en: South Korea has four facility clusters of salmonellosis totaling 208 cases as of 13 June, all linked to facility-supplied bread products, which were recalled.
items.description_zh: 韓國自5月發生2起忠清北道區機構群聚事件後,又新增2起群聚事件,分別於世宗特別行政區及全羅北道扶安郡,截至6/13累計4起208例病例,感染源皆為機構提供之麵包類產品,當局已召回產品,並監測相關機構。
items.description_en: After two facility cluster outbreaks in Chungcheongbuk-do in May, two more cluster outbreaks have been reported, in Sejong Special Self-Governing City and in Buan County, Jeollabuk-do. As of 13 June, 4 cluster outbreaks with 208 cumulative cases have been reported. The source in every case was bread products supplied by the facilities. Authorities have recalled the products and are monitoring the relevant facilities.

items.summary_zh: 美國李斯特菌症累計17例、3例死亡,疑為冷藏雞肉寬麵產品,廠商已召回
items.summary_en: The US has 17 Listeria cases in 13 states and 3 deaths as of 18 June; refrigerated chicken wide-noodle products are suspected, and they were recalled.
items.description_zh: 美國於6/18報告累計13州17例病例,其中3例死亡,經調查疑感染源為冷藏雞肉寬麵產品,廠商已召回產品。
items.description_en: As of 18 June, the United States has reported 17 cumulative cases in 13 states, including 3 deaths. Investigation suggests the source of infection is refrigerated chicken and wide-noodle products. The manufacturer has recalled the products.

items.headline_zh: 中國/日本/越南/新加坡/韓國/香港-腸病毒
items.headline_en: China / Japan / Viet Nam / Singapore / South Korea / Hong Kong SAR – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 中國5月新增逾5.2萬例腸病毒,河內市今年2,839例,新加坡日均33例
items.summary_en: China added over 52,000 enterovirus cases in May; Hanoi has 2,839 cases this year, and Singapore averages 33 new cases daily.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第22-24週(5/25-6/14)疫情更新,中國疫情上升,5月新增5.2萬餘例病例;日本疫情緩升,定醫平均病例數0.19,該國今年截至6/19累計報告5例Echo11型病例;越南河內市報告單週報告新增112例病例,該市自今年截至6/13已累計報告2,839例,較去年同期增加;新加坡疫情自高峰下降,平均單日新增33例病例,惟仍高於去年同期;韓國疫情持平,就診陽性率2‰;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.3‰。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 22–24 (25 May–14 June): China's epidemic is rising, with more than 52,000 new cases in May. Japan's epidemic is rising slowly, with an average of 0.19 cases per sentinel clinic. Japan has reported 5 Echo 11 virus cases so far this year, as of 19 June. In Hanoi, Viet Nam, 112 new cases were reported in one week, and the city has cumulatively reported 2,839 cases so far this year as of 13 June, an increase over the same period last year. Singapore's epidemic has declined from its peak, with an average of 33 new cases per day, still higher than the same period last year. South Korea's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 2‰. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.3‰.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡,越南

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國/美國-結核病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo / United States – Tuberculosis
items.summary_zh: 美國堪薩斯州結核病爆發,活動性68例、潛伏性100例
items.summary_en: Kansas, USA, has a tuberculosis outbreak with 68 active cases and 100 latent infections since last year; public risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國東北部伊圖里省於去年報告1.3萬例,其中343例死亡;美國堪薩斯州爆發疫情,自去年以來累計68例活動性結核和100例潛伏性結核感染,多數病例為去年5-8月間發現,持續有病例報告,惟對一般民眾風險仍為低。
items.description_en: Ituri Province in the northeast of the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 13,000 cases last year, including 343 deaths. In Kansas, USA, an outbreak has occurred: since last year, 68 active tuberculosis cases and 100 latent tuberculosis infections have been reported cumulatively. Most were identified between May and August last year, and cases continue to be reported, but the risk to the general public remains low.

items.summary_zh: 日本傳染性紅斑症近1週定點平均2.28例,為1999年以來最高
items.summary_en: Japan's erythema infectiosum sentinel average rose to 2.28 for 2–8 June, the highest weekly average since 1999; Tochigi was highest at 7.19.
items.description_zh: 日本近1週(6/2-8)定點平均報告數為2.28例,較前1週1.87例上升,單週平均報告數為1999年以來最高,其中以櫪木縣7.19例為高,其次為群馬縣6.32例,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
items.description_en: In the most recent week (2–8 June), Japan's sentinel average was 2.28, up from 1.87 the previous week. The weekly average is the highest since 1999, with Tochigi Prefecture highest at 7.19, followed by Gunma Prefecture at 6.32. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

items.summary_zh: 聖保羅市今年流感1,754例、175例死亡;韓國流感警報解除
items.summary_en: São Paulo city reported 1,754 influenza cases and 175 deaths this year, and South Korea lifted its flu epidemic warning after three weeks below threshold.
items.description_zh: 巴西首都聖保羅市今年截至6/11,報告1,754例,其中175例死亡,相較去年同期983例病例(77例死亡)為多,並以H1N1為主,當地高風險族群疫苗覆蓋率僅約40%,遠低於目標(90%),當局於公共運輸點設立接種站,加強接種工作。 韓國自去年12/20發布流感流行警告,於今年第1週99.8例達高峰後下降,春季再次上升,於第15週達峰(21.6例)後持續下降,已連續3週低於閾(8.6例),宣布解除流行警告。本流感季初期以A型為主,惟今年春季後改為B型。當局表示雖已解除警告,惟仍須注意夏季可能爆發新冠疫情。
items.description_en: São Paulo city, Brazil, reported 1,754 cases and 175 deaths from the start of this year to 11 June, up from 983 cases (77 deaths) in the same period last year. The main subtype is H1N1. Vaccination coverage in high-risk groups is only about 40%, far below the 90% target, and authorities have set up vaccination stations at public transport points to strengthen vaccination. South Korea issued an influenza epidemic warning on 20 December last year. After peaking at 99.8 in week 1 of this season, cases fell, rose again in spring, and peaked at 21.6 in week 15 before declining. Having been below the threshold of 8.6 for 3 consecutive weeks, the warning has been lifted. Influenza A predominated early in the season, but after spring it shifted to influenza B. Authorities say that although the warning has been lifted, a COVID-19 outbreak may still occur in summer.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳近1週3,044例,為2018年來新高,今年逾2.8萬例
items.summary_en: Japan reported 3,044 pertussis cases in one week, up 715 and the highest since 2018, with over 28,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/2-8)通報3,044例,較前1週2,329例上升715例,為2018年以來新高,病例數以東京都(194)為多,其次為琦玉縣(175)。今年迄今已累計逾2.8萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例。該國於6/13發布疫情監測報告,今年截至5月下旬病例數為去年全年病例數逾5倍,其中近60%為青少年。自2024年以來陸續於東京/大阪/烏取縣/沖繩縣檢出抗藥性菌株,另今年4月報告1例新生兒因感染抗藥性菌株出現呼吸衰竭、肺動脈高壓及腎衰竭等症狀死亡,當局表示病例數仍持續增加,所有年齡層皆須注意防範措施。
items.description_en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (2–8 June), 3,044 cases were reported, up 715 from 2,329 the previous week, the highest since 2018. Tokyo Metropolis (194) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (175). So far this year, more than 28,000 cumulative cases have been reported, and severe and fatal infant cases have been reported. On 13 June the country issued an epidemic surveillance report: as of late May this year, cases were more than five times the total for all of last year, and nearly 60% were adolescents. Drug-resistant strains have been detected since 2024 in Tokyo, Osaka, Tottori and Okinawa prefectures. In April this year, a newborn died after infection with a drug-resistant strain, with symptoms including respiratory failure, pulmonary hypertension and renal failure. Authorities say case numbers continue to rise, and precautions are needed in all age groups.

items.summary_zh: 蒙古今年麻疹逾6,500例、6例死亡,近3週新增逾3,600例
items.summary_en: Mongolia has over 6,500 measles cases and 6 deaths this year, with more than 3,600 added in three weeks; the Netherlands reported a death.
items.description_zh: 蒙古疫情嚴峻,今年截至6/12累計報告逾6,500例及6例死亡,該國僅近3週新增已超過3,600例,此波疫情主要影響未接種疫苗之學齡兒童,多數病例發生於10-14歲年齡層,由於疫情快速蔓延且接觸者眾多,尤其在首都烏蘭巴托等人口密集處,構成持續傳播風險。 荷蘭報告1例死亡病例,病患為具免疫系統相關疾病之成年人,於5月下旬住院,感染源仍不明。該國今年截至6/4累計報告437例,其中50例為境外移入,多數病例為境外移入個案及相關接觸者,目前皆為小規模群聚,尚未發生全國性疫情,該國上次發生大規模疫情為2013-14年。
items.description_en: Mongolia's outbreak is severe. As of 12 June this year, more than 6,500 cases and 6 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with more than 3,600 of the cases added in just the past three weeks. The outbreak mainly affects unvaccinated school-age children, with most cases aged 10–14. Because the outbreak is spreading rapidly and there are many contacts, especially in densely populated areas such as the capital, Ulaanbaatar, it poses a continuing risk of transmission. The Netherlands reported one death, an adult with an immune-system-related disease who was hospitalized in late May; the source of infection remains unknown. The country has reported 437 cumulative cases this year as of 4 June, 50 of them imported. Most are imported cases and their contacts, and currently these are small clusters; no nationwide outbreak has occurred. The country's last large-scale outbreak was in 2013–14.

items.disease_zh: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.headline_zh: 日本-發熱伴血小板減少綜合症(SFTS)
items.headline_en: Japan – Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS)
items.summary_zh: 日本三重縣男性獸醫感染SFTS死亡,曾治療感染貓隻,今年全國56例
items.summary_en: A male veterinarian in Mie Prefecture, Japan, died of SFTS after treating an infected cat; Japan has reported 56 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 日本三重縣報告1例死亡病例,為男性獸醫,於5月治療感染SFTS之貓隻後,出現呼吸困難等症狀就醫,數日後死亡,病患無蜱蟲咬傷痕跡,獸醫診所工作人員及貓飼主均未出現症狀。該國自2013年截至今年4月下旬累計報告1,071例,其中117例死亡;今年截至6/1累計報告56例,該國每年報告40-130例間,病例主要集中於西部地區。
items.description_en: Mie Prefecture in Japan reported one death, a male veterinarian. In May he treated a cat infected with SFTS, then developed symptoms including breathing difficulty and sought medical care; he died several days later. The patient had no tick bite marks, and staff at the veterinary clinic and the cat's owner have shown no symptoms. Japan has reported 1,071 cases cumulatively from 2013 to late April this year, including 117 deaths. As of 1 June this year, 56 cases have been reported. Japan reports 40–130 cases per year, mainly concentrated in western regions.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至6/1拉薩熱747例確診,142例死亡(CFR 19.0%)
items.summary_en: Nigeria has 747 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 142 deaths (CFR 19.0%) across 18 states as of 1 June this year.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,今年截至6/1累計報告18州747例確診,其中142例死亡(CFR:19.0%),近期病例數以西南部翁多州及東北部包奇州為多。
items.description_en: Nigeria's update: as of 1 June this year, 747 confirmed cases have been reported across 18 states, including 142 deaths (CFR 19.0%). Recently, the highest case counts have been in the southwestern Ondo State and the northeastern Bauchi State.

items.headline_zh: 伊拉克/喬治亞-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 伊拉克今年克里米亞-剛果出血熱125例、21例死亡;喬治亞南部3例
items.summary_en: Iraq has reported 125 CCHF cases and 21 deaths this year; Georgia's Samtskhe–Javakheti region has 3 cases, 2 fatal.
items.description_zh: 伊拉克疫情更新,今年迄今報告125例,其中21例死亡,以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)36例為多,病患多數為牲畜相關業者,該國規劃針對非法放牧、屠宰及牲畜販運採取更嚴的管制。 喬治亞南部薩姆茨赫-賈瓦赫蒂區今年迄今報告3例,其中2例死亡,該區人類感染病例占全國80%以上,該國已針對該區大型牲畜場域進行殺蟎劑處理,以減少蜱蟲數量。
items.description_en: Iraq's update: so far this year, 125 cases have been reported, including 21 deaths, with 36 cases in Dhi Qar Province in the south. Most patients are livestock-related workers. Iraq plans stricter controls on illegal grazing, slaughter and livestock trafficking. Georgia: in the Samtskhe–Javakheti region in the south, 3 cases have been reported so far this year, 2 of them fatal. This region accounts for more than 80% of human cases nationally. The country has applied acaricide treatment to large livestock areas in the region to reduce tick numbers.

items.summary_zh: 印度今年新冠病例逾7,000例,其中206例為XFG變異株
items.summary_en: India has reported over 7,000 COVID-19 cases this year, including 206 of the XFG variant, which has high immune escape but no evidence of greater severity.
items.description_zh: 印度疫情上升,今年截至6/12累計報告逾7,000例病例,其中206例為新興變異株XFG,其分布以西部馬哈拉施特拉邦(Maharashtra)為多,當局表示XFG具高度免疫逃脫特性,惟尚無證據顯示重症風險增加,該變異株別名Stratus,屬於Omicron後代,由LF.7及LP.8.1.2重組而成,最早於加拿大發現,自5月起,該變異株於印度等9個亞洲國家、英國等12個歐洲國家、美國及巴西之通報上升;血清研究顯示,XFG 變異株相對於 LP.8.1.1 之中和抗體效價下降約2倍,NB.1.8.1下降約 1.6 倍。
items.description_en: India's epidemic is rising. As of 12 June this year, more than 7,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 206 cases of the emerging variant XFG, most of them in the western state of Maharashtra. Authorities say XFG has strong immune-escape characteristics, but there is no evidence yet that the risk of severe disease has increased. The variant, also known as Stratus, is a descendant of Omicron and a recombinant of LF.7 and LP.8.1.2; it was first detected in Canada. Since May, reports of this variant have increased in 9 Asian countries including India, 12 European countries including the United Kingdom, and in the United States and Brazil. Serological studies show that neutralizing antibody titres against XFG are about 2-fold lower than against LP.8.1.1, and about 1.6-fold lower than against NB.1.8.1.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年登革熱累計5,739例、29例死亡,當局預估未來2個月續升
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has 5,739 cumulative dengue cases and 29 deaths this year, and authorities expect cases to keep rising for two months.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,今年6月迄今已報告1,394例病例,5月報告1,773例病例,今年迄今累計報告5,739例病例及29例死亡,當局評估未來2個月疫情仍呈上升趨勢;該國去年累計101,130例病例及573例死亡,2023年累計321,179例病例及1,705例死亡。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Bangladesh. So far in June, 1,394 cases have been reported, and 1,773 cases were reported in May. So far this year, 5,739 cumulative cases and 29 deaths have been reported. Authorities assess that cases will continue to rise over the next two months. Last year the country reported 101,130 cumulative cases and 573 deaths, and in 2023 it reported 321,179 cases and 1,705 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 法國普羅旺斯大區6/11報告今年首例本土屈公病,今年境外移入逾900例
items.summary_en: France's Provence region reported its first local Chikungunya case of the year on 11 June, with over 900 imported cases so far this year.
items.description_zh: 法國東南部普羅旺斯大區於6/11報告今年首例本土病例,個案近期無國外旅遊史,當局立即採取防治措施,降低疾病傳播風險;該國今年迄今累計報告逾900例境外移入病例。
items.description_en: In the southeast of France, the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region reported this year's first locally acquired case on 11 June. The patient had no recent overseas travel history. Authorities immediately implemented control measures to reduce the risk of transmission. France has reported more than 900 cumulative imported cases so far this year.

items.headline_zh: 美洲/美國/古巴/巴西-奧羅普切熱
items.headline_en: Americas / United States / Cuba / Brazil – Oropouche fever
items.summary_zh: WHO評估奧羅普切熱主要病媒區風險中,古巴首次發生疫情
items.summary_en: WHO rates Oropouche risk as moderate where the main vector is active; Cuba had its first outbreak, and Brazil reported vertical transmission cases.
items.description_zh: WHO於6/10公布風險評估報告,主要病媒為帕拉森斯庫蠓(Culicoides paraensis),其廣泛分布於美洲,疫情主要發生於亞馬遜雨林地區,2024年病例數明顯上升且持續傳播至原流行區以外地區,並首次於古巴發生疫情,且美國及歐洲部分國家亦報告境外移入病例,另巴西報告多起垂直傳染致新生兒小頭症等不良妊娠案例。人類病例主要透過病媒叮咬感染,目前尚未報告人際傳播病例,惟近期發生疑垂直感染案例,持續對其傳播機制進行研究。WHO評估於主要病媒活躍地區風險為中,存在次要病媒地區風險為低,主要病媒已知不存在地區風險為非常低。
items.description_en: WHO published a risk assessment on 10 June. The main vector is Culicoides paraensis, which is widely distributed in the Americas. Outbreaks have occurred mainly in the Amazon rainforest region. Case numbers rose markedly in 2024, and transmission has spread beyond the original endemic areas. An outbreak has occurred in Cuba for the first time, and some countries in the United States and Europe have reported imported cases. Brazil has reported several cases of vertical transmission leading to adverse pregnancy outcomes, including microcephaly in newborns. Human cases are mainly infected through vector bites, and no person-to-person transmission has been reported so far; recent suspected vertical transmission cases are being studied to clarify the transmission mechanism. WHO assesses the risk as moderate in areas where the main vector is active, low in areas with secondary vectors, and very low in areas where the main vector is known to be absent.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1,65歲女性無死禽接觸史,今年累計5例
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a new H5N1 case in a 65-year-old woman with no known contact with dead poultry; the country has 5 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國南部茶膠省波雷加巴縣65歲女性,病患出現發燒、咳嗽、氣喘及呼吸困難等症狀住院,經檢驗確診,目前於ICU治療中。據調查,病患無病死家禽接觸史,居家周遭及村莊亦未發生病/死雞或通報禽流感疫情,當局刻正調查感染源,並持續監測疑病例,該國今年累計5例,自2023年迄今已累計21例,其中10例死亡。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, a 65-year-old woman from Prey Kabbas district in Takeo Province in the south. She presented with fever, cough, asthma and difficulty breathing, was hospitalized and confirmed by testing, and is now in the ICU. The investigation found that she had no contact with dead poultry, and there were no sick or dead chickens or reported avian influenza outbreaks around her home or in her village. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and continue to monitor suspected cases. The country has recorded 5 cases this year, and 21 cases since 2023, 10 of them fatal.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球禽流感週報:中國新增3例H9N2,全球風險仍低
items.summary_en: China reported three new H9N2 human infections this week; the global public health risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:中國新增3例H9N2流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共5國於2024/12/6-2025/6/9期間新增113起H5N1疫情,日本99起、荷蘭6起、英國5起、美國2起、加拿大1起。 加拿大於4/1新增1起H5N5疫情。 日本於4/19新增1起H5N2疫情。 祕魯於2025/3/3-5/16新增8起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,073(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州及加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第23週計374個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感15例 (2003年迄今累計978*例)、H9N2流感14例(迄今累計142例)、H10N3流感1例(迄今累計5例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計54國家/地區通報1,895起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week. Human cases: China reported three new H9N2 human infections. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): five countries added 113 H5N1 outbreaks between 6 December 2024 and 9 June 2025, with Japan 99, the Netherlands 6, the United Kingdom 5, the United States 2 and Canada 1. Canada added one H5N5 outbreak on 1 April. Japan added one H5N2 outbreak on 19 April. Peru added 8 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 3 March and 16 May 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,073 (0) herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho and California. At least 9,300 cattle-exposed humans have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: week 23 testing reports were provided by 374 sampling sites, with H5-positive detections at 4 sampling sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Oregon). Annual summary: Human cases: 15 H5N1 influenza cases (978* cumulative since 2003), 14 H9N2 influenza cases (142 cumulative) and 1 H10N3 influenza case (5 cumulative); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Following WHO counting, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 1,895 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively by 54 countries and territories. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment of H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domesticated animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For the general public, infection risk remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate, depending on the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率3.19%,LP.8.1占比最高(27%)
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was 3.19% in week 21, and LP.8.1 is the top global variant at 27%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新: 2025年第21週(5/19-25)全球陽性率3.19%,除非洲以外,各區陽性率皆顯著增加。  中國疫情經高點後呈下降趨勢,第23週(6/2-8)定醫門診陽性率20.3%,低於過去兩週,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方省份,變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最高(5月份65%)。 香港疫情已呈明顯下降趨勢,第23週(6/1-7)陽性率6.95%,低於過去三週,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(90%)。 日本今年第23週(6/2-8)累計新增3,544例病例,定醫平均病例數0.92,較前兩週疫情略升,變異株NB.1.8.1佔多數(41%)。 孟加拉疫情上升,今年截至6/12累計新增240例病例,陽性率在第17週後顯著上升,變異株B.1.1.529佔多數。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,除非洲以外,各區域皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高(27%),NB.1.8.1占比次高(21%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 21 of 2025 (19–25 May), global positivity was 3.19%, with significant increases in all regions except Africa. China: after its peak, the epidemic is declining. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 23 (2–8 June) was 20.3%, lower than in the previous two weeks. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern ones, and NB.1.8.1 accounted for the highest share (65% in May). Hong Kong: the epidemic has clearly declined. Positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 6.95%, lower than in the previous three weeks, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also declined. Wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share (90%). Japan: 3,544 new cases were reported in week 23 (2–8 June) this year. The sentinel average was 0.92, slightly higher than in the previous two weeks, and NB.1.8.1 was the majority variant (41%). Bangladesh: the epidemic is rising. 240 new cases have been reported so far this year as of 12 June. Positivity rose significantly after week 17, and variant B.1.1.529 is the majority. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with increases in all regions except Africa. The current most prevalent global variant is LP.8.1 (27%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21%). WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 巴基斯坦/衣索比亞/葉門/查德/安哥拉/尼日-小兒麻痺症
items.headline_en: Pakistan / Ethiopia / Yemen / Chad / Angola / Niger – Poliomyelitis
items.summary_zh: 5/29-6/4期間cVDPV2新增15例,巴基斯坦WPV1新增1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 15 new cVDPV2 polio cases in five countries for 29 May–4 June, eight in Ethiopia, plus one new WPV1 case in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/29-6/4期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例,cVDPV2新增5國共15例,分別為衣索比亞8例、葉門3例、查德2例、安哥拉/日各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加2國共4件,分別為吉布地3件、索馬利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 29 May and 4 June, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 15 cases in 5 countries: 8 in Ethiopia, 3 in Yemen, 2 in Chad, and 1 each in Angola and Niger. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 2 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Djibouti and 1 in Somalia.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,查德,衣索比亞,尼日,巴基斯坦,葉門

items.headline_zh: 韓國/新加坡/日本/香港-腸病毒
items.headline_en: South Korea / Singapore / Japan / Hong Kong SAR – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 韓國腸病毒就診陽性率2.3‰為今年最高,新加坡日均37例
items.summary_en: South Korea's enterovirus clinic positivity hit 2.3‰, this year's highest, while Singapore averages 37 new cases daily after easing from its peak.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第21-23週(5/18-6/7)疫情更新,韓國就診陽性率為2.3‰,為今年最高點,惟仍顯著低於過去2年同期;新加坡疫情自高峰趨緩,平均單日新增37例病例;日本定醫平均病例數0.16,未進入流行期;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.3‰。
items.description_en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 21–23 (18 May–7 June): South Korea's clinic positivity was 2.3‰, the highest this year, though still significantly lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Singapore's epidemic has eased from its peak, with an average of 37 new cases per day. Japan's sentinel average was 0.16 cases, and its epidemic has not entered the epidemic period. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.3‰.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡

items.headline_zh: 匈牙利/英國/印度/中國-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Hungary / United Kingdom / India / China – Hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 匈牙利A型肝炎今年641例、為去年同期7倍,中國近1萬例
items.summary_en: Hungary has 641 hepatitis A cases this year, seven times the same period last year, and China has nearly 10,000 cases.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情更新,匈牙利疫情嚴峻,今年截至5月累計報告641例病例,為去年同期7倍;英國於6/12公布近期累計95例病例,其中58例住院,經調查推估有兩起群聚事件,其中1起之感染源為超市食品;印度南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala)於6/11報告51例病例,其中21例來自同一地區,懷疑為相同感染源,當局已發布疫情警報;中國今年截至5月累計報告近1萬例病例,為去年同期1.5倍。
items.description_en: Global update: Hungary's outbreak is severe. As of May this year, 641 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7 times the same period last year. On 12 June, the UK published that 95 recent cases had been reported cumulatively, 58 of whom were hospitalized. Investigation estimates two clusters, one of which had a food source from a supermarket. In Kerala State in southern India, 51 cases were reported on 11 June, 21 of them from the same area; they are suspected to share the same source, and authorities have issued an outbreak alert. China reported nearly 10,000 cumulative cases as of May this year, 1.5 times the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),匈牙利,印度,英國
items.area_en: China,Hungary,India,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 英國/巴基斯坦-傷寒/副傷寒
items.headline_en: United Kingdom / Pakistan – Typhoid and paratyphoid fever
items.summary_zh: 英國今年傷寒84例、副傷寒39例,2024年702例創史上新高
items.summary_en: The UK reported 84 travel-linked typhoid and 39 paratyphoid cases by March this year; 2024's 702 cases were a record high.
items.description_zh: 英國今年截至3月累計報告與旅遊相關共84例傷寒,以及39例副傷寒病例,另該國2024年傷寒/副傷寒合計報告702例病例,高於2023年8%,為史上新高;當局提醒於巴基斯坦流行之抗藥性菌株,呼籲民眾旅行前應接種傷寒疫苗。
items.description_en: The UK has reported 84 travel-associated typhoid cases and 39 paratyphoid cases cumulatively this year as of March. In 2024 the UK reported a combined 702 typhoid and paratyphoid cases, 8% higher than in 2023 and a record high. Authorities warn of drug-resistant strains prevalent in Pakistan and urge travellers to receive typhoid vaccination before travel.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Pakistan

items.summary_zh: 美國內布拉斯加州西南部5月兔熱病新增3例,病例數異常上升
items.summary_en: Southwestern Nebraska reported 3 tularemia cases in May, against only 6 in the past decade, and officials say the rise is abnormal.
items.description_zh: 美國內布拉斯加州西南部地區於5月份新增3例,該地區過去10年僅報告6例,當局表示病例數異常增加,該州之去年病例數高於平均,其中9月份新增7例,超過半數為嚴重度高之肺部型感染疾病。
items.description_en: In southwestern Nebraska, 3 cases were reported in May. The area had reported only 6 cases in the past 10 years, and authorities say case numbers have risen abnormally. Nebraska's case count last year was above average, with 7 cases added in September, more than half of them severe pulmonary infections.

items.summary_zh: 韓國今年猩紅熱截至5/24逾3,800例,較去年同期增2.5倍
items.summary_en: South Korea has recorded over 3,800 scarlet fever cases as of 24 May this year, an increase of 2.5 times on last year's same period.
items.description_zh: 韓國今年截至5/24累計報告3,800餘例,較去年同期增加2.5倍,上次發生大規模疫情為2017年,報告逾2.2萬例,該國每3-4年發生一次大規模疫情,惟新冠疫情期間因各項防護措施中斷流行週期,可能為今年病例數大幅增加原因之一。
items.description_en: South Korea reported more than 3,800 cases as of 24 May this year, an increase of 2.5 times over the same period last year. The last large-scale outbreak was in 2017, when more than 22,000 cases were reported. The country has large-scale outbreaks every 3–4 years, but during the COVID-19 period, various protective measures interrupted the epidemic cycle, which may be one reason for the sharp rise in cases this year.

items.summary_zh: 歐盟白喉病例2022年升至320例,2016-20年平均每年27例,德國今年1起
items.summary_en: EU diphtheria cases rose to 320 in 2022 from an average of 27 a year in 2016–20; Germany reported one outbreak this year.
items.description_zh: 歐盟公布於2022年病例數大幅增加,於2016-20年期間平均每年報告27例,2022年上升至320例,另2022-25年間,報告10例死亡病例。病患多為移民族群,另包含街友及毒品施用者等弱勢族群病例數亦上升。ECDC針對受此波疫情影響國家之白喉分離株進行基因體分析,顯示菌株間出現高度遺傳相性,發現 4種主要基因型,並表示多數病例於遷移過程中受到感染及傳播,惟尚未確定傳播之全部範圍及確切感染地點,故仍存在傳播風險。另德國今年報告1起疫情,其基因顯示與2022年疫情相關。
items.description_en: The European Union reported a substantial rise in cases in 2022: an average of 27 cases were reported per year in 2016–20, rising to 320 cases in 2022. Between 2022 and 2025, 10 deaths were reported. Most patients are migrants, and cases among vulnerable groups, including homeless people and people who use drugs, have also increased. ECDC carried out genomic analysis of diphtheria isolates from the countries affected by this wave, finding high genetic similarity among strains and identifying 4 main genotypes. ECDC says most cases were infected and spread during migration, but the full extent of transmission and exact places of infection have not been determined, so the transmission risk remains. Germany reported one outbreak this year, and its genetic profile is linked to the 2022 outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 美國肯塔基州2名嬰兒死於百日咳;日本今年逾2.5萬例
items.summary_en: Kentucky reported two infant pertussis deaths, with neither the infants nor their mothers vaccinated; Japan has over 25,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 美國肯塔基州報告2例嬰兒死亡案例,嬰兒及母親皆未接種疫苗,該案為該州2018年以來首起百日咳死亡病例,當局表示該州發病率呈上升趨勢,於去(2024)年報告543例,為2012年以來最高,今年迄今已報告247例。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/26-6/1)通報2,329例,較前1週2,660例下降331例,病例數以東京都(120)為多,其次為千葉縣/兵庫縣(109)。今年迄今已累計逾2.5萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例。
items.description_en: In Kentucky, USA, 2 infant deaths were reported, with neither the infants nor their mothers vaccinated. This is the state's first pertussis death since 2018. Authorities say incidence in the state is rising: 543 cases were reported last year, the highest since 2012, and 247 cases have been reported so far this year. Japan's epidemic continues: in the most recent week (26 May–1 June), 2,329 cases were reported, down 331 from 2,660 the previous week. Tokyo Metropolis (120) reported the most, followed by Chiba and Hyogo prefectures (109). So far this year, more than 25,000 cumulative cases have been reported, and severe infant cases and deaths have been reported.

items.headline_zh: 德國/波蘭/義大利/捷克/英國/玻利維亞/美國-麻疹
items.headline_en: Germany / Poland / Italy / Czech Republic / United Kingdom / Bolivia / United States – Measles
items.summary_zh: 德國巴伐利亞18例麻疹與國際活動相關;美國1,168例、3例死亡
items.summary_en: Bavaria, Germany, reported 18 measles cases linked to an early-May international event; the US has 1,168 cases and 3 deaths.
items.description_zh: 德國巴伐利亞邦爆發疫情,共報告18例,病例皆與當地5月初舉行之國際活動相關,其中12例為來自波蘭/義大利/捷克/英國之民眾;玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省報告7例,指標病例為22歲男性,具傳染力期間曾參加大型宗教集會,因具社區傳播風險,當局發布衛生警示。隨北半球夏季即將到來,預期旅遊及大型活動增加,將提升疾病傳播及跨境感染風險。 美國亞利桑納州報告該州今年首起疫情,4例病患來自該州東部納瓦荷郡,皆未接種疫苗,近期有境外旅遊史,均來自同一感染源;該國截至6/5共34州報告17起疫情,累計1,168例病例,其中137例住院及3例死亡。
items.description_en: An outbreak in Bavaria, Germany, has reported 18 cases, all linked to an international event held locally in early May; 12 of the cases were people from Poland, Italy, the Czech Republic and the United Kingdom. In Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia, 7 cases have been reported. The index case was a 22-year-old man who attended a large religious gathering during his infectious period. Because of the risk of community transmission, authorities have issued a health alert. As the northern hemisphere summer approaches, travel and large events are expected to increase, raising the risk of disease spread and cross-border infection. In the United States, Arizona reported the state's first outbreak this year: 4 patients from Navajo County in the east of the state, all unvaccinated, with recent overseas travel, all from the same source. As of 5 June, 34 states have reported 17 outbreaks in the country, with 1,168 cumulative cases, including 137 hospitalized and 3 deaths.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,捷克,德國,義大利,波蘭,英國,美國
items.area_en: Bolivia,Czech,Germany,Italy,Poland,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland,USA

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 菲律賓-人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年第一季愛滋病毒新增5,101例,較去年同期增50%
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 5,101 new HIV infections in the first quarter of this year, up 50% from a year earlier, with about 95% in men.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓6/4公布今年第一季新增5,101例感染病例,較去年同期增加50%,其中約95%為男性,病例年齡主要分布於15-34歲,主要傳播方式為男男性(MSM)行為,當局已加強藥物與匿名篩檢服務,並建議宣布為公共衛生緊急狀態。
items.description_en: The Philippines announced on 4 June that 5,101 new infections were reported in the first quarter of this year, 50% higher than the same period last year. About 95% were male, and most cases are aged 15–34. The main mode of transmission is sex between men (MSM). Authorities have strengthened access to medication and anonymous testing services, and a public health emergency declaration has been recommended.

items.summary_zh: 英國今年頭孢曲松抗藥性淋病14例,超過去年全年13例,其中6例XDR
items.summary_en: The UK has 14 ceftriaxone-resistant gonorrhoea cases this year, more than last year's 13, including 6 extensively drug-resistant.
items.description_zh: 英國今年截至5/19累積報告14例頭孢曲松(Ceftriaxone)抗藥性病例,高於去年全年病例數(13例),其中6例為廣泛抗藥性細菌(XDR),當局指出抗藥性病例多與亞太地區旅遊史相關,並訂定抗藥性淋病治療指引
items.description_en: As of 19 May this year, the UK has reported 14 cumulative cases of ceftriaxone-resistant gonorrhoea, exceeding the 13 cases reported for all of last year. Six of these were extensively drug-resistant (XDR). Authorities say resistant cases are mostly linked to travel in the Asia-Pacific region, and have issued treatment guidelines for drug-resistant gonorrhoea.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 西班牙/衣索比亞/摩洛哥-狂犬病
items.summary_zh: 西班牙44歲男性赴衣索比亞遭犬咬未接受暴露後預防,6/6死亡
items.summary_en: Spain reported an imported rabies death: a 44-year-old man bitten by a dog in Ethiopia who did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis; he died on 6 June.
items.description_zh: 西班牙報告1例境外移入病例,為44歲男性,於去(2024)年7月前往衣索比亞旅行期間腿部遭狗咬傷,僅進行傷口清洗,未進行狂犬病暴露後預防(PEP)治療,約10個月後出現發燒、情緒波動及恐水症等症狀住院治療,5/29確診後,注射免疫球蛋白,仍於6/6死亡。另患者妻子為唯一接觸者,已注射疫苗及免疫球蛋白,目前狀況良好。該國最近1例死亡病例為2019年自摩洛哥境外移入病例。
items.description_en: Spain reported one imported case, a 44-year-old man who was bitten on the leg by a dog during a trip to Ethiopia in July last year. He only had the wound cleaned and did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). About 10 months later he developed fever, emotional changes and hydrophobia, and was hospitalized. He was confirmed on 29 May, received immunoglobulin, and died on 6 June. His wife, the only contact, has received vaccine and immunoglobulin and is doing well. Spain's most recent rabies death was an imported case from Morocco in 2019.
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,摩洛哥,西班牙

items.summary_zh: WHO重申M痘仍為PHEIC,建議延長至8/20,新增7國病例
items.summary_en: WHO says Mpox remains a PHEIC, extends recommendations to 20 August, and notes seven new countries have reported cases since February.
items.description_zh: WHO於6/5召開M痘第4次IHR緊急委員會,全球疫情仍維持PHEIC,並將相關建議延長至今年8/20。會議中表示,自2024年迄今累計25國報告3.7萬餘例,其中125例死亡,非洲疫情仍嚴峻,以剛果民主共和國為多,每週通報2,000-3,000例疑病例,其次為烏干達/蒲隆地/獅子山。自今年2月以來,新增7國報告病例,包含歐洲2國(阿爾巴亞/北馬其頓)及非洲5國(衣索比亞/馬拉威/南蘇丹/坦尚亞/多哥)。WHO建議包含加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種等措施及作為。
items.description_en: WHO held the 4th meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on Mpox on 5 June. The global situation remains a PHEIC, and related recommendations have been extended to 20 August this year. The meeting noted that since 2024, 25 countries have reported more than 37,000 cases, including 125 deaths. African outbreaks remain severe, mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which reports 2,000–3,000 suspected cases weekly, followed by Uganda, Burundi and Sierra Leone. Since February this year, 7 new countries have reported cases: 2 in Europe (Albania and North Macedonia) and 5 in Africa (Ethiopia, Malawi, South Sudan, Tanzania and Togo). WHO recommends measures including strengthened surveillance, improved diagnostic capacity and promotion of vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 印尼今年截至5月逾5.6萬例、250例死亡;巴西1-5月近271萬例
items.summary_en: Indonesia reports over 56,000 dengue cases and 250 deaths through May this year; Brazil records nearly 2.71 million cases from January to May.
items.description_zh: 印疫情更新,今年截至5月,全國累計報告超過56,000例,其中250例死亡,該國去年疫情嚴峻,報告近25萬例,其中超過1,400例死亡。 巴西疫情更新,今年1-5月累計報告近271萬例,病例主要分布於該國東南部聖保羅州。
items.description_en: Indonesia update: as of May this year, nationwide cumulative reports exceed 56,000 cases, including 250 deaths. Last year's epidemic was severe, with nearly 250,000 cases reported, of which more than 1,400 were fatal. Brazil update: from January to May this year, nearly 2.71 million cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in São Paulo State in the southeast of the country.

items.headline_zh: 巴西/法屬馬約特島-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 馬約特島今年累計560例,住院增加;巴西1-5月逾15.8萬例
items.summary_en: Mayotte reported 560 chikungunya cases this year with rising hospitalizations; Brazil recorded over 158,400 cases from January to May.
items.description_zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情更新,今年第21週報告204例病例,較前1週144例上升42%,自第10週起住院病例數持續上升,今年迄今累計560例,病例主要分布於該島省會馬穆楚,以15-64歲個案為多,佔所有病例近80%。 巴西疫情更新,今年1-5月累計報告15萬8,400餘例病例,病例主要分布於該國西部馬托羅索州。
items.description_en: Mayotte (France) update: 204 cases were reported in week 21 this year, up 42% from 144 cases the previous week. Hospitalizations have risen continuously since week 10, with 560 cases reported year to date. Cases are concentrated in the island's capital, Mamoudzou, and people aged 15 to 64 account for nearly 80% of all cases. Brazil update: from January to May this year, more than 158,400 cases have been reported, mainly in Mato Grosso State in the west of the country.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年累計逾1.1萬例,以聖埃斯皮里圖州6,271例最多
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported 11,305 Oropouche fever cases this year, most in Espírito Santo with 6,271; 13,801 cases were reported last year.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告11,305例病例,病例多分布於該國東南部地區,以聖埃斯皮里圖州為多(6,271例),其次為里約熱內盧州(2,302例)及米納斯吉拉斯州(1,232例);該國去年全年累計13,801例病例。
items.description_en: Brazil update: 11,305 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, mainly in the southeastern part of the country. Espírito Santo State had the most (6,271 cases), followed by Rio de Janeiro State (2,302 cases) and Minas Gerais State (1,232 cases). The country reported 13,801 cases for the whole of last year.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大今年首例麻疹死亡為安大略省新生兒;該省已逾2,000例
items.summary_en: Canada's first measles death this year is an Ontario newborn infected in utero; the province has reported over 2,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 加拿大安大略省報告該國今年首例死亡案例,為該省西南部一名新生兒,於出生前經由母親垂直感染,母親未接種MMR疫苗,當局表示該新生兒除麻疹感染外,亦有其他非傳染病併發症。該省今年截至6/3已報告逾2,000例,其中超過1,700例確診,該省於去年5月報告1例兒童死亡案例。
items.description_en: Ontario, Canada, reported the country's first measles death this year: a newborn in the southwest of the province who was infected in utero through vertical transmission from a mother who had not received the MMR vaccine. Authorities said the newborn also had other non-communicable complications in addition to measles infection. As of 3 June, the province had reported more than 2,000 cases this year, of which over 1,700 were confirmed. The province reported one child death case last May.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉新增2例H5N1人類感染;美國乳牛累計1,073起疫情
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported 2 new human H5N1 infections this week; US dairy herds have 1,073 cumulative outbreaks across 17 states; global risk stays low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:孟加拉新增2例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共6國於2025/3/28-/6/4期間新增9起H5N1疫情,美國3起、巴西2起、菲律賓/柬埔寨/拉脫維亞/波蘭各1起。 日本於2025/1/17-2/21新增3起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,073(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州及加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第22週計339個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(加州、紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)10個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感15例 (2003年迄今累計978*例)、H9N2流感11例(迄今累計139例)、H10N3流感1例(迄今累計5例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計54國家/地區通報1,773起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: Bangladesh reported 2 new human H5N1 infections this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 6 countries reported 9 new H5N1 outbreaks between 28 March and 4 June 2025: the United States 3, Brazil 2, and one each in the Philippines, Cambodia, Latvia and Poland. Japan reported 3 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 17 January and 21 February 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,073 (1) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho and California. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 22, 339 sampling sites provided test reports, and 10 sampling sites in 3 states (California, New Jersey and Oregon) detected H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases: 15 H5N1 influenza cases (978* cumulative since 2003), 11 H9N2 influenza cases (139 cumulative) and 1 H10N3 influenza case (5 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases. Avian and animal cases: 1,773 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 54 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk populations.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率3.19%且近期上升;中國5月新增約44萬例
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity reached 3.19% in week 20 of 2025 and is rising; China reported about 440,000 cases in May, including 606 severe cases.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第20週(5/12-18)全球陽性率3.19%,除美洲以外,各區域陽性率皆顯著增加。 中國5月累計新增約44萬例病例,其中606例重症、7例死亡,於5/26達高峰後,每日新增病例數開始下降;陽性率上升至第21週達今年新高(23.8%)後,呈下降趨勢,南方省份陽性率高於北方,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(92%)。 香港第22週(5/25-31)陽性率9.27%,低於前兩週,疫情仍處高點,惟已呈明顯下降趨勢,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(94%)。 泰國今年截至5/27累計報告約21萬例病例,其中51例死亡,4月潑水節後,疫情持續上升,並以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(65%)。 印度今年截至4/6累計報告近5,000例病例,病例分布以喀拉拉邦(Kerala)及德里為多,並以變異株JN.1占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,東地中海、西太平洋、歐洲及東南亞區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高,NB.1.8.1占比持續上升。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 20 of 2025 (12–18 May), the global positivity rate was 3.19%, with significant increases in all regions except the Americas. China added about 440,000 cases in May, including 606 severe cases and 7 deaths. After peaking on 26 May, daily new cases began to decline. The positivity rate rose to this year's high of 23.8% in week 21 and has since declined; positivity in southern provinces is higher than in northern provinces, and the variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (92%). Hong Kong's positivity rate in week 22 (25–31 May) was 9.27%, lower than in the previous two weeks. The outbreak remains at a high level but shows a clear downward trend, and the sentinel clinic consultation rate has also declined. Wastewater surveillance data show the variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (94%). Thailand reported about 210,000 cases cumulatively this year as of 27 May, including 51 deaths. After the Songkran festival in April, cases continued to rise, with the variant NB.1.8.1 accounting for the largest share (65%). India reported nearly 5,000 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, mainly in Kerala and Delhi, with the variant JN.1 accounting for the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions. The variant LP.8.1 currently accounts for the largest share globally, while the share of NB.1.8.1 continues to rise. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年截至5月19日累計104例沙門氏菌感染,1例死亡
items.summary_en: The US has reported 104 Salmonella infections from 35 states this year as of 19 May, including one death and 25 hospitalizations; authorities are investigating links to backyard poultry.
items.description_zh: 美國今年截至5/19累計35州報告104例病例,其中1例死亡,25例住院,發病日介於2/9-5/3;當局已啟動與自養家禽者之相關調查及防治措施,並呼籲民眾應於接觸自養家禽後,加強個人衛生。
items.description_en: As of 19 May this year, 35 US states have reported 104 cases cumulatively, including 1 death and 25 hospitalizations; onset dates ranged from 9 February to 3 May. Authorities have launched investigations and control measures related to backyard poultry, and urge the public to strengthen personal hygiene after contact with backyard poultry.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 全球/巴基斯坦-小兒麻痺症
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦今年野生型小兒麻痺病例已達11例,疫情有擴大趨勢
items.summary_en: Pakistan has reported 11 wild poliovirus type 1 cases this year, including a new case in Gilgit-Baltistan, indicating expanding transmission.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/22-28期間,cVDPV2新增葉門6例,cVDPV3新增幾內亞1例,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗5件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加4國共5件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞2件、德國/阿爾及利亞/奈及利亞各1件。 巴基斯坦今年迄今,感染WPV1病例已達 11 例,以開伯爾-普什圖省(5例)及信德省(4例)為多,近期於北部吉爾吉特-巴提斯坦(Gilgit-Baltistan)地區確診1例23個月大之男童病例,其未離開該地區,亦有疫苗接種紀錄,當地已8年無案例,顯示疫情有擴大趨勢。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 22 and 28 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 6 in Yemen, cVDPV3 by 1 in Guinea, and WPV1 by 2 in Pakistan. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 5 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 5 across 4 countries: 2 in Papua New Guinea, and 1 each in Germany, Algeria and Nigeria. Pakistan has reported 11 WPV1 cases so far this year, mainly in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province (5 cases) and Sindh Province (4 cases). Recently, 1 case was confirmed in a 23-month-old boy in the northern Gilgit-Baltistan region. He had not left the area and had a record of vaccination. The area had been free of cases for 8 years, indicating an expanding outbreak.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),幾內亞,巴基斯坦,葉門

items.summary_zh: 新加坡日均47例降溫;中國第19-20週新增約1.9萬例
items.summary_en: Singapore's enterovirus outbreak is cooling at about 47 cases a day; China recorded about 19,000 cases in weeks 19–20, up 26% from the previous two weeks.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第20-21週(5/11-24)疫情更新,新加坡疫情逐漸降溫,平均單日新增47例病例,低於去年同期(50例);日本定醫平均病例數0.18,為今年最高,惟尚未進入流行期;韓國就診陽性率為1.7‰,較前週(2.2‰)略降;香港處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.3‰;中國第19-20週(5/5-18)新增約1.9萬例病例,較前兩週上升26%,惟低於過去3年同期。
items.description_en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 20–21 (11–24 May): in Singapore the outbreak is gradually cooling, with an average of 47 new cases per day, below the 50 cases in the same period last year. Japan's average number of cases per sentinel clinic was 0.18, the highest this year, but the country has not yet entered an epidemic period. Korea's positivity rate among clinic visits was 1.7‰, slightly down from 2.2‰ the previous week. Hong Kong is at a low point, with a positivity rate among clinic visits of 0.3‰. China reported about 19,000 new cases in weeks 19–20 (5–18 May), up 26% from the previous two weeks but lower than the same period in the past three years.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡

items.summary_zh: 全球霍亂今年截至4月累計15.7萬例、2,148例死亡,風險評估為非常高
items.summary_en: WHO reports 157,035 cholera cases and 2,148 deaths worldwide through April this year; global transmission risk is rated very high.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至4月累計報告已達157,035例,2,148例死亡,其中,4月報告逾3.7萬例病例(死亡561例),較今年3月增加5%,各國CFR介於0-5.3%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共18個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及剛果民主共和國為多,目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存360萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that as of April this year, 157,035 cases and 2,148 deaths have been reported cumulatively worldwide. In April alone, more than 37,000 cases (561 deaths) were reported, a 5% increase from March this year, with CFRs between 0 and 5.3% across countries. Cases are distributed across 18 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 3.6 million doses, below the safety level of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection. The global transmission risk is assessed as very high.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,南蘇丹共和國
