items.headline_zh: 奈及利亞-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年2至5月初逾4,000例,逾六成為C型腦膜炎雙球菌
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported over 4,000 meningitis cases from February to early May this year; over 60% of cases were serogroup C meningococcal disease, mostly in children.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞今年2至5月上旬報告4,000餘例,病例主要集中於西北部凱比州和索科托州,多數病例為兒童,經檢驗超過60%病例係由腦膜炎雙球菌C型所引起。
items.description_en: Nigeria reported more than 4,000 cases from February to early May this year. Cases were mainly concentrated in Kebbi and Sokoto States in the northwest, and most cases were children. Laboratory testing showed that more than 60% of cases were caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C.

items.summary_zh: 日本近1週定點平均報告1.97例,較前週下降,群馬縣6.32例最高
items.summary_en: Japan's average reports per sentinel site for erythema infectiosum fell to 1.97 cases in the week of 19–25 May; Gunma had the highest, at 6.32.
items.description_zh: 日本近1週(5/19-5/25)定點平均報告數為1.97例,較前一週2.05例下降,其中以群馬縣6.32例為高,其次為櫪木縣6.19例,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
items.description_en: In Japan, the average number of reports per sentinel site in the most recent week (19–25 May) was 1.97 cases, down from 2.05 cases the previous week. Gunma Prefecture had the highest figure at 6.32 cases, followed by Tochigi Prefecture at 6.19 cases. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

items.summary_zh: 美洲7國百日咳上升,美國逾1萬例、5例死亡;日本單週2,660例
items.summary_en: PAHO issued a pertussis alert as seven Americas countries see rising cases, with the US over 10,000 and 5 deaths; Japan reported 2,660 cases in one week.
items.description_zh: PAHO於5/31發布百日咳流病警報,美洲7國病例數呈上升趨勢,其中,以美國逾1萬例病例及5例死亡最為嚴峻,餘有巴西/墨西哥/厄瓜多/祕魯/哥倫比亞/巴拉圭,病例數在37-1,634例間。該地區於2012年病例數達高峰後,持續下降,惟於2023年開始上升,去年報告4.4萬例,病例數增加與新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下降相關,PAHO呼籲各國加強監測及加強疫苗接種等措施。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/19-25)通報2,660例,較前1週2,299例增加360餘例,持續創2018年以來新高,新增病例數以新潟縣(148)為多,其次為兵庫縣(139)。今年迄今已累計逾2.2萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,專家表示此次疫情嚴峻與易感性族群增加相關,由於疫情期間防護措施,導致對多種呼吸道傳染病免疫力下降,且抗藥性菌株於去年秋天以來持續傳播。今年報告2例未達接種月齡之新生兒死亡病例,且此次疫情集中於10多歲青少年族群,建議常與家中嬰幼兒接觸之家庭成員接種疫苗。
items.description_en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.
items.area_zh: 巴西,哥倫比亞,厄瓜多,日本,墨西哥,巴拉圭共和國,秘魯,美國

items.summary_zh: 美國今年麻疹1,088例含3例死亡;吉爾吉斯逾7,300例
items.summary_en: The US reported 1,088 measles cases in 33 states this year, including 3 deaths; Kyrgyzstan has over 7,300 cases, 94% unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 美洲:美國今年截至5/29報告14起疫情,累計33州1,088例,其中133例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾740例為多,近期德州地區疫情已趨緩,惟其他州仍持續報告零星病例,南達科他州報告今年首例;墨西哥今年截至5/12報告逾 4,200例,其中1,520例確診及4例死亡,以奇瓦瓦州(1,434)為多。 亞洲:吉爾吉斯今年截至5/27累計報告逾7,300例,主要分布於首都比斯凱克,另北部楚河州及南部奧什州病例數亦較高,疫情分布廣泛,遍及都會及農村地區,94%病例未接種疫苗;蒙古今年迄今報告3,100餘例,病例主要集中於校園,當局呼籲學生、教職員及與學齡族群密切接觸人員接種疫苗。 非洲:摩洛哥今年累計報告超過40,000例,其中79例死亡(CFR:0.2%),目前當局持續進行全國性疫苗接種。
items.description_en: Americas: as of 29 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,088 cases cumulatively across 33 states, including 133 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 740 cases. The Texas outbreak has recently slowed, but other states continue to report sporadic cases, and South Dakota reported its first case this year. As of 12 May, Mexico had reported over 4,200 cases this year, including 1,520 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, mainly in Chihuahua State (1,434). Asia: as of 27 May this year, Kyrgyzstan has reported over 7,300 cases cumulatively, mainly in the capital Bishkek, with high numbers also in the northern Chui Region and the southern Osh Region. The outbreak is widespread across urban and rural areas, and 94% of cases were unvaccinated. Mongolia has reported over 3,100 cases so far this year, concentrated in schools, and authorities urge students, school staff and people in close contact with school-age children to be vaccinated. Africa: Morocco has reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively this year, including 79 deaths (CFR 0.2%), and nationwide vaccination is ongoing.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓中部錫基霍爾島報告6例類鼻疽,其中2例死亡
items.summary_en: Siquijor Island in central Philippines reported 6 melioidosis cases, including 2 deaths; initially suspected as glanders, later lab-confirmed.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓中部錫基霍爾島報告6例病例(前已掌握),其中2例死亡,病患最初被懷疑鼻疽(Glanders),後經實驗室確診為類鼻疽。當局已啟動調查及監測措施,並呼籲有暴露於泥濘及淹水風險者,應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,以降低接觸污染源之風險。
items.description_en: Siquijor Island in central Philippines reported 6 cases (already identified), 2 of which were fatal. The patients were initially suspected to have glanders, but laboratory testing confirmed melioidosis. Authorities have launched investigation and surveillance measures and urge people at risk of exposure to mud and flooding to wear protective equipment such as boots and gloves to reduce the risk of contact with the contaminated source.

items.summary_zh: 美國德州71歲女性以露營車自來水鼻沖洗後死亡
items.summary_en: A 71-year-old Texas woman died after nasal rinsing with inadequately disinfected camper-van tap water; CDC detected the amoeba in her spinal fluid.
items.description_zh: 美國於5/29報告德州1例死亡病例,為71歲女性,無潛在病史,病患使用露營車供水系統之自來水進行鼻腔沖洗後,4日內出現發燒、頭痛及精神意識改變等嚴重神經症狀,經治療出現癲癇症狀,並於發病後8日死亡。CDC於病患腦脊髓液中檢出福氏內里阿米巴原蟲,惟於露營車採樣之自來水檢體並未檢出,該自來水未消毒完全。該國於1962-2023年期間報告164例,其中160例死亡(CFR:97.5%),每年報告約10例以下。當局建議使用蒸餾水、消毒水等進行鼻腔沖洗,另訂定露營車用水安全使用及儲存建議文件。
items.description_en: The United States reported one death in Texas on 29 May: a 71-year-old woman with no underlying conditions who had used tap water from a camper van's water supply system for nasal rinsing. Within 4 days she developed fever, headache and altered consciousness, and other severe neurological symptoms. Under treatment she had seizures, and she died 8 days after onset. CDC detected Naegleria fowleri in her cerebrospinal fluid, but it was not detected in the tap water samples collected from the camper van, which had not been fully disinfected. The country reported 164 cases between 1962 and 2023, of which 160 were fatal (CFR 97.5%), with about 10 or fewer cases reported each year. Authorities recommend rinsing the nose with distilled water or disinfected water, and have issued guidance on the safe use and storage of water in camper vans.

items.headline_zh: 西班牙-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 西班牙薩拉曼卡省1例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,70歲男性病況穩定
items.summary_en: Salamanca Province, Spain, reported one Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever case in a 70-year-old man, who is stable in hospital after a tick bite.
items.description_zh: 西班牙西部薩拉曼卡省(Salamanca)報告1例病例,為70歲男性,目前已入院隔離治療,病況穩定,病患曾被蜱蟲叮咬,當局已啟動接觸者監測,該省於去年報告1例死亡病例。
items.description_en: Salamanca Province in western Spain reported one case, in a 70-year-old man, who has been admitted to hospital for isolation and treatment; his condition is stable. The patient had been bitten by a tick. Authorities have launched contact monitoring. The province reported one death case last year.

items.summary_zh: 德國巴伐利亞邦2例腦炎,1例死亡,皆為玻那病毒1型神經感染症狀
items.summary_en: Two men in their 50s with acute encephalitis in Bavaria, Germany, show Borna disease virus 1 infection symptoms; one died and one is hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 德國東南部巴伐利亞邦報告2例急性腦炎病例,其中1例死亡,1例重症住院治療中,病患皆為50多歲男性,並居住於上巴伐利亞地區,均出現玻那病毒1型(BoDV-1)神經性感染症狀,當局已啟動感染源調查。鼩鼱被認為是BoDV-1天然宿主,經由排泄物及唾液傳播病毒,目前人類感染機制不明,推測與環境暴露相關。該國於2018年報告首例,並自2020年起列為法定傳染病,迄今已報告55例病例,多集中於巴伐利亞邦。
items.description_en: Two cases of acute encephalitis were reported in Bavaria in southeastern Germany, one of which was fatal and one severe case is hospitalized for treatment. Both patients are men in their 50s living in Upper Bavaria, and both showed neurological symptoms of Borna disease virus 1 (BoDV-1) infection. Authorities have launched an investigation into the source of infection. Shrews are considered the natural host of BoDV-1, and the virus is transmitted through excreta and saliva. The mechanism of human infection is currently unknown and is presumed to be related to environmental exposure. Germany reported its first case in 2018 and has made the infection notifiable since 2020; 55 cases have been reported to date, mostly concentrated in Bavaria.

items.summary_zh: 泰國沙繳府1例炭疽病,52歲男性曾食生牛肉;今年全國5例
items.summary_en: A 52-year-old man in Sa Kaeo Province, eastern Thailand, has anthrax after eating raw beef; Thailand has reported 5 cases this year, including 1 death.
items.description_zh: 泰國東部沙繳府(Sa Kaeo)報告1例病例,為52歲男性,因頭/頸/四肢出現潰瘍症狀住院,經檢驗確診。據調查,病患曾於發病前一週食用生牛肉,當局已啟動調查及監測措施,並呼籲民眾避免接觸及食用生病及死亡動物。該國今年累積報告5例,其中1例死亡,本案為該府首起疫情。
items.description_en: Sa Kaeo Province in eastern Thailand reported one case, in a 52-year-old man who was hospitalized with ulcers on the head, neck and limbs and confirmed by testing. Investigation found that the patient had eaten raw beef in the week before onset. Authorities have launched investigation and surveillance measures and urge people to avoid contact with, and consumption of, sick or dead animals. The country has reported 5 cases this year, including 1 death; this is the province's first outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 美國密西根州2024年萊姆病1,215例,為2020年的2.7倍
items.summary_en: Michigan reported 1,215 Lyme disease cases in 2024, 2.7 times the 452 cases in 2020, as the blacklegged tick's range expands.
items.description_zh: 美國密西根州於2024年報告1,215例病例,為2020年452例之 2.7倍,疫情呈上升趨勢,萊姆病主要是由肩板硬蜱 (Ixodes scapularis)傳播,其分布範圍逐漸擴大,當局建議民眾採取預防措施,以避免蜱蟲叮咬。
items.description_en: Michigan reported 1,215 cases in 2024, 2.7 times the 452 cases reported in 2020, showing a rising trend. Lyme disease is mainly transmitted by the blacklegged tick (Ixodes scapularis), whose distribution range is gradually expanding. Authorities recommend that the public take preventive measures to avoid tick bites.

items.summary_zh: 法屬留尼旺島今年累計約5.2萬例屈公病、15例死亡
items.summary_en: Réunion reported about 52,000 chikungunya cases and 15 deaths this year; cases peaked in week 13 and have since fallen below 2,000 a week.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島疫情更新,今年疫情於第13週逾7,500例病例達高峰後,自第18週病例數降至低於2,000例,今年迄今累計約52,000例病例及15例死亡,死亡及重症病例均以65歲以上罹患合併症個案為多,另累計71例重症病例中, 3個月以下嬰兒占23例。
items.description_en: Update on the outbreak in Réunion (France): this year's cases peaked at more than 7,500 in week 13, and after week 18 weekly cases fell to below 2,000. So far this year, about 52,000 cases and 15 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Most deaths and severe cases occurred among people aged 65 and over with comorbidities. Of the 71 severe cases reported cumulatively, 23 were infants under 3 months old.

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年截至第20週累計221例黃熱病,89例死亡,為去年同期8倍
items.summary_en: The Americas have reported 221 yellow fever cases and 89 deaths through week 20 this year, about eight times the same period last year; most cases were unvaccinated.
items.description_zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至第20週累計221例病例(89例死亡),今年病例數約為去年同期27例之8倍,分布於巴西、哥倫比亞、秘魯、玻利維亞及厄瓜多,去年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟今年已傳播至前揭地區以外之巴西聖保羅州及哥倫比亞托利馬省,且以未接種疫苗個案為多,評估美洲地區(尤其流行國家)風險為高。
items.description_en: Americas regional update: as of week 20 this year, 221 cases (89 deaths) have been reported cumulatively. This year's case count is about eight times the 27 cases reported in the same period last year. Cases are distributed in Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia and Ecuador. Last year's cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but this year the disease has spread beyond those areas, to São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia, and most cases were unvaccinated. The risk for the Americas, especially in endemic countries, is assessed as high.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,巴西,哥倫比亞,厄瓜多,秘魯

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球2國新增2例cVDPV2小兒麻痺,蘇丹與奈及利亞各1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 2 new cVDPV2 polio cases in 2 countries in the week of 15–21 May, one each in Sudan and Nigeria, plus 3 positive environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/15-21期間,cVDPV2新增2國共2例,分別為蘇丹及奈及利亞各1例。環境樣本部分,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為德國/奈及利亞/巴布亞紐幾內亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 15 and 21 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 2 in 2 countries, one each in Sudan and Nigeria. For environmental samples, cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries, one each in Germany, Nigeria and Papua New Guinea.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年累計逾2.1萬例確診,非洲占1.8萬例
items.summary_en: Mpox: 21,655 confirmed cases in 74 countries and regions this year through week 22, 18,107 in Africa; WHO says it remains a public health emergency of international concern.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年5/29累計133國/地區報告14萬2,367例確診病例,其中至少325例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第22週累計74國/地區報告2萬1,655例確診病例,其中,非洲區1萬8,107例、美洲區1,787例、西太平洋區477例、歐洲區1218例、東南亞區37例及東地中海區29例。  其他更新:  非洲烏干達近幾週疫情呈下降趨勢,惟仍嚴峻,每週新增病例數約200例;蒲隆地每週新增病例數持續少於50例。WHO表示剛果民主共和國迄今仍為非洲疫情最嚴重之國家,由於檢測和確診能力下降,可能低報病例數,應審慎評估疫情趨勢。  評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。
items.description_en: Monthly update: as of 29 May this year, 133 countries and regions have reported 142,367 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 325 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 22 this year, 74 countries and regions have reported 21,655 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 18,107 in the African Region, 1,787 in the Region of the Americas, 477 in the Western Pacific Region, 1,218 in the European Region, 37 in the South-East Asia Region and 29 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: in Africa, the outbreak in Uganda has declined in recent weeks but remains severe, with about 200 new cases per week; new weekly cases in Burundi have remained below 50. WHO says the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the most affected country in Africa; because testing and diagnostic capacity has declined, case numbers may be underreported, so trends should be assessed with caution. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccines and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).
items.area_zh: 蒲隆地,剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨、中國各新增1例H5N1人類感染;全球53國通報1,740起禽流感疫情
items.summary_en: Cambodia and China each reported one new human H5N1 infection this week; 53 countries have reported 1,740 avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週柬埔寨/中國各新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共5國於5/24-/5/30 期間新增13起H5N1疫情,美國8起、加拿大2起、瑞典/立陶宛/荷蘭各1起。 美國於5/30新增4起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,072(0)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第21週計339個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中2州(紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)17個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感13例 (2003年迄今累計976*例)、H9N2流感11例(迄今累計139例)、H10N3流感1例(迄今累計5例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計53國家/地區通報1,740起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: Cambodia and China each reported one new human H5N1 infection this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 5 countries reported 13 new H5N1 outbreaks between 24 and 30 May 2025: the United States 8, Canada 2, and one each in Sweden, Lithuania and the Netherlands. The United States reported 4 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 30 May. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,072 (0) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 21, 339 sampling sites provided test reports, and 17 sampling sites in 2 states (New Jersey and Oregon) detected H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases: 13 H5N1 influenza cases (976* cumulative since 2003), 11 H9N2 influenza cases (139 cumulative) and 1 H10N3 influenza case (5 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases. Avian and animal cases: 1,740 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 53 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode of contact, duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.
items.area_zh: 柬埔寨,中國大陸(不含港澳)

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約3%且持續上升;新加坡陽性率由13%升至20%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 3% in week 19 of 2025 and trending up; Singapore's rose from 13% to 20% in weeks 17–20, and WHO says risk remains high.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第19週(5/5-11)全球陽性率約3%,以東地中海、西太平洋、東南亞區之陽性率增加較為顯著。 WHO報告全球疫情自今年2月起顯著上升,近期陽性率已接近去年7月高峰;變異株LP.8.1佔比自4月中旬開始下降,NB.1.8.1佔比上升,於5月中旬達10.7%;WHO評估目前全球風險仍高,惟公衛風險迄未受到監測中之變異株影響。 第17-20週(4/20-5/17)疫情,新加坡陽性率自13%上升至20%;澳大利亞陽性率自2.4%上升至3%,變異株XEC及LP.8.1佔比最高;馬來西亞第15-18週陽性率持續上升,自8%上升至24%,每日通報至少110例病例;香港第21週陽性率11.1%,低於前一週(13.8%),疫情仍處高點,惟呈開始下降趨勢,定醫就診率亦下降,汙水監測及呼吸道樣本顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1佔比最高。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,東地中海、西太平洋、歐洲、東南亞區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株仍以LP.8.1占比最高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 19 of 2025 (5–11 May), the global positivity rate was about 3%, with more significant increases in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and South-East Asia regions. WHO reports that the global outbreak has risen significantly since February this year, and recent positivity rates are approaching last July's peak. The share of the LP.8.1 variant has declined since mid-April, while the share of NB.1.8.1 has risen to 10.7% in mid-May. WHO assesses that the current global risk remains high, although public health risk has not so far been affected by the variants under monitoring. In weeks 17–20 (20 April–17 May), positivity in Singapore rose from 13% to 20%; in Australia it rose from 2.4% to 3%, with XEC and LP.8.1 the most prevalent variants; in Malaysia, positivity in weeks 15–18 continued to rise, from 8% to 24%, with at least 110 cases reported daily. Hong Kong's positivity in week 21 was 11.1%, lower than the previous week (13.8%). The outbreak remains at a high level but has begun to decline, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also fallen; wastewater and respiratory sample surveillance show NB.1.8.1 as the most prevalent variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions, and the LP.8.1 variant still accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,香港特別行政區,馬來西亞,新加坡

items.headline_zh: 美國/哥斯大黎加-組織漿菌症
items.summary_zh: 12人赴哥斯大黎加洞穴旅遊後發病,2人確診組織漿菌症
items.summary_en: Twelve members of one family became ill after visiting a Costa Rican cave; 2 of 4 tested had histoplasmosis, and all have recovered.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC於5/15報告1起與洞穴旅遊相關案例,來自同一家庭之12名病患於去(2024)年12月下旬前往哥斯大黎加北部一處洞穴旅遊,回國後出現頭痛、發燒、呼吸道及腸胃道等症狀,初期因未詢問旅遊史,導致誤診。其後採檢4名成員進行真菌抗原檢測,其中2名莢膜組織漿菌陽性,開始抗真菌藥物治療,目前均已康復。該處洞穴於1998-99年亦曾爆發組織漿菌症疫情,與蝙蝠糞便相關,故懷疑為此事件可能感染源,哥國已將此地點列入旅遊排除名單,美國亦發布旅遊警示,提醒民眾洞穴旅遊感染風險。
items.description_en: The US CDC reported on 15 May one case linked to cave tourism. Twelve patients from the same family had visited a cave in northern Costa Rica in late December 2024. After returning home they developed headache, fever, and respiratory and gastrointestinal symptoms. The illness was initially misdiagnosed because their travel history was not asked about. Four family members were then tested with fungal antigen testing, and 2 of them were positive for Histoplasma capsulatum; antifungal treatment was started, and all have now recovered. The cave also had a histoplasmosis outbreak in 1998–99 linked to bat droppings, so it is suspected to be a possible source of this infection. Costa Rica has placed the site on its tourism exclusion list, and the United States has issued a travel alert reminding travelers of the infection risk from cave tourism.

items.summary_zh: 日本定點平均2.05例創1999年以來新高,櫪木縣7.56例最高
items.summary_en: Japan's average of 2.05 erythema infectiosum reports per sentinel site in the week of 12–18 May is the highest since 1999; Tochigi led with 7.56.
items.description_zh: 日本近1週(5/12-18)定點平均報告數為2.05例,單週平均報告數為1999年以來最高,其中以櫪木縣7.56例為高,其次為群馬縣6.52例、山形縣6.27例,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
items.description_en: In the most recent week (12–18 May), the average number of reports per sentinel site in Japan was 2.05 cases, the highest weekly average since 1999. Tochigi Prefecture had the highest figure at 7.56 cases, followed by Gunma Prefecture at 6.52 and Yamagata Prefecture at 6.27. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲昆士蘭州今年近2,400例;日本單週2,299例為2018年以來新高
items.summary_en: Queensland reported nearly 2,400 pertussis cases this year, 3.5 times the 2023–24 average; Japan logged 2,299 cases in one week, a high since 2018.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州自今年年初迄今報告近2,400例,為2023-24年平均病例數的3.5倍,該州於去年報告1.5萬餘例,全年病例數超過過去11年病例總和。 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(5/12-18)通報2,299例,較前1週1,792例增加500餘例,達2018年以來新高,新增病例數以東京都(151)為多,其次為兵庫縣(140)。今年迄今已累計逾1.9萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗,並建議兒童接種追加劑。
items.description_en: Queensland, Australia, has reported nearly 2,400 cases since the beginning of this year, 3.5 times the average for 2023–24. The state reported more than 15,000 cases last year, and last year's annual total exceeded the combined total of the previous 11 years. Japan's outbreak is severe. In the most recent week (12–18 May), 2,299 cases were reported, an increase of more than 500 from 1,792 the previous week, reaching a high not seen since 2018. The largest number of new cases was in Tokyo Metropolis (151), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (140). So far this year, more than 19,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible, and recommends booster doses for children.

items.headline_zh: 美國/加拿大/阿富汗-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗今年麻疹逾5.5萬例、357例死亡,第16週達高峰
items.summary_en: Afghanistan has reported over 55,000 measles cases and 357 deaths this year, peaking in week 16; the US has 1,046 cases across 31 states.
items.description_zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/22報告14起疫情,累計31州1,046例,其中127例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,惟近期疫情已趨緩,然其他州仍持續報告零星病例,愛荷華州及內布拉斯加州報告今年首例;加拿大今年截至5/17共9省2,515例,以安大略省(1,848)為多,其次為亞伯達省(509),近期中部曼托巴省/薩斯喀徹溫省病例數亦快速增加,預估疫情將持續至夏季。 阿富汗疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告5.5萬餘例及357例死亡(CFR : 0.6%),自年初以來病例數呈穩定上升趨勢,於第16週達最高峰,疫情高於前3年(2022-24年)平均,發病率以該國南部赫爾曼德省最高,由於該國政局不穩及醫療基礎設施不足,嚴重影響疫苗接種及疫情控制等措施之推動。
items.description_en: North America update: as of 22 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,046 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 127 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. Although the outbreak in Texas has recently slowed, other states continue to report sporadic cases, and Iowa and Nebraska reported their first cases this year. As of 17 May, Canada had 2,515 cases across 9 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,848), followed by Alberta (509). Case numbers have also risen rapidly recently in the central provinces of Manitoba and Saskatchewan, and the outbreak is expected to continue into the summer. Afghanistan's outbreak is severe: this year more than 55,000 cases and 357 deaths (CFR 0.6%) have been reported. Cases have risen steadily since the beginning of the year and peaked in week 16, higher than the average for the previous three years (2022–24). Incidence is highest in Helmand Province in the south of the country. Political instability and insufficient medical infrastructure have seriously hampered vaccination and outbreak control efforts.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,11歲男童死亡;今年累計4例
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a new human H5N1 infection in an 11-year-old boy who died on 27 May; the country has reported 4 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西部磅士卑省三隆棟縣11歲男童,病患因出現發燒、咳嗽、疲倦及呼吸困難等症狀住院,經檢驗確診,於5/27死亡。據調查,病患在出現症狀前一週,其住家附近家禽有生病及死亡情形,當局刻正調查感染源,並對疑病例及相關接觸者進行監測,該國今年累計4例,自2023年迄今已累計20例,其中10例死亡。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported 1 new human H5N1 infection, in an 11-year-old boy from Samrong Tong District in Pursat Province in western Cambodia. He was hospitalized with fever, cough, fatigue and difficulty breathing, was confirmed by testing, and died on 27 May. Investigation found that poultry near his home had been sick and dying in the week before symptoms began. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and monitoring suspected cases and close contacts. Cambodia has reported 4 cases this year; since 2023 it has reported 20 cases cumulatively, 10 of them fatal.

items.headline_zh: 菲律賓/衣索比亞/迦納/多哥/北馬其頓-M痘
items.headline_en: Philippines / Ethiopia / Ghana / Togo / North Macedonia – Mpox
items.summary_zh: M痘:菲律賓累計15例,衣索比亞、多哥、北馬其頓各報告首例
items.summary_en: Mpox: Mindanao (Philippines) has reported 15 cases in 3 provinces; Ethiopia, Togo and North Macedonia reported their first cases, Ethiopia's with preliminary cross-border spread.
items.description_zh: 亞洲:菲律賓南部民答那峨島疫情上升,5/22報告累計3省15例,其中南哥打巴托省10例、蘇丹庫達拉省3例、馬京達瑙省2例。另該島南部三寶顏錫布省報告該省首例,為3歲女童,於5/5就診採檢後確診,目前隔離治療,相關接觸者追蹤中。 非洲:  衣索比亞報告該國首起疫情,病患為該國南部邊境小鎮摩亞雷(Moyale) 1個月齡以下嬰兒及其母親,據調查,病患父親曾跨境前往鄰國,當局已隔離相關接觸者,並追蹤感染源,初步結果顯示為跨境傳播;當地為該國重要經貿及交通樞紐,與肯亞接壤,肯國近期有報告病例。 迦納今年截至5/21累計9例,病患分布於該國首都阿克拉及西部大區,該國於去(2024)年報告13例IIb型病例;多哥於5/16報告該國首例,截至5/22報告3例,皆分布於首都洛梅,病患隔離中,相關接觸者追蹤中。  歐洲:東南歐北馬其頓報告該國首起病例,2例確診病患皆已隔離接受治療,當局展開疫調中。
items.description_en: Asia: the outbreak in the southern island of Mindanao in the Philippines is rising. As of 22 May, 15 cases had been reported cumulatively in 3 provinces: 10 in Lanao del Sur, 3 in Sultan Kudarat and 2 in Maguindanao. The island's southern province of Zamboanga Sibugay also reported its first case, a 3-year-old girl who was diagnosed after seeking care and sampling on 5 May. She is in isolation, and close contacts are being traced. Africa: Ethiopia reported its first outbreak in the country, involving an infant under one month old and the infant's mother, in Moyale, a small town on the southern border. According to investigation, the infant's father had travelled across the border to a neighbouring country. Close contacts have been isolated and the source of infection is being traced; preliminary results indicate cross-border transmission. The town is an important economic and transport hub on the border with Kenya, which has recently reported cases. Ghana reported 9 cases cumulatively this year as of 21 May, distributed in the capital Accra and the Western Region; Ghana reported 13 clade IIb cases in 2024. Togo reported its first case on 16 May; as of 22 May, 3 cases had been reported, all in the capital Lomé. Patients are in isolation and close contacts are being traced. Europe: North Macedonia reported its first case; the 2 confirmed patients are isolated and receiving treatment, and authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation.
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,迦納共和國,菲律賓,北馬其頓共和國,多哥

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓錫基霍爾島報告6例鼻疽感染,病況穩定,為該島首次疫情
items.summary_en: Siquijor Island in the central Philippines reported 6 human glanders infections; patients are stable, and it is the island's first outbreak.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓中部錫基霍爾島報告6例人類感染病例,病患住院治療後病況穩定,當局已啟動調查及監測措施,並呼籲民眾避免接觸及食用生病及死亡動物,本案為該島首次出現疫情。感染症狀包括發燒、身體疼痛、頭痛、打噴嚏、發冷和胸痛;嚴重情況下,導致皮膚潰瘍和肺炎。
items.description_en: Siquijor Island in central Philippines reported 6 human infection cases. After hospitalization, the patients' condition is stable. Authorities have launched investigation and surveillance measures and urge people to avoid contact with, and consumption of, sick or dead animals. This is the island's first outbreak. Symptoms of infection include fever, body aches, headache, sneezing, chills and chest pain; in severe cases they can lead to skin ulcers and pneumonia.

items.summary_zh: WHO將NB.1.8.1列為監測中變異株,全球占比升至10.7%
items.summary_en: WHO designated NB.1.8.1 a variant under monitoring on 23 May; its global share rose from 2.5% in week 14 to 10.7% in week 17, with risk rated low.
items.description_zh: WHO於5/23將變異株NB.1.8.1列為監測中變異株(VUM),該變異株於全球占比漸升,第14週(3/31-4/6)至第17週(4/21-27)該變異株占比由2.5%上升至10.7%,截至5/18,共22國報告518筆序列,其中西太平洋/美洲/歐洲皆呈上升趨勢,其餘區署上傳序列數較低或無相關紀錄。NB.1.8.1變異株源於重組變異株XDV.1.5.1,首例於今年1/22樣本檢測出,現有證據顯示部分位點突變使病毒可增強與人體ACE受體結合能力,以提高傳播力,並降低抗體中和效力及增加免疫逃脫力,惟需更多實驗證據。目前西太平洋區該變異株比例較高之國家,其病例/住院數皆上升,惟無證據顯示其嚴重度高於其他變異株,目前已核准使用之疫苗,預期仍具有保護效力,評估對全球公衛風險為低。
items.description_en: On 23 May, WHO designated the variant NB.1.8.1 as a variant under monitoring (VUM). Its share of global cases has been rising: from 2.5% in week 14 (31 March–6 April) to 10.7% in week 17 (21–27 April). As of 18 May, 22 countries had reported 518 sequences. The variant's share is rising in the Western Pacific, the Americas and Europe, while other regions have uploaded fewer sequences or have no relevant records. NB.1.8.1 derives from the recombinant variant XDV.1.5.1, and the first case was detected in a sample collected on 22 January this year. Current evidence suggests that some mutations may enhance the virus's binding to the human ACE receptor, potentially increasing transmissibility, reducing antibody neutralization and increasing immune escape, but more experimental evidence is needed. In Western Pacific countries where this variant accounts for a higher share, case and hospitalization numbers have risen, but there is no evidence that it causes more severe disease than other variants. Currently approved vaccines are expected to remain protective, and the global public health risk is assessed as low.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大魁北克省今年截至5/14累計61例萊姆病,去年834例為10年新高
items.summary_en: Quebec has reported 61 Lyme disease cases this year as of 14 May, similar to last year; last year's 834 total was a 10-year high.
items.description_zh: 加拿大魁北克省(Québec)今年截至5/14累計報告61例病例,主要分布於埃斯特里區26例,今年病例數與去年同期68例相當,該省近15年來病例數呈上升趨勢,去年全年累計834例為近10年來最高,預期今年病例數仍會持續增加,推測疫情上升為氣候變化所致。
items.description_en: In Quebec, Canada, 61 cases have been reported cumulatively this year as of 14 May, with 26 cases in the Estrie region. This year's count is comparable to the 68 cases reported in the same period last year. Case numbers in the province have risen over the past 15 years, and last year's full-year total of 834 cases was the highest in nearly 10 years. Case numbers are expected to keep increasing this year, and the rise is presumed to be due to climate change.

items.summary_zh: 法國5月1-20日報告225例屈公病,今年累計逾950例,多來自留尼旺島
items.summary_en: France reported 225 chikungunya cases from 1 to 20 May, about ten times last year's full total; more than 950 cases so far this year, mostly from Réunion.
items.description_zh: 法國疫情更新,於5/1-20報告225例病例,約為去年全年病例數的10倍,今年迄今累計報告950餘例病例,明顯高於前2年病例數,病例主要來自法屬留旺島。因主要病媒蚊於該國之活躍期為5-11月,預期疫情將持續上升。
items.description_en: France update: 225 cases were reported between 1 and 20 May, about 10 times the total for all of last year. So far this year, more than 950 cases have been reported cumulatively, significantly higher than in the previous two years. The cases mainly come from Réunion. Because the main vector mosquitoes are active in France from May to November, cases are expected to keep rising.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年累計約245萬例、逾1,000例死亡;巴拉圭累計16,033例
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported about 2.45 million dengue cases and over 1,000 deaths this year; Paraguay has 16,033 cases, with DENV-3 spreading in the community.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告約245萬例病例,截至5/17報告逾1,000例死亡,以聖保羅州、米納斯吉拉斯州及巴拉那州疫情較為嚴峻。 巴拉圭疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告16,033例病例,平均每週報告約873例病例,近3週報告144例確診病例,疫情在該國所有地區蔓延,尤其近期DENV-3血清型別於社區持續傳播,可能造成重症病例數增加。
items.description_en: Brazil update: so far this year, about 2.45 million cases have been reported cumulatively, and more than 1,000 deaths were reported as of 17 May. The outbreak is most severe in São Paulo, Minas Gerais and Paraná States. Paraguay's outbreak is rising: 16,033 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, averaging about 873 cases per week. In the past three weeks, 144 confirmed cases were reported. The outbreak has spread across all regions of the country, and recently the DENV-3 serotype has continued to spread in the community, which may increase the number of severe cases.

items.summary_zh: 獅子山M痘今年累計3,059例、14例死亡,近10日增50%
items.summary_en: Sierra Leone has reported 3,059 mpox cases and 14 deaths this year as of 24 May; cases rose 50% in the last 10 days, with spread nationwide.
items.description_zh: 獅子山疫情嚴峻,今年截至5/24累計3,059例,其中14例死亡(CFR:0.45%),病例遍及全國,該國病例數自4月中旬快速上升,近10日(5/14-24)病例數增加50%,推估於疫情早期階段可能已存在隱性之社區傳播,因目前疫情仍持續上升,顯示現有防疫措施未能有效阻斷傳播鏈。
items.description_en: Sierra Leone's outbreak is severe. This year, as of 24 May, 3,059 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 14 deaths (CFR 0.45%), and cases are found throughout the country. Case numbers have risen rapidly since mid-April, and over the past 10 days (14–24 May) cases increased by 50%. It is estimated that covert community transmission may already have existed in the early stage of the outbreak. Because the outbreak is still rising, existing prevention and control measures have not been effective in blocking chains of transmission.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染;11國新增33起H5N1禽/動物疫情
items.summary_en: No new human H5N1 infections were reported this week; 11 countries reported 33 new H5N1 animal outbreaks, led by the UK with 15.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共11國於2025/5/16-2025/5/23期間新增33起H5N1疫情,英國15起、韓國6起、荷蘭3起、美國2起、保加利亞/巴西/德國/捷克/柬埔寨/波蘭/西班牙各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,072(7)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第20週計399個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(阿拉斯加州、紐澤西州、奧勒岡州)18個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感11例 (2003年迄今累計974*例)、H9N2流感11例(迄今累計139例)、H10N3流感1例(迄今累計5例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計53國家/地區通報1,740起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 11 countries reported 33 new H5N1 outbreaks between 16 and 23 May 2025: the United Kingdom 15, South Korea 6, the Netherlands 3, the United States 2, and one each in Bulgaria, Brazil, Germany, Czechia, Cambodia, Poland and Spain. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,072 (7) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 20, 399 sampling sites provided test reports, and 18 sampling sites in 3 states (Alaska, New Jersey and Oregon) detected H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases: 11 H5N1 influenza cases (974* cumulative since 2003), 11 H9N2 influenza cases (139 cumulative) and 1 H10N3 influenza case (5 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases. Avian and animal cases: 1,740 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 53 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約3%;泰國第20週新增5.1萬例,為上週1.5倍
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 3% in week 18 of 2025; Thailand added 51,000 cases in week 20, 1.5 times the previous week.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第18週(4/28-5/4)全球陽性率約3%,陽性率以東地中海區、及西太平洋區為高。 泰國第20週(5/12-18)累計新增5.1萬例,為上週1.5倍,病例多介於30-39歲,評估4月潑水節活動致疫情快速上升;香港第20週(5/11-17)陽性率持續上升,惟有跡象顯示上升趨勢開始趨緩,定醫就診率亦呈上升趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,變異株XDV占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,東地中海、西太平洋、歐洲、東南亞區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 18 of 2025 (28 April–4 May), the global positivity rate was about 3%, highest in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions. Thailand added 51,000 cases in week 20 (12–18 May), 1.5 times the previous week, with most cases among people aged 30–39. The rapid rise is assessed to be due to activities during the Songkran festival in April. Hong Kong's positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) continued to rise, but signs suggest the upward trend is starting to slow; sentinel clinic consultation rates have also risen, and wastewater surveillance data show the XDV variant accounts for the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions, and the LP.8.1 variant currently accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球新增9例cVDPV2小兒麻痺,衣索比亞5例;巴基斯坦環境樣本11件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 9 new cVDPV2 polio cases in 4 countries for 8–14 May, 5 in Ethiopia; Pakistan logged 11 new WPV1-positive environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/8-14期間,cVDPV2型新增4國共9例,分別為衣索比亞5例、蘇丹2例、布吉納法索/象牙海岸各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦11件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加3國共5件,分別為阿爾及利亞3件、查德/索馬利亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 8 and 14 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 9 in 4 countries: 5 in Ethiopia, 2 in Sudan, and 1 each in Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 11 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 5 across 3 countries: 3 in Algeria, and 1 each in Chad and Somalia.
items.area_zh: 阿爾及利亞,布吉納法索,查德,象牙海岸,衣索比亞,巴基斯坦,索馬利亞,蘇丹

items.headline_zh: 美國-細菌性腸胃炎(沙門氏菌)
items.summary_zh: 美國15州26例沙門氏菌感染,疑與佛州小黃瓜有關
items.summary_en: Salmonella infections reached 26 cases in 15 US states as of 19 May, 9 hospitalized; cucumbers from a Florida producer are suspected as the source.
items.description_zh: 美國於5/19累計15州報告26例病例,其中9例住院,經調查疑感染源為生產自佛羅里達州某廠商之小黃瓜,當局已通知廠商下架4/29-5/19期間批發之產品。
items.description_en: As of 19 May, 15 US states have reported 26 cases cumulatively, 9 of them hospitalized. Investigation suggests the suspected source of infection is cucumbers produced by a manufacturer in Florida. Authorities have notified the manufacturer to withdraw products wholesaled between 29 April and 19 May.

items.summary_zh: 新加坡日均49例高於去年同期;中國3月新增約1.2萬例
items.summary_en: Singapore's enterovirus cases averaged 49 a day in weeks 19–20, above last year's 33; China reported about 12,000 cases in March, down 34%.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第19-20週(5/4-5/17)疫情更新,新加坡疫情仍處高點,平均單日新增49例病例,高於去年同期(33例);韓國就診陽性率為1.1‰,較前週(0.9‰)略升;香港處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.1‰;日本定醫平均病例數0.08,與前週(0.09)相當,尚未進入流行期;中國3月新增約1.2萬例病例,較去年同期下降34%。
items.description_en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 19–20 (4–17 May): Singapore's outbreak remains at a high level, with an average of 49 new cases per day, higher than the 33 cases in the same period last year. Korea's clinic-visit positivity rate was 1.1‰, slightly up from 0.9‰ the previous week. Hong Kong is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.1‰. Japan's average sentinel clinic case count was 0.08, similar to the previous week (0.09), and it has not yet entered an epidemic period. China reported about 12,000 new cases in March, a 34% decrease from the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡

items.summary_zh: 印度東部奧里薩邦不明原因疾病逾500例,症狀含手腳腫脹、發燒
items.summary_en: An unexplained illness in Malkangiri District, Odisha, India, has caused over 500 cases with swollen hands and feet, joint pain and fever; malaria and typhoid ruled out.
items.description_zh: 印度東部奧里薩邦馬爾坎基里縣(Malkangiri)於5/19報告爆發不明原因疾病,已累計500餘例,症狀包含手腳腫脹、膝蓋與關節疼痛及發燒,當局已排除瘧疾及傷寒,病因待調查。
items.description_en: In Malkangiri District of Odisha State in eastern India, an outbreak of an unexplained illness was reported on 19 May, with more than 500 cases cumulatively. Symptoms include swelling of the hands and feet, knee and joint pain, and fever. Authorities have ruled out malaria and typhoid; the cause is under investigation.

items.headline_zh: 玻利維亞/美國-漢他病毒症候群
items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞今年逾20例、7例死亡;美國內華達州瓦肖郡1例
items.summary_en: Bolivia has reported over 20 hantavirus syndrome cases this year, 7 fatal; Nevada's Washoe County reported a case in a woman in her 90s.
items.description_zh: 玻利維亞今年迄今已報告超過20例,其中7例死亡,以該國北部拉巴斯省報告20例為多,另南部塔里哈省報告4例及首例死亡病例,病毒於該國多個省份持續流行,每年皆有報告病例。 美國內華達州瓦肖郡(Washoe County)報告1例,為90多歲女性,病患出現症狀前數週曾直接或間接接觸囓齒動物排遺,或於施作木工時接觸到動物巢穴,相關調查持續進行中,本案為該郡2023年8月以來首例。
items.description_en: Bolivia has reported more than 20 cases so far this year, 7 of them fatal. The largest number, 20 cases, were reported in La Paz Department in the north of the country, while Tarija Department in the south reported 4 cases and its first death. The virus continues to circulate in several provinces of the country, and cases are reported every year. In Washoe County, Nevada, USA, one case was reported in a woman in her 90s. In the weeks before symptoms began, she had direct or indirect contact with rodent droppings, or came into contact with animal nests while doing woodwork. The investigation is ongoing. This is the county's first case since August 2023.

items.summary_zh: 日本5/5-11定點平均1.14例,為近10年同期最高,疫情可能延續至秋季
items.summary_en: Japan's erythema infectiosum reports reached 1.14 per sentinel site in 5–11 May, the highest for that period in 10 years; the outbreak may last into autumn.
items.description_zh: 日本近1週(5/5-11)定點平均報告數為1.14例,單週平均報告數為近10年以來之同期最高,其中以櫪木縣4.19例為高,其次為宮城/山形縣3.23例,專家表示目前疫情熱區逐漸往北海道及北日本地區移動,疫情可能持續到秋季。
items.description_en: In the most recent week (5–11 May), the average number of reports per sentinel site in Japan was 1.14 cases, the highest for the same period in the past 10 years. Tochigi Prefecture had the highest at 4.19 cases, followed by Miyagi and Yamagata Prefectures at 3.23 cases. Experts say the current hotspot is gradually moving north to Hokkaido and northern Japan, and the outbreak may continue until autumn.

items.summary_zh: 日本5/5-11通報1,792例,今年累計逾1.6萬例,疫苗存量不足
items.summary_en: Japan reported 1,792 pertussis cases in the week of 5–11 May and over 16,000 this year; vaccine supply is short and manufacturers are rationing.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情處高點,近1週(5/5-11)通報1,792例,較前1週1,746例上升,新增病例數以福岡縣(110)為多,其次為兵庫縣(109)。今年迄今已累計逾1.6萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,且各地均有抗藥性菌株感染案例,因疫苗接種人數增加,已出現存量不足情形,疫苗廠商已對各醫療機構限制配發數量。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is at its peak. In the most recent week (5–11 May), 1,792 cases were reported, up from 1,746 the previous week. The largest number of new cases was in Fukuoka Prefecture (110), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (109). So far this year, more than 16,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions. As vaccinations have increased, stocks have become insufficient, and vaccine manufacturers have limited the quantities allocated to each medical institution.

items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭今年至3月報告472例麻疹,較去年增20.5倍,2例兒童死亡
items.summary_en: Ukraine reported 472 measles cases through March this year, a 20.5-fold increase compared with last year, with 2 child deaths.
items.description_zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/15報告14起疫情,累計31州1,024例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多;加拿大今年截至5/3共7省1,846例,以安大略省(1,460)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告1,300餘例。 烏克蘭疫情上升,今年至3月報告472例,較去(2024)年增加20.5倍,並報告2例兒童死亡,病例集中於西部地區之外喀爾巴阡/車夫契/敖得薩州,由於當地戰事持續使公共衛生服務受到干擾,降低疫苗接種率,且人口流動加劇疾病傳播風險。
items.description_en: North America update: as of 15 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,024 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. As of 3 May, Canada had 1,846 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,460), and case numbers in Alberta have also risen rapidly. In northern Mexico, the outbreak in Chihuahua State is severe, with more than 1,300 cases reported so far this year. Ukraine's outbreak is rising: 472 cases were reported through March this year, a 20.5-fold increase compared with last year, and 2 child deaths have been reported. Cases are concentrated in the western oblasts of Zakarpattia, Chernivtsi and Odesa. Ongoing conflict in the area is disrupting public health services and lowering vaccination rates, and population movement is increasing the risk of spread.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,墨西哥,烏克蘭,美國

items.summary_zh: 越南今年截至4月上旬狂犬病死亡20例,高於2024年同期
items.summary_en: Vietnam has recorded 20 rabies deaths this year as of early April, more than the same period in 2024; hot weather from April to August raises risk.
items.description_zh: 越南今年截至4月上旬累計20例死亡,較2024年同期死亡數為高。當局表示4至8月間天氣炎熱,感染數及死亡數增加,尤以中/北部地區省份為多,呼籲民眾倘被犬貓咬傷,應立即就診,並定期為犬貓完整接種疫苗。
items.description_en: As of early April this year, Vietnam has reported 20 deaths cumulatively, higher than the number of deaths in the same period of 2024. Authorities say that temperatures are high from April to August, and infections and deaths increase, especially in provinces in the central and northern regions. The public is urged to seek medical care immediately if bitten by a dog or cat, and to ensure dogs and cats are fully and regularly vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 獅子山單週新增611例M痘,累計2,045例;多哥報告首例
items.summary_en: Sierra Leone reported 611 new mpox cases in one week (9–16 May), 2,045 cumulative this year; Togo reported its first case, in a 22-year-old woman.
items.description_zh: 獅子山疫情持續上升,自5/9-16單週新增611例病例,高於前1週483例,為IIb型病例,男性占68%,病例集中於西部區等6個區域,亦包含首都自由城。自今年1月截至5/18累計報告2,045例確診,其中11例死亡(CFR:0.54%)。另,剛果民主共和國、烏干達及蒲隆地上週病例略有增加,整體呈下降趨勢。當局持續進行疫苗接種活動。 多哥於5/16報告該國首例,病患為22歲女性,居住於該國首都洛梅,5/11出現發燒及皮疹症狀就醫,近15日內無旅遊史,經檢驗為IIb型,另該病患丈夫亦確診,兩人皆隔離接受治療。
items.description_en: Sierra Leone's outbreak continues to rise: from 9 to 16 May, 611 new cases were reported in one week, up from 483 the previous week. These are clade IIb cases, 68% of them male, and cases are concentrated in 6 areas including the Western Area and the capital, Freetown. Since January this year, 2,045 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively as of 18 May, including 11 deaths (CFR 0.54%). Cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and Burundi increased slightly last week, but the overall trend is declining. Authorities continue vaccination campaigns. Togo reported its first case on 16 May: a 22-year-old woman living in the capital Lomé, who developed fever and rash on 11 May and sought medical care. She had no travel history in the past 15 days. Testing identified clade IIb, and her husband also tested positive; both are isolated and receiving treatment.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲昆士蘭州今年截至5/18累計219例類鼻疽,31例死亡
items.summary_en: Queensland has reported 219 melioidosis cases this year as of 18 May, including 31 deaths, over triple the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州今年截至5/18累計報告219例,其中31例死亡,病例數為去(2024)年同期3倍以上,今年累計病例數高於2020-24年全年病例數,病例多集中於凱恩斯及湯斯維爾區,其中湯斯維爾北部郊區發生群聚感染。
items.description_en: Queensland, Australia, has reported 219 cases cumulatively as of 18 May this year, including 31 deaths. Case numbers are more than triple those of the same period last year, and cumulative cases this year exceed the full-year totals for 2020–24. Cases are concentrated in the Cairns and Townsville areas, and a cluster of infections has occurred in the northern suburbs of Townsville.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至5/4確診717例、死亡138例,致死率19.3%
items.summary_en: Nigeria has confirmed 717 Lassa fever cases and 138 deaths this year as of 4 May, among over 4,800 suspected cases; case fatality rate 19.3%.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,今年截至5/4累計報告18州4,800餘例疑病例,其中717例確診,138例死亡(CFR:19.3%),近期病例數以西南部翁多州及南部埃多州為多。
items.description_en: Nigeria update: as of 4 May this year, more than 4,800 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively across 18 states, of which 717 were confirmed and 138 died (CFR 19.3%). Recent cases are concentrated in Ondo State in the southwest and Edo State in the south.

items.summary_zh: 中南美洲蠅蛆症病例增加,加拿大1例80歲男性具哥斯大黎加旅遊史
items.summary_en: Human screwworm myiasis cases are rising across Central and South America; Canada reported a case in an 80-year-old man who had traveled to Costa Rica.
items.description_zh: 中南美洲近年病例數上升,巴拿馬/哥斯大黎加/加拉瓜/宏都拉斯/瓜地馬拉/薩爾瓦多/墨西哥等國均有人類感染病例。另加拿大於今年3月報告1例80歲男性病例,具哥斯大黎加旅遊史,顯示其可能透過國際旅遊傳播,增加國際傳播風險。螺旋蠅為寄生性蠅類,其幼蟲可寄生於人類及動物之傷口或天然腔道,造成「蠅蛆症」,目前無疫苗或特效藥物。
items.description_en: Human infections have increased in Central and South America in recent years, with human cases reported in Panama, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico and other countries. In addition, Canada reported a case in an 80-year-old man in March this year who had a travel history to Costa Rica, indicating that the disease may spread through international travel and increase the risk of international transmission. The screwworm fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae can parasitize wounds or natural body cavities of humans and animals, causing myiasis. There is currently no vaccine or specific drug.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,哥斯大黎加,薩爾瓦多,瓜地馬拉,宏都拉斯,墨西哥,尼加拉瓜,巴拿馬共和國

items.headline_zh: 法屬馬約特島/法屬留尼旺島-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 馬約特島截至5/4累計116例屈公病,57例本土感染,無死亡
items.summary_en: Mayotte has reported 116 chikungunya cases as of 4 May, 57 locally acquired, the first local transmission since 2005–06; no deaths reported.
items.description_zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,自3/5於該島東北部發現首例輸入病例後,截至5/4累計報告116例病例,其中57例為本土病例,1例住院治療,迄無死亡病例,為自2005-06年疫情以來首次報告本土傳播病例,另法屬留旺島近期亦爆發大規模疫情,WHO預期印度洋島嶼將進一步爆發疫情。
items.description_en: Mayotte (France): the outbreak is rising. After the first imported case was detected in the northeast of the island on 5 March, 116 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 4 May, of which 57 were locally acquired, and 1 patient is hospitalized. No deaths have been recorded. This is the first reported locally acquired case since the outbreak of 2005–06. Meanwhile, Réunion (France) has recently experienced a large outbreak, and WHO expects further outbreaks on Indian Ocean islands.
items.area_zh: 法屬馬約特島,法屬留尼旺島

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年累計10,076例;智利5/17報告1例有巴西旅遊史
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported 10,076 Oropouche fever cases this year as of 13 May; Chile reported one case on 17 May in a patient with a travel history to Brazil.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年截至5/13累計報告10,076例病例,以東南部聖埃斯皮里圖州6,123例病例為多,其次為里約熱內盧州1,900例;該國2024年累計13,000餘例病例。 智利5/17報告1例病例,個案就醫時有發燒、頭痛、肌肉痛等症狀,曾有巴西旅遊史。
items.description_en: Brazil update: as of 13 May this year, 10,076 cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly 6,123 in Espírito Santo State in the southeast, followed by 1,900 in Rio de Janeiro State. The country reported more than 13,000 cases cumulatively in 2024. Chile reported one case on 17 May; when seeking medical care, the patient had fever, headache and muscle pain, and had a travel history to Brazil.

items.summary_zh: 巴拿馬報告2例瘧疾死亡,為2017年以來首見;2024年累計15,109例
items.summary_en: Panama reported two malaria deaths, in a 10-year-old and a 15-year-old girl, the first since 2017; 15,109 cases were recorded in 2024.
items.description_zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,報告2例死亡病例,分別為10歲及15歲女性個案,分別來自該國中西部及東部省份,為自2017年以來首次報告死亡病例,該國2024年累計15,109例病例,2023年累計11,659例病例,顯示近年疫情呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en: Panama update: two deaths were reported, in a 10-year-old female and a 15-year-old female, from the central-western and eastern parts of the country respectively. These are the first deaths reported since 2017. The country reported 15,109 cases cumulatively in 2024 and 11,659 cases in 2023, indicating a rising trend in recent years.

items.summary_zh: 捷克5/16報告1例疑似伊波拉/馬堡病毒感染病例,41歲美國籍男性
items.summary_en: Czechia reported a suspected Ebola or Marburg case on 16 May in a 41-year-old US man who had traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 26 contacts were quarantined.
items.description_zh: 捷克5/16報告1例病例,疑伊波拉病毒感染症/馬堡病毒出血熱,病患為41歲美國籍男性個案,近期自剛果民主共和國經盧安達及美國,於5/6抵達捷克,原於該國南部塔博爾就診,後於5/16出現出血熱症狀,轉診至北部布拉醫院隔離,已排除瘧疾,當局匡列26名接觸者進行隔離,餘檢驗結果待公布。
items.description_en: Czechia reported one case on 16 May, suspected to be Ebola virus disease or Marburg haemorrhagic fever. The patient is a 41-year-old US national who recently travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Rwanda and the United States, arriving in Czechia on 6 May. He first received care in Tábor in the south of the country, and on 16 May developed haemorrhagic fever symptoms and was transferred to a hospital in Prague for isolation. Malaria has been ruled out. Authorities have identified 26 contacts and placed them in quarantine; other test results are pending.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉新增1例H5N1、中國新增8例H9N2與1例H10N3人類感染
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported one new H5N1 human infection this week, and China reported 8 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human infections.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週孟加拉新增1例H5N1流感、中國新增8例H9N2流感及1例H10N3流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):WAHIS 共8國於2025/3/21-2025/5/12期間新增17起H5N1疫情,美國5起、加拿大4起、菲律賓3起、瑞典/愛爾蘭/捷克/奈及利亞/巴西各1起。 陵蘭於2024/9/30新增1起H5N5疫情。 菲律賓於2025/4/15新增1起H5N9疫情。 比利時於2025/4/27新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,065(12)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。   廢水監測:第19週計397個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中4州(愛荷華州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州、北卡羅來納州)5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感11例 (2003年迄今累計974*例)、H9N2流感11例(迄今累計139例)、H10N3流感1例(迄今累計5例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計53國家/地區通報1,713起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: this week Bangladesh reported 1 new H5N1 human infection, and China reported 8 new H9N2 and 1 new H10N3 human infections. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 17 new H5N1 outbreaks between 21 March and 12 May 2025: the United States 5, Canada 4, the Philippines 3, and one each in Sweden, Ireland, Czechia, Nigeria and Brazil. Greenland reported 1 new H5N5 outbreak on 30 September 2024. The Philippines reported 1 new H5N9 outbreak on 15 April 2025. Belgium reported 1 new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 27 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,065 (12) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 19, 397 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 4 states (Iowa, Oregon, New Jersey and North Carolina) detected H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases: 11 H5N1 influenza cases (974* cumulative since 2003), 11 H9N2 influenza cases (139 cumulative) and 1 H10N3 influenza case (5 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases. Avian and animal cases: 1,713 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 53 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約2.7%;中國4月陽性率由7.5%升至16.2%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 2.7% in week 17; China's rose from 7.5% in early April to 16.2% by late April, with southern provinces higher.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第17週(4/21-27)全球陽性率約2.7%,陽性率以東地中海區、西太平洋區及非洲區為高。 中國陽性率自4月初7.5%持續上升至4月底16.2%,其中,南部省份陽性率高於北部省份,目前門急診類流感呼吸道病原體陽性率以新冠病毒為最高;香港第19週(5/4-10)陽性率持續上升,已超過最近52週高點,定醫就診率亦呈上升趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,變異株XDV占比最高。 新加坡第18週(4/27-5/3)新增約14,200例病例,高於前1週11,100例病例,目前主要流行變異株為LF.7及NB.1.8。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲區持平,其他地區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 17 of 2025 (21–27 April), the global positivity rate was about 2.7%, highest in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and African regions. China's positivity rose steadily from 7.5% in early April to 16.2% at the end of April; positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern provinces, and among influenza-like respiratory pathogens detected in outpatient and emergency settings, COVID-19 had the highest positivity. In Hong Kong, positivity in week 19 (4–10 May) continued to rise and has exceeded the high of the past 52 weeks; sentinel clinic consultation rates are also rising, and wastewater surveillance data show the XDV variant accounts for the largest share. In Singapore, about 14,200 cases were added in week 18 (27 April–3 May), up from 11,100 cases the previous week; the main circulating variants are currently LF.7 and NB.1.8. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward; the Americas are flat, while other regions are all rising. The LP.8.1 variant currently accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球新增cVDPV2、cVDPV3病例各1例,阿富汗WPV1環境樣本7件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new cVDPV2 case in Chad and one cVDPV3 case in Guinea for 1 April–7 May, plus 7 WPV1-positive environmental samples in Afghanistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/1-5/7期間, cVDPV2型新增查德1例,cVDPV3新增幾內亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗7件,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為喀麥隆、中非共和國、吉布地各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 1 April and 7 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 in Chad, and cVDPV3 cases by 1 in Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 7 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries: 1 each in Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Djibouti.

items.headline_zh: 烏克蘭-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭首都基輔5/13報告34例A型肝炎,其中20例為兒童
items.summary_en: Kyiv reported 34 hepatitis A cases on 13 May, 20 of them children; authorities are investigating the source, and affected schools have moved to remote learning.
items.description_zh: 烏克蘭首都基輔於5/13報告34例病例,其中有20例為兒童,當局已進行調查,以確定導致感染傳播的來源和因素,受疫情影響的學校已改為遠距教學。
items.description_en: The Ukrainian capital, Kyiv, reported 34 cases on 13 May, 20 of them children. Authorities are investigating to determine the source and factors behind the spread of infection, and schools affected by the outbreak have switched to distance learning.

items.summary_zh: 美國10例李斯特菌症全數住院,疑與三明治、蛋白棒等即食產品有關
items.summary_en: The US reported 10 listeriosis cases, all hospitalized, in California and Nevada; ready-to-eat products such as sandwiches and protein bars are suspected sources, with recalls issued.
items.description_zh: 美國於5/10報告10例病例,病患皆住院,分布於加州及內華達州,經調查疑感染源為三明治及蛋白棒等即食產品,當局已通知廠商召回有效期限介於4/22-5/19間之產品。
items.description_en: The United States reported 10 cases on 10 May, all hospitalized, distributed in California and Nevada. Investigation suggests the suspected source of infection is ready-to-eat products such as sandwiches and protein bars. Authorities have notified the manufacturer to recall products with expiry dates between 22 April and 19 May.

items.summary_zh: 新加坡日均61例為2020年以來最高;泰國疫情下降
items.summary_en: Singapore's enterovirus cases averaged 61 a day, the highest since 2020, while Thailand's outbreak declined.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第18-19週(4/27-6/3)疫情,新加坡疫情嚴峻,平均單日新增61例病例,為2020年以來最高;香港就診陽性率為0.4‰,與前週持平;日本定醫平均病例數0.09,與前週(0.1)相當,仍處疫情低點;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.9‰,較前週略升;泰國疫情下降,第15-16週(4/6-4/19)新增929例。
items.description_en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 18–19 (27 April–3 June): Singapore's outbreak is severe, with an average of 61 new cases per day, the highest since 2020. Hong Kong's clinic-visit positivity rate was 0.4‰, unchanged from the previous week. Japan's average sentinel clinic case count was 0.09, similar to the previous week (0.1), and it remains at a low point. Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.9‰, slightly up from the previous week. Thailand's outbreak is declining, with 929 new cases in weeks 15–16 (6–19 April).
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡,泰國

items.summary_zh: 日本第17週定點平均1.3例,為近10年最高;當局發布通告提醒留意
items.summary_en: Japan's erythema infectiosum reports averaged 1.3 per sentinel site in week 17, the highest weekly average in 10 years; authorities issued a notice to local governments.
items.description_zh: 日本第17週(4/21-27)定點平均報告數為1.3例,單週平均報告數為近10年以來最高,其中以櫪木縣4.56例為高,其次為群馬縣4.36例,由於病例數顯著上升,當局於4/30向各地方政府發布通告,提醒須留意疫情,並呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
items.description_en: In week 17 (21–27 April), the average number of reports per sentinel site in Japan was 1.3 cases, the highest weekly average in the past 10 years. Tochigi Prefecture had the highest at 4.56 cases, followed by Gunma Prefecture at 4.36. Because case numbers had risen significantly, on 30 April the authorities issued a notice to local governments reminding them to monitor the outbreak, and urged pregnant women to take protective measures.

items.headline_zh: 越南-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 越南南部今年截至4月12例流行性腦脊髓膜炎,較去年同期3例大增
items.summary_en: Southern Vietnam reported 12 meningococcal meningitis cases in 8 provinces and cities as of April, up from 3 in the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 越南南部今年病例數較去年同期顯著增加,截至4月共8省市報告12例,較去年同期3例為多,其中,胡志明市報告4例,專家表示南部地區疫情較去年同期上升,社區風險升高,評估未來可能持續通報病例。
items.description_en: Case numbers in southern Vietnam this year have increased significantly compared with the same period last year. As of April, 12 cases had been reported across 8 provinces and municipalities, compared with 3 cases in the same period last year, and Ho Chi Minh City reported 4 cases. Experts say the outbreak in the south has risen compared with the same period last year and community risk has increased, and cases are expected to continue to be reported.

items.summary_zh: 日本4/28-5/4通報1,746例,較前週減少,今年累計逾1.4萬例
items.summary_en: Japan reported 1,746 pertussis cases in the week of 28 April–4 May, down from 2,176 the previous week, its first recent decline; over 14,000 this year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情更新,近1週(4/28-5/4)通報1,746例,較前1週2,176例下降,為近期首次下降,新增病例數以新潟縣(114)為多,其次為千葉縣(100)。今年迄今已累計逾1.4萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,且各地均有抗藥性菌株感染案例。
items.description_en: Japan update: in the most recent week (28 April–4 May), 1,746 cases were reported, down from 2,176 the previous week, the first decline in recent weeks. The largest number of new cases was in Niigata Prefecture (114), followed by Chiba Prefecture (100). So far this year, more than 14,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, with severe cases and deaths among infants reported, and drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions.

items.headline_zh: 摩洛哥/北美洲/澳大利亞-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 摩洛哥逾2.5萬例疑似麻疹、184例死亡,連續10週下降;澳洲近6年最嚴重
items.summary_en: Morocco's measles outbreak has declined for 10 weeks, with over 25,000 suspected cases and 184 deaths; Australia's 72 cases is its worst outbreak in nearly six years.
items.description_zh: 摩洛哥自2023年10月爆發疫情以來,截至今年4/13全國共12個地區報告2.5萬餘例疑病例,其中1.3萬餘例確診及184例死亡,該國於今年1月下旬達高峰後,已連續10週呈下降趨勢,經基因定序顯示多為B3基因型,該基因型於非洲地區流行,亦與全球疫情相關。目前疫情已受控制,惟部分地區仍持續傳播,惟該國麻疹-德國麻疹(MR)疫苗接種率僅73.6%,WHO評估該國未接種疫苗/未完全接種疫苗者與免疫功能低下者風險為「中」,由於處非/歐洲交接處,人員流動頻繁,評估區域及全球風險為「中」。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/8報告14起疫情,累計31州1,001例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,今年僅4個多月,病例數已接近2019年全年病例數(1,274),其為1992年以來病例數最高峰;加拿大今年截至4/26共7省1,506例,以安大略省(1,249)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/12累計報告362例;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告954例,其中1例死亡,該國今年迄今累計1,003例。 澳大利亞爆發近6年來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計報告72例,超過去(2024)年全年病例數(57例),分布以維多利亞州27例為多,其次為新南威爾斯州(21)及西澳大利亞州(18),超過6成病例為29歲以下族群。
items.description_en: Morocco: since its outbreak began in October 2023, as of 13 April this year, 12 regions nationwide have reported more than 25,000 suspected cases, of which more than 13,000 were confirmed and 184 died. The country peaked in late January this year and has since declined for 10 consecutive weeks. Genetic sequencing shows that most cases are genotype B3, which circulates in Africa and is also linked to the global outbreak. The outbreak is now under control, but transmission continues in some areas. Morocco's measles-rubella (MR) vaccination coverage is only 73.6%. WHO assesses the risk for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated people and immunocompromised people in the country as moderate. Because the country sits at the junction of Africa and Europe with frequent population movement, the regional and global risk is also assessed as moderate. North America update: as of 8 May, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,001 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. In just over four months this year, case numbers are close to the 2019 full-year total (1,274), the highest since 1992. As of 26 April, Canada had 1,506 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,249); Alberta's case numbers have risen rapidly, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 12 May. The outbreak in Chihuahua State in northern Mexico is severe, with 954 cases reported this year so far, including 1 death; the country has reported 1,003 cases so far this year. Australia is experiencing its most severe outbreak in nearly six years, with 72 cases reported so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (57 cases). Victoria had the most (27 cases), followed by New South Wales (21) and Western Australia (18). More than 60% of cases were aged 29 years or younger.

items.summary_zh: 中國新增8例H9N2人類感染,今年累計12例;另1例H10N3
items.summary_en: China reported 8 new H9N2 human infections, 12 so far this year, plus one H10N3 case in a 68-year-old woman in Shaanxi, the country's fifth.
items.description_zh: 香港公布中國新增8例H9N2流感人類感染病例,發病時間介於4/1-19間,分布於湖南省4例、貴州省2例、重慶市/雲南省各1例,其中1例為67歲男性,餘為7歲以下兒童,其他流病資訊不明,該國今年累計報告12例;另新增1例H10N3流感人類感染病例,為陝西省68歲女性,於4/13發病,其餘流病資訊不明,該案為該國第5例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong announced that China reported 8 new human H9N2 influenza infections, with onset between 1 and 19 April: 4 in Hunan Province, 2 in Guizhou Province, and 1 each in Chongqing Municipality and Yunnan Province. One patient was a 67-year-old man, and the rest were children under 7 years of age; other epidemiological information is unknown. The country has reported 12 cases cumulatively this year. In addition, 1 new human H10N3 influenza infection was reported, in a 68-year-old woman in Shaanxi Province with onset on 13 April; other epidemiological information is unknown. This case is the country's fifth.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大蒙特婁2024年梅毒556例,較2014年增60%,女性病例增至56例
items.summary_en: Montreal reported 556 syphilis cases in 2024, up 60% from 2014; cases among women rose from 14 to 56, which may lead to more congenital syphilis cases.
items.description_zh: 加拿大蒙特婁2024年全年報告556例病例,較2014年(348例)增加60%。過去10年間,女性病例數顯著上升,自2014年14例增至2024年56例,當局表示此上升趨勢可能衍生先天性梅毒病例增加。該區於2011-19年未發現先天性梅毒病例,惟自2020年起每年報告1-7例。
items.description_en: Montreal, Canada, reported 556 cases in 2024, a 60% increase over 2014 (348 cases). Over the past 10 years, cases among women have risen significantly, from 14 in 2014 to 56 in 2024; authorities say this upward trend may lead to an increase in congenital syphilis cases. The area recorded no congenital syphilis cases in 2011–19, but has reported 1–7 cases each year since 2020.

items.headline_en: Brazil / Sierra Leone / United Kingdom – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 巴西亞馬遜州今年33例M痘,獅子山累計1,603例,英國Ib型12例
items.summary_en: Brazil's Amazonas State has 33 mpox cases this year; Sierra Leone has 1,603 confirmed cases with 11 deaths, and the UK has 12 clade Ib cases.
items.description_zh: 巴西亞馬遜州疫情上升,今年截至4月累計33例病例,多為男性,年齡介於30-39歲,當局將持續採取預防措施,另該州2023年全年僅累計10例病例。其鄰近帕拉州今年截至4/28累計19例病例、其中2例死亡。 獅子山疫情持續,截至5/8累計1,603例確診病例,其中11例死亡,病例多為IIb型男性、年齡介於30-35歲,分布於該國西部,包含首都自由城。另非洲部分高負擔國家,如剛果民主共和國等疫情已趨緩。 英國5/8報告,自2024年10月截至2025年4月30日累計12例Ib型病例,多數病例與疫區旅遊有直接或間接相關。另自2023年截至2025年4月30日累計508例IIb型病例,病例多為MSM族群。
items.description_en: Brazil's Amazonas State outbreak is rising: as of April this year, 33 cases have been reported cumulatively, mostly in men aged 30–39. Authorities will continue preventive measures. The state reported only 10 cases for the whole of 2023. Neighboring Pará State reported 19 cases as of 28 April this year, including 2 deaths. Sierra Leone's outbreak continues: as of 8 May, 1,603 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 11 deaths. Most cases are clade IIb men aged 30–35, distributed in the west of the country, including the capital Freetown. Outbreaks in some high-burden African countries, such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo, have slowed. The UK reported on 8 May that from October 2024 to 30 April 2025, 12 clade Ib cases had been reported cumulatively, most of which were directly or indirectly linked to travel to affected areas. In addition, from 2023 to 30 April 2025, 508 clade IIb cases were reported cumulatively, mostly among men who have sex with men (MSM).
