items.summary_zh: 泰國穆達漢府炭疽病累計4例,1死,636名接觸者監測完成無新增
items.summary_en: Mukdahan Province, Thailand, has reported 4 anthrax cases since 1 May, including one death; 636 contacts completed monitoring with no new cases.
items.description_zh: 泰國東北部穆達漢府(Mukdahan)疫情更新,自5/1報告首例,截至5/11累計4例確診病例,其中1例死亡、1例已出院、2例刻正治療中,另636例接觸者已完成監測,並無新增病例。當局呼籲倘有異常死亡之動物,切勿任意觸碰並應通知相關單位。
items.description_en: Mukdahan Province in northeastern Thailand: the first case was reported on 1 May, and as of 11 May, 4 cases had been confirmed cumulatively, including 1 death, 1 discharged and 2 still under treatment. Monitoring of 636 close contacts has been completed, with no new cases. Authorities urge people not to touch animals that have died unusually, and to notify the relevant authorities.

items.summary_zh: 巴拿馬累計286例奧羅普切熱及1例死亡,東部達連省264例
items.summary_en: Panama has recorded 286 Oropouche fever cases and one death, with 264 cases in eastern Darién Province; most patients are aged 25–49.
items.description_zh: 巴拿馬迄今已累計286例病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於東部達連省264例,年齡分布以25-49歲族群為多,當局已加強相關監測及蚊蟲防治措施。
items.description_en: Panama has reported 286 cases cumulatively and 1 death, mainly in Darién Province in the east, with 264 cases. The age distribution is mostly among people aged 25–49. Authorities have strengthened related surveillance and mosquito control measures.

items.headline_zh: 法屬留尼旺島/法國-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 留尼旺島今年累計逾4.75萬例屈公病、12例死亡;法國輸入766例
items.summary_en: Réunion has reported over 47,500 chikungunya cases and 12 deaths this year; France has recorded 766 imported cases, nearly 97% of them from Réunion.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島疫情持續,近1週(4/28-5/4)報告3,079例病例,今年迄今累計逾47,500例病例及12例死亡,死亡病例均為70歲以上且患有合併症個案。另該島病例增加導致法國本土傳播風險增加,自今年以來,法國已發現766例輸入性病例,近97%(742例)來自留旺島。
items.description_en: Réunion update: the outbreak continues. In the most recent week (28 April–4 May), 3,079 cases were reported, and so far this year more than 47,500 cases and 12 deaths have been reported cumulatively. All deaths were in people aged over 70 with comorbidities. Because case numbers on the island are rising, the risk of local transmission in mainland France has increased. Since the beginning of the year, France has detected 766 imported cases, of which nearly 97% (742 cases) came from Réunion.

items.summary_zh: 薩摩亞宣布登革熱疫情,今年累計36例、1例死亡,主要在烏波盧島
items.summary_en: Samoa has announced a dengue outbreak, with 36 cases and one death this year, mainly on Upolu Island; DENV-2 and DENV-1 are circulating.
items.description_zh: 薩摩亞宣布爆發疫情,今年迄今累計報告36例病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於烏波盧島,以15-19歲族群為多,目前檢出流行型別為DENV-2及DENV-1,當局已採取相關防治措施。
items.description_en: Samoa has announced an outbreak. So far this year, 36 cases and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, mainly on Upolu Island, with most cases among people aged 15–19. The circulating serotypes detected are DENV-2 and DENV-1. Authorities have taken related prevention and control measures.

items.summary_zh: 秘魯今年截至4/20累計33例黃熱病、12例死亡,死者皆未接種疫苗
items.summary_en: Peru has reported 33 yellow fever cases and 12 deaths as of 20 April this year; all deaths were in unvaccinated people, with 20 cases in Amazonas Region.
items.description_zh: 秘魯疫情更新,今年截至4/20累計33例病例及12例死亡,病例主要分布於荒野及農業地區,並經由狩獵及農業活動而感染,其中以亞馬遜大區20例為最多,死亡病例均無接種疫苗,當局已發布警報並加強預防措施。
items.description_en: Peru update: as of 20 April this year, 33 cases and 12 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in wild and agricultural areas, and infections occur through hunting and agricultural activities. Amazonas Region has the most cases, with 20. All deaths were in unvaccinated people. Authorities have issued an alert and strengthened preventive measures.

items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦今年首例立百病毒感染,42歲女性病況危急
items.summary_en: Kerala, India, reported its first Nipah virus case this year, a 42-year-old woman in critical condition; two family members also showed symptoms.
items.description_zh: 印度南部喀拉拉邦報告今年首例,指標病例為馬拉普蘭縣42歲女性,於5/2出現腦炎症狀就醫,8日確診,目前病況危急,據調查2名家人亦出現相症狀,近期未食用水果或接觸蝙蝠,惟家中有雞隻死亡,將釐清是否與疫情相關。該邦自2018年以來已累計5起疫情共28例,其中22例死亡(CFR:78.6%)。
items.description_en: Kerala State in southern India has reported its first case this year. The index patient is a 42-year-old woman from Malappuram District who presented with encephalitis symptoms on 2 May and was confirmed on 8 May. Her condition is critical. Investigation shows that two family members have also developed similar symptoms. The patient had not recently eaten fruit or come into contact with bats, but chickens had died in the household, and whether this is related to the outbreak is being clarified. Since 2018 the state has recorded 5 outbreaks with 28 cases cumulatively, of which 22 died (CFR 78.6%).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓首次檢出H5N9禽流感,本週無新增人類感染
items.summary_en: No new human infections were reported this week; the Philippines detected H5N9 avian influenza in ducks for the first time in the country, with human risk assessed as low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共5國於2024/12/9-2025/5/4期間新增36起H5N1疫情,美國16起、荷蘭/加拿大各6起、匈牙利4起、波蘭3起、比利時1起。 共2國於2025/3/1- 4/18新增3起H5N5疫情,加拿大2起、瑞典1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,053(5)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第18週計410個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州)8個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  某回顧性研究檢視過去20年文獻,12種貓科動物共607件禽流感病毒(AIV)感染案例,發現家貓於2023-24年之感染數驟增,與H5N1 2.3.4.4b分支出現並在鳥類及哺乳動物間擴散趨勢一致。超過90%案例為感染HPAI禽流感,逾70%死亡,其中,家貓致死率超過50%,病例以感染2.3.4.4b分支為多,且感染分支之致死率更高,病毒持續演化並跨物種傳播,惟相關研究及監測仍被低估,建議應加強監測與人類頻繁接觸之哺乳動物。 菲律賓呂宋島東南部南甘馬仁省於例行性監測鴨隻樣本中檢出HPAI H5N9陽性,為該國首次檢出該病毒株,當局於當地加強監測及清消,並撲殺受影響農場鴨隻。依目前評估,H5N9流感對鳥類具高致病性,對人類風險則為低。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,694起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:  FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 5 countries reported 36 new H5N1 outbreaks between 9 December 2024 and 4 May 2025: the United States 16, the Netherlands and Canada 6 each, Hungary 4, Poland 3 and Belgium 1. A total of 2 countries reported 3 new H5N5 outbreaks between 1 March and 18 April 2025: Canada 2 and Sweden 1. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,053 (5) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 18, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 8 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: a retrospective study reviewed literature from the past 20 years and identified 607 avian influenza virus (AIV) infection cases across 12 felid species. It found that infections in domestic cats rose sharply in 2023–24, consistent with the emergence of the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and its spread among birds and mammals. More than 90% of cases were infections with highly pathogenic avian influenza, and more than 70% died; the case fatality rate in domestic cats exceeded 50%. Most cases involved the 2.3.4.4b clade, which had a higher fatality rate. The virus continues to evolve and spread across species, but related research and surveillance remain underestimated, and the study recommends strengthening surveillance of mammals that have frequent contact with humans. In Camarines Sur Province in southeastern Luzon, the Philippines, HPAI H5N9 was detected in duck samples during routine surveillance; this is the first detection of this virus strain in the country. Local authorities have strengthened surveillance and disinfection and culled ducks on affected farms. Current assessment: H5N9 is highly pathogenic to birds, and the risk to humans is low. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,694 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約2.6%;香港第18週陽性率達52週來新高
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 2.6% in week 16 of 2025; Hong Kong's positivity in week 18 reached a 52-week high.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第16週(4/14-20)全球陽性率約2.6%,陽性率以東地中海區、西太平洋區及美洲區為高。 香港第18週(4/27-5/3)陽性率持續上升,為最近52週以來最高,污水監測數據顯示,變異株XDV占比最高且呈上升趨勢。 東南亞區各國第17週陽性率介於0%-4.8%,其中,以泰國陽性率4.8%為高,主要流行變異株為XEC。  評估與建議: 球陽性率近期略升,其中,東地中海區及西太平洋區近期上升,東南亞區及非洲區呈上下波動,其他地區則呈持平或下降;全球主要流行變異株為XEC、LP.8.1及JN.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 16 of 2025 (14–20 April), the global positivity rate was about 2.6%, highest in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and Americas regions. In Hong Kong, positivity in week 18 (27 April–3 May) continued to rise and was the highest in the past 52 weeks; wastewater surveillance data show the XDV variant accounts for the largest share and is rising. Among countries in the South-East Asia Region, positivity in week 17 ranged from 0% to 4.8%, with Thailand the highest at 4.8%; the main circulating variant is XEC. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently risen slightly. It has risen recently in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions, fluctuated in the South-East Asia and African regions, and remained flat or declined elsewhere. The main variants circulating globally are XEC, LP.8.1 and JN.1. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),香港特別行政區,泰國

items.headline_zh: 美國-病毒性腸胃炎(沙門氏菌)
items.summary_zh: 美國7例腸胃炎疑與家禽有關,FDA要求召回14州番茄產品
items.summary_en: The US reported 7 gastroenteritis cases in six states, possibly linked to poultry; FDA sought recalls of possibly contaminated tomatoes sold in 14 states.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC報告7例病例,病患發病日介於2/9-3/24,分布於佛羅里達等6州,推測實際患病人數可能遠高於報告人數,經調查感染源疑為家禽;另FDA公告於2家廠商生產之番茄疑受到汙染,要求召回已於14個州販售之產品。
items.description_en: The US CDC reported 7 cases, with onset dates between 9 February and 24 March, distributed across 6 states including Florida. It estimates that the actual number of people ill may be much higher than the number reported. The investigation suspected poultry as the source of infection. In addition, the FDA announced that tomatoes produced by 2 manufacturers were suspected to be contaminated, and requested the recall of products already sold in 14 states.

items.headline_zh: 日本/韓國/美國-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Japan / South Korea / United States – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 日本今年截至5/7累計47例A型肝炎,高於去年同期43例
items.summary_en: Japan reported 47 hepatitis A cases this year as of 7 May, above last year's 43; Los Angeles County's cases doubled, with 165 since 2024 including 7 deaths.
items.description_zh: 日本今年截至5/7累計報告47例病例,高於去年同期(43例);韓國今年截至4/26累計報告399例病例,與去年同期(422例)相當。 美國加州洛杉磯郡今年截至3月累計報告29例病例,為去年同期2倍;此波疫情自2024年開始,累計165例病例,其中7例死亡,為10年來最高紀錄。
items.description_en: Japan reported 47 cases cumulatively this year as of 7 May, higher than the 43 cases in the same period last year. South Korea reported 399 cases cumulatively this year as of 26 April, comparable to the 422 cases in the same period last year. Los Angeles County, California, reported 29 cases cumulatively as of March this year, twice the number in the same period last year. This outbreak began in 2024 and has reported 165 cases cumulatively, including 7 deaths, the highest figure in 10 years.

items.headline_zh: 新加坡/日本/韓國/香港-腸病毒
items.headline_en: Singapore / Japan / South Korea / Hong Kong – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 新加坡日均51例高於2020-24年任一週;日本、韓國處低點
items.summary_en: Singapore's enterovirus cases averaged 51 a day in weeks 17–18, above any weekly total from 2020 to 2024; Japan and Korea remain at low levels.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第17-18週(4/20-5/3)疫情,新加坡疫情嚴峻,平均單日新增51例病例,高於2020-24年任一週病例數;日本定醫平均病例數0.1,較前週(0.07)增加,仍處疫情低點;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.7‰,較前週略降;香港就診陽性率為0.4‰,與前週持平。
items.description_en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 17–18 (20 April–3 May): Singapore's outbreak is severe, with an average of 51 new cases per day, higher than the weekly case count in any week of 2020–24. Japan's average sentinel clinic case count was 0.1, up from 0.07 the previous week, and it remains at a low point. South Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.7‰, slightly down from the previous week. Hong Kong's clinic-visit positivity rate was 0.4‰, unchanged from the previous week.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡

items.summary_zh: ECDC:全球今年截至5/2累計逾11.1萬例霍亂、約1,500例死亡
items.summary_en: ECDC reports more than 111,000 cholera cases and about 1,500 deaths globally as of 2 May this year, lower than last year; transmission risk remains high.
items.description_zh: ECDC公布全球今年截至5/2累計報告逾11.1萬例病例,其中約1,500例死亡(CFR:1.4%),病例/死亡數皆低於去年同期(15.1萬例/1,752例)。病例分布於非洲、美洲、東地中海及東南亞區共27個國家,新增死亡數以安哥拉、蘇丹及莫三比克等為多,評估全球傳播風險仍為高。
items.description_en: The European CDC (ECDC) reports that globally, as of 2 May this year, more than 111,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which about 1,500 died (CFR 1.4%). Both case and death numbers are lower than in the same period last year (151,000 cases and 1,752 deaths). Cases are distributed across 27 countries in Africa, the Americas, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. The largest numbers of new deaths were in Angola, Sudan and Mozambique, and the global transmission risk remains high.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),安哥拉,莫三比克,蘇丹

items.summary_zh: 美國2024-25流感季兒童死亡216例,為2009-10季以來最高
items.summary_en: US CDC reports 216 pediatric flu deaths in the 2024–25 season, the highest since 2009–10, with at least 47 million cases and 26,000 deaths overall.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC公布2024-25年流感季累計兒童死亡病例數為216例,逾上一流感季之207例,亦為2009-10年流感季以來最高,本流感季迄今累計報告至少4,700萬例,其中,61萬例住院、2.6萬例死亡,為2017-18年流感季以來最高,近期流感活動度呈下降趨勢。
items.description_en: The US CDC reported that the cumulative number of paediatric deaths in the 2024–25 influenza season is 216, exceeding the 207 in the previous season and the highest since the 2009–10 season. So far this season, at least 47 million cases have been reported cumulatively, including 610,000 hospitalizations and 26,000 deaths, the highest since the 2017–18 season. Recent influenza activity is declining.

items.headline_zh: 日本/墨西哥/美國-百日咳
items.summary_zh: 日本4/21-27通報2,176例,連5週創2018年以來新高;墨美亦升
items.summary_en: Japan reported 2,176 pertussis cases in the week of 21–27 April, the highest weekly level since 2018 for five straight weeks; Mexico and the US are also rising.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情更新,近1週(4/21-27)通報2,176例,高於前1週1,884例,已連續5週達2018年以來單週最高紀錄,新增病例數以東京都/福岡縣(142)、新潟縣(132)及兵庫縣(110)為多。今年迄今已累計近1.2萬例,為去年全年病例數2倍以上,並發生嬰兒重症及死亡案例,且各地均有抗藥性菌株感染案例。小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗。 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至5/2共31州報告835例,其中49例死亡,病例/死亡數皆高於去年全年總數(463/32),該國於疫情前之2016-19年間,每年報告約900例確診。 美國今年截至4/26累計報告逾9,000例,為去年同期之2倍,以西岸地區為多,華盛頓州報告逾1,000例,另俄勒岡(663)及加州(590)病例數亦高,該國近期疫情上升原因可能為接種率下降影響。
items.description_en: Japan update: in the most recent week (21–27 April), 2,176 cases were reported, up from 1,884 the previous week, marking five consecutive weeks at the highest weekly level since 2018. The largest numbers of new cases were in Tokyo Metropolis / Fukuoka Prefecture (142), Niigata Prefecture (132) and Hyogo Prefecture (110). So far this year, nearly 12,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, more than double the full-year total for last year. Severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported, and drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible. Mexico's outbreak is rising: as of 2 May this year, 835 cases had been reported across 31 states, 49 of them fatal, exceeding last year's full-year totals (463 cases and 32 deaths). In 2016–19, before the outbreak, about 900 confirmed cases were reported each year. The United States reported more than 9,000 cases cumulatively as of 26 April this year, twice the same period last year, mainly on the West Coast. Washington State reported more than 1,000 cases, and Oregon (663) and California (590) also had high numbers. The recent rise may be linked to declining vaccination coverage.

items.summary_zh: 韓國今年麻疹52例,多數為越南輸入;美國累計935例
items.summary_en: South Korea has 52 measles cases this year, 33 acquired in Viet Nam; the US has 935 cases in 30 states, and Chihuahua, Mexico, is surging.
items.description_zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
items.description_en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓達沃市4/16新增2例M痘II型,其中1例因免疫缺陷併發症死亡
items.summary_en: Davao City, Philippines, reported 2 new clade II mpox cases on 16 April; one patient died from complications linked to immune deficiency.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓南部達沃市4/16報告新增2例II型病例,均於4/16確診並隔離治療,其中1例因自身免疫功能不全而引發併發症死亡,當局已匡列並追蹤密切接觸者,呼籲民眾倘有症狀,應儘速就醫。
items.description_en: In Davao City in the south of the Philippines, 2 new clade II cases were reported on 16 April; both were confirmed and isolated for treatment on 16 April. One patient died from complications caused by an immune deficiency. Authorities have identified and are tracing close contacts, and urge anyone with symptoms to seek medical care as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至4/27確診707例、死亡135例,致死率19.1%
items.summary_en: Nigeria has confirmed 707 Lassa fever cases and 135 deaths this year as of 27 April, among 4,672 suspected cases; case fatality rate 19.1%.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞疫情更新,今年截至4/27累計報告18州4,672例疑及707例確診病例,其中135例死亡(CFR:19.1%)。病例多集中於翁多州、包奇州及塔拉巴州。
items.description_en: Nigeria update: as of 27 April this year, 4,672 suspected cases and 707 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 18 states, of which 135 died (CFR 19.1%). Cases are concentrated in Ondo State, Bauchi State and Taraba State.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-炭疽病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Anthrax
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國北基伍省炭疽病,截至5/2疑似16例、確診1例,1死
items.summary_en: North Kivu, DR Congo, reported 16 suspected and 1 confirmed anthrax cases as of 2 May, one fatal; the outbreak is linked to 7 suspected cases in Uganda.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國北基伍省爆發疫情,截至5/2累計16例疑及1例確診病例,其中1例死亡,主要發生在與烏干達相鄰之愛德華(Edward)湖周圍之4個衛生區,此次疫情亦與烏國西部卡巴萊區報告之7例疑病例具關聯性。當局已加強疾病監測及調查等應對措施,並評估風險及落實兩國之跨境合作。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in North Kivu Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 2 May, 16 suspected cases and 1 confirmed case had been reported cumulatively, of which 1 died. Cases mainly occurred in 4 health zones around Lake Edward, which borders Uganda. This outbreak is also linked to 7 suspected cases reported in Kabarole District in western Uganda. Authorities have strengthened disease surveillance, investigation and other response measures, assessed the risk, and are implementing cross-border cooperation between the two countries.

items.summary_zh: 納米比亞去年底至3/23累計逾3萬例瘧疾、60餘例死亡,超過2024年全年
items.summary_en: Namibia recorded over 30,000 malaria cases and more than 60 deaths from late last year to 23 March, already above 2024's full-year total of 12,000 cases.
items.description_zh: 納米比亞疫情更新,自去年底迄3/23累計逾30,000例病例及60餘例死亡,致死率為0.2%,高於去年全年12,000例病例及28例死亡。
items.description_en: Namibia update: from late last year to 23 March, more than 30,000 cases and over 60 deaths have been reported cumulatively, a CFR of 0.2%. This is higher than the full-year 2024 total of 12,000 cases and 28 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓截至4/21累計95,262例登革熱;東加累計625例、3例死亡
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 95,262 dengue cases this year as of 21 April, above the same period last year; Tonga has 625 cases and 3 deaths.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情更新,今年截至4/21累計95,262例病例,致死率為0.36%,病例數高於去年同期54,556例。 東加疫情更新,最近1天新增7例病例,自今年2月宣布疫情爆發迄今累計625例病例及3例死亡,病例分布以瓦瓦烏群島300例及湯加塔布島265例為多,主要流行型別為DENV-2。
items.description_en: Philippines update: as of 21 April this year, 95,262 cases have been reported cumulatively, with a CFR of 0.36%. This is higher than the 54,556 cases in the same period last year. Tonga update: 7 cases were reported in the most recent day. Since the outbreak was announced in February this year, 625 cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly distributed in the Vava'u island group (300 cases) and Tongatapu Island (265 cases). The main circulating serotype is DENV-2.

items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡今年迄今累計逾16,500例屈公病,西部省逾7,600例最多
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka has reported over 16,500 chikungunya cases so far this year, with more than 7,600 in the Western Province, mainly in Colombo District and Gampaha.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,今年迄今累計16,500餘例病例,以西部省7,600餘例為最多,其中病例主要分布於該省可倫坡區2,700餘例及加姆珀哈,當局正採取相關預防措施,以避免疫情蔓延。
items.description_en: Sri Lanka update: so far this year, more than 16,500 cases have been reported cumulatively, with the Western Province having the most, at more than 7,600. Cases are mainly distributed in Colombo District (more than 2,700) and Gampaha, and authorities are taking preventive measures to prevent the outbreak from spreading.

items.summary_zh: 泰國穆達漢府炭疽病2例確診、1死,逾600名接觸者追蹤中
items.summary_en: Mukdahan Province, Thailand, has 2 confirmed anthrax cases as of 2 May, one fatal, after slaughtering cattle at a religious event; over 600 contacts are traced.
items.description_zh: 泰國東北部穆達漢府(Mukdahan)爆發疫情,截至5/2累計報告2例確診病例,其中1例死亡,另有3例疑病例。首例為53歲男性,於4/24右手紅腫結節,於27日出現傷口變黑、淋巴結腫大、頭暈及抽搐等症狀就醫後死亡,經檢驗確診。病患曾參加宗教活動並宰殺牛隻,且分送村民食用;第2例為死者友人,一同宰殺牛隻,後出現皮膚水泡潰傷症狀,目前已住院接受抗生素治療,狀況良好;當局已追蹤當日宰殺牛隻等接觸者共600餘人,並對高風險族群預防性用藥,進行區域疫情管控,並安排當地牛隻施打疫苗。泰國於2000年報告15例,無死亡病例,2017年與緬甸鄰近之達府報告2例,皆曾處理山羊;鄰近之寮國於去(2024)年報告129例及1例死亡;越南於2023年報告3起與食用牛肉相關之疫情,累計報告13例。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in Mukdahan Province in northeastern Thailand. As of 2 May, 2 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 1 died, with 3 further suspected cases. The first case was a 53-year-old man who developed a red, swollen nodule on his right hand on 24 April; on 27 April he developed a blackened wound, lymph node swelling, dizziness and convulsions, and died after seeking medical care. Laboratory testing confirmed the diagnosis. The patient had attended a religious activity and slaughtered cattle, and the meat was shared with villagers to eat. The second case was a friend of the deceased who slaughtered the cattle together with him and later developed skin blisters and ulcers; he is now hospitalized receiving antibiotic treatment and is in good condition. Authorities have traced more than 600 contacts, including others who slaughtered cattle that day, given preventive medication to high-risk groups, implemented regional outbreak control measures, and arranged vaccination of local cattle. Thailand reported 15 cases in 2000 with no deaths. In 2017, Tak Province, which borders Myanmar, reported 2 cases, both of whom had handled goats. Neighboring Laos reported 129 cases and 1 death last year (2024). Viet Nam reported 3 outbreaks linked to beef consumption in 2023, with 13 cases cumulatively.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國CDC將2株新H5N1病毒列入IRAT評估,評為中度風險
items.summary_en: US CDC added two new H5N1 viruses to its influenza risk assessment tool, rating them moderate risk; no new human infections were reported this week.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共8國於2025/2/17-4/28期間新增52起H5N1疫情,美國17起、韓國12起、英國11起、德國/波蘭各4起、匈牙利2起、孟加拉/丹麥各1起。 共2國於2025/3/17-4/11期間新增2起H5N5疫情,挪威/英國各1起。 日本於2025/4/25新增1起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,048 (17)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第17週計407個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州)5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC於5月2日更新流感風險評估工具(IRAT),將兩種新H5N1病毒列入評估名單:A/California/147/2024(基因型B3.13)及A/Washington/239/2024(基因型D1.1),兩病毒均屬H5N1 2.3.4.4b群,並被評為「中度風險」,近於先前被評估之其他 H5N1病毒。 期刊於4/28評論,來自40多國專家呼籲各國應加強監測、增強生物安全及新興傳染病整備計畫,以應對H5N1流感威脅,美國自2024年迄今超過995起乳牛場疫情及至少70例人類病例,並包含多起重症及該國首例死亡病例,部分人類病例未曾接觸感染動物,顯示病毒可能發生適應,並具有人際傳播潛力,另病毒持續於野鳥、家禽及被狩獵候鳥中傳播,亦增加人類及家畜風險。持續投入人畜監測資源,即時分享現地異常資訊及病毒基因學資料,對於掌握病毒動態至關重要。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,656起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約2.4%持平;美國陽性率、急診與住院率下降
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 2.4% in week 15 of 2025, roughly flat; US positivity, emergency visits and hospitalizations were declining.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第15週(4/7-13)全球陽性率約2.4%,陽性率以東地中海區、西太平洋區及美洲區為高。 香港第17週(4/20-26)陽性率及定醫就診率持續上升,污水監測數據顯示,變異株KP.3占比最高,其次為變異株XDV。 美國近期陽性/急診就診/住院率均呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株LP.8.1呈上升趨勢,另變異株LF.7.7.2占比略升。  評估與建議:球陽性率近期持平,其中,東地中海區、西太平洋區及東南亞區近期上升,非洲區呈上下波動,其他地區則呈持平或下降;全球主要流行變異株為XEC及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 15 of 2025 (7–13 April), the global positivity rate was about 2.4%, highest in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and Americas regions. In Hong Kong, positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates continued to rise in week 17 (20–26 April); wastewater surveillance data show the KP.3 variant accounts for the largest share, followed by XDV. In the United States, recent positivity, emergency department visit and hospitalization rates have all declined; the main circulating variant, LP.8.1, is rising, and the share of LF.7.7.2 has risen slightly. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been roughly flat, with recent rises in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and South-East Asia regions, fluctuations in the African region, and flat or declining trends elsewhere. The main variants circulating globally are XEC and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),香港特別行政區,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 阿富汗/衣索比亞/奈及利亞-小兒麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗新增1例WPV1小兒麻痺,衣索比亞3例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: GPEI reported one new WPV1 polio case in Afghanistan and 4 cVDPV2 cases, 3 in Ethiopia and 1 in Nigeria, for 17–23 April.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/17-23期間,WPV1型新增阿富汗1例,cVDPV2型新增2國共4例,分別為衣索比亞3例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 17 and 23 April, one new WPV1 case was reported in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2 cases increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Ethiopia and 1 in Nigeria. For environmental samples, one new WPV1-positive sample was reported in Afghanistan.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,衣索比亞,奈及利亞

items.headline_zh: 中國/日本/韓國/荷蘭-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: China / Japan / South Korea / Netherlands – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 中國3月1,919例A型肝炎仍高於去年同期;荷蘭24例疑與冷凍藍莓有關
items.summary_en: China reported 1,919 hepatitis A cases in March, above the same period last year; the Netherlands recorded 24 cases, with frozen blueberries suspected as the source.
items.description_zh: 中國疫情持續,今年3月報告1,919例病例,較1、2月(月增約2,200例)下降,惟仍高於去年同期(1,624例);日本今年截至4/13累計報告42例病例,高於去年同期(28例);韓國今年截至4/24累計報告377例病例,與去年同期(381例)相當。 荷蘭於3月中旬報告24例病例,其中8例住院,病患發病日介於去(2024)年11月至今年2月,經當局調查疑感染源為超市的冷凍藍莓並提醒民眾不要食用該批產品。
items.description_en: China's outbreak continues: 1,919 cases were reported in March this year, down from January and February (a monthly increase of about 2,200 cases), but still higher than the same period last year (1,624 cases). Japan reported 42 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, higher than the 28 cases in the same period last year. South Korea reported 377 cases cumulatively this year as of 24 April, comparable to the 381 cases in the same period last year. The Netherlands reported 24 cases in mid-March, 8 of whom were hospitalized. The patients had onset between November 2024 and February this year. Investigation suggests the suspected source was frozen blueberries sold at supermarkets, and the public has been advised not to eat that batch of product.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),日本,韓國,荷蘭

items.headline_zh: 新加坡/日本/韓國/香港-腸病毒
items.headline_en: Singapore / Japan / South Korea / Hong Kong – Enterovirus
items.summary_zh: 新加坡日均53例已連4週增加,高於去年任一單週;日韓處低點
items.summary_en: Singapore's enterovirus cases averaged 53 a day in weeks 16–17, up for four straight weeks and above any single week last year; Japan and Korea are low.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第16-17週(4/13-4/26)疫情,新加坡疫情上升,平均單日新增53例病例,已連續4週增加,且高於去年任一單週病例數;日本疫情處相對低點,定醫平均病例數0.07,較前週增加;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.8‰,與前週持平;香港處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.4‰。
items.description_en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 16–17 (13–26 April): Singapore's outbreak is rising, with an average of 53 new cases per day, up for four consecutive weeks and higher than any single week last year. Japan's outbreak is at a relatively low point, with an average sentinel clinic case count of 0.07, up from the previous week. South Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.8‰, unchanged from the previous week. Hong Kong is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.4‰.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡

items.summary_zh: 日本4/14-20通報1,884例,今年累計9,336例,連4週創2018年新高
items.summary_en: Japan reported 1,884 pertussis cases in the week of 14–20 April, with 9,336 so far this year, the highest weekly level since 2018 for four straight weeks.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(4/14-20)通報1,884例,高於前1週1,222例,已連續4週達2018年以來單週最高紀錄。病例數以兵庫縣(134)、新潟縣(127) 及東京都(116)為多。今年迄今已累計9,336例,較去年全年病例數多5,000餘例,並發生嬰兒重症及死亡案例,且各地均有抗藥性菌株感染案例。專家表示今年疫情持續擴大可能原因為新冠疫情期間,因感染產生免疫人數下降,另抗藥性菌株增加,致常用抗生素失效,導致感染擴大。小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗,另建議兒童接種追加劑,以避免衍生重症。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is severe. In the most recent week (14–20 April), 1,884 cases were reported, up from 1,222 the previous week, marking four consecutive weeks at the highest weekly level since 2018. The largest numbers of cases were in Hyogo Prefecture (134), Niigata Prefecture (127) and Tokyo Metropolis (116). So far this year, 9,336 cases have been reported cumulatively, more than 5,000 above last year's full-year total. Severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported, and drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions. Experts say the continued expansion of the outbreak this year may be due to a decline in immunity from infections during the COVID-19 pandemic, and to an increase in drug-resistant strains that have rendered commonly used antibiotics ineffective, allowing infections to spread. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible, and recommends booster doses for children to avoid severe illness.

items.headline_zh: 澳大利亞/越南/羅馬尼亞-麻疹
items.summary_zh: 維多利亞州麻疹近10年最重;歐洲2024年逾3.5萬例,羅馬尼亞占87%
items.summary_en: Victoria, Australia, has its worst measles outbreak in nearly 10 years; Europe recorded over 35,000 cases in 2024, with Romania accounting for 87% of EU cases.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞維多利亞州爆發近10年以來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計23例,超過去年全年病例數,當地本土病例數上升,多數病例未完整接種疫苗,當局表示大墨爾本及鄰近地區傳播風險上升,亦須持續因應返國旅客之境外移入風險。 越南疫情更新,近1週(4/19-4/25)新增3,900餘例,較前1週減少4.3%,近期多數地區疫情已趨緩,惟北部地區疫情仍持續,今年截至4月下旬已累計8.1萬例。目前共52個省達疫苗覆蓋率95%以上目標,然偏遠地區及都會地區接種率仍偏低,部分民眾存在疫苗猶豫及基層醫事人員不足,致疫情控制仍面臨挑戰。 ECDC公布2024年麻疹流行病學報告,於去年報告3.5萬餘例,較2023年3,900餘例上升近10倍,歐洲地區於2023年疫情開始上升,2024年通報率為每百萬人77.4例,高於2023年9.1例,亦高於疫情前水平(27.2例),其中以羅馬亞為高,占歐盟病例87%。病例多為1歲以下嬰兒,惟部分國家成人病例數占比達28-53%,去年23例死亡病例中有22例來自羅馬亞,逾半為5歲以下兒童。歐盟會員國去年第1劑接種率為93.9%,低於2023年94.2%,僅4國第2劑接種率達95%目標,多數會員國未達接種建議水準。
items.description_en: Victoria State in Australia has experienced its most severe outbreak in nearly 10 years, with 23 cases cumulatively this year, exceeding last year's full-year total. Locally acquired cases have increased, and most cases were not fully vaccinated. Authorities say the risk of transmission has risen in Greater Melbourne and nearby areas, and the imported risk from returning travelers must continue to be addressed. Viet Nam update: in the most recent week (19–25 April), more than 3,900 new cases were reported, a 4.3% decrease from the previous week. The outbreak has eased in most areas recently, but it continues in the northern region, and 81,000 cases have been reported cumulatively this year as of late April. Currently 52 provinces have reached the target of 95% vaccination coverage, but coverage remains low in remote and urban areas, and some people are hesitant about vaccines and there is a shortage of primary healthcare workers, so outbreak control still faces challenges. The ECDC published its 2024 measles epidemiological report: more than 35,000 cases were reported last year, nearly 10 times the more than 3,900 cases in 2023. The European region's outbreak began rising in 2023; the 2024 notification rate was 77.4 cases per million population, higher than 9.1 in 2023 and also higher than the pre-pandemic level (27.2). Romania had the highest rate, accounting for 87% of EU cases. Most cases were in infants under 1 year, but in some countries adults accounted for 28–53% of cases. Of last year's 23 deaths, 22 were in Romania, and more than half were children under 5. First-dose vaccination coverage in EU member states last year was 93.9%, lower than 94.2% in 2023; only 4 countries reached the 95% second-dose target, and most member states did not reach recommended vaccination levels.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,羅馬尼亞,越南

items.headline_zh: 伊拉克-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 伊拉克今年9省報告27例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,7例死亡
items.summary_en: Iraq has reported 27 Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases this year across 9 provinces, 7 of them fatal; Dhi Qar Province had the most, with 8.
items.description_zh: 伊拉克疫情更新,今年迄今共9省報告27例,其中7例死亡,病例以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)8例為多,其次為穆薩納省(Muthanna)7例及北部基爾庫克省(Kirkuk) 6例。當局呼籲屠宰業者於屠宰前應進行清消,並於合法地點進行相關作業;民眾於可信賴管道購買肉品,並徹底煮熟肉類等。
items.description_en: Iraq update: so far this year, 27 cases have been reported across 9 provinces, 7 of them fatal. Cases are most numerous in Dhi Qar Province in the south (8), followed by Muthanna Province (7) and Kirkuk Province in the north (6). Authorities urge slaughterhouse operators to disinfect before slaughter and to carry out slaughter only at legal sites. The public is advised to buy meat from trusted sources and to cook meat thoroughly.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染(蘇丹病毒疾病)
items.headline_en: Uganda – Ebola virus disease (Sudan virus disease)
items.summary_zh: 烏干達宣布伊波拉病毒感染(蘇丹病毒病)疫情結束,共14例、4例死亡
items.summary_en: Uganda declared its Sudan virus disease outbreak over on 26 April, after 42 days without new cases; 14 cases, 12 confirmed and 4 deaths, were reported.
items.description_zh: 烏干達於4/26宣布疫情結束,自3/14最後1例確診蘇丹病毒疾病(SVD)患者檢測為陰性以來,已連續2個潛伏期(共42天)未通報新增病例。疫情於1/30宣布爆發後,截至疫情結束共報告14例,其中12例確診及4例死亡,病例來自該國7個地區,此次疫情為烏國第6次疫情,目前疫情雖已結束,惟當局仍持續保持監測,以備迅速應對未來可能再次發生之疫情,另疫情來源及範圍仍持續調查中。
items.description_en: Uganda declared the end of its outbreak on 26 April. Since the last confirmed Sudan virus disease (SVD) patient tested negative on 14 March, no new cases have been reported for two consecutive incubation periods (42 days in total). After the outbreak was declared on 30 January, 14 cases were reported by the end of the outbreak, of which 12 were confirmed and 4 died. Cases came from 7 districts in the country. This was Uganda's sixth outbreak. Although the outbreak has ended, authorities continue surveillance to be ready to respond rapidly if an outbreak recurs, and the source and scope of this outbreak are still under investigation.

items.summary_zh: 獅子山今年迄今763例M痘、6例死亡,已展開12歲以上兒童接種
items.summary_en: Sierra Leone has reported 763 mpox cases and 6 deaths this year, after declaring a public health emergency in January; vaccination since April includes children aged 12 and over.
items.description_zh: 獅子山今年1月宣布公共衛生緊急狀態,今年迄今報告763例,其中6例死亡,病例數以首都自由市為多,WHO提供該國6萬餘劑疫苗,自4月起為醫護人員、高風險族群及12歲以上孩童進行接種。
items.description_en: Sierra Leone declared a public health emergency in January this year. So far this year, 763 cases have been reported, including 6 deaths, with cases concentrated in the capital, Freetown. WHO has provided more than 60,000 vaccine doses, and since April vaccination has been given to health workers, high-risk groups and children aged 12 and over.

items.summary_zh: 美洲6國今年逾2,300例麻疹、3例死亡,較去年同期升11倍
items.summary_en: Six Americas countries reported over 2,300 measles cases and 3 deaths as of 18 April, 11 times the same period last year; WHO rates regional risk high.
items.description_zh: WHO於4/28公布美洲今年截至4/18疫情概況,共6國報告超過2,300例,其中3例死亡,較去(2024)年同期上升11倍,以加拿大報告1,069例為多,其次為美國(800例,2例死亡)、墨西哥(421例,1例死亡),阿根廷/巴西/貝里斯報告2-21例間。因境外病例持續輸入導致疫情爆發,傳播鏈延長,影響範圍擴大,且美洲區疫苗覆蓋率不佳,僅約30%國家第一劑MMR疫苗覆蓋率超過95%目標,另新冠疫情、疫苗猶豫及醫療保健資源限制,致疫苗覆蓋率偏低,易感人群數上升。WHO評估該地區風險為高。其他區署疫情持續,且因資源限制、及公衛系統薄弱等因素,評估全球風險為中。
items.description_en: WHO published on 28 April an overview of the Americas as of 18 April this year: 6 countries reported more than 2,300 cases, including 3 deaths, 11 times the figure for the same period last year. Canada reported the most, with 1,069 cases, followed by the United States (800 cases, 2 deaths) and Mexico (421 cases, 1 death); Argentina, Brazil and Belize reported between 2 and 21 cases each. Continuing imported cases have led to outbreaks, lengthening transmission chains and expanding the affected area. Vaccination coverage in the Americas is poor: only about 30% of countries have first-dose MMR coverage above the 95% target. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy and limited healthcare resources have lowered vaccination coverage and increased the number of susceptible people. WHO assesses the risk in the region as high. Outbreaks in other regions continue, and due to resource constraints and weak public health systems, the global risk is assessed as moderate.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,貝里斯,巴西,加拿大,墨西哥,美國

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年已2例利什曼原蟲症死亡,分別在宋卡及曼谷
items.summary_en: Thailand has recorded two leishmaniasis deaths this year, in Songkhla and Bangkok; authorities issued an alert, as the disease is rare there.
items.description_zh: 泰國自今年以來已通報2例死亡案例,1例在宋卡,另1例在曼谷,當局已發布警報,提醒民眾採取預防措施,該疾病在該國屬罕見疾病,自1996年迄今記錄40多例病例。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 2 deaths since the beginning of this year, one in Songkhla and one in Bangkok. Authorities have issued an alert reminding the public to take precautionary measures. The disease is rare in Thailand, with more than 40 cases recorded since 1996.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年截至4/22累計8,901例,聖埃斯皮里圖州5,826例最多
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported 8,901 Oropouche fever cases this year as of 22 April, most in Espírito Santo with 5,826; 13,791 cases were reported in 2024.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年截至4/22累計報告8,901例病例,以東南部聖埃斯皮里圖州5,826例病例為多,其次為里約熱內盧州1,466例;該國2024年累計13,791例病例,2023年累計832例病例。
items.description_en: Brazil update: as of 22 April this year, 8,901 cases have been reported cumulatively, with 5,826 in Espírito Santo State in the southeast, followed by 1,466 in Rio de Janeiro State. The country reported 13,791 cases cumulatively in 2024 and 832 cases cumulatively in 2023.

items.headline_zh: 法屬留尼旺島/法屬馬約特島-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 留尼旺島今年累計39,532例屈公病,近1週本土4,304例
items.summary_en: Réunion has reported 39,532 chikungunya cases this year, with 4,304 locally acquired in the latest week; Mayotte has 55 cases, 17 of them local.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島疫情更新,近1週報告4,304例本土病例,今年迄今累計39,532例病例,自第11週迄今已報告47例重症,重症個案主要為老年族群及嬰兒。 法屬馬約特島疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告55例病例,其中17例為本土病例,1例住院治療,迄無死亡病例,該國鄰近之法屬留旺島近期疫情亦為嚴峻。
items.description_en: Réunion update: the outbreak is ongoing. In the most recent week, 4,304 locally acquired cases were reported, and so far this year 39,532 cases have been reported cumulatively. Since week 11, 47 severe cases have been reported, mainly among older people and infants. Mayotte update: 55 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, of which 17 were locally acquired; 1 patient is hospitalized and there have been no deaths so far. The recent outbreak on neighboring Réunion is also severe.
items.area_zh: 法屬馬約特島,法屬留尼旺島

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年截至4/15累計近100萬例登革熱,634例死亡
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported nearly 1 million dengue cases and 634 deaths this year as of 15 April, with São Paulo State accounting for 578,937 cases.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年截至4/15累計報告近100萬例病例,其中634例死亡,病例分布以聖保羅州(578,937例)、米納斯吉拉斯州(107,661例)及巴拉那州(79,341例)為多,該國2024年累計報告1千萬餘例病例。
items.description_en: Brazil update: as of 15 April this year, nearly 1 million cases have been reported cumulatively, including 634 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in São Paulo State (578,937), Minas Gerais State (107,661) and Paraná State (79,341). The country reported more than 10 million cases cumulatively in 2024.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年截至第16週累計逾1.7萬例確診,非洲占1.4萬例
items.summary_en: Mpox: 17,373 confirmed cases in 68 countries and regions this year through week 16, 14,564 in Africa; WHO says it remains a public health emergency of international concern.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年4/20累計132國/地區報告13萬8,085例確診病例,其中至少317例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第16週累計68國/地區報告1萬7,373例確診病例,其中非洲區1萬4,564例、美洲區1,500例、西太平洋區344例、歐洲區913例、東南亞區26例及東地中海區26例。  其他更新:   WHO公布3/28-4/20期間共4國(英國、法國、瑞士、泰國)新增4例Ib型病例,中國新增2例Ia型病例,多數具中非地區旅遊史。  評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。 另針對各分支風險評估如下:  Ia分支:於DRC傳播風險為中; Ib分支:於DRC及鄰近區域傳播風險為高; II分支:於奈及利亞及中、西非區域傳播風險為中; IIb分支 : 國際傳播風險為中。
items.description_en: Monthly update: as of 20 April this year, 132 countries and regions have reported 138,085 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 317 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 16 this year, 68 countries and regions have reported 17,373 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 14,564 in the African Region, 1,500 in the Region of the Americas, 344 in the Western Pacific Region, 913 in the European Region, 26 in the South-East Asia Region and 26 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: WHO reported that between 28 March and 20 April, 4 countries (the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and Thailand) reported 4 new clade Ib cases, and China reported 2 new clade Ia cases; most had travel history to Central Africa. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccine and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Risk assessment by clade: clade Ia, transmission risk in the DRC is moderate; clade Ib, transmission risk in the DRC and neighboring areas is high; clade II, transmission risk in Nigeria and across Central and West Africa is moderate; clade IIb, international transmission risk is moderate.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染;H1N2豬流感病毒被評估具人際傳播潛力
items.summary_en: No new human infections were reported this week; an H1N2 swine influenza study assesses the virus as having potential for human-to-human transmission.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共10國於2025/1/7-4/23期間新增41起H5N1疫情,匈牙利13起、波蘭9起、越南7起、美國5起、瑞典2起、南韓/比利時/法國/芬蘭/立陶宛各1起。 日本於2025/4/11-4/24期間新增3起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,031 (10)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第16週計410個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、明蘇達、紐澤西)4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:外媒報導2024年H1N2豬流感研究,病毒於歐洲由禽類跨物種傳播至豬隻形成H1N2 1C譜系,自2011-24年間報告至少29例人類感染事件,其中近半數發生於2021年後。據調查顯示多數人對該病毒無免疫力,目前疫苗對該病毒保護效力較低;於動物實驗中,病毒可與人類呼吸道受體結合,且可在支氣管細胞中有效複製,具高度穩定性及高活性神經胺酸酶等特性,評估具有人際傳播潛力。惟現有證據顯示病毒致死率低,於豬隻感染症狀亦屬輕微,且未具高致病性,惟因具備人際傳播潛力及多數人無免疫能力,仍需持續納入監測及定期風險評估。 年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,601起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks between 11 and 24 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,031 (10) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 16, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Minnesota and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: foreign media reported on a 2024 study of H1N2 swine influenza. The virus was transmitted from birds to pigs in Europe, forming the H1N2 1C lineage; at least 29 human infection events were reported between 2011 and 2024, nearly half of them after 2021. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,601 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約2.3%;中國3月新增56,286例,含131例重症、7例死亡
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 2.3% in week 14 of 2025; China reported 56,286 cases in March, including 131 severe cases and 7 deaths.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:   2025年第14週(3/31-4/6)全球陽性率約2.3%,陽性率以東地中海區、西太平洋區及美洲區為高。 中國3月疫情概況,新增56,286例確診病例,其中131例重症及7例死亡,相較於2月病例/重症/死亡數均呈上升,新冠病毒陽性率略升,主要流行為XDV及其衍生變異株;香港第16週(4/13-19)陽性率及定醫就診率均上升,污水監測數據顯示,變異株XDV占比呈上升趨勢。  評估與建議:全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,東地中海區、西太平洋區及東南亞區近期上升,其他地區則呈下降趨勢;全球主要流行變異株為XEC及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 14 of 2025 (31 March–6 April), the global positivity rate was about 2.3%, highest in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and Americas regions. China's March figures: 56,286 confirmed cases were newly reported, including 131 severe cases and 7 deaths. Compared with February, cases, severe cases and deaths all increased, and positivity rose slightly; the main circulating variants are XDV and its derivatives. In Hong Kong, positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates both rose in week 16 (13–19 April), and wastewater surveillance data show the share of the XDV variant is rising. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity is trending downward, with recent rises in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and South-East Asia regions and downward trends elsewhere; the main variants circulating globally are XEC and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 全球cVDPV2新增15例,衣索比亞11例;巴基斯坦WPV1環境樣本25件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 15 new cVDPV2 polio cases in 3 countries for 10–16 April, 11 in Ethiopia; Pakistan logged 25 WPV1-positive environmental samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/10-16期間,cVDPV2型新增3國共15例,分別為衣索比亞11例、查德3例、日1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1陽性樣本新增2國共33件,分別為巴基斯坦25件、阿富汗8件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增4國共12件,分別為吉布地7件、查德3件、巴勒斯坦/巴布亞紐幾內亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 10 and 16 April, cVDPV2 cases increased by 15 across 3 countries: 11 in Ethiopia, 3 in Chad and 1 in Niger. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 33 across 2 countries: 25 in Pakistan and 8 in Afghanistan. cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 12 across 4 countries: 7 in Djibouti, 3 in Chad, and 1 each in the State of Palestine and Papua New Guinea.

items.summary_en: Bacolod City, Philippines, reported 27 typhoid cases as of 22 March this year, up from 11 in the same period last year; authorities issued a warning.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓西內羅省(Negros Occidental)巴克羅德市(Bacolod City)今年截至3/22累計報告27例病例,較去年同期(11例)上升,當局發布傷寒警告。
items.description_en: In Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, Philippines, 27 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of 22 March, up from 11 in the same period last year. Authorities have issued a typhoid warning.

items.headline_zh: 亞洲-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 中國1、2月各約2,200例,為去年同期2倍;日本、印度增加
items.summary_en: China reported about 2,200 hepatitis A cases in each of January and February, double last year's; Japan and India also rose.
items.description_zh: 亞洲部分國家疫情上升,中國今年1、2月各報告約2,200例病例,為去年同期2倍;日本今年截至4/6累計報告41例病例,高於去年同期(26例);印度今年截至2/23累計報告10起群聚案件,高於去年同期(2起),病患多分布於南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala);韓國今年截至4/12累計報告360例病例,與去年同期(369例)相當;泰國今年截至3/22累計報告189例病例,第11-12週(3/9-3/22)疫情下降。
items.description_en: Outbreaks are rising in some Asian countries. China reported about 2,200 cases in each of January and February this year, double the same period last year. Japan reported 41 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, higher than the 26 in the same period last year. India reported 10 clusters cumulatively this year as of 23 February, higher than the 2 in the same period last year, with cases mainly in Kerala State in the south. South Korea reported 360 cases cumulatively this year as of 12 April, comparable to the 369 in the same period last year. Thailand reported 189 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 March, and the outbreak declined in weeks 11–12 (9–22 March).

items.summary_zh: WHO:全球今年截至3月累計11.7萬例霍亂、1,514例死亡
items.summary_en: WHO reports 116,574 cholera cases and 1,514 deaths globally through March this year; March saw about 33,000 cases, and transmission risk is rated very high.
items.description_zh: WHO於4/22公布全球今年迄3月累計報告11萬6,574例病例,1,514例死亡,其中,3月份報告近3萬3,000例病例,517例死亡(CFR:1.6%),較2月病例/死亡數分別下降9%及8%。病患分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞區域共22個國家,新增病例數以南蘇丹(7,709例)、阿富汗(7,130例)及剛果民主共和國(5,679例)等為多,WHO評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reported on 22 April that globally, as of March this year, 116,574 cases and 1,514 deaths had been reported cumulatively. In March alone, nearly 33,000 cases and 517 deaths were reported (CFR 1.6%), a decrease of 9% in cases and 8% in deaths compared with February. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia. The largest numbers of new cases were in South Sudan (7,709), Afghanistan (7,130) and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (5,679). WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

items.summary_zh: 廣東省3月猩紅熱逾1,500例,較2月增逾640例,4至6月為高峰
items.summary_en: Guangdong Province, China, reported over 1,500 scarlet fever cases in March, up more than 640 from February; the peak season is April to June.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省3月報告逾1,500例,較2月增加640餘例,當地猩紅熱流行高峰於4至6月間,當局提醒家長應為孩童做好個人防護,減少交叉感染風險。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province in China reported more than 1,500 cases in March, an increase of more than 640 over February. The local scarlet fever epidemic peaks between April and June, and authorities remind parents to take personal protective measures for their children to reduce the risk of cross-infection.

items.headline_zh: 越南/吉爾吉斯/美國/加拿大-麻疹
items.headline_en: Viet Nam / Kyrgyzstan / United States / Canada – Measles
items.summary_zh: 越南今年累計7.6萬例麻疹,吉爾吉斯逾5,100例
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has recorded 76,000 measles cases this year, with 10 deaths; Kyrgyzstan has over 5,100 cases and rising, and Canada's count is its highest since 1998.
items.description_zh: 越南近1週(4/12-4/17)新增4,100餘例疑病例,較前1週4,500餘例下降8.8%,另有2例死亡,今年迄今累計63省市報告7.6萬例,其中超過8,600例確診及10例死亡。當局表示病例數於近期呈下降趨勢,新增病例多位於北部地區,其他地區已趨緩,經大規模疫苗接種後,10歲以下病例數已趨緩,惟10歲以上仍上升。目前該國已有52個省市接種率達95%以上接種目標,然偏遠地區及都會地區接種率仍偏低,部分民眾存在疫苗猶豫及基層醫事人員不足,致疫情控制仍面臨挑戰。 吉爾吉斯疫情嚴峻,今年迄4/10報告逾5,100例,病例數遽增,當局表示民眾因宗教因素及疫苗猶豫未接種疫苗,目前依法限制未接種疫苗者進入教育機構,並呼籲民眾接種疫苗。 美國今年截至4/17共25州報告800例及3例死亡,並報告10起疫情,其中德州報告逾600例,另有3州(路易斯安那/密蘇里/維吉亞)報告今年首例;加拿大今年截至4/5共6省報告880例,以安大略省804例為多,多數病例與去年10月新布藍茲維省所爆發疫情相關,該國病例數已達1998年以來最高。
items.description_en: Viet Nam update: in the most recent week (12–17 April), more than 4,100 suspected cases were reported, down 8.8% from more than 4,500 the previous week, with 2 deaths. So far this year, 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively across 63 provinces and cities, of which more than 8,600 were confirmed and 10 died. Authorities say case numbers have declined recently; new cases are mostly in the north, and other areas have eased. After large-scale vaccination, cases among children under 10 have slowed, but cases among those over 10 are still rising. Currently 52 provinces and cities have reached the target of more than 95% vaccination coverage, but coverage remains low in remote and urban areas, and some people are hesitant about vaccines and there is a shortage of primary healthcare workers, so outbreak control still faces challenges. Kyrgyzstan's outbreak is severe: as of 10 April this year, more than 5,100 cases had been reported, and case numbers have risen rapidly. Authorities say some people have not been vaccinated for religious reasons or due to vaccine hesitancy; unvaccinated people are now legally restricted from entering educational institutions, and the public is urged to get vaccinated. The United States reported 800 cases and 3 deaths in 25 states as of 17 April this year, with 10 outbreaks reported; more than 600 cases were in Texas, and 3 other states (Louisiana, Missouri and Virginia) reported their first cases this year. As of 5 April, Canada had reported 880 cases across 6 provinces this year, 804 of them in Ontario; most cases are linked to the outbreak that broke out in New Brunswick last October, and the country's case count has reached its highest level since 1998.

items.summary_zh: 日本4/7-13通報1,222例,連3週創2018年來新高;美國逾8,000例
items.summary_en: Japan reported 1,222 pertussis cases in the week of 7–13 April, the highest weekly level since 2018 for three straight weeks; the US has over 8,000 this year.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(4/7-13)通報1,222例,高於前1週722例,已連續3週達2018年以來單週最高紀錄,病例數以新潟縣(99)、東京都(89)及兵庫縣(86)為多。今年迄今已累計7,084例,較去年全年病例數多3,000餘例,並發生嬰兒重症及死亡案例。小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上之嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗,另建議兒童接種追加劑,以避免衍生重症。 美國今年迄今累計超過8,000例,較去年同期3,800餘例顯著上升,已有多個州陸續報告嬰幼兒及兒童死亡案例,該國去年病例數達10年以來新高,迄今持續上升,由於新冠疫情影響及對疫苗猶豫之家長數增加皆使疫苗接種率下降。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is severe. In the most recent week (7–13 April), 1,222 cases were reported, up from 722 the previous week, marking three consecutive weeks at the highest weekly level since 2018. The largest numbers of cases were in Niigata Prefecture (99), Tokyo Metropolis (89) and Hyogo Prefecture (86). So far this year, 7,084 cases have been reported cumulatively, more than 3,000 above last year's full-year total, and there have been severe cases and deaths among infants. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible, and recommends booster doses for children to avoid severe illness. The United States has reported more than 8,000 cases cumulatively so far this year, significantly higher than the more than 3,800 cases in the same period last year. Several states have reported deaths among infants and children. The US reached a 10-year high in cases last year, and numbers continue to rise; declining vaccination coverage is attributed to the COVID-19 pandemic and a growing number of parents hesitant about vaccines.

items.headline_en: United States – Syphilis and congenital syphilis
items.summary_zh: 美國威斯康辛州梅毒病例較2019年增14.5倍,先天性梅毒2024年31例
items.summary_en: Wisconsin's syphilis cases are 14.5 times their 2019 level and above the national average; congenital syphilis rose from 25 cases in 2023 to 31 in 2024.
items.description_zh: 美國威斯康辛州於2024年報告3.1萬餘例性傳染病,超過一半以上感染者年齡介於15-24歲,雖然整體感染率下降,惟梅毒病例數較2019年上升14.5倍,且高於全國平均水準。另先天性梅毒於2023-24年分別報告25例及31例,當局將密切注意先天性梅毒病例數增加之問題。
items.description_en: Wisconsin reported more than 31,000 sexually transmitted infections in 2024, more than half of those infected aged 15–24. Although the overall infection rate has declined, syphilis cases are 14.5 times the 2019 level and higher than the national average. Congenital syphilis cases were 25 in 2023 and 31 in 2024; authorities will closely monitor the rise in congenital syphilis cases.

items.summary_zh: 昆士蘭州今年截至4/6累計184例類鼻疽、26例死亡,超過2024年同期3倍
items.summary_en: Queensland has 184 melioidosis cases as of 6 April this year, over triple the same period in 2024, with 26 deaths; January–March already exceed 2020–24 annual totals.
items.description_zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州病例數顯著上升,今年截至4/6累計報告184例,為2024年同期之3倍以上,並報告26例死亡,今年1-3月病例數已超過2020-24年之各全年病例數。該州3月受洪水影響,環境中存在受污染土壤及汙水,增加慢性病等具潛在健康問題族群之感染風險。
items.description_en: Queensland, Australia, has seen a significant rise in cases: as of 6 April this year, 184 cases had been reported cumulatively, more than three times the same period in 2024, and 26 deaths were reported. Cases from January to March this year already exceed the full-year totals for each year from 2020 to 2024. In March the state was affected by flooding, leaving contaminated soil and wastewater in the environment, which increases the infection risk for people with chronic conditions and other potential health problems.

items.summary_zh: 美國明尼蘇達州2024年兔熱病5例,全數住院,4例具肺炎症狀
items.summary_en: Minnesota reported 5 tularemia cases in 2024, all hospitalized, 4 with pneumonia symptoms; the US records 200–300 human infections a year.
items.description_zh: 美國明蘇達州於去(2024)年報告5例,病患皆住院,其中4例具肺炎感染症狀,相較2000-23年間之32例確定病例,僅2例出現肺炎感染。所有病患皆以抗生素作暴露後預防,出院後無併發症,據調查,2名感染者曾接觸過動物屍體。該州過去平均每年僅報告1-2例人類/動物感染病例,惟於2023年報告20例動物病例,2024年報告5例人類及27例動物病例。另美國每年報告200-300例人類感染病例,大多數發生於中部地區。
items.description_en: Minnesota reported 5 cases in 2024, all hospitalized, 4 of them with pneumonia symptoms. By comparison, of 32 confirmed cases in 2000–23, only 2 had pneumonia. All patients received antibiotics as post-exposure prophylaxis and had no complications after discharge. According to investigation, 2 of the infected people had handled animal carcasses. The state reported only 1–2 human or animal infections per year on average in the past, but reported 20 animal cases in 2023, and 5 human and 27 animal cases in 2024. In addition, the US reports 200–300 human infections each year, most of them in the central region.

items.headline_zh: 伊拉克-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 伊拉克今年8省報告19例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,2例死亡
items.summary_en: Iraq has reported 19 Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases in 8 provinces this year, 2 fatal; Salah al-Din Province has declared a public health emergency.
items.description_zh: 伊拉克今年迄今共8省報告19例,其中2例死亡,病例以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)7例為多,其次為北部基爾庫克省(Kirkuk) 4例,部分地區關閉無照屠宰場,當局加強店家及屠宰場檢查,另薩拉丁省宣佈進入公共衛生緊急狀態。
items.description_en: Iraq has reported 19 cases in 8 provinces so far this year, 2 of them fatal. Cases were mostly in Dhi Qar Province in the south (7), followed by Kirkuk Province in the north (4). Some areas have closed unlicensed slaughterhouses, and authorities have strengthened inspections of shops and slaughterhouses. Salah al-Din Province has declared a public health emergency.

items.summary_zh: 貝里斯西部卡優省4/15報告4例瘧疾,其中3例為本土病例
items.summary_en: Cayo District in western Belize reported 4 malaria cases on 15 April, 3 locally acquired, the first local cases in six years.
items.description_zh: 貝里斯西部卡優省4/15報告4例病例,其中1例為瓜地馬拉境外移入,3例為本土病例,為6年來首次報告本土病例,當局已採取多項防治措施。
items.description_en: In Cayo District in western Belize, 4 cases were reported on 15 April; 1 was imported from Guatemala and 3 were locally acquired. This is the first reported locally acquired case in 6 years. Authorities have taken a number of prevention and control measures.

items.summary_zh: 全球今年3月前累計約8萬例屈公病、46例死亡,巴西7.16萬例
items.summary_en: Globally, about 80,000 chikungunya cases and 46 deaths were reported through March this year, most in the Americas, led by Brazil's 71,578.
items.description_zh: 全球今年截至3月累計14國/地區報告約80,000例病例及46例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西71,578例(44例死亡)及阿根廷1,550例為多,亞洲巴基斯坦報告393例,非洲塞內加爾報告2例,另法屬留旺島報告逾13,000例(2例死亡),法屬馬約特島報告1例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境仍不利於病媒蚊活動,每年疫情多發生於6 -11月。
items.description_en: As of March this year, 14 countries and regions globally have reported about 80,000 cases and 46 deaths cumulatively, distributed across the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as Réunion and Mayotte (France). The Americas have the most cases, led by Brazil with 71,578 cases (44 deaths) and Argentina with 1,550. In Asia, Pakistan reported 393 cases; in Africa, Senegal reported 2 cases. Réunion (France) reported more than 13,000 cases (2 deaths), and Mayotte (France) reported 1 case. The ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is still unfavourable for vector mosquito activity, and outbreaks in Europe each year mostly occur from June to November.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,巴西,法屬馬約特島,巴基斯坦,法屬留尼旺島,塞內加爾

items.summary_zh: 斐濟今年累計逾5,100例登革熱、3例死亡,已超過去年全年2,033例
items.summary_en: Fiji has reported over 5,100 dengue cases and 3 deaths this year, already above last year's 2,033 total; Uruguay recorded 2 local cases.
items.description_zh: 斐濟疫情更新,今年迄今累計逾5,100例病例及3例死亡,病例主要分布於該國西部及中部,主要流行型別為DENV-2及DENV-3,今年病例數已高於去年全年2,033例,疫情可能因雨季而持續上升。 烏拉圭今年迄今累計2例本土病例,病例分布於蒙特維多及派桑杜,當局於疫區加強防治措施;該國去年報告1例本土病例,為2020年以來首例本土病例。
items.description_en: Fiji update: so far this year, more than 5,100 cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the west and centre of the country. The main circulating serotypes are DENV-2 and DENV-3. This year's case count already exceeds the 2,033 cases for the whole of last year, and the outbreak may continue to rise during the rainy season. Uruguay has reported 2 locally acquired cases so far this year, in Montevideo and Paysandú; authorities have strengthened control measures in the affected areas. The country reported 1 locally acquired case last year, its first since 2020.

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本北海道十勝地區諾羅病毒群聚逾140例,飯店廚師檢出病毒
items.summary_en: A norovirus cluster in Tokachi, Hokkaido, Japan, exceeded 140 cases; the hotel's chef tested positive, and the venue was scheduled to close until 27 April.
items.description_zh: 日本於4/19報告1起於位於北海道十勝地區的群聚案件,逾140例病例,其中1例住院,於4/8-11入住某飯店後出現腹瀉、發燒、嘔吐等症狀,後續皆已康復,經調查其飯店廚師檢出諾羅病毒,該場所預計歇業至4/27。
items.description_en: On 19 April Japan reported a cluster in the Tokachi area of Hokkaido, with more than 140 cases; 1 patient was hospitalized. Between 8 and 11 April, people stayed at a hotel and developed diarrhoea, fever, vomiting and other symptoms, all of whom have since recovered. Investigation found norovirus in the hotel's chef, and the venue was scheduled to close until 27 April.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 越南8歲女童H5N1腦膜腦炎,ICU治療中;中國新增3例H9N2
items.summary_en: Viet Nam reported an 8-year-old girl with H5N1 meningoencephalitis, detected only in cerebrospinal fluid, now in ICU; China reported 3 new H9N2 cases this week.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週新增越南1例H5N1流感、中國3例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):共8國於2025/2/3-4/17期間新增33起H5N1疫情,匈牙利11起、德國/英國各7起、荷蘭3起、美國2起、羅馬亞/愛沙亞/賴比瑞亞各1起。 日本於2025/4/10新增3起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,021 (14)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州、內華達州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第15週計351個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、愛荷華、紐澤西)3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  越南 4/18報告1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國東南部西寧省邊求縣8歲女童,病患具先天心臟疾病史,4/11發病,出現發燒、頭痛、嘔吐等症狀就醫住院,因病況無改善於13日轉院,後出現嗜睡、頸部僵硬、精神意識異常等症狀,診斷為腦膜腦炎,17日腦脊髓液檢驗出H5流感陽性,18日H5N1流感確診,惟呼吸道檢體皆為陰性,病患目前仍於ICU進行治療,生命徵象暫穩定。據調查病患於發病前2週曾接觸病死家禽,相關調查持續進行。專家表示僅腦脊髓液檢出H5N1流感,呼吸道檢體陰性為罕見事件,該國曾於2004年報告過2例症狀相兒童,病患皆病況嚴重且死亡。 WHO更新墨西哥H5N1流感人類感染資訊,病患為該國西北部杜蘭戈州3歲女童,3/7出現發燒、嘔吐等症狀,3/13因呼吸衰住院,其後接受抗病毒藥物治療,於4/1確診,8日因呼吸併發症死亡。經檢驗感染D1.1基因型(屬2.3.4.4b分支),該基因型亦於美國及加拿大檢出,並報告5例人類感染病例,其中1例死亡。目前接觸者調查皆為陰性,該州近期無家禽疫情,惟今年迄今報告3起其他禽鳥H5流感案件。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計50國家/地區通報1,557起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: this week Viet Nam reported 1 new H5N1 human infection, and China reported 3 H9N2 human infections. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 33 new H5N1 outbreaks between 3 February and 17 April 2025: Hungary 11, Germany and the United Kingdom 7 each, the Netherlands 3, the United States 2, and one each in Romania, Estonia and Liberia. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks on 10 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,021 (14) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California, Nevada and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 15, 351 sampling sites provided test reports, and 3 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Iowa and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 18 April, Viet Nam reported one human H5N1 influenza infection in an 8-year-old girl from Biên Cầu District, Tây Ninh Province, in southeastern Viet Nam. The patient had a history of congenital heart disease. She developed fever, headache and vomiting from 11 April and was hospitalized; as her condition did not improve, she was transferred on 13 April. She later developed drowsiness, neck stiffness and altered consciousness, and was diagnosed with meningoencephalitis. H5 influenza was detected in her cerebrospinal fluid on 17 April, and H5N1 influenza was confirmed on 18 April; however, all her respiratory specimens were negative. She is still receiving treatment in the ICU, and her vital signs are temporarily stable. Investigation shows that she had contact with dead poultry two weeks before onset, and the investigation is ongoing. Experts say that detection of H5N1 influenza only in cerebrospinal fluid, with negative respiratory specimens, is a rare event; the country reported two children with similar symptoms in 2004, both of whom were severely ill and died. WHO updated information on a human H5N1 infection in Mexico: the patient was a 3-year-old girl from Durango State in the northwest, who developed fever and vomiting on 7 March, was hospitalized for respiratory failure on 13 March, received antiviral treatment, was confirmed on 1 April, and died of respiratory complications on 8 April. The virus was genotype D1.1 (belonging to the 2.3.4.4b clade), a genotype also detected in the United States and Canada, which have reported 5 human infection cases, one of them fatal. Contact investigations are all negative; the state has had no recent poultry outbreaks, but 3 other avian influenza outbreaks have been reported there this year. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,557 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 50 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.
