items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約2.2%,西太平洋區3.5%最高;香港續升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 2.2% in week 13 of 2025, highest in the Western Pacific (3.5%); Hong Kong's positivity continued to rise.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第13週(3/24-30)全球陽性率約2.2%,陽性率以西太平洋區(3.5%)及美洲區(2.9%)為高。 香港第15週(4/6-12)陽性率持續上升,污水監測數據顯示,變異株KP.3占比最高,其次為變異株XDV。 東南亞區各國第13週陽性率介於0%-0.7%,其中以泰國陽性率0.7%為高,主要流行變異株為XEC。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,西太平洋區及東地中海區近期上升,東南亞區呈上下波動,其他地區則呈下降趨勢;全球主要流行變異株為XEC,另變異株LP.8.1占比呈上升趨勢。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 13 of 2025 (24–30 March), the global positivity rate was about 2.2%, highest in the Western Pacific Region (3.5%) and the Region of the Americas (2.9%). In Hong Kong, positivity in week 15 (6–12 April) continued to rise; wastewater surveillance data show the KP.3 variant accounts for the largest share, followed by XDV. Among countries in the South-East Asia Region, positivity in week 13 ranged from 0% to 0.7%, with Thailand the highest at 0.7%; the main circulating variant is XEC. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity is trending downward, with recent increases in the Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions, fluctuations in the South-East Asia Region, and downward trends elsewhere. The main variant circulating globally is XEC, and the share of the LP.8.1 variant is trending upward. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球cVDPV2新增4例,衣索比亞3例、安哥拉1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 4 new cVDPV2 polio cases in 2 countries for 3–9 April (3 in Ethiopia, 1 in Angola); 2 environmental samples were also positive.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/3-9期間,cVDPV2型新增2國共4例,分別為衣索比亞3例、安哥拉1例。環境樣本部分,cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增2國共2件,分別為以色列/象牙海岸各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 April, cVDPV2 cases increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Ethiopia and 1 in Angola. For environmental samples, cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 2 in 2 countries, 1 each in Israel and Côte d'Ivoire.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,象牙海岸,衣索比亞,以色列

items.headline_zh: 英國-細菌性腸胃炎(曲狀桿菌/沙門氏菌)
items.summary_zh: 英格蘭曲狀桿菌症2024年逾7.03萬例,沙門氏菌近1.04萬例
items.summary_en: England's Campylobacter cases rose from 54,884 in 2022 to over 70,300 in 2024, while Salmonella cases reached nearly 10,400.
items.description_zh: 英國公布英蘭曲狀桿菌症病例,自2022年54,884例逐年上升至 2024年70,300餘例,疫情高峰為6月,病患年齡多介於50-69歲,以東南部地區為多;沙門氏菌感染症病例自2022年8,290例亦逐年增加至2024年近10,400例,疫情高峰為9月,病患年齡多介於0-9歲,倫敦病例最多,經調查最大規模之疫情與生產自波蘭之禽肉有關,造成逾250人感染。(公布之病例資訊以2023年為主)
items.description_en: The UK has published data on Campylobacter cases in England, which rose year by year from 54,884 cases in 2022 to more than 70,300 in 2024, with a peak in June. Patients are mainly aged 50–69, and cases are concentrated in the southeast. Salmonella infection cases in England also increased year by year, from 8,290 in 2022 to nearly 10,400 in 2024, with a peak in September. Patients are mainly aged 0–9, and London has the most cases. Investigation showed that the largest outbreak was linked to poultry meat produced in Poland, which infected more than 250 people. (The published case data are mainly for 2023.)
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 新加坡日均43例連2週上升,高於去年同期19例
items.summary_en: Singapore's enterovirus cases averaged 43 a day in week 14, rising for two weeks and above the 19 seen in the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 亞洲國家第14週(3/30-4/5)疫情,新加坡疫情上升,平均單日新增43例病例,已連續2週增加,且高於去年同期(19例);日本疫情處相對低點,定醫平均病例數0.04,較前週減少;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.6‰,與前週持平;香港第15週(4/6-4/12)就診陽性率為0.1‰,為今年最低點。
items.description_en: Update on Asian countries for week 14 (30 March–5 April): Singapore's outbreak is rising, with an average of 43 new cases per day, up for two consecutive weeks and higher than the 19 cases in the same period last year. Japan's outbreak is at a relatively low point, with an average sentinel clinic case count of 0.04, down from the previous week. South Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.6‰, unchanged from the previous week. Hong Kong's clinic-visit positivity rate in week 15 (6–12 April) was 0.1‰, the lowest this year.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,新加坡

items.summary_zh: 非洲霍亂擴散:安哥拉單週新增1,164例、25例死亡,疫情擴至17省
items.summary_en: Cholera is spreading across Africa: Angola reported 1,164 new cases and 25 deaths in week 14, with the outbreak spread to 17 provinces.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情持續且呈區域擴散趨勢,非洲區署公布第14週(3/31- 4/6)疫情,其中,安哥拉新增1,164例病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:2%),疫情擴散至17個省份;衣索比亞疫情回升,新增322例病例,疫情主要於西北及西南部省分;迦納新增30例病例,較前週減少62%,集中於中部地區。WHO呼籲受影響國家強化飲水衛生、疫苗及治療等防疫措施。
items.description_en: The outbreak in Africa continues and is spreading regionally. The WHO Regional Office for Africa published data for week 14 (31 March–6 April): in Angola, 1,164 new cases were reported, including 25 deaths (CFR 2%), and the outbreak has spread to 17 provinces. In Ethiopia the outbreak has resurged, with 322 new cases, mainly in the north-western and south-western provinces. Ghana reported 30 new cases, a 62% decrease from the previous week, concentrated in the central region. WHO calls on affected countries to strengthen preventive measures such as water and sanitation hygiene, vaccination and treatment.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,衣索比亞,迦納共和國

items.headline_zh: 非洲-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 非洲今年截至3/30逾6,000例腦膜炎,325例死亡,剛果民主共和國最多
items.summary_en: Across 22 African countries, over 6,000 meningitis cases and 325 deaths were reported as of 30 March; the DRC (1,585) and Nigeria (1,156) account for most.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至3/30共22國報告逾6,000例,其中325例死亡(CFR:5.4%),主要分布於剛果民主共和國(1,585)及奈及利亞(1,156),另迦納、日及多哥等國之部分地區爆發疫情且超過閾。WHO於4/10發布首份腦膜炎診斷、治療及護理指引,針對流行/非流行地區提供建議,以提供不同國家循證建議及應對措施。
items.description_en: Africa update: as of 30 March this year, 22 countries had reported more than 6,000 cases, of which 325 died (CFR 5.4%). Cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1,585) and Nigeria (1,156). In addition, parts of Ghana, Niger and Togo have had outbreaks that exceed the epidemic threshold. On 10 April, WHO issued its first guidelines on the diagnosis, treatment and care of meningitis, providing recommendations for endemic and non-endemic areas to give different countries evidence-based advice and response measures.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,迦納共和國,尼日,奈及利亞,多哥

items.summary_zh: 韓國第14週類流感門診就診率16.9‰,連4週上升,超過閾值8.6‰
items.summary_en: South Korea's influenza-like illness clinic visit rate reached 16.9‰ in week 14, rising for four weeks and above the 8.6‰ threshold; influenza B is the main circulating type.
items.description_zh: 韓國於第14週(3/30-4/5) 類流感門診就診率為16.9‰,已連續4週上升,且高於閾(8.6‰),疫情仍持續上升中,此波疫情以學齡兒童及青少年(7-18歲)感染率最高,近期主要流行型別為B型,當局呼籲家長及學校加強衛教及呼吸道感染防護,並儘速接種疫苗。
items.description_en: In week 14 (30 March–5 April), South Korea's influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate was 16.9‰, rising for four consecutive weeks and above the epidemic threshold of 8.6‰. The outbreak is still rising. This wave has the highest infection rate among school-age children and adolescents (aged 7–18). The main type circulating recently is influenza B. Authorities urge parents and schools to strengthen health education and respiratory infection protection, and to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 日本3/31-4/6通報722例創2018年來單週新高,今年累計5,652例
items.summary_en: Japan reported 722 pertussis cases in the week of 31 March–6 April, the highest weekly figure since 2018; 5,652 cases so far this year, exceeding last year's total.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(3/31-4/6)百日咳通報722例,高於前1週578例,為2018年以來單週最高紀錄,病例數持續上升,評估目前尚未達高峰,病例數以新潟縣(73)及宮崎縣(51)為多。今年累計報告5,652例,已逾去年全年病例數,並發生嬰兒重症及死亡病例,且各地均有抗藥性菌株感染案例。小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上之嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗,另建議兒童接種追加劑,以避免衍生重症。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak is severe. In the most recent week (31 March–6 April), 722 pertussis cases were reported, up from 578 the previous week, the highest weekly figure since 2018. Case numbers continue to rise, and the peak is assessed not yet to have been reached. The largest numbers were in Niigata Prefecture (73) and Miyazaki Prefecture (51). So far this year, 5,652 cases have been reported cumulatively, exceeding last year's full-year total. Severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported, and drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible, and recommends booster doses for children to avoid severe illness.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: WHO第41次IHR會議決議延長小兒麻痺PHEIC至少3個月
items.summary_en: WHO's 41st polio IHR Emergency Committee, meeting on 6 March, extended the polio emergency of international concern by at least three months; WPV1 persists in Afghanistan and Pakistan.
items.description_zh: WHO於3/6召開小兒麻痺症第41次IHR會議,決議延長PHEIC至少3個月,針對各型病毒現況摘要如下:  WPV1:於阿富汗南部及巴基斯坦部分地區持續傳播,受影響範圍擴大,兩國疫苗覆蓋率不佳且疫苗接種計畫推動受阻,以及跨境交流頻繁,WPV1國際傳播風險持續。 cVDPV:國際傳播風險仍高,奈及利亞cVDPV2疫情嚴峻,非洲東北部衣索比亞疫情加劇,因人道及健康危機,使疫苗接種計畫無法順利推動,致當地未接種疫苗孩童大幅增加,葉門北部有眾多未接種疫苗之兒童,當地檢體運送亦受阻。另自2016年OPV2口服疫苗退場後,使各地區兒童免疫覆蓋率差距擴大。 cVDPV1病例數持續下降,惟剛果民主共和國於2024年出現新病例,顯示仍有免疫缺口。 cVDPV3超過2年無新增病例後,近期於法屬圭亞那及幾內亞報告環境樣本及新病例。
items.description_en: WHO convened the 41st IHR Emergency Committee on poliomyelitis on 6 March and decided to extend the polio PHEIC by at least three months. A summary of the situation for each virus type is as follows. WPV1: continues to spread in southern Afghanistan and parts of Pakistan, with affected areas expanding. Poor vaccination coverage in both countries, obstacles to the vaccination programme and frequent cross-border movement mean the international transmission risk of WPV1 persists. cVDPV: the international transmission risk remains high. The cVDPV2 outbreak in Nigeria is severe, and the outbreak in Ethiopia in northeastern Africa has intensified; because of humanitarian and health crises, vaccination campaigns cannot proceed smoothly, and the number of unvaccinated children in the area has increased substantially. Northern Yemen has many unvaccinated children, and transport of local specimens has also been obstructed. In addition, since the withdrawal of the OPV2 oral vaccine in 2016, the gap in child immunity coverage between regions has widened. Cases of cVDPV1 continue to decline, but the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported new cases in 2024, indicating that immunity gaps remain. After more than two years without new cases, cVDPV3 has recently been reported in environmental samples and new cases in French Guiana and Guinea.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,衣索比亞,法屬圭亞那,幾內亞,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,葉門

items.headline_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯3/13報告11例腦膜炎,病患均曾赴沙國朝覲且未接種疫苗
items.summary_en: Saudi Arabia reported 11 meningococcal W135 cases on 13 March, all in unvaccinated people who had visited for Hajj; WHO urges vaccination 10 days before travel.
items.description_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯於3/13報告11例,病患皆於今年1-3月中旬曾前往沙國朝覲,診斷時間介於1/7-3/2間,均未接種疫苗,病患於該國接受治療後,已康復出院,經檢驗為腦膜炎雙球菌W135血清型;另有6例零星個案返國就醫,其中2例檢出W135血清型。WHO表示朝覲等大型宗教活動人數眾多,且長時間近距離接觸,大幅提高腦膜炎雙球菌等呼吸道疾病傳播風險。當局評估今年截至3月上旬,僅54%朝覲者接種疫苗,因各國旅客前往沙國進行宗教活動,國際傳播風險上升。鑑於近期與朝覲相關病例增加,WHO呼籲預計參加活動者,應於出發至少10日前接種疫苗,以降低感染及傳播風險。
items.description_en: Saudi Arabia reported 11 cases on 13 March. All patients had visited Saudi Arabia for the Hajj pilgrimage between January and mid-March this year, with diagnosis dates between 7 January and 2 March. None had been vaccinated. After treatment in Saudi Arabia, the patients recovered and were discharged; testing identified Neisseria meningitidis serotype W135. Another 6 sporadic cases returned home for medical care, 2 of which were confirmed as serotype W135. WHO said that large religious gatherings such as the Hajj, with large numbers of people and prolonged close contact, greatly increase the risk of transmission of respiratory diseases such as meningococcal meningitis. Authorities assessed that as of early March this year, only 54% of pilgrims had been vaccinated; as travellers from various countries go to Saudi Arabia for religious activities, the international transmission risk has increased. Given the recent rise in Hajj-related cases, WHO calls on those planning to attend to get vaccinated at least 10 days before departure to reduce the risk of infection and transmission.

items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞宣布衛生緊急狀態,今年57例黃熱病、22例死亡,致死率逾40%
items.summary_en: Colombia declared a health emergency; as of 13 April this year, 57 confirmed yellow fever cases and 22 deaths were reported, an estimated fatality rate above 40%.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞宣布衛生緊急狀態,今年截至4/13已通報57例確診病例,22例死亡,致死率估計逾40%,病例以中西部托利馬省為多,該地區自2007年後未曾報告病例,另有6隻靈長類動物感染黃熱病死亡,評估該國目前有388個城市面臨高風險,並有擴散至鄰國包括秘魯和玻利維亞之風險。當局已針對前往高風險地區旅客實施強制接種疫苗措施。
items.description_en: Colombia has declared a health emergency. As of 13 April this year, 57 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, with an estimated case fatality rate above 40%. Cases are concentrated in Tolima Department in the central-west, an area where no cases had been reported since 2007. In addition, 6 primates have died of yellow fever. Authorities assess that 388 cities in the country are at high risk, and that the disease may spread to neighboring countries including Peru and Bolivia. Authorities have made vaccination mandatory for travelers to high-risk areas.

items.summary_zh: 巴拿馬今年截至2月累計221例奧羅普切熱,1例死亡,東部達連省207例
items.summary_en: Panama has reported 221 Oropouche fever cases and one death as of February this year, with 207 in eastern Darién Province.
items.description_zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,今年截至2月累計221例病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於東部達連省207例,年齡分布以35-49歲為多,當局已加強流行病學監測及相關防治措施。
items.description_en: Panama update: as of February this year, 221 cases and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, with cases mainly in Darién Province in the east (207), and most cases among people aged 35–49. Authorities have strengthened epidemiological surveillance and related prevention and control measures.

items.headline_zh: 巴西/阿根廷/玻利維亞-茲卡病毒感染症
items.headline_en: Brazil / Argentina / Bolivia – Zika virus disease
items.summary_zh: 美洲今年累計逾7,300例茲卡病毒感染,主要在巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞
items.summary_en: The Americas have reported over 7,300 Zika cases this year, mainly in Brazil, Argentina and Bolivia; last year the region recorded over 40,000.
items.description_zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告7,300餘例病例,主要分布於巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞等國;去年該洲累計報告逾4萬例病例,病例數以巴西為最多。
items.description_en: Americas update: so far this year, more than 7,300 cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in Brazil, Argentina and Bolivia. Last year the region reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively, with Brazil having the most.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年累計2,052例登革熱、14例死亡;阿根廷確診逾2,800例
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported 2,052 dengue cases and 14 deaths this year; Argentina has more than 2,800 confirmed cases since week 31 of last year, mainly DEN-1 serotype.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,最近1天內報告8例病例住院治療,今年迄今已累計2,052例病例及14例死亡,去年累計101,214例病例及575例死亡。 阿根廷疫情更新,自去年第31週至今年第11週累計42,800餘例疑病例及2,800餘例確診病例,以中部地區為多,其中97.5%病例無旅遊史,4例病例與器官移植相關,主要流行型別為DEN-1,其次為DEN-2。
items.description_en: Bangladesh update: 8 cases were reported and hospitalized within the most recent day. So far this year, 2,052 cases and 14 deaths have been reported cumulatively; last year there were 101,214 cases and 575 deaths. Argentina update: from week 31 of last year to week 11 of this year, more than 42,800 suspected cases and more than 2,800 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the central region. Of these, 97.5% had no travel history, and 4 cases were related to organ transplantation. The main circulating serotype is DEN-1, followed by DEN-2.

items.summary_zh: 英格蘭今年截至4/10累計213例麻疹,韓國35例,墨西哥奇瓦瓦州新增1死
items.summary_en: England reported 213 measles cases as of 10 April this year, 60% under 10; South Korea has 35 cases, and Chihuahua, Mexico, reported a new death.
items.description_zh: 英國英蘭病例數更新,今年截至4/10累計報告213例,60%病例為小於10歲族群,病例分布以倫敦為多,英蘭去年全年報告超過2,900確診病例,為2012年以來最高;韓國公布今年截至4/5累計報告35例,病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,多數病例感染地為越南(22例);墨西哥奇瓦瓦州新增1例死亡案例,為 31 歲男性個案,患者未接種疫苗且有糖尿病史,經調查與鄰近之德克薩斯州疫情有關。
items.description_en: England update: as of 10 April this year, 213 cases have been reported cumulatively, 60% of them under 10 years old, with cases concentrated in London. England reported more than 2,900 confirmed cases in total last year, the highest since 2012. South Korea reported 35 cases cumulatively as of 5 April this year, all imported or linked to imported cases; most were infected in Viet Nam (22 cases). In Chihuahua State, Mexico, a new death was reported: a 31-year-old man who was unvaccinated and had diabetes. Investigation linked the case to the nearby outbreak in Texas, United States.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類病例;全球17國新增69起H5N1疫情
items.summary_en: No new human cases were reported this week; 17 countries reported 69 new H5N1 animal outbreaks between October 2024 and April 2025, led by the US with 16.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共17國於2024/10/14~2025/4/10間新增69起H5N1疫情,美國16起、英國15起、捷克7起、匈牙利6起、德國5起、波蘭4起、臺灣3起、荷蘭/比利時/加拿大各2起、瑞典/奧地利/克羅埃西亞/立陶宛/以色列/丹麥/土耳其各1起。 以色列於2025/3/31新增1起H5N8疫情。 比利時於2025/3/26新增2起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,007(9)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州、內華達州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,200例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第14週計376個採檢點提供檢測報告,3州4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 9例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計9721例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(備註:依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計48國家/地區通報1,521起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human cases were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 17 countries reported 69 new H5N1 outbreaks between 14 October 2024 and 10 April 2025: the United States 16, the United Kingdom 15, Czechia 7, Hungary 6, Germany 5, Poland 4, Taiwan 3, the Netherlands, Belgium and Canada 2 each, and Sweden, Austria, Croatia, Lithuania, Israel, Denmark and Turkey 1 each. Israel reported 1 new H5N8 outbreak on 31 March 2025. Belgium reported 2 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 26 March 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,007 (9) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Nevada. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,200 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths reported. Wastewater surveillance: in week 14, 376 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states detected H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases: 9 H5N1 influenza cases (9,721* cumulative since 2003); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Note: following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,521 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 48 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe complications (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球陽性率約2.0%,非洲區4.5%最高;香港陽性率持續上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 2.0% in week 12 of 2025, highest in Africa (4.5%); Hong Kong's positivity kept rising, and Europe's kept falling.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第12週(3/17-3/23)全球陽性率約2.0%,陽性率以非洲區(4.5%)、美洲區(3.0%)及西太平洋區(2.3%)為高。 香港第14週(3/30-4/5)陽性率及定醫就診率持續上升,污水監測數據顯示,變異株XDV占比呈上升趨勢。 歐洲區陽性率持續下降,主要流行變異株為XEC;第12週英國及希臘分別新增1,200餘例及700餘例病例。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,西太平洋區及非洲區近期上升,東地中海區呈上下波動,其他地區則下降;全球主要流行變異株為XEC,另變異株LP.8.1占比呈上升趨勢。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: in week 12 of 2025 (17–23 March), the global positivity rate was about 2.0%, highest in the African Region (4.5%), the Region of the Americas (3.0%) and the Western Pacific Region (2.3%). In Hong Kong, positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates continued to rise in week 14 (30 March–5 April); wastewater surveillance data show the XDV variant share is rising. Positivity in the European Region continued to decline, with XEC the main circulating variant; in week 12, the UK and Greece reported about 1,200 and 700 new cases respectively. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity is trending downward; the Western Pacific and African regions have risen recently, the Eastern Mediterranean Region has fluctuated, and other regions have declined. The main variant circulating globally is XEC, and the share of the LP.8.1 variant is trending upward. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球新增cVDPV2病例2例(查德),巴基斯坦WPV1環境樣本19件
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 2 new cVDPV2 polio cases in Chad for 27 March–2 April, and 19 WPV1-positive environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/27-4/2期間,cVDPV2型新增查德2例病例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦19件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增4國共6件,分別為奈及利亞/阿爾及利亞各2件、查德/塞內加爾各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 27 March and 2 April, cVDPV2 cases increased by 2 in Chad. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 19 in Pakistan. cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 6 across 4 countries: 2 each in Nigeria and Algeria, and 1 each in Chad and Senegal.
items.area_zh: 阿爾及利亞,查德,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,塞內加爾

items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞吉蘭丹州今年截至4/5累計4,591例腸病毒,為去年同期10倍
items.summary_en: Kelantan, Malaysia, reported 4,591 enterovirus cases this year as of 5 April, 10 times last year's same-period count; nearly 90% are children under 6.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞北部吉蘭丹州(Kelantan)今年截至4/5累計報告4,591例病例,為去年同期(459例)10倍,近9成病患為未滿6歲孩童,其中2例重症,疫情主要發生在托兒所及幼兒園等。當局已針對發生疫情之兒童保育相關機構發佈停課措施。
items.description_en: Kelantan State in northern Malaysia has reported 4,591 cases so far this year as of 5 April, 10 times the 459 cases in the same period last year. Nearly 90% of patients are children under 6, and 2 cases are severe. The outbreak has occurred mainly in child-care centres and kindergartens. Authorities have ordered class suspensions at child-care institutions where outbreaks have occurred.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓西內羅斯省今年截至3/29累計387例傷寒,為去年同期約1.8倍
items.summary_en: Negros Occidental, Philippines, has reported 387 typhoid cases as of 29 March this year, about 1.8 times the same period last year; most patients are aged 11–20.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓中部西內羅斯省(Negros Occidental)疫情上升,今年截至3/29累計報告387例病例,為去年同期約1.8倍,病例分布於7個城市,以卡班卡蘭市(Kabankalan)(96例)為多,大多數病患為11-20歲族群。當局呼籲民眾須注意飲用水衛生。
items.description_en: In Negros Occidental, central Philippines, the outbreak is rising. As of 29 March this year, 387 cases had been reported cumulatively, about 1.8 times the same period last year. Cases were distributed across 7 cities, with the largest number in Kabankalan City (96 cases). Most patients are aged 11–20. Authorities urge the public to pay attention to drinking water hygiene.

items.summary_zh: 瑞典2024年沙門氏菌1,612例創14年新高,烏克蘭雞蛋等為主因
items.summary_en: Sweden reported 1,612 salmonellosis cases in 2024, its highest in nearly 14 years; investigation linked large outbreaks to Ukrainian eggs and Italian alfalfa sprouts.
items.description_zh: 瑞典2024年累計報告1,612例病例,為近14年來新高,病患年齡中位數為42歲,檢出型別多為腸道沙門氏菌及傷寒沙門氏菌;經調查生產自烏克蘭之雞蛋及義大利之苜蓿芽為造成當年大規模疫情的主因,各造成逾百人之感染,另境外輸入病例多來自泰國。
items.description_en: Sweden reported 1,612 cases cumulatively in 2024, the highest in nearly 14 years, with a median patient age of 42. The types detected were mainly Salmonella enterica and Salmonella Typhi. Investigation found that eggs produced in Ukraine and alfalfa sprouts from Italy were the main causes of large-scale outbreaks that year, each infecting more than 100 people. Imported cases mainly came from Thailand.
items.area_zh: 義大利,瑞典,泰國,烏克蘭

items.summary_zh: 全球今年截至3/17累計逾7.6萬例霍亂、969例死亡,較去年同期升約15%
items.summary_en: Globally, over 76,000 cholera cases and 969 deaths were reported through 17 March this year, about 15% above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情持續,今年截至3/17累計報告逾7萬6,000例病例,其中969例死亡(CFR:1.3%),病例數較去年同期上升約15%,分布於18個非洲國家及3個亞洲國家。自2/20截至3/17,新增病例數前五名分別為南蘇丹(5,240)、阿富汗(4,947)、蘇丹(4,166)、安哥拉(3,972)及葉門(3,674)。
items.description_en: The global outbreak continues. As of 17 March this year, more than 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 969 died (CFR 1.3%). Case numbers are about 15% higher than in the same period last year. Cases have been reported in 18 African countries and 3 Asian countries. From 20 February to 17 March, the top five countries for new cases were South Sudan (5,240), Afghanistan (4,947), Sudan (4,166), Angola (3,972) and Yemen (3,674).
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),阿富汗,安哥拉,南蘇丹共和國,蘇丹,葉門

items.disease_zh: 侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 美國-侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 美國2013-22年侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌發病率倍增至每10萬人8.2例
items.summary_en: US incidence of invasive pneumococcal disease more than doubled from 2013 to 2022, rising from 3.6 to 8.2 per 100,000 population.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC針對10個州進行長期監測,於2013-22年期間該國發病率增加1倍以上,由每10萬人3.6例上升至8.2例,其中原住民族群顯著高於其他族裔,另街友、毒品使用者及長照機構住民發病率亦偏高,抗藥性菌株比例由12.7%上升至45.1%。
items.description_en: The US CDC conducted long-term surveillance in 10 states. From 2013 to 2022, the incidence in the country more than doubled, rising from 3.6 to 8.2 cases per 100,000 population. Indigenous populations had significantly higher rates than other ethnic groups, and incidence was also high among people experiencing homelessness, people who use drugs and residents of long-term care facilities. The proportion of drug-resistant strains rose from 12.7% to 45.1%.

items.summary_zh: 墨西哥杜蘭戈州3歲女童4/8因呼吸道併發症死亡,為首例H5N1人類感染
items.summary_en: Mexico's first human H5N1 case, a 3-year-old girl in Durango State, died on 8 April of respiratory complications; contacts tested negative and risk is low.
items.description_zh: 墨西哥病例資訊更新,該國於4/4報告首例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西北部杜蘭戈州(Durango)3歲女童,病患於4/8因呼吸道併發症死亡,目前相關接觸者檢驗結果皆為陰性,迄無其他人類感染病例,評估傳播風險為低。
items.description_en: Mexico has updated information on human H5N1 infection cases. The country reported its first human H5N1 infection case on 4 April: a 3-year-old girl from Durango State in the northwest, who died on 8 April of respiratory complications. All contact test results are negative, no other human infection cases have been reported, and the risk of transmission is assessed as low.

items.summary_zh: 日本百日咳今年累計4,771例,近一週新增578例為2018年來新高
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 4,771 pertussis cases this year, exceeding last year's total, with 578 new cases in one week, the highest since 2018.
items.description_zh: 日本今年截至3/30累計報告4,771例,已超過去年全年病例數(4,054例),近一週(3/24-30)新增578例,為2018年以來最高,其中,以新潟縣(73例)、兵庫縣及沖繩縣為多。另東京都通報1例新生兒死亡案例,近期於大阪及沖繩等地發現抗藥性菌株,當局呼籲嬰幼兒儘早接種疫苗,小學學童補接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Japan has reported 4,771 cumulative cases so far this year as of 30 March, already exceeding last year's full-year total of 4,054 cases. A further 578 cases were reported in the past week (24–30 March), the highest weekly figure since 2018. Cases were concentrated in Niigata Prefecture (73 cases), Hyogo Prefecture and Okinawa Prefecture. Tokyo Metropolitan Government reported one neonatal death. Drug-resistant strains have recently been found in areas including Osaka and Okinawa. Authorities urge early vaccination of infants and catch-up vaccination for elementary school children.

items.summary_zh: 全球麻疹持續流行,美國德州累計505例,越南今年逾5.4萬例
items.summary_en: Measles continues globally: Texas reported 505 cases, Ontario 655, and Viet Nam over 54,000 cases so far this year.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情持續:  北美:美國德州疫情更新,截至4/8累計報告505例,其中57例住院及2例死亡,另印第安納州報告該州今年首例,CDC於4/8對醫事人員發布警報,提醒留意併發症,迄已有12%患者住院,3例死亡;加拿大安大略省疫情嚴峻,今年截至4/2報告655例,其中560例確診,鄰近之美國紐約州已將該省列入旅遊警示。 亞洲:越南今年迄今報告5.4萬例,大部分省市疫情持續並報告多例死亡病例,峴港市今年累計報告約3,700例,去年同期則為11例,河內近1週(3/28-4/4)新增200餘例,病例數持續增加,該國目前已有40個省接種率達95%以上,將持續加強疫苗接種工作;蒙古疫情上升,自2月中旬報告首例以來截至4/9累計報告414例確診,病例以首都烏蘭巴托為多。 非洲:剛果民主共和國今年截至3月中旬報告1.2萬餘例,其中199例死亡(CFR:1.6%),該國目前11個省爆發疫情。
items.description_en: Outbreaks continue worldwide. North America: Texas, USA, reports 505 cumulative cases as of 8 April, including 57 hospitalized and 2 deaths. Indiana reported its first case of the year. On 8 April, CDC issued an alert to healthcare workers, urging them to watch for complications; to date, 12% of patients have been hospitalized and 3 have died. Ontario, Canada, has a severe outbreak, with 655 cases reported this year as of 2 April, of which 560 are confirmed. New York State, which borders Ontario, has added the province to its travel alerts. Asia: Viet Nam has reported about 54,000 cases so far this year, with most provinces and cities still experiencing outbreaks and multiple deaths. Da Nang has reported about 3,700 cases this year, compared with 11 in the same period last year. Hanoi reported over 200 new cases in the past week (28 March–4 April), and case numbers continue to rise. Forty provinces have vaccination coverage above 95%, and the country will continue to strengthen vaccination. Mongolia's outbreak is rising: since the first case in mid-February, 414 confirmed cases have been reported as of 9 April, mainly in the capital Ulaanbaatar. Africa: the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported over 12,000 cases so far this year as of mid-March, including 199 deaths (CFR 1.6%), with outbreaks in 11 provinces.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),加拿大,剛果民主共和國,蒙古,美國,越南

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至3月23日確診645例、死亡119例,病例數低於去年同期
items.summary_en: Nigeria has recorded 645 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 119 deaths this year as of 23 March, fewer than at this time last year.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至3/23共33州報告3,400餘例疑病例,其中645例確診及119例死亡,今年迄今累計病例數低於去年同期。
items.description_en: Nigeria has reported over 3,400 suspected cases across 33 states as of 23 March this year, including 645 confirmed cases and 119 deaths. Cumulative cases so far this year are lower than the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 印度曼普爾邦狂犬病爆發,今年已3例死亡、逾700例咬傷
items.summary_en: A rabies outbreak in India's Manipur state has caused 3 deaths and over 700 animal bites this year; vaccine shortages hinder control.
items.description_zh: 印度東北部曼普爾邦爆發疫情,今年迄今已報告3例死亡,並報告700餘例咬傷,當局已採取預防措施,包含部分村莊被劃為隔離區,禁止寵物及流浪犬進入,並加強犬隻疫苗接種,疫苗供應不足為控制疫情之最大挑戰。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in Manipur State in northeastern India. So far this year, 3 deaths and over 700 animal bite cases have been reported. Authorities have taken preventive measures, including designating some villages as quarantine zones, banning pets and stray dogs from entering them, and stepping up dog vaccination. Insufficient vaccine supply is the greatest challenge to controlling the outbreak.

items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡今年登革熱逾1.1萬例、7例死亡;印尼累計逾1.07萬例、48例死亡
items.summary_en: Sri Lanka reported over 11,400 dengue cases and 7 deaths this year; Indonesia recorded over 10,700 cases and 48 deaths as of 16 February.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年迄今累計11,400餘例病例及7例死亡,當局已採取疾病防治計畫;該國2024年累計逾5萬例病例。 印疫情更新,今年截至2/16累計10,700餘例病例及48例死亡;該國2024年累計逾20萬例病例及1,400餘例死亡。
items.description_en: Dengue activity is rising in Sri Lanka, with over 11,400 cases and 7 deaths reported so far this year. Authorities have implemented a disease prevention and control plan. The country recorded over 50,000 cases in 2024. Indonesia update: as of 16 February this year, over 10,700 cases and 48 deaths have been reported cumulatively; in 2024 the country recorded over 200,000 cases and more than 1,400 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年奧羅普切熱逾7,300例,以聖埃斯皮里圖州5,300餘例最多
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported over 7,300 Oropouche fever cases this year, with Espírito Santo state accounting for over 5,300 of them.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計7,300餘例病例,以東南部聖埃斯皮里圖州5,300餘例病例為多,其次為里約熱內盧州1,000餘例及帕拉伊巴州500餘例;該國2024年累計13,700餘例病例,2023年累計800餘例病例。
items.description_en: Brazil update: over 7,300 cases have been reported so far this year, mainly in the southeastern state of Espírito Santo (over 5,300 cases), followed by Rio de Janeiro State (over 1,000 cases) and Paraíba State (over 500 cases). The country recorded over 13,700 cases in 2024 and over 800 cases in 2023.

items.headline_zh: 法屬留尼旺島/模里西斯-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 留尼旺島屈公病累計逾2.02萬例、2死亡;模里西斯2009年來首例本土病例
items.summary_en: French Réunion has recorded over 20,200 chikungunya cases and 2 deaths; Mauritius reported its first local case since 2009.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島疫情持續,近1週(3/17-23)報告5,800餘例確診病例,迄今累計20,200餘例病例及2例死亡,以勒唐蓬4,700例病例為多。 模里西斯共和國報告1例本土病例,為37歲女性,3/15檢驗陽性,為該國自2009年以來首例病例,由於鄰近之法屬留旺島適逢疫情流行,該國已加強疫情監測及因應防治措施。
items.description_en: The outbreak on French Réunion continues. In the past week (17–23 March), over 5,800 confirmed cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total to over 20,200 cases and 2 deaths; Le Tampon accounts for most of these, with 4,700 cases. The Republic of Mauritius has reported one local case, a 37-year-old woman who tested positive on 15 March. This is the country's first case since 2009. Because the neighbouring French Réunion is experiencing an epidemic, Mauritius has strengthened surveillance and response measures.
items.area_zh: 模里西斯,法屬留尼旺島

items.summary_zh: 美國今年麻疹逾600例,為2024年全年2倍以上,已有3例死亡
items.summary_en: US measles cases this year exceed 600, more than double the 2024 total; three deaths have been reported, mostly linked to Texas.
items.description_zh: 美國德州報告該州第2例死亡案例,病患為未曾接種疫苗及無潛在病史之女童,於4/3因麻疹併發肺衰竭死亡。該國今年迄今病例數逾600例,為2024年全年之2倍以上,病例多與德州疫情相關,其中,已累計3例死亡病例,包含2例兒童及1例成人。
items.description_en: Texas has reported the state's second measles death: an unvaccinated girl with no underlying medical conditions, who died on 3 April of respiratory failure caused by measles complications. The United States has recorded more than 600 cases so far this year, more than double the total for all of 2024. Most cases are linked to the Texas outbreak. Three deaths have been reported cumulatively, including two children and one adult.

items.summary_zh: 美洲2025年第12週黃熱病累計131例、53死亡,巴西病例最多
items.summary_en: PAHO warns of rising yellow fever in the Americas: 131 cases and 53 deaths by week 12 of 2025, with Brazil reporting the most.
items.description_zh: 泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,美洲近期病例數上升,2025年迄第12週累計131例病例及53例死亡,分布於巴西81例病例(31例死亡)、哥倫比亞31例病例(13例死亡)、秘魯18例病例(8例死亡)及玻利維亞1例死亡病例,大部分病例均未接種疫苗,2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟2025年已傳播至前揭地區以外之區域。
items.description_en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert over rising yellow fever cases in the Americas. Through week 12 of 2025, 131 cases and 53 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Brazil 81 cases (31 deaths), Colombia 31 cases (13 deaths), Peru 18 cases (8 deaths) and one fatal case in Bolivia. Most cases were unvaccinated. In 2024, cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in 2025 transmission has spread beyond those areas.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,巴西,哥倫比亞,秘魯

items.headline_zh: 美國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 美國CDC:瑪麗皇后2號郵輪諾羅病毒群聚,241人腹瀉嘔吐
items.summary_en: US CDC reports a norovirus outbreak on the Queen Mary 2 cruise: 241 of 3,770 people had diarrhoea and vomiting; 12 cruise GI outbreaks this year.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC公布瑪麗皇后2號郵輪(Queen Mary 2)發生諾羅病毒群聚事件,該航程係於今年3/8 - 4/6自英國至東加勒比海,全船共3,770人,其中241人出現腹瀉及嘔吐症狀,CDC公布今年迄今報告12起郵輪腹瀉群聚疫情,其中10起病原為諾羅病毒,另有大腸桿菌/雪卡毒素各1起。
items.description_en: The US CDC has reported a norovirus outbreak on the cruise ship Queen Mary 2. The voyage ran from the United Kingdom to the Eastern Caribbean from 8 March to 6 April this year, with 3,770 people on board, of whom 241 had diarrhoea and vomiting. The CDC says it has received reports of 12 cruise ship gastrointestinal outbreaks so far this year, 10 caused by norovirus, and one each caused by E. coli and ciguatoxin.

items.summary_zh: 北美麻疹擴大:美國逾600例、22州報告,97%未接種或接種史不明
items.summary_en: Measles is spreading in North America: over 600 US cases in at least 22 states, 97% unvaccinated or of unknown status; Canada confirmed 514.
items.description_zh: 北美疫情擴大,美國今年截至4/3累計6(新增3起)起疫情,至少22州報告逾600例,為2019年以來新高,97%病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明;德州疫情最為嚴峻,主要發生於蓋恩斯郡及西部地區,迄已累計19個郡報告逾480例,其中56例住院;加拿大今年截至3/22累計報告615例疑,其中514例確診,病例以安大略省(548例)為多。
items.description_en: The outbreak in North America is expanding. As of 3 April this year, the United States has recorded six outbreaks cumulatively (three new), with more than 600 cases reported in at least 22 states, the highest since 2019. 97% of cases were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Texas is the most severely affected, mainly in Gaines County and western areas; 19 counties have reported more than 480 cases cumulatively, 56 of whom were hospitalized. As of 22 March this year, Canada has reported 615 suspected cases cumulatively, of which 514 were confirmed; cases are concentrated in Ontario (548 cases).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 印度、墨西哥本週各新增1例H5N1人類感染,墨西哥為該國首例
items.summary_en: India and Mexico each reported one new human H5N1 case this week; Mexico's first case is a 3-year-old girl, and public risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週印度/墨西哥各新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共16國於2023/3/30~2025/4/2間新增111起H5N1疫情,美國21起、英國20起、波蘭15起、荷蘭11起、印度10起、德國/匈牙利各8起、比利時6起、奈及利亞3起、愛爾蘭/丹麥各2起、羅馬亞/瑞典/挪威/柬埔寨/加拿大各1起。 冰島於2025/2/7~3/7新增5起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告998(4)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,200例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第13週計409個採檢點提供檢測報告,6州9個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  印度報告1例H5N1人類感染病例,為該國南部安德拉邦(Andhra Pradesh)2歲女童,3/4因出現發燒、呼吸困難、流鼻涕、癲癇、腹瀉等症狀住院,惟經過治療,仍於3/16死亡。經調查病患曾於發病前2日食用生雞肉,3/7檢驗A型流感確診,後續檢驗為H5N1流感。該邦自1月以來發生大規模禽流感疫情,當局於3/31發布警報並於當地啟動主動監測,目前尚未發現其他病例,仍將持續監測2週,該案為該國第2例死亡病例,首例死亡案例為2021年之11歲男童。 墨西哥於4/4報告該國首例H5N1人類感染病例,為該國西北部杜蘭戈州(Durango)3歲女童,於4/1確診,病患住院並接受抗病毒藥物治療,目前病況嚴重,其他流行病學資訊未敘明,當局已通報WHO,並展開相關調查工作,評估對一般人群風險仍為低。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 9例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計972例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。1依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計48國家/地區通報1,447起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:  FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week India and Mexico each reported one new human H5N1 infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 16 countries reported 111 new H5N1 outbreaks between 30 March 2023 and 2 April 2025: the USA 21, the UK 20, Poland 15, the Netherlands 11, India 10, Germany and Hungary 8 each, Belgium 6, Nigeria 3, Ireland and Denmark 2 each, and Romania, Sweden, Norway, Cambodia and Canada 1 each. Iceland reported 5 H5N5 outbreaks between 7 February and 7 March 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 998 outbreaks cumulatively (4 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California and Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,200 people monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with one cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 13, 409 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 9 sites in 6 states. Other updates: India reported one human H5N1 infection, in a 2-year-old girl from Andhra Pradesh in southern India. She was hospitalized on 4 March with fever, breathing difficulty, runny nose, convulsions and diarrhoea, and died on 16 March despite treatment. Investigation found she had eaten raw chicken two days before symptom onset; influenza A was confirmed on 7 March and later identified as H5N1. The state has had large-scale avian influenza outbreaks since January. Authorities issued an alert on 31 March and began active local surveillance. No other cases have been found so far; monitoring will continue for two weeks. This is the country's second death; the first was an 11-year-old boy in 2021. Mexico reported its first human H5N1 infection on 4 April: a 3-year-old girl in Durango State, northwestern Mexico, confirmed on 1 April. She was hospitalized and receiving antiviral treatment, and her condition is serious. Other epidemiological information has not been provided. Mexican authorities have notified WHO and begun an investigation, and assess the risk to the general population as still low. Annual summary: 9 human H5N1 cases (972 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 48 countries and territories have reported 1,447 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約3.1%且整體下降,香港及西太平洋區回升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 3.1% in week 11 of 2025 and is declining overall, while Hong Kong and the Western Pacific rose.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第11週(3/10-3/16)全球陽性率約3.1%,陽性率以美洲區(3.4%)、非洲區(3.3%)及歐洲區(3.1%)為高。 香港第13週(3/23-3/29)陽性率及定醫就診率持續上升,主要流行變異株爲JN.1及其衍生變異株。 美國近期陽性/急診就診/住院率均呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為LP.8.1,其次為變異株XEC。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,西太平洋區及非洲區近期上升,東地中海區呈上下波動,其他地區則呈下降趨勢;全球主要流行變異株為XEC,另變異株LP.8.1占比上升。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 11 of 2025 (10–16 March), global test positivity was about 3.1%, highest in the Americas region (3.4%), the African region (3.3%) and the European region (3.1%). Hong Kong SAR's test positivity and outpatient consultation rate continued to rise in week 13 (23–29 March), with JN.1 and its descendant variants the main circulating strains. In the United States, positivity, emergency department visits and hospitalization rates have recently declined; the main variant is LP.8.1, followed by XEC. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity is declining. Recently it has risen in the Western Pacific and African regions, fluctuated in the Eastern Mediterranean region, and declined in other regions. The main global variant is XEC, and the share of LP.8.1 is rising. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 印度-人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.summary_zh: 印度特里普拉邦HIV盛行率0.33%,高於全國0.22%,每月150-200例
items.summary_en: Tripura state in India has an HIV prevalence of 0.33%, above the national 0.22%, with 150–200 new cases reported each month.
items.description_zh: 印度東北部特里普拉邦盛行率達0.33%,高於全國0.22%,2024年迄今年1月累計報告1,185例病例,自2015-24年累計報告512例死亡病例。當局表示該邦每月報告150-200例病例,其中多與藥物濫用相關,已採衛教宣導及藥物治療政策。
items.description_en: HIV prevalence in Tripura State, in northeastern India, is 0.33%, higher than the national rate of 0.22%. From 2024 through January, 1,185 cases were reported cumulatively, and 512 deaths were reported cumulatively from 2015 to 2024. Authorities say the state reports 150–200 cases a month, most linked to drug abuse. Health education campaigns and medication-based treatment policies have been adopted.

items.summary_zh: 日本今年截至3/19梅毒2,672例,東京占26%;2023年先天性梅毒創新高
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 2,672 syphilis cases this year as of 19 March, 26% in Tokyo; congenital syphilis reached a record 37 in 2023.
items.description_zh: 日本自今年初迄3/19報告2,672例病例,其中東京佔26%。該國於2012年前報告病例數低於900例,惟自2013年起上升,2022年病例數首次突破萬例,2023-24年分別報告14,906及14,663例。另2023年全年報告37例先天性梅毒,創歷史新高。
items.description_en: Japan reported 2,672 cases from the start of this year to 19 March, of which 26% were in Tokyo. Before 2012 the country reported fewer than 900 cases a year, but numbers have risen since 2013. Cases exceeded 10,000 for the first time in 2022, with 14,906 reported in 2023 and 14,663 in 2024. In addition, 37 cases of congenital syphilis were reported for the whole of 2023, a record high.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年1-3月拉薩熱645例確診、118例死亡,含20餘名衛生工作者
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 645 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 118 deaths (CFR 18.3%) from January to March, including over 20 health workers.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞自今年1-3月累計報告645例確診病例、其中118例死亡(CFR:18.3%),病例包括20多名衛生工作者;該國西部奧貢州爆發疫情,3/26報告該州首例確診死亡病例,指標病例為25歲女性個案。
items.description_en: Nigeria has reported 645 confirmed cases, including 118 deaths (CFR: 18.3%), from January to March this year. The cases include more than 20 health workers. An outbreak is under way in Ogun State in western Nigeria; on 26 March the state reported its first confirmed fatal case, an index case in a 25-year-old woman.

items.summary_zh: 安哥拉霍亂累計8,543例、329死亡,近期單週病例再達1,200例高峰
items.summary_en: Angola's cholera outbreak has reached 8,543 cases and 329 deaths this year; weekly cases recently peaked again at 1,200.
items.description_zh: 安哥拉疫情持續且嚴峻,自今年初截至3/23累計16省報告8,543例病例,其中329例死亡(CFR:3.9%),約30%死亡數發生在社區,2月單週病例逾1,000例,達高峰後下降,惟於近期單週再達1,200例高峰。病患分布於盧安達省為多,本戈省次之,多為6-14歲族群(佔21.7%)。WHO表示當地公衛介入措施不足、延遲通報、當地雨季加劇傳播風險,且位處交通要道並與鄰國尚比亞及剛果民主共和國接壤,評估該國和鄰國傳播風險為非常高。另今年迄3/23累計3區署24國報告9 3,172例病例,其中1,197例死亡。
items.description_en: Angola's outbreak continues and is severe. From the start of the year to 23 March, 8,543 cases and 329 deaths (CFR: 3.9%) were reported from 16 provinces, and about 30% of deaths occurred in the community. Weekly cases exceeded 1,000 in February and then declined after peaking, but recently reached a new weekly peak of 1,200. Most cases are in Luanda Province, followed by Benguela Province; most patients are aged 6–14 years (21.7%). WHO notes insufficient local public health interventions, delayed reporting and rainy-season conditions that increase transmission risk. The country sits on major transport routes and borders Zambia and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO assesses the transmission risk for Angola and its neighbours as very high. Also, from the start of the year to 23 March, 24 countries across 3 WHO regions reported 93,172 cases, of which 1,197 were deaths.
items.area_zh: 安哥拉,剛果民主共和國,尚比亞

items.headline_zh: 菲律賓/澳大利亞-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年截至3/15登革熱逾7.6萬例,較去年同期升約78%
items.summary_en: The Philippines has recorded over 76,000 dengue cases this year as of 15 March, about 78% above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,最近2週報告約14,000例病例,今年截至3/15累計報告76,000餘例病例,較去年同期上升約78%,以卡拉巴松15,000餘例病例為最多,其次為首都地區和呂宋島中部。 澳大利亞疫情更新,昆士蘭州湯斯維爾市2/19宣布爆發疫情,截至3/25累計9例確診病例及2例疑病例。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines, with about 14,000 cases reported in the past two weeks. As of 15 March this year, more than 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, about 78% higher than the same period last year. Calabarzon region has the most cases, with over 15,000, followed by the National Capital Region and central Luzon. Australia update: an outbreak was declared in Townsville, Queensland, on 19 February; as of 25 March, 9 confirmed and 2 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively.

items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞今年截至2月8日瘧疾逾90萬例、34死亡,第6週報告逾13萬例
items.summary_en: Ethiopia has recorded over 900,000 malaria cases and 34 deaths this year as of 8 February, mainly in Oromia region.
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞疫情持續,於第6週報告13萬餘例病例及3例死亡,病例主要分布於該國中南部奧羅米亞州,今年截至2/8累計報告90萬餘例病例及34例死亡,另去年累計報告逾1千萬例病例。
items.description_en: Malaria in Ethiopia continues. In week 6, over 130,000 cases and 3 deaths were reported, mainly in the south-central Oromia Region. As of 8 February this year, over 900,000 cases and 34 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Over 10 million cases were reported cumulatively last year.

items.summary_zh: 巴西聖保羅州今年黃熱病32例、20死亡,已超過去年全年病例與死亡數
items.summary_en: São Paulo State has recorded 32 yellow fever cases and 20 deaths this year, already exceeding last year's full-year totals.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情上升,聖保羅州今年迄今累計報告32例病例及20例死亡,高於去年全年病例數2例及死亡數1例,為2018年疫情後病例及死亡數較高之一年,約80%病例未接種疫苗,病患主要集中於坎皮納斯市。
items.description_en: Yellow fever is rising in Brazil. In São Paulo State, 32 cases and 20 deaths have been reported so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year totals by 2 cases and 1 death. This is one of the years with the highest case and death counts since the 2018 outbreak. About 80% of cases were unvaccinated, and most patients are concentrated in the city of Campinas.

items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯多地出現不明原因疾病,疑與肺炎黴漿菌有關,當局未證實
items.summary_en: Russia reports unexplained illnesses in several regions; clinicians suspect Mycoplasma pneumoniae, but authorities have not confirmed it or published case counts.
items.description_zh: 俄羅斯報告多個地區出現不明原因疾病,病患症狀包含疲倦、全身痠痛、咳嗽/血及高燒等,部分個案之流感及新冠檢測結果均為陰性,且有抗藥性出現,醫護推測可能與肺炎黴漿菌相關,惟該國當局仍未證實且未公布病例數。
items.description_en: Russia has reported unexplained illness in several regions. Symptoms include fatigue, body aches, coughing (including coughing up blood) and high fever. Some cases tested negative for influenza and COVID-19, and drug resistance has been observed. Clinicians suspect a link to Mycoplasma pneumoniae, but Russian authorities have not confirmed this and have not published case numbers.

items.summary_zh: WHO:美國今年截至3/20麻疹378例、2死亡,德州259例、新墨西哥州35例
items.summary_en: WHO reports 378 US measles cases and 2 deaths in 17 states as of 20 March, mostly in Texas (259) and New Mexico (35).
items.description_zh: WHO公布美國疫情,今年截至3/20共17州報告378例,其中2例死亡,約90%病例與今年報告之3起疫情相關,病例集中於德州(259例)及新墨西哥州(35例)。目前基因序列資料顯示,共報告19種D8 序列,其中,新墨西哥州及堪薩斯州之部分序列與德州之D8基因型序列相同,另有8個州報告5種不同之B3基因型序列。目前疫情源頭仍不明,迄無證據顯示疫苗有效性下降或病毒改變致疾病嚴重度增加。因境外移入個案使病毒於美洲地區持續流行,疫苗覆蓋率持續偏低,導致易感人群增加,美洲地區公共衛生風險仍高。
items.description_en: WHO has published an update on the US outbreak. As of 20 March this year, 378 cases and 2 deaths have been reported from 17 states. About 90% of cases are linked to the three outbreaks reported this year, concentrated in Texas (259 cases) and New Mexico (35 cases). Genetic sequence data show 19 D8 sequences in total. Some sequences in New Mexico and Kansas are identical to the Texas D8 genotype sequences, and 8 states have reported five different B3 genotype sequences. The source of the outbreak remains unknown. There is no evidence that vaccine effectiveness has declined or that the virus has changed in a way that increases disease severity. Because imported cases keep the virus circulating in the Americas and vaccination coverage remains low, the number of susceptible people is rising, and public health risk in the Americas remains high.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘累計133,599例、305死亡,WHO宣布仍構成國際關注緊急事件
items.summary_en: WHO reports 133,599 mpox cases and at least 305 deaths globally since 2022; the outbreak remains a PHEIC, with clade Ib spreading to more countries.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  自2022年5月截至今年3/28全球累計132國/地區報告13萬3,599例確診病例,其中至少305例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第13週全球累計68國/地區報告1萬2,883例確診病例,其中非洲區1萬0,533例、美洲區861例、西太平洋區812例、、歐洲區641例、東南亞區20例及東地中海區16例。  其他更新: WHO公布剛果及坦尚亞分別於3/10及17日各新增1例Ib型境外移入病例。 評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。 另針對各分支風險評估如下:  Ia分支:於DRC傳播風險為中; Ib分支:於DRC及鄰近區域傳播風險為高; II分支:於奈及利亞及中、西非區域傳播風險為中; IIb分支 : 國際傳播風險為中。
items.description_en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and as of 28 March this year, 132 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 133,599 confirmed cases globally, including at least 305 deaths (CFR: 0.2%). As of week 13 this year, 68 countries and territories have reported 12,883 confirmed cases in total: African Region 10,533, Region of the Americas 861, Western Pacific Region 812, European Region 641, South-East Asia Region 20 and Eastern Mediterranean Region 16. Other updates: WHO reported one new imported clade Ib case each in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (10 March) and the United Republic of Tanzania (17 March). Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It said the outbreak remains serious, the scale of outbreaks in countries such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is still unclear, and the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied. Reduced funding has also affected access to vaccines and diagnostic resources. The Committee therefore declared that the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Risk assessments by clade are as follows: clade Ia transmission risk in the DRC is moderate; clade Ib transmission risk in the DRC and neighbouring areas is high; clade II transmission risk in Nigeria and across central and west Africa is moderate; and clade IIb international transmission risk is moderate.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨本週新增1例H5N1人類感染,美國乳牛禽流感累計994起
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 case this week; US dairy herds have 994 cumulative avian influenza outbreaks, mainly in California and Idaho.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要  人類疫情:本週柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共13國於2024/12/11~2025/3/26間新增105起H5N1疫情,匈牙利19起、美國17起、印度14起、英國/波蘭各13起、荷蘭10起、加拿大8起、德國/瑞典/愛爾蘭/俄羅斯/法國各2起、多哥1起。 孟加拉於2025/3/11新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。 加拿大於2025/1/1新增2起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告994(5)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,200例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第12週計406個採檢點提供檢測報告,3州5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。    其他更新  美國密蘇里大學進行牛隻對A型流感病毒易感性大規模評估,發現牛隻不僅對人類季節性流感具易感性,亦容易感染豬流感病毒,研究樣本檢出H1N1、H3N2季節性流感及豬源性H3N2及H1N2,樣本均未檢出H5N1。該研究顯示監測牛群感染A型流感之重要性,來自不同物種之病毒可能在牛體內發生重組,進而產生新型 A 型流感病毒,對動物或人類構成潛在威脅。  年度摘要  人類病例: 7例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計9701例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。1依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計48國家/地區通報1,333起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:  FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 13 countries reported 105 new H5N1 outbreaks between 11 December 2024 and 26 March 2025: Hungary 19, the USA 17, India 14, the UK and Poland 13 each, the Netherlands 10, Canada 8, Germany, Sweden, Ireland, Russia and France 2 each, and Togo 1. Bangladesh reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 11 March 2025. Canada reported two new H5N5 outbreaks on 1 January 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 994 outbreaks cumulatively (5 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California and Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,200 people monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with one cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 12, 406 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 5 sites in 3 states. Other updates: a large-scale assessment of cattle susceptibility to influenza A viruses by the University of Missouri found that cattle are susceptible not only to human seasonal influenza but also readily infected by swine influenza viruses. Samples detected H1N1 and H3N2 seasonal influenza, and swine-origin H3N2 and H1N2, but no H5N1. The study shows the importance of monitoring influenza A infection in cattle herds: viruses from different species may recombine in cattle and produce novel influenza A viruses, posing a potential threat to animals or humans. Annual summary: 7 human H5N1 cases (9,701 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 48 countries and territories have reported 1,333 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約3.1%持續下降,中國大陸2月新增22,966例
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 3.1% in week 10 of 2025 and continues to decline; mainland China added 22,966 cases in February.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新  2025年第10週(3/3-3/9)全球陽性率約3.1%,陽性率以美洲區(3.6%)、歐洲區(3.1%)及非洲區(2.7%)為高。 中國2月疫情概況,新增22,966例確診病例,病例數呈上下波動,其中92例重症及1例死亡,相較於1月(163例重症/4例死亡)均呈下降趨勢,新冠病毒陽性率略升,主要流行為XDV及其衍生變異株;香港第12週陽性率及定醫就診率上升,主要流行變異株爲JN.1及其衍生變異株。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率持續下降,其中,東地中海區上下波動,其他地區則呈持平或下降;全球主要流行變異株為XEC,另變異株LP.8.1占比上升。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 10 of 2025 (3–9 March), global test positivity was about 3.1%, highest in the Americas region (3.6%), the European region (3.1%) and the African region (2.7%). Mainland China (excluding Hong Kong and Macao) added 22,966 confirmed cases in February. Case numbers fluctuated, with 92 severe cases and 1 death; both declined compared with January (163 severe cases and 4 deaths). Test positivity rose slightly, with XDV and its descendant variants the main circulating strains. Hong Kong SAR's test positivity and outpatient consultation rate rose in week 12, with JN.1 and its descendant variants the main circulating strains. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity continues to decline. The Eastern Mediterranean region has fluctuated up and down, while other regions have been flat or declining. The main global variant is XEC, and the share of LP.8.1 is rising. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球新增cVDPV2型小兒麻痺病例6例,索馬利亞4例居多
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 6 new cVDPV2 polio cases in 3 countries for 13–19 March, 4 of them in Somalia.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/13-19期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共6例病例,分別為索馬利亞4例、安哥拉/奈及利亞各1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦12件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增7國共13件,分別為葉門5件、吉布地3件、安哥拉/查德/象牙海岸/衣索比亞/索馬利亞各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 March, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 4 in Somalia, and 1 each in Angola and Nigeria. For environmental samples, 12 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 7 countries: 5 in Yemen, 3 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Angola, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia and Somalia.

items.headline_zh: 阿爾及利亞-布氏桿菌病
items.summary_zh: 阿爾及利亞提濟烏祖省布氏桿菌病累計10例,牧場67頭牛過半陽性
items.summary_en: Algeria's Tizi Ouzou Province has 10 brucellosis cases; 38 of 67 cattle on one farm tested positive and infected animals were culled.
items.description_zh: 阿爾及利亞北部提濟烏祖省報告累計10例病例,匡列之接觸者為畜牧牛場工人之親友,該牧場之過半數(38/67)牛隻經採檢為陽性,且染病牛隻已撲殺,其餘已隔離。另該省於2022年全年報告40例病例。
items.description_en: Tizi Ouzou Province in northern Algeria has reported 10 cumulative cases. The contacts traced were relatives and friends of workers at a cattle farm. More than half (38 of 67) of the farm's cattle tested positive; the infected cattle have been culled and the rest have been isolated. The province reported 40 cases throughout 2022.

items.summary_zh: 英國、德國共7例霍亂病例與衣索比亞聖水有關;安哥拉累計5,872例
items.summary_en: Seven cholera cases in the UK and Germany were linked to Ethiopian holy water; Angola has recorded 5,872 cases and 208 deaths.
items.description_zh: 歐洲報告自今年迄2月底累計2國7例病例,分別為英國4例、德國3例,病患曾去衣索比亞或接觸衣國阿姆哈拉區之聖水,其中5例報告曾飲用來自疫區之瓶裝水,該瓶裝水亦檢測出病原,當局提醒旅客前往該國或接觸疫區之瓶裝水皆有感染風險。 安哥拉疫情持續升高,自1/7宣布爆發後,截至3月中旬已累計13省5,872例病例,其中937例確診、208例死亡,15歲以下兒童佔病例/死亡數之39%及35%。
items.description_en: Europe has reported 7 cholera cases in 2 countries from the start of this year to the end of February: 4 in the United Kingdom and 3 in Germany. The patients had travelled to Ethiopia or had consumed holy water from the Amhara Region of Ethiopia. Five cases reported drinking bottled water from an affected area, and the bottled water also tested positive for the pathogen. Authorities warn that travellers to Ethiopia, and bottled water from the affected areas, carry a risk of infection. Cholera in Angola continues to rise. Since the outbreak was declared on 7 January, 5,872 cases have been reported cumulatively from 13 provinces as of mid-March, including 937 confirmed cases and 208 deaths. Children under 15 account for 39% of cases and 35% of deaths.
