items.summary_zh: 菲律賓1/1-2/22手足口病7,958例,較去年同期增近3倍
items.summary_en: The Philippines recorded 7,958 hand, foot and mouth disease cases from 1 January to 22 February, nearly triple last year's figure.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓報告今年前2個月疫情上升,自1/1-2/22報告7,958例手足口病病例,與去年同期(2,665例)增加近3倍,其中4歲以下兒童佔56%、5-9歲占27%,病患多數來自4區,分別為中呂宋、民馬羅巴、首都及科地列拉區。
items.description_en: The Philippines reported an increase in cases in the first two months of this year. From 1 January to 22 February, 7,958 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases were reported, nearly three times the 2,665 cases in the same period last year. Children under 4 accounted for 56% and those aged 5–9 for 27%. Most cases came from four regions: Central Luzon, Mimaropa, the National Capital Region and the Cordillera region.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained fatal illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國不明致死疾病證實為瘧疾,累計2,957例、58死亡
items.summary_en: DRC confirmed the unexplained deadly illness in Équateur Province is malaria: 2,957 cases and 58 deaths from 10 January to 16 March.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國3/21更新赤道省班薩庫蘇區(Bansakusu)疫情,於3/10-16期間新增37例病例,其中1例死亡,博洛姆巴區(Bolomba)近期則無新增個案,自1/10-3/16累計2區共2,957例病例,其中58例死亡(CFR:1.96%)。當局證實本次疾病為瘧疾,WHO評估當地公共衛生風險為中,該國與全球風險為低。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo updated on 21 March on the outbreak in Bansakusu health zone in Équateur Province. Between 10 and 16 March, 37 new cases were reported, including 1 death. Bolomba health zone has had no new cases recently. From 10 January to 16 March, the two health zones reported 2,957 cases cumulatively, with 58 deaths (CFR: 1.96%). Authorities have confirmed the illness is malaria. WHO assesses the local public health risk as moderate, and the risk for the country and globally as low.

items.summary_zh: 韓國2024年結核病逾1.7萬例,每10萬人35.2例,較前一年減8.2%
items.summary_en: South Korea reported over 17,000 tuberculosis cases in 2024 (35.2 per 100,000), down 8.2%, extending 13 years of decline.
items.description_zh: 韓國公布2024年結核病報告,全年報告1.7萬餘例(35.2例/10萬人),較前一年減少8.2%,高齡及外籍患者數量減少,惟占比逐年上升,該國病例數自2011年達高峰後,已連續13年下降,年均下降7.6%。
items.description_en: South Korea has published its 2024 tuberculosis report. Over 17,000 cases were reported for the full year (35.2 per 100,000 people), a decrease of 8.2% from the previous year. The number of elderly and foreign patients fell, but their share has risen each year. Cases have declined for 13 consecutive years since peaking in 2011, with an average annual decline of 7.6%.

items.summary_zh: 愛爾蘭2024年百日咳539例創新高,逾65%為0-5個月嬰兒
items.summary_en: Ireland recorded a record 539 pertussis cases in 2024, over 65% of them in infants aged 0–5 months; no deaths were reported.
items.description_zh: 愛爾蘭2024年病例數達新高,報告539例,約25%病例需住院,超過65%病例為0-5個月大嬰兒,無死亡病例,疫情趨勢延續到2025年初,預期春、夏季病例數將持續增加。
items.description_en: Ireland's case numbers in 2024 reached a record high, with 539 cases reported. About 25% of cases required hospitalization, and over 65% of cases were infants aged 0–5 months. There were no deaths. The trend continued into early 2025, and case numbers are expected to keep rising in spring and summer.

items.summary_zh: 越南今年疑似病例逾4.2萬例、5死亡,吉爾吉斯已8名兒童死亡
items.summary_en: Viet Nam reports over 42,000 suspected measles cases and 5 deaths this year; Kyrgyzstan has 4,055 cases, including 8 child deaths.
items.description_zh: 越南3/21公布今年迄今共63省市報告4.2萬餘例疑病例,其中逾4,000例確診及5例死亡,以南部(54%)為多,次為中部(20%),多數病例為9個月至15歲以下孩童,占比超過70%,其中超過95%未接種疫苗。目前病例集中於都會地區,惟山區省分病例數呈增加趨勢,目前預期疫情將下降,惟全國各地仍將持續發生病例,尤其是山區及疫苗覆蓋率低之省分。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/25累計報告379例(德州327例/新墨西哥州43例/奧克拉荷馬州9例),其中42例住院,2例死亡,該國公布今年截至3/20已有18州報告378例,其中64例住院。 PAHO於3/24發布美洲地區風險評估,截至3/15共4國報告507例,分別為美國301例(含2例死亡)、加拿大173例、墨西哥22例及阿根廷11例,病例數較去年同期91例上升5.5倍。因病毒於該區持續流行,多數國家疫苗覆蓋率未達95%目標,且新冠疫情期間疫苗接種中斷,疫苗猶豫情形增加及弱勢族群醫療可近性有限等因素,評估整體風險為高,評估信心水準為高。 吉爾吉斯今年迄今報告4,055例,其中,8例兒童死亡,首都比斯凱克、北部楚河州與南部奧什州病例數大幅上升,超過95%病例未接種疫苗;該國去年報告1.4萬餘例及6例死亡,疫情上升主要為疫苗覆蓋率低所致,比斯凱克覆蓋率僅63%。
items.description_en: Viet Nam announced on 21 March that 63 provinces and cities have reported over 42,000 suspected cases so far this year, of which over 4,000 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south (54%), followed by the central region (20%). Most cases are children aged from 9 months to under 15 years, accounting for over 70%, and over 95% were unvaccinated. Cases are currently concentrated in urban areas, but numbers are rising in mountainous provinces. Although the outbreak is expected to decline, cases will continue to occur across the country, especially in mountainous areas and provinces with low vaccination coverage. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 25 March, 379 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 327, New Mexico 43, Oklahoma 9), of which 42 were hospitalized and 2 died. The United States reported that as of 20 March, 378 cases had been reported from 18 states, of which 64 were hospitalized. PAHO issued a risk assessment for the Americas on 24 March. As of 15 March, 4 countries had reported 507 cases: the United States 301 (including 2 deaths), Canada 173, Mexico 22 and Argentina 11. This is 5.5 times the 91 cases reported in the same period last year. Because the virus continues to circulate in the region, most countries have not reached the 95% vaccination coverage target, vaccination was disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy has increased and access to healthcare for vulnerable groups is limited, the overall risk is assessed as high, with high confidence. Kyrgyzstan has reported 4,055 cases so far this year, including 8 child deaths. Case numbers have risen sharply in the capital Bishkek, northern Chuy Region and southern Osh Region, and over 95% of cases were unvaccinated. Kyrgyzstan reported over 14,000 cases and 6 deaths last year. The increase is mainly due to low vaccination coverage; coverage in Bishkek is only 63%.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,加拿大,吉爾吉斯,墨西哥,美國,越南

items.summary_zh: 英國約克郡農場發現全球首例綿羊感染H5N1,公眾風險仍極低
items.summary_en: The UK reported the world's first H5N1 avian influenza infection in sheep, on a Yorkshire farm; public risk remains very low.
items.description_zh: 英國3/24公布,於英蘭東北部約克郡某農場發現全球首例綿羊感染H5N1流感,該農場禽鳥曾感染禽流感,於例行監測時,發現染疫羊隻之羊乳呈陽性,血液樣本亦呈現H5抗體陽性,並有乳腺炎症狀,為防止疫情擴散,已撲殺該羊隻,目前場內其他羊隻並未檢出感染。當局表示,於全球範圍內仍可能持續發現哺乳動物感染H5N1流感,目前證據顯示現存病毒不易傳播予人類,對公眾風險仍極低,另食品標準局表示,該病毒通常不會經由食物傳播,評估禽流感對消費者的食品安全風險仍極低。
items.description_en: On 24 March the UK announced the world's first case of H5N1 avian influenza infection in sheep, found on a farm in Yorkshire in northeastern England. The farm's birds had previously been infected with avian influenza. During routine surveillance, the milk of an infected ewe tested positive, and blood samples showed positive H5 antibodies, with mastitis symptoms. To prevent spread, the infected sheep was culled, and no other sheep on the farm have tested positive so far. Authorities say mammal infections with H5N1 may continue to be found globally. Current evidence suggests the virus does not spread easily to humans, and the risk to the public remains very low. The Food Standards Agency says the virus is not normally transmitted through food, and assesses the food safety risk of avian influenza to consumers as very low.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年3例狂犬病死亡皆未接種;印度德里1例飲用牛乳後死亡
items.summary_en: Thailand has recorded 3 rabies deaths this year, all unvaccinated dog-bite victims; Delhi reported a death after drinking milk from a bitten cow.
items.description_zh: 泰國3/25報告自今年截至3/23累計3地區3例死亡,3例均曾被狗咬傷,且未接種疫苗。截至今年3/10,當局經檢驗發現動物檢體陽性率為6.19% (58/937)。 印度德里新增1例死亡病例,病患為成年女性,因飲用牛乳數日後死亡,據調查相關牛隻曾被流浪犬咬傷。當局提醒,牛隻被感染動物咬傷後其牛乳即可能含有病毒,應煮沸消毒;若傷口或黏膜被感染動物舔舐亦可能感染,應立即接受治療。
items.description_en: Thailand reported on 25 March that from the start of this year to 23 March, 3 deaths had been recorded cumulatively in 3 areas. All 3 had been bitten by dogs and were unvaccinated. As of 10 March this year, laboratory testing of animal samples found a positivity rate of 6.19% (58/937). India reported one new death in Delhi: an adult woman who died several days after drinking cow's milk. Investigation found the cow had been bitten by a stray dog. Authorities warn that milk from cattle bitten by an infected animal may contain the virus and should be boiled; infection can also occur if a wound or mucous membrane is licked by an infected animal, and treatment should be sought immediately.

items.summary_zh: 香港3月21日新增1例M痘,35歲男子病況穩定,當局正調查感染源
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a new mpox case on 21 March, a 35-year-old man in stable condition; authorities are investigating the source of infection.
items.description_zh: 香港3/21報告新增1例病例,病患為35歲具慢性病史男子,3/13出現症狀,3/17就診並隔離治療,目前情況穩定,當局刻正調查感染源。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported one new case on 21 March. The patient is a 35-year-old man with a history of chronic illness. Symptoms began on 13 March; he sought care on 17 March and was isolated for treatment. His condition is stable, and authorities are investigating the source of infection.

items.summary_zh: 秘魯今年登革熱累計逾1.8萬例、28死亡,聖馬丁大區居多
items.summary_en: Peru has recorded over 18,000 dengue cases and 28 deaths this year, 8 of the deaths in children; San Martín region has the most cases.
items.description_zh: 秘魯疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告18,000餘例病例及28例死亡,主要分布於該國中北部聖馬丁大區,累計6,000餘例病例及15例死亡,該國死亡病例中有8例為兒童,可能成為今年流行型別的第3型病毒對未曾感染過該型病毒之兒童和青少年有嚴重影響。
items.description_en: Peru update: so far this year, over 18,000 cases and 28 deaths have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the San Martín region in the north-central part of the country, which has accounted for over 6,000 cases and 15 deaths. Eight of the country's deaths were children. Dengue serotype 3 may become the circulating serotype this year, which could have a severe impact on children and adolescents who have not previously been infected with this serotype.

items.summary_zh: 西澳州今年墨累河谷腦炎累計3例、1死亡,主要分布於金伯利及皮爾布拉
items.summary_en: Western Australia has recorded 3 Murray Valley encephalitis cases and 1 death this year, mainly in the Kimberley and Pilbara areas.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情更新,西澳州今年迄今累計3例病例,已有1例死亡,病例主要分布於該州北部金伯利及皮爾布拉等地區,北部雨季及之後時期為該區蚊媒活動高風險期。2023年為該州12年來疫情較嚴重之一年,累計6例病例,其中2例死亡。
items.description_en: Australia update: in Western Australia, 3 cases have been reported cumulatively so far this year, and 1 has died. Cases are mainly in the Kimberley and Pilbara areas of the north of the state. The northern wet season and the period after it is a high-risk period for mosquito-borne transmission in the area. 2023 was a more severe year in the state over the past 12 years, with 6 cases cumulatively, 2 of them fatal.

items.summary_zh: 秘魯今年黃熱病累計19例,遠高於2024年同期2例,皆有林區暴露史
items.summary_en: Peru has recorded 19 yellow fever cases this year, far above 2 in the same period of 2024; all had exposure to forest areas.
items.description_zh: 秘魯疫情上升,今年迄今累計19例病例,明顯高於2024年同期之2例,個案皆有林區暴露史,該國已發布警報,並採取疫情監測及疫苗接種等防治措施。
items.description_en: Yellow fever is rising in Peru. So far this year, 19 cases have been reported cumulatively, clearly higher than the 2 cases in the same period of 2024. All cases had exposure to forest areas. The country has issued an alert and implemented control measures, including surveillance and vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染,3歲男童死亡,今年累計3例
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a new human H5N1 case, a 3-year-old boy who died on 23 March; the country has 3 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨公布新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國東北部橘井省切波雷縣3歲男童,因發燒、咳嗽及呼吸困難等症狀就醫治療,因病況嚴重,於3/23死亡,病患家中飼養雞隻於近期有死亡情形,並煮食病雞食用,當局已針對感染源及接觸者展開調查,該國今年累計3例,自2023年迄今已累計19例,其中9例死亡,柬國近期人類感染病例檢出多為2.3.2.1c分支,為該國禽類主要流行分支。
items.description_en: Cambodia has reported one new human H5N1 infection: a 3-year-old boy from Chhlong district in Kratie Province in northeastern Cambodia. He sought treatment for fever, cough and difficulty breathing. Because of the severity of his illness he died on 23 March. Poultry at his home had recently died, and he had eaten a cooked sick chicken. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and his contacts. Cambodia has recorded 3 cases this year and 19 cases since 2023, of which 9 were fatal. Recently detected human infections are mostly clade 2.3.2.1c, the main clade circulating in the country's poultry.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無人類病例;16國新增138起H5N1動物疫情,英國70起最多
items.summary_en: No human H5N1 cases this week; 16 countries reported 138 animal H5N1 outbreaks since September 2024, with the UK recording 70.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情: 本週無人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共16國於2024/9/12~2025/3/20間新增138起H5N1疫情,英國70起、波蘭15起、匈牙利13起、美國10起、德國8起、荷蘭6起、愛爾蘭/丹麥各3起、法國/多哥各2起、羅馬亞/聖赫勒拿島/保加利亞/芬蘭/奈及利亞/印度各1例。 祕魯/多哥於2025/2/20~2/25各新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。 美國於2025/3/8新增1起H7N9疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告989(4)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,100例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第11週計443個採檢點提供檢測報告,7州12個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC更新H5N1流感調查資訊:  今年1月加州舊金山1例兒童感染病例檢出H5N1抗體,其密切接觸者皆未檢出,目前排除人際傳播可能。 俄亥俄州禽場工人其檢體定序結果顯示為2.4.4.4b(D1.3),該基因型與D1.1基因型均源於2022年進入北美之A3基因型與當地野鳥禽流感病毒重組演化而來,該基因型目前尚未發現對抗病毒藥物或現有候選疫苗病毒效力的突變。  美國FDA與各州政府合作檢驗經巴氏消毒乳製品之H5N1病毒汙染情形,目前初步結果皆為陰性,另與康乃爾大學合作研究發現未經巴氏消毒處理之起司病毒可存活達60日以上。 美國密西西比州於禽場檢出HPAI H7N9,為2017年以來首次於家禽中檢出,動植物衛生檢驗署(APHIS)表示北美地區LPAI H7病毒與此次HPAI密切相關,顯示病毒可能源於野鳥的LPAI病毒病原溢出突變為HPAI,鑑於野鳥禽流感病毒可能傳播至家禽,APHIS將加強監測LPAI H5及H7病毒。H7N9流感人類感染病例自2013年迄今報告1,568例,其中616例死亡(CFR: 39%)。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 6例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計969例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(備註:依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計47國家/地區通報1,226起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 16 countries reported 138 new H5N1 outbreaks between 12 September 2024 and 20 March 2025: the UK 70, Poland 15, Hungary 13, the USA 10, Germany 8, the Netherlands 6, Ireland and Denmark 3 each, France and Togo 2 each, and Romania, Saint Helena, Bulgaria, Finland, Nigeria and India 1 each. Peru and Togo each reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak between 20 and 25 February 2025. The USA reported one new H7N9 outbreak on 8 March 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 989 outbreaks cumulatively (4 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada and Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,100 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 11, 443 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 12 sites in 7 states. Other updates: US CDC has updated its H5N1 investigation information. In January, a child in San Francisco, California, was found to have H5N1 antibodies; none of the close contacts tested positive, so person-to-person transmission is currently ruled out. Sequencing of samples from a poultry worker in Ohio shows genotype 2.4.4.4b (D1.3). This genotype and D1.1 both arose from recombination between the A3 genotype that entered North America in 2022 and local wild bird avian influenza viruses. No mutations conferring resistance to antivirals or reduced effectiveness of existing candidate vaccine viruses have yet been found in this genotype. The US FDA, working with state governments, is testing pasteurized dairy products for H5N1 contamination; preliminary results are all negative. In collaboration with Cornell University, it found that cheese made from unpasteurized milk can keep the virus alive for more than 60 days. Mississippi detected HPAI H7N9 on a poultry farm, the first detection in poultry since 2017. APHIS said that LPAI H7 viruses in North America are closely related to this HPAI virus, suggesting that it may have originated from LPAI viruses in wild birds that spilled over and mutated into HPAI. Because wild bird avian influenza viruses can spread to poultry, APHIS will strengthen surveillance of LPAI H5 and H7 viruses. Since 2013, 1,568 human H7N9 infections have been reported, of which 616 were fatal (CFR: 39%). Annual summary: 6 human H5N1 cases (969 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. (Note: following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases.) Avian and animal cases: 47 countries and territories have reported 1,226 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2025年第9週全球新冠陽性率約3.2%整體下降,東南亞區近期上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 3.2% in week 9 of 2025 and declining overall, though Southeast Asia has recently risen.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第9週(2/24-3/2)全球陽性率約3.2%,陽性率以美洲區(3.7%)、歐洲區(3.2%)及非洲區(2.3%)為高。 WHO更新全球疫情資訊:  全球近28天(1/6-2/2)期間,新增逾14萬例病例及4,500例死亡,病例數及死亡數較前28天期間分別下降16%及上升28%;住院數及重症數分別新增逾1.6萬例及700例,住院/重症數較前28天期間分別下降40%及31% 2025年第5週(1/27-2/2),全球主要流行變異株XEC占比42.7%,其次為變異株KP.3.1.1占比20.3% 。   評估與建議: 全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,東南亞區近期上升,東地中海區及西太平洋區上下波動,其他地區則下降;全球主要流行變異株為XEC。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。 ​​​​​​​
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 9 of 2025 (24 February–2 March), global test positivity was about 3.2%, highest in the Americas (3.7%), Europe (3.2%) and Africa (2.3%). WHO global update: over the 28 days from 6 January to 2 February, more than 140,000 cases and 4,500 deaths were reported globally. Compared with the previous 28-day period, cases fell by 16% and deaths rose by 28%. Over 16,000 hospitalizations and 700 severe cases were reported, down 40% and 31% respectively from the previous 28-day period. In week 5 of 2025 (27 January–2 February), the main global circulating variant XEC accounted for 42.7%, followed by variant KP.3.1.1 at 20.3%. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity is declining. Recently it has risen in Southeast Asia, fluctuated in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions, and declined in other regions. The main global variant is XEC. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓西內羅斯省今年傷寒344例、3死亡,較去年同期增91%
items.summary_en: Negros Occidental Province in the Philippines has recorded 344 typhoid cases and 3 deaths this year, 91% more than last year.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓西內羅斯省疫情上升,該省今年截至3月中旬累計報告344例病例、其中3例死亡,病例數比去年同期增加91%,並以卡班卡蘭市(Kabankalan)78例為最多,當局呼應民眾須注意水源衛生。
items.description_en: Typhoid cases are rising in Negros Occidental Province in the Philippines. As of mid-March this year, the province has reported 344 cumulative cases, including 3 deaths. This is 91% higher than the same period last year. Kabankalan City has the most cases, with 78. Authorities remind residents to pay attention to water source hygiene.

items.summary_zh: 英國醫療長照機構李斯特菌症群聚,5例、3死,問題甜品已下架
items.summary_en: The UK reported a listeriosis cluster linked to care facilities: 5 cases and 3 deaths; a dessert containing the pathogen was withdrawn.
items.description_zh: 英國3/19報告自去年5-12月於醫療/長照機構相關的疫情,累計5例病例,其中3例死亡,病患年齡介於68-89歲。當局於今年2月檢測出機構提供某甜品含有病原體,此產品已下架。
items.description_en: On 19 March the UK reported an outbreak linked to medical and long-term care facilities from May to December last year, with 5 cumulative cases, 3 of whom died. Patients were aged 68–89. In February this year, authorities detected the pathogen in a dessert provided by one of the facilities, and the product has been withdrawn.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 香港-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 香港3月報告2起諾羅病毒群聚,韶關團55例、廈門團6例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported two March norovirus clusters: 55 cases in a Shaoguan exchange group and 6 cases in a Xiamen exchange group.
items.description_zh: 香港3/17報告3月共2起群聚疫情,前者為三所中學之廣東韶關交流團,自3月初截至17日累計55例病例,於3/3-10日出現症狀,其中16例就醫,3例檢驗陽性,感染源可能為某家餐廳;後者為一所中學3/13-15之廈門交流團,截至3/17累計6例病例,於3/14-15出現症狀,感染源刻正調查中。
items.description_en: On 17 March Hong Kong reported two clusters in March. The first involves an exchange group from Shaoguan, Guangdong, from three secondary schools. From early March to 17 March, 55 cases were reported cumulatively, with symptoms beginning between 3 and 10 March. Of these, 16 sought medical care and 3 tested positive; the likely source is a restaurant. The second is a Xiamen exchange group from one secondary school, active from 13 to 15 March. As of 17 March, 6 cases were reported cumulatively, with symptoms beginning on 14–15 March; the source is under investigation.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球新增cVDPV2型小兒麻痺病例7例,查德及奈及利亞各3例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 7 new cVDPV2 polio cases for 6–12 March, 3 each in Chad and Nigeria; Pakistan logged 18 new WPV1-positive samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/6-12期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共7例病例,分別為查德/奈及利亞各3例、剛果民主共和國1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦18件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增3國共8件,分別為查德/巴勒斯坦各3件、坦尚亞2件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 6 and 12 March, 7 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 3 each in Chad and Nigeria, and 1 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. For environmental samples, 18 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 3 countries: 3 each in Chad and Palestine, and 2 in Tanzania.
items.area_zh: 查德,剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,坦尚尼亞

items.summary_zh: 美國2014-2022年食源性疫情累計6,618起,約17%與自製食品有關
items.summary_en: The US recorded 6,618 foodborne outbreaks in 2014–2022, about 17% linked to home-made food; bacterial share rose while viral share fell.
items.description_zh: 美國報告2014-2022年共累計6,618起食源性疾病事件,每年約有800起食源性事件,致約15,000人罹病、800人住院、20人死亡。分析其中2,677起疫情,以每三年為一期,比較第一期與第三期發現細菌性感染比例上升,病毒性感染比例下降。另每期均有約17%的疫情與自製食品相關,當局呼籲應落實食品加工時的溫度控制及適當烹調時間以確保食品安全。
items.description_en: The US reported 6,618 cumulative foodborne disease outbreaks for 2014–2022. About 800 foodborne outbreaks occur each year, causing about 15,000 illnesses, 800 hospitalizations and 20 deaths. An analysis of 2,677 of these outbreaks, comparing three-year periods, found that the proportion of bacterial infections rose and the proportion of viral infections fell between the first and third periods. In each period, about 17% of outbreaks were linked to home-made food. Authorities urge strict temperature control during food processing and appropriate cooking times to ensure food safety.

items.summary_zh: 日本今年百日咳累計2,924例,第10週新增482例,為2018年以來最高
items.summary_en: Japan has recorded 2,924 pertussis cases so far this year, the highest since 2018, with 482 cases in week 10 alone.
items.description_zh: 日本第10週(3/3-9)報告482例,今年累計報告2,924例,為2018年以來最高,以大阪府43例為多,其次為新潟縣39例及宮崎縣33例,專家表示許多慢性咳嗽病患未就醫,實際病例數可能更高,當局已規劃疫苗接種計畫。
items.description_en: Japan reported 482 cases in week 10 (3–9 March), bringing the year's cumulative total to 2,924, the highest since 2018. Osaka Prefecture had the most, with 43 cases, followed by Niigata Prefecture with 39 and Miyazaki Prefecture with 33. Experts say many patients with chronic cough have not sought medical care, so actual case numbers may be higher. Authorities have planned a vaccination programme.

items.headline_zh: 奈及利亞-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞西北部爆發流行性腦脊髓膜炎,已報告200餘例疑似病例、26死亡
items.summary_en: Northwestern Nigeria has an outbreak of meningococcal meningitis: over 200 suspected cases and 26 deaths reported since late January.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞西北部地區爆發疫情,疫情始於1月下旬,迄今已報告200餘例疑病例,並報告26例死亡,該國位於「非洲流腦帶」地區,2022-23年報告超過2,700例疑病例及190例死亡,WHO表示該國於去年報告153例死亡。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in northwestern Nigeria, starting in late January. So far over 200 suspected cases and 26 deaths have been reported. Nigeria lies in the African meningitis belt. In 2022–23, over 2,700 suspected cases and 190 deaths were reported. WHO says the country reported 153 deaths last year.

items.summary_zh: 日本第10週麻疹新增12例,為今年新高;美國中南部疫情累計317例
items.summary_en: Japan added 12 measles cases in week 10, its highest this year; the US south-central outbreak reached 317 cases by 18 March.
items.description_zh: 多國疫情持續:  韓國自去年12月迄今報告18例,其中13例為境外移入,病例皆來自越南;香港報告今年首例,為越南境外移入個案;日本第10週(3/6-12)新增12例,新增病例數為今年以來新高,累計報告22例,其中15例為境外移入,感染國家以越南(10例)為多,近期發現數例未有境外旅遊史個案,該國將於4月舉行大型博覽會,海外遊客眾多,呼籲加強相關防疫措施。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/18累計報告317例(德州279例/新墨西哥州38例),其中38例住院,2例死亡,另鄰近奧克拉荷馬州報告4例與此次疫情相關病例,該國今年截至3/13共15州報告301例,並於3/7發布麻疹疫情健康警示。 澳洲今年迄今報告29例,病例多來自維多利亞州及新南威爾斯州,兩州各報告13例,病例多為境外移入,感染國包含越南、印等國,該國2023-24年分別報告26及57例。
items.description_en: Measles continues in several countries. South Korea has reported 18 cases since last December, 13 of them imported, all from Viet Nam. Hong Kong reported its first case this year, an imported case from Viet Nam. Japan added 12 cases in week 10 (6–12 March), the highest weekly number this year, bringing the cumulative total to 22, of which 15 were imported. Viet Nam is the most common source country, with 10 cases. Several recent cases had no overseas travel history. Japan will host a large expo in April with many overseas visitors, and authorities call for strengthened preventive measures. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 18 March, 317 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 279, New Mexico 38), of which 38 were hospitalized and 2 died. Neighbouring Oklahoma reported 4 cases related to this outbreak. As of 13 March, 15 states had reported 301 cases this year, and on 7 March the US issued a health alert on measles. Australia has reported 29 cases so far this year, mostly from Victoria and New South Wales, with 13 cases in each. Most cases are imported, from countries including Viet Nam and India. Australia reported 26 cases in 2023 and 57 in 2024.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,香港特別行政區,日本,韓國,美國,越南

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本第10週感染性腸胃炎定點病例11.38人,創十年同期新高
items.summary_en: Japan's sentinel gastroenteritis reports reached 11.38 per site in week 10, the highest for that period in ten years.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情持續,報告第10週(3/3-9)感染性腸胃炎定點報告病例數為11.38人,較前一週增加1.55人,創十年同期新高,都道府縣定點報告病例數前三名分別為大分縣、愛媛縣及香川縣。當局提醒民眾注意並落實手部衛生。
items.description_en: Outbreaks in Japan continue. In week 10 (3–9 March), sentinel-reported infectious gastroenteritis cases reached 11.38 per sentinel site, an increase of 1.55 from the previous week and the highest for the same period in ten years. The three prefectures with the most sentinel reports were Oita, Ehime and Kagawa. Authorities urge the public to be aware of the risk and to practise hand hygiene.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 巴基斯坦-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜炎
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦卡拉奇今年首例福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜炎死亡,36歲女性
items.summary_en: Karachi, Pakistan, recorded its first Naegleria fowleri death this year, a 36-year-old woman presumably infected through household water.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦東南部信德省卡拉奇報告今年首例死亡病例,病患為36歲女性,無開放水域接觸史,惟有於家中禮拜沐浴之習慣,推測感染源為家中水源,上個月於醫院死亡。另自2012年迄今,該市已累計逾100例病例。
items.description_en: Karachi, in Sindh Province in southeastern Pakistan, has reported its first death this year: a 36-year-old woman with no history of contact with open water, but who habitually performed ritual ablutions at home before prayer. Authorities presume the source of infection was household water. She died in hospital last month. Since 2012, the city has reported more than 100 cases cumulatively.

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉-立百病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年立百病毒感染死亡3例,累計341例、241死亡
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has recorded 3 Nipah virus deaths this year; cumulative cases stand at 341, with 241 deaths (CFR 70.6%).
items.description_zh: 孟加拉報告自今年迄今累計3例死亡案例,其中2例男性,分別來自不同區域。該國為全球病例數最多之國家,迄已累計341例病例,其中,241例死亡(CFR:70.6%)。
items.description_en: Bangladesh has reported 3 deaths so far this year, 2 of them men from different areas. The country has the highest number of cases globally, with 341 cases recorded cumulatively, of which 241 died (CFR: 70.6%).

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 烏干達西部凱耶瓦新增1例克里米亞-剛果出血熱確診及2例疑似
items.summary_en: Western Uganda's Kyegegwa reported one new confirmed and two suspected Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases; contacts are being traced.
items.description_zh: 烏干達西部凱耶瓦爆發疫情,3/14報告新增1例確診病例與2例疑病例,指標病例為28歲男性,2/28出現症狀,3/7就診,與2例疑病例於相同院所隔離中,當局已主動監測並匡列接觸者。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in Kyegegwa in western Uganda. On 14 March, one new confirmed case and two suspected cases were reported. The index case is a 28-year-old man who developed symptoms on 28 February and sought care on 7 March; he was isolated at the same facility as the two suspected cases. Authorities have begun active surveillance and are tracing contacts.

items.headline_zh: 坦尚尼亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: WHO宣布坦尚尼亞馬堡病毒疫情結束,累計10例死亡、272名接觸者未發病
items.summary_en: WHO declared Tanzania's Marburg outbreak over on 13 March after 42 days without new cases; 10 deaths were recorded in total.
items.description_zh: WHO於3/13宣布坦尚亞疫情結束,最後1例確診者於1/28死亡後已經連續42日(2倍潛伏期)未新增報告病例。此波疫情於1/20爆發,截至3/12累計報告10例死亡病例,其中2例確診,餘8例於未確診前即死亡(CFR:100%),年齡中位數為30歲(1-75歲),多數病例(7)為女性,另完成272名接觸者追蹤管理且均未發病。目前疫情來源仍不清楚,雖宣布疫情結束,惟仍存在病毒再次出現風險,評估該國家傳播風險為中,區域和全球風險則為低。
items.description_en: WHO declared the end of the outbreak in Tanzania on 13 March. The last confirmed case died on 28 January, and no new cases have been reported for 42 consecutive days, twice the incubation period. The outbreak began on 20 January. As of 12 March, 10 deaths had been reported cumulatively: 2 confirmed cases, and 8 people who died before being confirmed (CFR: 100%). The median age was 30 years (range 1–75). Most cases (7) were women. 272 contacts were traced and monitored, and none developed illness. The source of the outbreak remains unclear. Although the outbreak has been declared over, there remains a risk of the virus reappearing. WHO assesses the transmission risk in the country as moderate and the regional and global risk as low.

items.summary_zh: WHO仍認定M痘為國際關注公共衛生緊急事件,Ib分支在剛果風險高
items.summary_en: WHO's third mpox emergency committee kept the outbreak a PHEIC; clade Ib transmission risk is high in the DRC and nearby areas.
items.description_zh: WHO公布於2025年2月25日召開M痘疫情IHR第三次緊急會議結論報告,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。 另針對各分支風險評估如下:  Ia分支:於DRC傳播風險為中; Ib分支:於DRC及鄰近區域傳播風險為高; II分支:於奈及利亞及中、西非區域傳播風險為中; IIb分支 : 國際傳播風險為中。
items.description_en: WHO has published the conclusions of the third IHR Emergency Committee meeting on the mpox outbreak, held on 25 February 2025. It said the outbreak remains serious, the scale of outbreaks in countries such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is still unclear, and the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied. Reduced funding has affected access to vaccines and diagnostic resources. The Committee therefore declared that the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Risk assessments by clade: clade Ia transmission risk in the DRC is moderate; clade Ib transmission risk in the DRC and neighbouring areas is high; clade II transmission risk in Nigeria and across central and west Africa is moderate; clade IIb international transmission risk is moderate.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年登革熱累計逾102萬例,PAHO對DENV-3傳播發布警報
items.summary_en: Americas dengue has exceeded 1.02 million cases this year; PAHO issued an alert on DENV-3 spread, while Paraguay reports about 1,000 cases weekly.
items.description_zh: 美洲疫情更新,2024年累計1,300萬餘例病例,為該地區病例數最多之一年;今年迄今累計逾102萬例病例,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)對於DENV-3血清型別於該地區傳播發布警報,評估可能造成疫情上升。 巴拉圭疫情上升,平均每週報告約1,000例病例,且9年來首次檢出2例DENV-3血清型別病例,目前主要流行型別為DENV-1及DENV-2。
items.description_en: Update on the Americas: 2024 recorded over 13 million cumulative cases, one of the years with the highest case numbers in the region. So far this year, over 1.02 million cases have been reported cumulatively. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert on the spread of DENV-3 serotype in the region, assessing that it may lead to an increase in outbreaks. Paraguay's outbreak is rising, with about 1,000 cases reported per week on average; for the first time in 9 years, 2 cases of DENV-3 serotype have been detected. The main circulating serotypes are DENV-1 and DENV-2.

items.summary_zh: 澳洲新南威爾斯州今年第2例日本腦炎死亡,70多歲男性3月6日死亡
items.summary_en: New South Wales reported its second Japanese encephalitis death this year, a man in his 70s, and the state's fourth since 2022.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情更新,新南威爾斯州報告今年第2例死亡病例,為70多歲男性,於3/6死亡,為該州自2022年以來之第4例死亡病例。
items.description_en: Australia update: New South Wales has reported the state's second death this year, a man in his 70s who died on 6 March. This is the state's fourth death since 2022.

items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞自2024年至今年2/21累計黃熱病40例、19死亡
items.summary_en: Colombia has recorded 40 yellow fever cases and 19 deaths from the 2024 outbreak to 21 February, with six departments still affected.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,自2024年疫情截至今年2/21累計40例病例及19例死亡(CFR:47%),截至今年3月中旬,托利馬省、卡克塔省、烏伊拉省、納里奧省、普圖馬約省、沃佩斯省之疫情仍持續;南美洲在2024年至今年已累計61例病例,其中19例死亡(CFR:49%)。
items.description_en: Colombia update: from the 2024 outbreak to 21 February this year, 40 cases and 19 deaths (CFR: 47%) have been reported cumulatively. As of mid-March this year, outbreaks continue in the departments of Tolima, Caquetá, Huila, Nariño, Putumayo and Vaupés. Across South America, 61 cases, of which 19 were fatal (CFR: 49%), have been reported cumulatively from 2024 to date.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓2024年狂犬病426例全數死亡;印度死亡54例,較2022年增2.5倍
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 426 rabies cases in 2024, all fatal; India reported 54 deaths, up 2.5-fold from 2022's 21.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓報告2024年全年累計426例病例,且所有病例均已死亡,其中,45%病例係寵物咬傷所致,2024年病例數高於2022、2023年。 印度報告2024年全年累計54例死亡病例,較2022年(21例)增加2.5倍,多數病例發生於馬哈拉什特拉邦,其中,30%病例為15歲以下孩童。WHO統計該國死亡數占全球36%,為狂犬病流行區。另該國2024年通報咬人事件累計219.5萬例,2023年為304萬餘例。
items.description_en: The Philippines reported 426 cumulative human rabies cases for the whole of 2024, and all of them died. 45% of cases were caused by pet bites. The number of cases in 2024 was higher than in 2022 and 2023. India reported 54 cumulative deaths for the whole of 2024, an increase of 2.5 times compared with 21 in 2022. Most cases occurred in Maharashtra State, and 30% of cases were children under 15. WHO estimates that India accounts for 36% of global rabies deaths, and it is a rabies-endemic country. In 2024 the country reported 2.195 million cumulative animal bite incidents; in 2023 it reported over 3.04 million.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年截至3/1麻疹922例、增35%;越南疑似病例近4萬例、5死亡
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 922 measles cases to 1 March this year, up 35%; Viet Nam has nearly 40,000 suspected cases and 5 deaths.
items.description_zh: 東南亞疫情嚴峻:  菲律賓:該國今年截至3/1報告922例,較去年同期683例上升35%,其中近70%未接種疫苗。 越南:今年迄今報告近4萬例疑病例,其中超過3,400例確診及5例死亡,病例分布以南部地區為多,多數病例為15歲以下兒童,該國疫苗接種率仍低,部分省分接種率僅40%。
items.description_en: Measles is severe in Southeast Asia. Philippines: this year, as of 1 March, 922 cases have been reported, up 35% from 683 in the same period last year; nearly 70% were unvaccinated. Viet Nam: nearly 40,000 suspected cases have been reported so far this year, of which over 3,400 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south, and most are children under 15. Viet Nam's vaccination rate remains low, and in some provinces coverage is only 40%.

items.summary_zh: EURO:歐洲及中亞2024年麻疹逾12.7萬例,為1997年以來新高
items.summary_en: EURO reports over 127,000 measles cases in Europe and Central Asia in 2024, double 2023 and the highest since 1997.
items.description_zh: EURO公布歐洲及中亞於2024年報告12.7萬餘例,為2023年之2倍,亦為1997年以來新高,超過40%為5歲以下兒童,逾半數住院治療,截至今年3/6累計報告38例死亡;羅馬亞去年報告逾3萬例,為該區域最高,其次為哈薩克2.8萬餘例。WHO表示自1997年以來病例數持續下降,惟新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下滑,使2023-2024年病例數大幅增加,全球去年報告近36萬例,歐洲區病例數約佔1/3。
items.description_en: EURO reports that Europe and Central Asia recorded over 127,000 measles cases in 2024, double the 2023 figure and the highest since 1997. Over 40% were children under 5, and more than half were hospitalized. As of 6 March this year, 38 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Romania reported over 30,000 cases last year, the highest in the region, followed by Kazakhstan with over 28,000. WHO notes that case numbers had been declining since 1997, but falling vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic caused a sharp rise in cases in 2023–2024. Globally, nearly 360,000 cases were reported last year, and the European Region accounted for about one third of them.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無人類病例;14國新增84起H5N1動物疫情,美國19起最多
items.summary_en: No human H5N1 cases this week; 14 countries reported 84 animal H5N1 outbreaks from 5 February to 13 March, with the US highest at 19.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共14國於2025/2/5~2025/3/13間新增84起H5N1疫情,美國19起、比利時14起、波蘭11起、荷蘭8起、匈牙利7起、德國/法國各5起、臺灣4起、羅馬亞/瑞典/柬埔寨/加拿大/丹麥各2起、芬蘭1起。 冰島於2025/2/3新增1起H5N5疫情。 烏克蘭於2025/3/7新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告985(7)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州、愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,000例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第10週計467個採檢點提供檢測報告,9州29個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  比利時聯邦食品鏈安全局(AFSCA)於3/4公布該國西部東法蘭德斯省(East Flanders)一間禽場飼養之家貓檢出H5禽流感病毒,為該國首次於貓隻檢出,該禽場於2月曾爆發禽流感疫情。ECDC評估對一般民眾風險為低,對於職業暴露或接觸受禽流感感染之動物或受汙染之環境者,風險為低至中,目前尚無貓隻間或貓傳人之證據。 美國CDC研究評估H5N1病毒對抗病毒藥物的敏感性,研究樣本分別為2.3.2.1c分支(柬埔寨樣本)及2.3.4.4b(美洲樣本),結果顯示所有病毒對於常見之抗病毒藥物均有敏感性,惟效果各有差異;另除部分柬埔寨樣本外,其餘病毒於細胞培養測試中對治療A型流感的M2離子通道阻斷劑均呈現敏感性。  年度摘要  人類病例: 6例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計9691例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。1依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計46國家/地區通報1,086起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 14 countries reported 84 new H5N1 outbreaks between 5 February and 13 March 2025: the USA 19, Belgium 14, Poland 11, the Netherlands 8, Hungary 7, Germany and France 5 each, Taiwan 4, Romania, Sweden, Cambodia, Canada and Denmark 2 each, and Finland 1. Iceland reported one new H5N5 outbreak on 3 February 2025. Ukraine reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 7 March 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 985 outbreaks cumulatively (7 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada, Arizona and Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,000 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 10, 467 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 29 sites in 9 states. Other updates: Belgium's Federal Agency for the Safety of the Food Chain (AFSCA) announced on 4 March that a domestic cat kept on a poultry farm in East Flanders, western Belgium, had tested positive for H5 avian influenza virus. This is the first detection in cats in Belgium; the farm had an avian influenza outbreak in February. ECDC assesses the risk to the general public as low, and the risk for occupational exposure or contact with infected animals or contaminated environments as low to moderate. There is currently no evidence of cat-to-cat or cat-to-human transmission. A US CDC study assessed the susceptibility of H5N1 viruses to antiviral drugs, using samples from clade 2.3.2.1c (Cambodian samples) and clade 2.3.4.4b (American samples). All viruses were sensitive to common antiviral drugs, although effects varied. Apart from some Cambodian samples, the other viruses were sensitive in cell culture tests to M2 ion channel blockers used to treat influenza A. Annual summary: 6 human H5N1 cases (9,691 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. (Note: following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases.) Avian and animal cases: 46 countries and territories have reported 1,086 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),比利時,美國

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2025年第8週全球新冠陽性率約3.5%整體下降,非洲區近期上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 3.5% in week 8 of 2025 and declining overall, while Africa's positivity recently rose.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第8週(2/17-2/23)全球陽性率約3.5%,陽性率以美洲區(4.1%)、歐洲區(3.5%)及非洲區(3.2%)為高。 日本近期病例數持續下降,於第10週(3/3-3/9)定醫報告病例數為20,000餘例,每定醫點平均4.07例;第2-5週以XEC變異株占比為高。 紐西蘭於第3週報告1,000餘例病例,第9週報告14例死亡且皆為50歲以上個案,其中以奧克蘭5例死亡為多;該國自2020年迄今累計272萬餘例病例。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,非洲區近期上升,其他地區則呈下降趨勢;全球主要流行變異株為XEC。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 8 of 2025 (17–23 February), global test positivity was about 3.5%, highest in the Americas (4.1%), Europe (3.5%) and Africa (3.2%). In Japan, cases continue to decline: in week 10 (3–9 March), sentinel clinic reports exceeded 20,000 cases, an average of 4.07 cases per sentinel clinic. The XEC variant accounted for a high share in weeks 2–5. New Zealand reported over 1,000 cases in week 3, and 14 deaths in week 9, all in people aged over 50; Auckland accounted for most of them, with 5 deaths. The country has recorded over 2.72 million cumulative cases since 2020. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity is declining. Recently it has risen in the African region, while other regions are declining. The main global variant is XEC. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 全球(第三級國家除外),日本,紐西蘭

items.summary_zh: 歐洲9國沙門氏菌感染509例,挪威257例,源頭疑為義大利苜蓿芽
items.summary_en: Nine European countries reported 509 Salmonella cases from 2023 to January 2025, with Norway at 257; Italian alfalfa sprouts are the suspected source.
items.description_zh: 歐洲3/6報告,自2023/1-2025/1期間,累計9個國家/區509例病,分別為挪威(257例)、瑞典(110)、芬蘭(94)、德國(30)、荷蘭(9)、丹麥(4)、法國(3)、比利時(1)、愛沙亞(1)。多國調查皆認為感染源為義大利某產地之苜蓿芽,基因定序亦有相同結論,當局已實施相關介入措施,以防止受汙染產品進入市場。
items.description_en: Europe reported on 6 March that, between January 2023 and January 2025, 509 cases had been reported cumulatively in 9 countries: Norway 257, Sweden 110, Finland 94, Germany 30, the Netherlands 9, Denmark 4, France 3, Belgium 1 and Estonia 1. Investigations in several countries concluded that the source was alfalfa sprouts from a production site in Italy, and genetic sequencing reached the same conclusion. Authorities have implemented relevant interventions to prevent contaminated products from entering the market.
items.area_zh: 比利時,丹麥,愛沙尼亞,芬蘭,法國,德國,荷蘭,挪威,瑞典

items.headline_zh: 日本-細菌性腸胃炎(曲狀桿菌)
items.summary_zh: 日本神戶餐廳群聚,16名用餐者中10人腹瀉發燒,該店已停業
items.summary_en: A Kobe, Japan restaurant cluster sickened 10 of 16 diners with diarrhoea and fever; the pathogen was found and the restaurant ordered closed.
items.description_zh: 日本神戶報告某餐廳疫情,民眾於2/28在某餐廳食用雞肉、生魚片等食物後,用餐之16人中有10人自3/1出現腹瀉、發燒等症狀。當局於4位病患檢體檢測出病原,並下令該餐廳停業。
items.description_en: Japan's Kobe has reported an outbreak linked to a restaurant. On 28 February, 16 people dined at a restaurant and ate foods including chicken and sashimi; 10 of them developed diarrhoea, fever and other symptoms from 1 March. Authorities detected the pathogen in samples from 4 patients and ordered the restaurant to suspend operations.

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本岐阜縣餐盒群聚累計320例、1死亡,鳥取縣兩起共175例
items.summary_en: Gifu Prefecture reported 320 norovirus cases and one death linked to packed meals; two Tottori outbreaks caused 175 cases; all venues were closed.
items.description_zh: 日本岐阜縣報告某餐飲公司餐盒疫情,自2月底截至3/6累計320例病例,其中1例死亡,死者為40歲男性,於2/25-27食用該公司餐盒,於3/1死亡,其檢體檢出病原,當局已禁止該公司營業,刻正調查中。另鳥取縣發生兩起疫情,分別為某和菓子製造商與某旅館餐點,前者於2/26-3/2期間販售草莓大福,累計99例病例,病患體內與餐點皆檢測出病原;後者於2/25-3/3供應餐點,累計76例病例,病患與烹調人員體內皆檢測出病原;前述兩場所皆已停業。
items.description_en: Gifu Prefecture in Japan has reported an outbreak linked to packed meals from a catering company: from late February to 6 March, 320 cases were reported cumulatively, including 1 death. The deceased, a 40-year-old man, ate the company's packed meals on 25–27 February and died on 1 March; his specimens tested positive for the pathogen. Authorities have ordered the company to cease operations, and an investigation is ongoing. Tottori Prefecture also had two outbreaks: one linked to a Japanese confectionery manufacturer, which sold strawberry daifuku from 26 February to 2 March, with 99 cases cumulatively, and the pathogen was detected in patients and in the food; and one linked to meals served at a hotel from 25 February to 3 March, with 76 cases cumulatively, and the pathogen was detected in patients and cooks. Both venues have been closed.

items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦今年M痘累計5例,新增2例,其中1例有沙烏地阿拉伯旅遊史
items.summary_en: Pakistan has recorded 5 mpox cases this year, including 2 new cases in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa; one case had travelled to Saudi Arabia.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦開伯爾-普什圖省於3/8報告新增2例病例,該國自今年初迄3/11已累計5例。病患分別為42歲男性(案4)及20歲青年(案5),案4具沙烏地阿拉伯旅遊史,案5為案4之接觸者,分支未明。
items.description_en: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province in Pakistan reported 2 new cases on 8 March. The country has recorded 5 cases since the start of this year as of 11 March. The patients are a 42-year-old man (case 4) and a 20-year-old young man (case 5). Case 4 had travelled to Saudi Arabia; case 5 is a contact of case 4. The clade has not yet been identified.

items.summary_zh: 新墨西哥州今年首例漢他病毒症候群死亡,1975-2023年累計129例
items.summary_en: New Mexico reported its first hantavirus syndrome death this year, a 65-year-old woman; the state has recorded 129 cases since 1975.
items.description_zh: 美國新墨西哥州今年報告首例,為聖塔菲郡65歲女性,病患因感染死亡,該州於1975年至2023年累計129例,致死率43%;另加州莫諾郡及華盛頓州惠特曼郡於2月下旬各報告1例死亡病例。該國病例多發生於西部各州。
items.description_en: New Mexico has reported its first case of the year: a 65-year-old woman from Santa Fe County who died of the infection. From 1975 to 2023, the state recorded 129 cases cumulatively, with a case fatality rate of 43%. In addition, Mono County in California and Whitman County in Washington State each reported one death in late February. Most US cases occur in western states.

items.summary_zh: 摩洛哥今年麻疹逾2萬例、37死亡,越南河內近一週新增120例
items.summary_en: Morocco has reported over 20,000 measles cases and 37 deaths this year; Hanoi added 120 cases in one week.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情嚴峻:  非洲:今年迄今累計7國報告2.1萬餘例疑病例,其中確診3,600餘例及54例死亡,病例集中於摩洛哥,今年迄今報告超過2萬例及37例死亡。 歐洲:ECDC更新2025年1月麻疹資訊,17國報告1,033例,其中以羅馬亞663例為多,其次為義大利74例及西班牙70例,餘14國報告病例數為1-67例。歐盟多國仍持續發生疫情,去年病例數遽增,全年報告3.2萬餘例,其中19例死亡,ECDC表示依據疾病季節模式,評估今年春季病例數將持續增加。因歐洲多數國家皆未達到完整接種之水準,呼籲各國應積極接種。荷蘭今年迄2月累計報告63例,多數病例為境外移入及其接觸者,境外移入病例多來自摩洛哥及羅馬亞。 亞洲:越南河內市近1週(2/28-3/7)新增120例,今年迄今累計報告745例,去年同期則無報告病例;日本第9週(2/27-3/5)新增4例,為今年以來新高,該國累計報告9例,多為境外移入,近期千葉縣及埼玉縣各報告1例自越南移入個案。 美洲:美國德州及新墨西哥州疫情持續,今年截至3/11累計報告256例(德州223例),其中30例住院,2例死亡;加州洛杉磯郡報告今年首例,病患具臺灣旅遊史,於3/5返國,目前相關單位調查中。美洲地區今年截至2/21,共4國報告268例,顯著高於去年同期之60例。
items.description_en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

items.headline_zh: 伊拉克-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 伊拉克濟加爾省今年首例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,2024年全國211例
items.summary_en: Iraq's Dhi Qar Province reported its first CCHF case this year, a 40-year-old man; Iraq recorded 211 cases and 26 deaths in 2024.
items.description_zh: 伊拉克南部濟加爾省於3/2報告新增今年首例病例,病患為40歲男性個案,當局已封鎖該區並進行消毒。另該國於2024年全年累計211例病例,其中,26例死亡(CFR:12%),病例以濟加爾省為多。
items.description_en: Dhi Qar Province in southern Iraq reported its first case of the year on 2 March: a 40-year-old man. Authorities have cordoned off the area and carried out disinfection. The country recorded 211 cases cumulatively in 2024, of which 26 died (CFR: 12%); cases were concentrated in Dhi Qar Province.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年截至3/2確診535例、98死亡,1名赴英醫生病例已死亡
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 535 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 98 deaths as of 2 March; a 31-year-old doctor who had travelled to the UK died.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞於3/5通報1例死亡病例,病患為31歲醫生,於2/19前往英國,並於旅行期間發病,27日返國後確診,於3/1死亡。奈及利亞自今年初截至3/2已累計2,728例疑病例,累計14州535例確診,其中98例死亡(CFR:18.3%),病患多分布於翁多州、埃多州及包奇州。英國及奈國均已進行接觸者追蹤調查,英國評估該國內整體傳染風險仍為低。
items.description_en: Nigeria reported one death on 5 March: a 31-year-old doctor who travelled to the United Kingdom on 19 February, developed symptoms during the trip, returned home on 27 February, where he was confirmed, and died on 1 March. From the start of this year to 2 March, Nigeria has recorded 2,728 suspected cases cumulatively, and 535 confirmed cases in 14 states, of which 98 died (CFR: 18.3%). Cases are concentrated in Ondo, Edo and Bauchi states. Both the UK and Nigeria have carried out contact tracing investigations. The UK assesses the overall transmission risk within the country as still low.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Nigeria

items.summary_zh: 瑞典去年12月底至今年2月20日M痘累計30例,皆為IIb型
items.summary_en: Sweden has recorded 30 mpox cases from late December 2024 to 20 February 2025, all clade IIb and mostly in Stockholm.
items.description_zh: 瑞典於3/9報告自去年12/30截至今年2/20,已累計30例病例,皆為IIb型,多數病例在斯德哥爾摩,且均為成年男性。當局呼籲民眾倘接觸疑症狀者,應儘速接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Sweden reported on 9 March that from 30 December last year to 20 February this year, 30 cases had been reported cumulatively, all clade IIb. Most cases were in Stockholm, and all were adult men. Authorities urge anyone who has been in contact with people showing symptoms to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.headline_zh: 菲律賓/阿根廷/東加-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓西內羅省1-2月登革熱1,151例;阿根廷確診病例94.9%無旅遊史
items.summary_en: Negros Occidental reported 1,151 dengue cases in January–February; in Argentina, 94.9% of confirmed cases had no travel history.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓西內羅省疫情上升,今年1-2月累計報告1,151例病例,明顯高於去年同期病例數,主要分布於Bago City 232例。 阿根廷疫情更新,自去年第31週迄今年第5週累計報告28,815例病例,467例確診,其中443例無旅遊史(94.9%),4例病例與器官移植相關,主要流行型別為DEN-1及DEN-2。 東加疫情上升,最近1天新增30例病例,今年迄3/4累計129例病例,無死亡病例,以瓦瓦烏群島63例病例為多。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Negros Occidental, Philippines. Cases reported in January and February this year total 1,151, clearly higher than the same period last year, mainly in Bago City with 232 cases. Argentina update: from week 31 of last year to week 5 of this year, 28,815 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 467 were confirmed; of the confirmed cases, 443 (94.9%) had no travel history, and 4 cases were related to organ transplantation. The main circulating serotypes are DEN-1 and DEN-2. Tonga's outbreak is rising: 30 new cases were reported in the last day, and 129 cases have been reported cumulatively to 4 March this year, with no deaths; most are in the Vava'u island group, with 63 cases.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,菲律賓,東加王國

items.summary_zh: 全球今年截至2/25屈公病逾3萬例、14死亡,巴西31,484例居首
items.summary_en: As of 25 February, 14 countries have reported over 30,000 chikungunya cases and 14 deaths this year; Brazil accounts for 31,484 cases.
items.description_zh: 全球今年截至2/25累計14國報告逾30,000例病例及14例死亡,分布於美洲(11國)、非洲(1國)、亞洲(1國)及歐洲(1國),美洲病例數最多,以巴西31,484例(14例死亡)及阿根廷512例為多,亞洲之巴基斯坦報告201例,非洲之塞內加爾報告2例,另法屬留旺島報告1,631例。
items.description_en: As of 25 February this year, 14 countries globally have reported over 30,000 cases and 14 deaths cumulatively, distributed across the Americas (11 countries), Africa (1 country), Asia (1 country) and Europe (1 country). The Americas have the most cases, mainly Brazil with 31,484 cases (14 deaths) and Argentina with 512. Pakistan in Asia reported 201 cases, Senegal in Africa reported 2 cases, and French Réunion reported 1,631 cases.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,巴西,巴基斯坦,法屬留尼旺島,塞內加爾

items.summary_zh: 加拿大今年截至3/6麻疹227例,多為未接種兒童,旅遊季恐加劇傳播
items.summary_en: Canada has reported 227 measles cases this year as of 6 March, mostly unvaccinated children; the travel season may increase spread.
items.description_zh: 加拿大疫情上升,今年截至3/6報告227例病例,多數病例為尚未接種疫苗之兒童,近期安大略省、魁北克省及英屬哥倫比亞省皆有報告具國外旅遊史相關病例,因旅遊季到來且該國兒童疫苗接種率下降,可能導致疾病傳播。
items.description_en: Measles is rising in Canada. As of 6 March this year, 227 cases have been reported. Most cases are children who have not been vaccinated. Recently, Ontario, Quebec and British Columbia have reported cases linked to overseas travel. With the travel season under way and childhood vaccination coverage in the country declining, transmission may increase.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染(蘇丹病毒疾病)
items.headline_en: Uganda – Ebola virus disease (Sudan virus disease)
items.summary_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉蘇丹病毒疾病累計14例、4例死亡,3/6新增追蹤69名接觸者
items.summary_en: Kampala, Uganda has recorded 14 Sudan virus disease cases and 4 deaths since 30 January; 69 new contacts were listed on 6 March.
items.description_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,3/3-6新增報告2例確診病例,自1/30截至3/6累計14例病例,其中12例確診,累計4例死亡(2例確診;CFR:16%),評估該地區病毒傳播風險持續存在,當局於3/6新匡列69位接觸者,並加強監測。
items.description_en: Kampala, Uganda update: 2 new confirmed cases were reported between 3 and 6 March. From 30 January to 6 March, 14 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 12 were confirmed, with 4 deaths cumulatively (2 confirmed; CFR: 16%). Assessment: the virus transmission risk in the area persists. On 6 March, authorities listed 69 new contacts and strengthened surveillance.

items.summary_zh: 日本兵庫縣明石市麻疹病例為未接種女性,發病後仍搭機赴臺灣
items.summary_en: A woman in her 20s in Akashi City, Hyogo, Japan, unvaccinated, flew to Taiwan while symptomatic; she was confirmed on 6 March.
items.description_zh: 日本兵庫縣明石市報告1例病例,為該市2020年以來首例,病患為20多歲女性,未曾接種疫苗,於2月中旬曾前往越南,3/1出現發燒、倦怠等症狀,惟3/2仍搭乘大眾交通工具至關西機場,出境前往臺灣,3/4返國後高燒,於6日就醫後確診。
items.description_en: Akashi City in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan, reported one case, the city's first since 2020. The patient is a woman in her 20s who had not been vaccinated. She travelled to Viet Nam in mid-February. She developed fever and fatigue on 1 March, but on 2 March she still took public transport to Kansai Airport and left Japan for Taiwan. She returned to Japan on 4 March with a high fever, and was confirmed after seeking medical care on 6 March.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無人類病例;20國新增91起H5N1動物疫情,英國29起最多
items.summary_en: No human H5N1 cases this week; 20 countries reported 91 animal H5N1 outbreaks from 13 December to 6 March, with the UK highest at 29.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要 人類疫情:本週無人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共20國於2024/12/13~2025/3/6間新增91起H5N1疫情,分別為英國29起、美國16起、德國12起、匈牙利10起、荷蘭5起、瑞典3起、柬埔寨/波蘭各2起、羅馬亞/墨西哥/摩爾多瓦/愛爾蘭/挪威/俄羅斯/阿爾巴亞/法國/希臘/西班牙/比利時/丹麥各1起。 英國於2025/2/17新增1起H5N5疫情。 比利時於2025/1/5-2/27間新增2起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告978(2)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州、愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,900例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第9週計453個採檢點提供檢測報告,4州8個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新  美國CDC公布H5N1流感對該國民眾風險評估:尚無證據顯示病毒於該國具人際傳播能力,且多數報告病例多具有受感染動物接觸史,評估一般民眾感染風險為低;倘接觸受感染動物或受汙染之物品或液體,其風險為中至高,該評估具中等信心水準。風險評估仍可能改變,因A型流感可迅速突變,具引發全球大流行之潛在可能性。H5N1流感病毒已於人類密切接觸動物中高度流行,增加突變及基因重組機會,且季節性A流與H5N1病毒同時感染同一人類或動物,可能產生兼具兩者病毒特徵之新型流感病毒,該病毒可能更易於人際傳播。已開發H5流感候選疫苗,預期可有效對抗目前於野鳥、家禽及牛隻間流行病毒,倘有需要亦能用於生產人用疫苗。 中國發布禽源性H3N2犬流感病毒(CIV)研究報告,研究團隊於2023年12月至2024年2月間蒐集131件具呼吸道症狀之貓狗拭子樣本,於此批樣本中分離出一流感病毒株,發現具人類流感病毒相的氨基酸替換,其研究結果顯示H3N2 CIV (canine influenza virus)朝向適應哺乳動物宿主之方向演化,有對其加強監測及風險評估之必要性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 6例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計9691例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。1本週依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計46國家/地區通報1,000起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 20 countries reported 91 new H5N1 outbreaks between 13 December 2024 and 6 March 2025: the UK 29, the USA 16, Germany 12, Hungary 10, the Netherlands 5, Sweden 3, Cambodia and Poland 2 each, and Romania, Mexico, Moldova, Ireland, Norway, Russia, Albania, France, Greece, Spain, Belgium and Denmark 1 each. The UK reported one new H5N5 outbreak on 17 February 2025. Belgium reported two new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 5 January and 27 February 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 978 outbreaks cumulatively (2 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada, Arizona and Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 8,900 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 9, 453 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 8 sites in 4 states. Other updates: the US CDC has published its risk assessment of H5N1 influenza for the US public. There is no evidence so far that the virus can spread between people in the United States, and most reported cases had contact with infected animals. The risk to the general public is assessed as low; for people exposed to infected animals or to contaminated objects or fluids, the risk is assessed as moderate to high. This assessment has moderate confidence. The assessment may change, because influenza A viruses can mutate rapidly and have the potential to cause a global pandemic. H5N1 is highly prevalent among animals in close contact with humans, which increases opportunities for mutation and reassortment. If seasonal influenza A and H5N1 infect the same person or animal, a novel influenza virus with characteristics of both could emerge, which might spread more easily between people. H5 influenza candidate vaccines have been developed and are expected to be effective against viruses currently circulating among wild birds, poultry and cattle, and could be used to produce human vaccines if needed. China has published a study on avian-origin H3N2 canine influenza virus (CIV). Between December 2023 and February 2024, the research team collected 131 respiratory swab samples from cats and dogs with respiratory symptoms, and isolated one influenza virus strain from these samples. The strain showed amino acid substitutions resembling those of human influenza viruses. The results suggest that H3N2 CIV is evolving toward adaptation to mammalian hosts, so enhanced surveillance and risk assessment are needed. Annual summary: 6 human H5N1 cases (9,691 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. This week, following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 46 countries and territories have reported 1,000 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2025年第7週全球新冠陽性率約3.8%持續下降,美洲最高為4.9%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 3.8% in week 7 of 2025 and falling, with the Americas highest at 4.9%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第7週(2/10-2/16)全球陽性率約3.8%,陽性率以美洲區(4.9%)、歐洲區(3.7%)及非洲區(2.4%)為高。 日本近期病例數持續下降,於第9週(2/24-3/2)定醫報告病例數為21,700餘例,每定醫點平均4.42例。 巴西於第7週(2/10-2/16)報告9,100餘例病例,最近1個月(1/17-2/16)報告約132例死亡病例,重症病例以兒童及老年人為多,死亡病例則以老年人為多。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,各區署近期均呈下降。全球主要流行變異株為XEC,另變異株LP.8.1占比亦上升。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 7 of 2025 (10–16 February), global test positivity was about 3.8%, highest in the Americas (4.9%), Europe (3.7%) and Africa (2.4%). Japan's cases continue to decline: in week 9 (24 February–2 March), sentinel clinic reports exceeded 21,700, an average of 4.42 cases per sentinel clinic. Brazil reported over 9,100 cases in week 7 (10–16 February); about 132 deaths were reported in the past month (17 January–16 February). Severe cases were mainly among children and older people, and deaths were mainly among older people. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity is declining, with recent declines in all regional offices. The main global variant is XEC, and the share of LP.8.1 is also rising. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_en: GPEI reported 13 new cVDPV2 polio cases in 3 countries for 20–26 February, with Chad recording 6, plus one new WPV1 case in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/20-26期間,新增報告WPV1型巴基斯坦1例病例;cVDPV2型新增3國13例病例,分別為查德6例、衣索比亞5例、葉門2例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦13件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增6國10件,分別為德國4件、吉布地2件、查德/象牙海岸/波蘭/英國各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 20 and 26 February, one new WPV1 case was reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 6 in Chad, 5 in Ethiopia and 2 in Yemen. For environmental samples, 13 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 10 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 6 countries: 4 in Germany, 2 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Poland and the United Kingdom.
