items.summary_zh: WHO:2025年第1-4週全球霍亂逾3.4萬例、349死亡,非洲疫情續擴大
items.summary_en: WHO reports over 34,000 cholera cases and 349 deaths globally in weeks 1–4 of 2025; the African outbreak continues to expand.
items.description_zh: WHO於2/20公布2025年第1-4週累計3區署共19國家/地區34,000餘例病例,其中349例死亡,分別相較去年12月下降27%與33%,疫情趨緩可能與冬季傳播下降相關,病例數以非洲、東地中海區及東南亞區為多。WHO評估全球疫情風險仍為非常高。 非洲2025年截至2/21(第8週)累計10國/地區2,6000餘例、其中616死亡(CFR:22.8%),疫情持續擴大,病例數累計前五名分別為南蘇丹(12,711)、蘇丹(5,063)、安哥拉(4,914)、迦納(2,152)、衣索比亞(857)。
items.description_en: On 20 February WHO reported that, in weeks 1–4 of 2025, 19 countries and territories across 3 WHO regions had reported a cumulative total of over 34,000 cases, of which 349 died. Compared with December last year, these were down 27% for cases and 33% for deaths. The slowdown may be related to reduced winter transmission. Cases were concentrated in the African, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. WHO assesses the global risk as still very high. In Africa, from the start of 2025 to 21 February (week 8), 10 countries and territories have reported over 26,000 cases cumulatively, including 616 deaths (CFR: 22.8%). The outbreak continues to expand. The top five countries by cumulative cases are South Sudan (12,711), Sudan (5,063), Angola (4,914), Ghana (2,152) and Ethiopia (857).

items.summary_zh: 南非首次報告M痘I型病例,累計3例,指標病例具非洲Ib疫區旅遊史
items.summary_en: South Africa reported its first clade I mpox cases, three in total; the index case had travelled to an African clade Ib outbreak area.
items.description_zh: 南非豪登省於2/24報告該國首次I型病例,共3例個案,指標案例為30歲男性,具非洲Ib型疫區旅遊史,1/24發病,27日就醫,初誤診為皰疹,並以抗生素治療,後於2/6採檢,21日確診為I型。當局匡列7名接觸者後發現2例個案,其中,案2為案1伴侶,27歲女性;案3為案1朋友,30歲男性。WHO評估跨境風險持續存在,呼籲需加強醫護人員專業訓練,與民眾風險溝通,並加強監測。
items.description_en: Gauteng Province, South Africa, reported on 24 February the country's first clade I cases: 3 cases in total. The index case is a 30-year-old man with a travel history to an African clade Ib outbreak area. He developed symptoms on 24 January and sought care on 27 January; he was initially misdiagnosed as herpes and treated with antibiotics. Samples were taken on 6 February, and clade I was confirmed on 21 February. After 7 contacts were listed, 2 more cases were found: case 2, the index case's partner, a 27-year-old woman; and case 3, the index case's friend, a 30-year-old man. WHO assesses that cross-border risk persists and calls for strengthened professional training for healthcare workers, risk communication with the public, and enhanced surveillance.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染(蘇丹病毒疾病)
items.headline_en: Uganda – Ebola virus disease (Sudan virus disease)
items.summary_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉蘇丹病毒疾病累計12例、4死亡,重新追蹤接觸者201人
items.summary_en: Kampala, Uganda reported 12 Sudan virus disease cases and 4 deaths from 30 January to 3 March; 201 contacts were re-listed.
items.description_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,3/1-3新增報告2例疑死亡病例,自1/30截至3/3累計12例病例,其中10確診,累計4例死亡(2例確診; CFR:20%),其中,案10(4歲男童)於2/15求診,24日死亡,其後回溯發現其母親與弟弟可能為疑案例,其母親(案11)於1/23產子,2/6因急性病症死亡,該新生兒(案12)約1週後死亡,2位疑病例皆未採檢且已埋葬,評估該地區病毒傳播風險持續存在,當局於3/2重新匡列201位接觸者,並加強監測。
items.description_en: Kampala, Uganda update: between 1 and 3 March, 2 suspected deaths were newly reported. From 30 January to 3 March, 12 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 10 were confirmed, with 4 deaths cumulatively (2 confirmed; CFR: 20%). Case 10, a 4-year-old boy, sought care on 15 February and died on 24 February. On later investigation, his mother and younger brother were found to be possible suspected cases. His mother (case 11) gave birth on 23 January and died on 6 February of an acute illness; the newborn (case 12) died about a week later. Neither suspected case was sampled, and both had already been buried. Assessment: the virus transmission risk in the area persists. On 2 March, authorities re-listed 201 contacts and strengthened surveillance.

items.summary_zh: 美國奧克拉荷馬州今年77例、去年469例;愛達荷州中部自2024年起574例
items.summary_en: Oklahoma recorded 77 pertussis cases this year and 469 last year; central Idaho has reported 574 cases since January 2024, including this year's first death.
items.description_zh: 美國奧克拉荷馬州自去年10月以來,病例數持續上升,今年迄今累計報告77例,該州去(2024)年報告469例,2020年僅20例;賓州匹茲堡地區於去年報告338例,較2023年7例顯著上升;愛達荷州中部地區報告今年首例死亡病例,為成年個案,當地於2024年1月起迄今已報告574例,遠高於2022-23年之每年不到10例。
items.description_en: In Oklahoma, case numbers have risen steadily since last October; 77 cases have been reported so far this year. The state reported 469 cases in 2024, compared with only 20 in 2020. The Pittsburgh area of Pennsylvania reported 338 cases last year, a marked rise from 7 in 2023. In central Idaho, the first death of the year was reported, in an adult. The area has reported 574 cases since January 2024, far above the fewer than 10 per year seen in 2022–23.

items.headline_en: Viet Nam / Japan / United States – Measles
items.summary_zh: 越南河內今年麻疹累計625例;美國德州累計159例、1死亡
items.summary_en: Hanoi has recorded 625 measles cases this year, with none at this time last year; Texas has 159 cases, including one death.
items.description_zh: 越南河內市今年迄今累計報告625例,去年同期則無報告病例,該市疫情自年初迅速蔓延,多數病患未接種疫苗或未完整接種疫苗,其中1歲以下幼兒病例持續增加,評估疫情將持續,尤其該地區近期連續降雨,增加傳播風險,當局已進行疫苗接種工作。 日本橫濱市於2/26-27新增2例,為20多歲女性及40多歲男性,2人分別自泰國及越南返國,個案無流行病學關聯;該國今年截至2/26累計報告6例,其中1例本土病例,5例為境外移入,多來自越南。 美國德州疫情更新,截至3/4,累計報告159例,其中22例住院,1例死亡;鄰近新墨西哥州利郡累計報告9例。該國今年截至2/27報告3起疫情,共9州報告164例,其中32例住院,多數病例未接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Hanoi, Viet Nam, has reported 625 cumulative cases so far this year, with no cases reported in the same period last year. The outbreak in the city has spread rapidly since the start of the year. Most patients were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated, and cases among children under one year old continue to rise. Authorities expect the outbreak to continue, especially as recent continuous rain in the area increases transmission risk. Vaccination work is under way. In Yokohama City, Japan, 2 cases were added on 26–27 February: a woman in her 20s and a man in his 40s, who had returned from Thailand and Viet Nam respectively, with no epidemiological link between them. Japan has reported 6 cases this year as of 26 February, 1 of them locally acquired and 5 imported, mostly from Viet Nam. In Texas, USA, as of 4 March, 159 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 22 were hospitalized and 1 died. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. The United States reported 3 outbreaks this year as of 27 February, with 164 cases in 9 states, of which 32 were hospitalized; most cases were unvaccinated.

items.summary_zh: WHO建議2025-26年北半球流感疫苗株更換H3N2,新增2株禽流感候選株
items.summary_en: WHO recommends updating the H3N2 component of the 2025–26 northern hemisphere flu vaccine and adds two H5 avian candidate vaccine viruses.
items.description_zh: WHO公布其諮詢委員會針對2025-26年北半球流感季之疫苗病毒株建議,其中H3N2病毒株更換,H1N1與B型流感病毒株則保留,另H3N2對於雞胚蛋培養與細胞培養分別提供不同病毒株建議。 WHO更新人畜共通流感病毒株審查,新增2種禽流感病毒株為新候選疫苗株,分別為H5N1(2.3.2.1a)分支及H5N6(2.3.4.4h)分支,2.3.2.1a分支於南亞禽鳥及貓科動物檢出,而2.3.4.4h分支曾於東南亞流行,近期於中國東南省分重新出現,於2024年報告2例人類感染。
items.description_en: WHO published its advisory committee's recommendations on vaccine virus strains for the 2025–26 northern hemisphere influenza season. The H3N2 strain is to be replaced, while the H1N1 and B strains are retained. For H3N2, the recommendations differ for egg-based and cell-based culture. WHO also updated its review of zoonotic influenza viruses, adding two avian influenza strains as new candidate vaccine viruses: clade H5N1 (2.3.2.1a) and clade H5N6 (2.3.4.4h). Clade 2.3.2.1a has been detected in birds and felids in South Asia. Clade 2.3.4.4h circulated in Southeast Asia and has recently re-emerged in provinces of southeastern China, with 2 human infections reported in 2024.

items.summary_zh: 印尼峇里島新增1例狂犬病死亡,35歲男子半年前被流浪狗咬傷未接種
items.summary_en: Bali reported a rabies death on 28 February: a 35-year-old man bitten by a stray dog six months earlier who had not been vaccinated.
items.description_zh: 印峇里島2/28報告新增1例死亡病例,該病患為35歲男子,於半年前被流浪狗咬傷,僅清洗傷口,惟未注射疫苗,2/22出現症狀,於24日發燒後死亡。當局呼籲民眾,倘被犬隻咬傷,應盡速施打狂犬病疫苗。另該島於去年共累計7例死亡病例,近56,000人被咬傷。
items.description_en: Bali, Indonesia, reported one new death on 28 February: a 35-year-old man bitten by a stray dog six months earlier. He only washed the wound and did not receive a rabies vaccine. Symptoms began on 22 February, he developed fever on 24 February, and he died. Authorities urge anyone bitten by a dog to get a rabies vaccination as soon as possible. Last year the island recorded 7 cumulative deaths, and nearly 56,000 people were bitten.

items.summary_zh: 肯亞西南部基西縣不明原因疾病,逾200人住院,已蔓延至3個村落
items.summary_en: Kisii County in southwestern Kenya has over 200 hospitalizations from an unexplained illness with bloody diarrhoea; it has spread to three villages.
items.description_zh: 肯亞西南部基西縣3/3報告爆發不明原因疾病,自2月中旬於南穆吉蘭戈爆發,已累計逾200人住院,症狀包括嚴重腹瀉、血便、發燒和頭痛,該疫情已蔓延至鄰近3村落,當局目前調查原因中。
items.description_en: Kisii County in southwestern Kenya reported an outbreak of an unexplained illness on 3 March. The outbreak began in South Mugirango in mid-February and has led to over 200 hospitalizations cumulatively. Symptoms include severe diarrhoea, bloody stools, fever and headache. The outbreak has spread to 3 neighbouring villages, and authorities are investigating the cause.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained fatal illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國班薩庫蘇區疑似病例1,318例、53死亡,約半數檢體驗出瘧疾
items.summary_en: DRC's Bansakusu zone reported 1,318 suspected cases and 53 deaths from 9–25 February; about half of samples tested positive for malaria.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國班薩庫蘇區(Bansakusu)自2/9-25累計報告1,318例疑病例,其中53例死亡,出現症狀到死亡中位數為1天,平均為2天,目前大約50%檢體的瘧疾檢測呈陽性。WHO依據病例臨床表現和症狀發作到死亡速度,鑑別診斷包括快速發作之細菌性腦膜炎或化學中毒污染,並將當地公共衛生風險評估為中等,國家和全球風險評估為低。
items.description_en: In the Bansakusu health zone of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 1,318 suspected cases were reported cumulatively between 9 and 25 February, of which 53 died. The median time from symptom onset to death was 1 day, with a mean of 2 days. About 50% of specimens tested positive for malaria. Based on the clinical presentation and the speed from symptom onset to death, WHO's differential diagnoses include rapidly progressing bacterial meningitis and chemical poisoning contamination. WHO assessed the local public health risk as moderate and the national and global risk as low.

items.summary_zh: 非洲M痘每週病例自2024年8月909例升至2025年2月3,264例
items.summary_en: Africa's weekly mpox cases rose from 909 in August 2024 to 3,264 in February 2025; the continental emergency remains in place.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情上升,ACDC於2/28公布將該病持續列為非洲公共衛生緊急事件(PHECS)。該洲每週平均病例數從2024年8月909例病例持續上升,2025年2月達3,264例;自去年8月非洲宣布PHECS迄今,該病已傳播至另外9個非洲國家。另於剛果民主共和國發現Ia型病毒攜帶 APOBEC3 突變之變異株,具有高度傳播性,並構成重大公共衛生風險。
items.description_en: Mpox is rising in Africa. On 28 February, the Africa CDC (ACDC) announced that it continues to list the disease as a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS). The weekly average number of cases in Africa rose from 909 in August 2024 to 3,264 in February 2025. Since Africa declared the PHECS last August, the disease has spread to 9 more African countries. In the DRC, a clade Ia virus variant carrying APOBEC3 mutations has been found; it is highly transmissible and poses a major public health risk.

items.summary_zh: 印尼屈公病上升,據去年12月資料7省571例,衛生部發布警報
items.summary_en: Indonesia's chikungunya cases are rising: 571 cases in 7 provinces per December data; the health ministry has issued an alert.
items.description_zh: 印疫情上升,依據去年12月資料顯示,該國7個省報告571例病例,於去年底及今年初病例數呈上升趨勢,該國衛生部對今年屈公病病例數上升及突發公共衛生事件(KLB)發布警報。
items.description_en: Indonesia's outbreak is rising. According to December data, 7 provinces reported 571 cases, and case numbers have been rising since the end of last year and into this year. The Ministry of Health has issued an alert over the rise in chikungunya cases this year and declared an extraordinary public health event (KLB).

items.headline_zh: 越南/斯里蘭卡/孟加拉-登革熱
items.headline_en: Viet Nam / Sri Lanka / Bangladesh – Dengue
items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年登革熱逾3,400例,病例遽增且高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has over 3,400 dengue cases this year, rising sharply and above last year's level; Sri Lanka's outbreak is also rising.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,該市今年迄今累計報告3,400餘例病例,病例數遽增且高於去年同期,預期疫情可能會提早開始。當局已採取預防措施,以控制疫情。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,今年2/1-4已報告419例病例,今年截至2/3累計報告5,300餘例病例及2例死亡,病例數以西部省2,300餘例最多。 孟加拉疫情更新,最近1天內新增6例病例,今年迄今累計1,500餘例病例及13例死亡,去年累計101,200餘例病例及575例死亡。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam. The city has reported over 3,400 cases so far this year; case numbers have risen sharply and are higher than the same period last year, and the outbreak may start earlier than expected. Authorities have taken preventive measures to control it. Sri Lanka update: 419 cases were reported between 1 and 4 February this year; as of 3 February, over 5,300 cases and 2 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year, with the Western Province accounting for the most, at over 2,300. Bangladesh update: 6 new cases were reported in the last day; so far this year, over 1,500 cases and 13 deaths have been reported, and last year over 101,200 cases and 575 deaths were recorded.

items.summary_zh: 阿根廷今年茲卡病毒感染累計288例,去年564例;巴西去年逾4.2萬例
items.summary_en: Argentina has recorded 288 Zika cases so far this year (564 last year); Brazil reported over 42,000 cases in 2024.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年截至2/27累計報告288例病例,去年全年共報告564例病例;去年美洲地區以巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞、哥倫比亞等國病例數為多,其中巴西報告42,000餘例病例。
items.description_en: Argentina update: as of 27 February this year, 288 cases have been reported cumulatively, compared with 564 cases for the whole of last year. Last year, case numbers in the Americas were highest in Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia and other countries; Brazil reported over 42,000 cases.
items.area_zh: 阿根廷,玻利維亞,巴西,哥倫比亞

items.summary_zh: 南非首3例Ib型M痘,疑有社區傳播鏈,2024年5月起累計28例
items.summary_en: South Africa confirmed three clade Ib mpox cases, possibly indicating undetected community spread; 28 cases and 3 deaths since May 2024.
items.description_zh: 南非2/21新增首3例1b型病例,指標病例為30歲男性,2/21確診,具烏干達旅遊史,其餘2例為匡列時發現,為案1接觸者,分別為30歲男性與27歲女性,目前已漸康復並居家隔離中,另顯示可能有潛在的社區傳播鏈。該國上次報告案例為2024年9月,皆為II型病例。自2024年5月截至2025/2/28已累計28例病例,其中3例死亡。
items.description_en: On 21 February South Africa reported the first 3 clade Ib cases. The index case is a 30-year-old man, confirmed on 21 February, with a travel history to Uganda. The other 2 cases were found during contact tracing: contacts of case 1, a 30-year-old man and a 27-year-old woman. They are gradually recovering and are isolating at home. This suggests a possible chain of undetected community transmission. The country's previous reported cases were in September 2024, all clade II. From May 2024 to 28 February 2025, 28 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 3 deaths.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained fatal illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國赤道省兩區1,096例、60死亡,571件樣本中309件瘧疾陽性
items.summary_en: Two DRC health zones in Équateur Province reported 1,096 cases and 60 deaths by 27 February; 309 of 571 samples tested positive for malaria.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國赤道省班薩庫蘇(Bansakusu)區與博洛姆巴(Bolomba)區自1月中旬截至2/27累計通報1,096例病例、其中60例死亡;班薩庫蘇區持續新增個案並累計943例病例、其中52例死亡(CFR:5.5%),博洛姆巴區近期則無新增個案,5歲以下兒童佔病例17%,佔死者15.5%,多數症狀包含發燒、畏寒、嘔吐及腹痛等症狀。採檢之571件樣本中,伊波拉與馬堡病毒檢測呈陰性,有309件(54.1%)呈瘧疾陽性。當局刻正調查瘧疾、食物中毒及水汙染等潛在病因。
items.description_en: In the Bansakusu and Bolomba health zones of Équateur Province, DRC, 1,096 cases and 60 deaths were reported cumulatively from mid-January to 27 February. Bansakusu continues to add cases, with 943 cases cumulatively, including 52 deaths (CFR: 5.5%). Bolomba has had no new cases recently. Children under 5 account for 17% of cases and 15.5% of deaths. Most patients had symptoms including fever, chills, vomiting and abdominal pain. Of 571 specimens tested, Ebola and Marburg tests were negative, and 309 (54.1%) were positive for malaria. Authorities are investigating potential causes, including malaria, food poisoning and water contamination.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染(蘇丹病毒疾病)
items.headline_en: Uganda – Ebola virus disease (Sudan virus disease)
items.summary_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉蘇丹病毒疾病累計10例確診、2死亡,8例康復出院
items.summary_en: Uganda's Kampala has 10 confirmed Sudan virus disease cases and 2 deaths to 1 March; eight patients recovered and a new child death was reported.
items.description_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,公布自2/7-3/1新增1例死亡病例,自1月中旬截至3/1累計10例確診病例,其中2例死亡(CFR:20%),餘8例確診者已於2/18-19康復出院。新增1例死亡病患為四歲半兒童,於2/25因症就診後死亡,顯示病毒仍在傳播,該國已恢復更積極因應措施。
items.description_en: Kampala, Uganda update: between 7 February and 1 March, one new death was reported. From mid-January to 1 March, 10 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 2 died (CFR: 20%); the other 8 confirmed cases recovered and were discharged on 18–19 February. The new death was a 41⁄2-year-old child who sought care on 25 February and died afterwards, showing that the virus is still spreading. The country has resumed more intensive response measures.

items.summary_zh: 美國德州未接種兒童麻疹死亡,為2015年以來首例,累計124例
items.summary_en: Texas reported an unvaccinated child's measles death, the first US measles death since 2015; the state has 124 cases in 9 counties.
items.description_zh: 美國德州報告1例未接種疫苗的兒童死亡病例,病患於2/25晚間住院後死亡,為該國2015年以來首例。自1月下旬爆發疫情以來,共9郡報告124例,其中18例住院,多數病例為兒童,為該州近30年以來最大的疫情。
items.description_en: Texas has reported the death of an unvaccinated child, who died after being admitted to hospital on the evening of 25 February. This is the first measles death in the United States since 2015. Since the outbreak began in late January, 124 cases have been reported across 9 counties, of which 18 were hospitalized. Most cases are children, and this is the largest outbreak in the state in nearly 30 years.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘累計128,627例、287死亡,WHO仍宣布為國際關注緊急事件
items.summary_en: WHO reports 128,627 mpox cases and at least 287 deaths globally since May 2022; the outbreak remains a PHEIC, with temporary recommendations valid until 20 August.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  自2022年5月截至今年2/28全球累計131國/地區報告12萬8,627例確診病例,其中至少287例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第9週全球累計63國/地區報告7,915例確診病例,其中非洲區6,047例、西太平洋區757例、美洲區665例、歐洲區425例、東南亞區13例及東地中海區8例。  其他更新:  南非於2/25新增1例Ib型確診病例,病患為成年男性,具烏干達旅遊史。 德國於2/21新增1例Ib型確診病例,病患為成年男性,旅遊史未明。  評估與建議: WHO於2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,基於「病例數繼續上升、地理傳播持續存在、剛果民主共和國東部暴力阻礙反應,以及缺乏資金貫徹因應計畫」等,宣告此波疫情仍然構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,並發布效期至今年8/20之臨時建議措施,包括緊急協調、監控與防控及疫苗接種等8項措施,並請各國須定期向WHO報告臨時建議的執行情況。
items.description_en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and as of 28 February 2025, 131 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 128,627 confirmed cases globally, including at least 287 deaths (CFR: 0.2%). As of week 9 this year, 63 countries and territories have reported 7,915 confirmed cases in total: African Region 6,047, Western Pacific Region 757, Region of the Americas 665, European Region 425, South-East Asia Region 13 and Eastern Mediterranean Region 8. Other updates: South Africa reported one new clade Ib confirmed case on 25 February; the patient is an adult man with a travel history to Uganda. Germany reported one new clade Ib confirmed case on 21 February; the patient is an adult man, and travel history is unknown. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February. Citing continuing increases in cases, persistent geographic spread, violence in eastern DRC impeding the response, and a lack of funding to implement response plans, it declared that the outbreak continues to constitute a PHEIC. Temporary recommendations, valid until 20 August this year, were issued. They comprise eight measures, including emergency coordination, surveillance and control, and vaccination, and countries are asked to report regularly to WHO on implementation.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國、柬埔寨本週各新增1例H5N1人類感染;美國乳牛累計976起
items.summary_en: The US and Cambodia each reported one new human H5N1 case this week; US dairy herds have 976 cumulative outbreaks, mainly in California, Nevada and Arizona.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:美國/柬埔寨於本週各新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共15國於2024/11/9~2025/2/27間新增166起H5N1疫情,分別為美國93起、德國15起、荷蘭14起、波蘭11起、韓國9起、匈牙利7起、捷克6起、丹麥3起、比利時2起、墨西哥/義大利/瑞典/柬埔寨/保加利亞/加拿大各1起。 澳大利亞於2025/02/22新增1起H7N8疫情。 秘魯於2025/1/16-2/13新增12起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告976(3)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,900例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。C 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第8週計389個採檢點提供檢測報告,4州10個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國更新近期3例H5N1流感人類感染病例資訊,內華達州乳牛場工人僅出現結膜炎症狀,目前已康復;俄亥俄州禽場工作人員曾參與禽流感禽場撲殺作業,而懷俄明州病患為接觸家中病死家禽,2名病患皆曾因病情嚴重住院治療,目前皆已出院。內華達州及懷俄明州病患檢體經基因檢測皆為2.3.4.4b(基因型D1.1),該基因型已於野鳥及家禽廣泛傳播,近期於內華達州及亞利桑那州乳牛中檢出,2名病患檢體皆發現於PB2蛋白中發生突變,該突變與病毒於哺乳動物細胞中有效複製相關;CDC表示目前尚未發現會影響抗病毒藥物及H5候選疫苗有效性之基因變化。 加拿大食品檢驗局(CFIA)於2月發布研究報告,去(2024)年10月於卑詩省8個禽場發現對奧司他韋(Tamiflu)具抗藥性之H5N1禽流感變異株,該變異株於NA蛋白帶有H275Y突變,該突變於2.3.4.4b分支中極為罕見;研究團隊表示病毒可能於去年9月底出現於該國,美國農業部(USDA)已將病毒指定為基因型D1.1。現有證據顯示突變可能降低病毒適應性,惟該病毒仍於15天內迅速傳播至8個禽場,研究團隊建議可能需重新評估流感治療策略。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 6例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計914例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計44國家/地區通報907起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: the USA and Cambodia each reported one new human H5N1 infection this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 15 countries reported 166 new H5N1 outbreaks between 9 November 2024 and 27 February 2025: the USA 93, Germany 15, the Netherlands 14, Poland 11, South Korea 9, Hungary 7, Czechia 6, Denmark 3, Belgium 2, and Mexico, Italy, Sweden, Cambodia, Bulgaria and Canada 1 each. Australia reported one new H7N8 outbreak on 22 February 2025. Peru reported 12 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 16 January and 13 February 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 976 outbreaks cumulatively (3 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada and Arizona. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 8,900 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 8, 389 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 10 sites in 4 states. Other updates: the US has updated information on three recent human H5N1 infections. A dairy farm worker in Nevada had only conjunctivitis and has recovered. A worker at an Ohio poultry farm had taken part in culling operations at an avian influenza farm, and a patient in Wyoming had been exposed to poultry that died at home. Both of the latter patients were hospitalized with serious illness and have since been discharged. Specimens from the Nevada and Wyoming patients were genotyped as clade 2.3.4.4b (genotype D1.1), a genotype that has spread widely among wild birds and poultry and was recently detected in dairy cattle in Nevada and Arizona. Both patients' specimens showed a mutation in the PB2 protein associated with efficient replication in mammalian cells. The CDC says it has not yet found genetic changes affecting the effectiveness of antivirals or H5 candidate vaccines. Canada's Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) published a research report in February: in October last year, an H5N1 avian influenza variant resistant to oseltamivir (Tamiflu) was found on 8 poultry farms in British Columbia. The variant carries the H275Y mutation in the NA protein, which is very rare in clade 2.3.4.4b. The research team said the virus may have appeared in the country in late September last year. The USDA has designated the virus as genotype D1.1. Current evidence suggests the mutation may reduce viral fitness, yet the virus still spread rapidly to 8 poultry farms within 15 days. The research team recommends that influenza treatment strategies may need to be reassessed. Annual summary: 6 human H5N1 cases (914 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 44 countries and territories have reported 907 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2025年第6週全球新冠陽性率約4.3%近期下降,非洲區上升至6.9%
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 4.3% in week 6 of 2025 and falling overall, though Africa rose and had the highest rate at 6.9%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第6週(2/3-2/9)全球陽性率約4.3%,陽性率以非洲區(6.9%)、美洲區(5.2%)及歐洲區(4.3%)為高。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為XEC、KP.3.1.1及LP.8.1,其中,變異株LP.8.1占比上升,變異株KP.3.1.1占比則持續下降。 日本近期病例數下降,2024年第50週至2025年第1週以XEC及KP.3.1.1變異株占比為高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,其中,非洲區上升,其他地區則下降或持平。全球主要流行變異株為XEC,另變異株LP.8.1占比亦上升。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 6 of 2025 (3–9 February), global test positivity was about 4.3%, highest in the African region (6.9%), the Americas (5.2%) and Europe (4.3%). In the United States, test positivity, emergency department visits and hospitalization rates have recently declined. The main circulating variants are XEC, KP.3.1.1 and LP.8.1; the share of LP.8.1 is rising while that of KP.3.1.1 continues to fall. Japan's cases have declined recently, and from week 50 of 2024 to week 1 of 2025 the XEC and KP.3.1.1 variants accounted for a high share. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently been declining, with the African region rising while other regions are declining or flat. The main global variant is XEC, and the share of LP.8.1 is also rising. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.headline_zh: 法國-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 法國今年1月腦膜炎病例驟增,90例、13死亡,B群占45%
items.summary_en: France's meningococcal disease rose sharply in January: 90 cases and 13 deaths, with serogroup B accounting for 45%.
items.description_zh: 法國疫情上升,今年1月病例數驟增,報告90例病例及13例死亡,其中以B血清群45%為多,其次為W血清群(30%)及Y血清群(25%)。其資料顯示腦膜炎與流感流行存在時間關聯性,感染流感增加疾病風險,呼籲民眾儘速接種腦膜炎雙球菌疫苗。
items.description_en: France has seen rising disease. Case numbers surged in January this year, with 90 cases and 13 deaths reported. Serogroup B accounted for the most cases at 45%, followed by serogroup W (30%) and serogroup Y (25%). Its data show a temporal link between meningitis and influenza epidemics, and influenza infection increases the risk of disease. The public is urged to get meningococcal vaccination as soon as possible.

items.headline_en: United States / Canada / United Kingdom – Measles
items.summary_zh: 美國德州累計124例;加拿大今年逾70例,英格蘭今年確診91例
items.summary_en: Texas has 124 measles cases in 9 counties; Canada has over 70 cases this year and England 91 confirmed.
items.description_zh: 美國德州疫情持續擴大,截至2/25共9郡報告124例,其中18例住院,多數病例均未接種疫苗或接種情形不明,目前以蓋恩斯郡80例為多,另鄰近該郡的新墨西哥州利郡(Lea County)累計報告9例。 加拿大東南部疫情高於往年,安大略省今年累計報告57例確診及6例疑病例,魁北克省自去年12月以來迄今累計報告27例,該國新布藍茲維省自去年10月以來爆發疫情,此波疫情影響周邊地區迄今,該國近10年年度病例數介於0至418例間,歷史最高為2011年之751例,今年截至2月中旬已累計70例以上。 英國英蘭今年迄今報告91例確診,病例多分布於約克郡、亨伯郡及西南地區。2024年英蘭報告超過2,900例,為2012年以來新高,伯明罕及倫敦於去年爆發大規模疫情,其他地區亦有小型群聚事件,疫情於去年7月後漸趨緩,惟部分地區持續有小規模疫情;另蘇蘭今年截至2/19累計報告17例,該地於2023-24年全年分別報告1例及24例。
items.description_en: Texas, USA: the outbreak continues to expand. As of 25 February, 124 cases had been reported in 9 counties, of which 18 were hospitalized. Most patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Gaines County currently has the most cases, with 80. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. Canada: southeastern Canada has more cases than usual. Ontario has reported 57 confirmed and 6 suspected cases cumulatively this year, and Quebec has reported 27 cases cumulatively since December last year. New Brunswick has had an outbreak since October last year, which has affected surrounding areas to date. Canada's annual case numbers over the past decade have ranged from 0 to 418; the historical high was 751 in 2011, and more than 70 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of mid-February. England, UK: 91 confirmed cases have been reported this year, mainly in Yorkshire and the Humber and the South West. England reported over 2,900 cases in 2024, the highest since 2012. Large outbreaks occurred in Birmingham and London last year, with small clusters elsewhere. The outbreak has eased since July last year, although small-scale outbreaks continue in some areas. Scotland has reported 17 cases this year as of 19 February; it reported 1 case in 2023 and 24 in 2024.
items.area_en: Canada,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland,USA

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨2/25新增1例H5N1人類感染,2歲男童死亡,為今年第2例
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported its second H5N1 case this year on 25 February, a 2-year-old boy who died; 18 cases and 8 deaths since 2023.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨於2/25報告1例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國南部波羅勉省柏斯賴縣2歲男童,病患出現發燒、咳嗽、倦怠及呼吸困難等症狀就醫,病患病況嚴重,於2/25死亡。病患家中飼養雞隻,近期部分雞隻罹病,病患平時於雞舍附近活動。該病例為該國今年第2例,該國自2023年迄今累計18例,其中8例死亡;該國於近期人類感染病例檢出多為2.3.2.1c分支,為該國禽類主要流行分支。
items.description_en: Cambodia reported one human H5N1 infection on 25 February: a 2-year-old boy from Bos Rai district in Bopolmen Province in southern Cambodia. He presented with fever, cough, lethargy and difficulty breathing. His condition was severe, and he died on 25 February. Poultry at his home had recently fallen ill, and he often played near the chicken coop. This is the country's second case this year. Since 2023, Cambodia has recorded 18 cases cumulatively, 8 of them fatal. Recently detected human infections are mostly clade 2.3.2.1c, the main clade circulating in the country's poultry.

items.headline_zh: 阿富汗-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗去年1,221例疑似病例、95死亡,檢驗陽性率32.1%
items.summary_en: Afghanistan reported 1,221 suspected CCHF cases and 95 deaths in 14 provinces last year; 32.1% of tested cases were positive.
items.description_zh: 阿富汗報告去年該國全年累計報告14省1,221例疑病例、其中95例死亡(CFR:7.8%),採檢844例疑病例,其中271例為陽性(陽性率:32.1%)。另該國前年(2023年)全年累計1,236例疑病例、其中114例死亡(CFR:9.2%)。
items.description_en: Afghanistan reported that last year, 1,221 suspected cases were recorded cumulatively in 14 provinces, of which 95 died (CFR: 7.8%). Of 844 suspected cases tested, 271 were positive (positivity: 32.1%). In 2023, the country recorded 1,236 suspected cases cumulatively, of which 114 died (CFR: 9.2%).

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 2/13-19小兒麻痺新增WPV1病例3例,巴基斯坦2例、阿富汗1例
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 3 new WPV1 polio cases for 13–19 February, 2 in Pakistan and 1 in Afghanistan, plus new vaccine-derived cases in Algeria and Guinea.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/13-19期間,WPV1型新增報告2國3例,分別為巴基斯坦2例、阿富汗1例;cVDPV2型新增報告阿爾及利亞1例病例;cVDPV3型新增報告幾內亞1例病例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦/阿富汗各9件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本,新增巴勒斯坦3件、阿爾及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 February, WPV1 cases were newly reported in 2 countries: 3 cases, 2 in Pakistan and 1 in Afghanistan. One new cVDPV2 case was reported in Algeria, and one new cVDPV3 case in Guinea. For environmental samples, 9 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in each of Pakistan and Afghanistan. For cVDPV2-positive samples, 3 new samples were reported in Palestine and 1 in Algeria.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,阿爾及利亞,幾內亞,巴基斯坦

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本東京餐廳群聚81人腹瀉嘔吐,有症狀廚師為感染源,停業3日
items.summary_en: A Tokyo restaurant cluster sickened 81 people with diarrhoea and vomiting; a symptomatic cook was the source and the restaurant closed for 3 days.
items.description_zh: 日本公布自2/9-13期間發生東京某家餐廳集體食物中毒事件,累計81人腹瀉、嘔吐,經調查感染源為一名有症狀廚師,並於病患與環境中採檢出諾羅病毒,當局勒令該店停業3日。
items.description_en: Japan reported a mass food poisoning incident at a Tokyo restaurant between 9 and 13 February. A total of 81 people had diarrhoea and vomiting. The investigation found that the source was a cook with symptoms, and norovirus was detected in patients and in the environment. Authorities ordered the restaurant to close for 3 days.

items.summary_zh: 美國李斯特菌症累計38例、12死亡,多為機構住民,冷凍奶昔遭召回
items.summary_en: US listeriosis has 38 cases and 12 deaths across 21 states since 2018, mostly care-facility residents; a frozen milkshake was recalled.
items.description_zh: 美國於去年11/25接獲通報疫情,回溯自2018年截至今年2/24已累計21州38例病例、其中12例死亡,多為醫療或長照機構住民(34例),年齡分布為43-101歲,感染源與機構提供的冷凍補充奶昔相關,多提供予軟食需求者,當局於該產品工廠環境採檢樣本,其反應為陽性,已於22日召回其產品,並呼應民眾切勿食用。
items.description_en: The US received a report of an outbreak on 25 November last year. Retrospectively from 2018 to 24 February this year, 38 cases have been reported cumulatively in 21 states, of which 12 died. Most cases (34) were residents of healthcare or long-term care facilities. Ages ranged from 43 to 101. The source was linked to frozen supplementary milkshakes provided by facilities, which are mostly given to people who need soft foods. Environmental samples taken at the product's manufacturing plant tested positive. The product was recalled on 22 February, and the public was urged not to eat it.

items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國南基伍省武裝衝突,逾400例M痘病例逃離隔離中心
items.summary_en: Armed conflict in DRC's South Kivu has led over 400 mpox cases to escape isolation centres, weakening surveillance and raising spread risk.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國南基伍省武裝衝突持續,致使逾400例病例逃離隔離中心,影響該省之監測及防治措施,亦衍伸疫情傳播至鄰國之風險。另非洲已有7國接收到M痘疫苗,其中,5國已接種逾20萬劑疫苗。
items.description_en: Armed conflict continues in South Kivu Province, DRC. Over 400 cases have escaped from isolation centres, affecting surveillance and control measures in the province and raising the risk of the disease spreading to neighbouring countries. Also, 7 African countries have received mpox vaccines, and 5 of them have administered over 200,000 doses.

items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞今年瘧疾逾77萬例、31死亡,2024年逾1千萬例
items.summary_en: Ethiopia has reported over 770,000 malaria cases and 31 deaths so far this year; over 10 million cases were reported in 2024.
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞疫情持續,今年迄今累計報告77萬餘例病例及31例死亡;2024年累計報告逾1千萬例病例。
items.description_en: Malaria in Ethiopia continues. So far this year, over 770,000 cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Over 10 million cases were reported cumulatively in 2024.

items.summary_zh: 法屬留尼旺島今年屈公病927例,2024年8月起本土病例累計1,069例
items.summary_en: French Réunion has 927 chikungunya cases this year and 1,069 local cases since August 2024; the outbreak may spread island-wide.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島疫情持續,今年迄今累計927例病例,自2024年8月迄今累計1,069例本土病例,主要分布於勒唐蓬及萊唐薩萊,由於夏季及近期的降雨有利於疾病傳播,預測當地疫情可能持續並擴散至整個島嶼。
items.description_en: The outbreak on French Réunion continues. So far this year, 927 cases have been reported cumulatively. Since August 2024, 1,069 locally acquired cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in Le Tampon and L'Étang-Salé. Because summer and recent rainfall favour transmission, the outbreak is expected to continue and may spread across the whole island.

items.summary_zh: PAHO 2/4發布警報:美洲黃熱病今年1月17例、7死亡
items.summary_en: PAHO issued an alert on 4 February over rising yellow fever in the Americas: 17 cases and 7 deaths in January this year.
items.description_zh: 美洲疫情上升,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)於2/4對美洲近期病例數上升發布警報,今年1月已報告17例病例及7例死亡。2024年累計61例病例及30例死亡,高於2022-2023年玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞及秘魯等國之病例數及死亡數;2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,包括玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞、蓋亞那及秘魯等國,今年疾病傳播至該地區以外的區域,主要分布於巴西聖保羅州、哥倫比亞托利馬省等地區;該組織呼籲加強疫苗接種措施及疫情監測。
items.description_en: Cases are rising in the Americas. On 4 February, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an alert over the recent increase in cases in the region. In January this year, 17 cases and 7 deaths were reported. In 2024, 61 cases and 30 deaths were reported cumulatively, higher than the case and death numbers for 2022–2023 in countries including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia and Peru. Cases in 2024 were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Guyana and Peru. This year, the disease has spread beyond that region, mainly to areas including São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia. The organization calls for strengthened vaccination and disease surveillance.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,巴西,哥倫比亞,蓋亞那共和國,秘魯

items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦首例本土M痘確診,成年女性,其丈夫有波斯灣國家旅遊史
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported its first locally acquired mpox case, an adult woman whose husband had travelled to a Persian Gulf country; contacts are being traced.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦開伯爾-普什圖省於2/23報告新增首例本土確診,病患為成年女性,2/18出現發燒、19日出疹,20-21日採檢確診,其丈夫具波斯灣國家旅遊史,5-6日出現發燒出疹,未就醫,其後檢測為陽性,分支未明。此為國際旅行的二次傳播,當局已匡列家庭與密切接觸者。另該國今年已累計3例境外移入病例,首例為1/25報告自阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)返國之成年男性,第二例為1/31報告曾與父母至卡達之5個月大嬰兒。
items.description_en: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province in Pakistan reported on 23 February its first locally acquired confirmed case: an adult woman who developed fever on 18 February and a rash on 19 February. Samples were taken on 20–21 February and confirmed the infection. Her husband had travelled to a Persian Gulf country; he developed fever and rash on 5–6 February, did not seek medical care, and later tested positive. The clade is not yet known. This is secondary transmission from international travel, and authorities have listed family members and close contacts. The country has recorded 3 imported cases this year. The first was an adult man, reported on 25 January after returning from the United Arab Emirates. The second was a 5-month-old infant, reported on 31 January, who had travelled to Qatar with his parents.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國本週新增1例H5N1人類感染,21國新增175起動物疫情
items.summary_en: The US reported one new human H5N1 case this week; 21 countries reported 175 animal H5N1 outbreaks, with the UK highest at 62.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:美國於本週新增1例H5N1人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共21國於2024/2/1~2025/2/18間新增175起H5N1疫情,分別為英國62起、美國28起、菲律賓25起、臺灣13起、德國11起、波蘭/匈牙利各6起、比利時4起、瑞士/奈及利亞/印度各3起、希臘2起、愛爾蘭/奧地利/柬埔寨/保加利亞/芬蘭/波士亞與赫塞哥維/泊爾/日/土耳其各1起。 澳大利亞於2025/02/17新增1起H7N8疫情。 阿根廷於2025/2/11新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告973(5)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,900例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第7週計360個採檢點提供檢測報告,3州12個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國亞利桑那州公布於牛乳中檢測出H5N1,為D1.1基因型,美國農業部表示該基因型為去年秋冬候鳥常見主要型別,已於野鳥及哺乳動物中發現。基因檢測顯示此案為野鳥將HPAI傳播至乳牛的獨立事件,為第3次發現HPAI病原溢出予乳牛,現有證據顯示透過野鳥傳入HPAI進入乳牛場風險上升;另美國CDC於2/20發布疑H5N1流感由人傳貓案例,2名乳牛場工作人員家中貓隻檢出H5N1,貓隻皆未接觸過受HPAI感染農場,惟2名人員拒絕接受檢測,其他接觸者皆為陰性。 加拿大公共衛生署於2/19宣布將購買50萬劑禽流感人用疫苗,將採用H5N1 2.3.4.4b分支作為疫苗抗原,作為緊急計畫一部分,疫苗將用於具暴露禽流感動物風險之族群,該國於去(2024)年11/9報告首例H5N1人類感染病例。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感4例(2003年迄今累計912例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計40國報告669起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: the USA reported one new human H5N1 infection this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 21 countries reported 175 new H5N1 outbreaks between 1 February 2024 and 18 February 2025: the UK 62, the USA 28, the Philippines 25, Taiwan 13, Germany 11, Poland and Hungary 6 each, Belgium 4, Switzerland, Nigeria and India 3 each, Greece 2, and Ireland, Austria, Cambodia, Bulgaria, Finland, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Nepal, Japan and Türkiye 1 each. Australia reported one new H7N8 outbreak on 17 February 2025. Argentina reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 11 February 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 973 outbreaks cumulatively (5 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada and Arizona. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 8,900 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 7, 360 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 12 sites in 3 states. Other updates: Arizona in the USA reported detecting H5N1 in cow's milk, genotype D1.1. The USDA said this genotype was a common main type among wild migratory birds last autumn and winter, and has been found in wild birds and mammals. Genetic testing shows this case was an independent event in which wild birds transmitted HPAI to dairy cattle; it is the third detection of HPAI spillover into cattle. Current evidence suggests that the risk of HPAI entering dairy farms via wild birds is rising. In addition, the US CDC on 20 February published a report of a suspected human-to-cat H5N1 transmission: H5N1 was detected in cats at the homes of 2 dairy farm workers. The cats had not been in contact with infected farms. The 2 workers declined testing, and other contacts tested negative. The Public Health Agency of Canada announced on 19 February that it will purchase 500,000 doses of human avian influenza vaccine, using the H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b as the antigen, as part of an emergency plan. The vaccine will be used for populations at risk of exposure to infected animals. Canada reported its first human H5N1 case on 9 November last year. Annual summary: 4 human H5N1 cases (912 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 40 countries have reported 669 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2025年第5週全球新冠陽性率約4.0%整體下降,美洲5.6%最高
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 4.0% in week 5 of 2025 and declining, with the Americas highest at 5.6%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第5週(1/27-2/2)全球陽性率約4.0%,陽性率以美洲區(5.6%)、非洲區(4.9%)及歐洲區(3.9%)為高。 日本近期病例數下降,2025年第7週(2/10-2/16)定醫報告病例數為25,000餘例,每定醫點平均5.15例。  WHO更新全球疫情資訊: 全球近28天(2024/12/9-2025/1/5)期間,新增逾16萬例病例及3,300例死亡,病例數及死亡數較前28天期間分別下降21%及上升14%;住院數及重症數分別新增逾1.4萬例及1,000例,住院數及重症數較前28天期間分別上升10%及持平。 評估與建議: 全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,東地中海區上升,其他地區則下降或持平。於1月上旬,全球流行變異株以XEC占比最高,呈上升趨勢,其次為變異株KP.3.1.1,占比呈下降趨勢。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 5 of 2025 (27 January–2 February), global test positivity was about 4.0%, highest in the Americas (5.6%), Africa (4.9%) and Europe (3.9%). Japan's cases have declined recently; in week 7 of 2025 (10–16 February), sentinel clinic reports exceeded 25,000, an average of 5.15 per sentinel clinic. WHO global update: over the 28 days from 9 December 2024 to 5 January 2025, more than 160,000 cases and 3,300 deaths were newly reported globally. Compared with the previous 28-day period, cases fell by 21% and deaths rose by 14%. Over 14,000 hospitalizations and 1,000 severe cases were newly reported; compared with the previous 28-day period, hospitalizations rose by 10% and severe cases were unchanged. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity is declining. The Eastern Mediterranean region has risen, while other regions are declining or flat. In early January, the XEC variant accounted for the highest share globally and was rising, followed by KP.3.1.1, whose share was falling. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 葡萄牙馬德拉群島2月初2例本土登革熱,當局評估疫情已受控制
items.summary_en: Portugal's Madeira Islands reported 2 local dengue cases in early February; authorities say the outbreak is under control.
items.description_zh: 葡萄牙馬德拉群島2月初報告2例本土病例,當局表示個案自1月發病迄今已逾可傳染期,評估疫情獲得控制,並已加強相關防治措施;該地區於2012-2013年曾爆發疫情,報告逾1,000例病例。
items.description_en: Portugal's Madeira Islands reported 2 locally acquired cases in early February. Authorities said that since symptoms began in January, the cases have passed their infectious period, and they assess the outbreak as under control. Prevention and control measures have been strengthened. The region had an outbreak in 2012–2013 that reported over 1,000 cases.

items.summary_zh: 美國CDC公布懷俄明州首例H5N1確診,累計69例、1死亡,公衛風險低
items.summary_en: The US CDC reported Wyoming's first confirmed H5N1 case; the country has 69 cases since last year, including 1 death, and risk is low.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC公布懷俄明州首例H5N1確診(前已掌握),該國去年迄今累計報告69例,其中1例死亡,CDC評估對公共衛生風險為低。
items.description_en: The US CDC announced Wyoming's first confirmed H5N1 case (already known). The country has reported 69 cases cumulatively since last year, including 1 death. The CDC assesses the public health risk as low.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因疾病死亡
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained deaths
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國赤道省不明疾病431例、53死亡,已排除伊波拉與馬堡
items.summary_en: Two unexplained illness outbreaks in DRC's Équateur Province caused 431 cases and 53 deaths by 15 February; Ebola and Marburg were ruled out.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國西北部赤道省近期爆發兩起疫情,分別分布於博洛姆巴區(Bolomba)及班薩庫蘇(Bansakusu)區,於今年1/10至2/15期間累計已報告431例病例、其中53例死亡(CFR:12.3%),個案症狀包括發燒、頭痛、腹瀉、出血熱等,兩起疫情個案間無流行病學關聯,具體傳播途徑均仍調查中,目前已排除伊波拉病毒與馬堡病毒感染。
items.description_en: Two outbreaks have recently occurred in Équateur Province in northwestern DRC, in the Bolomba and Bansakusu health zones. From 10 January to 15 February this year, 431 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 53 died (CFR: 12.3%). Symptoms included fever, headache, diarrhoea and haemorrhagic fever. The two outbreaks have no epidemiological link, and transmission routes are still under investigation. Ebola and Marburg virus infections have been ruled out.

items.summary_zh: 愛爾蘭西南部首例漢生病確診,韓國去年5例皆為外國人
items.summary_en: Southwestern Ireland recorded a leprosy case last year, and South Korea reported 5 cases in 2024, all in foreign nationals.
items.description_zh: 愛爾蘭西南部於去年新增該區首例確診病例,為30多歲男性,出生並成長於加勒比海國家,移居至愛爾蘭逾10年,2023年底出現右臂麻木疼痛等症狀,去年夏季確診,已康復出院。當局將加強醫護專業訓練;該國10年內累計5例病例。 韓國報告去年全年累計5例病例,皆為外國籍人士,該國自2019-23年每年新增病例數介於2-5例,多為外國人士,爰增加外國人免費篩檢次數;2023年全球約182,815例病例,其中東南亞地區佔7成。
items.description_en: In southwestern Ireland, the region recorded its first confirmed case last year: a man in his 30s who was born and raised in a Caribbean country and had lived in Ireland for over 10 years. He developed numbness and pain in his right arm at the end of 2023, was confirmed last summer, and has recovered and been discharged. Authorities will strengthen professional training for healthcare workers. Ireland has recorded 5 cases over the past 10 years. South Korea reported 5 cases for the whole of last year, all in foreign nationals. Annual new cases in South Korea from 2019 to 2023 ranged from 2 to 5, mostly among foreigners, so the number of free screenings for foreigners has been increased. Globally, about 182,815 cases were reported in 2023, 70% of them in South-East Asia.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染,梅毒,淋病
items.summary_zh: 歐洲2023年淋病、梅毒病例皆上升;泰國2024年梅毒率較2018年增3.8倍
items.summary_en: Europe's gonorrhoea (+31%) and syphilis (+13%) cases rose in 2023; Thailand's 2024 syphilis rate was 3.8 times its 2018 level.
items.description_zh: 歐洲報告2023年的淋病與梅毒病例數皆呈上升趨勢。淋病累計28國報告近10萬例確診病例,比2022年增加31%;梅毒累計29國通報4萬1千餘例確診,比2022年增加13%,MSM族群佔通報數之72%;披衣菌感染症累計27國報告逾23萬例病例,仍為最常見的細菌性性病,其中女性20-24歲族群占比最高;抗藥性淋病的菌株亦增加,當局將積極監控抗藥性趨勢。 泰國報告2024年性病呈上升趨勢,淋病每十萬人口發生率99.9例,較2018年增加1.6倍;梅毒為105.2例,較2018年增加3.8倍;愛滋病新增約8,869例病例,46%為15-24歲族群。
items.description_en: Europe reported rising gonorrhoea and syphilis cases in 2023. For gonorrhoea, 28 countries reported nearly 100,000 confirmed cases, a 31% increase over 2022. For syphilis, 29 countries reported over 41,000 confirmed cases, a 13% increase over 2022; men who have sex with men (MSM) accounted for 72% of reports. Chlamydia infection was reported by 27 countries, with over 230,000 cases, and remains the most common bacterial sexually transmitted infection; women aged 20–24 had the highest share. Drug-resistant gonorrhoea strains have also increased, and authorities will actively monitor resistance trends. Thailand reported rising STIs in 2024. The gonorrhoea rate was 99.9 per 100,000 population, 1.6 times the 2018 rate; the syphilis rate was 105.2, 3.8 times the 2018 rate. About 8,869 new HIV cases were reported, 46% of them among people aged 15–24.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年截至2/1登革熱28,234例,較去年同期升約40%
items.summary_en: The Philippines has recorded 28,234 dengue cases this year as of 1 February, about 40% higher than last year; Quezon City's cases rose about 200%.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,今年截至2/1累計報告28,234例病例(CFR:0.35%),較去年同期上升約40%;馬拉大都會、中央呂宋及卡拉巴松區之病例數明顯上升,其中,奎松市今年迄今累計1,700餘例病例及10例死亡,病例數較去年同期上升約200%。
items.description_en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines. As of 1 February this year, 28,234 cases have been reported cumulatively (CFR: 0.35%), about 40% higher than the same period last year. Metro Manila, Central Luzon and Calabarzon have seen marked increases in cases. In Quezon City, over 1,700 cases and 10 deaths have been reported so far this year, an increase of about 200% over the same period last year.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染(蘇丹病毒疾病)
items.headline_en: Uganda – Ebola virus disease (Sudan virus disease)
items.summary_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉蘇丹病毒疾病累計9例、1死亡,216名接觸者隔離中
items.summary_en: Kampala, Uganda has 9 Sudan virus disease cases and 1 death to 9 February; 216 contacts remain in quarantine.
items.description_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,自1月中旬截至2/9,累計5地區報告9例(增加2例)確診病例,其中1例死亡(CFR:11.1%),病患分布於瓦基索4例、坎帕拉2例、姆巴萊/金賈/穆科諾各1例。截至2/18,8例確診病例已出院,其餘216名接觸者仍在隔離中。當局自2/3進行全球首次疫苗臨床試驗。
items.description_en: Kampala, Uganda update: from mid-January to 9 February, 9 confirmed cases (2 newly added) were reported cumulatively in 5 areas, of which 1 died (CFR: 11.1%). Patients were distributed as follows: 4 in Wakiso, 2 in Kampala, and 1 each in Mbale, Jinja and Mukono. As of 18 February, 8 confirmed cases had been discharged, and 216 contacts remained in quarantine. Authorities began the world's first clinical trial of a vaccine on 3 February.

items.summary_zh: 美國德州今年截至2/14麻疹48例,13例住院,蓋恩斯郡42例
items.summary_en: Texas has 48 measles cases as of 14 February, 13 hospitalized, with 42 in Gaines County; none were known to be vaccinated.
items.description_zh: 美國德州疫情更新,今年截至2/14累計報告48例,其中13例住院,所有病例均未接種疫苗或接種情形不明,目前以蓋恩斯郡42例為多,另鄰近該郡的新墨西哥州利郡(Lea County)報告3例,惟關聯性尚待釐清。
items.description_en: Texas update: as of 14 February this year, 48 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 13 were hospitalized. All cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Gaines County has the most cases, with 42. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 3 cases; the link between the two outbreaks is yet to be clarified.

items.summary_zh: 美國流感住院達2010-11年以來新高,泰國今年逾9.9萬例、9死亡
items.summary_en: US flu hospitalizations hit their highest since 2010–11, with 11 pediatric deaths in week 6; Thailand has over 99,000 cases and 9 deaths.
items.description_zh: 美國流感活動於第6週(2/2-2/8)接近本流感季高峰,住院及死亡數皆上升,為2017-18年流感季以來,CDC首次將所有年齡層皆提升為最嚴重程度,其中,以24歲(含)以下族群最為嚴重。近2週住院數達2010-11年流感季以來最高,近一週死亡人數中,因流感死亡占比為2.6%,高於新冠的1.5%;第6週新增11例兒童因流感死亡報告,本流感季迄今累計68例。類流感門診就診率已連續11週高於閾,該國共計46個州之流感活動度為高及非常高。 泰國衛生部報告今年迄今已累計報告超過9.9萬例,其中9例死亡,病例數高於過去5年中位數,其中以該國東北部地區疫情最為嚴峻,當局呼籲高風險民眾儘速接種疫苗。
items.description_en: US influenza activity approached this season's peak in week 6 (2–8 February), with both hospitalizations and deaths rising. For the first time since the 2017–18 season, the CDC has raised the severity level for all age groups, with those aged 24 and under most severely affected. Hospitalizations over the past two weeks reached their highest level since the 2010–11 season. Among deaths reported in the past week, the share attributed to influenza was 2.6%, higher than the 1.5% attributed to COVID-19. In week 6, 11 new paediatric influenza deaths were reported, bringing the season's total to 68. Influenza-like illness outpatient visit rates have been above the threshold for 11 consecutive weeks. Influenza activity is high or very high in 46 states. Thailand's Ministry of Public Health reported over 99,000 cases so far this year, including 9 deaths; case numbers are above the five-year median. The outbreak is most severe in the northeast, and authorities urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年奧羅普切熱累計逾4,300例,聖埃斯皮里圖州逾4,000例
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported over 4,300 Oropouche fever cases this year, more than 4,000 of them in Espírito Santo State.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計4,300餘例確診病例,以該國東南部瀕臨大西洋的聖埃斯皮里圖州4,000餘例病例為多;2024年累計13,700餘例確診病例,5例垂直感染病例中,有4例胎兒死亡及1例先天異常病例,另2023年共800餘例病例。
items.description_en: Brazil update: so far this year, over 4,300 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, more than 4,000 of them in Espírito Santo State on the Atlantic coast of the southeast. In 2024, over 13,700 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively. Of 5 cases of vertical transmission, 4 resulted in fetal death and 1 in a congenital anomaly. In 2023, over 800 cases were reported.

items.summary_zh: 今年截至1/22屈公病逾5,000例、2死亡;2024年62萬例、213死亡
items.summary_en: As of 22 January, 2025 chikungunya had over 5,000 cases and 2 deaths globally; 2024 saw about 620,000 cases and 213 deaths.
items.description_zh: 全球今年截至1/22累計4國報告逾5,000例病例及2例死亡,分布於美洲(3國)及歐洲(1國);2024年累計報告約62萬例病例及213例死亡,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,美洲病例數以巴西42萬餘例為多,其次為巴拉圭3,100餘例,亞洲病例數以印度19萬餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦7,300餘例。
items.description_en: Globally this year, as of 22 January, 4 countries have reported over 5,000 cases and 2 deaths cumulatively, in the Americas (3 countries) and Europe (1 country). In 2024, about 620,000 cases and 213 deaths were reported cumulatively across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe. In the Americas, Brazil accounted for over 420,000 cases, followed by Paraguay with over 3,100. In Asia, India accounted for over 190,000 cases, followed by Pakistan with over 7,300.
items.area_zh: 巴西,印度,巴基斯坦,巴拉圭共和國

items.summary_zh: 印尼南蘇門答臘省今年登革出血熱309例,孟加拉累計逾1,300例
items.summary_en: South Sumatra has 309 dengue haemorrhagic fever cases this year, with 4 deaths in January; Bangladesh reports over 1,300 dengue cases.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,最近1天內新增逾18例病例,今年迄今累計1,300餘例病例及12例死亡,2024年累計101,200餘例病例。 印疫情更新,南蘇門答臘省今年1月報告4名登革出血熱死亡案例,該省今年迄今累計309例登革出血熱病例,以巨港市最多。
items.description_en: Bangladesh update: over 18 new cases were reported in the last day. So far this year, over 1,300 cases and 12 deaths have been reported cumulatively, and over 101,200 cases were recorded in 2024. Indonesia update: in South Sumatra Province, 4 deaths from dengue haemorrhagic fever were reported in January this year. So far this year the province has reported 309 cumulative dengue haemorrhagic fever cases, most of them in Palembang City.

items.headline_zh: 坦尚尼亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 坦尚尼亞卡蓋拉地區馬堡病毒累計10例死亡,281名接觸者完成追蹤
items.summary_en: Tanzania's Kagera region has recorded 10 Marburg deaths (2 confirmed, 8 suspected); all 281 contacts completed 21-day follow-up.
items.description_zh: 坦尚亞卡蓋拉地區自1/14-2/10期間,新增1例死亡,累計2例確診病例、8例疑病例,所有病例皆已死亡,前8例為未採檢即死亡埋葬,最後1例確診病例於1/28死亡並安全埋葬,匡列的281位接觸者皆完成21天追蹤。指標病例於去年12/9出現症狀,並於12/16死亡。該國首次疫情為2023年3月爆發,持續近兩個月,累計9例確診病例、其中6例死亡。
items.description_en: In the Kagera region of Tanzania, from 14 January to 10 February, 1 new death was reported. Cumulatively, there are 2 confirmed cases and 8 suspected cases, and all have died. The first 8 cases died without being sampled and were buried. The last confirmed case died on 28 January and was safely buried. All 281 identified contacts completed 21 days of follow-up. The index case developed symptoms on 9 December last year and died on 16 December. The country's first outbreak began in March 2023, lasted nearly two months, and recorded 9 confirmed cases cumulatively, 6 of them fatal.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因出血熱
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained haemorrhagic fever
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國班薩庫蘇區2/3-9新增36例死亡,累計逾50例
items.summary_en: DRC's Bansakusu health zone recorded 36 new deaths from 3–9 February; over 50 deaths since the outbreak began.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國於2/13報告,該國西北部赤道省班薩庫蘇區(Bansakusu) 自2/3-2/9期間新增36例死亡,自疫情爆發以來,累計逾50例死亡,症狀主要為出血熱、頭痛、全身關節痛或腰痛等,當局呼籲民眾遵守衛生措施。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported on 13 February that in the Bansakusu health zone of Équateur Province in the northwest, 36 deaths were newly recorded between 3 and 9 February. Since the outbreak began, over 50 deaths have been recorded cumulatively. Symptoms mainly include haemorrhagic fever, headache, body or joint aches and back pain. Authorities urge the public to follow health measures.

items.headline_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國/中國-M痘
items.summary_zh: 阿聯首例Ib型M痘,已輸出7例;中國大陸累計7例Ib型
items.summary_en: The UAE reported its first clade Ib mpox case and has exported 7 cases; mainland China has 7 clade Ib cases since 3 January.
items.description_zh: WHO於2/13公布:  阿拉伯聯合大公國於2/7報告該國首例Ib型確診病例,具烏干達旅遊史,1/11出現症狀,18日確診,目前隔離治療中。迄今已累計7例自該國之輸出病例(3例泰國、中國/阿曼/巴基斯坦/印度各1例),推測該國可能有未知之社區傳播鏈。 中國自1/3起截至2/5累計7例Ib型確診病例,首例為1/3報告,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,二次傳播至其餘5人;另1起為1/21報告新增1例病例,具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史。
items.description_en: WHO reported on 13 February that the United Arab Emirates reported its first clade Ib confirmed case on 7 February, with a travel history to Uganda. Symptoms began on 11 January and the case was confirmed on 18 January; the patient is in isolation for treatment. So far, 7 exported cases from the UAE have been recorded: 3 in Thailand, and 1 each in China, Oman, Pakistan and India. Authorities suspect there may be an unknown community transmission chain in the UAE. Mainland China has reported 7 clade Ib confirmed cases cumulatively from 3 January to 5 February. The first case, reported on 3 January, had a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and transmitted the virus to 5 others. Another case, reported on 21 January, was newly added and had a travel history to the UAE.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),阿拉伯聯合大公國

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國本週新增1例H5N1人類感染,16國新增192起動物疫情,日本47起最多
items.summary_en: The US reported one new human H5N1 infection this week; 16 countries reported 192 animal H5N1 outbreaks, with Japan highest at 47.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:美國於本週新增1例H5N1人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共16國於2024/1/20~2025/2/11間新增192起H5N1疫情,分別為日本47起、荷蘭44起、英國23起、德國20起、美國18起、波蘭8起、義大利/韓國/印度各6起、比利時5起、奈及利亞3起、摩爾多瓦2起、烏克蘭/波士亞/匈牙利/日各1起。 加拿大於2025/1/15新增1起H5N5疫情。 澳大利亞於2025/2/3~2025/2/10間新增2起H7N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計16州報告968(9)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,700例,檢測194例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第6週計387個採檢點提供檢測報告,3州15個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國新增2例疑H5N1人類感染病例,首例為俄亥俄州默瑟郡(Mercer County)農場工人,曾接觸死禽,其他流行病學資訊未提供;案2為懷俄明州普拉特郡(Platte County)女性長者,具有其他潛在疾病,目前重症住院,另病患家中後院飼養雞隻生病後死亡,兩案皆為該州首例疑病例,仍待CDC公布確診資訊。 美國CDC於2/13發布調查報告,針對2024年乳牛感染H5N1疫情期間,來自美國及加拿大150名獸醫進行血清流行病學調查,發現3名無症狀感染者體內存在HPAI A(H5)抗體,報告指出感染者中有2名表示未接觸過受HPAI感染動物,1名於尚未報告乳牛感染疫情地區執業,顯示該國可能有H5流感之人及動物感染者尚未被發現;另感染者於照顧牛隻時並未佩戴口罩及護目鏡,顯示病毒可透過呼吸道、部及腸胃道暴露造成感染,報告建議加強牛群及散裝牛奶檢測,以監測更多H5流感陽性牛群,提高對畜牧從業人員保護。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 3例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計911例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計35國報告585起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: the USA reported one new human H5N1 infection this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 16 countries reported 192 new H5N1 outbreaks between 20 January 2024 and 11 February 2025: Japan 47, the Netherlands 44, the UK 23, Germany 20, the USA 18, Poland 8, Italy, South Korea and India 6 each, Belgium 5, Nigeria 3, Moldova 2, and Ukraine, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Hungary and Japan 1 each. Canada reported one new H5N5 outbreak on 15 January 2025. Australia reported 2 new H7N8 outbreaks between 3 and 10 February 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 968 outbreaks cumulatively (9 new) in 16 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California and Nevada. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 8,700 people monitored cumulatively, 194 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 6, 387 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 15 sites in 3 states. Other updates: the USA reported 2 new suspected human H5N1 infections. The first was a farm worker in Mercer County, Ohio, who had been exposed to dead poultry; no other epidemiological information was provided. Case 2 is an elderly woman in Platte County, Wyoming, with underlying conditions, currently hospitalized in serious condition; backyard chickens at her home fell ill and died. Both cases are the first suspected cases in their states, and CDC confirmation is pending. On 13 February the US CDC published an investigation report. Serological surveys of 150 veterinarians from the USA and Canada during the 2024 H5N1 dairy cattle outbreak found HPAI A(H5) antibodies in 3 asymptomatic people. Two of them reported no exposure to infected animals, and one practised in an area where cattle infections had not yet been reported, suggesting that undetected human and animal H5 infections may exist in the country. The infected people did not wear masks or goggles when caring for cattle, which indicates the virus may infect through the respiratory tract, eyes and gastrointestinal tract. The report recommends strengthening testing of herds and bulk milk to detect more H5-positive herds and better protect livestock workers. Annual summary: 3 human H5N1 cases (911 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 35 countries have reported 585 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 2025年第4週全球新冠陽性率約5.0%近期下降,非洲區7.3%最高
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 5.0% in week 4 of 2025 and recently declining, with Africa highest at 7.3%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第4週(1/20-1/26)全球陽性率約5.0%,陽性率以非洲區(7.3%)、美洲區(6.2%)及歐洲區(5.0%)為高。 日本於2024年11月中旬起病例數呈上升趨勢,近期呈上下波動,2025年第6週(2/3-2/9)定醫報告病例數為28,000餘例,每定醫點平均5.82例。 中國1月疫情概況,新增33,218例確診病例,病例數呈波動下降趨勢,其中163例重症及4例死亡,相較於12月(112例重症/7例死亡)重症數上升而死亡數略降,新冠病毒陽性率處低點,主要流行變異株為XDV、JN.1及其衍生變異株;香港第6週陽性率及定醫就診率處低點,於污水監測檢出變異株LP.8.1,主要流行變異株爲JN.1及其衍生變異株。  評估與建議: 依WHO資料顯示,近期全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,於1月上旬(1/6-1/12),全球流行變異株以XEC占比最高,呈上升趨勢,其次為變異株KP.3.1.1,占比呈下降趨勢。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemiological update: in week 4 of 2025 (20–26 January), global test positivity was about 5.0%, highest in the African region (7.3%), the Americas (6.2%) and Europe (5.0%). In Japan, case numbers have trended upward since mid-November 2024 and have recently fluctuated; in week 6 of 2025 (3–9 February), sentinel clinic reports exceeded 28,000, an average of 5.82 per sentinel clinic. Mainland China's January situation: 33,218 confirmed cases were added, with case numbers fluctuating and trending downward. There were 163 severe cases and 4 deaths. Compared with December (112 severe cases and 7 deaths), severe cases rose while deaths fell slightly. Test positivity was at a low point, with XDV and JN.1 and their descendant variants the main circulating strains. In Hong Kong SAR, test positivity and the outpatient consultation rate were at a low point in week 6; the LP.8.1 variant was detected in wastewater surveillance, and JN.1 and its descendants remain the main circulating strains. Assessment and recommendations: according to WHO data, global test positivity has recently been declining. In early January (6–12 January), the XEC variant accounted for the highest share globally and was rising, followed by KP.3.1.1, whose share was falling. WHO notes that most countries now include COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.headline_zh: 美國/韓國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.headline_en: United States / South Korea – Viral gastroenteritis (norovirus)
items.summary_zh: 荷美郵輪鹿特丹號119人腹瀉嘔吐;韓國第4週469例創近10年新高
items.summary_en: A Holland America cruise ship, Rotterdam, had 119 people with vomiting and diarrhoea; South Korea logged 469 weekly cases, a 10-year high.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC公布荷美郵輪鹿特丹號(Rotterdam)腹瀉群聚事件,航程介於2/2-14,全船3,583人,其中119人(含12名船員)出現嘔吐及腹瀉症狀。 韓國公布今年第4週單週報告病例數469例病例,為近10年最高,逾半數為0-6歲嬰幼兒(51.4%),7-18歲族群佔2成,自去年第43週開始迄今,GII.17型之檢出率最高,而自今年1月起,GII.4型的檢出率也呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en: The US CDC reported a diarrhoea outbreak on the Holland America Line cruise ship Rotterdam, sailing from 2 to 14 February. A total of 3,583 people were on board, and 119 people, including 12 crew members, developed vomiting and diarrhoea. South Korea reported 469 cases in week 4 of this year, the highest weekly figure in 10 years. Over half were infants and young children aged 0–6 (51.4%), and 20% were aged 7–18. From week 43 of last year to date, genotype GII.17 has had the highest detection rate, and since January this year the detection rate of GII.4 has also been rising.

items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 香港/法國-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR / France – Enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli infection
items.summary_zh: 香港醫院群聚3例含1死亡;法國起司疫情11例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a hospital cluster of 3 EHEC cases (1 death); France linked 11 cases, 9 with HUS, to a recalled cheese.
items.description_zh: 香港2/11報告1起醫院內相關疫情,累計3例病例、其中1例死亡,均為同一棟大樓之專科醫師,3例病患分別於2/4、6、10出現發燒、腹痛及腹瀉症狀。案1沒有慢性疾病,於2/6住院,7日死亡,另2例病患症狀輕微,其中1例已出院。採驗結果僅有1人呈陽性,餘為陰性(含死者),目前仍在調查感染源。香港以往每年報告約0-6例病例。 法國爆發一起與起司相關疫情,截至1/28累計報告11例病例,其中9例成人確診溶血性尿毒症候群(HUS),此產品於2024/11/12-2025/1/24期間銷售,當局已召回產品。
items.description_en: On 11 February Hong Kong reported one hospital-related outbreak with 3 cumulative cases, of which 1 died. All were specialist doctors in the same building. The three patients developed fever, abdominal pain and diarrhoea on 4, 6 and 10 February respectively. Case 1 had no chronic illness, was hospitalized on 6 February and died on 7 February. The other two cases had mild symptoms, and one has been discharged. Only one person tested positive; the others, including the deceased, were negative. The source of infection is still under investigation. Hong Kong has reported about 0–6 cases a year in the past. France reported an outbreak linked to cheese: as of 28 January, 11 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 9 adults with confirmed haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS). The product was sold between 12 November 2024 and 24 January 2025, and authorities have recalled it.

items.summary_zh: 美國紐約州首例Ib型M痘,為全美第4例,具非洲旅遊史,風險仍低
items.summary_en: New York State reported its first clade Ib mpox case, the US's fourth, in a patient with African travel history; public risk remains low.
items.description_zh: 美國紐約州2/12新增該州首例及該國第4例Ib型病例,具非洲旅遊史,刻正隔離治療中,與前3例病例為獨立事件,迄未於社區中發現其他感染者,當局評估一般大眾傳播風險仍為低,MSM族群為低至中,呼籲民眾及醫護人員對於相關症狀應有警覺性。
items.description_en: New York State reported on 12 February its first clade Ib case, which is also the country's fourth clade Ib case. The patient has an African travel history and is isolated for treatment. This case is independent of the first three cases, and no other infected persons have been found in the community. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as still low, and low to moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM). The public and healthcare workers are urged to be alert to relevant symptoms.

items.headline_zh: 迦納-流行性腦脊髓膜炎
items.summary_zh: 迦納西北部上西部大區2月初疑似腦膜炎60例、14死亡
items.summary_en: Ghana's Upper West Region has reported 60 suspected meningitis cases and 14 deaths (CFR 23.3%) as of early February.
items.description_zh: 迦納西北部上西部大區截至2月上旬報告60例疑病例及14例死亡(CFR: 23.3%),該國北部位於「非洲流腦帶」地區,週期性發生腦膜炎疫情,當地已發布疫情警示。
items.description_en: As of early February, the Upper West Region in northwestern Ghana had reported 60 suspected cases and 14 deaths (CFR: 23.3%). Northern Ghana lies in the African meningitis belt, where meningitis outbreaks occur periodically, and the local area has issued an outbreak alert.

items.summary_zh: 尼日自2022年白喉累計逾4.1萬例疑似,逾1,200例死亡
items.summary_en: Niger has recorded over 41,000 suspected diphtheria cases since 2022, with over 24,000 confirmed and over 1,200 deaths.
items.description_zh: 日第4週(1/20-1/26)報告8例疑病例,其中6例確診,該國自2022年爆發此波疫情迄今年第4週累計報告超過4.1萬例疑病例,其中,逾2.4萬例確診及超過1,200例死亡(CFR: 5.1%),病例主要分布於該國7個省。
items.description_en: Niger reported 8 suspected cases in week 4 (20–26 January), 6 of them confirmed. Since this wave of the outbreak began in 2022, over 41,000 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively up to week 4 of this year, of which over 24,000 were confirmed and over 1,200 died (CFR: 5.1%). Cases are mainly distributed across 7 regions of the country.

items.headline_zh: 韓國-肺炎黴漿菌感染症
items.headline_en: Republic of Korea – Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection
items.summary_zh: 韓國肺炎黴漿菌感染症連續4週低於閾值,第4週113例,解除警示
items.summary_en: South Korea's Mycoplasma pneumoniae cases have stayed below the threshold for four weeks (113 in week 4), so the alert has been lifted.
items.description_zh: 韓國已連續4週病例數降至閾以下,第4週(1/19-1/25)報告113例,該國自2023年冬季呈現上升趨勢,於去年8月達到高峰(1,179例)後呈下降趨勢,並於11月後顯著下降,目前已降至閾以下,故解除疫情警示。
items.description_en: South Korea's Mycoplasma pneumoniae case numbers have been below the threshold for four consecutive weeks. In week 4 (19–25 January), 113 cases were reported. The country's activity has risen since winter 2023 and peaked in August last year at 1,179 cases, then declined and fell markedly after November. Case numbers are now below the threshold, so the epidemic alert has been lifted.

items.headline_en: United States / Viet Nam / South Korea – Measles
items.summary_zh: 越南去年疑似麻疹45,550例、16死亡;德州蓋恩斯郡累計24例
items.summary_en: Viet Nam reported 45,550 suspected measles cases and 16 deaths last year; Gaines County, Texas, has 24 cases, 9 hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 美國德州西部蓋恩斯郡(Gaines County)爆發疫情,累計報告24例,其中9例住院,多數病例為學齡兒童,此波疫情可能與當地學校群聚相關,目前仍調查中。另該郡因某些因素,兒童接種率較低,且當地有許多自學學童,實際未接種數可能更高,當局已推動疫苗接種活動。 越南於去年報告45,550例疑病例,其中超過7,500例確診及16例死亡,約25%確診病例為9個月以下嬰幼兒,WHO已將該國疫情風險評估為非常高,該國已展開全國疫苗接種活動。 韓國濟州島報告5年來首例病例,病患於1/22入境該國前具越南旅遊史,目前相關接觸者無症狀,該國今年累計報告3例,皆為境外移入。
items.description_en: Gaines County in West Texas, USA, has an outbreak with 24 cumulative cases, of which 9 were hospitalized. Most patients are school-age children. The outbreak may be linked to school clusters locally, and the investigation is ongoing. Child vaccination coverage in the county is low for several reasons, and there are many homeschooled children, so the actual number of unvaccinated children may be higher. Authorities have promoted vaccination campaigns. Viet Nam reported 45,550 suspected cases last year, of which over 7,500 were confirmed and 16 died. About 25% of confirmed cases were infants under 9 months old. WHO has assessed the outbreak risk in Viet Nam as very high, and the country has launched a nationwide vaccination campaign. South Korea's Jeju Island reported its first case in five years. The patient had a travel history to Viet Nam before entering South Korea on 22 January. Contacts are currently asymptomatic. South Korea has reported 3 cases this year, all imported.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞埃多州宣布拉薩熱爆發,266例疑似、47例確診、9死亡
items.summary_en: Nigeria's Edo State declared a Lassa fever outbreak: 266 suspected cases, 47 confirmed and 9 deaths from 30 December to 24 January.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞埃多州宣布爆發疫情,自去年12/30至今年1/24該州已累計報告266例疑病例,其中47例確診、9例死亡(CFR:19.1%)。相較去(2024)年3,270例疑病例(292例確診)、41例死亡(CFR:14%)更為嚴峻。當局已成立緊急應變管理小組,加強疾病監控、擴大治療及衛教宣導活動。另該州於2023年為疫情高峰,有3,764例疑(372例確診)、65例死亡(CFR:17.6%)。
items.description_en: Edo State in Nigeria has declared an outbreak. From 30 December last year to 24 January this year, 266 suspected cases were reported cumulatively in the state, of which 47 were confirmed and 9 died (CFR: 19.1%). This is more severe than the 2024 figures of 3,270 suspected cases (292 confirmed) and 41 deaths (CFR: 14%). Authorities have set up an emergency response management team, strengthened disease surveillance, and expanded treatment and health education campaigns. Edo's peak year was 2023, with 3,764 suspected cases (372 confirmed) and 65 deaths (CFR: 17.6%).

items.summary_zh: 美國內華達州首例H5N1人類感染為乳牛場工人,累計68例
items.summary_en: Nevada reported its first human H5N1 infection, a dairy worker with conjunctivitis; the US has 68 cumulative cases, 41 linked to cattle.
items.description_zh: 美國內華達州邱吉爾郡(Churchill County)報告該州首例H5N1人類感染病例,病患為乳牛場工人,曾接觸受感染乳牛,患者出現結膜炎症狀,未通報其他症狀,目前恢復狀況良好。該國自去年迄今累計68例H5N1人類感染病例,其中41例與乳牛相關。該地區近期報告乳牛感染D1.1基因型,現有資訊顯示該基因型感染人類可能有較嚴重症狀。
items.description_en: Churchill County in Nevada has reported the state's first human H5N1 infection: a dairy farm worker who had been exposed to infected dairy cattle. The patient developed conjunctivitis and reported no other symptoms, and is recovering well. Since last year, the country has reported 68 cumulative human H5N1 infections, 41 of them linked to dairy cattle. The area has recently reported cattle infections with the D1.1 genotype, and current information suggests that human infection with this genotype may cause more severe symptoms.

items.headline_zh: 美國/香港/剛果民主共和國
items.headline_en: United States / Hong Kong SAR / Democratic Republic of the Congo – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 美國新增第2、3例I型M痘;剛果2024年疑似64,173例、1,341死亡
items.summary_en: The US reported its 2nd and 3rd clade I mpox cases; the DRC recorded 64,173 suspected cases and 1,341 deaths in 2024, per UNICEF.
items.description_zh: 美國分別於1及2月新增報告第2、3例I型病例,案2位於喬治亞州,案3為新罕布夏州,皆自疫區返國後就診確認感染,此2例並無關聯,當局已展開疫調,並建議高風險者接受疫苗,評估一般民眾風險仍為低,有高風險性行為者風險為低至中。 香港報告新增1例病例,37歲男子患有慢性病且有高風險暴露,1/28出現症狀,並於2/4就診,刻正接受隔離,感染源仍在調查中。 UNICEF公布剛果民主共和國於2024年累計64,173例疑病例、14,053例確診、1,341例死亡(CFR:2.08%),自2024年10月中旬通報病例數有下降趨勢,惟確診數仍在波動中,12月單週平均通報病例數降至2,500例以下,顯著下降。各年齡層病例數分布因省份而異,其中,金夏沙省20歲以上的族群最為嚴重,南基伍/北基伍省逾50%病例數為10歲以下族群。UNICEF已於赤道/北基伍/南基伍省等6省展開第2次疫苗接種活動。
items.description_en: The US reported its second and third clade I cases in January and February respectively. Case 2 was in Georgia and case 3 in New Hampshire, and both were confirmed after returning from affected areas; the two cases are not linked. Authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation and recommend vaccination for high-risk people. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, and low to moderate for people with high-risk sexual behaviour. Hong Kong reported one new case, a 37-year-old man with a chronic illness and high-risk exposure. He developed symptoms on 28 January, sought care on 4 February, and is in isolation; the source of infection is still under investigation. UNICEF reported that the Democratic Republic of the Congo recorded 64,173 suspected cases, 14,053 confirmed cases and 1,341 deaths in 2024 (CFR: 2.08%). Reported cases have trended downward since mid-October 2024, although confirmed numbers are still fluctuating, and weekly average reports fell below 2,500 in December. Age distribution varies by province: in Kinshasa, people aged over 20 are most affected, while in South Kivu and North Kivu more than 50% of cases are under 10. UNICEF has launched a second round of vaccination in six provinces, including Équateur, North Kivu and South Kivu.
