items.summary_zh: 古巴奧羅普切熱累計23,639例,626例確診,76例併發格林-巴利症候群
items.summary_en: Cuba has recorded 23,639 Oropouche fever cases cumulatively, 626 confirmed, including 76 with Guillain-Barré syndrome.
items.description_zh: 古巴疫情更新,該國迄今累計報告23,639例病例,626例確診病例,其中76例為林-巴利症候群(Guillain-Barré syndrome),近50%病例有胃腸症狀,病例分布於該國各省,惟自2024年底迄今尚無報告確診病例。
items.description_en: Cuba update: the country has reported 23,639 cases cumulatively, of which 626 were confirmed. Of these, 76 were Guillain-Barré syndrome. Nearly 50% of cases had gastrointestinal symptoms. Cases were distributed across the provinces of the country, but no confirmed cases have been reported since late 2024.

items.headline_zh: 法屬留尼旺島/菲律賓-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 法屬留尼旺島2025年第4週新增屈公病31例,2024年8月起本土529例
items.summary_en: French Réunion added 31 chikungunya cases in week 4 of 2025, with 529 local cases since August 2024; Davao City recorded 12 in 2024.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島疫情明顯上升,於2025年第4週新增31例病例,自2024年8月迄今累計529例本土病例,以勒唐蓬、聖皮耶及萊唐薩萊之疫情較為嚴峻。 菲律賓疫情更新,達沃市2024年累計12例病例,當局已加強宣導以免疫情擴大。
items.description_en: The outbreak on French Réunion has risen markedly, with 31 new cases in week 4 of 2025. Since August 2024, 529 local cases have been reported cumulatively, with the outbreaks most severe in Le Tampon, Saint-Pierre and L'Étang-Salé. Philippines update: Davao City reported 12 cases cumulatively in 2024. Authorities have strengthened awareness campaigns to prevent the outbreak from spreading.

items.headline_zh: 菲律賓/哥倫比亞-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞烏伊拉省第2型登革熱爆發,宣布公衛緊急狀態,今年逾1.9萬例
items.summary_en: Colombia's Huila Department declared a public health emergency over a serotype 2 dengue outbreak; Colombia has over 19,000 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情更新,達沃市2024年累計7,000餘例病例及55例死亡,高於2023年的6,700餘例病例,當局持續宣導並採取防治措施。 哥倫比亞疫情更新,該國西南部烏伊拉省爆發第2型血清型疫情,當局宣布進入公共衛生緊急狀態,該國2025年迄今累計19,000餘例病例。
items.description_en: Philippines update: Davao City recorded over 7,000 cases and 55 deaths in 2024, higher than the 6,700-plus cases in 2023. Authorities continue to run awareness campaigns and take control measures. Colombia update: a serotype 2 dengue outbreak has broken out in Huila Department in the southwest, and authorities have declared a public health emergency. Colombia has recorded over 19,000 cases cumulatively so far in 2025.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 新加坡2/7報告1例境外移入疫苗相關小兒麻痺,5個月大印度女嬰
items.summary_en: Singapore reported an imported vaccine-associated polio case in a 5-month-old Indian girl with immunodeficiency; community risk is assessed as low.
items.description_zh: 新加坡2/7報告1例境外移入之疫苗相關病例,為5個月大印女嬰,個案免疫功能低下,於印接種小兒麻痺疫苗,2024年12月出現發燒、急性肢體無力麻痺症狀,抵達新加坡後即入院隔離,病況穩定,目前調查有3名家庭及護理人員密切接觸者,持續進行追蹤。新加坡自1978年以來無報告本土病例,最近於2006年報告1例境外移入病例,評估社區傳播風險為低。
items.description_en: On 7 February Singapore reported one imported vaccine-associated case: a 5-month-old Indian girl with immunodeficiency. She had received a polio vaccine in India and developed fever and acute limb weakness and paralysis in December 2024. She was admitted to isolation on arrival in Singapore, and her condition is stable. Authorities are following 3 close contacts, including family members and caregivers. Singapore has reported no local case since 1978; its most recent imported case was reported in 2006, and the risk of community transmission is assessed as low.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲35例相同基因株痢疾,英國20例,27例有國際旅遊史
items.summary_en: Europe has 35 Shigella sonnei cases with the same genetic strain, 20 in the UK; 27 cases had international travel, mainly to Asia.
items.description_zh: 歐洲報告自今年1月截至2/6,檢測出有相同基因關聯的菌株(Shigella sonnei ST152)聚集,顯示有相同的感染來源,分別為英國報告20例、奧地利/法國均為7例、荷蘭1例,其中27例有國際旅遊史,主要於亞洲國家旅行。病患介於15-70歲,多數為女性。發病期間為1/8-17,感染源仍不明,ECDC評估可能有國際間旅行傳播的可能性。
items.description_en: From January to 6 February, Europe detected a cluster of strains with the same genetic link (Shigella sonnei ST152), indicating a common source of infection: the UK reported 20 cases, Austria and France 7 each, and the Netherlands 1. Among them, 27 cases had an international travel history, mainly to Asian countries. Patients were aged 15–70, and most were women. Illness onset was between 8 and 17 January. The source of infection remains unknown, and the ECDC assesses that transmission linked to international travel is possible.
items.area_en: Austria,France,Netherlands,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-伊波拉病毒感染(蘇丹病毒疾病)
items.headline_en: Uganda – Ebola virus disease (Sudan virus disease)
items.summary_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉蘇丹病毒疾病累計7例、1死亡,已知兩條傳播鏈
items.summary_en: Uganda has 7 confirmed Sudan virus disease cases and one death as of 7 February; two transmission chains are identified, including a healthcare cluster.
items.description_zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,自1月中旬截至2/7,累計報告7例(增加5例)確診病例、其中1例死亡(CFR:14.3%),指標病例為32歲男性護理人員,於1/20發病後,1/29死亡,案2為案1之妻子,案1生前曾於姆巴萊區的傳統治療所及3個醫療機構就診,後死於首都坎帕拉。目前已知有兩條傳播鏈,分別為親友與醫護機構群,當局已匡列298位接觸者,其中11位親友、34位醫護人員。
items.description_en: Kampala, Uganda update: from mid-January to 7 February, 7 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (5 newly added), of which 1 died (CFR: 14.3%). The index case was a 32-year-old male nurse who developed symptoms on 20 January and died on 29 January. Case 2 was his wife. Before he died, the index case had visited a traditional healing centre in Mbale District and three healthcare facilities, and he died in Kampala. Two transmission chains are now known: one among relatives and friends, and one in a healthcare facility cluster. Authorities have listed 298 contacts, including 11 relatives and friends and 34 healthcare workers.

items.summary_zh: 南蘇丹新增1例I型M痘,成為第22個非洲疫區國家;愛爾蘭首例Ib型
items.summary_en: South Sudan reported a clade I mpox case, making it Africa's 22nd affected country; Ireland reported its first clade Ib case.
items.description_zh: WHO於2/7公布南蘇丹新增1例I型病例、141例疑病例,指標病例為烏干達國民、該國居民,2/6確診,該國成為第22個非洲疫區國家。 愛爾蘭於2/6報告新增首例Ib型病例,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,個案刻正接受治療,當局已匡列接觸者,評估一般民眾風險仍為低。
items.description_en: WHO announced on 7 February that South Sudan had reported 1 clade I case and 141 suspected cases. The index case is a Ugandan national and resident of South Sudan, confirmed on 6 February; the country became the 22nd African country with outbreaks. Ireland reported its first clade Ib case on 6 February. The patient has a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is under treatment. Authorities have listed contacts and assess the risk to the general public as still low.
items.area_zh: 愛爾蘭共和國,南蘇丹共和國

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 本週無新增人類感染;15國新增116起H5N1動物疫情,美國乳牛首見D1.1型
items.summary_en: No new human H5N1 cases this week; 15 countries reported 116 animal H5N1 outbreaks, and the D1.1 genotype was detected in US dairy cattle for the first time.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共15國於2024/3/19~2025/2/6間新增116起H5N1疫情,分別為美國58起、德國25起、波蘭13起、日本/比利時各3起、義大利/荷蘭/英國/匈牙利各2起、烏克蘭/挪威/保加利亞/法國/加拿大/巴拿馬各1起。 冰島於2024/9/21~2025/1/29間新增14起H5N5疫情。 日本於2024/12/2~2024/12/7間新增3起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計16州報告959(8)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,600例,檢測171例,其中40例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第5週計348個採檢點提供檢測報告,3州17個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國農業部於2/5公布內華達州乳牛檢體中檢出基因型D1.1,該基因型為首次檢出,先前乳牛中檢出皆為B3.13型,D1.1為去年北美地區候鳥主要流行基因型別,已於野鳥、哺乳動物及家禽中發現,目前該州已記錄4起D1.1乳牛群聚。人類感染D1.1症狀可能較B3.13嚴重,去年迄今報告2例人類感染D1.1型,其中1例死亡。 美國報告新增1例A(H1N2)v人類感染病例,該病患為愛荷華州18歲以上成年人,於2025年第3週(1/12-1/18)就診,住院後已康復,經調查病患無豬隻接觸史,其密切接觸者亦無症狀,迄未發現與該名病患相關人際傳播。本案為該國2024-2025年流感季首例流感變種病毒人類感染,該國於2023-2024年流感季報告9例流感變種病毒感染,其中4例為A(H1N2)v。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感2例(2003年迄今累計910例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計33國報告418起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 15 countries reported 116 new H5N1 outbreaks between 19 March 2024 and 6 February 2025: the USA 58, Germany 25, Poland 13, Japan and Belgium 3 each, Italy, the Netherlands, the UK and Hungary 2 each, and Ukraine, Norway, Bulgaria, France, Canada and Panama 1 each. Iceland reported 14 new H5N5 outbreaks between 21 September 2024 and 29 January 2025. Japan reported 3 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 2 and 7 December 2024. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 959 outbreaks cumulatively (8 new) in 16 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California and Nevada. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 8,600 people monitored cumulatively, 171 tested, and 40 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 5, 348 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 17 sites in 3 states. Other updates: on 5 February the USDA reported detection of genotype D1.1 in dairy cattle samples from Nevada. This is the first detection of this genotype in cattle; all previous cattle detections were genotype B3.13. D1.1 was the main circulating genotype among North American wild migratory birds last year and has been found in wild birds, mammals and poultry. The state has recorded 4 D1.1 dairy herd clusters so far. Human infection with D1.1 may cause more severe symptoms than B3.13; since last year, 2 human D1.1 infections have been reported, one of which was fatal. The USA reported one new A(H1N2)v human infection in an adult over 18 in Iowa, who sought care in week 3 of 2025 (12–18 January) and recovered after hospitalization. The investigation found no contact with pigs; close contacts were asymptomatic, and no human-to-human transmission linked to this patient has been found. This is the first variant influenza virus human infection in the country in the 2024–25 season. In the 2023–24 season, 9 variant influenza virus infections were reported, 4 of them A(H1N2)v. Annual summary: 2 human H5N1 cases (910 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 33 countries have reported 418 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約5.8%且下降,XEC變異株占46.8%為主
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity is about 5.8% and declining; XEC is the leading circulating variant at 46.8%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第3週(1/13-1/19)全球陽性率約5.8%,陽性率以非洲區(12.0%)、美洲區(7.1%)及歐洲區(5.7%)為高。 美國近期陽性率呈下降趨勢,急診就診率亦下降且以幼童及老年人為多,以變異株XEC、KP.3.1.1及LP.8.1占比為高。 歐洲區陽性率呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為XEC;第3週英國、希臘及俄羅斯分別新增800-10,000餘例病例。 WHO於1/24將變異株LP.8.1列為監測中變異株(VUM),於全球占比上升,2024年第51週(12/16-12/22)至2025年第2週(1/6-1/12)變異株LP.8.1占比變化,於西太平洋區由0.8%上升至7.5%,於美洲區由2.2%上升至7.9%,於歐洲區由1.6%上升至2.5%,評估對全球公共衛生的風險為低。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,東地中海區上升,東南亞區上下波動,其他地區則下降。依據WHO資料顯示,於2025年1月上旬(1/6-1/12),全球流行變異株以XEC占比46.8%最高,呈上升趨勢,其次為變異株KP.3.1.1占比26.9%,呈下降趨勢。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 3 of 2025 (13–19 January), the global positivity rate was about 5.8%, highest in the African Region (12.0%), the Region of the Americas (7.1%) and the European Region (5.7%). In the United States, the recent positivity rate has declined, and emergency department visit rates have also fallen, mainly among young children and older adults; the predominant variants are XEC, KP.3.1.1 and LP.8.1. In the European Region, the positivity rate is declining, with XEC as the main circulating variant; in week 3, the United Kingdom, Greece and Russia each reported between 800 and just over 10,000 new cases. WHO designated variant LP.8.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring (VUM) on 24 January. Its share of global variants rose between week 51 of 2024 (16–22 December) and week 2 of 2025 (6–12 January): in the Western Pacific Region from 0.8% to 7.5%, in the Region of the Americas from 2.2% to 7.9%, and in the European Region from 1.6% to 2.5%. WHO assesses the risk to global public health as low. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity is declining; it is rising in the Eastern Mediterranean Region, fluctuating in the South-East Asia Region, and declining elsewhere. According to WHO data, in early January 2025 (6–12 January), XEC was the leading global circulating variant at 46.8%, with an upward trend, followed by KP.3.1.1 at 26.9%, with a downward trend. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.headline_zh: 澳大利亞-羅斯河病毒感染
items.summary_zh: 澳洲昆士蘭州2024年羅斯河病毒病例2,477例,高於2023年699例
items.summary_en: Queensland, Australia reported 2,477 Ross River virus cases in 2024, up from 699 in 2023, as humid weather boosted mosquitoes.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情更新,該國東北部昆士蘭州2024年累計報告2,477例病例,高於2023年的699例,症狀包括發燒、寒顫、頭痛、疼痛等,近幾年濕熱天氣造成蚊子繁殖且數量增加,以致疾病傳播風險上升,防蚊措施可降低感染風險。
items.description_en: Australian epidemic update: In 2024, Queensland, in the northeast of the country, reported a cumulative 2,477 cases, higher than the 699 cases in 2023. Symptoms include fever, chills, headache and pain. Hot, humid weather in recent years has led to increased mosquito breeding and numbers, raising the risk of transmission. Mosquito-prevention measures can reduce the risk of infection.

items.summary_zh: 中國呼吸道傳染病趨降,流感仍為主要病原,春節人流增加風險仍高
items.summary_en: China's respiratory infections are declining, with influenza still the main pathogen; transmission risk stays high during Spring Festival gatherings.
items.description_zh: 中國公布第5週(1/27-2/2)全國呼吸道傳染病監視情形,近期呼吸道傳染病於該國呈現下降趨勢;主要檢出病原體為流感病毒,目前仍處流行期,惟活動度呈下降趨勢,當局表示目前仍為呼吸道傳染病流行期,且適逢春節期間,人流活動及聚會增加,疾病傳播風險仍高。
items.description_en: China published national surveillance data on respiratory infectious diseases for week 5 (27 January–2 February). Respiratory infections in the country have recently shown a declining trend. The main pathogen detected is influenza virus, and the country remains in its influenza epidemic period, although activity is declining. Authorities state that the country is still in the respiratory infectious disease epidemic period, and as the Spring Festival coincides with this period, population movement and gatherings have increased, so the risk of transmission remains high.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球小兒麻痺:巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1,衣索比亞與尼日新增11例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported one new WPV1 polio case; Ethiopia and Niger reported 11 cVDPV2 cases; European wastewater in five countries tested positive.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/23-29期間,巴基斯坦新增報告1例WPV1型;cVDPV2型新增報告2國11例病例,衣索比亞10例、日1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增3件WPV1型陽性樣本。 歐洲報告於去年9 -12月之常規廢水檢測中,在西班牙、英國、德國、波蘭、芬蘭皆檢測出cVDPV2型陽性樣本。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 23–29 January, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case. Two countries reported 11 new cVDPV2 cases, with 10 in Ethiopia and 1 in Niger. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported three new WPV1-positive samples. In Europe, routine wastewater testing from September to December 2024 detected cVDPV2-positive samples in Spain, the United Kingdom, Germany, Poland and Finland.
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,芬蘭,德國,尼日,巴基斯坦,波蘭,西班牙,英國
items.area_en: Ethiopia,Finland,Germany,Niger,Pakistan,Poland,Spain,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓西內羅省1月1至18日新增81例傷寒,為去年同期兩倍
items.summary_en: Negros Occidental, Philippines, reported 81 typhoid cases from 1–18 January, twice the 40 cases in the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓西內羅省於1/1-18期間新增81例病例,為去年同期(40例)兩倍。
items.description_en: Negros Occidental Province in the Philippines reported 81 new cases during 1–18 January, twice the 40 cases in the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 美國佛羅里達州2024年創傷弧菌83例、18死,超過2022年紀錄
items.summary_en: Florida recorded 83 Vibrio vulnificus cases and 18 deaths in 2024, exceeding 2022's 74 cases and 17 deaths, both times linked to hurricanes.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州去年全年累計83例病例、18例死亡,超越2022年之74例病例、17例死亡紀錄,兩次皆因颶風侵襲造成感染人數上升。
items.description_en: Florida, United States, reported 83 cases and 18 deaths for the whole of 2024, surpassing the 74 cases and 17 deaths recorded in 2022. Infections rose in both years because of hurricanes.

items.summary_zh: 全球去年霍亂逾80萬例、5,800餘死;安哥拉1月累計1,081例
items.summary_en: Global cholera exceeded 800,000 cases and 5,800 deaths last year; Angola's outbreak reached 1,081 cases and 45 deaths by 29 January.
items.description_zh: 全球去年報告,WHO之5個區署累計共80萬餘例病例、5千8百餘例死亡。東地中海區(8國)佔比最多,累計59萬餘例、2千4百餘例死亡;其次為非洲區(18國),累計17萬餘例、3千1百餘例;東南亞區為1萬9千餘例病例、58例死亡,美洲區為1萬餘例病例、162例死亡。病例最多國家依序為葉門(26萬餘例)、阿富汗(17萬餘例)、巴基斯坦(7萬6千餘例)。死亡數國家依序為蘇丹(1,296例)、葉門(879例)、奈及利亞(726例)。 安哥拉疫情上升且嚴峻,自1/7-29累計6個省報告1,081例病例、45例死亡,首例發生於西部魯安達省,該省病例占7成(748例),病患年齡介於2-86歲,當局已於1/27開始疫苗接種活動。前一次爆發疫情為2018年,累計3省1,262例病例、19例死亡。
items.description_en: Global reporting for last year: the five WHO regional offices together reported over 800,000 cases and over 5,800 deaths. The Eastern Mediterranean Region (8 countries) accounted for the largest share, with a cumulative 590,000+ cases and 2,400+ deaths; followed by the African Region (18 countries), with 170,000+ cases and 3,100+ deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 19,000+ cases and 58 deaths, and the Region of the Americas reported 10,000+ cases and 162 deaths. The countries with the most cases were Yemen (260,000+), Afghanistan (170,000+) and Pakistan (76,000+). The countries with the most deaths were Sudan (1,296), Yemen (879) and Nigeria (726). Angola: the outbreak is increasing and severe. From 7 to 29 January, six provinces cumulatively reported 1,081 cases and 45 deaths. The first case occurred in Luanda Province in the west, which accounts for 70% of cases (748); patients are aged 2–86. Authorities began vaccination activities on 27 January. The previous outbreak, in 2018, reported 1,262 cases and 19 deaths in three provinces.

items.headline_zh: 日本-腸病毒感染併發重症
items.headline_en: Japan – Enterovirus infection with severe complications
items.summary_zh: 日本關東地區7例伊科11型重症,3名1個月大嬰兒因肝衰竭死亡
items.summary_en: Japan reported seven severe echovirus type 11 infections in Kanto since August 2024; three infants died of acute liver failure.
items.description_zh: 日本於1/25報告關東地區自去年8月迄今累計發現7例感染伊科11型病毒之重症病例,其中3例因急性肝衰竭症狀後死亡,死者皆為1個月之嬰兒。另4例嬰兒則為腦膜炎症狀,均已治癒出院。
items.description_en: On 25 January, Japan reported that seven severe cases infected with echovirus type 11 had been identified in the Kanto region since August last year. Three of these cases died of acute liver failure, and all three deceased were one-month-old infants. Four other infants presented with meningitis-like symptoms; all have recovered and been discharged.

items.summary_zh: 美國堪薩斯州2024年結核病79例、2死;阿拉斯加發生率升至12.8
items.summary_en: Kansas reported 79 active TB cases and two deaths in 2024; Alaska's TB rate rose to 12.8 per 100,000, third highest in nearly 30 years.
items.description_zh: 美國堪薩斯州於去年報告79例活動性病例(2例死亡),其中,堪薩斯城自去年初迄今報告67例病例,大多數病例分布於懷恩多特郡;阿拉斯加州發生率於去年亦上升,為每10萬人12.8例,高於2023年10.5例,為近30年來第3高,該州發生率亦明顯高於全國(約2.9例)。該國結核病疫情於近年呈上升趨勢,2023年報告9,600餘例,為2013年以來最高。
items.description_en: Kansas, United States, reported 79 active tuberculosis cases (2 deaths) last year. Kansas City reported 67 cases from the beginning of last year to date, with most cases in Wyandotte County. Alaska's incidence also rose last year, to 12.8 per 100,000 population, up from 10.5 in 2023; this is the third highest in nearly 30 years and is markedly higher than the national rate (about 2.9). Tuberculosis has been rising in the country in recent years, with over 9,600 cases reported in 2023, the highest since 2013.

items.summary_zh: 印度2024年流行性腮腺炎4,145例,高於2023年1,194例
items.summary_en: India reported 4,145 mumps cases in 2024, up from 1,194 in 2023, with Kerala the most affected state.
items.description_zh: 印度於去(2024)年報告4,145例,顯著高於2023年1,194例,以喀拉拉邦疫情最為嚴峻,另查膜喀什米爾地區於近2年報告大量病例, 2023年報告450例,去年雖趨緩,惟仍報告95例;鄰近拉達克地區以往未報告病例,惟去年報告111例。
items.description_en: India reported 4,145 cases in 2024, markedly higher than the 1,194 cases in 2023, with the most severe outbreak in Kerala State. Jammu and Kashmir reported large numbers of cases over the past two years: 450 in 2023, and last year cases declined but still totalled 95. Neighbouring Ladakh had not previously reported cases but reported 111 cases last year.

items.summary_zh: 越南春節期間麻疹逾1,500例,重症與兒童病例增加,疫情恐續升
items.summary_en: Viet Nam reported over 1,500 measles cases during the Lunar New Year period, with rising severe and child cases; outbreaks are expected to keep increasing.
items.description_zh: 越南於春節期間(1/25-2/2)報告逾1,500例,該國於春節前重症數及併發症患者數上升,近期兒童病例數及重症數亦增加,因春節聚會增加及人潮聚集,評估春節後疫情將持續上升。
items.description_en: Viet Nam reported more than 1,500 cases during the Lunar New Year period (25 January–2 February). Severe cases and complications rose before the holiday, and recent numbers of child cases and severe cases have also increased. Because of more gatherings and crowds during the Lunar New Year, the outbreak is expected to keep rising after the holiday.

items.summary_zh: 日本流感第4週逾5.4萬例,韓國門診就診率36.5‰仍高於閾值
items.summary_en: Japan reported over 54,000 influenza cases in week 4, declining from its 2024 peak; South Korea's visit rate of 36.5‰ remains above threshold.
items.description_zh: 日本第4週(1/20-1/26)報告5.4萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數11.06例,該國於2024年52週報告逾31萬例(定醫平均病例數64.39例)達高峰後,病例數呈下降趨勢。近期病例數以山形縣、新潟縣及石川縣為多,部分地區仍有病床不足情形,專家表示近期新增病例數雖趨緩,惟須留意B型流感可能取代A型流感,亦應注意新冠等傳染病,呼籲民眾仍需採取防護措施。 韓國第4週(1/19-1/25)流感門診就診率為36.5‰,該國於今年第1週(2024/12/29-2025/1/4)就診率99.8‰達高峰後呈下降趨勢,惟目前仍高於閾,當局密切監測春節假期期間流感及呼吸道傳染病情形。
items.description_en: Japan reported over 54,000 cases in week 4 (20–26 January), with an average of 11.06 cases per sentinel clinic. After peaking in week 52 of 2024 with over 310,000 cases (an average of 64.39 per sentinel clinic), case numbers have been declining. Recent cases are concentrated in Yamagata, Niigata and Ishikawa prefectures, and some areas still have insufficient hospital beds. Experts say that although new cases have slowed, attention should be paid to influenza B possibly replacing influenza A, and COVID-19 and other infectious diseases should also be monitored; the public is urged to continue taking protective measures. South Korea's influenza outpatient visit rate in week 4 (19–25 January) was 36.5‰. After peaking at 99.8‰ in week 1 of this year (29 December 2024–4 January 2025), the rate has declined but remains above the threshold, and authorities are closely monitoring influenza and respiratory infections during the Lunar New Year holiday.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 斐濟-人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.summary_zh: 斐濟去年1至9月愛滋病毒感染1,093例,為前年同期3倍
items.summary_en: Fiji reported 1,093 HIV cases from January to September 2024, three times the same period in 2023; 223 were linked to drug use.
items.description_zh: 斐濟爆發疫情,去年1-9月已報告1,093例病例,病例數為前年同期的3倍,前5年的9倍。病患當中有223例與毒品濫用相關,202例為性傳播,餘仍在調查中,當局已針對毒品使用者提出介入措施。
items.description_en: Fiji is experiencing an outbreak: from January to September last year, 1,093 cases were reported, three times the same period of the previous year and nine times the average for the same period over the previous five years. Of these cases, 223 are associated with drug abuse and 202 were sexually transmitted; the remainder are still under investigation. Authorities have introduced interventions targeting drug users.

items.summary_zh: 香港1月28日新增1例類鼻疽,今年累計2例,2024年全年23例
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a new melioidosis case, a 70-year-old man in Sham Shui Po; 2 cases so far this year and 23 in all of 2024.
items.description_zh: 香港於1/28報告新增1例病例,為70歲並患有慢性病之男性個案,居住於深水埗,於1/21出現排尿困難並就醫,經採檢確診,當局持續調查感染源。自今年初迄今累計2例,2024年全年累計報告23例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported one new case on 28 January: a 70-year-old man with chronic illness living in Sham Shui Po, who developed difficulty urinating on 21 January, sought medical treatment, and was confirmed by sampling. Authorities are continuing to investigate the source of infection. Since the beginning of this year, cumulative cases total 2; 23 cases were reported in 2024 as a whole.

items.headline_zh: 塞內加爾-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 塞內加爾卡夫林1月13日報告2例克里米亞-剛果出血熱,1例死亡
items.summary_en: Senegal reported two Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases in Kaffrine in January, one fatal; 28 contacts had completed follow-up by 24 January.
items.description_zh: 塞內加爾中部卡夫林地區於1/13報告2例確診病例,其中1例死亡。指標病例為45歲農村男性,1/2出現發燒、疲倦、關節痛及吐血等症狀,1/4-5進行門診治療後返家,1/7病情加劇送往醫學中心並採檢,1/8死亡後確診;案2為65歲男性,為案1之接觸者,在同間醫學中心就診,出現類症狀後採檢確診,現已康復出院。指標病例住家附近之牛血清及蜱檢體為陽性。本案截至1/24,已完成28例接觸者追蹤,另23例仍在追蹤,該國最近一次疫情為去年11月。
items.description_en: In Kaffrine region, central Senegal, two confirmed cases were reported on 13 January, one of whom died. The index case is a 45-year-old rural man who developed fever, fatigue, joint pain and vomiting of blood on 2 January. He received outpatient treatment on 4–5 January and went home; on 7 January his condition worsened and he was taken to a medical centre, where samples were collected. He died on 8 January, and was confirmed after death. Case 2 is a 65-year-old man, a contact of case 1, who attended the same medical centre; after developing similar symptoms he was sampled and confirmed, and has now recovered and been discharged. Bovine serum and tick samples near the index case's home tested positive. As of 24 January, 28 contacts have completed follow-up, and 23 remain under follow-up. The country's most recent previous outbreak was in November 2024.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達M痘累計2,031例、10死;獅子山1月26日累計16例確診
items.summary_en: Uganda has recorded 2,031 mpox cases and 10 deaths since July 2024; Sierra Leone reported 16 confirmed cases as of 26 January.
items.description_zh: 烏干達近期疫情上升且嚴峻,自今年迄今已有3例輸出病例至英國,皆為Ib型,依據WHO統計自2024/7/29截至2025/1/17已有2,031例確診病例,其中10例死亡(CFR:0.4%),疫情主要在坎帕拉。 獅子山於今年1/11報告該國首例確診,為IIb分支型病例。截自1/26累計7省16例確診。病患中有10例為男性,年齡範圍為1-52歲,其中1例為醫護人員,當局已匡列293位接觸者。
items.description_en: Uganda: The outbreak has risen and is severe. Since the start of this year, three exported cases, all clade Ib, have been reported to the United Kingdom. According to WHO, from 29 July 2024 to 17 January 2025, 2,031 confirmed cases were reported, including 10 deaths (CFR 0.4%); the outbreak is mainly in Kampala. Sierra Leone: On 11 January this year, the country reported its first confirmed case, a clade IIb case. As of 26 January, 16 confirmed cases had been reported in seven provinces. Ten of the patients are male, aged 1–52 years, and one is a healthcare worker. Authorities have listed 293 contacts.

items.summary_zh: 巴西聖保羅州今年黃熱病累計7例、3死,已加強監測與接種
items.summary_en: São Paulo State, Brazil, has reported 7 yellow fever cases and 3 deaths so far this year, with surveillance and vaccination stepped up.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,聖保羅州今年迄今累計報告7例病例及3例死亡,病例主要分布於索科魯(4例)、圖尤蒂(1例)及若阿諾波利斯(1例);該州去年累計報告2例病例,當局已加強監測和疫苗接種措施。
items.description_en: Brazil epidemic update: So far this year, São Paulo State has cumulatively reported 7 cases and 3 deaths. Cases are mainly located in Sorocaba (4 cases), Itu (1 case) and Joanópolis (1 case); the state reported 2 cases last year. Authorities have strengthened surveillance and vaccination measures.

items.summary_zh: 巴拿馬達連省奧羅普切熱34例,以40至49歲族群為多
items.summary_en: Panama's Darién Province reported 34 Oropouche fever cases, mostly in Metetí, with most patients aged 40–49.
items.description_zh: 巴拿馬疫情更新,該國東部達連省報告34例病例,分布於梅特蒂(27例)、亞維薩(3例)、里奧伊萊西亞斯(2例)及拉哈斯布蘭卡斯(1例),主要症狀為發燒及頭痛,年齡分布以40-49歲為多,當局建議有症狀的民眾儘速就醫。
items.description_en: Panama epidemic update: Darién Province in the east of the country has reported 34 cases, distributed among Metetí (27), Yaviza (3), Río Iglesias (2) and Las Blancas (1). The main symptoms are fever and headache, and most cases are in the 40–49 age group. Authorities advise people with symptoms to seek medical care as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 厄瓜多2024年登革熱逾6萬例、76死;秘魯今年累計逾7,800例
items.summary_en: Ecuador reported over 60,000 dengue cases and 76 deaths in 2024; Peru has recorded over 7,800 cases and 6 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 厄瓜多疫情更新,2024年累計報告6萬餘例病例及76例死亡,病例數高於2023年2萬餘例病例,今年迄今病例分布以中部納波省(899例)及東部奧雷亞納省(626例)為多。 祕魯疫情更新,該國今年迄今累計報告7,800餘例病例及6例死亡,其中,該國中北部聖馬丁大區報告約3,000例病例,該國北部皮烏拉省報告逾560例病例,尚無死亡病例。
items.description_en: Ecuador epidemic update: In 2024, Ecuador reported more than 60,000 cases and 76 deaths, higher than the 20,000+ cases reported in 2023. So far this year, cases are concentrated in Napo Province in the central region (899) and Orellana Province in the east (626). Peru epidemic update: So far this year, Peru has cumulatively reported over 7,800 cases and 6 deaths. The San Martín region in the north-central part of the country reported about 3,000 cases, and Piura Province in the north reported over 560 cases; no deaths have been reported.

items.headline_zh: 菲律賓/巴西/伊朗-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 菲律賓西內羅省今年登革熱250例,較去年同期增297%
items.summary_en: Negros Occidental, Philippines reported 250 dengue cases this year, up 297% on the same period in 2024; São Paulo, Brazil reported over 7,200 cases in week 1.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情更新,該國西內羅省今年迄今累計報告250例病例及2例死亡,病例數較2024年同期63例增加297%,疫情明顯上升;該省於2024年累計6,700餘例病例及22例死亡,病例數較2023年增加354%。 巴西疫情更新,該國聖保羅州今年截至第2週累計報告約18,100例病例,其中4,340例確診,30例死亡;該州今年第1週(2024/12/29-2025/1/4)報告7,200餘例病例,高於去年同期6,500餘例。 伊朗疫情更新,該國去年累計報告逾1,000例病例,其中863例為本土病例,以南部恰巴哈爾市病例數852例為多。
items.description_en: Philippines epidemic update: In Negros Occidental Province, 250 cases and 2 deaths have been reported so far this year, a 297% increase over the 63 cases in the same period of 2024; the outbreak has risen markedly. In 2024 the province cumulatively reported over 6,700 cases and 22 deaths, a 354% increase in cases over 2023. Brazil epidemic update: In São Paulo State, about 18,100 cases had been reported so far this year as of week 2, of which 4,340 were confirmed and 30 died. In week 1 of this year (29 December 2024–4 January 2025), the state reported over 7,200 cases, higher than the over 6,500 in the same period last year. Iran epidemic update: Last year the country cumulatively reported over 1,000 cases, of which 863 were locally acquired; most were in Chabahar in the south, with 852 cases.

items.summary_zh: 印度2024年茲卡病毒感染151例,其中馬哈拉施特拉邦140例
items.summary_en: India reported 151 Zika virus infections in 2024, 140 in Maharashtra, its highest since 2021; no microcephaly cases have been reported.
items.description_zh: 印度東部3個邦於2024年累計報告151例,其中以馬哈拉施特拉邦(下稱馬邦)報告140例為多,病例數為該邦自2021年以來最高,目前尚無小頭畸形或林-巴利症候群(GBS)報告病例。WHO表示該國自2016年報告首例後,多個邦均曾出現疫情,惟迄今尚無小頭畸形相關報告病例。該國境內埃及/白線斑蚊廣泛分布,另馬邦2024年之病例數高於往年,屬異常情形,另茲卡病毒感染症狀不明顯,臨床醫師認知程度不同,實際病例數可能低估。
items.description_en: Three states in eastern India reported 151 cases cumulatively in 2024, of which Maharashtra State reported 140; this is the highest number for that state since 2021. No cases of microcephaly or Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) have been reported so far. WHO notes that multiple states have had outbreaks since the first case was reported in 2016, but no microcephaly-related cases have been reported to date. Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus are widely distributed across the country. Maharashtra's 2024 case count is higher than in previous years, which is abnormal. Zika virus infection often has inconspicuous symptoms and clinicians' awareness varies, so actual case numbers may be underestimated.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-伊波拉病毒感染
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola virus disease
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國赤道省1月10至22日12例疑似伊波拉,8例死亡
items.summary_en: DRC's Équateur Province reported 12 suspected Ebola virus disease cases and 8 deaths from 10–22 January; samples await testing.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國西部赤道省博洛姆巴區自1/10-1/22期間報告12例疑病例,8例死亡,已採檢樣本檢驗中;該省前次疫情發生在2022 年4~7月期間。
items.description_en: In Bolomba Health Zone, Équateur Province in western DRC, 12 suspected cases and 8 deaths were reported between 10 and 22 January. Samples have been collected and are being tested. The province's previous outbreak occurred from April to July 2022.

items.headline_zh: 坦尚尼亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 坦尚尼亞卡蓋拉地區馬堡病毒2例確診、1死,281名接觸者監測中
items.summary_en: Tanzania's Kagera region has two confirmed Marburg virus disease cases, one fatal, as of 23 January; 281 contacts are being monitored.
items.description_zh: 坦尚亞卡蓋拉地區截至1月23日,已通報2例確診病例,其中1例死亡,另42例疑病例,共有281名接觸者受到密切監控;WHO緊急專家小組已部署到西北部卡蓋拉地區,以支持加強對疫情的應對。
items.description_en: In Kagera region, Tanzania, as of 23 January, two confirmed cases had been reported, one of whom died, and 42 suspected cases were recorded; 281 contacts are under close monitoring. A WHO emergency expert team has been deployed to the Kagera region in the northwest to support strengthened outbreak response.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達確認蘇丹病毒病例,32歲護理人員1月29日死亡,45名接觸者列管
items.summary_en: Uganda announced a Sudan virus disease outbreak after a 32-year-old nurse died on 29 January; 45 contacts have been identified.
items.description_zh: 烏干達衛生部於1/30宣布爆發疫情,病患為32歲男性護理人員,1/20-1/21出現發燒、胸痛及呼吸困難等症狀,隨後出現不明原因之體內外出血,1/29轉院後死亡,死後經檢驗感染蘇丹病毒確診,目前已確認45名接觸者,包含34名醫護人員及11名家庭接觸者。蘇丹病毒於1976年首次發現以來已爆發8次疫情,其中5次於烏干達,最近一次於2023/1/11宣布結束,當時報告164例病例及77例死亡。WHO表示目前尚無批准之疫苗及治療藥物,SVD可能造成公衛嚴重影響,當地社區對防護感染措施有限,可能存在多條傳播鏈,該國持續疫調,以確定疫情範圍,不排除已傳播至周邊地區及其他國家的可能。
items.description_en: On 30 January, Uganda's Ministry of Health announced an outbreak. The patient is a 32-year-old male nurse who developed fever, chest pain and difficulty breathing on 20–21 January, followed by internal and external bleeding of unknown cause; he was transferred and died on 29 January. After death, testing confirmed Sudan virus infection. So far 45 contacts have been identified, including 34 healthcare workers and 11 household contacts. Since Sudan virus was first identified in 1976, eight outbreaks have occurred, five of them in Uganda; the most recent, declared over on 11 January 2023, reported 164 cases and 77 deaths. WHO notes that no vaccine or treatment is currently approved, that SVD may have a serious public health impact, that community protective measures against infection are limited, and that multiple transmission chains may exist. The country continues epidemiological investigation to define the extent of the outbreak; spread to surrounding areas and other countries cannot be ruled out.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘自2022年迄今12萬4,753例、至少272死;今年42國4,800例
items.summary_en: Global mpox has 124,753 confirmed cases since May 2022 and at least 272 deaths; 4,800 cases were reported in 42 countries this year to week 5.
items.description_zh: 本月更新:  自2022年5月截至今年01/31全球累計128國/地區報告12萬4,753例確診病例,其中至少272例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第5週全球累計42國/地區報告4,800例確診病例,其中非洲區3,846例、西太平洋區560例、美洲區210例、歐洲區178例、東南亞區5例及東地中海區1例。  其他更新:  英國於1/27-1/31間新增2例Ib型確診病例,個案近期皆自烏干達返國,該國自2024年10月以來確診病例數達8例(5例境外移入,3例本土感染);迄今共11個非非洲國家報告Ib分支輸入病例,包括瑞典/泰國/印度/德國/英國/美國/加拿大/巴基斯坦/比利時/中國/法國。 獅子山及亞塞拜然分別於1/10及1/18報告首例確診病例。  評估與建議: WHO於2024/8/14宣告此波疫情構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,另於11/22針對各分支風險評估如下:  Ia分支:公衛風險為高,國內/國際傳播風險為高; Ib分支:公衛風險為高,國內/國際傳播風險為高; II分支:公衛風險為中,國內/國際傳播風險為中。
items.description_en: This month's update: From May 2022 through 31 January this year, 128 countries and territories worldwide have cumulatively reported 124,753 confirmed cases, including at least 272 deaths (CFR 0.2%). So far this year, up to week 5, 42 countries and territories have reported 4,800 confirmed cases: 3,846 in the African Region, 560 in the Western Pacific Region, 210 in the Region of the Americas, 178 in the European Region, 5 in the South-East Asia Region and 1 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: The United Kingdom reported two new confirmed clade Ib cases between 27 and 31 January; both had recently returned from Uganda. Since October 2024 the country has recorded 8 confirmed cases (5 imported, 3 locally acquired). So far, 11 non-African countries have reported imported clade Ib cases, including Sweden, Thailand, India, Germany, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Pakistan, Belgium, China and France. Sierra Leone and Azerbaijan reported their first confirmed cases on 10 and 18 January, respectively. Assessment and recommendations: WHO declared this mpox wave a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 14 August 2024, and on 22 November assessed the risks for each clade: clade Ia has high public health risk and high national and international transmission risk; clade Ib has high public health risk and high national and international transmission risk; clade II has moderate public health risk and moderate national and international transmission risk.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 英國新增1例H5N1人類感染;美國乳牛場累計951(23)起疫情
items.summary_en: The UK reported one new human H5N1 infection this week; US dairy herds have 951 (23) outbreaks reported across 16 states since March 2024.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:英國於本週新增1例H5N1人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):   共29國於2022/12/30~2025/1/30間新增328起H5N1疫情,分別為美國74起、智利53起、荷蘭29起、德國/英國各22起、義大利17起、波蘭16起、日本15起、韓國14起、匈牙利10起、奈及利亞/以色列各7起、奧地利6起、捷克5起、越南/法國/印度各4起、葡萄牙/加拿大各3起、墨西哥/愛爾蘭/立陶宛各2起、羅馬亞/摩爾多瓦/哥倫比亞/柬埔寨/芬蘭/比利時/丹麥各1起。 共2國於2024/10/14~2025/1/19間新增2起H5N5疫情,分別為挪威/冰島各1起。 共2國於2024/11/23~2025/1/2間新增5起H5(N untyped)疫情,分別為美國4起、祕魯1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計16州報告951(23)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,500例,檢測170例,其中40例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第4週計328個採檢點提供檢測報告,5州33個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  英國於1/28公布1例與農場大量病禽長期密切接觸之H5N1感染病例,為該國自2022年以來首例;患者來自中部西米德蘭茲地區,目前狀況良好,該農場病禽感染DI.2 基因型,為已知在該國鳥類中傳播之病毒,與美國哺乳動物和鳥類中傳播病毒株不同。迄未發現人與人間傳播情況,評估公眾感染風險仍然非常低。當局近期已將H5禽流感疫苗添加為國家儲備物資。 美國FDA更新寵物食品規範,以肉類、牛奶及雞蛋為原料且未經高溫加熱處理之寵物食品,需將高病原性禽流感(以H5N1為主)列入食品安全計畫,將其列為已知或可預見的危害,減少經生食感染寵物之風險;美國農業部於去年12月下旬發現火雞與家貓感染存在關聯,於今年1月更新監測政策,將加強火雞高病原性禽流感監測。 美國CDC因應季節性流感活動增加期間零星出現的人類感染新型A型流感H5N1病毒案例,建議縮短住院病患之A型流感樣本進行分型時間,以減少延遲鑑別診斷情形。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感2例(2003年迄今累計910例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計29國報告303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: The United Kingdom reported one new human H5N1 infection this week. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 29 countries reported 328 new H5N1 outbreaks between 30 December 2022 and 30 January 2025: United States 74, Chile 53, Netherlands 29, Germany and United Kingdom 22 each, Italy 17, Poland 16, Japan 15, South Korea 14, Hungary 10, Nigeria and Israel 7 each, Austria 6, Czechia 5, Viet Nam, France and India 4 each, Portugal and Canada 3 each, Mexico, Ireland and Lithuania 2 each, and Romania, Moldova, Colombia, Cambodia, Finland, Belgium and Denmark 1 each. Between 14 October 2024 and 19 January 2025, 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks, one each in Norway and Iceland. Between 23 November 2024 and 2 January 2025, 2 countries reported 5 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks: United States 4 and Peru 1. United States dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy herds have reported 951 (23) outbreaks across 16 states since March last year, mainly concentrated recently in California. Human infections from cattle: at least 8,500 cases monitored, 170 tested, and 40 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, with fatal cases in cats. Wastewater surveillance: in week 4, 328 sampling sites provided test results, and H5-positive detections were found at 33 sampling sites in 5 states. Other updates: On 28 January, the United Kingdom reported one H5N1 infection in a person with long-term close contact with a farm with many sick birds; this is the first case in the country since 2022. The patient, from the West Midlands in central England, is doing well. The sick birds on the farm were infected with genotype DI.2, a virus known to circulate among birds in the country, which differs from the virus spreading among mammals and birds in the United States. No human-to-human transmission has been identified, and the risk to the general public is assessed as very low. Authorities recently added H5 avian influenza vaccine to the national stockpile. The US FDA updated pet food rules: pet foods made from meat, milk and eggs that are not heat-treated must include highly pathogenic avian influenza (mainly H5N1) in their food safety plans as a known or reasonably foreseeable hazard, to reduce the risk of infection from raw feeding. The USDA found a link between infections in turkeys and domestic cats in late December last year, and in January this year updated its surveillance policy to strengthen monitoring of highly pathogenic avian influenza in turkeys. In response to sporadic human infections with novel influenza A H5N1 virus during periods of increased seasonal influenza activity, the US CDC recommends shortening the time needed to subtype influenza A specimens from hospitalised patients, to reduce delays in differential diagnosis. Annual summary: Human cases: 2 H5N1 influenza cases (910 cumulative since 2003); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. Avian and animal cases: 303 high- and low-pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively in 29 countries. Assessment and recommendations: On 20 December, FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment for H5 influenza viruses. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capability. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The infection risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約6.0%趨降,近28天新增約20萬例、2,600餘死
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity is about 6.0% and declining; about 200,000 cases and 2,600 deaths were reported in the past 28 days.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第2週(1/6-1/12)全球陽性率約6.0%,陽性率以非洲區(13.9%)、美洲區(8.0%)及歐洲區(5.8%)為高。  WHO更新全球疫情資訊:  全球近28天(2024/11/11-12/8)期間,新增約20萬例病例及2,600餘例死亡,病例數及死亡數較前28天期間分別下降6%及24%;住院數及重症數分別新增約2.2萬例及2,000餘例,住院數及重症數較前28天期間分別下降1%及上升3%。 於2024年12月初(12/2-12/8),全球主要流行變異株XEC占比38.6%呈上升趨勢,其次為變異株KP.3.1.1占比33.2%呈下降趨勢。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率呈下降趨勢,其中,非洲區及西太平洋區呈上升趨勢,東南亞區上下波動,其他地區則呈下降趨勢。XEC為全球主要流行變異株,占比呈上升趨勢,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 2 of 2025 (6–12 January), the global positivity rate was about 6.0%, highest in the African Region (13.9%), the Region of the Americas (8.0%) and the European Region (5.8%). WHO update on the global situation: In the past 28 days (11 November–8 December 2024), about 200,000 new cases and over 2,600 deaths were reported globally, a decrease of 6% in cases and 24% in deaths compared with the previous 28 days. About 22,000 new hospitalisations and over 2,000 new severe cases were reported; compared with the previous 28 days, hospitalisations fell 1% and severe cases rose 3%. In early December 2024 (2–8 December), the leading global circulating variant was XEC at 38.6%, with an upward trend, followed by KP.3.1.1 at 33.2%, with a downward trend. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity is declining; it is rising in the African Region and the Western Pacific Region, fluctuating in the South-East Asia Region, and declining elsewhere. XEC is the main global circulating variant and its share is rising, but it has not yet increased disease severity. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 美國內華達州2024年桿菌性痢疾27例,12月爆發,街友占71.4%
items.summary_en: Nevada reported 27 shigellosis cases in 2024, a sharp rise, with a December outbreak; 71.4% of cases were homeless people.
items.description_zh: 美國內華達州於去(2024)年累計27例病例,較往年劇幅增加,最後兩季之病例數達24例,尤其於12月爆發疫情,其中街友佔71.4%,因有症狀者才會就醫,故可能低估病例數,當局已於收容機構進行感染管控並加強衛教。
items.description_en: Nevada, United States, reported 27 cases last year (2024), a considerable increase over previous years. Cases in the last two quarters totalled 24, with an outbreak in December in particular; homeless people accounted for 71.4% of cases. Because only people with symptoms seek medical care, the number of cases may be underestimated. Authorities have implemented infection control measures in shelters and strengthened health education.

items.headline_zh: 加拿大-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 加拿大5省61例沙門氏菌感染,與某甜點品牌相關,1月18日召回產品
items.summary_en: Canada reported 61 confirmed Salmonella cases across five provinces linked to a dessert brand; the product was recalled on 18 January.
items.description_zh: 加拿大於去年9-12月爆發與某品牌甜點相關疫情,累計5省報告61例確診病例,其中以魁北克省33例及安大略省21例為多,有17例個案住院治療,病患年齡介於3-88歲,多為女性(61%),當局於1/18召回相關產品。
items.description_en: Canada experienced an outbreak linked to a certain brand of dessert between September and December last year. A total of 61 confirmed cases were reported across five provinces, mainly Quebec (33) and Ontario (21). Seventeen cases were hospitalised; patients were aged 3–88 years, and most were female (61%). Authorities recalled the related product on 18 January.

items.headline_zh: 日本-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 日本北海道某大樓集體食物中毒37例,21例確診,起因為地下水塔受汙染
items.summary_en: A mass food-poisoning incident at a Hokkaido building caused 37 cases, 21 confirmed by testing; a contaminated underground water tank was the cause.
items.description_zh: 日本北海道於本年1/17公布去年12/29發生某大樓集體食物中毒事件,累計報告37例病例,其中21例經採檢確診,經調查,當局確認起因為地下室水塔受汙染,已完成消毒換水。
items.description_en: On 17 January, Hokkaido, Japan, announced a mass food-poisoning incident at a building on 29 December last year. A total of 37 cases were reported, 21 of which were confirmed by testing. The investigation determined that the cause was contamination of the underground water tank; disinfection and water replacement have been completed.

items.summary_zh: 安哥拉霍亂疫情上升,1月15日累計332例、20死,多為兒童
items.summary_en: Angola's cholera outbreak is rising: 332 cases and 20 deaths by 15 January 2025, mostly children, with half of deaths under age 10.
items.description_zh: 安哥拉疫情持續上升,2025年迄1/15累計報告332例病例,其中66例確診,20例死亡(CFR:6%),多集中於該國西北部魯安達省。病患多為兒童及青少年,佔比最多為0-9歲(32.2%)、10-19歲(24.6%)次之,死者半數為10歲以下兒童。
items.description_en: Angola's outbreak continues to rise. From the beginning of 2025 to 15 January, 332 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 66 were confirmed, with 20 deaths (CFR 6%), mostly concentrated in Luanda Province in the northwest of the country. Patients are mainly children and adolescents; the largest share is aged 0–9 years (32.2%), followed by 10–19 years (24.6%). Half of the deaths were children under 10.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球小兒麻痺:巴基斯坦新增2例WPV1,3國新增11例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported two new WPV1 polio cases; three countries reported 11 cVDPV2 cases, with Ethiopia reporting seven.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/9-1/15期間,巴基斯坦報告新增2例WPV1型病例;共3國新增11例cVDPV2型病例,分別為衣索比亞7例、查德3例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增17件WPV1型陽性樣本;德國新增11件cVDPV2型陽性樣本。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 9–15 January, Pakistan reported two new WPV1 cases. Three countries reported 11 new cVDPV2 cases in total: Ethiopia 7, Chad 3 and Nigeria 1. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 17 new WPV1-positive samples, and Germany reported 11 new cVDPV2-positive samples.
items.area_zh: 查德,衣索比亞,德國,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦

items.disease_zh: 流感併發重症,侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌感染症
items.disease_en: 流感併發重症, Invasive pneumococcal disease
items.headline_zh: 香港-流感/侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌感染症
items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR – Influenza and invasive pneumococcal disease
items.summary_zh: 香港4歲男童同時感染A型流感與侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌,病況嚴重,未接種流感疫苗
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a severe case of co-infection with influenza A (H1) and invasive pneumococcal disease in an unvaccinated 4-year-old boy.
items.description_zh: 香港報告1例同時感染A型流感及侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌重症病例,為4歲男童,1/5出現發燒、咳嗽及腹痛症狀就醫,1/7再次就醫並住院,經檢驗肺炎鏈球菌陽性,1/8轉院後A型流感(H1)陽性確診,病患出現肺炎症狀,目前病況嚴重,該病患未接種流感疫苗。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported one severe case of concurrent influenza A and invasive pneumococcal disease: a 4-year-old boy who presented with fever, cough and abdominal pain on 5 January. He sought medical care again and was hospitalised on 7 January, when pneumococcus tested positive. After transfer on 8 January, influenza A (H1) was confirmed. The patient developed pneumonia and is currently in serious condition. The patient had not received influenza vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 日本-肺炎黴漿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 日本肺炎黴漿菌第2週定醫門診平均1.11例,為10年同期最高
items.summary_en: Japan's Mycoplasma pneumoniae cases per sentinel clinic rose to 1.11 in week 2, the highest for that period in 10 years.
items.description_zh: 日本第2週(1/6-1/12)定醫門診平均病例數1.11例,較前1週(12/30-1/5) 0.77例增加,為10年同期以來最高。
items.description_en: In week 2 (6–12 January), Japan's average number of cases per sentinel clinic was 1.11, up from 0.77 in the previous week (30 December–5 January). This is the highest for the same period in 10 years.

items.summary_zh: 日本流感超過警報標準,美國陽性率18.8%,疫情尚未達高峰
items.summary_en: Japan's flu cases exceeded the national alert level in week 2; US test positivity was 18.8%, and CDC says the peak has not yet been reached.
items.description_zh: 日本第2週(1/6-1/12)累計報告17.2萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數35.02例,全國超過警報標準,近期已出現醫療量能不足之情形。 美國類流感門診就診率由6.1%下降至5.4%,第2週(1/5-1/11)流感陽性率為18.8%,較前1週18.6%略升,惟死亡數上升,美國CDC表示本週較上週相關指標持平或下降可能受假期影響,評估疫情尚未達到高峰,未來數週疫情可能加劇。
items.description_en: Japan: In week 2 (6–12 January), 172,000+ cases were reported cumulatively, with an average of 35.02 cases per sentinel clinic, exceeding the national alert standard; medical capacity has recently become insufficient in some areas. United States: The influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate fell from 6.1% to 5.4%. Influenza test positivity in week 2 (5–11 January) was 18.8%, slightly up from 18.6% the previous week, while deaths rose. The US CDC said that this week's indicators were flat or lower than the previous week, which may be affected by holidays. It assessed that the outbreak has not yet reached its peak and may intensify over the coming weeks.

items.headline_zh: 亞洲/大洋洲/美洲-百日咳
items.summary_zh: 多國百日咳上升:中國2024年逾49萬例,澳洲逾5.7萬例,美國逾3.5萬例
items.summary_en: Pertussis is rising in several countries: China reported over 490,000 cases in 2024, Australia over 57,000 and the US over 35,000.
items.description_zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
items.description_en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,巴西,中國大陸(不含港澳),日本,韓國,紐西蘭,美國,越南

items.summary_zh: 西班牙特內里費島某醫院疥瘡疫情,累計10例疑病例,接觸者已隔離
items.summary_en: A scabies outbreak at a hospital on Tenerife, Spain, has 10 suspected cases; contacts have been isolated and disinfection stepped up.
items.description_zh: 西班牙特內里費島1/16報告某醫院爆發疫情,累計10例疑病例,指標案例於1/10確診,該病患為物理治療師,另一位醫護人員亦出現症狀,接觸者已被隔離,當局已加強消毒與預防措施。該地區上次爆發疫情為2023年。
items.description_en: On 16 January, an outbreak was reported at a hospital on Tenerife, Spain, with 10 suspected cases in total. The index case, a physiotherapist, was confirmed on 10 January. Another healthcare worker has also developed symptoms. Contacts have been isolated, and authorities have strengthened disinfection and prevention measures. The previous outbreak in this area was in 2023.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞2025年第1週拉薩熱疑病例196例、確診54例、10死
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported 54 confirmed Lassa fever cases and 10 deaths in week 1 of 2025, mainly in Ondo, Edo and Bauchi states.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞於2025年第1週新增報告196例疑病例、54例確診、10例死亡(CFR:18.5%),病患主要來自三個州(翁多、埃多和包奇);該國去年全年28州累計報告1,309確診、214例死亡(CFR:16.3%)。
items.description_en: In week 1 of 2025, Nigeria reported 196 suspected cases, 54 confirmed cases and 10 deaths (CFR 18.5%). Patients mainly come from three states: Ondo, Edo and Bauchi. Across 28 states, Nigeria reported 1,309 confirmed cases and 214 deaths (CFR 16.3%) for the whole of last year.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 烏干達穆本德1月10日新增1例克里米亞-剛果出血熱確診、3例疑似
items.summary_en: Uganda's Mubende region reported one new confirmed Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever case and three suspected cases on 10 January.
items.description_zh: 烏干達中部穆本德地區1/10報告新增1例確診、3例疑病例,確診病患為45歲男性農民,有牛、羊隻接觸史,症狀包含發燒、喉嚨痛及自發性出血,當局已加強衛生與個案管理。去年該國五地區累計20例病例,其中8例確診,4例死亡。
items.description_en: In Mubende region, central Uganda, one new confirmed case and three suspected cases were reported on 10 January. The confirmed patient is a 45-year-old male farmer with contact with cattle and goats, with symptoms including fever, sore throat and spontaneous bleeding. Authorities have strengthened health measures and case management. Last year the country reported 20 cases cumulatively across five regions, of which 8 were confirmed and 4 died.

items.headline_zh: 坦尚尼亞-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 坦尚尼亞卡蓋拉地區馬堡病毒1例確診,25例疑似皆為陰性
items.summary_en: Tanzania's Kagera region has one confirmed Marburg virus disease case as of 20 January; all 25 suspected cases tested negative.
items.description_zh: 坦尚亞卡蓋拉地區截至1/20累計報告1例確診,25例疑病例經檢驗皆為陰性;該國於2023年3月在卡蓋拉地區報告首次疫情,共報告9例病例(8例確診及1例可能病例),其中6例死亡,致死率67%。
items.description_en: As of 20 January, Kagera region, Tanzania, had cumulatively reported one confirmed case, and all 25 suspected cases tested negative. The country first reported an outbreak in Kagera region in March 2023, with 9 cases in total (8 confirmed and 1 probable), of which 6 died, a case fatality rate of 67%.

items.summary_zh: 英國1月20日新增1例Ib型M痘,為2024年10月來第6例,有烏干達旅遊史
items.summary_en: The UK reported its sixth clade Ib mpox case since October 2024 on 20 January; the patient had travelled to Uganda and contacts are being traced.
items.description_zh: 英國1/20新增報告1例Ib型病例,為2024年10月以來第6例Ib型病例,與該國之前發現的病例無關聯,刻正治療中,病患有烏干達旅遊史,當局已匡列密切接觸者。該國IIb型疫情部分,2018-2021年累計報告7例病例。自2022年5月起至該年底累計報告3,732例病例。自2023年初至2024年底報告429例病例。
items.description_en: On 20 January, the United Kingdom reported one new clade Ib case, the sixth clade Ib case since October 2024. It is unrelated to the cases previously identified in the country. The patient is receiving treatment and has a history of travel to Uganda; authorities have identified close contacts. For the clade IIb situation in the country, 7 cases were reported cumulatively in 2018–2021. From May 2022 to the end of that year, 3,732 cases were reported cumulatively. From early 2023 to the end of 2024, 429 cases were reported.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.headline_zh: 法屬留尼旺島/巴西-屈公病
items.summary_zh: 留尼旺島屈公病累計192例,巴西今年截至1月17日523例
items.summary_en: Réunion has recorded 192 chikungunya cases since 23 August 2024; Brazil reported 523 cases this year as of 17 January.
items.description_zh: 法屬留旺島疫情上升,該地區自去年8/23迄今累計報告192例病例,病例主要分布於萊唐薩萊,當局採已取防治措施,以控制疫情。 巴西疫情持續,今年截至1/17累計報告523例病例,去年累計420,000餘例病例及200餘例死亡,病例主要分布於伯南布科、聖保羅及帕拉伊巴州。
items.description_en: Chikungunya cases are rising in Réunion, a French overseas territory. Since 23 August last year, 192 cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in L'Étang-Salé, and authorities have taken prevention and control measures to contain the outbreak. Brazil's outbreak continues: so far this year (to 17 January), 523 cases have been reported cumulatively. Last year Brazil reported over 420,000 cases and over 200 deaths, mainly in Pernambuco, São Paulo and Paraíba states.

items.headline_zh: 澳洲/馬來西亞-日本腦炎
items.summary_zh: 澳洲昆士蘭州湯斯維爾1例及馬來西亞砂拉越州沐膠1例日本腦炎
items.summary_en: Townsville, Queensland, and Mukah, Sarawak, each reported one Japanese encephalitis case; the Australian patient is hospitalised.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情更新,該國東北部昆士蘭州湯斯維爾報告1例病例,個案已入院治療,該州最近一次報告病例為2022年5月。 馬來西亞疫情更新,該國砂拉越州沐膠報告1例病例,當局已採取疫苗接種措施。
items.description_en: Australia epidemic update: In Townsville, Queensland State in the northeast, one case was reported; the patient has been admitted for treatment. The most recent previous case reported in the state was in May 2022. Malaysia epidemic update: In Mukah, Sarawak State, one case was reported, and authorities have implemented vaccination measures.

items.summary_zh: 全球去年截至11月登革熱逾1,400萬例、1萬死;澳洲湯斯維爾五年來首例本土
items.summary_en: Global dengue reached over 14 million cases and 10,000 deaths last year to November; Townsville, Australia, reported its first local case in five years.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情更新,去年截至11月累計逾1,400萬例病例及1萬例死亡,病例主要分布於美洲區報告逾1,250萬例病例及7,000例死亡,以巴西報告逾1,000萬例病例為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、哥倫比亞、巴拉圭。 澳洲疫情更新,該國東北部昆士蘭州湯斯維爾報告1例病例,為該市五年來首例本土病例。
items.description_en: Global update: Last year, up to November, over 14 million cases and 10,000 deaths were reported worldwide. Cases were mainly in the Region of the Americas, which reported over 12.5 million cases and 7,000 deaths, with Brazil reporting over 10 million cases, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Colombia and Paraguay. Australia update: Townsville in Queensland State in the northeast reported one case, the city's first locally acquired case in five years.

items.summary_zh: 美國新增1例H5人類感染,去年以來累計67例,多與乳牛場相關
items.summary_en: The US reported one new H5 human infection this week, bringing its total to 67 cases since 2024, 40 of them linked to dairy herds.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要  人類疫情:本週美國新增1例H5流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS)  共20國於2023/4/15~2025/1/14間新增142起H5N1疫情,分別為美國64起、德國15起、加拿大8起、墨西哥/荷蘭/英國各7起、臺灣/匈牙利/日本各5起、瑞士/波蘭各4起、義大利3起、蒙古/愛爾蘭/斯洛伐克/茅利塔亞/阿爾巴亞/波多黎各/法國/奈及利亞各1起。 共2國於2024/12/10~2025/1/8間新增5起H5N5疫情,分別為冰島4起、德國1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計16州報告928(4)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州及密西根州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,100例,檢測166例,其中40例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第2週計335個採檢點提供檢測報告,3州53個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國1/16公布加州新增1例感染源不明H5病例,已知為輕症,其他流病資訊未敘明;該國自去年迄今累計公布67例病例,其中40例與乳牛場相關,23例與禽場相關,1例具動物暴露史,3例不明,分布於10州,以加州(38)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)最多。 美國獸醫協會於1/15表示自去年12月以來,加州、華盛頓州陸續報告家貓食用寵物生食產品及生牛奶後感染H5N1流感並死亡,專家及衛生部門呼籲民眾避免餵食寵物生食製品,並減少寵物與野生動物接觸。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計H5(含推測)流感1例、H5N1流感1例(2003 年迄今累計909 例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計14國報告50起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議 FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: This week the United States reported one new human H5 influenza infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 20 countries reported 142 new H5N1 outbreaks between 15 April 2023 and 14 January 2025: United States 64, Germany 15, Canada 8, Mexico, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom 7 each, Taiwan, Hungary and Japan 5 each, Switzerland and Poland 4 each, Italy 3, and Mongolia, Ireland, Slovakia, Mauritania, Albania, Puerto Rico, France and Nigeria 1 each. Two countries reported 5 new H5N5 outbreaks between 10 December 2024 and 8 January 2025: Iceland 4 and Germany 1. United States dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy herds have reported 928 (4) outbreaks across 16 states since March last year, mainly concentrated recently in California and Michigan. Human infections from cattle: at least 8,100 cases monitored, 166 tested, and 40 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, with fatal cases in cats. Wastewater surveillance: in week 2, 335 sampling sites provided test results, and H5-positive detections were found at 53 sampling sites in 3 states. Other updates: On 16 January, the United States announced one additional H5 case in California with an unknown source of infection; it is known to be mild, and other epidemiological information was not specified. Since last year the United States has cumulatively announced 67 cases, of which 40 were linked to dairy farms, 23 to poultry farms, 1 involved animal exposure and 3 are unknown, spread across 10 states, with the most in California (38), Washington (11) and Colorado (10). On 15 January, the American Veterinary Medical Association said that since December last year, pet cats in California and Washington have been reported infected with H5N1 influenza and have died after eating raw pet food products and raw milk. Experts and health authorities urge the public to avoid feeding pets raw pet food products and to reduce contact between pets and wild animals. Annual summary: Human cases: so far this year, 1 H5 (including presumptive) influenza case and 1 H5N1 influenza case (909 cumulative since 2003); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. Avian and animal cases: 50 high- and low-pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively in 14 countries. Assessment and recommendations: On 20 December, FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment for H5 influenza viruses. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capability. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The infection risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約4.3%近期下降,XEC占比上升但未增加嚴重度
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 4.3% in late December 2024 and declining; XEC's share is rising but has not increased disease severity.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第52週(12/23-12/29)全球陽性率約4.3%,陽性率以非洲區(15.8%)、美洲區(9.2%)及歐洲區(3.6%)為高。 日本病例數持續上升,2024年第46-49週以KP.3.1.1變異株占比為高,其次為XEC變異株。 中國2024年12月疫情概況,新增112例重症及7例死亡,相較11月(35例重症/11例死亡)重症數上升而死亡數略降,新冠病毒陽性率略降且處低點,發燒門診就診量及類流感就診率呈上升趨勢,主要流行變異株為XDV、JN.1及其衍生變異株;香港2025年第2週(1/5-1/11)陽性率略降且處低點,JN.1及其衍生變異株爲主要流行變異株。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期下降,其中,非洲區上升,東地中海區上下波動,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。XEC及KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 52 of 2024 (23–29 December), the global positivity rate was about 4.3%, highest in the African Region (15.8%), the Region of the Americas (9.2%) and the European Region (3.6%). Japan's case numbers continue to rise; in weeks 46–49 of 2024 the KP.3.1.1 variant accounted for the largest share, followed by XEC. China's COVID-19 situation in December 2024: 112 new severe cases and 7 deaths were reported, compared with 35 severe cases and 11 deaths in November. Severe case numbers rose while deaths fell slightly; the positivity rate declined slightly and is at a low point; fever clinic visits and influenza-like illness visit rates are rising. The main circulating variants in China are XDV, JN.1 and their derivatives. In Hong Kong, the positivity rate in week 2 of 2025 (5–11 January) declined slightly to a low point, and JN.1 and its derivatives are the main circulating variants. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently declined; it is rising in the African Region, fluctuating in the Eastern Mediterranean Region, and flat or declining elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 and XEC are the main global circulating variants; the XEC share is rising, but disease severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大安大略省貴湖大學諾羅病毒疫情累計170例,學校限制學生活動
items.summary_en: An outbreak of norovirus gastroenteritis at the University of Guelph, Ontario, had 170 cases by 10 January; students' activities were restricted.
items.description_zh: 加拿大安大略省貴湖大學於1/6爆發疫情,截至1/10累計報告170例病例,學校立即限制學生活動並加強衛生宣導。
items.description_en: In Ontario, Canada, an outbreak occurred at the University of Guelph on 6 January. As of 10 January, 170 cases had been reported cumulatively. The school immediately restricted student activities and strengthened hygiene education.

items.summary_zh: 非洲霍亂第1週4國339例、5死,安哥拉2025年第2週224例、18死
items.summary_en: Africa's cholera outbreak: four countries reported 339 cases and 5 deaths in week 1; Angola reported 224 cases and 18 deaths by week 2.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
items.description_en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).
