items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球小兒麻痺:巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1,奈及利亞與印尼新增4例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported one new WPV1 polio case; Nigeria and Indonesia reported four cVDPV2 cases, with 13 new WPV1-positive environmental samples in Pakistan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/1-1/8期間,巴基斯坦報告新增1例WPV1型病例;共2國新增4例cVDPV2型病例,分別為奈及利亞3例、印1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增13件WPV1型陽性樣本;英國新增1例cVDPV2型陽性樣本。 2024年全年病例數,其中奈及利亞累計93例cVDPV2型,巴基斯坦累計報告68例WPV1型,剛果民主共和國累計9例cVDPV1與14例cVDPV2型,印累計7例cVDPV2型,南蘇丹10例cVDPV2 型。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 1–8 January, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case. Two countries reported four new cVDPV2 cases: three in Nigeria and one in Indonesia. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 13 new WPV1-positive samples, and the United Kingdom reported one new cVDPV2-positive sample. Full-year 2024 case counts: Nigeria cumulatively reported 93 cVDPV2 cases; Pakistan 68 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo 9 cVDPV1 and 14 cVDPV2 cases; Indonesia 7 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan 10 cVDPV2 cases.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,印尼,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,南蘇丹共和國,英國
items.area_en: Congo,Democratic Republic of the,Indonesia,Nigeria,Pakistan,South Sudan,Republic of,United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 越南南部檳椥省某製衣工廠水痘群聚,累計83例,病例數恐續增
items.summary_en: A varicella cluster at a garment factory in Bến Tre Province, Viet Nam, has reached 83 cases; more cases are expected.
items.description_zh: 越南南部檳椥省爆發群聚事件,某製衣工廠迄今累計83例,疫情發生於2024/11/6-12/24間,該工廠人員已進行健康檢查,並進行相關防治措施,惟預期病例數將持續增加。
items.description_en: An outbreak cluster has been reported in Bến Tre Province in southern Viet Nam. At one garment factory, 83 cases have been reported cumulatively; the outbreak occurred between 6 November and 24 December 2024. Factory personnel have undergone health checks and relevant control measures have been implemented, but case numbers are expected to continue to rise.

items.headline_zh: 韓國/新加坡/馬來西亞-人類間質肺炎
items.headline_en: South Korea / Singapore / Malaysia – Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) infection
items.summary_zh: 韓國HMPV住院數上升,0至6歲占48.6%;新加坡12月占比升至9%
items.summary_en: South Korea's hMPV hospitalisations are rising, with 48.6% among children aged 0–6; Singapore's hMPV share rose to 9% in December 2024.
items.description_zh: 韓國近期監測顯示HMPV住院數上升,其中以0-6歲占48.6%為多,其次為65歲以上族群(20.4%)及7-12歲兒童(18.2%),檢出率從第49週3.2%上升至52週之5.3%,當局表示目前仍低於閾。 新加坡HMPV病例數上升,於2024年12月,社區之ARI樣本中之HMPV病例占比由0.8%上升至9%,惟趨勢與往年一致,研判為年底社交聚會和假期旅行增加所致;馬來西亞2024年報告327例HMPV病例,較2023年增加45%。
items.description_en: South Korea's recent surveillance shows rising hMPV hospitalisations, with the largest share among children aged 0–6 (48.6%), followed by people aged 65 and over (20.4%) and children aged 7–12 (18.2%). The detection rate rose from 3.2% in week 49 to 5.3% in week 52, and authorities state that it remains below the threshold. Singapore: hMPV cases have risen. In December 2024, the share of hMPV among acute respiratory infection (ARI) samples from the community rose from 0.8% to 9%. However, the trend is consistent with previous years, and authorities attribute it to increased social gatherings and holiday travel at the end of the year. Malaysia reported 327 hMPV cases in 2024, an increase of 45% over 2023.

items.summary_zh: 香港2024年退伍軍人病135例,高於2023年121例,當局展開流病調查
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 135 Legionnaires' disease cases in 2024, up from 121 in 2023; authorities are investigating sources and clusters.
items.description_zh: 香港於2024年報告135例,較前一年121例增加,當局表示相關案例將進行流行病學調查,以發現可能感染源、高風險因子及群聚個案,呼籲民眾採取預防措施,尤其高風險族群應留意供水設施及水源環境。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported 135 cases in 2024, up from 121 the previous year. Authorities state that the relevant cases will be subject to epidemiological investigation to identify possible sources of infection, high-risk factors and clusters. The public is urged to take preventive measures; high-risk groups in particular should pay attention to water supply facilities and water environments.

items.summary_zh: 中國流感陽性率2025年第1週上升3.8%,上升趨緩且低於去年同期
items.summary_en: China's influenza positivity rose 3.8% in week 1 of 2025, but the increase is slowing and remains below last year's level.
items.description_zh: 中國流感陽性率於2025年第1週(2024/12/30-2025/1/5)較前1週(2024/12/23-12/29)上升3.8%,上升趨緩並低於去年同期,且學校陸續放假,評估本月中下旬流感活動將下降,惟不同省分間情形略有差異。當局表示發熱門診、急診患者數呈現上升趨勢,低於去年同期水準,且未出現醫療資源明顯緊張情況。另人類間質肺炎陽性率成波動趨勢,惟北方省分陽性率上升趨緩,14歲以下患者陽性率下降;0-4歲幼童RSV陽性率則呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en: China's influenza positivity rate in week 1 of 2025 (30 December 2024–5 January 2025) rose by 3.8% from the previous week (23–29 December 2024). The increase is slowing and is lower than the same period last year, and schools are gradually closing for the holidays. The assessment is that influenza activity will decline in the middle and latter part of this month, although conditions vary somewhat among provinces. Authorities state that fever clinic and emergency patient numbers are rising, but remain below the level of the same period last year, and no obvious strain on medical resources has been observed. In addition, the human metapneumovirus positivity rate has fluctuated; in northern provinces the increase is slowing, and the positivity rate among patients aged 14 and under has declined. The RSV positivity rate among young children aged 0–4 is rising.

items.summary_zh: 日本2024年梅毒14,663例,較15年前增15倍,女性增23倍
items.summary_en: Japan reported 14,663 syphilis cases in 2024, 15 times the level 15 years earlier, with female cases up 23-fold.
items.description_zh: 日本於1/13報告2024年全年累計14,663例病例,以東京都3,703例為多,其次為大阪府1,906例、福岡縣880例,去年病例數略低於2023年(14,906 例),惟較15年前病例數增加15倍,其中,男性增加10倍,女性增加23倍。
items.description_en: On 13 January, Japan reported 14,663 cumulative cases for 2024, with the largest numbers in Tokyo Metropolis (3,703), followed by Osaka Prefecture (1,906) and Fukuoka Prefecture (880). Last year's case count was slightly lower than the 14,906 cases in 2023, but it is 15 times the number reported 15 years ago. Among men, cases increased 10-fold, and among women, 23-fold.

items.summary_zh: 非洲拉薩熱2024年至第49週10,747例、197死,奈及利亞10,450例
items.summary_en: Africa's Lassa fever cases from early 2024 to week 49 total 10,747 with 197 deaths, mostly in Nigeria (10,450 cases).
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情持續,自2024年初截至49週累計3國共10,747例病例,其中1,157例確診,197例死亡,分別是奈及利亞10,450例病例,184例死亡、賴比瑞亞270例病例(11例死亡)及幾內亞27例病例(6例死亡),WHO評估傳播風險為高。
items.description_en: The outbreak in Africa continues. From early 2024 to week 49, three countries cumulatively reported 10,747 cases, including 1,157 confirmed and 197 deaths: Nigeria 10,450 cases and 184 deaths, Liberia 270 cases (11 deaths), and Guinea 27 cases (6 deaths). WHO assesses the transmission risk as high.
items.area_zh: 幾內亞,賴比瑞亞,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 非洲2024年炭疽病294例、8死,烏干達277例,WHO評估傳播風險為中
items.summary_en: Africa reported 294 anthrax cases and 8 deaths in 2024 across three countries, mainly Uganda with 277 cases; WHO rates risk as moderate.
items.description_zh: 非洲報告自2024年初截至52週累計3國共294例病例,其中42例確診,8例死亡;分別是烏干達277例病例,6例死亡、剛果民主共和國10例病例(2例死亡)及肯亞7例病例(無人死亡),WHO評估傳播風險為中,當局呼籲加強監測與妥善處理動物遺體。
items.description_en: Africa reported 294 cases cumulatively from early 2024 to week 52 across three countries, including 42 confirmed and 8 deaths: Uganda 277 cases and 6 deaths, the Democratic Republic of the Congo 10 cases (2 deaths), and Kenya 7 cases (no deaths). WHO assesses the transmission risk as moderate. Authorities urge strengthened surveillance and proper handling of animal carcasses.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,肯亞,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 美國舊金山1月10日報告1例疑似H5N1人類感染,兒童症狀輕微已康復
items.summary_en: San Francisco reported a suspected human H5N1 infection in a child on 10 January; the child had mild symptoms and has recovered.
items.description_zh: 美國舊金山於1/10報告1例疑H5N1流感人類感染病例,病患為兒童,出現發燒及結膜炎症狀,症狀輕微,現已康復;當地衛生單位檢出A型流感陽性,將由CDC進行後續檢驗。當局表示目前病毒仍未具人際間之傳播能力,對一般民眾風險為低,呼籲民眾避免接觸生病及死亡禽鳥,並避免食用未經消毒之乳製品。美國舊金山於1/10報告1例疑H5N1流感人類感染病例,病患為兒童,出現發燒及結膜炎症狀,症狀輕微,現已康復;當地衛生單位檢出A型流感陽性,將由CDC進行後續檢驗。當局表示目前病毒仍未具人際間之傳播能力,對一般民眾風險為低,呼籲民眾避免接觸生病及死亡禽鳥,並避免食用未經消毒之乳製品。
items.description_en: On 10 January, San Francisco, United States, reported one suspected human H5N1 influenza infection in a child, who presented with fever and conjunctivitis with mild symptoms and has recovered. The local health unit detected influenza A positivity, and the CDC will carry out follow-up testing. Authorities state that the virus does not yet have human-to-human transmission capability and that the risk to the general public is low. They urge people to avoid contact with sick and dead birds and to avoid consuming unpasteurised dairy products.

items.disease_zh: 萊姆病,發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.disease_en: Lyme disease, 發熱伴血小板減少綜合症
items.summary_zh: 中國東北某醫院252名蜱叮咬後發熱患者檢出新型XCV病毒,蜱中亦檢出
items.summary_en: A study found the novel tick-borne orthonairovirus XCV in samples from 252 febrile patients in northeast China, and in local ticks.
items.description_zh: 中國於國際期刊1/8發表報告顯示,於東北地區某醫院收集2023年5-7月間,對252名有蜱叮咬史並出現發熱症狀的患者進行檢體檢測,檢出由蜱傳播感染新型orthonairovirus病例,並將其命名為Xue-Cheng virus (XCV),於病例分布地區之蜱亦檢出XCV。
items.description_en: A report published in an international journal on 8 January described samples collected at a hospital in the northeast region between May and July 2023 from 252 patients with a history of tick bites and fever. Testing detected cases of a novel tick-borne orthonairovirus infection, which the researchers named Xue-Cheng virus (XCV). XCV was also detected in ticks in the areas where the cases were located.

items.summary_zh: 多明尼加共和國去年截至第48週瘧疾984例,高於前一年同期265例
items.summary_en: The Dominican Republic reported 984 malaria cases to week 48 of 2024, up from 265 in the same period of 2023, mostly in Azua.
items.description_zh: 多明加共和國疫情更新,去年截至第48週累計報告984例病例,高於前一年同期的265例,病例分布以該國南部的阿蘇阿省最多,當局持續實施防治措施,以避免疾病傳播。
items.description_en: Dominican Republic epidemic update: Last year, up to week 48, 984 cases were reported cumulatively, up from 265 in the same period of the previous year. Cases are concentrated in Azua Province in the south of the country, which has the most cases. Authorities continue to implement prevention and control measures to avoid transmission.

items.summary_zh: 印度馬哈拉什特拉邦去年屈公病逾5,700例,為近6年最高
items.summary_en: India's Maharashtra State reported over 5,700 chikungunya cases last year, the highest in nearly six years, mainly in Nagpur.
items.description_zh: 印度疫情更新,該國中部馬哈拉什特拉邦疫情上升,去年報告5,700餘例病例,為近6年以來最高,病例主要分布於那浦爾市;該國南部泰倫加納邦疫情上升,截至去年11/21累計逾400例病例。
items.description_en: India epidemic update: In the central state of Maharashtra, cases have risen; the state reported over 5,700 cases last year, the highest in nearly six years, mainly concentrated in Nagpur city. In the southern state of Telangana, the outbreak has risen, with over 400 cases reported cumulatively as of 21 November last year.

items.summary_zh: 巴西去年登革熱6,565,716例、5,954死;多明尼加共和國確診1,284例
items.summary_en: Brazil reported 6,565,716 dengue cases and 5,954 deaths last year; the Dominican Republic recorded 1,284 confirmed cases, down 65.54%.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,去年累計報告6,565,716例病例及5,954例死亡,年齡分布以20-29歲為多,其次為30-39歲及40-49歲,該國之中、南部發生率較高,其中以聖保羅州病例數為多。 多明加共和國疫情更新,去年累計1,284例確診病例,較前一年下降65.54%,以該國南部聖何塞德奧科阿省之發生率最高。
items.description_en: Brazil epidemic update: Last year, 6,565,716 cases and 5,954 deaths were reported cumulatively. The age distribution is highest among people aged 20–29, followed by 30–39 and 40–49. Incidence is higher in the central and southern parts of the country, with São Paulo State reporting the most cases. Dominican Republic epidemic update: Last year, 1,284 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively, a decrease of 65.54% from the previous year. Incidence is highest in San José de Ocoa Province in the south.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1人類感染;美國乳牛場累計924(8)起疫情
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection this week; US dairy herds have 924 (8) outbreaks across 16 states since March 2024.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:柬埔寨新增 1 例 H5N1 人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共16國於2024/10/14~2025/1/7間新增169起 H5N1 疫情,分別為美國66起、義大利46起、德國/韓國各12起、荷蘭9起、匈牙利/日本各5起、英國4起、以色列3起、葡萄牙/斯洛維亞/烏克蘭/波蘭/法國/比利時/丹麥各 1 起。 共2國於 2024/10/7~2024/12/20 間新增3起H5N5疫情,分別為冰島2起、陵蘭 1 起。 菲律賓於 2024/11/19 新增1起H5N2疫情。 法國於 2024/12/16 新增 1 起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年 3 月迄今累計 16 州報告 924(8)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、德州及密西根州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少 7,300 例,檢測 160 例,其中40例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第 52 週計 236 個採檢點提供檢測報告,2 州 44 個採檢點檢出 H5 陽性。CDC  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告 H5N1 流感 1 例(2003 年迄今累計 909 例)、H9N2 流感 2 例(迄今累計 130 例)、H10N3 流感 1 例(迄今 累計 4 例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。  禽類/動物案例:累計 8 國報告 27 起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20 針對 H5 流感病毒發表風險評估,目前 H5 2.3.4.4b 病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決 於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 16 countries reported 169 new H5N1 outbreaks between 14 October 2024 and 7 January 2025: United States 66, Italy 46, Germany and South Korea 12 each, Netherlands 9, Hungary and Japan 5 each, United Kingdom 4, Israel 3, and Portugal, Slovenia, Ukraine, Poland, France, Belgium and Denmark 1 each. Two countries reported 3 new H5N5 outbreaks between 7 October and 20 December 2024: Iceland 2 and Greenland 1. The Philippines reported one new H5N2 outbreak on 19 November 2024. France reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 16 December 2024. United States dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy herds have reported 924 (8) outbreaks across 16 states since March last year, mainly concentrated recently in California, Texas and Michigan. Human infections from cattle: at least 7,300 cases monitored, 160 tested, and 40 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, with fatal cases in cats. Wastewater surveillance: in week 52, 236 sampling sites provided test results, and H5-positive detections were found at 44 sampling sites in 2 states. CDC annual summary: Human cases: this year, 1 H5N1 influenza case (909 cumulative since 2003), 2 H9N2 influenza cases (130 cumulative to date) and 1 H10N3 influenza case (4 cumulative to date); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. Avian and animal cases: 27 high- and low-pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks reported cumulatively in 8 countries. Assessment and recommendations: On 20 December, FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment for H5 influenza viruses. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capability. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The infection risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.summary_zh: 柬埔寨1月10日報告1例H5N1人類感染,28歲男性死亡,曾食用病雞
items.summary_en: Cambodia reported a fatal H5N1 human case on 10 January: a 28-year-old manager of a family chicken farm who had eaten sick chickens.
items.description_zh: 柬埔寨於 1/10 報告 1 例 H5N1 流感人類感染病例,為該國東部磅湛省占卡勒縣 28 歲男性,1/9 確診,該病患病情危急,出現發燒及呼吸困難等症狀,於 1/10 死亡;病患為家庭養雞場之管理人員,並曾食用病雞。當局已針對感染源及接觸者進行調查,並對當地民眾進行衛教。該國 2024 年報告 10 例 H5N1 流感人類感染病例。
items.description_en: On 10 January, Cambodia reported one human H5N1 influenza infection: a 28-year-old man in Chamkar Leu district, Kampong Cham Province in the east, who was confirmed on 9 January. His condition was critical, with fever and difficulty breathing, and he died on 10 January. He was a manager at a household chicken farm and had eaten sick chickens. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and contacts, and are providing health education to local residents. Cambodia reported 10 human H5N1 infections in 2024.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率第51週約11.2%,近期整體下降,XEC占比上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 11.2% in week 51 of 2024 and recently declining; XEC's share is rising, though severity has not increased.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024 年第 51 週(12/16-12/22)全球陽性率約 11.2%,陽性率以歐洲區(11.7%)、非洲區(10.7%)及美洲區(9.7%)為高。 日本病例數持續上升,2024 年第 52 週(12/23-12/29)定醫報告病例數為 34,000 餘例,每定醫點平均 7.01 例。 泰國 2024 年第 51 週(12/15-12/21)新增 867 例病例,病例數呈上升趨勢。 香港 2025 年第 1 週(2024/12/29-2025/1/4)陽性率略升,惟仍處低點,JN.1 及其衍生變異株爲主要流行變異株。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期下降,其中,東南亞區及非洲區上升,東地中海區上下波動,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。XEC 及 KP.3.1.1 為全球主要流行變異株,XEC 變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO 表示多數國家已將 COVID-19 納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向 WHO 通報疫情資訊及維繫 COVID-19 期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 51 of 2024 (16–22 December), the global positivity rate was about 11.2%, highest in the European Region (11.7%), the African Region (10.7%) and the Region of the Americas (9.7%). Japan's case numbers continue to rise; in week 52 of 2024 (23–29 December), reported cases at sentinel clinics exceeded 34,000, an average of 7.01 per sentinel site. Thailand reported 867 new cases in week 51 of 2024 (15–21 December), and the trend is rising. Hong Kong's positivity rate rose slightly in week 1 of 2025 (29 December 2024–4 January 2025) but remains at a low level; JN.1 and its derivatives are the main circulating variants. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently declined; it is rising in the South-East Asia and African regions, fluctuating in the Eastern Mediterranean Region, and flat or declining elsewhere. XEC and KP.3.1.1 are the main global circulating variants; the XEC share is rising, but disease severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.headline_zh: 巴西-不明原因疾病(急性腹瀉與嘔吐)
items.headline_en: Brazil – Undiagnosed illness (acute diarrhoea and vomiting)
items.summary_zh: 巴西聖保羅州沿海腹瀉嘔吐案例上升,疑與污水洩漏有關,調查中
items.summary_en: Diarrhoea and vomiting cases have risen along the São Paulo coast since December, possibly linked to sewage leaks; the source is under investigation.
items.description_zh: 巴西聖保羅州沿海自去年12月迄今腹瀉嘔吐案例上升,症狀包括噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉和腹痛,可能與污水洩漏相關,當局仍在調查感染源,並呼籲民眾洗手及避免接觸受污染之水,建議症狀嚴重時,立即就醫。
items.description_en: Cases of diarrhoea and vomiting have increased along the coast of São Paulo State, Brazil, since December last year. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and abdominal pain, and the cause may be related to sewage leakage. Authorities are still investigating the source of infection, and urge people to wash their hands and avoid contact with contaminated water. People with severe symptoms are advised to seek medical care immediately.

items.disease_zh: 第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.disease_en: 第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 泰國-第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 泰國自2024年1月至2025年1月5日第2型豬鏈球菌感染956例、59死
items.summary_en: Thailand reported 956 serotype 2 Streptococcus suis cases and 59 deaths from 1 January 2024 to 5 January 2025, mostly in the north and northeast.
items.description_zh: 泰國自2024/1/1迄今年1/5累計報告956例病例,59例死亡,病例多發生於東北部和北部地區,多數死者有食用生豬肉或接觸其內臟等危險因子,且多具有慢性疾病。
items.description_en: Thailand reported 956 cases and 59 deaths cumulatively from 1 January 2024 to 5 January 2025. Cases occurred mainly in the northeast and north. Most of the deceased had risk factors such as eating raw pork or handling pork offal, and most had chronic illnesses.

items.headline_zh: 韓國/香港-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.headline_en: South Korea / Hong Kong SAR – Viral gastroenteritis (norovirus)
items.summary_zh: 韓國去年病毒性腸胃炎6,762例;香港12月29日至1月4日新增19例
items.summary_en: South Korea reported 6,762 viral gastroenteritis cases last year, nearly 60% in children aged 0–6; Hong Kong added 19 cases from 29 December to 4 January.
items.description_zh: 韓國疫情上升,去年累計報告6,762例病例,高於前年(2023年)5,926例,去年52週新增291例,病患近6成為0-6歲幼兒;香港疫情上升,去年12/22-28新增報告7例病例,於12/29-2025/1/4則新增19例,多集中於安養機構,當局呼籲加強衛生措施。
items.description_en: South Korea: Cases are rising. Last year, 6,762 cases were reported cumulatively, higher than the 5,926 cases in the previous year (2023). In week 52 of last year, 291 new cases were reported, and nearly 60% of patients are children aged 0–6. Hong Kong: Cases are rising. From 22 to 28 December last year, 7 new cases were reported, and from 29 December 2024 to 4 January 2025, 19 new cases were reported, mostly concentrated in elderly care facilities. Authorities urge strengthened hygiene measures.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球小兒麻痺:巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1,剛果與南蘇丹新增3例cVDPV2
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported three new WPV1 polio cases for 19–31 December 2024; the DRC and South Sudan reported three cVDPV2 cases.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於去年12/19-12/31期間,巴基斯坦報告新增3例WPV1型病例;共2國新增3例cVDPV2,分別為剛果民主共和國2例、南蘇丹1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增52件WPV1型陽性樣本;共3國新增6件cVDPV2型陽性樣本,分別為象牙海岸4件、阿爾及利亞/波蘭各1件。 2024年巴基斯坦累計報告WPV1型67例,剛果民主共和國累計WPV1型9例與cVDPV2型14例,南蘇丹cVDPV2 型10例。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–31 December last year, Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported three new cVDPV2 cases: two in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and one in South Sudan. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 52 new WPV1-positive samples. Three countries reported six new cVDPV2-positive samples: four in Côte d'Ivoire, and one each in Algeria and Poland. For 2024, Pakistan cumulatively reported 67 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo cumulatively reported 9 WPV1 cases and 14 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan reported 10 cVDPV2 cases.

items.summary_zh: 中國1月9日報告首起Ib型M痘群聚,境外移入個案,已有4例接觸者確診
items.summary_en: China reported its first clade Ib mpox cluster on 9 January, starting with an imported case with DR Congo travel history; four contacts are confirmed.
items.description_zh: 中國於1/9報告首起Ib型病例群聚疫情,指標病例為境外移入之外籍人員,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,密切接觸者已有4例確診,相關病例以皮疹、皰疹等症狀為主,症狀輕微,均接受治療中。
items.description_en: On 9 January, China reported its first cluster of clade Ib cases. The index case was an imported case in a foreign national with a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Four close contacts have since been confirmed. The cases mainly present with rash and blisters; symptoms are mild, and all are receiving treatment.

items.summary_zh: 越南2024年麻疹疑似逾3.8萬例、確診逾6,700例、13死
items.summary_en: Viet Nam recorded over 38,000 suspected and 6,700 confirmed measles cases in 2024, with 13 deaths; South Korea reported 49, mostly imported.
items.description_zh: 越南去年全年累計逾3.8萬例疑病例,其中確診逾6,700例,相較2023年確診數已逾百倍,死亡13例,多數病例來自南部地區,惟北部地區病例數亦呈上升趨勢,有持續擴散趨勢;韓國去年全年累計報告49例,病例皆為境外移入及其接觸病例,感染國家多為中亞及東南亞地區。
items.description_en: Viet Nam reported more than 38,000 suspected cases last year, of which over 6,700 were confirmed, more than 100 times the number confirmed in 2023, with 13 deaths. Most cases came from the southern region, but case numbers in the northern region are also rising, indicating continued spread. South Korea reported 49 cases in total last year; all were imported cases or their contacts, and most infections were acquired in Central Asia and Southeast Asia.

items.summary_zh: 阿根廷恩特雷里奧斯省鸚鵡熱20例,當局提醒減少接觸禽鳥
items.summary_en: Entre Ríos Province in Argentina has reported 20 psittacosis cases; authorities urge the public to reduce contact with birds.
items.description_zh: 阿根廷東北部恩特雷里奧斯省(Entre Rios)報告20例病例,當局提醒民眾應減少或避免接觸禽鳥等預防措施,以降低感染風險。
items.description_en: In Entre Ríos Province in northeastern Argentina, 20 cases have been reported. Authorities remind the public to reduce or avoid contact with birds and to take other preventive measures to lower the risk of infection.

items.summary_zh: 美國流感陽性率第52週升至18.7%,42州疫情處高點
items.summary_en: US influenza test positivity rose to 18.7% in week 52 of 2024, with 42 states at high activity levels.
items.description_zh: 美國類流感門診就診率由4.9%上升至6.8%,第52週(12/22-12/28)流感陽性率為18.7%,較前1週12.0%上升,其中,全國有42州疫情處高點,各年齡層之流感住院數皆呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en: In the United States, the influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate rose from 4.9% to 6.8%. Influenza test positivity in week 52 (22–28 December) was 18.7%, up from 12.0% the previous week. Forty-two states are at high levels of activity, and influenza hospitalisations are rising in all age groups.

items.summary_zh: 日本每定醫門診平均流感42.66例,為10年來最高;韓國就診率升至73.9‰
items.summary_en: Japan's average flu cases per sentinel clinic hit a 10-year high in week 51 of 2024; South Korea's visit rate rose to 73.9‰.
items.description_zh: 日本於去年第51週(12/16-12/22)累計報告21.1萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數42.66例,為10年來最高,全國有36個都道府縣超過警報標準,該國病例數快速上升,第51週病例數為前1週2倍以上,評估病例將持續增加;韓國第52週類流感門診就診率為73.9 ‰,較前1週31.3‰顯著上升,當局於去年12/20發布警報,並呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Japan's cumulative reports in week 51 of last year (16–22 December) exceeded 211,000 cases, with an average of 42.66 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest in 10 years. Thirty-six prefectures nationwide exceeded the alert threshold. Japan's case numbers are rising rapidly: the number in week 51 was more than double that of the previous week, and the assessment is that cases will continue to rise. South Korea's influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate in week 52 was 73.9‰, a significant increase from 31.3‰ the previous week. Authorities issued an alert on 20 December last year and urge the public to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.summary_zh: 北半球呼吸道傳染病上升以流感為主;中國hMPV與RSV亦上升
items.summary_en: Respiratory infections are rising in the Northern Hemisphere, led by influenza; in China, hMPV and RSV are also increasing, and WHO urges surveillance.
items.description_zh: 北半球溫帶地區近期類流感(ILI)及急性呼吸道感染(ARI)比率有所上升,多國超過閾:  流感於歐洲、中美洲、中/西非及亞洲多國呈上升趨勢,新冠肺炎則處低點,RSV於北美地區呈上升趨勢。 中國近期呼吸道傳染病疫情上升,南/北方類流感活動自2024年底持續上升,惟趨勢與2023年一致;流感、RSV及人類間質性肺炎(hMPV)感染均呈上升趨勢,其中以流感為主要病原,hMPV陽性率於5-14歲兒童族群為高。另新冠肺炎處低點,惟重症數上升,當局表示醫療資源仍於可負荷之範圍。 WHO表示冬季為呼吸道傳染病好發季節,北半球多國呼吸道感染及檢測數皆呈增加趨勢,符合預期情形,由於多種呼吸道病原同時流行,對各國醫療機構造成一定程度負擔,建議民眾採取預防措施,並呼籲各國針對呼吸道病原進行監測。
items.description_en: Influenza-like illness (ILI) and acute respiratory infection (ARI) rates have risen recently in temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere, with several countries above the threshold. Influenza is rising in Europe, Central America, Central and West Africa and several Asian countries; COVID-19 is at a low level; and RSV is rising in North America. In China, respiratory infectious disease activity has recently risen. Seasonal influenza activity in the north and south has continued to rise since late 2024, consistent with the trend in 2023. Influenza, RSV and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) infections are all rising, with influenza the main pathogen, and hMPV positivity is highest among children aged 5–14. COVID-19 is at a low level, but severe cases have risen, and authorities say medical resources remain within manageable limits. WHO notes that winter is the peak season for respiratory infections, and that respiratory infections and testing numbers are rising in many Northern Hemisphere countries, as expected. Because several respiratory pathogens are circulating at the same time, healthcare facilities in many countries are under a degree of strain. WHO recommends that the public take preventive measures and calls on countries to monitor respiratory pathogens.

items.summary_zh: 法國1月6日報告首例Ib型M痘,女性個案,感染於布列塔尼,無中非旅遊史
items.summary_en: France reported its first clade Ib mpox case on 6 January, a woman infected in Brittany with no travel history to Central Africa.
items.description_zh: 法國於1/6報告該國首例Ib型病例,為女性個案,感染發生在該國西部布列塔地區,感染者沒有中非等流行區旅遊史,惟曾與兩名從中非返國者有過接觸,當局刻正調查感染源,並釐清有風險之接觸者。
items.description_en: On 6 January, France reported its first clade Ib case, a female patient. The infection occurred in Brittany in western France. The patient had no history of travel to endemic areas such as Central Africa, but had been in contact with two people who had returned from Central Africa. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and identifying contacts at risk.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 印度-人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
items.summary_zh: 印度2024年12月1日全國HIV盛行率0.2%,新病例65%為注射毒品感染
items.summary_en: India's national HIV prevalence was 0.2% as of 1 December 2024; 65% of new cases were linked to injection drug use.
items.description_zh: 印度去年12/1報告全國平均盛行率為0.2%,其中,東北部阿薩姆邦盛行率為0.13%,較全國平均為低,惟新病例中,經注射毒品感染比率高達65%;另北部查謨和喀什米爾邦病例數逐年增加,目前仍有3,800餘例正在接受治療。
items.description_en: India reported a national average HIV prevalence of 0.2% as of 1 December 2024. In the northeastern state of Assam, prevalence was 0.13%, lower than the national average, but 65% of new cases were infected through injection drug use. In the northern state of Jammu and Kashmir, case numbers have increased year by year, and more than 3,800 people are still receiving treatment.

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 非洲-人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
items.summary_zh: 蘇丹2024年12月3日HIV感染4.8萬例,18%接受治療;烏干達約5.1%
items.summary_en: Sudan had 48,000 known HIV infections as of 3 December 2024, with 18% on treatment; Uganda's national prevalence was about 5.1%.
items.description_zh: 東非蘇丹疫情嚴峻,去年12/3已知感染病例達48,000例,其中18%正在接受治療,另12/23報載南蘇丹瓊萊州產前檢查陽性孕婦人數亦明顯上升,推測社會動盪及缺乏醫療資源應為當地疫情上升主因;烏干達去年全國盛行率約5.1%,其中,卡蘭加拉區較為嚴峻,盛行率約12.8%,惟近年已有明顯下降。
items.description_en: The HIV situation in Sudan in East Africa is severe: as of 3 December 2024, 48,000 known infections had been recorded, and 18% of them were receiving treatment. Media reported on 23 December that the number of pregnant women testing positive at antenatal screening in Jonglei State, South Sudan, had also risen markedly. The rise is presumed to be mainly due to social unrest and a lack of medical resources. Uganda's national prevalence in 2024 was about 5.1%; Kalangala District is more severe, with a prevalence of about 12.8%, although it has declined markedly in recent years.
items.area_zh: 南蘇丹共和國,蘇丹,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 摩洛哥、突尼西亞、以色列及印度新增狂犬病病例,多因犬貓咬傷
items.summary_en: Morocco, Tunisia and India reported rabies deaths and Israel its first case in nearly eight years, all following animal bites.
items.description_zh: 北非摩洛哥、突西亞於去年第四季,各新增至少1例狂犬病死亡病例,病患均曾經犬隻咬傷,疫苗接種史不明;西亞以色列亦報告近8年來首例病例,為經犬隻咬傷,目前仍住院治療,當局已對接觸者進行預防接種;南亞印度馬哈拉什特拉邦新增至少1例死亡病例,病患曾被流浪犬貓咬傷,因無傷口而未接種疫苗。
items.description_en: In North Africa, Morocco and Tunisia each reported at least one new rabies death in the fourth quarter of last year. All patients had been bitten by dogs, and their vaccination history is unknown. In West Asia, Israel reported its first case in nearly eight years, a person bitten by a dog, who is still hospitalised; authorities have given post-exposure vaccination to contacts. In South Asia, Maharashtra State in India reported at least one new death; the patient had been bitten by a stray dog or cat and, because there was no wound, had not been vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 美國路易斯安那州公布先前H5N1病例死亡,為該國首例H5N1感染死亡
items.summary_en: Louisiana announced that a previously reported H5N1 patient, aged 65 or older with chronic illness, has died, the first US H5N1 infection death.
items.description_zh: 美國路易斯安那州1/6公布先前報告之H5N1病例死亡,病患65歲以上(原僅公布為18歲以上),具慢性病史,迄無相關接觸者發病;本案為該國首例H5N1感染死亡案例。
items.description_en: On 6 January, Louisiana State, United States, announced that a previously reported H5N1 case had died. The patient was aged 65 or older (previously announced only as 18 or older) and had a history of chronic disease; no related contacts have fallen ill. This is the first H5N1 infection death in the country.

items.summary_zh: 非洲2024年黃熱病截至11月30日1,138例、7死,剛果共和國452例
items.summary_en: Africa reported 1,138 yellow fever cases and 7 deaths as of 30 November 2024, with the Republic of the Congo accounting for 452.

items.description_en: Africa epidemic update: As of 30 November 2024, 1,138 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 41 confirmed and 7 deaths. Cases were distributed as follows: Republic of the Congo (452), Central African Republic (390), Gabon (146), South Sudan (139), Cameroon (8), Guinea (2) and Uganda (1).

items.summary_zh: 澳洲維多利亞州1例日本腦炎疑似病例,墨累河沿岸與新南威爾斯州蚊豬檢出病毒
items.summary_en: Victoria, Australia, reported a suspected Japanese encephalitis case, possibly its first this season; the virus has been found in NSW mosquitoes and pigs.
items.description_zh: 澳洲疫情更新,維多利亞州報告1例疑病例,可能為該州本季首例病例,於該州北部墨累河沿岸之環境監測及新南威爾斯州之蚊及豬隻亦檢出病毒,顯示該病毒可能於維多利亞州北部傳播,該州已對於高風險族群提供疫苗接種服務。
items.description_en: Australia epidemic update: Victoria State reported one suspected case, which may be the state's first case this season. The virus was also detected through environmental monitoring along the Murray River in northern Victoria, and in mosquitoes and pigs in New South Wales, indicating that the virus may be spreading in northern Victoria. The state has provided vaccination services to high-risk groups.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉1月4日報告今年首例登革熱死亡,2024年累計10萬1,214例、575死
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported its first dengue death of 2025 on 4 January; 101,214 cases and 575 deaths were recorded in 2024.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉於1/4報告今年首例死亡病例,目前仍有436例患者於醫院接受治療;2024年累計101 ,214例病例,其中,575例死亡。
items.description_en: Bangladesh reported its first dengue death of 2025 on 4 January, and 436 patients are still being treated in hospital. A total of 101,214 cases were recorded in 2024, of which 575 died.

items.summary_zh: 維德角近1個月登革熱逾8,000例,2024年迄今累計44,410例、8死
items.summary_en: Cape Verde reported over 8,000 dengue cases in the past month; 44,410 cases and 8 deaths were recorded in 2024 to date.
items.description_zh: 維德角疫情更新,最近1個月報告逾8,000例病例,2024年迄今累計44,410例病例(17,942例確診),8例死亡,病例分布於該國9島嶼,以聖地亞哥島之病例數最多,該國主要流行型別為DENV-1及DENV-3。
items.description_en: Cape Verde epidemic update: In the past month, over 8,000 cases were reported. In 2024 to date, 44,410 cases (17,942 confirmed) and 8 deaths have been recorded cumulatively. Cases are distributed across the country's nine islands, with the most on Santiago Island. The main circulating serotypes in the country are DENV-1 and DENV-3.

items.headline_zh: 布吉納法索/維德角-登革熱

items.summary_en: Africa has recorded 176,481 dengue cases and 136 deaths in 2024 to date, with Burkina Faso and Cape Verde reporting the most.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,2024年迄今累計176,481例病例(30,324例確診),136例死亡,以布吉納法索及維德角病例數為多。
items.description_en: Africa epidemic update: From 2024 to date, 176,481 cases (30,324 confirmed) and 136 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with the largest numbers in Burkina Faso and Cape Verde.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國新增1例未分型人類流感感染;2024年H5人類病例55例,65國禽流感疫情
items.summary_en: The US reported one untyped human influenza case this week; 2024 saw 55 H5 human cases, including 26 H5N1, and 65 countries reported avian outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週美國新增1例未分型人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共11國於2023/12/31~2024/12/31間新增70起H5N1疫情,分別為美國34起、德國8起、加拿大6起、荷蘭/南韓各5起、英國/波蘭各4起、摩爾多瓦/愛爾蘭/阿爾巴亞/以色列各1起。 共3國於2024/12/17~2024/12/27間新增4起H5 (N untyped)疫情,分別為法國2起、德國/秘魯各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計16州報告915(14)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州及德州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少7,300例,檢測160例,其中40例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第52週計236個採檢點提供檢測報告,2州44個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  12/31研究公布加拿大人類感染H5N1重症病例案件細節,病患為英屬哥倫比亞省13歲女孩,具輕度氣喘及肥胖病史,其感染之2.3.4.4b D1.1分支病毒,檢出PB2 E627K人類適應性突變及HA E186D、Q222H等增加人類受體結合力之變異,仍無抗藥性變異。 美國加州洛杉磯郡12/31再次報告家貓感染H5禽流感案例,已知同一戶中之5隻家貓均曾食用受汙染之生雞肉寵物食品,其中1隻已確診,當局呼籲民眾避免讓寵物(或自己)食用生乳及生肉製品。  年度摘要  人類病例:2024年累計報告H5(含推測)流感55例,H5N1流感26例(2003年迄今累計908例)、H5N2流感1例(首例),H5N6流感3例(迄今累計93例)、H9N2流感21例(迄今累計128例)、H10N3流感1例(迄今累計3例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:2024年累計65國報告3,153起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:  FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: This week the United States reported one new untyped human influenza infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 11 countries reported 70 new H5N1 outbreaks between 31 December 2023 and 31 December 2024: United States 34, Germany 8, Canada 6, Netherlands and South Korea 5 each, United Kingdom and Poland 4 each, and Moldova, Ireland, Albania and Israel 1 each. Three countries reported 4 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 17 and 27 December 2024: France 2, and Germany and Peru 1 each. United States dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy herds have reported 915 (14) outbreaks across 16 states since March this year, mainly concentrated in California, Nevada and Texas. Human infections from cattle: at least 7,300 cases monitored, 160 tested, and 40 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, with fatal cases in cats. Wastewater surveillance: in week 52, 236 sampling sites provided test results, and H5-positive detections were found at 44 sampling sites in 2 states. Other updates: On 31 December, a study reported details of a severe human H5N1 case in Canada: a 13-year-old girl in British Columbia Province with mild asthma and obesity, infected with the 2.3.4.4b D1.1 subclade virus. Mutations were detected including PB2 E627K, a marker of human adaptation, and HA E186D and Q222H, which increase binding to human receptors; no antiviral-resistance mutations were found. On 31 December, Los Angeles County, California, again reported an H5 avian influenza case in a domestic cat; five domestic cats from the same household had all eaten contaminated raw chicken pet food, and one has been confirmed. Authorities urge the public to avoid feeding pets, or themselves, raw milk and raw meat products. Annual summary: Human cases: in 2024, 55 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases were reported cumulatively, including 26 H5N1 (908 cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 (first case), 3 H5N6 (93 cumulative to date), 21 H9N2 (128 cumulative to date) and 1 H10N3 (3 cumulative to date); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. Avian and animal cases: in 2024, 65 countries cumulatively reported 3,153 high- and low-pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 20 December, FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment for H5 influenza viruses. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capability. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The infection risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率第51週約15.9%且近期上升,美國陽性率與住院率同步上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 15.9% in week 51 of 2024 and rising; US positivity, ED visits and hospitalisations are also increasing.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第51週(12/16-12/22)全球陽性率約15.9%,陽性率以歐洲區(18.1%)、非洲區(13.7%)及美洲區(9.9%)為高。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈上升趨勢,主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1及XEC。 歐洲區以XEC變異株占比最高,其次為KP.3.1.1變異株。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,歐洲區、東南亞區及非洲區上升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 51 of 2024 (16–22 December), the global positivity rate was about 15.9%, highest in the European Region (18.1%), the African Region (13.7%) and the Region of the Americas (9.9%). In the United States, the recent positivity rate, emergency department visit rate and hospitalisation rate are all rising; the main circulating variants are KP.3.1.1 and XEC. In the European Region, the XEC variant accounts for the largest share, followed by KP.3.1.1. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen; it is rising in the European, South-East Asian and African regions, and flat or declining elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but disease severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 美國佛州2024年創傷弧菌83例、17死,為2015年來最高
items.summary_en: Florida's Vibrio vulnificus cases reached 83, with 17 deaths, as of 13 December 2024, the highest since 2015, after Hurricane Helene.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州於 2024 年病例數達自 2015 年來最高,截至 12/13 累計報告 83 例,其中 17 例死亡,病例數為去年 1.8 倍,該州於 9 月下旬受海倫颶風影響,病例數顯著上升。
items.description_en: Florida, United States, reached its highest number of cases since 2015 in 2024: as of 13 December, 83 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 17 deaths, 1.8 times last year's count. In late September the state was affected by Hurricane Helene, and case numbers rose significantly.

items.headline_zh: 美國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 美國2024年諾羅病毒疫情高於往年,郵輪群聚達16起,為2012年以來新高
items.summary_en: US norovirus activity in 2024 exceeded prior years; cruise ship clusters reached 16, the highest since 2012, mostly norovirus.
items.description_zh: 美國 2024 年諾羅病毒疫情高於往年同期,11/29-12/5 單週新增 91 起諾羅群聚事件,另實驗室監測資料顯示 12/15-12/21 當週陽性率為 22%,為 2018 年以來新高。另該國郵輪群聚事件於 2024 年全年達 16 起,為 2012 年以來新高,案件多為諾羅病毒所引起。
items.description_en: US norovirus activity in 2024 was higher than in the same period of previous years: in the single week of 29 November–5 December, 91 norovirus cluster events were newly reported. Laboratory surveillance data show that the positivity rate for the week of 15–21 December was 22%, the highest since 2018. The country recorded 16 cruise ship cluster events in 2024 as a whole, the highest since 2012, and most were caused by norovirus.

items.summary_zh: 緬甸克倫邦2024年霍亂逾700例、2死,泰國達府累計4例
items.summary_en: Myanmar's Kayin State reported over 700 cholera cases and 2 deaths in 2024; Thailand's Tak Province reported 4 cases.
items.description_zh: 緬甸東南部克倫邦水溝谷地區爆發疫情,2024 年截至 12/30 累計報告逾 700 例急性腹瀉病例,其中 2例死亡;與該地區接壤之泰國達府地區累計報告 4 例,當局已關閉邊境通道並提供緬甸醫療物資,在世界衛生組織等介入協助下,病例數已大幅減少。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in the Shwe Kokko area of Kayin State in southeastern Myanmar. As of 30 December 2024, over 700 cases of acute diarrhoea had been reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths. Tak Province in neighbouring Thailand reported 4 cases cumulatively. Authorities have closed border crossings and provided medical supplies to Myanmar. With the assistance of WHO and other partners, case numbers have fallen substantially.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 以色列2024年12月25日新增1例小兒麻痺,為未接種疫苗的17歲男性
items.summary_en: Israel reported one new poliomyelitis case on 25 December 2024: an unvaccinated 17-year-old man from the Jerusalem area.
items.description_zh: 以色列於 2024/12/25 新增 1 例,病患為 17 歲男性,來自耶路撒冷地 區,該病患未曾接種疫苗,當局持續於當地進行接觸者調查,並呼籲民 眾接種疫苗。
items.description_en: On 25 December 2024, Israel reported one new case: a 17-year-old male from the Jerusalem area who had not been vaccinated. Authorities continue contact investigations in the area and urge vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 中國/日本-肺炎黴漿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 中國肺炎黴漿菌居嚴重呼吸道感染住院病原首位,日本11月高峰近往年2倍
items.summary_en: Mycoplasma pneumoniae was the leading severe respiratory pathogen in China for most of the year; Japan's November peak was nearly twice prior peaks.
items.description_zh: 中國今年疫情嚴峻,幾乎全年居於嚴重呼吸道感染住院病例之病原首位,11月起陽性率已逐漸下降,影響全年齡層;日本今年下半年疫情亦嚴峻,自6月起疫情持續上升,至11月達高峰,峰為往年高峰近2倍,目前已逐週下降,惟仍處於極高水平。
items.description_en: China's severe respiratory infection situation in 2024 has been serious; Mycoplasma pneumoniae has been the leading pathogen among hospitalised severe respiratory infection cases for nearly the whole year. Positivity has gradually declined since November, affecting all age groups. Japan's epidemic was also severe in the second half of 2024: cases rose continuously from June and peaked in November at nearly twice the level of previous years' peaks. Cases are now falling each week but remain at an extremely high level.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),日本

items.summary_zh: 日本細小病毒B19感染11月起驟升,目前處高峰,升幅趨緩
items.summary_en: Japan's parvovirus B19 sentinel reports surged from November and are now at a peak, though growth has slowed.
items.description_zh: 日本今年定點報告數自4月起持續緩升,11月起出現驟升,目前處於高峰,升幅已趨緩,疫情集中於關東地區及北方之青森縣。
items.description_en: Japan's sentinel reports this year rose gradually from April and surged from November; the epidemic is now at its peak, although the rate of increase has slowed. The outbreak is concentrated in the Kanto region and in Aomori Prefecture in the north.

items.summary_zh: 中國10月起hMPV上升,近兩週成為門急診類流感病患前三大病原
items.summary_en: China's hMPV infections have risen since October and are now among the top three pathogens in outpatient and emergency flu-like illness, mainly in under-14s.
items.description_zh: 中國10月起疫情上升,近二週已成為門急診類流感病患之前三大病原,且升幅僅次於流感,主要影響14歲以下族群。
items.description_en: Human metapneumovirus infections in China have risen since October. In the past two weeks, hMPV has become one of the top three pathogens among outpatient and emergency influenza-like illness cases, and its rate of increase is second only to influenza. It mainly affects people aged under 14.

items.summary_zh: 北半球流感明顯上升,日本兩週內驟升至往年高峰水準,疫情較往年提前
items.summary_en: Northern Hemisphere influenza is rising markedly; Japan surged to past-peak levels within two weeks, and the season started earlier than usual.
items.description_zh: 北半球流感活動度近期明顯上升,往來頻繁國家中以日本升幅最劇,於兩週內驟升至往年高峰水準,整體疫情較往年提前,預期仍將持續升高;中國北方、韓國及北美洲國家升幅亦嚴峻,疫情趨勢與往年相符;而中國南方、香港等地亦已於第51週起開始出現緩升趨勢。
items.description_en: Influenza activity in the Northern Hemisphere has risen markedly recently. Among countries with frequent travel, Japan has had the steepest rise, surging within two weeks to peak levels seen in previous years. Overall the epidemic is earlier than in previous years and is expected to keep rising. Increases are also severe in northern China, South Korea and North American countries, with trends consistent with previous years. In southern China, Hong Kong and other areas, a slight upward trend began from week 51.

items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州12月中旬一週新增2例狂犬病,分別遭犬與貓咬傷
items.summary_en: Malaysia's Sarawak State reported two rabies cases in one mid-December week, from dog and cat bites; authorities urge immediate medical care after bites.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州12月中旬單週新增2例病例,分別為經犬隻及貓隻咬傷,當局呼籲民眾保持警覺,除確保家中寵物接種疫苗外,倘經犬貓抓咬傷,應立即就醫。
items.description_en: In Sarawak State, Malaysia, two cases were reported in a single week in mid-December, from dog bites and cat bites respectively. Authorities urge the public to remain alert: in addition to ensuring that household pets are vaccinated, anyone scratched or bitten by a dog or cat should seek medical care immediately.

items.summary_zh: 非洲拉薩熱截至12月16日10,747例、197死,奈及利亞10,450例
items.summary_en: Africa's Lassa fever toll reached 10,747 cases and 197 deaths as of 16 December 2024, with Nigeria accounting for 10,450 cases.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至12/16累計3國報告10,747例病例,其中1,157例確診,197例死亡(CFR:17%),以奈及利亞報告10,450例、184例死亡最為嚴峻,另有賴比瑞亞及幾內亞分別報告270例(11例死亡)及27例(2例死亡),疫情持續流行中。
items.description_en: Africa epidemic update: As of 16 December 2024, three countries had reported 10,747 cases cumulatively, including 1,157 confirmed and 197 deaths (CFR 17%). Nigeria, with 10,450 cases and 184 deaths, is the most severely affected; Liberia reported 270 cases (11 deaths) and Guinea 27 cases (2 deaths). The outbreak continues.
items.area_zh: 幾內亞,賴比瑞亞,奈及利亞

items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR / United States / Thailand – Melioidosis
items.summary_zh: 香港2024年類鼻疽23例高於2023年17例;泰國3,935例、127死
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 23 melioidosis cases in 2024, above 17 in 2023; Thailand reported 3,935 cases and 127 deaths to mid-December.
items.description_zh: 香港12/13新增報告1例病例,為63歲具慢性病史男性,居住於深水埗,11/30發病,12/4死亡,感染源仍在調查中;當地今年累計報告23例病例,較去年17例為高。 美國波多黎各今年7至11月間新增報告6例病例,其中4例死亡,死者均為60歲以上老年族群,當局表示近幾月持續發生大雨及淹水,可能為疫情上升主因。 泰國今年截至12月中旬累計75省報告3,935例病例,其中127例死亡,病患多為男性,年齡層以65歲以上族群最多。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported one new case on 13 December: a 63-year-old man with a chronic illness, living in Sham Shui Po, who developed symptoms on 30 November and died on 4 December. The source of infection is still under investigation. Hong Kong has reported 23 cases cumulatively in 2024, higher than the 17 cases in 2023. In the United States, Puerto Rico reported six new cases between July and November 2024, four of which were fatal, all in people over 60; authorities say that heavy rain and flooding over recent months are the main reason for the rise. Thailand reported 3,935 cases cumulatively in 2024 up to mid-December across 75 provinces, with 127 deaths; patients are mostly male, and the largest age group is those aged 65 and over.
items.area_zh: 香港特別行政區,泰國,美國

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉/哥斯大黎加-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉2024年登革熱逾10萬例、561死;哥斯大黎加逾3萬例
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported over 100,000 dengue cases and 561 deaths in 2024 to 21 December; Costa Rica reported over 30,000 cases.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,今年截至12/21累計報告10萬餘例病例,561例死亡,其中,約60%病例發生於10及11月份,並以男性病例為多;該國去年全年病例數達32萬餘例。 哥斯大黎加疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告3萬餘例病例,高於去年同期的2.8萬餘例,病例集中於該國中南部地區。
items.description_en: Bangladesh epidemic update: In 2024, up to 21 December, over 100,000 cases had been reported cumulatively, with 561 deaths. About 60% of cases occurred in October and November, and male cases predominate. Bangladesh recorded over 320,000 cases in 2023 as a whole. Costa Rica epidemic update: So far in 2024, over 30,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the over 28,000 cases in the same period of 2023. Cases are concentrated in the central and southern parts of the country.

items.summary_zh: 衣索比亞2024年瘧疾累計840萬例,為病例數最高的一年
items.summary_en: Ethiopia reported 8.4 million malaria cases in 2024, averaging over 300,000 a week, its highest annual case count.
items.description_zh: 衣索比亞疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告840萬例病例,平均每週報告超過30萬例,為病例數最高的一年,流行期分別於每年4-5月及9-12月。
items.description_en: Ethiopia epidemic update: So far in 2024, 8.4 million cases have been reported cumulatively, an average of over 300,000 cases per week. This is the year with the highest case count on record. Transmission periods occur in April–May and September–December each year.

items.summary_zh: 巴西2024年奧羅普切熱確診約1.1萬例,分布22州,全國4例死亡
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported about 11,000 confirmed Oropouche fever cases in 2024 across 22 states, with four deaths nationwide.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計約11,000例確診病例,分布於該國22州,以亞馬遜州及聖埃斯皮里圖州為多,病例年齡分布以20-29歲為主;聖埃斯皮里圖州另報告1例死亡個案,為61歲女性,於8/28死亡,為該國今年第4例死亡個案。
items.description_en: Brazil epidemic update: So far in 2024, about 11,000 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 22 states, mainly Amazonas and Espírito Santo, with most patients aged 20–29. Espírito Santo State also reported one death, a 61-year-old woman who died on 28 August; this is the fourth death case in the country this year.

items.headline_zh: 不明原因致死疾病-剛果民主共和國
items.headline_en: Undiagnosed fatal illness – Democratic Republic of the Congo
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省不明疾病累計891例、48死,檢出瘧疾與呼吸道病毒
items.summary_en: DRC's Kwango Province reported 891 cases and 48 deaths from an undiagnosed illness as of 16 December; malaria and respiratory viruses were detected.
items.description_zh: WHO 12/27更新剛果民主共和國寬果省Panzi區疫情,自10月下旬爆發不明原因疾病,截至12/16累計報告891例病例,其中48例死亡,多為5歲以下兒童。依現有實驗室檢驗結果顯示,檢出陽性樣本包含瘧疾及常見呼吸道病毒,顯示瘧疾及呼吸道病毒共同感染引發,另營養不良導致嚴重感染及死亡。WHO評估疫情於該國內、區域及全球傳播風險為低,惟該國營養不良情況日益嚴重,其類疫情可能發生於該國其他地區。
items.description_en: WHO, in an update on 27 December, reported an outbreak in Panzi Health Zone, Kwango Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. An undiagnosed illness broke out in late October; as of 16 December, 891 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 48 deaths, mostly among children under five. Current laboratory results show that the positive samples included malaria and common respiratory viruses, indicating co-infection with malaria and respiratory viruses, with malnutrition leading to severe infection and death. WHO assesses the risk of spread within the country, regionally and globally as low. However, malnutrition in the country is becoming increasingly serious, and similar outbreaks may occur in other parts of the country.

items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦與阿曼首例M痘皆由阿拉伯聯合大公國移入,巴基斯坦為Ib型
items.summary_en: Pakistan and Oman each reported a first mpox case imported from the UAE; Pakistan's case was clade Ib, Oman's clade I (subclade pending).
items.description_zh: WHO於12/23報告巴基斯坦通報由阿拉伯聯合大公國移入該國之首例Ib分支個案,病例為男性,於11月下旬出現症狀就醫確診;阿曼亦通報1例由阿拉伯聯合大公國移入該國之首例I型(待定分支)個案,為男性,11/30出現症狀,12/9確診。
items.description_en: WHO reported on 23 December that Pakistan had notified its first clade Ib case imported from the United Arab Emirates. The patient is a man who developed symptoms in late November, sought medical care and was confirmed. Oman also notified one case of clade I (subclade undetermined) imported from the United Arab Emirates, the first such case in Oman. The patient is a man who developed symptoms on 30 November and was confirmed on 9 December.
items.area_zh: 阿曼,巴基斯坦,阿拉伯聯合大公國

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘迄今12萬712例、至少242死;2024年84國報告27,311例
items.summary_en: Global mpox reached 120,712 confirmed cases since May 2022 and at least 242 deaths; 27,311 cases were reported in 84 countries in 2024.
items.description_zh: 自2022年5月截至今年12/27全球累計128國/地區報告12萬0,712例確診病例,其中至少242例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第52週全球累計84國/地區報告27,311例確診病例,其中非洲區15,130例(本月1,993例)、美洲區6,679例(398)、西太平洋區2,398例(143)、歐洲區2,083例(268)、東地中海區778例(1)及東南亞區243例(7)。
items.description_en: From May 2022 through 27 December this year, 128 countries and territories worldwide have cumulatively reported 120,712 confirmed cases, including at least 242 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 52 this year, 84 countries and territories have reported 27,311 confirmed cases: 15,130 in the African Region (1,993 this month), 6,679 in the Region of the Americas (398), 2,398 in the Western Pacific Region (143), 2,083 in the European Region (268), 778 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region (1) and 243 in the South-East Asia Region (7).

items.summary_zh: 美國H5N1基因定序顯示對人類上呼吸道受體結合力增加,多隻家貓感染死亡
items.summary_en: US sequencing of the Louisiana H5N1 virus found mutations that increase binding to human upper-airway receptors; several pet cats have died after infection.
items.description_zh: 美國12/26公布路易斯安那州病例病毒基因測序結果,該病毒仍屬禽類病毒,與該州鳥類D1.1疫情之病毒相關,亦與現行HPAI A(H5N1) CVV相關,因出現NP A134V、N182K及E186D變異,導致與人類上呼吸道受體結合力增加,尚未發現與已知或疑抗病毒藥物敏感性降低的突變有關。 美國加州洛杉磯郡、聖塔芭芭拉郡及奧勒岡州陸續報告家貓感染禽流感死亡案例,受感染貓隻多出現神經系統或呼吸窘迫症狀,當局研判係因食用受汙染禽肉或生乳感染,該受汙染寵物食品之公司已宣布召回商品。
items.description_en: On 26 December, the United States released gene sequencing results for the Louisiana case. The virus is still an avian virus and is related both to the D1.1 virus causing bird outbreaks in that state and to the current HPAI A(H5N1) candidate vaccine virus (CVV). Because of the NP A134V, N182K and E186D mutations, its binding to human upper-respiratory receptors has increased. No mutations associated with reduced susceptibility to known or suspected antiviral drugs have been found. Domestic cats in Los Angeles County, Santa Barbara County in California, and Oregon State have successively reported fatal avian influenza cases in cats; infected cats mostly showed neurological or respiratory distress symptoms. Authorities believe the infection came from eating contaminated poultry meat or raw milk, and the company that produced the contaminated pet food has announced a product recall.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國新增1例H5人類感染;乳牛場累計901(10)起疫情
items.summary_en: The US reported one new H5 human infection this week; dairy herds have 901 (10) outbreaks across 16 states since March 2024.
items.description_zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週美國新增1例H5人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共10國於2024/4/1~2024/12/23間新增89起H5N1疫情,分別為美國41起、加拿大21起、荷蘭12起、波蘭6起、英國/法國/日本各2起、斯洛伐克/哥倫比亞/以色列各1起。 加拿大於2024/10/9~2024/11/26間新增3起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計16州報告901(10)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州及德州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少6,800例,檢測160例,其中40例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第51週計298個採檢點提供檢測報告,4州52個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  12/12研究表示,在生乳中之HPAI病毒,其RNA於攝氏4度下持續57日仍可檢出且未降解。  評估與建議:  FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
items.description_en: Weekly summary. Human cases: This week the United States reported one new H5 human infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 10 countries reported 89 new H5N1 outbreaks between 1 April and 23 December 2024: United States 41, Canada 21, Netherlands 12, Poland 6, United Kingdom, France and Japan 2 each, and Slovakia, Colombia and Israel 1 each. Canada reported 3 new H5N5 outbreaks between 9 October and 26 November 2024. United States dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy herds have reported 901 (10) outbreaks across 16 states since March this year, mainly concentrated in California, Nevada and Texas. Human infections from cattle: at least 6,800 cases monitored, 160 tested, and 40 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, with fatal cases in cats. Wastewater surveillance: in week 51, 298 sampling sites provided test results, and H5-positive detections were found at 52 sampling sites in 4 states. Other updates: On 12 December, a study reported that HPAI virus in raw milk remained detectable and undegraded for 57 days at 4 °C. Assessment and recommendations: On 20 December, FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment for H5 influenza viruses. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capability. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The infection risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率第49週約13.5%,日本病例連續5週上升,XEC占比上升
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 13.5% in week 49 of 2024; Japan's cases rose for five straight weeks, with XEC's share rising.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第49週(12/2-12/8)全球陽性率約13.5%,陽性率以歐洲區(14.7%)、美洲區(9.3%)及非洲區(7.9%)為高。 日本病例數持續上升,第51週(12/16-12/22)新增22,000餘例,已連續5週增加,報告病例數亦高於去年同期,其中北海道、東北及關東地區病例數顯著增加;東京都以KP.3為主流變異株,惟XEC變異株占比迅速上升,近期占比逾40%,該國新年連續假期將至,預期新冠及流感等呼吸道疫情將持續上升。  WHO更新全球疫情資訊:  全球近28天(10/14-11/10)新增逾20萬例及3,000例死亡,病例數較前28天分別下降39%及36%;住院數及重症數分別新增逾2.2萬例及900例,住院數及重症數較前28天期間分別下降15%及24%。 11月中旬(11/4-11/10) 全球主要流行變異株KP.3.1.1、XEC、JN.1、KP.3占比分別為45.6%、28.4%、13.1%、7.7%,其中變異株XEC占比呈上升趨勢。 WHO於12/23建議各國持續COVID-19疫苗接種,病毒持續演化,更新疫苗抗原以加強對於現有變異株免疫反應,並建議未來疫苗配方中,保留使用單價JN.1譜系變異株作為抗原。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,非洲區、歐洲區及西太平洋區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 49 of 2024 (2–8 December), the global positivity rate was about 13.5%, highest in the European Region (14.7%), the Region of the Americas (9.3%) and the African Region (7.9%). Japan's case numbers continue to rise: over 22,000 new cases were reported in week 51 (16–22 December), the fifth consecutive week of increase, and reported cases are higher than in the same period last year, with marked increases in Hokkaido, Tohoku and Kanto. In Tokyo Metropolis, KP.3 is the main variant, but the share of XEC is rising rapidly and is now over 40%. With the New Year holiday approaching in Japan, respiratory infections including COVID-19 and influenza are expected to keep rising. WHO global update: In the 28 days from 14 October to 10 November, over 200,000 new cases and 3,000 deaths were reported globally, a decrease of 39% in cases and 36% in deaths compared with the previous 28 days. Hospitalisations and severe cases increased by over 22,000 and 900 respectively; compared with the previous 28-day period, hospitalisations fell 15% and severe cases fell 24%. In mid-November (4–10 November), the main global circulating variants KP.3.1.1, XEC, JN.1 and KP.3 accounted for 45.6%, 28.4%, 13.1% and 7.7% respectively, and the XEC share was rising. On 23 December, WHO recommended that countries continue COVID-19 vaccination. As the virus keeps evolving, vaccine antigens should be updated to strengthen immune responses against current variants, and WHO recommends retaining monovalent JN.1-lineage variants as antigens in future vaccine formulations. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen slightly, with slight increases in the African, European and Western Pacific regions, and flat or declining trends elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.headline_zh: 西班牙/葡萄牙-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Spain / Portugal – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 西班牙本土A型肝炎720例,男性15至44歲增幅最大;葡萄牙267例
items.summary_en: Spain reported 720 local hepatitis A cases by 27 November 2024, with the sharpest rise among men aged 15–44; Portugal reported 267 cases, 98 linked to sexual contact.
items.description_zh: 伊比利半島兩國今年病例顯著增加,西班牙截至11/27累計報告720例本土及133例境外移入,分別高於2023年的255例及73例,其中以15-44歲男性族群增幅最為顯著,男同性行為疑為疫情流行原因之一;葡萄牙截至12/1累計報告267例,其中98例與性接觸相關,病例集中於20-49歲男性,該國近期整體疫情雖趨緩,惟南部阿爾加維地區近期報告新疫情,累計報告25例,多數病例為兒童及青少年。
items.description_en: Both Iberian countries have seen a marked increase in cases this year. As of 27 November, Spain had cumulatively reported 720 local and 133 imported cases, higher than the 255 local and 73 imported cases in 2023. The sharpest rise is among men aged 15–44, and sexual contact between men is suspected to be one of the causes of the epidemic. As of 1 December, Portugal had cumulatively reported 267 cases, 98 of which were related to sexual contact, with cases concentrated among men aged 20–49. Although the overall outbreak in the country has recently slowed, the southern Algarve region has reported a new outbreak, with 25 cases cumulatively, most of them children and adolescents.

items.summary_zh: 全球霍亂截至11月24日逾73.3萬例、5,000餘死;南蘇丹與蘇丹擴大
items.summary_en: Global cholera exceeded 733,000 cases and 5,000 deaths by 24 November 2024; outbreaks are expanding in South Sudan and Sudan.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至11/24累計33國報告733,000餘例病例及逾5,000例死亡;分別較去年同期增加37%及27%,病例數以東地中海區、非洲區及東南亞區為多,地區性戰爭衝突、自然災害等因素降低醫療服務資源可近性並加劇爆發疫情,WHO於11月通過審查新疫苗配方及生產流程,疫苗產量達2013年以來新高,以應付目前疫苗短缺之情況,評估全球疫情風險仍為非常高。 非洲地區今年截至12/21累計報告逾219,000例及3,500餘例死亡(CFR: 1.6%),南蘇丹於10月下旬宣布爆發疫情,迄今累計4,700餘例及47例死亡(CFR: 0.9%);蘇丹今年迄今累計49,000餘例及892例死亡(CFR: 1.8%),兩國近期受人道危機及天災影響,疫情持續擴大;迦納、莫三比克、坦尚亞及辛巴威持續報告病例。
items.description_en: WHO reported that globally as of 24 November this year, 33 countries had reported over 733,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths, increases of 37% and 27% respectively over the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian regions. Regional wars and conflicts, and natural disasters, have reduced access to health services and aggravated outbreaks. WHO approved a review of a new vaccine formulation and production process in November, and vaccine output reached its highest level since 2013 to address the current vaccine shortage. The global outbreak risk is still assessed as very high. In Africa, as of 21 December this year, over 219,000 cases and over 3,500 deaths (CFR 1.6%) had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan declared an outbreak in late October; to date, over 4,700 cases and 47 deaths (CFR 0.9%) have been recorded. Sudan has recorded over 49,000 cases and 892 deaths (CFR 1.8%) this year. Both countries are affected by humanitarian crises and natural disasters, and their outbreaks continue to expand. Ghana, Mozambique, Tanzania and Zimbabwe continue to report cases.
items.area_zh: 迦納共和國,莫三比克,南蘇丹共和國,蘇丹,坦尚尼亞,辛巴威

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1;8國共23件cVDPV2陽性樣本;澳洲墨爾本汙水檢出
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported four new WPV1 polio cases; eight countries had 23 cVDPV2-positive environmental samples, and Melbourne wastewater tested positive for VDPV2.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/12-12/18期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為查德4例、奈及利亞3例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增8件WPV1陽性樣本;共8國新增23件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國7件、英國5件、奈及利亞/南蘇丹各3 件、查德2件、喀麥隆/象牙海岸/芬蘭各1件。 澳洲墨爾本於汙水中檢出VDPV2陽性樣本,經檢測可能與海外接種小兒麻痺活性疫苗人員相關,並於維多利亞州境內持續散播,當局表示當地疫苗接種率高且汙水經有效處理,評估傳播風險為低。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 December, Pakistan reported four new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: four in Chad and three in Nigeria. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported eight new WPV1-positive samples. Eight countries reported 23 new cVDPV2-positive samples: seven in Germany, five in the United Kingdom, three each in Nigeria and South Sudan, two in Chad, and one each in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Finland. In Australia, VDPV2-positive samples were detected in wastewater in Melbourne. Testing suggests they may be linked to personnel who received live oral polio vaccine overseas, and the virus continues to spread within Victoria State. Authorities state that vaccination coverage in the area is high and wastewater is effectively treated, and they assess the transmission risk as low.
items.area_zh: 澳大利亞,查德,象牙海岸,芬蘭,德國,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,喀麥隆,南蘇丹共和國,英國
