items.summary_zh: 越南2024年麻疹近5,000例;柬埔寨、加拿大、烏克蘭與摩洛哥亦上升
items.summary_en: Viet Nam has reported nearly 5,000 measles cases in 2024; Cambodia, Canada, Ukraine and Morocco also report rising measles activity.
items.description_zh: 南亞越南今年疫情驟升,截至12/21累計報告近5千例病例,已逾去年病例數百倍,分布以胡志明市佔1,800例最多,目前疫情仍持續,近期北部省份疫情亦有上升趨勢,研判此波疫情為自然疾病週期和低疫苗接種率之結果;柬埔寨今年疫情亦上升,截至12/22累計17省報告375例病例,當局呼籲家長確保孩童接種疫苗。 北美加拿大安大略省今年截至12/18累計報告63例病例,較去年之7例大幅上升,其中1例死亡,病患中有37例與新布藍茲維省麻疹群聚事件有關,多數病例未接種疫苗。 東歐烏克蘭今年截至11月累計報告333例病例,為去年同期之6倍,近期西南部車夫契州疫情上升,當局表示已在控制之中,惟仍呼籲兒童及孕婦接種疫苗。 北非摩洛哥北部丹吉爾-得土安-胡塞馬大區近期疫情上升,已知謝夫沙萬省及得土安省已分別報告50及70例病例,並有至少3例兒童死亡案例。
items.description_en: In South-East Asia, Viet Nam's measles outbreak has surged this year: as of 21 December, nearly 5,000 cases had been reported cumulatively, more than a hundredfold increase over last year's total. Ho Chi Minh City accounts for the largest share, with 1,800 cases. The outbreak is still ongoing, and case numbers have recently been rising in northern provinces too. Authorities attribute this wave to the natural disease cycle and low vaccination coverage. In Cambodia, cases have also risen this year: as of 22 December, 375 cases had been reported cumulatively across 17 provinces, and authorities urge parents to make sure their children are vaccinated. In North America, Ontario, Canada, reported 63 cases cumulatively as of 18 December this year, sharply up from 7 cases last year; one patient died. Of these cases, 37 were linked to the measles cluster in New Brunswick Province, and most cases were unvaccinated. In Eastern Europe, Ukraine reported 333 cases cumulatively as of November this year, six times the same period last year. Cases have recently risen in the south-western Chernivtsi Oblast; authorities say the situation is under control but still urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. In North Africa, cases have risen recently in the Tangier-Tétouan-Al Hoceima region of northern Morocco. Chefchaouen and Tétouan provinces have reported 50 and 70 cases respectively, and at least three child deaths have occurred.
items.area_zh: 柬埔寨,加拿大,摩洛哥,烏克蘭,越南

items.summary_zh: 新加坡2024年百日咳108例、為2023年全年5.7倍;紐西蘭累計1,490例
items.summary_en: Singapore reported 108 pertussis cases by mid-December 2024, 5.7 times its 2023 total; New Zealand reported 1,490 cases, up from 141 in 2023.
items.description_zh: 新加坡今年疫情上升,截至12月中旬累計報告108例病例,為去年全年之5.7倍,當局呼籲兒童、孕婦接種疫苗。 紐西蘭今年疫情驟升,目前單週新增約160例病例,截至12月中旬已累計報告1,490例,去年全年僅141例,病患中1/3為5至14歲青少年,住院率8.7%。
items.description_en: Singapore's cases rose this year: as of mid-December 2024, 108 cases had been reported cumulatively, 5.7 times the full-year total for 2023. Authorities urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. New Zealand's cases have surged: about 160 cases were added in a single week recently, and 1,490 cases had been reported cumulatively as of mid-December 2024, compared with only 141 cases in the whole of 2023. One third of patients were aged 5–14 years, and the hospitalisation rate was 8.7%.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Undiagnosed fatal illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省不明疾病累計592例,致死率約6.2%,瘧疾陽性率高
items.summary_en: DRC's Kwango Province recorded 592 cases of an undiagnosed illness, mostly children, with malaria positive in 86% of PCR tests.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省Panzi區疫情自10月爆發迄今累計報告592例病例,多為兒童,致死率約6.2%,當局12/20表示,病患檢體中,瘧疾於PCR及快篩之陽性率分別為86%及63%,另亦檢出流感、新冠、鼻病毒等呼吸道病毒陽性,其中流感陽性高達28%,顯示本次疫情病患可能係於營養不良狀況下,存在上述呼吸道病毒及瘧疾之合併感染。
items.description_en: In the Panzi Health Zone of Kwango Province, DRC, an outbreak that began in October has cumulatively reported 592 cases, mostly children, with a case fatality rate of about 6.2%. On 20 December, authorities said that among patient samples, malaria was positive in 86% by PCR and 63% by rapid diagnostic test. Other respiratory viruses were also detected, including influenza, COVID-19 and rhinovirus, with influenza positivity as high as 28%. This indicates that patients in this outbreak may have had co-infection with these respiratory viruses and malaria in the context of malnutrition.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大拉布拉多-倫費爾健康區梅毒今年19例,超過過去十年16例
items.summary_en: Canada's Labrador-Grenfell health region has recorded 19 syphilis cases this year, more than the 16 cases in the previous ten years.
items.description_zh: 加拿大紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省拉布拉多-倫費爾健康區爆發疫情,今年迄今累計報告19例病例,該區過去十年僅累計報告16例,目前爆發原因仍在調查中,當局已加強衛教及孕婦篩檢。
items.description_en: An outbreak has occurred in the Labrador-Grenfell Health region of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. This year 19 cases have been reported cumulatively, while the region reported only 16 cases over the past ten years. The cause of the outbreak is still under investigation, and authorities have strengthened health education and prenatal screening for pregnant women.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 巴西-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.summary_zh: 巴西塞阿拉州1歲3個月幼童確診福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎,建議水庫消毒
items.summary_en: Ceará State, Brazil, confirmed the country's first Naegleria fowleri meningoencephalitis case, a toddler; the reservoir is recommended for disinfection.
items.description_zh: 巴西東北部塞阿拉州12/11新增報告1例病例,為該國經檢驗確診之首例個案,病患為1歲3個月大幼童,居住於農村聚落且未曾接觸野外水源,當局已於病患家中蓄水池檢出病原,由於水源來自當地水庫,故建議水庫進行消毒,並進行病例回溯,迄無發現其他病例。
items.description_en: In Ceará State in northeastern Brazil, one case was newly reported on 11 December. It is the country's first laboratory-confirmed case of this infection, in a child aged 1 year and 3 months who lives in a rural settlement and had no contact with natural water sources. Authorities detected the pathogen in the water storage tank at the child's home. Because the water comes from a local reservoir, they recommend disinfecting the reservoir and conducting case tracing. No other cases have been found.

items.headline_zh: 盧安達-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 盧安達2024年馬堡病毒疫情結束,累計66例、15死,近8成為醫療工作者
items.summary_en: WHO declared Rwanda's Marburg outbreak over on 20 December 2024; 66 cases and 15 deaths were recorded, nearly 80% among healthcare workers.
items.description_zh: WHO12/20宣布盧安達疫情結束,於最後1例病例檢測陰性後,已經連續42日(2倍潛伏期)未新增報告病例。此波疫情於9/27爆發,截至10/30累計報告66例病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:23%),病患中近7成為男性,且近8成為醫療工作者,分布集中於3行政區;WHO評估,本次疫情來源為果蝠,未來仍可能透過接觸動物或患者體液傳播,目前該國國內/區域/全球風險均為低。
items.description_en: On 20 December, WHO declared the end of the Rwanda outbreak: 42 consecutive days (twice the incubation period) had passed without any new case reported since the last case tested negative. The outbreak began on 27 September; as of 30 October, 66 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 15 deaths (CFR 23%). Nearly 70% of patients were men, and nearly 80% were healthcare workers, with cases concentrated in three administrative districts. WHO assesses that the source of this outbreak was fruit bats, and that transmission through contact with animals or patients' bodily fluids may still occur in future. The national, regional and global risk for the country is currently assessed as low.

items.summary_zh: 比利時12月18日首例Ib型M痘,病患曾赴非洲疫區,ECDC評估風險低
items.summary_en: Belgium reported its first clade Ib mpox case on 18 December, an adult who had travelled to Africa; ECDC rates the further spread risk as low.
items.description_zh: 比利時12/18報告首例Ib型病例,病患已成年,發病前曾前往非洲疫區國家旅行,並與疑病例者有性接觸,返國後無高風險接觸者;ECDC評估進一步傳播風險仍低。目前已報告Ib疫情之非洲以外國家包括:加拿大/德國/印度/瑞典/泰國/英國/美國/比利時。
items.description_en: On 18 December, Belgium reported its first clade Ib case, an adult who had travelled to an African country with an outbreak before symptom onset and who had had sexual contact with a suspected case. There were no high-risk contacts after returning home. ECDC assesses the risk of further transmission as low. Countries outside Africa that have so far reported clade Ib outbreaks include Canada, Germany, India, Sweden, Thailand, the United Kingdom, the United States and Belgium.

items.summary_zh: 美國愛荷華州新增禽場相關H5輕症,2024年累計65例,39例與乳牛場有關
items.summary_en: The US reported an Iowa poultry-linked H5 case on 23 December, bringing 65 cases in 2024, 39 of them linked to dairy farms.
items.description_zh: 美國12/23公布愛荷華州新增1例禽場相關H5病例,已知為輕症,其他流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布65例病例,其中39例與乳牛場相關,23例與禽場相關,1例具動物暴露史,2例不明,分布於10州,以加州(36)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)最多。
items.description_en: On 23 December, the United States announced one new H5 case linked to a poultry farm in Iowa State; the case is known to be mild, and other epidemiological information was not specified. In total in 2024, the United States has announced 65 cases: 39 linked to dairy farms, 23 to poultry farms, 1 with animal exposure and 2 unknown, spread across 10 states, with the most in California (36), Washington (11) and Colorado (10).

items.summary_zh: 印度德里最近一週登革熱319例,今年累計5,701例,低於去年同期6,727例
items.summary_en: Delhi, India, reported 319 dengue cases in the latest week; 5,701 cases so far in 2024, below 6,727 in the same period of 2023.
items.description_zh: 印度疫情更新,德里最近1週報告319例病例,於9月已報告3例死亡,今年迄今累計5,701例,低於去年同期的6,727例。
items.description_en: India epidemic update: In Delhi, 319 cases were reported in the most recent week, and 3 deaths had been reported in September. So far this year, 5,701 cases have been reported cumulatively, lower than the 6,727 cases in the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲2024年西尼羅熱本土1,436例、125死,義大利455例最多
items.summary_en: Europe reported 1,436 locally acquired West Nile fever cases and 125 deaths as of 4 December 2024, with Italy recording the most at 455.
items.description_zh: 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至12/4累計19國報告1,436例本土病例,分布以義大利(455)、希臘(217)、西班牙(138)為多;累計報告125例死亡病例,以希臘(34)、義大利(21)、羅馬亞(20)為多。今年累計病例數高於去年同期(802),多為65歲以上男性。
items.description_en: Europe epidemic update: As of 4 December this year, 19 countries had reported 1,436 locally acquired cases, mainly in Italy (455), Greece (217) and Spain (138). A cumulative 125 deaths have been reported, mainly in Greece (34), Italy (21) and Romania (20). The cumulative case count this year is higher than the same period last year (802), and most cases are men aged over 65.
items.area_zh: 希臘,義大利,羅馬尼亞,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 印度德里2024年截至11月30日瘧疾766例,為近5年最高
items.summary_en: Delhi, India, recorded 766 malaria cases as of 30 November 2024, the highest in five years.
items.description_zh: 印度疫情更新,德里今年截至11/30累計766例病例,病例數為近5年來最高。
items.description_en: India epidemic update: In Delhi, 766 cases of malaria had been reported as of 30 November this year, the highest in five years.

items.summary_zh: 全球2024年截至11月30日屈公病約48萬例、逾200死,巴西占40萬餘例
items.summary_en: Globally, 23 countries reported about 480,000 chikungunya cases and over 200 deaths as of 30 November 2024, mostly in Brazil.
items.description_zh: 全球今年截至11/30累計23國報告約48萬例病例,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,其中逾200例死亡;美洲病例數以巴西40萬7,000餘例為多(203例死亡),其次為巴拉圭3,000餘例;亞洲病例數以印度6萬9,000餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦5,000餘例。 印度疫情更新,德里今年截至11/30累計226例病例,病例數為最近5年來最高。 孟加拉疫情更新,今年迄今累計67例病例,主要分布於該國首都達卡。
items.description_en: Globally, 23 countries had reported about 480,000 chikungunya cases as of 30 November this year, distributed across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe, with over 200 deaths. The Americas reported the most cases, with 407,000+ in Brazil (203 deaths), followed by over 3,000 in Paraguay. In Asia, India reported over 69,000 cases, followed by over 5,000 in Pakistan. India epidemic update: Delhi has recorded 226 cases so far this year as of 30 November, the highest in the past five years. Bangladesh epidemic update: 67 cases have been reported so far this year, mainly in the capital, Dhaka.
items.area_zh: 孟加拉,巴西,印度,巴基斯坦,巴拉圭共和國

items.summary_zh: 非洲M痘截至12月16日65,947例、1,239死,LC16疫苗將陸續到貨
items.summary_en: Africa recorded 65,947 mpox cases and 1,239 deaths in 2024 as of 16 December; the first 50,000 LC16 doses are expected the following week.
items.description_zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至12/16累計20國報告65,947例病例,其中14,394例確診,1,239例死亡(CFR:1.88%),以剛果民主共和國報告10,533例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地2,402例次之,烏干達925例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 ACDC 12/19表示,預計下週取得首批5萬劑LC16疫苗,2月起並將陸續到貨300萬劑,該疫苗可用於1歲以上兒童,可填補目前兒童疫苗接種無法涵蓋之族群。
items.description_en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 16 December this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 65,947 cases cumulatively, including 14,394 confirmed and 1,239 deaths (CFR 1.88%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,533 confirmed cases, is the most severely affected; Burundi, with 2,402 cases, ranks second, and Uganda, with 925 cases, shows a marked increase. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each. Africa CDC stated on 19 December that it expects to receive the first 50,000 doses of LC16 vaccine the following week, with 3 million doses to arrive in batches from February. The vaccine can be used in children over one year old, filling a gap in populations not covered by current childhood vaccination.
items.area_zh: 蒲隆地,剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 美國今年H5累計64例,加州36例;每週廢水陽性站點由14增至60
items.summary_en: The US has announced 64 H5 cases in 2024, 39 linked to dairy cattle, and wastewater positive sites rose from 14 to 60 since October.
items.description_zh: 美國12/20公布加州新增2例乳牛場相關、威斯康辛州新增1例禽場相關病例,其他流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布64例病例,其中39例與乳牛業相關,22例與家禽養殖業相關,1例具動物暴露史,2例不明,分布於加州(36)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、奧勒岡州、德州、密蘇里州、路易斯安那州及威斯康辛州(各1)。 美國加州洛杉磯郡12/18表示,除先前2起家貓感染H5禽流感案例外,又新增3件來自不同家庭案之家貓疑案例,感染源推測為生乳或生肉,相關接觸者已匡列追蹤並預先投藥;該國自2022年迄今已報告56例家貓感染H5N1案例。 美國自10月底起每週廢水檢測之陽性站點數量持續上升,自10月底之14站上升至12月初之60站,其中佛羅里達州、德拉瓦州、緬因州和紐澤西州廢水檢出陽性,惟未曾報告禽場或牛隻疫情。
items.description_en: On 20 December, the United States announced two new dairy-cattle-related cases in California and one poultry-related case in Wisconsin; other epidemiological information was not specified. This year the United States has cumulatively announced 64 cases: 39 linked to dairy cattle farming, 22 to poultry farming, 1 with animal exposure and 2 unknown, spread across California (36), Washington (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Oregon, Texas, Missouri, Louisiana and Wisconsin (1 each). On 18 December, Los Angeles County, California, reported that in addition to two earlier domestic cat H5 avian influenza cases, three new suspected cases had been identified in cats from different households. The likely source is raw milk or raw meat; close contacts have been traced and given preventive medication. The country has reported 56 H5N1 cases in domestic cats since 2022. Since late October, the number of wastewater sampling sites testing positive each week in the United States has continued to rise, from 14 at the end of October to 60 in early December. Wastewater in Florida, Delaware, Maine and New Jersey tested positive, but no poultry or cattle outbreaks have been reported in those states.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國本週新增4例H5N1人類感染;乳牛場累計875(43)起疫情
items.summary_en: The US reported four new H5N1 human infections this week; dairy herds have 875 (43) outbreaks across 16 states since March 2024.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  本週美國新增4例H5N1人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共18國於2023/12/3~2024/12/16間新增293起H5N1疫情,分別為美國157起、印度36起、荷蘭/南韓18起、日本17起、英國8起、波蘭7起、臺灣/斯洛維亞/捷克各6起、德國4起、墨西哥/哥倫比亞/丹麥各2起、羅馬亞/福克蘭群島/匈牙利/土耳其各1起。 挪威於2024/12/19新增1起H5N5疫情。 蘇丹於2024/3/31新增1起未分型疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計16州報告875(43)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州及德州。USDA 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少6,670例,檢測155例,其中39例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。CDC、CDC 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第50週計337個採檢點提供檢測報告,5州49個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en: Human cases: This week the United States reported four new H5N1 human infections. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 18 countries reported 293 new H5N1 outbreaks between 3 December 2023 and 16 December 2024: United States 157, India 36, Netherlands and South Korea 18 each, Japan 17, United Kingdom 8, Poland 7, Taiwan, Slovenia and Czechia 6 each, Germany 4, Mexico, Colombia and Denmark 2 each, and Romania, the Falkland Islands, Hungary and Turkey 1 each. Norway reported one new H5N5 outbreak on 19 December 2024. Sudan reported one new untyped outbreak on 31 March 2024. United States dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy herds have reported 875 (43) outbreaks across 16 states since March this year, mainly concentrated in California, Nevada and Texas (USDA). Human infections from cattle: at least 6,670 cases monitored, 155 tested, and 39 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms) (CDC). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, with fatal cases in cats. Wastewater surveillance: in week 50, 337 sampling sites provided test results, and H5-positive detections were found at 49 sampling sites in 5 states.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率第48週約13.4%,日本病例連續4週上升,XEC占比快速增加
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 13.4% in week 48 of 2024; Japan's cases rose for four straight weeks, and XEC is growing quickly.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第48週(11/25-12/1)全球陽性率約13.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(14.4%)、美洲區(9.7%)及非洲區(8.1%)為高。 中國公布11月新冠感染疫情,新增35例重症及11例死亡,近期發燒門診就診量持平,類流感病例佔比略升,新冠陽性率處低點,以XDV及JN.1為主流變異株。 日本病例數連續4週上升,第50週(12/9-12/15)病例數逾20,000例,住院數亦持續增加,其中北海道及東北地區病例數快速增加;檢驗報告顯示以KP.3.1.1及KP.3.3為主流變異株,惟XEC變異株近期快速上升,佔比已達10%以上。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,非洲區及歐洲區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 48 of 2024 (25 November–1 December), the global positivity rate was about 13.4%, highest in the European Region (14.4%), the Region of the Americas (9.7%) and the African Region (8.1%). China reported 35 new severe COVID-19 cases and 11 deaths in November. Recently, fever clinic visits have been flat and the proportion of influenza-like cases has risen slightly, while the COVID-19 positivity rate is at a low point; XDV and JN.1 are the main circulating variants. Japan's case numbers have risen for four consecutive weeks; in week 50 (9–15 December), over 20,000 cases were reported, hospitalisations also continued to rise, and the Hokkaido and Tohoku regions saw rapid increases. Test reports show that KP.3.1.1 and KP.3.3 are the main variants, but XEC has risen rapidly recently and now accounts for over 10%. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen slightly, with slight increases in the African and European regions and flat or declining trends elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

items.headline_zh: 中國/英國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 中國諾羅病毒疫情近300起,較去年減36.7%;英格蘭實驗室報告為往年2倍以上
items.summary_en: China reported nearly 300 norovirus outbreaks by 4 November 2024, 36.7% fewer than last year; England's lab reports were over twice the five-season average.
items.description_zh: 中國今年截至11/4,全國累計報告諾羅病毒腸胃炎疫情近300起,較去年同期減少36.7%,惟高於2019年同期,超過8成為校園通報,以中小學及幼教機構為主;GII.17為主要基因型,佔整體60%以上,當局表示需密切關注病毒變異情形。 英國英蘭地區於第47週至第48週(11/18-12/1) 諾羅病毒實驗室報告總數為過去5個流行季同期平均的2倍以上,自2024-2025流行季以來,醫院向通報系統報告疫情數量比過去5個流行季平均高出27.4%,經檢驗多數樣本基因型為GII.17,佔整體60%以上;蘇蘭地區第49週(截至12/8)累計報告1,718例,高於去年同期1,550例,亦高於2015-2019年同期平均1,208例。
items.description_en: China: As of 4 November this year, nationwide norovirus gastroenteritis outbreaks totalled nearly 300, 36.7% fewer than the same period last year but higher than the same period in 2019. Over 80% were reported from schools, mainly primary and secondary schools and early childhood education institutions. GII.17 is the main genotype, accounting for over 60% of cases, and authorities say the virus's variation needs close monitoring. United Kingdom: In England, norovirus laboratory reports for weeks 47 to 48 (18 November–1 December) were more than twice the average of the same period over the past five seasons. Since the 2024–2025 season began, the number of outbreaks reported by hospitals to the surveillance system has been 27.4% higher than the five-season average. Most samples tested were genotype GII.17, accounting for over 60% overall. In Scotland, 1,718 cases were reported cumulatively by week 49 (as of 8 December), higher than the 1,550 in the same period last year and the 2015–2019 same-period average of 1,208.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1,奈及利亞與查德新增7例cVDPV2,歐洲5國檢出
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported three new WPV1 polio cases; Nigeria and Chad reported seven cVDPV2 cases, and five European countries have detected cVDPV2 in samples.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/5-12/11期間,巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為奈及利亞5例、查德2例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增15件WPV1陽性樣本;共5國新增11件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為巴勒斯坦6件、吉布地2件、阿爾及利亞/象牙海岸/日各1件。 歐洲更新cVDPV2陽性樣本資訊,英國於12/10發布於倫敦、南部及中部地區檢出4件陽性樣本,德國新增6件陽性樣本,所有樣本皆於11月採集;歐洲迄今累計5國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,經檢驗該地區樣本皆與奈及利亞贊法拉州(Zamfara)病毒株相關,ECDC表示病毒可能由流行地區多次移入或一次移入後於歐洲社區傳播。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 5–11 December, Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: five in Nigeria and two in Chad. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 15 new WPV1-positive samples. Five countries reported 11 new cVDPV2-positive samples: six in Palestine, two in Djibouti, and one each in Algeria, Côte d'Ivoire and Niger. Europe has updated its cVDPV2-positive sample information: the United Kingdom reported on 10 December that four positive samples had been detected in London and in the southern and central regions, and Germany reported six new positive samples; all samples were collected in November. So far, five European countries have detected cVDPV2-positive samples. Testing shows that the samples in this region are all related to the virus strain from Zamfara State, Nigeria. ECDC says the virus may have been introduced to Europe through repeated introductions from endemic areas, or through a single introduction followed by community spread.

items.summary_zh: 美國路易斯安那州首例H5重症住院,加州因乳牛感染宣布進入緊急狀態
items.summary_en: Louisiana's H5 case, the US's first severe case, is hospitalised after backyard poultry exposure; California declared an emergency over cattle infections.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情更新:  路易斯安那州病例為美國首例重症病例,目前住院中,已知係因接觸後院家禽感染,病毒屬D1.1分支,當局表示整體風險不變,惟呼籲有飼養禽畜者、獵人或鳥類愛好者等,均應採取預防措施。 加州宣布,由於乳牛感染區域已自中央谷地區向外擴散至南加州,故自12/18起進入緊急狀態,以確保擁有快速應對疫情所需資源和靈活性,並以最大檢測和監測系統為基礎,保護公眾健康,支援農業,包括提供禽畜業者足夠防護設備,並確保民眾能夠獲得準確及最新的資訊。另評估對一般民眾風險仍然很低。
items.description_en: US epidemic update: The Louisiana case, the first severe case in the United States, is currently hospitalised; it is known to have been caused by contact with backyard poultry, and the virus belongs to clade D1.1. Authorities state that the overall risk is unchanged, but urge people who keep poultry or livestock, hunters and bird enthusiasts to take preventive measures. California announced that because the cattle infection has spread from the Central Valley to southern California, it entered a state of emergency from 18 December, to secure the resources and flexibility needed to respond rapidly. Based on maximum testing and surveillance, the state aims to protect public health and support agriculture, including providing adequate protective equipment to poultry and livestock producers and ensuring the public has access to accurate, up-to-date information. The risk to the general public is still assessed as very low.

items.summary_zh: 四川省11月流感2.6萬例,為10月3.4倍;泰國流感高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Sichuan reported 26,000 influenza cases in November, 3.4 times October; Thailand's influenza activity is above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 中國四川省11月報告2.6萬例病例,為10月份之3.4倍,整體而言南方流感活動度持平,北方10月起已逐漸上升;泰國整體流感疫情上升,高於去年同期,其中又以北部及東北地區升幅較明顯,當局呼籲民眾注意衛生並接種疫苗。
items.description_en: China: In November, Sichuan Province reported 26,000 cases, 3.4 times the number in October. Overall, influenza activity in southern China has been flat, while in northern China it has been rising since October. Thailand: Influenza activity has risen overall and is higher than the same period last year, with particularly marked increases in the northern and northeastern regions. Authorities urge the public to pay attention to hygiene and get vaccinated.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),泰國

items.summary_zh: 非洲細菌性腦膜炎截至10月17日7,086例、492死,奈及利亞3,302例
items.summary_en: Africa reported 7,086 bacterial meningitis cases and 492 deaths as of 17 October 2024, with Nigeria accounting for 3,302 cases.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至10/17累計4國報告7,086例病例,其中1,469例確診,492例死亡(CFR:6.94%);流行國家中,以奈及利亞報告3,302例最為嚴峻,另有日報告2,781例、馬利707例及中非共和國296例。
items.description_en: Africa epidemic update: As of 17 October this year, four countries had reported 7,086 cases cumulatively, including 1,469 confirmed and 492 deaths (CFR 6.94%). Among the affected countries, Nigeria reported the most, with 3,302 cases; Niger reported 2,781, Mali 707 and the Central African Republic 296.
items.area_zh: 中非共和國,尼日,奈及利亞,馬利

items.summary_zh: 非洲白喉截至11月22日23,040例、588死;越南高平省1名11歲女童死亡
items.summary_en: Africa recorded 23,040 diphtheria cases and 588 deaths to 22 November 2024, with Nigeria most affected; an 11-year-old girl died in Viet Nam.
items.description_zh: 非洲今年截至11/22累計報告23,040例病例,其中11,114例確診,588例死亡(CFR:5.26%),以奈及利亞報告16,747例(461例死亡)最為嚴峻,另有幾內亞報告2,869例、查德2,625例、日746例、茅利塔亞及加彭各數十例亦正處流行期,其中,查德近期疫情明顯上升;非洲區去年報告2.7萬例病例。 越南北部高平省11月新增1例死亡病例,病患為11歲女孩,於11月中旬出現咳嗽及發燒症狀,一週後死亡,當局已進行接觸者隔離及校園消毒。
items.description_en: Africa reported 23,040 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 November, including 11,114 confirmed and 588 deaths (CFR 5.26%). Nigeria has the most severe situation, with 16,747 cases (461 deaths). Guinea reported 2,869 cases, Chad 2,625 and Niger 746, while Mauritania and Gabon each reported several dozen cases; all are in epidemic periods. Chad's recent outbreak has risen markedly. The African Region reported 27,000 cases last year. Viet Nam: In November, Cao Bằng Province in northern Viet Nam reported one new death, an 11-year-old girl who developed cough and fever in mid-November and died a week later. Authorities have quarantined contacts and disinfected the school.
items.area_zh: 查德,加彭,幾內亞,茅利塔尼亞,尼日,奈及利亞,越南

items.summary_zh: 德國北萊茵-西發利亞邦Ib型M痘家庭群聚,3名同住家人感染
items.summary_en: North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, reported a clade Ib mpox household cluster on 16 December: three household members, including two children, were infected.
items.description_zh: 德國北萊茵-西發利亞邦12/16報告1起Ib型家庭群聚,指標案例曾至非洲旅行,返國後傳染給3名同住家人,包括2名兒童,病情均輕微,當局已隔離病患並追蹤相關接觸者,學校並已改為遠距學習,迄無進一步傳播。
items.description_en: On 16 December, North Rhine-Westphalia State, Germany, reported one clade Ib household cluster. The index case had travelled to Africa and, after returning home, infected three household members, including two children; all cases were mild. Authorities have isolated the patient and are tracing related contacts, and the school has switched to remote learning. No further transmission has been found.

items.summary_zh: 美國路易斯安那州新增1例H5病例,2024年累計61例,37例與乳牛業相關
items.summary_en: Louisiana reported one new case with exposure to sick animals on 17 December; the US total for 2024 reached 61, with 37 linked to dairy cattle.
items.description_zh: 美國12/17公布路易斯安納州新增1例病例,病患具患病動物接觸史,型別及其他流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布61例病例,其中37例與乳牛業相關,21例與家禽養殖業相關,1例具動物暴露史,2例不明,分布於加州(34)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、奧勒岡州、德州、密蘇里州及路易斯安那州(各1)。
items.description_en: On 17 December, the United States announced one new case in Louisiana State with exposure to sick animals; the type and other epidemiological information were not specified. This year the United States has cumulatively announced 61 cases: 37 linked to dairy cattle, 21 to poultry, 1 with animal exposure and 2 unknown, spread across California (34), Washington (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Oregon, Texas, Missouri and Louisiana (1 each).

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Undiagnosed fatal illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省不明疾病檢驗確認為瘧疾,營養不良加劇,累計592例
items.summary_en: DRC's Kwango Province outbreak of unexplained deaths: lab results identify malaria, malnutrition worsens it, and 592 cases have been reported.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省Panzi區不明原因疫情更新,該國12/17公布實驗室檢驗結果,此波疫情為瘧疾,並因患者營養不良以致疫情更為嚴峻,目前累計報告592例病例,致死率約6.2%;WHO表示迄仍有檢體樣本檢測中,後續將有更完整的病因報告。
items.description_en: There is an update on the unexplained outbreak in Panzi Health Zone, Kwango Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 17 December, the country released laboratory results showing that this wave is malaria, and that malnutrition in patients has made the outbreak more severe. A cumulative 592 cases have been reported, with a case fatality rate of about 6.2%. WHO says some specimens are still being tested, and a more complete report on the cause will follow.

items.headline_zh: 奈及利亞-不明原因致死疾病
items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞卡杜納州軍事學校12月初不明疫情,多名學生住院,至少2死
items.summary_en: An unidentified illness at a military school in Nigeria's Kaduna State in early December hospitalised several students and killed at least two.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞北部卡杜納州一所軍事學校12月初爆發不明疫情,據報導,已有多名學生住院,至少2例死亡,其中第一例死亡病例之死因為心血管相關病變。
items.description_en: In Kaduna State in northern Nigeria, an unidentified outbreak occurred at a military school in early December. Media reports say several students have been hospitalised and at least two have died; the cause of death of the first fatal case was a cardiovascular condition.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達西部卡左區12月12日新增2例炭疽病死亡,皆為屠宰人員
items.summary_en: Two anthrax deaths were newly reported on 12 December in Uganda's Kazo district, both slaughterhouse workers who ate contaminated meat.
items.description_zh: 烏干達西部大區卡左區於12/12新增2例死亡病例,病患均為屠宰人員,並於食用受汙染肉品約5日後發病,當局呼籲民眾避免食用來源不明肉品。
items.description_en: In Kazo district of Western Region, Uganda, two new deaths were reported on 12 December. Both patients were slaughterhouse workers who fell ill about five days after eating contaminated meat. Authorities urge people to avoid eating meat of unknown origin.

items.headline_zh: 斯里蘭卡/巴拿馬-鉤端螺旋體病
items.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡賈夫納市鉤端螺旋體病58例、8死;巴拿馬科克萊省63例
items.summary_en: Jaffna, Sri Lanka, reported 58 leptospirosis cases and 8 deaths by 16 December; Coclé Province, Panama, recorded 63 cases.
items.description_zh: 斯里蘭卡北部省賈夫納市疫情上升,截至12/16累計報告58例病例,其中8例死亡;該國今年迄今累計報告1.2萬例,約200例死亡。 巴拿馬中部科克萊省今年截至12/7累計報告63例病例,其中1例死亡,當局呼籲民眾接觸汙水,應注意防護措施,並注意防鼠及飲水衛生。
items.description_en: Sri Lanka: Cases are rising in Jaffna municipality in the Northern Province; as of 16 December, 58 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths. Sri Lanka has reported 12,000 cases this year cumulatively, with about 200 deaths. Panama: In Coclé Province in central Panama, 63 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 7 December this year, including 1 death. Authorities urge people who come into contact with sewage to take protective measures, and to pay attention to rodent control and drinking-water hygiene.
items.area_zh: 巴拿馬共和國,斯里蘭卡

items.summary_zh: 越南2024年狂犬病死亡80例,高於近5年平均70例,感染多來自犬貓
items.summary_en: Viet Nam recorded 80 rabies deaths as of 13 December 2024, above the five-year average of 70; most infections came from dogs and cats.
items.description_zh: 越南今年截至12/13累計33省市報告80例死亡病例,高於近5年平均(70例),其中以中南部平順省、多樂省及義安省最多,該國感染來源以犬貓為主,推測放養犬貓眾多且未接種疫苗可能為主要原因。
items.description_en: As of 13 December this year, 33 provinces and cities in Viet Nam had reported 80 rabies deaths cumulatively, higher than the five-year average of 70. The highest numbers were in Bình Thuận, Đắk Lắk and Nghệ An provinces in the central and south-central regions. Infection sources were mainly dogs and cats, and authorities presume that the large numbers of free-roaming dogs and cats that have not been vaccinated are the main cause.

items.summary_en: Maine reported 3,035 Lyme disease cases as of 3 December 2024, above the 2,943 recorded in all of 2023, with authorities citing a warm winter.
items.description_zh: 美國緬因州疫情更新,今年截至12/3累計報告3,035例病例,高於去年全年共2,943例,當局表示暖冬氣候造成病例數上升。
items.description_en: Maine State, United States, has updated its epidemic information: as of 3 December this year, 3,035 cases had been reported cumulatively, higher than the 2,943 cases reported in the whole of last year. Authorities say that a warm winter climate has contributed to the increase in cases.

items.summary_zh: 美國佛州2024年本土登革熱74例;古巴13省快速蔓延,已見6例重症
items.summary_en: Florida reported 74 local dengue cases in 2024; Cuba's outbreak is spreading rapidly across 13 provinces, with six severe cases found.
items.description_zh: 美國佛州疫情更新,於12月第1週新增4例本土病例,今年迄今累計74例,主要分布於邁阿密-戴德郡,以第3型血清型為多;該國今年迄今累計90例本土病例。 古巴疫情正於13個省份迅速蔓延,大量患者住院治療,其中,已發現6例重症病例,同時,奧羅普切熱亦在該國15個省份流行,大多數病例皆居家治療,惟登革熱和奧羅普切熱的臨床表現非常相,致民眾誤解其感染之疾病,而衍生重症。
items.description_en: Florida State, United States: In the first week of December, four new local cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total for 2024 to 74, mainly in Miami-Dade County, predominantly serotype 3. The country has reported 90 local cases cumulatively in 2024. Cuba: The outbreak is spreading rapidly across 13 provinces, with many patients hospitalised, and six severe cases have been identified. Oropouche fever is also circulating in 15 provinces of the country. Most of these cases are treated at home. However, the clinical presentations of dengue and Oropouche fever are very similar, which leads people to misidentify their infection and can result in severe illness.

items.summary_zh: 南蘇丹西北部阿維爾兒童瘧疾6至9月每週約400例,高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Child malaria cases in Aweil, north-western South Sudan, reached about 400 a week from June to September 2024, above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 南蘇丹疫情更新,近3個月該國西北部阿維爾之兒童病例數呈上升趨勢,6-9月每週報告約400例病例,較去年同期為高,當局推動疫苗接種及相關防治措施,希望能控制疫情。
items.description_en: South Sudan epidemic update: Over the past three months, child malaria cases in Aweil, in the north-west of the country, have shown an upward trend. From June to September, about 400 cases were reported each week, higher than the same period last year. Authorities are promoting vaccination and related control measures, hoping to bring the outbreak under control.

items.summary_zh: 非洲M痘截至11月29日62,789例、1,204死,剛果民主共和國最多
items.summary_en: Africa recorded 62,789 mpox cases and 1,204 deaths as of 29 November 2024, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo most affected.
items.description_zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至11/29累計20國報告62,789例病例,其中13,848例確診,1,204例死亡(CFR:1.85%),以剛果民主共和國報告10,158例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地2,392例次之,烏干達784例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 ACDC表示,上週新增病例數顯著增加,仍以剛果民主共和國為多,另自7月中旬以來,Ib型的檢出量持續穩定上升。
items.description_en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 29 November this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 62,789 cases cumulatively, including 13,848 confirmed and 1,204 deaths (CFR 1.85%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,158 confirmed cases, is the most severely affected, followed by Burundi with 2,392 cases; Uganda, with 784 cases, shows a marked increase. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each. Africa CDC stated that case numbers rose significantly last week, still concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; since mid-July, detections of clade Ib have continued to rise steadily.
items.area_zh: 蒲隆地,剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: 美國路易斯安那州12月13日首例H5N1人類推定病例住院,疑接觸感染禽鳥
items.summary_en: Louisiana reported its first presumptive human H5N1 case on 13 December; the patient is hospitalised after suspected contact with infected birds.
items.description_zh: 美國12/13公布加州新增2例與牛隻相關病例,型別及流病相關資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布60例病例,其中37例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,2例不明,分布於加州(34)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。 美國路易斯安那州衛生部於12/13公告,發現該州首例H5N1人類(推定)個案,目前住院中,感染源為疑接觸感染之禽鳥。
items.description_en: On 13 December, the United States announced two new cattle-related cases in California; the type and other epidemiological information were not specified. This year the United States has cumulatively announced 60 cases: 37 linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 2 unknown, spread across California (34), Washington (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each). The Louisiana Department of Health announced on 13 December the state's first presumptive human H5N1 case; the patient is hospitalised, and the source of infection is suspected to be contact with infected birds.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國新增2例H9N2人類感染;美國乳牛場累計832(114)起疫情
items.summary_en: China reported two new H9N2 human infections this week; US dairy herds have 832 (114) outbreaks across 16 states since March 2024.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  本週中國新增2例H9N2人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共16國於2024/10/10~2024/12/11間新增133起H5N1疫情,分別為美國54起、義大利17起、荷蘭14起、德國12起、匈牙利7起、英國6起、奧地利5起、波蘭4起、哥倫比亞/法國/加拿大各3起、葡萄牙/瑞士/愛爾蘭/日本/丹麥各1起。 共3國於2024/11/20~2024/11/29間新增4起H5N5疫情,分別為冰島2起、挪威/英國各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計16(1*)州報告832(114)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。*內華達州USDA 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少6,050例,檢測152例,其中37例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。CDC、CDC 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第48週計317個採檢點提供檢測報告,11州60個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國亞利桑那州馬里科帕郡12/11宣布一所動物園疑爆發H5N1禽流感疫情,感染動物包括老虎、獵豹、山獅及三隻不同種之鳥類(水雞/草雁/翠鳥)等,除老虎外,均已死亡,該園已停止讓遊客接觸動物,當局評估民眾及動物園遊客感染風險仍低。 美國加州洛杉磯郡12/12新增2起家貓感染H5禽流感案例,案貓均出現發燒、食慾降低及神經系統症狀,並已死亡,發病前均曾飲用Raw Farm生乳(先前已被要求召回),當局呼籲民眾避免食用生乳,亦應避免餵食寵物。 美國農業部12/6發布聯邦命令,內容包括:1.所有州別強制進行生乳樣本檢測;2.受影響牛群之擁有者須配合分享流行病學資訊;3.私人或州立實驗室須通報陽性檢驗結果。 12/5研究表示,從德州人類H5N1感染病例之病毒(A/Texas/37/2024)發現,HA蛋白中之Q226L突變,可使病毒與人類受體結合,且N224K突變之存在將增強其結合力。
items.description_en: Human cases: This week China reported two new H9N2 human infections. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 16 countries reported 133 new H5N1 outbreaks between 10 October and 11 December 2024: United States 54, Italy 17, Netherlands 14, Germany 12, Hungary 7, United Kingdom 6, Austria 5, Poland 4, Colombia, France and Canada 3 each, and Portugal, Switzerland, Ireland, Japan and Denmark 1 each. Three countries reported 4 new H5N5 outbreaks between 20 and 29 November 2024: Iceland 2, and Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. United States dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy herds have reported 832 (114) outbreaks across 16 (1*) states since March this year, mainly concentrated in California. *Nevada State, per USDA. Human infections from cattle: at least 6,050 cases monitored, 152 tested, and 37 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms) (CDC). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, with fatal cases in cats. Wastewater surveillance: in week 48, 317 sampling sites provided test results, and H5-positive detections were found at 60 sampling sites in 11 states. Other updates: On 11 December, Maricopa County in Arizona State announced a suspected H5N1 avian influenza outbreak at a zoo. Infected animals included tigers, cheetahs, mountain lions and three bird species (moorhens, grass geese and kingfishers). Apart from the tiger, the animals have died. The zoo has stopped allowing visitors to touch animals, and authorities assess the risk to the public and zoo visitors as low. On 12 December, Los Angeles County, California, reported two new domestic cat H5 avian influenza cases. Both cats developed fever, reduced appetite and neurological symptoms, and died. Before symptoms appeared, both had drunk raw milk from Raw Farm, a product that had previously been subject to a recall request; authorities urge the public to avoid consuming raw milk and to avoid feeding it to pets. On 6 December, the USDA issued a federal order that includes: 1. mandatory testing of raw milk samples in all states; 2. owners of affected cattle herds must cooperate in sharing epidemiological information; and 3. private or state laboratories must report positive test results. On 5 December, a study found that in the virus from the Texas human H5N1 case (A/Texas/37/2024), the Q226L mutation in the HA protein enables binding to human receptors, and the presence of the N224K mutation strengthens that binding. Assessment and recommendations: On 20 December, FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment for H5 influenza viruses. The H5 2.3.4.4b virus remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capability. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The infection risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率第47週約13.4%,XEC占比升至36.8%,風險評估為低
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 13.4% in week 47 of 2024; XEC's share rose to 36.8%, and WHO rates its overall risk as low.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第47週(11/18-11/24)全球陽性率約13.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(14.4%)、美洲區(9.9%)及非洲區(6.2%)為高。 WHO於12/9發布XEC變異株風險評估,該變異株由第44週(10/28-11/3)的26.9%上升至第47週(11/18-11/24)的36.8%,依目前資料顯示該病毒株免疫逃脫風險較低,現有JN.1或KP.2疫苗可提供保護,與其他變異株相較,並無明顯增加之公共衛生負擔及風險,評估整體風險為低。 美洲區近期整體呈現下降趨勢,惟南美洲東南部地區近期陽性率處高點,近期智利、巴拉圭及烏拉圭疫情處上升趨勢。 日本新增病例數持續上升,第49週(12/2-12/8)新增15,000餘例,較前一週11,900餘例上升,新增住院數亦持續增加。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,非洲區、歐洲區及東南亞區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en: Epidemic update: In week 47 of 2024 (18–24 November), the global positivity rate was about 13.4%, highest in the European Region (14.4%), the Region of the Americas (9.9%) and the African Region (6.2%). On 9 December, WHO issued a risk assessment for the XEC variant: its share rose from 26.9% in week 44 (28 October–3 November) to 36.8% in week 47 (18–24 November). Current data suggest that this virus strain has a low risk of immune escape, that existing JN.1 or KP.2 vaccines can provide protection, and that there is no obvious increase in public health burden or risk compared with other variants; the overall risk is assessed as low. Recently, the Region of the Americas has shown an overall declining trend, but positivity in the south-eastern part of South America is at a high point, and Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay are trending upward. Japan's new cases continued to rise, with over 15,000 new cases in week 49 (2–8 December), up from over 11,900 the previous week, and new hospitalisations also continued to rise. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen slightly, with slight increases in the African, European and South-East Asian regions, and flat or declining trends elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_zh: 智利,日本,巴拉圭共和國,烏拉圭

items.summary_zh: 越南頭頓市食物中毒累計379例、1死,店家豬肉與生菜檢出沙門氏菌
items.summary_en: Vũng Tàu City, Viet Nam, has 379 food-poisoning cases and one death; Salmonella and E. coli were found in a bakery's pork and vegetables.
items.description_zh: 越南南部頭頓市爆發食物中毒,累計報告379例,其中1例死亡,多數病患曾於某麵包店購買麵包及糯米飯,自11/27當地陸續出現疑食物中毒病例,出現發燒、腹痛、腹瀉及嘔吐等症狀,當局於店家的豬肉製品及生菜中檢出沙門氏菌及大腸桿菌。
items.description_en: A food-poisoning outbreak occurred in Vũng Tàu City in southern Viet Nam, with 379 cases reported cumulatively and one death. Most patients had bought bread and sticky rice from a certain bakery. Suspected food-poisoning cases began appearing locally from 27 November, with fever, abdominal pain, diarrhoea and vomiting. Authorities detected Salmonella and Escherichia coli in the shop's pork products and raw vegetables.

items.headline_zh: 挪威/瑞典-沙門氏菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 挪威沙門氏菌感染累計49例,疑與苜蓿芽有關,瑞典亦爆發同源疫情
items.summary_en: Norway has recorded 49 Salmonella cases since mid-October, likely linked to alfalfa sprouts; Sweden has a related outbreak from the same source.
items.description_zh: 挪威疫情持續,自10月中旬迄今累計報告49例,其中24例住院,病例遍及全國,經檢驗42例感染新港沙門氏菌(Salmonella Newport)及7例鼠傷寒桿菌(Salmonella typhimurium),調查顯示可能的感染源為苜蓿芽。另瑞典亦刻正爆發來自同一來源的苜蓿芽產品衍生的鼠傷寒桿菌感染疫情。
items.description_en: Norway's outbreak continues: since mid-October, 49 cases have been reported cumulatively, 24 of whom were hospitalised, with cases across the country. Testing found that 42 cases were infected with Salmonella Newport and 7 with Salmonella Typhimurium. Investigation indicates that the likely source of infection is alfalfa sprouts. Sweden is also experiencing an outbreak of Salmonella Typhimurium infection linked to alfalfa sprout products from the same source.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗與巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1,尼日新增3例cVDPV2;芬蘭檢出陽性樣本
items.summary_en: Afghanistan and Pakistan reported three WPV1 polio cases, and Niger three cVDPV2 cases; Finland detected cVDPV2-positive samples with no cases reported.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/28-12/4期間,共2國新增3例WPV1病例,分別為阿富汗2例、巴基斯坦1例;日新增3例cVDPV2病例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增16件WPV1陽性樣本;共2國新增5件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國4件、日1件。 芬蘭於12/9公布於11月自該國西南部坦佩雷地區監測到cVDPV2陽性樣本,目前尚無報告病例,當局表示目前該國疫苗接種覆蓋率為非常高(98%),該國為近期歐洲第4個檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本之國家。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 28 November–4 December, three new WPV1 cases were reported in two countries: two in Afghanistan and one in Pakistan. Niger reported three new cVDPV2 cases. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 16 new WPV1-positive samples, and two countries reported five new cVDPV2-positive samples: four in Germany and one in Niger. On 9 December, Finland reported cVDPV2-positive samples collected in November from the Tampere region in the south-west of the country; no cases have been reported. Authorities state that the country's vaccination coverage is very high, at 98%. Finland is the fourth European country recently to detect cVDPV2-positive samples.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,芬蘭,德國,尼日,巴基斯坦

items.summary_zh: 捷克2024年百日咳36,149例、12死;芬蘭2,215例為近30年最高
items.summary_en: Czech Republic reported 36,149 pertussis cases and 12 deaths as of 1 December 2024; Finland's 2,215 cases by October were its highest in nearly 30 years.
items.description_zh: 捷克疫情持續嚴峻,每週新增400餘例病例,今年截至12/1累計報告36,149例,其中2.4%住院,12例死亡,以15至19歲年齡族群發病率最高。 芬蘭今年4月起疫情驟升,截至10月累計報告2,215例病例,為近30年最高,病患以10-19歲青少年最多,並有22例不足3個月齡(未接種疫苗)病例,當局表示將加強孕婦疫苗接種;另法國及芬蘭均已發現抗藥性菌株,對嬰兒之治療影響重大,專家呼籲需加強抗藥性菌株診斷能力。
items.description_en: Czech Republic: The outbreak remains severe, with over 400 new cases weekly. As of 1 December this year, 36,149 cases had been reported cumulatively, 2.4% of them hospitalised, and 12 deaths; incidence is highest in the 15–19-year-old age group. Finland: The outbreak has surged since April this year. As of October, 2,215 cases had been reported cumulatively, the highest in nearly 30 years. Patients are mostly aged 10–19 years, and there were 22 cases in infants under three months old (unvaccinated); authorities say they will strengthen vaccination of pregnant women. In addition, France and Finland have both detected antibiotic-resistant strains, which have a major impact on the treatment of infants; experts call for stronger diagnostic capacity for resistant strains.

items.summary_zh: 東南亞麻疹:泰國7月起每月逾千例,越南胡志明市每週300餘例
items.summary_en: Measles in South-East Asia: Thailand has reached more than 1,000 cases a month since July, and Ho Chi Minh City reports over 300 cases weekly.
items.description_zh: 依WHO監測數據,泰國疫情於7月起驟升,達每月千餘例之規模,明顯高於往年;越南胡志明市9月起疫情爆發,疫情仍在上升,目前達每週300餘例之規模,並有擴散至鄰近同奈及平陽省之趨勢;馬來西亞今年疫情較往年嚴峻,惟下半年已趨緩;菲律賓、印疫情則持續流行,今年處於相對嚴峻之水平。
items.description_en: According to WHO surveillance data, Thailand's outbreak surged from July, reaching more than 1,000 cases a month, clearly higher than in previous years. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, an outbreak began in September and is still rising, currently at over 300 cases a week, and is spreading to neighbouring Đồng Nai and Bình Dương provinces. Malaysia's situation this year has been more severe than in previous years, but has eased in the second half of the year. The Philippines and Indonesia continue to have ongoing epidemics, which are at a relatively severe level this year.
items.area_zh: 印尼,馬來西亞,菲律賓,泰國,越南

items.summary_zh: 日本細小病毒B19感染今年持續上升,關東地區集中,多縣已發布流行警報。
items.summary_en: Parvovirus B19 infections in Japan have kept rising this year, concentrated in Kanto, with epidemic alerts issued in several prefectures.
items.description_zh: 日本今年定點報告數自4月起持續緩升,10月起升幅加劇,疫情明顯集中於關東地區,包括東京都(11/21)、埼玉縣(12/4)、千葉縣(12/4)、神奈川縣(12/5)均已發布流行警報。
items.description_en: In Japan, sentinel-site reports have risen steadily since April this year, with the increase accelerating from October. Cases are concentrated in the Kanto region, and epidemic alerts have been issued for Tokyo Metropolis (21 November), Saitama Prefecture (4 December), Chiba Prefecture (4 December) and Kanagawa Prefecture (5 December).

items.headline_en: China / United States – Novel influenza A
items.summary_zh: 中國新增2例H9N2感染,美國加州兒童病例病毒基因顯示對一般民眾風險仍低。
items.summary_en: Two more human H9N2 infections were reported in mainland China, while US sequencing of a California child case still assesses risk to the public as low.
items.description_zh: 香港公布中國新增2例人類感染H9N2病例,為貴州省及廣西壯族自治區1歲女童,分別於10/28及11/18發病,其餘資訊不明,該國今年累計9省市報告17例H9N2病例*。*9省17例為本署監測資訊,與CIDRAP統計不同。 美國12/10公布加州兒童病例(11/22報告)之基因定序結果,因病毒量不足,目前僅知該病毒屬2.3.4.4b分支,基因片段與加州流行之B3.13分支相,且無其他具威脅性之位點變異,亦與加拿大病例之病毒無關,評估對一般民眾風險仍然維持為低。
items.description_en:
Hong Kong authorities reported two new human H9N2 infections in mainland China, in two 1-year-old girls from Guizhou Province and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, with onset on 28 October and 18 November respectively. Other information is unavailable. China has reported 17 H9N2 cases from 9 provinces/municipalities this year.* *The 17 cases from 9 provinces are from Taiwan CDC surveillance information and differ from CIDRAP statistics.

On 10 December the United States released genetic sequencing results for a California child case (reported 22 November). Because the viral load was insufficient, it is currently only known that the virus belongs to clade 2.3.4.4b, that its gene segments are consistent with the B3.13 genotype circulating in California, and that there are no other threatening site mutations. It is also unrelated to the virus in the Canadian case. The risk assessment for the general public remains low.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),美國

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained deadly illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國Panzi不明疾病累計416例、31例死亡,病因仍待查。
items.summary_en: Unexplained illness in Panzi, DR Congo: 416 cases, 31 deaths; 10 of 12 samples tested positive for malaria, and more than one disease may be involved.
items.description_zh: WHO 12/11更新剛果民主共和國Panzi區疫情,表示目前於12件樣本中檢出10件瘧疾陽性,並推測引發本次疫情不止1種疾病,將收集更多樣本進行檢測,以確定病因;當地目前累計報告416例病例,其中31例死亡。
items.description_en: WHO updated on 11 December on the outbreak in the Panzi area of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, reporting that 10 of 12 samples tested positive for malaria. WHO suspects that more than one disease may be behind the outbreak, and more samples will be collected and tested to determine the cause. The area has reported a cumulative 416 cases, including 31 deaths.

items.headline_zh: 馬來西亞-急性病毒性B型肝炎
items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州西連省今年截至10月累計76例,急性B型肝炎,當局加強衛教。
items.summary_en: Serian Division in Sarawak, Malaysia, has reported 76 acute hepatitis B cases this year through October, prompting stepped-up health education.
items.description_zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州西連省今年截至10月累計報告76例病例,因近年病例升高,當局將加強對民眾、病患及接觸者之衛教。
items.description_en: Serian Division in Sarawak State, Malaysia, has reported a cumulative 76 cases this year as of October. Because cases have risen in recent years, the authorities will step up health education for the public, patients and their contacts.

items.summary_zh: 日本梅毒疫情持續嚴峻,今年截至11月逾1.3萬例,與去年同期持平。
items.summary_en: Japan's syphilis epidemic remains severe, with over 13,000 cases reported through November, the same as last year's pace.
items.description_zh: 日本自2022年5月起疫情持續嚴峻迄今,目前維持每週新增280餘例之規模(往年每週新增100餘例),今年截至11月累計報告1.3萬餘例,與去年同期相同,該國去年全年報告近1.5萬例,為歷史新高。
items.description_en: Japan's syphilis epidemic has remained severe since May 2022. The current weekly number of new cases is about 280 or more, compared with more than 100 per week in previous years. This year, a cumulative total of more than 13,000 cases has been reported as of November, the same as the same period last year. The country reported nearly 15,000 cases last year as a whole, a historic high.

items.summary_zh: 泰國加拉信府今年累計120例、3例死亡;印度拉賈斯坦邦首起疫情報告5例。
items.summary_en: Thailand's Kalasin Province has reported 120 melioidosis cases and 3 deaths this year; Rajasthan, India, logged its first local outbreak, with 5 cases.
items.description_zh: 泰國東北部加拉信府疫情上升,今年截至12月初累計報告120例病例,其中3例死亡,當局表示東北地區發生率最高,且以務農工作者居多,呼籲民眾採取防護措施。 印度西北部拉賈斯坦邦12月初新增報告5例病例,為當地首起疫情,其中1例死亡;當局表示,因病原菌較適應潮濕環境,往年疫情多集中於中南部邦別,現在發生於乾旱地區,顯示菌株可能出現變化。
items.description_en:
Cases are rising in Kalasin Province in northeastern Thailand. As of early December this year, 120 cases have been reported, including 3 deaths. Authorities say the Northeast has the highest incidence and that farmers make up most of those affected, and they urge people to take protective measures.

In Rajasthan State in northwestern India, 5 new cases were reported in early December, the first local outbreak in the area, including 1 death. Authorities say the pathogen is better adapted to humid environments, and past outbreaks were concentrated in central and southern states, whereas this outbreak is occurring in an arid region, suggesting the strain may be changing.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓今年截至11月23日累計7,234例鉤端螺旋體病,致死率約9%。
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 7,234 leptospirosis cases through 23 November this year, 1.2 times last year's level, with about 9% fatality.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓今年截至11/23累計報告7,234例病例,為去年同期之1.2倍,致死率約9%,當局表示10月之數起颱風可能為病例數大幅增加之主因。
items.description_en: The Philippines has reported a cumulative 7,234 cases this year as of 23 November, 1.2 times the figure for the same period last year, with a case fatality rate of about 9%. Authorities say several typhoons in October may be the main reason for the sharp increase in cases.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年逾600萬例、5,086例死亡;越南胡志明市病例上升。
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported over 6 million suspected dengue cases and 5,086 deaths this year, its highest case count since 1986; Ho Chi Minh City cases are rising.
items.description_zh: 越南疫情更新,胡志明市於近10週病例數持續上升,最近1週報告約700例病例,已有1例死亡,今年迄今累計已逾12,000例惟較去年同期為低。 巴西疫情更新,今年截至11月已累計逾600萬例(疑)病例及5,086例死亡,該國今年病例數已為1986年以來最高,其中以米納斯吉拉斯州最為嚴峻。
items.description_en:
Viet Nam update: In Ho Chi Minh City, case numbers have kept rising over the past 10 weeks, with about 700 cases reported in the latest week and 1 death so far. Cumulative cases this year exceed 12,000, which is lower than the same period last year.

Brazil update: As of November this year, more than 6 million (suspected) cases and 5,086 deaths have been cumulatively reported. The country's case count this year is already the highest since 1986, with Minas Gerais State the most severely affected.

items.summary_zh: 巴西今年截至11月逾26萬例屈公病,截至8月已有159例死亡,超過去年全年。
items.summary_en: Brazil has reported over 260,000 chikungunya cases this year through November; 159 deaths through August already exceed last year's total of 122.
items.description_zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年截至11月累計逾26萬例病例,病例數分布以該國東南部米納斯吉拉斯為多,該國今年截至8月累計159例死亡,已高於去年全年之122例死亡數。
items.description_en: Brazil update: As of November this year, more than 260,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, with most cases in Minas Gerais in the southeast of the country. As of August this year, 159 deaths have been cumulatively reported, already exceeding last year's full-year total of 122 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年累計11,634例奧羅普切熱,2例死亡均在巴西。
items.summary_en: The Americas have reported 11,634 Oropouche fever cases this year through 25 November, with both deaths in Brazil; WHO rates regional risk as high.
items.description_zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至11/25累計11,634例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共11國/地區報告病例,分別為巴西(9,563)、秘魯(936)、古巴(603)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)、蓋亞那(2)及巴拿馬(1)。另美國(94)、加拿大(2)及英屬開曼群島(1)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例;此外,巴西已報告垂直感染確診病例。WHO評估該病毒對區域的公共衛生風險為高,對全球的風險為低。
items.description_en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,巴西,加拿大,開曼群島(英國海外領地),哥倫比亞,古巴,厄瓜多,蓋亞那共和國,巴拿馬共和國,秘魯,美國

items.summary_zh: 巴貝多12月6日報告2例成人奧羅普切熱病例,當局呼籲防蚊並持續監測。
items.summary_en: Barbados reported two adult Oropouche fever cases on 6 December; authorities urge mosquito bite prevention and continued close surveillance.
items.description_zh: 巴貝多12/6報告2例成人病例,當局建議民眾採取相關防護措施,避免蚊蟲叮咬以預防感染,並持續密切監測疫情。
items.description_en: Barbados reported 2 adult cases on 6 December. Authorities advise people to take relevant protective measures and avoid mosquito bites to prevent infection, and will continue to closely monitor the situation.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計58例,多與牛隻或家禽相關;亞利桑那新增2例H5人類感染。
items.summary_en: The United States has reported 58 novel influenza A cases this year, mostly linked to cattle or poultry; Arizona reported two new human H5 infections.
items.description_zh: 美國12/5公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關病例,型別及流病相關資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布58例病例,其中35例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,2例不明,分布於加州(32)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。 美國亞利桑那州12/6公布新增2例H5人類感染病例,皆曾於工作時接觸受感染家禽,症狀輕微且已康復,目前病毒尚無人際傳播能力,評估對一般民眾風險為低。
items.description_en:
The United States announced on 5 December one new case in California linked to cattle; the subtype and epidemiological details were not stated. The country has announced 58 cases so far this year, of which 35 were linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 2 were unknown. Cases are distributed across California (32), Washington State (11), Colorado (10) and Michigan (2), and in Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each).

On 6 December, Arizona announced 2 new human H5 infections. All had been exposed to infected poultry at work. Symptoms were mild and they have recovered. The virus currently has no human-to-human transmission ability, and the risk to the general public is assessed as low.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國乳牛場禽流感累計718起,人類陽性35例;多國新增H5N1動物疫情。
items.summary_en: US dairy farms have reported 718 outbreaks since March this year, with 35 positive human cases, while several countries logged new H5N1 animal outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  本週美國新增2例H5及3例未分型、越南新增1例H5N1人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共13國於2024/9/18~2024/12/4間新增248起H5N1疫情,分別為美國87起、奧地利51起、日本/加拿大各29起、斯洛維亞12起、德國10起、義大利9起、捷克7起、匈牙利5起、波蘭3起、荷蘭/英國/克羅埃西亞各2起。 共3國於2024/11/19~2024/12/2間新增5起H5N5疫情,分別為冰島3起、挪威/英國各1起。 加拿大於2024/11/16新增1起H5N2疫情。 哥倫比亞於2024/11/20新增1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 紐西蘭於2024/11/23新增1起H7N6疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計15州報告718(30)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少5,790例,檢測147例,其中35例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第47週計292個採檢點提供檢測報告,2州43個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國加州衛生部12/3宣布召回Raw Fram公司所有生乳及奶油產品,並於11/27起對該農場進行隔離與銷售管制,該公司生產線多次檢出禽流感病毒,當局呼籲消費者避免食用(或讓寵物食用)任何Raw Fram公司生乳製品。 英國12/3公布,已預先向國內公司採購500萬劑基於現行H5病毒株設計之H5流感疫苗,於人際傳播發生時能立即使用,另已針對未來大流行病毒株之特異性疫苗進行預購。美國、日本、歐盟均已啟動儲備H5疫苗。 12/2研究表示,針對2005年迄今5支(感染不同哺乳動物之)H5N1流感病毒及2009年H1N1流感病毒進行雪貂試驗並比較,可發現雪貂感染較近代之H5N1病毒後,排至空氣中之傳染性病毒量相較舊病毒為高,顯示目前H5N1傳播增加未必係因「哺乳動物適應性突變」,亦可能係因空氣中病毒脫落(shedding)量上升之故。 12/3研究表示,今年4月澳洲報告(印度移入)之H5N1人類感染案例,屬2.3.2.1a分支重組病毒,包括2.3.2.1a、2.3.4.4b及野鳥低病原性禽流感基因片段;另印度H5N1感染已外溢至他國,惟國內通報病例極少,顯示該國(或南亞)監測型態導致之數據落差,呼籲各界持續關注亞洲HPAI H5疫情。
items.description_en:
Human cases: This week the United States reported 2 new H5 and 3 untyped cases, and Viet Nam reported 1 new human H5N1 infection.

Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 13 countries reported 248 new H5N1 outbreaks between 18 September and 4 December 2024: United States 87, Austria 51, Japan and Canada 29 each, Slovenia 12, Germany 10, Italy 9, Czechia 7, Hungary 5, Poland 3, and the Netherlands, United Kingdom and Croatia 2 each.

A total of 3 countries reported 5 new H5N5 outbreaks between 19 November and 2 December 2024: Iceland 3, and Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each.

Canada reported 1 new H5N2 outbreak on 16 November.

Colombia reported 1 new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 20 November.

New Zealand reported 1 new H7N6 outbreak on 23 November.

US dairy cattle avian influenza:

Dairy farms: Since March this year, 15 states have reported a cumulative 718 (30) outbreaks, mainly concentrated in California recently.

Human exposure via cattle: At least 5,790 people have been cumulatively monitored and 147 tested, with 35 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms).

Other derived outbreaks: Infections have been found in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with fatal cases reported in cats.

Wastewater surveillance: In week 47, 292 sampling sites provided test reports; H5-positive results were detected at 43 sampling sites in 2 states.

Other updates:

On 3 December, the California Department of Public Health announced a recall of all raw milk and cream products from Raw Fram, and since 27 November the farm has been under quarantine and sales restrictions. The company's production lines have repeatedly tested positive for avian influenza virus, and authorities advise consumers to avoid eating (or feeding pets) any raw milk products from Raw Fram.

On 3 December, the United Kingdom announced it had pre-purchased 5 million doses of H5 influenza vaccine from a domestic company, designed on current H5 virus strains, for immediate use if human transmission occurs, and had also pre-ordered vaccines targeting future pandemic strains. The United States, Japan and the EU have all activated stockpiled H5 vaccines.

Research published on 2 December compared ferret experiments with five H5N1 influenza viruses infecting different mammals since 2005 and a 2009 H1N1 influenza virus. Ferrets infected with more recent H5N1 viruses shed more infectious virus into the air than those infected with older viruses. This suggests that the current increase in H5N1 transmission may not necessarily be due to 'mammalian adaptation mutations' and may also result from higher viral shedding into the air.

Research published on 3 December found that an H5N1 human infection case reported by Australia in April this year (imported from India) was a reassortant virus of clade 2.3.2.1a, including gene segments from 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.4.4b and low-pathogenicity avian influenza in wild birds. Separately, H5N1 infections in India have spread to other countries, but few cases have been reported domestically, indicating data gaps caused by surveillance patterns in that country (or in South Asia). Authorities call on all sectors to continue monitoring HPAI H5 outbreaks in Asia.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率持平約12.8%,日本第48週新增13,583例,較前週上升。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was stable at about 12.8% in week 46; Japan reported 13,583 cases in week 48, up from the previous week.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第46週(11/11-11/17)全球陽性率約12.8%,陽性率以歐洲區(13.7%)、美洲區(10.6%)及非洲區(5.0%)為高。 英國近期多項指標呈下降趨勢,第48週(11/25-12/1)入/住院率及入/住院數皆處低點,當局呼籲民眾儘快接種COVID-19及流感等疫苗,降低感染呼吸道傳染病風險。 日本第48週(11/25-12/1)新增13,583例,病例數較前1週(11/18-11/24) 之11,499例上升,住院數亦較前1週增加,其中北海道及東北地區病例數顯著上升,推估未來病例數將持續增加,當局已針對冬季疫情進行擴大整備工作。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期持平,其中,非洲區及東南亞區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 46 of 2024 (11–17 November), the global positivity rate was about 12.8%, highest in the European Region (13.7%), the Region of the Americas (10.6%) and the African Region (5.0%).

The United Kingdom has seen several recent indicators decline. In week 48 (25 November–1 December), hospital admission rates and numbers of admissions were at low levels. Authorities urge people to get COVID-19 and influenza vaccines as soon as possible to reduce the risk of respiratory infections.

Japan reported 13,583 new cases in week 48 (25 November–1 December), up from 11,499 in the previous week (18–24 November). Hospital admissions also rose compared with the previous week, with notable increases in case numbers in Hokkaido and the Tohoku region. Cases are expected to keep rising, and authorities have expanded preparations for the winter season.

Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has been stable recently, with slight increases in the African Region and South-East Asia Region, while other regions show stable or declining trends. KP.3.1.1 remains the main circulating variant globally, and the share of XEC variants is increasing, but this has not yet increased disease severity. WHO notes that most countries have now included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance. WHO recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, keep tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure built during the COVID-19 period.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Japan

items.headline_en: South Korea – Common intestinal parasitic diseases
items.summary_zh: 韓國腸道寄生蟲感染率4.5%整體下降,肝吸蟲2.3%略升,部分地區逾10%。
items.summary_en: South Korea's parasite survey found a 4.5% overall infection rate, with liver fluke at 2.3%, slightly up but still declining overall; some regions exceed 10%.
items.description_zh: 韓國公布今年度腸道寄生蟲感染調查,調查顯示整體腸道寄生蟲感染率為4.5%,其中致癌性病原肝吸蟲感染率為2.3%,較去年略有上升,但整體仍呈下降趨勢,以肝吸蟲2.3%感染率為高,另部分地區感染率仍高於10%,當局表示仍需持續針對當地飲食習慣進行衛教。
items.description_en: South Korea has published its survey of intestinal parasitic infections for this year. The survey shows an overall intestinal parasite infection rate of 4.5%. The infection rate for liver fluke, a carcinogenic pathogen, was 2.3%, slightly higher than last year, although the overall trend is still declining. Liver fluke had the highest infection rate at 2.3%, and infection rates in some regions remain above 10%. Authorities say continued health education tailored to local dietary habits is still needed.

items.summary_zh: 美國疑似黃瓜相關68例、挪威疑似苜蓿芽相關23例,新加坡幼教機構24童不適。
items.summary_en: Salmonella outbreaks include 68 US cases possibly linked to Mexican cucumbers, 23 Norwegian cases possibly linked to alfalfa sprouts, and 24 children ill in Singapore.
items.description_zh: 美國爆發與黃瓜相關疫情,截至11/26共19州報告68例,其中至少18例住院,無死亡病例,病例數以蒙大拿州為多,發病日介於10/12-11/16間。據調查,可能感染源為墨西哥所生產之黃瓜,當局已召回疑受汙染之產品。 挪威爆發疫情,自10月中旬迄今累計報告23例,其中8例住院,病例遍及全國9個地區,經基因定序結果顯示疫情菌株具共同來源,目前可能的感染源為苜蓿芽,當局已召回相關產品,並建議民眾避免食用。 新加坡公布一所幼教機構有24名孩童出現腸胃症狀,其中7人住院,3人確診感染沙門氏菌,該機構已採取停止團體活動及加強環境清消等多項衛生防護措施。
items.description_en:
The United States has an outbreak linked to cucumbers: as of 26 November, 68 cases have been reported from 19 states, at least 18 of whom were hospitalized, with no deaths. Most cases are in Montana, with onset dates between 12 October and 16 November. Investigations indicate the likely source is cucumbers produced in Mexico, and authorities have recalled suspected contaminated products.

Norway has an outbreak with 23 cases reported since mid-October, 8 of whom were hospitalized. Cases are spread across 9 regions of the country. Genetic sequencing shows the outbreak strains share a common source, which is possibly alfalfa sprouts. Authorities have recalled related products and advise people to avoid eating them.

Singapore reported that 24 children at an early childhood education centre had gastrointestinal symptoms, 7 of whom were hospitalized, and 3 were confirmed to be infected with Salmonella. The centre has taken multiple health protection measures, including suspending group activities and strengthening environmental disinfection.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增6例WPV1病例,德國4城市汙水檢出cVDPV2。
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported six new WPV1 cases between 21 and 27 November, and cVDPV2 was detected in wastewater in four German cities.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/21-11/27期間,巴基斯坦新增6例WPV1病例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增24件WPV1陽性樣本;共2國新增2件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為阿爾及利亞/奈及利亞各1件。GPEI 11/28 德國11/28公布分別於4座城市汙水中皆檢出cVDPV2,歐洲近期分別於波蘭及西班牙相繼檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,惟目前尚未發現任何病例。WHO及ECDC皆表示各國都應持續留意,並進行常規監測和疫苗接種,以防止病毒在社區中重新傳播。
items.description_en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 21 and 27 November, Pakistan added 6 WPV1 cases. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 24 WPV1-positive samples. In total, 2 countries added 2 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Algeria and Nigeria (GPEI, 28 November).

Germany announced on 28 November that cVDPV2 had been detected in wastewater in each of 4 cities. Europe recently also detected cVDPV2-positive samples in Poland and Spain, but no cases have been found so far. WHO and ECDC both state that all countries should remain vigilant and carry out routine surveillance and vaccination to prevent the virus from re-spreading in communities.
items.area_zh: 阿爾及利亞,德國,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,波蘭,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 香港11月新增20例退伍軍人病,1例死亡,7例自中國移入,今年累計124例。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 20 new Legionnaires' disease cases in November, including one death and seven imported from mainland China; 124 cases this year so far.
items.description_zh: 香港今年11月新增報告20例病例,其中1例死亡,病患年齡介於42至86歲間,其中17例為男性,18例具慢性病史,7例為自中國移入,其中5例屬同一旅行團(佛山),餘分布於11個社區;香港今年迄今累計報告124例,前2年分別報告80及121例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported 20 new cases in November this year, including 1 death. Patients were aged 42 to 86 years; 17 were male, 18 had chronic conditions, and 7 were imported from mainland China, 5 of whom belonged to the same tour group (Foshan). The remaining cases were distributed across 11 communities. Hong Kong has reported 124 cases so far this year; in the previous two years, 80 and 121 cases were reported respectively.

items.headline_zh: 澳門-猩紅熱與侵襲性A群鏈球菌感染
items.headline_en: Macao SAR – Scarlet fever and invasive group A streptococcal infection
items.summary_zh: 澳門11月底單週升至22例猩紅熱,今年累計1,654例,54例住院。
items.summary_en: Macao SAR's scarlet fever cases rose to 22 a week by late November; 1,654 cases have been reported this year, with 54 hospitalized.
items.description_zh: 澳門近期猩紅熱疫情上升,10月初單週報告5例病例,11月底已升至單週22例,今年截至12/3累計報告1,654例,以1至9歲兒童居多,其中54例(3.3%)住院,無人死亡,當局呼籲家長及教育機構提高警覺。
items.description_en: Scarlet fever cases have been rising in Macao SAR recently. Weekly reported cases were 5 in early October and rose to 22 by late November. As of 3 December this year, a cumulative 1,654 cases have been reported, mostly children aged 1 to 9. Of these, 54 (3.3%) were hospitalized, and there were no deaths. Authorities urge parents and educational institutions to stay alert.

items.headline_zh: 日本-肺炎黴漿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 日本肺炎黴漿菌感染單週定點報告數達2.84,為近10年最高,仍陡升。
items.summary_en: Japan's Mycoplasma pneumoniae infections reached 2.84 weekly reports per sentinel clinic, the highest in 10 years, and are still climbing steeply.
items.description_zh: 日本疫情持續上升,單週定醫平均報告數達2.84,為近10年最高,目前仍呈陡升趨勢,該國往年疫情高峰多發生於10至12月,峰介於0.4至0.6間,前二次爆發(2015及2016年)峰分別為0.9及1.6。
items.description_en: Cases in Japan continue to rise. The average weekly number of reports per sentinel medical institution reached 2.84, the highest in 10 years, and the curve is still climbing steeply. In past years, Japan's epidemic peaks have mostly occurred between October and December, with peaks typically between 0.4 and 0.6. The peaks of the previous two outbreaks (2015 and 2016) were 0.9 and 1.6, respectively.

items.summary_zh: 美國百日咳單週新增破500例,今年截至11月23日累計27,036例。
items.summary_en: The US reported over 500 pertussis cases in week 47 alone, with 27,036 cases by 23 November, 4.8 times the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續上升,第47週單週新增破500例,明顯持續升高,該國今年截至11/23累計報告27,036例病例,為去年同期之4.8倍,其中以賓州、威斯康辛州、伊利諾州、加州及華盛頓州等地最為嚴峻。
items.description_en: Pertussis continues to rise in the United States. Weekly new cases exceeded 500 in week 47, a clear and sustained increase. The country has reported 27,036 cases as of 23 November this year, 4.8 times the same period last year. The most severely affected areas include Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Illinois, California and Washington State.

items.headline_zh: 剛果民主共和國-不明原因致死疾病
items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Unexplained deadly illness
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省不明疾病爆發,已報告143例死亡,婦幼受影響最劇。
items.summary_en: An unidentified illness in Kwango Province, DR Congo, has reported 143 deaths, with women and children most affected.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國西南部寬果省11月中旬起爆發不明疾病,病患出現類流感疾病症狀,包括發燒、頭痛、咳嗽及貧血等,目前已報告143例死亡,以婦女及兒童受影響最劇,當局已派遣醫療團隊進駐採樣分析。
items.description_en: An unidentified disease broke out from mid-November in Kwango Province in southwestern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Patients show influenza-like symptoms, including fever, headache, cough and anaemia. A total of 143 deaths have been reported so far, with women and children most severely affected. Authorities have sent medical teams to the site to collect and analyse samples.

items.summary_zh: 加州佛雷斯諾郡新增狂犬病病例,為30餘年來首例;中國湖南長沙縣1例死亡。
items.summary_en: California's Fresno County reported its first rabies case in over 30 years, linked to a bat bite; Hunan, China, reported one dog-bite death.
items.description_zh: 美國加州佛雷斯諾郡11/27新增報告1例病例,為近30餘年來首例,病患10月中旬曾於美熹德郡經蝙蝠咬傷,並於11/22死亡,當局呼籲民眾避免接觸蝙蝠。 中國湖南省長沙縣11/18報告1例死亡病例,病患係經自養家犬咬傷感染,當局表示該省犬隻免疫接種率約30%,且抗體會隨時間下降,呼籲飼主確保寵物具足夠之抗體保護力。
items.description_en:
In Fresno County, California, a new case was reported on 27 November. It is the first case in more than 30 years. The patient had been bitten by a bat in Mariposa County in mid-October and died on 22 November. Authorities urge people to avoid contact with bats.

In Changsha County, Hunan Province, China, one death was reported on 18 November. The patient was infected through a bite from a dog raised at home. Authorities say the dog vaccination rate in the province is about 30%, and antibodies decline over time. They urge pet owners to ensure their pets have sufficient antibody protection.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),美國

items.disease_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(愛滋病毒)感染
items.headline_zh: 歐洲/香港-人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
items.headline_en: Europe / Hong Kong SAR – HIV infection
items.summary_zh: 香港今年第三季新增85例感染,歐盟區2023年感染率較2014年降16%。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 85 new HIV infections in Q3 this year, while the 2023 EU/EEA infection rate was 16% lower than in 2014.
items.description_zh: 香港11/26宣布今年第三季新增85例感染病例及22例愛滋病病例,感染率約0.1%,低於全球平均;感染病例年齡介於18至75歲間,其中72例男性,97%係透過性接觸感染。 ECDC 11/29更新2023年數據,去年歐盟區累計30國報告24,731例感染病例,每10萬人感染率5.3,相較2014年降低16%,傳播方式中,MSM及異性性行為分別佔約3成,經毒品注射感染約4%、經垂直傳染感染約0.9%,餘無相關資訊;另有26國報告2,690例愛滋病例,發病率較10年前降低36%。
items.description_en:
On 26 November, Hong Kong announced 85 new infections and 22 new AIDS cases in the third quarter of this year. The infection rate is about 0.1%, lower than the global average. Infected cases were aged 18 to 75 years; 72 were male, and 97% were infected through sexual contact.

On 29 November, ECDC updated its data for 2023. Last year, 30 countries in the EU/EEA reported a cumulative 24,731 infections, a rate of 5.3 per 100,000 population, 16% lower than in 2014. By transmission route, MSM and heterosexual sex each accounted for about 30%, injecting drug use about 4%, and mother-to-child transmission about 0.9%; no relevant information was available for the rest. In addition, 26 countries reported 2,690 AIDS cases, with incidence 36% lower than 10 years earlier.

items.summary_zh: 非洲3國今年累計10,267例拉薩熱,188例死亡,以奈及利亞最嚴峻。
items.summary_en: Three African countries have reported 10,267 Lassa fever cases and 188 deaths this year through 15 November, mostly in Nigeria.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至11/15累計3國報告10,267例病例,其中1,110例確診,188例死亡(CFR:16.9%),以奈及利亞報告10,028例、175例死亡最為嚴峻,另有賴比瑞亞及幾內亞分別報告212例(11例死亡)及27例(2例死亡),疫情持續流行中。
items.description_en: Africa update: As of 15 November this year, 3 countries have cumulatively reported 10,267 cases, including 1,110 confirmed cases and 188 deaths (CFR: 16.9%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 10,028 cases and 175 deaths. Liberia and Guinea reported 212 cases (11 deaths) and 27 cases (2 deaths), respectively. The outbreak remains active.
items.area_zh: 幾內亞,賴比瑞亞,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 加拿大麻疹兩週遽增47例,今年截至11月16日累計131例。
items.summary_en: Canada's measles cases jumped by 47 in two weeks, with 131 cases nationwide by 16 November this year.
items.description_zh: 加拿大近期疫情上升,10/27-11/9二週內病例遽增47例,今年截至11/16全國累計報告131例,分布以魁北克、新布藍茲維及安大略省為多,近期病例多集中於後2省;該國近10年年度病例數介於0至418例間,歷史最高為2011年之751例。
items.description_en: Measles activity is rising in Canada. Cases increased sharply by 47 within two weeks, from 27 October to 9 November. As of 16 November this year, 131 cases have been cumulatively reported nationwide, mostly in Quebec, New Brunswick and Ontario, with recent cases concentrated in the latter two provinces. Over the past 10 years, the country's annual case numbers have ranged from 0 to 418, and the historic high was 751 cases in 2011.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計57例,多與牛隻或家禽相關;加州新增2例牛隻相關病例。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 57 novel influenza A cases this year, mostly linked to cattle or poultry, with two new cattle-linked cases in California.
items.description_zh: 美國12/2公布加州新增2例與牛隻相關病例,型別及流病相關資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告57例病例,其中34例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,2例不明,分布於加州(31)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
items.description_en: On 2 December the United States announced 2 new cases in California linked to cattle; the subtype and epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 57 cases so far this year, of which 34 were linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 2 were unknown. Cases are distributed across California (31), Washington State (11), Colorado (10) and Michigan (2), and in Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each).

items.summary_zh: 秘魯今年累計273,847例、252例死亡;尼泊爾病例自10月中旬起下降。
items.summary_en: Peru has reported 273,847 dengue cases and 252 deaths this year, above the same period last year; Nepal's cases have declined since mid-October.
items.description_zh: 秘魯疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告273,847例病例,252例死亡,高於去年同期病例數。 泊爾疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告逾28,000例病例,12例死亡,自10月中旬以來病例數呈下降趨勢,病例主要分布於該國中部卡斯基縣。
items.description_en:
Peru update: This year, a cumulative 273,847 cases and 252 deaths have been reported so far, higher than the same period last year.

Nepal update: This year, more than 28,000 cases and 12 deaths have been cumulatively reported so far. Case numbers have declined since mid-October, and cases are mainly distributed in Kaski District in central Nepal.

items.headline_zh: 烏干達/塞內加爾-克里米亞-剛果出血熱
items.summary_zh: 烏干達今年累計20例、7例死亡;塞內加爾累計7例無死亡,分布5個衛生區。
items.summary_en: Uganda has reported 20 Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases and 7 deaths this year; Senegal has reported 7 cases, with no deaths.
items.description_zh: 烏干達疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告20例病例,7例死亡,病例分布於5個地區。 塞內加爾今年迄今累計報告7例病例,無死亡病例,病例分布於5個衛生區,當局已在受影響地區進行防治活動。
items.description_en:
Uganda update: So far this year, 20 cases and 7 deaths have been cumulatively reported, with cases distributed across 5 areas.
