Senegal update: So far this year, 7 cases have been cumulatively reported, with no deaths. Cases are distributed across 5 health districts, and authorities have carried out prevention and control activities in affected areas.

items.summary_zh: 印度今年累計1,548例日本腦炎,阿薩姆邦925例最多;德里逾10年首例。
items.summary_en: India has reported 1,548 Japanese encephalitis cases this year, most in Assam (925); Delhi logged its first case in more than a decade.
items.description_zh: 印度疫情更新,德里11/28報告1例72歲男性病例,為該地區10多年來首例病例,該地區於2011年曾報告14例病例,該國今年迄今累計報告1,548例病例,以阿薩姆邦報告925例為多。
items.description_en: India update: Delhi reported 1 case in a 72-year-old man on 28 November, the first case in the area in more than 10 years; the area had reported 14 cases in 2011. The country has reported 1,548 cases so far this year, with Assam State reporting the most, at 925 cases.

items.summary_zh: 英國新增Ib型M痘病例,為累計第5例,病患自烏干達返國,屬輸入病例。
items.summary_en: The UK reported its fifth Mpox case, a clade Ib infection in a patient returning from Uganda, assessed as imported.
items.description_zh: 英國英蘭11/29再新增1例Ib型病例,為該國累計第5例,病患近期自烏干達返國,研判為輸入病例,與前案家庭群聚無關;當局表示已追蹤接觸者並進行檢驗及疫苗接種,評估一般民眾感染風險仍低。
items.description_en: England reported one more clade Ib case on 29 November, the fifth cumulative case in the country. The patient recently returned from Uganda and is judged to be an imported case, unrelated to the household cluster linked to the previous case. Authorities said they have traced contacts and carried out testing and vaccination, and assess the risk to the general public as still low.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年累計23,696例,非洲區占12,592例。
items.summary_en: Global Mpox reached 23,696 confirmed cases by week 48 this year, with 12,592 in the African Region.
items.description_zh: 自2022年5月截至今年11/29全球累計128(1*)國/地區報告11萬7,097例確診病例,其中至少242例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。*安哥拉 今年截至第48週全球累計80國/地區報告23,696例確診病例,其中非洲區12,592例(本月1,847例)、美洲區6,214例(342)、西太平洋區2,240例(230)、歐洲區1,654例(82)、東地中海區773例(0),及東南亞區223例(0)。
items.description_en:
Since May 2022 and as of 29 November this year, 128 (1*) countries/territories have cumulatively reported 117,097 confirmed cases, including at least 242 deaths (CFR: 0.2%). *Angola

As of week 48 this year, 80 countries/territories have cumulatively reported 23,696 confirmed cases globally: African Region 12,592 (1,847 this month), Region of the Americas 6,214 (342), Western Pacific Region 2,240 (230), European Region 1,654 (82), Eastern Mediterranean Region 773 (0), and South-East Asia Region 223 (0).

items.summary_zh: 美國加州兩度於零售生乳檢出禽流感病毒,同一廠商產品下架召回。
items.summary_en: California detected avian influenza virus in retail raw milk twice, on 24 and 27 November; all products came from one manufacturer, which must recall them.
items.description_zh: 美國加州於11/24、27分別宣布於零售生乳中檢出禽流感病毒,商品均來自同一廠商,當局已公布產品批號、要求廠商下架召回,並呼籲民眾立即將剩餘產品退回並避免食用。該國目前禁止跨州銷售未經消毒之生乳,惟多數州別之州內銷售仍屬合法。 美國目前H5N1 2.3.4.4b病毒之細分支流行情形如下:  A3:夏威夷州禽類疫情; B3.13:乳牛相關疫情、猶他州家禽疫情,乳牛相關人類疫情; D1.1:華盛頓州家/野禽、人類疫情(加拿大BC省人類疫情); D1.2:奧勒岡州家/野禽與豬隻疫情。

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國乳牛場禽流感累計688起,人類陽性32例;多國新增H5N1動物疫情。
items.summary_en: US dairy farms have reported 688 outbreaks since March this year, with 32 positive human cases; 12 countries reported 176 new H5N1 animal outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  本週無新增人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共12國於2020/11/10~2024/11/27間新增176起H5N1疫情,分別為美國107起、匈牙利30起、義大利/波蘭各10起、德國9起、西班牙3起、烏克蘭2起、羅馬亞/摩爾多瓦/臺灣/日本/土耳其各1起。 秘魯於2024/10/7~2024/10/7間新增1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 加拿大於2024/10/3~2024/10/30間新增3起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計15州報告688(76)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州。USDA 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少5,040例,檢測140例,其中32例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。CDC、CDC 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第46週計325個採檢點提供檢測報告,1州46個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en:
Human cases: No new human infections were reported this week.

Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 12 countries reported 176 new H5N1 outbreaks between 10 November 2020 and 27 November 2024: United States 107, Hungary 30, Italy and Poland 10 each, Germany 9, Spain 3, Ukraine 2, and Romania, Moldova, Taiwan, Japan and Turkey 1 each. Peru reported 1 new H5 (N untyped) outbreak from 7 October to 7 October 2024. Canada reported 3 new H5N5 outbreaks between 3 and 30 October 2024.

US dairy cattle avian influenza:

Dairy farms: Since March this year, 15 states have reported 688 (76) outbreaks; recent cases are mainly concentrated in California (USDA).

Human infection via cattle: At least 5,040 people have been monitored and 140 tested, with 32 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms) (CDC, CDC).

Other derived outbreaks: Infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with fatal cases in cats.

Wastewater surveillance: In week 46, 325 sampling sites provided test reports; H5-positive results were detected at 46 sampling sites in 1 state.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約14.6%,歐洲區最高;韓國、紐西蘭指標處低點。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 14.6% in week 44, highest in Europe (18.7%); South Korea and New Zealand indicators are at low levels.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第44週(11/4-11/10)全球陽性率約14.6%,陽性率以歐洲區(18.7%)、美洲區(10.2%)及非洲區(4.4%)為高。 韓國近期處低點,新增病例數及廢水樣本病毒量皆處低點,該國調整治療藥物瑞德西韋(Remdesivir)的處方標準,將年齡限制提高到70歲以上。 紐西蘭陽性率近期處低點,截至10/27陽性率約4.9%;廢水監測顯示近期XEC變異株占比逐漸上升,目前該國主流株為KP.3,其次為JN.1及XEC。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,西太平洋區上升;歐洲區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 44 of 2024 (4–10 November), the global positivity rate was about 14.6%, highest in the European Region (18.7%), the Region of the Americas (10.2%) and the African Region (4.4%).

South Korea's indicators are at low levels: both new cases and viral load in wastewater samples are low. The country has revised the prescribing criteria for the treatment drug remdesivir, raising the age limit to over 70 years.

New Zealand's positivity rate is currently at a low level; as of 27 October it was about 4.9%. Wastewater surveillance shows that the share of XEC variants has gradually increased recently. The dominant strain in the country is currently KP.3, followed by JN.1 and XEC.

Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has risen slightly recently, with an increase in the Western Pacific Region and a slight rise in the European Region; other regions show stable or declining trends. KP.3.1.1 remains the main circulating variant globally, and the share of XEC variants is increasing, but this has not yet increased disease severity. WHO notes that most countries have now included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, keep tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure built during the COVID-19 period.

items.summary_zh: 美國熟食肉品李斯特菌疫情結束,61例、10例死亡;另即食肉品疫情11例。
items.summary_en: The US announced the end of a deli-meat Listeria outbreak with 61 cases and 10 deaths; a separate ready-to-eat meat-product outbreak has 11 cases in four states.
items.description_zh: 美國公布熟食店肉品疫情結束,截至11/19共19州報告61例,其中60例住院及10例死亡,並包含1名孕婦,此疫情實際病例數可能高於報告人數,經調查多數病患曾食用熟食肉品。 美國公布即食產品疫情更新,截至11/22共4州報告11例,其中1例死亡,病人樣本採集時間介於2021/10至2024/7間,經調查顯示感染源為某公司所生產之即食肉類產品。
items.description_en:
The United States announced the end of an outbreak linked to deli meat products. As of 19 November, 61 cases had been reported from 19 states, of whom 60 were hospitalized and 10 died, including 1 pregnant woman. The actual number of cases in this outbreak may be higher than the number reported. Investigations found that most patients had eaten deli meat products.

The United States also announced an update on an outbreak linked to ready-to-eat products. As of 22 November, 11 cases had been reported from 4 states, including 1 death. Patient specimens were collected between October 2021 and July 2024. Investigations showed that the source of infection was a ready-to-eat meat product produced by a company.

items.summary_zh: 全球霍亂今年累計逾48.6萬例,病例較去年同期減42%、死亡增54%。
items.summary_en: WHO reports over 486,000 cholera cases globally as of 27 October; cases fell 42% versus the same period last year while deaths rose 54%.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至10/27累計33國報告486,000餘例病例及逾4,000例死亡;分別較去年同期減少42%及增加54%,病例數以東地中海區、非洲區及東南亞區為多,地區性戰爭衝突、自然災害等因素降低醫療服務資源可近性並加劇爆發疫情,WHO提高口服疫苗(OCV)生產,以應付目前疫苗短缺的情況,評估全球疫情風險仍為非常高。
items.description_en: WHO reports that as of 27 October this year, 33 countries have cumulatively reported more than 486,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths globally. Compared with the same period last year, cases decreased by 42% and deaths increased by 54%, respectively. Cases are concentrated in the Eastern Mediterranean Region, the African Region and the South-East Asia Region. Regional armed conflicts, natural disasters and other factors have reduced access to health care resources and intensified outbreaks. WHO is increasing production of oral cholera vaccine (OCV) to address the current vaccine shortage. WHO assesses the global risk of the outbreak as still very high.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1病例,查德5例及奈及利亞1例cVDPV2病例。
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case, Chad five cVDPV2 cases and Nigeria one, and Poland detected cVDPV2 in wastewater.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/14-11/20期間,巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1病例;共2國新增6例cVDPV2病例,其中查德5例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增7件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗6件、巴基斯坦1件;共3國新增3件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為查德/波蘭/南蘇丹各1件。 波蘭於11/18報告該國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,係自該國首都華沙10/22之廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例。經分析顯示,該病毒與奈及利亞北部疫情相關,近期亦於西班牙被檢測到。
items.description_en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 14 and 20 November, Pakistan added 1 WPV1 case. A total of 2 countries added 6 cVDPV2 cases: Chad 5 and Nigeria 1. For environmental samples, 2 countries added 7 WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 6 and Pakistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 3 cVDPV2-positive samples: Chad, Poland and South Sudan, 1 each.

Poland reported on 18 November that cVDPV2-positive samples had been detected in the country, from wastewater samples collected in the capital, Warsaw, on 22 October. No cases have been reported locally. Analysis shows that the virus is related to the outbreak in northern Nigeria, and it has also recently been detected in Spain.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,查德,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,波蘭,南蘇丹共和國

items.summary_zh: 西班牙瓦倫西亞11/20新增3例退伍軍人病,當局指出經供水系統傳播。
items.summary_en: Spain's Valencian Community reported 3 new Legionnaires' disease cases on 20 November; authorities say the disease spread via water systems after a DANA weather event.
items.description_zh: 西班牙東南部瓦倫西亞自治區11/20新增報告3例病例,病患居住於不同城市,惟居住地於近期均受DANA(孤立高空低氣壓,帶來強風暴雨)影響,當局表示DANA事件後,該疾病透過供水系統傳播,呼籲民眾清潔工作時做好個人防護措施,提高警覺並儘早就醫。
items.description_en: The Valencian Community in south-eastern Spain reported 3 new cases on 20 November. The patients live in different cities, but their places of residence had all recently been affected by DANA (an isolated upper-level low-pressure system bringing strong winds and heavy rain). Authorities say the disease spread through water supply systems after the DANA event, and urge people to take personal protective measures during cleaning work, stay alert and seek medical care early.

items.headline_zh: 巴西/玻利維亞-猩紅熱與侵襲性A群鏈球菌感染
items.headline_en: Brazil / Bolivia – Scarlet fever and invasive group A streptococcal infection
items.summary_zh: 巴西巴拉那州今年39例為去年同期1.9倍;玻利維亞科恰班巴新增2例死亡。
items.summary_en: Paraná State, Brazil, has reported 39 cases this year, 1.9 times last year's level; Bolivia's Cochabamba Department recorded 2 new deaths and issued an alert.
items.description_zh: 巴西南部巴拉那州今年截至11月累計報告39例病例,為去年同期之1.9倍;玻利維亞中部科恰班巴省10月底至11月初新增2例死亡病例,當局已發布流行病學警報。
items.description_en: In Paraná State in southern Brazil, 39 cases have been reported this year as of November, 1.9 times the same period last year. In Cochabamba Department in central Bolivia, 2 deaths were newly reported between late October and early November, and authorities have issued an epidemiological alert.

items.summary_zh: 非洲今年麻疹23萬2,363例、死亡3,136例;越南胡志明市單週破200例。
items.summary_en: Africa has recorded 232,363 measles cases and 3,136 deaths this year through 8 November, while Ho Chi Minh City's weekly cases topped 200.
items.description_zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
items.description_en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.
items.area_zh: 布吉納法索,蒲隆地,查德,剛果民主共和國,象牙海岸,衣索比亞,吉爾吉斯,摩洛哥,奈及利亞,索馬利亞,越南

items.summary_zh: 美國截至11/16累計22,244例,為去年同期1.3倍,亞利桑那州占逾半。
items.summary_en: US coccidioidomycosis cases reached 22,244 by 16 November, 1.3 times the same period last year, with Arizona accounting for more than half.
items.description_zh: 美國今年疫情上升,截至11/16累計報告22,244例,為去年同期之1.3倍,逾半數病例發生於亞利桑那州,該州今年疫情嚴峻,迄今累計報告12,522例,已高於過去6年之全年病例數。
items.description_en: Cases are rising in the United States this year. As of 16 November, 22,244 cases have been cumulatively reported, 1.3 times the same period last year. More than half of the cases occurred in Arizona, where the outbreak is severe this year. Arizona has cumulatively reported 12,522 cases to date, already exceeding its full-year case count for each of the past 6 years.

items.summary_zh: 南蘇丹今年累計至少162例炭疽病,3例死亡,36,861隻動物感染。
items.summary_en: South Sudan has reported at least 162 anthrax cases and 3 deaths this year, and 36,861 animals have been infected.
items.description_zh: 南蘇丹今年迄今累計報告至少162例病例,其中3例死亡(CFR:1.9%),病患以壯年人口及男性為多,均有食用病死動物肉接觸史,並出現發燒、皮膚潰瘍等症狀,分布集中於該國西南部西加札爾河州及瓦拉卜州。另該國今年迄今已有36,861隻動物感染該疾病。
items.description_en: South Sudan has cumulatively reported at least 162 cases this year so far, including 3 deaths (CFR: 1.9%). Patients are mostly working-age adults and men, all with a history of eating meat from dead animals, and presented with fever, skin ulcers and other symptoms. Cases are concentrated in Western Bahr el Ghazal State and Warrap State in the southwest of the country. In addition, 36,861 animals have been infected with the disease in the country so far this year.

items.summary_zh: 西班牙帕倫西亞省今年累計102例兔熱病,男性佔8成,主要媒介為田鼠。
items.summary_en: Palencia Province in Spain has reported 102 tularaemia cases this year, 80% men, with voles cited as the main local vector.
items.description_zh: 西班牙北部帕倫西亞省今年累計報告102例病例,其中男性佔8成,以55至64歲年齡層為多,當局表示當地主要傳播媒介為田鼠,患者多係於農務或園藝過程暴露感染。
items.description_en: Palencia Province in northern Spain has reported 102 cases cumulatively this year, 80% of them men, with most aged 55 to 64 years. Authorities say the main local transmission vector is voles, and most patients were exposed to infection during farm work or gardening.

items.headline_en: Hong Kong SAR / Viet Nam – Melioidosis
items.summary_zh: 香港11/15新增1例、今年累計22例;越南清化省11/20報告1例。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 22 melioidosis cases this year, including a new case on 15 November; Viet Nam's Thanh Hoa Province reported a case on 20 November.
items.description_zh: 香港11/15新增報告1例病例,為觀塘區80歲具慢性病史男性,10/30發病,感染源調查中;當地今年累計報告22例,較前年全年17例為高。 越南11/20新增報告1例病例,為中北部清化省36歲具慢性病史男性,病情嚴重,病患為挖土機工人,可能係於工作環境感染,當局呼籲有傷口者應避免接觸汙染土壤或水源。
items.description_en:
Hong Kong reported 1 new case on 15 November, a man aged 80 with chronic conditions from Kwun Tong District, with onset on 30 October; the source of infection is under investigation. The city has reported 22 cases so far this year, higher than the full-year total of 17 cases in the year before last.

Viet Nam reported 1 new case on 20 November, a 36-year-old man with chronic conditions from Thanh Hoa Province in north-central Viet Nam. The patient is seriously ill and works as an excavator operator and may have been infected in the work environment. Authorities urge people with wounds to avoid contact with contaminated soil or water.

items.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加今年截至10月底累計27,791例登革熱,較去年同期增逾5成。
items.summary_en: Costa Rica reported 27,791 dengue cases through late October this year, up more than 50% on the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 哥斯大黎加疫情更新,今年截至10月底累計27,791例病例,較去年同期18,125例增加逾5成,病例主要分布於首都聖荷西(3,369例),另已報告5例死亡病例。
items.description_en: Costa Rica update: As of late October this year, 27,791 cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of more than 50% over the same period last year (18,125 cases). Cases are mainly distributed in the capital, San José (3,369 cases). A total of 5 deaths have also been reported.

items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞今年截至11月2日累計110,343例瘧疾,較去年同期增約8成。
items.summary_en: Colombia has reported 110,343 malaria cases this year through 2 November, about 80% above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,今年截至11/2累計110,343例病例,較去年同期增加約8成,以間日瘧原蟲感染病例占61.9%為多,病例主要分布於西北部喬科省(35.4%)。美洲疫情主要流行於亞馬遜雨林地區及巴西、哥倫比亞、委內瑞拉、秘魯等鄰近多國之農村及叢林地區。
items.description_en: Colombia update: As of 2 November this year, 110,343 cases have been cumulatively reported, about 80% higher than the same period last year. Plasmodium vivax infections account for the majority, at 61.9%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Chocó Department in the northwest (35.4%). In the Americas, malaria is mainly prevalent in the Amazon rainforest and in rural and jungle areas of several neighbouring countries, including Brazil, Colombia, Venezuela and Peru.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲今年累計1,375例本土西尼羅熱,113例死亡,高於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Europe has recorded 1,375 locally acquired West Nile fever cases and 113 deaths this year through 6 November, above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至11/6累計19國報告1,375例本土病例,分布以義大利(449)、希臘(217)、西班牙(131)為多;累計報告113例死亡,以希臘(34)、羅馬亞(20)、義大利(18)為多。今年累計病例數高於去年同期(781),多為65歲以上男性。
items.description_en: Europe update: As of 6 November this year, 19 countries have cumulatively reported 1,375 locally acquired cases, mainly in Italy (449), Greece (217) and Spain (131). A cumulative 113 deaths have been reported, mainly in Greece (34), Romania (20) and Italy (18). Cumulative cases this year are higher than the same period last year (781), and most are men aged 65 and over.
items.area_zh: 希臘,義大利,羅馬尼亞,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 非洲今年累計55,413例M痘,1,142例死亡;加拿大首例Ib型病例。
items.summary_en: Africa CDC reports 55,413 Mpox cases and 1,142 deaths across 20 African countries through 8 November; Canada reported its first clade Ib case.
items.description_zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至11/8累計20國報告55,413例病例,其中12,162例確診,1,142例死亡(CFR:2.06%),以剛果民主共和國報告9,456例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地1,834例次之,烏干達443例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 加拿大曼托巴省11/22報告該國首例Ib型病例,個案近期有非洲流行國家旅遊史,目前隔離中,並進行接觸者追蹤,評估對一般民眾的風險仍低。
items.description_en:
According to Africa CDC, across Africa as of 8 November this year, 20 countries have cumulatively reported 55,413 cases, including 12,162 confirmed cases and 1,142 deaths (CFR: 2.06%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, reporting 9,456 confirmed cases, followed by Burundi with 1,834 cases. Uganda, with 443 cases, has seen a marked rise in its outbreak, and the remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each.

Manitoba Province, Canada, reported the country's first clade Ib case on 22 November. The patient had recently travelled to an African country with ongoing outbreaks, is in isolation, and contacts are being traced. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as still low.
items.area_zh: 蒲隆地,加拿大,剛果民主共和國,烏干達

items.summary_zh: WHO將日本LC16m8疫苗列入EUL,M痘仍為國際關注公共衛生緊急事件。
items.summary_en: WHO added Japan's LC16m8 vaccine to its Emergency Use Listing (EUL) for ages 1 and over, and said Mpox remains a PHEIC.
items.description_zh: WHO 11/20宣布核准日本LC16m8疫苗加入EUL(緊急使用清單),可用於1歲以上各年齡層個體,惟不適用孕婦及免疫低下族群。(MVA-BN疫苗目前可用於12歲以上個體) WHO 於11/22召開M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第二次會議並聲明,M痘疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,將在下週發佈委員會的完整報告及其更新的建議。
items.description_en:
On 20 November, WHO approved Japan's LC16m8 vaccine for inclusion on its Emergency Use Listing (EUL). It can be used for people aged over 1 year, but is not applicable to pregnant women or immunocompromised groups. (The MVA-BN vaccine is currently available for people aged 12 years and over.)

On 22 November, WHO convened the second meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on Mpox and stated that the Mpox outbreak continues to constitute a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). The committee's full report and updated recommendations will be released next week.

items.summary_zh: 美國加州新增1例H5N1兒童感染,症狀輕微,感染源調查中。
items.summary_en: California reported a mild H5N1 infection in a child on 22 November; the source is under investigation and the virus is assessed as not spreading between people.
items.description_zh: 美國11/22公布加州新增1例H5N1兒童感染病例,症狀輕微,感染源調查中,並進行接觸者追蹤,評估病毒尚無人際傳播能力。
items.description_en: On 22 November the United States announced one new H5N1 infection in a child in California. Symptoms were mild, the source of infection is under investigation, and contacts are being traced. The virus is assessed as not yet capable of human-to-human transmission.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國新增8例人類感染,乳牛場累計612起;14國新增151起H5N1疫情。
items.summary_en: The US reported 8 new human infections and 612 dairy farm outbreaks since March; 14 countries logged 151 new H5N1 outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  美國新增8例人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共14國於2020/10/28~2024/11/21間新增151起H5N1疫情,分別為美國77起、日本19起、斯洛維亞/加拿大各11起、波蘭9起、義大利6起、英國5起、西班牙3起、德國/南韓/匈牙利/土耳其各2起、荷蘭/法國各1起。 共3國於2024/10/31~11/13間新增8起H5N5疫情,分別為挪威3起、英國3起、冰島2起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計15州報告612(107)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少4,440例,檢測131例,其中31例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第45週計311個採檢點提供檢測報告,3州19個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國11/19研究指出,比較2004年越南(A/Vietnam/1203/2004 (VN1203))及2024年美國(A/Bovine/ Ohio/B24osu-342/ 2024 (Bov342))H5N1病毒株,二株對小鼠均具致命力,惟前者侷限於感染呼吸道,後者除導致呼吸道症狀外亦導致中樞神經炎。 美國11/18更新資訊指出,近期案例均為農場工人,均輕症,症狀為結膜炎或輕微上呼吸道症狀。其中華盛頓州H5病例病毒出現NA-S247N突變,可能略降低神經氨酸酶抑制劑敏感性,惟不至於影響藥物臨床治療效果;加州H5N1病例病毒出現PA-I38M突變,可能略降低Cap依賴型內切酶抑制劑(Baloxavir marboxil)敏感性,惟該藥物目前非H5N1建議治療用藥。 美國賓夕法亞州尚無牛隻禽流感疫情,惟宣布自11/26起針對乳品加工廠之散裝牛奶加強檢測,以預防禽流感傳播;目前無疫情即採取類措施者包括阿肯色州、麻薩諸塞州及奧克拉荷馬州。
items.description_en:
Human cases: The United States reported 8 new human infections.

Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 14 countries reported 151 new H5N1 outbreaks between 28 October 2020 and 21 November 2024: United States 77, Japan 19, Slovenia and Canada 11 each, Poland 9, Italy 6, United Kingdom 5, Spain 3, Germany, South Korea, Hungary and Turkey 2 each, and the Netherlands and France 1 each.

A total of 3 countries reported 8 new H5N5 outbreaks between 31 October and 13 November 2024: Norway 3, United Kingdom 3 and Iceland 2.

US dairy cattle avian influenza:

Dairy farms: Since March this year, 15 states have reported 612 (107) outbreaks; recent cases are mainly concentrated in California.

Human infection via cattle: At least 4,440 people have been monitored and 131 tested, with 31 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms).

Other derived outbreaks: Infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with fatal cases in cats.

Wastewater surveillance: In week 45, 311 sampling sites provided test reports; H5-positive results were detected at 19 sampling sites in 3 states.

Other updates:

A US study published on 19 November compared H5N1 viruses from Viet Nam in 2004 (A/Vietnam/1203/2004, VN1203) and the United States in 2024 (A/Bovine/Ohio/B24osu-342/2024, Bov342). Both were lethal to mice. The former was confined to the respiratory tract, whereas the latter caused central nervous system inflammation in addition to respiratory symptoms.

US information updated on 18 November indicates that recent cases were all farm workers with mild illness, showing conjunctivitis or mild upper respiratory symptoms. The virus in the Washington State H5 case carried the NA-S247N mutation, which may slightly reduce susceptibility to neuraminidase inhibitors but is unlikely to affect clinical treatment outcomes. The virus in the California H5N1 case carried the PA-I38M mutation, which may slightly reduce susceptibility to cap-dependent endonuclease inhibitors (baloxavir marboxil); however, this drug is not currently a recommended treatment for H5N1.

Pennsylvania has no avian influenza outbreaks in cattle, but announced that from 26 November it would step up testing of bulk milk at dairy processing plants to prevent the spread of avian influenza. States that have taken similar measures despite having no outbreaks include Arkansas, Massachusetts and Oklahoma.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約16.2%,日本第46週新增9,406例且上升。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 16.2% in week 43; Japan reported 9,406 cases in week 46, up from the previous week.
items.description_zh: 2024年第43週(10/28-11/3)全球陽性率約16.2%,陽性率以歐洲區(17.8%)、美洲區(12.6%)及非洲區(3.7%)為高。 美國近期處低點,近1週(11/3-11/9)陽性率3.6%,近期廢水樣本病毒量、陽性率、急診就診率及住院率持續下降,死亡數處低點,變異株以KP.3.1.1占比52%為多,其次為XEC變異株。 日本第46週(11/11-11/17)新增9,406例,病例數較前1週(11/4-11/10) 的7,246例上升,住院數亦較前1週增加,該國以KP.3.3及其衍生變異株為主流株。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 43 of 2024 (28 October–3 November), the global positivity rate was about 16.2%, highest in the European Region (17.8%), the Region of the Americas (12.6%) and the African Region (3.7%).

The United States is at low levels recently: positivity was 3.6% in the most recent week (3–9 November). Viral load in wastewater samples, positivity, emergency department visit rates and hospitalization rates have continued to decline, and deaths are at a low level. KP.3.1.1 accounts for the largest share of variants at 52%, followed by XEC variants.

Japan reported 9,406 new cases in week 46 (11–17 November), up from 7,246 in the previous week (4–10 November). Hospital admissions also rose compared with the previous week. KP.3.3 and its derived variants are the main circulating strains in the country.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 美國/歐洲-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_en: United States / Europe – Enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli infection
items.summary_zh: 美國O121:H19累計39例;密蘇里州聖路易郡O157至少97例。
items.summary_en: US E. coli outbreaks: O121:H19 has 39 cases in 18 states; St. Louis County, Missouri, has at least 97 O157 cases.
items.description_zh: 美國爆發大腸桿菌O121:H19疫情,截至11/17共18州累計報告39例,其中15例住院及1例死亡。發病日期介於9/6-10/28,多數病例於發病前曾食用胡蘿蔔,當局已召回疑受汙染之產品。 美國多地爆發O157疫情,明蘇達州自10/31以來報告10例,其中2例住院,發病日期介於11/4-11/9,多數病例曾食用漢堡及碎牛肉製品;密蘇里州聖路易郡報告至少97例,多數病例為某高中學生,感染源疑為學校活動提供之餐點。 愛爾蘭報告13例 O157:H7病例,無HUS病例及死亡病例;冰島報告23例,病例皆為某幼教機構學童;兩案感染源疑為食源性,惟感染源尚待調查。
items.description_en:
The United States has an outbreak of E. coli O121:H19: as of 17 November, 39 cases had been reported from 18 states, of whom 15 were hospitalized and 1 died. Onset dates range from 6 September to 28 October. Most patients had eaten carrots before becoming ill, and authorities have recalled suspected contaminated products.

Multiple US locations have E. coli O157 outbreaks. Minnesota has reported 10 cases since 31 October, 2 of whom were hospitalized, with onset dates between 4 and 9 November; most patients had eaten hamburgers and ground beef products. St. Louis County, Missouri, has reported at least 97 cases; most are students at a high school, and the suspected source is meals provided at a school activity.

Ireland reported 13 E. coli O157:H7 cases, with no HUS or deaths. Iceland reported 23 cases, all among children at an early childhood education centre. In both cases the source is suspected to be foodborne, but the source is still under investigation.
items.area_zh: 冰島,愛爾蘭共和國,美國

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1,奈及利亞7例及查德2例cVDPV2病例。
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases from 7 to 13 November, while Nigeria reported seven and Chad two cVDPV2 cases.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/7-11/13期間,巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1病例;共2國新增9例cVDPV2病例,其中奈及利亞7例、查德2例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增19件WPV1陽性樣本;共2國新增2件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日/塞內加爾各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 7 and 13 November, Pakistan added 3 WPV1 cases. A total of 2 countries added 9 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 7 and Chad 2. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 19 WPV1-positive samples. A total of 2 countries added 2 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Niger and Senegal.
items.area_zh: 查德,尼日,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,塞內加爾

items.summary_zh: 西班牙埃斯特雷馬杜拉自治區校園結核病群聚,截至11/11累計4例。
items.summary_en: Spain's Extremadura region reports a school tuberculosis cluster with 4 cases as of 11 November; national incidence, down over the past decade, has risen slightly since 2022.
items.description_zh: 西班牙西部埃斯特雷馬杜拉自治區爆發校園群聚,11/5報告首例,後續於接觸者中再檢出3例,截至11/11累計報告4例,該國近10年發病率呈下降趨勢,惟2022年起略有回升。
items.description_en: A school cluster of tuberculosis has been identified in the Extremadura Autonomous Community in western Spain. The first case was reported on 5 November, and 3 more cases were detected among contacts, bringing the cumulative total to 4 cases as of 11 November. Spain's incidence declined over the past decade but has risen slightly since 2022.

items.summary_zh: 香港11/14新增1例本土麻疹,衣索比亞今年累計29,391例、210例死亡。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a locally acquired measles case on 14 November; Ethiopia has reported 29,391 cases and 210 deaths this year, with 56% under age five.
items.description_zh: 香港11/14新增1例本土病例,為22歲無慢性病史女性,疫苗接種史不明,11/8發病,11/12入院隔離治療,潛伏期多出沒於香港城市大學,當局已進行接觸者追蹤,目前無人發病。 衣索比亞今年截至10月中旬累計報告29,391例病例,其中210例死亡,56%病例為5歲以下兒童,且逾6成未接種疫苗,WHO呼籲加強常規疫苗接種。
items.description_en:
Hong Kong reported 1 new locally acquired case on 14 November, a 22-year-old woman with no chronic conditions, whose vaccination history is unknown, with onset on 8 November. She was admitted to hospital for isolation treatment on 12 November. During the incubation period she frequently visited City University of Hong Kong. Authorities have traced contacts, and no contacts have developed symptoms so far.

Ethiopia has cumulatively reported 29,391 cases this year as of mid-October, including 210 deaths. Children under 5 account for 56% of cases, and more than 60% of cases were unvaccinated. WHO calls for strengthened routine vaccination.
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,香港特別行政區

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至11/13累計1,290例百日咳,2例死亡,耶拉府575例最多。
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 1,290 pertussis cases this year through 13 November, including 2 deaths, with Yala Province the most affected at 575 cases.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至11/13累計報告1,290例病例,其中2例死亡(CFR:0.16%),分布以耶拉府575例最多,年齡層則以0至4歲佔6成為多,當局呼籲民眾按時接種疫苗。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 1,290 cases so far this year as of 13 November, including 2 deaths (CFR: 0.16%). Yala Province has the most cases, with 575. Children aged 0 to 4 years account for about 60% of cases. Authorities urge people to get vaccinated on schedule.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大安大略省10月初1例兒童狂犬病死亡,越南與菲律賓新增3例死亡。
items.summary_en: Ontario, Canada reported a fatal rabies case in a child exposed to bats in early October; Viet Nam and the Philippines reported three deaths between them.
items.description_zh: 美洲疫情更新,加拿大安大略省10月初新增1例死亡案例,病患為兒童並曾接觸蝙蝠,當地蝙蝠帶原比例有升高跡象,當局呼籲民眾與蝙蝠接觸後,無論是否有傷痕,均應就醫治療;巴西托坎廷斯州10月底新增1例病例,暴露情形未敘明,當局已前往調查帶原動物。 亞洲疫情更新,越南同奈省、廣南省分別於9、10月新增1例死亡病例,均係經狗咬傷且未接種疫苗,該國狂犬病發病後死亡率為100%;菲律賓北達沃省10月底新增1例死亡病例,病患曾食用狗肉,當局已啟動追蹤共同暴露者。
items.description_en:
Americas update: In Ontario, Canada, 1 death was newly reported in early October. The patient was a child who had had contact with bats. The proportion of bats carrying rabies in the area appears to be rising. Authorities urge anyone who has had contact with bats to seek medical treatment, regardless of whether there are wounds. In Tocantins State, Brazil, 1 new case was reported in late October; the exposure circumstances were not stated, and authorities have gone to investigate rabies-carrying animals.

Asia update: In Dong Nai and Quang Nam provinces, Viet Nam, 1 death each was newly reported in September and October respectively. Both patients had been bitten by dogs and were unvaccinated. The case fatality rate of rabies in Viet Nam once symptoms develop is 100%. In Davao del Norte Province, Philippines, 1 death was newly reported in late October; the patient had eaten dog meat, and authorities have begun tracing people with shared exposure.
items.area_zh: 巴西,加拿大,菲律賓,越南

items.summary_zh: 蒙古烏布蘇省11/14新增2例炭疽病,均曾宰殺或食用同一病牛。
items.summary_en: Mongolia's Uvs Province reported 2 anthrax cases on 14 November, both from slaughtering or eating the same sick cow; 9 others with shared exposure are under observation.
items.description_zh: 蒙古西部烏布蘇省11/14報告新增2例病例,均曾宰殺或食用同一頭病牛,另有9例共同暴露者,已進行隔離觀察中。
items.description_en: In Uvs Province in western Mongolia, 2 new cases were reported on 14 November. Both had slaughtered or eaten the same sick cow. Another 9 people with shared exposure are under isolation and observation.

items.summary_en: The US has reported 53 novel influenza A cases this year, mostly linked to cattle or poultry, including one new cattle-linked case in California.
items.description_zh: 美國11/18公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關病例,型別及其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告53例病例,其中31例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(27)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
items.description_en: On 18 November the United States announced one new case in California linked to cattle; the subtype and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 53 cases so far this year, of which 31 were linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (27), Washington State (11), Colorado (10) and Michigan (2), and in Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each).

items.description_en:
Indonesia update: As of 19 October this year, more than 203,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1,210 deaths.

Sri Lanka update: So far this year, more than 42,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 20 deaths.

Nepal update: As of 25 October this year, more than 27,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 11 deaths; this is lower than the same period last year.

items.summary_en: Colombia has reported 26 yellow fever cases this year through 7 November; across the Americas, 38 confirmed cases and 19 deaths by week 35.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,今年截至11/7累計26例病例,主要分布於該國中西部托利馬省,當局已實施疫苗接種措施。今年截至第35週美洲區已報告38例確診病例,其中19例死亡,疫情主要分布於哥倫比亞、玻利維亞、秘魯、巴西及蓋亞那。
items.description_en: Colombia update: As of 7 November this year, 26 cases have been cumulatively reported, mainly in Tolima Department in west-central Colombia, and authorities have implemented vaccination measures. As of week 35 this year, the Region of the Americas has reported 38 confirmed cases, including 19 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Colombia, Bolivia, Peru, Brazil and Guyana.

items.summary_zh: 中國東北某醫院檢出18例蜱傳Yezo病毒感染,病例中位年齡53歲。
items.summary_en: Researchers detected 18 tick-borne Yezo virus infections in patient specimens collected at a northeastern China hospital from 2022 to 2024; median age was 53.
items.description_zh: 國際期刊11/7發表報告,於中國東北地區某醫院收集2022-2024年間病患檢體,檢出18例由蜱傳播感染Yezo病毒病例,以男性12例為多,病例之年齡中位數為53歲,Yezo病毒為2019年於日本北海道發現藉由蜱叮咬傳染的病毒。
items.description_en: An international journal published a report on 7 November. Specimens from patients collected between 2022 and 2024 at a hospital in northeastern China were tested, and 18 cases of tick-borne Yezo virus infection were detected. Male patients accounted for most cases (12), and the median age of cases was 53 years. Yezo virus was first identified in Hokkaido, Japan, in 2019 as a virus transmitted through tick bites.

items.summary_zh: 美國加州11/16首例第I型M痘,病患有非洲旅遊史,無持續傳播跡象。
items.summary_en: California reported its first clade I Mpox case on 16 November, in a patient with Africa travel history; no signs of ongoing spread have been found.
items.description_zh: 美國加州11/16報告首例第I型病例,病患具非洲旅遊史,目前於家中隔離,當局已追蹤相關接觸者,迄無持續傳播跡象。 非洲Ib型疫情持續,其中剛果民主共和國、蒲隆地原多係透過年輕人性接觸傳播,惟隨感染族群擴大,已轉為家庭及社區傳播,幼兒感染比例亦上升;烏干達近期疫情明顯上升,多係透過性接觸感染。 ACDC 11/6已與生技公司合作,啟動天花藥物 brincidofovir (TEMBEXA)用於治療M痘之相關試驗。
items.description_en:
California, United States, reported its first clade I case on 16 November. The patient had travel history to Africa and is isolated at home. Authorities have traced related contacts, and there are no signs of ongoing transmission so far.

Clade Ib outbreaks continue in Africa. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Burundi, transmission was originally mostly through sexual contact among young people; as the affected population has expanded, transmission has shifted to household and community spread, and the proportion of young children infected has also risen. In Uganda, the outbreak has risen markedly recently, with infection mostly through sexual contact.

Africa CDC, on 6 November, worked with a biotechnology company to launch trials of the smallpox drug brincidofovir (TEMBEXA) for treating Mpox.

items.summary_zh: 加拿大英屬哥倫比亞省11/13確診首例H5N1人類感染,病情危急。
items.summary_en: British Columbia, Canada, confirmed a first human H5N1 infection on 13 November, in a critically ill adolescent with no known poultry exposure.
items.description_zh: 加拿大英屬哥倫比亞省11/13宣布確診首例H5N1人類感染病例,病患為青少年,目前住院中,病情危急,已進行接觸者追蹤並預防性投藥,迄未發現更多病例;病患無接觸禽鳥或高風險環境,感染源仍不明,病毒型別為2.3.4.4b(D1.1),與當地家禽流行病毒相關,當局已排除透過乳牛或牛乳感染。
items.description_en: British Columbia, Canada, announced on 13 November the first confirmed human H5N1 infection in the country. The patient is an adolescent, currently hospitalized in critical condition. Contact tracing and prophylactic treatment have been carried out, and no further cases have been found so far. The patient had no contact with birds or high-risk environments, and the source of infection remains unknown. The virus is genotype 2.3.4.4b (D1.1), related to locally circulating poultry viruses, and authorities have ruled out transmission from dairy cows or milk.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 加拿大1例H5N1、中國7例H9N2人類感染;19國新增128起動物疫情。
items.summary_en: Canada reported one H5N1 human case and China seven H9N2 cases; 19 countries logged 128 new animal H5N1 outbreaks.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  加拿大新增1例H5N1、中國新增7例H9N2人類感染病例  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共19國於2024/10/15~2024/11/14間新增128起H5N1疫情,分別為美國/匈牙利各46起、德國5起、義大利/捷克/法國各4起、波蘭/日本各3起、臺灣/土耳其各2起、羅馬亞/葡萄牙/瑞士/斯洛伐克/烏克蘭/香港/英國/保加利亞/加拿大1起。 法國於2024/11/1~2024/11/13間新增3起H5 (N untyped)疫情。 加拿大於2024/10/31新增1起H5N2疫情。 英國於2024/11/4新增1起H5N5疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計15州報告505(59)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州及猶他州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少4,010例,檢測121例,其中25例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。  其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第44週計324個採檢點提供檢測報告,1州14個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  11/2研究(預印本)顯示,特定出生年份之老年人對H5N1病毒之抵抗力較高,可能是童年曾接觸H1N1及H2N2病毒之故;而在接種H5N1疫苗後,年輕與老年族群均能產生H5反應性抗體,其中幼兒之血清轉化率較高,顯示發生疫情時,年輕族群接種疫苗之效益較佳。 11/5研究(預印本)表示,柬埔寨2023年2月至2024年8月間之16例H5N1人類病例,均係由2.3.2.1c進化支引起,其中14例為2.3.2.1c及2.3.4.4b之重組病毒,推測為該國疫情再次發生的可能原因,亦突顯東南亞始終存在疫情威脅。 11/11研究表示,2022年來南美洲多國出現海洋哺乳動物HPAI H5N1疫情,研究發現病毒多具相同哺乳動物適應突變,且已溢出回燕鷗中;H5N1之哺乳動物間傳播案例,已分別於北美乳牛場、歐洲毛皮養殖場及南美海洋野生動物中發生,為一不應忽視之警訊。 美國夏威夷州歐胡島11/7首次於廢水中檢出H5病毒,尚無法確認病毒來源;該州迄無報告人類及動物病例,當局表示民眾風險仍低,惟鼓勵採取預防措施。
items.description_en:
Human cases: Canada reported 1 new H5N1 infection, and China reported 7 new H9N2 human infections.

Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 19 countries reported 128 new H5N1 outbreaks between 15 October and 14 November 2024: United States and Hungary 46 each, Germany 5, Italy, Czechia and France 4 each, Poland and Japan 3 each, Taiwan and Turkey 2 each, and Romania, Portugal, Switzerland, Slovakia, Ukraine, Hong Kong, United Kingdom, Bulgaria and Canada 1 each.

France reported 3 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 1 and 13 November 2024.

Canada reported 1 new H5N2 outbreak on 31 October 2024.

The United Kingdom reported 1 new H5N5 outbreak on 4 November 2024.

US dairy cattle avian influenza:

Dairy farms: Since March this year, 15 states have reported 505 (59) outbreaks; recent cases are mainly concentrated in California and Utah.

Human infection via cattle: At least 4,010 people have been monitored and 121 tested, with 25 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms).

Other derived outbreaks: Infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with fatal cases in cats.

Wastewater surveillance: In week 44, 324 sampling sites provided test reports; H5-positive results were detected at 14 sampling sites in 1 state.

Other updates:

A preprint study published on 2 November found that older people born in certain years had higher resistance to H5N1 virus, possibly because they were exposed to H1N1 and H2N2 viruses in childhood. After H5N1 vaccination, both younger and older groups produced H5-reactive antibodies, with young children showing higher seroconversion rates, suggesting that vaccinating younger groups may be more effective during an outbreak.

A preprint study published on 5 November reported that all 16 H5N1 human cases in Cambodia between February 2023 and August 2024 were caused by clade 2.3.2.1c, and 14 of them were reassortant viruses of clades 2.3.2.1c and 2.3.4.4b. This is presumed to be a possible reason for the recurrence of outbreaks in the country and also highlights the persistent outbreak threat in Southeast Asia.

A study published on 11 November reported that since 2022, several South American countries have had HPAI H5N1 outbreaks in marine mammals. The study found that the viruses largely carry the same mammalian adaptation mutations and have spilled back into terns. Cases of mammal-to-mammal transmission of H5N1 have already occurred in North American dairy farms, European fur farms and South American marine wildlife, a warning sign that should not be ignored.

On 7 November, Oahu, Hawaii, United States detected H5 virus in wastewater for the first time; the source of the virus cannot yet be confirmed. The state has reported no human or animal cases, and authorities say the risk to the public remains low but encourage precautionary measures.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約16.5%,歐盟自7月高峰後持續下降。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 16.5% in week 43; EU countries' activity has declined steadily since their July peak.
items.description_zh: 2024年第43週(10/28-11/3)全球陽性率約16.5%,陽性率以歐洲區(17.8%)、美洲區(13.0%)及非洲區(5.0%)為高。 中國公布10月新冠病毒感染疫情,新增57例重症及6例死亡,近期發燒門診就診量、定點醫院類流感病例占比持平,新冠病毒陽性率處低點,以XDV及JN.1為該國主流變異株;香港各項指標處低點,以JN.1衍生變異株為主流株。 歐盟各國自7月疫情達高峰後,持續呈下降趨勢,其定點醫院之陽性率低於去年同期或持平,病例仍以65歲以上族群為主,近期KP.3為主流變異株,占比約60%。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 43 of 2024 (28 October–3 November), the global positivity rate was about 16.5%, highest in the European Region (17.8%), the Region of the Americas (13.0%) and the African Region (5.0%).

China reported COVID-19 infection data for October, with 57 new severe cases and 6 deaths. Fever clinic visits and the proportion of influenza-like illness cases at sentinel hospitals have remained stable recently, and COVID-19 positivity is at a low level. XDV and JN.1 are the main circulating variants in the country. Hong Kong's indicators are at low levels, with JN.1-derived variants the main circulating strains.

EU countries have shown a continuing downward trend since their July peak. Positivity at sentinel hospitals is lower than the same period last year or stable, cases are still mainly among people aged 65 and over, and KP.3 is the main circulating variant recently, accounting for about 60%.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲16國232例沙門氏菌感染,義大利西西里番茄可能為感染源。
items.summary_en: Sixteen European countries reported 232 Salmonella Strathcona cases from 2023 to November 2024, mostly in Italy (67) and Germany (62); Sicilian tomatoes are a possible source.
items.description_zh: 歐洲多國爆發Salmonella Strathcona,自2023年1/1截至2024年11/5,共16國報告232例,以義大利67例為多,其次為德國62例。經調查,基因定序結果顯示疫情菌株具共同來源,義大利西西里地區所產番茄為可能的感染源,惟實際感染源及汙染途徑尚待釐清。
items.description_en: Multiple European countries have experienced an outbreak of Salmonella Strathcona. From 1 January 2023 to 5 November 2024, 16 countries reported 232 cases, with Italy the most affected at 67 cases, followed by Germany at 62. Investigations show that genetic sequencing results indicate the outbreak strains share a common source. Tomatoes produced in the Sicily region of Italy are the possible source, but the actual source and contamination route are still to be clarified.

items.summary_zh: 美國O157:H7疫情累計104例,14州,可能感染源為洋蔥。
items.summary_en: US E. coli O157:H7 outbreak has reached 104 cases across 14 states, including 4 HUS cases; onions are the possible source.
items.description_zh: 美國大腸桿菌O157:H7疫情更新,截至11/13共14州累計報告104例,其中34例住院,4例HUS病例,1例死亡。目前調查顯示可能感染源為洋蔥,當局已召回可能受汙染之原料,評估對民眾健康風險為低。
items.description_en: United States update on E. coli O157:H7: As of 13 November, 104 cases have been cumulatively reported from 14 states, including 34 hospitalized, 4 HUS (haemolytic uraemic syndrome) cases and 1 death. Investigations currently indicate that the possible source is onions. Authorities have recalled raw materials that may be contaminated and assess the health risk to the public as low.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1,5國新增12例cVDPV2,奈及利亞7例。
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case, five countries reported 12 cVDPV2 cases, and Nigeria accounted for seven.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 10/31-11/6期間,巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1病例;剛果民主共和國新增2例cVDPV1病例;共5國新增12例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞7例、葉門2例,衣索比亞/塞內加爾/日各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增53件WPV1陽性樣本;共3國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為阿爾及利亞2件及日/奈及利亞1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 31 October and 6 November, Pakistan added 1 WPV1 case; the Democratic Republic of the Congo added 2 cVDPV1 cases; and a total of 5 countries added 12 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 7, Yemen 2, and Ethiopia, Senegal and Niger 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 53 WPV1-positive samples. A total of 3 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples: Algeria 2, and Niger and Nigeria 1 each.
