items.summary_zh: 玻利維亞塔里哈省11/8新增5例漢他病毒症候群,患者皆30多歲。
items.summary_en: Tarija Department in Bolivia reported 5 hantavirus syndrome cases on 8 November, all aged in their 30s, across 3 urban areas.
items.description_zh: 玻利維亞南部塔里哈省11/8新增報告5例病例,年齡均為30多歲,分布於3市區,當局呼籲農村地區提高警覺。
items.description_en: In Tarija Department in southern Bolivia, 5 new cases were reported on 8 November. All patients were in their 30s, and cases were distributed across 3 urban areas. Authorities call on rural areas to raise vigilance.

items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年近1,500例麻疹,加拿大紐布朗斯維克省25例。
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has reported nearly 1,500 measles cases this year as of 7 November, a quarter of them infants; New Brunswick, Canada, reported 25 cases.
items.description_zh: 越南南部胡志明市疫情持續上升,10月底單週新增140餘例,今年截至11/7累計報告近1,500例,其中1/4為未符合疫苗接種對象之未滿9個月幼兒,當局已核准6個月以上幼兒提前接種單價麻疹疫苗,並擴大接種對象至學校及社福機構人員。 加拿大東部紐布朗斯維克省(New Brunswick)疫情上升,今年10月中旬迄今累計報告25例,預期仍有潛在案例,當局呼籲民眾加強防護及接種疫苗。
items.description_en:
Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam continues to see rising outbreaks. Weekly new cases exceeded 140 in late October, and cumulative cases this year reached nearly 1,500 as of 7 November. About one quarter of cases were infants under 9 months old, who are not eligible for vaccination. Authorities have approved early vaccination with monovalent measles vaccine for children aged 6 months and older, and have expanded vaccination to staff at schools and social welfare institutions.

In New Brunswick, eastern Canada, outbreaks are rising, with 25 cases cumulatively reported since mid-October this year. Further potential cases are expected, and authorities urge people to strengthen protection and get vaccinated.

items.summary_zh: 拉脫維亞今年累計2,517例、1例死亡;韓國疑似病例逾3萬例,嬰兒死亡。
items.summary_en: Latvia has reported 2,517 pertussis cases this year, including one death; South Korea has reported 30,332 suspected cases and its first death, in an infant.
items.description_zh: 拉脫維亞疫情升高,9月單月新增680例病例,且發病率仍持續上升,今年迄今累計報告2,517例,其中1例死亡;該國去年僅報告112例。 韓國11/12報告今年首例死亡病例,為未滿2個月嬰兒,於接種首劑疫苗前即感染;該國今年疫情嚴峻,累計報告30,332例疑病例,遠高於新冠疫情前規模(單年千例以下),病例分布於全國,多發生於7至19歲青少年,當局呼籲高風險族群按時接種疫苗。
items.description_en:
Latvia's outbreak is rising. In September alone, 680 new cases were reported, and incidence continues to climb. This year, 2,517 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1 death; the country reported only 112 cases last year.

South Korea reported its first death this year on 12 November, in an infant under 2 months old who was infected before receiving the first dose of vaccine. The outbreak in the country this year is severe, with 30,332 suspected cases cumulatively reported, far above the pre-COVID-19 level of fewer than 1,000 cases per year. Cases are distributed nationwide, mostly among adolescents aged 7 to 19. Authorities urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated on schedule.

items.summary_zh: 中國新增7例H9N2人類感染,湖南4例,1例為67歲女性。
items.summary_en: China reported 7 new human H9N2 infections with onset from late September to mid-October, 4 of them in Hunan Province.
items.description_zh: 香港11/12禽流感週報指出,中國新增報告7例H9N2人類感染病例,發病時間介於9/23至10/14,分布於湖南省4例、湖北/江西/四川省各1例,其中1例為67歲成年女性,餘為7歲以下兒童。
items.description_en: Hong Kong's weekly avian influenza report dated 12 November states that China reported 7 new human H9N2 infections, with onset between 23 September and 14 October. Four were in Hunan Province, and one each in Hubei, Jiangxi and Sichuan provinces. One patient was a 67-year-old adult woman, and the rest were children under 7 years old.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達卡左區群聚5例,孟加拉諾多爾縣群聚12例,疑食用或屠宰感染動物所致。
items.summary_en: Uganda's Kazo cluster (5 cases) involved people who slaughtered a dead cow; Bangladesh's Natore cluster has 12 cases.
items.description_zh: 烏干達卡左區(Kazo)11/8報告群聚感染事件,累計報告5例病例,皆已隔離治療,該些病患均曾屠宰一頭死亡牛隻。 孟加拉中部拉傑沙希專區諾多爾縣10月爆發群聚感染事件,迄今累計報告12例病例,當地近2個月曾出現牛隻及山羊疫情,推測本次群聚事件為食用或屠宰感染動物所致,當局已加強牲畜疫苗接種。
items.description_en:
In the Kazo area of Uganda, a cluster was reported on 8 November with 5 cumulative cases, all isolated for treatment. All of these patients had slaughtered a dead cow.

In Natore District, Rajshahi Division, central Bangladesh, a cluster outbreak began in October, with 12 cumulative cases reported so far. Cattle and goat outbreaks have occurred in the area in the past two months. The cluster is presumed to be due to eating or slaughtering infected animals, and authorities have stepped up livestock vaccination.

items.headline_zh: 法屬玻里尼西亞-鉤端螺旋體病
items.summary_zh: 法屬玻里尼西亞今年累計153例鉤端螺旋體病,逾8成病例環境有鼠。
items.summary_en: French Polynesia has reported 153 leptospirosis cases this year as of 19 October, with rats present in more than 80% of patients' living or working environments.
items.description_zh: 法屬玻里西亞今年疫情於2月底陡升,復於3月中旬趨緩後持續迄今,截至10/19累計報告153例病例,多數從事園藝/農業活動,其中逾8成病患之生活/工作環境存在老鼠。
items.description_en: In French Polynesia, cases this year rose sharply at the end of February, eased in mid-March and have continued since then. As of 19 October, 153 cases have been cumulatively reported. Most patients were engaged in gardening or agricultural activities, and in more than 80% of patients' living or working environments, rats were present.

items.summary_zh: 美國科羅拉多州圓石郡11/1新增1例兔熱病,今年全國累計193例。
items.summary_en: A new tularaemia case was reported on 1 November in Yuanshi County, Colorado, presumed to be an insect bite; the US has 193 cases this year.
items.description_zh: 美國科羅拉多州圓石郡11/1新增報告1例病例,病患於10/2發病,出現發燒、精神狀態改變及肺積水等症狀,曾有犬貓接觸史,惟犬貓未有生病跡象,研判可能係經昆蟲叮咬感染;該國今年累計報告193例。
items.description_en: In Yuanshi County (圓石郡), Colorado, United States, 1 new case was reported on 1 November. The patient developed symptoms on 2 October, including fever, altered mental status and pulmonary oedema. The patient had contact with dogs and cats, but the animals showed no signs of illness, so infection is presumed to have been acquired through an insect bite. The country has reported 193 cases this year.

items.headline_zh: 盧安達-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 盧安達馬堡病毒出血熱累計66例、15例死亡,末例11/8出院,待42日無新增。
items.summary_en: Rwanda's Marburg outbreak has 66 confirmed cases and 15 deaths; the last patient was discharged on 8 November, and no new cases in 42 days would end it.
items.description_zh: WHO公布盧安達最後1例病例已於11/8出院,倘未來42日內無發生新病例,則將宣布本次疫情結束。該國自9/27疫情爆發迄今累計確診66例,其中15例死亡(CFR:22.7%),近8成為醫療感染,並未產生社區傳播鏈。
items.description_en: WHO reports that Rwanda's last patient was discharged from hospital on 8 November. If no new cases occur within 42 days, the outbreak will be declared over. Since the outbreak began on 27 September, the country has cumulatively confirmed 66 cases, including 15 deaths (CFR: 22.7%). Nearly 80% were healthcare-associated infections, and no community transmission chains have developed.

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾今年累計80例日本腦炎,23例死亡,致死率逾28%,超過去年7例死亡。
items.summary_en: Nepal has reported 80 Japanese encephalitis cases this year from 30 districts, with 23 deaths, a fatality rate above 28%, exceeding last year's 7 deaths.
items.description_zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年迄今累計30縣報告80例病例,其中23例死亡,致死率已超過28%,高於去年7例死亡,病例年齡以15歲以下兒童為多。
items.description_en: Japanese encephalitis is rising in Nepal. So far this year, 80 cases have been cumulatively reported from 30 districts, including 23 deaths, a case fatality rate above 28%. Deaths this year already exceed the 7 reported last year. Most cases are among children under 15 years old.

items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦信德省逾411例疑似屈公病、153例確診;印度馬爾達縣24例。
items.summary_en: Pakistan's Sindh Province has over 411 suspected chikungunya cases this year, 153 confirmed; India's Malda District has reported 24 cases.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦信德省疫情上升,今年迄今累計逾411例疑病例,其中153例確診。 印度東部西孟加拉邦馬爾達縣爆發疫情,迄今累計報告24例病例,當局已採取相關防治措施。
items.description_en:
Pakistan: Cases are rising in Sindh Province. So far this year, more than 411 suspected cases have been cumulatively reported, including 153 confirmed cases.

India: An outbreak has occurred in Malda District, West Bengal State, in eastern India. So far, 24 cases have been cumulatively reported, and authorities have adopted relevant prevention and control measures.

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉/巴基斯坦-登革熱
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年累計逾6.5萬例登革熱,326例死亡;巴基斯坦信德省1,724例。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported over 65,000 dengue cases and 326 deaths this year; Pakistan's Sindh Province has reported 1,724 cases, 1 death.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,今年迄今累計65,000餘例病例,其中326例死亡,以10月份報告134例死亡數最多,每年8-9月為疫情高峰期;該國去年累計1,000餘例死亡案例。 巴基斯坦東南部信德省疫情上升,今年迄今累計1,724例病例,其中1例死亡,病例主要分布於喀拉蚩1,484例。
items.description_en:
Bangladesh: Cases are rising. So far this year, more than 65,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 326 deaths. October had the highest number of reported deaths, at 134. August and September are the annual peak period for dengue, and the country recorded more than 1,000 deaths last year.

Pakistan: Sindh Province in southeastern Pakistan has seen rising cases. So far this year, 1,724 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1 death; cases are mainly distributed in Karachi, which accounts for 1,484 cases.

items.headline_zh: 蘇丹-不明原因致死疾病
items.summary_zh: 蘇丹傑濟拉州阿爾希拉利亞市11/7爆發不明腹瀉群聚,至少73例死亡。
items.summary_en: An unexplained diarrhoeal cluster in al-Hilaliya, Sudan, has reported at least 73 deaths since 7 November; its cause remains unconfirmed amid recent military attacks.
items.description_zh: 蘇丹東部傑濟拉州阿爾希拉利亞市(al-Hilaliya)11/7爆發不明原因腹瀉群聚事件,累計至少73例死亡;當地近期受軍事襲擊,無法確認爆發疫情原因。
items.description_en: In al-Hilaliya city in Gezira State, eastern Sudan, an unexplained diarrhoeal cluster broke out on 7 November, with at least 73 deaths cumulatively reported. Due to recent military attacks in the area, the cause of the outbreak cannot be confirmed.

items.summary_zh: 義大利維羅納11/7新增1例境外移入瘧疾,自1970年代起無本土病例。
items.summary_en: Italy reported one imported malaria case in Verona on 7 November, linked to recent travel to Nigeria; Italy has had no local cases since the 1970s.
items.description_zh: 義大利北部維羅納11/7報告1例境外移入病例,個案近期有瘧疾流行國家奈及利亞旅遊史,該國自1970年代以來零本土病例。
items.description_en: Verona in northern Italy reported 1 imported malaria case on 7 November. The patient had recently travelled to Nigeria, a malaria-endemic country. Italy has had no locally acquired cases since the 1970s.

items.summary_zh: 非洲今年累計49,310例M痘,1,059例死亡,剛果民主共和國最多。
items.summary_en: Africa has reported 49,310 Mpox cases and 1,059 deaths this year as of 25 October, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo most affected.
items.description_zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至10/25累計19國報告49,310例病例,其中10,672例確診,1,059例死亡(CFR:2.15%),以剛果民主共和國報告8,607例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地1,059例次之,其餘各國報告1至175例不等。
items.description_en: According to Africa CDC, in Africa as of 25 October this year, 19 countries have cumulatively reported 49,310 cases, including 10,672 confirmed cases and 1,059 deaths (CFR: 2.15%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, with 8,607 confirmed cases, followed by Burundi with 1,059 cases. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 175 cases each.
items.area_zh: 蒲隆地,剛果民主共和國

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計46例,加州新增1例牛隻相關、華盛頓州新增1例家禽相關。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 46 novel influenza A cases this year, with one new cattle-linked case in California and one new poultry-linked H5 case in Washington State.
items.description_zh: 美國11/6公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關之型別不明病例、華盛頓州新增1例與家禽相關之H5病例,其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告46例病例,其中25例與牛隻相關,20例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(21)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。*先前管轄權不明案例已歸入華盛頓州。 美國奧勒岡州11/6公布再新增1件豬隻感染H5N1流感案例,為前案同農場豬隻,定序結果顯示感染病毒屬D1.2基因型,與該農場禽類疫情相同,並與該地區之候鳥樣本相。
items.description_en:
On 6 November the United States announced one new California case linked to cattle, of unidentified type, and one new Washington State H5 case linked to poultry; other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 46 cases so far this year, of which 25 were linked to cattle, 20 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (21), Washington State (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each). *A previously unclear-jurisdiction case has been attributed to Washington State.

On 6 November, Oregon announced one additional H5N1 influenza case in a swine. It was from the same farm as the previous case; sequencing shows the virus belongs to genotype D1.2, the same as the poultry outbreaks on that farm, and it is related to migratory bird samples from the area.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 13國新增201起H5N1疫情;美國乳牛場累計446起,25例人類陽性。
items.summary_en: Thirteen countries reported 201 new H5N1 outbreaks; US dairy farms have 446 outbreaks since March, with 25 positive human cases.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  美國新增通報2例H5、4例未分型人類感染病例。 加拿大新增通報1例H5人類感染(疑)病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共13國於2024/1/14~11/7間新增201起HPAI H5N1疫情,分別為美國77起、匈牙利64起、斯洛維亞及加拿大各11起、義大利7起、波蘭及日本各6起、德國、捷克及南韓各5起、土耳其各2起、摩爾多瓦及烏克蘭各1起。 法國於2024/11/1新增1起HPAI H5(N untyped)疫情。 共3國於2024/8/14~11/1間新增8起HPAI H5N5疫情,分別為英國5起、法羅群島2起、挪威1起。 南韓於2024/10/2新增1起HPAI H5N3疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計15(1*)州報告446(43)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州、猶他州。*猶他州USDA 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少3,870例,檢測112例,其中25例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。CDC、CDC 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第43周計317個採檢點提供檢測報告,2州6採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  MMWR 11/7研究顯示,美國CDC於6至8月間在密西根州及科羅拉多州進行血清學調查,115位乳品廠工人中,8位(7%)具近期感染之血清學證據,8例案例工作均與擠乳有關,其中4人表示發病時間點均發生於乳牛發病之前後數日內。 美國CDC 11/1更新近期研究摘要,以德州人類病毒樣本(A/Texas/37/2024)進行之研究中,雪貂間直接接觸傳染率為100%,經呼吸道或污染表面傳染率則為66%;受感染雪貂均重症並死亡,與西班牙水貂、智利人類病毒樣本結果一致,但與密西根州人類病毒樣本結果不同;另德州病毒較具哺乳類適應性特徵(PB2 E627K  K142E),該國將進一步進行IRAT評估。
items.description_en:
Human cases: The US reported 2 new H5 and 4 untyped human infections. Canada reported 1 new suspected H5 human infection.

Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 13 countries reported 201 new HPAI H5N1 outbreaks between 14 January and 7 November 2024: United States 77, Hungary 64, Slovenia and Canada 11 each, Italy 7, Poland and Japan 6 each, Germany, Czechia and South Korea 5 each, Turkey 2 each, and Moldova and Ukraine 1 each.

France reported 1 new HPAI H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 1 November 2024.

A total of 3 countries reported 8 new HPAI H5N5 outbreaks between 14 August and 1 November 2024: United Kingdom 5, Faroe Islands 2 and Norway 1.

South Korea reported 1 new HPAI H5N3 outbreak on 2 October 2024.

US dairy cattle avian influenza:

Dairy farms: Since March this year, 15 (1*) states have reported 446 (43) outbreaks; recent cases are mainly concentrated in California and Utah. *Utah, USDA

Human infection via cattle: At least 3,870 people have been monitored and 112 tested, with 25 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms) (CDC, CDC).

Other derived outbreaks: Infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with fatal cases in cats.

Wastewater surveillance: In week 43, 317 sampling sites provided test reports; H5-positive results were detected at 6 sampling sites in 2 states.

Other updates:

An MMWR report published on 7 November found that the US CDC conducted serological surveys in Michigan and Colorado between June and August. Of 115 dairy plant workers, 8 (7%) showed serological evidence of recent infection. The work of all 8 cases was related to milking, and 4 of them said their illness began within a few days before or after the cows fell ill.

On 1 November the US CDC updated a summary of a recent study. In the study using a human virus sample from Texas (A/Texas/37/2024), direct contact transmission between ferrets was 100%, and transmission via respiratory route or contaminated surfaces was 66%. All infected ferrets became severely ill and died. These results are consistent with those for a Spanish mink and a Chilean human virus sample, but differ from those for a human virus sample from Michigan. The Texas virus also has more mammalian-adaptation features (PB2 E627K and K142E), and the country will conduct a further IRAT assessment.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約19.4%;近28天病例升18%、死亡降25%。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 19.4% in week 42; over the past 28 days cases rose 18% and deaths fell 25%.
items.description_zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第42週(10/21-10/27)全球陽性率約19.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(21.1%)、美洲區(13.1%)及非洲區(6.7%)為高。 日本以KP.3.3及其衍生株為主流變異株,XEC占比約4.3%,東京都XEC占比上升,近期(10/14-10/20)占比達25%。  WHO更新全球疫情資訊:  全球近28天(9/16-10/13)新增逾33萬例病例及4,500例死亡,病例數較前28天分別上升18%及下降25%;住院數及重症數分別新增逾2.5萬例及800例,住院數及重症數較前28天期間分別下降9%及39%。 10月中旬(10/7-10/13),全球主要流行變異株KP.3.1.1、XEC、JN.1、KP.3占比分別為51.1%、17.2%、12.2%、10.9%,其中變異株KP.3.1.1及XEC占比呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 42 of 2024 (21–27 October), the global positivity rate was about 19.4%, highest in the European Region (21.1%), the Region of the Americas (13.1%) and the African Region (6.7%).

In Japan, KP.3.3 and its derived strains are the main circulating variants, and XEC accounts for about 4.3%. The XEC share has risen in Tokyo Metropolis, reaching 25% in the recent period (14–20 October).

WHO global update: In the past 28 days (16 September–13 October), more than 330,000 new cases and 4,500 deaths were reported globally. Compared with the previous 28 days, cases rose by 18% and deaths fell by 25%. New hospital admissions and severe cases totalled more than 25,000 and 800, respectively. Compared with the previous 28-day period, hospitalizations fell by 9% and severe cases by 39%.

In mid-October (7–13 October), the shares of the main global variants were KP.3.1.1 51.1%, XEC 17.2%, JN.1 12.2% and KP.3 10.9%. The shares of KP.3.1.1 and XEC are trending upward.

items.headline_zh: 中國-病毒性腸胃炎(諾羅病毒)
items.summary_zh: 中國多地諾羅病毒進入高峰,廣東腹瀉疫情高於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Norovirus infections in many parts of China have reached their peak; Guangdong's diarrhoeal outbreaks are above the same period last year.
items.description_zh: 中國多地諾羅病毒感染疫情進入高峰,廣東省諾羅病毒等腹瀉症狀疫情較去年同期為高,另學生症狀監視之腹瀉症狀報告率亦高於近3年同期,當局呼籲民眾注意手部及食品衛生。
items.description_en: Norovirus infections have reached their peak in many parts of China. In Guangdong Province, diarrhoeal outbreaks, including norovirus, are higher than in the same period last year. The reporting rate of diarrhoeal symptoms in student symptom surveillance is also higher than in the same period of the past three years. Authorities urge people to pay attention to hand and food hygiene.

items.summary_zh: 香港1例腸病毒71型重症,12日齡女嬰併發腦膜炎,病情穩定。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported a severe EV71 case in a 12-day-old girl with meningitis, now stable; an earlier outbreak at her brother's childcare centre involved six children.
items.description_zh: 香港報告1例腸病毒71型重症病例,為12日齡之新生女嬰,確診腸病毒感染並併發腦膜炎,目前情況穩定。案兄及父親曾出現病徵,現已康復。案兄所在幼教機構曾爆發腸病毒,涉及6名幼童。當局對有病徵幼童進行檢驗,該機構停業並進行消毒。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported 1 severe enterovirus 71 (EV71) case, a 12-day-old newborn girl. She was confirmed to have an enterovirus infection complicated by meningitis, and her condition is currently stable. The patient's older brother and father had symptoms and have recovered. The early childhood centre attended by the older brother previously had an enterovirus outbreak involving 6 young children. Authorities tested children with symptoms, and the centre was closed for business and disinfected.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦2例WPV1,查德2例cVDPV2及幾內亞3例cVDPV3。
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported two new WPV1 cases, Chad two cVDPV2 cases and Guinea three cVDPV3 cases between 24 and 30 October.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 10/24-10/30期間,巴基斯坦新增2例WPV1病例;查德新增2例cVDPV2病例;幾內亞新增3例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分,阿富汗新增1件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為喀麥隆/幾內亞/日/塞內加爾各1件。 西班牙於10/3報告該國首件cVDPV2陽性樣本,該樣本於9月中旬自該國東北部加泰隆亞廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例,當地疫苗覆蓋率逾92%,評估對公眾健康影響有限。 法屬圭亞那於10/14首次檢出cVDPV3陽性樣本,樣本採集自首府開雲(Cayenne),目前尚無報告病例。
items.description_en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 24 and 30 October, Pakistan added 2 WPV1 cases, Chad added 2 cVDPV2 cases and Guinea added 3 cVDPV3 cases. For environmental samples, Afghanistan added 1 WPV1-positive sample; a total of 4 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Cameroon, Guinea, Niger and Senegal.

Spain reported on 3 October its first cVDPV2-positive sample, detected in mid-September in wastewater from Catalonia in northeastern Spain. No cases have been reported locally, local vaccination coverage exceeds 92%, and the impact on public health is assessed as limited.

French Guiana detected its first cVDPV3-positive sample on 14 October. The sample was collected in the capital, Cayenne. No cases have been reported so far.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,查德,幾內亞,尼日,巴基斯坦,喀麥隆,塞內加爾

items.summary_zh: 英國11/6新增1例Ib型M痘,為首例家庭接觸者,累計確診4例。
items.summary_en: The UK reported a clade Ib Mpox case on 6 November, a household contact of the first case, bringing confirmed cases to four.
items.description_zh: 英國11/6公布新增1例Ib型病例,為首例病患之家庭接觸者,目前確診病例總數累計4例,當局已加強接觸者追蹤及疫苗接種,研判該國整體風險仍為低。
items.description_en: The United Kingdom announced on 6 November one new clade Ib case, a household contact of the first patient. The cumulative total of confirmed cases is now 4. Authorities have strengthened contact tracing and vaccination, and assess the overall risk to the country as still low.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 香港今年10月新增17例退伍軍人病,累計104例,1例自中國移入。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 17 Legionnaires' disease cases in October, with one imported from mainland China; the year-to-date total is 104.
items.description_zh: 香港今年10月新增報告17例病例,年齡介於55至89歲間,其中10例為男性,1例為自中國移入,餘分布於9個社區,所有病例均具慢性病史;當地今年迄今累計報告104例,前2年分別報告80及121例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported 17 new cases in October this year, aged 55 to 89 years. Ten were male, 1 was imported from mainland China, and the rest were distributed across 9 communities. All cases had chronic conditions. So far this year, Hong Kong has reported 104 cumulative cases; in the previous two years, 80 and 121 cases were reported, respectively.

items.summary_zh: 美國百日咳單週462例、今年累計逾2萬例;捷克累計34,423例。
items.summary_en: US pertussis reached 462 weekly cases in week 43 and 20,824 cumulative cases by 26 October; Czechia has 34,423 cases, with 12 deaths.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情上升,第43週單週新增462例,明顯較前2週之246、348例為高,今年截至10/26累計報告20,824例病例,為去年同期之4.5倍,其中以賓州、威斯康辛州、伊利諾州、紐約州及加州等地最為嚴峻。 南太平洋法屬波里西亞疫情上升,10月下旬單週新增30餘例病例,自6月爆發疫情迄今累計報告191例,其中10例兒童住院治療;新喀里多亞今年截至10月中旬累計報告79例病例,其中44%為14歲以下兒童,分布以南部省佔近6成最多。 捷克疫情持續嚴峻,今年截至11/3累計報告34,423例病例,其中2.4%住院,12例死亡,以15至19歲年齡層發病率最高,分布以該國東北部摩拉維亞-西利西亞州4,125例最多。
items.description_en:
United States: Pertussis is rising. Weekly new cases reached 462 in week 43, clearly higher than the 246 and 348 in the previous two weeks. As of 26 October this year, 20,824 cases have been cumulatively reported, 4.5 times the same period last year. The most severely affected areas include Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Illinois, New York State and California.

French Polynesia in the South Pacific: Cases are rising. Weekly new cases exceeded 30 in late October. Since the outbreak began in June, 191 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 10 children hospitalized for treatment. New Caledonia: As of mid-October this year, 79 cases have been cumulatively reported, 44% of whom are children under 14. Cases are concentrated in the Southern Province, which accounts for nearly 60%.

Czechia: The outbreak remains severe. As of 3 November this year, 34,423 cases have been cumulatively reported, 2.4% of whom were hospitalized, with 12 deaths. The highest incidence is in the 15–19 age group. Most cases are in the Moravian-Silesian Region in the northeast, with 4,125 cases.
items.area_zh: 捷克,法屬玻里尼西亞,新喀里多尼亞,美國

items.headline_zh: 美國-鬚癬毛癬菌VII型感染
items.headline_en: United States – Trichophyton mentagrophytes genotype VII infection
items.summary_zh: 美國今年4至7月新增4例鬚癬毛癬菌VII型感染,均為30至39歲男性。
items.summary_en: The US reported four Trichophyton mentagrophytes genotype VII cases in men aged 30 to 39 from April to July, all with sexual contact with men.
items.description_zh: 美國10/31公布今年4至7月間新增4例病例,均為30至39歲男性,出現臉部、四肢及臀部皮疹,所有病患均曾與其他男性發生性接觸,其中2例彼此相關,鑑於症狀容易誤診,當局呼籲醫療人員提高警覺。鬚癬毛癬菌VII型為新型皮癬菌,多透過性接觸傳播。
items.description_en: On 31 October the United States announced 4 new cases between April and July this year. All were men aged 30 to 39 with rashes on the face, limbs and buttocks. All patients had had sexual contact with other men, and 2 of the cases were linked to each other. Because the symptoms are easily misdiagnosed, authorities urge healthcare workers to remain alert. Trichophyton mentagrophytes genotype VII is an emerging dermatophyte, mostly transmitted through sexual contact.

items.summary_zh: 香港今年10月新增6例類鼻疽,深水埗4例,今年累計21例。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong reported 6 melioidosis cases in October, 4 from Sham Shui Po; 21 cases this year already exceed last year's full-year total of 17.
items.description_zh: 香港今年10月新增報告6例病例,其中4例來自深水埗,病患年齡介於59至83歲間,多出現發燒、咳嗽、身體腫痛等症狀;當地今年累計報告21例病例,已高於去年全年之17例。
items.description_en: Hong Kong reported 6 new cases in October this year, 4 of them from Sham Shui Po. Patients were aged 59 to 83 years, and most had symptoms such as fever, cough, and body pain and swelling. The city has reported 21 cases so far this year, already exceeding last year's full-year total of 17 cases.

items.headline_zh: 盧安達-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 盧安達新增1例,累計66例確診、15例死亡,559名接觸者追蹤中。
items.summary_en: Rwanda reported one more Marburg case this week, a contact of an earlier case; 66 confirmed cases, 15 deaths, and 559 contacts are being followed.
items.description_zh: 盧安達近一週新增1例病例,為先前病例之接觸者,迄今累計報告66例確診,其中15例死亡(CFR:22.7%),仍有2例治療中,559名接觸者追蹤中;病患近8成為醫療機構工作者,集中於3行政區,WHO評估傳播風險於國內極高,於區域為高,於全球則低。
items.description_en: Rwanda reported 1 new case in the past week, a contact of a previous case. To date, 66 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, including 15 deaths (CFR: 22.7%). Two patients are still under treatment, and 559 contacts are being followed up. Nearly 80% of patients are healthcare workers, concentrated in 3 administrative districts. WHO assesses the risk of transmission as very high nationally, high regionally and low globally.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計44例,多與牛隻或家禽相關;加州11/4新增3例牛隻相關。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 44 novel influenza A cases this year, mostly linked to cattle or poultry, with three new cattle-linked cases in California on 4 November.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC 11/4公布加州新增3例與牛隻相關病例,型別及其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告44例病例,其中24例與牛隻相關,19例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(20)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(9)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1),另有1例管轄權待定。
items.description_en: The US CDC announced on 4 November three new cattle-linked cases in California; the subtype and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 44 cases so far this year, of which 24 were linked to cattle, 19 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (20), Colorado (10), Washington State (9), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each); 1 case is pending jurisdiction.

items.summary_zh: 英國11/4新增2例Ib型M痘,為首例家庭接觸者,當局加強追蹤與接種。
items.summary_en: The UK reported two new clade Ib Mpox cases on 4 November, both household contacts of the first patient; authorities judge national risk still low.
items.description_zh: 英國11/4公布新增2例Ib型病例,為首例病患之家庭接觸者,當局已加強接觸者追蹤及疫苗接種,研判該國整體風險仍為低。
items.description_en: The UK announced 2 new clade Ib cases on 4 November, both household contacts of the first patient. Authorities have strengthened contact tracing and vaccination, and assess the overall risk to the country as still low.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 葉門塔伊茲省今年累計4,338例瘧疾,多明尼加842例且高於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Yemen's Taiz Governorate has reported 4,338 malaria cases this year with no deaths; the Dominican Republic has 842 cases, above last year's 213 for the same period.
items.description_zh: 葉門西南部塔伊茲省疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告4,338例病例,無死亡病例。 多明加共和國今年累計842例病例,高於去年同期的213例,病例分布以該國北部聖多明哥省為多。
items.description_en:
Yemen: In Taiz Governorate in south-western Yemen, cases are rising. So far this year, 4,338 cases have been cumulatively reported, with no deaths.

Dominican Republic: This year, 842 cases have been cumulatively reported, higher than the 213 cases reported in the same period last year. Cases are mainly distributed in Santo Domingo Province in the north of the country.

items.summary_zh: 廣東省第43週新增1,785例登革熱,累計約1萬例,今年無死亡。
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 1,785 dengue cases in week 43 and about 10,000 cumulatively since 9 September, with no deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省今年第43週(10/21-27)新增1,785例病例,9/9-10/27期間累計約1萬例病例,病例分布以佛山市及廣州市為多,今年迄今無死亡病例。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province, China, reported 1,785 new cases in week 43 of this year (21–27 October). Between 9 September and 27 October, about 10,000 cases were cumulatively reported. Cases are mainly distributed in Foshan and Guangzhou. No deaths have been reported so far this year.

items.headline_zh: 哥倫比亞/幾內亞-黃熱病
items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞報告1例死亡;幾內亞新增2例黃熱病,非洲累計703例。
items.summary_en: Colombia reported a yellow fever death on 29 October; Guinea reported two cases in Labé Region, and Africa has 703 cases and 6 deaths.
items.description_zh: 哥倫比亞中西部托利馬省10/29報告1例死亡病例,為47歲男性個案,當局已採取相關防治措施。 幾內亞中北部拉貝大區11/2報告2例病例,分別為15、24歲女性個案,其中1例為孕婦,皆於9月中旬出現症狀,10/5採檢送驗,10/8確診;非洲截至10/26累計703例病例,6例死亡。
items.description_en:
Colombia: In Tolima Department in west-central Colombia, 1 death was reported on 29 October, in a 47-year-old man. Authorities have adopted relevant prevention and control measures.

Guinea: In Labé Region in north-central Guinea, 2 cases were reported on 2 November, a 15-year-old and a 24-year-old woman; one of them was pregnant. Both developed symptoms in mid-September, were sampled on 5 October and confirmed on 8 October. Africa has cumulatively reported 703 cases and 6 deaths as of 26 October.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年截至第44週累計21,193例確診,非洲區10,743例。
items.summary_en: Global Mpox reached 21,193 confirmed cases by week 44 this year, with 10,743 in the African Region.
items.description_zh: 自2022年5月截至今年11/1全球累計127(1*)國/地區報告11萬4,594例確診病例,其中至少241例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第44週全球累計79國/地區報告21,193例確診病例,其中非洲區10,743例(本週1,382例)、美洲區5,872例(201)、西太平洋區2,010例(82)、歐洲區1,572例(13)、東地中海區773例(0),及東南亞區223例(0)。 10/24 一項研究(預印本)顯示,剛果民主共和國金夏沙市之Ia疫情,與南基伍省之Ib疫情,均於病毒基因發現一定比例之APOBEC3型突變,研判此波Ia疫情與人際傳播有關,而非多次獨立之人畜傳播案件,其流行病學特徵正在衍變中。
items.description_en:
Since May 2022 and as of 1 November this year, 127 (1*) countries/territories have cumulatively reported 114,594 confirmed cases globally, including at least 241 deaths (CFR: 0.2%).

As of week 44 this year, 79 countries/territories have cumulatively reported 21,193 confirmed cases globally: African Region 10,743 (1,382 this week), Region of the Americas 5,872 (201), Western Pacific Region 2,010 (82), European Region 1,572 (13), Eastern Mediterranean Region 773 (0), and South-East Asia Region 223 (0).

A preprint study on 24 October found that the Ia outbreak in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the Ib outbreak in South Kivu both show a certain proportion of APOBEC3-type mutations in viral genes. The researchers judge that this wave of Ia cases is linked to human-to-human transmission rather than multiple independent animal-to-human transmission events, and that its epidemiological characteristics are still evolving.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計41例,加州新增1例牛隻相關;奧勒岡州豬隻首次檢出H5N1。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 41 novel influenza A cases this year, with one new cattle-linked case in California; Oregon detected H5N1 in a pig for the first time.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC 11/1公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關病例,另新增1例管轄權待定之家禽相關病例,型別及其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告41例病例,其中21例與牛隻相關,19例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(17)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(9)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1),另有1例管轄權待定。 美國10/30公布首次於豬隻身上檢出H5N1病毒,案件發生於奧勒岡州一禽畜混合農場,其於10/25爆發H5N1禽類疫情,因農場牲畜與禽類共用生活空間,故擴大檢驗範圍,進而發現本案;該豬隻未進入食品供應鏈,當局已隔離該農場並加速基因定序,目前家禽之基因定序顯示病毒尚未發生基因變異。 10/28研究表示,美國德州H5N1人類感染案例雖症狀輕微,惟自其睛中分離出之病毒,除能於人類肺泡中有效複製,亦可於小鼠及雪貂全身中傳播,並具致命性。
items.description_en:
On 1 November the US CDC announced one new cattle-linked case in California and one new poultry-linked case whose jurisdiction is pending; the subtype and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 41 cases so far this year, of which 21 were linked to cattle, 19 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (17), Colorado (10), Washington State (9), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each); 1 case is pending jurisdiction.

On 30 October the US announced the first detection of H5N1 virus in a pig, at a mixed poultry and livestock farm in Oregon. The farm had an H5N1 poultry outbreak on 25 October. Because livestock and poultry share living space, testing was expanded, which led to this detection. The pig did not enter the food supply chain. Authorities have quarantined the farm and accelerated genetic sequencing; sequencing of the poultry so far shows the virus has not undergone genetic changes.

A study reported on 28 October that although symptoms in the Texas US human H5N1 case were mild, the virus isolated from the patient's eye can replicate effectively in human alveolar cells and spread systemically in mice and ferrets, and is lethal.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國新增7例H5及3例未分型人類感染;16國新增90起H5N1疫情。
items.summary_en: The US reported 7 new H5 and 3 untyped human infections; 16 countries logged 90 new H5N1 outbreaks, with Hungary the most at 25.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  美國新增通報7例H5、3例未分型人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共16國於2024/9/23~10/28間新增90起HPAI H5N1疫情,分別為匈牙利25起、美國22起、義大利14起、波蘭7起、斯洛伐克/斯洛維亞各4起、加拿大3起、羅馬亞/日本各2起、西班牙/德國/葡萄牙/以色列/北馬其頓/奧地利/阿爾巴亞各1起。 法國於2024/10/23~25間新增2起HPAI H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計14(0)州報告403(64)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少3,350例,檢測103例,其中20例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。  其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第42周計320(/330)個採檢點提供檢測報告,僅在1州1採檢點檢出H5陽性。
items.description_en:
Human cases: The US reported 7 new H5 and 3 untyped human infections.

Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 16 countries reported 90 new HPAI H5N1 outbreaks between 23 September and 28 October 2024: Hungary 25, United States 22, Italy 14, Poland 7, Slovakia and Slovenia 4 each, Canada 3, Romania and Japan 2 each, and Spain, Germany, Portugal, Israel, North Macedonia, Austria and Albania 1 each.

France reported 2 new HPAI H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 23 and 25 October 2024.

US dairy cattle avian influenza:

Dairy farms: Since March this year, 14 (0) states have reported 403 (64) outbreaks; recent cases are mainly concentrated in California.

Human infection via cattle: At least 3,350 people have been monitored and 103 tested, with 20 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms).

Other derived outbreaks: Infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with fatal cases in cats.

Wastewater surveillance: In week 42, 320 (/330) sampling sites provided test reports; H5-positive results were detected at only 1 sampling site in 1 state.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約18.9%;墨西哥今年累計638例死亡。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 18.9% in week 42; Mexico has reported 13,000 cases and 638 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 2024年第42週(10/14-10/20)全球陽性率約18.9%,陽性率以歐洲區(20.1%)、美洲區(13.5%)及非洲區(4.4%)為高。 歐洲XEC病例數呈上升趨勢,愛爾蘭最近5週XEC變異株占比約7.1%。 美國主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,另XEC變異株占比持續上升。 墨西哥今年迄今累計13,000例病例,其中638例死亡,病例分布以墨西哥城、克雷塔羅州、新萊昂州及普埃布拉州為多。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 42 of 2024 (14–20 October), the global positivity rate was about 18.9%, highest in the European Region (20.1%), the Region of the Americas (13.5%) and the African Region (4.4%).

XEC cases are rising in Europe; in Ireland, the XEC variant accounted for about 7.1% over the past 5 weeks.

The main circulating variant in the United States is KP.3.1.1, and the share of XEC variants continues to rise.

Mexico has cumulatively reported 13,000 cases this year, including 638 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Mexico City, Querétaro State, Nuevo León State and Puebla State.
items.area_zh: 墨西哥,愛爾蘭共和國,美國

items.summary_zh: 葉門哈德拉毛今年1-9月累計488例霍亂,3例死亡,疫情持續上升。
items.summary_en: Yemen's Hadhramaut has reported 488 cholera cases and 3 deaths from January to September, with the outbreak rising.
items.description_zh: 葉門東南部哈德拉毛疫情上升,今年1-9月累計488例病例,其中3例死亡,當局持續對疫情進行追蹤調查,並呼籲民眾維持良好衛生習慣。
items.description_en: Cholera is rising in Hadhramaut in south-eastern Yemen. From January to September this year, 488 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths. Authorities continue to investigate the outbreak and urge people to maintain good hygiene habits.

items.headline_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞-布氏桿菌病
items.summary_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞10/13報告11例布氏桿菌病,牧牛場疫苗接種率偏低。
items.summary_en: Albania reported 11 human brucellosis cases on 13 October, including a male minor, with low vaccination rates on cattle farms cited as a cause.
items.description_zh: 阿爾巴亞10/13報告11例人類罹患布氏桿菌病,其中包含未成年男性,疫情發生原因之一為牧牛場疫苗接種率偏低。
items.description_en: Albania reported 11 human brucellosis cases on 13 October, including a male minor. One of the causes of the outbreak is low vaccination rates on cattle farms.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 10/17-23巴基斯坦新增7例WPV1,奈及利亞新增5例cVDPV2。
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported seven new WPV1 cases and Nigeria five cVDPV2 cases between 17 and 23 October.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/17-10/23期間,共2國新增8例WPV1病例,分別為巴基斯坦7例、阿富汗1例;共3國新增9例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞5例、查德3例、日1例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增11件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗10件、巴基斯坦1件;共3國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為查德2件、吉布地/日各1件。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 17 and 23 October, a total of 2 countries added 8 WPV1 cases: Pakistan 7 and Afghanistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 9 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 5, Chad 3 and Niger 1. For environmental samples, 2 countries added 11 WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 10 and Pakistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples: Chad 2, and Djibouti and Niger 1 each.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,查德,吉布地共和國,尼日,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦

items.summary_zh: 法國今年9月檢出171例細小病毒B19感染,陽性率8%,累計10例死亡。
items.summary_en: France detected 171 parvovirus B19 cases in September, 8% positivity, and 10 deaths through September, five of them infants under one year.
items.description_zh: 法國近2年疫情回升,於今年3月達高峰後趨緩;今年9月單月檢出171例(陽性率8%),已趨近新冠疫情前同期水準,另今年截至9月累計報告10例死亡,其中5例為1歲以下兒童,多屬先天性感染。
items.description_en: Parvovirus B19 infections in France have risen over the past two years, peaking in March this year and then easing. In September alone, 171 cases were detected (positivity 8%), approaching the level of the same period before the COVID-19 pandemic. As of September this year, 10 deaths have been cumulatively reported, 5 of them in children under 1 year old, mostly due to congenital infection.

items.summary_zh: 2023年全球新診斷結核病例820萬例,為1995年以來新高,死亡125萬例。
items.summary_en: WHO reports 8.2 million newly diagnosed TB cases in 2023, the highest since 1995, with 1.25 million deaths; 98% of cases are in low- and middle-income countries.
items.description_zh: WHO 10/29公布去(2023)年全球新診斷結核病例數達820萬例,為自1995年以來新高,死亡數則達125萬例,低於前年;WHO表示,全球98%結核病例分布於低、中收入國家,強調持續投注資源於疾病預防、診斷及治療之重要性。
items.description_en: On 29 October WHO reported that in 2023 the number of newly diagnosed tuberculosis cases worldwide reached 8.2 million, the highest since 1995. Deaths reached 1.25 million, lower than in 2022. WHO said 98% of global TB cases are in low- and middle-income countries, and stressed the importance of continued investment in disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment.

items.summary_zh: 非洲今年累計19,130例白喉,494例死亡,奈及利亞14,195例最嚴峻。
items.summary_en: Africa has reported 19,130 diphtheria cases and 494 deaths this year as of 11 October, with Nigeria most affected at 14,195 cases.
items.description_zh: 非洲今年截至10/11累計報告19,130例病例,其中9,816例確診,494例死亡(CFR:5.0%),以奈及利亞報告14,195例(397例死亡)最為嚴峻,另有幾內亞報告2,869例、查德1,307例、日746例及加彭13例亦正流行中;該地區去年報告2.7萬例病例,CFR:5.7%。
items.description_en: Africa has cumulatively reported 19,130 cases so far this year as of 11 October, including 9,816 confirmed cases and 494 deaths (CFR: 5.0%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 14,195 cases (397 deaths). Guinea reported 2,869 cases, Chad 1,307, Niger 746 and Gabon 13, and these outbreaks are also ongoing. Last year the region reported 27,000 cases, with a CFR of 5.7%.
items.area_zh: 查德,加彭,幾內亞,尼日,奈及利亞

items.summary_zh: 韓國今年截至10/12累計25,365例百日咳,7月高峰後每週仍逾千例。
items.summary_en: South Korea has reported 25,365 pertussis cases this year as of 12 October; weekly reports peaked in July above 3,000 and remain above 1,000.
items.description_zh: 韓國今年疫情上升,截至10/12累計報告25,365例病例,整體疫情於7月達高峰(每週3千餘例)後趨緩,目前每週仍持續報告1千餘例病例;當局表示病患近9成為青少年,已加強中學生族群接種加強劑疫苗。
items.description_en: Pertussis is rising in South Korea this year. As of 12 October, 25,365 cases have been cumulatively reported. Overall, the outbreak peaked in July, with more than 3,000 cases weekly, and then eased; more than 1,000 cases are still being reported each week. Authorities say nearly 90% of patients are adolescents, and have stepped up booster vaccination for middle school students.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計39例,多與牛隻或家禽相關;華盛頓州新增3例H5家禽相關。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 39 novel influenza A cases this year, mostly linked to cattle or poultry, with three new H5 poultry-linked cases in Washington State.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC 10/30公布華盛頓州新增3例H5病例,均與家禽相關,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告39例病例,其中20例與牛隻相關,18例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(16)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(9)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
items.description_en: On 30 October the US CDC announced 3 new H5 cases in Washington State, all linked to poultry; other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 39 cases so far this year, of which 20 were linked to cattle, 18 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (16), Colorado (10), Washington State (9), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each).

items.summary_zh: 英國倫敦10/30新增1例Ib型M痘,病患近期曾赴非洲流行國家,風險仍低。
items.summary_en: London, UK, reported a clade Ib Mpox case on 30 October in a patient with recent African travel; authorities judge domestic transmission risk still low.
items.description_zh: 英國倫敦10/30新增報告1例Ib型病例,病患近期曾前往非洲Ib型病毒流行國家,當局研判國內傳播風險仍為低。
items.description_en: London, United Kingdom, reported 1 new clade Ib case on 30 October. The patient had recently travelled to an African country where clade Ib virus is circulating. Authorities judge the risk of domestic transmission to remain low.
items.area_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

items.summary_zh: 非洲今年累計45,672例M痘,1,014例死亡,剛果民主共和國最多。
items.summary_en: Africa has reported 45,672 Mpox cases and 1,014 deaths this year as of 18 October, with the DRC most affected at 7,517 confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 非洲今年截至10/18累計18國報告45,672例病例,其中9,298例確診,1,014例死亡,以剛果民主共和國報告7,517例確診病例(1,005例死亡)最為嚴峻,蒲隆地1,287例次之,其餘各國報告1至152例不等;該區域送檢率約52.8%,其中,陽性率為36.2%。
items.description_en: Africa has cumulatively reported 45,672 cases in 18 countries so far this year as of 18 October, including 9,298 confirmed cases and 1,014 deaths. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, with 7,517 confirmed cases (1,005 deaths), followed by Burundi with 1,287 cases. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 152 cases each. In the region, the testing rate was about 52.8% and the positivity rate was 36.2%.
items.area_zh: 蒲隆地,剛果民主共和國

items.summary_zh: 美國佛羅里達州颶風後10/15累計70例創傷弧菌感染,11例死亡。
items.summary_en: Florida's post-hurricane Vibrio vulnificus outbreak reached 70 cases by 15 October, 1.5 times last year's total, with 11 deaths.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州颶風後疫情持續,截至10/15累計報告70例病例,為去年全年之1.5倍,其中11例死亡,病例分布以皮拉斯郡13例為多。
items.description_en: In Florida, United States, outbreaks have continued after the hurricane. As of 15 October, 70 cases had been cumulatively reported, 1.5 times last year's full-year total, including 11 deaths. Cases are most concentrated in Pinellas County, with 13 cases.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達今年截至10/22累計251例炭疽病,29例確診,至少5成在卡農古區。
items.summary_en: Uganda has reported 251 anthrax cases this year as of 22 October from 11 districts, with 29 confirmed and at least half in Kanungu District.
items.description_zh: 烏干達9月底起疫情上升,今年截至10/22累計11(/146)地區報告251例病例,其中29例確診,確診病例中有6例死亡,至少50%病例分布於西南部卡農古區,當局已加強該區之動物疫苗接種措施。
items.description_en: Anthrax has been rising in Uganda since late September. As of 22 October this year, 251 cases have been cumulatively reported from 11 (of 146) districts, of which 29 were confirmed; 6 of the confirmed cases died. At least 50% of cases are in Kanungu District in the southwest, where authorities have stepped up animal vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 非洲今年累計9,829例拉薩熱,186例死亡;美國愛荷華州新增1例死亡。
items.summary_en: Africa has reported 9,829 Lassa fever cases and 186 deaths this year as of 18 October, mostly in Nigeria; Iowa reported a fatal case presumed imported from West Africa.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至10/18累計3國報告9,829例病例,其中1,075例確診,186例死亡(CFR:17.3%),以奈及利亞報告9,604例、174例死亡最為嚴峻,另有賴比瑞亞及幾內亞分別報告198例(10例死亡)及27例(2例死亡),疫情持續流行中,其中賴比瑞亞近期疫情有上升趨勢。 美國愛荷華州10/28公布新增1例死亡病例,研判係自西非移入,當局已加強監測密切接觸者;該國近55年內累計報告8例病例,均具旅遊史,多數症狀輕微。
items.description_en:
Africa update: As of 18 October this year, 3 countries have cumulatively reported 9,829 cases, including 1,075 confirmed cases and 186 deaths (CFR: 17.3%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 9,604 cases and 174 deaths. Liberia and Guinea reported 198 cases (10 deaths) and 27 cases (2 deaths), respectively. The outbreak continues, and the recent outbreak in Liberia shows an upward trend.

United States update: On 28 October, Iowa announced 1 new fatal case, presumed to have been imported from West Africa, and authorities have strengthened monitoring of close contacts. Over the past 55 years, the country has cumulatively reported 8 cases, all with travel history, and most with mild symptoms.
items.area_zh: 幾內亞,賴比瑞亞,奈及利亞,美國

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計36例,多與牛隻或家禽相關;10/28華盛頓州及加州各增1例。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 36 novel influenza A cases this year, mostly linked to cattle or poultry; one new case each in Washington State and California.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC 10/28公布華盛頓州及加州各新增1例病例,分別與家禽及牛隻相關,前者已確認屬H5,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告36例病例,其中20例與牛隻相關,15例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(16)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(6)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
items.description_en: On 28 October the US CDC announced one new case each in Washington State and California, linked to poultry and cattle respectively; the Washington case has been confirmed as H5, and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 36 cases so far this year, of which 20 were linked to cattle, 15 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (16), Colorado (10), Washington State (6), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each).

items.summary_zh: 希臘今年6/21起累計213例西尼羅熱,33例死亡,去年全年162例。
items.summary_en: Greece has reported 213 West Nile fever cases since 21 June this year, including 33 deaths; last year's full-year total was 162 cases.
items.description_zh: 希臘自今年6/21通報首例,迄今累計213例病例,其中154例出現中樞神經系統症狀,59例為輕微/無中樞神經系統症狀,33例死亡,去年全年累計162例病例及23例死亡。
items.description_en: Greece reported its first case this year on 21 June. As of now, 213 cases have been cumulatively reported, of which 154 showed central nervous system symptoms and 59 had mild or no central nervous system symptoms. A total of 33 deaths have been reported. Last year, Greece recorded 162 cases and 23 deaths for the full year.

items.summary_zh: 義大利今年本土194例、境外456例;法國本土80例,高於2022年65例。
items.summary_en: Italy reported 194 local and 456 imported dengue cases this year, France 80 local cases, above 2022's 65; Spain has 8 local cases so far.
items.description_zh: 義大利今年迄今累計報告194例本土病例,456例境外移入病例,無死亡病例,去年全年報告82例病例。 法國今年迄今累計報告80例本土病例,已高於2022年疫情較嚴峻的65例病例。 西班牙今年迄今累計報告8例本土病例,已高於往年病例數較高年份2018及2022年之6例病例。
items.description_en:
Italy has cumulatively reported 194 locally acquired cases this year, 456 imported cases and no deaths; last year the country reported 82 cases in total.

France has cumulatively reported 80 locally acquired cases this year, already higher than the 65 cases in 2022, a more severe year.

Spain has cumulatively reported 8 locally acquired cases this year, already exceeding the 6 cases recorded in 2018 and 2022, both years with higher case numbers.

items.summary_zh: 印度那浦爾市今年截至10/18逾1,000例屈公病,9月達高峰。
items.summary_en: Nagpur, India, has reported over 1,000 chikungunya cases this year as of 18 October, peaking in September; rains may spur a rebound.
items.description_zh: 印度中部那浦爾市今年截至10/18報告1,000餘例病例,自8月以來病例數明顯上升,於9月份達高峰,近3個月報告約810例病例,10月病例數略降,然而當地近期降雨持續,可能造成病例數再次上升。
items.description_en: Nagpur city in central India has reported more than 1,000 cases so far this year as of 18 October. Cases rose markedly from August, peaking in September, with about 810 cases reported over the past three months. Case numbers dipped slightly in October; however, continued recent rainfall in the area may cause case numbers to rise again.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年累計34例,多與牛隻或家禽相關;華盛頓州10/25新增3例家禽接觸。
items.summary_en: The US has reported 34 novel influenza A cases this year, mostly linked to cattle or poultry; three new Washington State cases had poultry exposure.
items.description_zh: 美國CDC 10/25公布華盛頓州新增3例病例,均曾接觸家禽,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該國今年累計報告34例病例,其中19例與牛隻相關,14例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(15)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(5)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
items.description_en: On 25 October the US CDC announced 3 new cases in Washington State, all with poultry exposure; other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 34 cases so far this year, of which 19 were linked to cattle, 14 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (15), Colorado (10), Washington State (5), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each).

items.headline_zh: 盧安達-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 盧安達10/26累計65例確診、15例死亡,1,100餘名接觸者追蹤中。
items.summary_en: Rwanda's Marburg outbreak reached 65 confirmed cases and 15 deaths by 26 October, with more than 1,100 contacts under follow-up.
items.description_zh: 盧安達10/24報告新增2例病例,其中1例為醫護相關人員,另1例曾與指標個案暴露於同一採礦洞穴,目前皆於醫療機構隔離治療中。截至10/26累計報告65例確診病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:23%),47例已康復,病例主要分布於吉佳利,目前1,100餘名接觸者追蹤中。
items.description_en: Rwanda reported 2 new cases on 24 October: one was a health-care worker, and the other had been exposed to the index case in the same mine cave. Both are isolated and being treated in healthcare facilities. As of 26 October, 65 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, including 15 deaths (CFR: 23%) and 47 recoveries. Cases are mainly distributed in Kigali, and more than 1,100 contacts are being followed up.

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年截至第43週累計19,514例確診,非洲區9,363例。
items.summary_en: Global Mpox reached 19,514 confirmed cases by week 43 this year, with 9,363 in the African Region.
items.description_zh: 自2022年5月截至今年10/25全球累計126國/地區報告11萬2,915例確診病例,其中至少241例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第43週全球累計78國/地區報告19,514例確診病例,其中非洲區9,363例(本週772例)、美洲區5,671例(0)、西太平洋區1,928例(144)、歐洲區1,559例(13)、東地中海區770例(0),及東南亞區223例(0)。
items.description_en:
Since May 2022 and as of 25 October this year, 126 countries/territories have cumulatively reported 112,915 confirmed cases globally, including at least 241 deaths (CFR: 0.2%).

As of week 43 this year, 78 countries/territories have cumulatively reported 19,514 confirmed cases globally: African Region 9,363 (772 this week), Region of the Americas 5,671 (0), Western Pacific Region 1,928 (144), European Region 1,559 (13), Eastern Mediterranean Region 770 (0), and South-East Asia Region 223 (0).

items.summary_zh: 華盛頓州10/24新增2例H5人類感染(禽場工人);密蘇里州1例來源不明。
items.summary_en: Washington State reported 2 new H5 infections in poultry farm workers on 24 October; Missouri's unknown-source case had serology tests suggesting no person-to-person spread.
items.description_zh: 美國華盛頓州10/24新增2例H5人類感染案例,均為禽場工人,病原屬2.3.4.4b(D1.1)分支,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該分支與乳牛中流行之B1.13分支不同,主要流行於野禽中,惟引起之症狀與B1.13相。該國今年迄今累計報告31例,其中19例與牛隻相關,11例與家禽相關,1例不明。 美國密蘇里州前於9/6報告1例感染源不明病例,當局針對其6例接觸者(5例醫療人員及1例家庭接觸者)進行血清檢測,檢驗結果均為陰性,排除人傳人之可能性;其中,家庭接觸者於H5中和抗體檢出微弱反應(未達閾),又曾與病患同時出現症狀,顯示可能曾共同接觸病原,惟感染源仍不明。
items.description_en:
On 24 October, Washington State reported 2 new human H5 infections, both in poultry farm workers. The pathogen belongs to clade 2.3.4.4b (D1.1); other epidemiological details were not stated. This clade differs from the B1.13 clade circulating in dairy cattle and is mainly found in wild birds, but the symptoms it causes are similar to those of B1.13. The country has reported 31 cases so far this year, of which 19 were linked to cattle, 11 to poultry and 1 was unknown.

Missouri reported 1 case of unknown source earlier, on 6 September. Serological testing was conducted on its 6 contacts (5 health workers and 1 household contact), and all results were negative, which excludes human-to-human transmission. However, the household contact showed a weak H5 neutralising antibody response (below the cut-off) and had symptoms at the same time as the patient, suggesting possible shared exposure to the pathogen; the source of infection remains unknown.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國新增2例H5及2例未分型人類感染;19國新增78起H5N1疫情。
items.summary_en: The US reported 2 new H5 and 2 untyped human infections; 19 countries logged 78 new H5N1 outbreaks between October 2023 and October 2024.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  美國新增通報2例H5、2例未分型人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共19國於2023/10/8~2024/10/24間新增78起HPAI H5N1疫情,分別為美國21起、匈牙利15起、以色列6起、日本5起、塞爾維亞4起、葡萄牙/摩爾多瓦/捷克/波蘭各3起、西班牙/法國/斯洛伐克/斯洛維亞/義大利各2起、英國/德國/奧地利/北馬其頓/福克蘭群島各1起。 共3國於2024/10/1~18間新增13起HPAI H5N5疫情,分別為英國10起、冰島2起、比利時1起。 法國於2024/10/22新增1起HPAI H5(N untyped)疫情。 挪威於2024/10/7~15間新增3起HPAI 未分型疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計14(0)州報告339(19)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少2,590例,檢測97例,其中19例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第42周(10/12-19),有319(/330)個採檢點提供檢測報告,僅在1個州的1個採檢點(佔0.3%)以廢水檢測到H5的病毒RNA。
items.description_en:
Human cases: The US reported 2 new H5 and 2 untyped human infections.

Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 19 countries reported 78 new HPAI H5N1 outbreaks between 8 October 2023 and 24 October 2024: United States 21, Hungary 15, Israel 6, Japan 5, Serbia 4, Portugal, Moldova, Czechia and Poland 3 each, Spain, France, Slovakia, Slovenia and Italy 2 each, and United Kingdom, Germany, Austria, North Macedonia and the Falkland Islands 1 each.

A total of 3 countries reported 13 new HPAI H5N5 outbreaks between 1 and 18 October 2024: United Kingdom 10, Iceland 2 and Belgium 1.

France reported 1 new HPAI H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 22 October 2024.

Norway reported 3 new untyped HPAI outbreaks between 7 and 15 October 2024.

US dairy cattle avian influenza:

Dairy farms: Since March this year, 14 (0) states have reported 339 (19) outbreaks; recent cases are mainly concentrated in California.

Human infection via cattle: At least 2,590 people have been monitored and 97 tested, with 19 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms).

Other derived outbreaks: Infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with fatal cases in cats.

Wastewater surveillance: In week 42 (12–19 October), 319 (/330) sampling sites provided test reports; H5 viral RNA was detected in wastewater at only 1 sampling site in 1 state (0.3% of sites).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約21.2%,歐洲區22.9%最高;日本第42週病例持續下降。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 21.2% in week 41, highest in Europe at 22.9%; Japan's cases kept falling in week 42.
items.description_zh: 2024年第41週(10/7-10/13)全球陽性率約21.2%,陽性率以歐洲區(22.9%)、美洲區(12.9%)及非洲區(5.2%)為高。 日本第42週(10/14-10/20)病例數持續下降,定醫報告病例數為9,100餘例,每定醫點平均1.86例,第34-37週以KP.3.3變異株占比為高。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,另XEC變異株占比上升。 歐洲區以KP.3.1.1變異株占比最高,其次為XEC變異株。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 41 of 2024 (7–13 October), the global positivity rate was about 21.2%, highest in the European Region (22.9%), the Region of the Americas (12.9%) and the African Region (5.2%).

Japan's case numbers continued to decline in week 42 (14–20 October). Sentinel medical institutions reported more than 9,100 cases, an average of 1.86 cases per sentinel site. KP.3.3 accounted for the highest share of variants in weeks 34–37.

In the United States, recent positivity, emergency department visit rates and hospitalization rates have all trended downward. The main circulating variant is KP.3.1.1, and the share of XEC variants has risen.

In the European Region, KP.3.1.1 accounts for the highest share of variants, followed by XEC.

items.summary_zh: 全球霍亂今年截至9/29累計逾43.9萬例,死亡增126%。
items.summary_en: WHO reports over 439,000 cholera cases globally as of 29 September this year; deaths rose 126% versus last year, cases fell 16%.
items.description_zh: WHO公布全球今年截至9/29累計30國報告439,000餘例病例及3,432例死亡,分別較去年減少16%及增加126%,病例數以東地中海區、非洲區及東南亞區為多,死亡數明顯增加則與地區性戰爭衝突或洪災等降低醫療服務資源可近性有關。近期中非、西非及東南亞多國因洪災加劇疾病傳播,預期該些地區疫情持續。
items.description_en: WHO reports that globally, as of 29 September this year, 30 countries have cumulatively reported more than 439,000 cases and 3,432 deaths. Compared with last year, cases decreased by 16% and deaths increased by 126%, respectively. Cases are mainly concentrated in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian Regions. The marked increase in deaths is linked to regional armed conflicts, floods and other factors that reduced access to health services. Recently, floods have intensified disease transmission in several countries in Central Africa, West Africa and South-East Asia, and outbreaks in these areas are expected to continue.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.disease_en: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 美國-腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_en: United States – Enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli infection
items.summary_zh: 美國O157:H7疫情截至10/23累計49例,10州,多數曾食速食漢堡。
items.summary_en: US E. coli O157:H7 outbreak reached 49 cases in 10 states by 23 October; most patients ate hamburgers from a fast-food chain beforehand.
items.description_zh: 美國爆發大腸桿菌O157:H7疫情,截至10/23共10州累計報告49例病例,其中10例住院及1例死亡,病例年齡介於13-88歲,多數病例於發病前曾食用某速食連鎖餐廳的漢堡,主要分布於科羅拉多州及內布拉斯加州,目前已對可能引起疫情事件之受污染食材進行調查。
items.description_en: The United States has an outbreak of E. coli O157:H7. As of 23 October, 49 cases had been cumulatively reported from 10 states, including 10 hospitalized and 1 death. Patients are aged 13 to 88 years. Most patients had eaten hamburgers from a fast-food chain restaurant before becoming ill, and cases are mainly distributed in Colorado and Nebraska. Investigations into contaminated ingredients that may have caused the outbreak are under way.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦4例WPV1,衣索比亞2例cVDPV2,委內瑞拉首例VDPV3。
items.summary_en: Pakistan reported 4 new WPV1 cases and Ethiopia 2 cVDPV2 cases between 10 and 16 October; Venezuela reported its first VDPV3 case in 30 years.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/10-10/16期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;衣索比亞新增2例cVDPV2病例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增15件WPV1陽性樣本;巴勒斯坦新增5件cVDPV2陽性樣本。 委內瑞拉10/5報告1例VDPV3兒童病例,為該國30年來首例病例。
items.description_en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 10 and 16 October, Pakistan added 4 WPV1 cases and Ethiopia added 2 cVDPV2 cases. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 15 WPV1-positive samples, and Palestine added 5 cVDPV2-positive samples.

Venezuela reported on 5 October 1 VDPV3 child case, the first case in the country in 30 years.
items.area_zh: 衣索比亞,巴基斯坦,委內瑞拉

items.summary_zh: 美國加州10/23新增2例確診,累計15例;華盛頓州禽場4例疑似病例輕症。
items.summary_en: California reported 2 new confirmed cases on 23 October, bringing its total to 15; a Washington poultry farm reported 4 mild suspected cases.
items.description_zh: 美國加州10/23新增公布2例確診病例,感染型別及流病資訊未敘明,目前累計達15例;另該國華盛頓州某禽流感陽性禽場10/20通報4例疑病例,均為輕症且已接受治療。
items.description_en: On 23 October, California announced 2 new confirmed cases; the infection type and epidemiological information were not stated, and the cumulative total in California has reached 15. In addition, a poultry farm in Washington State that tested positive for avian influenza reported 4 suspected cases on 20 October. All were mild and had received treatment.

items.summary_zh: 越南胡志明市累計1,079例麻疹、4例死亡,象牙海岸今年1,287例確診。
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has reported 1,079 measles cases and 4 deaths through 13 October; Côte d'Ivoire has 1,287 confirmed cases this year.
items.description_zh: 越南南部胡志明市疫情持續嚴峻,截至10/13累計報告達1,079例,其中4例死亡,5成病例為5歲以下兒童,該市已透過學校系統加強兒童免疫覆蓋率;該國北部清化省10月初亦爆發疫情,單週新增近40例病例,近7成病例為5歲以下兒童,多數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 西非象牙海岸今年截至10/14累計報告1,287例確診病例,病患多為9歲以下兒童,近9成未接種疫苗或接種史不明;該國前3年病例數約介於1,300至2,000例間。 東非南蘇丹南部瓦拉卜州宣布爆發疫情,截至10/22累計報告88例確診病例,當局已加強疫苗接種。
items.description_en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam, the outbreak remains severe. As of 13 October, 1,079 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 4 deaths. About half of cases are children under 5 years old, and the city has strengthened children's immunization coverage through the school system. In Thanh Hoa Province in northern Viet Nam, an outbreak also began in early October, with nearly 40 new cases in a single week; nearly 70% of cases are children under 5, and most cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history.

Côte d'Ivoire, in West Africa: As of 14 October this year, 1,287 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, mostly children under 9 years old; nearly 90% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. The country's case numbers in the previous three years ranged from about 1,300 to 2,000.

South Sudan, in East Africa: Warrap State in southern South Sudan has announced an outbreak. As of 22 October, 88 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, and authorities have strengthened vaccination.
items.area_zh: 象牙海岸,南蘇丹共和國,越南

items.summary_zh: 中國今年截至9月累計469,712例百日咳,疫情趨緩但仍遠高於往年。
items.summary_en: China has reported 469,712 pertussis cases through September this year; cases are easing from April–July levels but remain far above past years.
items.description_zh: 中國疫情持續,8、9月分別新增4.3萬及1.7萬餘例病例,相較4至7月期間,每個月通報7至9萬餘例已有和緩趨勢,惟仍遠高於往年平均數;今年截至9月已累計報告46萬9,712例,往年最高峰為2022年之3.6萬例。
items.description_en: Pertussis continues in China. Cases increased by 43,000 in August and by more than 17,000 in September. Compared with April to July, when more than 70,000 to over 90,000 cases were reported each month, there is a sign of easing, but levels remain far above the average of past years. This year, 469,712 cases have been cumulatively reported as of September, and the previous peak was 36,000 cases in 2022.

items.headline_zh: 美國/日本-肺炎黴漿菌感染症
items.headline_en: United States / Japan – Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection
items.summary_zh: 美國肺炎黴漿菌8月達高峰後持續;日本單週定點報告1.9,為近10年最高。
items.summary_en: US Mycoplasma pneumoniae cases peaked in August and continue; Japan's sentinel weekly average reached 1.9, the highest in 10 years and still rising.
items.description_zh: 美國今年4至9月疫情上升,所有年齡層報告數均增加,以未成年族群增幅較高,其中以4歲以下族群最為顯著,並於8月達高峰後持續迄今,當局呼籲醫護工作者提高警覺,並注意抗生素之使用。 日本疫情持續上升,單週定醫平均報告數達1.9,為近10年最高,且仍呈陡升趨勢,該國往年疫情高峰多發生於10至12月,峰介於0.4至0.6間,前二次爆發峰分別為0.9及1.6。
items.description_en:
United States: Cases have risen from April to September this year, with increases across all age groups, higher among minors, and most pronounced in children aged 4 and under. The peak occurred in August, and cases have continued since then. Authorities urge healthcare workers to remain alert and to pay attention to antibiotic use.

Japan: Cases continue to rise. The average weekly number of reports per sentinel medical institution reached 1.9, the highest in 10 years, and the curve is still climbing steeply. In past years, Japan's epidemic peaks have mostly occurred between October and December, with peaks between 0.4 and 0.6. The peaks of the previous two outbreaks (2015 and 2016) were 0.9 and 1.6, respectively.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.headline_zh: 越南-急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 越南多樂省10/19報告1例10個月大男嬰,疑與VDPV3相關。
items.summary_en: Viet Nam's Dak Lak Province reported a 10-month-old boy with acute flaccid paralysis on 19 October, suspected to be linked to VDPV3.
items.description_zh: 據報載,越南多樂省10/19報告1例病例,為10個月大男嬰,9/29出現發燒症狀,2日後發病,當局檢驗疑與VDPV3相關;該國自2000年起即屬無小兒麻痺症國家。
items.description_en: According to media reports, Dak Lak Province in Viet Nam reported 1 case on 19 October, a 10-month-old boy who developed fever on 29 September and became ill 2 days later. Authorities' testing suggests it may be related to VDPV3. Viet Nam has been free of polio since 2000.

items.summary_zh: 德國10/18檢出首例Ib型M痘,33歲男性,研判自東非輸入。
items.summary_en: Germany detected its first clade Ib Mpox case on 18 October, in a 33-year-old man presumed imported from East Africa.
items.description_zh: 德國於10/18檢出首例Ib型病例,為33歲男性個案,於10/12入院後被隔離治療,研判係自東非國家移入。當局已加強監測,目前研判I型疫情傳播風險仍未增加。
items.description_en: On 18 October Germany detected its first clade Ib case, a 33-year-old man who was admitted to hospital and isolated for treatment on 12 October. The case is presumed to have been imported from an East African country. Authorities have strengthened surveillance and currently judge that the transmission risk of clade I has not increased.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至9月累計2,881例類鼻疽,90例死亡(CFR約3%)。
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 2,881 melioidosis cases through September this year, with 90 deaths (CFR about 3%); most patients were farm or garden workers.
items.description_zh: 泰國疫情持續,今年截至9月累計報告2,881例病例,其中90例死亡(CFR:3%),多數病例為執行農/園藝工作,而有土壤及涉水等接觸史。
items.description_en: Melioidosis continues in Thailand. As of September this year, 2,881 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 90 deaths (CFR: 3%). Most patients were agricultural or gardening workers and had a history of contact with soil and water.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓鉤端螺旋體病今年5,835例,509例死亡,較去年同期升16%。
items.summary_en: The Philippines has reported 5,835 leptospirosis cases this year through 5 October, 16% above the same period last year, with 509 deaths.
items.description_zh: 菲律賓疫情持續,今年截至10/5累計報告5,835例病例,較去年同期上升16%,其中509例死亡,CFR約8.7%;疫情原於8月中旬趨緩,惟於9月下旬疫情又再次升溫,目前該國14(/18)個大區疫情仍在上升。
items.description_en: The Philippines' outbreak continues. As of 5 October this year, 5,835 cases have been cumulatively reported, 16% higher than the same period last year, including 509 deaths (CFR about 8.7%). The outbreak had eased in mid-August but rose again in late September. Currently, 14 (of 18) regions in the country are still seeing rising outbreaks.

items.headline_zh: 孟加拉-立百病毒感染症
items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年5例立百病毒感染全數死亡,累計344例、致死率71.2%。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported 5 Nipah virus cases this year, all fatal; since its first case in 2001, 344 cases have been reported, with 71.2% fatal.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉今年累計報告5例病例,均死亡;該國自2001年出現首例,迄今累計報告達344例,其中245例死亡(CFR:71.2%)。
items.description_en: Bangladesh has reported 5 cases this year, all fatal. The country recorded its first case in 2001 and has cumulatively reported 344 cases, of which 245 were fatal (CFR: 71.2%).

items.headline_zh: 盧安達-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 盧安達截至10/21累計62例確診,15例死亡,逾800名接觸者追蹤中。
items.summary_en: Rwanda's Marburg outbreak has 62 confirmed cases and 15 deaths as of 21 October, with more than 800 contacts still followed; no new cases in the past week.
items.description_zh: 盧安達近一週未新增病例,截至10/21累計報告62例確診病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:24.2%),1例隔離治療中,46例已康復。WHO 10/18表示,逾8成病患為首都吉佳利某2家醫療機構之工作者,目前仍有800餘名接觸者追蹤中。另當地研究員表示,目前所有案例之病毒基因序列均密切相關,顯示為同一事件,且未發現具威脅性之突變。
items.description_en: Rwanda has reported no new cases in the past week. As of 21 October, 62 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, including 15 deaths (CFR: 24.2%); 1 case is still in isolation and treatment, and 46 have recovered. WHO said on 18 October that more than 80% of patients were workers at two healthcare facilities in the capital, Kigali, and more than 800 contacts are still being followed up. Local researchers also said that the viral genetic sequences of all cases are closely related, indicating a single event, and no threatening mutations have been found.

items.summary_zh: 印度德里今年截至10/5累計511例瘧疾,無死亡,高於近4年同期。
items.summary_en: Delhi has reported 511 malaria cases this year as of 5 October, with no deaths, above the same period in each of the past four years.
items.description_zh: 印度德里疫情上升,今年截至10/5累計511例病例,迄無死亡病例,病例數高於近4年同期,分別為2023年329例、2022年153例、2021年127例及2020年189例。
items.description_en: Malaria is rising in Delhi, India. So far this year, as of 5 October, 511 cases have been cumulatively reported, with no deaths. The case count is higher than the same period in each of the past four years: 329 cases in 2023, 153 in 2022, 127 in 2021 and 189 in 2020.

items.summary_zh: 全球今年累計逾1,300萬例登革熱、8,500例死亡,巴西居美洲之首。
items.summary_en: Globally more than 13 million dengue cases and 8,500 deaths have been reported this year; Brazil leads the Americas, with cases rising in Bangladesh and Nepal.
items.description_zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
items.description_en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年1-9月逾1萬例奧羅普切熱,2例死亡均在巴西。
items.summary_en: The Americas reported over 10,000 Oropouche fever cases from January to September this year, with both deaths in Brazil.
items.description_zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年1-9月累計1萬餘例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共9國報告病例,分別為巴西(8,258)、秘魯(936)、古巴(555)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)及蓋亞那(2),另美國(90)及加拿大(2)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例。
items.description_en: Americas update: From January to September this year, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both in Brazil. A total of 9 countries reported cases: Brazil (8,258), Peru (936), Cuba (555), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2) and Guyana (2). The United States (90) and Canada (2) also reported cases, all of them imported.
items.area_zh: 玻利維亞,巴西,加拿大,哥倫比亞,古巴,厄瓜多,蓋亞那共和國,秘魯,美國

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(每週更新)
items.headline_en: Global – COVID-19 with severe illness (weekly update)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約20.6%;中國9月重症159例、死亡6例,較8月下降。
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 positivity was about 20.6% in week 40; China's September figures: 159 severe cases and 6 deaths, both down from August.
items.description_zh: 2024年第40週(9/30-10/6)全球陽性率約20.6%,陽性率以歐洲區(22.3%)、美洲區(13.6%)及非洲區(4.9%)為高。 中國更新9月疫情概況,新增159例重症及6例死亡,相較於8月(359例重症/18例死亡)重症數及死亡數皆下降,新冠病毒陽性率自9月初12.8%持續下降至9月底6.1%,發燒門診就診量及類流感就診率呈上下波動,主要流行變異株為JN.1、XDV及其衍生變異株;香港第41週(10/6-10/12)陽性率及定醫就診率呈下降趨勢,JN.1及其衍生變異株爲主要流行變異株,污水監測和人類感染個案中也檢測到 KP.2 和 KP.3。
items.description_en:
Situation update: In week 40 of 2024 (30 September–6 October), the global positivity rate was about 20.6%, highest in the European Region (22.3%), the Region of the Americas (13.6%) and the African Region (4.9%).

China updated its September situation: 159 new severe cases and 6 deaths were reported, both lower than in August (359 severe cases and 18 deaths). COVID-19 positivity fell from 12.8% in early September to 6.1% at the end of September. Fever clinic visits and influenza-like illness visit rates have fluctuated up and down. The main circulating variants are JN.1, XDV and their derived variants.

Hong Kong's positivity rate and sentinel clinic visit rate in week 41 (6–12 October) declined. JN.1 and its derived variants are the main circulating variants, and KP.2 and KP.3 have also been detected in wastewater surveillance and in human infection cases.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),香港特別行政區

items.summary_zh: 全球M痘今年截至第42週累計18,585例確診,非洲區8,591例。
items.summary_en: Global Mpox reached 18,585 confirmed cases by week 42 this year, with 8,591 in the African Region.
items.description_zh: 自2022年5月截至今年10/18全球累計126(2*)國/地區報告11萬1,988例確診病例,其中至少240例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第42週全球累計78國/地區報告18,585例確診病例,其中非洲區8,591例(本週1,049例)、美洲區5,671例(313)、西太平洋區1,784例(73)、歐洲區1,546例(124)、東地中海區770例(0),及東南亞區223例(13)。*辛巴威、尚比亞 美國10/10公布發現第2起對治療藥物tecovirimat(Tpoxx)抗藥性之群聚事件,與2022年於加州首次發現之抗藥群聚事件不同,本次群聚涉及跨州且無治療史個案;研究認為目前恐低估抗病毒治療藥物之抗藥性的傳播與其盛行率,建議加強定序與監測,並強化醫事人員對抗病毒藥物使用與診治指引遵循度,以減少抗藥性發生。 WHO 10/14宣布核准Jynneos疫苗用於12至17歲青少年。
items.description_en:
Since May 2022 and as of 18 October this year, 126 (2*) countries/territories have cumulatively reported 111,988 confirmed cases globally, including at least 240 deaths (CFR: 0.2%).

As of week 42 this year, 78 countries/territories have cumulatively reported 18,585 confirmed cases globally: African Region 8,591 (1,049 this week), Region of the Americas 5,671 (313), Western Pacific Region 1,784 (73), European Region 1,546 (124), Eastern Mediterranean Region 770 (0), and South-East Asia Region 223 (13). *Zimbabwe and Zambia

On 10 October the US reported a second cluster with resistance to the treatment drug tecovirimat (TPOXX). It differs from the first resistant cluster identified in California in 2022: this cluster involves multiple states, and its cases had no treatment history. The study considers that the transmission and prevalence of antiviral drug resistance may currently be underestimated, and recommends strengthened sequencing and surveillance, as well as improved healthcare workers' adherence to antiviral use and clinical guidelines to reduce the occurrence of resistance.

WHO approved the use of the Jynneos vaccine for adolescents aged 12 to 17 on 14 October.

items.summary_zh: 美國加州10/18再新增2例H5人類感染,細節未公布。
items.summary_en: California announced 2 more H5 human infections on 18 October; details have not been disclosed.
items.description_zh: 美國加州10/18公布再新增通報2例H5人類感染案例,細節迄未敘明。
items.description_en: California announced 2 further reported H5 human infection cases on 18 October; details have not been disclosed.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(每週更新)
items.summary_zh: 中國新增1例H9N2,美國新增7例H5人類感染,多國禽流感疫情增加
items.summary_en: China reported one new H9N2 human case and the US seven new H5 human infections, alongside rising avian outbreaks across 12 countries.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  中國新增1例H9N2、美國新增通報7例H5人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共12國於2024/7/1~10/16間新增84起HPAI H5N1疫情,分別為美國45起、匈牙利9起、義大利8起、奧地利5起、摩爾多瓦4起、德國3起、斯洛維亞/越南/保加利亞/波蘭各2起、加拿大及捷克各1起。 共2國於2024/9/27~10/2間新增4起HPAI H5N5疫情,分別為英國3起、德國1起。 共2國於2024/10/5~10/12間新增2起HPAI H5(N untyped)疫情,為法國及比利時。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計14(0)州報告320(21)起疫情;近期主要集中於加州。USDA 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少2,560例,檢測85例,其中15例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。CDC 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第41周(10/6-12),有313(/330)個採檢點提供檢測報告,僅在1個州的1個採檢點(佔0.3%)以廢水檢測到H5的病毒RNA。
items.description_en: Human cases: China reported 1 new H9N2 case, and the United States reported 7 new notified H5 human infection cases. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 12 countries reported 84 new HPAI H5N1 outbreaks between 1 July and 16 October 2024, namely the United States 45, Hungary 9, Italy 8, Austria 5, Moldova 4, Germany 3, Slovenia, Viet Nam, Bulgaria and Poland 2 each, and Canada and Czechia 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 4 new HPAI H5N5 outbreaks between 27 September and 2 October 2024, namely the United Kingdom 3 and Germany 1. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new HPAI H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 5 and 12 October 2024, namely France and Belgium. US avian influenza in dairy cattle: Dairy farms: since March this year, a cumulative 14 (0) states have reported 320 (21) outbreaks, currently concentrated mainly in California (USDA). Human infection via cattle: at least 2,560 cases monitored cumulatively, 85 tested, 15 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms) (CDC). Other derived outbreaks: infection of domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths reported. Wastewater surveillance: in week 41 (6–12 October), 313 of 330 sampling sites provided testing reports; H5 viral RNA was detected in wastewater at only 1 sampling site in 1 state (0.3%).

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年1-9月逾1萬例霍亂病例、359例死亡,高於去年同期
items.summary_en: Nigeria has recorded over 10,000 cholera cases and 359 deaths from January to September, exceeding last year's same-period total.
items.description_zh: 奈及利亞今年1-9月報告1萬餘例病例,其中359例死亡(CFR 3.3%),分布以該國西南部拉哥斯4,000餘例為多,年齡分布以小於5歲族群為多,其次為5-14歲族群,今年病例數高於去年同期3,000餘例及106例死亡,爆發疫情主因為缺乏安全衛生的飲用水及下水道設施。
items.description_en: Nigeria reported over 10,000 cases from January to September this year, including 359 deaths (CFR 3.3%). Cases are concentrated in Lagos, in the southwest of the country, with over 4,000 cases. By age, children under 5 account for the most cases, followed by those aged 5 to 14. This year's case count is over 3,000 higher than the same period last year, with 106 more deaths. The outbreak is mainly attributed to the lack of safe drinking water and sanitation and sewerage facilities.

items.disease_zh: 第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.disease_en: 第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 泰國-第二型豬鏈球菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 泰國149例出現聽力障礙病例,12例死亡,多為65歲以上長者
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 149 cases with hearing impairment linked to eating undercooked pork, including 12 deaths, mostly among people aged 65 and over.
items.description_zh: 泰國公布因食用未煮熟豬肉引起的相關疫情,1/7-9/3期間報告149例病例有聽力障礙症狀,迄今已有12例死亡,以65歲以上病例為多,病例分布以該國東北部呵叻、猜也蓬府為多。
items.description_en: Thailand announced an outbreak linked to eating undercooked pork. From 7 January to 3 September, 149 cases with hearing impairment symptoms were reported, and 12 deaths have occurred to date. Cases are mostly among people aged 65 and over, and are concentrated in Nakhon Ratchasima and Chaiyaphum provinces in the northeast of the country.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 全球今年野生型小兒麻痺病例累計50例,巴基斯坦28例、阿富汗22例
items.summary_en: Global WPV1 polio cases this year total 50, with 28 in Pakistan and 22 in Afghanistan, plus new cVDPV2 cases in Nigeria, Angola and South Sudan.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-10/9期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共3國新增6例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞4例、安哥拉/南蘇丹各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增50件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增8件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日4件、南蘇丹2件、西班牙/葉門各1件;法屬圭亞那新增3件cVDPV3陽性樣本。 全球今年WPV1病例累計50例,其中巴基斯坦28例、阿富汗22例,疾病仍持續傳播並造成兒童健康風險。
items.description_en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 October, Pakistan recorded 4 new WPV1 cases. Across 3 countries, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported: Nigeria 4, and Angola and South Sudan 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan recorded 50 new WPV1-positive samples. Across 4 countries, 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported: Japan 4, South Sudan 2, and Spain and Yemen 1 each. French Guiana recorded 3 new cVDPV3-positive samples. Globally this year, cumulative WPV1 cases total 50, including 28 in Pakistan and 22 in Afghanistan. The disease continues to spread and poses health risks to children.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,安哥拉,法屬圭亞那,奈及利亞,巴基斯坦,南蘇丹共和國,西班牙,葉門

items.summary_zh: 美國加州新增5例H5人類感染,今年累計25例,多數曾接觸病牛或病禽
items.summary_en: California reported five new H5 human infections; the US has 25 H5 cases this year, most with exposure to sick cattle or poultry.
items.description_zh: 美國加州新增5例H5人類感染病例,今年截至10/16累計9間乳牛場報告11例病例,均為輕症,僅出現結膜炎症狀,且均曾於農場接觸乳牛。該國今年累計報告25例H5病例(含H5N1),其中15例曾與病牛接觸,9例曾與病禽接觸,1例接觸史不明,分布於加州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、德州(1)及密蘇里州(1)。
items.description_en: California reported 5 new H5 human infection cases. As of 16 October this year, 9 dairy farms have reported 11 cases cumulatively this year. All cases were mild, presented only with conjunctivitis, and all had contact with dairy cattle on the farms. The country has reported 25 H5 cases this year (including H5N1) cumulatively: 15 had contact with sick cattle, 9 had contact with sick poultry, and 1 had an unknown exposure history. Cases are distributed across California (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), Texas (1) and Missouri (1).
