items.summary_zh: 美國麻疹累計267例、32州,阿根廷內羅河省爆發群聚感染
items.summary_en: US measles cases reached 267 across 32 states this year, with 88% unvaccinated or of unknown status; Argentina reported a cluster in Entre Ríos.
items.description_zh: 美國今年疫情較往年為高,截至10/10累計32州報告267例病例,近期有緩和趨勢,病患中41%為5歲以下兒童,88%未接種疫苗或接種史不明,約40%住院,分布以伊利諾州、明蘇達州及奧勒岡州為多。 阿根廷中部內羅河省10/4爆發群聚感染事件,累計報告10例疑病例,其中3例已確診,確診者均為兒童且無疫苗接種史,研判與境外移入病例有關。
items.description_en: US cases this year are higher than in previous years. As of 10 October, 267 cases had been reported cumulatively from 32 states, with a recent easing trend. Of the patients, 41% were children under 5 years old, 88% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and about 40% were hospitalized. Cases are concentrated in Illinois, Minnesota and Oregon. In Entre Ríos province in central Argentina, a cluster outbreak occurred on 4 October; 10 suspected cases were reported cumulatively, of which 3 have been confirmed. All confirmed cases were children with no vaccination history, and the outbreak is assessed to be related to an imported case from abroad.

items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦信德省白喉今年166例、28例死亡,印度拉賈斯坦邦6名兒童死亡
items.summary_en: Pakistan's Sindh province has recorded 166 diphtheria cases and 28 deaths this year, while India's Rajasthan reported six child deaths in a month.
items.description_zh: 巴基斯坦東南部信德省疫情上升,今年截至10/12累計報告166例病例,其中28例死亡,多集中於喀拉蚩市,當地專家表示該省抗毒素藥物短缺,接種疫苗仍為控制疫情之關鍵。 印度北部拉賈斯坦邦疫情上升,近1個月內新增報告6例死亡病例,均為10歲以下兒童,其中半數未接種疫苗,整體病例數未明,當局已介入調查。※該邦與巴基斯坦信德省相鄰。
items.description_en: Diphtheria cases are rising in Sindh province in southeastern Pakistan, with 166 cases reported cumulatively this year as of 12 October, including 28 deaths. Cases are concentrated mainly in Karachi. Local experts say the province faces a shortage of antitoxin medicine, and vaccination remains key to controlling the outbreak. In Rajasthan state in northern India, the outbreak is rising, with 6 deaths newly reported in the past month, all in children under 10, half of whom were unvaccinated. The overall case count is unclear, and authorities have launched an investigation. Note: this state borders Sindh province in Pakistan.

items.summary_zh: 美國今年截至第40週百日咳累計17,611例,為去年同期4.4倍
items.summary_en: US pertussis cases reached 17,611 by week 40 this year, 4.4 times the same period last year, with Pennsylvania and New York among the hardest hit.
items.description_zh: 美國疫情持續,今年截至第40週(10/5)累計報告17,611例病例,為去年同期之4.4倍,其中以賓州、紐約州、加州、伊利諾州等最為嚴峻。
items.description_en: The outbreak in the United States continues. As of week 40 (5 October) this year, 17,611 cases have been reported cumulatively, 4.4 times the figure for the same period last year. Pennsylvania, New York, California and Illinois are among the hardest-hit states.

items.summary_zh: 烏干達卡農古區單週新增59例,今年6區累計185例確診、4例死亡
items.summary_en: Uganda's Kanungu district reported 59 cases in one week in late September; six districts have recorded 185 confirmed cases and 4 deaths this year.
items.description_zh: 烏干達西南部卡農古區9月底爆發疫情,單週新增報告59例病例,其中2例確診,1例死亡;今年截至9月底累計6行政區報告185例確診,4例死亡。當局已加強防治措施及動物疫苗接種。
items.description_en: An outbreak occurred in Kanungu district in southwestern Uganda in late September. In a single week, 59 cases were reported, of which 2 were confirmed and 1 died. This year, cumulatively to the end of September, 6 administrative districts have reported 185 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Authorities have strengthened control measures and animal vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年2,926例、印度喀拉拉邦約4,500例,喀拉拉155例死亡
items.summary_en: Thailand has recorded 2,926 leptospirosis cases this year, and India's Kerala reported about 4,500 cases, including 155 deaths among confirmed cases.
items.description_zh: 泰國今年截至10/8累計報告2,926例病例,以45至64歲族群為多,其中29例死亡,多為農民。 印度喀拉拉邦今年截至10/4累計報告約4,500例病例,其中2,512例確診,確診病例中155例死亡(CFR:6.2%)。 捷克9/29報告今年首例病例,為東部摩拉維亞-西利西亞州64歲男性,於9月中旬遭遇洪災,直接暴露於受汙染水源。
items.description_en: Thailand has reported 2,926 cases cumulatively this year as of 8 October, mainly among people aged 45 to 64; 29 died, most of them farmers. India's Kerala state reported about 4,500 cases cumulatively this year as of 4 October, of which 2,512 were confirmed; 155 of the confirmed cases died (CFR: 6.2%). Czechia reported its first case of this year on 29 September: a man aged 64 from the Moravian-Silesian Region in the east, who was directly exposed to contaminated water after floods in mid-September.

items.headline_zh: 盧安達-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 盧安達馬堡病毒出血熱累計62例、15例死亡,逾8成為醫護人員
items.summary_en: Rwanda has reported 62 Marburg virus disease cases and 15 deaths, with over 80% among healthcare workers; South Korea tightened quarantine for arrivals.
items.description_zh: 盧安達近一週疫情趨緩,截至10/15累計報告62例病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:24.2%),21例隔離治療中,26例已康復。WHO 10/11表示,逾8成病患為醫療工作者,來自首都吉佳利(Kigali)某2間醫療機構,目前仍有約700名接觸者追蹤中;評估傳播風險於國內為非常高,於區域為高,於全球則低。 韓國宣布10/10起針對來自盧安達、衣索比亞、烏干達、剛果民主共和國及坦尚亞入境旅客加強檢疫措施。
items.description_en: Rwanda's outbreak has slowed over the past week. As of 15 October, 62 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 15 deaths (CFR: 24.2%); 21 patients are in isolation treatment and 26 have recovered. WHO stated on 11 October that more than 80% of patients are healthcare workers from two healthcare facilities in the capital, Kigali, and about 700 contacts are still being followed up. WHO assesses the risk of spread as very high nationally, high regionally and low globally. South Korea announced that from 10 October it will strengthen quarantine measures for arriving travellers from Rwanda, Ethiopia, Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Tanzania.

items.headline_zh: 阿富汗-不明原因致死疾病
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗爆發不明原因疾病,逾500例、2例死亡,泰國加強入境篩檢
items.summary_en: Media reports describe an unexplained illness in Afghanistan with over 500 cases and 2 deaths; Thailand has stepped up entry screening for travelers from Afghanistan.
items.description_zh: 據報載,阿富汗近期爆發不明原因疾病,累計報告逾500例病例,其中2例死亡,病患出現虛弱、四肢疼痛、嚴重腹瀉、高燒等類傷寒症狀。泰國衛生當局10/9宣布針對來自阿富汗旅客加強入境篩檢,並呼籲民眾前往高風險國家前先行接種傷寒疫苗。
items.description_en: Media reports indicate that an unexplained illness has recently broken out in Afghanistan, with over 500 cases reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths. Patients present with weakness, limb pain, severe diarrhea and high fever, with typhoid-like symptoms. On 9 October, Thailand's health authorities announced enhanced entry screening for travelers from Afghanistan and called on people to get typhoid vaccination before travelling to high-risk countries.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉單日新增逾千例住院、3例死亡,今年累計39,822例、196例死亡
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported over 1,000 new dengue hospitalizations and 3 deaths in one day, with 39,822 cases and 196 deaths so far this year.
items.description_zh: 孟加拉疫情持續,單日新增逾千例住院及3例死亡,今年截至10/9累計39,822例病例及196例死亡;該國去年共321,179例病例,其中1,705例死亡。
items.description_en: Bangladesh's outbreak continues, with over 1,000 new hospitalizations and 3 deaths recorded in a single day. This year, as of 9 October, 39,822 cases and 196 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Last year the country recorded 321,179 cases, including 1,705 deaths.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲18國累計1,202例本土西尼羅熱,88例死亡,以義大利、希臘為多
items.summary_en: Europe has recorded 1,202 locally acquired West Nile cases in 18 countries this year, with 88 deaths, mainly in Greece, Italy and Albania.
items.description_zh: 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至10/2累計18國報告1,202例本土病例,分布以義大利(422)、希臘(202)、西班牙(114)為多,其中88例死亡,以希臘(31)、義大利(16)、阿爾巴亞(13)為多。今年累計病例數高於去年同期(681),多為65歲以上男性;ECDC指出,隨季節轉換,預期疫情將逐漸趨緩。
items.description_en: In this European update, as of 2 October this year, 18 countries have reported 1,202 locally acquired cases cumulatively, mainly in Italy (422), Greece (202) and Spain (114), with 88 deaths, mainly in Greece (31), Italy (16) and Albania (13). This year's cumulative case count exceeds the same period last year (681), and cases are mostly men aged over 65. ECDC notes that as the season changes, the outbreak is expected to gradually subside.
items.area_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞,希臘,義大利,西班牙

items.summary_zh: 全球今年截至9月30日約46萬例屈公病,170例死亡均在巴西
items.summary_en: Globally, about 460,000 chikungunya cases were reported in 23 countries by 30 September, with 170 deaths, all in Brazil.
items.description_zh: 全球今年截至9/30累計23國報告約46萬例病例,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,其中170例死亡均來自巴西;美洲病例數以巴西391,000餘例為多,其次為巴拉圭2,000餘例;亞洲病例數以印度69,000餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦2,000餘例。
items.description_en: Globally this year as of 30 September, 23 countries have reported about 460,000 cases cumulatively across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe, and all 170 deaths were in Brazil. In the Americas, cases are highest in Brazil with over 391,000, followed by Paraguay with over 2,000. In Asia, cases are highest in India with over 69,000, followed by Pakistan with over 2,000.
items.area_zh: 巴西,印度,巴基斯坦,巴拉圭共和國

items.summary_zh: 美國加州新增2例H5人類感染,今年累計20例,多數曾接觸病牛或病禽
items.summary_en: California reported two new H5 human infections; the US has 20 H5 cases this year, mostly linked to sick cattle or poultry.
items.description_zh: 美國加州新增報告2例H5人類感染病例,今年截至10/11累計5乳牛場報告6例病例,均為乳牛場工人,彼此間無密切接觸,僅出現結膜炎症狀;該國今年累計報告20例H5病例,其中10例曾與病牛接觸,9例曾與病禽接觸,1例接觸史不明,分布於科羅拉多州(10)、加州(6)、密西根州(2)、德州(1)及密蘇里州(1)。
items.description_en: California reported 2 new H5 human infection cases. As of 11 October this year, 5 dairy farms have reported 6 cases cumulatively this year. All were dairy farm workers with no close contact among them, and all had only conjunctivitis symptoms. The country has reported 20 H5 cases this year, of which 10 had contact with sick cattle, 9 had contact with sick poultry, and 1 had an unknown exposure history. Cases are distributed across Colorado (10), California (6), Michigan (2), Texas (1) and Missouri (1).

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: 阿富汗與巴基斯坦各新增3例WPV1,剛果民主共和國新增2例cVDPV1
items.summary_en: Afghanistan and Pakistan each reported three new WPV1 polio cases, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported two new cVDPV1 cases, between 26 September and 2 October.
items.description_zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/26-10/2期間,共2國新增6例WPV1病例,分別為阿富汗/巴基斯坦各3例;剛果民主共和國新增2例cVDPV1病例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增4件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗3件、巴基斯坦1件;共2國新增2件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為象牙海岸/日各1件。
items.description_en: GPEI reported that between 26 September and 2 October, 2 countries reported 6 new WPV1 cases: Afghanistan 3 and Pakistan 3. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 2 new cVDPV1 cases. For environmental samples, 2 countries reported 4 new WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 3 and Pakistan 1. Also, 2 countries reported 2 new cVDPV2-positive samples: Côte d'Ivoire and Japan 1 each.
items.area_zh: 阿富汗,剛果民主共和國,象牙海岸,尼日,巴基斯坦

items.headline_en: Democratic Republic of the Congo – Mpox
items.summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國10月5日啟動M痘疫苗接種,優先衛生人員與接觸者
items.summary_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo launched Mpox vaccination on 5 October, prioritizing health workers and contacts in 11 hardest-hit health zones.
items.description_zh: 剛果民主共和國10/5正式啟動疫苗接種活動,目前將以衛生相關工作人員、接觸者等為優先,預計自北基伍、南基伍省起,於6省份11個受影響最嚴重的衛生區推行疫苗接種。
items.description_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo formally launched a vaccination campaign on 5 October. Health workers and contacts are currently prioritized. Vaccination is planned to begin in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces and cover 11 of the most severely affected health zones across 6 provinces.

items.summary_zh: 美國加州中央谷地新增1例H5N1感染,曾接觸感染乳牛,一般民眾風險低
items.summary_en: California's Central Valley reported one new mild H5N1 human case in a person exposed to infected dairy cows; public risk is assessed as low.
items.description_zh: 美國加州中央谷地10/10報告新增1例H5N1人類感染病例,症狀輕微,個案曾接觸受感染的乳牛,該州迄今發生的4例確診病例均位於不同地點的乳牛場。另有2例可能病例之檢體送驗中,當局評估對一般民眾的風險為低,接觸受感染的動物者之感染風險較高。
items.description_en: On 10 October, California's Central Valley reported 1 new mild H5N1 human infection case. The patient had contact with infected dairy cows. The state has had 4 confirmed cases to date, all at different dairy farm locations. Specimens from 2 other possible cases are being tested. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as low, while people who have contact with infected animals face a higher risk of infection.

items.summary_zh: 全球今年累計16,263例M痘確診,非洲區本週新增552例
items.summary_en: Globally, 16,263 mpox cases were confirmed in 75 countries this year by week 41, with 552 new cases in the African Region this week.
items.description_zh: 自2022年5月截至今年10/11全球累計124國/地區報告11萬0,417例確診病例,其中至少238例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第41週全球累計75國/地區報告16,263例確診病例,其中非洲區7,542例(本週552例)、美洲區5,358例(76)、西太平洋區1,711例(72)、歐洲區1,422例(52)、東地中海區773例(1),及東南亞區210例(0)。
items.description_en: Since May 2022, and as of 11 October this year, 124 countries and territories globally have reported 110,417 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 238 died (CFR: 0.2%). As of week 41 this year, 75 countries and territories globally have reported 16,263 confirmed cases cumulatively: 7,542 in the African Region (552 this week), 5,358 in the Region of the Americas (76), 1,711 in the Western Pacific Region (72), 1,422 in the European Region (52), 773 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region (1), and 210 in the South-East Asia Region (0).

items.headline_zh: 全球-新型A型流感(本週更新)
items.summary_zh: 美國新增1例H5N1人類感染,9國新增39起禽流感H5N1疫情
items.summary_en: The US reported one new H5N1 human infection; nine countries reported 39 new avian H5N1 outbreaks in the period to 10 October.
items.description_zh: 人類疫情:  美國新增1例H5N1人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共9國於2024/9/8~10/10間新增39起HPAI H5N1疫情,分別為美國20起、匈牙利6起、德國及摩爾多瓦各3起,西班牙及義大利各2起,波蘭、奧地利及斯洛伐克各1起。 冰島於2024/9/22~23間新增2起HPAI H5N5疫情。 秘魯於2024/9/5~20間新增6起HPAI H5(N untyped)疫情。 挪威於2024/9/27新增1起HPAI 未分型疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:今年3月迄今累計14(0)州報告299(44)起疫情;目前主要集中於加州。USDA 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少2,400例,檢測75例,其中7例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。CDC 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第39週於288個哨點中0站點檢出H5病毒。
items.description_en: Human cases: The United States reported 1 new H5N1 human infection. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): A total of 9 countries reported 39 new HPAI H5N1 outbreaks between 8 September and 10 October 2024, namely the United States 20, Hungary 6, Germany and Moldova 3 each, Spain and Italy 2 each, and Poland, Austria and Slovakia 1 each. Iceland reported 2 new HPAI H5N5 outbreaks on 22–23 September 2024. Peru reported 6 new HPAI H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 5 and 20 September 2024. Norway reported 1 new HPAI untyped outbreak on 27 September 2024. US avian influenza in dairy cattle: Dairy farms: since March this year, a cumulative 14 (0) states have reported 299 (44) outbreaks, currently concentrated mainly in California (USDA). Human infection via cattle: at least 2,400 cases monitored cumulatively, 75 tested, 7 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms) (CDC). Other derived outbreaks: infection of domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths reported. Wastewater surveillance: in week 39, H5 virus was detected at none of 288 sentinel sites.

items.headline_zh: 全球-新冠併發重症(本週更新)
items.summary_zh: 全球新冠陽性率約23.7%,歐洲區25.8%最高,美國與香港皆續降
items.summary_en: Global COVID-19 test positivity was about 23.7% in week 39, highest in Europe; US and Hong Kong SAR positivity is falling.
items.description_zh: 2024年第39週(9/23-9/29)全球陽性率約23.7%,陽性率以歐洲區(25.8%)、美洲區(14.2%)及非洲區(5.0%)為高。 香港第40週(9/29-10/5)陽性率持續下降,於污水監測檢出KP.2、KP.3、JN.1、KP.3.1.1、LB.1、JN.1.7及JN.1.18等變異株。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,亦有檢出XEC變異株呈上升趨勢。
items.description_en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 39 of 2024 (23–29 September) was about 23.7%, highest in the European Region (25.8%), the Region of the Americas (14.2%) and the African Region (5.0%). Hong Kong SAR: the positivity rate continued to decline in week 40 (29 September–5 October), and wastewater surveillance detected variants KP.2, KP.3, JN.1, KP.3.1.1, LB.1, JN.1.7 and JN.1.18. United States: recent positivity rate, emergency department visit rate and hospitalization rate have all been declining. The predominant circulating variant is KP.3.1.1, and the XEC variant, which is on an upward trend, has also been detected.

items.headline_zh: 日本-肺炎黴漿菌感染症
items.summary_zh: 日本肺炎黴漿菌感染症今年持續上升,週平均報告數超越2016年大爆發
items.summary_en: Japan's Mycoplasma pneumoniae infections have risen since April, and weekly average reports have surpassed those of the 2016 major outbreak.
items.description_zh: 日本今年自4月起疫情升溫,5月驟升,而後持續上升至今,週平均報告數已超越前次(2016年)大爆發時期;該國往年疫情高峰為10至12月,週平均報告數峰多介於0.4至0.6間,前二次爆發之峰分別為0.9及1.6,今年最新數據(38週)則為1.5。
items.description_en: Japan's outbreak has risen since April this year, surged in May, and has continued to rise to date. The weekly average number of reports has already exceeded that of the previous major outbreak in 2016. Japan's usual annual peak occurs from October to December, with weekly average peaks typically between 0.4 and 0.6. The peaks of the two previous outbreaks were 0.9 and 1.6, and the latest figure (week 38) is 1.5.

items.summary_zh: 阿爾及利亞白喉累計115例、28例死亡,當局歸因疫苗及醫療資源不足
items.summary_en: Algeria's diphtheria cases have risen since September, reaching 115 cases and 28 deaths by 5 October, which authorities attribute to vaccine and medical resource shortages.
items.description_zh: 北非阿爾及利亞9月起疫情上升,截至10/5累計報告115例病例,其中28例死亡,當局表示主要係疫苗及醫療資源不足導致。
items.description_en: In North Africa, Algeria's outbreak has risen since September. As of 5 October, 115 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 28 died. Authorities say this is mainly due to shortages of vaccines and medical resources.

items.summary_zh: 非洲麻疹累計逾21萬例、2,968例死亡,越南胡志明市743例
items.summary_en: Africa has reported 218,258 measles cases and 2,968 deaths this year, while Ho Chi Minh City in Viet Nam has recorded 743 cases.
items.description_zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年截至9/26累計報告21萬8,258例病例,其中19,454例確診,2,968例死亡(CFR:1.25%),以剛果民主共和國8.5萬餘例、衣索比亞2.7萬餘例最多,另有蒲隆地、摩洛哥、奈及利亞、布吉納法索及索馬利亞報告1萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,19國報告數十至5千例不等。 越南南部胡志明市疫情上升,9月底單週新增近百例病例,自疫情爆發(時間不明)截至9/26累計報告達743例,多為5歲以下兒童,當局表示該市之免疫覆蓋率於各地區差異大,目前已超過72%;另報載該國中、北部省份疫情亦在上升。
items.description_en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
items.area_zh: 布吉納法索,蒲隆地,查德,剛果民主共和國,象牙海岸,衣索比亞,摩洛哥,奈及利亞,索馬利亞,越南

items.summary_zh: 中國廣東第39週通報1,167例登革熱,美國聖地牙哥郡出現首例本土病例
items.summary_en: Guangdong reported 1,167 dengue cases in week 39, 1,161 of them locally acquired; San Diego County recorded its first local US case.
items.description_zh: 中國廣東省於第39週(9/23-29)通報1,167例病例,其中,本土病例1,161例,以佛山(324)及廣州(271)等為多,當局已呼籲民眾加強孳清及防蚊措施。 美國加州聖地牙哥郡10/6報告首例本土病例,該病例未有疫區旅遊史,迄今亦未發現其他本土病例,當局已加強撲滅病媒蚊措施;加州今年累計6例本土病例,較往年增加且範圍擴大。
items.description_en: Guangdong Province in mainland China reported 1,167 cases in week 39 (23–29 September), of which 1,161 were locally acquired, mainly in Foshan (324) and Guangzhou (271). Authorities have called on residents to strengthen breeding-site elimination and mosquito control measures. San Diego County, California, reported its first locally acquired case on 6 October. The patient had no travel history to outbreak areas, and no other local cases have been found to date. Authorities have intensified vector control. California has recorded 6 locally acquired cases this year cumulatively, more than in previous years, and the geographic spread has widened.
items.area_zh: 中國大陸(不含港澳),美國

items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾今年6月雨季迄今日本腦炎63例、至少17例死亡,致死率逾27%
items.summary_en: Nepal has recorded 63 Japanese encephalitis cases since June this year, at least 17 fatal, with a fatality rate above 27%.
items.description_zh: 泊爾自今年6月雨季迄今已累計63例病例,其中至少17例死亡,且以15歲以下孩童為多,致死率已超過27%,每年9-10 月為疫情高峰期。
items.description_en: Nepal has recorded 63 cases cumulatively since the June rainy season began this year, of which at least 17 died. Cases are mainly among children under 15. The case fatality rate has exceeded 27%, and the annual peak season is September to October.

items.summary_zh: 美國新罕布夏州今年第5例東部馬腦炎,為第2例死亡,致死率約3成
items.summary_en: New Hampshire has recorded five Eastern equine encephalitis cases this year, two fatal; the disease has a fatality rate of about 30%.
items.description_zh: 美國新罕布夏州10/4報告新增1例死亡病例,為該州今年第5例病例,且為第2例死亡案例,該州已10年未出現相關疫情。隨著當地氣候轉涼且蚊媒活動降低,傳播風險趨緩,惟當局仍呼籲民眾注意防護措施,該疾病致死率約達3成,而倖存者可能有神經系統問題。
items.description_en: New Hampshire reported one new fatal case on 4 October, the state's fifth case this year and its second death. The state has not had related outbreaks in 10 years. As local weather turns cooler and mosquito activity declines, the transmission risk is easing. Authorities still urge the public to take protective measures. The disease has a fatality rate of about 30%, and survivors may have neurological problems.

items.disease_zh: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.disease_en: 福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.headline_zh: 印度-福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎
items.summary_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦近5個月累計19例阿米巴腦膜腦炎,5例死亡
items.summary_en: Kerala state in India has reported 19 amoebic meningoencephalitis cases in nearly five months, with five deaths, and urges people to avoid pond swimming.
items.description_zh: 印度西南部喀拉拉邦近5個月內累計報告19例阿米巴腦膜腦炎病例,已知部分病原為福氏內里阿米巴原蟲,其中5例死亡,當居呼籲民眾避免於池塘湖泊中戲水,尤其應避免嗆水。
items.description_en: In Kerala state in southwestern India, 19 cases of amoebic meningoencephalitis have been reported cumulatively in nearly the past 5 months. Some cases are known to be caused by Naegleria fowleri. Five of the cases died. Authorities urge people to avoid swimming in ponds and lakes, and especially to avoid getting water up the nose.

items.summary_zh: 象牙海岸今年截至9月28日狂犬病累計35例死亡,過半為15歲以下兒童
items.summary_en: Côte d'Ivoire has recorded 35 rabies deaths this year as of 28 September, more than half in children under 15.
items.description_zh: 象牙海岸今年截至9/28累計報告35例死亡病例,其中過半數為15歲以下兒童,該國往年每年報告約1.4萬例病例,當局已加強衛教推廣及寵物疫苗接種。
items.description_en: As of 28 September this year, Côte d'Ivoire has reported 35 cumulative deaths from rabies, more than half of them children under 15. The country has typically reported about 14,000 cases per year. Authorities have strengthened health education and pet vaccination.

items.summary_zh: 美國佛羅里達州創傷弧菌感染累計64例、9例死亡,為近10年第二高
items.summary_en: Florida has reported 64 Vibrio vulnificus infections and 9 deaths as of 4 October, the second-highest in a decade, linked to recent hurricanes.
items.description_zh: 美國佛羅里達州疫情升高,截至10/4累計報告64例病例,為近10年來第二高,其中9例死亡,研判係受近期颶風影響,當局呼籲有開放性傷口者,應避免接觸汙水及海水,如出現相關症狀,應儘速就醫。
items.description_en: Cases are rising in Florida. As of 4 October, 64 cases have been reported cumulatively, the second highest in 10 years, of which 9 died. Authorities assess that this is linked to recent hurricanes. People with open wounds are urged to avoid contact with sewage and seawater, and to seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear.

items.headline_zh: 盧安達-馬堡病毒出血熱
items.summary_zh: 盧安達馬堡病毒出血熱累計49例、12例死亡,美國實施監測
items.summary_en: Rwanda has reported 49 Marburg cases and 12 deaths as of 6 October; the US will monitor healthcare workers who were in Rwandan facilities within 21 days.
items.description_zh: 盧安達疫情更新,截至10/6累計報告49例病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:24.5%),其餘病例隔離治療中,目前已累計檢驗2,107件。美國於10/3宣布,將對21日內曾於盧安達醫療照護機構工作者進行監測,並禁止於監測期間內於醫療照護機構從事相關工作。
items.description_en: In this Rwanda outbreak update, as of 6 October, 49 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 12 deaths (CFR: 24.5%). Remaining cases are in isolation treatment, and 2,107 tests have been conducted cumulatively. On 3 October, the United States announced that it will monitor healthcare workers who worked in healthcare facilities in Rwanda within the past 21 days, and will prohibit them from working in healthcare facilities during the monitoring period.

AE.zh: 近兩年共 7 則疫情通報,多為M痘:2025年2月通報首例分支Ib病例並有輸出個案;另有2026年4月新冠陽性率升至8.82%。最新為2026年4月新冠通報。
AE.en: 7 notices in the past two years, mostly mpox: the UAE reported its first clade Ib case in February 2025 and exported cases abroad. Latest, April 2026: COVID-19 positivity climbed to 8.82%.

AF.zh: 近兩年共 41 則疫情通報,以小兒麻痺(野生株 WPV1)最常見,另有霍亂、麻疹與剛果出血熱通報。最近為 2026 年 10 月,通報該國 9 月中旬一週內有 7 例 WPV1。
AF.en: 41 notices in the past two years, mostly on polio (wild poliovirus type 1 cases reported repeatedly), plus cholera, measles and CCHF. The most recent, in October 2026, reported 7 WPV1 cases in Afghanistan in one week in mid-September.

AI.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2026 年 3 月安圭拉通報 1 例本土感染西尼羅熱,患者為 25 歲、近期無旅遊史,已住院。
AI.en: Anguilla has 1 notice in the past two years: in March 2026 it reported a locally acquired West Nile fever case in a 25-year-old with no recent travel, who was hospitalised.

AL.zh: 近兩年共 3 則疫情通報,包括2024年10月歐洲西尼羅熱(阿爾巴尼亞為病例較多國之一)與11月11例布氏桿菌病;最新為2025年9月西尼羅熱區域通報。
AL.en: 3 notices in the past two years: West Nile fever across Europe, with Albania among the main affected countries (October 2024), and 11 human brucellosis cases (October 2024). The latest, September 2025, was a regional West Nile update.

AO.zh: 近兩年共 29 則疫情通報,2025年霍亂疫情擴及17省(單週最高約1,200例),另有小兒麻痺;2026年轉為M痘社區傳播及瘧疾,最新為同年10月霍亂通報。
AO.en: 29 notices in the past two years. A large cholera outbreak in 2025 reached 8,543 cases by April and spread to 17 provinces; polio cases also recurred. In 2026 notices turned to mpox with local transmission (264 cases by September) and malaria in Malanje, over 520,000 cases by June 2026.

AR.zh: 近兩年共 33 則通報,以漢他病毒、屈公病、登革熱與麻疹反覆出現,2025 年百日咳與梅毒病例上升。最近為 2026 年 9 月內烏肯省漢他病毒 2 例,其中 1 例死亡。
AR.en: 33 notices in the past two years, with hantavirus, chikungunya, dengue and measles recurring, and pertussis and syphilis rising in 2025. The latest, in September 2026, reported two hantavirus cases in Neuquén Province, one fatal.

AT.zh: 近兩年共 9 則疫情通報,涵蓋 A 型肝炎、沙門氏菌、退伍軍人病、M痘與志賀氏菌。2025 年中歐 A 型肝炎病例逾 6,000 例;最新為 2026 年 9 月林茲 31 例退伍軍人病、3 人死亡。
AT.en: Austria has 9 notices in the past two years, covering hepatitis A, Salmonella, Legionnaires' disease, mpox and Shigella. Central Europe reported over 6,000 hepatitis A cases to October 2025. The latest notable event is Linz's Legionnaires' cluster of 31 cases and 3 deaths in July–August 2026.

AU.zh: 近兩年共 44 則疫情通報,涵蓋麻疹、白喉、M痘、類鼻疽與日本腦炎等。2026年白喉疫情顯著,7月已逾410例。最新為2026年10月麻疹通報,今年119例。
AU.en: 44 notices in the past two years covering measles, diphtheria, mpox, melioidosis and Japanese encephalitis. Diphtheria stood out in 2026, with 410 cases by July. Latest, October 2026: measles, with 119 cases reported this year.

AZ.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2026 年 8 月炭疽病:西北部薩穆赫地區出現 1 例確診、9 例疑似,與極端乾旱及接觸牛隻有關。
AZ.en: One notice in the past two years: anthrax in August 2026, when Samukh district in north-western Azerbaijan reported one confirmed and nine suspected cases, linked to extreme drought and contact with cattle.

BB.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則通報:2024 年 12 月 6 日巴貝多通報 2 例成人歐洛普什熱,當局持續監測並呼籲防蚊。
BB.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: on 6 December 2024 Barbados reported two adult Oropouche fever cases, with authorities urging mosquito bite prevention and continued close surveillance.

BD.zh: 近兩年共 64 則疫情通報,登革熱每年均有大量病例,2026 年麻疹疫情為近 20 年最嚴重。最近為 2026 年 10 月通報,登革熱住院 84,369 例、死亡 2,256 人;另有立百病毒與炭疽病。
BD.en: 64 notices in the past two years: dengue recurred each year, and a measles outbreak since March 2026 is described as the worst in 20 years. In October 2026, dengue hospitalisations reached 84,369 with 2,256 deaths. Nipah, anthrax and H5 avian influenza cases were also reported.

BE.zh: 近兩年共 13 則疫情通報,以沙門氏菌最多:2026 年 5 月已有 236 例確診,9 月再報逾 300 例,疑與雞蛋有關。另有 M痘(2024 年 12 月首例 Ib 型)與麻疹、伊波拉區域通報。最新為 2026 年 9 月。
BE.en: Belgium has 13 notices in the past two years, mostly Salmonella: 236 confirmed cases by May 2026 and over 300 by September, linked to contaminated eggs. Mpox (first clade Ib case in December 2024), measles and Ebola items also appeared. The latest notice is from September 2026.

BF.zh: 近兩年共 5 則疫情通報,皆屬非洲區域性通報,涵蓋麻疹、登革熱、小兒麻痺與腦膜炎。2025 年 1 月指布吉納法索為 2024 年非洲登革熱病例最多的國家之一;最新為 2026 年 4 月腦膜炎通報。
BF.en: Burkina Faso has 5 notices in the past two years, all African regional reports covering measles, dengue, polio and meningitis. A January 2025 notice named it among the countries with the most dengue cases in Africa in 2024. The latest, in April 2026, is a meningitis update.

BG.zh: 近兩年共 5 則疫情通報,多為歐洲西尼羅熱與禽流感的區域性通報(2025年8至9月),本國未見獨立疫情;最新為2026年9月美洲麻疹通報。
BG.en: 5 notices in the past two years, mostly Europe-wide West Nile fever and avian influenza digests from August-September 2025 that mention the country only in a regional context. The latest, September 2026, was a measles update for the Americas.

BI.zh: 近兩年共 17 則疫情通報,以M痘為主,2026 年另有剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情通報。2026 年 4 月蒲隆地北部出現原因不明疾病(35 例、5 人死亡);最近為 2026 年 9 月M痘通報。
BI.en: 17 notices in the past two years, mostly mpox, plus 2026 Ebola updates from the neighbouring DRC. In April 2026 Burundi reported an unexplained illness in the north (35 cases, 5 deaths; Ebola and Marburg ruled out). The latest notice, in September 2026, was on mpox.

BJ.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報,皆為2025年6至7月小兒麻痺(cVDPV2)全球通報,各提及貝南一例病例。最新為2025年7月。
BJ.en: 2 notices in the past two years, both global polio updates in June and July 2025 that each included one cVDPV2 case in Benin. Latest: July 2025.

BO.zh: 近兩年共 24 則通報,涉及黃熱病、屈公病、麻疹與漢他病毒。2025 年 6 月因麻疹宣布公衛緊急狀態,2026 年初屈公病快速增加;最近為 2026 年 4 月聖克魯斯黃熱病警示。
BO.en: 24 notices in the past two years covering yellow fever, chikungunya, measles and hantavirus. Bolivia declared a measles emergency in June 2025, and chikungunya surged in early 2026; the latest, in April 2026, was a Santa Cruz yellow fever alert after two cases.

BR.zh: 近兩年共 71 則通報,反覆出現登革熱、屈公病、黃熱病與歐洛普什熱。2026 年登革熱至第 28 週逾 111 萬例,低於前一年;2026 年 9 月通報茲卡疑似病例 11,017 例。
BR.en: 71 notices in the past two years, with dengue, chikungunya, yellow fever and Oropouche fever recurring. Dengue passed 1.11 million cases by week 28 of 2026, below the previous year, and in September 2026 Zika reached 11,017 suspected cases.

BS.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2026年5月美國郵輪諾羅病毒群聚,累計160例(佔乘客及工作人員3.6%),屬區域性事件,無本國疫情數據。
BS.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: a norovirus cluster on a US cruise ship in May 2026 with 160 cases (3.6% of passengers and crew). No country-specific outbreak data were given.

BT.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報:2025年7月一所學校爆發鉤端螺旋體病,180例、3人死亡;2026年9月WHO認可不丹消除犬隻傳播之人類狂犬病。
BT.en: 2 notices in the past two years: a school leptospirosis cluster in July 2025 with 180 cases and 3 deaths, and in September 2026 WHO recognised Bhutan's elimination of dog-mediated human rabies.

BW.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2025 年 7 月瘧疾:辛巴威病例與死亡大增,並提到鄰近國家同樣上升。
BW.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in July 2025, a malaria update noting sharp rises in Zimbabwe and that neighbouring countries were also rising.

BZ.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報,皆為2025年4月:卡尤區瘧疾4例(3例本土,為六年來首見),以及美洲麻疹疫情升高的區域通報。
BZ.en: 2 notices in the past two years, both from April 2025: four malaria cases in Cayo District (three locally acquired, the first in six years) and a regional update on rising measles in the Americas.

CA.zh: 近兩年共 72 則疫情通報,以麻疹最多(28 則),2025 年病例逾 5,000 例並於 11 月失去消除麻疹資格;另有沙門氏菌、A 型肝炎、退伍軍人病與狂犬病。最新為 2026 年 9 月的美洲麻疹通報。
CA.en: Canada has 72 notices in the past two years, dominated by measles (28): over 5,000 cases in 2025 and loss of elimination status in November 2025. Salmonella, hepatitis A, Legionnaires' disease and rabies also appeared. The latest, in September 2026, was an Americas measles update.

CD.zh: 近兩年共 162 則疫情通報,以伊波拉為主,累計確診由2026年6月的956例升至10月初的8,376例、死亡4,042例;另有霍亂、麻疹、小兒麻痺與M痘通報。
CD.en: 162 notices in the past two years, dominated by Ebola: confirmed cases rose from 956 in late June 2026 to 8,376 (4,042 deaths) by 1 October 2026. Cholera, measles, polio and mpox were also reported, including over 114,000 suspected measles cases this year.

CF.zh: 近兩年共 13 則疫情通報,以小兒麻痺(cVDPV2)、腦膜炎、M痘為主,另有黃熱病。最近為 2026 年 7 月通報,當月該國出現 cVDPV2 病例,另有鄰近剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情通報。
CF.en: 13 notices in the past two years, mainly polio (cVDPV2), meningitis and mpox, plus yellow fever. The latest, in July 2026, reported a cVDPV2 case in the Central African Republic, alongside Ebola updates from the neighbouring DRC.

CG.zh: 近兩年共 6 則通報,多為 M 痘、伊波拉、小兒麻痺的區域摘要。2025 年 1 月非洲黃熱病通報中,剛果共和國占 452 例;最新為 2026 年 8 月的小兒麻痺摘要。
CG.en: 6 notices in the past two years, mostly regional digests on mpox, Ebola and polio. A January 2025 African yellow fever update counted 452 cases in the Republic of the Congo. The latest notice, in August 2026, was a polio committee update.

CH.zh: 近兩年共 5 則通報,以 M痘為主,另有退伍軍人病。最近為 2026 年 9 月全球 M痘通報;8 月提及巴塞爾通報 26 例退伍軍人病。
CH.en: 5 notices in the past two years, mostly global mpox updates, plus Legionnaires' disease. The latest, in September 2026, was a global mpox update; in August 2026 Basel was reported to have 26 Legionnaires' disease cases.

CI.zh: 近兩年共 13 則通報,多為小兒麻痺與麻疹的非洲區域摘要。2024 年 10 月象牙海岸麻疹確診 1,287 例、狂犬病 35 例死亡;2025 年 9 月另有 M 痘全球通報。
CI.en: 13 notices in the past two years, mostly African regional digests on polio and measles. In October 2024 Côte d'Ivoire reported 1,287 confirmed measles cases and 35 rabies deaths. The latest notice, in September 2025, was a global mpox update.

CL.zh: 近兩年共 13 則疫情通報,多為美洲區域的麻疹、M痘與新冠通報。2026 年 8 月智利漢他病毒症候群 46 例、18 人死亡,衛生部發布警示;2026 年 10 月世衛認證其消除犬隻傳人狂犬病。
CL.en: 13 notices in the past two years, mostly regional measles, mpox and COVID-19 updates. In August 2026 Chile reported 46 hantavirus syndrome cases and 18 deaths, prompting a health ministry alert. In October 2026 WHO certified Chile as having eliminated dog-mediated human rabies.

CM.zh: 近兩年共 7 則通報,多為小兒麻痺與 M 痘的區域或全球摘要。2025 年 1 月非洲黃熱病通報,剛果共和國占 452 例;最新為 2026 年 8 月的 M 痘與小兒麻痺摘要。
CM.en: 7 notices in the past two years, mostly regional or global digests on polio and mpox, plus a January 2025 African yellow fever update. The latest notices, in August 2026, were a global mpox summary and a polio committee update.

CN.zh: 近兩年共 154 則疫情通報,以新冠、H9N2 等新型A型流感、腸病毒、A型肝炎為主,另有屈公病與梅毒。最近為 2026 年 10 月新冠通報,中國門診陽性率於 9 月已回落。
CN.en: 154 notices in the past two years, mainly COVID-19, novel influenza A (repeated H9N2 cases), enterovirus and hepatitis A, plus chikungunya and syphilis. The latest, in October 2026, was a COVID-19 update; China's outpatient positivity had fallen by late September 2026.

CO.zh: 近兩年共 26 則通報,以黃熱病為主,另有登革熱、M痘與百日咳。2026 年 7 月累計 202 例黃熱病、90 例死亡,多為未接種者;同月南部發生腹瀉群聚。
CO.en: 26 notices in the past two years, dominated by yellow fever, with dengue, mpox and pertussis also reported. As of July 2026 Colombia had 202 yellow fever cases and 90 deaths this year, mostly unvaccinated people; an August 2026 diarrhoea outbreak in Nariño was the latest.

CR.zh: 近兩年共 12 則疫情通報,涵蓋A型肝炎、屈公病、M痘與登革熱。2026年A型肝炎772例,逾2025年全年兩倍;最新為2026年9月A肝通報。
CR.en: 12 notices in the past two years covering hepatitis A, chikungunya, mpox and dengue. Dengue topped 30,000 cases in 2024. Latest, September 2026: 772 hepatitis A cases, over twice 2025's total, plus chikungunya and first mpox cases this year.

CU.zh: 近兩年共 13 則疫情通報,以屈公病與奧羅普切熱為主:2025 年古巴屈公病累計 51,217 例,遍及 15 省;2025 年初奧羅普切熱累計 23,639 例,另有登革熱。最新為 2026 年 3 月屈公病區域通報。
CU.en: Cuba has 13 notices in the past two years, mainly chikungunya and Oropouche fever. Chikungunya reached 51,217 cases in 2025 across all 15 provinces; Oropouche reached 23,639 cases by February 2025, and dengue spread in late 2024. The latest, in March 2026, is a regional chikungunya update.

CV.zh: 近兩年共 6 則疫情通報,包括登革熱與桿菌性痢疾。2025 年 1 月通報維德角一個月內逾 8,000 例登革熱;2026 年 3 月歐洲通報 776 例曾赴維德角的痢疾病例,5 月另有郵輪漢他病毒群聚。
CV.en: 6 notices in the past two years, covering dengue and bacillary dysentery. Cape Verde reported over 8,000 dengue cases in one month in early 2025, and ECDC counted 776 dysentery cases with Cape Verde travel history by March 2026. In May 2026, a cruise ship hantavirus cluster was also reported.

CZ.zh: 近兩年共 17 則通報,以 A 型肝炎為主,2025 年疫情嚴重(逾 2,100 例、26 人死亡),另有百日咳與 M痘。最近為 2026 年 10 月 1 例破傷風,為 2022 年來首例。
CZ.en: 17 notices in the past two years, mostly hepatitis A, with a severe 2025 outbreak (over 2,100 cases and 26 deaths by October), plus pertussis and mpox. The latest, in October 2026, was a tetanus case, the first since 2022.

DE.zh: 近兩年共 44 則疫情通報,沙門氏菌、M痘、腸道出血性大腸桿菌與萊姆病較常見;最新為2026年10月沙門氏菌通報(6月起39例)及9月非旅遊史瘧疾2例。
DE.en: 44 notices in the past two years. Salmonella outbreaks, mpox (first clade Ib case October 2024), EHEC (over 350 cases from August 2025) and Lyme disease (Berlin's highest since 2013) recurred. The latest, October 2026, reported 39 Salmonella cases since June; two malaria cases without travel were noted in September 2026.

DJ.zh: 近兩年共 6 則疫情通報,皆為小兒麻痺全球通報,主要為cVDPV2與巴基斯坦WPV1病例。最新為2026年8月,WHO維持小兒麻痺為國際關注公共衛生緊急事件。
DJ.en: 6 notices in the past two years, all global polio updates covering cVDPV2 and wild poliovirus cases. Latest, August 2026: the WHO polio committee kept polio a public health emergency of international concern.

DK.zh: 近兩年共 11 則通報,以沙門氏菌為主,另有曲狀桿菌、隱孢子蟲、禽流感與 M痘。最近為 2026 年 6 月歐洲九國沙門氏菌群聚;2026 年 2 月丹麥獲世衛認證消除先天性梅毒。
DK.en: 11 notices in the past two years, mostly Salmonella, plus Campylobacter, cryptosporidiosis, avian influenza and mpox. The latest, in June 2026, was a nine-country Salmonella Stanley outbreak; in February 2026 Denmark was certified as having eliminated congenital syphilis.

DO.zh: 近兩年共 6 則疫情通報,涵蓋瘧疾(2024年984例)、鉤端螺旋體病(2025年178例,為前一年2.75倍)、腦膜炎球菌及登革熱;最新為2026年8月M痘群聚。
DO.en: 6 notices in the past two years: malaria rose to 984 cases in 2024, leptospirosis reached 178 cases (2.75 times the prior year) in 2025, and meningococcal disease and dengue were also noted. The latest, August 2026, reported a mpox cluster at a detention centre (2 confirmed, 9 suspected).

DZ.zh: 近兩年共 16 則疫情通報,以小兒麻痺(2025年9月奧蘭省疫苗衍生株病例)與白喉(2024年10月115例、28死亡)為主;最新為2026年8月區域性白喉及小兒麻痺通報。
DZ.en: 16 notices in the past two years, mainly polio and diphtheria. Diphtheria reached 115 cases and 28 deaths by October 2024, and a vaccine-derived polio case was reported in Oran in September 2025. Brucellosis was noted in March 2025. The latest, August 2026, covered African regional diphtheria and polio.

EC.zh: 近兩年共 8 則通報,涉及登革熱、鉤端螺旋體病、黃熱病、百日咳與 M痘。2025 年 6 月鉤端螺旋體病例為前一年同期的 3 倍;最近為 2026 年 5 月全球 M痘通報。
EC.en: 8 notices in the past two years, covering dengue, leptospirosis, yellow fever, pertussis and mpox. Leptospirosis cases in mid-2025 were triple the prior year's; the latest, in May 2026, was a global mpox update.

EE.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2025 年 3 月沙門氏菌:歐洲九國 2023 年至 2025 年 1 月共 509 例,懷疑與義大利苜蓿芽有關。
EE.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in March 2025, a nine-country European Salmonella outbreak with 509 cases from 2023 to January 2025, with Italian alfalfa sprouts suspected.

EG.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報,皆為區域或全球性通報:2025年12月M痘Ib型病例與2026年3月歐洲首例H9N2人類感染(感染地非歐洲);本國無獨立疫情數據。
EG.en: 2 notices in the past two years, both global digests: clade Ib mpox in December 2025 and Europe's first human H9N2 case in March 2026, infected outside Europe. The notices give no country-specific outbreak figures.

ES.zh: 近兩年共 43 則通報,以 M痘(含 Ib 型群聚)、西尼羅熱與麻疹為主,另有漢他病毒與剛果出血熱。最近為 2026 年 9 月歐洲西尼羅熱與美洲麻疹通報。
ES.en: 43 notices in the past two years, led by mpox (including a clade Ib cluster in Mallorca), West Nile fever and measles, plus hantavirus and Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever cases. The latest, in September 2026, were European West Nile and Americas measles updates.

ET.zh: 近兩年共 37 則通報,以疫苗衍生小兒麻痺(17 則)為主,另有麻疹、瘧疾、霍亂。2025 年 11 月起發生首次馬堡病毒疫情,2026 年 1 月宣告結束(19 例、14 死亡)。
ET.en: 37 notices in the past two years, mainly vaccine-derived polio (17), plus measles, malaria and cholera. Ethiopia's first Marburg outbreak began in November 2025 and was declared over in January 2026 with 19 cases and 14 deaths.

FI.zh: 近兩年共 7 則疫情通報,多為歐洲或全球性通報,涵蓋百日咳、沙門氏菌、小兒麻痺病毒污水檢出與新型流感。芬蘭本身最顯著者為 2025 年 8 月 4 例嚴重弧菌感染,以及 2024 年百日咳達近 30 年新高。
FI.en: Finland has 7 notices in the past two years, mostly European or global items on pertussis, Salmonella, polio wastewater detections and novel influenza. Finland-specific events include four severe Vibrio infections in August 2025 and record pertussis (2,215 cases by October 2024) in nearly 30 years.

FJ.zh: 近兩年共 8 則疫情通報,以愛滋病毒感染為主:2025 年新增約 2,000 例,2026 年 9 月宣布全國緊急狀態。另有 2025 年 4 月登革熱逾 5,100 例,超過前一年全年。
FJ.en: Fiji has 8 notices in the past two years, mostly HIV: about 2,000 new infections in 2025, with a national state of emergency declared on 15 September 2026. Dengue also surpassed 5,100 cases in April 2025, above the previous year's total.

FR.zh: 近兩年共 57 則疫情通報,屈公病最多(13 則),2025 年本土病例累計約 700 例;另有 M痘、西尼羅熱、沙門氏菌、李斯特菌與退伍軍人病。2026 年 6 月通報首例境外移入伊波拉,最新為 2026 年 9 月沙門氏菌群聚。
FR.en: France has 57 notices in the past two years, mostly chikungunya (13), with local cases reaching about 700 in 2025. Mpox, West Nile, Salmonella, listeriosis and Legionnaires' disease also recurred. An imported Ebola case was reported in June 2026; the latest is a Salmonella outbreak in September 2026.

GA.zh: 近兩年共 3 則疫情通報,皆為非洲區域性通報,涉及黃熱病與白喉,未見加彭本國的具體病例數。最近為 2025 年 1 月,通報非洲 2024 年黃熱病 1,138 例。
GA.en: 3 notices in the past two years, all regional African updates on yellow fever and diphtheria, with no Gabon-specific case counts. The latest, in January 2025, reported 1,138 yellow fever cases across Africa in 2024.

GB.zh: 近兩年共 69 則疫情通報,以M痘、沙門氏菌感染、麻疹與腦膜炎球菌為主,另有桿菌性痢疾。最新為2026年9月沙門氏菌疫情,確診已達474例、1例死亡,疑與進口雞蛋有關。
GB.en: 69 notices in the past two years, led by mpox, Salmonella, measles and meningococcal disease, with shigellosis also recurring. Latest, September 2026: the largest Salmonella outbreak reached 474 confirmed cases and one death, possibly linked to imported eggs.

GE.zh: 近兩年共 2 則通報。2025 年 6 月提及薩姆茲赫—賈瓦赫季地區 3 例克里米亞剛果出血熱(2 死亡);2026 年 9 月提比利斯幼兒園爆發群聚,逾百人住院並檢出諾羅病毒。
GE.en: 2 notices in the past two years. In June 2025 Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever was reported in Samtskhe–Javakheti, with 3 cases and 2 deaths. In September 2026 Tbilisi had over 100 hospitalised cases across 20 kindergartens, with norovirus detected.

GF.zh: 近兩年共 8 則疫情通報,幾乎都是屈公病:2026 年 1 月出現 2014 年以來首例本土病例,其後快速增加。最近為 2026 年 7 月通報,累計確診 1,157 例、2 人死亡,當局發布警示。
GF.en: 8 notices in the past two years, almost all on chikungunya: the first local case since 2014 appeared in January 2026, followed by rapid growth. The latest, in July 2026, reported 1,157 confirmed cases and 2 deaths this year, with authorities issuing an alert.

GH.zh: 近兩年共 19 則疫情通報,以M痘、傷寒、腦膜炎為主,另有霍亂區域通報。2026 年 3 月通報迦納自 2025 年 5 月起 M痘 1,038 例,且每週病例持續下降;最近為 2026 年 8 月M痘全球通報。
GH.en: 19 notices in the past two years, mainly mpox, typhoid and meningitis, plus regional cholera updates. In March 2026 Ghana reported 1,038 mpox cases and 8 deaths since May 2025, with weekly cases declining. The latest notice, in August 2026, was a global mpox update.

GM.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報,均與 M痘有關。2025 年 7 月甘比亞宣布 M痘疫情,7 月底已有 75 例疑似病例;2025 年 8 月通報鄰國塞內加爾出現首例。
GM.en: The Gambia has 2 notices in the past two years, both on mpox. An outbreak was announced in July 2025, with 75 suspected cases by 30 July. In August 2025 neighbouring Senegal reported its first case.

GN.zh: 近兩年共 25 則疫情通報,以M痘、白喉、拉薩熱為主,另有小兒麻痺與黃熱病。2025 年 8 月幾內亞 M痘確診 381 例且上升;最近為 2026 年 9 月非洲白喉通報。
GN.en: 25 notices in the past two years, mainly mpox, diphtheria and Lassa fever, plus polio and yellow fever. Guinea had 381 confirmed mpox cases and a rising outbreak by August 2025. The most recent notice, in September 2026, was a regional diphtheria update.

GQ.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則通報:2026 年 3 月世衛組織非洲區域通報八國逾 29,000 例白喉疑似病例、1,420 死亡,區域風險降為中度。
GQ.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: in March 2026 WHO's African Region reported over 29,000 suspected diphtheria cases and 1,420 deaths in eight countries, with regional risk lowered to moderate.

GR.zh: 近兩年共 14 則通報,主要為西尼羅熱,每年夏秋反覆出現:2024 年累計 213 例、33 人死亡。最近為 2026 年 8 月,希臘通報 65 例、6 人死亡,另有 2025 年首例 Ib 型 M痘。
GR.en: 14 notices in the past two years, mostly West Nile fever recurring each summer and autumn (213 cases and 33 deaths in 2024). The latest, in August 2026, reported 65 cases and 6 deaths; Greece also had its first clade Ib mpox case in November 2025.

GT.zh: 近兩年共 14 則疫情通報,2026年麻疹急遽上升:5月累計6,209例,9月美洲通報中瓜地馬拉達33,334例;另有屈公病與蠅蛆症。最新為2026年9月。
GT.en: 14 notices in the past two years, with measles dominant in 2026: Guatemala had 6,209 confirmed cases by mid-May and 33,334 by early September, the highest in the Americas. Chikungunya and screwworm myiasis were also noted. The latest notice is from September 2026.

GU.zh: 近兩年共 1 則疫情通報:2026年5月關島自4月起累計15例確診百日咳與1例疑似,並已加強疫苗接種。
GU.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in May 2026 Guam reported 15 confirmed pertussis cases and one suspected case since April, and stepped up vaccination.

GW.zh: 近兩年共 3 則通報,涉及 M痘與小兒麻痺。最近為 2026 年 8 月世衛小兒麻痺委員會通報;7 月幾內亞比索通報首例 M痘確診。
GW.en: 3 notices in the past two years, on mpox and polio. The latest, in August 2026, was a WHO polio committee update on cVDPV2 outbreaks; in July 2026 Guinea-Bissau reported its first confirmed mpox case.

GY.zh: 近兩年共 7 則通報,均為美洲區域性警示,涉及歐洛普切熱、黃熱病與屈公病。最近為 2026 年 3 月加勒比海鄰國通報屈公病,2 月泛美衛生組織曾發布屈公病警示。
GY.en: 7 notices in the past two years, all regional Americas updates on Oropouche fever, yellow fever and chikungunya. The latest, in March 2026, was a chikungunya report from a Caribbean neighbour, following a PAHO chikungunya alert in February.

HK.zh: 近兩年共 96 則疫情通報,以新冠重症監測最多(25 則),另有屈公病、腸病毒、流感、退伍軍人病、麻疹與腦膜炎球菌感染反覆出現。最新為 2026 年 10 月的全球新冠陽性率上升通報,2026 年 8 月亦有 M痘病例。
HK.en: Hong Kong has 96 notices in the past two years, led by COVID-19 monitoring (25), with chikungunya, enterovirus, influenza, Legionnaires' disease, measles and meningococcal disease recurring. Latest: a COVID-19 positivity update in October 2026, and an mpox case in August 2026.

HN.zh: 近兩年共 5 則疫情通報,涵蓋百日咳、麻疹、登革熱。2026年百日咳280例、22人死亡,較去年全年增145.6%;5月通報首例麻疹。最新為2026年10月。
HN.en: 5 notices in the past two years covering pertussis, measles and dengue. Pertussis reached 280 cases and 22 deaths in 2026, up 145.6% on last year's total, and the first measles case came in May 2026. Latest: October 2026 pertussis update.

HU.zh: 近兩年共 10 則疫情通報,以A型肝炎最突出:2025 年 6 月病例為前一年同期的 7 倍。另有先天性梅毒、西尼羅熱與沙門氏菌通報。最近為 2026 年 9 月歐洲M痘通報。
HU.en: 10 notices in the past two years, with hepatitis A the most notable: by June 2025 cases were seven times the previous year's level. Congenital syphilis (63 cases, December 2025), West Nile fever and Salmonella were also covered. The latest notice, in September 2026, was on mpox.

ID.zh: 近兩年共 22 則疫情通報,以登革熱、麻疹為主,另有狂犬病(峇里島)、茲卡、漢他病毒、屈公病。2025年登革熱逾5.6萬例;最新為2026年5月漢他與茲卡通報。
ID.en: 22 notices in the past two years, mainly dengue and measles, plus rabies (Bali), Zika, hantavirus and chikungunya. Dengue exceeded 56,000 cases by May 2025. Latest, May 2026: 23 hantavirus cases since 2024, rising Zika transmission and 706,000 malaria cases in 2025.

IE.zh: 近兩年共 10 則通報,以 M 痘全球摘要為主,另有百日咳、李斯特菌與 COVID-19。2025 年愛爾蘭通報首例 M 痘 Ib 型;2024 年百日咳破紀錄達 539 例;2026 年 9 月為全球 M 痘摘要。
IE.en: 10 notices in the past two years, mostly global mpox updates, plus pertussis, Listeria and COVID-19. Ireland reported its first clade Ib mpox case in February 2025 and a record 539 pertussis cases in 2024. The latest, September 2026, was a global mpox update.

IL.zh: 近兩年共 18 則通報,以麻疹為主(8 則),另有狂犬病、小兒麻痺與 M 痘。2025 年麻疹至 11 月達 1,935 例、9 死亡;2026 年 9 月通報福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎病例。
IL.en: 18 notices in the past two years, mostly measles (8), plus rabies, polio and mpox. Measles reached 1,935 cases and 9 deaths in 2025 by November. The latest notice, in September 2026, reported a child infected with Naegleria fowleri after swimming in the Sea of Galilee.

IN.zh: 近兩年共 87 則疫情通報,立百病毒(2026年1月西孟加拉、6至7月喀拉拉)、傷寒、屈公病與喀拉拉阿米巴腦膜腦炎反覆出現;最新為2026年9月瘧疾下降通報。
IN.en: 87 notices in the past two years. Nipah (West Bengal in January 2026, Kerala in June-July 2026), typhoid, chikungunya and amoebic meningoencephalitis in Kerala recurred. Leptospirosis in Kerala (1,394 cases by August 2026) was also noted; the latest notice, in September 2026, reported falling malaria.

IQ.zh: 近兩年共 7 則疫情通報,全部為剛果出血熱(CCHF)。2024 年全年 211 例、26 人死亡;2025 年 9 月累計 231 例、36 人死亡,以濟加爾省最多,為最近一則通報。
IQ.en: 7 notices in the past two years, all on Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF). Iraq recorded 211 cases and 26 deaths in 2024. By September 2025, the latest notice, it had reported 231 cases and 36 deaths that year, mostly in Dhi Qar Province.

IR.zh: 近兩年共 2 則通報,均為登革熱,且為全球或他國的區域性概況。最近為 2025 年 2 月,內容為菲律賓與巴西登革熱上升。
IR.en: 2 notices in the past two years, both about dengue in global or other-country updates. The latest, in February 2025, covered rising dengue in the Philippines and Brazil.

IS.zh: 近兩年共 1 則疫情通報:2024年11月美國大腸桿菌疫情通報中提及冰島,內容以美國病例為主。
IS.en: 1 notice in the past two years: a November 2024 update on E. coli outbreaks, which mainly described US cases and was tagged to Iceland.

IT.zh: 近兩年共 45 則疫情通報,西尼羅熱最多(11 則),2025 年義大利病例居歐洲之首;另有麻疹、屈公病、沙門氏菌、M痘與 H9N2 流感。最新為 2026 年 10 月沙門氏菌通報,2026 年 9 月曾有白喉死亡病例。
IT.en: Italy has 45 notices in the past two years, led by West Nile fever (11), with Italy leading Europe in 2025. Measles, chikungunya, Salmonella, mpox and H9N2 influenza also appeared. The latest is a Salmonella notice in October 2026; a diphtheria death in Palermo was reported in September 2026.

JM.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2025 年 11 月鉤端螺旋體病:10 月底颶風後有 37 例疑似、9 例確診,6 人死亡。
JM.en: One notice in the past two years: leptospirosis in November 2025, when Jamaica recorded 37 suspected cases (9 confirmed) and 6 deaths after the late-October hurricane.

JO.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2026 年 7 月扎爾卡省一家餐廳發生 138 例原因不明的食源性疾病,28 人仍住院觀察。
JO.en: Jordan has 1 notice in the past two years: in July 2026, Zarqa Governorate reported 138 unexplained foodborne illness cases linked to a single restaurant, with 28 still hospitalized for observation.

JP.zh: 近兩年共 155 則疫情通報,以流感、麻疹、新冠、腸病毒與病毒性腸胃炎反覆出現;2026 年麻疹病例已超過去年全年。最近為 2026 年 10 月德島縣腸胃炎群聚,9 月日本宣布流感流行期。
JP.en: 155 notices in the past two years, with influenza, measles, COVID-19, enterovirus and viral gastroenteritis recurring; 2026 measles cases (511 by June) already exceeded last year's total. The latest, in October 2026, was a Tokushima gastroenteritis cluster, after Japan declared its influenza epidemic period in late August.

KE.zh: 近兩年共 17 則疫情通報,以 M痘最多:2025 年 8 月 24 個郡有 336 例、5 人死亡,之後多為全球 M痘更新。另有炭疽病、不明腹瀉群聚及剛果民主共和國伊波拉風險通報。最新為 2026 年 9 月全球 M痘通報。
KE.en: Kenya has 17 notices in the past two years, mostly mpox: 336 cases and five deaths across 24 counties in August 2025, followed by global mpox updates. Anthrax, an unexplained diarrhoeal illness in Kisii and DRC Ebola risk items also appeared. The latest is a global mpox update in September 2026.

KG.zh: 近兩年共 5 則疫情通報,皆為麻疹:2025年3月4,055例(含8名兒童死亡),6月升至逾7,300例,94%未接種疫苗;最新為2025年7月。
KG.en: 5 notices in the past two years, all on measles. Cases rose from 4,055 (including 8 child deaths) in March 2025 to over 5,100 in April and over 7,300 in June, 94% unvaccinated. The latest notice is from July 2025.

KH.zh: 近兩年共 32 則疫情通報,絕大多數為H5N1人類病例,2025年達15例、多人死亡;2026年7月通報今年第5例。另有登革熱,2025年6.3萬例。
KH.en: 32 notices in the past two years, most on human H5N1 cases: 15 in 2025 with several deaths, and a fifth case of 2026 reported in July 2026. Dengue also appeared, with 63,016 cases and 79 deaths in 2025.

KM.zh: 近兩年共 4 則通報,涉及 M痘與屈公病,多為區域或全球性通報。最近為 2026 年 6 月馬達加斯加 M痘疫情達 3,241 例,鄰近島嶼亦有本土病例。
KM.en: 4 notices in the past two years, on mpox and chikungunya, mostly regional or global updates. The latest, in June 2026, reported Madagascar's mpox outbreak at 3,241 cases, with local cases on nearby islands.

KR.zh: 近兩年共 92 則疫情通報,以新冠、腸病毒、病毒性腸胃炎與流感為主,另有瘧疾、恙蟲病及輸入性麻疹。最新為2026年10月新冠陽性率通報,9月曾發布流感流行警示。
KR.en: 92 notices in the past two years, mainly COVID-19, enterovirus, viral gastroenteritis and influenza, plus malaria, scrub typhus and imported measles. Latest, October 2026: COVID-19 positivity reports; in September 2026 South Korea issued an influenza epidemic alert and reported a first local Japanese encephalitis case.

KW.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則通報:2025 年 9 月世衛組織宣布 M 痘結束國際關注公共衛生緊急事件,但全球風險仍屬中度,該年已逾 42,000 例。
KW.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: in September 2025 WHO ended the mpox PHEIC but still rated global risk as moderate, with over 42,000 cases that year.

KY.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2024 年 12 月的美洲奧羅普切熱區域通報,至 11 月底累計 11,634 例,世衛評估區域風險為高;未見開曼群島本地病例的描述。
KY.en: The Cayman Islands has 1 notice in the past two years: a December 2024 regional update on Oropouche fever, with 11,634 cases in the Americas through 25 November and regional risk rated high. It describes no local cases.

KZ.zh: 近兩年共 11 則疫情通報,以麻疹最突出:2026 年 1 月確診 1,951 例,2 月底累計 3,343 例。另有炭疽病與剛果出血熱。最近為 2026 年 10 月百日咳通報,報告 76 例。
KZ.en: 11 notices in the past two years, with measles the most prominent: 1,951 confirmed cases in January 2026 and 3,343 by late February. Anthrax and CCHF were also reported in 2025. The latest, in October 2026, noted 76 pertussis cases, mostly unvaccinated.

LA.zh: 近兩年共 5 則疫情通報,以小兒麻痺為主。2025 年 12 月寮國確診 1 例 cVDPV1 病例,推測已潛在傳播約三年;最近為 2026 年 8 月全球小兒麻痺通報,另有新冠與登革熱區域通報。
LA.en: 5 notices in the past two years, mainly on polio. In December 2025 Laos confirmed a cVDPV1 case in a 3-year-old, likely circulating for about three years. The latest, in August 2026, was a global polio update; regional COVID-19 and dengue notices were also included.

LB.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2025 年 12 月 M痘:世衛結束緊急事件後,全球通報 43 例 Ib 型病例,內容為跨國概況。
LB.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in December 2025, a multi-country mpox update reporting 43 clade Ib cases globally since WHO ended its emergency designation.

LC.zh: 近兩年共 1 則疫情通報:2026年3月聖露西亞通報自2021年以來首例屈公病,患者住院4天後已完全康復。
LC.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in March 2026 Saint Lucia reported its first chikungunya case since 2021; the patient was hospitalised for four days and has fully recovered.

LK.zh: 近兩年共 18 則疫情通報,以登革熱為主,2026年疫情明顯升溫,8月累計84,724例、62人死亡;另有2025年屈公病逾1.6萬例。最新為2026年8月登革熱通報。
LK.en: 18 notices in the past two years, mostly dengue, which surged in 2026 to 84,724 cases and 62 deaths by August, with about 29,000 in July alone. Chikungunya exceeded 16,500 cases in 2025. Latest: August 2026 dengue report.

LR.zh: 近兩年共 12 則通報,為 M痘與拉薩熱。2025 年 II 型 M痘疫情達 1,451 例;最近為 2026 年 6 月全球 M痘通報,4 月邦縣另有 2 例拉薩熱、1 例死亡。
LR.en: 12 notices in the past two years, covering mpox and Lassa fever. Liberia had a clade II mpox outbreak of 1,451 cases in 2025; the latest, in June 2026, was a global mpox update, after two Lassa fever cases (one fatal) in Bong County in April.

LS.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2025 年 10 月塔巴采卡區通報 8 例炭疽病確診,其中 1 名 6 歲男童死亡。
LS.en: Lesotho has 1 notice in the past two years: in October 2025, Thaba-Tseka district reported eight confirmed anthrax cases, including the death of a six-year-old boy.

LT.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報,均為全球性通報,涉及 2026 年 8 月的全球 M痘累計數據與 2025 年 4 月的新型 A 型流感;立陶宛本身無特定疫情事件。
LT.en: Lithuania has 2 notices in the past two years, both global in scope: a worldwide mpox update in August 2026 and a novel influenza A report in April 2025. Neither describes a specific outbreak within Lithuania.

LU.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2026 年 4 月的全球新冠通報,指出陽性率升至 2.47%,XFG 為主要變異株;未見盧森堡本國的具體病例。
LU.en: One notice in the past two years: a global COVID-19 update in April 2026, with positivity at 2.47% and XFG the leading variant. No Luxembourg-specific cases were reported.

LV.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報:2024年11月百日咳累計2,517例、1例死亡;2026年9月兔熱病17例,全數住院,已超過2025年全年11例。
LV.en: 2 notices in the past two years: pertussis reached 2,517 cases with one death in 2024, and in September 2026 tularaemia hit 17 hospitalised cases, already above the 11 recorded for all of 2025.

MA.zh: 近兩年共 11 則通報,以麻疹與狂犬病為主。2025 年麻疹逾 2.5 萬疑似病例、184 人死亡,後來下降;最近為 2026 年 10 月蘇斯—馬薩地區白喉家戶群聚。
MA.en: 11 notices in the past two years, mainly measles and rabies. A 2025 measles outbreak exceeded 25,000 suspected cases and 184 deaths before declining; the latest, in October 2026, was a diphtheria cluster in the Souss-Massa region.

MD.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則通報:2026 年 7 月基希涅夫一家旅館爆發沙門氏菌群聚,共 59 例、20 人住院,食物來源仍在調查中。
MD.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: in July 2026 a hotel salmonellosis cluster in Chișinău reported 59 cases, 20 of them hospitalised, with the food source still under investigation.

ME.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則通報:2025 年 6 月通報蒙特內哥羅 2 例布氏桿菌病,感染源為農場綿羊,同則並提及墨西哥哈利斯科州疫情。
ME.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: in June 2025 Montenegro reported 2 brucellosis cases traced to farm sheep, alongside an update on Jalisco State, Mexico.

MG.zh: 近兩年共 19 則疫情通報,幾乎都是M痘:2026 年疫情快速上升,為全球最大 Ib 分支疫情。最近為 2026 年 9 月通報,全球 7 月新增 1,370 例,非洲占 74.8%。
MG.en: 19 notices in the past two years, nearly all on mpox: a clade Ib outbreak rose rapidly in 2026 and is described as the world's largest, with over 4,100 cases by July. The latest notice, in September 2026, noted global mpox cases down 12.5% from June.

MK.zh: 近兩年共 1 則疫情通報:2025年5月全球M痘通報中,北馬其頓列為新增首例病例的國家之一。
MK.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in May 2025 a global mpox update listed North Macedonia among countries reporting their first cases.

ML.zh: 近兩年共 14 則疫情通報,以小兒麻痺(cVDPV2)、白喉為主,另有M痘與登革熱。2025年11月通報首例M痘;最新為2026年9月cVDPV2病例通報。
ML.en: 14 notices in the past two years, mostly polio (cVDPV2) and diphtheria, plus mpox and dengue. Mali reported its first mpox case in November 2025. Latest, September 2026: new cVDPV2 polio cases including Mali.

MM.zh: 近兩年共 3 則疫情通報,包括霍亂與瘧疾。2025 年 7 月若開邦瘧疾逾 1,000 例、30 人死亡;最近為 2026 年 8 月仰光霍亂疫情,自 8 月 9 日起逾 500 人因腹瀉住院。
MM.en: 3 notices in the past two years, on cholera and malaria. Rakhine State recorded over 1,000 malaria cases and 30 deaths by July 2025. The latest, in August 2026, reported a cholera outbreak in Yangon, with over 500 diarrhoea hospitalisations since 9 August.

MN.zh: 近兩年共 10 則疫情通報,2025 年麻疹逾 1.3 萬例、10 人死亡;另有鼠疫、炭疽病與腦膜炎。最新為 2026 年 9 月霍布德省在處理旱獺後確診腺鼠疫,2025 年 9 月亦有鼠疫病例。
MN.en: Mongolia has 10 notices in the past two years: a 2025 measles outbreak of over 13,000 cases and 10 deaths, plus plague, anthrax and meningococcal meningitis. The most recent, in September 2026, is a bubonic plague case in Khovd Province linked to marmots; plague was also reported in September 2025.

MO.zh: 近兩年共 6 則通報,以屈公病為主。2025 年 7–8 月受廣東佛山疫情影響,澳門通報 2 例本土病例;2024 年底猩紅熱每週 22 例,當年累計 1,654 例。
MO.en: 6 notices in the past two years, mainly chikungunya. During the Guangdong outbreak in July–August 2025, Macao reported two local cases. In late 2024 scarlet fever reached 22 cases a week, with 1,654 cases for the year. The latest notice was a September 2025 mpox update.

MR.zh: 近兩年共 8 則疫情通報,以白喉與裂谷熱為主。2025年裂谷熱286例、15人死亡;南部白喉74例疑似。最新為2026年8月非洲白喉通報。
MR.en: 8 notices in the past two years, on diphtheria and Rift Valley fever. Mauritania reported 286 Rift Valley fever cases and 15 deaths in 2025, and 74 suspected diphtheria cases in the south. Latest: August 2026 African diphtheria report.

MU.zh: 近兩年共 7 則通報,以屈公病為主。2025 年 4 月通報首例本土病例(2009 年來首次),同年 7 月累計 1,540 例;2026 年 3 月累計 735 例,6 月另有本土 M 痘病例。
MU.en: 7 notices in the past two years, mainly chikungunya. The first local case since 2009 was reported in April 2025 and 1,540 cases by July 2025; 735 cases were confirmed by March 2026. In June 2026 Mauritius also recorded local mpox cases.

MV.zh: 近兩年共 3 則疫情通報,分別為登革熱、流感與麻疹。2025 年 10 月通報登革熱 821 例,低於 2024 年同期;最新為 2026 年 7 月麻疹通報,累計 121 例,最近一週新增 55 例。
MV.en: Maldives has 3 notices in the past two years, on dengue, influenza and measles. Dengue stood at 821 cases by July 2025, below 2024. The latest, in July 2026, reports measles rising to 121 cases, with 55 in the most recent week.

MW.zh: 近兩年共 7 則疫情通報,涵蓋M痘(2025年7月59例確診、無死亡)、霍亂與小兒麻痺;最新為2026年8月瘧疾通報,病例較去年減72%至117萬例。
MW.en: 7 notices in the past two years, covering mpox (59 confirmed cases, no deaths, July 2025), cholera and polio. The latest, August 2026, reported malaria falling 72% year on year to 1.17 million cases and 555 deaths through June.

MX.zh: 近兩年共 51 則通報,以麻疹為主(31 則),另有百日咳、登革熱與狂犬病。麻疹自 2025 年起擴大,2026 年 6 月累計 18,440 例、43 死亡;2026 年 9 月仍有通報。
MX.en: 51 notices in the past two years, dominated by measles (31), with pertussis, dengue and rabies also reported. The measles outbreak grew from 2025, reaching 18,440 cases and 43 deaths by June 2026, and notices continued into September 2026.

MY.zh: 近兩年共 18 則疫情通報,登革熱與砂拉越狂犬病最突出:2026 年 8 月登革熱已逾 5.5 萬例,超過 2025 全年。另有腸病毒、新冠與流感。最新為 2026 年 10 月吉打州狂犬病死亡通報。
MY.en: Malaysia has 18 notices in the past two years, mainly dengue and rabies in Sarawak. By August 2026 dengue passed 55,000 cases, above 2025's full-year total. Enterovirus, COVID-19 and influenza also appeared. The latest, in October 2026, is a rabies death in Kedah.

MZ.zh: 近兩年共 7 則疫情通報,以霍亂為主(2026年全球通報點名莫三比克為新增病例集中地之一),另有2025年M痘13例。最新為2026年8月麻疹通報。
MZ.en: 7 notices in the past two years, mainly cholera, with Mozambique named among countries with concentrated new cases in early 2026, plus 13 mpox cases in 2025. Latest: August 2026 report on measles in the DRC.

NA.zh: 近兩年共 8 則疫情通報,以瘧疾為主:2025 年 7 月已有近 9 萬例、146 人死亡,2026 年 1 至 3 月約 2.8 萬例。另有 2025 年 12 月污水檢出疫苗衍生 2 型小兒麻痺病毒及剛果出血熱死亡。
NA.en: Namibia has 8 notices in the past two years, mainly malaria: nearly 90,000 cases and 146 deaths by July 2025, and about 28,000 cases in early 2026. Other items include vaccine-derived poliovirus detected in wastewater in December 2025 and a Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever death.

NC.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報:2026年3月登革熱432例,為2019年來首次大規模疫情,以第1型為主;另有2024年11月百日咳全球通報。
NC.en: 2 notices in the past two years. Latest, March 2026: 432 dengue cases, the first major outbreak since 2019, mostly DENV-1. A November 2024 global pertussis update also named it.

NE.zh: 近兩年共 21 則疫情通報,以白喉、腦膜炎與小兒麻痺症反覆出現;2025 年 2 月指尼日自 2022 年累計逾 4.1 萬例疑似白喉。2026 年 3 月腦膜炎達流行閾值,最新為 2026 年 10 月腦膜炎帶通報。
NE.en: Niger has 21 notices in the past two years, with diphtheria, meningitis and polio recurring. A February 2025 notice cited over 41,000 suspected diphtheria cases since 2022, and meningitis reached the epidemic threshold in March 2026. The latest is a meningitis belt update in October 2026.

NG.zh: 近兩年共 94 則通報,以小兒麻痺(疫苗衍生株)、拉薩熱、白喉為主,另有霍亂與腦膜炎。2026 年拉薩熱至第 36 週達 1,086 例、259 死亡;2026 年 9 月白喉疑似病例逾 1.2 萬例。
NG.en: 94 notices in the past two years, mainly polio (vaccine-derived strains), Lassa fever and diphtheria, plus cholera and meningitis. Lassa fever reached 1,086 cases and 259 deaths by week 36 of 2026, and in September 2026 diphtheria stood at 12,155 suspected cases.

NI.zh: 近兩年共 2 則通報,皆為區域性摘要:2025 年 5 月中南美洲人類蠅蛆症增加,2025 年 8 月日本通報球黴菌症輸入病例;均未載明尼加拉瓜本地病例數。
NI.en: 2 notices in the past two years, both regional: rising human screwworm myiasis in Central and South America (May 2025) and Japan's imported coccidioidomycosis cases (August 2025). Neither gives case counts specific to Nicaragua.

NL.zh: 近兩年共 22 則疫情通報,涵蓋M痘(2025年11月起Ib型本土病例)、沙門氏菌、麻疹與西尼羅熱;最新為2026年9月歐洲沙門氏菌及西尼羅熱通報。
NL.en: 22 notices in the past two years. Mpox (clade Ib cases without travel history from November 2025), Salmonella, measles and listeriosis were reported, plus a cruise-ship hantavirus cluster in May-June 2026 (13 cases, three deaths). The latest, September 2026, covered Europe-wide Salmonella and West Nile fever.

NO.zh: 近兩年共 9 則疫情通報,以沙門氏菌(2024年12月起與苜蓿芽相關)為主,另有A型肝炎群聚(2025年8月22例)與耶氏菌;最新為2026年7月。
NO.en: 9 notices in the past two years, mainly Salmonella linked to alfalfa sprouts (49 cases from October 2024). A hepatitis A cluster at an Oslo restaurant reached 22 cases in August 2025. The latest, July 2026, reported 15 Yersinia enterocolitica cases, plus a mpox global update.

NP.zh: 近兩年共 21 則通報,以日本腦炎(7 則)與登革熱為主。2025 年日本腦炎死亡 31 人,為十年最多;2026 年 10 月恙蟲病今年累計 9,923 例,9 月就有 2,746 例。
NP.en: 21 notices in the past two years, mainly Japanese encephalitis (7) and dengue. Japanese encephalitis deaths hit 31 in 2025, the most in ten years. In October 2026 scrub typhus totalled 9,923 cases for the year, 2,746 of them in September alone.

NR.zh: 近兩年共 1 則疫情通報:2025年8月諾魯通報今年登革熱379例,其中77%為18歲以下。
NR.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in August 2025 Nauru reported 379 dengue cases for the year, 77% of them aged 18 or under.

NZ.zh: 近兩年共 9 則疫情通報,涵蓋流感、麻疹、百日咳與新冠。2024年底百日咳1,490例,遠高於2023年141例;最新為2026年8月流感住院數上升。
NZ.en: 9 notices in the past two years covering influenza, measles, pertussis and COVID-19. Pertussis reached 1,490 cases in 2024 versus 141 in 2023. Latest, August 2026: influenza rising, with 177 severe hospitalisations in one week.

OM.zh: 近兩年共 2 則通報,均為 M痘。2024 年 12 月阿曼通報自阿聯酋輸入的首例 M痘;最近為 2025 年 9 月世衛結束 M痘國際關注公衛緊急事件。
OM.en: 2 notices in the past two years, both on mpox. In December 2024 Oman reported its first mpox case, imported from the UAE; the latest, in September 2025, noted that WHO had ended the mpox emergency designation.

PA.zh: 近兩年共 12 則疫情通報,以奧羅普切熱(2025年10月逾600例,集中達連省)與登革熱為主,另有瘧疾死亡通報;最新為2026年3月登革熱(1至2月1,232例)。
PA.en: 12 notices in the past two years, mostly Oropouche fever (over 600 cases by October 2025, concentrated in Darién) and dengue (6,458 cases by mid-2025). Malaria deaths were noted in May 2025. The latest, March 2026, reported 1,232 dengue cases and 4 deaths in January-February.

PE.zh: 近兩年共 25 則通報,反覆出現麻疹、黃熱病與登革熱。2026 年 5 月祕魯因普諾地區麻疹宣布衛生緊急狀態,9 月累計 2,438 例;2025 年登革熱 39,028 例、54 死亡。
PE.en: 25 notices in the past two years, with measles, yellow fever and dengue recurring. Peru declared a health emergency over measles in Puno in May 2026, and cases reached 2,438 by September 2026; 2025 saw 39,028 dengue cases and 54 deaths.

PF.zh: 近兩年共 3 則疫情通報,涵蓋鉤端螺旋體病(2024年153例)、百日咳與沙門氏菌感染。最新為2026年5月第17週22例沙門氏菌感染。
PF.en: 3 notices in the past two years, on leptospirosis (153 cases in 2024), pertussis and Salmonella. Latest, May 2026: 22 Salmonella cases in week 17, mostly from communal raw food at one venue.

PG.zh: 近兩年共 8 則疫情通報,主要為小兒麻痺:2025年8月萊城出現疫苗衍生2型病例,環境檢出自4月起;其餘為區域性通報。最新為2026年8月麻疹。
PG.en: 8 notices in the past two years, mainly polio: a vaccine-derived type 2 case was reported in Lae in August 2025, with environmental detections since April. Others were global digests (HIV, measles). The latest, August 2026, was a measles update for the Americas that mentioned the country only in passing.

PH.zh: 近兩年共 51 則通報,反覆出現登革熱、鉤端螺旋體病、麻疹、屈公病與 M 痘。2026 年 9 月鉤端螺旋體病累計 6,253 例、378 死亡,較前一年低 12%;屈公病較同期增 36%。
PH.en: 51 notices in the past two years, with dengue, leptospirosis, measles, chikungunya and mpox recurring. In September 2026 leptospirosis totalled 6,253 cases and 378 deaths, 12% below last year, while chikungunya ran 36% above the same period last year.

PK.zh: 近兩年共 67 則疫情通報,逾半為小兒麻痺(野生株WPV1病例與環境檢出持續),另有屈公病、M痘、剛果出血熱與腦膜腦炎;最新為2026年9月小兒麻痺通報。
PK.en: 67 notices in the past two years, more than half on polio, with wild poliovirus type 1 cases and environmental detections recurring. Chikungunya, mpox (first cases reported in December 2024 and February 2025), Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever and Naegleria infections were also reported. The latest notice, September 2026, again covered polio.

PL.zh: 近兩年共 13 則通報,多為區域性小兒麻痺、新型 A 型流感與麻疹摘要。2025 年 7 月西波美拉尼亞省出現 2019 年來首例本土霍亂;另曾於汙水中檢出 cVDPV2。
PL.en: 13 notices in the past two years, mostly regional digests on polio, novel influenza A and measles. In July 2025 Poland reported its first locally acquired cholera case since 2019, and cVDPV2 was detected in its wastewater.

PT.zh: 近兩年共 9 則通報,其中 8 則為 M 痘全球摘要。2025 年 6 月通報葡萄牙 A 型肝炎疫情累計 504 例;最新為 2026 年 9 月的全球 M 痘摘要。
PT.en: 9 notices in the past two years, eight of them global mpox updates. In June 2025 a hepatitis A outbreak in Portugal had reached 504 cumulative cases. The latest notice, in September 2026, was a global mpox summary.

PY.zh: 近兩年共 10 則疫情通報,以登革熱與屈公病為主,另有百日咳。2025 年 5 月巴拉圭登革熱 16,033 例,DENV-3 社區傳播;多數通報為區域性,最近為 2025 年 9 月。
PY.en: 10 notices in the past two years, mainly dengue and chikungunya, plus pertussis. By May 2025 Paraguay had 16,033 dengue cases with DENV-3 spreading in the community. Most notices were regional or global; the latest, in September 2025, concerned chikungunya.

QA.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2026 年 8 月的全球M痘通報,指出全球累計 188,847 例確診、521 人死亡,馬達加斯加為最大 Ib 型疫情;未見卡達本國的具體病例。
QA.en: One notice in the past two years: a global mpox update in August 2026, reporting 188,847 confirmed cases and 521 deaths since 2022, with Madagascar hosting the largest clade Ib outbreak. No Qatar-specific cases were reported.

RE.zh: 近兩年共 19 則疫情通報,以屈公病為主,2025年累計逾5.2萬例、15例死亡,3月底達高峰後下降;2026年轉為M痘,最新為同年8月鉤端螺旋體病通報。
RE.en: 19 notices in the past two years, mostly chikungunya: Réunion reported about 52,000 cases and 15 deaths in 2025, peaking in week 13 then falling. Mpox local cases were noted in June 2026. The latest notice, August 2026, concerned leptospirosis in India and mentioned Réunion only in passing.

RO.zh: 近兩年共 12 則疫情通報,主要為歐洲麻疹與西尼羅熱的區域性通報,羅馬尼亞曾占歐盟2024年麻疹病例87%;另有2025年7月狂犬病死亡。最新為2026年4月麻疹通報。
RO.en: 12 notices in the past two years, mostly European regional reports on measles and West Nile fever. Romania accounted for 87% of EU measles cases in 2024, and a rabies death was reported in July 2025. Latest: April 2026 measles report.

RS.zh: 近兩年共 2 則通報。2025 年 9 月為義大利西尼羅熱疫情報導,提及歐洲多國有本土傳播;2026 年 7 月塞爾維亞拉斯卡區通報綿羊痘,疑與走私有關。
RS.en: 2 notices in the past two years. A September 2025 West Nile fever update noted local transmission in several European countries. In July 2026 Serbia reported sheep pox in Raška District, with illegal smuggling from Kosovo suspected.

RU.zh: 近兩年共 8 則通報,涉及漢他病毒(2025 年逾 3,300 例)、腸病毒、狂犬病與腸胃炎群聚。最近為 2026 年 10 月伊爾庫茨克 1 例疑似肺鼠疫死亡,約 200 名接觸者受隔離。
RU.en: 8 notices in the past two years, covering hantavirus (over 3,300 cases in 2025), enterovirus, rabies and gastroenteritis clusters. The latest, in October 2026, was a suspected pneumonic plague death in Irkutsk, with about 200 close contacts quarantined.

RW.zh: 近兩年共 11 則疫情通報,2024 年 10 至 12 月馬堡病毒疫情累計 66 例、15 人死亡,近八成為醫護人員,12 月 20 日宣布結束。2026 年 5 至 6 月另有剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情的區域通報。
RW.en: Rwanda has 11 notices in the past two years. A Marburg outbreak from October to December 2024 caused 66 cases and 15 deaths, nearly 80% among healthcare workers, and was declared over on 20 December 2024. Four notices in May–June 2026 concern the DRC Ebola outbreak.

SA.zh: 近兩年共 4 則疫情通報,以中東呼吸症候群(MERS)為主。2025 年全球 19 例中 17 例在沙烏地阿拉伯;2026 年 6 月通報該國至 4 月有 2 例(1 例死亡)。另有 2025 年朝覲相關腦膜炎通報。
SA.en: 4 notices in the past two years, mainly MERS. Of 19 MERS cases reported worldwide in 2025, 17 were in Saudi Arabia. In June 2026 two cases through April were reported, one fatal. A March 2025 notice also covered 11 meningococcal W135 cases linked to Hajj visitors.

SD.zh: 近兩年共 16 則疫情通報,涵蓋霍亂、小兒麻痺(cVDPV2)、登革熱、白喉。霍亂逾12萬例,2026年3月宣布結束。最新為2026年5月南達佛爾M痘疑似疫情。
SD.en: 16 notices in the past two years covering cholera, polio (cVDPV2), dengue and diphtheria. A cholera outbreak of over 120,000 cases was declared over in March 2026. Latest, May 2026: a suspected mpox outbreak in South Darfur with 347 cases.

SE.zh: 近兩年共 10 則疫情通報,以沙門氏菌(2024年1,612例,近14年最高)與李斯特菌症為主,另有蜱媒腦炎、M痘。最新為2026年8月麻疹通報。
SE.en: 10 notices in the past two years, mainly Salmonella (1,612 cases in 2024, the highest in nearly 14 years) and listeriosis (record 158 cases last year), plus tick-borne encephalitis and mpox. Latest: August 2026 measles reports.

SG.zh: 近兩年共 30 則疫情通報,以腸病毒為主(2025年5月曾達日均61例),另有新冠、M痘與麻疹;最新為2026年6月新冠陽性率下降通報。
SG.en: 30 notices in the past two years, mostly enterovirus: daily cases peaked at 61 in May 2025 and were about 15-18 a day in early 2026. COVID-19 waves, mpox (first local clade Ib cases, April 2026), measles and Zika were also reported. The latest, June 2026, noted COVID-19 positivity declining.

SI.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2025年12月中歐四國(含斯洛維尼亞)A型肝炎今年至10月逾6,000例,41至80%住院。
SI.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: in December 2025, hepatitis A in four central European countries including Slovenia exceeded 6,000 cases to October, with 41-80% hospitalised.

SK.zh: 近兩年共 4 則疫情通報,包括 A 型肝炎、福氏內格里阿米巴腦膜腦炎與 M痘。2025 年 10 月科馬爾諾 8 至 9 月出現 140 例 A 型肝炎;2025 年 6 月一名 11 歲男童感染死亡。
SK.en: Slovakia has 4 notices in the past two years, on hepatitis A, Naegleria fowleri infection and mpox. Komárno reported 140 hepatitis A cases in August–September 2025, and an 11-year-old boy died of Naegleria infection in June 2025. The latest, in June 2026, is a global mpox update.

SL.zh: 近兩年共 10 則疫情通報,皆為M痘:2025年1月宣布公衛緊急狀態後,5月單週新增611例,8月累計達5,072例、47例死亡;最新為2025年10月。
SL.en: 10 notices in the past two years, all on mpox. After a public health emergency in January 2025, cases surged to 611 in one week in May and 5,072 confirmed cases with 47 deaths by August 2025. The latest notice is from October 2025.

SN.zh: 近兩年共 24 則疫情通報,2025 年 9 月起裂谷熱疫情至 12 月累計 546 例確診、31 例死亡;另有剛果出血熱、M痘首例、屈公病與白喉。最新為 2026 年 10 月腦膜炎帶及 9 月白喉(57 例、8 死亡)通報。
SN.en: Senegal has 24 notices in the past two years. A Rift Valley fever outbreak from September 2025 reached 546 confirmed cases and 31 deaths by December. Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, a first mpox case and diphtheria also featured. Latest: September 2026, 57 diphtheria cases and 8 deaths.

SO.zh: 近兩年共 17 則通報,以疫苗衍生小兒麻痺與白喉為主。2025 年白喉逾 1,600 例、87 死亡,為前一年總數兩倍;2026 年 8 月仍有 cVDPV2 小兒麻痺病例通報。
SO.en: 17 notices in the past two years, mainly vaccine-derived polio and diphtheria. Diphtheria passed 1,600 cases and 87 deaths in 2025, twice the previous year's total. The latest notice, in August 2026, again reported a cVDPV2 polio case.

SR.zh: 近兩年共 6 則疫情通報,皆為屈公病。2026 年 3 月蘇利南累計逾 1,357 例檢驗陽性、1 人死亡,1 月即有 137 例;泛美衛生組織於 2026 年 2 月發布美洲屈公病警示。
SR.en: Suriname has 6 notices in the past two years, all about chikungunya. By March 2026 it had more than 1,357 test-positive cases and one death, with 137 cases in January alone. PAHO issued an Americas-wide chikungunya alert in February 2026.

SS.zh: 近兩年共 38 則疫情通報,以霍亂與小兒麻痺症反覆出現最多,另有 M痘、炭疽病、瘧疾及伊波拉風險通報。最新為 2026 年 10 月全球霍亂通報;2026 年 7 月曾有美國將南蘇丹納入入境限制的伊波拉通報。
SS.en: South Sudan has 38 notices in the past two years, mostly recurring cholera and polio reports, plus mpox, anthrax, malaria and Ebola-related items. The latest is a global cholera update in October 2026; in July 2026 US entry restrictions covering South Sudan were noted amid the DRC Ebola outbreak.

SV.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2025年5月中南美洲蠅蛆症病例增加的區域性通報,未提供薩爾瓦多本國病例數。
SV.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: a regional update in May 2025 on rising human screwworm myiasis in Central and South America, with no El Salvador case figures given.

SY.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報,分別為麻疹與 A 型肝炎。2026 年 10 月通報敘利亞麻疹病例 765 例;2026 年 5 月南部德拉省於 4 月下旬兩週內確診 109 例 A 型肝炎,疑為水源污染。
SY.en: Syria has 2 notices in the past two years, on measles and hepatitis A. The latest, in October 2026, cites 765 measles cases this year. In May 2026, Daraa reported 109 confirmed hepatitis A cases in two weeks of April, mostly children, with suspected water contamination.

SZ.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2025 年 7 月瘧疾:辛巴威病例暴增,並指出鄰近國家也在上升;未見史瓦帝尼本國的具體病例數。
SZ.en: One notice in the past two years: malaria in July 2025, reporting a surge in Zimbabwe with neighbouring countries also rising. No Eswatini-specific case counts were given.

TD.zh: 近兩年共 39 則疫情通報,多為小兒麻痺(疫苗衍生株 cVDPV2)病例,另有白喉、腦膜炎與霍亂。最近為 2026 年 10 月的小兒麻痺通報,其中 2025 年 9 月曾通報查德東部難民營霍亂。
TD.en: 39 notices in the past two years, mostly polio (repeated cVDPV2 cases), plus diphtheria, meningitis and cholera. Chad reported 1,631 cholera cases in eastern refugee camps in September 2025, and the meningitis epidemic threshold was reached by March 2026. The latest notice, in October 2026, concerned polio.

TG.zh: 近兩年共 7 則疫情通報,包括2025年5月首例M痘、2025至2026年腦膜炎區域通報及2026年3至4月疫苗衍生2型小兒麻痺2例;最新為2026年4月。
TG.en: 7 notices in the past two years: the first mpox case in May 2025, regional meningitis updates (April 2025 and March 2026) and polio. The latest, April 2026, reported two vaccine-derived type 2 polio cases in Togo.

TH.zh: 近兩年共 73 則疫情通報,反覆出現腸病毒、流感、登革熱、M痘、類鼻疽與狂犬病,另有炭疽病個案。最近為 2026 年 9 月腸病毒與 SFTS 通報,腸病毒年累計逾 6.5 萬例。
TH.en: 73 notices in the past two years, with recurring enterovirus, influenza, dengue, mpox, melioidosis and rabies, plus anthrax cases. In September 2026 Thailand reported over 65,000 enterovirus cases this year and listed SFTS as a notifiable disease after 3 cases.

TJ.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2025 年 7 月塔吉克通報該年已有 41 例炭疽病,與牲畜食用受污染乾草有關。
TJ.en: Tajikistan has 1 notice in the past two years: in July 2025 it reported 41 anthrax cases for the year, linked to livestock eating contaminated hay.

TN.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2025 年 1 月狂犬病:摩洛哥、突尼西亞與印度均有動物咬傷後死亡的病例通報。
TN.en: One notice in the past two years: rabies in January 2025, when Morocco, Tunisia and India reported deaths following animal bites.

TO.zh: 近兩年共 3 則通報,皆為登革熱。2025 年 5 月東加累計 625 例、3 死亡;2026 年 5 月通報東加確診 56 例,鄰近薩摩亞疫情較大。
TO.en: 3 notices in the past two years, all on dengue. Tonga had 625 cases and 3 deaths by May 2025. The latest notice, in May 2026, reported 56 confirmed cases in Tonga, while neighbouring Samoa had a larger outbreak.

TR.zh: 近兩年共 2 則疫情通報,皆為M痘。2025 年 7 月通報土耳其出現一例追溯確認的 Ia 型病例;最近為 2025 年 9 月全球M痘通報,84 國累計逾 37,000 例。
TR.en: 2 notices in the past two years, both on mpox. In July 2025 Türkiye reported a retrospective clade Ia case. The latest, in September 2025, was a global update with over 37,000 cases in 84 countries this year.

TZ.zh: 近兩年共 11 則通報,多為伊波拉、馬堡與小兒麻痺的區域通報。2025 年 1–2 月卡蓋拉地區出現馬堡病毒疫情(2 例確診);2026 年 5–6 月為剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情通報。
TZ.en: 11 notices in the past two years, mostly regional alerts on Ebola, Marburg and polio. Tanzania's Kagera region had a Marburg outbreak in January–February 2025 with two confirmed cases. The latest notices, May–June 2026, concerned the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

UA.zh: 近兩年共 8 則通報,涵蓋麻疹、A 型肝炎、結核病、狂犬病等。2025 年上半年麻疹 472 例、較前一年增 20.5 倍;2026 年 9 月通報 1 例 M 痘 Ib 型,7 月有漢他病毒病例。
UA.en: 8 notices in the past two years, covering measles, hepatitis A, tuberculosis and rabies. Measles reached 472 cases in early 2025, a 20.5-fold rise. In July 2026 a hantavirus case was reported in Lviv, and in September 2026 one clade Ib mpox case.

UG.zh: 近兩年共 66 則通報,以伊波拉為主(2025 年蘇丹型、2026 年本迪布焦型),另有 M痘與炭疽。2026 年 8 月世衛宣布烏干達伊波拉疫情結束,累計 20 例確診、2 例死亡。
UG.en: 66 notices in the past two years, dominated by Ebola (Sudan virus in early 2025, a Bundibugyo outbreak in 2026), with mpox and anthrax also recurring. In August 2026 WHO declared Uganda's Ebola outbreak over, after 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths.

US.zh: 近兩年共 315 則疫情通報,以麻疹最常見,2026年累計病例已高於去年全年;另有退伍軍人病(紐約市)、西尼羅熱、環孢子蟲症。最新為2026年10月腮腺炎與西尼羅熱通報。
US.en: 315 notices in the past two years, with measles most frequent: 2026 cases have already passed last year's full-year total. Legionnaires' disease (New York City), West Nile fever and a record cyclosporiasis outbreak also recurred. Latest, October 2026: mumps at a university and 987 West Nile cases.

UY.zh: 近兩年共 4 則通報,多為美洲區域摘要。2025 年 4 月烏拉圭通報 2 例本土登革熱;最新為 2026 年 2 月的美洲麻疹摘要,另有歐洛普什熱與 COVID-19 全球通報。
UY.en: 4 notices in the past two years, mostly Americas-wide digests. Uruguay recorded two local dengue cases in April 2025. The latest, in February 2026, was a regional measles update; the others covered Oropouche fever and global COVID-19.

UZ.zh: 近兩年共 3 則通報,皆為麻疹,且為 2025 年 5 至 8 月的跨國通報;最近為 2025 年 8 月,蒙古麻疹逾 1.3 萬例,韓國病例多為境外移入。
UZ.en: 3 notices in the past two years, all measles-related multi-country updates from May to August 2025. The latest, in August 2025, noted over 13,000 measles cases in Mongolia and mostly imported cases in South Korea.

VE.zh: 近兩年共 7 則疫情通報,包括黃熱病、歐羅普切熱與不明原因疾病。2026 年 3 月通報 14 州共 36 例黃熱病確診;最近為 2026 年 7 月,不明疾病至少 6 人死亡,且 6 月地震後世衛警告傳染病風險升高。
VE.en: 7 notices in the past two years, covering yellow fever, Oropouche fever and unexplained illness. In March 2026, 36 confirmed yellow fever cases were reported across 14 states. In July 2026 an unexplained illness caused at least 6 deaths, and WHO warned of rising risks after a June earthquake.

VN.zh: 近兩年共 73 則通報,以腸病毒、麻疹與登革熱為主,另有狂犬病、腦膜炎。2026 年腸病毒與登革熱病例均高於去年;最近為 2026 年 9 月胡志明市登革熱逾 3.4 萬例。
VN.en: 73 notices in the past two years, mainly enterovirus, measles and dengue, plus rabies and meningococcal disease. Enterovirus and dengue ran well above last year in 2026; the latest, in September 2026, reported over 34,000 dengue cases in Ho Chi Minh City.

VU.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報:2025年8月塔納島百日咳37例疑似,含3名嬰兒死亡。
VU.en: Only 1 notice in the past two years: in August 2025, 37 suspected pertussis cases on Tanna Island, including three infant deaths.

WF.zh: 近兩年僅 1 則疫情通報,為 2026 年 4 月登革熱:富圖納島確診 1 例本土病例,與香港首例本土登革熱同時通報。
WF.en: 1 notice in the past two years: in April 2026, Futuna Island confirmed a local dengue case, reported alongside Hong Kong's first local dengue case of the year.

WS.zh: 近兩年共 6 則通報,全為登革熱。2025 年 5 月宣布疫情,2026 年 2 月累計 16,842 例、8 人死亡;最近為 2026 年 5 月單週 159 例,2025 年以來確診 5,386 例。
WS.en: 6 notices in the past two years, all about dengue. An outbreak was announced in May 2025 and had reached 16,842 cases and 8 deaths by February 2026; the latest, in May 2026, reported 159 cases in one week.

YE.zh: 近兩年共 28 則疫情通報,以小兒麻痺(cVDPV2)、霍亂、麻疹為主,另有狂犬病、瘧疾、登革熱、百日咳。最新為2026年10月全球霍亂通報,9月巴伊達超過1,000例疑似霍亂。
YE.en: 28 notices in the past two years, mostly polio (cVDPV2), cholera and measles, plus rabies, malaria, dengue and pertussis. Latest, October 2026: a global cholera report; in September 2026 Al-Bayda reported over 1,000 suspected cholera cases.

YT.zh: 近兩年共 12 則疫情通報,2025年屈公病(5月起出現本土傳播)後,2026年瘧疾上升(7月已244例)及M痘(7月底43例);最新為2026年8月M痘通報。
YT.en: 12 notices in the past two years. Chikungunya appeared in 2025, with local transmission from May. In 2026 malaria rose (244 confirmed cases by July, above last year's full total) and mpox reached 43 cases by late July, mostly linked to Madagascar. The latest notice is from August 2026.

ZA.zh: 近兩年共 17 則通報,涉及白喉、M痘、麻疹、狂犬病與瘧疾。2026 年 8 月麻疹已逾 3,800 例;2025 年 3 月出現首批 Ib 型 M痘,最近為 2026 年 9 月流感通報。
ZA.en: 17 notices in the past two years, covering diphtheria, mpox, measles, rabies and malaria. South Africa had 3,891 measles cases by mid-August 2026, and first clade Ib mpox cases in March 2025; the latest, in September 2026, noted influenza positivity of 9%.

ZM.zh: 近兩年共 8 則通報,涉及炭疽、麻疹、伊波拉、霍亂與 M痘。最近為 2026 年 10 月通報尚比亞炭疽 21 例確診;7 月麻疹疫情達 119 例確診。
ZM.en: 8 notices in the past two years, covering anthrax, measles, Ebola, cholera and mpox. The latest, in October 2026, reported 21 confirmed anthrax cases in Zambia; a measles outbreak had reached 119 confirmed cases by July 2026.

ZW.zh: 近兩年共 5 則疫情通報,涵蓋瘧疾、霍亂、M痘與腸病毒。2025年瘧疾126,229例、較前年增296.8%;最新為2025年11月哈拉雷腸病毒575例。
ZW.en: 5 notices in the past two years covering malaria, cholera, mpox and enterovirus. Malaria reached 126,229 cases in 2025, up 296.8%, with 358 deaths. Latest, November 2025: Harare reported 575 enterovirus cases, 90% under age 5.
